14-15As the material for protecting the tent, goat hair was used to weave eleven sections 13 meters by 2 meters each. 16These eleven sections were joined to make two panels, one with five and the other with six sections. 17Fifty loops were put along one of the wider sides of each panel, 18and the two panels were fastened at the loops with 50 bronze hooks. 19Two other coverings were made—one with fine leather and the other with ram skins dyed red.
The Framework for the Sacred Tent
(Exodus 26.15-30)
20Acacia wood was used to build the framework for the walls of the sacred tent. 21Each frame was 4 meters high and 66 centimeters wide 22-26with two wooden pegs near the bottom. Then two silver stands were placed under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so they could be joined together. Twenty of these frames were used along the south side and 20 more along the north. 27Six frames were used for the back wall along the west side 28-29with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. These corner frames were joined from top to bottom. 30Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.
31-33Five crossbars were made for each of the wooden frames, with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall. 34The frames and crossbars were covered with gold, and gold rings were attached to the frames to run the crossbars through.
The Inside Curtain for the Sacred Tent
(Exodus 26.31-37)
35They made the inside curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. 36They also made four acacia wood posts and covered them with gold. Then gold rings were fastened to the posts, which were set on silver stands.
37For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework. 38They made five posts, covered them completely with gold, and set each of them on a gold-covered bronze stand. Finally, they attached hooks for the curtain.
translation_text:
1Ko ná ye Bezaleli de Oholiaba dedaane gwaro telo maama Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba swa dedaane yi-poro se ba taa wae ba ke wara-jei sem de se zela yam maama to, banto jege se ba yɔɔre ba toŋe se ko tɔge kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ na bere tei to mo.”
2Moses déem ma bwoŋi Bezaleli de Oholiaba dedaane gwaro telo maama Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba dam ye ba boboŋa ja se ba toŋe to se ba ba. O laam ma ta-ba se ba bobo totoŋa yam. 3Ba de maa jwoŋi pɛɛra yalo maama nɔɔna bam na pɛ se ba maa ke wara-jei sem to Moses jeŋa ne. Se ko ná ye nɔɔna bam, ba ta yɔɔre ba jaane wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra mo ba tui Moses tei dɛ maama zezeŋa ne, ye ya laam tiini ya gaale. 4Tontoŋena bam laam ma yage wara-jei sem totoŋa ye ba vo Moses tei ba we, 5“Pɛɛra yalo nɔɔna bam na jaane ba ba totoŋa yam ŋwaane to daga ya dwoi totoŋe delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ debam ni se dé toŋe to.”
6Moses ma toŋe kwora se ka yi nɔɔna bam maama se ba daa yé ja pɛɛra ba ba wara-jei sem totoŋa yam ŋwaane. Ba ma seene ba yage. 7Kokuri to, ba na maŋe ba pa tei to yi se ko toŋe totoŋa yam se ya ti.
Wara-jei sem
8Gwaro telo na tiini ba jege swa to déem ma ke daane ba ke wara-jei sem. Ba ma kwei gare-jale-laaro fuga na nwoŋi gare-fefale delo na ye chekke to, ye ba daare ba kwei gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba ma gɔgere cherubi nyenyero ba ke gare-jala yam yera ne. 9Gare-jala fuga kam maama déem mae daane mo. Gare-jale dedwe dedɔrem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finlei-nana. De kayɔlɔ baŋa maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bena. 10Ba ma nyaane gare-jala yanu ba twoŋi daane, ba ta daare ba nyaane yanu yadwonna yam de ba twoŋi daane. Te laam ma ji gare-puna yalei. 11-12Ba daa ta maa kwei gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia to ba ke kuna finnu ba lei gare-pum ni-dedɔrɔ kom seeni. Ba ma daare ba ke konto gare-pum dedwoŋi dem ne. Ba ma ke kuna yam gare-puna yalei nia dedwaaro tem na jeeri daane to yera ne. 13Ba ta ma ke sabu-seŋa gwoli finnu mo se se ja gare-puna yalei yam se ke daane. Ko ma pa se gare-puna yalei yam meeli daane pa se wara-jei sem ji woŋo dedoa.
14Ba déem ma kwei boŋo koro ba sɔ gare-jala se ba ma-ya ba pu wara-vwei dem yuu kom seeni. Ya maama ke daane se ya taa ye fuga-dedoa mo. 15Ya maa mae daane mo. Ya dedɔrem baŋa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fintɔ. Ya kayɔlɔ baŋa maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bena. 16Ba ma kwei gare-jala yanu ba twoŋi daane se ya ji gare-pum, ye ba daare ba kwei gare-jala yaredo yam na daare to mo ba twoŋi daane se ya de ji gare-pum. 17Ba ma ke kuna finnu ba lei gare-pum ni-dedɔrɔ kom seeni, ye ba daare ba ke konto gare-pum dedwoŋi dem ne. 18Ba déem ta kwei channa ba maa ke gwoli finnu pa se se twoŋi gare-puna yalei yam daane se ya ji gɔrɔ dedoa. 19Ba ta ma pwoni pi-bɛ tankwallo ba daare ba seini-te nasoŋo se ba maa kwoli wara-vwei dem, ye ba kwei twan-nyenno ba daŋe boboa twanno tem baŋa ne.
20Ba déem ma kwei golesaa dɛ ba ma ke ywoa yalo na zege cheppe to, se ba ma ke wara-vwei dem. 21Ywei maama dedɔrem baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuga mo, ye de kayɔlɔ baŋa seeni ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa de chichworo. 22Ba laam ma sare nwa balei ywei maama yera ne se ba pa ywei maama taa wae de twoŋi dedaane dedwoŋi na saŋe-de to. 23Ba ta ke ywoa finlei se ya zege ya maŋe de wara-vwei dem tega-kuri seeni, 24ye ba daare ba kwei lu-nyenno ba maa ke wonnu telo na wó teili ywoa yam to finna, pa se luuru telei taa zege ywei dedoa maama ŋwaane. Te maa jege chwiim jei selei mo se ywei nwa bam wane ba zege se wone. 25Ba daa ta ma ke konto se ko maŋe de wara-vwei dem baŋa seeni saŋa kam de, se ywoa finlei taa zege da. 26Ba ma ke lu-nyenno wonnu finna se te teili ywoa yam. Luuru telei maa wora ywei dedoa maama ŋwaane. 27Ko ná ye saŋa kalo na wo bira-kwaga ne ye ka jeeri wɛ-zoore seeni to, ba ma ke ywoa yaredo se ba chwi-ya dáane. 28Ba ta ma ke ywoa yalei ba woli da se ba chwi-ya vwei dem kwaga saŋa kam gugworru telei tem ne. 29Ba ma twoŋi gugworru ywoa yam konto se ya meeli daane. Ko zege tega kam ne mo ko meeli se ko taa diini baŋa kam mɛ sabu-seŋa kwane dem na leigi da to. 30Bira-kwaga kam seeni ywoa yam déem ye nana mo, ye ya jege luuru fuga-teredo telo na teili-ya to.
31-32Ba ma kwei golesaa dɛ mo ba ma-se ba gare wara-vwei dem sɛ sem maama. Dagare senu mo gare ywoa yam na wo saŋa kalo maama ne to, se ya ja daane chekke. Tega-kuri seeni saŋa kam, de baŋa seeni saŋa kam de bira-kwaga seeni saŋa kam mo konto. 33Tetare dagara kam ma tole ka zege saŋa kam daa dedoa ne ka vo ka yi daa kadwoŋi kam, ka twoŋi ywoa yam maama ka ke daane. 34Ba déem ta kwei sabu-seŋa ba kwoli ywoa yam, ye ba daare ba maa ke kwana ba meeli ywoa yam yera ne se dagare sem taa tore ya wone. Ba ta ma kwoli dagare sem de sabu-seŋa.
35Ba ta ma kwei gare-fefale de gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba ma sɔ gare-jale delo na wó che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to. Ba ma daare ba gɔgere cherubi nyenyero ba ke gare-jale dem yera ne. 36Ba ta ma sare golesaa da-dɛɛro tena mo ba taare-se de sabu-seŋa, se gare-jale dem lei se yera ne. Ba laam ma ke sabu-seŋa gwoli sena ba meeli se yera ne, ye ba daare ba kwei lu-nyenno ba ma ke luuru se te teili da-dɛɛro tem.
37Ko ná ye wara-vwei ni dem, ba ma kwei gare-fefale selo na ye chekke to de gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba ma sɔ gare-jale delo na wó lei ni dem ne to. Ba ma daare ba gɔgere nyenyero gare-jale dem yera ne. 38Ba ma ke da-dɛɛro tenu, ye ba meeli gwoli te yera ne. Ba ma kwoli se yuni tem de se nia yam de sabu-seŋa. Ba ta ma kwei channa ba ma mɔ luuru tenu se te teili da-dɛɛro tem, ye ba pale gare-jale dem dɛ sem baŋa ne.

english_text:
The Sacred Chest
(Exodus 25.10-22)
1Bezalel built a chest of acacia wood 110 centimeters long, 66 centimeters wide, and 66 centimeters high. 2He covered it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the top. 3He made four gold rings and attached one of them to each of the four legs of the chest. 4Then he made two poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold, 5and put them through the rings, so the chest could be carried by the poles.
6The entire lid of the chest, which was made of pure gold, was the place of mercy. 7-9On each of the two ends of the chest he made a winged creature of hammered gold. They faced each other, and their wings covered the place of mercy.
The Table for the Sacred Bread
(Exodus 25.23-30)
10Bezalel built a table of acacia wood 88 centimeters long, 44 centimeters wide, and 66 centimeters high. 11-12He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border 75 millimeters thick. 13He made four gold rings and attached one to each of the legs 14near the edging. The poles for carrying the table were placed through these rings 15and were made of acacia wood covered with gold. 16Everything that was to be set on the table was made of pure gold—the bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings.
The Lampstand
(Exodus 25.31-40)
17Bezalel made a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered gold, 18with three branches on each of its two sides. 19There were three decorative almond blossoms on each branch 20and four on the stem. 21There was also a blossom where each pair of branches came out from the stem. 22The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered pure gold. 23-24The lamp and its equipment, including the tongs and trays, were made of about 35 kilograms of pure gold.
The Altar for Burning Incense
(Exodus 30.1-5)
25For burning incense, Bezalel made an altar of acacia wood. It was 45 centimeters square and 90 centimeters high with each of its four corners sticking up like the horn of a bull. 26He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it. 27Then below the edging on opposite sides he attached two gold rings through which he put the poles for carrying the altar. 28These poles were also made of acacia wood and covered with gold.
The Oil for Dedication and the Incense
(Exodus 30.22-38)
29 Bezalel mixed the sacred oil for dedication and the pure spices for the sweet-smelling incense.
translation_text:
Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam
1Bezaleli déem ma kwei golesaa dɛ o ma ke Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam. Ka maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni belei de chichworo mo dedɔrɔ baŋa ne. Kayɔlɔ baŋa maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa de chichworo. Ka baŋa seeni de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa de chichworo. 2O ma kwei sabu-seŋa na tiini ka ye chekke to o ma kwoli ka yiga de ka kwaga maama, ye o pa se sabu-seŋa tɔge ka nia yam maama. 3O ta ma mɔ sabu-seŋa kwana yana. O ma kwei ya dedoa dedoa o meeli dakaa kam nɛ sena maama yera ne. Kwana yalei maa wo dakaa kam saŋa dedoa ne, yalei maa wo saŋa kadwoŋi ne. 4O ma gwoni golesaa dɛ selei o daare o kwei sabu-seŋa o kwoli dɛ sem konto maama. 5O ma kwei-se o tore kwana yana yam wone se ba taa mae ba zeŋe dakaa kam.
6O ma kwei sabu-seŋa kalo na tiini ka ye chekke to o ma ke wɛleera saarem ni-pugu se ko pu dakaa kam. Ka dedɔrɔ baŋa maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem belei de chichworo, ka kayɔlɔ baŋa de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa de chichworo. 7-8O ta ma kwei sabu-seŋa o ma mɔ wonnu telei na nye de malese ye ba bwoi-ba we cherubi to. Cherubi selei sem meeli se zege ni-pugu kom dɛ selei sem ne mo. O déem kwei sabu-seŋa kandwɛ-dale dedwe mo o mage-de o ke cherubi selei sem dedaane ni-pugu kom tete. 9Cherubi sem déem jeeri daane mo, ye se yibia chɔɔle tega ne se se taa nii dakaa kam ni-pugu kom seeni. Se vɔna de maa yarege wɛɛne, ye se laam kwaare se vɔna yam daane se ma-ya se kwoli ni-pugu kom.
Bworobworo tabolo kom
10Bezaleli daa ma kwei golesaa dɛ o ma ke tabolo. Ko dedɔrem baŋa maŋem ye jatwogo de noa maŋem belei mo, ye ko kayɔlɔ baŋa maŋem dem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bedwe. Ko wɛ-baŋa seeni maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa de chichworo mo. 11O déem ma kwei sabu-seŋa na ye chekke to o kwoli ko yiga de ko kwaga maama, ye o daare o pa se sabu-seŋa kam tɔge ko nia yam. 12Sabu-seŋa kam na tɔge tabolo kom nia yam to déem ye da-yiga noa maŋem mo. 13O ta ma kwei sabu-seŋa o mɔ kwana yana o meeli tabolo kom nɛ sena sem na wo mɛ to. 14Kwana yam konto nam meeli ya bwola de tabolo kom nia yam mo, ye dɛ selo ba na wó taa mae ba zeŋe-ko to tore ya wone. 15O laam ma sare golesaa dɛ ye o daare o taare-se dedaane sabu-seŋa. 16Ko kwaga ne mo o kwei sabu-seŋa na ye chekke to o ke zwe dwi dwi tabolo kom totoŋa yam ŋwaane. Se maa ye zon-tanlɛ, de kabeili, de kambi selo na wó taa toŋe wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra totoŋa to.
Min-zwon-zego kom
17Bezaleli nam ta kwei sabu-seŋa kalo na ye chekke to o ma ke woŋo kolo min-zwonnu na wó taa zege ko baŋa ne to. O déem mɛ sabu-seŋa kandwɛ-dale dedwe mo o mage se o mɔ ko kuri, de ko daa kam, de zwe selo min-zwonnu tem na wó zege se wone to. Zwe sem maa nye de pun-kogela mo. 18Min-zwon-zego kom ya jege nɛ seredo mo, ye se nwoŋi tetare daa kam yera ne. Nɛ setɔ maa wo jazem baŋa ne ye setɔ wo jagwia baŋa ne. 19Nenɔŋa punnu tetɔ mo wo naga maama ne, se te taa nye de Aamonda pun-kogela de te vɔɔro. Nɛ seredo sem maama maa ye konto mo. 20Ko tetare daa kam tete déem jege nenɔŋa punnu tena mo na nye de Aamonda pun-kogela de te vɔɔro to. 21Pun-kogele dedwe maama na wo daa kam yera ne to mo teili nɛ selei selo maama na jeeri daane ka yera ne to. Konto to, pun-kogela yatɔ mo teili nɛ seredo sem. 22O ma mage sabu-seŋa kandwɛ-dale dedwe mo o ma ke pun-kogela yam, de nɛ seredo sem, de tetare daa kam tete maama. 23O ta ma ke min-zwonnu terepɛ se te taa zege da, ye o daare o kwei sabu-seŋa kam o ma ke wonnu telo na wó fɔge te kwɛ mini dem to, dedaane zon-tanlɛ selo ba na wó taa mae ba pɛ tentwarem dem to. 24O déem kwei sabu-seŋa kalo ye chekke ye ka dunni maŋe de kilo fintɔ-tenu (35) to mo o ma ke min-zwon-zego kom de ko zela yam maama.
Talwoŋ-ywoŋa dakaa kam
25Bezaleli daa ma kwei golesaa dɛ o ma ke dakaa kalo talwoŋ-ywoŋa na wó taa zwɛ ka baŋa ne to. Ka sɛ sem déem mae daane mo, dedɔrɔ baŋa de kayɔlɔ baŋa seeni. Saŋa maama maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bedwe mo. Ko daare ka wɛ-baŋa maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni belei mo. O ma ke-ka dedaane nyea yana se ya cheili wɛɛne nenɛɛne nabea nyea tei. 26O maa kwei sabu-seŋa kalo na ye chekke to o kwoli dakaa kam maama, ye o daare o ma sabu-seŋa kam o tɔge ka nia yam maama. 27O laam ma ke sabu-seŋa kwana yalei o meeli-ya dakaa kam sɛ selei sem ne se ya maŋe de ka nia yam kuri seeni. Kwana yam ye se ba tore dɛ mo ya wone se nɔɔna taa mae ba zeŋe dakaa kam. 28Dɛ sem tete maa ye golesaa dɛ mo o mɛ o ke, ye o daare o kwei sabu-seŋa o kwoli se maama.
29Bezaleli déem ma viiri Wɛ swolim nuga kam na ye ka yera to. O ma daare o guuri wonnu telo na wó pa se talwoŋ-ywoŋa kam taa ye chekke to.

english_text:
The Altar for Offering Sacrifices
(Exodus 27.1-8)
1Bezalel built an altar of acacia wood for offering sacrifices. It was 2.25 meters square and 1.34 meters high 2with each of its four corners sticking up like the horn of a bull, and it was completely covered with bronze. 3The equipment for the altar was also made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans. 4About halfway up the altar he built a ledge around it and covered the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating. 5Then he attached a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners to put the poles through. 6He covered two acacia wood poles with bronze and 7put them through the rings for carrying the altar, which was shaped like an open box.
The Large Bronze Bowl
(Exodus 30.18-21)
8 Bezalel made a large bowl and a stand out of bronze from the mirrors of the women who helped at the entrance to the sacred tent.
The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent
(Exodus 27.9-19)
9-17Around the sacred tent Bezalel built a courtyard 44 meters long on the south and north and 22 meters wide on the east and west. He used 20 bronze posts on bronze stands for the south and north and 10 for the west. Then he hung a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. He placed three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hung a curtain 6.67 meters wide on each set of posts.
18-19For the entrance to the courtyard, Bezalel made a curtain nine meters long, which he hung on four bronze posts that were set on bronze stands. This curtain was 2.25 meters high, the same height as the one for the rest of the courtyard, and was made of fine linen embroidered and woven with blue, purple, and red wool. He hung the curtain on the four posts, using silver hooks and rods. 20The pegs for the tent and for the curtain around the tent were made of bronze.
The Sacred Tent
21-23Bezalel had worked closely with Oholiab, who was an expert at designing and engraving, and at embroidering blue, purple, and red wool. The two of them completed the work that the Lord had commanded to be done.
Moses put Aaron's son Ithamar in charge of the Levites who kept record of the metals used for the sacred tent. 24According to the official weights, the amount of gold given was a ton, 25 and the silver that was collected when the people were counted came to 3.4 tons. 26 Everyone who was counted paid the required amount, and there was a total of 603,550 men who were 20 years old or older.
27Thirty-four kilograms of the silver were used to make each of the 100 stands for the sacred tent and the curtain. 28The remaining 30 kilograms of silver were used for the hooks and rods and for covering the tops of the posts.
29Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given. 30And it was used to make the stands for the entrance to the tent, the altar and its grating, the equipment for the altar, 31the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.
translation_text:
Zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam
1Bezaleli déem kwei golesaa dɛ mo o ke dakaa se ba taa zwɛ kaanem de baŋa ne. O ma ke-ka pa se ka sɛ sena sem taa mae daane, jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu. Ko daare ka wɛ-baŋa maŋem dem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni betɔ. 2O ma sare wonnu tena na nye de nyea o ke dakaa kam gugworru tena tem ne. Tento de dakaa kam maama déem ye woŋo dedoa mo, ye o ma channa o taare ka dedaane ka nyea yam maama. 3O ta ma kwei channa o ke dakaa kam yera totoŋa zela maama. O ma mɔ zwe selo ba na wó taa mae ba pɛ tentwarem to, de sɛbullu, de na-zwe, de mini zon-tanlɛ, dedaane wonnu telo na wó taa mae te chu nɔna to. 4O ma maŋe dakaa kam tetare ne o ke wo-daŋɔ o meeli ka yera ne. O laam ma kwei channa luuru o sɔ o lɛɛne daane, ye o daare o ke woŋo kom konto se ko yi wo-daŋɔ kom kuri ne. 5O ta ma ke channa kwana yana mo o meeli dakaa kam sɛ sena sem ne se ya maŋe de channa lɛɛna yam, se dɛ wane se taa tore da. 6O ma sare golesaa dɛ selo ba na wó taa mae ba zeŋe dakaa kam to, ye o daare o taare-se de channa. 7O ma kwei-se o tore kwana yana yam na wo dakaa kam sɛ sem ne to. O déem na ke dakaa kam to mo o twoŋi dɛ sem daane se ka taa ye wo-wogo.
Channa ware-zoŋa kam
8Kaana badwonna déem yeini ba wo wara-jei sem manchwo-peena yam ni ne ba zeini totoŋa. Bezaleli ma jwoŋi channa niiru ba tei ne ye o kwei-te o ma mɔ ware-zoŋa kam de ka na wó taa zege woŋo kolo baŋa ne to.
Wara-jei sem konkɔlɔ kom
9Bezaleli déem chege wara-jei sem konkɔlɔ kom mo. O ma sɔ gare-fefale se se kaare-ko. Ko tega-kuri seeni maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi mo dedɔrɔ baŋa ne, 10ye gare-jala yam pale da-dɛɛro finlei baŋa ne mo, te na zege channa luuru finlei baŋa ne to. O déem mɛ lu-nyenno o mɔ gwoli o meeli dɛ sem yera ne ye o ke se lu-vɔɔro tem. 11Konkɔlɔ kom baŋa seeni saŋa kam déem ye bedwe de tega-kuri seeni saŋa kam mo. 12Se ko ná ye saŋa kalo na jeeri wɛ-zoore seeni to, ka maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finnu mo dedɔrɔ baŋa ne. Ba ma daŋe gwaaro tem da-dɛɛro fuga de te luuru fuga kam baŋa ne se ba ma kwoli saŋa kam konto. Ba ma meeli lu-nyenno gwoli dɛ sem yera ne ye ba ke se lu-vɔɔro tem. 13Konkɔlɔ kom wɛ-puli seeni saŋa kam maŋem de déem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finnu mo dedɔrɔ baŋa ne.
14Wara-jei sem manchwoŋo ni dem maa wo wɛ-puli seeni saŋa kam ne mo. Ni dem jazem seeni mo ba leigi gwaaro telo dedɔrem na ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuga-benu ye te daŋe da-dɛɛro tetɔ de te luuru tetɔ tem baŋa ne to. 15Ni dem jagwia seeni de maa ye konto mo. 16Ba déem kwei gare-fefale selo na ye chekke to ba ma sɔ gwaaro telo na wó che wara-jei sem konkɔlɔ kom to. 17Ba déem mɛ channa mo ba ke luuru telo na teili da-dɛɛro tem to. Se ko ná ye gwoli sem de lu-vɔɔro tem, lu-nyenno mo ba mɛ ba ke-te se te meeli da-dɛɛro tem maama yera ne. Ba ma kwoli da-dɛɛro tete yuni tem de sabu-seŋa.
18Ko nam ná ye manchwoŋo ni dem gare-jale dem tete, ba déem mɛ gare-fefale de gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to mo ba sɔ-de. Ba ta ma gɔgere-de de nyenyero lanyerane. Gare-jale dem konto ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finlei mo dedɔrɔ baŋa ne, ye de ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu wɛ-baŋa seeni, nenɛɛne konkɔlɔ kom gwaaro tem na mae tei to. 19Gare-jale dem pale da-dɛɛro tena na chwi channa luuru tena baŋa ne to mo. Ba mɛ lu-nyenno mo ba ke se gwoli sem de se lu-vɔɔro tem ye ba kwoli se yuni tem. 20Ba ta ma kwei channa ba ma ke paara yalo na wó taa jaane vwei dem de konkɔlɔ kom gwaaro tem dedaane dɛ sem maama to.
Zela yalo ba na mɛ ba ke wara-jei sem to
21Zela yalo maama ba déem na mɛ ba ke wara-jei sem mɛ Wɛ ni-gwonim kandwa yam na tigi to dum na mae tei to mo tento. Vwei dem dedaane de zela yam maama mo konto. Moses ma pa se Levi dwi tiina bam popone-te ba tiŋi. Wɛ kaanem tu Aron bu Itamara déem nam mo nii jeelim dem baŋa ne. 22Yuri bu Bezaleli ya nwoŋi Judah dwi dem wone mo. O maa nii totoŋe dem maama baŋa ne, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ déem na maŋe o bere we ba ke tei to. 23Ahisamaki bu Oholiaba de ya nwoŋi Dan dwi dem wone mo. O maa tiini o woli Bezaleli pa se ba ke woŋo maama. Oholiaba déem ye gɔgɔ mo chekke, ye o wae o mae gare-fefale, de gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to o gɔgere wo-laaro.
24Ko ná ye sabu-seŋa kalo nɔɔna bam na jaane ba ba ba pa Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem totoŋa ŋwaane to, ka dum maŋem dem déem maa ye kilo moro dedoa (1000) mo, se ko tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke na ye tei to.
25Lu-nyenno tem Moses déem na jwoŋi nɔɔna bam jeelim dem baŋa ne to maŋem dem de maa ye kilo morro tetɔ de bia yana de fintɔ (3,430) mo. 26Nɔɔno wolo maama na yi bena finlei ye o tɔge o wo jeelim dem wone to ya ŋwe sɛkɛle chichworo mo, se ko dunni tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke. Ba na jeeli nɔɔna bam ni to, ba nɛ we baara moro kuni bia yaredo de yatɔ, dedaane bia yanu de finnu (603,550) mo wora, ye ba jwoŋi lu-nyenno tem konto ba tei ne ba ma toŋe. 27Ba ma kwei lu-nyenno kilo morro tetɔ de bia yana (3,400) ba ma ke luuru bi (100) se te teili wara-vwei dem de de gare-jale dem. Luu maama maa ye lu-nyenno kilo fintɔ-tena (34) mo ba mɛ ba ke. 28Lu-nyenno kilo fintɔ (30) telo na daare to mo ba mɛ ba ke gwoli sem dedaane lu-vɔɔro tem, ye ba ta ma-te ba kwoli da-dɛɛro yuni tem.
29Ko nam ná ye channa kalo nɔɔna bam na kwei ba pa Baŋa Wɛ to, ka maŋem dem ye kilo morro telei de bia yana de finlei-tenu (2,425) mo. 30Channa kam konto mo ba mɛ ba ke luuru telo na teili wara-vwei dem ni dɛ sem de de gwaaro tem. Ba ta ma kwei-ka ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam, de ka tetare luu kom, de ka yera zela yam maama. 31Ba déem ta mɛ channa kam ba ke luuru telo na teili konkɔlɔ kom dɛ sem de ko gwaaro tem, dedaane manchwoŋo ni dem dɛ sem de de gare-jale dem, ko woli de paara yalo na wó taa jaane wara-vwei dem de de konkɔlɔ kom gwaaro tem de te dɛ sem maama mo.

english_text:
Making the Priestly Clothes
(Exodus 28.1-14)
1Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
2-3The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest. 4-5It had two shoulder straps to support it and a sash that fastened around the waist. 6Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons. 7Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The Breastpiece
(Exodus 28.15-30)
8The breastpiece was made with the same materials and designs as the priestly vest. 9It was 22 centimeters square and folded double 10with four rows of three precious stones: A carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald were in the first row; 11a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row; 12a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row; 13and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting, 14and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
15-18Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps. 19Two other gold rings were attached to the lower inside corners next to the vest, 20and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash. 21To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The Clothes for the Priests
(Exodus 28.31-43)
22The priestly robe was made of blue wool 23with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out. 24-26Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
27-29Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
30The words “Dedicated to the Lord” were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold, 31which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The Work Is Completed
(Exodus 35.10-19)
32So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make. 33Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands; 34the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain; 35the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy; 36the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread; 37the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil; 38the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent; 39the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand; 40the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent; 41and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons.
42-43When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_text:
Wɛ kaanem tiina gwaaro tem
1Gwaro tem déem ma kwei gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba ma sɔ nenɔŋa gwaaro se Aron de kaanem tiina bam maama taa zoora, ko maŋe de ba ná yeini ba zo Wɛ wara-jei sem di-yuu kom wone se ba toŋe. Ko maama déem ke ko tɔge nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses tei to mo.
Gare-wogo kom
2Gwaro tem ma kwei gare-fefale selo na ye chekke to, ye ba laam woli de gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba ma sɔ gare-wogo kom. 3Ba ma tiini ba mage sabu-seŋa pa se ka chaane ka ji ŋon-memene. Ba ma kwei-se ba gɔgere nyenyero ba woli de gare-fefale sem de gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to. 4Ba déem ta ke vovwe selei mo ba pa se tɔge gare-wogo kom vɔna yam seeni se ko pa gɔrɔ kom yiga de kwaga twoŋi daane. 5Ba ta ma ke teiŋa vovoa se ka de taa ye bedwe de gare-wogo kom. Ba déem kwei wonnu telo ba na mɛ ba sɔ gare-wogo kom to mo ba ma ke vovoa kam. Konto maama déem ke ko tɔge de Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses tei to mo.
6Ba ma kwei Onika kandwa-nyenno tem ye ba sare Isarele dwi maama yere ba ke ya baŋa ne. Ba ta ma kwei sabu-seŋa ba tɔge ya nia yam maama. 7Ba laam ma meeli kandwa-nyenno tem ba lei gare-wogo kom vɔna vovwe sem yera ne. Ya ye kandwa-gula mo se ya guli Isarele tiina bam ba dwia yam yera. Konto déem ke ko tɔge de Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses tei to mo.
Nyɔɔne gare-pale dem
8Ba ta ma kwei gare-fefale selo na ye chekke to ba ma ke gare-yi delo na wó pale Aron nyɔɔne ne to. Ba déem mɛ gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye sabu-seŋa, de nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba gɔgere-de nenɛɛne gare-wogo kom de na ye tei to mo. 9Ba déem maŋe da-yiga noa maŋem mo ba ke gare-pale dem pa se de nia yana yam maama taa mae daane, ye ba daare ba piri-de kuni belei. 10Ba ma daare ba tigisi kandwa-nyenno dwi dwi se ya peini gene sena de kandwa-nyenno tetɔ. Boboa gena kam kandwa-nyenno tem ye Rubi, de Topazi, dedaane Berili. 11Gena balei tu kandwa-nyenno tem maa ye Tukwazi, de Safira, dedaane Emeraleda. 12Gena batɔ tu wom maa jege kandwa-nyenno tento: Jakinfa, de Agate, dedaane Ametisita. 13Se gena bana tu wom kandwa-nyenno tem maa ye Berili, de Onika dedaane Jasipa. Ba ta ma kwei sabu-seŋa ba tɔge kandwa yam konto maama nia yam. 14Ba ma sare Isarele dwi maama yera fuga-yalei yam kandwa yam baŋa ne. Kandwɛ maama déem bere yere dedwe se de taa ye maana.
15Ba déem ma kwei sabu-seŋa na ye chekke to ba jujugi ba ma ke chaponno nenɛɛne ŋona dwoŋi, se ko twoŋi de gare-pale dem. 16Ba ta ma ke sabu-seŋa kuna yalei de sabu-seŋa kwana yalei, ye ba kwei-ya ba lei gare-pale dem baŋa seeni gugworru telei tem ne. 17Ba laam ma kwei sabu-seŋa chaponno tem ba tore kwana yalo na leigi gare-pale dem yera ne to wone. 18Ba ta ma ja chaponno tem nia yadwonna yam ba vo ba kuni dedaane kuna yalei yam se te ja gare-wogo kom vɔna vovwe sem. 19Ba maa ke sabu-seŋa kwana yalei se ya meeli gare-pale dem kuri dem seeni. Ya maa wo de kwaga seeni na sale de gare-wogo kom to mo. 20Ba ta maa ke sabu-seŋa kwana yalei yayam ba meeli-ya gare-wogo kom yera ne se ya taa bwola de ko vɔna vovwe sem kuri seeni. Ya maa wo ko teiŋa vovoa kam baŋa seeni, gare-yia yam na twoŋi daane mɛ to. 21Ba laam maa kwei gare-ŋona kalo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to, ba ma vɔ kwana yalei yam na wo gare-pale dem kuri ne to de yalo na wo gare-wogo kom vɔna yam seeni to ba ke daane. Ko ma pa se gare-pale dem yé taa bibiga. Ko maama déem ke ko tɔge Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses se o ke tei to.
Kaanem tiina gwaaro tedwonna
22Ba déem ma kwei gare-ŋone selo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to yerane mo ba ma sɔ gare-bwora kalo kaanem tu wom na wó zo ye o daare o zo gare-wogo kom o daŋe ka baŋa ne to. 23Ba ma bɔɔre bɔɔne ko tetare ne se nɔɔno yuu wane ko tɔge da ko zo. Ba laam ma bɛɛre ba dem seeni maama se ko yé kaare. 24Ba ma kwei gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba gɔgere Pomegara tio-bia nyenyero pa se te kaare gɔrɔ kom kuri nia yam maama te pu. 25Ba laam ma kwei sabu-seŋa kalo na ye chekke to ba ma ke lwoŋina balwa se ba meeli-ya ba ke da. 26Lwoŋini dedoa wora Pomegara tio-bia balei maama tetare ne mo pa se ba saŋe daane. Ba ma ke konto mo ba kaare gɔrɔ kom kuri seeni nia yam maama. Gɔrɔ kom maa ye se kaanem tiina bam zo-ko se ba taa toŋe ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ko maama déem ke ko tɔge nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses tei to.
27Ba laam ma kwei gare-fefale ba ma sɔ Aron gare-dedwaaro se Aron de o bia bam taa zoora. 28Ba ta ma ke Aron yuu gare-yi dem dedaane o bia bam yipwi sem. Ba ma kwei gare-fefale ba ma ke gare-kuri-kukwi sem. 29Ba ma ke Aron teiŋa vovoa kam de gare-fefale ye ba gɔgere-ka de gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to. Ko maama déem ke ko tɔge nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na bere Moses tei to.
30Ba laam ma kwei sabu-seŋa na ye chekke to ba mage-ka ba ke wo-pelɔgɔ se ko taa dɔge Aron yuu ne. Ba ma sare ko baŋa ne we: ‘Wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane’. 31Ba ta ma kwei gare-ŋona kalo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to ba ma vɔ-ko ba meeli Aron yuu gare-yi dem yiga seeni. Ko maama déem ke ko tɔge nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses tei to.
Moses kaare wara-jei sem o nii
32 Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ma ke se ti. Isarele tiina bam déem ke kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ na bere Moses se o ke to mo. 33Ba laam ma ja vwei dem tete de de wo zela yam maama ba vo ba bere Moses. Ko maa ye tento:
Gwaaro tem, de sabu-seŋa gwoli sem, de ywoa yam, de dagare sem, de da-dɛɛro tem, dedaane vwei dem kuri luuru tem maama,
34de wonnu telo ba na mɛ ba kwoli wara-vwei dem baŋa kam: pi-bea twanno telo ba na seini to, de twan-nyenno,
de gare-jale delo na wó che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to,
35de Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam, de dɛ selo na wó taa maa zeŋe-ka to, dedaane ka ni-pugu kom,
36de tabolo kom, dedaane ko yera zela yam maama,
de bworobworo kolo na wó taa tigi Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to,
37de sabu-seŋa min-zwon-zego kom, de ko yera wonnu tem maama,
ko woli de min-zwonnu terepɛ tem, de nuga kam na wó ke-da to,
38de talwoŋ-ywoŋa zwɛɛm dakaa kam sabu-seŋa na kwoli ka maama to,
de Wɛ swolim nuga kam, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa kam,
de gare-jale delo na wo wara-vwei dem ni dem ne to,
39de channa kaanem dakaa kam, de luu kolo na meeli ka yera ne to, de ka yera zela yam maama, ko ta woli de dɛ selo na wó taa zeŋe-ka to,
de ware-zoŋa kam, dedaane ka na wó taa zege woŋo kolo baŋa ne to,
40de konkɔlɔ kom gare-jala yam, de dɛ selo baŋa ne ya na wó pale to, de se luuru tem,
ko ta woli de gare-jale delo na wó che konkɔlɔ kom manchwoŋo ni dem to,
de ŋone sem, de paara yalo na wó chwi ya ja vwei dem to,
dedaane wara-jei sem zela yam maama,
41dedaane nenɔŋa gwaaro telo Wɛ kaanem tu Aron de o bia bam na wó taa zoore se ba yeini ba zo Wɛ diga kam wone ba ke kaanem ba pa‑o to.
42Isarele tiina bam déem seene ba ke kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ na bere Moses se ba ke to lanyerane. 43Moses na nii ba totoŋa yam to, mo o maane we ba ke se ko tɔge tei maama Baŋa Wɛ na bere se ba ke to chekke. O ma sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o ke ba yuu ne.

english_text:
The Lord's Tent Is Set Up
1The Lord said to Moses:
2Set up my tent on the first day of the year 3and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain. 4Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it. 5Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent. 6Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent. 7Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water. 8Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
9Use the sacred olive oil to dedicate to me the tent and everything in it. 10Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment 11and with the bowl and its stand. 12Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves. 13Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest. 14Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons 15and ordain them in the same way, so they and their descendants will always be my priests.
16Moses followed the Lord's instructions. 17And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up. 18The posts, stands, and framework were put in place, 19then the two layers of coverings were hung over them. 20The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached. 21The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
22The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place, 23after which the bread was set on the table. 24The lampstand was put along the south wall, 25then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord. 26The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain, 27and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
28The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent. 29Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there. 30The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water, 31then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet. 32In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
33Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance.
The Glory of the Lord
34 Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord. 35And so, Moses could not enter the tent. 36Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow; 37then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again. 38No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_text:
Wara-jei sem chwiim
1 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de Moses o we:
2“Ta‑n yei se n chwi amo wara-jei sem ben-doore dem boboa dɛ dem ne. 3Laam kwei ni-gwonim dakaa kam Wɛ nia fuga kam na wo ka wone to, n ja n zo n zege wara-vwei dem ne. Nmo nam wó pale gare-jale dem mo se de kwoli-ka de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam wone. 4Nam ta ja tabolo kom n zo n zege vwei dem ne, se n daare n tigisi ko yera zela yam ko baŋa ne. Laam ja min-zwon-zego kom n ja n zo da, se n kwei min-zwonnu terepɛ tem n zege ko baŋa ne. 5N ma‑n wó kwei talwoŋ-ywoŋa dakaa kam mo n zege se ka taa wo ni-gwonim dakaa kam yiga ne, Wɛ di-yun-gala kam wone. Laam pale gare-jale delo na wó taa wo wara-vwei ni dem ne to.
6Ko ná ye zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam, se n zege-ka se ka taa bwola de wara-vwei ni dem. 7Laam kwei channa ware-zoŋa kam n zege wara-vwei dem de zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam tetare laŋa ne. Mɔ na n su-ka. 8Nmo ta wó che konkɔlɔ n kaare wara-vwei dem maama, se n daare n kwei gare-jale delo na wó che manchwo-peena yam to n pale da.
9Nmo nam ná ke konto maama, kwei Wɛ swolim nuga kam, se n ma‑n kwɛ wara-jei sem de se zela yam maama se ya taa ye wose ya pa-ne. 10Ta kwei swolim nuga kam n ma‑n kwɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam dedaane ka yera zela yam, se ya taa ye wose ya pa-ne, 11se n daare n kwɛ ware-zoŋa kam de ka na zege woŋo kolo baŋa ne to se te de taa ye te yera.
12Nmo laam ma‑n wó pa se Aron de o bu-baara bam jeeri wara-vwei dem ni ne se n pa ba swɛ ba yera ba kwɛ ba tete amo ŋwaane. 13Kwei kaanem gwaaro tem n zo Aron, se n daare n ma nuga kam n turi‑o. Ke konto n pwɛ Aron o kaanem totoŋa yam ŋwaane, se o taa toŋe o pa-ne. 14Nam ta kwei gare-dedwaaro tem n zo Aron bia bam de, 15se n daare n turi-ba de nuga kam, nenɛɛne n na ke tei de ba kwo wom to. Konto mo wó pa se ba de ba dwi tiina taa ye amo kaanem tiina se ko taa vei wuu.”
16Moses déem ke ko maama se ko tɔge Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere‑o tei to. 17Bena yalei bene dem boboa chana kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo ba déem chwi wara-jei sem. 18Moses ma pa ba chwi vwei dem ywoa yam ya luuru tem baŋa ne, se ba daare ba tore dagare sem da. Ba ta ma chwi da-dɛɛro tem. 19O ta ma kwei gwaaro telo na kwoli wara-vwei dem yuu kom to o pu ko jei ne, ye o daare o kwei tankwallo tem o daŋe te baŋa ne. Ko maama déem ke ko tɔge nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere‑o tei to.
20Moses ma kwei Wɛ ni-gwonim kandwa-pelɛ selei sem o tiŋi dakaa kam wone. O ta ma kwei dɛ selo na wó taa mae se zeŋe dakaa kam to o tore ka kwana yam wone. O ma daare o kwei wɛleera saarem ni-pugu kom o pu ka ni. 21O laam ma ja dakaa kam o zo o zege wara-vwei dem wone, ye o kwei gare-jale dem o maa che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam se dakaa kam taa wora. Ko déem ke ko tɔge kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses se o ke to.
22Moses ta ma ja tabolo kom o zo o zege wara-vwei dem baŋa seeni, gare-jale dem yiga ne. 23O ma tiŋi bworobworo ko baŋa ne, se ko taa wo Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne, nenɛɛne Wɛ na bere‑o se o ke tei to.
24O ta ma kwei min-zwon-zego kom o zege se ko maŋe de tabolo kom ye ko wo vwei dem tega-kuri seeni. 25O ma zege min-zwonnu terepɛ tem maama te zega jei ne, se te taa wo Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne, nenɛɛne Wɛ na bere‑o se o ke tei to.
26Moses déem ma zege sabu-seŋa talwoŋ-ywoŋa dakaa kam gare-jale dem yiga ne. 27O laam ma zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa ka baŋa ne, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na bere‑o se o ke tei to. 28O ta ma pa se ba kwei gare-jale dedwoŋi dem ba che wara-vwei ni dem.
29Moses laam ma kwei zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam o zege konkɔlɔ kom ne, vwei dem ni yiga ne. O ta ma kwei vara de muni pɛɛra o ke kaanem de baŋa ne. O déem ke ko maama se ko tɔge Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere‑o se o ke tei to.
30O ma kwei ware-zoŋa kam o zege kaanem dakaa kam de wara-vwei dem tetare laŋa ne. O ma pa se ba mɔ na ba ke da se kaanem tiina taa wae ba zare ba tete. 31Moses de Aron, dedaane Aron bia bam maa zege ko yiga ne ba zare ba jea dedaane ba nɛ sem. 32Maŋa kalo maama ba ná lage ba ke kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne, naa ba ná zo vwei dem wone, ba jege se ba zare ba tete konto mo, se ko tɔge Baŋa Wɛ ya na bere Moses se o ke to.
33Moses laam ma pa se ba che konkɔlɔ ba kaare wara-vwei dem de kaanem dakaa kam maama. O ma kwei gare-jale delo na wó che ko manchwoŋo ni dem to o pale da. Konto na ke to, Moses déem ma ti totoŋe dem maama.
Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom
34Kunkwoŋo kom déem ma chu ko kwoli wara-vwei dem pa se wara-jei sem maama su de Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom. 35Moses daa ware se o zo vwei dem wone, kunkwoŋo kom de Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
36Isarele tiina bam veiŋa maama wone, kunkwoŋo kom ná yeini ko zaŋe wara-jei sem ne, ba de wó zaŋe ba tɔge ba via mo. 37Kunkwoŋo kom nam ná maŋe da, ba de wó maŋe jei sem konto ne se ko taa nii maŋa kalo ko daa na wó zaŋe to. 38Ba ná wo mɛ maama ba veiŋa wone, Baŋa Wɛ wo ba tei ne mo. Wea ne mo kunkwoŋo kom yeini ko dɔge wara-jei sem yuu ne. Ko maa ná ye tete ne, mini mo wo kunkwoŋo kom yera ne de pae pwooni.

english_text:
1-3The Lord spoke to Moses from the sacred tent and gave him instructions for the community of Israel to follow when they offered sacrifices.
Sacrifices To Please the Lord
The Lord said:
Sacrifices to please me must be completely burned on the bronze altar.
Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices. If the animal is a bull, it must not have anything wrong with it. Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, and I will let you know if it is acceptable to me. 4Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
5After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
6Skin the bull and cut it up, 7while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing. 8-9Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
10If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it. 11Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
12-13Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
14If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon. 15A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar, 16remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar. 17Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_text:
Zwɛɛm pɛɛre kaanem
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem zege wara-vwei dem ne mo o bwoŋi Moses, ye o ta ded‑o o we, 2“Ta de Isarele tiina bam we:
Abam wolo ná yeini o boŋe se o ja pɛɛra o ba o kaane o pa Baŋa Wɛ, se o le o sɔŋɔ vara bam wone o ja o ba.
3Wolo ná kuri se o kwei naao o ma o ke zwɛɛm kaanem, se o nii o naane dem wone o le nabea kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to o ja o ba. Kotu laam maa wó ja-ka o vo o zege wara-vwei ni dem ne, se Baŋa Wɛ laam sɛ se o jwoŋi-ka. 4Kotu ta wó kwei o jeŋa mo o daŋe nabea kam yuu ne se ko bere we varem wom leiri o yuu ne mo, se Wɛ wane o saare o wɛleera yam o yage. 5O laam maa wó gwoni nabea kam ba Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne, se Aron dwi dem na ye kaanem tiina to de laam kwei ka jana bam ba ja vo ba dole dole kaanem dakaa kam na wo wara-vwei ni dem ne to sɛ sena sem yera ne. 6Kotu ta wó pwoni varem wom mo se o daare o cha o nɔna yam muga-muga. 7Kaanem tiina bam de maa wó tɔre mini kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne, ye ba daare ba tigisi dɛ ba daŋe mini dem baŋa ne. 8Ba ta wó kwei varem wom nɔna, de o yuu, de o lara kam maama ba daŋe dɛ sem na jege mini to baŋa ne mo. 9Ko nam ná ye varem wom nɛ sem, de o loro tem, se kotu zare tento yiga se kaanem tu wom laam zwɛ te maama kula kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. Pɛɛre dem konto ye zwɛɛm kaanem mo. De lwom maa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ.
10Ko nam ná ye pia, naa boŋo mo kotu kuri se o ma o ke zwɛɛm kaanem, se o le pi-bea naa bo-bala o vara bam wone, ye gɛɛ tere ka yera ne. 11O laam maa wó ja varem wom o vo kaanem dakaa kam saŋa kalo na jeeri baŋa seeni to o go‑o Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Kaanem tiina bam de maa wó kwei varem wom jana bam ba dole dole kaanem dakaa kam sɛ sena sem yera ne. 12Nɔɔno wom ta wó cha varem wom nɔna yam muga-muga, se kaanem tu wom kwei o nɔna yam, de o yuu, de o lara maama o tigisi dɛ selo na jege mini ye se wo kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne to ne. 13Ko nam ná ye varem wom nɛ sem, de o loro tem, se kotu zare tento yiga se kaanem tu wom laam zwɛ te maama kula kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. Pɛɛre dem konto ye zwɛɛm kaanem mo. De lwom maa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ.
14Ko nam ná ye zuna dwi dem mo kotu kuri se o ma ke zwɛɛm kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ, se o kwei kunkwoŋa, naa kunkwon-puuri o ma o toŋe. 15Kaanem tu wom mo wó ja-ka o yi kaanem dakaa kam jei sem se o jujugi ka yuu o gwori ye o daare o zwɛ ka yuu kom kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. O laam maa wó zulimi zuŋa kam se ka jana lwoori ba ke kaanem dakaa kam saŋa ne. 16O ta wó le ka fonfɔlɔ kom de kolo maama na wo ko wone to, ye o daare o dole-te o yage kaanem dakaa kam saŋa kalo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to ne, tentwarem na dogele mɛ to. 17Kaanem tu wom ta wó ja kunkwoŋa kam mo ka vɔna seeni o kaare belei se ka yé tore. O maa wó kwei-ka o zwɛ dɛ sem na jege mini ye se wo kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne to. Pɛɛre dem konto ye zwɛɛm kaanem mo. De lwom maa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ.

english_text:
Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord
The Lord said:
1When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour, 2and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 3The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
4If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
5If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast. 6Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil. 7If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
8You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar. 9Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 10The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
11Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice. 12You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
13Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
14Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest. 15You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice. 16A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_text:
Wodiu pɛɛre kaanem
1Abam wolo ná boŋe se o ja muni pɛɛre o ba se o kaane o pa Baŋa Wɛ, kotu jege se o beeri mun-bwei delo na lamma chekke to. O wó lwo Olivi nuga de baŋa ne, se o daare o woli Faraniki talwoŋ-ywoŋa da. 2O laam maa wó ja o pɛɛre dem o vo Aron dwi dem kaanem tiina bam tei. Ba dedoa mo wó zwɛ muni dem na gwaane de nuga to, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa kam maama o ke o ja-bɔŋɔ ne. O laam wó zwɛ pɛɛre dem popɔra kanto mo kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne se ka taa ye gulim pɛɛre ka pa Wɛ. Pɛɛre dem konto lwom maa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ. 3Muni pɛɛre delo ta na daare to wó taa ye Aron de o bia bam nyem mo. De maa tiini de ye wose mo, de na nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ wodiu pɛɛra yam wone to ŋwaane.
4Abam wolo nam ná boŋe se o wɔ bworobworo kura wone se o kwei o ma ke kaanem dento dwoŋi, kotu jege se o kwei mun-bwei delo na tiini de lamma chekke, ye sabɔle wo woli da to. O wae o gwaane muni dem de nuga o ma ke bworobworo kom, naa se o kwei muni dem o ma wɔ bworobworo-memene o daare o ma nuga o taare taare de maama. 5Kotu nam ná lage se o wɔ bworobworo kom luu baŋa ne, se o kwei mun-bwei delo na tiini de lamma chekke to o ma ke wodiu pɛɛre dem konto. O wó woli nuga da, se o yé pa se sabɔle woli de wone. 6Ko kwaga ne, o wó fɔ-ko mena-mena mo, ye o daare o lwo nuga ko baŋa ne, se ko taa ye wodiu pɛɛre. 7Kotu nam ná saŋe o wodiu pɛɛre dem kambia wone, se o kwei mun-bwei delo na tiini de lamma chekke to, ye o woli nuga de wone.
8Nmo ná mɛ wonnu tem konto n ke wodiu pɛɛre dem se n kaane n pa Baŋa Wɛ, n laam wó ja-de n vo n pa Wɛ kaanem tu wom. Wonto de laam wó ja-de o vo kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa. 9O wó kwei pɛɛre dem o pɔɔre popɔra kadwoŋi se ka taa ye gulim pɛɛre ka pa Wɛ, ye o zwɛ-ka kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. Pɛɛre dem konto lwom maa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ. 10Wodiu pɛɛre delo ta na daare to wó taa ye Aron de o bia bam nyem mo. De maa tiini de ye wose mo, de na nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ wodiu pɛɛra yam wone to ŋwaane.
11Abam wolo ná lage se o kwei wodiu pɛɛre o kaane o pa Baŋa Wɛ, se o yé woli sabɔle de wone. Kokuri to, sabɔle dedaane tooro dae se abam ma-te á zwɛ á ke pɛɛre á pa Baŋa Wɛ. 12Kotu nam ná lage se o kwei wodiiru telo na lwoori yiga te ke to o pa Baŋa Wɛ, o jege chwoŋa se o woli sabɔle de tooro te wone. Ko nam dae se á kwei wonnu tem konto á zwɛ kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne se te lwom taa ywomma. 13Á nam jege se á woli yɛ á wodiu pɛɛra yam maama wone. Kokuri to, yɛ dem zege de pae ni-gwonim delo Wɛ na ke de abam to mo. Konto ŋwaane, yeini á zezage yɛ á wodiu pɛɛra yam wone.
14Abam wolo nam ná boŋe se o kwei o kara wodiu kolo na dɛ yiga ko ke to o pa Baŋa Wɛ, se kotu kwei ko bia o nɔ ko wodi-doŋo maŋa ne ye o daare o wɔ de mini. 15O ta wó gwaane nuga ko wone o daare o kwei talwoŋ-ywoŋa o woli da, se ko taa ye wodiu pɛɛre mo. 16Kaanem tu laam maa wó pɔɔre gulim pɛɛre popɔra ko wone se o kwei o zwɛ o pa Wɛ. Men-bia bam chichworo de nuga kam chichworo dedaane talwoŋ-ywoŋa kam maama mo o jege se o kwei o zwɛ konto, ko na ye wodiu pɛɛre mo ko pae Baŋa Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_text:
Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing
The Lord said:
1When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal. 2Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
3Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides, 4as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. 5Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
6Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it. 7If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent. 8Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
9Offer the fat on the tail, the tailbone, and the insides, 10as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. 11One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
12If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me 13at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
14Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides, 15as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. 16One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me.
All fat belongs to me. 17So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_text:
Yazura pɛɛre kaanem
1Abam wolo ná boŋe se o ke yazura pɛɛre o kaane o pa Baŋa Wɛ, ye kotu ná kuri na-bala, naa na-choa o vara bam wone, ko wó taa ye kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to mo. 2Kotu laam maa wó kwei o jeŋa o daŋe varem wom yuu ne ye o daare o gwoni varem wom ba wara-vwei dem ni dem ne. Aron dwi dem kaanem tiina bam maa wó kwei varem wom jana bam ba dole dole kaanem dakaa kam sɛ sena sem yera ne. 3Nɔɔno wom wó le o yazura pɛɛre dem wone kolo na wó taa ye pɛɛre ko pae Baŋa Wɛ to. Ko maa wó taa ye lara kalo na meeli varem wom wo-zela yam yera ne to maama, 4dedaane o tapwale-bia balei bam de lara kalo na meeli da to mo. O ta wó le chwɛ dem kuri seeni mo o woli da. 5Kaanem tiina bam laam maa wó kwei wonnu tem konto maama ba ja vo ba tiŋi kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne ba zwɛ-te ba woli de zwɛɛm pɛɛre delo na maŋe de wora mini ne to. Pɛɛre dem konto lwom maa ywomma ko pae Baŋa Wɛ.
6Nɔɔno nam ta wó wane o ma pia, naa boŋo se o ma o ke yazura pɛɛre o pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ko wae ko ye wo-bala naa wo-kana kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to. 7Ko ná ye pia mo nɔɔno wom jaane o ba, se o ja-ka o jeeri Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. 8O laam maa wó kwei o jeŋa o daŋe ka yuu ne ye o daare o gwoni varem wom ba wara-vwei dem yiga ne. Aron bia bam laam maa wó kwei varem wom jana bam ba dole dole kaanem dakaa kam sɛ sena sem yera ne. 9Nɔɔno wom wó le o yazura pɛɛre dem wone kolo na wó taa ye pɛɛre ko pae Baŋa Wɛ to. Ko maa wó taa ye varem wom lara kam maama, de lara kalo na meeli o wo-zela yam yera ne to de. Ba jege se ba gwoni o nabili dem tetare kua kam seeni, se ba le nabili-bwogo kom de ko lara kam. 10Ba ta wó le varem wom tapwale-bia balei bam de lara kalo na meeli da to, de chwɛ dem kuri seeni ba woli da. 11Kaanem tu wom laam wó kwei-te o ja o vo o zwɛ kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne, se ko taa ye nɔna mo na ye pɛɛra ya pae Baŋa Wɛ.
12Ko nam ná ye boŋo mo nɔɔno jaane o ba se o ma o ke pɛɛre dem konto o pa Baŋa Wɛ, 13kotu wó kwei o jeŋa mo o daŋe ko yuu ne, ye o daare o gwoni ko ba wara-vwei dem yiga ne. Aron bia bam maa wó kwei boŋo kom jana bam ba dole dole kaanem dakaa kam sɛ sena sem maama yera ne. 14Nɔɔno wom wó le o pɛɛre dem wone kolo na wó taa ye pɛɛre ko pae Baŋa Wɛ to. Ko nam ye lara kalo na meeli boŋo kom wo-zela yam yera ne to mo, 15dedaane ko tapwale-bia balei bam de lara kalo na meeli da to. O ta wó le chwɛ dem kuri seeni mo o woli da. 16Kaanem tu wom laam maa wó kwei-te o ja o vo o zwɛ kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne, se ko taa ye wodiu na ye pɛɛre ko pae Baŋa Wɛ to. Pɛɛre dem konto lwom maa ywomma ko pae Baŋa Wɛ.
Varem wom lara kam maama ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. 17Abam ná vei á wo jei selo maama ne, á ba jege se á fɔge á di lara naa jana. Abam de á kwaga kam maama jege se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ ni dem konto se ko taa vei wuu.”

english_text:
Sacrifices for Sin
(Leviticus 6.24-30)
1The Lord told Moses 2to say to the community of Israel:
Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do.
When the High Priest Sins
The Lord said:
3When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it. 4The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there. 5He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent, 6dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain. 7Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
8-10The priest will remove the fat from the bull, just as he does when he sacrifices a bull to ask my blessing. This includes the fat on the insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. He will then send it all up in smoke.
11-12The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap.
When the Whole Nation Sins
The Lord said:
13When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty. 14Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, 15where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
16The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent, 17dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain. 18Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent. 19-21After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven.
When a Tribal Leader Sins
The Lord God said:
22Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty. 23As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it. 24This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar. 25The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar. 26Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven.
When Ordinary People Sin
The Lord said:
27 When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty. 28As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it. 29Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed. 30Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar. 31After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
32If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it. 33Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed. 34The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar. 35After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_text:
Wɛleere saarem kaanem
1 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de Moses o we:
2“Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Abam wolo ná ke woŋo kolo Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere we ko chuli to, ye kotu ná wo paale o ke o tusi mo, pa-na se o ke tento:
3Wɛ kaanem tiina yiga tu wom mo ná ke o tusi konto dwoŋi, pa se o wɛleere jene ba nɔɔna bam maama yuu ne, o wó ja na-bala kalo na ba jege gɛɛ to mo o ba se o ma o ke wɛleere saarem kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ. 4O jege se o ja na-bala kam mo o ja o ba wara-vwei dem ni ne se o jeeri Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. O laam wó kwei o jeŋa o daŋe ka yuu ne, se o daare o gwoni ka ba dáane. 5Kaanem tiina yiga tu wom maa wó lwo na-bala kam jana badwonna o ke zoŋa ne o ja o zo wara-vwei dem wone. 6O laam maa wó kwei o noa o laŋe jana bam, ye o miisi jana bam se ko jeeri gare-jale delo na leigi de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to. O jege se o ke konto Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne kuni berepɛ mo. 7O ta wó ma jana bam o taare talwoŋa zwɛɛm bimbini na wo wara-vwei dem ne ye de zege Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to, de nyea yana yam seeni. Jana balo laam na daare to mo, o wó ja-ba o vo o zege wara-vwei ni dem ne ye o daare o lwo-ba zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne. 8Kaanem tiina yiga tu wom laam jege se o le wɛleere saarem na-bala kam lara kam maama, de lara kalo na meeli ka wo-zela yam yera ne to de mo. 9O ta wó le ka tapwale-bia balei bam de lara kalo na meeli da to, de chwɛ dem kuri seeni o woli da. 10O na wó le wonnu tem konto to ye bedwe de o na yeini o ke tetei de na-bala kalo nɔɔno na jaane o ba se o ma ke yazura pɛɛre o pa Wɛ to. O laam maa wó zwɛ te maama zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. 11Ko ná daare na-bala kam tankɔlɔ kom, de ka nɔna yam, de ka yuu kom, de ka nɛ sem, de ka wo-zela yam, de ka loro tem, 12kaanem tiina yiga tu wom jege se o kwei te maama na daare to o ja nwoŋi ba tigisim jeiga kam o yi dáa dáa. Jei sem konto wó taa ye pwola kalo ba na kwɛ Wɛ chullu tem ŋwaane ye ba dole zwɛɛm kaanem tentwarem da to. O wó kwei tento maama o ja o vo dáane o zwɛ dɛ selo na jege mini to baŋa ne, ba na dogele tentwarem mɛ to.
13Ko nam ná ye Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama ná ke ba tusi Wɛ yiga ne, ye ba wo paale ba ke, ba ta wó ga ba bora mo, ba na ke kolo Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere we ko chuli to ŋwaane, de ba ná maŋe ba wo lɔre we ba tusi mo de. 14Ba ná tu ba maane ba tusim dem ni ne, ko jege se ba ja na-bala mo ba ba se ba ma ke wɛleere saarem kaanem ba pa Wɛ. Ba wó kwei-ka ba ja ba vo wara-vwei dem yiga ne. 15Isarele nakwa bam maa wó vo Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne ba kwei ba je ba daŋe na-bala kam yuu ne, ye ba dedoa gwoni ka ba o go. 16Kaanem tiina yiga tu wom maa wó lwo na-bala kam jana badwonna o ke zoŋa ne o ja o zo wara-vwei dem wone. 17O laam maa wó kwei o noa o laŋe jana bam, ye o miisi jana bam se ko jeeri Wɛ di-yuu kom gare-jale dem. O jege se o ke konto Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne kuni berepɛ mo. 18O ta wó ma jana bam o taare talwoŋa zwɛɛm bimbini delo na wo wara-vwei dem ne ye de zege Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to, de nyea yana yam seeni. Jana balo laam na daare to mo, o wó ja-ba o vo o zege wara-vwei ni dem ne ye o daare o lwo-ba zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne. 19Kaanem tiina yiga tu wom ta wó lɔɔne na-bala kam lara maama mo, ye o daare o zwɛ-ka kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. 20O na yeini o ke tetei de na-bala kalo o na zwɛ o tete wɛleera saarem ŋwaane to mo, o ta wó ke konto dwoŋi de na-bala kam konto. Kaanem tu wom wó da chwoŋa kam konto o ma le nɔɔna bam lwarem se Wɛ de kwei ba tusim dem o yage o ma chɛ-ba. 21O ta jege se o kwei na-bala kam o ja o nwoŋi ba tigisim jeiga kam o vo dáa dáa, ye o daare o zwɛ-ka, nenɛɛne o na ke tei de na-bala kakam kam to. Ko maa ye wɛleere saarem kaanem mo ko pae Isarele nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama.
22Yiga tiina bam wone dedoa ná ke o tusi Wɛ yiga ne, ye o wo paale o ke, o ta wó ga o bora mo, o na ke kolo o Tu Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere we ko chuli to ŋwaane. 23Ba ná pɛ o maane we o sage chwoŋa, se o ja bo-bala kalo na ba jege gɛɛ to o ba o ke kaanem. 24O jege se o kwei o jeŋa mo o daŋe ka yuu ne, se o laam gwoni ka ba o go. O wó ke konto ko maŋe de jeiga kalo ba na yeini ba goe zwɛɛm kaanem vara bam Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to mo. Nɔɔno wom kaanem dem konto ye wɛleere saarem kaanem mo. 25Kaanem tu wom laam maa wó de o noa boŋo kom jana ne, se o ma jana bam o taare zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam nyea yana yam. Jana balo na daare to ye se o lwo-ba zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne mo. 26Se ko ná ye varem wom lara kam maama, o jege se o zwɛ ka maama mo kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne, nenɛɛne o na zwɛ lara o ma ke yazura pɛɛre dem tei to. Kaanem tu wom wó da chwoŋa kam konto mo o ma le nɔɔno wom lwarem, se Wɛ de kwei o tusim dem o ma chɛ‑o.
27Á kɔgɔ kom wone nɔɔno de nɔɔno ná ke o tusi Wɛ yiga, ye o wo paale o ke, o ta wó ga o bora mo, o na ke kolo Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere we ko chuli to ŋwaane. 28Ba ná pɛ o maane o tusim dem ni ne, se o ja bo-choa kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to o ba o ke kaanem o wɛleere dem ŋwaane. 29O jege se o kwei o jeŋa mo o daŋe ka yuu ne, se o laam gwoni ka ba, jeiga kalo ba na yeini ba goe zwɛɛm kaanem vara bam da to. 30Kaanem tu wom laam maa wó de o noa boŋo kom jana ne, se o ma jana bam o taare zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam nyea yana yam. Jana balo na daare to ye se o lwo-ba zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne mo. 31O ta jege se o lɔɔne ko lara kam mo, nenɛɛne o na ke tei dedaane yazura pɛɛre varem lara kam to. O ta wó zwɛ lara kam kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne se ka lwom taa ywomma ko pae Baŋa Wɛ. Kaanem tu wom wó da chwoŋa kam konto o ma le nɔɔno wom lwarem, se Wɛ de kwei o tusim dem o ma chɛ‑o.
32Nɔɔno nam ná kuri pia o ma o ke wɛleere kaanem, kotu wó ja pi-choa mo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to o ja o ba. 33O laam maa wó kwei o jeŋa o daŋe pia kam yuu ne, ye o daare o gwoni ka ba se ko taa ye wɛleere saarem kaanem. O wó ke konto jeiga kalo ba na yeini ba goe zwɛɛm kaanem vara bam da to. 34Kaanem tu wom laam maa wó de o noa boŋo kom jana ne, se o ma jana bam o taare zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam nyea yana yam. Jana balo na daare to ye se o lwo-ba zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne mo. 35O ta jege se o lɔɔne pia kam lara kam mo, nenɛɛne o na ke tei dedaane yazura pɛɛre pia lara kam to. O ta wó kwei lara kam o daŋe Baŋa Wɛ pɛɛra yadwonna yam baŋa ne o daare o zwɛ-ka kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. Kaanem tu wom wó da chwoŋa kam konto o ma le lwarem delo nɔɔno wom na ke to, se Wɛ de kwei o tusim dem o ma chɛ‑o.

english_text:
The Lord said:
1If you refuse to testify in court about something you saw or know has happened, you have sinned and can be punished.
2You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
3You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
4You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
5As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done. 6Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
7If you are poor and cannot afford to bring an animal, you may bring two doves or two pigeons. One of these will be a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, and the other will be a sacrifice to please me.
8Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head, 9splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar. 10Then he will follow the proper rules for offering the other bird as a sacrifice to please me.
You will be forgiven when the priest offers these sacrifices as the price for your sin.
11If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it. 12Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me. 13By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices.
Sacrifices To Make Things Right
(Leviticus 7.1-10)
14-15The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to:
If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests. 16In addition, you must pay what you owe plus a fine of 20 percent. Then the priest will offer the ram as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven.
17-19If you break any of my commands without meaning to, you are still guilty, and you can be punished. When you realize what you have done, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven.
translation_text:
Wɛleere saarem taane
1Abam wolo ná nɛ keim de o yi, naa o nigi de ŋwa, ye ba ná bwoŋi‑o se o ba o pa maana, kotu ná ve se o zaŋe o ta o bere chega keim dem konto baŋa ne, o tusi mo. O maŋe se o na waarem ko ŋwaane.
2Abam wolo ná dwei wo-teko kolo na jege digiru Wɛ chullu tem seeni to, ye o ná wo maane ko ni ne, kotu wɛleere ta wo o yuu ne mo. Wo-teko kom ná ye ga-varem, naa sɔŋɔ varem, naa tega-veilu, ye kotu ná dwei-ko, o digiri o tete mo de chullu tem.
3Abam wolo ta ná dwei woŋo kolo na nwoŋi nabiina yera yam ne ye ko biini nɔɔna to mo, ko ná maŋe ko jege digiru dwi delo, kotu ya ná wo maane ye o laam ba o lɔre ko ni ne, o wɛleere ta wo o yuu ne mo.
4Ko ta woli da, abam wolo ná wo zuri o yera ye o du duuri yɔɔ yerane, ko ná ye o gwoni ni se o ke totoŋ-laao naa totoŋ-balɔrɔ, kotu tusi mo. O ná dugi duuri yɔɔ yɔɔ woŋo kolo maama ŋwaane, ne o ya ná maŋe o yeiri ko ni ne ye o laam ba o lɔre, kotu wɛleere wo o yuu ne mo.
5Chwei sento maama wone mo, abam wolo ná tu o maane we o sage chwoŋa, se o ta o wɛleera jaja Wɛ yiga ne. 6Kotu nam wó ja pi-choa naa bo-choa mo o ja o ba o ke wɛleere saarem kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ se o ma o ŋwe o wɛleere jene. Kaanem tu wom maa wó kwei varem wom o ma o le kotu lwarem dem Wɛ yiga ne.
7Wolo nam ná ware varem o yi, se kotu ja kunkwona balei, naa kunkwon-puura balei o ba, se o ma o ŋwe o wɛleere jene. O wó kwei zuŋa dedoa o ma o ke wɛleere saarem kaanem, se dedoa kam de toŋe zwɛɛm kaanem. 8Kotu wó ja kunkwona bam o vo o ke kaanem tu wom jeŋa ne. Kaanem tu wom maa wó bobo o kwei dedoa o ma o ke wɛleere saarem kaanem dem. O jege se o bwori ka ba mo se o yé gwori ka yuu. 9O ta wó ma ka jana bam badwonna o miisi kaanem dakaa kam saŋa dedoa ne. Jana balo na daare to, se o lwo ba maama o yage kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne. Konto ye wɛleere saarem kaanem dem mo. 10O maa wó ma kunkwoŋa kadwoŋi kam o ke zwɛɛm kaanem dem, nenɛɛne de chwoŋa kam na ye tei to. Kaanem tu wom jege se o tɔge konto baŋa mo o ma le nɔɔno wom lwarem dem, se Wɛ kwei kotu tusim dem o ma chɛ‑o.
11Nɔɔno nam ná ba jege kunkwona balei, naa kunkwon-puura balei se o ja o ba, kotu nam wó ja mun-bwei bwɛ selei o ja o ba o ma o ke wɛleere saarem kaanem mo. O nam yé woli nuga naa talwoŋ-ywoŋa de wone, kokuri to, ko ye wɛleere saarem kaanem mo. 12Kotu wó ja muni dem o vo o ke kaanem tu wom jeŋa ne. Kaanem tu wom wó zwɛ jaguli-yi se de taa ye gulim pɛɛre de pa Wɛ mo. O wó zwɛ-de kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne o woli de wodiu pɛɛra yadwonna na zwɛ ya pae Baŋa Wɛ to. Konto ye wɛleere saarem kaanem dem mo. 13Kaanem tu wom wó tɔge chwoŋa kam konto mo, se o le nɔɔno wom lwarem dem Wɛ yiga ne, se Wɛ de yage o tusim dem o ma chɛ‑o. Muni delo maama ná daare, de ye kaanem tu wom nyem mo, nenɛɛne wodiu pɛɛre ná daare, ko de na ye o nyem tei to.”
Wɛleere jene kaanem
14 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses o we:
15“Abam wolo maama ná sage chwoŋa ye o ná pini Baŋa Wɛ wonnu telo na ye wose to baŋa ne, ye o wo paale o ke o tusi konto, kotu wó ja pi-bala kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to mo o ja o ba o pa Baŋa Wɛ se o ŋwe o wɛleere dem jene. Pi-bala kam sabu wó maŋe de lu-nyenno telo dunni na tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke to. Konto ye wɛleere jene kaanem dem mo. 16Kotu ta wó jwoori o ŋwe o na pini Wɛ kolo baŋa ne to jene dem, se o ta ŋwe jene dem popɔra dedoa senu maama wone o woli da. O wó ŋwe tento maama o pa Wɛ kaanem tu wom, se wonto laam kwei pi-bala kam o ma ke wɛleere jene kaanem se o le nɔɔno wom lwarem dem Wɛ yiga ne. Wɛ maa wó yage kotu tusim dem o ma chɛ‑o.
17Abam wolo ná chɔge o ke kolo na chuli Baŋa Wɛ ni delo maama wone to, ye o ya ná yeiri ko ni ne de, kotu tusim dem wo o yuu ne mo ye o maŋe se o na waarem. 18Kotu nam jege se o ja pi-bala kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to mo o ja o ba o ke kaanem tu wom jeŋa ne se wonto ma o ke wɛleere jene kaanem. Varem wom sabu wó maŋe de kolo na ye chekke to. Ko ná ke konto, kaanem tu wom wó le nɔɔno wom lwarem dem Wɛ yiga ne, de o na tusi ye o wo paale o ke tei to. Wɛ maa wó yage kotu tusim dem o ma chɛ‑o.
19Konto ye wɛleere jene kaanem mo, kotu na tusi Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne pa se o wɛleera wo o yuu ne to ŋwaane.”

english_text:
Other Sins That Need Sacrifices or Payments
(Numbers 5.5-10)
1-3 The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord:
You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
4When this happens, you must return what doesn't belong to you 5and pay the owner a fine of 20 percent. 6-7In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong.
Daily Sacrifices
(Exodus 29.38-43; Numbers 28.1-8)
8-9The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord:
You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning. 10The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar. 11Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
12The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
13The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out.
Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord
The Lord said:
14When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar, 15where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 16-17The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
18Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change.
When Priests Are Ordained
19The Lord spoke to Moses 20and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained:
It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour 21mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 22-23Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten!
Sacrifices for Sin
(Leviticus 4.1,2)
24The Lord told Moses 25how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin:
This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar. 26The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent, 27and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place. 28If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
29This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it. 30None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_text:
1 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses o we:
2“Abam wolo ná tusi ye o nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne de o na gane o dwoŋi tei to, kotu na jege se o ke tei to mo tento. Ko wó taa ye nenɛɛne o ná pini o dwoŋi woŋo mo o ya na kwei o pa‑o se o taa nia, naa o ná yɔɔre o vere o dwoŋi wonnu, naa o ná ke swa o gane‑o, 3naa o ná nɛ woŋo kolo na jei to ye o fɔ vwa we o wo nɛ-ko, naa o ná fɔge vwa wonnu tedwonna ŋwaane pa se o tusi ne nabiina na yeini ba tusi tei maama to. 4Nɔɔno ná tusi konto dwoŋi ye o maane we o wɛleere dem wo o yuu ne, kotu jege se o jwoori o ŋwe kolo o na vere to o pa o dwoŋi wom mo. Ko ná ye wonnu telo o na pini to, naa jejegero telo o na vere to, naa wo-jiu kolo o na nɛ to, 5naa woŋo kolo o na fɔge vwa ko baŋa ne to, se o jwoori o ŋwe te maama ni ne, ye o ta woli ko sabu popɔra dedoa popɔre senu maama wone. O maa wó ke konto mo o pa te tu wom dɛ dem o na tu se o ke o wɛleere jene kaanem dem to. 6Kotu ta jege se o ja pi-bala kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to mo o ba o pa Baŋa Wɛ se o ma o ŋwe o wɛleere jene. O wó kwei pi-bala kam o ke Wɛ kaanem tu jeŋa ne se o ma o ke wɛleere jene kaanem dem.
