13Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
14This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death. 15-16And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
17 Death is also the penalty for murder, 18but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced. 19Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime— 20 a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth. 21It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder. 22 I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
23When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_text:
Wara-vwei dem min-zwonnu tem
1 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses o we:
2“Ta de Isarele tiina bam se ba ja Olivi nuga kalo na ye chekke to ba ba ba pa‑m min-zwonnu tem ŋwaane. Konto mo wó pa se te mini taa di taa, ye de ba dwia. 3Dɛ maama wɛ-zoore maŋa ne, Aron wó nii mo se min-zwonnu tem taa di Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne taa, se tega vo ka poore. Te nam wó taa wo wara-vwei di-yuu kom ne mo mɛ gare-jale dem na kwoli ni-gwonim dakaa kam to. Abam de á dwi dem wó taa tɔge ni dento mo taa wuu. 4Aron maa wó pa se min-zwonnu tem taa zege sabu-seŋa min-zwon-zego kom yuu ne konto, se te mini taa di taa Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.
Wara-vwei dem bworobworo kom
5Nam viiri-na mun-bwei se á ma-de á wɔ bworobwooru fuga-telei. Abam wó kwei muni bwɛ sena mo á ma á ke bworobworo maama. 6Laam kwei-na bworobwooru tem á tiŋi gene selei. Teredo wó taa wo gena maama wone. Te nam wó taa tigi tabolo kolo sabu-seŋa na kwoli ko maama ye ko zege Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to baŋa ne mo. 7Ta kwei-na talwoŋ-ywoŋa á ke gena maama wone, se kanto leiri bworobwooru tem yuu ne ka ji wodiu pɛɛre ka pa Baŋa Wɛ. 8Wɛ siu dɛ maama wone, Aron wó tiŋi bworobwooru tem konto mo Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Isarele tiina bam jege se ba taa ke konto mo maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. 9Bworobwooru tem konto ye Aron de o bia bam nyem mo. Ba nam jege se ba di-te jeiga kalo na ye wose to ne mo, te na tiini te ye wose to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ pɔɔre-te o pɛɛra yam maama wone se te taa ye kaanem tiina bam nyem mo.”
Nɔɔno ná lwɛ Baŋa Wɛ kotu na wó na waarem delo to
10-11Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem wora o kwo na ye Ejipti tu. O nu maa ye Isarele tu, o yere mo Selomifa. Wonto kwo yere mo Dibiri, ye o nwoŋi Dan dwi dem wone. Nɔɔno wom déem nwoŋi o ke jara de Isarele tu ba zoorem jei sem ne. Ba jara yam ne, mo nɔɔno wom sɔɔle lwarem o ma lwɛ Baŋa Wɛ yere dem. Ba ma ja‑o ba vo Moses tei. 12Ba ma ja nɔɔno wom ba pe, ye ba daare ba cheigi se Baŋa Wɛ veere o boboŋa o bere-ba nɔɔno wom taane dem baŋa ne.
13 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de Moses o we:
14“Ja-na nɔɔno wom á nwoŋi abam na zoore mɛ to á vo dáa. Balo maama na nigi nɔɔno wom ta-balɔrɔ to maa wó daŋe ba je o yuu ne. Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom laam maa wó dole‑o de kandwa ba go. 15Nam ta de Isarele tiina bam maama we, wolo ná lwɛ o Tu Wɛ wom, konto tu tusim dem wó taa wo o yuu ne mo ye o maŋe se o na waarem. 16Wolo maama ná yaale Baŋa Wɛ yere, konto tu jege se o te mo. Á kɔgɔ kom maama jege se á dole‑o á go mo. O ná ye Isarele tu, naa o ye veiru mo de, kotu maŋe se o te mo.
17Nɔn-goro waarem ye se ba go o de mo. 18Nɔɔno nam ná go o dwoŋi varem, se o jwoori o yiri varem o pa varem wom tu. Woŋo kolo na ŋwe to mo wó leiri woŋo kolo na gɛ ko ŋwea to yuu ne. Ŋwea mo ba wó yiri ba ma ba leiri ŋwea. 19Nɔɔno ná ke zonne o dwoŋi yera ne, se ba ke o de zonne se de maŋe de zonne delo o na ke o dwoŋi wom yera ne to. 20Wolo ná bwori o dwoŋi yera kua, se ba bwori kotu de yera kua. Yi mo ba wó le ba ma leiri yi. Yeili de mo ba wó guri ba ma leiri yeili. Zonne delo maama o na ke o dwoŋi yera ne to, mo ba wó ke o de yera ne. 21Nɔɔno ná go varem, se o jwoori o yiri varem wom o pa o na go wolo varem to. Wolo nam ná go o dwoŋi nabiinu, se ba go o de. 22Ni dento zege de pae Isarele tiina maama mo, de veira balo na zoore de abam to. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”
23Moses ma yɔɔre o kwei Wɛ nia yam konto maama o pa Isarele tiina bam. Ba laam ma ja nɔɔno wom ba nwoŋi ba kɔgɔ kom zoorem jeiga kam ba vo dáa. Ba ma dole‑o de kandwa ba go. Konto to, Isarele tiina bam déem ke ne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se ba ke tei to mo.

english_text:
The Seventh Year
(Deuteronomy 15.1-11)
1 When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him 2to say to the community of Israel:
After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven. 3You may raise grain and grapes for six years, 4but the seventh year you must let your fields and vineyards rest in honor of me, your Lord. 5This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce. 6-7However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own.
The Year of Celebration
The Lord said to his people:
8Once every 49 years 9on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land. 10This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families. 11This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce. 12In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
13During this year, all property must go back to its original owner. 14-15So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat. 16If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce. 17I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
18-19If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops. 20Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest. 21I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years. 22In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
23No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
24When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
25If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back, 26if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it, 27you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again. 28But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
29If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back. 30If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration. 31But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration. 32If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back. 33And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel. 34No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession.
Help for the Poor
The Lord said:
35 If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you. 36-37 Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live. 38Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
39 Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves. 40Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free, 41so they and their children may return home to their families and property. 42I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves. 43So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
44If you want slaves, buy them from other nations 45or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property. 46You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
47Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country, 48you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother 49or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom 50by paying your owner for the number of years you would still be a slave before the next Year of Celebration. 51-52The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay. 53And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated. 54If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration. 55People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_text:
Bena yarepɛ bene dem
Nwoŋim 23:10-11; Nia Gulim 15:1-11
1Moses déem na wo Sinayi peo kom yuu ne to, Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we:
2“Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Abam ná zo tega kalo amo Baŋa Wɛ na lage a pa abam se á ta‑á tei to wone, se á pa tega kam sii bene delo maama na ke yarepɛ to wone. 3Kwei-na bena yaredo se á du á kadwi, de á kare sem wone. Nam ta fɔge-na á kwɛ á Vini teeni, se á daare á la á wodiiru á zo diga bena yaredo wone. 4Se ko ná ye bena yarepɛ bene dem, yage-na tega kam se ka de sii. De wó taa ye siu bene mo de pae Baŋa Wɛ. Yé du-na á kadwi de á kare wone, nam yé kwɛ-na á Vini teeni dem. 5Ko ná ye wodi-twaro telo na ke te tete yerane to, yé la-te á ja á zo diga. Ta yé gwori-na Vini tio-bia balo teeni dem na leiri de tete yerane to. Bene dem maama wone, tega kam wó yɔɔre ka sii mo. 6De ko de, ka ta wó ke wodiiru ka pa abam, pa se abam tete, de á kabɛ, baara de kaana maama, de balo á na jene se ba toŋe ba pa abam to, de veira balo na zoore abam tei ne to, 7de á sɔŋɔ vara, de kago-vara maama di te wone mo. Á jege chwoŋa se á di wodiiru telo maama tega kam na ke to.
Wonnu yirim bene dem
8Yeini á jeeli bena yarepɛ yarepɛ kuni berepɛ, se bena finna-nogo kɛ. 9Bena finnu bene dem ne, ko ná yi chane serepɛ chana kam da fuga dɛ ne, á wó pa se ba taa kare tega kam jei maama ne ba wui nabwanno. Wɛleera saarem dɛ dem ne mo á wó ke konto. 10Abam wó pɔɔre bene dem konto se de taa ye de yera Wɛ ŋwaane. Á wó taa kare tega kam maama ne á tɔɔle á bere nɔɔna maama we wonnu yirim bene dem mo yia. De ye ywoni dim bene mo de pae abam. Abam wolo maama ya ná kwei o nabaara tega o yeigi, se kotu jwoori o taa tei-ka. Ba ná yeigi wolo se o ji kabaa, se kotu de jwoori o chorro tei zɛɛra. 11Bena finnu bene dem na ye ywoni dim bene de pae abam to ŋwaane, yé du-na á kadwi de á kare wone, nam yé la-na wodi-twaro á ja á zo diga. Ta yé gwori-na Vini tio-bia balo teeni dem na leiri de tete yerane to. 12Bene dem konto maama ye de yera mo Wɛ ŋwaane. Nam di-na á kadwi de á kare wodiiru telo na ke te tete yerane to.
13Wonnu yirim bene dem konto wone, abam wolo maama ya ná kwei o nabaara tega o yeigi, se kotu jwoori o taa tei-ka. 14Konto ŋwaane abam ná lage á yeigi tega á pa daane, nam lɔre-na se á yé pini daane. 15Nmo ná boŋe se n yeigi tega n dwoŋi tei ne, se n jeeli ka sabu se ko maŋe de bena yalo na maŋe ya kɛ ya gaale wonnu yirim bene dem to. N dwoŋi wom maa wó jwoŋi sabu se ko maŋe de bena yalo ta na daare se á ta‑á zage wodiiru ye wonnu yirim bene dem daa yi to. 16Bena yalo na daare to ná daga, se tega kam sabu ke ko ke yiga ne. Wonnu yirim bene delo nam daa na beene to ná twɛ se de yi, se á pa sabu kom tu tega. Kokuri to, tega kam tu lage o yeigi wodiiru zagem bena mo o pa o dwoŋi wom. 17Ta‑á kɔre-na á Tu Wɛ wom, se á yé pini daane. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.
18Nam tɔge-na amo nia yam, de a bera yam maama se á ta‑á ke-ya. Konto wó pa se á ta‑á zoore tega kam wone de wo-zuru. 19Tega kam de nam wó ke wodiu lanyerane ka pa abam, se á ta‑á di á sui ye á jege yazura.
20Nɔɔno nam wae o bwei we, ‘Bɛ mo dé nam wó di bena yarepɛ bene dem wone, ye dé ba jege chwoŋa se dé du tega ne, dé maa dae se dé zage wodiu dé zo diga?’ 21Ko na ye tei to, amo Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ tega kam swolim pa se bena yaredo bene dem wone, abam kare sem, de á kadwi sem ke wodiu kolo na wó yi bena yatɔ to. 22Bena nana bene dem ná yia ye á lage á du tega kam ne, á ta wó ta‑á jege wodiu kolo á na zage bena yaredo bene dem wone to á di. Á ta wó di wodiu kom konto se ko yi bena nogo bene dem wodiiru zagem maŋa kam.
23Abam dae se á kwei tega á yeigi á pa nɔɔno se kotu taa tei-ka taa wuu. Tega kam ye amo Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. Abam ye veira mo amo na sɛ se á ta‑á jege-ka á toŋa. 24Á ná jege tega jei selo maama ne ye á yeigi-ka á pa daane, chwoŋa wó taa tigi mo se tega kam tu jwoori o yeigi-ka.
25Yiniga ná tiini ka ja abam wolo, pa se konto tu kwei o tega o yeigi, o yera nɔɔno wolo na maŋe se o nii‑o to wó jwoori o yeigi tega kam se ba taa tei-ka. 26Yiniga tu nam ná kwei o tega o yeigi, ye o ná ba jege yera nɔɔno se kotu jwoori o yeigi-ka, kotu jeŋa ná tu ka gara pa se o boŋe se o jwoori o yeigi o tega kam o ya na kwei-ka o yeigi o pa wolo to tei ne, 27o jege chwoŋa se o ke konto. O nam wó jeeli bena yam se ko zege maŋa kalo o ya na yeigi-ka o pa nɔɔno wom to, ye o laam ŋwe tega kam sabu o pa‑o se ko maŋe de bena yalo ta na daare to. O daa maa wó jwoori o taa tei tega kam. 28Kotu nam ná ba jege sabu se o ŋwe ne ko na maŋe tei to, wolo na yeigi tega kam o tei ne to nam mo wó taa tei-ka se ko yi wonnu yirim bene dem. Maŋa kam konto ne mo ba laam wó kwei tega kam ba jwoori ba pa ka tu.
29Wolo ná jege o sɔŋɔ teo kolo na lɔge ko pe to wone, ye o kwei-ko o yeigi o pa nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o jege chwoŋa se o kwei bene dedwe o jwoori o yeigi-ko nɔɔno wom tei ne. 30Bene dedoa nam ná kɛ, ye kotu ná ware se o jwoori o yeigi o sɔŋɔ kom, chwoŋa daa tera se o jwoori o yeigi-ko. Ko lɛɛre ko ye wolo na yeigi-ko to de o dwi dem nyem mo se ko taa vei wuu. Wonnu yirim bene dem ná yia, sɔŋɔ kom daa bá jwoori ko ji wolo na yeigi-ko o pa to nyem. 31Ko daare sam na wo te-balwa balo na wo lɔge ba pe to wone, dento kikia nye de tega yeiga na ye tei to mo. Wolo ná kwei o sɔŋɔ kom konto o yeigi, kotu jege chwoŋa se o jwoori o yeigi-ko maŋa de maŋa. Ko maa ná yi wonnu yirim bene dem, ba wó jwoori ba kwei-ko ba pa kotu mo.
32Ko nam ná ye Levi dwi tiina na zoore teene delo wone to, Levi dwi tu wolo ná yeigi o sɔŋɔ o pa nɔɔno wodwoŋi, kotu jege chwoŋa se o jwoori o yeigi-ko nɔɔno wom tei ne maŋa de maŋa. 33Ba ná yeigi sɔŋɔ kolo maama na wo Levi tiina teene dem wone to, chwoŋa wora se ba jwoori ba yeigi-ko maŋa de maŋa. Wonnu yirim bene dem ná yia, sɔŋɔ kom wó jwoori ko ji Levi dwi tu wom nyem mo. Kokuri to, sam delo na wo Levi dwi tiina teene dem wone to yerane mo ye banto jejegero Isarele dwi tiina tega kam maama wone. 34Ko daare ko ná ye vara pwoli selo na kaare Levi tiina teene dem to, chwoŋa tera se ba kwei-se ba yeigi. Tega kam konto ye ba nyem mo se ko taa vei wuu.
Yiniga tiina wolim taane
35Abam chorro Isarele tiina bam wolo ná ware se o nii o tete baŋa ne o yiniga ŋwaane, se á woli kotu ne á na wó ke tei de veira balo na zoore abam tei ne to. Konto wó pa se o de wane o zo de abam. 36Nmo ná jene sabu n pa yiniga tu, se n yé pa se o ŋwe sabu-daŋɔ o pa‑m. Nam kɔre-na á Tu Wɛ wom! Woli-na á dwonna bam se ba taa zoore á tei ne. 37Ko dae se á dɔne nyɔɔre á chorro tem baŋa ne de á na jene kolo maama á pa-ba to, ne ko ná ye sabu, naa wodiu de.
38Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A déem jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne se a daare a pa abam Kanaan tega kam, se a taa ye abam Tu Wɛ wom mo.
39Abam chorro Isarele tiina bam wolo yiniga ná jaane‑o pa se o kwei o tete o yeigi o pa‑m se n ta‑n tei‑o, ko dae se nmo pa o taa toŋa o pa‑m ne kabaa tei. 40Yage se o taa zoore nmo tei ne, ne o ye veiru naa wolo n na jene se o toŋe o pa‑m to. O nam wó taa toŋa o pa‑m se ko taa nii wonnu yirim bene dem maŋa mo. 41Bene dem konto ná yia, se n yage o de o bia se ba viiri. O wó jwoori o sɔ-yuu tiina bam tei mo se o taa zoore o nabaara tega kam baŋa ne. 42Chega to, Isarele tiina bam ye amo Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena mo. Amo mo jaane-ba a nwoŋi Ejipti wone a ba ywo-seeni. Konto ŋwaane ko dae se nɔɔno yeigi-ba ne kabɛ tei to. 43Yé bɛɛse-ba-na! Nam kɔre-na á Tu Wɛ wom se á ta‑á sɛ o ni.
44Abam nam jege chwoŋa se á vo teene delo na gilimi abam to wone á yeigi kabɛ, á pa á tete. 45Ko ta ná ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo na tu ba zoore abam jei sem ne to, de ba bia, á ta jege chwoŋa se á yeigi-ba se ba ji á kabɛ se á ta‑á tei-ba. 46Á ná tega á daare-ba, á wó wane á pa se ba ji á bia kabɛ, se ba toŋe ba pa banto de se ko taa vei ba toone. Ko daare ko ná ye á chorro Isarele tiina bam, yé bɛɛse-ba-na.
47Dwi-gɛ tu wolo na zoore abam jei sem ne to ná duni, ye yiniga ná jaane Isarele tu wodwoŋi pa se o kwei o tete o yeigi o pa dwi-gɛ tu wom naa o sɔŋɔ tiina, 48chwoŋa wora se ba jwoori ba yeigi Isarele tu wom veiru wom tei ne. Isarele tu wom choro mo wó jwoori o yeigi‑o. Ko ná ye o nyaane, naa o zembaaro, 49naa o kwo choro, naa wonto bu, naa o yera nɔɔno wodwoŋi mo, banto jege chwoŋa se ba jwoori ba yeigi‑o se o taa tei o tete. Ko nam dáa ná dae konto, kotu jeŋa ná tu ka gara, o wó wane o jwoori o yeigi o tete. 50Kotu wó jeini de wolo na yeigi‑o to, ye ba jeeli bena yam se ko zege maŋa kalo o na yeigi o tete to, se ko yi wonnu yirim bene delo na wó ba to. Sabu kolo kotu na wó ŋwe to jege se ko maŋe de ba na yeini ba jene nɔɔna ba toŋe ye ba ŋwe-ba tei to mo. 51Bena dedɛ nam ta ná dɔra se wonnu yirim bene dem yi, nɔɔno wom wó jwoori o ŋwe se ko maŋe de konto mo o pa veiru wom. 52Bena yalo na daare to nam ná ba daga, se o jwoori o ŋwe sabu fenfee ne ba na jeeli-ko tei to.
53Kotu ta ná wo veiru wom tei ne o toŋa, veiru wom jege se o ke‑o ne ba na jene nɔɔno bene de bene wone pa se o toŋe tei to mo. Yé sɛ-na se veiru wom taa jege Isarele tu wom o bɛɛsa. 54Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ná wo wane se o tɔge chwei sento maama wone se o jwoori o yeigi o dwoŋi Isarele tu, wonnu yirim bene dem ná yia, ba nam jege se ba yage Isarele tu wom se o de o bia viiri zɛɛra mo.
55Isarele tiina bam ye amo Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena mo. Amo mo jaane-ba a nwoŋi Ejipti wone. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_text:
Blessings for Obeying the Lord
The Lord said:
1 I am the Lord your God! So don't make or worship idols or images. 2Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
3 Faithfully obey my laws, 4and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit. 5Your harvest of grain and grapes will be so abundant, that you won't know what to do with it all. You will eat and be satisfied, and you will live in safety. 6I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks. 7You will chase and destroy your enemies, 8even if there are only 5 of you and 100 of them, or only 100 of you and 10,000 of them. 9I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you. 10Your barns will overflow with grain each year. 11I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust. 12 I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people. 13I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high.
Punishment for Disobeying the Lord
The Lord said:
14-15 If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement, 16I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant, 17and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack. 18Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins, 19until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper. 20All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
21If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve! 22I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
23If you remain my enemies after this, 24I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse. 25War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies. 26You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
27Then if you don't stop rebelling, 28I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins! 29In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children. 30I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me. 31I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices. 32Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it. 33After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
34-35While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there. 36-37In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you. 38Many of you will die in foreign lands, 39and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
40-41Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right, 42 I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land 43and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
44 No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies. 45While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
46Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_text:
Ni-sɛɛm na wó ja Wɛ swolim delo de ba to
1“Yé zaŋe-na á ke jwona se á zuli-ya. Nam yé mɔ-na kamwaro, naa se á cheili kandwa, naa a sare-ya á pa se ya ji wa-yɔɔro se á zuli-ya. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.
2Ta‑á yei-na amo siu da yam ni ne, se á daare á ta‑á nege amo wara-jei sem. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.
3Abam ná sɛ amo bera yam, ye á toŋe á tɔge amo nia yam, 4amo de wó toŋe doa se ka ne ka maŋa ne, se á wodiiru ke lanyerane. Abam teeni dem de maa wó lei bia dedɛ. 5Abam wodiiru na wó puli dedɛ konto to, abam ta wó ta‑á zage wodiiru mo ye á Vini tio-bia maŋe ba yi se á gwori-ba. Abam nam bá gwori á teeni bia á ti, de duum maŋa na yi se á du á wo-dwa. Abam wó ta‑á jege á di á sui á boboŋa, ye á zoore á tega kam ne de wo-zuru.
6Amo wó pa se á ta‑á zoore tega kam ne de yazura. Á maa wó peini á dɔ ye foone ba jege abam. Amo wó le kago-vara se ba yé taa wo abam tega kam wone, ye a daare a che á dona. 7Chega to, abam wó zeili á dona á di dam ba baŋa ne, ye á go-ba. 8Abam nɔɔna banu wó na dam se á zeili á dona bam nɔɔna bi. Abam nɔɔna bi de wó zeili ba nɔɔna morro fuga ye á wane-ba á go.
9Amo yiga wó taa wora de abam, pa se á na bia dedɛ ye á puli de dam. A maa wó su ni-gwonim delo a na tiŋi de abam to. 10Abam wodiiru na wó tiini te gaale to ŋwaane, ko ná yi se á zage wodiiru, ben-dwoori dem wodiu ta wó taa wo á tuli ne, pa se á dole-ko á yage se á na jei á ke á wodi-doŋo da.
11Amo maa wó ba a taa zoore abam tetare ne. Amo bere a bá yaale abam. 12Amo wó taa wo á tei ne. A maa wó taa ye abam Tu Wɛ wom, ye abam de wó taa ye amo nɔɔna. 13Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A ma ja abam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne, se á daa yé ta‑á ye Ejipti tiina kabɛ. A ma chɔge dam delo ya na nye abam de se tega ne to, ye a jwoŋi abam pa se á vei ye á yuni wo wɛɛne.”
Zwabania taane
14“Abam nam ná ba sɛ amo kwora, ye á ba tɔge a nia yam maama, 15á ná nwoŋi amo bera yam kwaga ne, á daare á chɔge ni-gwonim delo a na ke de abam to, 16amo laam wó waare abam tento mo: lɛɛro wó yi abam lela, nenɛɛne jawe-chɛɛro, de sesa-dwonnu, de paa. Tento mo lage te dwei á yia, se á daare á bugi á jei. Abam ná dugi wodiiru, ko bá jwoŋi abam. Kokuri to, á dona mo lage ba vere-te á tei ne ba di ba daare abam. 17Amo tete mo lage a nwoŋi abam kwaga ne, pa se á dona di abam jara wone. Nɔɔna balo na chuli abam to wó di dam á baŋa ne. Á ta wó kwaane se á duri á lu ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba zeili abam.
18Tento maama nam ná yi abam ye á ta ve se á sɛ amo kwora, a laam wó pa se á waarem dem puli de ke da kuni berepɛ mo á wɛleera yam ŋwaane. 19Amo maa wó pa se á kamunim dem ba de tu tega. Amo wó che se doa yé ne ka pa abam, se á tega kam ko ye ka taa dana nenɛɛne luu na ye tei to. 20Abam totoŋ-dɛɛra yam maama bá ja kuri ya pa abam. Kokuri to, tega kam bá ke wodiiru ka pa abam, á teeni dem de nam bá lei bia.
21Konto maama nam ná kea, ye abam ta ná ve-ne, ye á ba sɛ a kwora kam, amo laam wó pa se á cham dem puli mo de ke kuni berepɛ de woli da. 22Amo wó saase kago-vara a yage abam yera ne mo. Ba maa wó go á bia, ye ba daare ba chɔge á vara bam. Á kɔgɔ kom wó ba ko mɔ, pa se nɔɔna daa bá taa wo á chwei sem yuu ne ba via.
23De konto maama de, abam ta ná ve amo koresem dem konto, 24amo de wó ve abam. A ta wó waare abam kuni berepɛ mo a daa woli da á wɛleera yam ŋwaane. 25A lage a pa se jara mo zaŋe abam de á dona tetare ne, abam na chɔge ni-gwonim delo amo na ke de abam to ŋwaane. Abam ná duri se á zo á te-kamunnu tem wone á seigi da se á lu, amo wó pa se jawe-chɛɛro ja abam dáane. Abam dona laam maa wó na chwoŋa se ba wane abam. 26Amo wó pa se á ga wodiu se á di. Bworobworo wɔɔm jeiga dedoa wone mo kaana fuga wó lare muni ba wɔ bworobworo se ba di sem tiina di. Ba nam ná chɛ bworobworo kom se ba pa daane, diga maama wó na fenfee yerane mo. Á ná nɛ wodiu, á bá wane-ko á di á su.
27De konto maama de, abam ta ná ba sɛ amo kwora kam ye á ve-ne, 28amo laam wó yɔɔre a le a bane mo se de zaŋe abam baŋa ne. Amo ta wó waare abam á wɛleera yam ŋwaane kuni berepɛ mo. 29Kana wó tiini ka ni abam mo pa se á ja á tete bia á di. 30Amo nam wó chɔge wara-jei bimbina yam mɛ á na vei da á kaane á wa yam to. A ta wó yigi á bimbina yalo á na zwɛ talwoŋa ya baŋa ne to a de tega ne. A laam wó dogele á twa a daŋe á jwona yam baŋa ne, ya na ye wo-yɔɔro to ŋwaane. Amo wó chuli abam. 31A maa wó pa se á teene dem ji di-dwonnu yerane, ye a daare a chɔge wara-jei selo á na vei da á zuli á wa yam to. Á ná zwɛ wonnu á pa-ne, te lwom bá pwoli a wo. 32Amo tete nam mo lage a chɔge á tega kam. Abam dona ná tu se ba zo ka wone, ko wó so-ba dedɛ. 33Amo wó zeili abam a jage a yage teene dedwonna wone, jara-keim ŋwaane. Abam maama wó nwoŋi á daare á tega kam mo se ka ji di-dwonnu yerane. 34-35Ko maa wó pa se tega kam na siu, ne ko ya na maŋe se ka na bena yarepɛ maama wone to. Abam ná zoore ka wone ye á wo pɔɔre siu bene dem á pa-ka, ka laam wó sii bena yalo maama abam na wó jage á ta‑á wo á dona bam teene dem wone to.
36Abam balo na wó wori to, amo wó pa á vɔna pare ye foone ja abam á dona teene dem wone. Vɔɔ tete ná siiri tega ne á wó duri mo ko dɔnne ŋwaane. Á wó boŋe we nɔɔna mo pare abam se ba ja ye á duri se á lu. Á wó to tega ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera. 37Abam nam wó duri á tiri á to á daŋe da-baŋa ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba pare abam. Abam bá ta‑á jege dam se á wane á dwoni de á dona. 38Á wó te á dona teene dem wone, pa se á dwi dem jei dáane. 39Abam wone balo fenfee na wó daare á dona teene dem wone to de maa wó bugi ba jei. Ko nam wó taa ye wɛleera yalo ba de ba nabaara na ke to ŋwaane mo ba lage ba bugi ba jei konto.
40Ko kwaga seeni, ba nam wó wane ba sɛ we ba de ba nabaara bam seene ba tusi, ye ba daare ba chuli ba wɛleera, de ba na ywori amo kwaga ne ye ba ve amo, 41pa se amo de ve banto ye a daare a zeili-ba a ja vo ba dona teene dem ne tei to. Ba ná seene ba tu ba tete ba daare ba leiri ba boboŋ-balwaaro tem, ye ba sɛ waarem delo amo na pɛ-ba to, 42amo de wó guli a ni-gwonim dem a na ke de ba nabaara Jakob, de Izaak, de Abaraham to. Amo ta wó guli ba tega kam gula se a fɔge-ka. 43Amo nam wó zeili-ba ba tega kam ne se ka wane ka na siu, ne ko ya na maŋe se ka sii bena yarepɛ maama wone tei to. Ba ná viiri ba daare tega kam, ka laam wó na siu konto dwoŋi. Ba jege se ba na waarem delo na wó maŋe de ba wɛleera yam to mo, ba na yɔɔre ba ve amo nia yam de a bera yam to ŋwaane.
44De ko de, ba ná maŋe ba wo ba dona teene dem wone, amo bá yɔɔre a ve-ba. Amo bá yiri ni-gwonim delo a na ke de-ba to ye a daare a chɔge-ba a ti. Amo mo ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. 45A nam daa wó jwoori a guli ni-gwonim delo a na ke de ba nabaara bam to, ye a woli-ba. Amo déem jaane ba nabaara bam konto a ja nwoŋi Ejipti ne se a taa ye ba Tu Wɛ wom, ye dwi-gɛ tiina bam zege ba nia. Amo seene a ye Baŋa Wɛ wom mo.”
46 Baŋa Wɛ déem zege Sinayi peo kom yuu ne o tɔge Moses baŋa o pa Isarele tiina bam o nia yam, de o bera yam, de o chullu tem konto mo, se ba taa tɔga.

english_text:
Making Promises to the Lord
1The Lord told Moses 2to say to the community of Israel:
If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me, 3-7you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
50 pieces of silver for men
ages 20 to 60,
and 30 pieces for women;
20 pieces of silver
for young men ages 5 to 20,
and 10 pieces
for young women;
15 pieces of silver for men
ages 60 and above
and 10 pieces for women;
5 pieces of silver for boys
ages 1 month to 5 years,
and 3 pieces for girls.
8If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
9If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free. 10If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed. 11Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest, 12and let him determine its value. 13But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional 20 percent.
14If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house. 15But if you decide to buy it back, you must pay an additional 20 percent.
16If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every 20 kilograms of seed. 17If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price. 18But any time after that, the price will be figured according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration. 19If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional 20 percent, 20but you cannot buy it back once someone else has bought it. 21When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
22If you promise me a field that you have bought, 23its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine. 24However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner. 25Every price will be set by the official standards.
Various Offerings
The Lord said:
26All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me. 27If you promise me a donkey, you may buy it back by adding an additional 20 percent to its value. If you don't buy it back, it can be sold to someone else for whatever a priest has said it is worth.
28 Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me. 29In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
30 Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees. 31If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional 20 percent.
32When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me, 33no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
34Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_text:
Nɔɔno na wó kwei ni Baŋa Wɛ tei ne to
1 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de Moses o we:
2“Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Wolo ná kwei o yera nɔɔno se o ma gwoni ni o pa Baŋa Wɛ, kotu wó wane o ŋwe sabu se ko leiri o nɔɔno wom yuu ne. Nɔɔno de nɔɔno kwora na maŋe de lu-nyenno sɛkɛle na ye chekke to mo tento:
3Baaro ná maŋe de bena finlei se ko yi bena fuseredo, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala finnu o ŋwaane.
4Kaane nam ná maŋe de bena yam konto, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala fintɔ o ŋwaane.
5Bakeira ná maŋe de bena yanu se ko yi bena finlei, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala finlei o ŋwaane.
Busankana nam ná maŋe de bena yam konto, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala fuga o ŋwaane.
6Bakeira ná maŋe de chana dedoa se ko yi bena yanu, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala yanu o ŋwaane.
Busankana bena nam ná maŋe de bena yam konto, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala yatɔ o ŋwaane.
7Baaro ná kwe o yi bena fuseredo o daŋe, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala fuga-yanu o ŋwaane.
Kaane nam ná maŋe de bena yam konto, se á ŋwe lu-nyenno sabu-dala fuga o ŋwaane.
8Nɔɔno wolo ná ke ni-gwonim dem konto, ye o ba jege sabu kolo na maŋe de ni dem to, se kotu ja o nɔɔno wom o yi kaanem tu tei. Kaanem tu wom ná nii nɔɔno wom, o laam wó jeeli ni-gwonim tu wom na wó ŋwe bagera se ko maŋe de o dam na wae tei to.
9Wolo nam ná kwei vara balo na maŋe de kaanem to se o ke ni-gwonim o pa Baŋa Wɛ, vara bam konto dwoŋi maama wó ji wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. 10Chwoŋa tera se kotu kwei vare-gaa o leiri wodwoŋi wom yuu ne. Ko ná maŋe ko ye o kwei vare-ŋom mo o leiri vare-nabwom yuu ne, o dae se o ke konto. Wolo nam ná ke konto, vara balei bam maama wó ji Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. 11Ko nam ná ye varem wolo na wo maŋe de kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ to mo kotu lage se o ma o gwoni o ni dem, o nam wó ja varem wom o vo kaanem tu wom tei ne mo. 12Kaanem tu wom ná nii varem wom na jege lam tei to, o wó ta o bere nɔɔno wom o na wó ŋwe bagera to. O nam ná tage tei, ko zege konto mo. 13Varem wom tu nam ná lage se o jwoori o yeigi o varem wom, se o ŋwe varem wom sabu kom, ye o ta woli sabu kom popɔra dedoa senu maama wone.
14Nɔɔno nam ná kwei o sɔŋɔ se o ke-ko Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne, kaanem tu mo wó yi da se o nii ko dunni na mae tei to. Kaanem tu nam ná bere ko sabu se ko taa ye tei, ko zege konto mo. 15Sɔŋɔ kom tu nam ná lage se o jwoori o yeigi-ko, se o ŋwe ko sabu kom, ye o ta woli sabu kom popɔra dedoa senu maama wone. O ná ke konto, sɔŋɔ kom wó jwoori ko taa ye o nyem.
16Nɔɔno wolo ná fɔge o nabaara tega wone se o ke-ka Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne, ba wó jeeli ka kwora se ko maŋe de wo-dwa na wó maŋe tei se ba du ka wone to mo. Ba wó maŋe lu-nyenno sabu-dala finnu mo mena ywollu tetɔ maama ŋwaane. 17Ko ná ye wonnu yirim bene dem wone mo kotu kwei tega kam o pa Baŋa Wɛ, o wó ŋwe ka sabu jeelim maama na ye tei to mo. 18Se ko ná ye wonnu yirim bene dem kwaga ne mo o kwei-ka se o pa Baŋa Wɛ, ba wó jeeli ka sabu ni se ko maŋe de bena yagera ta na daare se wonnu yirim bene delo na beene to laam yi mo. Kotu bá ŋwe se ko yi ka sabu kom maama. 19Nɔɔno wom ná boŋe se o jwoori o yeigi o tega kam, se o ŋwe ka sabu kom, ye o ta woli sabu kom popɔra dedoa senu maama wone. O ná ke konto, tega kam wó jwoori ka taa ye o nyem. 20Kotu nam ná wo jwoori o yeigi-ka Baŋa Wɛ tei ne, ye o ná kwei-ka o yeigi o pa nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o daa ba jege chwoŋa se o jwoori o yeigi-ka. 21Wonnu yirim bene dem ná kaare de yi, ye ba lage ba kwei tega kam konto ba pa, ka wó yɔɔre ka ji wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Ba jege se ba pɔɔre-ka ba pa Wɛ kaanem tiina se ba taa tei-ka taa wuu.
22Nɔɔno wolo nam ná kwei tega kalo na dae o nabaara tega ye o tete yeigi-ka nɔɔno wodwoŋi tei ne to mo se o ke-ka Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne, 23kaanem tu wom mo wó jeeli ka sabu ni se ko maŋe de bena yagera ta na daare se wonnu yirim bene dem yi to. Nɔɔno wom laam maa wó ŋwe ka sabu kom dɛ dem konto wone nɔɔ. Sabu kom konto ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. 24Wonnu yirim bene dem ná yia, se nɔɔno wom kwei tega kam konto o jwoori o pa o na yeigi-ka wolo tei ne to, se wonto dwi dem taa tei-ka.
25Sabu kom konto maama dunni jege se ko tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke mo. Sɛkɛle dedoa maa ye gɛra kuni finlei.
26Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jege se o kwei wo-kwea kalo o varem na loge to o ke Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne, ka na maŋe ka ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem to ŋwaane. Ko ná ye á naane dem wone, naa á pei sem wone, naa á bone dem wone, tento wo-kwe selo maama na ye wo-bɛ to ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. 27Ko nam ná ye vara balo na wo maŋe de kaanem to wone wo-kwea, ka tu wom jege chwoŋa se o jwoori o yeigi-ka. O wó ŋwe ka sabu kom ye o ta woli sabu kom popɔra dedoa senu maama wone. Kotu nam ná wo jwoori o yeigi varem wom konto, ba jege chwoŋa se ba kwei‑o ba yeigi ba pa nɔn-gaa se ko maŋe de varem wom sabu na ye tei to.
28Wolo nam ná yɔɔre o kwei o woŋo kolo maama o ke Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne, ko ná ye o choro, naa o varem, naa o nabaara tega mo, woŋo kom konto yɔɔre ko ye wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Nɔɔno wom daa ba jege chwoŋa se o jwoori o yeigi-ko, naa o kwei-ko o yeigi o pa nɔn-gaa, ko na ye Wɛ nyem taa wuu to ŋwaane.
29Ba nam ná pɔɔre nabiinu wolo ba yɔɔre ba ke Wɛ jeŋa ne chɔgem ŋwaane, chwoŋa daa tera se ba jwoori ba yeigi konto tu Baŋa Wɛ tei ne. Ba jege se ba go‑o mo.
30Tega kam wodiu popɔre fuga maama wone popɔra dedoa ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo, ne ko ná ye wodiiru, naa tio-bia de. Abam nam wó pɔɔre-ko se ko taa ye wose Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. 31Nɔɔno nam ná boŋe se o jwoori o yeigi wodiiru tento telo, se o ŋwe te sabu kom ni ne ye o ta woli sabu kom popɔra dedoa senu maama wone. 32Sɔŋɔ vara fuga maama wone dedoa ye wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Nam jeeli-na á vara bam maama se á le wolo na ye fuga tu maama to á pa Baŋa Wɛ. 33Abam ba jege se á paale á kuri á vare-ŋona de á vare-balwaaro wone, naa se á leiri balo á na maŋe á le to yuu ne. Abam ná kwei varem se á leiri wodwoŋi yuu ne á pa Baŋa Wɛ, vara balei bam maama nam wó taa ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. Á ba jege chwoŋa se á jwoori á yeigi-ba de sabu.”
34 Baŋa Wɛ déem zege Sinayi peo kom yuu ne mo o ta o nia yam konto o bere Moses Isarele tiina bam ŋwaane.

english_text:
The People of Israel Are Counted
1 The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
2-3I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men 20 years and older who are able to fight in battle. 4-15The following twelve family leaders, one from each tribe, will help you:
Elizur son of Shedeur
from Reuben,
Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai
from Simeon,
Nahshon son of Amminadab
from Judah,
Nethanel son of Zuar
from Issachar,
Eliab son of Helon
from Zebulun,
Elishama son of Ammihud
from Ephraim,
Gamaliel son of Pedahzur
from Manasseh,
Abidan son of Gideoni
from Benjamin,
Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai
from Dan,
Pagiel son of Ochran
from Asher,
Eliasaph son of Deuel
from Gad,
and Ahira son of Enan
from Naphtali.
16-17Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders, 18called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older, 19just as the Lord had commanded. 20-46The number of men from each tribe who were at least 20 years old and strong enough to fight in Israel's army was as follows:
46,500 from Reuben,
the oldest son of Jacob,
59,300 from Simeon,
45,650 from Gad,
74,600 from Judah,
54,400 from Issachar,
57,400 from Zebulun,
40,500 from Ephraim,
32,200 from Manasseh,
35,400 from Benjamin,
62,700 from Dan,
41,500 from Asher,
53,400 from Naphtali.
The total number of men registered by Moses, Aaron, and the twelve leaders was 603,550.
47But those from the Levi tribe were not included 48because the Lord had said to Moses:
49When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe. 50-51Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
52The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners. 53But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
54The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_text:
Ba jeeli Isarele tiina bam ni
1Bena yalei bene dem chane selei chana kam boboa dɛ delo Isarele tiina bam na nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne to mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋɔɔne de Moses Sinayi kagoa kam ne. Wara-vwei dem wone mo o déem ŋɔɔne ded‑o ye o we:
2“Nmo de Aron jege se á jeeli Isarele tiina bam ni mo. Jeeli-ba-na sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga wone se á lɔre baaro maama de o yere. 3Á maa wó jeeli balo bam na yi bena finlei ba daŋe ye ba yi jara keim to ni, se á pɔɔre-ba kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ. 4Ko na ye tei to, dwi maama wó le ba sɔ-yuu yiga tu dedoa mo se kotu woli abam.
5-15Baara balo na zege dwi maama ŋwaane se ba woli abam de á totoŋe dem to yera mo tento:
Dwi dem Yiga tu wom
Ruben Sedura bu Elizura
Simeon Zurisadayi bu Selumeli
Judah Aminadabi bu Naason
Isakara Zuwara bu Netaneli
Zebulun Helon bu Eliabi
Josɛf bu Efrayim Amihuda bu Elisama
Josɛf bu Manasɛ Pedazura bu Gamaleli
Benjamin Gideoni bu Abidan
Dan Amisadayi bu Ahiyezera
Asere Ocharan bu Pageli
Gad Deweli bu Eliasafe
Nafitali Enan bu Ahira”
16Nɔɔna bam konto mo ba déem le Isarele dwia yam maama wone, se ba leiri ba kɔgɔ kom maama yuu ne ba toŋe totoŋe dem konto. Banto mo ye yiga tiina ba sɔ-yuni tem ne.
17Moses de Aron na lɔre nɔɔna bam konto yera yam to, ba déem ma seene ba ja-ba se ba woli totoŋe dem. 18Chane selei chana kam boboa dɛ ne mo ba bwoŋi Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama ba ke daane. Ba ma popone ba sɔ-yuni tem de ba di sem yera ba tiŋi. Ko ná ye baara balo maama na yi bena finlei ba daŋe to, ba déem popone nɔɔno maama de o yere. 19Ba ke se ko maŋe de Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se o ke tei to mo. Sinayi kagoa kam ne mo ba jeeli baara bam tento dwoŋi:
20-43Isarele dwia yam maama wone ba déem jeeli baara balo na yi bena finlei ba daŋe ye ba yi jara keim to ni. Ba ma popone ba yera ba tiŋi, nɔɔno maama de o sɔ-yuu kom de o diga kam mo.
Dwi dem Baara bam ni
Isarele bu-kwea Ruben 46,500
Simeon 59,300
Gad 45,650
Judah 74,600
Isakara 54,400
Zebulun 57,400
Josɛf bu Efrayim 40,500
Josɛf bu Manasɛ 32,200
Benjamin 35,400
Dan 62,700
Asere 41,500
Nafitali 53,400
44Moses de Aron dedaane Isarele yiga tiina fuga-balei bam déem na jeeli nɔɔna bam ni tei to mo konto. Nɔɔno maama nam zege o pae o diga kam mo. 45Ko nam ye Isarele tiina baara balo na yi bena finlei ba daŋe ye ba yi jara keim to mo ba jeeli ba ni. 46Baara bam maama maa ye nɔɔna morro bia yaredo de tetɔ, dedaane bia yanu de finnu (603,550).
47Ba déem nam wo jeeli Levi dwi tiina bam ba woli de dwia yadwonna yam. 48Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ déem ya maŋe o ta de Moses mo o we:
49“Abam ná lage á jeeli Isarele tiina bam ni, se á yé jeeli Levi dwi tiina bam á woli da. 50Ko nam na ye tei to, abam wó pa se Levi tiina bam mo taa nii amo wara-jei sem, dedaane jei sem konto wo zela yam baŋa ne. Banto mo wó yeini ba zeŋe wara-vwei dem de de zela yam ba ja kɛ. Ba ta wó taa toŋe de wo totoŋa ba pa-ne, se ba daare ba chwi ba vwoa ba che wara-jei sem. 51Abam ná lage á gɔ á vwoa yam se á vo jeiga kadwoŋi, ko ye banto mo wó gɔ wara-vwei dem, se ba ja-de ba kɛ. Á ná yi jeiga kam, banto mo wó chwi vwei dem jei-doŋa kam ne. Wolo maama ná dae Levi dwi tu ye o ná tiini o yi wara-vwei dem yera, se ba go konto tu.
52Ko nam ná ye Isarele tiina bam maama, ba jege se ba chwi ba vwoa mo sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, se kɔgɔ maama taa jege tuta na popone ko yere jaja to. 53Ko daare, Levi tiina bam wó chwi ba vwoa ba kaare Wɛ wara-jei sem mo. Konto wó pa se ba che se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé yi dáane se ko pa a bane zaŋe Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom baŋa ne ko ŋwaane. Ko ye Levi dwi tiina bam mo wó taa nii wara-vwei dem wonnu maama baŋa ne.”
54Isarele tiina bam déem ma yɔɔre ba ke ba tɔge ni delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses se ba ke to.

english_text:
Instructions for Setting Up Israel's Camp
1The Lord told Moses and Aaron 2how the Israelites should arrange their camp:
Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
3-4Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The 74,600 troops of the tribe of Judah will be arranged by divisions and led by Nahshon son of Amminadab. 5-6On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its 54,400 troops. 7-8On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its 57,400 troops. 9These 186,400 troops will march into battle first.
10-11Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The 46,500 troops of the tribe of Reuben will be arranged by divisions and led by Elizur son of Shedeur. 12-13On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its 59,300 troops. 14-15On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its 45,650 troops. 16These 151,450 troops will march into battle second.
17Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
18-19Ephraim and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the west side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The 40,500 troops of the tribe of Ephraim will be arranged by divisions and led by Elishama son of Ammihud. 20-21On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its 32,200 troops. 22-23On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its 35,400 troops. 24These 108,100 troops will march into battle third.
25-26Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The 62,700 troops of the tribe of Dan will be arranged by divisions and led by Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai. 27-28On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its 41,500 troops. 29-30On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its 53,400 troops. 31These 157,600 troops will march into battle last.
32So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled 603,550. 33The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
34Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_text:
Ba na chwi ba vwoa yera yera tei to
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem ta ma ta de Moses de Aron o we:
2“Isarele tiina bam maama jege se ba chwi ba vwoa yam mo dwi de dwi na ye dáa dáa ba kaare wara-jei sem. Nɔɔno maama maa wó taa jege o kɔgɔ gwɛɛm yere de o sɔ-yuu kom yere na gweere ya bere jaja to.
3-9Ko ná ye wara-jei sem wɛ-puli seeni daa kam, dwia yanto mo wó jeini se Judah dwi dem taa wo ba yiga ne. Dwi maama wó jeini de ba yiga tu tento dwoŋi mo:
Dwi dem Yiga tu wom Baara bam ni
Judah Aminadabi bu Naason 74,600
Isakara Zuwara bu Netaneli 54,400
Zebulun Helon bu Eliabi 57,400
Ba maama: 186,400
Judah kɔgɔ kom mo wó to Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom yiga ne se ba taa via.
10-16Ko ná ye wara-jei sem tega-kuri seeni daa kam, dwia yanto mo wó jeini se Ruben dwi dem taa wo ba yiga ne. Dwi maama wó jeini de ba yiga tu tento dwoŋi mo:
Dwi dem Yiga tu wom Baara bam ni
Ruben Sedura bu Elizura 46,500
Simeon Zurisadayi bu Selumeli 59,300
Gad Deweli bu Eliasafe 45,650

Ruben kɔgɔ kom konto mo wó saŋe Judah kɔgɔ kom se Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom taa via.
17Levi tiina bam nam mo wó zeŋe wara-vwei dem ba taa via kɔ-fɔrɔ kom tetare laŋa ne. Kɔgɔ maama wó taa via nenɛɛne ba na yeini ba chwi ba vwoa yam jei selo ne to mo, se nɔɔno maama taa vei de o kɔgɔ kom gwɛɛm yere na gweere de bere jaja to.
18-24Ko ná ye wara-jei sem wɛ-zoore seeni daa kam, dwia yanto mo wó jeini se Efrayim dwi dem taa wo ba yiga ne. Dwi maama wó jeini de ba yiga tu tento dwoŋi mo:
Dwi dem Yiga tu wom Baara bam ni
Efrayim Amihuda bu Elisama 40,500
Manasɛ Pedazura bu Gamaleli 32,200
Benjamin Gideoni bu Abidan 35,400
Ba maama: 108,100
Efrayim kɔgɔ kom konto mo wó saŋe ba ke batɔ tu se Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom taa via.
25-31Ko ná ye wara-jei sem baŋa seeni daa kam, dwia yanto mo wó jeini se Dan dwi dem taa wo ba yiga ne. Dwi maama wó jeini de ba yiga tu tento dwoŋi mo:
Dwi dem Yiga tu wom Baara bam ni
Dan Amisadayi bu Ahiyezera 62,700
Asere Ocharan bu Pageli 41,500
Nafitali Enan bu Ahira 53,400
Ba maama: 157,600
Dan kɔgɔ kom konto mo wó kweeli Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama wone ba taa via. Ba maama wó taa vei de ba kɔgɔ kom gwɛɛm yere na gweere de bere jaja to mo.”
32Ba déem na jeeli Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu to, ba kɔgɔ kom maama na ke daane to ye baara morro bia yaredo de tetɔ, de bia yanu de finnu (603,550). 33Ko daare, ba déem wo jeeli Levi dwi dem ni ba woli Isarele kɔ-fɔrɔ kom ne. Ko maa ye se ko tɔge de Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se o ke tei to mo.
34Isarele tiina bam déem ma yɔɔre ba ke ba tɔge ni delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses se ba ke to. Ba déem yeini ba chwi ba vwoa konto dwoŋi mo, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ. Ba déem ta na gwɛ ba maa kɛ to, nɔɔno maama tɔge de o sɔ-yuu tiina mo o via.

english_text:
The Sons of Aaron
1When the Lord talked with Moses on Mount Sinai, 2 Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, 3were the ones to be ordained as priests. 4 But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron.
The Duties of the Levites
5The Lord said to Moses:
6Assign the Levi tribe to Aaron the priest. They will be his assistants 7and will work at the sacred tent for him and for all the Israelites. 8The Levites will serve the community by being responsible for the furnishings of the tent. 9They are assigned to help Aaron and his sons, 10who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
11-13 Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. When I killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in every Israelite family and the first-born males of their flocks and herds would be mine. But now I accept these Levites in place of the first-born sons of the Israelites.
The Levites Are Counted
14In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses, 15“Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.” 16So Moses obeyed and counted them.
17Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans. 18Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei. 19Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 20And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
21The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites, 22and they had 7,500 men and boys at least one month old. 23-24The Gershonites, under the leadership of Eliasaph son of Lael, were to camp on the west side of the sacred tent. 25Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance, 26the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
27The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites, 28and they had 8,600 men and boys at least one month old. 29-30The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent. 31Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
32Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
33The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites, 34and they had 6,200 men and boys at least one month old. 35The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent. 36-37Their duties included taking care of the tent frames and the pieces that held the tent up: the bars, the posts, the stands, and its other equipment. They were also in charge of the posts that supported the courtyard, as well as their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merari clans were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
38Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
39So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was 22,000.
The Levites Are Accepted as Substitutes for the First-Born Sons
40The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families. 41They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
42Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons; 43there were 22,273 of them.
44Then the Lord said, 45“The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock. 46But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra 273 men and boys must be bought back from me. 47For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards. 48This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
49Moses collected the silver from the extra 273 first-born men and boys, 50and it amounted to 1,365 pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards. 51Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_text:
Levi dwi dem taane
1Maŋa kam Baŋa Wɛ déem na ŋɔɔne de Moses Sinayi peo kom yuu ne to, Aron de Moses diga kam tiina mo tento: 2Aron déem jege bu-baara bana mo. Nadab mo ye o bakeiri-kwea. Abihu ma saŋe o kwaga, de Eleaza, dedaane Itamara. 3Ba déem nam lwogi nuga Aron bu-baara bam konto yuu ne mo ba le-ba se ba taa ye Wɛ kaanem tiina ye ba toŋe ba pa‑o. 4Baŋa Wɛ nam pɛ se Nadab de Abihu te mo. Kokuri to, Sinayi kagoa kam seeni mo banto déem kwei min-yɔɔ ba zwɛ se ba ma zuli Baŋa Wɛ, ye o wo pɛ chwoŋa se ba zwɛ mini dem konto dwoŋi. Ba maa ba jege bia. Konto ŋwaane, Eleaza de Itamara yerane déem mo toŋe Wɛ kaanem tiina totoŋe ye ba kwo Aron ta ŋwe.
5 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses o we:
6“Pa se Levi dwi dem nwoŋi ba zege kaanem tu Aron yiga ne, se ba taa toŋe ba woli‑o. 7Banto wó taa toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa mo ba pae Aron de Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama. 8Ba wó taa nii wara-vwei dem wo zela yam baŋa ne, ye ba daare ba taa toŋe totoŋa yalo maama na maŋe de wara-jei sem to ba pae Isarele tiina bam. 9Pɔɔre Levi tiina bam se ba taa toŋe ba woli Aron de o bia bam. Le-ba Isarele dwi tiina bam maama wone se ba yɔɔre ba taa toŋe totoŋa yam konto yerane. 10Ko nam ye se n tiŋi Aron de o bu-baara bam mo se ba taa ye amo kaanem tiina. Nɔn-gaa ná tiini o yi wara-vwei dem yera, se ba go kotu.”
11 Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de Moses o we:
12“Amo kuri Levi dwi tiina bam mo se ba taa ye amo nyem. A le-ba Isarele tiina bam wone se ba leiri bakeiri-kwe selo maama abam na wó lo to yuu ne mo. 13Kokuri to, amo déem na go Ejipti tiina bakeiri-kwe sem maama to, a daare Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe sem de ba vare-kwe sem mo se ba taa ye amo nyem. Levi tiina bam mo jege se ba leiri bakeiri-kwe sem yuu ne ba ji amo nyem. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.”
Ba jeeli Levi tiina bam ni
14Sinayi kagoa kam ne mo Baŋa Wɛ déem tage de Moses o we, 15“Jeeli Levi dwi tiina bam ni se ko tɔge de ba sɔ-yuni tem, de ba di sem. Nam jeeli ba baara balo na yi chana se ko taa vei to n popone ba yera n tiŋi.” 16Moses ma seene o ke tei Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ ni se o ke to.
17Levi bia bam yera mo tento:
Gereson, de Kohafe, de Merari.
18Gereson sɔ-yuni tem ye Libini de Simeyi mo. 19Kohafe sɔ-yuni tem maa ye Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli. 20Merari sɔ-yuni tem de maa ye Mahili de Musi.
Levi dwi tiina sɔ-yuni tem mo konto.
Gereson sɔ-yuu kom de ba totoŋe dem
21Libini de Simeyi di sem déem nwoŋi Gereson sɔ-yuu kom wone mo. 22Ba baara balo na yi chana se ko taa vei ye ba jeeli ba ni to déem ye morro terepɛ de bia yanu (7,500). 23Banto sɔ-yuni tem déem mo jege se ba yeini ba chwi ba vwoa wara-vwei dem kwaga ne, de wɛ-zoore seeni. 24Gereson sɔ-yuu kom yiga tu wom déem ye Layeli bu Eliasafe mo.
25Ko déem ye Gereson sɔ-yuu tiina totoŋe mo se ba taa nii wara-vwei dem baŋa ne, de gwaaro telo na kwoli-de to, de gare-jale delo na leigi de ni dem ne to. 26Ba ta wó taa nii gare-jala yalo na kwoli wara-jei sem konkɔlɔ kom mɛ vwei dem tete de kaanem dakaa kam na wora to, de gare-jale delo na leigi konkɔlɔ kom ni dem ne to, de ŋone selo ba na mae ba chwi wara-vwei dem to. Ba ta jege se ba taa nii wonnu tem konto totoŋa yam maama baŋa ne se ya ke lanyerane.
Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom de ba totoŋe dem
27Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli di sem déem nwoŋi Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom wone mo. 28Ba baara balo na yi chana se ko taa vei to déem ye morro nana de bia yaredo (8,600) mo. Banto totoŋe dem mo ye se ba taa nii wara-vwei dem wo zela yam baŋa ne. 29Ba sɔ-yuni tem déem mo jege se ba yeini ba chwi ba vwoa yam wara-vwei dem tega-kuri seeni. 30Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom yiga tu wom déem ye Yuzeli bu Elizafan mo.
31Ko déem ye Kohafe sɔ-yuu tiina totoŋe mo se ba taa nii Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam baŋa ne, de tabolo kom, de min-zwon-zego kom, de kaanem dakɛ sem, dedaane zela yalo kaanem tiina bam na yeini ba kwei ba ma toŋe ba totoŋa to, de gare-jale delo na leigi de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to, dedaane wonnu tem konto maama totoŋa yam baŋa ne.
32Wɛ kaanem tu Aron bu Eleaza déem mo ye Levi dwi dem yiga tiina bam yuu tu. Ba ma tiŋi wonto se o taa nii balo maama na toŋe wara-vwei dem totoŋa yam to baŋa ne.
Merari sɔ-yuu kom de ba totoŋe dem
33Mahili de Musi di sem déem nwoŋi Merari sɔ-yuu kom wone mo. 34Ba baara balo na yi chana se ko taa vei ye ba jeeli ba ni to déem ye morro teredo de bia yalei (6,200) mo. 35Merari sɔ-yuu kom yiga tu wom déem ye Abihali bu Zureli mo. Banto sɔ-yuni tem déem mo jege se ba yeini ba chwi ba vwoa yam wara-vwei dem baŋa seeni.
36Ko déem nam ye Merari sɔ-yuu tiina totoŋe mo se ba taa nii ywoa yalo na jaane wara-vwei dem pa de zege to, dedaane da-gare sem, de ywoa yam, de dɛ sem na zege luuru telo baŋa ne to, de se zela yam maama baŋa ne. Ba ta jege se ba taa nii wonnu tem konto totoŋa yam maama baŋa ne mo. 37Ko ta ye Merari sɔ-yuu tiina totoŋe mo se ba taa nii wara-jei sem konkɔlɔ ywoa yam, de da-dɛɛra yam na zege luuru telo baŋa ne to, de paara yam, dedaane ŋone sem baŋa ne.
38Ko nam ná ye Moses, de Aron, de Aron bu-baara bam, ba yeini ba chwi ba vwoa yam wara-jei sem yiga ne mo, se ko jeeri wɛ-puli seeni. Banto mo lage ba taa nii wara-vwei dem de de totoŋa yam baŋa ne ba pae Isarele tiina bam. Nɔn-gaa ná tiini o yi wara-vwei dem yera, se ba go kotu. 39Levi dwi dem baara balo na yi chana ye Moses de Aron jeeli ba ni sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, ne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei to déem ye morro finlei-telei (22,000) mo.
Levi tiina de bakeiri-kwe sem jeilo kom
40 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de Moses o we, “Jeeli Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe selo maama na yi chana se ko taa vei to se n popone ba yera n tiŋi. 41Abam nam wó pa se Levi dwi tiina bam leiri á bakeiri-kwe sem yuu ne ba ji amo nyem. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom! Levi tiina vara bam de wó leiri Isarele tiina maama vare-kwe sem yuu ne ba taa ye amo nyem.”
42Moses ma seene o jeeli Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe sem ni, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ‑o ni se o ke tei to. 43Bakeiri-kwe selo na yi chana se ko taa vei ye ba popone ba yera to déem maa ye morro finlei-telei de bia yalei de fuserepɛ-batɔ (22,273).
44 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de Moses o we:
45“Laam pɔɔre Levi tiina bam se banto leiri Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe sem yuu ne ba ji amo nyem. Ta pɔɔre Levi tiina vara bam se banto de leiri Isarele tiina bam maama vare-kwe sem yuu ne. Levi dwi tiina bam wó taa ye amo nyem mo. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom. 46Ko na ye tei to, Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe sem ni daga ba dwoi Levi tiina bam ni na mae tei to, de nɔɔna 273. Abam jege se á jwoori á yeigi nɔɔna bam konto mo. 47Á wó ŋwe sɛkɛle sabu-dala yanu mo bu-kwea maama ŋwaane. Sabu kom konto dunni jege se ko tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke na ye tei to mo. Sɛkɛle dedoa maa ye gɛra kuni finlei. 48Á wó kwei sabu kom konto á pa Aron de o bu-baara bam, se á ma‑á jwoori á yeigi bakeiri-kwe selo na dwoi Levi tiina bam ni na mae tei to.”
49Moses ma sɛ ye o jwoŋi bakeiri-kwe sem konto yera sabu se o jwoori o yeigi-ba. 50Sabu kom maama déem ye sɛkɛle sabu-dala moro dedoa de bia yatɔ de fuseredo-yanu (1,365) mo. Ko dunni maa tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke na ye tei to. 51Moses laam ma kwei-ko o pa Aron de o bu-baara bam, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ ni se o ke tei to.

english_text:
The Duties of the Kohathite Clans
1The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
2-3Find out how many men between the ages of 30 and 50 are in the four Levite clans of Kohath. Count only those who are able to work at the sacred tent.
4The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent. 5When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain, 6and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
7Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself. 8They are to cover all of this with a bright red cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before putting the carrying poles in place.
9With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps. 10All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
11The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
12Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
13They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth. 14On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
15When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
16Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
17-20The Kohathites must not go near or even look at the sacred objects until Aaron and his sons have covered those objects. If they do, their entire clan will be wiped out. So make sure that Aaron and his sons go into the tent with them and tell them what to carry.
The Duties of the Gershonite Clans
21The Lord said to Moses:
22-23Find out how many men between the ages of 30 and 50 are in the two Levite clans of Gershon. Count only those who are able to work at the sacred tent.
24The Gershonites will be responsible 25for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent, 26the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things, 27and they will carry them wherever Aaron and his sons tell them to. 28These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work.
The Duties of the Merarite Clans
29-30The Lord said:
Moses, find out how many men between 30 and 50 are in the two Levite clans of Merari, but count only those who are able to work at the sacred tent.
31The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands, 32as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry, 33and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work.
The Levites Are Counted Again
34-49Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of 30 and 50 who could work at the sacred tent. There were 2,750 Kohathites, 2,630 Gershonites, and 3,200 Merarites, making a total of 8,580. Then they were all assigned their duties.
translation_text:
Kohafe tiina bam taane
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem tage de Moses o we:
2“Pɔɔre Kohafe tiina bam Levi dwi tiina badaara bam wone se n jeeli ba ni, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga. 3Ko ná ye baara balo na jege bena fintɔ se ko taa vei bena finnu ye ba yi se ba toŋe Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem totoŋa to, se n popone banto yera n tiŋi. 4Kohafe tiina bam totoŋa yam konto ye se ba taa nii wonnu telo na tiini te ye wose to baŋa ne mo.
5Ko ná yeini ko yi se á gɔ á vwoa yam se á vo jeiga kadwoŋi, Aron de o bia bam mo wó zo wara-vwei dem wone ba pare gare-jale delo na chege Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to, se ba ma-de ba kwoli Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam. 6Ba laam wó kwei twan-nyenno ba kwoli-ka, se ba daare ba kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to ba ma ba pu-ka. Ko kwaga ne, se ba laam tore dakaa kam zeŋem dɛ sem ka yera ne.
7Ko maa ná ye tabolo kolo baŋa ne ba na yeini ba ke bworobworo kolo na tigi da Wɛ ŋwaane to, ba ta wó kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to mo ba kwoli-ko. Ba laam maa wó kwei zon-tanlɛ sem, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa zwe sem, de kabeili sem, de sana pɛɛra kikeiri sem, ba zege ko baŋa ne. Bworobworo kom jege se ko yeini ko taa wo tabolo kom baŋa ne mo maŋa maama. 8Ba ná tigisi wonnu tento maama tabolo kom baŋa ne ba ti, se ba kwei gare-yi nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ ba lware ba pu-te, se ba daare ba ma twan-nyenno ba kwoli te maama. Ko kwaga ne se ba laam tore tabolo kom zeŋem dɛ sem ko yera ne.
9Ba ta wó kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to ba ma kwoli min-zwon-zego kom, de ko min-zwonnu tem, de wonnu telo na fɔge te kwɛ mini dem to, de tentwarem zon-tanlɛ sem, dedaane nuga kabɔɔro tem maama. 10Ba jege se ba kukuli-ko mo, de ko yera zela yam maama, twan-nyenno wone, se ba laam kwei-ko ba daŋe ko zeŋem dɛ sem baŋa ne.
11Ba daa ta wó kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to mo ba ma kwoli sabu-seŋa kaanem dakaa kam, se ba daare ba kwei twan-nyenno ba ma pu-ka. Ko kwaga ne se ba laam tore dakaa kam zeŋem dɛ sem ka yera ne.
12Aron de o bia bam ta wó kwaleme zela yalo maama ba na jege ba toŋe wara-jei sem wone to ye ba daare ba kukuli-te gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to wone. Ba laam maa wó kwei twan-nyenno ba ma ba pu te ni, ye ba daare ba kwei-te ba daŋe zeŋem dɛ sem baŋa ne. 13Ba ta wó kwoori tentwarem delo maama na wo zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam wone to mo ba yage, se ba daare ba kwei gare-yi na ye nasoŋ-pupwiu to ba ma kwoli-ka. 14Ba nam ta wó kwei zela yalo ba na jege ba toŋe kaanem dakaa kam totoŋa to mo ba tiŋi gare-yi dem konto baŋa ne. Ko maa ye mini zon-tanlɛ sem, de dɛ selo ba na jege ba chu ba le nɔna to, de sɛbullu tem, dedaane na-zwe sem mo. Ba ta wó kwei twan-nyenno mo ba ma ba pu te maama, ye ba laam tore dakaa kam zeŋem dɛ sem ka yera ne.
15Abam ná ti yiga se á gɔ á vwoa yam se á vo jeiga kadwoŋi, se Kohafe tiina bam ba ba zeŋe wara-jei sem yera zela de wonnu telo maama na woli ka totoŋa to se á kɛ. Ko nam ye se Aron de o bia mo da yiga ba kwoli wonnu tem konto. Te na tiini te ye wose te pae Wɛ to ŋwaane, Kohafe tiina yé dwei-te. Ba ná dwei te kolo, ba jege se ba te mo. Mo wonnu telo Kohafe sɔ-yuu tiina bam na jege se ba zeŋe ba ja kɛ to.
16Kaanem tu Aron bu Eleaza nam mo wó taa nii min-zwonnu tem wo nuga kam, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa kalo na wó zwɛ to, de dɛ dɛ wodiu pɛɛra yam, de Wɛ swolim nuga kam baŋa ne. Wonto ta wó taa nii wara-vwei dem dedaane de yera zela yalo maama na pɔɔre Baŋa Wɛ zula ŋwaane to baŋa ne.”
17 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses de Aron o we:
18“Yé pa-na se Kohafe sɔ-yuni dwi dem ti Levi tiina bam wone. 19Ba nam ná lage ba zeŋe zela yalo na ye wose to, ba na wó ke tei se ba yé te to mo tento: Aron de o bia bam mo wó zo wara-vwei dem wone se ba bere nɔɔno maama o totoŋe de woŋo kolo o na wó zeŋe to. 20Kohafe tiina bam tete nam ba jege chwoŋa se ba zo wara-vwei dem wone ba taa kare ba nii de yera zela yam, se ko yé pa ba te.”
Gereson tiina bam taane
21 Baŋa Wɛ déem tage de Moses o we:
22“Nam ta jeeli Gereson tiina bam ni, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga. 23Ko ná ye baara balo na jege bena fintɔ se ko taa vei bena finnu ye ba yi se ba toŋe Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem totoŋa to, se n popone banto yera n tiŋi. 24Gereson tiina bam totoŋa yam de zela yalo ba na wó zeŋe to mo tento: 25Ba wó taa zeŋe wara-vwei dem tete, dedaane gare-jala yalo na kwoli-de to, de twan-nyenno telo na daŋe da to, de gare-jale delo na leigi vwei dem ni ne to, 26de gare-jala yalo na kwoli wara-jei sem konkɔlɔ kom mɛ vwei dem tete de kaanem dakaa kam na wora to maama, de konkɔlɔ kom ni gare-jale dem, dedaane gwaaro tem konto ŋone de te yera zela maama. Gereson tiina bam mo wó taa toŋe wonnu tem konto maama totoŋa yam. 27Aron de o bia bam mo wó taa nii Gereson tiina totoŋa yam baŋa ne. Á wó pa-ba ni se ba lɔre woŋo de woŋo kolo maama ba na wó zeŋe to. 28Mo totoŋa yalo Gereson dwi tiina bam na jege se ba taa toŋa wara-vwei dem ŋwaane to. Kaanem tu Aron bu Itamara nam mo wó taa nii-ba se ba taa toŋe ba totoŋa yam.”
Merari tiina bam taane
29“Ta jeeli Merari tiina bam ni, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga. 30Ko ná ye baara balo na jege bena fintɔ se ko taa vei bena finnu ye ba yi se ba toŋe Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem totoŋa to, se n popone banto yera n tiŋi. 31Merari tiina bam na wó taa toŋe totoŋa yalo maama wara-vwei dem seeni to mo ye se ba zeŋe wonnu tento tem: ywoa yalo wara-vwei dem na leigi ya yera ne to, dedaane de da-gare sem, de de da-dɛɛra yam, de luuru telo baŋa ne dɛ sem na zege to, 32de da-dɛɛra yalo na kaare wara-jei konkɔlɔ kom to, de ya zegem wonnu tem, de paara yam maama, de ŋone sem, de zela yalo maama na wora totoŋa yam konto ŋwaane to. Á wó pa nɔɔno maama ni se o lɔre woŋo de woŋo kolo o na wó zeŋe to. 33Mo totoŋa yalo maama Merari dwi tiina bam na jege se ba taa toŋa wara-vwei dem ŋwaane to. Kaanem tu Aron bu Itamara nam mo wó taa nii-ba se ba taa toŋe ba totoŋa yam.”
Ba na jeeli Levi dwi tiina bam ni tei to
34Moses de Aron, dedaane Isarele kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam ma seene ba jeeli Kohafe tiina bam ni, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga. 35Ko ná ye baara balo na yi bena fintɔ se ko taa vei bena finnu, ye ba yi se ba taa toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa to, 36ba na gage-ba se ko tɔge de ba sɔ-yuni tem to, ba ye baara morro telei de bia yarepɛ de finnu (2,750) mo. 37Kohafe sɔ-yuni tem baara balo maama na toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa, ye Moses de Aron jeeli ba ni to mo konto. Ba déem jeeli-ba se ko maŋe de Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se o ke tei to mo.
38Ba déem ma jeeli Gereson tiina bam ni, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga. 39Ko ná ye baara balo na yi bena fintɔ se ko taa vei bena finnu, ye ba yi se ba taa toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa to, 40ba na gage-ba se ko tɔge de ba sɔ-yuni tem to, ba ye baara morro telei de bia yaredo de fintɔ (2,630) mo. 41Gereson sɔ-yuni tem baara balo maama na toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa, ye Moses de Aron jeeli ba ni to mo konto. Ba déem jeeli-ba se ko maŋe de Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se o ke tei to mo.
42Ba déem ma jeeli Merari tiina bam ni, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga. 43Ko ná ye baara balo na yi bena fintɔ se ko taa vei bena finnu, ye ba yi se ba taa toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa to, 44ba na gage-ba se ko tɔge de ba sɔ-yuni tem to, ba ye baara morro tetɔ de bia yalei (3,200) mo. 45Merari sɔ-yuni tem baara balo maama na toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa, ye Moses de Aron jeeli ba ni to mo konto. Ba déem jeeli-ba se ko maŋe de Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se o ke tei to mo.
46Ko déem ma pa se Moses de Aron, dedaane Isarele nakwa bam jeeli Levi tiina bam maama ni, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, diga de diga. 47Ko ná ye baara balo na yi bena fintɔ se ko taa vei bena finnu, ye ba yi se ba taa toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa ye ba zeŋe se zela to, 48ba maama déem ye baara morro nana de bia yanu de funɔnɔ (8,580) mo. 49Ba déem jeeli-ba se ko tɔge de Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo. Moses ma pa se nɔɔno maama lɔre o totoŋe dem de woŋo kolo o na wó zeŋe to.
Konto to, ba déem jeeli Levi tiina bam maama ni nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se o ke tei to mo.

english_text:
People Are Sent Outside the Camp
1The Lord told Moses 2-3to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
4The Israelites obeyed the Lord's instructions.
The Penalty for Committing a Crime
(Leviticus 6.1-7)
5 The Lord told Moses 6to say to the community of Israel:
If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me. 7You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of 20 percent. 8If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
9-10When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him.
A Suspicious Husband
11The Lord told Moses 12-14to say to the people of Israel:
Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof. 15He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
16The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there. 17He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent. 18-22Next, he will remove her veil, then hand her the barley offering, and say, “If you have been faithful to your husband, this water won't harm you. But if you have been unfaithful, it will bring down the Lord's curse—you will never be able to give birth to a child, and everyone will curse your name.”
Then the woman will answer, “If I am guilty, let it happen just as you say.”
23The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water, 24so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body. 25He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar 26and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
27If the woman has been unfaithful, the water will immediately make her unable to have children, and she will be a curse among her people. 28But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
29-30This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions. 31If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_text:
Wɛ chullu tem digiru taane
