nii á vwoa yam na chwi de nenɔŋa tei!
Jei selo á na zoore to tiini se lana.
6Á vwoa yam nye de nabare
selo na jage jei maama to.
Ya ta nye de gaara
yalo na ke buga ni ne to mo.
Abam zoorem jei ta maa ye nenɛɛne
kenkaa-vɔɔro telo Baŋa Wɛ na jeiri to,
de Sedare teeni na zege buga ni ne to mo.
7Doa wó taa nene dedɛ ka pa-ba,
pa se ba wo-dwa ke lanyerane.
Ba pɛ wó taa dana o dwoi Pɛ Agagi,
se o yere zaŋe de jage jei maama ne.
8 Baŋa Wɛ mo jaane-ba o nwoŋi Ejipti wone.
O na yeini o jaŋe tei o pa-ba to
nye de nabea kalo na ware ka ja to mo.
Ba wó wane dwia yalo na dwoni de-ba to ba li,
se ba daare ba chochoge ba kwi,
ye ba zɔ-ba de ba che-tɛɛra yam.
9Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom nye de nywoŋo
na tigi ko dɔ to mo.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ se o vo o zaŋe-ko.
Wolo ná sɔɔle swolim o ke abam yuu ne,
Wɛ de wó swɛ konto tu swolim.
Se wolo ná sɔɔle lwarem o pa abam,
Wɛ de wó sɔɔle lwarem mo o ke konto tu de yera ne.”
10Balaam na tole o taane dem o ti to, mo Balaki bane zaŋe o baŋa ne. O ma pu o jagula o mage daane ye o we, “Amo bwoŋi‑m se n ba n sɔɔle lwarem mo n chɔge a dona. Nmo nam sɔɔle lam n pa-ba tento n ke betɔ mo. 11Laam ta‑n viira! Amo ya seene a ta we a lage a ŋwe‑m dedɛ mo n totoŋa ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ nam wo pɛ‑m chwoŋa se n ke kolo na wó pa n na n ŋweero tem to.”
12Balaam ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo maŋe a ta de nɔɔna balo nmo na toŋe a tei ne to a we, 13‘Pɛ Balaki ná maŋe o lɔ sɔ-fɔrɔ mo, ye o laam su ko ni de sabu-seŋa dedaane lu-nyenno se o kwei o pa-ne de, amo ta bá wane a ve ni delo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa-ne to. A ba jege chwoŋa se a tɔge a tete boboŋa baŋa ne a ke wo-laao naa wo-balɔrɔ. Baŋa Wɛ na yeini o pa-ne ni se a ta kolo to yerane mo a jege se a ta.’ 14Tɔ. A nam seene a lage a jwoori a tete nɔɔna bam tei ne mo. Nam cheigi, se a ta a bere‑m Isarele tiina bam jwa na wó ke tei de nmo nɔn-bia bam to.”
Balaam taane bena tu
15Balaam ma bobo se o tole taane dem ye o we:
“Amo, Beora bu Balaam taane mo tento.
A yi-nɛɛre dem pae se a lɔre wonnu jaja.
16A maa yeini a ni Wɛ kwora,
pa se a lwoni o taane dem a bere nɔɔna.
A yeini a jwoŋi yeino mo Yuu-tu Wɛ wom tei ne.
A vwi a yibia tega ne ye a ta nae mo,
pa se Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom le wonnu o bere-ne.
17A na nɛ tei veera wone to dae leile woŋo.
Ko ta ba bwola se ko ke.
A ma na we dedɛɛro wó nwoŋi Jakob dwi dem wone,
ne chalechoa na puli tei to.
Pɛ wom konto wó jeini Isarele teo kom wone.
O maa wó mage Moaba tiina yuni tem o chochoge.
O ta wó chɔge Sɛfi dwi tiina bam maama.
18Wonto ta wó wane Edom tiina bam o di,
ye o pa se ba tega kam ji o nyem,
ba na ye o dona to ŋwaane.
Ko daare, Isarele tiina bam wó di yiga de dam.
19Dedɛɛro wó nwoŋi Jakob dwi dem wone.
Wonto wó chɔge balo maama ta na daare teo kom wone to.”
20Balaam ma pipiri o nii Amaleki tiina bam seeni. O ta ma tole o taane dem o we:
“Amaleki dwi tiina bam ya jege dam
ba dwoi logo baŋa dwi tiina bam maama.
Ba kweelim jei nam wó taa ye chɔgem yerane mo.”
21Balaam ta ma nii Keni tiina bam seeni. O ma tole o taane dem o we:
“Abam Keni tiina bam na zoore mɛ to dana lanyerane.
Á peiga jei maa wo peero gugworru wone.
22Nam lɔre-na we Asuri tiina bam jeŋa ná zo abam,
á maŋa yi mo konto se ba chɔge abam ba ti.”
23Balaam ta ma tole o taane dem o we:
“Lɛɛro wo á yuni ne!
Baŋa Wɛ ná boŋe se o ke konto,
wɔ mo wó wori?
24Nabwooru mo lage te nwoŋi Kitim teo kom ne te ba,
se te nɔɔna zaŋe Asuri tiina de Ebera tiina baŋa ne
ba bɛɛse-ba.
Kitim tiina bam de nam wó ba ba na ba chɔgem.”
25Balaam na tole o taane dem maama o ti to, o laam ma zaŋe o jwoori o tete sɔŋɔ. Balaki de ma zaŋe o viiri.

english_text:
The Israelites Worship Baal
1While the Israelites were camped at Acacia, some of the men had sex with Moabite women. 2These women then invited the men to ceremonies where sacrifices were offered to their gods. The men ate the meat from the sacrifices and worshiped the Moabite gods.
3The Lord was angry with Israel because they had worshiped the god Baal Peor. 4So he said to Moses, “Take the Israelite leaders who are responsible for this and have them killed in front of my sacred tent where everyone can see. Maybe then I will stop being angry with the Israelites.”
5Moses told Israel's officials, “Each of you must put to death any of your men who worshiped Baal.”
6Later, Moses and the people were at the sacred tent, crying, when one of the Israelite men brought a Midianite woman to meet his family. 7Phinehas, the grandson of Aaron the priest, saw the couple and left the crowd. He found a spear 8and followed the man into his tent, where he ran the spear through the man and into the woman's stomach. The Lord immediately stopped punishing Israel with a deadly disease, 9but 24,000 Israelites had already died.
10The Lord said to Moses, 11“In my anger, I would have wiped out the Israelites if Phinehas had not been faithful to me. 12-13But instead of punishing them, I forgave them. So because of the loyalty that Phinehas showed, I solemnly promise that he and his descendants will always be my priests.”
14The Israelite man that was killed was Zimri son of Salu, who was one of the leaders of the Simeon tribe. 15And the Midianite woman killed with him was Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite clan leader named Zur.
16The Lord told Moses, 17-18“The Midianites are now enemies of Israel, so attack and defeat them! They tricked the people of Israel into worshiping their god at Peor, and they are responsible for the death of Cozbi, the daughter of one of their own leaders.”
translation_text:
Moaba tiina soge Isarele tiina boboŋa
1Isarele tiina bam déem ma vo ba zoore Sitim ne. Ba baara bam badaara ma vo ba lage Moaba tiina bukwa se ba ke kabwoŋa de-ba. 2Moaba tiina bukwa bam konto laam ma soge Isarele tiina bam ba de ba jwona yam kaanem wone. Ko ma pa se Isarele tiina bam lɛɛre ba zuli Moaba tiina jwona yam, ye ba daare ba di ya wodiiru. 3Konto baŋa ne mo Isarele tiina bam déem tɔge ba zuli Moaba tiina jwoni Baal-Peora. Baŋa Wɛ bane ma zaŋe de-ba, 4ye o ta de Moses o we, “Nam zaŋe n ja nɔɔna banto yiga tiina bam n yɔɔre n go amo yere zula ŋwaane. Ke konto pwooni yiga ne jaja se nɔɔna maama taa zega ba nia. Konto wó pa se amo Baŋa Wɛ bane to de Isarele tiina bam.” 5Moses ma ta de Isarele tiina dedɛɛra bam o we, “Go-na baara balo maama na wo abam wone ye ba tɔge ba zuli Baal-Peora jwoni dem to.”
6Ko na ke fee to, mo Isarele tu wodwoŋi jaane Midian tiina bukɔ o zo o chorro tem vwei wone. Konto maama de Moses dedaane Isarele nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama wo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ni ne mo ba keera. Ba maama ma na nɔɔno wom na ke tei to. 7Kaanem tu Finehase de ma na-ba. O déem ye Eleaza bu mo, ye o kwo-nakwe ye Aron. O ma nwoŋi kɔ-fɔrɔ kom na wo mɛ to ne, ye o daare o kwei chichwei 8o ja o vo o tɔge nɔɔno wom kwaga o zo o vwei dem wone. Finehase na yi da to, mo o yɔɔre o moore chichwei dem ba maama yera ne o vo o ja bukɔ wom puga. Baŋa Wɛ ma da o keim dem ŋwaane o pa se jawe-chɛɔ kolo na wora ko goe Isarele tiina bam laam ti. 9De ko de, balo na maŋe ba te de jaweo kom to ye nɔɔna morro finlei-tena (24,000) mo.
10 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we, 11“Ko ná dae kaanem tu Finehase ŋwaane, amo ya wó go Isarele tiina bam maama a ti a ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane. Wonto nam jege chega lanyerane o pa-ne, ye o seene o yia amo ŋwaane se nɔɔna taa zuli amo yerane. 12Konto ŋwaane nam ta ded‑o we, amo gwoni ni a pa‑o se yazura taa wo o tei ne. 13Wonto de o kwaga kam wó taa ye amo kaanem tiina mo se ko taa vei wuu. O na seene o yia amo zula ŋwaane pa se o le Isarele tiina tusim dem amo yiga ne to ŋwaane mo tei a gwoni ni a pa‑o konto dwoŋi.”
14Isarele tu wolo ba déem na jaane‑o de bukɔ wom ye ba go-ba to ye Salu bu Zimiri mo. O déem ye Simeon dwi dem sɔ-yuu kodwoŋi yiga tu mo. 15Midian tiina bukɔ wom yere maa ye Kozibi. O kwo Zura déem ye Midian tiina sɔ-yuu-kamunu yiga tu mo.
16 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we, 17“Zaŋe-na Midian tiina bam baŋa ne se á wane-ba á di. 18Ba déem dwoni de abam mo de ba na soge abam se á zuli ba jwoni Baal-Peora to. Ba ta pɛ se á ke á tusi ba bukɔ Kozibi ŋwaane. Wonto maa ye Midian tiina dedɛɛro bukɔ ye o ba o te jaweo kolo na puri Baal-Peora zulim ŋwaane to baŋa ne.”

english_text:
The Israelites Are Counted a Second Time
1 After the Lord had stopped the deadly disease from killing the Israelites, he said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, 2“I want you to find out how many Israelites are in each family. Then make a list of every man 20 years and older who is able to serve in Israel's army.”
3Israel was now camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho. Moses and Eleazar told them 4what the Lord had said about counting the men 20 years and older, just as Moses and their ancestors had done when they left Egypt.
5-7There were 43,730 men from the tribe of Reuben, the oldest son of Jacob. These men were from the clans of Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. 8Pallu was the father of Eliab 9and the grandfather of Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had been chosen by the people, but who followed Korah and rebelled against Moses, Aaron, and the Lord. 10That's when the Lord made the earth open up and swallow Dathan, Abiram, and Korah. At the same time, fire destroyed 250 men as a warning to the other Israelites. 11But the Korahite clan wasn't destroyed.
12-14There were 22,200 men from the tribe of Simeon; they were from the clans of Nemuel, Jamin, Jachin, Zerah, and Shaul.
15-18There were 40,500 men from the tribe of Gad; they were from the clans of Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ozni, Eri, Arod, and Areli.
19-22There were 76,500 men from the tribe of Judah; they were from the clans of Shelah, Perez, and Zerah, as well as Hezron and Hamul, whose ancestor was Perez. Judah's sons Er and Onan had died in Canaan.
23-25There were 64,300 men from the tribe of Issachar; they were from the clans of Tola, Puvah, Jashub, and Shimron.
26-27There were 60,500 men from the tribe of Zebulun; they were from the clans of Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
28-34There were 52,700 men from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph; they were from the clan of Machir, the clan of Gilead his son, and the clans of his six grandsons: Iezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Shemida, and Hepher. Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, but he had five daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
35-37There were 32,500 men from the tribe of Ephraim son of Joseph; they were from the clans of Shuthelah, Becher, Tahan, and Eran the son of Shuthelah.
38-41There were 45,600 men from the tribe of Benjamin; they were from the clans of Bela, Ashbel, Ahiram, Shephupham, Hupham, as well as from Ard and Naaman, the two sons of Bela.
42-43There were 64,400 men from the tribe of Dan; they were all from the clan of Shuham.
44-47There were 53,400 men from the tribe of Asher; they were from the clans of Imnah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and from the two clans of Heber and Malchiel, the sons of Beriah. Asher's daughter was Serah.
48-50There were 45,400 men from the tribe of Naphtali; they were from the clans of Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
51The total number of Israelite men listed was 601,730.
52 The Lord said to Moses, 53“Divide the land of Canaan among these tribes, according to the number of people in each one, 54so the larger tribes have more land than the smaller ones. 55-56I will show you what land to give each tribe, and they will receive as much land as they need, according to the number of people in it.”
57The tribe of Levi included the clans of the Gershonites, Kohathites, Merarites, 58as well as the clans of Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, and Korah. Kohath the Levite was the father of Amram, 59the husband of Levi's daughter Jochebed, who was born in Egypt. Amram and Jochebed's three children were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. 60 Aaron was the father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. 61 But Nadab and Abihu had died when they offered fire that was unacceptable to the Lord.
62In the tribe of Levi there were 23,000 men and boys at least a month old. They were not listed with the other tribes, because they would not receive any land in Canaan.
63Moses and Eleazar counted the Israelites while they were camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho. 64None of the people that Moses and Aaron had counted in the Sinai Desert were still alive, 65 except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun. The Lord had said that everyone else would die there in the desert.
translation_text:
Ba daa jwoori ba jeeli nɔɔna bam ni
1Jawe-chɛɔ kom na kwori to, mo Baŋa Wɛ tage o bere Moses de kaanem tu Aron bu Eleaza o we, 2“Jeeli-na Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom maama ni. Jeeli-ba sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu maama wone se á lɔre ba baara balo na yi bena finlei ba daŋe ye ba maŋe se ba ke jara to ni.”
3Isarele tiina bam déem ya chwi ba vwoa yam Moaba laŋa kam te-kampare ne mo. Jei sem konto wo Jɔdan buga kam ni ne mo ye Jeriko de wo bubɛ dedwoŋi dem seeni. Moses de Eleaza ma seene ba sɛ Wɛ ni dem. Ba ma ta de nɔɔna bam ba we, 4“Jeeli-na baara bam se á lɔre balo na yi bena finlei ba daŋe to ni.”
Isarele tiina balo déem na nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne to mo tento:
5Ruben na ye Jakob bakeiri-kwea to dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Hanoki sɔ-yuu kom, de Pallu sɔ-yuu, 6de Hezeron sɔ-yuu, de Karimi sɔ-yuu mo. 7Ruben sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro finna-tetɔ de bia yarepɛ de fintɔ (43,730) mo. 8Pallu bu déem ye Eliabi mo. 9Eliabi bia maa ye Nemuweli, de Datan, de Abiram.
Datan de Abiram déem ye nɔɔna balo na ye dedɛɛra ba kɔgɔ kom wone ye ba dwoni de Moses de Aron de Baŋa Wɛ tete to mo. Ba déem tɔge de Kora mo ba lɔ Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne. 10Ba na ke konto to, mo tega kam déem bɔke belei, ye ka li-ba pa se ba tɔge de Kora ba te. Wonto kwaga tɔgena bam maama de ma te maŋa kalo ne min-vogo na pɔpɔ ko nwoŋi ko zwɛ nɔɔna bia yalei de finnu (250) ko go to. 11Kora sɔ-yuu kom maama déem nam wo ti.
12Simeon dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Nemuweli sɔ-yuu kom, de Jamin sɔ-yuu, de Jakin sɔ-yuu, 13de Zera sɔ-yuu, de Sawuli sɔ-yuu mo. 14Simeon sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro finlei-telei de bia yalei (22,200) mo.
15Gad dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Zefon sɔ-yuu kom, de Hagi sɔ-yuu, de Suni sɔ-yuu, 16de Ozini sɔ-yuu, de Eri sɔ-yuu, 17de Arodi sɔ-yuu, de Areli sɔ-yuu mo. 18Gad sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro finna de bia yanu (40,500) mo.
19Judah bia Era de Onan déem ya tege Kanaan tega kam ne mo. 20Judah dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Sela sɔ-yuu kom, de Pɛreza sɔ-yuu, de Zera sɔ-yuu kom mo. 21Pɛreza bia de ba sɔ-yuni tem maa ye: Hezeron sɔ-yuu kom, de Hamuli sɔ-yuu mo. 22Judah sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro fuserepɛ-teredo de bia yanu (76,500) mo.
23Isakara dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Tola sɔ-yuu kom, de Pua sɔ-yuu, 24de Jasubi sɔ-yuu, de Simiron sɔ-yuu mo. 25Isakara sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro fuseredo-tena de bia yatɔ (64,300) mo.
26Zebulun dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Seredi sɔ-yuu kom, de Elon sɔ-yuu, de Jahaleli sɔ-yuu mo. 27Zebulun sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro fuseredo de bia yanu (60,500) mo.
28Josɛf déem jege bia balei mo: Manasɛ, de Efrayim.
29Manasɛ dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Makira sɔ-yuu kom, de Gilead sɔ-yuu mo. Makira maa ye Gilead kwo. Gilead bia de ba sɔ-yuni tem maa ye: 30Yizera sɔ-yuu kom, de Heleke sɔ-yuu, 31de Asireli sɔ-yuu, de Sɛkɛm sɔ-yuu, 32de Semida sɔ-yuu, Hefera sɔ-yuu kom mo. 33Hefera bu Zelofehada déem nam ba jege bakeira. O busankane sem yera maa ye Maala, de Noah, de Hogela, de Milika, dedaane Tiraza. 34Manasɛ sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro finnu-telei de bia yarepɛ (52,700) mo.
35Efrayim dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Sutela sɔ-yuu kom, de Bechere sɔ-yuu, de Tahan sɔ-yuu mo. 36Sutela bu maa ye Eran de o diga kam. 37Efrayim sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro fintɔ-telei de bia yanu (32,500) mo.
Manasɛ de Efrayim dwia yam konto de ba sɔ-yuni tem mo nwoŋi Josɛf yera ne.
38Benjamin dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Bela sɔ-yuu kom, de Asabeli sɔ-yuu, de Ahiram sɔ-yuu, 39de Sufam sɔ-yuu, de Hufam sɔ-yuu mo. 40Bela bia de ba sɔ-yuni maa ye: Aradi sɔ-yuu, de Naaman sɔ-yuu mo. 41Benjamin sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro finna-tenu de bia yaredo (45,600) mo.
42Dan dwi dem sɔ-yuu déem ye:
Suham sɔ-yuu kom mo. 43Dan kwaga kam maama nwoŋi Suham sɔ-yuu kom wone mo. Ko déem nam jege baara morro fuserepɛ-tena de bia yana (64,400) mo.
44Asere dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Imina sɔ-yuu kom, de Isivi sɔ-yuu, de Beria sɔ-yuu mo. 45Beria bia de ba sɔ-yuni maa ye: Hebera sɔ-yuu, de Malikeli sɔ-yuu mo. 46Asere déem jege bukɔ mo, o yere na ye Sera. 47Asere sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro finnu-tetɔ de bia yana (53,400) mo.
48Nafitali dwi dem sɔ-yuni déem ye:
Jahazeli sɔ-yuu, de Guni sɔ-yuu, 49de Jezera sɔ-yuu, de Silem sɔ-yuu mo. 50Nafitali sɔ-yuni tem déem jege baara morro finna-tenu de bia yana (45,400) mo.
51Isarele tiina balo maama ba déem na jeeli to ye baara morro bia yaredo dedoa dedaane bia yarepɛ de fintɔ (601,730) mo.
52 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de Moses o we, 53“Abam ná tu se á pɔɔre tega kam á pa Isarele tiina bam, se á taa yei ba yera yam na daga tei to ni ne. 54Isarele tiina bam sɔ-yuu maama wó jwoŋi tega kam popɔra se ko maŋe de ba sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna na mae tei to mo. Á jege se á jeeli ba yera yalo á na popone á tiŋi to ni mo. 55Ko nam ye se á ta jɔrɔ mo á ma‑á pɔɔre tega kam á pa-ba. Ba maama wó jwoŋi ba tega se ko maŋe de ba yera yam ni na mae tei to mo. 56Á wó ta jɔrɔ mo se sɔ-yuu maama jwoŋi ba nyem, ne ba ná maŋe ba ye kɔ-kamunu naa kɔ-balaŋa mo de.”
57Ko ta ná ye Levi dwi tiina bam, banto sɔ-yuni tem déem ye:
Gereson sɔ-yuu kom, de Kohafe sɔ-yuu, de Merari sɔ-yuu mo. 58Banto bia de ba sɔ-yuni maa ye: Libini sɔ-yuu kom, de Heboron sɔ-yuu, de Mahili sɔ-yuu, de Musi sɔ-yuu, de Kora sɔ-yuu mo.
Kohafe bu déem maa ye Amiram. 59Wonto déem di Levi bukɔ, Jokebedi o ma ke o kaane. Ba déem ya loge‑o Ejipti wone mo. Jokebedi de Amiram déem nam loge bakeiri selei mo, Aron de Moses. Banto de ba nakɔ Miriam.
60Aron déem jege bia bana mo: Nadab, de Abihu, de Eleaza, de Itamara. 61Nadab de Abihu déem tege mo, ba na kwei min-yɔɔ ba zwɛ se ba ma zuli Baŋa Wɛ, ye o wo pɛ chwoŋa se ba zwɛ mini dem konto dwoŋi to ŋwaane.
62Ba na jeeli Levi dwi dem to, ba baara balo na yi chana to maa ye morro finlei-tetɔ (23,000). Ba nam wo jeeli-ba ba woli Isarele dwi tiina badwonna bam wone. Kokuri to, ba déem ba jege se ba tɔge ba jwoŋi ba popɔra tega chɛɛm baŋa ne.
63Isarele tiina bam na zoore Moaba laŋa kam te-kampare ne ye Moses de Eleaza jeeli ba ni to mo ba déem popone baara bam yera konto dwoŋi. Ba maa wo Jɔdan buga kam ni ne ye Jeriko de wo bubɛ dedwoŋi dem seeni. 64Ko ná ye balo Moses de Aron ya na jeeli Sinayi kagoa kam ne to, ba wolowolo déem daa tera se ba daa jeeli‑o. 65Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o ta banto taane o we, “Ba jege se ba te kagoa kam wone mo.” Balo yerane na daare ba wone to mo ye Jefunɛ bu Kaleb, de Nun bu Josua.

english_text:
The Daughters of Zelophehad Are Given Land
1Zelophehad was from the Manasseh tribe, and he had five daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
2One day his daughters went to the sacred tent, where they met with Moses, Eleazar, and some other leaders of Israel, as well as a large crowd of Israelites. The young women said:
3You know that our father died in the desert. But it was for something he did wrong, not for joining with Korah in rebelling against the Lord.
Our father left no sons 4to carry on his family name. But why should his name die out for that reason? Give us some land like the rest of his relatives in our clan, so our father's name can live on.
5Moses asked the Lord what should be done, 6and the Lord answered:
7 Zelophehad's daughters are right. They should each be given part of the land their father would have received.
8Tell the Israelites that when a man dies without a son, his daughter will inherit his land. 9If he has no daughter, his brothers will inherit the land. 10But if he has no brothers, his father's brothers will inherit the land. 11And if his father has no brothers, the land must be given to his nearest relative in the clan. This is my law, and the Israelites must obey it.
Joshua Is Appointed Israel's Leader
(Deuteronomy 31.1-8)
12 The Lord said to Moses, “One day you will go up into the Abarim Mountains, and from there you will see the land I am giving the Israelites. 13After you have seen it, you will die, just like your brother Aaron, 14because both of you disobeyed me at Meribah near the town of Kadesh in the Zin Desert. When the Israelites insulted me there, you didn't believe in my holy power.”
15Moses replied, 16“You are the Lord God, and you know what is in everyone's heart. So I ask you to appoint a leader for Israel. 17 Your people need someone to lead them into battle, or else they will be like sheep wandering around without a shepherd.”
18 The Lord answered, “Joshua son of Nun can do the job. Place your hands on him to show that he is the one to take your place. 19Then go with him and tell him to stand in front of Eleazar the priest and the Israelites. Appoint Joshua as their new leader 20and tell them they must now obey him, just as they obey you. 21 But Joshua must depend on Eleazar to find out from me what I want him to do as he leads Israel into battle.”
22Moses followed the Lord's instructions and took Joshua to Eleazar and the people, 23 then he placed his hands on Joshua and appointed him Israel's leader.
translation_text:
Zelofehada bukwa bam taane
1Maala, de Noah, de Hogela, de Milika, dedaane Tiraza déem ye Hefera bu Zelofehada bukwa mo. Hefera maa ye Gilead bu. Gilead de maa ye Makira bu. Makira maa ye Manasɛ bu. Manasɛ maa ye Josɛf bu. 2Bukwa banto déem ma zaŋe ba vo wara-jei sem ni ne ba yi Moses, de kaanem tu Eleaza, de Isarele yiga tiina, de ba kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama tei. Ba ma zege ba yiga ne ye ba ta ba we, 3“Debam kwo déem tege kagoa kam ne, ye o ba jege bakeiri. O nam ya tɔge o tere Kora kwaga tɔgena bam wone. Banto déem ke ni daane se ba lɔ Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne. Dé kwo nam tege o tete wɛleera baŋa ne mo. 4Abam nam wó sɛ se debam kwo yere jei o sɔ-yuu kom wone, de o na ba jege bakeira to ŋwaane na? Pa-na se debam balo na ye o bukwa to jwoŋi tega kalo na wó taa ye dé nyem to, ne dé kwo chorro tem na wó jwoŋi ba nyem tei to.”
5Moses ma ja ba taane dem o vo Baŋa Wɛ yiga. 6Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we, 7“Zelofehada bukwa bam wo ba chega wone. Pɔɔre-na tega ba kwo chorro tega kam wone á pa-ba. Banto mo jege se ba jwoŋi tega kalo na ye ba kwo nyem to. 8Nam ta n bere Isarele tiina bam we: ‘Nɔɔno ná tega ye o ba jege bakeira, se o bukɔ lɛɛre o jwoŋi o tega o ta tei. 9O nam ná tega ye o ba jege bukɔ de, se o chorro jwoŋi o tega kam. 10O nam ná maŋe o ba jege chorro de, se o kwo chorro tem jwoŋi o tega kam. 11O ná yɔɔre o ba jege chorro naa o kwo chorro, se wolo de daa na ye o yera nɔɔno ye konto tu bwola ded‑o to jwoŋi-ka o taa tei. Amo ni mo konto a na kwei a pa Isarele tiina bam se ko taa vei wuu. Ko maa ye ni delo amo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ nmo, Moses to mo.’ ”
Josua leiri Moses yuu ne
12 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we, “Amo wó pa se n vo Abarim peero tem wone, ye n di peo kolo na wora to yuu. Nmo ná diina, se n nii n na tega kalo a na lage a kwei a pa Isarele tiina bam to. 13Nmo nam ná nii-ka n ti, n de lage n te mo nenɛɛne n zembaaro Aron na tege tei to. 14Kokuri to, á déem na wo Zin kagoa kam wone ye Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom jege-ne ba poona to, abam balei nwoŋi a ni dem kwaga ne ye á wo pɛ se Isarele tiina bam maane ba lɔre we, amo yɔɔre a ye wose mo.” (Konto déem ke Meriba-kadese na wo Zin kagoa kam wone to mo, mɛ na na nwoŋi peo kom yera ne to.)
15Moses ma leiri Baŋa Wɛ o we, 16“Nabiina maama Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam beeri nɔɔno n leiri amo yuu ne, se o taa nii nɔn-kɔgɔ konto baŋa ne. 17Wonto wó taa tɔge nɔɔna bam yiga ye ba taa nwoŋi ba ke jara, ye ba daare ba jwoori ba sam wone. Ko ná dae konto, nmo Baŋa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wó taa nye de pei-kɔgɔ na wora ye se ba jege nayero tei to mo.”
18 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we, “Nun bu Josua nam ye wolo amo jworo na wo o tei ne se o wane o toŋe n totoŋe dem to mo. Kwei n jeŋa n daŋe o yuu ne se o leiri n yuu ne o taa toŋa. 19Pa se o vo o zege kaanem tu Eleaza, de Isarele kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama yiga ne, se n tiŋi‑o o totoŋe dem ŋwaane ye nɔɔna bam maama zege ba nia. 20Ke dam delo nmo na jege to dwoŋi n pa‑o, se Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom taa sɛ‑o. 21O de nam jege se o taa vei Eleaza tei mo, se wonto wane o tɔge Yurim memaŋa kandwɛ dem baŋa ne o lɔre amo Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa na ye tei to. Konto to, Eleaza wó bere‑o amo ni dem se o yeini ja nɔɔna bam o nwoŋi se ba kwaare jara, naa se ba jwoori ba sam wone.”
22Moses déem seene o ke Baŋa Wɛ ni dem na bere tei to mo. O ma ja Josua o vo Eleaza de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama tei se o zege ba yiga ne. 23O ma kwei o je o daŋe Josua yuu ne, ye o tiŋi‑o yiga tu totoŋe dem ŋwaane, ne Baŋa Wɛ déem na pɛ ni se o ke tei to.

english_text:
Regular Daily Sacrifices
(Exodus 29.38-43; Leviticus 6.8-13)
1The Lord told Moses 2to say to the people of Israel:
Offer sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, so that I will smell the smoke and be pleased.
3Each day offer two rams a year old as sacrifices to please me. The animals must have nothing wrong with them; 4one will be sacrificed in the morning, and the other in the evening. 5Along with each of them, one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice. 6This sacrifice to please me was first offered at Mount Sinai. 7Finally, along with each of these two sacrifices, a liter of wine must be poured on the altar as a drink offering. 8The second ram will be sacrificed that evening, along with the other offerings, just like the one sacrificed that morning. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.
The Sacrifice on the Sabbath
The Lord said:
9-10On the Sabbath, in addition to the regular daily sacrifices, you must sacrifice two rams a year old to please me. These rams must have nothing wrong with them, and they will be sacrificed with a drink offering and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil.
The Sacrifices on the First Day of the Month
The Lord said:
11On the first day of each month, bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me. 12Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram, 13and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.
14-15Offer two liters of wine as a drink offering with each bull, one and a half liters with the ram, and one liter with each of the young rams.
Finally, you must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
These sacrifices are to be offered on the first day of each month, in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
The Sacrifices during Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread
(Leviticus 23.4-8)
The Lord said:
16 Celebrate Passover in honor of me on the fourteenth day of the first month of each year. 17 The following day will begin the Festival of Thin Bread, which will last for a week. During this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast.
18On the first day of this festival, you must rest from your work and come together for worship. 19Bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me. 20Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram, 21and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. 22Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for the sins of the people. 23-24All of these are to be offered each day of the festival in additional to the regular sacrifices, and the smoke from them will please me. 25Then on the last day of the festival, you must once again rest from work and come together for worship.
The Sacrifices during the Harvest Festival
(Leviticus 23.15-22)
The Lord said:
26 On the first day of the Harvest Festival, you must rest from your work, come together for worship, and bring a sacrifice of new grain. 27Offer two young bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old as sacrifices to please me. 28Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram, 29and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. 30Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. 31The animals must have nothing wrong with them and are to be sacrificed along with the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_text:
Isarele tiina bam kaanem chullu tem
Dɛ dɛ wone pɛɛra
Nwoŋim 29:38-43; Chullu 6:8-13
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta de Moses o we:
2“Kwei amo ni dem n pa Isarele tiina bam we: Ko ná yeini ko yi ka maŋa se á zuli-ne, se á ja wodiu pɛɛra yalo lwom dem na ywomma amo tei ne to á ja á ba á pa-ne.
3Ta ta de-ba we: Dɛ maama, á ná lage á kwei á wodiu pɛɛra á pa Baŋa Wɛ, se á ja pi-bale selei na ye bene bene ye se ba jege gɛɛ se yera ne to á ba á ma‑á ke dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem. 4Á nam wó kwei pei sem dedoa mo á kaane zezeŋa ne, se dedaan-ni maŋa ne, se á daa kaane kadwoŋi kam. 5Á ta wó lage mun-bwei bwɛ selei mo na viiri dedaane Olivi nuga kalo na ye chekke to bɔŋa dedoa se ko taa ye wodiu pɛɛre ye á woli-de kaanem dem wone. 6Pɛɛre dento dwoŋi mo ye dɛ dɛ wone zwɛɛm kaanem dem ye de lwom dem ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ. Sinayi peo kom ne mo Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ ni se ba bobo ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem dem konto. 7Á jege se á ke wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre mo á woli pia maama kaanem wone. Kwei-na sana bɔŋa dedoa á ja á vo á lwo-ka wara-vwei dem wone á pa Baŋa Wɛ. 8Dedaan-ni maŋa ne, se á kaane pi-bala kadwoŋi kam. Á ta wó ke ka wodiu pɛɛre dem de ka wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem á woli da se ko maŋe de á na ke tei zezeŋa ne to mo. Á ná yeini á ke zwɛɛm kaanem konto dwoŋi, de lwom dem ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ mo.
Wɛ siu dɛ pɛɛra
9Ko ná yeini ko ye Wɛ siu dɛ, á pɛɛra yam wó taa ye pi-bale selei na ye bene bene ye se ba jege gɛɛ se yera ne to, dedaane wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre, de wodiu pɛɛre delo na ye mun-bwei bwɛ selei na viiri de nuga to. 10Siu dɛ maama ne mo á jege se á ke zwɛɛm kaanem konto dwoŋi á woli á dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem de de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wone.
Chana maama pɛɛra yam
11Chana maama boboa dɛ ne se á yeini á ja na-bale selei, de pi-bea, de pi-bale serepɛ na ye bene bene to á ja á ba á ma‑á ke zwɛɛm kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ. Vara bam maama nam ba jege se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 12Na-bala maama kaanem ŋwaane se á kwei wodiu pɛɛre na ye mun-bwei bwɛ seredo na viiri dedaane nuga to á woli da. Ta kwei-na mun-bwei bwɛ sena na viiri de nuga to á ma‑á ke wodiu pɛɛre á woli pi-bea kam kaanem wone. 13Ko nam ná ye pi-bala maama kaanem mo, se á kwei wodiu pɛɛre na ye mun-bwei bwɛ selei na viiri de nuga to á woli da. Pɛɛra yanto maa ye zwɛɛm kaanem á na ke á pa Baŋa Wɛ ye de lwom dem ywomma de pa‑o to. 14Á ta wó kwei sana bwɛ selei mo á ma‑á ke wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre á woli na-bala maama kaanem wone. Ko ta ná ye pi-bea kam kaanem, wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wó taa ye sana bɔŋa dedoa de chichworo. Wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre delo á na wó woli pi-bala maama kaanem wone to wó taa ye sana bɔŋa dedoa. 15Chana maama boboa dɛ ne á ta jege se á beeri bo-bala mo á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ á woli dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem dedaane de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wone.
Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem pɛɛra
Chullu 23:4-8
16Bene maama wone boboa chana kam da fuga-yana dɛ dem ne mo á wó ke kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ Atɔgebabaŋa ŋwaane. 17Dɛ dem na saŋe to wone á wó bobo se á di kuri da yarepɛ. Ya da yam wone á wó ta‑á di bworobworo-memene selo sabɔle na tere ko wone to mo. 18Kuri dem dim boboa dɛ dem ne, se á yage á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yalo á na yeini á toŋa to, se á daare á jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ. 19Á jege se á ke zwɛɛm kaanem mo se de taa ye wodiu pɛɛre de pa Baŋa Wɛ. Á wó ja na-bale selei, de pi-bea dedoa, de pi-bale serepɛ na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke zwɛɛm kaanem dem. Vara bam maama nam ba jege se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 20Na-bala kalo maama á na wó ma á ke kaanem to, se á kwei wodiu pɛɛre na ye mun-bwei bwɛ seredo ye á viiri dedaane nuga to á woli da. Ko ná ye pi-bea kam kaanem, wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ sena mo. 21Wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ selei pi-bala maama kaanem ŋwaane. 22Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem se á le nɔɔna bam wɛleera Wɛ yiga ne. 23Á jege se á kwei pɛɛra yam konto maama mo á ke kaanem á woli zezeŋa maama zwɛɛm kaanem dem wone. 24Kuri dem dim da yarepɛ yam maama wone mo á jege se á ke wodiu pɛɛra yam konto dwoŋi á zwɛ á pa Baŋa Wɛ se ya lwom dem taa ywomma de pa‑o. Á wó woli-ya dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem dedaane de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wone mo. 25Kuri dem tiim dɛ dem ne, se á daa yage á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yalo á na yeini á toŋa to, se á daare á jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ.
Ga-kwea kuri dem pɛɛra
Nwoŋim 23:16; Chullu 23:15-21; Nia Gulim 16:9-12
26Ga-kwea kuri dem ná yeini de yi, ye á ná lage á ja á da-yiga wodiiru pɛɛra á ba á pa Baŋa Wɛ, dento dɛ dem ne á jege se á yage á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yalo á na yeini á toŋa to mo, se á jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ. 27Á nam wó kwei na-bale selei mo, de pi-bea dedoa, de pi-bale serepɛ na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke zwɛɛm kaanem se de lwom dem taa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ. Vara bam maama nam ba jege se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 28Na-bala maama kaanem ŋwaane se á kwei wodiu pɛɛre na ye mun-bwei bwɛ seredo na viiri dedaane nuga to á woli da. Ko ná ye pi-bea kam kaanem, wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ sena mo. 29Wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ selei pi-bala maama kaanem ŋwaane. 30Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á le á wɛleera Wɛ yiga ne. 31Pɛɛra yam konto maama dedaane ya wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra yam á jege se á ma‑á ke kaanem á woli dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem dedaane de wodiu pɛɛre dem wone mo. Ta‑á yei-na se vara bam yé taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne.

english_text:
The Sacrifices at the Festival of Trumpets
(Leviticus 23.23-25)
The Lord said:
1On the first day of the seventh month, you must rest from your work and come together to celebrate at the sound of the trumpets. 2Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me. 3Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram, 4and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. 5You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. 6These sacrifices will be made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices and the sacrifices for the first day of the month. The smoke from these sacrifices will please me.
The Sacrifices on the Great Day of Forgiveness
(Leviticus 23.26-32)
The Lord said:
7 The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. On that day you must rest from all work and come together for worship. Show sorrow for your sins by going without food, 8and bring to the altar one young bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me. 9Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram, 10and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. 11A goat must also be sacrificed for the sins of the people. You will offer these sacrifices in addition to the sacrifice to ask forgiveness and the regular daily sacrifices.
The Sacrifices during the Festival of Shelters
(Leviticus 23.33-44)
The Lord said:
12 Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
13On the first day, you must rest from your work and come together for worship. Bring to the altar 13 bulls, 2 full-grown rams, and 14 rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me. 14Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the rams, 15and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. 16You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These are to be offered in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
17-34For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.
35On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. 36Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me. 37You must also offer the proper grain sacrifices and drink offerings of wine with each animal. 38And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
39You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.
40Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.
translation_text:
Nabwanno wum kuri dem pɛɛra
Chullu 23:23-25
1Bene maama wone chane serepɛ chana kam boboa dɛ dem ne, se á yage á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yalo á na yeini á toŋa to se á daare á jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ. Dɛ dem konto ne á wó wu nabwanno mo. 2Á jege se á kwei na-bala dedoa mo, de pi-bea dedoa, de pi-bale serepɛ na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke zwɛɛm kaanem se de lwom dem taa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ. Vara bam maama nam ba jege se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 3Na-bala kam kaanem ŋwaane se á kwei wodiu pɛɛre na ye mun-bwei bwɛ seredo ye de viiri dedaane nuga to á woli da. Ko ná ye pi-bea kam kaanem, wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ sena mo. 4Wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ selei pi-bale serepɛ sem dedoa dedoa kaanem ŋwaane. 5Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem se á le nɔɔna bam wɛleera Wɛ yiga ne. 6Nam kwei-na pɛɛra yam konto maama á ke kaanem á woli chan-doŋa zwɛɛm kaanem, de dɛ maama zwɛɛm kaanem, dedaane ya wodiu pɛɛra yam de ya wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra yam wone, ne Wɛ na pɛ abam ni se á ta‑á ke tei to. Ya ye wodiu pɛɛra mo á na ke á pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ya lwom dem maa ywomma de pa‑o.
Wɛleera saarem dɛ dem pɛɛra
Chullu 23:26-32
7Chane serepɛ chana kam da fuga dɛ dem ne, se á jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ. Dɛ dem konto wone á jege se á gwooni á tete mo se á yage totoŋa dwi maama. 8Nam kwei-na na-bala dedoa, de pi-bea dedoa, de pi-bale serepɛ na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke zwɛɛm kaanem se de lwom dem taa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ. Vara bam maama ba jege se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 9Na-bala kam kaanem ŋwaane se á kwei wodiu pɛɛre na ye mun-bwei bwɛ seredo na viiri dedaane nuga to á woli da. Ko ná ye pi-bea kam kaanem, wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ sena mo. 10Wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ selei pi-bale serepɛ sem dedoa dedoa kaanem ŋwaane. 11Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem. Nam ke-na pɛɛra yam konto maama á woli de wɛleera saarem kaanem delo na le nɔɔna bam wɛleera Wɛ yiga ne to, dedaane dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem, de de wodiu pɛɛre dem, de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra yam maama.
Vwoa chwiim kuri dem pɛɛra
Chullu 23:33-43; Nia Gulim 16:13-15
12Chane serepɛ chana kam da fuga-yanu dɛ dem ne se á yage totoŋa yalo á na yeini á toŋa dɛ dɛ to se á daare á jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ. Á wó ke da yarepɛ mo á di kuri á ma‑á zuli Baŋa Wɛ. 13Boboa dɛ dem ne, kwei-na na-bale fuga-setɔ, de pi-bɛ selei, dedaane pi-bale fuga-sena na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke zwɛɛm kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ se de lwom dem taa ywomma de pa‑o. 14Na-bale fuga-setɔ sem dedoa dedoa kaanem ŋwaane se á kwei wodiu pɛɛre na ye mun-bwei bwɛ seredo na viiri dedaane nuga to á woli da. Ko ná ye pi-bɛ selei sem dedoa dedoa kaanem, wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ sena mo. 15Wodiu pɛɛre dem wó taa ye mun-bwei bwɛ selei pi-bale fuga-sena sem dedoa dedoa kaanem ŋwaane. 16Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem. Nam ke-na pɛɛra yam konto á woli dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem, de de wodiu pɛɛre dem, de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wone.
17Da yalei dɛ dem wone, se á kwei na-bale fuga-selei, de pi-bɛ selei, dedaane pi-bale fuga-sena na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke kaanem. Vara bam maama nam dae se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 18Á wó ke wodiu pɛɛra dedaane wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra á woli da, se ya maŋe de vara bam ni na mae tei to. 19Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem. Nam ke-na pɛɛra yam konto á woli dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem, de de wodiu pɛɛre dem, de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra yam wone.
20Da yatɔ dɛ dem ne, se á kwei na-bale fuga-dedoa, de pi-bɛ selei, dedaane pi-bale fuga-sena na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke kaanem. Vara bam maama nam dae se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 21Á wó ke wodiu pɛɛra dedaane wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra á woli da, se ya maŋe de vara bam ni na mae tei to. 22Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem. Nam ke-na pɛɛra yam konto á woli dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem, de de wodiu pɛɛre dem, de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wone.
23Da yana dɛ dem ne, se á kwei na-bale fuga, de pi-bɛ selei, dedaane pi-bale fuga-sena na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke kaanem. Vara bam maama nam dae se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 24Á wó ke wodiu pɛɛra dedaane wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra á woli da, se ya maŋe de vara bam ni na mae tei to. 25Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem. Nam ke-na pɛɛra yam konto á woli dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem, de de wodiu pɛɛre dem, de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wone.

32Da yarepɛ dɛ dem ne, se á kwei na-bale serepɛ, de pi-bɛ selei, dedaane pi-bale fuga-sena na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke kaanem. Vara bam maama nam dae se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 33Á wó ke wodiu pɛɛra dedaane wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra á woli da, se ya maŋe de vara bam ni na mae tei to. 34Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem. Dɛ dem konto ye de yera Wɛ ŋwaane mo. 36Nam kwei-na na-bala dedoa, de pi-bea dedoa, de pi-bale serepɛ na ye bene bene to á ma‑á ke zwɛɛm kaanem se de lwom dem taa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ. Vara bam maama ba jege se ba taa jege gɛɛ ba yera ne. 37Á wó ke wodiu pɛɛra dedaane wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra á woli da, se ya maŋe de vara bam ni na mae tei to. 38Á ta wó kwei bo-bala dedoa mo á woli da se á ma‑á ke wɛleera saarem kaanem. Nam ke-na pɛɛra yam konto á woli dɛ dɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dem, de de wodiu pɛɛre dem, de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre dem wone.
39Á jege se á ke pɛɛra yam konto mo á pa Baŋa Wɛ á kura dim maŋa ne. Ko ná ye zwɛɛm kaanem pɛɛra yam, de wodiu pɛɛra yam, de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra yam, de yazura pɛɛra yam, á wó ke-ya á woli de á wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra yam, de pɛɛra yalo á na ke ni-gwonim ŋwaane to mo.”
40Moses déem ma yɔɔre o ta de Isarele tiina bam kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ‑o ni se o ta to.

english_text:
Making Promises to the Lord
1The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:
2 When one of you men makes a promise to the Lord, you must keep your word.
3Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord. 4If her father hears about it and says nothing, she must keep her promise. 5But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.
6-7Suppose a woman makes a promise to the Lord and then gets married. If her husband later hears about the promise but says nothing, she must do what she said, whether she meant it or not. 8But if her husband hears about the promise and objects, she no longer has to keep it, and the Lord will forgive her.
9Widows and divorced women must keep every promise they make to the Lord.
10Suppose a married woman makes a promise to the Lord. 11If her husband hears about the promise and says nothing, she must do what she said. 12But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise. 13Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord. 14If her husband hears about a promise and says nothing about it for a whole day, she must do what she said—since he did not object, the promise must be kept. 15But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.
16These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.
translation_text:
Ni-gwonim taane
1Moses déem ma ta de Isarele nakwa bam o we, 2“Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
Baaro ná gwoni ni o pa Baŋa Wɛ, naa o ná dugi duuri se o kwei woŋo o pa‑o, se konto tu yé jwoori o ni dem kwaga ne. O jege se o ke kolo maama o na tage to mo.
3Ko nam ná ye bukɔ na zoore o kwo sɔŋɔ ne to ná gwoni ni naa o du duuri se o ke woŋo o pa Baŋa Wɛ, 4ye o kwo ná lɔre ko ni ne, pa se o chem, ko jege se bukɔ wom seene o ke o ni dem na bere tei maama to mo. 5Se o kwo nam ná nigi o bukɔ wom ni-gwonim dem ŋwa, pa se o yiri-de o yage, bukɔ wom daa dae se o ke o tɔge kolo o na gwoni ni naa o du duuri se o ke to. Baŋa Wɛ wó kwei o kikia o chɛ‑o, o kwo na wo sɛ to ŋwaane.
6Bukɔ ni nam ná vere pa o du duuri naa o gwoni ni se o ke woŋo, se ko lwoori o ban-zore, 7o jege se o ke nenɛɛne o ni dem na bere tei maama to mo, ko ná dae we o baro wom mo nigi de ŋwa ye o yiri-de o yage. 8O baro wom nam ná nigi ye o yiri-de, kaane wom daa dae se o ke o tɔge kolo o na dugi duuri naa o gwoni ni se o ke to. Baŋa Wɛ wó kwei o kikia o chɛ‑o.
9Kadeina de balo ban-zore na chɔge to ná dugi duuri naa ba gwoni ni ba pa Wɛ, ba jege se ba ke ba nia yam na bere tei maama to mo.
10Kaane nam ná zoore o baro sɔŋɔ ne ye o gwoni ni naa o du duuri, 11o baro wom ná nigi ko ŋwa pa se o wo tage ded‑o we o yiri o ni dem o yage, kaane wom jege se o ke o tɔge o ni dem na bere tei maama to mo. 12O baro wom nam ná nigi ye o yiri-de, kaane wom daa dae se o ke o tɔge kolo o na gwoni ni naa o du duuri se o ke to. Baŋa Wɛ wó kwei o kikia o chɛ‑o, o baro wom na wo sɛ to ŋwaane.
13Nɔɔno kaane ná dugi duuri naa o gwoni ni se o gwooni o tete, o baro wom jege chwoŋa se o sɛ o ni dem konto, naa se o yiri-de o yage. 14O baro wom nam ná nigi o ni dem ŋwa pa se da yalei kɛ ye o ta maŋe da chemm, ko bere we o sɛ se o kaane wom ke o tɔge o ni dem na bere tei maama to mo. Kaane wom maa jege se o ke se ko tɔge de o ni dem mo, o baro wom na lɔre de ni ne ye o chem to ŋwaane. 15Da yalei nam ná kɛ ye o baro wom laam yiri kotu ni dem o yage, kaane wom tusim dem wó taa wo o baro wom yuu ne mo.”
16Nia yanto mo Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ Moses baara de ba kaana seeni, dedaane bukwa balo ta na zoore ba kwoa tei ne to seeni.

english_text:
Israel's War against Midian
1The Lord said to Moses, 2“Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.”
3Then Moses told the people, “The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle. 4Each tribe will send 1,000 men to fight.”
5Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle, 6Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.
7The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men, 8including Balaam son of Beor and the five Midianite kings, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba. 9The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them. 10They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.
11Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. 12-13Then they returned to their own camp in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, where Moses, Eleazar, and the other Israelite leaders met the troops outside camp.
14Moses became angry with the army commanders 15and said, “I can't believe you let the women live! 16 They are the ones who followed Balaam's advice and invited our people to worship the god Baal Peor. That's why the Lord punished us by killing so many of our people. 17You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex. 18But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”
19Then Moses said to the soldiers, “If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean. 20Then wash your clothes and anything made from animal skin, goat's hair, or wood.”
21-23Eleazar then explained, “If you need to purify something that won't burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, you must first place it in a hot fire. After you take it out, sprinkle it with the water that purifies. Everything else should only be sprinkled with the water. Do all of this, just as the Lord commanded Moses. 24Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.”
Everything Taken from the Midianites Is Divided
25The Lord told Moses:
26-27Make a list of everything taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. Then divide them between the soldiers and the rest of the people. Eleazar the priest and the family leaders will help you.
28-29From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every 500 people or animals and give these to Eleazar.
30From the half that belongs to the people, set aside one out of every 50 and give these to the Levites in charge of the sacred tent.
31Moses and Eleazar followed the Lord's instructions 32-35and listed everything that had been taken from the Midianites. The list included 675,000 sheep and goats, 72,000 cattle, 61,000 donkeys, and 32,000 young women who had never had sex.
36-47Each half included 337,500 sheep and goats, 36,000 cattle, 30,500 donkeys, and 16,000 young women. From the half that belonged to the soldiers, Moses counted out 675 sheep and goats, 72 cattle, 61 donkeys, and 32 women and gave them to Eleazar to be dedicated to the Lord. Then from the half that belonged to the people, Moses set aside one out of every 50 animals and women, as the Lord had said, and gave them to the Levites.
48The army commanders went to Moses 49and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing. 50So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
51Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders, 52and its total weight was over 200 kilograms. 53This did not include the things that the soldiers had kept for themselves. 54So Moses and Eleazar placed the gold in the Lord's sacred tent to remind Israel of what had happened.
translation_text:
Isarele de Midian jara yam
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta de Moses o we, 2“Zaŋe n pa se Isarele tiina bam jwoori ba chɔge Midian tiina bam de ba na ke-ba tei to. Dento keim dem kwaga ne, n jege se n te mo.”
3Moses ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, “Ti-na á yiga se á jar-keira badwonna nwoŋi ba vo ba kwaare jara de Midian tiina bam. Baŋa Wɛ lage o tɔge abam baŋa mo o waare-ba. 4Le-na nɔɔna moro moro Isarele dwi maama wone se ba vo ba ke jara yam.” 5Ba ma seene ba le nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) se ba nwoŋi ba vo ba kwaare jara yam, dwi maama de de nɔɔna moro. 6Moses ma pa ba nwoŋi ye Wɛ kaanem tu Eleaza bu Finehase de wo ba tei ne. Finehasi ma kwei wara-jei zela yadaara o woli da, dedaane nabwanno se ba wu-te jara-keim ŋwaane.
7Isarele tiina jar-keira bam ma nwoŋi ba jeeri Midian tiina de jara, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se ba ke tei to. Ba ma wane-ba ye ba go ba baara bam maama. 8Ba déem go Midian pwa banu bam de mo: Evi, de Rekem, de Zura, de Hura, dedaane Reba. Ba ta ma go Beyora bu Balaam ba woli da. 9Ba laam ma lɛɛre ba pɛ Midian tiina kaana de ba bia, ba daare ba vere ba vara, de ba jejegero maama ba ja ba viiri. 10Ba ma zwɛ teene delo Midian tiina bam na zoore de wone to, de ba vwoa yam. 11Ba laam ma pɛ kolo maama ba na vere ba dona tei ne to, ko woli de nɔn-bia de vara maama ba ja ba viiri. 12Ba ma ja nɔɔna bam, de vara bam, de jejegero tem maama se ba vo ba bere Moses, de Eleaza, dedaane Isarele kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama. Konto to, de ba ya chwi ba vwoa yam Moaba laŋa kam te-kampare ne mo, jei selo na wo Jɔdan buga kam ni ne ye Jeriko de wo bubɛ dedwoŋi dem seeni to.
13Moses de Wɛ kaanem tu Eleaza, dedaane Isarele kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama ma nwoŋi ba na zoore mɛ to ba vo ba jeeri ba jar-keira bam. 14Moses bane déem ma zaŋe de jar-keira dedɛɛra balo na jwoori jara yam wone to. Banto ye balo na nii nɔɔna moro baŋa ne de balo na nii nɔɔna bi baŋa ne to mo. 15O ma bwei-ba o we:
“Bɛ mo ye abam yage Midian tiina kaana bam maama pa se ba ta ŋwe? 16Nii-na! Kaana banto déem mo sɛ Balaam ni pa se ba soge dé baara bam se ba ywori Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne ba daare ba zuli Baal-Peora to. Ba na ke tei konto to pɛ se jawe-chɛɔ ja Baŋa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom mo ko chɔge-ba. 17Konto ŋwaane, zaŋe-na á go ba bia balo maama na ye bakeiri to, de ba kaana balo na peini de baara to maama. 18Ko nam ná ye ba bukwa balo ta na yeiri baara to, yage-ba-na se á di-ba á ma‑á ke á kaana.
19Abam wolo maama ná go nɔɔno naa o ná dwei too jara-keim baŋa ne, se kotu taa zoore dáa dáa de kɔgɔ kom maama se ko yi da yarepɛ. Da yam konto da yatɔ dɛ dem ne, dedaane ya da yarepɛ dɛ dem ne, kotu wó kwɛ o tete, de balo o na jaane jara-keim baŋa ne to se ba maama maŋe de chullu tem. 20Á ta jege se á zare á gwaaro, dedaane kolo maama á na jege ye ba kwei varem tɔnɔ, naa boŋo koro, naa dɛ ba ma ke-te to mo pa se te laam kwɛ.”
21Wɛ kaanem tu Eleaza de ma ta de jar-keira bam o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na kwei nia yalo o pa Moses se o pa abam to mo tento:
22-23Ko ná ye wonnu telo maama na ba zwɛ mini wone to, ne sabu-seŋa, de lu-nyenno, de channa, de luuru dwi dedwonna na ye tei to, á jege se á kwei-te á de mini wone pa se te kwɛ chullu tem seeni mo. Á ná le-te mini dem wone, se á ma chullu kwɛɛm na bam á miisi te yera ne se te laam kwɛ te ti. Ko nam ná ye wonnu telo mini na wó zwɛ to, se á miisi-te de chullu kwɛɛm na bam se te kwɛ. 24Da yarepɛ dɛ dem ne, á wó zare á gwaaro, se á maŋe de chullu tem. Abam laam jege chwoŋa se á jwoori á ba á ta‑á zoore kɔgɔ kom wone.”
Ba chɛ jejegero ba pa daane
25 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we, 26“Nmo de kaanem tu Eleaza, de Isarele sɔ-yuni yiga tiina bam mo jege se á jeeli kolo maama jar-keira bam na di Midian tiina bam ye ba ja ba ba ywo-seeni to, ko ná ye ba nabiina de vara de. 27Laam pɔɔre-te kuni belei, se a kwei popɔra dedoa á pa jar-keira bam, ye á daare á kwei popɔra kadwoŋi kam á pa Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kolo na daare to. 28-29Ko ná ye jar-keira popɔra kam, zo ka wone n le nɔɔno dedoa naa varem dedoa ba bia yanu maama wone, se n kwei n pa Eleaza. Nɔɔna bam konto, de vara bam konto ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. 30Ko nam ná ye Isarele tiina badaara bam popɔra, n jege se n le nɔɔno dedoa naa varem dedoa mo ba finnu maama wone, se n kwei n pa Levi tiina bam, ba na toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa to ŋwaane.”
31Moses de Eleaza ma ke tei Baŋa Wɛ na bere Moses to.
32Jar-keira bam déem na vere wonnu telo ba ja ba jwoori ye te daare to mo tento:
Pei morro bia yaredo de fuserepɛ-tenu (675,000), 33de naane morro fuserepɛ-telei (72,000), 34de bonɛ morro fuseredo-dedoa (61,000), 35dedaane bukwa balo na yeiri baara to morro fintɔ-telei (32,000).
36Jar-keira balo na vei jara-keim wone ye ba jwoori to popɔra kam déem ye tento mo:
Pei morro bia yatɔ de fintɔ-terepɛ dedaane bia yanu (337,500). 37Ba ma le pei bia yaredo de fuserepɛ-senu (675) se wone ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. 38Naane morro fintɔ-teredo (36,000). Ba ma le naane fuserepɛ-delei (72) de wone ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. 39Bonɛ morro fintɔ de bia yanu (30,500). Ba ma le bonɛ fuseredo-dedoa (61) se wone ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. 40Nɔɔna morro fuga-yaredo (16,000). Ba ma le nɔɔna fintɔ-balei (32) ba wone ba pa Baŋa Wɛ.
41Moses ma kwei Baŋa Wɛ nyem o pa Eleaza, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ‑o ni se o ke tei to.
42-43Isarele tiina badaara bam popɔra kalo Moses déem na pɔɔre jar-keira bam jejegero tem wone o pa Isarele nɔn-kɔgɔ kom to maa ye:
Pei morro bia yatɔ de fintɔ-terepɛ dedaane bia yanu (337,500), 44de naane morro fintɔ-teredo (36,000), 45de bonɛ morro fintɔ de bia yanu (30,500), 46de nɔɔna morro fuga-taredo (16,000).
47Moses ma zo Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom popɔra kam wo o le nɔɔno dedoa naa varem dedoa ba finnu maama wone, ne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ‑o ni se o ke tei to. O maa kwei nɔɔna bam de vara bam konto o pa Levi dwi tiina balo na toŋe wara-jei sem totoŋa to.
48Jar-keira bam dedɛɛra balo na nii nɔɔna moro baŋa ne de balo na nii nɔɔna bi baŋa ne to déem ma vo Moses tei, 49ye ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Dé kwo, debam na jeeli dé nɔɔna bam ni, kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ to, dé maane we nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo jei. 50Konto ŋwaane dé laam kwei sabu-seŋa jejegero telo dé na jaane dé kɔɔne Midian tiina bam yera ne to mo dé ba se dé pa Baŋa Wɛ. Sabu-seŋa wonnu tem maa ye bɛ, de jafola, de zwa-kwana, de wonnu tedwonna. Dé ke konto se dé ma dé ke Baŋa Wɛ lei ye dé daare dé le dé tusim o yiga ne mo.”
51Moses de Wɛ kaanem tu Eleaza ma jwoŋi sabu-seŋa jejegero tem jar-keira dedɛɛra bam tei ne. 52Ba déem na jeeli te dunni to, te déem yi kilo bi de funogo (190) mo. Ba ma kwei te maama ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. 53Ko daare jar-keira bam maama de déem jwoŋi ba nyem wonnu telo ba na vere Midian tiina bam tei ne to wone mo. 54Moses de Eleaza déem ma jwoŋi sabu-seŋa wonnu tem dedɛɛra bam tei ne ba ja ba vo ba tiŋi wara-jei sem wone, se ko taa ye gula ko pae Isarele tiina bam Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane.

english_text:
Land East of the Jordan River Is Settled
(Deuteronomy 3.12-22)
1The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland. 2So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said, 3-4“The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep, 5would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
6Moses answered:
You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle? 7If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them. 8 This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land. 9They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it. 10 The Lord became very angry. 11And he said that no one who was 20 years or older when they left Egypt would enter the land he had promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Not one of those people believed in the Lord's power, 12except Caleb and Joshua. They remained faithful to the Lord, 13but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for 40 years. By that time everyone who had sinned against him had died.
14Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier. 15If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
16The men from Reuben and Gad replied:
Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children, 17where they can stay and be safe. Then we'll prepare to fight and lead the other tribes into battle. 18We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands. 19The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
20Moses said:
You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord. 21You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things, 22then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others. 23But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
24Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
25The men from Reuben and Gad answered:
Sir, we will do just what you have said. 26Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead. 27But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
28 Then Moses said to Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders, 29“Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land. 30But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
31The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded. 32We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
33So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
34The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer, 35Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah, 36Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
37The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim, 38Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
39The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites. 40So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
41Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
42Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_text:
Dwia yalo na jeini Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni to
Nia Gulim 3:12-22
1Ko ná ye Ruben de Gad dwia yam, ba vara kɔgɔ déem daga dedɛ. Ba ma na we Jazera tega kam de Gilead tega kam lana se vara bam taa di ba sui. 2Ba ma vo Moses, de Wɛ kaanem tu Eleaza, dedaane Isarele kɔgɔ kom yiga tiina badwonna bam tei, ye ba we, 3-4“Baŋa Wɛ seene o woli debam pa se dé di Atarofa, de Dibon, de Jazera, de Nimira, de Hesebon, de Elealɛ, de Sebam, de Nebo, de Beon. Dé nam maane we tega kalo na gilimi teene dento to tiini ka lana de vara kɔnɔ. Chega to, dé vara kɔgɔ kom daga dedɛ. 5Dé kwo, nmo yi ná su dé kikia yam, sɛ se dé yé bɛ Jɔdan buga kam. Kwei ywo-seeni tega kam n pa debam se dé taa tei.”
6Moses ma leiri Ruben dwi tiina de Gad dwi tiina bam o we:
“Abam nam boŋe se á maŋe ywo-seeni, se á chorro Isarele tiina bam taa vei ba ke jara mo na? 7Abam ná ke konto, á chorro tem vɔna wó pare mo pa se ba ga chwoŋa se ba bɛ Jɔdan buga kam ba vo ba zo tega kalo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa-ba to wone. 8Amo déem na zege Kadese-Baranea ne, ye a toŋe á kwoa bam se ba vo ba nii tega kam to, ba déem ke abam kikia yam dwoŋi mo. 9Ba déem vei ba yi Esekola nabara kam ba nii ba na tega kam na ye tei to. Ba laam ma jwoori dé tei, ye ba pa Isarele tiina bam vɔna pare ye ba we, dé yé zo tega kalo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa debam to wone. 10Dento dɛ dem ne mo Baŋa Wɛ bane zaŋe, ye o du duuri o we:
11‘Nɔɔna balo maama na maŋe ba yi bena finlei ba daŋe ye ba nwoŋi Ejipti teo wone to bá na chwoŋa se ba zo tega kalo wone amo na gwoni ni de ba nabaara Abaraham, de Izaak, de Jakob se a pa-ba to wone. Kokuri to, ba wo yɔɔre ba ke ba wo-dedoa de amo. 12Jefunɛ bu Kaleb, de Nun bu Josua yerane mo wó zo da, banto na ke ba wo-dedoa de amo Baŋa Wɛ to ŋwaane.’
13 Baŋa Wɛ bane déem na zaŋe de Isarele tiina bam konto to, mo o pɛ se ba kaare kagoa kam wone ba beeri taa, bena finna. O ke-ba konto se ko vo ko yi balo na ke lwarem ba pa‑o to maama laam mo tege ba ti.
14Nii-na! Abam nam daa zege se á tɔge á kwoa totoŋ-naga kam mo, se Baŋa Wɛ bane daa tiini de zaŋe Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne de woli da. Á ye puseŋ-nyena mo! 15Abam zem ná ywori Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne, á wó pa se o de ve nɔɔna bam maama mo o yage kagoa kanto wone. Abam wó pa se ba na ba chɔgem.”
16Ruben dwi tiina, de Gad dwi tiina bam ma leiri Moses ba we:
“Dé ya boŋe se dé lɔ jei selo dé na wó pe dé pei sem, de dé bone dem se wone to, se dé daare dé lɔ teene delo dé kaana de dé bia na wó taa zoore da to mo. 17Konto ná kea, dé wó kwei dé jara zela dé to dé dwonna Isarele tiina bam yiga ne se dé vo dé pa ba zo ba tega kam wone. Dé bia bam nam wó taa zoore teene delo na fɔge de pe to wone mo, se tega kam tembia yé wane ba ke-ba kolokolo. 18Dé nam bá jwoori ywo-seeni, ko ná dae we Isarele dwi tiina maama nɛ ba jeiŋa jei se ba jeini. 19Debam tete bá tɔge dé jwoŋi tega kalo na tigi Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ dedwoŋi dem seeni to, dé na nɛ dé tega kam ywo-seeni to ŋwaane.”
20Moses ma leiri-ba o we:
“Abam ná seene yia mo se á ke konto, ti-na yiga se á nwoŋi á vo á ke jara yam Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. 21Nam pa-na se á baara bam maama kwei ba jara zela yam ba tɔge ba bɛ Jɔdan buga kam ba vo ba jeeri dé dona bam de jara, se ko taa nii Baŋa Wɛ ná zeili-ba dé yiga ne 22pa se dé wane ba maama dé di dé daare dé jwoŋi ba tega kam. Konto maama ná kea, se abam de jwoori ywo-seeni á jeini tega kalo wone Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa abam se á ta‑á tei to. Baŋa Wɛ de Isarele tiina bam daa bá taa jege abam jene.
23Abam nam ná wo ke se ko tɔge de á ni dem, ko ye á tusi Baŋa Wɛ chwoŋa ne mo konto. Ta‑á yei-na we, á wɛleere dem konto wó ba de lɔre jaja mo. 24Tɔ. Lɔ-na teene se á kaana de á bia taa zoore de wone. Ta fɔge-na jei se á pe á pei sem, de á bone dem se wone. Nam ta ke-na á na gwoni ni se á ke tei to.”
25Gad dwi tiina de Ruben dwi tiina bam ma leiri Moses ba we:
“Dé kwo. Dé wó ke tei nmo na pɛ debam ni se dé ke to. 26Dé kaana, de dé bia, de dé vara mo wó maŋe Gilead teene dem laŋa ne. 27Ko daare, dé baara bam maama wó ti yiga se dé vo dé ke jara yam Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Dé maa wó bɛ Jɔdan buga kam dé vo dé kwaare jara nenɛɛne nmo na tage tei to.”
28Moses de laam ma pa Wɛ kaanem tu Eleaza, de Nun bu Josua, dedaane Isarele sɔ-yuni yiga tiina bam ni ye o we, 29“Ruben dwi tiina de Gad dwi tiina baara bam maama jege se ba kwei ba jara zela ba tɔge de abam ba bɛ Jɔdan buga kam, se ba vo ba ke jara Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane ba woli abam se á de jwoŋi á tega. Konto ná ke pa se á na á jeiŋa jei, se á laam kwei Gilead laŋa kam á pa-ba se ba taa tei. 30Ba nam ná wo sɛ se ba bɛ ba vo ba ke jara yam, se á pa ba de tɔge ba jwoŋi ba tega Kanaan laŋa kam ne, mɛ á maama na wó jwoŋi á nyem to.”
31Gad dwi tiina bam, de Ruben dwi tiina bam ma leiri ba we, “Dé kwo, dé wó ke se ko tɔge de Baŋa Wɛ ni dem. 32Dé wó kwei dé jara zela dé tɔge dé bɛ Jɔdan buga kam dé zo Kanaan laŋa kam wone se dé ke jara Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Ko kwaga ne dé laam wó jwoori dé jeini ywo-seeni se dé taa tei tega kanto na wo Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni to.”
33Moses déem ma kwei tega o pa Gad dwi tiina bam, de Ruben dwi tiina bam, de Josɛf bu Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom se ba taa tei. O na pɛ-ba tega kalo to maa ye: Amori tiina Pɛ Sihon paare dim laŋa kam, dedaane Basan teo Pɛ Oga paare dim laŋa kam mo, ko ná ye ba tega kam maama, de ba teene dem de de nawuura yam.
34Gad tiina bam déem ma fɔge ba lɔ Dibon, de Atarofa, de Arowa, 35de Aterofa-Sofan, de Jazera, de Jogebeha, 36de Bɛte-Nimira, dedaane Bɛte-Haran. Ba ma lɔ teene dem konto ba pe, ye ba daare ba fɔge jei se ba pe ba pei se wone.
37Ruben tiina bam de ma jwoori ba lɔ Hesebon, de Elealɛ, de Kiriafayim, 38de Nebo, de Baal-Meon, ko woli de Sibima. Ba déem pɛ teene dem konto de yera mo. De yera badwonna de déem leiri mo.
39Manasɛ bu Makira sɔ-yuu tiina bam déem vei Gilead teo kom ba ke jara ba di-ko, ye ba zeili Amori tiina bam ya na zoore da to. 40Konto ŋwaane Moses ma kwei Gilead laŋa kam o pa Makira sɔ-yuu tiina bam se ba taa zoore da. 41Jayira na nwoŋi Manasɛ dwi dem wone to, de ma vo o ke jara o di Gilead nawuura yam. O ma pa se ba lɛɛre ba bwoi-ya we ‘Jayira te-balwa bam’. 42Noba de ma vo o ke jara o di Kenafa teo de ko nawuura yam. O déem ma pa se ba lɛɛre ba bwoi teo kom yere we ‘Noba’.

english_text:
Israel's Journey from Egypt to Moab
1As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron, 2Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
3-4Israel left the Egyptian city of Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. This was the day after the Lord had punished Egypt's gods by killing the first-born sons in every Egyptian family. So while the Egyptians were burying the bodies, they watched the Israelites proudly leave their country.
5After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth, 6and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert. 7Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol. 8They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah. 9Next, they camped at Elim, where there were 12 springs of water and 70 palm trees. 10They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea, 11then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert. 12-14From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water. 15They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
16-36As Israel traveled from the Sinai Desert to Kadesh in the Zin Desert, they camped at Kibroth-Hattaavah, Hazeroth, Rithmah, Rimmon-Perez, Libnah, Rissah, Kehelathah, Mount Shepher, Haradah, Makheloth, Tahath, Terah, Mithkah, Hashmonah, Moseroth, Bene-Jaakan, Hor-Haggidgad, Jotbathah, Abronah, Ezion-Geber, and finally Kadesh. 37When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
38 That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month, 40 years after the Israelites left Egypt. 39He was 123 years old at the time.
40 It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
41-47The Israelites left Mount Hor and headed toward Moab. Along the way, they camped at Zalmonah, Punon, Oboth, Iye-Abarim in the territory of Moab, Dibon-Gad, Almon-Diblathaim, at a place near Mount Nebo in the Abarim Mountains, 48and finally in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho. 49Their camp stretched from Beth-Jeshimoth to Acacia.
The Lord's Command To Conquer Canaan
50While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses 51to give the people of Israel this message:
When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan, 52you must force out the people living there. Destroy their idols and tear down their altars. 53Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
54 I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
55If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you, 56and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_text:
Isarele tiina bam chwo-veili
1Isarele tiina bam na nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne ba kɛ to, Moses de Aron déem mo to ba yiga ne pa se ba via. 2Baŋa Wɛ ma pa Moses ni se o taa popone mɛ de mɛ maama ba na yeini ba yi se ba chwi ba vwoa yam to. Isarele tiina bam na tɔge jei selo ye Moses popone se yera o tiŋi to mo tento:
3Bene delo wone ba na nwoŋi Ejipti ne to, ko ye bene dem konto boboa chana kam da fuga-yanu dɛ ne mo ba zege Ramesesa ne ba nwoŋi se ba kɛ. Ko ye dɛ delo na saŋe Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dɛ dem to mo konto. Ba déem gwɛ de baare ba maa kɛa ye Ejipti tiina bam yɔɔre ba zege ba nii mo. 4Banto maa wora ba suli ba twa, Baŋa Wɛ na mage ba bakeiri-kwe sem maama o go to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ dɛ keim dem konto baŋa ne mo o chɔge Ejipti tiina jwona yam dam.
5Isarele tiina bam déem nwoŋi Ramesesa teo ne, ba vo ba yi Sukofa mo ba chwi ba vwoa ba jeini. 6Ba ma zege dáane ba vo Etam. Ko maa wo kagoa kam ni ne. 7Ba daa ma pipiri ba vo Pi Hahirofa. Jei sem konto wo Baal-Zefon wɛ-puli seeni mo. Ba ma chwi ba vwoa Migidola seeni. 8Ba na yage Pi Hahirofa to, ba ma tɔge Nane-soŋo kom wone ba bɛ ba zo kagoa kam wone. Ba ma kwei da yatɔ ba beeri Etam kagoa kam wone ba vo ba yi Mara. Ba ma chwi ba vwoa dáane. 9Ba na yage Mara to, ba ma vo Elim. Buli-yia fuga-yalei, dedaane konkware fuserepɛ mo wo jei sem konto ne. Ba ma chwi ba vwoa ba jeini da. 10Ba daa na yage Elim to, ba ma jwoori Nane-soŋo kom ni ne ba jeini da. 11Ba na yage Nane-soŋo kom seeni to, ba ma vo ba chwi ba vwoa Sin kagoa kam wone. 12Ba ma zaŋe Sin kagoa kam ne ba vo ba chwi ba vwoa Dofeka ne. 13Ba ma zaŋe Dofeka ne ba vo ba chwi ba vwoa Alusi ne. 14Ba ma zaŋe Alusi ne ba vo ba chwi ba vwoa Refidim ne. Jei sem konto ne na déem tera se nɔɔna bam taa nyɔa. 15Ba na yage Refidim to, ba laam ma zo Sinayi kagoa kam ne.
16-36Isarele tiina bam déem na yage Sinayi kagoa kam to, ba ma beeri taa. Ba na vei ba zege jei selo ne ye ba chwi ba vwoa yam to mo tento:
Kiberof-Hataava, de Hazerofa, de Ritama, de Rimon-Pɛreza, de Libina, de Risa, de Kehelata, de Sefere peo kom, de Harada, de Makelofa, de Tahafe, de Tera, de Mitika, de Hasemona, de Moserofa, de Bene-Jakan, de Hora-Hagidagadi, de Jotibafa, de Aberona, de Ezion-Gebera, de Kadese na wo Zin kagoa kam ne to.
37Ba déem na yage Kadese to, ba ma vo Hora peo kom na wo Edom laŋa kam siseini ni ne to. Ba ma chwi ba vwoa ba jeini da. 38Ba na wora to, mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ Aron ni se o di peo kom yuu. Aron ma di ye o daare o te. Isarele tiina bam na nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne to bena finna bene dem, chane senu chana kam boboa dɛ ne mo o tega. 39O maa jege bena bi de finlei-yatɔ (123).
40Arada teo pɛ na zoore Kanaan kagoa kam na wo tega-kuri seeni to ma ni we Isarele tiina bam beene o jei sem seeni. 41-47Isarele tiina bam déem na yage Hora peo kom ba daare ba beeri ba zege jei selo ne ye ba chwi ba vwoa to mo tento:
Zalemona, de Punon, de Obofe, de Ye-Abarim na wo Moaba laŋa kam siseini ni ne to, de Dibon-Gad, de Alemon-Dibilafayim, de Abarim peero jei selo na bwola de Nebo peo kom to.
48Ba déem na yage Abarim peero tem to, ba ma vo Moaba laŋa kam te-kampare ba jeini. Jei sem konto wo Jɔdan buga kam ni ne mo ye Jeriko de wo bubɛ dedwoŋi dem seeni. 49Isarele tiina bam ma chwi ba vwoa Jɔdan buga kam ni ne, ko zege Bɛte-Jesimofa ne se ko taa vei Abel-Sitim.
50Ba na wo Moaba laŋa kam te-kampare ne konto to, mo Baŋa Wɛ tage de Moses o we:
51“Nam ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Abam ná bɛ Jɔdan buga kam se á zo Kanaan tega kam wone, 52se á kwaane á fe balo na zoore tega kam ne to á zeili-ba. Yɔɔre á chɔge-na ba jwona yalo ba na kwei kandwa de luuru ba ma ke to, dedaane ba wara-jei bimbina yam. 53Laam daare á jeini-na ba tega kam wone, se amo mo kwei-ka a pa abam se á ta‑á tei. 54Nam pɔɔre-na tega kam se á dwia yam maama jwoŋi ba nyem, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu. Abam wó ta jɔrɔ mo, se á ma‑á pɔɔre-ka á pa-ba. Sɔ-yuu maama wó jwoŋi tega se ko maŋe de ba ni na mae tei to mo, ne ba ná maŋe ba ye kɔ-kamunu naa kɔ-balaŋa de.
55Abam nam ná ve se á zeili balo na zoore tega kam ne to, ba balo na daare to wó pa á yera chɛ, nenɛɛne da-chɔrɔ mo chugi á yia, naa sabare mo zɔ á yera yam. Á ná tu á jeini tega kam ne, ba lage ba taa daane abam mo taa. 56Amo Baŋa Wɛ laam maa wó chɔge abam de, nenɛɛne a na boŋe se a ke-ba tei to.”

english_text:
Israel's Borders
1The Lord told Moses 2to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
3The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea. 4It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon. 5It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
6The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
7The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor. 8After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land. 9From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
10The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham, 11and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee, 12then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea.
The land within those four borders will belong to you.
13 Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes. 14The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land 15across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.”
The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
16The Lord said to Moses, 17“Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites. 18One leader from each tribe will help them, 19-28and here is the list of their names:
Caleb son of Jephunneh
from Judah,
Shemuel son of Ammihud
from Simeon,
Elidad son of Chislon
from Benjamin,
Bukki son of Jogli
from Dan,
Hanniel son of Ephod
from Manasseh,
Kemuel son of Shiphtan
from Ephraim,
Elizaphan son of Parnach
from Zebulun,
Paltiel son of Azzan
from Issachar,
Ahihud son of Shelomi
from Asher,
and Pedahel son of Ammihud
from Naphtali.”
29These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_text:
Kanaan tega kam siseina
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta de Moses o we:
2“Pa Isarele tiina bam ni se n daare n bere-ba we: Kanaan tega kam ye tega kalo ba na wó pɔɔre ba pa abam se á ta‑á tei to mo. Á ná tu á zo tega kam konto, se á ta‑á yei we ka siseini mo tento:
3Tega-kuri seeni siseini dem wó tɔge Zin kagoa kam, Edom laŋa kam siseini na wo mɛ to. Wɛ-puli daa kam seeni, siseini dem wó bobo Yɛ naneo kom ne mo. 4Ka ta ma vo ka lɛɛne Nɔŋɔ zwonnu chwoŋa kam tega-kuri seeni ka kɛ ka yi Zin se ka daare ka tɔge Kadese-Baranea kuri seeni ka vo ka yi Hazare-Adara de Azemon. 5Ka laam wó pipiri ka taa tɔge Ejipti bu-nɔgɔ kom se ka vo ka kweeli Mediterania naneo kom ni ne.
6Ko ná ye á tega kam wɛ-zoore seeni siseini dem, de ye Mediterania naneo kom mo.
7Á baŋa seeni siseini dem wó zege Mediterania naneo kom ni ne mo de tole de yi Hora peo kom. 8Ka wó zege dáane ka vo ka yi Lebo-Hamafa, de Zedadi, 9de Ziforon, se ka laam kweeli Hazara-Enan ne.
10Ko nam ná ye á wɛ-puli seeni siseini dem, ka wó zege Hazara-Enan ne mo ka tole ka yi Sefam. 11Ka ta wó tu kuri ka vo Ribila na wo Ayin wɛ-puli seeni to. Ka ná zege dáane ka wó vo ka yi zwonnu telo na wo Galili naneo kom bubɛ delo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to mo, 12se ka laam tu ka tɔge Jɔdan buga kam ka vo ka kweeli Yɛ naneo kom ne.
Abam tega kam siseina yana yam mo konto.”
13Moses déem ma ta de Isarele tiina bam o we, “Tega kanto mo abam jege se á ta jɔrɔ se á pɔɔre-ka á ta‑á tei. Baŋa Wɛ pɛ ni se á kwei-ka á pɔɔre á pa á dwia nogo de chichworo kom mo. 14Kokuri to, Ruben dwi dem, de Gad dwi dem, dedaane Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom maŋe ba na ba tega kam. 15Tega kalo ba na lage ba jwoŋi ba taa tei to wo Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni, mɛ na jeeri Jeriko bubɛ dedwoŋi dem seeni to mo.”
