24Some time later, King Benhadad of Syria called his entire army together, then they marched to Samaria and attacked. 25They kept up the attack until there was nothing to eat in the city. In fact, a donkey's head cost 80 pieces of silver, and a small bowl of pigeon droppings cost 5 pieces of silver.
26One day as the king of Israel was walking along the top of the city wall, a woman shouted to him, “Please, Your Majesty, help me!”
27“Let the Lord help you!” the king said. “Do you think I have grain or wine to give you?” 28Then he asked, “What's the matter anyway?”
The woman answered, “Another woman and I were so hungry that we agreed to eat our sons. She said if we ate my son one day, we could eat hers the next day. 29 So yesterday we cooked my son and ate him. But today when I went to her house to eat her son, she had hidden him.”
30The king tore off his clothes in sorrow, and since he was on top of the city wall, the people saw that he was wearing sackcloth underneath. 31He said, “I pray that God will punish me terribly, if Elisha's head is still on his shoulders by this time tomorrow.” 32Then he sent a messenger to Elisha.
Elisha was home at the time, and the important leaders of Israel were meeting with him. Even before the king's messenger arrived, Elisha told the leaders, “That murderer is sending someone to cut off my head. When you see him coming, shut the door and don't let him in. I'm sure the king himself will be right behind him.”
33Before Elisha finished talking, the messenger came up and said, “The Lord has made all these terrible things happen to us. Why should I think he will help us now?”
translation_text:
Dwooru na puki na baŋa ne tei to
1Dɛ dedwe mo Wɛ sampwori kɔgɔ kom taga de Elisa ba we, “Dé tu, jeiga kalo debam na zoore ye n nii dé baŋa ne to daa ba daga ka pae debam. 2Konto to, pa debam chwoŋa se dé vo Jɔdan buga kam ni dé beeri jeiga kadwoŋi se dé taa zoore da. Dáane debam maama wó wane dé gwoni dɛ dé ma dé che jei se ko taa daga.” Elisa ma leiri-ba o we, “Véi-na á ke konto.”
3Sampwori sem wone dedoa ma ta de Elisa o we, “Jan ja, tɔge dé kwaga se dé vo.” Elisa ma leiri o we, “Tɔ. Amo wó tɔge a vo.”
4Ba ma vo ba yi Jɔdan buga kam ni, ye Elisa de tɔge o wora. Ba ma bobo se ba gwoni teeni dem. 5Ba dedoa na wora o gwoni tio naga to mo o dwooru wom le o to buga kam wone. O ma laare de kwor-dɛa o we, “Woo! Amo tu Elisa, dwooru wom ye a jene‑o mo.” 6Wɛ tontoŋeno Elisa ma bwei‑o o we, “Ko le ko to yei ne mo?” O ma bere‑o ko na to mɛ to. Elisa ma gwoni tio naga o de buga kam wone. O keim dem konto ma pa se dwooru wom puki na bam baŋa ne. 7Elisa ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, “Laare n kwei-ko.” Nɔɔno wom ma tei o jeŋa o le-ko.
Elisa chege Siria jar-keira bam
8Maŋa de maŋa Siria teo pɛ déem yeini o kwaare jara de Isarele tiina bam mo. O ma yeini o bane de o nakwa ye o we, “A laga se dé jeeri-ba ywo naa ywo mo.”
9Wɛ tontoŋeno Elisa de déem ma yeini o toŋe ni o pa Isarele pɛ wom we, “Yé zaŋe n twɛ jeiga kam konto, se Siria jar-keira bam mo vei ba gilimi da.” 10Konto baŋa ne Isarele teo pɛ ma yeini o toŋe ni mɛ seeni Wɛ tontoŋeno wom na tage to se ko jeiga kam nɔɔna bam taa fɔge ba cho ba tete. Ko déem ke konto mo kuni dedɛ.
11Siria tiina pɛ wom boboŋa déem vugimi de keim dem konto. O ma bwoŋi o dedɛɛra bam ye o bwei-ba o we, “Abam wone wɔ tete mo nwoŋi a kwaga ne se o woli Isarele tiina pɛ wom?” 12Dedɛɛra bam wone dedoa ma leiri o we, “Dé tu, ko dae debam wolowolo mo ke konto. Ko ye Isarele tu Elisa wolo na ye Wɛ sampwora to mo tɛ woŋo maama o bere Isarele tiina pɛ wom. O bere o yei nmo na tɛ kolo maama n diga ne to de.” 13Pɛ wom ma ta o we, “Véi-na á beeri Elisa jei se a pa nɔɔna vo ba ja‑o.” Ba ma nii ba na‑o ye ba daare ba ta de pɛ wom we, “Elisa wo Dotan ne mo.” 14Pɛ wom ma toŋe o jar-keira dedɛ, de ba sisei, de ba torokooro se ba vo jeiga kam konto. Tete ne ba ma vo ba yi Dotan, ye ba kaare teo kom ba pu.
15Tega na poore tetete to mo Elisa tontoŋeno wom zaŋe o nwoŋi pwooni o na we jar-keira, de ba sisei, de ba torokooro mo kaare teo kom maama ba pu. O ma vo o ta de Elisa o we, “Woo, amo tu, lɛɛro yi debam! Dé nam wó ke tɛ mo?” 16Elisa ma leiri‑o o we, “Yé ta‑n kɔre foone, se balo na wo debam tei ne to daga ba dwoi balo na wo banto tei ne to.” 17Elisa ma lwoori Wɛ o we, “Baŋa Wɛ, puri a tontoŋeno wom yia se o wane o na amo na tɛ kolo to.” Baŋa Wɛ ma seene o puri nɔn-doŋo wom yia pa o nii o na we, sisei kɔgɔ kɔgɔ de torokooro dedɛ na jege min-vogo to mo faare peo kom maama te gilimi Elisa.
18Siria jar-keira bam ma fɔɔre ba yi se ba ja Elisa. Elisa ma lwoori Baŋa Wɛ o we, “A lwoori‑m se n pa nɔɔna banto maama yia dwei.” Baŋa Wɛ ma seene o pa se ba yia dwei, ne Elisa na lwoori‑o tei to. 19Elisa ma vo ba tei ye o ta-ba o we, “Abam tusi chwoŋa mo á ba teo konto wone. Tɔge-na amo kwaga se a ja abam a vo a bere wolo á na beeri to.” O ma ja-ba o vo Samaria.
20Ba na yɔɔre ba yi Samaria ba zo teo kom wo to mo Elisa lwoori Wɛ o we, “Baŋa Wɛ, puri nɔɔna banto yia se ba jwoori ba taa nae.” Baŋa Wɛ ma seene o ke konto pa se ba nae. Ba ma na we ba tu ba wo Samaria teo wone mo.
21Isarele tiina pɛ wom na nɛ-ba to, o ma bwei Elisa o we, “Amo tu, chwoŋa wora se a go-ba na?” 22Elisa ma leiri o we, “Aawo! Yé go-ba. Ko ná maŋe ko ye nɔɔna balo nmo na wane jara wone n ja to, n dae se n go-ba. Nam pa-ba wodiu se ba di se ba daare ba nyɔ na. Ba ná ti, se n pa-ba chwoŋa se ba jwoori ba tu wom tei.” 23Pɛ wom ma ke wodi-fɔrɔ kuri o pa-ba. Siria jar-keira bam na di ba ti to, o ma pa ba viiri. Ba ma jwoori ba vo ba tete pɛ wom tei. Keim dem konto kwaga ne, Siria tiina bam daa maa wo jwoori ba zo Isarele tiina laŋa kam se ba vere ba wonnu ba ja ba viiri.
Siria tiina kwaare jara de Samaria teo
24Konto kwaga ne mo Siria teo pɛ Ben-Hadadi ke o jar-keira kɔgɔ kom maama o ke daane pa se ba vo Samaria ba kwaare jara de Isarele tiina bam. 25Ba ma vo ba kaare Samaria teo kom taa ba pu. Ko ma pa se kana tiini ka zo teo kom. Bonaga yuu kwora déem ye lu-nyenno sabu-dala funɔnɔ mo. Kunkwon-puura beinnu bɔŋa balaŋa maa ye lu-nyenno sabu-dala yanu.
26Isarele tiina pɛ wom déem na tɔge teo kom kabira baŋa o maa kɛ to, mo kaane wodwoŋi laare de kwor-dɛa o we, “Jan ja, amo tu, zeini-ne!” 27Pɛ wom ma leiri‑o o we, “Baŋa Wɛ yerane ná wo zeini‑m, amo laam ke titigiro mo. A jege mena mo naa a jege sana mo?” 28O ta ma bwei kaane wom o we, “Bɛ mo daane‑m?” Kaane wom ma leiri o we, “Kaane wodwoŋi ya mo taga de amo se a ja a bu a go se dé maama di, se dɛ dedwoŋi ne o de daa ja o bu o go se dé maama di. 29A ma seene a go a bu wom a daare a saŋe‑o pa se dé maama di. Tega na poore to, a ma ta ded‑o se o de ja o bu wom o go se dé di. Kaane wom ma ve ye kwei o bu wom o seigi.”
30Pɛ wom na nigi kaane wom taane dem to, o ma vaŋe o gwaaro o kaare wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane. O ta na dɔge kabira kam yuu ne o vei to, nɔɔna ma kwoni ba nii ba na o gwaaro tem na kaare mɛ seeni ye o zo gare-nyenyaaro te kuri ne to. 31Pɛ wom ma du duuri o we, “Amo ná wo gwoni Safate bu Elisa yuu zem dɛ dem ne, se Wɛ ti a momwɛ.”
32Elisa déem maa jei o sɔŋɔ ne de Isarele teo nakwa ye ba lara. Pɛ wom ma toŋe o tontoŋeno se o vo o bwoŋi‑o. Tontoŋeno wom ta na wo yi to, Elisa ya maŋe o ta de nakwa bam o we, “Á wo nɛ na? Nɔn-goro wonto mo toŋe nɔɔno se o ba o gwoni a yuu. Nii-na, o tontoŋeno wom ná yia, se á ja bworru tem á pe‑o á yage pwooni yiga ne. Ko nam bá dáane ye pɛ wom tete saŋe o kwaga o ba.”
33Elisa ni wo to tega ne de tontoŋeno wom na yi o tei. Pɛ wom de ma yi ye o we, “Lɛɛro tento maama na tu de baŋa to ye Baŋa Wɛ yiga mo. Amo nam wó cheigi tento a vo a maŋe yein-seeni mo se Baŋa Wɛ laam ba o zeini debam?”

english_text:
1Elisha answered, “I have a message for you. The Lord promises that tomorrow here in Samaria, you will be able to buy a large sack of flour or two large sacks of barley for almost nothing.”
2The chief officer there with the king replied, “I don't believe it! Even if the Lord sent a rainstorm, it couldn't produce that much grain by tomorrow.”
“You will see it happen, but you won't eat any of the food,” Elisha warned him.
The Syrian Army Stops Its Attack
3About the same time, four men with leprosy were just outside the gate of Samaria. They said to each other, “Why should we sit here, waiting to die? 4There's nothing to eat in the city, so we would starve if we went inside. But if we stay out here, we will die for sure. Let's sneak over to the Syrian army camp and surrender. They might kill us, but they might not.” 5-8That evening the four men got up and left for the Syrian camp.
As they walked toward the camp, the Lord caused the Syrian troops to hear what sounded like the roar of a huge cavalry. The soldiers said to each other, “Listen! The king of Israel must have hired Hittite and Egyptian troops to attack us. Let's get out of here!” So they ran out of their camp that night, leaving their tents and horses and donkeys.
When the four men with leprosy reached the edge of the Syrian camp, no one was there. They walked into one of the tents, where they ate and drank, before carrying off clothes, as well as silver and gold. They hid all this, then walked into another tent; they took what they wanted and hid it too.
9They said to each other, “This isn't right. Today is a day to celebrate, and we haven't told anyone else what has happened. If we wait until morning, we will be punished. Let's go to the king's palace at once and tell the good news.”
10They went back to Samaria and shouted up to the guards at the gate, “We've just come from the Syrian army camp, and all the soldiers are gone! The tents are empty, and the horses and donkeys are still tied up. We didn't see or hear anybody.”
11The guards reported the news to the king's palace. 12The king got out of bed and said to his officers, “I know what those Syrians are doing. They know we're starving, so they're hiding in the fields, hoping we will go out to look for food. When we do, they can capture us and take over our city.”
13One of his officers replied, “We have a few horses left—why don't we let some men take five of them and go to the Syrian camp and see what's happening? We're going to die anyway like those who have already died.” 14They found two chariots, and the king commanded the men to find out what had happened to the Syrian troops.
15The men rode as far as the Jordan River. All along the way they saw clothes and equipment that the Syrians had thrown away as they escaped. Then they went back to the king and told him what they had seen.
16At once the people went to the Syrian camp and carried off what was left. They took so much that a large sack of flour and two large sacks of barley sold for almost nothing, just as the Lord had promised.
17The king of Israel had put his chief officer in charge of the gate, but he died when the people trampled him as they rushed out of the city. 18Earlier, when the king was at Elisha's house, Elisha had told him that flour or barley would sell for almost nothing. 19But the officer refused to believe that even the Lord could do that. So Elisha warned him that he would see it happen, but would not eat any of the food. 20And that's exactly what happened—the officer was trampled to death.
translation_text:
1Elisa ma leiri o we, “Nam cheigi Baŋa Wɛ kwora. Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Jwa kanto maŋa ne ba wó taa jege mun-bwei bɔŋa ba yeigi mɔle mɔle sabu-dale dedoa mo Samaria yaga ne. Chaara bwɛ selei de wó yeigi sabu-dale dedoa.” 2Dedɛɛro wolo na tiini o bwola de pɛ wom to ma ta de Wɛ tontoŋeno Elisa o we, “Baŋa Wɛ tete ná maŋe o pore wɛyuu kom se doa tiini ka ne mo de, konto bá wane ko ke.” Elisa ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo tete yi wó na ko na wó seene ko ke tei to. Nmo nam bá da n laŋe wodiu kom.”
Siria jar-keira bam na viiri ye ko daare ko ke tei to
3Baara bana déem mo jei Samaria teo manchwoŋo kom ni ne ba na ye naywanno. Ba ma ta ba bere daane ba we, “Debam wó taa jei ywo-seeni se toone ja debam wo bɛ mo? 4Dé ná we, ‘Pa-na se dé zo teo kom wo,’ kana wó go debam dáane. Dé nam ná maŋe ywo, de ta wó te mo. Nam pa-na se dé zaŋe dé vo Siria tiina jar-keira bam tei dé sɛ dé pa-ba. Ba wae ba yage debam se dé taa ŋwe. Ko nam ná dae konto, ba wó go debam ye ko ti.”
5Tega déem na lage ka yi to, ba ma zaŋe ba vo Siria tiina bam ya na tigisi daane mɛ to. Ba na vei ba yi jeiga kam to, ba ma nii ba na we nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera. 6Kokuri to Baŋa Wɛ ya pɛ se Siria tiina bam ni sɔɔ nenɛɛne torokooro de sisei na wuura ye jar-keira kɔgɔ kɔgɔ gwɛ tei to mo. Ba ma ta ba bere daane ba we, “Ko wó taa ye Isarele teo pɛ mo ware Hiti tiina de Ejipti tiina pwa se ba ba ba ke chichuŋu de debam.” 7Ko déem ma pa se foone zo-ba pa se ba duri tete dem konto ne ba jage da-yiga ne ba yage ba vwoa, de ba sisei, ko woli de ba bonɛ, de ba wonnu maama. Ba déem yage te maama puna mo se ba wane ba duri ba lu ye ba ta ŋwe.
8Naywanno tena tem na fɔɔre ba yi jei sem to, ba ma zo vwoa yam dedoa wone ba na wodiu ba di ba daare ba nyɔ na. Ba déem ta kwei Siria tiina bam lu-nyenno, de ba sabu-seŋa, ko woli de ba gwaaro ba ja ba vo ba seigi. Ba ta ma jwoori ba zo vwei dedwoŋi ba kwei wonnu tedwonna ba ja ba vo ba seigi. 9Ba ma ta ba bere daane ba we, “Kolo dé na jege dé ke to ba lana. Zem dɛ dem mo dé jege kwor-ywoŋa se dé tɔɔle dé pa nɔɔna maama, ye dé jege dé jei kafɛ yerane. Dé nam ná chem se tega poore, de wó ná waarem ko ŋwaane. Pa-na se dé ke lela dé vo pɛ sɔŋɔ dé ta kolo na ke to.”
10Ba ma jwoori ba vo ba yi teo kom manchwoŋo ni. Ba ma tɔɔle ba bere teo kom ni-yerena bam ba we, “Debam vei Siria jar-keira bam jei sem dé nii, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera. Kolokolo sɔɔ de nam ba dɔna. Ba sisei sem, de ba bonɛ sem na leigi se zege tei to mo se na zega. Ba vwoa yam de maa na zege tei mo ya na zega.” 11Teo kom ni-yerena bam ma ja kwora kam ba vo ba ta ba bere pɛ sɔŋɔ ne. 12Pɛ wom ma zaŋe tete dem konto o ta de o tontoŋena bam o we, “Amo wó ta a bere abam Siria tiina bam na boŋe se ba ke kolo to. Ba na yei we kana lage ka go debam to mo ba yage ba vwoa yam ba daare ba vo ba seigi gaao wone. Ba maa boŋe ba we, debam wó nwoŋi dé beeri wodiu dé di. Debam maa ná ke konto, ba laam wó na chwoŋa ba ja debam ŋweene ba daare ba taa tei dé teo kom.” 13O dedɛɛra bam dedoa ma leiri o we, “Pa nɔɔna kwei sisei sem ta na daare to senu ba vo ba nii keim dento baŋa ne. Banto ná maŋe ba te ko ŋwaane, ko ta ye bedwe mo de balo maama na maŋe teo kom wone ye ba lage ba te to.”
14Ba ma le nɔɔna de torokooro telei de te sisei. Pɛ wom ma toŋe-ba se ba vo ba nii kolo na ke Siria tiina jar-keira bam to. 15Nɔɔna bam ma tɔge Siria tiina bam nɛ taa ba vo ba yi Jɔdan buga kam. Ba ma na Siria tiina bam na duri se ba lu ye ba kwei ba gwaaro de ba zela dedɛ ba de ba yage chwoŋa kam yuu ne tei to. Ba laam ma jwoori ba vo pɛ wom tei ba ta ba bere‑o ko na ke tei to.
16Teo kom nɔɔna bam ma ke lela ba nwoŋi ba vo Siria tiina vwoa yam jei ba pɛ ba zela de ba wodiiru maama. Ba déem ma seene ba jege mun-bwei bɔŋa ba yeigi sabu-dale dedoa dedoa. Chaara bwɛ selei de yeigi sabu-dale dedoa mo. Ko déem yɔɔre ko ke ne Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o ta tei to mo.
17Ko nam ná ye dedɛɛro wolo na tiini o bwola de pɛ wom to, pɛ wom ya tiŋi‑o se o taa nii teo kom ni-yerena bam baŋa ne mo. Teo kom nɔɔna bam na duri ba maa nwoŋa to, ba ma nɔne dedɛɛro wom konto pa se o te manchwoŋo kom ni ne. Konto ma pa se Elisa na wuuri o ta kolo to ji chega. 18Kokuri to, Wɛ tontoŋeno Elisa ya maŋe o ta o bere pɛ wom o we, “Jwa kanto maŋa ne ba wó taa jege chaara bwɛ selei ba yeigi sabu-dale dedoa mo Samaria yaga ne. Mun-bwei bɔŋa de wó yeigi sabu-dale dedoa.” 19Pɛ dedɛɛro wom ya wo sɛ ye o we, “Baŋa Wɛ tete ná maŋe o pore wɛyuu kom se doa tiini ka ne mo de, konto bá wane ko ke.” Elisa de ya kaane‑o mo o we, “Nmo tete yi wó na ko na wó seene ko ke tei to. Nmo nam bá da n laŋe wodiu kom.” 20Konto nam mo yɔɔre ko ke‑o. Nɔɔna mo nɔne‑o manchwoŋo kom ni ne pa se o te.

english_text:
The Woman from Shunem Is Given Back Her Land
1 Elisha told the woman whose son he had brought back to life, “The Lord has warned that there will be no food here for seven years. Take your family and go live somewhere else for a while.” 2The woman did exactly what Elisha had said and went to live in Philistine territory.
She and her family lived there seven years. 3Then she returned to Israel and immediately begged the king to give back her house and property.
4Meanwhile, the king was asking Gehazi the servant of Elisha about the amazing things Elisha had been doing. 5While Gehazi was telling him that Elisha had brought a dead boy back to life, the woman and her son arrived.
“Here's the boy, Your Majesty,” Gehazi said. “And this is his mother.”
6The king asked the woman to tell her story, and she told him everything that had happened. He then said to one of his officials, “I want you to make sure that this woman gets back everything that belonged to her, including the money her crops have made since the day she left Israel.”
Hazael Kills Benhadad
7Some time later Elisha went to the capital city of Damascus to visit King Benhadad of Syria, who was sick. And when Benhadad was told he was there, 8he said to Hazael, “Go meet with Elisha the man of God and get him to ask the Lord if I will get well. And take along a gift for him.”
9Hazael left with forty camel loads of the best things made in Damascus as a gift for Elisha. He found the prophet and said, “Your servant, King Benhadad, wants to know if he will get well.”
10“Tell him he will,” Elisha said to Hazael. “But the Lord has already told me that Benhadad will definitely die.” 11Elisha stared at him until Hazael was embarrassed, then Elisha began crying.
12“Sir, why are you crying?” Hazael asked.
Elisha answered, “Because I know the terrible things you will do to the people of Israel. You will burn down their walled cities and slaughter their young men. You will even crush the heads of their babies and rip open their pregnant women.”
13 “How could I ever do anything like that?” Hazael replied. “I'm only a servant and don't have that kind of power.”
“Hazael, the Lord has told me that you will be the next king of Syria.”
14Hazael went back to Benhadad and told him, “Elisha said that you will get well.” 15But the very next day, Hazael got a thick blanket; he soaked it in water and held it over Benhadad's face until he died. Hazael then became king.
King Jehoram of Judah
(2 Chronicles 21.2-20)
16Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah in Joram's fifth year as king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was still king of Judah. 17Jehoram was 32 years old when he became king, and he ruled 8 years from Jerusalem.
18Jehoram disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He married Ahab's daughter and was as sinful as Ahab's family and the kings of Israel. 19 But the Lord refused to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah.
20 While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king. 21So Jehoram and his cavalry marched to Zair, where the Edomite army surrounded him and his commanders. During the night he attacked the Edomites, but he was defeated, and his troops escaped to their homes. 22Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time.
23Everything else Jehoram did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. 24Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king.
King Ahaziah of Judah
(2 Chronicles 22.1-6)
25Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel. 26Ahaziah was 22 years old when he became king, and he ruled from Jerusalem for only one year. His mother was Athaliah, a granddaughter of King Omri of Israel. 27Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.
28Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle, 29so he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. Ahaziah went there to visit him.
translation_text:
Da-kore zege Isarele teo ne
1Elisa déem ya maŋe o ta de kaane wolo bu o na bi to o we, “Zaŋe n viiri, nmo de n diga tiina, se á wane á na jeiga kadwoŋi á ta‑á zoore da. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa jaane se o pa da-kore mo zege tega kanto baŋa ne bena yarepɛ.” 2Kaane wom ma seene o ke kolo maama Wɛ tontoŋeno wom na taga to. O de o diga tiina maama ma vo ba zoore Filisi tiina teo ne bena yarepɛ.
3Bena yarepɛ yam ni na ti to o ma zege Filisi teo kom ne o jwoori o tete teo. O ma vo o lwoori pɛ wom se o jwoori o jwoŋi o sɔŋɔ de o tega se o taa zoora. 4O na yi pɛ wom tei to, de pɛ wom ya jege lara de Gehazi wolo na ye Elisa tontoŋeno to. Pɛ wom ma ta de Gehazi o we, “Ta n bere-ne wo-kenkagela yalo maama Elisa na ke to.” 5Gehazi ma lwoni Elisa déem na pɛ se bu wodwoŋi bi tei to. O ta na wora o ŋɔɔne konto to mo kaane wom tete de o bu wolo Elisa na bi to yia. Kaane wom ya tu se se o lwoori pɛ wom o sɔŋɔ kom de o tega kam ŋwaane mo. Gehazi ma na ye o we, “Amo tu, kaane wolo a na tɛ o taane to mo tento. Bu wom Elisa na bi to de tete mo tento o yia.” 6Pɛ wom ma bwei kaane wom se o lɔre kolo na ke to. Kaane wom ma tole ko na ke tei maama to nywa o de o jea ne. Pɛ wom na nigi ko maama to, o ma bwoŋi o dedɛɛro se o nii kaane wom taane dem baŋa ne. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Kolo maama ya na ye kaane wom nyem to se n kwei n jwoori n pa‑o, ko ta woli de o na gɛ nyɔɔre delo o tega kam ŋwaane, ko zege maŋa kalo o na viiri to se ko ba ko yi zem to de maama.”
Hazayeli go Ben-Hadadi
7Wɛ tontoŋeno Elisa déem ma vo Damasika. Siria tiina pɛ Ben-Hadadi maa ba jege yazura. Pɛ wom na maane we Elisa tu to, 8o ma ta de Hazayeli o we, “Ja pɛɛra n vo n ware Wɛ tontoŋeno wom se n daare n pa se o bwei Baŋa Wɛ o nii, amo wó wori na?” 9Hazayeli ma la zela yalo na wo Damasika ne ye te lana to dedɛ o daŋe kona finna baŋa ne o ja o vo se o pa Elisa. O ma zo o zege Elisa yiga ne ye o we, “Nmo bu Ben-Hadadi na ye Siria teo pɛ to mo toŋe-ne se a bwei a nii, o wó wori na?” 10Elisa ma leiri‑o o we, “Véi n ta ded‑o we, ‘Chega to, n wó wori.’ Baŋa Wɛ nam maŋe o veere o bere-ne we, o wó te mo.” 11Elisa ma yɔɔre o nii Hazayeli yibia ne zii pa se chaveera ja‑o. Elisa laam ma to keira ne. 12Hazayeli ma bwei‑o o we, “Amo tu, bɛŋwaane mo nmo keera?” Elisa ma leiri o we, “Amo yei lɛɛro telo na wó yi Isarele tiina bam nmo ŋwaane to. Nmo wó pa se mini di ba dam jei sem, n daare n go ba nɔn-donno jara wone. Nmo ta wó yigi ba bu-sese n de tega ne n go, ye n daare n lɔ ba kapwi sem ba pwi seeni n go. Konto ŋwaane mo a keera.” 13Hazayeli ma leiri o we, “A ye nabwom mo. Amo nyeene dento wó ke tɛ mo a toŋe totoŋ-kamunnu tento dwoŋi?” Elisa ma leiri o we, “Baŋa Wɛ nam veere o bere-ne we, n lage n di Siria teo paare mo.”
14Hazayeli ma zege Elisa tei ne o jwoori o vo pɛ wom tei. Ben-Hadadi ma bwei‑o o we, “Elisa tage bɛ mo dede‑m?” Hazayeli ma leiri o we, “O we, n wó wori.” 15Tega na yɔɔre ka poore to mo Hazayeli kwei gare-jale o de na wone o ma o peene pɛ Ben-Hadadi momwɛ o go. O na ke konto to, o ma lɛɛre o ji pɛ.
Judah teo pɛ Jehoram taane
16Isarele teo pɛ Ahab bu Joram bena yanu paare dim bene dem wone ye Jehosafate ta ye Judah teo pɛ to mo Jehosafate bu Jehoram bobo se o di paare Judah ne. 17O déem jege bena fintɔ-yalei mo ye o laam ji pɛ. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke bena nana. 18Jehoram déem kwei Isarele pwa bam totoŋ-naga mo, nenɛɛne pɛ Ahab de o dwi dem na ke tei to, kokuri to o di Ahab bukɔ mo. Konto to, o déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga. 19Baŋa Wɛ nam wo sɛ se o chɔge Judah dwi dem, bɛŋwaane o maŋe o gwoni ni de o tontoŋeno David we, o diga kam wó taa tei paare dem taa wuu.
20Jehoram paare dim maŋa ne mo Edom dwi dem ve se ba taa wo Judah pɛ wom dam kuri ne. Ba ma lɛɛre ba tiŋi ba tete pɛ. 21Jehoram ma ja o jar-keira de ba torokooro tem maama o vo se o li Zayiri teo. Edom tiina bam ma ba ba gilimi o de o nɔɔna bam ba ke tetare ne. Tete ne mo Jehoram de o dedɛɛra bam wane ba lu ba jeŋa ne. O jar-keira bam de ma pipiri ba duri ba jwoori sɔŋɔ. 22De zem maama Edom tiina ta ve mo se ba taa wo Judah tiina dam kuri ne. Libina teo tiina de déem ke konto dwoŋi mo.
23Jehoram déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. 24O ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli o kwoa bam yibeeli ne David teo Jerusalem ne. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Ahazia ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.
Judah teo pɛ Ahazia taane
25Isarele teo pɛ Ahab bu Joram bena fuga-yalei paare dim bene dem ne mo Jehoram bu Ahazia bobo se o di Judah teo paare. 26O déem jege bena finlei-yalei mo ye o laam ji pɛ. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke bene dedwe. O nu déem mo ye Atalia wolo na ye Isarele teo pɛ Omiri naa to. 27Ahazia déem kwei pɛ Ahab de o dwi dem totoŋ-naga kam mo. O tiini o toŋe lwarem mo o ma o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga, nenɛɛne Ahab de o dwi dem na ke tei to, Ahab na ye o tembaaro to ŋwaane.
28Ahazia déem dɛ de pɛ Ahab bu Joram mo pa se ba vo Ramofa-Gilead ba kwaare jara de Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli. Siria tiina bam ma ke Joram zonne jara yam wone. 29Mo kokuri o jwoori o vo Jezerele teo se o teibi o fufwollu tem. O na wo Jezerele ne to, Judah teo pɛ Ahazia ma vo o tei se o ware‑o de o zonne dem.

english_text:
Jehu Becomes King of Israel
1One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said:
Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead. 2When you get there, find Jehu son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a place where the two of you can be alone, 3then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, “The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel.” Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!
4The young prophet left for Ramoth. 5When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. “Sir, I have a message for you,” he said.
“For which one of us?” Jehu asked.
“You, sir,” the prophet answered. 6 So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him:
The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: “I am the Lord, and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel. 7I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants. 8Every man and boy in Ahab's family must die, whether slave or free. 9His whole family must be destroyed, just like the families of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah. 10 As for Jezebel, her body will be eaten by dogs in the town of Jezreel. There won't be enough left of her to bury.”
Then the young prophet opened the door and ran out.
11Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, “What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right?”
“You know him and how he talks,” Jehu answered.
12“No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked.
“He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
13They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!”
Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
14-16King Joram of Israel had been badly wounded in the battle at Ramoth, trying to defend it against King Hazael and the Syrian army. Joram was now recovering in Jezreel, and King Ahaziah of Judah was there, visiting him.
Meanwhile, Jehu was in Ramoth, making plans to kill Joram. He said to his officers, “If you want me to be king, then don't let anyone leave this town. They might go to Jezreel and tell Joram.” Then Jehu got in his chariot and rode to Jezreel.
17When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.”
Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
18One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.”
“What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!”
About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
19So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.”
“What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
20The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
21Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth. 22Joram asked, “Jehu, is this a peaceful visit?”
“How can there be peace?” Jehu asked. “Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.”
23“Ahaziah, let's get out of here!” Joram yelled. “It's a trap!” As Joram tried to escape, 24Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
25-26 Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? It was then that the Lord swore to Ahab that he would be punished in the same field where he had killed Naboth and his sons. So throw Joram's body there, just as the Lord said.”
27Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died. 28Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
29Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year of the rule of Ahab's son Joram.
Jehu Kills Jezebel
30Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive. 31As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
32He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window, 33and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
34Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
35But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet. 36 They reported this to Jehu, and he said, “The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel. 37And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.”
translation_text:
Ba tiŋi Jehu paare dem
1Dɛ dedwe mo Wɛ sampwori Elisa déem le nɔɔno wodwoŋi Wɛ sampwori kɔgɔ kom wone o ta ded‑o o we, “Fɔge n vɔ n gare-kura kiri-kiri n daare n jwoŋi kabɔɔ konto de ko wo nuga kam n ja n vo Ramofa-Gilead. 2Nmo ná yi da, se n beeri Jehu wolo na ye Jehosafate bu de Nimisi naa to jeiga. Nmo ná nɛ‑o, se n le‑o o yuudwonna wone n ja n zo diga wo. 3Laam kwei nuga kam n lwo Jehu yuu ne n daare ta ded‑o we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: amo laam mo tiŋi‑m se n ji Isarele teo pɛ.’ Nmo ná ke konto n ti, se n pore diga kam n nwoŋi n yage jeiga kam lela n viiri.”
4Nɔn-doŋo kom na ye Elisa tontoŋeno to ma seene o vo Ramofa-Gilead. 5O na yi da to, o ma nii o na jar-keira yiga tiina bam na jei daane ye ba lara. O ma ta o we, “Amo tu, a jege kwora mo se a pa‑m.” Jehu ma bwei o we, “Kwora kam ye debam maama wone wɔ tete nyem mo?” O ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, ko ye nmo nyem mo.” 6Banto balei ma zo diga kam wo. Nɔn-doŋo kom ma kwei nuga kam o lwo Jehu yuu ne, ye o daare o ta we, “Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage kolo to mo tento: amo laam mo tiŋi‑m se n ji amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam pɛ. 7Nmo nam jege se n chɔge n tu Ahab dwi dem mo. Amo wó da konto baŋa ne a waare Jezebele de o na go a sampwori sem de a tontoŋena bam to. 8Ahab dwi dem maama jege se ba te mo. O dwi dem bakeiri sem maama wó saare Isarele teo ne, ko ná ye balo ta na wo ba kwo sɔŋɔ ne to, de balo na tei ba tete to de. 9Amo lage a pa se o dwi dem yɔɔre de chɔge nenɛɛne a na ke Nebat bu Jeroboam dwi dem, de Ahija bu Baasa dwi dem tei to mo. 10Ko nam ná ye Jezebele, kukuri mo lage se di‑o Jezerele tega kam baŋa ne, ye nɔɔna bá kwei‑o ba suli.” Nɔn-doŋo kom na yɔɔre o ta konto o ti to, mo o pore diga kam o duri o viiri.
11Jehu na nwoŋi o jwoori o dwonna yiga tiina bam tei to mo ba dedoa bwei‑o o we, “Yazura mo na? Bɛ mo ke ye chichwoo konto ba nmo tei?” Jehu ma leiri o we, “Ko dae kolokolo. Abam maŋe á yei sampwora kanto dwoŋi na yirisi tei to.” 12Ba ma leiri ba we, “N fɔe vwa mo! Ta n bere debam o na taga kolo to chekke.” Jehu ma ta o bere-ba nɔn-doŋo kom na tage kolo de kolo to ye o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Amo tiŋi nmo mo se n ji Isarele tiina bam pɛ.”
13Jehu yuudwonna bam maama ma ke lela ba le ba gare-danno ba lware Jehu nɛ sem seeni. Ba ma daare ba wu nabwanno ye ba tɔɔle we, “Jehu mo ye pɛ.”
14Konto baŋa ne mo Jehosafate bu Jehu déem ke chichuŋu de Joram. Kanto maŋa ne Joram dedaane Isarele tiina bam maama ya yere Ramofa-Gilead mo se ba che Siria pɛ Hazayeli de o jar-keira bam. 15Pɛ Joram nam ya jwoori Jezerele mo se o teibi o fufwollu tem Siria tiina bam na ke o yera ne to. Jehu ma ta de balo na wo o tei ne to we, “Abam boboŋa ná seene ya ja se a ji pɛ, nam yé pa-na se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chwoŋa o nwoŋi teo konto ne o vo Jezerele o ta kolo na ke to.” 16Jehu ma jeini o toroko baŋa ne o duri o kɛ Jezerele se o beeri pɛ Joram, o na tigi dáane de o fufwollu tem to ŋwaane. Ko maa ye dáane mo Judah teo pɛ Ahazia ya vei se o ware‑o.
17Jehu de o nɔɔna bam na twɛ Jezerele teo kom to mo yereno wodwoŋi zege teo kom vɔŋɔ yuu ne o tole o na ba na maa beene. O ma tɔɔle o ta de Joram o we, “Amo nɛ nɔɔna mo na wurigi sisei ba beene.” Pɛ Joram de ma ta o we, “Pa se nɔɔno kwei siseiŋa o vo o yi o bwei o nii ba veiŋa kam ye yazura veiŋa mo na?”
18Nɔɔno ma seene o di siseiŋa baŋa o vo o jeeri Jehu. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Pɛ Joram bwei se o lɔre, á beene de yazura mo na?” Jehu ma leiri o we, “Nmo yiga mo ka kɔ? Nam pipiri n zo a kwaga kɔgɔ kom wone.” Teo kom yereno wom na tole o na to, o ma bwoŋi pɛ wom o ta ded‑o we, “Wolo n na toŋe to yi da, ye o nam ba jwoora.”
19Pɛ Joram daa ma toŋe nɔɔno wodwoŋi o ke belei. Wonto de ma di siseiŋa baŋa o vo o yi Jehu de o nɔɔna bam tei. O ma ta de Jehu o we, “Pɛ wom bwei se o lɔre, á beene de yazura mo na?” Jehu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo yiga mo ka kɔ? Nam pipiri n zo a kwaga kɔgɔ kom wone.” 20Teo kom yereno wom daa ta ma ta o we, “Nmo na toŋe wolo to yi da, ye o de nam ba jwoora. Ba yiga tu wom na wurigi tei o beene to nye de Nimisi bu Jehu mo. O na duri tei to nye de o yirisi mo.”
21Joram ma pa ni o we, “Ti-na siseiŋa de a toroko kom yiga á pa-ne.” Ba na ti to, Isarele teo pɛ Joram, dedaane Judah teo pɛ Ahazia ma di ba torokooro ba vo ba jeeri Jehu. Ba ma yi‑o tega kalo déem na ye Jezerele tu Nabofi nyem to jeiga ne. 22Joram na jeeri Jehu to, o ma bwei‑o o we, “Yazura veiŋa mo n vei na?” Jehu ma leiri o we, “Yazura laam wo yeim mo ye n nu Jezebele yɔɔre o tɔge jwo-yɔɔro de liri-mwa kikia?”
23Joram na nigi konto to, o ma pipiri o duri ye o laare baŋa baŋa o bwoŋi Ahazia o ta o we, “Swa mo o kea! Pa dé ke lela dé duri dé lu!” 24Jehu ma yɔɔre o saŋe o taŋa o ta Joram. Chene dem ma zɔ o bakale tetare laŋa seeni de vo de moore o bochare-kili wone pa se o to o toroko kom wone o te. 25Jehu ma ta de o tontoŋeno Bidika o we, “Kwei Joram yera yam n dole n yage tega kalo déem na ye Nabofi nyem to ne. Nmo wó guli we, debam balei déem na wo daane dé tɔge o kwo Ahab kwaga to mo Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o sɔɔle cham o yage Ahab yuu ne o we, 26‘Amo diim na nɛ Nabofi de o bia bam jana bam na taare tega kam tei to, amo ta wó yɔɔre a pa se n jwoori n ŋwe jana bam konto jene tega kam konto baŋa ne. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ Mo kokuri, n jege se n kwei‑o n de n yage Nabofi tega kam ne, ne Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam na bere we ko wó ke tei to.”
27Judah teo Pɛ Ahazia na nɛ kolo na jege ko ke to, o ma duri o yɔɔre Bɛte-Hagan seeni. Jehu ma pare‑o ye o ta de o nɔɔna bam o we, “Go-na o de.” Ba ma seene ba ta‑o de chena chwoŋa kalo na diini Guri seeni to yuu ne. Jei sem konto bwola de Ibeleyam. Ba na tage‑o to, Ahazia ma wane o duri o yi Megido. O ma te teo kom wone. 28O tontoŋena bam ma kwei‑o de toroko ba ja ba jwoori Jerusalem. Ba ma suli‑o o kwoa bam yibeeli ne David teo Jerusalem ne.
29Ko déem ya ye Ahab bu Joram bena fuga-dedwe paare dim bene dem ne mo Ahazia bobo se o di Judah teo paare.
Jezebele toone
30Jehu déem ma zaŋe o vo Jezerele. Jezebele na nigi to, o ma kwei yi-chero o ma o bei o yi-bonno, o daare o fɔge o vɔ o yu-ywei sem. O laam ma vo o jeini o diga kam takworo ni ne ye o pɔe Jehu. 31Jehu na yɔɔre o tɔge manchwoŋo kom o zo to mo Jezebele bage‑o o we, “Hae! Nmo bere we n veiŋa kam ye yazura veiŋa mo na? Nmo kikia de Zimiri kikia wo daare daane, de n na go n tu wom to.”
32Jehu ma kwoni o yuu o nii takworo kom seeni ye o ta de kwor-dɛa o we, “Abam wɔ mo zege amo kwaga ne? Wɔ mo wora?” Pɛ sɔŋɔ kom tontoŋena badwonna maa tɔge takworo kom ba leesi ba nii. 33Jehu ma bage-ba o we, “Yigi-na Jezebele á de tega ne!” Ba ma seene ba yigi‑o ba de tega ne. O na yi tega to, mo o jana bam taare kabira kam ba kɛ ba taare sisei sem de, de Jehu na pɛ se nɔne o baŋa ne se kɛ to.
34Jehu ma zo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wo o di wodiu. O laam ma ta de nɔɔna badwonna o we, “Sensɔla wo kaane wom yuu ne. De ko de, nam kwei-o-na á suli tega ne, se o ye pɛ bukɔ mo.” 35Ba na nwoŋi se ba kwei o yera yam ba suli konto to, ba wo nɛ-ya, ko ná dae o yu-kwoli-champoa, de o napera, de o jataala yerane mo ba nɛa. 36Ba ma vo ba ta ba bere Jehu kolo na ke to. O ma ta o we, “Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo seene ka ji chega. O déem tɔge Tisibi tu Elija baŋa mo o ta o we, ‘Kukuri wó ja Jezebele ya-nɔna se di Jezerele tega kam baŋa ne. 37O yera yam wó tore yera yera ya taa tigi Jezerele tega kam maama baŋa ne nenɛɛne popɔnɔ mo tei, pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá lɔre o na ye wolo to.’ ”

english_text:
Jehu Kills All of Ahab's Descendants
1Ahab still had 70 descendants living in Samaria. So Jehu wrote a letter to each of the important leaders and officials of the town, and to those who supported Ahab. In the letters he wrote:
2Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter, 3choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.
4The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.” 5The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
6Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.”
The 70 descendants of King Ahab were living with some of the most important people of the city. 7And when these people read Jehu's second letter, they called together all 70 of Ahab's descendants. They killed them, put their heads in baskets, and sent them to Jezreel.
8When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
9The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men? 10Listen to me. Everything the Lord's servant Elijah promised about Ahab's family will come true.”
11 Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
12-13Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?”
“We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
14“Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all 42 of them.
15As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?”
“Yes, I am.”
“Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot 16and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.”
They rode together in Jehu's chariot 17to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah.
Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
18Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said:
King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal. 19I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed.
But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal. 20He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced, 21Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other. 22Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
23Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.” 24Then they began to offer sacrifices to Baal.
Earlier, Jehu had ordered 80 soldiers to wait outside the temple. He had warned them, “I will get all these worshipers here, and if any of you let even one of them escape, you will be killed instead!”
25As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple 26and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it 27and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
28That's how Jehu stopped the worship of Baal in Israel. 29 But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
30Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
31But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do.
Jehu Dies
32In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control 33of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
34Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. 35Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king. 36Jehu had ruled Israel 28 years from Samaria.
translation_text:
Jehu go Ahab dwi dem
1Ahab bia fuserepɛ déem mo zoore Samaria ne. Jehu ma popone twanno o toŋe o pa teo kom dedɛɛra de nakwa balo maama na wo Samaria ne to, ko woli de balo na nii Ahab bia bam baŋa ne to. O ma popone o we, 2“A ware abam. Abam teo kom tiini ko dana. Á maa jege jara-keim torokooro dedaane sisei dedɛ. Abam tu Ahab bia bam zoore abam tei ne mo. Konto ŋwaane, tɔnɔ konto ná yi abam, 3se á kuri Ahab bia bam wone nɔɔno wolo na yɔɔre o ye chekke to se á tiŋi‑o pɛ. Á ná ke konto, se á daare á ti á yiga se á ke chichuŋu Ahab dwi dem ŋwaane.”
4Samaria teo dedɛɛra bam na gage tɔnɔ kom to, foone ma tiini de zo-ba ye ba we, “Nii-na! Pwa balei bam tete maŋe ba ga Jehu ŋwa. Debam nam ye bera mo se dé che o yiga?”
5Dedɛɛro wolo na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne to, de wolo na nii teo kom maama to, de teo kom nakwa bam, ko woli de balo na nii Ahab bia bam baŋa ne to ma toŋe kwora ba pa Jehu ye ba we, “Debam maama ye nmo tontoŋena mo. Kolo maama nmo na wó ta to, dé wó ke. Dé ba jege chwoŋa se dé tiŋi pɛ. Ke kolo maama nmo na boŋe we ko lana to.”
6Jehu daa ma popone tɔnɔ o ta we, “Abam nam ná seene á sɛ á pa amo, nam sɛ-na amo ni se á gwoni Ahab bia bam yuni á ja á ba Jezerele á pa-ne jwa kanto maŋa ne.” Ko déem ye Samaria teo dedɛɛra badwonna mo nii Ahab bia fuserepɛ bam baŋa ne. 7Samaria teo dedɛɛra bam na gage tɔnɔ kom to, ba ma seene ba gwoni pɛ wom bia fuserepɛ bam maama yuni ba kwei ba ke tetwaro wone ba toŋe ba pa Jehu Jezerele ne. 8Ba na jaane ba yi to, tontoŋeno wodwoŋi ma vo o ta de Jehu o we, “Ba jaane pɛ wom bia bam yuni tem ba yi.” Jehu ma pa ni o we, “Ja-na yuni tem á vo á tiŋi pwoa yalei teo kom manchwoŋo ni dem ne se tega laam poore.”
9Tega na poore tetete to, Jehu ma nwoŋi o vo o zege da o ta de nɔɔna bam maama o we, “Abam wo ke kolokolo á chɔge, se ko ye amo mo ke chichuŋu de a yuu tu Joram ye a daare a go‑o. Wɔ nam mo go nɔɔna banto maama? 10Lɔre-na we, kwora kalo Baŋa Wɛ na taga Ahab dwi dem ŋwaane to bá ji kafɛ de fenfee de. O na tɔge Elija baŋa o ta kolo to maama seene ko ke.” 11Jehu laam ma vo o go Ahab dwi tiina bam maama na daare Jezerele ne to. O ta ma go Ahab dedɛɛra bam, de o yuudwonna bam, de o kaanem tiina bam maama. Ahab nɔɔno dedoa tete bere o wo daare.
12Jehu ma zaŋe se o vo Samaria. O na maa kɛa to mo o vei o yi Bɛte-Ekede mɛ nayera na gilimi to. 13O na yi da to mo o jeeri Judah teo pɛ Ahazia chorro tedwonna. O ma bwei-ba o we, “Abam ye bera mo?” Ba ma leiri ba we, “Debam ye Ahazia chorro mo. De nam maa vei se dé jɔɔne pɛ wom diga tiina de o nu wom bia mo.”
14Jehu na nigi konto to, o ma pa o tontoŋena bam ni o we, “Ja-na-ba ŋweene.” Ba ma seene ba ja nɔɔna bam maama ba daare ba go-ba Bɛte-Ekede vole dem takeiri ne. Ba déem ye nɔɔna finna-balei (42) mo ye ba wolowolo wo daare.
15Jehu ma zaŋe jeiga kam konto ne o maa kɛa. O na maa vei to mo Rekabi bu Jonadabi jeeri‑o chwoŋa ne. Jehu ma jɔɔne‑o ye o daare o bwei‑o o we, “Dé jege boboŋe dedwe na? Nmo yiga nam wo amo wone na?” Jonadabi ma leiri o we, “Ɛɛ, ko ye konto mo.” Jehu ma ta o we, “Ko ná seene ko ye konto, ja n jeŋa n ba.” O ma vaŋe Jonadabi o di o jeini o toroko kom wone. 16O maa we, “Tɔge de amo se n lɔre we amo yia tiini ya seene Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane.” Ba maama balei ma tɔge daane ba kɛ Samaria.
17Ba na yi Samaria to, Jehu ma go Ahab dwi tiina balo ta na daare ye ba zoore da to maama. Konto to o déem chɔge Ahab dwi dem o ti, ne Baŋa Wɛ ya na pɛ Elija kwora we, ko wó ke tei to.
Jehu go Baal kaanem tiina
18Jehu déem ma bwoŋi Samaria tiina bam o ke daane ye o ta de-ba o we, “Pɛ Ahab déem zuli Baal jwoni dem o kwɛɛre mo. Amo nam wó seene a yia a zuli-de a dwoni wonto. 19Bwoŋi-na Baal sampwori sem, de kaanem tiina bam, ko woli de balo na zuli-de to maama, se ba jeeri amo yiga ne. A lage a ke kaanem kamunu mo a pa Baal. Wolo ná ve se o tɔge o jeeri, kotu wó ga o ŋwea mo.” Jehu déem tage konto dwoŋi se o ma o ke swa mo o ja balo maama na sɛ Baal to o go.
20Jehu ma ta o we, “Pɔɔre-na dɛ se nɔɔna seene ba yia ba zuli Baal jwoni dem de wone.” Ba ma tɔɔle ba bere teo kom nɔɔna bam maama. 21Jehu ma pa kwora yi Isarele teo kom ni maama, pa se balo maama na sɛ Baal to ba ba jeeri daane. Dedoa tete wo daare. Ba maama ma vo ba zo Baal jwoni diga kam pa se ka ni maama su de kɔgɔ. 22Jehu ma ta de wolo na nii gare-nyenno tem baŋa ne to o we, “Pa se wolo maama na tu se o zuli Baal jwoni dem to na gɔrɔ o zo.” O ma seene o kwei gwaaro tem o pa-ba ye ba zo.
23Jehu laam ma tɔge de Rekabi bu Jonadabi ye ba zo Baal jwoni diga kam. Jehu ma ta de balo na zuli Baal to o we, “Kwaane-na á nii se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé maŋe ywo-seeni ko ná dae abam yerane. Yé pa se Baŋa Wɛ tɔgena bam wolowolo na chwoŋa se o taa tɔge o wora.” 24Ba laam ma bobo se ba ke kaanem dem ba pa Baal. Ba na wo diga kam ne to de Jehu ya maŋe o yage nɔɔna funɔnɔ pwooni dem ne ye o kaane-ba o we, “Abam wolo ná pɛ se nɔɔna banto dedoa duri o lu, kotu wó ga o ŋwea mo.”
25Jehu na yɔɔre o ke zwɛɛm kaanem dem o ti to, o ma ta de babɛ sem de dedɛɛra bam o we, “Zo-na diga kam á go ba maama. Yé pa-na se ba dedoa tete duri o lu.” Ba ma seene ba kwei ba se-zɔɔro ba ma ba go Baal nɔɔna bam maama. Ba ma tuuri ba yera yam ba yage pwooni yiga ne. Ba ma daare ba zo di-yuu kom 26ba vo ba kwei Baal jwoni kandwɛ dem tete ba ja ba nwoŋi ba zwɛ de mini. 27Konto to, ba déem chɔge Baal jwoni dem de de diga kam maama mo. De zem maama nɔɔna laam kwei jeiga kam ba ma ba ji nɛ zegem jeiga mo.
28Mo ko na ke tei pa se Jehu chɔge Baal jwoni dem kaanem Isarele jei maama ne to. 29De ko de, Jehu ta paale o ke wɛleere dwi delo Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to mo. O déem pɛ se ba jege sabu-seŋa na-mɔre sem na zege Bɛtel de Dan ne to mo ba kaana.
30 Baŋa Wɛ déem tage de Jehu mo o we, “Nmo kwaane de n na ke kolo na jege chega amo yiga ne to. N yɔɔre n chɔge Ahab dwi dem maama, nenɛɛne a boboŋa na jaane se a pa ko ke tei to. Konto ŋwaane, amo wó pa se nmo dwi delo na wó saŋe n kwaga to di Isarele teo paare dem se ko taa vei dwia yana wɛɛne.” 31Jehu déem nam wo nii o tete se o taa tɔge Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to nia yam de o wo maama. O wo yage wɛleera dwi delo Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to.
Jehu toone
32Kanto maŋa ne mo Baŋa Wɛ bobo se o pa Isarele tega kam mɔ. Hazayeli ma wane o di Isarele tiina bam de ba tega kam ni maama, 33ka zege Jɔdan buga kam ni ne se ka vo ka yi wɛ-puli seeni. Ko maa ye Gilead de Basan tega kalo maama na zege Arowa na wo Aranon nabara kam ni ne to ko taa via. Gad dwi tiina laŋa kam, de Ruben dwi tiina laŋa kam, ko woli de Manasɛ dwi tiina laŋa kam mo konto.
34Jehu déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam, de o bembɛɛne kikia yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. 35Jehu ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli Samaria teo ne. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Jehohaza ma leiri o ji pɛ. 36Jehu déem jeini Samaria ne o di Isarele teo paare bena finlei-nana (28) mo.

english_text:
Queen Athaliah of Judah
(2 Chronicles 22.10-12)
1As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done that, 2but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as he was about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, hid her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah. 3Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah
(2 Chronicles 23.1-21)
4Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash 5and said to them:
Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace. 6Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.
7The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash. 8Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
9The commanders followed Jehoiada's orders. Each one called together his guards—those coming on duty and those going off duty. 10Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders. 11Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
12Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
13Queen Athaliah heard the crowd and went to the temple. 14 There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
15At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!” 16So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.
17Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord. 18Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars.
After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple, 19he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah. 20Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again. 21Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_text:
Atalia di paare Judah ne
1Pɛ Ahazia nu Atalia na maane we o bu wom tega to, o ma zaŋe se o pa ba go paare diga kam nɔn-bia maama. 2Ba na tu se ba go pɛ wom bia bam to, Pɛ Jehoram bukɔ Jehoseba na ye Ahazia nakɔ to ma ŋɔ Ahazia bu-seseŋa kam yere na ye Joasa to o seigi. O ma kwei bu wom de kaane wolo na jege‑o o kɔna to o vo o seigi peiga jeiga ne se Atalia yé na‑o. Konto ma pa se o wo tɔge de pa-bia badaara bam o te. 3Joasa déem maŋe Jehoseba tei ne bena yaredo mo, ye ba seigi‑o Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem diga kadwoŋi wone. Maŋa kam konto ne Atalia ma jeini Judah teo paare dem baŋa ne.
4Atalia paare dim bena yarepɛ bene dem ne mo Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada bwoŋi dedɛɛra balo na nii babɛ sem, de Kariti jar-keira bam, de pɛ sɔŋɔ yerena bam baŋa ne to se ba ba ba jeeri Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne. Dáane mo o gwoni ni de-ba o daare o pa se ba du duuri ba pa‑o. O laam ma kwei Ahazia bu Joasa o bere-ba. 5O ma pa-ba ni o we, “Abam na jege se á ke tei to mo tento: Á nɔɔna bam na pɔɔre kuni betɔ to, ba kɔgɔ kolo na tui totoŋa siu dɛ ne to chichworo yeini ba yere pɛ sɔŋɔ kom. 6Chichworo kodwoŋi de maa nii Suri ni dem. Chichworo kolo na daare to maa zege ni dem seeni babɛ sem kwaga ne. Banto maama nam wó taa yere pɛ sɔŋɔ kom mo. 7Ko daare kɔro telei tem na yage totoŋa siu dɛ ne to de laam maa wó taa yere Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem se kolokolo yé ke pɛ wom. 8Fɔge-na á zege á gilimi pɛ wom mo á ke tetare ne, ye á zei á jara zela. Nɔɔno wolo ná lɛɛne abam, se á yɔɔre á go kotu. Pɛ wom nam na wó vo mɛ maama to, se abam de ta‑á wo o tei ne.”
9Dedɛɛra bam ma seene ba tɔge ni delo maama Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada na taga to. Ba dedoa dedoa ma ja ba nɔɔna ba ba Jehoyada tei, ne ko ná ye balo na tui totoŋa siu dɛ ne to, de balo na yage totoŋa siu dɛ ne to maama. 10Jehoyada ma kwei chichwoa de jara-keim nantane selo déem na ye David nyem ye te tigi Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne to o pa dedɛɛra bam. 11Babɛ sem maama ma vo ba zege ba gilimi pɛ wom ba ke tetare ne, ye ba zei ba jara zela. Ba déem tigisi ba tete Wɛ diga kam jei maama ne, jagwia seeni de jazem seeni, ko zege kaanem bimbini dem takeiri ne de diga kam tete yiga ne.
12Jehoyada déem ma ja pɛ wom bu Joasa o ja o nwoŋi. O ma kwei paare yipuga kam o pu o yuu ne, ye o daare o kwei paare tiŋim seina tɔnɔ kom o ke o jeŋa ne. Ba ma lwo nuga o yuu ne ba ma ba tiŋi‑o paare. Nɔɔna bam ma mage ba jea ye ba tɔɔle ba we, “Wɛ wó pa pɛ wom momwɛ-dɛɛre!”
13Atalia na nigi babɛ sem de nɔɔna bam maama na ke sɔɔ kom to, o ma ke lela o nwoŋi o vo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem o daare o na nɔn-kɔgɔ kom. 14O ma na pɛ wom na zege Wɛ diga kam ywei dem teiŋa ne, ne ba na yeini ba ke tei ba tiŋi pɛ to. Dedɛɛra bam de balo na wui nabwanno to maa zege pɛ wom takeiri ne. Teo kom nɔn-bia bam maama maa chaka de wopwolo ye ba badwonna wui nabwanno. Atalia na nɛ to, o ma ja o gwaaro tem o vaŋe o kaare ye o we, “Bebare-nyena mo zaŋe a baŋa ne!”
15Jehoyada ma pa jar-keira dedɛɛra bam ni o we, “Ja-na Atalia á nwoŋi Wɛ diga kam wone á ke‑o babɛ sem gena tetare ne. Nɔɔno ná kwaane se o woli‑o, se á kwei se-zɔɔ á go kotu.” Kokuri to, Jehoyada ya maŋe o ta we, ba yé go Atalia Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone. 16Ba ma zi Atalia ba ja ba nwoŋi ba vo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom. Ba ma pa o tɔge manchwoŋo ni mɛ sisei na tɔge da se zoore nabwoo kom to, ye ba daare ba go‑o jei sem konto ne.
17Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada ma pa se pɛ wom de nɔɔna bam maama gwoni ni de Baŋa Wɛ we, ba wó taa ye Baŋa Wɛ tete nɔɔna. O ta ma pa se pɛ wom de nɔɔna bam gwoni ni ba pa daane. 18Judah nɔn-bia bam déem ma vo ba zo Baal jwoni diga kam ba yigi ka maama ba de tega ne, ba daare ba chochoge kaanem bimbina yam de jwoni kamwaro tem maama. Ko ta ná ye Baal kaanem tu Matan, ba jaane‑o bimbina yam takeiri ne mo ba go.
Jehoyada déem ma pa se nɔɔna zege ba yere Baŋa Wɛ diga kam. 19O laam ma tɔge de babɛ sem yiga tiina, de Kariti jar-keira bam, de pɛ sɔŋɔ yerena bam, ko ta woli de teo kom nɔn-bia bam maama, se ba vo ba ja pɛ Joasa ba ja ba nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone. Ba ma ja‑o ba vo ba tɔge babɛ ni dem ba zo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom. Joasa ma vo o jeini paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne. 20Nɔn-bia bam maama maa chaka de wopwolo. Ko kwaga ne teo kom maama ma ke ziim, ba na go Atalia pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wone to ŋwaane.
21Joasa déem jege bena yarepɛ mo ye o di Judah teo paare dem.

english_text:
King Joash of Judah
(2 Chronicles 24.1-16)
1Joash became king of Judah in Jehu's seventh year as king of Israel, and he ruled 40 years from Jerusalem. His mother Zibiah was from the town of Beersheba.
2Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord. 3But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
4 One day, Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money that has been given to the Lord's temple, whether from taxes or gifts, 5and use it to repair the temple whenever you see the need.”
6But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule, 7Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.” 8The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
9Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box. 10When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags. 11Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers, 12the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
13While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple. 14It went only to pay for repairs. 15 The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.
16 The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
17About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem. 18So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
19Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. 20-21At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_text:
Judah teo pɛ Joasa taane
2 Tigisim 24:1-16
1Isarele teo pɛ Jehu paare dim bena yarepɛ bene dem wone mo Joasa di paare Judah ne. O déem jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke bena finna mo. O nu déem nwoŋi Beeriseba, o yere mo Zibia. 2Pɛ Joasa ŋwea maama wone o totoŋa déem su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada na zamese‑o to ŋwaane. 3De ko de, o wo wane o chɔge wara-jei bimbina yalo ba na ke kaanem da to. Nɔɔna déem ta ma yeini ba ke kaanem de zwɛɛm pɛɛra jei sem konto ne.
4Joasa ma ta de Wɛ kaanem tiina bam o we, “La-na lu-nyenno telo maama nɔɔna na jaane ba ba ba tiŋi Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone se ba ma ba zuli‑o to. Ko ná ye Wɛ diga lampwoo sabu kom, de ba ni-gwonim sabu kom, de ba na pɛ sabu kolo de ba tete boboŋa to de, se á la te maama. 5Wɛ kaanem tu maama laam wó jwoŋi sabia bam mo sabu-tiŋinu maama tei ne se ba ma ba fɔge ba kwɛ Wɛ diga kam ne ko na maŋe tei to.”
6Joasa déem na di paare ye o ke bena finlei-yatɔ to, Wɛ kaanem tiina bam ta wo wane ba kwɛ Wɛ diga kam de fenfee de. 7Konto ŋwaane mo, Joasa bwoŋi Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Jehoyada de kaanem tiina badwonna bam o bwei-ba o we, “Bɛ mo ke ye abam ta wo kwɛ Wɛ diga kam? Daa á yé ta‑á jwoŋi-na sabu á sabu-tiŋina bam tei ne á di, ne ko ná dae Wɛ diga kam kwɛɛm yerane ŋwaane.” 8Kaanem tiina bam ma sɛ we ba daa bá jwoŋi sabu nɔɔna bam tei ne. Ba ma kwei Wɛ diga kam kwɛɛm totoŋa yam ba pa nɔɔna badwonna.
9Jehoyada ma kwei dakaa o puri bɔɔne ka ni-pugu kom yera ne, o daare o ja-ka o zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wo. O ma kwei-ka o zege kaanem bimbini dem jazem seeni. Wɛ kaanem tiina balo na yere Wɛ diga kam ni to wó jwoŋi sabia balo nɔɔna na jaane ba ba se ba pa Wɛ to ba ke dakaa kam wone. 10Maŋa kalo maama ba na maane we sabu kom su dakaa kam, pɛ sɔŋɔ tɔn-poponno wom de Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu wom mo wó ke daane ba kwei sabu kom ba jeeli ko ni ba kwei ba ke ywollu wone. 11Ba ná yeini ba lɔre sabu kom ni, ba wó kwei-ko ba pa nɔɔna balo ba na kuri se ba taa nii Wɛ diga kam totoŋe baŋa ne to mo. Banto de maa wó kwei sabu kom ba ma ŋwe balo maama na toŋe Wɛ diga kam kwɛɛm totoŋa to. Banto déem ye gwaro, de lɔra, 12ko woli de kandwa-cherena. Ba maa ta wó ma sabu kom ba yeigi da-kwollu de kandwa yalo ba na yare peo yera ne to se ba ma ba kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ba daare ba ŋwe kwora yalo maama ta na wora totoŋe dem ŋwaane to.
13Sabu kolo nɔɔna déem na jaane ba ba ba tiŋi Wɛ diga kam ne to, ba wo sɛ se ba kwei-ko ba ma ba mɔ lu-nyenno zon-tanlɛ, de min-zwonnu kwɛɛm fane, de zwe, de nabwanno, naa sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno wonnu telo maama na maŋe se te taa zege Wɛ diga kam ne to. 14Ba nam kwei ko maama ba pa tontoŋena bam mo se ba ma ba fɔge ba kwɛ Wɛ diga kam. 15Ko ná ye balo ba na pɛ-ba sabu kom se ba ma ŋwe tontoŋena bam to, ba wo fe-ba se ba jeeli sabu kom ba bere jaja, banto na yɔɔre ba toŋe de chega to ŋwaane. 16Ko daare ko ná ye wɛleere jene pɛɛra yam, de wɛleere saarem pɛɛra yam, ba wo jaane yanto ba zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam. Yanto maama ye Wɛ kaanem tiina bam nyem mo.
17Kanto maŋa ne mo Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli déem vei o kwaare jara de Gafa tiina. O ma wane teo kom o di. O ma zege dáane o daa vo se o kwaare jara de Jerusalem tiina. 18Judah teo pɛ Joasa ma kwaleme lonne wonnu telo maama o kwoa Jehosafate, de Jehoram, de Ahazia na kwei ba pa Baŋa Wɛ to, de telo o tete na kwei o pa Wɛ to, ko ta woli de sabu-seŋa jejegero telo na tigi Wɛ diga kam de pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wone to. O ma kwei te maama o toŋe o pa Hazayeli se o ma o ware‑o. Hazayeli laam ma yage jara yam o kɛ o daare Jerusalem.
19Joasa déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. 20Pɛ Joasa dedɛɛra déem ke ni daane mo se ba zaŋe o baŋa ne. Ba ma go‑o Bɛte-Millo ne. Jeiga kam konto wo Sila chwoŋa ni ne mo. 21Dedɛɛra balo na ke konto to maa ye Simeafi bu Jozabad, de Somera bu Jehozabadi. Ba ma kwei Joasa ba suli o kwoa bam yibeeli ne David teo Jerusalem ne. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Amazia ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.

english_text:
King Jehoahaz of Israel
1Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled 17 years from Samaria 2and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
3The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time. 4Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz 5by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before. 6-7But Hazael had defeated Israel's army so badly that Jehoahaz had only 10 chariots, 50 cavalry troops, and 10,000 regular soldiers left in his army.
The Israelites kept sinning and following the example of Jeroboam's family. They did not tear down the sacred poles that had been set up in Samaria for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
8Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. 9Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king.
King Jehoash of Israel
10Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled 16 years from Samaria. 11He disobeyed the Lord by doing just like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
12Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. 13Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king.
Elisha the Prophet Dies
14 Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
15-16“Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand 17and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
18Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped. 19Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
20Elisha died and was buried.
Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel. 21Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up.
Israel Defeats Syria
22Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz. 23But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
24Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria. 25King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_text:
Isarele teo pɛ Jehohaza taane
1Judah teo pɛ Ahazia bu Joasa paare dim bena finlei-yatɔ bene dem wone mo Jehu bu Jehohaza déem di Isarele teo paare. O ma jeini Samaria ne o di paare dem o ke bena fuga-yarepɛ. 2O toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga mo de o na ke wɛleera dwi delo Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to mo. O wo sɛ se o yage. 3Mo kokuri Baŋa Wɛ bane tiini de zaŋe Isarele tiina baŋa ne. O déem pɛ se Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli de o bu Ben-hadadi di dam ba baŋa ne taa.
4Jehohaza ma lwoori yibwona Baŋa Wɛ tei ne. Baŋa Wɛ ma sɛ o wɛ-lworo kom, o na maane we Siria teo pɛ mo jege Isarele tiina bam o bɛɛsa dedɛ to ŋwaane. 5Baŋa Wɛ ma le jwoŋinu o pa Isarele tiina bam, pa se ba vere ba tete Siria tiina bam dam kuri ne. Konto kwaga ne mo Isarele tiina bam jwoori ba zoore ba sam dem ne de yazura, ne faŋa kam ne ko ya na ye tei to. 6De ko de, ba déem ta ke wɛleera dwi delo Jeroboam dwi tiina déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to mo. Ba wo sɛ se ba chɔge Asera nyenyego dɛ sem na wo Samaria ne ye nɔɔna zuli-se to.
7Jehohaza jar-keira déem ta daare fee, nenɛɛne sisein-dira finnu, de jara-keim torokooro fuga, ko woli de jar-keira moro fuga yerane mo. Kokuri to, Siria teo pɛ wom ya yɔɔre o chɔge jar-keira badaara bam maama pa se ba ji ne fwogo mo tei.
8Jehohaza déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam, de o bembɛɛne dem maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. 9Jehohaza ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli Samaria teo ne. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Jehoasa ma leiri o ji pɛ.
Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa taane
10Judah teo pɛ Joasa paare dim bena fintɔ-yarepɛ bene dem wone mo Jehohaza bu Jehoasa déem di Isarele teo paare. O ma jeini Samaria ne o di paare dem o ke bena fuga-yaredo. 11O toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga mo de o na ke wɛleera dwi delo maama Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to mo. O déem paale o ke wɛleera yanto dwoŋi mo.
12Jehoasa déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam, de o na ke baare o kwaare jara de Judah teo pɛ Amazia tei to maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. 13Jehoasa ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli mɛ ba na suli Isarele tiina pwa badwonna bam Samaria ne to. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Jeroboam ma leiri o di paare dem.
14Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa déem ta na ŋwe to, jaweo ya mo jaane Wɛ sampwora Elisa ye ko ga fee se o te. O weelem dem maŋa ne Jehoasa ma vo o tei se o ware‑o. O ma zege Elisa yiga ne o ka yi-na ye o we, “Amo kwo! Amo kwo! Isarele jar-keira torokooro tem de te sisein-dira bam laam wó ke tɛ mo?”
15Elisa ma ta de pɛ wom o we, “Kwei taŋa de ka che-tɛɛra.” O ma seene o kwei-te o zia. 16Elisa ma ta ded‑o se o saŋe taŋa kam. O na lage o ta konto to mo Elisa jaane pɛ wom jea. 17Elisa ma ta de pɛ wom o we, “Pore takworo ni delo na yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni to.” O ma seene o ke konto. Elisa ma ta ded‑o se o ta chene, ye o seene o ke konto. Elisa ma ta o we, “Baŋa Wɛ wɔnɔ chene dem mo konto! Ko bere we Siria tiina bam wó to jara wone. Kokuri to, nmo wó yɔɔre n chɔge Siria jar-keira bam maama Afeka ne.”
18Elisa daa ta ma ta de pɛ wom o we, “Kwei che-tɛɛra yalo na daare to.” Pɛ wom ma kwei-ya. Elisa ma ta ded‑o o we, “Fere-ya tega ne.” Pɛ wom ma fere chena yam tega ne kuni betɔ ye o yage. 19Wɛ tontoŋeno Elisa bane ma zaŋe ded‑o ye o we, “Nmo ya wó fere-ya tega ne kuni benu naa beredo mo. Konto mo ya wó pa se n wane n chɔge Siria tiina bam maama nyɔ. Ko nam na ye tei to, nmo lage n di-ba kuni betɔ yerane mo.”
20Elisa déem ma te ye ba kwei‑o ba suli.
Ben-doore maama wone Moaba teo pawe-nyena mo yeini ba zo Isarele tega kam ba vuvugi nɔɔna bam. 21Dɛ dedwe Isarele tiina badwonna déem mo jaane ba too ba vo se ba suli. Ba ma na Moaba tiina pawe-nyena na beene de kɔgɔ tei to. Ba ma ke lela ba kwei too wom ba dole ba yage Elisa yibeeli dem ne ye ba daare ba duri. Too wom yera na yɔɔre ya dwei Elisa kwi sem to, mo o bi o zaŋe o zega.
22Maŋa kalo maama Jehohaza déem na ye pɛ to mo Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli tiini o bɛɛse Isarele tiina bam. 23Baŋa Wɛ yiga nam wo Isarele tiina bam wone pa se o duri ba yibwona, o na gwoni ni delo de ba nabaara Abaraham, de Izaak, de Jakob to ŋwaane. De zem maama Baŋa Wɛ wo sɛ se o chɔge-ba o ti, naa se o zeili-ba o tei ne.
24Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli ma ba o te. O bu Ben-hadadi ma leiri o yuu ne o di paare. 25Jehohaza bu Jehoasa ma wane Ben-hadadi o di, pa se o jwoori o ja teene delo Hazayeli déem na vere Jehohaza tei ne to o tei. Kuni betɔ mo Jehoasa wane o di Ben-hadadi, ye o daare o jwoori o jwoŋi Isarele teene dem konto.

english_text:
King Amaziah of Judah
(2 Chronicles 25.1-24)
1Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel. 2Amaziah was 25 years old when he became king, and he ruled 29 years from Jerusalem, which was also the hometown of his mother Jehoaddin.
3Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David. 4Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
5As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father. 6 But the children of those officers were not killed. The Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished, not their parents or children.
7While Amaziah was king, he killed 10,000 Edomite soldiers in Salt Valley. He captured the town of Sela and renamed it Joktheel, which is still its name.
8One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
9Jehoash sent back this reply:
Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
10Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
11But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops. 12During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home, 13and Jehoash captured Amaziah.
Jehoash then marched to Jerusalem and broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly 200 meters long. 14He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.
15Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. 16Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king.
17Fifteen years after Jehoash died, 18-20some people in Jerusalem plotted against Amaziah. He was able to escape to the town of Lachish, but another group of people caught him and killed him there. His body was taken back to Jerusalem on horseback and buried beside his ancestors.
Everything else Amaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. 21After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only 16 at the time. 22Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath.
King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
23Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year of Amaziah's rule in Judah. Jeroboam ruled 41 years from Samaria. 24He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
25 Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher. 26The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them. 27And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
28Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. 29Jeroboam died and was buried, and his son Zechariah became king.
translation_text:
Judah teo pɛ Amazia taane
1Isarele teo pɛ Jehohaza bu Jehoasa paare dim bena yalei bene dem wone mo Joasa bu Amazia déem di Judah teo paare. 2Amazia déem jege bena finlei-yanu mo ye ba tiŋi‑o paare. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke bena finlei-nogo. O nu yere mo Jehoadin ye o nwoŋi Jerusalem. 3O totoŋa déem su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, ye o totoŋ-laaro nam wo yi o nabaaro David déem na ke tei to. O déem yɔɔre o kwei o kwo Joasa totoŋ-naga mo. 4De ko de, Amazia wo wane o chɔge wara-jei bimbina yalo ba na ke kaanem da to. Nɔɔna déem yeini ba ke kaanem de zwɛɛm pɛɛra jei sem konto ne ye ba wo yage.
5O na yɔɔre o jeini paare dem baŋa ne to, o ma go nɔɔna balo déem na jaane o kwo ba go to. 6O nam wo pɛ ba go nɔn-gora bam konto bia bam. O déem sɛ ni delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses to. Ni dem konto bere we, “Kwoa ba jege se ba te ba bia kikia ŋwaane. Bia de nam ba jege se ba te ba kwoa kikia ŋwaane. Nɔɔno ná maŋe se o te, ko wó taa ye o tete yuu lwarem ŋwaane mo.”
7Amazia déem mo go Edom jar-keira morro fuga jeiga kalo ba na bwoi we ‘Yɛ bwolo’ to ne. O ta ma di Sela teo o jwoŋi Edom tiina bam tei ne. O ma leiri o pa ko yere we Joketeeli. Yere dem konto mo ba ta bwoi de zem maama.
8Dɛ dedwe mo Pɛ Amazia toŋe o tontoŋena se ba vo ba gware Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa na ye Jehohaza bu ye o ta ye Jehu naa to se ba ta ded‑o we, “Ba n jeeri-ne se dé ke kayiŋu.” 9Pɛ Jehoasa ma jwoori o toŋe kwora o pa Judah teo pɛ Amazia o we, “Sabara kadwoŋi mo zege Lebanon ne ka toŋe kwora ka pa Sedare tei-zɔŋɔ Lebanon ne ka we, ‘Kwei n bukɔ wom n pa a bu se o di o ma o ke kaane.’ Konto nɛ sem ni ne mo ga-varem zege Lebanon ne ka nɔne sabara kam ka chɔge. 10Nmo na seene n wane n di Edom tiina bam to mo pɛ se n cho n vɔna konto. Nam ya maŋe n sɔŋɔ ne se n ta‑n chaka. Bɛ mo ye n boŋe se n vaare lɛɛro n yage nmo tete yuu ne de Judah tiina de yuu ne?”
11Amazia ma se o zwa de taane dem konto. Ko kwaga ne Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa ma la o jar-keira o ke daane ye ba vo ba kwaare jara de Amazia Judah teo Bɛte-Semesa ne. 12Isarele jar-keira bam ma wane ba di Amazia de o nɔɔna bam pa se ba maama duri ba jwoori ba sam. 13Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa ma ja Amazia Bɛte-Semesa ne.
