De nam bá fɔge de zuri maŋa de maŋa 18Ko nam ná ye Judah pɛ wom tete na toŋe abam amo tei ne se á lɔre Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa to, Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage kolo ded‑o to mo tento: Ko ná ye taane delo na wo tɔnɔ kom wone ye n ni-de to, 19amo nɛ nmo wo na chɔge ye n gwooni n tete amo yiga ne de n na nigi we a bane zaŋe teo konto de ko nɔɔna bam baŋa ne to. N ta ma maane we, sɔla mo wo teo kom baŋa ne ye ko wó to ko saare. Nmo nam na kaare n gwaaro ye n keeri amo yiga ne to ŋwaane, amo nigi nmo lworo kom. 20Mo kokuri amo wó pa‑m chwoŋa se n te n tete toone, se n yé na lɛɛro telo a na wó pa te yi teo konto to.’ ”
Tontoŋena bam ma ja Wɛ sampwori-kana kam kwora ba jwoori ba vo ba pa Pɛ Josia.

english_text:
Josiah Reads The Book of God's Law
(2 Chronicles 34.29-33)
1King Josiah called together the older leaders of Judah and Jerusalem. 2Then he went to the Lord's temple, together with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, the priests, and the prophets. Finally, when everybody was there, he read aloud The Book of God's Law that had been found in the temple.
3After Josiah had finished reading, he stood by one of the columns. He asked the people to promise in the Lord's name to faithfully obey the Lord and to follow his commands. The people agreed to do everything written in the book.
Josiah Follows the Teachings of God's Law
(2 Chronicles 34.3-7)
4 Josiah told Hilkiah the priest, the assistant priests, and the guards at the temple door to go into the temple and bring out the things used to worship Baal, Asherah, and the stars. Josiah had these things burned in Kidron Valley just outside Jerusalem, and he had the ashes carried away to the town of Bethel.
5Josiah also got rid of the pagan priests at the local shrines in Judah and around Jerusalem. These were the men that the kings of Judah had appointed to offer sacrifices to Baal and to the sun, moon, and stars. 6Josiah had the sacred pole for Asherah brought out of the temple and taken to Kidron Valley, where it was burned. He then had its ashes ground into dust and scattered over the public cemetery there. 7He had the buildings torn down where the male prostitutes lived next to the temple, and where the women wove sacred robes for the idol of Asherah.
8In almost every town in Judah, priests had been offering sacrifices to the Lord at local shrines. Josiah brought these priests to Jerusalem and had their shrines made unfit for worship—every shrine from Geba just north of Jerusalem to Beersheba in the south. He even tore down the shrine at Beersheba that was just to the left of Joshua Gate, which was named after the highest official of the city. 9Those local priests could not serve at the Lord's altar in Jerusalem, but they were allowed to eat sacred bread, just like the priests from Jerusalem.
10 Josiah sent some men to Hinnom Valley just outside Jerusalem with orders to make the altar there unfit for worship. That way, people could no longer use it for sacrificing their children to the god Molech. 11He also got rid of the horses that the kings of Judah used in their ceremonies to worship the sun, and he destroyed the chariots along with them. The horses had been kept near the entrance to the Lord's temple, in a courtyard close to where an official named Nathan-Melech lived.
12 Some of the kings of Judah, especially Manasseh, had built altars in the two courts of the temple and in the room that Ahaz had built on the palace roof. Josiah had these altars torn down and smashed to pieces, and he had the pieces thrown into Kidron Valley, just outside Jerusalem. 13 After that, he closed down the shrines that Solomon had built east of Jerusalem and south of Spoil Hill to honor Astarte the disgusting goddess of Sidon, Chemosh the disgusting god of Moab, and Milcom the disgusting god of Ammon. 14He tore down the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole used in the worship of Asherah. Then he had the whole area covered with human bones.
15 But Josiah was not finished yet. At Bethel he destroyed the shrine and the altar that Jeroboam son of Nebat had built and that had caused the Israelites to sin. Josiah had the shrine and the Asherah pole burned and ground into dust. 16 As he looked around, he saw graves on the hillside. He had the bones in them dug up and burned on the altar, so that it could no longer be used. This happened just as God's prophet had said when Jeroboam was standing at the altar, celebrating a festival.
Then Josiah saw the grave of the prophet who had said this would happen 17 and he asked, “Whose grave is that?”
Some people who lived nearby answered, “It belongs to the prophet from Judah who told what would happen to this altar.”
18Josiah replied, “Then leave it alone. Don't dig up his bones.” So they did not disturb his bones or the bones of the old prophet from Israel who had also been buried there.
19Some of the Israelite kings had made the Lord angry by building pagan shrines all over Israel. So Josiah sent troops to destroy these shrines just as he had done to the one in Bethel. 20He killed the priests who served at them and burned their bones on the altars.
After all that, Josiah went back to Jerusalem.
Josiah and the People of Judah Celebrate Passover
(2 Chronicles 35.1-19)
21Josiah told the people of Judah, “Celebrate Passover in honor of the Lord your God, just as it says in The Book of God's Law.”
22This festival had not been celebrated in this way since the time that tribal leaders ruled Israel or the kings ruled Israel and Judah. 23But in Josiah's eighteenth year as king of Judah, everyone came to Jerusalem to celebrate Passover.
The Lord Is Still Angry with the People of Judah
24Josiah got rid of every disgusting person and thing in Judah and Jerusalem—including magicians, fortunetellers, and idols. He did his best to obey every law written in the book that the priest Hilkiah found in the Lord's temple. 25No other king before or after Josiah tried as hard as he did to obey the Law of Moses.
26But the Lord was still furious with the people of Judah because Manasseh had done so many things to make him angry. 27The Lord said, “I will desert the people of Judah, just as I deserted the people of Israel. I will reject Jerusalem, even though I chose it to be mine. And I will abandon this temple built to honor me.”
Josiah Dies in Battle
(2 Chronicles 35.20—36.1)
28Everything else Josiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. 29During Josiah's rule, King Neco of Egypt led his army north to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. Josiah led his troops north to fight Neco, but when they met in battle at Megiddo, Josiah was killed. 30A few of Josiah's servants put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried it in his own tomb. Then the people of Judah found his son Jehoahaz and poured olive oil on his head to show that he was their new king.
King Jehoahaz of Judah
(2 Chronicles 36.2-4)
31Jehoahaz was 23 years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem only 3 months. His mother Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah. 32Jehoahaz disobeyed the Lord, just as some of his ancestors had done.
33King Neco of Egypt had Jehoahaz arrested and put in prison at Riblah near Hamath. Then he forced the people of Judah to pay him 3.4 tons of silver and 34 kilograms of gold as taxes. 34 Neco appointed Josiah's son Eliakim king of Judah, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. He took Jehoahaz as a prisoner to Egypt, where he died.
35Jehoiakim forced the people of Judah to pay higher taxes, so he could give Neco the silver and gold he demanded.
King Jehoiakim of Judah
(2 Chronicles 36.5-8)
36 Jehoiakim was 25 years old when he was appointed king, and he ruled 11 years from Jerusalem. His mother Zebidah was the daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah. 37Jehoiakim disobeyed the Lord by following the example of his ancestors.
translation_text:
Pɛ Josia tu o kwɛ ni-sɛɛm dem
1Pɛ Josia déem ma pa ni se Jerusalem de Judah teene maama nakwa bam la daane o yiga ne. 2O ma ja Judah tiina bam maama de Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam maama, ko woli de Wɛ sampwori sem de Wɛ kaanem tiina bam o vo o zo Wɛ diga kam wone. Ko maa ye nɔɔna bam maama, nabwona de naduna de mo. Pɛ wom ma zege ba yiga ne o ga Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kolo ba déem na nɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to o bere-ba. 3Pɛ wom ma zege Wɛ diga kam ywei dem teiŋa ne o fɔge o gwoni ni de Baŋa Wɛ we, o wó kwei o wo maama o jwoori o tɔge Baŋa Wɛ, ye o sɛ o nia yam, de o bera yam, de o chullu tem maama, ne ko na popone Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom wone tei to. Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama de ma tɔge ba sɛ Josia ni-gwonim dem.
4Pɛ Josia ma ta de Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Hilikia, de balo na saŋe o kwaga to, de Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena bam se ba zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone ba kwei zela yalo ba na mae ba zuli Baal de Asera jwona yam to, de yalo ba na mae ba zuli chalechwe sem to ba ja ba nwoŋi. Josia ma ja wonnu tento maama o nwoŋi Jerusalem teo kom wone o vo o zwɛ-te Kidoron bwolo kom jei sem ne. Ba ma daare ba ja te tentwarem ba ja ba vo Bɛtel.
5Josia ma le kaanem tiina balo Judah pwa bam déem na kuri se ba taa kaane jwona Judah teene dem de Jerusalem nawuura yam wara-jei sem ne to o yage. Kaanem tiina bam konto déem mo yeini ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem ba pa Baal jwoni dem, de wea kam, de chana kam, de chalechwe sem maama. 6Josia ta ma kwei Asera nyenyego daa kam Wɛ diga kam wone o ja o vo Kidoron bwolo kom o zwɛ ka maama. O ma pɛ ka tentwarem dem o cho ywale-ywale o daare o dole-de o yage teo kom nɔn-bia yibeela jei sem ne. 7O ta ma chɔge di selo na wo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne ye baara balo na toŋe kabwoŋa totoŋa zoore da to. Ko maa ye dáane mo kaana badwonna sɔ gwaaro telo ba na mae ba zuli Asera jwoni dem to. 8O déem ma ja kaanem tiina balo maama na zoore Judah teene dem ne ye ba kaane jwona yam to o jwoori Jerusalem. Ba wara-jei bimbina yalo maama na zege Geba ne, se ko vo ko yi Beeriseba to, o pɛ se ya ji kafɛ mo. Ko ta ná ye bimbina yalo na wo teo kom manchwo-peena ni ne ye ba ke kaanem ba pa chichiri da to, Josia chɔge ya maama mo o yage. Bimbina yam konto déem wo teo kom ni dem jagwia seeni mo. Ba mɛ teo dedɛɛro Josua yere mo ba bwoi ni dem konto. 9De ko maama de, ba déem wo pɛ kaanem tiina bam konto chwoŋa se ba da ba toŋe Baŋa Wɛ bimbini dem totoŋa Jerusalem ne. Ba nam pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba da de ba dwonna kaanem tiina bam mo ba di bworobworo kolo ba na wo ke sabɔle ko wone to. 10Josia ta ma chɔge Tofete bimbini dem na wo Ben-Hinom bwolo kom ne to, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa yé wane o ja o bakeira naa o bukɔ o ma o ke zwɛɛm kaanem o pa Moleka jwoni dem. 11O ma ja sisei nyenyero telo Judah pwa badwonna ya na tɔge te baŋa ba zuli wea kam to o chɔge o yage. O ta ma zwɛ sisei torokooro tem de. Tento maama déem zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ni seeni, konkɔlɔ kodwoŋi ne mɛ teo kom dedɛɛro Natan-Mɛlɛka na zoore to mo.
12Ko ta ná ye jwona kaanem bimbina yalo Judah pwa badwonna na lɔge ba zege Ahaz nayuu kom ne to, ko woli de yalo Pɛ Manasɛ na lɔge Baŋa Wɛ diga kam konkwallo telei tem ne to, Josia ma chɔge-ya o yage. O déem vaare ya maama o de tega ne mo, o daare o chochoge-ya o pɛ o lwo o yage Kidoron nabara kam ne. 13Josia ta ma chɔge jwona kaanem bimbina yalo na wo Jerusalem wɛ-puli seeni ye ya maŋe de ‘Chɔgem Peo’ tega-kuri seeni to o yage. Isarele teo pɛ Solomon déem mo lɔge bimbina yanto o zege. O déem lɔge-ya o pa Asetare wo-zɔɔne delo Sidon tiina na zuli to, de Chemosi wo-zɔɔne delo Moaba tiina na zuli to, ko woli de Moleka wo-zɔɔne delo Amon tiina na zuli to mo. 14Josia déem bwori kandwa yalo ba na chwi ba jwona yam ŋwaane to mo muga-muga, o daare o gwoni Asera nyenyego dɛ sem o de tega ne. O laam ma kwei nabiina kwi o lwo o faare jeiga kam.
15Josia déem ta ma bwori jwoni bimbini delo na wo Bɛtel ne to o yage. Ko ye Nebat bu Jeroboam déem mo lɔge-de o zege pa Isarele tiina de tɔge ded‑o ba toŋe lwarem. Josia yɔɔre o chɔge bimbini dem de wara-jei sem konto maama mo. O ma zwɛ-te o daare o cho te tentwarem ywale-ywale. O ta ma zwɛ Asera nyenyego daa kam de o woli da. 16Josia ma kaare o nii o na yibeela yadwonna na wo zwoŋo kom baŋa ne to. O ma pa ba le twa bam kwi ba zwɛ-se bimbini dem baŋa ne ba ma ba chɔge-de. O keim dem konto mo pɛ se Wɛ tontoŋeno wom ya na wuuri o ta Baŋa Wɛ kwora tei to seene ko ji chega. Ba déem na di kuri ye Pɛ Jeroboam zege bimbini dem teiŋa ne to mo Wɛ tontoŋeno wom tage konto.
Josia laam ma pipiri o tole o na faŋa faŋa Wɛ tontoŋeno wom yibeeli. 17O ma bwei o we, “Wɔ yibeeli mo tento?” Bɛtel nɔɔna bam ma leiri ba we, “Ko ye mɛ ba na suli Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo déem na nwoŋi Judah ye o ta faŋa faŋa we kolo wó ke bimbini dento Bɛtel ne, ne nmo zem na yɔɔre n ke-de tei to mo.” 18Josia ma leiri o we, “Nam yage-na yibeeli dento se de taa wora. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé guri o kwi sem.” Ba ma seene ba yage wonto de Wɛ sampwora kalo ya na nwoŋi Samaria to kwi sem.
19Ko daare, ko ná ye wara-jei selo Isarele tiina pwa badwonna ya na lɔge Samaria teene dem ne pa ba chuchugi Baŋa Wɛ bane to, Josia déem chɔge se bimbina yam maama o yage mo, ne o na maŋe o ke tei Bɛtel ne to. 20Josia ta ma go kaanem tiina balo maama ya na kaane jwona jei sem konto ne to bimbina yam baŋa ne. O ma daare o zwɛ nabiina kwi ya baŋa ne. Konto na ti to, o ma jwoori Jerusalem.
Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem
2 Tigisim 35:1-19
21Pɛ Josia déem ma pa Judah tiina bam maama ni se ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem ba ma zuli ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ne ko na popone Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom wone tei to. 22Ba wo fɔge ba di kuri dento dwoŋi ko zege maŋa kalo ne yiga tiina na tei Isarele de Judah tiina bam ye ba ta wo tiŋi pɛ to. 23Josia paare dim bena fuga-nana bene dem ne mo ba laam jwoori ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem Jerusalem ne se ba ma ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.
Pɛ Josia totoŋa yadwonna
24Josia déem kwaane o kwɛ teo kom se ko tɔge nia yalo maama na popone tɔnɔ kolo wone Wɛ kaanem tu Hilikia na nɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to mo. O ma le chichiri vora, de yi-nara, de wa-yɔɔro, de jwona, de wo-zɔɔna maama pa se ya daa tere Jerusalem de Judah teene dem maama ne. 25Pwa balo maama déem na lwoori Josia yiga ba di paare to, de balo maama na saŋe o kwaga to wone, pɛ tera o na kwaane ne wonto tei. Josia déem zuli Baŋa Wɛ de o bochare maama, de o boboŋa maama, ko woli de o dam maama, ye o yɔɔre o tɔge Moses nia yam na bere tei to.
26De konto maama de, Baŋa Wɛ bane déem ta zaŋe mo de Judah tiina bam, Pɛ Manasɛ na tiini o toŋe o chaare ye o chuchugi Wɛ bane to ŋwaane. 27Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, “Amo lage a zeili Judah tiina bam a yiga ne mo, ne a na maŋe a ke Isarele tiina bam tei to. Ko ta ná ye Jerusalem teo kolo a na kuri a pa a tete to, amo wó ve-ko, ye a daare a ve amo diga kalo a na tage ka taane we, ka zege a yere dem zula ŋwaane to.”
Josia na tege jara wone tei to
2 Tigisim 35:20-27
28Josia déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.
29Maŋa kalo Josia déem na ye pɛ to, mo Ejipti teo Pa-faro Neko zaŋe de o jar-keira bam o vo Yuferata buga kam seeni se o woli Asiria pɛ wom. Josia de ma nwoŋi se o jeeri Pa-faro Neko de jara se o che o yiga. Pɛ Neko ma jeeri‑o Megido ne o go‑o. 30Josia tontoŋena bam ma kwei o yera yam ba ke toroko ne ba ja ba jwoori Jerusalem. Ba ma suli‑o o tete yibeeli dem ne. Judah tiina bam ma kuri Josia bu Jehohaza ba tiŋi‑o paare se o leiri o kwo wom yuu ne.
Judah teo Pɛ Jehohaza taane
31Jehohaza déem jege bena finlei-yatɔ mo ye o di paare dem. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke chane setɔ. O nu yere mo Hamutal. Wonto maa ye Jeremia wolo na nwoŋi Libina to bukɔ. 32Jehohaza déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga, ne o nabaara de na ke tei to mo. 33Pa-faro Neko déem ma ja Jehohaza o vo Ribila o ke o peena diga ne, se o daa yé na chwoŋa o di paare Jerusalem ne. Teo kom konto wo Hamafa kateiri dem ne mo. O ma daare o fe Judah tiina se ba ŋwe lampwoo na ye lu-nyenno kilo morro tetɔ de bia yana (3,400), ko woli de sabu-seŋa kilo fintɔ-tena (34) to. 34Pɛ Neko ma kwei Josia bu Eliakim o tiŋi‑o paare se o leiri o kwo yuu ne. O ma leiri Eliakim yere dem pa de ye Jehoyakim. O ma daare o ja Jehohaza o vo o yage Ejipti ne. Ko ye dáane mo Jehohaza tega. 35Jehoyakim déem ma pa Judah tiina bam ŋwe lampwoo ba pa‑o se ko maŋe de ba dedoa dedoa tega kam na mae tei to. O ma jwoŋi lampwoo kom konto o ŋwe Pɛ Neko na bwei‑o sabu kolo to.
Judah teo Pɛ Jehoyakim taane
36Jehoyakim déem jege bena finlei-yanu mo ye o di paare. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke bena fuga-dedwe. O nu yere mo Zebida na ye Pedaya wolo na nwoŋi Ruma to bukɔ. 37O de déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga, ne o nabaara bam ya na ke tei to mo.

english_text:
1 During Jehoiakim's rule, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded and took control of Judah. Jehoiakim obeyed Nebuchadnezzar for three years, but then he rebelled.
2At that time, the Lord started sending troops to rob and destroy towns in Judah. Some of these troops were from Babylonia, and others were from Syria, Moab, and Ammon. The Lord had sent his servants the prophets to warn Judah about this, 3and now he was making it happen. The country of Judah was going to be wiped out, because Manasseh had sinned 4and caused many innocent people to die. The Lord would not forgive this.
5Everything else Jehoiakim did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. 6Jehoiakim died, and his son Jehoiachin became king.
7King Nebuchadnezzar defeated King Neco of Egypt and took control of his land from the Egyptian Gorge all the way north to the Euphrates River. So Neco never invaded Judah again.
King Jehoiachin of Judah Is Taken to Babylon
(2 Chronicles 36.9,10)
8Jehoiachin was 18 years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled only 3 months from Jerusalem. His mother Nehushta was the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem. 9Jehoiachin disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Jehoiakim had done.
10King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia sent troops to attack Jerusalem soon after Jehoiachin became king. 11During the attack, Nebuchadnezzar himself arrived at the city. 12 Jehoiachin immediately surrendered, together with his mother and his servants, as well as his army officers and officials. Then Nebuchadnezzar had Jehoiachin arrested. These things took place in the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar's rule in Babylonia.
13The Lord had warned that someday the treasures would be taken from the royal palace and from the temple, including the gold objects that Solomon had made for the temple. And that's exactly what Nebuchadnezzar ordered his soldiers to do. 14He also led away as prisoners the Jerusalem officials, the military leaders, and the skilled workers—10,000 in all. Only the very poorest people were left in Judah.
15 Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon, along with his mother, his wives, his officials, and the most important leaders of Judah. 16He also led away 7,000 soldiers and 1,000 skilled workers, all of them trained for battle.
17 Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Jehoiachin's uncle Mattaniah king of Judah and changed his name to Zedekiah.
King Zedekiah of Judah
(2 Chronicles 36.11-16; Jeremiah 52.1-3)
18 Zedekiah was 21 years old when he was appointed king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for 11 years. His mother Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah. 19Zedekiah disobeyed the Lord, just as Jehoiakim had done. 20 It was Zedekiah who finally rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
The people of Judah and Jerusalem had made the Lord so angry that he turned his back on them. That's why these horrible things were happening.
translation_text:
1Maŋa kalo Jehoyakim déem na di paare to mo Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza cheiŋi Judah teo maama o tei. Konto ma pa se Jehoyakim maŋe Nebukadeneza dam kuri ne o ke bena yatɔ. Jehoyakim déem ma leiri o boboŋa ye o ve Nebukadeneza ni. 2Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se jar-keira nwoŋi Babilon, de Siria, de Moaba, de Amon teene dem ba vo ba ke chichuŋu de Judah tiina bam. Baŋa Wɛ déem maŋe o tɔge o sampwori sem baŋa ne o kaane Judah tiina bam we, ba wó na chɔgem konto dwoŋi. 3Lɛɛro telo na seene te yi-ba to mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ ni se te ke. O boboŋa ma ja se o zeili Judah tiina bam o yiga ne, Pɛ Manasɛ na toŋe wɛleera yalo to ŋwaane. 4Manasɛ déem na ke tei to, o go balo na ye nɔn-ŋona to mo pa se ba jana taare Jerusalem teo kom ni maama. Mo kokuri Baŋa Wɛ ve se o yage o wɛleera o ma chɛ‑o.
5Jehoyakim déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. 6Jehoyakim ma te ye o bu Jehoyachin leiri o yuu ne o di paare.
7Ejipti pɛ wom daa wo sɛ se o nwoŋi o ke jara, kokuri to Babilon teo pɛ mo maŋe o cheiŋi Ejipti teo maama o tei, ko zege Ejipti bu-nɔgɔ kom seeni se ko vo ko yi Yuferata buga kam jei sem maama.
Judah teo Pɛ Jehoyachin taane
8Jehoyachin déem jege bena fuga-nana mo ye o di paare. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke chane setɔ. O nu yere mo Nehusita. O maa ye Elinatan bukɔ ye o nwoŋi Jerusalem to mo. 9Jehoyachin déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga, ne o kwo wom de na ke tei to mo.
10Jehoyachin paare dim maŋa ne mo Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza toŋe o jar-keira se ba vo ba li Jerusalem teo de jara. Ba ma vo ba kaare teo kom ba pu. 11Pɛ Nebukadeneza tete de ma tɔge o yi da ye o nɔɔna bam ta wora ba ke chichuŋu de teo kom. 12Judah teo pɛ Jehoyachin, de o nu, de o tontoŋena, de o dedɛɛra, de o nakwa bam maama ma sɛ ba pa Babilon pɛ wom. Babilon pɛ wom ma pa ba ja Jehoyachin ba pe.
Konto déem ke Pɛ Nebukadeneza paare dim bena nana bene dem ne mo. 13O ma vere lonne wonnu telo maama na wo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne, de pɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne to o ja o viiri, ne Baŋa Wɛ na wuuri o ta we, ko wó ke tei to. O ma daare o kore sabu-seŋa wonnu telo Isarele teo pɛ Solomon déem na ke o zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to maama o ja o viiri. 14O ma yɔɔre o kwei Jerusalem nɔn-bia na yi morro fuga to o ja o vo o tete teo. Ko déem ye ba jar-keira bam, de ba dedɛɛra bam, ko woli de balo na ye gwaro de lura to maama mo. Balo na tiini ba ye yiniga tiina to yerane mo o yage teo kom wone.
15Pɛ Nebukadeneza ma ja Jehoyachin, de o nu, de o kaana, de o dedɛɛra, ko woli de Jerusalem teo kom naduna bam maama o vo Babilon. 16O ta ma ja jar-keira morro terepɛ, de gwaro de lura moro dedoa. Banto maama yei jara keim lanyerane. 17O ma pa Jehoyachin kwo choro Matania leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. O ma leiri o yere dem pa se de ye Zedekia.
Judah teo Pɛ Zedekia taane
Jeremia 52:1-3
18Zedekia déem jege bena finlei-dedwe mo ye o di paare. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke bena fuga-dedwe. O nu yere mo Hamutali. Wonto maa ye Jeremia wolo na nwoŋi Libina to bukɔ. 19Zedekia déem toŋe lwarem mo o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga, ne Pɛ Jehoyakim de ya na ke tei to.
20Lɛɛro telo maama na ke Jerusalem de Judah tiina bam yera ne to tɔge Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane mo. Ko na kweeli tei to, o le o yiga mo ba baŋa ne.
Jerusalem teo na to tei to
Jeremia 52:3-11
Pɛ Zedekia déem ma zaŋe o nwoŋi Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza kwaga ne.

english_text:
Jerusalem Is Captured and Destroyed
(2 Chronicles 36.17-21; Jeremiah 52.3-30)
1 In Zedekiah's ninth year as king, on the tenth day of the tenth month, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia led his entire army to attack Jerusalem. The troops set up camp outside the city and built ramps up to the city walls.
2-3After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month, 4 the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the desert, 5but the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah, but his soldiers scattered in every direction.
6Zedekiah was taken to Riblah, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty. 7 Zedekiah's sons were killed right in front of him. His eyes were then poked out, and he was put in chains and dragged off to Babylon.
8About a month later, in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king, Nebuzaradan, who was his official in charge of the guards, arrived in Jerusalem. 9 Nebuzaradan burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses. 10Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem. 11He led away as prisoners the people left in the city, including those who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar. 12Only some of the poorest people were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
13 The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia. 14 They carried off the bronze things used for worship at the temple, including the pans for hot ashes, and the shovels, snuffers, and also the dishes for incense, 15as well as the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to take everything made of gold or silver.
16The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed. 17Each column had been eight meters tall with a bronze cap over one meter high. These caps were decorated with bronze designs—some of them like chains and others like pomegranates.
18Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials. 19Then he arrested one of the army commanders, the king's five personal advisors, and the officer in charge of gathering the troops for battle. He also found 60 more soldiers who were still in Jerusalem. 20Nebuzaradan led them all to Riblah 21near Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar had them killed.
Most of the people of Judah had been carried away as captives from their own country.
Gedaliah Is Made Ruler of the People Left in Judah
(Jeremiah 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
22 King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam to rule the few people still living in Judah. 23When the army officers and troops heard that Gedaliah was their ruler, the officers met with him at Mizpah. These men were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth from Netophah, and Jaazaniah from Maacah.
24Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
25 Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia. 26 After that, the army officers and all the people in Mizpah, whether important or not, were afraid of what the Babylonians might do. So they left Judah and went to Egypt.
Jehoiachin Is Set Free
(Jeremiah 52.31-34)
27Jehoiachin was a prisoner in Babylon for 37 years. Then Evil-Merodach became king of Babylonia, and in the first year of his rule, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month, he let Jehoiachin out of prison. 28Evil-Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there. 29Jehoiachin was even allowed to wear regular clothes, and he ate at the king's table every day. 30As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_text:
1Zedekia paare dim bena nogo bene dem chane fuga chana kam wone, ka da fuga dɛ dem ne mo Babilon teo Pɛ Nebukadeneza déem tu o li Jerusalem de o jar-keira bam maama. Ba ma kaare teo kom ba pu ye ba daare ba lɔ taare-kamuna ba yeiri ko kabiri sem yera ne. 2Ko na yi Zedekia paare dim bena fuga-dedoa bene dem to mo Babilon tiina bam déem wane Jerusalem teo kom ba di.
3Ko na yi bene dem konto chane sena chana kam da nogo dɛ dem to, kana déem tiini ka chɛ mo pa se Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam daa ba jege wodiu se ba di. 4Babilon tiina bam ma yigi teo kom kabiri sem ba de tega ne, ye ba tɔge pwoli sem ne ba zo ko wo. Zedekia de o jar-keira bam maama déem duri se ba lu tete ne mo. Ba ma kwei pɛ gaare chwoŋa kam, ba vo ba tɔge ni dem na wo teo kabiri selei sem tetare ne to, ye ba laam duri ba tu Jɔdan bwolo kom seeni. 5De ko de, Babilon tiina jar-keira bam déem pare-ba mo. Ba ma vo ba yi Zedekia se ko maŋe de Jeriko te-kampare sem seeni. O jar-keira bam ma pwɛ da yiga ne, ye ba jage ba daare‑o.
6Ba ma zi Zedekia ba ja ba vo Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza tei. O déem wo Hamafa kateiri dem teo Ribila ne mo. Nebukadeneza ma di taane o vane Zedekia dáane. 7O ma pa ba go Zedekia bia bam, ye o zege da o nia. Ko kwaga ne o pɛ se ba chochɔrege Zedekia yia yam mo ba le, ye ba daare ba kwei channa chegero ba ma ba vɔ‑o ba vaŋe ba ja ba vo Babilon.
8Nebukadeneza déem na di Babilon teo paare o ke bena fuga-nogo bene delo ne to, chane senu chana kam da yarepɛ dɛ dem ne mo o kwaga-saŋeno Nebuzaradan zo Jerusalem teo kom wone. Wonto maa ye Babilon teo babɛ sem yiga tu. 9O déem ma pa ba zwɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam, de pɛ sɔŋɔ kom, de Jerusalem sam dem maama. Ba déem zwɛ sɔ-laao dwi maama mo Jerusalem teo wone. 10Nebuzaradan ma pa ni pa o jar-keira bam yɔɔre ba yigi Jerusalem teo kabiri sem ba de tega ne. 11O ma kale balo ta na daare teo kom wone to, ko ta woli de gwaro ta na daare to, de balo ya na duri ba zo Babilon tiina kɔgɔ kom wone to o ja o vo Babilon. 12Ko nam ná ye teo kom yiniga tiina badaara, Nebuzaradan yage-ba Judah laŋa kam ne mo. O ma pa-ba tega se ba va, de Vini teeni kare, se ba taa nii se baŋa ne.
13Babilon tiina bam ma zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ba bwori channa zela yam maama. Yanto maa ye ywoa yalei yam, de ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kolo ba na bwoi we ‘Naneo kom’ to, de ware-zwe zegem torokooro tem. Ba ma daare ba kwei te channa kam ba zeŋe ba ja ba vo Babilon. 14Ba ta ma kwei zwe selo ba na wó taa mae ba pɛ tentwarem to, de sɛbullu, de wonnu telo na wó fɔge te kwɛ mini dem to, de zwe selo ba na zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa se wone to, de channa wonnu telo maama na jege te fɔge Wɛ diga chullu tem to. 15Nebuzaradan ta ma pa ba kwei Wɛ diga zela yalo maama ba na mɛ sabu-seŋa, naa lu-nyenno ba ke-ya to. Tento maa ye min-chala zwe, de zwe selo ba na wó taa mae ba zezage na bimbini dem baŋa ne to mo. Ba ma kwei wonnu tem konto sabu-seŋa kam de te lu-nyenno tem ba ja ba viiri.
16Ko ná ye ywoa yalei yam, de ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kom, dedaane ware-zwe zegem torokooro tem, Pɛ Solomon déem ya pɛ ba mɔ wonnu tem konto maama Baŋa Wɛ diga chullu tem ŋwaane mo. Te yera channa kam déem tiini ka duna ka dwoi se ba maŋe. 17Ywoa yalei yam dedoa wɛ-baŋa seeni dedɔrem déem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuga-nana mo. Ywei maama yuu ne ba meeli channa wo-sugili mo da se de wane de teili diga kam yuu kom seeni. Wo-sugila yam dedoa maama dedɔrem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni betɔ. Ba mɛ channa mo ba sɔ ba lɛɛne daane ba ke da, ye ba gɔgere Pomegara tio-bia ba kaare wo-sugila yam. Ywoa yalei yam wo-sugila maama ye bedwe mo.
18Nebuzaradan déem ta jaane Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Seraya, de o kwaga-saŋeno Zefania, de Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena batɔ bam mo o ja o viiri. 19Ko ná ye balo ya ta na daare Jerusalem teo kom wone to, o ma kale ba jar-keira yiga tu wom, de nɔɔna banu balo ya na bwola de pɛ wom to, de dedɛɛro wolo na le nɔɔna se o woli-ba jar-keira kɔgɔ kom wone to, de nɔɔna fuseredo balo ta na wora to o woli da o ja o viiri. 20Nebuzaradan déem jaane banto maama mo o vo Babilon teo pɛ wom tei. O déem wo Hamafa kateiri dem teo Ribila ne mo. 21Dáane mo Babilon teo pɛ déem pɛ se ba go nɔɔna bam konto maama. Ko déem ke konto mo ye ba kale Judah dwi tiina bam ba ja ba vo sa-teo yiga yiga.
Gedalia tei Judah o pa Babilon tiina
22Pɛ Nebukadeneza ma le Ahikam bu Gedalia se o taa nii balo ta na daare Judah laŋa kam ne to. Wonto déem maa ye Safan naa. 23Judah teo jar-keira bam de ba yiga tiina na nigi we pɛ wom le Gedalia mo se o taa ye ba teo kom yuu tu to, ba déem ma vo Gedalia tei Mizipa ne. Yiga tiina bam yera mo tento: Netania bu Isameli, de Karea bia Johanan, de Jonatan, de Netofa tu Tanhumefa bu Seraya, de Maaka tu Jazania. 24Gedalia ma ke baare ba kuri ne ye o du duuri o ta de-ba o we, “Yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone de Babilon dedɛɛra bam. Maŋe-na ywo dé teo kom ne, se á sɛ á pa Babilon teo pɛ, se á ŋwea ke lanyerane ka pa abam.”
25Bene dem konto chane serepɛ chana kam wone, mo Netania bu Isameli na ye Elisama naa to déem tɔge de nɔɔna fuga pa ba vo Mizipa. Wonto déem ye pa-diga kam wo nɔɔno mo. O de o nɔɔna bam ma vo ba go Gedalia, de nɔɔna balo na wo o tei ne to, ko ná maŋe ko ye Judah tiina de Babilon tiina de. 26Keim dem konto baŋa ne nɔɔna maama ma duri ba vo Ejipti teo, ko ná ye nabwona bam, de dedɛɛra bam, ko woli de jar-keira yiga tiina bam maama de, ba na kɔre Babilon tiina bam to ŋwaane.
Ba na yage Jehoyachin tei to
27Ba déem na kale Judah teo Pɛ Jehoyachin ba ja ba vo Babilon ye o ke bena fintɔ-yarepɛ Babilon ne to, bene dem konto chane fuga-selei chana kam da finlei-yarepɛ dɛ dem ne mo Babilon teo Pɛ Evil-Merodaki ke Pɛ Jehoyachin zaane, ye o pore‑o peena diga ne o yage. Ko maa ye bene delo Evil-Merodaki na bobo o di Babilon teo paare to mo konto. 28O ma ke Pɛ Jehoyachin lanyerane, ye o pa‑o jeiŋa jei na tiini ka jege zula ka dwoi jei selo pwa badwonna bam na wo Babilon ne na nɛ to. 29Jehoyachin ma lɔɔre o peena diga gwaaro tem o tiŋi. Dɛ maama wone o ma lɛɛre o di wodiu Babilon teo pɛ tei ne. 30Babilon teo pɛ ta ma kwei kolo maama Jehoyachin na wó ke o yera ne to o pa‑o dɛ maama, se ko vo ko yi o toone maŋa.

english_text:
The Descendants of Adam
(Genesis 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-32)
1-4Adam was the father of Seth, and his descendants were Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah, who had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
5Japheth was the father of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 6Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah. 7Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
8Ham was the father of Ethiopia, Egypt, Put, and Canaan, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 9Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan. 10Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior. 11Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim, 12Pathrusim, Casluhim, and Caphtorim, the ancestor of the Philistines. 13Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth. 14-16Canaan was also the ancestor of the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and Arkites, the Sinites, the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
17Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 18Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather. 19Eber named his first son Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided into tribal regions. Eber's second son was Joktan, 20-23the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.
24-27Shem's descendants included Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, later renamed Abraham.
Abraham's Family
(Genesis 25.1-4,12-16)
28Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
29-31Ishmael had twelve sons, who were born in the following order: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
32Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. 33Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
Esau's Family
(Genesis 36.1-14)
34Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob. 35Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. 36Eliphaz was the father of Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek. 37Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
The First Edomites and Their Kings
(Genesis 36.20-43)
38Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. 39Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna. 40Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
41Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran. 42Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
43Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah. 44After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king. 45After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king. 46After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab. 47After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king; 48after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king; 49and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king. 50After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
51The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, 52Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, 53Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, 54Magdiel, and Iram.
translation_text:
Isarele tiina nabaara natɔga kam
Ko zege Adam ne se ko vo ko yi Abaraham
Pulim 5:1-32; 10:1-32
1Adam, Sɛfi, Enosi, 2Kenan, Mahalaleli, Jaredi, 3Enoki, Metusela, Lameke, Noah.
4Noah bia bam déem ye Sɛm, de Ham, de Jafete mo.
5Jafete bia bam mo tento:
Gomera, de Magoga, de Madayi, de Javan, de Tubal, de Meseka, dedaane Tirasi.
6Gomera bia bam mo tento:
Asekenazi, de Rifata, dedaane Togarama.
7Javan bia bam mo tento:
Elisa, de Tarasisi tiina bam, dedaane Kitim tiina bam, de Rodan tiina bam.
8Ham bia bam mo tento:
Kusi, de Ejipti, de Puti, dedaane Kanaan.
9Kusi bia bam mo tento:
Sebaa, de Havila, de Sabeta, de Raama, dedaane Sabeteka.
Raama bia bam mo tento:
Seba de Dedan.
10Kusi bu wodwoŋi déem ye Nimrodi. Nimrodi ma da yiga o ji babea logo kom ne.
11Ejipti bia bam mo tento:
Ludi tiina bam, de Anam tiina bam, de Lehabi tiina bam, de Nafitu tiina bam, 12de Patirusi tiina bam, de Kasilu tiina bam, dedaane Kiriti tiina bam. (Filisi tiina bam déem nwoŋi Kasilu dwi dem ne mo.)
13Kanaan bia bam mo tento:
Sidon mo déem ye o bu-kwea. Hiti tiina bam de ma woli da, 14de Jebusi tiina bam, de Amori tiina bam, de Giragasi tiina bam, 15de Hivi tiina bam, de Ariki tiina bam, de Sini tiina bam, 16de Aravadi tiina bam, de Zemari tiina bam, dedaane Hamafe tiina bam.
17Sɛm bia bam mo tento:
Elam, de Asuri, de Arapazade, de Ludi, dedaane Aram.
Aram bia bam mo tento:
Yuzi, de Huli, de Getera, dedaane Meseka.
18Arapazade déem loge Sela mo. Sela de ma lo Ebera. 19Ebera de déem loge bia balei mo: Ba dedoa yere mo ye Pɛlega, kokuri to, ba na loge‑o maŋa kalo ne to mo dwia yam déem pɔɔre pɔɔre tega baŋa ne pa se dwi maama wora de laŋa ne. O nyaane wom yere déem maa ye Jokitan.
20Jokitan déem loge bia banto mo:
Alimodadi, de Sɛlefa, de Hazaremava, de Jera, 21de Hadoram, de Yuzali, de Dikila, 22de Obal, de Abimayeli, de Seba, 23de Ofiri, de Havila, dedaane Jobaba.
Nɔɔna banto maama déem mo ye Jokitan bia bam.
24Sɛm, Arapazade, Sela 25Ebera, Pɛlega, Rewu, 26Serugi, Nahora, Tera, 27Abaram (Abaraham mo konto).
Abaraham dwi dem
Pulim 25:12-16
28Abaraham bia mo tento:
Izaak, de Isameli.
29Isameli dwi dem mo tento:
Nebayofa mo déem ye Isameli bu-kwea, ko woli de Kedare, de Adibeeli, de Mibisam, 30de Misima, de Duma, de Massa, de Hadad, de Tema, 31de Jetura, de Nafisi, dedaane Kedema.
Banto maama mo déem ye Isameli bia bam.
32Abaraham ka-bia Ketura de déem na loge bia balo o pa‑o mo tento:
Zimiran, de Jokisan, de Medan, de Midian, de Isibaka, dedaane Sua.
Jokisan bia bam mo tento:
Seba, de Dedan.
33Midian bia bam mo tento:
Efa, de Efere, de Hanoki, de Abida, de Elida.
Banto maama déem ye Ketura dwi mo.
34Abaraham bu Izaak bia bam mo tento:
Esawu, dedaane Isarele.
Esawu dwi dem
35Esawu bia bam mo tento:
Elifaza, de Reweli, de Jewusi, de Jalam, de Kora.
36Elifaza bia bam mo tento:
Teman, de Omara, de Zefo, de Gatam, de Kenazi. Elifaza ka-bia Timina de déem loge Amaleki o pa‑o.
37Reweli bia bam mo tento:
Nahafi, de Zera, de Samma, de Miza.
Dwia yalo na zoore Edom ne to
38Seyira bia bam mo tento:
Lotan, de Sobal, de Zibeon, de Ana, de Dison, de Ezere, dedaane Disan.
39Lotan bia bam mo tento:
Hori dedaane Homam. Timina de déem maa ye Lotan nakɔ.
40Sobal bia bam mo tento:
Alivan, de Manahafa, de Ebal, de Sefo, dedaane Onam.
Zibeon bia bam mo tento:
Aya, dedaane Ana.
41Ana bu wom mo tento:
Dison.
Dison bia bam mo tento:
Hemidan, de Esiban, de Iferan, dedaane Cheran.
42Ezere bia bam mo tento:
Bilihan, de Zaavan, dedaane Akan.
Disan de bia bam mo tento:
Yuzi, dedaane Aran.
Edom tiina pwa bam
43Pwa banto déem mo maŋe ba di Edom teo paare ye Isarele tiina ya ta ba jege pɛ se o taa nii ba baŋa ne:
Beora bu Bela. O teo kom yere déem mo ye Dinaaba.
44Bela na tege to, mo Zera bu Jobaba na nwoŋi Bozera to leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. 45Jobaba de na tege to mo, Husam na nwoŋi Teman tiina bam teo kom to leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. 46Husam de maa na tege to, Bedad bu Hadad de ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. Wonto déem mo ke tigura de Midian tiina bam, ye o wane-ba Moaba teo kom ne. O teo kom yere déem mo ye Avifa.
47Hadad maa na tege to, Samila de ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. Wonto déem nwoŋi Masareka ne mo. 48Samila na tege to, mo Sawuli leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. Wonto déem nwoŋi Rehobofa teo kolo na wo Yuferata buga kam ni ne to mo. 49Sawuli de na tege to, mo Akebora bu Baal-Hanan leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.
50Baal-Hanan déem na tege to, mo Hadad leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. Wonto teo kom yere déem mo ye Pawu. O kaane de yere déem mo ye Mehetabeli. Mehetabeli kwo mo déem ye Matiredi ye o kwo-nakwe yere déem ye Mezahabi. 51Hadad de déem ma ba o te.
Edom tiina sɔ-yuni tem déem ye:
Timina, de Aliva, de Jefeti, 52de Oholibama, de Ela, de Pinon, 53de Kenazi, de Teman, de Mibizare, 54de Magadeli, dedaane Yiram.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1-2Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
3Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated. 4Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
5Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul. 6Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. 7 Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord. 8Ethan's son was Azariah.
The Ancestors of King David
9Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb. 10Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah. 11Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz, 12Obed, and Jesse. 13-15Jesse had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, and David. 16Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel. 17Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa.
The Descendants of Hezron
18Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon. 19After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur 20was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
21When Hezron was 60 years old, he married the daughter of Machir, who settled the region of Gilead. Their son Segub 22was the father of Jair, who ruled 23 villages in the region of Gilead. 23Some time later the nations of Geshur and Aram captured 60 towns in that region, including the villages that belonged to Jair, as well as the town of Kenath and the nearby villages. Everyone from the region of Gilead was a descendant of Machir.
24After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa.
The Descendants of Jerahmeel
25Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah. 26Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam. 27Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker. 28Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada.
Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur. 29Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid. 30Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children; 31Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
32Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children, 33but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
34-35Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai, 36the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad. 37-41Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama.
The Descendants of Caleb
42Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron, 43and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. 44Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai, 45the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
46Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez. 47Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
48Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah. 49Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah. 50-51All of these were Caleb's descendants.
Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader. 52Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan, 53and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
54Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites. 55Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_text:
Pɛ David nabaara taane
1Isarele déem na loge bu-baara balo to mo tento:
Ruben, de Simeon, de Levi, de Judah, de Isakara, de Zebulun, 2de Dan, de Josɛf, de Benjamin, de Nafitali, de Gad, dedaane Asere.
3Judah na loge bu-baara balo to mo tento:
Era, de Onan, de Sela. Banto batɔ nu wom déem ye Kanaan bukɔ Baf-sua mo. Era maa ye Judah bu-kwea kam. O nam tiini o ke lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga mo pa se Wɛ go‑o. 4Judah bu-kaane Tamara de ma lo Pɛreza de Zera o pa‑o. Konto to, Judah déem jege bu-baara banu mo.
5Pɛreza bu-baara bam mo tento:
Hezeron de Hamuli.
6Zera bu-baara bam mo tento:
Zimiri, de Etan, de Heman, de Kalekole, dedaane Dara. Ba maama ye bakeiri senu. 7Karimi déem loge Akane. Wonto pɛ se lɛɛro dedɛ yi Isarele tiina bam, de o na vere wonnu telo na ye Wɛ nyem to o ma chɔge chullu tem. 8Etan déem ma lo Azaria.
9Hezeron na loge bu-baara balo to mo tento:
Jerameeli, de Ram, de Chelubayi. 10Ram ma lo Aminadabi. Aminadabi de ma lo Naason. Wonto déem ye Judah dwi tiina bam dedɛɛro mo. 11Naason ma lo Salimon. Salimon ma lo Bowaza. 12Bowaza de déem ma lo Obeda, ye Obeda lo Jesse.
13Bu-baara barepɛ balo Jesse déem na loge to mo tento:
Eliabi mo ye o bu-kwea kam. Balo na saŋe to maa ye Abinadaba, de Simea, 14de Netaneli, de Radayi, 15de Ozem, de David. 16Jesse déem loge bukwa balei, ba yera na ye Zeruya, de Abigali. Zeruya ma lo bakeiri setɔ: Abisayi, de Joaba, de Asaheli. 17Abigali de ma lo Amasa. Amasa kwo déem ye Isameli dwi tu Jefere.
18Hezeron bu Kaleb ma swo Azuba o ma ke o kaane. Wonto yere dedwoŋi maa ye Jeriota. Ba déem ma lo bia banto:
Jesera, de Sobabi, de Aredon. 19Azuba na tege to, mo Kaleb di Eferata. Ba ma lo Hura. 20Hura de déem ma lo Yuri, ye Yuri lo Bezaleli.
21Ko maama kwaga ne ye Hezeron jege bena fuseredo to, o ma di Gilead kwo Makira bukɔ. Ba ma lo Segubi. 22Segubi de ma lo Jayira. Wonto déem tei teene finlei-detɔ Gilead laŋa kam ne mo. 23Gesura de Aram dwi tiina nam vere Jayira teene dem o jeŋa ne, ko woli de Kenafa, de te-balwa fuseredo na bwola da to mo. Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye Gilead kwo Makira bia mo.
24Hezeron déem na tege to, o bu Kaleb ma swo o kaane Eferata. Wonto ma lo Asuuri o pa‑o. Asuuri déem mo bobo Tekoa teo kuri.
25Hezeron bu-kwea Jerameeli bu-baara bam mo tento:
Ram ye o bu-kwea kam mo. Balo na saŋe to maa ye Buna, de Oren, de Ozem, de Ahija. 26Jerameeli de déem swo kaane wodwoŋi, o yere mo Atara. Wonto ma lo Onam o pa‑o.
27Jerameeli bu-kwea Ram bu-baara bam mo tento:
Maazi, de Jamin, de Ekera. 28Onam bu-baara de déem maa ye Samayi, de Jada. Samayi ma lo Nadab, de Abisuri. 29Abisuri kaane yere mo Abihali. Wonto ma lo Aaban de Molida o pa‑o. 30Nadab bia déem ye Seleda de Apayim. Seleda maa wo loge bia. 31Apayim déem loge Yisi. Yisi de ma lo Sesan, ye Sesan lo Aalayi. 32Samayi nyaane Jada bia mo tento: Jefere, de Jonatan. Jefere maa wo loge bia. 33Jonatan déem loge Peleti de Zaza.
Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye Jerameeli bia mo.
34Sesan déem wo loge bu-baara, se bukwa yerane mo o loga. Sesan nam jege kabaa wolo yere na ye Jareha ye o ye Ejipti tu. 35Sesan ma kwei o bukɔ o pa Jareha se o di o ma ke o kaane.
Wonto ma lo Atayi o pa‑o. 36Atayi ma lo Natan, ye Natan lo Zabadi. 37Zabadi de déem ma lo Efalal, ye Efalal lo Obeda. 38Obeda de ma lo Jehu, ye Jehu lo Azaria. 39Azaria ma lo Heleza, ye Heleza lo Eleasa. 40Eleasa ma lo Sisimayi, ye Sisimayi lo Salum. 41Salum déem ma lo Jekamia, ye Jekamia lo Elisama.
42Jerameeli nyaane Kaleb bu-baara bam mo tento:
Mesa ye o bu-kwea mo, ye wonto lo Zifi. Kaleb ta ma lo Maresa, ye wonto lo Heboron.
43Heboron bu-baara bam mo tento:
Kora, de Tapua, de Rekem, de Sema. 44Sema déem ma lo Raham, ye wonto lo Jorakeam. Rekem de ma lo Samayi. 45Samayi bu déem maa ye Maon. Maon ma lo Bɛte-Zura.
46Kaleb ka-bia Efa déem loge Haran, de Moza, de Gazezi o pa‑o.
Haran de ma lo bakeira o yere na ye Gazezi to.
47Jaadayi bia mo tento:
Regem, de Jotam, de Gesan, de Peleti, de Efa, de Saafa.
48Kaleb ka-bia Maaka déem ma lo Sebera de Tirahana o pa‑o.
49Maaka daa ta ma lo Saafa wolo de na loge Madamana to, dedaane Seeva wolo na loge Machabena de Gibea to. Kaleb déem jege bukɔ, o yere mo Akisa.
50Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye Kaleb bia mo.
Eferata bu-kwea Hura bu-baara bam mo tento:
Sobal wolo na bobo Kiriaf-Jeerim kuri to, 51de Salema wolo na bobo Bɛtelehem kuri to, de Harefa wolo na bobo Bɛte-Gadere kuri to.
52Sobal ma lo Harowɛ. O déem jigi Manahafa tiina bam chichworo nabaaro mo, 53ko ta woli de sɔ-yuni telo na zoore Kiriaf-Jeerim seeni to nabaaro. Banto maa ye Ifiri tiina, de Pufi tiina, de Sumafi tiina, de Misarayi tiina bam. Zorafi tiina bam de Esatola tiina bam de nwoŋi banto dwi dem wone.
54Salema dwi dem déem ye Bɛtelehem tiina, de Netofa tiina, de Aterof-Bɛf-Joaba tiina, de Manahafa tiina bam chichworo, dedaane Zori tiina bam. 55Salema ta ma ji sɔ-yuni telo na zoore Jabezi ne ye ba ye tɔn-poponna to nabaaro. Banto maa ye Tirafi tiina, de Simeafi tiina, de Sukafi tiina bam. Sɔ-yuni tem konto déem ye Keni tu Hammafa dwi tiina mo. Hammafa maa ye Rekabi sɔ-yuu kom de nabaaro.

english_text:
The Descendants of King David
1-4 King David ruled from Hebron for seven years and six months, and during that time he had six sons, who were born in the following order: Amnon, Daniel, Absalom, Adonijah, Shephatiah, and Ithream. Ahinoam from Jezreel was the mother of Amnon; Abigail from Carmel was the mother of Daniel; Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur was the mother of Absalom; Haggith was the mother of Adonijah; Abital was the mother of Shephatiah; and Eglah was the mother of Ithream.
David then ruled from Jerusalem for 33 years, 5 and during that time, he had 13 more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. 6-8David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet. 9David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter.
The Descendants of King Solomon
10-15Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz. 16Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
17Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel, 18Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah. 19Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister. 20He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed. 21Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah, 22the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat. 23Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam. 24Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_text:
Pɛ David dwi dem
1David bu-baara balo o na loge Heboron ne to mo tento:
Jezerele tu Ahinoam déem mo loge o bu-kwea Aminon. Kamele tu Abigali ma lo bu wolo na saŋe to. Wonto yere maa ye Danyeli. 2Batɔ tu wom yere mo Abisalom. O nu déem ye Gesura teo pɛ Talimayi bukɔ Maaka mo. Bana tu wom maa ye Adonija, o nu na ye Hagifa. 3Banu tu wom maa ye Sefatia, o nu na ye Abitali. Baredo tu wom de déem ye Ifream, ye David kaane Egela mo loge‑o.
4Konto to ba loge bu-baara baredo mo ba pa David Heboron ne. David déem ke bena yarepɛ de chane seredo mo o di paare Heboron ne. O laam ma di paare bena fintɔ-yatɔ Jerusalem ne o woli da.
5Bia balo David na loge Jerusalem ne to yera mo tento:
Simea, de Sobabi, de Natan, de Solomon. O kaane Bafeseba na ye Ameli bukɔ to mo loge bia bana bam konto o pa‑o.
6David ta ma lo bia nogo o woli da. Ba yera mo tento:
Ibihara, de Elisama, de Elifeleti, 7de Noga, de Nefega, de Jafia, 8de Elisama, de Eliada, de Elifeleti.
9Banto maama déem ye David bia, ko ta woli de bia balo o ka-bi sem na loge ba pa‑o to. Ba déem maa jege ba nakɔ, o yere na ye Tamara.
10Solomon dwi dem na ye tei to mo tento:
Rehoboam, de o bu Abija, de wonto de bu Asa, de wonto bu Jehosafate, 11de wonto bu Jehoram, de wonto bu Ahazia, de wonto bu Joasa, 12de wonto bu Amazia, de wonto bu Azaria, de wonto bu Jotam, 13de wonto bu Ahaz, de wonto bu Hezekia, de wonto bu Manasɛ, 14de wonto bu Amon, de wonto bu Josia.
15Josia na loge bia balo to mo tento:
Johanan déem ye o bu-kwea kam. Balei tu wom maa ye Jehoyakim. Batɔ tu wom maa ye Zedekia. Bana tu wom de maa ye Salum. 16Jehoyakim bia déem ye Jehoyachin de Zedekia.
17Ba déem jaane Jehoyachin ba vo Babilon. Wonto bia bam mo tento:
Selateli, 18de Malichiram, de Pedaya, de Senazaa, de Jekamia, de Hosama, de Nedabia.
19Pedaya de bia mo tento:
Zerubabel, de Simeyi. Zerubabel bia maa ye Mesulam, de Hanania. Banto nakɔ yere mo Selomifa. 20Zerubabel daa ta loge bia banu o woli da. Banto maa ye Hasuba, de Oheli, de Berekia, de Hasadia, de Jusabi-Hesedi.
21Hanania dwi dem mo tento:
Pelatia, de Jesaya, de Jesaya bu Refaya, de wonto de bu Aranan, de wonto bu Obadia, de wonto bu Sekania. 22Sekania bu maa ye Semaya. Semaya de déem loge bia banu. Banto ye Hatusi, de Igale, de Baria, de Nearia, de Safate. 23Nearia déem jege bia batɔ. Banto ye Elio-Enayi, de Hizikia, de Azerikam. 24Elio-Enayi de déem loge bia barepɛ. Banto maa ye Hodavia, de Eliasibi, de Pelaya, de Akuba, de Johanan, de Delaya, de Anani.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal. 2Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
3-4Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
5Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah. 6Ashhur and Naarah were the parents of Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. 7Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
8Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
9Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family. 10One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
11Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton, 12whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
13Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai, 14who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
15Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
16Jehallelel was the father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
17-18Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
19A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
20Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon.
Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
21-22Judah also had a son named Shelah, whose descendants included Jokim and the people of the town of Cozeba, as well as Er who settled the town of Lecah and Laadah who settled the town of Mareshah. The people who lived in Beth-Ashbea were also descendants of Shelah, and they were experts in weaving cloth. Shelah was the ancestor of Joash and Saraph, two men who married Moabite women and then settled near Bethlehem—but these family records are very old. 23The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king.
The Descendants of Simeon
24Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul. 25The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma. 26The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei. 27Shimei had 16 sons and 6 daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
28-31 Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim. 32They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, 33as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
34-38As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza. 39When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located, 40and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites, 41but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
42Some time later, 500 men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi. 43They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_text:
Judah dwi dem nɔɔna badaara
1Judah dwi dem bia badwonna mo tento:
Pɛreza, de Hezeron, de Karimi, de Hura, de Sobal.
2Sobal bu Reaya déem loge Jahafe. Jahafe ma lo Ahumayi de Lahadi. Banto déem ye Zorafi sɔ-yuni tem nabaara mo.
3Etam bia bam mo tento:
Jezerele, de Isama, de Idibasa.
Banto nakɔ yere déem ye Hazeleponi. 4Penweli déem ma lo Gedora. Ezere de déem ma lo Husa. Banto mo ye Hura dwi dem. Hura déem ye Eferata bu-kwea mo ye o ta ye Bɛtelehem tiina bam nabaaro.
5Tekoa kwo Asuuri déem jege kaana balei mo. Ba yera maa ye Hela de Naara. 6Naara ma lo bakeiri sena o pa‑o. Banto mo ye Ahuzam, de Hefera, de Temeni, de Haahastari. 7O kaane Hela de ma lo Zerefa, de Zohare, de Etanan, 8de Koza. Koza déem ma lo Anubi de Zobeba, ye o ta ye Harum bu Ahareli sɔ-yuni tem nabaaro.
9Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora o yere na ye Jabezi. Wonto mo jege yere se ko dwoni o chorro tem maama. O nu déem nam ya bwoŋi o yere we Jabezi, ye o we, “A na loge‑o to, ko tiini ko chɛ a yera ne mo.” 10Jabezi de déem ma zaŋe o keeri o jare Isarele tiina Wɛ wom o we, “Jan ja! Swɛ amo swolim, se n pa laŋa kalo amo na wó taa tei to yale ka gaale. Ta‑n wo a tei ne se n zeini-ne, se n daare n che se lwarem yé yi-ne se ko chɛ a yera.” Wɛ ma seene o ke Jabezi na lwoori kolo to o pa‑o.
11Suha choro Kalubi déem loge Mehira. Mehira de ma lo Eseton. 12Eseton de déem ma lo Bɛte-Rafa, de Pasea, de Tehinna wolo na ye Nahase tiina nabaaro to. Reka dwi dem mo konto.
13Kenazi bia bam mo tento:
Ofineli de Seraya.
Ofineli de bia bam maa ye Hatafe de Meonotayi. 14Meonotayi déem ma lo Ofera. Seraya de ma lo Joaba, ye wonto déem mo jigi teo kolo ba na bwoi we “Gwaro jeiga” to kwo, ko nɔn-bia bam na tiini ba yei gɔgerem totoŋa to ŋwaane.
15Jefunɛ bu Kaleb bia bam mo tento:
Yiru, de Ela, de Naam. Ela ma lo Kenazi.
16Jehaleli bia bam mo tento:
Zifi, de Zifa, de Tiria, de Asareli.
17-18Ezera bia bam mo tento:
Jefere, de Mered, de Efere, de Jalon.
Mered déem di Ejipti pa-faro bukɔ Bitia mo o ma o ke o kaane. Ba ma lo busankana o yere na ye Miriam to, ko woli de Samayi, de Esetemoa kwo Yisiba. Mered kaane wodwoŋi wom na nwoŋi Judea to ma lo Gedora kwo Jeredi, de Sokoo kwo Hebera, ko woli de Zanoa kwo Jekuteli.
19Hodia kaane na ye Naham nakɔ to bia mo tento:
Keila kwo wolo na ye Garimi tu to, ko woli de Esetemoa wolo na ye Maaka tu to.
20Siimon bia mo tento:
Aminon, de Rina, de Ben-Hanan, de Tilon.
Yisi de bia bam maa ye Zohefe de Ben-Zohefe.
21Judah bu Sela bia bam mo tento:
Era wolo bu na ye Leka to, de Laada wolo bu na ye Maresa to.
Sela déem ye sɔ-yuni telo na zoore Bɛte-Asebea ne ye ba sɔ gare-fefale to nabaaro mo. 22Sela ma lo Jokim, de balo na zoore Kozeba ne to, ko ta woli de Joasa, de Sarafa. Banto balei déem mo di Moaba bukwa ye ba daare ba jwoori ba zoore Lehem ne. (Taane dento nwoŋi faŋa faŋa mo.) 23Banto déem daa ta ye kamɔ-mɔra balo na zoore Netayim de Gedera ne to mo. Ba na wora to, ba toŋe ba pa pɛ wom mo.
Simeon dwi dem
24Simeon dwi dem mo tento:
Nemuweli, de Jamin, de Jaribi, de Zera, de Sawuli. 25Sawuli bu déem mo ye Salum. Salum bu maa ye Mibisam, ye Mibisam bu de ye Misima. 26Misima de dwi dem maa ye o bu Hamuweli, de wonto bu Zakura, ko woli de Zakura bu Simeyi.
27Simeyi déem loge bakeiri fuga-seredo de busankane seredo mo. O chorro tem nam wo loge bia dedɛ. Konto ma pa se Simeon dwi dem wo puli se ba taa mae de Judah dwi dem.
28Simeon dwi dem maa zoore teene dento wone:
Beeriseba, de Molada, de Hazara-Suwala, 29de Biliha, de Ezem, de Toladi, 30de Bɛtuweli, de Horama, de Zikalag, 31de Bɛte-Makabota, de Hazara-Susim, de Bɛte-Biri, de Saarayim. Teene dento maama déem wo ba dam kuri ne mo se ko taa nii maŋa kalo David laam na tu o di paare to.
32Ba déem ta maa zoore te-balwa banto wone:
Etam, de Ayin, de Rimon, de Tochen, de Asan, 33ko ta woli de teene dem konto nawuura yam se ko kɛ ko yi Baalafa. Mo teene delo ba déem na zoore de wone to. Ba déem nam popone ba nabaara bam natɔga kam ba tiŋi tɔnɔ wone mo.
34Ba nakwa bam mo tento:
Mesobaba, de Jamaleka, de Amazia bu Josa, 35de Joweli, de Josibia bu Jehu. Josibia maa ye Seraya bu ye o kwori o ye Aseli naa mo. 36Ba nakwa badwonna maa ye Elio-Enayi, de Jaakoba, de Jesohaya, de Asaya, de Adeli, de Jesimeli, de Benaya, 37ko ta woli de Sifi bu Ziza. Sifi kwo ye Alon mo. Alon kwo maa ye Jedaya ye Jedaya kwo ye Simiri. Simiri de kwo maa ye Semaya.
38Baara bam konto maama déem ye Simeon sɔ-yuni tem yiga tiina mo. Ba dwi dem déem puli lanyerane. 39Ba déem jage mo ba vo ba yi Gedora se ba beeri ga-lɛɛro se ba vara taa di. Laŋa kam konto déem bwola de bwolo kolo na wo teo kom wɛ-puli seeni to mo. 40Ba ma na te-ywoŋa na yala ye ka maŋe de vara kɔnɔ to ba jeini da. Kolokolo wo daane-ba jei sem konto ne. Ham dwi tiina déem ya mo zoore tega kam konto baŋa ne.
41Hezekia déem na di Judah teo paare to, mo yiga tiina bam konto ke chichuŋu de Ham tiina bam de Meyunim tiina balo de na zoore da to ba chɔge ba sam maama. Ba ma yɔɔre ba chɔge ba maama pa se ba yera saare de zem maama. Ba ma daare ba jwoŋi ba tega kam ba jega, ka na lana de vara kɔnɔ to ŋwaane. 42Konto kwaga ne mo Simeon dwi tiina bam wone nɔɔna bia yanu (500) déem vei Seyira zwonnu laŋa kam ba ke jara de balo na zoore da to. Ko nam ye Yisi bia mo dɛ ba yiga ye ba vo. Pelatia, de Nearia, de Refaya, de Yuzeli mo konto. 43Ba déem ma vo ba go Amaleki dwi tiina balo ya na lugi jara wone ye ba ta wora to. Ba ma jwoŋi ba tega kam ye ba zoore da de zem maama.

english_text:
The Descendants of Reuben
1 Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph, 2 even though it was the Judah tribe that became the most powerful and produced a leader.
3Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
4-6 The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
7-8The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon, 9and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
10When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead.
The Descendants of Gad
11The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah. 12Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat. 13Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
14They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz. 15Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
16The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon. 17Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
18The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh had 44,760 soldiers trained to fight in battle with shields, swords, bows, and arrows. 19They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab. 20Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies. 21These Israelite tribes captured 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 people. 22Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria.
The Tribe of East Manasseh
23East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. 24Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers.
The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
25The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan. 26 So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_text:
Ruben dwi dem
1Ruben ya mo ye Isarele bu-kwea. O nam gɛ o nakweene dem mo, o na peini de o kwo kaane to ŋwaane. O nyaane Josɛf bia balei bam mo leiri o yuu ne ba di nakweene dem. Konto ŋwaane Ruben yere wo dɛ de zo we o ye bu-kwea kam. 2Judah déem mo seene o dana o dwoi o chorro tem maama, ye o dwi dem nɔɔno ba o ji teo kom yuu tu. De ko de, Josɛf dwi dem déem mo jege nakweene dem.
3Isarele bu-kwea Ruben bia mo tento:
Hanoki, de Pallu, de Hezeron, de Karimi.
4Joweli dwi dem na ye tei to mo tento:
Semaya de o bu Goga, de wonto bu Simeyi, 5de wonto de bu Mika, de wonto bu Reaya, de wonto bu Baal, 6de wonto bu Beera. Beera déem na ye Ruben dwi dem nakwe maŋa kalo ne to, mo Asiria teo pɛ Tigilaf-Pilesa jaane‑o o vo o tete teo.
7Ruben dwi dem sɔ-yuni nakwa yera yam na popone tei lonne twanno tem wone to mo tento:
Ba yiga tu Jeyeli, de Zekaria, 8de Azaze bu Bela. Azaze déem ye Sema bu mo, ye Sema de ye Joweli bu.
Dwi dento déem jeini laŋa kalo na zege Arowa ne se ka vo ka yi Nebo de Baal-Meon seeni to mo. 9Ko ná ye wɛ-puli seeni, ba laŋa kam ta kɛ ka yi kagoa kam ni mo, mɛ na wo Yuferata buga kam bubɛ baŋa seeni to. Ba laŋa kam déem yala konto dwoŋi, ba vara bam kɔgɔ na puli dedɛ Gilead ne to ŋwaane.
10Maŋa kalo Sɔɔl na di paare to, mo Ruben dwi tiina déem ke jara de Hagiri tiina bam ba di-ba. Ba laam ma vo ba jwoŋi Hagiri tiina bam jei sem maama na wo Gilead wɛ-puli seeni to ba tei.
Gad dwi dem
11Gad dem déem zoore Basan ne mo se ko vo ko yi Saleka. Jei sem konto bwola de Ruben dwi tiina bam na zoore mɛ to. 12Joweli déem mo ye ba yiga tu Basan ne. Safam maa ye belei tu. Janayi de Safate de ma saŋe. 13Ba chorro telo na daare to de dwia yam nakwa mo tento:
Mikayeli, de Mesulam, de Seba, de Jorayi, de Jakan, de Zia, de Ebera. Ba maama ye barepɛ mo. 14Banto maama déem ye Abihali dwi mo. Abihali déem ye Huri bu mo. Huri maa ye Jaroa bu. Jaroa de maa ye Gilead bu, ye Gilead ye Mikayeli bu. Mikayeli maa ye Jesisayi bu. Jesisayi déem ye Jaado bu, ye Jaado ye Buzi bu. 15Abideli bu Ahi déem mo ye ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe. Abideli de déem maa ye Guni bu.
16Gad dwi tiina bam déem zoore Basan de Gilead jei sem ne de se nawuura yam ne mo. Ba maa tei pwoli selo na wo Saron ne se ko vo ko yi se siseina yam maama to.
17Ba déem popone ba natɔga kam konto ba tiŋi maŋa kalo Jotam na di Judah teo paare ye Jeroboam de di Isarele teo paare to mo.
18Ruben dwi dem, de Gad dwi dem, ko woli de Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom déem jege babɛ morro finna-tena de bia yarepɛ de fuseredo (44, 760) balo na yei jara keim to mo. Banto wae ba mae jara nantane de se-zɔɔro ba ke jara, ye ba yei chena tam chekke. 19Ba déem ma ke jara de Hagiri tiina, de Jetura tiina, de Nafisi tiina, ko woli de Nodaba tiina maama. 20Wɛ déem zeini babɛ sem konto mo pa se ba wane Hagiri tiina bam de balo na woli-ba jara wone to ba di, ba na keeri ba jare‑o jara yam wone to ŋwaane. Wɛ ma sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom, ba na ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. 21Babɛ sem ma vere Hagiri tiina bam vara bam maama ba ja ba viiri. Kona morro finnu (50,000), de pei morro bia yalei de finnu (250,000), ko woli de bonɛ morro telei (2,000) mo konto. Ba déem ta ma ja nɔɔna morro bi (100,000) ba woli da ba ja ba viiri. 22Wɛ na woli-ba jara yam wone to, babɛ sem déem go ba dona bam dedɛ mo. Ba laam maa zoore jei sem konto ne mo se ko yi maŋa kalo Asiria tiina bam na jaane-ba ba vo ba tete teo to.
Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom
23Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom déem daga mo dedɛ. Ba maa zoore jei selo na zege Basan ne se ko vo ko yi Baal-Heremon, de Senira, de Heremon peo kom seeni to.
24Ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa bam mo tento:
Efere, de Yisi, de Eleli, de Azireli, de Jeremia, de Hodavia, de Jaadeli.
Nakwa banto maama déem ye babɛ mo jara wone ye ba tiini ba jege yere. 25Ba nam nwoŋi ba nabaara Wɛ wom kwaga ne, ye ba daare ba kaane wa-yɔɔro telo Kanaan tiina bam déem na tɔge to mo. Wɛ nam ya chɔge nɔɔna bam konto o yage pa se o nɔɔna laam jwoŋi ba tega kam mo ba tei. 26Konto ŋwaane Wɛ ma pa se Asiria teo pɛ Pulu ke chichuŋu de-ba. Pɛ wom konto yere dedwoŋi maa ye Tigilaf-Pilesa. O ma wane o di Ruben dwi tiina bam, de Gad dwi tiina bam, de Manasɛ dwi chichworo tiina bam, ye o daare o ja-ba o ja viiri. O ma kale-ba o vo Hala, de Habora, de Hara, ko woli de Gozan buga kam seeni. Dáane mo ba zoora se ko ba ko yi zem maama.

english_text:
The Descendants of Levi
1Levi was the father of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
2Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 3Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
4-14Eleazar's descendants included Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Ahimaaz, Azariah, Johanan, Azariah the priest who served in the temple built by King Solomon, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Shallum, Hilkiah, Azariah, Seraiah, and Jehozadak. 15King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
16 Levi's three sons had sons of their own. 17Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei. 18Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 19Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
20-21Gershon's descendants included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah, Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.
22-24Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
25Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth. 26-27Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
28Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
29-30Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.
The Temple Musicians
31After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship. 32These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
33-38Here is a list of these musicians and their family lines:
Heman from the Kohathite clan was the director. His ancestors went all the way back to Jacob and included Joel, Samuel, Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah, Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai, Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah, Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah, Izhar, Kohath, Levi.
39-43Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
44-47Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
48The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent.
The Descendants of Aaron
49Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
50-53Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz.
The Towns for the Levites
(Joshua 21.1-42)
54Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in. 55They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it. 56But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh. 57-59So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh. 60From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
61The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
62The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
63The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
64So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them. 65All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
66Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim. 67-69These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon. 70And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
71The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them. 72-73The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them. 74-75The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them. 76Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
77The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun. 78-79They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them. 80-81And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_text:
Levi dwi dem
1Levi bia bam mo tento:
Gereson, de Kohafe, de Merari.
2Kohafe bia bam mo tento:
Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli.
3Amiram bia bam déem mo ye:
Aron, de Moses, de Miriam.
Aron de bia bam mo tento:
Nadab, de Abihu, de Eleaza, de Itamara.
4Eleaza déem mo loge Finehase. Finehase ma lo Abisua. 5Abisua de ma lo Buki, ye Buki lo Yuzi. 6Yuzi déem ma lo Zerahia.
