Zerahia de ma lo Merayofa. 7Merayofa ma lo Amaria, ye Amaria lo Ahituba. 8Ahituba déem ma lo Zadoki, ye Zadoki de lo Ahimaazi. 9Ahimaazi ma lo Azaria. Azaria de ma lo Johanan. 10Johanan déem ma lo Azaria wolo na ye Wɛ kaanem tu ye o toŋe Wɛ diga kalo Solomon na lɔge Jerusalem ne to totoŋa. 11Azaria ma lo Amaria. Amaria ma lo Ahituba. 12Ahituba de déem ma lo Zadoki, ye Zadoki lo Salum. 13Salum ma lo Hilikia. Hilikia de ma lo Azaria. 14Azaria ma lo Seraya. Seraya ma lo Jehozadaki. 15Maŋa kalo Baŋa Wɛ déem na pɛ se Pɛ Nebukadeneza ja Judah tiina bam de Jerusalem tiina bam o ja o viiri to mo o jaane Jehozadaki o woli da.
16Levi bia bam mo tento:
Gereson, de Kohafe, de Merari.
17Gereson bia bam yera mo tento:
Libini dedaane Simeyi.
18Kohafe bia bam mo tento:
Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli.
19Merari bia bam mo tento:
Mahili de Musi.
Levi sɔ-yuni tem nabaara bam mo tento.
20Gereson dwi dem na ye tei to mo tento:
Libini, de o bu Jahafe, de wonto bu Zimma, 21de wonto bu Joa, de wonto bu Ido, de wonto bu Zera, de wonto bu Jeterayi.
22Kohafe dwi dem mo tento:
Aminadabi, de o bu Kora, de wonto bu Asiri, 23de wonto bu Elikana, de wonto bu Ebiasafa, de wonto bu Asiri 24de wonto bu Tahafe, de wonto bu Yureli, de wonto bu Yuzia, de wonto bu Sawuli.
25Elikana dwi dem mo tento:
Amasayi, de Ahimofi, 26de wonto bu Elikana, de wonto bu Zofayi, de wonto bu Nahafi, 27de wonto bu Eliabi, de wonto bu Jeroham, de wonto bu Elikana, [de wonto de bu Samuwel].
28Samuwel bia bam mo tento:
O bu-kwea Joweli, de wonto nyaane Abija.
29Merari dwi dem mo tento:
Mahili, de wonto bu Libini, de wonto de bu Simeyi, de wonto bu Yuza, 30de wonto bu Simea, de wonto bu Hagia, dedaane wonto bu Asaya.
Wɛ diga lein-leena bam
31Ba déem na jaane Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba ja ba zo ba zege o wara-jei sem ne to, nɔɔna balo David na kuri se ba taa nii lein-leena totoŋa yam baŋa ne to mo tento. 32Banto déem mo leeni lei ba zuli Wɛ o wara-vwei dem ne ye Solomon laam ba o lɔ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam Jerusalem ne to. Ba déem toŋe ba tɔge chullu telo maama ba na tiŋi ba pa-ba to mo. 33Lein-leena bam de ba bia bam yera mo tento:
Balo na nwoŋi Kohafe dwi dem wone to mo tento:
Lein-leenu Heman.
Wonto déem ye Joweli bu. Joweli maa ye Samuwel bu. 34Samuwel maa ye Elikana bu. Elikana maa ye Jeroham bu. Jeroham maa ye Eleli bu. Eleli maa ye Toa bu. 35Toa maa ye Zufa bu. Zufa maa ye Elikana bu. Elikana maa ye Mahafe bu. Mahafe maa ye Amasayi bu. 36Amasayi maa ye Elikana bu. Elikana maa ye Joweli bu. Joweli maa ye Azaria bu. Azaria maa ye Zefania bu. 37Zefania maa ye Tahafe bu. Tahafe maa ye Asiri bu. Asiri maa ye Ebiasafa bu. Ebiasafa maa ye Kora bu. 38Kora maa ye Izehara bu. Izehara maa ye Kohafe bu. Kohafe maa ye Levi bu. Levi maa ye Isarele bu.
39Gereson dwi tu Asaf déem ye Heman kwaga saŋeno wom mo.
Asaf ye Berekia bu mo. Berekia de maa ye Simea bu. 40Simea maa ye Mikayeli bu. Mikayeli maa ye Baaseya bu. Baaseya maa ye Malakija bu. 41Malakija maa ye Etini bu. Etini maa ye Zera bu. Zera maa ye Adaya bu. 42Adaya maa ye Etan bu. Etan maa ye Zimma bu. Zimma maa ye Simeyi bu. 43Simeyi maa ye Jahafe bu. Jahafe maa ye Gereson bu. Gereson maa ye Levi bu.
44Merari dwi tu Etan de déem saŋe Asaf kwaga ne o woli Heman.
Etan ye Kisi bu mo. Kisi maa ye Abidi bu. Abidi maa ye Maluki bu. 45Maluki maa ye Hasabia bu. Hasabia maa ye Amazia bu. Amazia maa ye Hilikia bu. 46Hilikia maa ye Amezi bu. Amezi maa ye Bani bu. Bani maa ye Semera bu. 47Semera maa ye Mahili bu. Mahili maa ye Musi bu. Musi maa ye Merari bu. Merari maa ye Levi bu.
48Levi dwi tiina badwonna bam déem maa tei totoŋa yalo na daare Wɛ wara-vwei dem ne to. 49Ko nam ye Aron de o dwi dem déem mo toŋe Wɛ kaanem totoŋa yam. Banto yeini ba kwei pɛɛra ba ma ba kaane Wɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne, ye ba daare ba zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa ka de dakaa kam baŋa ne. Ba ta ke chullu telo maama na maŋe se ba ke Wɛ di-yun-gala kam wone to se ba saare Isarele tiina bam wɛleera to. Konto to, ba déem toŋe ba tɔge Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses na pɛ ni se ba taa ke tei maama to mo.
50Aron dwi dem na ye tei to mo tento:
Eleaza, de wonto bu Finehase, de wonto bu Abisua, 51de wonto bu Buki, de wonto bu Yuzi, de wonto bu Zerahia, 52de wonto bu Merayofa, de wonto bu Amaria, de wonto bu Ahituba, 53de wonto bu Zadoki, de wonto bu Ahimaazi.
54Aron dwi dem déem nwoŋi Levi bu Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom ne mo. Ba na tage jɔrɔ se ba pɔɔre tega kam ba pa Levi dwi tiina to, banto mo di yiga. Tega kalo ba na jwoŋi se ba taa zoore da to mo tento:
55Ba déem pɛ-ba Judah teo Heboron de pwoli selo na na gilimi da to mo. 56Ko nam ná ye teo kom kare sem de ko nawuura yam, ba kwei tento ba pa Jefunɛ bu Kaleb mo. 57Heboron déem ye teo kolo ba na tiŋi ka-duri-ka-zo-ka-seigi ŋwaane to mo. Ba déem kwei teene dento de pwoli selo na gilimi-de to ba pa Aron dwi dem mo se ba taa tei:
Heboron, de Libina, de Jatira, de Esetemoa, 58de Hilen, de Debiri, 59de Asan, [de Juta], ko woli de Bɛte-Semesa. 60Ba ta ma kwei teene dento na wo Benjamin dwi dem laŋa ne to dedaane pwoli selo na gilimi-de to ba pa-ba: [Gibeon], de Geba, de Alemefi, de Anatofe. Teene dem maama déem ye teene fuga-detɔ mo ba kwei ba pa Aron dwi dem.
61Ko ná ye Kohafe dwi tiina balo maa na daare to, ba déem kwei teene fuga na wo Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom laŋa ne to mo ba pa-ba.
62Ko ta ná ye Gereson dwi dem sɔ-yuu maama, ba déem kwei teene fuga-detɔ mo na wo Isakara dwi dem laŋa ne, de Asere dwi dem laŋa ne, de Nafitali dwi dem laŋa ne, ko woli de Basan jei sem na wo Manasɛ dwi dem laŋa ne to mo ba pa-ba.
63Merari dwi dem sɔ-yuu maama de ma jwoŋi teene fuga-delei na wo Ruben dwi dem laŋa ne, de Gad dwi dem laŋa ne, de Zebulun dwi dem laŋa ne to.
64Isarele tiina bam déem ke konto mo ba kwei teene dem konto ko woli de pwoli selo na gilimi-de to ba pa Levi dwi tiina bam se ba taa zoore de wone. 65Ko ta ná ye teene delo na wo Judah dwi dem laŋa ne, de Simeon dwi dem laŋa ne, de Benjamin dwi dem laŋa ne, ye de yera maŋe ya popone to, ba déem tage jɔrɔ mo ba kuri dento ba woli da.
66Kohafe dwi dem sɔ-yuni tedwonna de déem ma jwoŋi teene delo na wo Efrayim dwi dem laŋa kam ne to. 67Efrayim zwonnu laŋa kam ne ba kwei Sɛkɛm de pwoli selo na gilimi-ko to mo ba pa-ba. Teo kom konto ba déem tiŋi ka-duri-ka-zo-ka-seigi ŋwaane mo. Ba ta ma kwei Gezere, 68de Jokemeam, de Bɛte-Horon, 69de Ayijalon, de Gafa-Rimon ba woli da. 70Kohafe dwi sɔ-yuni telo na daare to, ba ma kwei teene dento na wo Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom laŋa ne to ba pa-ba: Anera, de Bileyam dedaane de pwoli sem maama.
71Gereson dwi tiina bam déem jwoŋi teene dento mo se ba taa zoore de wone.
Manasɛ dwi dem laŋa ne mo ba kwei teene dento ba pa-ba:
Golan na wo Basan ne to, ko woli de Asetarof, de se pwoli sem maama.
72Ko ná ye Isakara dwi dem laŋa ne, ba jwoŋi teene dento mo:
Kedesa, de Daberafa, 73de Ramofa, ko woli de Anem, dedaane de pwoli sem maama.
74Ko maa ná ye Asere dwi dem laŋa ne, ba jwoŋi teene dento mo:
Masal, de Abedon, 75de Hukoka, de Rehobi, de de pwoli sem maama.
76Nafitali dwi dem laŋa ne mo ba jwoŋi teene dento:
Kedesa na wo Galili ne to, de Hamon, de Kiriafayim de de pwoli sem.
77Ko ná ye Levi dwi tiina balo na daare to, Merari dwi dem déem jwoŋi teene dento mo se ba taa zoore de wone.
Zebulun dwi dem laŋa ne mo ba jwoŋi teene dento:
[Jokeneam, de Karata,] de Rimon, de Tabora, de de pwoli sem maama.
78Ko maa ná ye Ruben dwi dem laŋa kam na zege Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni ye ka jeeri Jeriko teo to, ba déem jwoŋi teene dento mo laŋa kam konto ne:
Bezere na wo kagoa kam ne to, de Jahaza, 79de Kedemofa, de Mefaafa, dedaane de pwoli sem maama.
80Ko maa ná ye Gad dwi dem de laŋa kam ne, ba jwoŋi teene dento mo:
Ramofa na wo Gilead ne to, de Mahanayim, 81de Hesebon, de Jazera, dedaane de pwoli sem maama.

english_text:
The Descendants of Issachar
1Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
2Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were 22,600 people in Tola's family by the time David became king.
3Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders. 4Their families were so large that they had 36,000 soldiers in their clans. 5In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of 87,000 warriors.
The Descendants of Benjamin and Dan
6Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
7Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was 22,034.
8Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. 9The official family records listed 20,200 soldiers in the families of this clan, as well as their family leaders.
10Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. 11They were family leaders in their clan, which had 17,200 soldiers prepared to fight in battle. 12Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan.
Dan was the father of Hushim.
The Descendants of Naphtali
13Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.
The Descendants of Manasseh
14Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead. 15Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah.
Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
16Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem. 17Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
18Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
19Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
The Descendants of Ephraim
20Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath, 21Zabad, and Shuthelah.
Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath. 22Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him. 23Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
24Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
25Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan, 26Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama, 27Nun, and Joshua.
28The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
29The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages.
The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages.
The Descendants of Asher
30Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
31Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith. 32Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua. 33Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. 34Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram. 35And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. 36Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, 37Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. 38Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
39Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
40These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of 26,000 soldiers.
translation_text:
Isakara dwi dem
1Isakara bia bana bam mo tento:
Tola, de Pua, de Jasubi, de Simiron.
2Tola bia bam maa ye:
Yuzi, de Refaya, de Jereli, de Jamayi, de Yibisam, de Semuwel.
Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo. Maŋa kalo David na tu o di paare to, Tola dwi tiini balo na yi jara-keim ye ba yera popone ya tiŋi to déem ye baara morro finlei-telei de bia yaredo (22,600) mo.
3Yuzi bu déem ye Izarahia mo. Izarahia bia bam mo tento:
Mikayeli, de Obadia, de Joweli, de Issiya.
Banu bam konto maama déem ye nakwa mo. 4Ba dwi dem nɔɔna balo na yi jara-keim ye ba yera popone ya tiŋi to maa ye baara morro fintɔ-teredo (36,000) mo, ba kaana de ba bia bam na puli dedɛ to ŋwaane.
5Isakara sɔ-yuni tem maama nɔɔna balo na yi jara-keim ye ba yera popone ya tiŋi to maama ná ke daane, ba déem ye baara morro funɔnɔ-terepɛ (87,000) mo.
Benjamin dwi dem
6Benjamin bia batɔ bam mo tento:
Bela, de Bechere, de Jedayeli.
7Bela bia banu bam maa ye:
Ezibon, de Yuzi, de Yuzeli, de Jerimofa, de Yiri.
Ba maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo. Ba dwi dem nɔɔna balo na yi jara keim to maa ye baara morro finlei-telei de fintɔ-bana (22, 034) mo.
8Bechere bia bam maa ye:
Zemira, de Joasa, de Eliazera, de Elio-Enayi, de Omiri, de Jeremofa, de Abija, de Anatofe, de Alemefi.
9Bechere dwi dem wone, ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa dedaane baara morro finlei de bia yalei (20,200) na yi jara keim to yera déem mo popone ya tiŋi tɔnɔ ne.
10Jedayeli bu mo ye Bilihan. Bilihan bia bam maa ye:
Jewusi, de Benjamin, de Ehuda, de Kenaana, de Zetan, de Tarasisi, de Ahisahara.
11Jedayeli bia banto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo. Ba dwi dem nɔɔna balo na yi jara keim to maa ye baara morro fuga-terepɛ de bia yalei (17, 200).
12Supi tiina bam de Hupi tiina bam déem nwoŋi Iri dwi dem wone mo.
Husim tiina bam de déem nwoŋi Ahiram dwi dem wone.
Nafitali dwi dem
13Nafitali bia bam mo tento:
Jahazeli, de Guni, de Jezera, de Salum. Banto maama déem ye Biliha mo loge-ba.
Manasɛ dwi dem
14Manasɛ dwi dem mo tento:
O ka-bia kalo na nwoŋi Aram to mo loge Asireli o pa‑o. O daa ta ma lo Makira wolo bu na ye Gilead to. 15Makira déem ma di kaane na ye Hupi de Supi tiina bam bukɔ. O ta maa jege nakɔ, o yere mo Maaka. Makira bu wolo na saŋe to yere maa ye Zelofehada ye wonto déem loge bukwa yerane mo.
16Makira kaane Maaka déem ma lo bakeira o pa o yere we Peresa. Wonto nyaane yere maa ye Seresa. Peresa ma lo bakeiri selei, ba yera mo Yulam de Rekem. 17Yulam de ma lo Bedan.
Banto déem ye Makira bu Gilead bia mo. Makira de déem maa ye Manasɛ bu.
18Gilead nakɔ Hamolekefa ma lo Yisoda, de Abizeri, de Maala.
19Semida de ma lo Ahian, de Sɛkɛm, de Liki, de Aniam.
Efrayim dwi dem
20Efrayim dwi dem na ye tei to mo tento:
Sutela, de o bu Bereda, de wonto bu Tahafe, de wonto bu Eleada, de wonto bu Tahafe, 21de wonto bu Zabadi, de wonto bu Sutela.
Efrayim bia Ezere de Eleadi déem vei se ba ŋɔ Gafa tiina bam vara mo ye nɔɔna balo na zoore jei sem konto ne to go-ba. 22Ba kwo Efrayim ma kwei da kɔgɔ o keeri ba lua. O chorro ma zaŋe ba vo se ba ke o lei. 23Efrayim daa ma peini de o kaane ye o ja puga o lo bakeira. O ma pa o yere we Beria, bɛŋwaane ba loge‑o maŋa kalo cham na yi o sɔŋɔ kom to mo. 24Efrayim déem jege bukɔ, o yere mo Seera. Bukɔ wom konto déem mo lɔge Bɛte-Horon baŋa seeni de kuri seeni jei sem maama. Wonto ta mo lɔge Yuzen-Seera jei sem de.
25Efrayim dwi dem ta maa ye Refa, de o bu Resefa, de wonto bu Tela, de wonto bu Tahan, 26de wonto bu Ladan, de wonto bu Amihuda, de wonto bu Elisama, 27de wonto bu Nun, de wonto bu Josua.
28Ba déem na zoore tega kalo baŋa ne to zege Bɛtel de ko nawuura yam ne, se ko yi Naaran jei sem na wo wɛ-puli seeni to. Ko ta ná ye wɛ-zoore seeni, ba tega kam tole konto mo ko yi Gezere de ko nawuura yam maama. Ko ta ma zege Sɛkɛm de ko nawuura yam ne ko tole ko yi Aya de ko nawuura yam. 29Teene delo na wo Manasɛ laŋa kam siseini dem ne to maa ye Bɛte-san, de Taanaka, de Megido, de Dora, ko woli de de nawuura yam maama. Teene dem konto wone mo Isarele bu Josɛf dwi dem déem zoora.
Asere dwi dem
30Asere bia bam mo tento:
Imina, de Isiva, de Isivi, de Beria. Banto nakɔ yere mo Sera.
31Beria bia bam maa ye:
Hebera, de Malikeli. Malikeli bu maa ye Berezati.
32Hebera déem loge Jafelete, de Somere, de Hotam mo. O ta ma lo busankana, o yere mo Sua.
33Jafelete bia maa ye Pasake, de Bimale, de Asevafe.
34Somere bia maa ye Ahi, de Roga, de Huba, de Aram.
35Jafelete nyaane Hotam de bia maa ye Zofa, de Imina, de Selesi, de Amali.
36Zofa bia bam mo ye Sua, de Hanefera, de Suwali, de Beri, de Imira, 37de Bezere, de Hodi, de Samma, de Silisa, de Iferan, de Beera.
38Jefere bia bam maa ye Jefunɛ, de Pisipa, de Ara.
39Yulla bia bam de maa ye Ara, de Hanneli, de Rizia.
40Nɔɔna banto maama déem ye Asere dwi dem mo. Ba maa ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa. Ba déem ye babɛ na yei jara keim chekke to, ye ba tiini ba jege yere. Asere dwi dem nɔɔna balo na yi jara keim to déem ye baara morro finlei-teredo (26,000) mo.

english_text:
More Descendants of Benjamin
1Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah, 2Nohah, and Rapha. 3Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud, 4Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, 5Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
6-7Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
8-11Shaharaim and his wife Hushim had two sons: Abitub and Elpaal. But Shaharaim later divorced her and his other wife, Baara. Then he moved to the country of Moab and married Hodesh, and they had seven sons: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. They were all family leaders in his clan. 12Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
13Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath. 14-16Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha. 17-18Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab. 19-21Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath. 22-25Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel. 26-27Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri. 28These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
29Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there 30along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 31Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, 32and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
The Descendants of King Saul
33Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 34Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, 35and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz. 36Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, 37Binea, Raphah, Eleasah, Azel, 38as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. 39Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet. 40Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of 150 children and grandchildren.
All of these belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_text:
Benjamin dwi dem
1Benjamin bia banu bam mo tento:
O bu-kwea Bela, de Asabeli, de Ahara, 2de Noha, de Rafa.
3Bela bia bam maa ye:
Adara, de Gera, de Abihudi, 4de Abisua, de Naaman, de Ahoa, 5de Gera, de Sefufana, de Huram.
6-7Ehuda bia bam mo tento:
Naaman, de Ahija, de Gera.
Banto déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo Geba ne. Ba dona déem ma zeili-ba pa ba vo ba zoore Manahafa ne. Gera mo dɛ ba yiga pa se ba nwoŋi. Wonto ma lo Yuza de Ahihuda.
8Saharayim na ve o kaana balei Husim de Baara to, o déem ta jeini Moaba teo ne o lo bakeiri. 9O ka-dooro wolo yere na ye Hodesa to ma lo Jobaba, de Zibia, de Mesa, de Malikam, 10de Jewuzi, de Sakia, de Mirama. Saharayim bia bam konto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo. 11O kaane Husim déem ya maŋe o lo bakeiri selei o pa‑o, ye banto yera mo ye Abitubi de Elipaale.
12Elipaale bia bam mo tento:
Ebera, de Misam, de Semeda.
Semeda déem mo lɔge Ono de Loda teene dem, ko woli de de nawuura yam maama. 13Elipaale ta ma lo Beria de Sema. Banto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo Ayijalon ne. Ba ma zeili balo maama ya na zoore Gafa ne to.
14Beria bia bam maa ye:
Ahio, de Sasake, de Jeremofa, 15de Zebadia, de Arada, de Edere, 16de Mikayeli, de Isipa, de Joha.
17Elipaale bia bam maa ye:
Zebadia, de Mesulam, de Hiziki, 18de Isimerayi, de Izila, de Jobaba.
19Simeyi bia bam maa ye:
Jakim, de Zikiri, de Zabidi, 20de Elenayi, de Ziletayi, de Eleli, 21de Adaya, de Beraya, de Simarafa.
22Sasake bia bam maa ye:
Isipana, de Ebera, de Eleli, 23de Abedon, de Zikiri, de Hanan, 24de Hanania, de Elam, de Antotija, 25de Ifideya, de Penweli.
26Jeroham bia bam maa ye:
Sameserayi, de Sehariya, de Atalia, 27de Jaaresia, de Elija, de Zikiri.
28Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo ye ba yera yam popone ya tiŋi lonne twanno tem wone. Ba déem maa zoore Jerusalem ne.
29Gibeon kwo Jeyeli déem zoore Gibeon teo ne mo. O kaane yere maa ye Maaka. 30O bia bam maa ye:
O bu-kwea Abedon, de Zura, de Kisi, de Baal, [de Nera], de Nadab, 31de Gedora, de Ahio, de Zekere, 32de Mikilofa.
Mikilofa de ma lo Simea. Banto maama déem zoore ba twɛ de ba chorro tedwonna mo Jerusalem ne.
33Nera déem mo loge Kisi. Kisi ma lo Sɔɔl. Sɔɔl de déem ma lo Jonatan, de Maliki-sua, de Abinadaba, de Esi-baal. 34Jonatan bu mo ye Meri-baal. Meri-baal de ma lo Mika.
35Mika bia bam maa ye:
Piton, de Meleka, de Tarea, de Ahaz.
36Ahaz déem mo loge Jehoada. Jehoada de ma lo Alemefi, de Azimavefa, de Zimiri. Zimiri ma lo Moza. 37Moza ma lo Binea. Binea bu maa ye Rafa. Rafa bu maa ye Eleasa. Eleasa bu maa ye Azeli.
38Azeli déem jege bia baredo mo. Ba yera mo ye:
Azerikam, de Bokeru, de Isameli, de Searia, de Obadia, de Hanan.
39Azeli nyaane Eseke de déem maa jege bia batɔ ye banto mo ye o bu-kwea Yulam, de Jewusi, de Elifeleti. 40Yulam bia bam déem ye babɛ mo jara wone. Ba maa yei chena tam chekke. Yulam bia bam de o naaro tem maama daga dedɛ. Ba déem yi nɔɔna bi de finnu (150) mo.
Banto maama nam ye Benjamin dwi dem mo konto.

english_text:
The People Who Returned from Babylonia and Settled in Jerusalem
1Everyone in Israel was listed in the official family records that were included in the history of Israel's kings.
The people of Judah were taken to Babylonia as prisoners because they sinned against the Lord. 2 And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites. 3People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
4-6There were 690 people from the Judah tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They were all descendants of Judah's three sons: Perez, Shelah, and Zerah. Their leaders were Uthai, Asaiah, and Jeuel. Uthai was the son of Ammihud and a descendant of Omri, Imri, Bani, and Perez. Asaiah was a descendant of Shelah; Jeuel was a descendant of Zerah.
7-9There were also 956 family leaders from the Benjamin tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They included: Sallu son of Meshullam, grandson of Hodaviah, and great-grandson of Hassenuah; Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi and grandson of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, grandson of Reuel, and great-grandson of Ibnijah.
The Priests Who Settled in Jerusalem
10-12Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
13There was a total of 1,760 priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple.
The Levites Who Settled in Jerusalem
14-16Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah.
The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
17Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan, 18and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
19Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent. 20Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
21Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
22There was a total of 212 guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work, 23and now they guarded the temple gates.
24There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple. 25Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty. 26The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there. 27They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning.
The Duties of the Levites
28Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used. 29Others were responsible for the temple furnishings and its sacred objects, as well as the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices. 30But only the priests could mix the spices. 31Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings. 32The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
33The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
34All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem.
King Saul's Family
(1 Chronicles 8.29-38)
35Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived. 36They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 37Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth 38the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
39Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 40-41Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz. 42-44The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_text:
Nɔɔna balo na tu ba zoore Jerusalem ne to
1Ba déem popone Isarele nɔn-bia bam maama yera ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.
Ko ná ye Judah tiina bam, ba dona déem jaane-ba ba vo Babilon, ba na nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne to ŋwaane. 2Nɔɔna balo na dɛ yiga ba jwoori ba tete teo to déem ye Wɛ kaanem tiina, de Levi dwi dem badaara, ko woli de Wɛ diga kam tontoŋena, dedaane Isarele tiina badaara mo. 3Nɔɔna balo déem na tu ba zoore Jerusalem ne ye ba nwoŋi Judah dwi dem wone, de Benjamin dwi dem wone, de Efrayim dwi dem wone, ko woli de Manasɛ dwi dem wone to mo tento:
4Amihuda bu Yutayi. Amihuda kwo déem ye Omiri. Omiri kwo maa ye Imiri. Imiri kwo maa ye Bani. Bani déem ye Judah bu Pɛreza dwi tu.
5Ko ná ye Sela dwi dem wone, ko ye o bu-kwea Asaya de wonto bia bam mo.
6Ko maa ná ye Zera dwi dem wone, ko ye Jeweli.
Balo na nwoŋi Judah dwi dem wone ye ba jwoori to maama déem ye nɔɔna bia baredo de funogo (690) mo.
7Benjamin dwi dem wone nɔɔna balo na jwoori to mo tento:
Mesulam bu Saalu. Mesulam kwo déem ye Hodavia. Hodavia kwo maa ye Hasenua.
8Jeroham bu Yibineya.
Yuzi bu Ela. Yuzi kwo déem ye Mikiri.
Sefatia bu Mesulam. Mesulam kwo maa ye Reweli. Reweli kwo de déem maa ye Yibinija.
9Nɔɔna banto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo. Benjamin dwi tiina balo yera na popone ya tiŋi tɔnɔ ne to déem ye nɔɔna bia nogo de finnu-baredo (956) mo.
10Wɛ kaanem tiina balo na tu ba zoore Jerusalem ne to mo tento:
Jedaya, de Jehoyaribi, de Jakin.
11Azaria wolo déem na nii Wɛ diga kam tontoŋa yam baŋa ne to.
O kwo déem ye Hilikia. Hilikia kwo maa ye Mesulam. Mesulam kwo maa ye Zadoki. Zadoki kwo maa ye Merayofa. Merayofa kwo de déem ye Ahituba.
12Jeroham bu Adaya.
Jeroham kwo maa ye Pasura. Pasura kwo maa ye Malakija. Malakija kwo maa ye Maasayi. Maasayi kwo maa ye Adeli. Adeli kwo maa ye Jaazera. Jaazera kwo maa ye Mesulam. Mesulam kwo maa ye Mesilemifa. Mesilemifa kwo maa ye Yimera.
13Kaanem tiina bam konto de ba chorro telo na ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa to déem ye nɔɔna moro de bia yarepɛ de fuseredo (1, 760) mo. Ba maa toŋe totoŋa dwi dwi Wɛ diga kam ne ye ba yei ba na wó ke tei to.
14Levi dwi dem nɔɔna balo de na jwoori to mo tento:
Merari dwi tu Semaya. Semaya kwo déem mo ye Hasubi. Hasubi kwo maa ye Azerikam. Azerikam kwo maa ye Hasabia.
15Bakebakara, de Herese, de Galale, ko woli de Mika bu Matania. Mika kwo déem ye Zikiri. Zikiri kwo maa ye Asaf.
16Semaya bu Obadia. Semaya kwo maa ye Galale. Galale kwo de maa ye Jedutuna.
Asa bu Berekia. Asa kwo déem ye Elikana mo. Wonto déem zoore Netofa tiina bam jei sem ne.
17Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena balo na jwoori to mo tento:
Salum, de Akuba, de Talemon, de Ahiman, de ba chorro tem.
Salum déem mo ye ba totoŋa yiga tu. 18De zem maama ba maa nii ni delo na yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni ye ba bwoi-de we ‘Pɛ Ni dem’ to. Banto déem ye Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena balo na nwoŋi Levi dwi dem wone to mo.
19Kore bu Salum, de o dwonna Kora dwi tiina déem mo yere Wɛ wara-jei sem manchwo-peena yam.
Ba nabaara bam totoŋa de déem maŋe ya ye se ba taa yere Baŋa Wɛ wara-vwei dem ni mo. Kore kwo déem ye Ebiasafa, ye Ebiasafa ye Kora dwi tu mo. 20Faŋa to, Eleaza bu Finehase ya mo ye ni-yerena bam yuu tu. Baŋa Wɛ déem maa wo o tei ne. 21Meselemia bu Zekaria de déem yere Wɛ wara-jei ni dem mo.
22Nɔɔna bia yalei de fuga-balei (212) déem mo yere Wɛ wara-jei sem manchwo-peena yam. Ba déem popone ba yera ba tiŋi ko tɔge ba dwi dem mo kateiri de kateiri maama ne.
Ko nam ye Pɛ David de Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu Samuwel ya mo kuri ni-yerena bam se ba taa toŋe ba totoŋa yam de chega. 23Banto de ba dwi tiina bam mo tei Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ni dem yerem, ne ko ná ye Wɛ vwei dem mo naa diga kam tete. 24Ni-yerena bam déem zege Wɛ wara-jei sem sɛ sena sem maama ne ba yere nia yam mo. 25Maŋa de maŋa ba chorro tem na zoore ba kateira yam ne to maa yeini ba ba ba ke da yarepɛ ba woli-ba. 26Ni-yerena bana balo na ye ba yiga tiina to ye Levi dwi tiina mo. Ba nam pɛ-ba chega mo se ba taa yere Wɛ wara-jei zela di sem, ko woli de di selo lonne wonnu tem na tigi se wone to. 27Banto déem yere Wɛ wara-jei sem wea de tete maama mo, ko na ye ba totoŋa se ba taa nii ko maama baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Tega ná yeini ka poore, ba wó kwei bwor-bu mo ba ma ba pore ko nia yam ba yage dɛ wone maama.
28Ba déem ta kuri ni-yerena badwonna se ba taa nii wonnu telo ba na mae ba kaane Wɛ to baŋa ne. Maŋa maama ba ná kwei-te ba ja ba nwoŋi te jei sem ne, ba wó jeeli te ni mo, ye ba ná toŋe ba ti, ba daa ta wó ke konto mo se te dedoa yé muri. 29Nɔɔna badaara maa nii Wɛ wara-jei sem zela yam maama baŋa ne, ko ta woli de mun-bwei dem, de sana bam, de nuga kam, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa kam, de terale dem maama baŋa ne. 30Ko nam ye Wɛ kaanem tiina badwonna mo jege chwoŋa se ba gwaane terale dwi dwi ba ke daane. 31Levi dwi tu dedoa déem wora o yere mo Matitia. O maa ye Kora dwi tu Salum bu-kwea mo. Ba kuri wonto mo se o taa nii bworobworo kolo ba na ma ba ke Wɛ pɛɛra to fɔgem baŋa ne. 32Ko déem ye Kohafe dwi tiina badaara totoŋe mo se ba fɔge ba kwɛ bworobworo kolo ba na tiŋi Wɛ yiga ne Wɛ siu dɛ maama to.
33Balo na ye lein-leena ye ba ye Levi dwi dem nakwa to déem zoore Wɛ wara-jei di sem wone mo, se ba taa toŋe ba totoŋa yam wea de tete, ne ko na maŋe tei to. Mo kokuri ba daa ba jege totoŋa yadwonna se ba taa toŋe ba woli da. 34Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo ye ba yera yam popone ya tiŋi lonne twanno tem wone. Ba déem maa zoore Jerusalem ne.
Sɔɔl kwoa natɔga kam
35Gibeon kwo Jeyeli déem zoore Gibeon teo ne mo. O kaane yere maa ye Maaka. 36O bia bam maa ye:
O bu-kwea Abedon, de Zura, de Kisi, de Baal, de Nera, de Nadab, 37de Gedora, de Ahio, de Zekaria, de Mikilofa.
38Mikilofa de ma lo Simeam. Banto maama déem zoore ba twɛ de ba chorro tedwonna mo Jerusalem ne.
39Nera déem mo loge Kisi. Kisi ma lo Sɔɔl. Sɔɔl de déem ma lo Jonatan, de Maliki-sua, de Abinadaba, de Esi-baal.
40Jonatan bu mo ye Meri-baal. Meri-baal de ma lo Mika.
41Mika bia bam maa ye:
Piton, de Meleka, de Tarea, de Ahaz.
42Ahaz déem mo loge Jara. Jara de ma lo Alemefi, de Azimavefa, de Zimiri. Zimiri ma lo Moza. 43Moza ma lo Binea. Binea bu maa ye Refaya. Refaya bu maa ye Eleasa. Eleasa bu maa ye Azeli.
44Azeli déem jege bia baredo mo. Ba yera mo ye:
Azerikam, de Bokeru, de Isameli, de Searia, de Obadia, de Hanan.

english_text:
King Saul and His Sons Die
(1 Samuel 31.1-13)
1The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed. 2The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua. 3The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
4Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.”
But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade. 5When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
6Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead. 7The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
8The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa, 9they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods. 10They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
11When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul, 12some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
13 Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead, 14instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
Sɔɔl na gɛ o ŋwea tei to
1 Samuwel 31:1-13
1Filisi tiina bam déem kwaare jara dedaane Isarele tiina bam. Isarele jar-keira bam ma jage sae ye Filisi tiina bam pare-ba. Ba ma go Isarele tiina bam dedɛ Giliboa peo kom yuu ne. 2Sɔɔl de o bia bam ma duri, ye Filisi tiina bam pɛ ba kwaga ba pu. Ba ma go Sɔɔl bia Jonatan, de Abinadaba, de Maliki-Sua. 3Jara yam ma tiini ya peene Sɔɔl dedɛ. O dona bam ma na‑o ye ba ta ba chena ba tɔ‑o pa ko ke‑o zonne. 4Sɔɔl ma ta de nɔn-doŋo wolo na zei o jara zela yam to o we, “Le n se-zɔɔ kom n ma n zɔ-ne n go. Amo ba lage se Filisi nɔn-yɔɔro tento yi amo yera ba zɔ-ne se ba mɔne-ne ba ke-ne chaveera.”
Nɔn-doŋo kom maa wo sɛ se o go‑o, foone na tiini de jege‑o to ŋwaane. Konto baŋa ne, Sɔɔl ma vaŋe o tete se-zɔɔ kom o le. O ma kwei-ko o moore o puga ne, ye o daare o to ko baŋa ne o te. 5Nɔn-doŋo kom na maane we Sɔɔl tege to, o de ma le o se-zɔɔ kom ye o to ko baŋa ne o te. 6Ko déem ke konto mo ye Sɔɔl de o bia batɔ bam, de o dwi tiina bam maama tɔge daane ba te.
7Isarele tiina balo déem na zoore Jezerele bwolo kom ne to ma lɔre we Sɔɔl de o bia bam tege mo, ye Isarele jar-keira bam maama duri ba jage. Ba na nigi konto to mo ba duri ba lage jei ba daare ba teene dem. Filisi tiina bam ma vo ba zoore de wone. 8Tega na poore to, Filisi tiina bam ma jwoori jara kapworo kom ne se ba zane ba le jejegero twa bam yera ne. Ba ma na we Sɔɔl de o bia bam tege mo ba tigi Giliboa peo kom yuu ne. 9Ba na nɛ to, ba ma gwoni Sɔɔl yuu ba le, ye ba lɔɔre o jara zela yam na wo o yera ne to. Ba laam ma toŋe kwora se ka yi Filisi tiina teene dem maama we, ba di Sɔɔl. Ba ma tɔɔle se ba dwi tiina maama ni taane dem konto, ye ba daare ba jege-de ba bore ba jwona yiga ne. 10Ko ná ye Sɔɔl jara zela yam, ba kwei-ya ba ja zo ba tiŋi ba jwona diga kam ne mo. Ba ma daare ba kwei o yuu kom ba vo ba pale ba jwoni Dagon diga kam ne.
11Nɔɔna balo maama déem na zoore Jabese Gilead ne to ma ni Filisi tiina bam na ke Sɔɔl tei maama to. 12Balo na tiini ba ye bembɛ ba wone to ma zaŋe ba vo ba pare Sɔɔl de o bia bam yera yam. Ba ma ja-ya ba jwoori Jabese, ye ba daare ba kwei ba kwi sem ba suli tio-kamunu kodwoŋi kuri ne, Jabese teo wone. Ba ta ma di ba lwi ye ba vɔ ba nia da yarepɛ.
13Sɔɔl déem tega o na nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne to ŋwaane mo. O wo sɛ se o toŋe o tɔge Baŋa Wɛ nia yam. O déem vei kaane wolo na wae o bwei chira to se o wane o nii o yiga. 14O nam wo sɛ se o bwei Baŋa Wɛ se o bere‑o chwoŋa. Mo kokuri Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se Sɔɔl te. O ma daare o jwoŋi Isarele teo paare dem o jeŋa ne o kwei o pa Jesse bu David.

english_text:
David Becomes King of Israel
(2 Samuel 5.1-3)
1Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives, 2and we know that you have led our army into battle, even when Saul was still our king. The Lord God has promised that you would rule our country and take care of us like a shepherd. 3So we have come to crown you king of Israel.”
David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said.
David Captures Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 5.6-10)
4 Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town. 5The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
6David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
7Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David. 8He had the city rebuilt, starting at the landfill on the east side. Meanwhile, Joab supervised the repairs to the rest of the city.
9David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side.
The Three Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.8-17)
10The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
11The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed 300 men with his spear.
12Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. 13During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away, 14except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
15One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley 16and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress, 17and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
18The Three Warriors sneaked through the Philistine camp and got some water from the well near Bethlehem's gate. They took it back to David, but he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured out the water as a sacrifice to the Lord 19and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.”
The Three Warriors did these brave deeds.
The Thirty Warriors
(2 Samuel 23.18-39)
20Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed 300 men with his spear. He was just as famous as the Three Warriors 21and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
22Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion. 23Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it. 24Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors, 25even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
26-47Here is a list of the other famous warriors:
Asahel the brother of Joab; Elhanan the son of Dodo from Bethlehem; Shammoth from Haror; Helez from Pelon; Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa; Abiezer from Anathoth; Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai the Ahohite; Maharai from Netophah; Heled the son of Baanah from Netophah; Ithai the son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin; Benaiah from Pirathon; Hurai from near the streams on Mount Gaash; Abiel from Arbah; Azmaveth from Baharum; Eliahba from Shaalbon; Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan the son of Shagee from Harar; Ahiam the son of Sachar the Hararite; Eliphal the son of Ur; Hepher from Mecherah; Ahijah from Pelon; Hezro from Carmel; Naarai the son of Ezbai; Joel the brother of Nathan; Mibhar the son of Hagri; Zelek from Ammon; Naharai from Beeroth who carried Joab's weapons; Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite; Uriah the Hittite; Zabad the son of Ahlai; Adina the son of Shiza, a leader in the Reuben tribe, and 30 of his soldiers; Hanan the son of Maacah; Joshaphat from Mithan; Uzzia from Ashterah; Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham from Aroer; Jediael and Joha the sons of Shimri from Tiz; Eliel from Mahavah; Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam; Ithmah from Moab; Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel from Mezobah.
translation_text:
1Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom maama déem vei Heboron mo. Ba ma ta de David ba we, “Nii mo. Debam maama dedaane nmo ye yera dedoa de jana dedoa mo. 2Faŋa ye Sɔɔl ta ye debam maama pɛ to, nmo mo ye wolo na tɔge dé yiga pa se dé vei dé ke jara de dé dona to. Nmo Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam ya maŋe o ta de nmo o we, ‘Nmo mo wó ji a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam yuu tu ye n nii ba baŋa ne ne nayero tei.’ ”
3Konto to, Isarele nakwa bam maama déem jeeri Pɛ David tei ne Heboron ne mo. Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne mo David ke ni-sɛɛm de-ba. Ba laam ma lwo nuga o yuu ne se o taa ye Isarele tiina bam maama pɛ, ne Baŋa Wɛ ya na tage de Samuwel we ko wó ke tei to.
David wane o jwoŋi Jerusalem
2 Samuwel 5:6-10
4Jebusi tiina déem mo zoore Jerusalem teo kom ne. Teo kom yere dedwoŋi déem ye Jebusi mo. David dedaane Isarele tiina jar-keira bam maama ma zaŋe ba vo Jerusalem se ba li teo kom. 5Jebusi tiina bam ma ta de David ba we, “Abam bá na chwoŋa á zo ywo-seeni.” De konto de, David wane Zion o di. Zion déem ye teo kom dam jeiga mo. Nɔɔna laam maa jege jei sem konto ba bwoi we, ‘David teo’.
6David ya tage o we, “Wolo ná tɔge jar-keira bam yiga o kwaare jara de Jebusi tiina bam, kotu wó ji ba yiga tu.” Zeruya bu Joaba mo ye wolo na bobo o ja jara yam to. Mo kokuri wonto seene o ji jar-keira bam yiga tu.
7David na di teo kom dam jeiga kam to, mo o lɛɛre o maŋe da o zoore ko wone. Konto ŋwaane mo ba bwoŋi ko yere we, ‘David teo’. 8O ma zege mɛ tega kam na suuri ka maŋe daane to o jwoori o lɔ teo kom o zege o kaage jeiga kam. Teo kom jei selo ta na daare to mo Joaba fɔge o lɔ. 9David dam dem déem ma fɔge de puli de ke da, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na wo o tei ne to ŋwaane.
Bembɛ selo na woli Pɛ David to
2 Samuwel 23:8-39
10Nɔɔna banto déem mo ye Pɛ David bembɛ sem yiga tiina. Ba ma tɔge de Isarele tiina bam maama ba zege David kwaga ne, pa se o laam ba o di paare tega kam maama baŋa ne, ne Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o pwooli we, ko wó ke tei to.
11Bembɛ sem yera mo tento:
Hakimoni tu Jasobema déem mo ye ‘Bembɛ setɔ sem’ yiga tu wom. O déem jeeri nɔɔna bia yatɔ (300) mo de jara. O ma kwei o chichwei o ma go ba maama jara-keim bedwe baŋa ne.
12Wolo na saŋe wonto kwaga bembɛ setɔ sem wone to déem ye Ahohi tu Dodo bu Eleaza mo.
13Dɛ dedwe Filisi tiina bam na gilimi Pasa-Damim ne jara ŋwaane to, Eleaza wo David tei ne mo. Jei sem konto ne nɔɔna dugi chaara mo ba kara ne. Dáane mo Isarele jar-keira bam tutwoni ba duri se ba lu Filisi tiina bam jeŋa ne. 14David de Eleaza ma zege kara kam tetare ne ba kwaane ba ke jara yam ka ŋwaane. Ba ma go Filisi tiina bam dedɛ. Baŋa Wɛ déem ma pa se Isarele tiina bam di wɔnɔ dedɛ.
15Dɛ dedwe mo bembɛ fintɔ sem wone setɔ déem vei David tei, o na seigi Adulam peo bɔɔne wone to. Filisi tiina jar-keira kɔgɔ kodwoŋi ya tu ba tigisi Refayim bwolo kom ne. 16Ba kɔgɔ kodwoŋi de ya jwoŋi Bɛtelehem teo kom mo ba wora. Konto maama dedaane David ya wo o peo kom dalem jei sem ne mo. 17David boboŋa ma tiini ya ja o tete teo kom ye o ta o we, “Wɔ mo wó zaŋe o vo Bɛtelehem se o mɔ na vole delo na tigi teo kom manchwoŋo ni ne to wone o ja o ba o pa-ne se a nyɔ?” 18Bembɛ setɔ sem konto ma lɔɔre ba tɔge Filisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone ba vo ba yi vole dem ba mɔ na bam, ye ba jwoori ba ja-ba ba ba ba pa David. Ba na jwoori to, o ma ve se o nyɔ na bam konto. O ma lwo-ba o yage tega ne se ba taa ye pɛɛre ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. 19O ma ta o we, “Amo Tu Wɛ, amo bá wane a nyɔ na banto! A ná nyɔge-ba, ko nye de a nyɔge nɔɔna banto jana mo, ba na sɛ se ba ga ba ŋwea se ba ma mɔ na banto to ŋwaane.” O ma ve se o nyɔ-ba.
Bembɛ setɔ sento déem na toŋe tei to mo konto.
20Joaba nyaane Abisayi de déem mo ye ‘Bembɛ fintɔ kom’ yiga tu. O ma kwei o chichwei o jeeri nɔɔna bia yatɔ (300) jara wone o go. Konto ŋwaane o ma na yere bembɛ setɔ sem yiga ne. 21Wonto déem mo tiini o na yere o dwoni bembɛ fintɔ kom maama, ye o ji ba yiga tu. O nam wo woli bembɛ setɔ sem wone.
22Jehoyada bu Benaya de déem ye jar-keiru mo na ye bembea. O nwoŋi Kabezele mo, ye o toŋe baare dedɛ.
Benaya déem go Moaba bembɛ selei. O ta ma tu gwoŋo wone o go nywoŋo dɛ dedwe waaro na tiini te wora maŋa kalo to. 23Benaya ta go Ejipti nɔn-wagele dedwoŋi mo. Nɔɔno wom dedɔrem déem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu, ye o zei chichwei na maŋe de beiŋa to mo. Ko daare ye Benaya jege da-lɔŋɔ. O ma vo o vere chichwei dem Ejipti tu wom jeŋa ne, o jwoori o ma-de o zɔ‑o o go. 24Jehoyada bu Benaya déem na toŋe tei to mo konto. O de ma na yere bembɛ setɔ sem yiga ne. 25O ma tiini o na yere bembɛ fintɔ kom wone, ye o wo tɔge o woli bembɛ setɔ sem wone. David ma pa se Benaya ji balo na yere‑o to yiga tu.
26Bembɛ sem sedaara yera mo tento:
Joaba nyaane Asaheli.
Bɛtelehem tu Dodo bu Elihanan.
27Harodi tu Samofa.
Peloni tu Heleza.
28Tekoa tu Ikesa bu Yira.
Anatofe tu Abizeri.
29Husaa tu Sibekayi.
Ahohi tu Yilayi.
30Netofa tu Maharayi.
Netofa tu Baana bu Heledi.
31Ribayi bu Ifayi, na nwoŋi Gibea teo Benjamin laŋa kam ne to.
Pirafon tu Benaya.
32Hurayi na nwoŋi Gaasa bu-nwaro tem seeni to.
Arabafa tu Abiyeli.
33Baharum tu Azimavefa.
Saalebon tu Eliaba.
34Gizon tu Hasem bia.
Harara tu Sagea bu Jonatan.
35Harara tu Sachare bu Ahiyam.
Yuri bu Elifala.
36Mekerafa tu Hefera.
Peloni tu Ahija.
37Kamele tu Hezero.
Ezibayi bu Naarayi.
38Natan nyaane Joweli.
Hagiri bu Mibaha.
39Amon tu Zeleki.
Beerofa tu Naharayi.
Wonto déem zei Zeruya bu Joaba jara zela yam mo.
40Ifiri tu Yira.
Ifiri tu Gareba.
41Hiti tu Yuria.
Ahalayi bu Zabadi.
42Ruben dwi tu Siza bu Adina.
Wonto déem ye Ruben dwi tiina yiga tu, ye o jege kwaga nɔɔna fintɔ.
43Maaka bu Hanan.
Mitini tu Josafate.
44Aseterafa tu Yuzia.
Arowa tu Hotam bia balei, Sama dedaane Jeyeli.
45Tizi tu Jedayeli bu Simiri, de o nyaane Joha.
46Mahavi tu Eleli.
Elinaam bia balei, Jeribayi dedaane Josavia.
Moaba tu Itama.
47Eleli, de Obeda, de Mezoba tu Jaaseli.

english_text:
David's Men at Ziklag
1Some time earlier, David had gone to live in the town of Ziklag to escape from King Saul. While David was there, several brave warriors joined him to help fight his battles.
Warriors from the Benjamin tribe
2Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand. 3-7Their leaders were Ahiezer and Joash, the sons of Shemaah from Gibeah. Here is a list of those men from Benjamin: Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah and Jehu from Anathoth; Ishmaiah from Gibeon, who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad from Gederah; Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah from Haruph; Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam from the Korah clan; Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
Warriors from the Gad tribe
8Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears. 9-13There were eleven of them, ranked in the following order: Ezer the leader, then Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, and Machbannai.
14All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops. 15Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river.
Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
16One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying. 17David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
18Amasai, who later became the leader of the Thirty Warriors, was one of these men who went to David. God's Spirit took control of him, and he said, “We will join you, David son of Jesse! You and your followers will always be successful, because God fights on your side.”
So David agreed to let them stay, and he even put them in charge of his soldiers who raided enemy villages.
Warriors from the Manasseh tribe
19Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag. 20That's when the following men from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. They had all been commanders in Saul's army 21and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
22Day after day, new men came to join David, and soon he had a large, powerful army.
David's Men at Hebron
23-37The kingdom of Israel had been taken away from Saul, and it now belonged to David. He was ruling from Hebron, and thousands of well-trained soldiers from each tribe went there to crown David king of all Israel, just as the Lord had promised. These soldiers, who were always prepared for battle, included: 6,800 from Judah, who were armed with shields and spears; 7,100 from Simeon; 4,600 from Levi, including Jehoiada, who was a leader from Aaron's descendants, and his 3,700 men, as well as Zadok, who was a brave soldier, and 22 of his relatives, who were also officers; 3,000 from Benjamin, because this was Saul's own tribe and most of the men had remained loyal to him; 20,800 from Ephraim, who were not only brave, but also famous in their clans; 18,000 from West Manasseh, who had been chosen to help make David king; 200 leaders from Issachar, along with troops under their command—these leaders knew the right time to do what needed to be done; 50,000 from Zebulun, who were not only loyal, but also trained to use any weapon; 1,000 officers from Naphtali and 37,000 soldiers armed with shields and spears; 28,600 from Dan; 40,000 from Asher; and 120,000 from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, who were armed with all kinds of weapons.
38All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing. 39The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them. 40Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil.
Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_text:
David kwaga nɔɔna na wo Zikalag ne to
1David déem vei o zoore Zikalag ne, Kisi bu Sɔɔl na zeili‑o o tei ne to ŋwaane. O na zoore da konto to, mo babɛ sedwonna na yei jara keim chekke to tu ba woli‑o se o ke jara yam. 2Babɛ sem déem jege tɛ mo. Ba maa yei chena tam de napana dolem chekke jazem de jagwia maama. Ba maa ye Benjamin dwi tu Sɔɔl chorro mo. 3Ba yiga tu wom mo ye Ahiyezera. O nyaane Joasa de maa wo o kwaga ne. Banto balei kwo maa ye Gibea tu Semaa. Ba nɔɔna bam mo ye:
Azimavefa bia Jezeli, de Peleti, ko woli de Beraka, de Anatofe tu Jehu, 4de Gibeon tu Isamaya.
Wonto déem ye bembea mo jar-keira fintɔ bam wone ye o ta ye ba yiga tu. Ba nɔɔna badwonna maa ye:
Jeremia, de Jahazeli, de Johanan, de Gedera tu Jozabadi, 5de Eluzayi, de Jerimofa, de Bealia, de Semaria de Harufi tu Sefatia, 6dedaane Kora tiina Elikana, de Issiya, de Azareli, de Jozere, de Jasobema, 7ko woli de Gedora tu Jeroham bia balei, Jowela de Zebadia.
8Babɛ sedwonna de déem nwoŋi Gad dwi dem wone ba da ba woli David kɔgɔ kom wone. Ba ma vo o tei kagoa yuu ne. Ba de déem ye bembɛ selo na yei jara keim chekke to mo. Ba maa jege jara nantane de chichwoa. Ba maa jege foone ne nywoŋo tei, ye ba tiini ba wara ne feira na duri tei peero yuu ne to. 9Ba yiga tu wom mo ye Ezere. O kwaga nɔɔna maa ye:
Obadia, de Eliabi, 10de Misimana, de Jeremia, 11de Atayi, de Eleli, 12de Johanan, de Elizabad, 13de Jeremia, de Makabanayi.
14Babɛ sento na ye Gad tiina to déem ye jar-keira yiga tiina mo. Ba dedoa wó wane nɔɔna bi o zeili jara wone. Ba wone wolo dam na daga to wae nɔɔna moro o zeila. 15Babɛ sem konto déem mo bɛ Jɔdan buga kam maŋa kalo ka ni na pɛɛle bene dem boboa chana kam ne to. Ba ma vo ba zeili nɔɔna balo maama na zoore bubɛ dem bwollu tem wɛ-puli de wɛ-zoore seeni to pa se ba duri ba viiri.
16Baara badwonna na ye Benjamin dwi tiina de Judah dwi tiina to déem vei David tei o dam jei sem ne. 17David ma zaŋe o jeeri-ba ye o ta de-ba o we, “Á veiŋa kam ná ye zaane veiŋa mo á beene se á woli-ne, amo de nam sɛ se dé maama woli daane. Á nam ná tu se á yeigi-ne mo á pa a dona bam, se debam nabaara Wɛ wom taa yei ko ni ne se o daare o waare abam. Kokuri to a wo ke kolokolo a chɔge.”
18Wɛ Jworo ma ba Amasayi wolo na ye ba jar-keira fintɔ kom yiga tu to baŋa ne, ye o ta o we,
“David! Debam ye nmo nɔɔna mo,
Jesse bu! Dé wo n kwaga ne.
Yazura taa wo n tei ne,
se ko kɛ ko yi balo de
na woli‑m to.
Nmo Tu Wɛ wom wó zeini‑m.”
David ma sɛ o jwoŋi-ba ye o daare o pa se ba ji o jar-keira bam yiga tiina.
19Baara badwonna de déem nwoŋi Manasɛ dwi dem wone ba da ba woli David kɔgɔ kom wone maŋa kalo o na tɔge de Filisi tiina bam se ba kwaare jara de Sɔɔl to. Ko nam na ke tei to, David de o nɔɔna bam wo woli Filisi tiina bam, foone na jaane ba yiga tiina bam to ŋwaane. Ba déem boŋe we David wó wane o lɔ ba kwaga ne o jwoori Pɛ Sɔɔl tei o daare-ba pa se ba ga ba ŋwea mo. Mo kokuri ba jeini tega ne ba bwɛ daane ye ba pa David pwɛ o tete de-ba. 20Maŋa kalo David na maa jwoori Zikalag to, Manasɛ nɔɔna balo na dɛ ba tɔge ded‑o to mo ye:
Adina, de Jozabadi, de Jedayeli, de Mikayeli, de Jozabadi, de Elihu, de Ziletayi.
Nɔɔna bam konto dedoa dedoa tei Manasɛ dwi jar-keira moro mo. 21Ba déem yeini ba woli David pa se o wane venverena balo na ke jara de-ba to, bɛŋwaane ba déem ye babɛ mo chekke ye ba kwori ba ye o jar-keira bam yiga tiina. 22Dɛ maama wone nɔɔna déem yeini ba tui ba woli David kɔgɔ kom wone. Konto déem ma pa se o na jar-keira kɔgɔ dedɛ, nenɛɛne Wɛ tete jar-keira to.
David kwaga nɔɔna na wo Heboron ne to
23David déem na wo Heboron ne to, baara balo na yei jara keim to mo tu ba woli o jar-keira kɔgɔ kom wone, se ba pa o leiri Sɔɔl yuu ne o di paare dem, ne Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o pwooli tei to. Nɔɔna bam ni mo tento:
24Judah dwi dem wone:
Baara morro teredo de bia nana (6,800). Banto déem zei nantane de chichwoa mo de jara zela dedɛ.
25Simeon dwi dem wone:
Jar-keira morro terepɛ de bi (7,100). Banto ye babɛ chekke.
26Levi dwi dem wone:
Baara morro tena de bia yaredo (4, 600). 27Aron dwi tu Jehoyada de woli da, de o nɔɔna morro tetɔ de bia yarepɛ (3, 700). 28Zadoki de maa wora. O déem ye nɔn-doŋo kolo na ye bembea to mo, ye dedɛɛra finlei-balei (22) wo o tei ne, ba na ye o chorro to.
29Benjamin dwi dem wone:
Baara morro tetɔ (3,000). Sɔɔl tete dwi dem mo konto. Ba dedɛ déem sɛ ba zege Sɔɔl de o diga kam kwaga ne ye ba wo yage.
30Efrayim dwi dem wone:
Baara morro finlei de bia nana (20, 800). Banto déem tiini ba jege yere mo ba sɔ-yuni tem wone.
31Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom wone:
Baara morro fuga-nana (18,000). Ba chorro tem déem kuri-ba dedoa dedoa se ba yɔɔre ba ba ba woli David se o ji pɛ.
32Isakara dwi dem wone:
Dedɛɛra bia yalei (200), de ba chorro telo maama na wo ba kwaga nɔɔna to. Dedɛɛra bam konto yei kolo na jege ko ke kanto maŋa kam ne to pa se ba lɔre chwoŋa kalo Isarele tiina na jege se ba tɔge to.
33Zebulun dwi dem wone:
Jar-keira morro finnu (50,000). Ba déem yei jara keim chekke mo. Ba maa jege jara zela dwi dwi se ba ma woli David jara wone. Ba déem yɔɔre ba ke ba chega ded‑o.
34Nafitali dwi dem wone:
Jar-keira yiga tiina moro (1,000), ko woli de ba jar-keira morro fintɔ-terepɛ (37,000) na zeeri jara nantane de chichwoa to.
35Dan dwi dem wone:
Jar-keira morro finlei-nana de bia yaredo (28, 600).
36Asere dwi dem wone:
Jar-keira morro finna (40, 000). Banto yei jara keim chekke.
37Isarele dwia yalo déem na zoore Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni to. Ruben dwi dem, de Gad dwi dem, ko woli de Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom mo konto:
Jar-keira morro bi de finlei (120, 000). Ba de déem jege jara zela dwi dwi.
38Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye jar-keira balo na ti ba yiga se ba kwaare jara yam to mo. Ba na tu David tei Heboron ne to, ba boboŋa ya jaane se ba pa o di paare Isarele teo kom maama baŋa ne mo. Ko nam dae banto yerane. Isarele na tigi pip to, nɔɔna maama jaane boboŋe dedwe mo se ba pa David ji ba pɛ. 39Nɔɔna banto maama déem maŋe David tei ne mo da yatɔ ba di wodi-fɔrɔ kuri. Kokuri to, ba chorro tem déem pɛ-ba ba na lage kolo to maama mo. 40Ba nu-bia badwonna na wo Isakara, de Zebulun, de Nafitali dwia yam maama laŋa ne to de ma la wodiiru dedɛ ba toŋe ba pa-ba se ba taa di. Ba déem mɛ bonɛ, de kona, de bona-sisei, de nabɛ ba zeŋe wodiiru tem ba ba ba pa-ba. Wodiiru tem maa ye muni, de kapere-kora, de kekan-wogila, de sana, de nuga, ko ta woli de na-bale, de pei. Kokuri Isarele teo kom maama ne mo ba déem di ywoni lanyerane.

english_text:
David Moves the Sacred Chest to Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 6.1-12a)
1Some time later, David talked with his army commanders, 2-3and then announced to the people of Israel:
While Saul was king, the sacred chest was ignored. But now it's time to bring the chest to Jerusalem. We will invite everyone in Israel to come here, including the priests and the Levites in the towns surrounded by pastureland. But we will do these things only if you agree, and if the Lord our God wants us to.
4The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
5David gathered everyone from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo-Hamath in the north. 6 Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
7The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart, 8while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
9But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling. 10The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
11David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
12David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?” 13So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
14 The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_text:
Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam
2 Samuwel 6:1-11
1David déem mo nɛ de o jar-keira dedɛɛra balo na tei nɔɔna moro moro to, de balo na tei nɔɔna bi bi to, de o jar-keira bam yiga tiina maama. 2O ma daare o ta de Isarele tiina nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama we, “Abam ná wó sɛ, ye ko ná tɔge debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa de, pa-na se dé toŋe kwora dé pa dé chorro telo na wo Isarele laŋa kam jei maama ne to se ba maama ba ywo se dé jeeri daane. Dé ta wó toŋe kwora kam konto dé pa Wɛ kaanem tiina de Levi dwi tiina maama na wo teene delo pwoli na gilimi-de to wone. 3Pa-na dé kwaane dé kwei dé Tu Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam dé ja dé jwoori dé tei ne. Kokuri to, maŋa kalo Sɔɔl na jege paare dem o di to, dé wo bwei se dé lɔre Wɛ boboŋa.” 4David na tage konto to, nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama ma sɛ o taane dem, ko na tɔge chwoŋa ba maama yiga ne to ŋwaane.
5David ma la Isarele tiina bam maama ko zege Ejipti siseini dem ne se ko vo ko yi Lebo-Hamafa o ke daane, se ba da ba vo Kiriaf-Jeerim ba kwei Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba ja ba jwoori. 6O ma da ba yiga se ba maama vo Judah teo Baala kolo yere dedwoŋi na ye Kiriaf-Jeerim to. Ba déem vei se ba ja Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam mo ba jwoori Jerusalem. Dakaa kam konto wora Baŋa Wɛ yere ŋwaane mo. Wonto di paare cherubi sem tetare laŋa ne, se na zege dakaa kam baŋa ne to.
7Dakaa kam nam ya wo Abinadaba sɔŋɔ ne mo. Ba ma vo ba kwei-ka ba daŋe nabɛ toroko-doŋo baŋa ne. Abinadaba bia balei Yuza de Ahio maa tɔge toroko kom ye ba yere-ko. 8David de Isarele tiina bam maama ma leeni lei ba seini Wɛ de ba dam maama. Ba ta maa jege kwanno, de zwe, de gungwei, de nabwanno, dedaane kwɛɛra zela dwi dwi ba kwɛɛre, ye ba daare ba sae ba tɔge kwaga.
9Ba ma vo ba yi Chidon na yeini o fere o mena mɛ to. Nabɛ sem ma gare se tete se lage se to. Yuza ma zi Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam se o pa ka fɔge ka zege. 10Baŋa Wɛ bane ma tiini de zaŋe Yuza baŋa ne, o na twe o jeŋa o dwei dakaa kam to ŋwaane. Nɛ sem konto ni ne, Wɛ ma mage Yuza o go. 11David wo ma fuli dedɛ de Baŋa Wɛ na tɔge o ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa o go Yuza to. Konto ma pa o bwoŋi jei sem konto yere we, ‘Pɛrezi Yuza.’ Mo jei sem yere de zem maama. 12Keim dem konto ma pa se David kɔre Wɛ. O ma bwɛ o we, “Amo wó ke tɛ mo a ja Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam a ba a tei?” 13O daa maa wo jaane-ka o ja o vo o zo o tete teo Jerusalem wone. O ma lɛɛre o pa se ba ywori ba ja-ka ba vo Gafa tu Obed-Edom sɔŋɔ. 14Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ma maŋe Obed-Edom sɔŋɔ ne chane setɔ mo. Ka na wora to, Baŋa Wɛ ma swɛ wonto de o sɔŋɔ tiina, de o wonnu maama swolim.

english_text:
David's Palace in Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 5.11-16)
1King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace. 2David now knew that the Lord had made him a powerful king of Israel for the good of his people.
3After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters. 4-7His children born there were Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
David Defeats the Philistines
(2 Samuel 5.17-25)
8When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle. 9The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
10David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?”
The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
11David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.” 12Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
13Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley. 14David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are. 15Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
16David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
17From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_text:
David dwi dem taane
1Tura teo Pɛ Hiram déem ma toŋe nɔɔna David tei ne se ba ke pipiu daane. O ma pa se ba ja Sedare da-kwollu ba vo ba pa‑o. O ta ma pa se kandwa-cherena, de gwaro tɔge ba vo, se ba wane ba lɔ pɛ sɔŋɔ ba pa David. 2David ma lɔre we Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o pa se o di Isarele teo paare, ye o ta daare o pa se o paare dem fɔge de puli lanyerane, Wɛ tete nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam ŋwaane.
3David na zoore Jerusalem ne to, mo o daa ta di kaana badwonna o woli da. Ba ma lo bia, bakeiri de busankane, ba pa‑o. 4Bia balo David na loge Jerusalem ne to yera mo tento:
Sammua, de Sobabi, de Natan, de Solomon, 5de Ibihara, de Elisua, de Elipelete, 6de Noga, de Nefega, de Jafia, 7de Elisama, de Beliada, dedaane Elifeleti.
David wane Filisi tiina bam.
8Filisi tiina bam déem ma ni we ba tiŋi David se o taa ye Isarele tiina maama pɛ. Ba ma la ba jar-keira bam maama ba ke daane ba vo ba beeri o jeiga se ba ja. David ma lɔre ko ni ne ye o nwoŋi teo kom ne o vo se o jeeri-ba. 9Filisi tiina bam ma ba ba yi Refayim bwolo kom. Ba ma ke chichuŋu de nɔɔna balo na zoore da to. 10David ma bwei Wɛ o we, “A véi a jeeri Filisi tiina bam de jara, se nmo wó ke-ba a jeŋa ne na?” Baŋa Wɛ ma leiri‑o o we, “Ɛɛ, zaŋe n vo n jeeri-ba, se amo wó ke-ba n jeŋa ne.”
11David ma vo o yi Baal Perazim. O ma wane Filisi tiina bam o di. O laam ma ta o we, “Wɛ tɔge amo dam baŋa ne mo o mage o pore a dona bam baŋa ne o zeili-ba, nenɛɛne na na mage ba pore tei to.” Ba ma lɛɛre ba jege jei sem konto ba bwoi we ‘Baal Perazim’. 12Dáane mo Filisi tiina bam duri ba daare ba jwona yam ba yage. David ma pa o nɔɔna bam ni se ba kwei mini ba zwɛ jwona yam.
13Ko na ke da fenfee to, Filisi jar-keira bam daa ta ma jwoori Refayim bwolo kom ba ke chichuŋu de nɔɔna bam. 14David daa ma bwei Wɛ se o lɔre o na wó ke tei to. Wɛ ma ta o we, “Nmo ná jeeri-ba, se n yé yɔɔre ba yiga vekke. Nam kaare n tɔge Balesam teeni dem n kekare dáa kadwoŋi kam ne n yi-ba. 15Ta‑n nii teeni dem yuu ne. Nmo ná tu n ni ko dɔna de baŋa ne, se n laam nwoŋi n jeeri-ba. Ko bere we amo tete mo dɛ á yiga se a jeeri Filisi tiina jar-keira bam de jara a daare a di-ba.” 16David ma seene o ke kolo Wɛ na bere‑o se o ke to. Ko ma pa se ba wane Filisi jar-keira bam ba di. Ba ma zege Gibeon ne ba pare-ba ba vo ba yi Gezere.
17Konto maama baŋa ne mo David yere déem zaŋe de jage tega baŋa jei maama ne. Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se dwi-gɛ tiina maama tiini ba kɔre foone ded‑o.

english_text:
David Gets Ready To Bring the Sacred Chest to Jerusalem
1David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept. 2 He said, “Only Levites will be allowed to carry the chest, because the Lord has chosen them to do that work and to serve him forever.”
3Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it. 4He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were: 5Uriel, the leader of the Kohath clan, and 120 of his relatives; 6Asaiah, the leader of the Merari clan, and 220 of his relatives; 7Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and 130 of his relatives; 8Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and 200 of his relatives; 9Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and 80 of his relatives; and 10Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with 112 of his relatives.
11David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar. 12He said to them, “You are the leaders of the clans in the Levi tribe. You and your relatives must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean and acceptable to the Lord. Then you may carry the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord God of Israel and bring it to the place I have prepared for it. 13The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
14The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest 15 on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
16David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals. 17-21The men chosen to play the cymbals were Heman the son of Joel, his relative Asaph the son of Berechiah, and Ethan the son of Kushaiah from the Merari clan. Some of their assistants played the smaller harps: they were Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah. Others played the larger harps: they were Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Azaziah, and two of the temple guards, Obed-Edom and Jeiel.
22Chenaniah was chosen to be the music director, because he was a skilled musician.
23-24Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah.
Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer.
The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem
(2 Samuel 6.12-22)
25David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest. 26God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
27David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth. 28While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
29Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_text:
Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam
1David déem lɔge sam mo o tete teo Jerusalem ne se o taa zoore de wone. O ma daare o chwi vwei se o wane o kwei Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam o zege da. 2O déem ma ta o we, “Levi dwi tiina yerane mo jege chwoŋa se ba zeŋe Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam. Kokuri banto mo Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o kuri se ba taa zeŋe-ka, se ba daare ba taa toŋe ba pa‑o se ko taa vei wuu.”
3David ma la Isarele tiina bam maama o ke daane Jerusalem ne, se ba laam wane ba kwei Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba ba ba zege o na ke jei selo o pa-ka to. 4O ma bwoŋi Aron dwi dem de Levi dwi tiina bam o ke daane.
Banto déem mo ye:
5Levi bu Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Yureli de o chorro bi de finlei (120).
6Levi bu Merari sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Asaya de o chorro bia yalei de finlei (220).
7Levi bu Gereson sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Joweli de o chorro bi de fintɔ (130).
8Elizafan sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Semaya de o chorro bia yalei.
9Heboron sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Eleli de o chorro fu-nɔnɔ (80).
10Yuzeli sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Aminadabi de o chorro bi de fuga-balei (112).
11David déem bwoŋi Wɛ kaanem tiina Zadoki, de Abiatara. O ta ma bwoŋi Levi dwi tiina baredo bam, Yureli, de Asaya, de Joweli, de Semaya, de Eleli, de Aminadabi. 12O ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam ye Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo. Abam dedaane á dwonna Levi tiina bam jege se á kwɛ á tete Wɛ ŋwaane mo se á wane á zeŋe Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to ni-gwonim dakaa kam á ja á ba mɛ amo na kwɛ se ka taa wora to. 13Dé na kwaane se dé ke konto boboa ne to, abam Levi dwi tiina ya tera se á zeŋe-ka, ne Wɛ chullu tem na bere tei to. Mo kokuri dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ bane fuli dé baŋa ne, dé na wo bwei‑o se dé lɔre dé na wó ke tei to ŋwaane.”
14Wɛ kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam ma kwɛ ba tete Wɛ ŋwaane se ba wane ba zeŋe Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to ni-gwonim dakaa kam. 15Levi tiina bam kwei da-dedwaaro mo ba ma ba zeŋe Wɛ dakaa kam ba bakale baŋa ne, ne Baŋa Wɛ déem na tɔge Moses baŋa ne o pa-ba ni se ba ke tei to.
16David ma ta de Levi tiina nakwa bam se ba kuri ba tete chorro tem wone balo na wae ba leeni to se ba taa leeni wopwolo lei. Badaara maa wó taa tae kwanno dwi dwi, ye badaara de taa jege zwe ba maga. 17Levi tiina bam ma kuri Joweli bu Heman, de o choro Asaf wolo kwo na ye Berekia to. Ko maa ná ye Merari dwi dem wone, ba ma kuri Kusaya bu Etan. 18Ba déem ta kuri ba chorro telo na wó woli-ba to. Banto mo ye:
Zekaria, de Jaazeli, de Semiramofa, de Jeheli, de Yunni, de Eliabi, de Benaya, de Maaseya, de Matitia, de Elifelehu, de Mikineya, ko woli de Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena balei balo yera na ye Obed-Edom, de Jeyeli to.
19Heman, de Asaf, de Etan mo ba kuri se ba taa mage channa zwe. 20Ba déem ta kuri Zekaria, de Azeli, de Semiramofa, de Jeheli, de Yunni, de Eliabi, de Maaseya, de Benaya se ba taa tae kwan-baloa se te kwori taa ywomma. 21Matitia, de Elifelehu, de Mikineya, de Obed-Edom, de Jeyeli, de Azazia maa wó taa tae kwan-kamunnu se te kwori dé taa ywomma. 22Ba déem kuri Chenania mo se o taa ye lein-leena bam yiga tu, o na yɔɔre o ye gɔgɔ lei wone to ŋwaane.
23Ba ma kuri Berekia, de Elikana se banto taa yere Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam. 24Wɛ kaanem tiina Sebania, de Josafate, de Netaneli, de Amasayi, de Zekaria, de Benaya, de Eliazera maa ye se ba to Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam yiga ne ba taa wui nabwanno. Obed-Edom, de Jehia de déem maa ye se ba taa yere dakaa kam ba woli da.
25David déem tɔge de Isarele tiina nakwa bam, ko woli de jar-keira dedɛɛra balo na tei nɔɔna moro moro to se ba vo Obed-Edom sɔŋɔ kom ba kwei Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam mo ba ja ba ba Jerusalem. Ba na maa vei to, ba jege wopwolo dedɛ mo. 26Wɛ déem yɔɔre o zeini Levi tiina balo na zeŋe Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam to. Konto ŋwaane ba ma go nabɛ serepɛ de pi-bale serepɛ ba ma kaane ba zuli‑o.
27David, de Levi tiina balo maama na zeŋe dakaa kam to, ko woli de lein-leena bam, de Chenania wolo na nii ba totoŋa yam baŋa ne to déem vɔge gare-fefale ba yera ne mo. David tete ma zo gare-wogo kolo ba na mɛ gare-fefale ba sɔ to o daŋe da. 28Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom maama ma tɔge ba la ba pu o kwaga, pa se ba ja Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba vo Jerusalem. Ba na maa vei to, ba tiini ba bage wopwolo sɔɔ mo ye ba wui nabwanno, de namunnu. Ba maa mage zwe, ye ba daare ba tae kwanno dwi dwi de. 29Ba na yɔɔre ba jege Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba zoore Jerusalem teo wone tei to, mo Sɔɔl bukɔ Mikaale tɔge o takworo seeni o nii o na kɔgɔ kom. O maa na nɛ Pɛ David na tiini o sae de wopwolo tei to, o ma gwooni‑o o bochare ne.

english_text:
1They put the sacred chest inside the tent that David had set up for it, then they offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. 2After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord 3and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
4David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel. 5Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals, 6and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest.
David's Song of Praise
(Psalms 105.1-15; 96.1-13; 106.1,47,48)
7That same day, David instructed Asaph and his relatives for the first time to sing these praises to the Lord:
8Praise the Lord
and pray in his name!
Tell everyone
what he has done.
9Sing praises to the Lord!
Tell about his miracles.
10Celebrate and worship
his holy name
with all your heart.
11Trust the Lord
and his mighty power.
Worship him always.
12Remember his miracles
and all his wonders
and his fair decisions.
13You belong to the family
of Israel, his servant;
you are his chosen ones,
the descendants of Jacob.
14The Lord is our God,
bringing justice
everywhere on earth.
15We must never forget
his agreement and his promises,
not in thousands of years.
* 16 God made an eternal promise
17to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
18when he said, “I'll give you
the land of Canaan.”
19At the time there were
only a few of us,
and we were homeless.
20We wandered from nation
to nation, from one country
to another.
21 God did not let anyone
mistreat our people.
Instead he protected us
by punishing rulers
22and telling them,
“Don't touch my chosen leaders
or harm my prophets!”
23Everyone on this earth,
sing praises to the Lord.
Day after day announce,
“The Lord has saved us!”
24Tell every nation on earth,
“The Lord is wonderful
and does marvelous things!
25The Lord is great and deserves
our greatest praise!
He is the only God
worthy of our worship.
26Other nations worship idols,
but the Lord created
the heavens.
27Give honor and praise
