to the Lord,
whose power and beauty
fill his holy temple.”
28Tell everyone of every nation,
“Praise the glorious power
of the Lord.
29He is wonderful! Praise him
and bring an offering
into his temple.
Worship the Lord,
majestic and holy.
30Everyone on earth, now tremble!”
The world stands firm,
never to be shaken.
31Tell the heavens and the earth
to be glad and celebrate!
And announce to the nations,
“The Lord is King!”
32Command the ocean to roar
with all of its creatures
and the fields to rejoice
with all of their crops.
33Then every tree in the forest
will sing joyful songs
to the Lord.
He is coming to judge
all people on earth.
34 Praise the Lord
because he is good to us,
and his love never fails.
35Say to him, “Save us, Lord God!
Bring us back
from among the nations.
Let us celebrate and shout
in praise of your holy name.
36 Lord God of Israel,
you deserve to be praised
forever and ever.”
After David finished, the people shouted, “Amen! Praise the Lord!”
David Appoints Worship Leaders at Jerusalem and Gibeon
37David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept. 38Obed-Edom and 68 of his relatives were their assistants, and Hosah and Obed-Edom the son of Jeduthun were the guards.
39David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon. 40They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel. 41 Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love. 42Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
43 After that, everyone went home, and David went home to his family.
translation_text:
1David déem ya maŋe o chwi vwei Wɛ dakaa kam ŋwaane. Ba ma kwei dakaa kam ba zege vwei dem wone. Ba ma go vara ba ke kaanem ba zwɛ ba pa Wɛ, ye ba daare ba ja yazura pɛɛra ba ba se ba ma ba zuli‑o. 2David na ke kaanem dem o ti to, o laam ma kwei Baŋa Wɛ yere dem o ma o sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o pa nɔɔna bam. 3O ta ma pa se ba chɛ wodiiru tem ba pa Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom maama, baara de kaana. Nɔɔno maama ma jwoŋi bworobworo dedoa, de nɔn-wɔa, de kekan-wogila bɔŋa dedoa.
4David déem ma kuri Levi tiina badwonna se ba taa zuli Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to o dakaa kam yiga ne. Ba totoŋa maa ye se ba taa lwoori‑o, ye ba ke o lei, ye ba daare ba tei‑o. 5Banto wone Asaf déem mo ye ba yiga tu. Zekaria ma saŋe, ko woli de Jeyeli, de Semiramofa, de Jeheli, de Matitia, de Eliabi, de Benaya, de Obed-Edom, de Jeyeli wodwoŋi. Banto maa ye balo na tae kwanno dwi dwi to. Asaf mo tei zwe sem magem. 6Wɛ kaanem tiina Benaya de Jahazeli maa zege Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam yiga ne ba wui nabwanno tem maŋa de maŋa.
David lei keim leiŋa
Lei 105:1-15; 96:1-9; 106:47-48
7Dɛ dem konto ne mo David bobo o pa se Asaf de o dwonna bam leeni Wɛ seinim leiŋa kanto se ba ma ba ke Baŋa Wɛ lei:
8Ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei,
se á daare á tei o yere!
Pa-na se logo baŋa dwi tiina lɔre
o na toŋe kolo maama to.
9Leeni-na tia lei á pa‑o.
Ta-na kwanno á tei‑o!
Bere-na nɔɔna o totoŋ-kamuna na ye tei to.
10Ta‑á jege-na teera,
o yere dem na ye wose to ŋwaane.
Abam balo na kwaane
se á lɔre Baŋa Wɛ to,
di-na ywoni.
11Véi-na Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne
se o pa á jwoŋi dam.
Ta‑á fɔɔre-na á twɛ‑o
maŋa maama wone.
12Jwoori á guli-na o totoŋ-kamunnu tem,
dedaane o wo-kenkagela yam gula,
se á yé swei o bora borem dem
o na pɛ abam to swia.
13Chega to, á ye balo Wɛ na kuri
o pa o tete mo.
Á maa ye Wɛ tontoŋeno Isarele bia bam.
Jakob dwi dem mo konto.
14Wonto nam mo ye debam Tu
Baŋa Wɛ wom.
O maa tei logo baŋa maama
de chega.
15Guli-na o na gwoni o ni
de o nɔɔna bam tei to,
se á daa yé swei de swia.
O bá kwane o ni se ko taa vei wuu,
dwia moro na wó saŋe to.
16Wɛ déem gwoni o ni dem konto mo de Abaraham,
ye o daare o du duuri
o ma gwoni ni de Izaak.
17Jakob na tu o wora to,
Wɛ ma fɔge o ke ni-gwonim dem o pa‑o,
se o de o kwaga kam
taa tɔge-de taa wuu.
18Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we,
“Amo lage a pa nmo Kanaan tega kam mo,
se nmo de n dwi dem jwoŋi-ka á ta‑á tei.”
19Ba kɔgɔ kom déem ta ba daga.
Ba maa ye nɔɔna fenfee yerane,
ye ba kare Kanaan tega kam ne ba beera,
ne veira mo tei.
20Ba maa tole teene dem maama wone
de dwi tiina maama wone.
21De konto de, Wɛ déem wo pɛ pwola
se nɔɔna bɛɛse-ba.
Banto ŋwaane mo
o déem kaane pwa ye o we:
22“Yé dwei-na nɔɔna banto,
se amo mo kuri-ba a pa a tete.
Nam yé pa-na ko chɛ
amo sampwori sem yera.”
23Leeni-na á ma‑á tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Nabiina maama,
leeni-na á pa-o-na.
Dɛ maama wone se á tɔɔle-na
o taane we, o ye Verem Tu.
24Ta-na jaja se dwi maama tiina lɔre we,
o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom gaale.
Pa-na se nɔɔna maama ni
o totoŋ-kamuna yam ŋwa.
25Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ tiini o ye kamunu mo.
O ma seene o maŋe dedaane tia.
Nɔɔna jege se ba taa kɔre‑o
se ko dwoni wa yam maama.
26Wa yalo dwi-gɛ tiina na zuli to
ye jwona mo.
Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo naane wɛyuu maama.
27Kamunni dedaane paare mo
wo o tei ne.
Dam de ywoni de maa wo
o tete diga kam ne.
28Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama,
kwei-na zula á pa Baŋa Wɛ.
O na jege dam de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to ŋwaane,
kwei-na zula á pa‑o.
29O yere dem na maŋe de tia to ŋwaane,
kwei-na zula á pa‑o.
Ja-na pɛɛra á vo o yiga
á ma á zuli‑o.
Zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ
se ko tɔge de o na tiini
o jege lam tei to.
30Nabiina maama jege se
ba taa kɔre‑o ye ba yera sae mo.
O naane logo kom pa se ko zege mo ga cheppe.
Ko bá fɔge ko gɔ maŋa de maŋa.
31Pa se wɛyuu kom taa di ywoni!
Ta pa se tega kam baŋa
taa jege wopwolo!
Pa se dwi maama tiina taa tɛ we,
‘Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ!’
32Pa se naneo kom taa wuura,
konto de wonnu telo maama
na wo ko wone to.
Pa se kare sem de se wodiiru tem maama taa chaka!
33Teeni delo na wo goa ne to
laam wó leeni lei-ywei
de tei Baŋa Wɛ.
Kokuri to, o maa beene se o di
logo baŋa maama taane mo.
34Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei,
se o tiini o lamma.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
35Lwoori-na Wɛ á ta we,
“Nmo ye debam Vereno.
Jan ja, jwoŋi debam n yage!
Le debam dwi-gɛ tiina bam tetare ne n ke daane,
se n pa dé jwoori
dé tete teo kom.
Dé laam wó ke nmo lei,
n yere dem na ye wose to ŋwaane,
ye dé daare dé taa tei‑m
n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.”
36Pa-na dé taa tei Baŋa Wɛ wom
na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to!
Wonto maŋe de teem mo
ko zege faŋa faŋa
se ko taa vei wuu.
Nɔɔna bam maama laam ma ta ba we, “Ameena!” Ba ma daare ba tei Baŋa Wɛ.
Wɛ zula yam taane
37Pɛ David déem na kuri Asaf de o chorro tem se ba taa zuli Baŋa Wɛ o ni-gwonim dakaa kam yiga ne to, o ma pa se ba toŋe ba pa Wɛ dɛ maama wone, ne chullu tem na bere tei to. 38O ta ma pa se Jedutuna bu Obed-Edom de o chorro fuseredo-nana (68) de toŋe ba woli da. Obed-Edom dedaane Hosa déem yere Wɛ diga nia yam mo.
39Ko ta ná ye Zadoki de o dwonna kaanem tiina bam, David déem pɛ se ba toŋe ba pa Baŋa Wɛ o wara-vwei dem ne mo. Wara-jei selo na wo Gibeon ne to mo konto. 40Ba déem yeini ba jege se ba go vara ba zwɛ ba pa Baŋa Wɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne tetete de dedaan-ni maama mo, ne Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere se Isarele tiina taa ke tei to. 41Jedutuna de Heman déem mo woli ba wone, dedaane balo maama David na kuri dedoa dedoa to se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei, o swono kom na wora taa wuu to ŋwaane. 42Heman de Jedutuna déem nii lein-leena bam baŋa ne mo. Ba maa jege nabwanno, de zwe, de kwɛɛra zela dwi dwi se ba taa mae ba zuli Wɛ. Jedutuna dwi dem maa jege se ba taa yere Wɛ diga kam ni dem.
43Ba na ti konto maama to, nɔɔna maama ma jwoori ba sam. David de ma jwoori sɔŋɔ se o sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o pa o sɔŋɔ tiina bam.

english_text:
The Lord's Message to David
(2 Samuel 7.1-17)
1Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
2Nathan replied, “The Lord is with you—do what you want.”
3That night, the Lord told Nathan 4to go to David and tell him:
David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me. 5I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them. 6I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
7David, this is what I, the Lord All-Powerful, say to you. I brought you in from the fields where you took care of sheep, and I made you the leader of my people. 8Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
9I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did 10when I let judges rule my people, and I will keep your enemies from attacking you.
Now I promise that like you, your descendants will be kings. 11I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler, 12and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me. 13 I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you. 14I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
15Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said.
David Gives Thanks to the Lord
(2 Samuel 7.18-29)
16David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed:
Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us, 17and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person. 18I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me? 19It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.
20No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true. 21And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here. 22You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
23 Lord God, please do what you promised me and my descendants. 24Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.”
My kingdom will be strong, 25because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
26You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me. 27Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_text:
Wɛ na gwoni ni de David tei to
2 Samuwel 7:1-17
1Pɛ David déem laam maa zoore o sɔ-fɔrɔ kom ne. Dɛ dedwe o ma ta de Wɛ sampwora Natan o we, “Nii amo mo tento! A zoore sɔ-fɔrɔ kolo ba na kwei Sedare da-ŋonno ba ma lɔ-ko to, ko daare ye Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam laam zege vwei kuri ne.” 2Natan ma leiri o we, “Ke n boboŋa na jaane tei maama to, se Wɛ wo n tei ne.”
3Dɛ dem konto tete ne mo Wɛ ŋɔɔne dedaane Natan o we:
4“Véi n ta de amo tontoŋeno David we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Ko dae nmo mo wó lɔ sɔŋɔ n pa-ne se a taa zoore da. 5Ko nam na ye tei to, ko zege maŋa kalo a na jaane Isarele dwi dem a ba ywo-seeni to, se ko ba ko yi zem, amo ta wo fɔge a zo sɔŋɔ wone. Mɛ maama a ná jaane-ba a vo, a yeini a zoore vwei kuri ne mo. 6Jei selo maama amo dedaane Isarele dwi dem na beeri dé vo to, amo ta wo fɔge a ta de dedɛɛra balo a na kuri se ba taa nii a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam to we, “Bɛ mo ke ye á wo kwei Sedare da-ŋonno á ma á lɔ sɔŋɔ á pa-ne?” ’
7Konto to, ta ta de a tontoŋeno David we, ‘Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Amo na le nmo to, dedaane n déem ye nayero mo gaao ne n nii pei baŋa ne. A ma daare a pa se n di paare amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne. 8Mɛ maama nmo na yeini n vei to, a déem tɔge n kwaga konto mo, ye a pa se n dona dwi maama saare tega baŋa ne. Leile konto, amo wó pa n yere zaŋe, se n ta‑n tɔge n ye logo baŋa dedɛɛra bam wone dedoa. 9Amo laam nam kwei tega kalo a nɔɔna bam na wó taa zoore ka wone to mo a pa-ba. Ko lage ko taa ye ba tete kugu jei nɔɔn-nɔɔno na bá wane o daane-ba ko wone to mo. Nankɔ-nyena daa bá bɛɛse-ba nenɛɛne ko déem na ke tei, 10ko zege maŋa kalo a na pɛ se yiga tiina nii a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne to. Amo ta lage a wane abam dona bam maama mo a di.
Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam ta we, amo tete wó pa n dwi dem puli mo pa se n sɔŋɔ kom jeini de dam. 11Nmo ŋwea kam ná ba ka ti ye ba kwei‑m ba suli mɛ ba déem na suli nmo kwoa bam to, a ta wó pa n dwi dem wone nɔɔno dedoa zaŋe se o leiri nmo yuu ne o ji pɛ. A maa wó pa se o paare dem jeini de dam. 12Ko ye wonto mo wó lɔ sɔŋɔ o pa-ne. Amo ta wó pa se wonto dwi dem taa di paare dem taa wuu. 13Amo wó taa ye o kwo, se o de taa ye amo bu. Amo nam bá fɔge a dɔne a swono kom o baŋa ne, nenɛɛne a déem na ke tei dedaane Sɔɔl ye a le‑o paare dem wone se nmo laam ji pɛ to. 14Amo wó pa se n bu wom konto taa di paare amo nɔɔna baŋa ne taa wuu. Maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu o paare dem wó fɔge de ja dam.’ ”
15Natan ma ta kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ na le o bere‑o to dedaane David.
David ke Baŋa Wɛ lei
16David ma vo o zo Baŋa Wɛ wara-vwei dem o jeini da, ye o ware Wɛ o we:
“Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo ye wɔ mo, amo dwi dem de ye bɛ mo, ye n zeini amo tento se ko yi zem? 17De konto maama de, n ta boŋe se n ke-ne lanyerane n woli da! Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ta ma‑n tiŋi ni a dwi dem ŋwaane se ko vo ko yi jwa seeni. Nmo maŋe n gare n pa a ye nɔn-kamunu mo.
18Nmo na pɛ a jege yere tei to, amo nam daa jege bɛ mo se a ta? Amo ye n tontoŋeno mo ye n yei a maama n tia. 19Baŋa Wɛ, ko ye amo ŋwaane de n boboŋa yam ŋwaane mo n ke wo-kamunnu tento maama, ye n daare n pa amo lɔre-te.
20Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dwoŋi tera! Nmo yerane mo ye Wɛ. Dé yɔɔre dé yei konto mo chekke. 21Debam Isarele tiina bam mo ye dwi dedwe logo baŋa ne. Dwi dedwoŋi tera de na ma de Isarele tiina bam. Nmo déem jwoŋi-ba kabɛɛne wone mo pa se ba ji nmo tete nɔɔna, se n daare n pa n yere zaŋe wɛɛne. Nmo na vere-ba Ejipti tiina jeŋa ne to, n déem ke wo-kenkagela na jege foone to mo. Ko ta ná ye dwi tiina balo na kwaane se ba che-ba to, n zeili banto mo ba yiga ne. 22Nmo ma‑n kuri Isarele dwi tiina bam se ba taa ye nmo tete nɔɔna se ko taa vei wuu. Ko daare nmo Baŋa Wɛ de ma ji banto Wɛ wom.
23 Baŋa Wɛ, laam nam pa se n ni-gwonim dem, n na ke amo de a dwi dem ŋwaane to taa jege kuri se ko taa vei wuu. Seene n ke kolo nmo na tage to, 24se n yere dem taa ye kamunu taa wuu ye de daa bá jei. Nɔɔna laam wó taa tɛ ba we, ‘Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina bam Wɛ to mo nii Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne.’ Ko ta wó pa se amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to sɔŋɔ kom na dwi se ko taa vei wuu.
25Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo le wonnu tento maama n bere-ne we, n wó pa a dwi dem puli mo ye a sɔŋɔ kom jeini de dam. Konto ŋwaane mo pɛ se a na baare a lwoori‑m konto dwoŋi. 26Baŋa Wɛ, nmo seene n ye Wɛ mo chekke! Nmo pwooli wo-laaro tento na ye chekke to mo n pa amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to. 27Nmo nam lage n swɛ a kwaga kam swolim mo, se n ta‑n ke-ba zaane taa wuu. Baŋa Wɛ, nmo na swɛ ba swolim konto to, n swolim wó seene de taa tɔge a dwi dem mo se ko taa vei wuu.”

english_text:
A List of David's Victories in War
(2 Samuel 8.1-14)
1Later, David attacked and defeated the Philistines. He captured their town of Gath and the nearby villages.
2David also defeated the Moabites, and so they had to accept him as their ruler and pay taxes to him.
3While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him. 4David captured 1,000 chariots, 7,000 chariot drivers, and 20,000 soldiers. And he crippled all but 100 of the horses.
5When troops from the Syrian kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed 22,000 of them. 6Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him.
Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
7Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem. 8 He also took a lot of bronze from the cities of Tibhath and Cun, which had belonged to Hadadezer. Later, Solomon used this bronze to make the large bowl called the Sea, and to make the pillars and other furnishings for the temple.
9-10King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze. 11David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
12 Abishai the son of Zeruiah defeated the Edomite army in Salt Valley and killed 18,000 of their troops. 13Then he stationed troops in Edom, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler.
Everywhere David went, the Lord gave him victory in war.
A List of David's Officials
(2 Samuel 8.15-18)
14David ruled all Israel with fairness and justice.
15Joab the son of Zeruiah was the commander in chief of the army.
Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept the government records.
16Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests.
Shavsha was the secretary.
17Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was the commander of David's bodyguard.
David's sons were his highest-ranking officials.
translation_text:
David di wɔnɔ jara wone
2 Samuwel 8:1-18
1Konto kwaga ne, David déem ma vo o jeeri Filisi tiina bam de jara. O ma di-ba pa se ba na chaveera. O ma wane o jwoŋi Gafa teo kom de ko nawuura yam maama ba jea ne. 2David déem ma kwaare jara o di Moaba tiina bam de. Moaba tiina bam déem ma lɛɛre ba zo David dam kuri ne, ye ba tui ba ŋwe lampwoo ba pa‑o. 3Rehobi bu Hadadezere déem ye Zoba teo pɛ mo. O nam ya maa vei se o jwoŋi Yuferata buga laŋa kam teene dem mo o taa tei. David ma vo Hamafa seeni o jeeri Hadadezere de jara o di. 4David de o nɔɔna bam ma ja Hadadezere jara-keim torokooro moro (1,000), de o jar-keira balo na dɔge sisein-nɔɔna yuu ne to morro terepɛ (7, 000) mo, ko woli de o jar-keira balo na vei tega ne to morro finlei (20, 000). David ma le ba sisein-nɔɔna bi (100) se o taa jege o vaŋa o jara-keim torokooro, ye o daare o bwori selo na daare to nɛ pa se gwarege. 5Aram tiina balo déem na zoore Damasika laŋa kam ne to ma nwoŋi ba vo se ba woli Hadadezere. David ma jeeri-ba de jara ye o go ba nɔɔna morro finlei-telei (22, 000) 6David ma daare o ja o jar-keira badwonna o vo o che Aram tiina laŋa kam maama. Damasika ne mo konto. Aram tiina bam déem ma zo David dam kuri ne, ye ba ŋwe lampwoo ba pa‑o. Mɛ maama David ná via, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o pa se o di o dona mo jara wone. 7David ma vere sabu-seŋa jara zela yalo Hadadezere dedɛɛra bam ya na jege to o ja o jwoori o vo Jerusalem. 8Ko ta ná ye Tibafa dedaane Kun teene dem Hadadezere na tei to, David déem zo de wone mo o vere channa wonnu dedɛ o ja o viiri. Channa kam konto mo Solomon déem mɛ o mɔ ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kolo ba na bwoi we ‘Naneo Kom’ to, de Wɛ diga kam ywoa yam, ko woli de channa zwe sedwonna.
9Hamafa teo Pɛ Toyi déem ma ni we David di Zoba teo Pɛ Hadadezere jar-keira bam maama. 10Toyi tete déem ya ke jara kuni dedɛ mo de Hadadezere. O ma toŋe o bu Joram se o vo o jɔɔne David o ke o yu-ywoŋo lei de o na wane Hadadezere o di to. Joram ma ja sabu-seŋa pɛɛra, de lu-nyenno pɛɛra, de channa pɛɛra o vo o pa David. 11David ma kwei pɛɛra yam konto o pa se ba taa mae ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ. O déem ya maŋe o ke konto dwoŋi de lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa wonnu telo o na vere o dona bam tei ne to mo. Banto maa ye: Edom dwi, de Moaba dwi, de Amon tiina, de Filisi tiina, ko woli de Amaleki tiina bam. 12Abisayi wolo nu na ye Zeruya to ma vo Yɛ bwolo kom o kwaare jara de Edom tiina bam o go ba nɔɔna morro fuga-nana (18, 000). 13O ma ja o jar-keira badwonna o vo o che Edom laŋa kam. Edom tiina bam maama laam ma zo David dam kuri ne. Mɛ maama David ná via, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o pa se o di o dona mo jara wone.
David tontoŋena bam taane
14David déem ma di paare Isarele tiina bam maama ka baŋa ne. O ma tɔge chwoŋa de o na ke o nɔɔna bam tei to, pa ko lana ko pa-ba. 15Zeruya bu Joaba mo ye David jar-keira bam yiga tu. Ahiluda bu Jehosafate de ma nii woŋo maama baŋa ne se o popone-te o tiŋi. 16Ahituba bu Zadoki dedaane Abiatara bu Ahimeleka déem ye Wɛ kaanem tiina mo. Seraya maa ye tɔn-poponno. 17Jehoyada bu Benaya mo nii Cherete tiina bam dedaane Peleti tiina bam baŋa ne. David bu-baara bam maa wo o dedɛɛra bam yiga ne ba toŋe ba pa‑o.

english_text:
Israel Fights Ammon and Syria
(2 Samuel 10.1-19)
1Some time later, King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king. 2David said, “Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son.” He sent some officials to Ammon to tell Hanun how sorry he was that his father had died.
But when David's officials arrived at Ammon, 3the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, “Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.”
4Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away. 5They were terribly ashamed.
When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.”
6The Ammonites realized they had made David furious. So they paid 34 tons of silver to hire chariot troops from Mesopotamia and from the Syrian kingdoms of Maacah and Zobah. 7Thirty-two thousand troops, as well as the king of Maacah and his army, came and camped near Medeba. The Ammonite troops also left their towns and came to prepare for battle.
8David heard what was happening, and he sent out Joab with his army. 9The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.
10Joab saw that the enemy troops were lined up on both sides of him. So he picked some of the best Israelite soldiers to fight the Syrians. 11Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites. 12Joab told his brother, “If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you. 13Be brave and fight hard to protect our people and the towns of our Lord God. I pray he will do whatever pleases him.”
14Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them. 15When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.
16As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.
17David found out what the Syrians were doing, and he brought Israel's entire army together. They crossed the Jordan River, and he commanded them to take their positions facing the Syrian troops.
Soon after the fighting began, 18the Syrians ran from Israel. David killed 7,000 chariot troops and 40,000 regular soldiers. He also killed Shophach, their commander.
19When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.
translation_text:
Amon tiina bam taane
1Konto kwaga ne, Amon tiina pɛ Nahasi ma te. O bu Hanun ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. 2David ma ta o we, “Amo lage a ke Nahasi bu Hanun lanyerane mo, nenɛɛne o kwo de déem na ke amo lanyerane tei to.” O ma toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo ba ke Hanun lei de o kwo lua kam. David nɔɔna bam na yi Amon tiina laŋa kam ye ba vo ba ke Hanun lei to, 3Amon tiina dedɛɛra bam ma ta de Hanun ba we, “Nmo pɛ chega we, David boŋe lanyerane mo ye o toŋe nɔɔna se ba ba ba ke n kwo lua kam lei na? Lɔre we o nɔɔna bam tu se ba ŋɔ ba nii dé tega kam mo, se o laam wane o ba o di debam.” 4Hanun ma pa se ba ja David tontoŋena bam ba cheeri ba twana yam. Ba ta ma ja ba gwaaro tem tetare ne ba gwoni ba yage se ko yi ba takeira seeni. Ba laam ma yage-ba se ba viiri de kuri-nɔrɔ. 5David tontoŋena bam ma kɔre se ba jwoori sɔŋɔ, chaveera na jege-ba to ŋwaane. David na nigi ko na ke-ba tei to, o ma toŋe nɔɔna se ba jeeri-ba chwoŋa ne. O ma pa-ba kwora o we, “Maŋe-na Jeriko ne se á twana yam ná nwoŋi maama se á laam jwoori sɔŋɔ.”
6Amon tiina bam ma maane we, ba kikia maama laam lwoi David momwa ne mo. Hanun de Amon tiina bam ma vo ba sɔ ni de Aram tiina balo na wo Aram-Naharam, de Aram-Maaka, de Zoba ne to. Ba déem ŋwe lu-nyenno telo dunni na ye kilo morro fintɔ-tena (34,000) mo ba ma jwoŋi jara-keim torokooro de se dira bam Aram tiina bam tei ne. 7Torokooro morro fintɔ-telei (32, 000), de Maaka pɛ wom, de o jar-keira bam ma woli ba wone. Ba maama ma vo ba jeeri Medeba ne. Amon tiina bam de ma nwoŋi ba teene dem ne se ba da ba kwaare jara yam.
8David na lɔre ko ni ne to, o ma toŋe Joaba se o ja o babɛ sem kɔgɔ kom maama o vo o jeeri-ba de jara. 9Amon tiina bam ma gwɛ ba nwoŋi ba chichei ba zege ba teo kom manchwoŋo ni ne se ba ke jara yam. Ko daare pwa balo de na tu se ba da ba woli-ba to laam ma chichei ba zege teo kom pwola ne ye ba cheiga.
10Joaba ma lɔre we ba dona bam lage ba jeeri-ba yiga de kwaga maama mo. O ma kuri Isarele jar-keira bam wone balo na tiini ba yei jara laŋa chekke to, se banto yɔɔre ba jeeri Aram tiina bam. 11Jar-keira balo na daare to, o ma ke-ba o nyaane Abisayi jeŋa ne se banto maama vo ba jeeri Amon tiina bam. 12Joaba laam ma ta Abisayi o we, “Nmo ná nɛ we Aram tiina bam tiini ba dana ba dwoi amo, se n ba n woli-ne. Amon tiina bam de nam ná dana ba dwoi nmo, amo de wó ba a woli‑m. 13Ke dam n ke n tete kuri ne se n ta‑n jege baare! Pa-na dé jaŋe dé pa dé nɔɔna bam, dedaane dé Tu Wɛ wom teene dem. Baŋa Wɛ wó ke kolo na su o yi to!”
14Joaba de o jar-keira bam ma ja jara yam ba jeeri Aram tiina bam, ye ba duri ba jage. 15Amon tiina bam na nɛ we Aram tiina bam duri ba jage to, mo ba de duri ba jwoori ba zo ba teo kom wone, ye ba daare Abisayi de o jar-keira kɔgɔ kom. Jara yam ma ti pa se Joaba jwoori o vo Jerusalem. 16Aram tiina bam na maane we Isarele tiina bam wane-ba ba di to, mo ba jwoori ba toŋe nɔɔna pa se ba vo ba la ba jar-keira balo na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-puli seeni to ba ke daane. Pɛ Hadadezere jar-keira yiga tu Sobaka déem mo wo ba yiga ne.
17David ma lɔre ba na ke tei to ni ne. O de ma la Isarele jar-keira bam maama o ke daane. Ba ma vo ba bɛ Jɔdan buga kam ba chichei ba fɔge ba zege ba jeeri Aram tiina bam. Aram tiina bam na nɛ David na ke tei to, ba ma kwaare jara ded‑o. 18Isarele tiina bam ma fe Aram tiina bam ba zeili pa se ba duri ba jage. David de o nɔɔna bam ma go ba dona balo na dɔge sisei-torokooro yuu ne to morro terepɛ (7, 000). Ba ta ma go jar-keira balo na vei tega ne to morro finna (40, 000). Ko ná ye ba jar-keira bam yiga tu Sobaka, ba ma go o de. 19Hadadezere kwaga nɔɔna bam maama ma maane we Isarele tiina bam mo di-ba ba ti. Ba ma lwoori yibwona David tei ne ye ba daare ba sɛ ba pa‑o. Aram tiina bam maa ba sɛa se ba daa woli Amori tiina bam jara keim baŋa ne.

english_text:
The End of the War with Ammon
(2 Samuel 11.1; 12.26-31)
1 The next spring, the time when kings go to war, Joab marched out in command of the Israelite army and destroyed towns all over the country of Ammon. He attacked the capital city of Rabbah and left it in ruins. But David stayed in Jerusalem.
2Later, David himself went to Rabbah, where he took the crown from the statue of their god Milcom. The crown was made of about 34 kilograms of gold, and there was a valuable jewel on it. David put the jewel on his crown, then carried off everything else of value. 3He forced the people of Rabbah to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. He also did the same thing with the people in all the other Ammonite towns.
David then led Israel's army back to Jerusalem.
The Descendants of the Rephaim
(2 Samuel 21.15-22)
4Some time later, Israel fought a battle against the Philistines at Gezer. During this battle, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were defeated.
5 In another battle against the Philistines, Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.
6Another one of the Philistine soldiers who was a descendant of the Rephaim was as big as a giant and had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. During a battle at Gath, 7he made fun of Israel, so David's nephew Jonathan killed him.
8David and his soldiers killed these three men from Gath who were descendants of the Rephaim.
translation_text:
Ba wane ba di Raba teo
1Ko déem ma yi teeni punnu keim maŋa. Ko maa ye maŋa kalo pwa na yeini ba nwoŋi se ba ke jara to. Joaba ma tɔge Isarele jar-keira bam yiga pa se ba vo Amon tiina laŋa kam ba kwaare jara de-ba. Ba ma li Raba teo kom. Joaba de o nɔɔna bam ma wane-ko ba di. Ko daare David tete ma maŋe Jerusalem ne. 2David ma dɔne sabu-seŋa paare yipuga kam ba pɛ wom yuu ne. O ma maane we ka dunni daga dedɛ, nenɛɛne kilo fintɔ-tena, ye kandwɛ-nyeno mo meeli ka yera ne. Ba ma kwei yipuga kam ba ke David yuu ne. O de o nɔɔna bam déem ta ma pɛ teo kom jejegero dedɛ ba ja ba viiri. 3Ko nam ná ye teo kom nɔn-bia bam, o déem kwei-ba mo o de totoŋ-dɛɛra wone. O ma pa se ba mae pengasa, de dwoora, de seene ba toŋa. David déem ke Amon tiina teene dem maama konto dwoŋi mo. Konto kwaga ne, David dedaane o jar-keira bam maama ma jwoori ba vo Jerusalem.
Ba ke jara de Filisi tiina bam
4Ko kwaga ne, Filisi tiina bam daa ma ke jara de Isarele tiina bam Gezere teo ne. Husaa teo nɔɔno Sibekayi ma go nɔn-sawaara dwi tu wodwoŋi, o yere mo Sifayi. Ba ma wane Filisi tiina bam ba di.
5Maŋa kadwoŋi ne Isarele tiina bam daa ta ma kwaare jara de Filisi tiina bam. Jayiri bu Elihanan déem go Giti tu Goliafe choro wodwoŋi, o yere mo Laami. Wonto chichwei dem daga de dwoi gare-yi sɔɔna da-kwolo na mae tei to.
6Jara yadwonna daa ma ke Gafa teo ne. Filisi tiina bam babea kadwoŋi maa wora o de na ye nɔn-sawɔrɔ ye o nwoŋi Rafa dwi dem wone. O jeŋa maama déem jege nwa baredo mo. O namimbia de maa ye baredo baredo. 7O maa jege Isarele tiina bam o twea. David zembaaro Samma bu Jonatan ma zaŋe o go‑o.
8Filisi tiina bam konto déem mo ye nɔn-sawaara dwi dem tiina na nwoŋi Gafa ne to. David de o nɔɔna bam nam mo go-ba.

english_text:
David Counts the People
(2 Samuel 24.1-9)
1Satan decided to cause trouble for Israel by making David think it was a good idea to find out how many people there were in Israel and Judah. 2David told Joab and the army commanders, “Count everyone in Israel, from the town of Beersheba in the south all the way north to Dan. Then I will know how many people can serve in my army.”
3Joab answered, “Your Majesty, even if the Lord made your kingdom a hundred times larger, you would still rule everyone in it. Why do you need to know how many soldiers there are? Don't you think that would make the whole nation angry?”
4But David would not change his mind. And so Joab went everywhere in Israel and Judah and counted the people. He returned to Jerusalem 5and told David that the total number of men who could serve in the army was 1,100,000 in Israel and 470,000 in Judah. 6Joab refused to include anyone from the tribes of Levi and Benjamin, because he still disagreed with David's orders.
God Punishes Israel
(2 Samuel 24.10-17)
7David's order to count the people made God angry, and he punished Israel. 8David prayed, “I am your servant. But what I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Please forgive me.”
9The Lord said to Gad, one of David's prophets, 10“Tell David that I will punish him in one of three ways. But he will have to choose which one it will be.”
11Gad went to David and told him:
You must choose how the Lord will punish you: 12Will there be three years when the land won't grow enough food for its people? Or will your enemies constantly defeat you for three months? Or will the Lord send a horrible disease to strike your land for three days? Think about it and decide, because I have to give your answer to God who sent me.
13David was miserable and said, “It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.”
14So the Lord sent a horrible disease on Israel, and 70,000 Israelites died. 15Then he sent an angel to destroy the city of Jerusalem. But just as the angel was about to do that, the Lord felt sorry for all the suffering he had caused the people, and he told the angel, “Stop! They have suffered enough.” This happened at the threshing place that belonged to Araunah the Jebusite.
16David saw the Lord's angel in the air, holding a sword over Jerusalem. He and the leaders of Israel, who were all wearing sackcloth, bowed with their faces to the ground, 17and David prayed, “It's my fault! I sinned by ordering the people to be counted. They have done nothing wrong—they are innocent sheep. Lord God, please punish me and my family. Don't let the disease wipe out your people.”
David Buys Araunah's Threshing Place
(2 Samuel 24.18-25)
18The Lord's angel told the prophet Gad to tell David that he must go to Araunah's threshing place and build an altar in honor of the Lord. 19David followed the Lord's instructions.
20Araunah and his four sons were threshing wheat at the time, and when they saw the angel, the four sons ran to hide. 21Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.
22David said, “Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.”
23Araunah answered, “Take it, Your Majesty, and do whatever you want with it. I'll even give you the oxen for the sacrifice and the wheat for the grain sacrifice. And you can use the threshing-boards for the fire. It's all yours!”
24But David replied, “No! I want to pay you what they're worth. I can't just take something from you and then offer the Lord a sacrifice that cost me nothing.”
25So David paid Araunah 600 gold coins for his threshing place. 26David built an altar and offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. David prayed, and the Lord answered him by sending fire down on the altar. 27Then the Lord commanded the angel to put the sword away.
28When David saw that the Lord had answered his prayer, he offered more sacrifices there at the threshing place, 29-30because he was afraid of the angel's sword and did not want to go all the way to Gibeon. That's where the sacred tent that Moses had made in the desert was kept, as well as the altar where sacrifices were offered to the Lord.
translation_text:
David jeeli Isarele jar-keira bam ni
2 Samuwel 24:1-25
1Setaana pɛ déem boŋe se o pa cham yi Isarele tiina bam mo. O ma soge Pɛ David se o jeeli o lɔre Isarele tiina bam ni na mae tei to. 2David ma ta de Joaba de jar-keira dedɛɛra badwonna bam o we, “Véi-na á kaare Isarele teo kom maama, ko na zege Beeriseba ne se ko yi Dan laŋa kam seeni to se á jeeli nɔn-bia bam ni. Á ná ke konto á ti, se á pa a lɔre nɔɔna bam maama ni na mae tei to.”
3Joaba ma leiri o we, “Pɛ, amo lwoori Baŋa Wɛ se o pa Isarele kɔgɔ kom puli kuni bi se ko dwoni ba zem na ye tei tento to. Amo tu, ba maama ye nmo kwaga nɔɔna mo. Bɛŋwaane mo nmo lage se n lɔre ba ni na mae tei? Nmo wo lɔre we keim dem konto wó pa wɛleera taa wo Isarele tiina bam yuu ne mo na?”
4De konto maama de, Pɛ David wo to o pa Joaba. Joaba ma zaŋe o vo o kaare Isarele jei maama o ga nɔɔna bam ni. O na ke konto o ti to, o ma jwoori Jerusalem. 5Joaba ma lwoni o bere pɛ David Isarele baara balo na yi jara keim to ni na mae tei to. Isarele dwia yam maama wone, ba déem ye baara morro kuni moro dedaane morro bi dedoa (1,100, 000) mo. Judah dwi dem wone ba maa ye baara morro bia yana de fuserepɛ (470, 000).
6Joaba na wo yɔɔre o sɛ Pɛ David ni dem to, ko ma pa se o daa wo jeeli Levi dwi dem, de Benjamin dwi dem o woli jeelim dem wone. 7Wɛ tete de bane ma zaŋe de David na ke kolo to. O ma pa se cham ba Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne. 8David ma ta de Wɛ o we, “Amo tiini a ke wɛleere de a keim dento. Popo a lwoori‑m se n yage n ma n chɛ-ne. Kokuri to, a tiini a toŋe jworim dedɛ.”
9Gaadi déem ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu wolo na toŋe o pa David to mo. Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we, 10“Véi n ta de David we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: N jege se n kuri wonnu tento tetɔ wone dedoa mo se a ke-ko se ko taa ye waarem ko pa‑m.’ ”
11Gaadi ma seene o vo ta de David o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: N jege se n kuri wonnu tento tetɔ wone dedoa. 12Kɔ mo nmo nam wó kuri? N lage se kana mo zo n teo kom bena yatɔ, naa se á dona mo taa jege abam ba zeila ye ba goe chane setɔ, naa se Baŋa Wɛ maleka ba á baŋa ne pa se jawe-chɛɛro to n teo kom ne te go abam da yatɔ mo? Nam boŋe lanyerane se n kuri te wone n ta n bere-ne, se amo de jwoori a vo a ta de wolo na toŋe-ne n tei ne to.”
13David ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo bochare tiini de di mo. A wó kuri kɔ se a daare kɔ? Amo ba lage se nabiina taa jege debam ba dam kuri ne. Baŋa Wɛ tete nam ná waare debam, ko gara, wonto na tiini o duri nɔɔna yibwona to ŋwaane.”
14 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma pa se jawe-chɛɛro ba ko to Isarele teo kom ne. Ko nɔn-bia morro fuserepɛ (70, 000) déem ma te. 15Wɛ ma daare o toŋe o maleka se ka vo ka chɔge Jerusalem teo kom. Maleka kam na yi da se ka go ko nɔn-bia to mo Baŋa Wɛ maane cham delo o na toŋe ba baŋa ne to, pa se o leiri o boboŋa ye o daare o duri ba ŋwaŋa. O ma ta de maleka kam o we, “Ko maŋe! Dɔne n jeŋa n daare teo kom se n daa yé chɔge-ko!” Konto de Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam ya zege Jebusi tu Arawuna mena ferem jei sem ne mo. 16David ma kwoni o yuu o nii o na Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam na wo wɛyuu ne ye ka zei se-zɔɔ ka jeeri Jerusalem teo kom. David dedaane teo kom nakwa bam ya na zo gare-zenzwanno to ma vwi ba yiga tega ne.
17David ma ware Wɛ o we, “Ko ye amo mo tiini a ke wɛleere. Ko ye amo mo pɛ ni se ba jeeli nɔɔna bam na mae tei to. Nɔɔna banto ye amo kwaga nɔɔna mo. Banto nam ke bɛ mo ye ba na lɛɛro tento? Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam ma n jeŋa n waare amo de a sɔŋɔ tiina bam, se n daare n yage nɔɔna banto se jawe-chɛɛro yé chɔge-ba.”
18 Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam ma ta de Wɛ sampwora Gaadi se o pa David ni se o vo o lɔ kaanem bimbini Arawuna mena ferem jei sem ne se o ma o zuli Baŋa Wɛ. 19David ma sɛ Baŋa Wɛ ni dem o na pɛ Gaadi se o ta ded‑o to, ye o zaŋe o vo jei sem. 20Arawuna maa wo jei sem ne o fere o mena. O ma pipiri o na Wɛ maleka kam. O bia bana na wo o tei ne to ma duri ba seigi. 21Arawuna ma yɔɔre o tole o na Pɛ David na maa beena. O ma yage o mena yam ferem o daare o vo o vwi o yibia tega ne o zuli‑o. 22David ma ta ded‑o o we, “Sɛ se n yeigi n mena ferem jei sem n pa-ne. A lage se a lɔ kaanem bimbini mo dáane a zuli Baŋa Wɛ se ko pa jawe-chɛɛro tem ti dé teo kom ne. Amo wó ŋwe ko sabu kom ni maama a pa‑m.”
23Arawuna ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo tu, nam kwei-ka zɛɛra n ma n ke kolo maama n na lage to. Nii amo nabɛ mo tento se n wane n ja n zwɛ n ma n ke kaanem dem. Mena ferem dɛ sem de maa wora se n kwei-se n ma n tɔre mini n zwɛ vara bam. Mena de maa wora se n ma n ke wodiu pɛɛra. Pɛ, amo lage a kwei tento maama a pa nmo zɛɛra.”
24David ma leiri Arawuna o we, “Aawo! Amo wó ŋwe te maama jene mo a pa‑m. Kokuri to, a ba lage se a kwei nmo tete jeŋa wonnu a pa Baŋa Wɛ, naa se a kwei pɛɛra yalo a na jwoŋi zɛɛra to a zwɛ a ke kaanem a pa‑o.”
25David ma jeeli sabu-seŋa sabu-dala bia yaredo o pa Arawuna o ma yeigi o mena ferem jei sem. 26O ma lɛɛre o lɔ bimbini da se o ma ke kaanem o zuli Baŋa Wɛ. O ma daare o ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de yazura pɛɛra o ma kaane Baŋa Wɛ. O ma ware Baŋa Wɛ jei sem konto ne. Baŋa Wɛ ma sɛ o wɛ-lworo kom, ye o pa mini zege wɛyuu ne de ba de to kaanem bimbini dem baŋa ne.
27 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de maleka kam se ka kwei se-zɔɔ kom ka jwoori ka ke ko pwolo kom ne. 28David ma maane we Baŋa Wɛ cheigi o wara yam. O ma ke kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ Arawuna mena ferem jei sem ne.
29Maŋa kam konto ne Baŋa Wɛ wara-vwei delo Moses ya na chugi kagoa kam ne to, de zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam maama déem ta wo Gibeon teo wara-jei sem ne mo. 30David tete déem wo wane o vo dáane o bwei Baŋa Wɛ se o lɔre o boboŋa, Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam se-zɔɔ kom foone déem na jege‑o to ŋwaane.

english_text:
1David said, “The temple of the Lord God must be built right here at this threshing place. And the altar for offering sacrifices will also be here.”
David Prepares To Build the Temple
2David ordered the foreigners living in Israel to come to Jerusalem. Then he assigned some to cut blocks of stone for building the temple. 3He got a large supply of iron to make into nails and hinges for the doors, and he provided so much bronze that it could not be weighed. 4He also brought an endless supply of cedar logs from the cities of Sidon and Tyre.
5He said, “The temple for the Lord must be great, so that everyone in the world will know about it. But since my son Solomon is young and has no experience, I will make sure that everything is ready for the temple to be built.”
That's why David did all these things before he died.
David Instructs Solomon To Build the Temple
6David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel. 7 He said:
My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped. 8But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple. 9But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful. 10Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
11Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him. 12May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law. 13 If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
14I have all the supplies you'll need to build the temple: You have more than 3,000 tons of gold and over 34,000 tons of silver. There's also plenty of wood, stone, and more bronze and iron than I could weigh. Ask for anything else you need. 15I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with 16gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
17David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon. 18David said:
The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people. 19Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_text:
1David laam ma ta o we, “Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wó lɔ ka zege ywo-seeni mo, se bimbini delo Isarele tiina bam na wó taa jaane ba pɛɛra ba ma ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem da to de zege ywo!”
Ba ti ba yiga se ba lɔ Wɛ diga kam
2David déem ma pa ni se ba la veira balo maama na zoore Isarele teo wone to ba ke daane. O déem kuri ba wo nɔɔna mo se ba lɔ kandwa-zana ba le peero yera ne ye ba daare ba sare-ya ba ma ba lɔ Wɛ diga kam. 3O ma beeri luuru dedɛ o tiŋi se ba ma-te ba ke chena yalo na wó kwɛ ka nia yam bworru tem to, de zela yadwonna. O ta ma la channa dedɛ, ka dunni na dwoi maŋem to. 4Sidon teo tiina de Tura teo tiina déem ya jaane Sedare da-kwollu dedɛ ba ba ba pa David, ye o tiŋi-te Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm ŋwaane. Te na tiini te daga tei to gaale jeelim.
5Kokuri, David déem tage mo o we, “Amo bu Solomon tiini o muri, ye o boboŋa ta wo kweere. Ko nam maŋe se diga kalo dé na wó lɔ se dé zuli Baŋa Wɛ da to taa lana chekke mo, se ka yere yi tega baŋa ni maama, ye ka nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ de nwoŋi ko yi jei maama. Mo kokuri a nam wó ti ka zela yiga leile se ka lɔɔm maŋa ba ka yi.” David ma da ko ŋwaane o la Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm zela dedɛ o tiŋi ye o laam daare o te.
6O maa toŋe o bwoŋi o bu Solomon ye o pa‑o ni se o lɔ diga Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to zula ŋwaane. 7O ma ta ded‑o o we:
“Amo bu, amo tete mo ya jaane boboŋa se a lɔ diga amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere zula ŋwaane. 8Baŋa Wɛ déem nam toŋe o kwora mo o ta de amo we, ‘Nmo tiini n go nɔɔna dedɛ jara-keim baŋa ne. Nmo nam bá‑n lɔ diga amo yere zula ŋwaane, amo na maane we n pwori jana dedɛ tega ne to ŋwaane. 9Ko na ye tei to, nmo wó lo bu na lage bochare-zuru de ywoni yerane to mo. O dona maama daa bá taa daane‑o. O yere wó taa ye Solomon mo. O na wó di paare maŋa kalo to Isarele tiina bam wó jeini de yazura de bochare-zuru. 10Wonto mo wó lɔ diga o zege a yere dem zula ŋwaane. O wó taa ye amo bu mo, se amo de taa ye o kwo. O paare dem wó nu Isarele teo kom ne mo se ko taa vei wuu.’
11Konto ŋwaane, a bu, n Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wó taa wo n tei ne, se n de kwaane n lɔ o diga kam n ti, ne o na pɛ ni se n ke tei to. 12N Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam wó pa se n lɔre lɔra de yeino chekke se n wane n tɔge o nia yam na bere tei to baŋa ne n ta‑n tei Isarele tiina bam. 13Nmo ná sɛ n tɔge Wɛ nia yalo de o chullu telo o na tɔge Moses baŋa ne o kwei o pa Isarele tiina bam to chekke, nmo chwei maama wó kwɛ se pa‑m. Yɔɔre n ke dam n ke n tete kuri ne, se n daare n tiini n ta‑n jege baare. Yé ta‑n fona, nam yé pa se n vɔna pare.
14Amo maŋe a la Baŋa Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm zela dedɛ mo a tiŋi. A lage sabu-seŋa a tiŋi se ka dunni maŋe de kilo moro kuni morro tetɔ de bia yanu (3,500,000). A ta ma la lu-nyenno telo dunni de na yi ne kilo moro kuni morro fintɔ-tenu (35,000,000) to. A ta ma la channa de luuru dedɛ pa te dunni dwoi maŋem, ko woli de da-kwollu de kandwa dedɛ a tiŋi. De ko de, nmo ta wó wane n beeri tedwonna n woli da. 15Nmo nam jege tontoŋena dedɛ n tei ne, ba na ye kandwa-cherena, de lɔra, de kapenta tiina, de gwaro tedwonna na wae totoŋa dwi dwi ba toŋe to. Banto maama tiini ba yei ba totoŋa lanyerane. 16Ba maa wó wane ba kwei sabu-seŋa, de lu-nyenno, de channa, de luuru ba gɔgere wonnu dwi dwi. Chega to, gwaro tem daga dedɛ. Nam yɔɔre n bobo totoŋa, se Baŋa Wɛ wó taa wo n tei ne.”
17David déem ma pa Isarele teo yiga tiina bam ni se ba woli Solomon. 18O ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wo á tei ne mo, ye o pa se á jei á teo ne de yazura. Ko ná ye balo déem na zoore tega kam ne to, o ke-ba amo dam kuri ne mo. Baŋa Wɛ de o nɔɔna bam laam maa tei tega kam. 19Konto ŋwaane, yɔɔre á ta‑á zuli á Tu Baŋa Wɛ de á bochare maama, ko woli de á dam maama. Nam bobo-na á lɔ Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ diga kam, se á laam wane á ja o ni-gwonim dakaa kam, de o lonne zela yam á zo da. Ka maa wó taa ye diga kalo á na wó lɔ Baŋa Wɛ yere dem zula ŋwaane to.”

english_text:
David Assigns the Levites Their Duties
1 David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel. 2Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites. 3He then counted the Levite men who were at least 30 years old, and the total was 38,000. 4He said, “Twenty-four thousand of the Levites will be in charge of the temple, 6,000 will be temple officials and judges, 54,000 will be guards at the temple, and 4,000 will praise the Lord by playing the musical instruments I have given them.”
6David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
7Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei. 8Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel. 9They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran. 10-11Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
12Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 13 Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name. 14-15Moses, the man of God, was the father of Gershom and Eliezer, and their descendants were considered Levites. 16Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel. 17Rehabiah, who was Eliezer's only son, had many children. 18The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith. 19Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam. 20Kohath's youngest son, Uzziel, was the father of Micah and Isshiah.
21Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. 22Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons. 23Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
24These were the clans and families of the tribe of Levi. Those who were 20 years and older were assigned to work at the Lord's temple.
25David said:
The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever. 26 And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place. 27From now on, all Levites at least 20 years old 28 will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure. 29They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
30Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him. 31They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done. 32They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_text:
Levi dwi dem taane
1Pɛ David déem na maane we o kwe o gaale to, o ma pa se o bu Solomon leiri o yuu ne o di Isarele teo paare dem. 2David ma la Isarele nakwa bam, de kaanem tiina bam, ko woli de Levi tiina bam maama o ke daane. 3O ma jeeli Levi tiina balo na yi bena fintɔ ba daŋe to ni na mae tei. Ba maama déem ye baara morro fintɔ-nana (38,000) mo. 4David ma ta o we, “Levi tiina baara bam maama wone, baara morro finlei-tena (24,000) wó taa nii Wɛ diga kam totoŋa baŋa ne. Baara morro teredo (6,000) maa wó taa ye dedɛɛra, de balo na di nɔɔna taane to. 5Ba baara morro tena (4,000) wó taa ye Wɛ diga kam yerena. Babam morro tena (4,000) maa wó taa mae kwɛɛra zela yalo a na pɛ-ba to ba maga ba tei Baŋa Wɛ.”
6David déem ma pɔɔre Levi tiina bam kuni betɔ se ko tɔge de ba nabaara kuri na ye tei to. Ba nabaara bam mo ye Gereson, de Kohafe, dedaane Merari.
Gereson dwi dem taane
7Gereson bia bam mo tento:
Ladan de Simeyi.
8Ladan de déem jege bakeiri setɔ mo. Ba maa ye:
O bu-kwea Jeheli, de Zetam, de Joweli.
9Simeyi bia batɔ bam maa ye:
Selomifa, de Hazeli, de Haran.
Banto maama déem ye Ladan sɔ-yuni tem yiga tiina mo.
10Simeyi déem daa loge bia bana mo. Banto mo ye:
Jahafe, de Zina, de Jewusi, de Beria.
11Jahafe maa ye ba sɔ-yuu kom yiga tu, ye Ziza de déem saŋe o kwaga. Ko nam ná ye Jewusi de Beria, banto déem wo nɛ dwi dedɛ. Ba ma lɛɛre ba nii banto balei bam pa ba ye diga dedoa nɔɔna.
Kohafe dwi dem taane
12Kohafe bia bana bam mo tento:
Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli.
13Amiram bia bam maa ye:
Aron de Moses.
Aron de o dwi dem mo ba pɔɔre se ba taa ye ba yera taa wuu. Ba totoŋa déem ye se ba taa fɔge ba nii Baŋa Wɛ lonne wonnu tem mo ba pa‑o, se ba daare ba taa toŋe o kaanem totoŋa, ye ba taa toŋe o yiga ne, ba daare ba taa tɔge o yere dem ŋwaane ba sɔɔle swolim ba yage o nɔɔna yuu ne se ko taa vei wuu. 14Ba déem nii Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses dwi dem pa ba wo Levi dwi dem wone mo.
15Moses bia bam mo tento:
Geresom, de Eliazera.
16Geresom dwi dem wone:
Sebuwel mo ye ba nakwe.
17Eliazera dwi dem wone:
Rehabia mo ye ba nakwe.
Eliazera daa wo loge bakeira. Rehabia nam déem loge bia dedɛ.
18Izehara bia bam wone:
Selomifa mo ye ba nakwe.
19Heboron bia bam mo tento:
O bu-kwea Jeria. Balo na saŋe to maa ye Amaria, de Jahazeli, de Jekameam.
20Yuzeli bia bam mo tento:
O bu-kwea Mika, de wonto nyaane Issiya.
Merari dwi dem taane.
21Merari bia bam mo tento:
Mahili, de Musi.
Mahili de bia bam maa ye:
Eleaza de Kisi.
22Eleaza déem tege ye o wo loge bakeira, se bukwa yerane mo o loga. Banto ma zo ba kwo wom nyaane Kisi bia badwonna.
23Musi bia batɔ bam maa ye:
Mahili, de Edera, de Jeremofa.
24Banto maama déem ye Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo, diga maama de ka yuu tu. Ba ma popone ba yera yam ba tiŋi konto dedoa dedoa. Banto maa ye balo na yi bena finlei ba daŋe ye ba laam jege chwoŋa se ba taa toŋa Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone to mo. 25Kokuri to, David déem maŋe o ta o we, “Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to pɛ se o nɔɔna bam jeini de wo-zuru, ye o ba o zoore Jerusalem teo wone taa wuu. 26Levi dwi tiina bam daa ba jege se ba taa zeŋe wara-vwei dem de de wo zela yam ba taa beera jeiga maama.”
27David na pɛ o ni delo o kweeli to bere we, Levi dwi tu wolo maama na yi bena finlei o daŋe to jege chwoŋa se o taa toŋa o pa Wɛ. 28Levi dwi tiina totoŋa yam ye se ba da ba woli Aron dwi dem de ba na toŋe Wɛ diga kam wone tei to mo. Ba jege se ba taa nii Wɛ diga kam konkwallo tem baŋa ne, de di-balwa balo na wo ka wone to, se ba daare ba kwɛ Wɛ lonne zela yam maama digiru seeni, ko woli de Wɛ diga kam totoŋa yalo na maŋe to de. 29Ba daa ta wó taa nii bworobworo kolo ba na yeini ba tiŋi Wɛ yiga ne to baŋa ne, dedaane mun-bwei delo ba na wó ma ba ke wodiu pɛɛra ba pa Wɛ to, de bworobworo-memene selo sabɔle na wo woli ko wone to, de maasa fɔgem baŋa ne. Ba daa ta jege se ba taa nii te maama dunni maŋem baŋa ne mo. 30Tega ná yeini ka poore, Levi tiina bam jege se ba zege ba jeiga ne ba ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo ye ba leeni ba zuli‑o. Ba ta wó ke konto dedaan-ni maama ne, 31ko woli de dɛ delo maama ba na yeini ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ to, ko ná ye o siu dɛ, naa chan-doŋa kuri maŋa ne, naa kuri dedwoŋi maŋa ne de.
32Konto dwoŋi mo Levi dwi tiina bam déem nii Wɛ wara-vwei dem de de jei selo na ye wose to totoŋa yam baŋa ne. Ba ma woli ba chorro telo na ye Aron dwi dem to pa se ba toŋa Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone.

english_text:
David Assigns the Priests Their Duties
1Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. 2 But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
3David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
4Eleazar's descendants were divided into 16 groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders. 5However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
6As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
7-18Each group of priests went by the name of its family leader, and they were assigned their duties in the following order: Jehoiarib, Jedaiah, Harim, Seorim, Malchijah, Mijamin, Hakkoz, Abijah, Jeshua, Shecaniah, Eliashib, Jakim, Huppah, Jeshebeab, Bilgah, Immer, Hezir, Happizzez, Pethahiah, Jehezkel, Jachin, Gamul, Delaiah, Maaziah. 19These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron.
The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
20Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi:
Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
21Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
22Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
23Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
24Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
25Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
26Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
27Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri. 28-29Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel. 30Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth.
These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans. 31Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_text:
Kaanem tiina totoŋa na pɔɔre tei to
1Aron dwi dem na pɔɔre sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu tei to mo tento:
Aron bia bam ya ye Nadab, de Abihu, de Eleaza, de Itamara. 2Ko nam ná ye Nadab de Abihu, banto tege ko lwoori ba kwo toone. Ba maa wo loge bakeiri. Konto ma pa se ba nyaana Eleaza de Itamara ji Wɛ kaanem tiina. 3David ma pɔɔre Aron dwi dem kɔgɔ kɔgɔ, se kɔgɔ maama taa jege ko totoŋa ko toŋa ko pae Wɛ. Ko nam ye Eleaza dwi tu Zadoki, de Itamara dwi tu Ahimeleka mo ke daane ba woli David se o pɔɔre nɔɔna bam. 4Ba ma maane we Eleaza dwi dem déem jege dedɛɛra dedɛ ko dwoni Itamara dwi dem na jege tei to. Mo kokuri ba déem pɔɔre Eleaza dwi dem kuni fuga-beredo, ye ba daare ba pɔɔre Itamara dwi dem kuni nana. 5Ba ma ta jɔrɔ se ba wane ba pɔɔre totoŋa yam de chega, bɛŋwaane Wɛ diga tontoŋena de kaanem tiina déem wora ba na nwoŋi Itamara de Eleaza dwia yam wone mo.
6Ba na pɛ nɔɔna bam popɔra maama ba totoŋa se ba taa toŋe konto to, tɔn-poponno Semaya mo popone ba yera yam o tiŋi. Wonto maa ye Levi dwi tu Netaneli bu. David de o dedɛɛra bam badwonna déem mo nii keim dem konto baŋa ne. Dedɛɛra bam maa ye Wɛ kaanem tu Zadoki, de Abiatara bu Ahimeleka, ko woli de kaanem tiina bam, de Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuni tem nakwa bam maama. Eleaza dwi dem de Itamara dwi dem déem mo jege jɔrɔ kom ba tae ba leiri ba pa daane. 7-18Nɔɔna bam popɔre finlei-sena sem na saŋe daane tei to mo tento:
1. Jehoyaribi
2. Jedaya
3. Harim
4. Seyorim
5. Malakija
6. Mijamina
7. Hakoza
8. Abija
9. Jesua
10. Sekania
11. Eliasibi
12. Jakim
13. Hupa
14. Jesebeba
15. Biliga
16. Yimera
17. Hezira
18. Hapizeza
19. Petahia
20. Jehezikeli
21. Jakin
22. Gamuli
23. Delaya
24. Maazia
19Mo ba déem na pɛ nɔɔna maama popɔra de popɔra ba totoŋe tei to. Ba déem jege se ba saŋe daane konto dwoŋi mo ba taa zoore Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ba toŋa ka wone, se ko maŋe de Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom déem na pɛ ba nabaaro Aron ni se ba taa toŋe tei to.
Levi dwi delo na daare to
20Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuni tem nakwa balo na daare to mo tento:
Amiram dwi dem wone nakwe tu wom mo ye Sebuwel.
Sebuwel dwi dem nakwe tu wom maa ye Jedeya.
21Rehabia bia bam wone Issiya mo ye nakwe.
22Izehara dwi dem wone Selomifa mo ye nakwe.
Selomifa de bia bam wone Jahafe de maa ye nakwe.
23Heboron bia bam wone Jeria mo ye nakwe.
Amaria de ma saŋe belei tu.
Jahazeli ma ke betɔ tu.
Jekameam ma ke bena tu.
24Yuzeli bu mo ye Mika.
Mika de bia bam wone Samira mo ye nakwe.
25Mika nyaane maa ye Issiya.
Issiya de bia bam wone Zekaria mo ye nakwe.
26Merari bia bam wone Mahili de Musi mo ye nakwa.
Jaazia bu mo ye Beno.
27Merari bu Jaazia bia bam maama maa ye:
Beno, de Soham, de Zakura, de Yibiri.
28Mahili bia bam wone Eleaza mo ye nakwe.
Eleaza nam wo loge bakeiri.
29Kisi bia bam wone o bu Jerameeli mo ye nakwe.
30Musi bia bam wone Mahili, de Edera, de Jerimofa mo ye ba nakwa.
Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu mo konto. 31Banto déem tage jɔrɔ mo ba totoŋa dwi maama ŋwaane, nenɛɛne ba chorro tem na ye Aron bia to de na ke tei to. Ba ke konto Pɛ David, de Zadoki, de Ahimeleka, ko woli de kaanem tiina bam de Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuni tem nakwa bam maama yiga ne mo. Ba déem na tage jɔrɔ kom tei to, popɔra tera de ba na ke tei nakwe maama de o nyaana yera ne to.

english_text:
David Assigns the Temple Musicians Their Duties
1David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
2Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
3Jeduthun's six sons, Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, were under the direction of their father and played harps and sang praises to the Lord.
4Heman had 14 sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth. 5Heman was one of the king's prophets, and God honored Heman by giving him 14 sons and 3 daughters. 6His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple.
Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
7There were 288 of these men, and all of them were skilled musicians. 8David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
9-31The musicians were divided into 24 groups of twelve, and each group went by the name of their family leader. They were assigned their duties in the following order: Joseph, Gedaliah, Zaccur, Zeri, Nethaniah, Bukkiah, Asarelah, Jeshaiah, Mattaniah, Shimei, Uzziel, Hashabiah, Shebuel, Mattithiah, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Joshbekashah, Hanani, Mallothi, Eliathah, Hothir, Giddalti, Mahazioth, and Romamtiezer.
translation_text:
Wɛ diga kam lein-leena bam taane
1David de o jar-keira yiga tiina bam déem ma kuri Asaf, de Heman, de Jedutuna bia badwonna se ba taa pworisi Wɛ kwora ye ba tae kwanno dwi dwi ba daare ba mage zwe. Nɔɔna bam yera de ba totoŋa mo tento:
2Asaf bia bam wone:
Zakura, de Josefa, de Netania, de Asarela maama déem toŋe ba kwo Asaf dam kuri ne mo. Asaf déem nam yeini o pworisi Wɛ kwora mo ne pɛ wom na wó pa‑o ni se o pworisi tei to.
3Jedutuna bia bam wone:
Gedalia, de Zeri, de Jesaya, de Simeyi, de Hasabia, de Matitia.
Banto baredo maama déem wo ba kwo Jedutuna dam kuri ne mo. Jedutuna déem yeini o pworisi Wɛ kwora ye o tae kɔnɔ mo o leeni o zuli Baŋa Wɛ.
4Heman de bia bam wone:
Bukia, de Matania, de Yuzeli, de Sebuwel, de Jerimofa, de Hanania, de Hanani, de Eliata, de Gidaliti, de Romanti-Ezera, de Josibekasa, de Maloti, de Hotiri, dedaane Mahaziofa.
5Heman déem ye pɛ wom yi-naro mo. Baŋa Wɛ déem na pɛ o lo bia dedɛ to tɔge Wɛ na tiŋi ni se o pa o yere zaŋe to ŋwaane mo. Wɛ ma pa o lo bakeiri fuga-bana, de bukwa batɔ. 6Heman bia banto maama déem wo o dam kuri ne mo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam lei baŋa ne. Ba maa mage zwe, ye ba tae kwanno dwi dwi ba ma toŋe Wɛ diga kam wone.
Ko nam ná ye Asaf, de Jedutuna, de Heman tete, banto maama déem wo pɛ wom dam kuri ne mo. 7Nɔɔna bam konto maama de ba chorro tem déem wae ba leeni lei chekke ba ma ba tei Baŋa Wɛ. Ba maama ni maa ye nɔɔna bia yalei de funɔnɔ-nana (288). 8Ba na tage jɔrɔ tei to, nɔɔno maama ma na o totoŋe. Ko ná ye nɔn-kwe, de nɔn-donno, de berena, de balo ta na zamese to, ba maama ye bedwe mo. 9-31Ba déem ye nɔɔna fuga-balei kuni finlei-bena mo, ye popɔra maama jege ka nakwe. Ba na kuri-ba ye ba saŋe daane tei to mo tento:
1. Asaf dwi tu Josefa, de o bia, de o chorro.
2. Gedalia, de o bia, de o chorro.
3. Zakura, de o bia, de o chorro.
4. Zeri, de o bia, de o chorro.
5. Netania, de o bia, de o chorro.
6. Bukia, de o bia, de o chorro.
7. Asarela, de o bia, de o chorro.
8. Jesaya, de o bia, de o chorro.
9. Matania, de o bia, de o chorro.
10. Simeyi, de o bia, de o chorro.
11. Azareli, de o bia, de o chorro.
12. Hasabia, de o bia, de o chorro.
13. Sebuwel, de o bia, de o chorro.
14. Matitia, de o bia, de o chorro.
15. Jerimofa, de o bia, de o chorro.
16. Hanania, de o bia, de o chorro.
17. Josibekasa, de o bia, de o chorro.
18. Hanani, de o bia, de o chorro.
19. Maloti, de o bia, de o chorro.
20. Eliata, de o bia, de o chorro.
21. Hotiri, de o bia, de o chorro.
22. Gidaliti, de o bia, de o chorro.
23. Mahaziofa, de o bia, de o chorro.
24. Romanti-Ezera, de o bia, de o chorro.
Popɔra maama ye baara fuga-balei mo.

english_text:
The Temple Guards Are Assigned Their Duties
1The temple guards were also divided into groups according to clans.
Meshelemiah son of Kore was from the Korah clan and was a descendant of Asaph. 2He had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Zechariah, Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel, 3Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
4-5 Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.
6-7Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan. 8There were 62 descendants of Obed-Edom who were strong enough to be guards at the temple.
9Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
10-11Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
12The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites. 13Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
14Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate. 15Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms. 16Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road.
The guards were assigned the following work schedule: 17Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms, 18four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
19These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari.
Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
20The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
21Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan. 22Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
23Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
24Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury. 25The descendants of Gershom's brother Eliezer included Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zichri, and Shelomoth.
26Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders. 27And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple. 28Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah.
Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
29Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
30Hashabiah from the Hebron clan and 1,700 of his skilled relatives were the officials in charge of all religious and government business in the Israelite territories west of the Jordan River.
31-32Jerijah was the leader of the Hebron clan. David assigned him and 2,700 of his relatives, who were all respected family leaders, to be the officials in charge of all religious and government business in the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. David found out about these men during the fortieth year of his rule, when he had a list made of all the families in the Hebron clan. They were from the town of Jazer in the territory of Gilead.
translation_text:
Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena bam taane
1Levi dwi tiina balo déem na toŋe Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena totoŋa to na pɔɔre kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ tei to mo tento.
Kora dwi dem wone:
Meselemia na ye Kore bu ye o nwoŋi Asaf dwi dem wone to.
2Meselemia bu-baara barepɛ bam na saŋe da-kwaga tei to mo tento:
O bu-kwea Zekaria, de Jedayeli, de Zebadia, de Jateneli, 3de Elam, de Jehohanan, de Eli-hoyenayi.
4Obed-Edom bu-baara nana maa ye:
O bu-kwea Semaya, de Jehozabadi, de Joa, de Sachare, de Netaneli, 5de Ameli, de Isakara, de Puletayi.
Wɛ déem tiini o swɛ Obed-Edom swolim lanyerane mo.
6Obed-Edom bu Semaya de déem jege bakeiri na ye babɛ ba sɔ-yuni tem ne, nɔɔna na nege-ba to ŋwaane. 7Semaya bia maa ye:
Ofini, de Refayeli, de Obeda, de Elizabad. O chorro tem na ye Elihu de Semakia to de déem jege yere mo.
8Obed-Edom bia bam konto. Banto de ba bia bam, ko woli de ba chorro tem déem ye babɛ mo chekke. Ba maa dana pa ba wae totoŋe dem ba toŋa. Obed-Edom dwi dem déem ye baara fuseredo-balei (62) mo.
9Meselemia bia bam de o chorro tem wone ba déem kuri baara fuga-nana (18) balo na jege yere to mo.
10Hosa na nwoŋi Merari sɔ-yuu kom ne to bia bam mo tento:
Ba yiga tu mo ye Simiri.
O nam maŋe o dae bu-kwea ye o kwo ta kuri‑o se o taa ye o bia bam yiga tu. 11O bia balo na saŋe to maa ye:
Hilikia, de Tebalia, de Zekaria.
Hosa bia bam de o chorro tem wone ba déem kuri baara fuga-batɔ mo.
12Ba déem na pɔɔre ni-yerena banto tei to tɔge de ba yiga tiina na ye balo to mo. Ba ma pa popɔra maama de ka totoŋa se ka toŋe Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone, nenɛɛne ba chorro de déem na ke tei to. 13Ba déem tage jɔrɔ mo se ba lɔre ni de ni delo diga maama na wó taa yere to. Ba ya ná ye nɔn-kwe naa nɔn-donno de, ko ye bedwe mo.
14Jɔrɔ kom déem kuri Selemia mo se o taa yere ni delo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to. Ba ta ma kuri o bu Zekaria se o taa yere ni delo na jeeri baŋa seeni to. Zekaria déem nam jege swa mo chekke. 15Jɔrɔ kom ta ma kuri Obed-Edom se o taa yere ni delo na jeeri tega-kuri seeni to. Ba ta ma kuri o bia bam se ba taa yere zela yam na tigi di selo wone to. 16Jɔrɔ kom ma kuri Supim de Hosa se ba taa yere Wɛ diga kam ni delo na jeeri wɛ-zoore seeni to, dedaane Salekefa ni dem na jeeri baŋa seeni chwoŋa kam to.
Ni-yereno maama déem saŋe o dwoŋi mo o zege o takeiri ne. 17Dɛ maama wone Levi dwi tiina baredo déem mo yere Wɛ diga kam ni delo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to. Ba bana maa yere ni delo na jeeri baŋa seeni to. Ba bana de maa yere ni delo na jeeri tega-kuri seeni to. Ba balei balei ma yere zela yam na tigi di selei sem wone to. 18Ko ta ná ye konkɔlɔ kolo na wo Wɛ diga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to, nɔɔna bana ma yere ko ni delo na wo chwoŋa kam ni ne to. Ba balei ma yere konkɔlɔ kom tete.
19Nɔɔna balo na nwoŋi Kora de Merari sɔ-yuni tem ne ye ba ye Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena to déem na pɔɔre kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ tei to mo konto.
Wɛ diga kam dedɛɛra badwonna taane
20Levi dwi tiina badwonna déem mo nii Wɛ diga kam sabu baŋa ne, ko woli de di selo ba na tiŋi ka lonne wonnu da to.
21Gereson dwi tiina balo na ye Ladan bia ye ba ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa to déem ye Jeheli, 22de Jeheli de bia bam mo. O bia bam maa ye Zetam, de o nyaane Joweli. Banto déem mo yere Baŋa Wɛ diga kam sabu na tigi mɛ to.
23Yerena badwonna de déem nwoŋi Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli dwia yam wone.
24Moses bu Geresom dwi tu Sebuwel déem mo ye dedɛɛro wolo na nii Wɛ diga kam sabu tiŋim baŋa ne to. 25O chorro telo na ye Eliazera bia to maa ye:
Rehabia, de Jesaya, de Joram, de Zikiri, de Selomifa.
26Selomifa de o chorro tem déem mo yere zela yalo maama ba na tiŋi se ba ma ba ke pɛɛra ba pa Baŋa Wɛ to. Balo na jaane pɛɛra yam konto ba ba to déem ye Pɛ David, de nakwa balo na tei nɔɔna moro moro to, de balo na tei nɔɔna bi bi to, dedaane jar-keira dedɛɛra bam. 27Ba déem yeini ba kwei zela yalo ba na vere ba dona bam tei ne to yadwonna mo ba ke Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne, se ba ma ba fɔge ba kwɛ o diga kam. 28Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu Samuwel, de Kisi bu Sɔɔl, de Nera bu Abenera, de Zeruya bu Joaba de déem jaane pɛɛra yadwonna ba ba ba ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. Selomifa de o chorro tem mo nii te maama baŋa ne.
29Izehara sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Chenania de o bia bam déem ye dedɛɛra balo na toŋe Isarele teo jei sedwonna ne to mo. Ba totoŋa maa ye se ba taa nii teo kom taana baŋa ne.
30Heboron sɔ-yuu kom wone:
Hasabia de o chorro mo ba déem kuri se ba taa nii Isarele laŋa kalo na wo Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to. Banto maa ye nɔɔna moro de bia yarepɛ (1,700) na jege yere to. Jei sem konto ne mo ba déem nii Wɛ chwoŋa totoŋa, dedaane pɛ wom totoŋa maama baŋa ne. 31Jeria déem mo ye Heboron sɔ-yuu kom nakwe, ne ko na popone tei ba dwi dem lonne twanno tem wone to. David paare dim bena finna bene dem wone mo ba buŋi Heboron dwi dem wone diga de ka diga ba kuri nɔn-yerro ba ja ba nwoŋi Gilead teo Jazera ne. 32Jeria chorro telo na ye nakwa ye ba kwori ba ye nɔn-yerro to déem ye baara morro telei de bia yarepɛ (2,700) mo. Pɛ David déem kuri banto mo se ba taa nii Ruben dwi dem, de Gad dwi dem, ko woli de Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom. Dwia yam konto tei ne mo ba déem yeini ba nii Wɛ chwoŋa totoŋa, dedaane pɛ wom totoŋa maama baŋa ne.

Isarele jar-keira bam taane
1Isarele dwi tiina bam na pɔɔre pɔɔre jara keim ŋwaane tei to mo tento. Ba maa ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa, de balo na tei jar-keira moro moro to, de balo na tei jar-keira bi bi to, dedaane ba dedɛɛra balo na toŋe ba pa pɛ wom totoŋa maama baŋa ne to. Bene maama wone jar-keira bam popɔra dedoa maama toŋe ba leiri daane mo chana de chana wone. Ba popɔra dedoa ni maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
2Da-yiga popɔra kalo na toŋe boboa chana kam wone to mo tento:
Zabideli bu Jasobema déem mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama maa ye jar-keira morro finlei-tena (24,000). 3Wonto déem ye Pɛreza dwi tu mo. O maa nii jar-keira dedɛɛra bam maama baŋa ne boboa chana kam ne.
4Popɔra balei tu na toŋe chane selei chana kam wone to mo tento:
Dodayi na ye Ahohi dwi tu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Mikilofa déem mo ye yuu tu wolo na saŋe o kwaga to. Ba maama maa ye jar-keira morro finlei-tena (24,000).
5Popɔra batɔ tu na toŋe chane setɔ chana kam wone to mo tento:
Benaya na ye Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada bu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama maa ye jar-keira morro finlei-tena (24,000). 6Benaya déem tiini o na yere ‘Bembɛ fintɔ kom’ wone mo. O maa ye ba yuu tu. O bu Amizabadi déem mo ye yuu tu wolo na saŋe o kwaga to.
7Popɔra bana tu na toŋe chane sena chana kam wone to mo tento:
Joaba nyaane Asaheli mo nii ba baŋa ne. O bu Zebadia mo leiri o yuu ne o ji ba yuu tu. Ba maama maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
8Popɔra banu tu na toŋe chane senu chana kam wone to:
Samufa na ye Izara dwi tu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
9Popɔra beredo tu na toŋe chane seredo chana kam wone to mo tento:
Yira na ye Tekoa dwi tu Ikesa bu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
10Popɔra berepɛ tu na toŋe chane serepɛ chana kam wone to mo tento:
Peloni tu Heleza na nwoŋi Efrayim dwi dem wone to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
11Popɔra nana tu na toŋe chane nana chana kam wone to mo tento:
Husaa tu Sibekayi na ye Zera dwi tu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama déem maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
12Popɔra nogo tu na toŋe chane nogo chana kam wone to mo tento:
Anatofe tu Abizeri na ye Benjamin dwi tu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama déem maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
13Popɔra fuga tu na toŋe chane fuga chana kam wone to mo tento:
Netofa tu Maharayi na ye Zera dwi tu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama déem maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
14Popɔra fuga-dedoa tu na toŋe chane fuga-dedoa chana kam wone to mo tento:
Pirafon tu Benaya na ye Efrayim dwi tu to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama déem maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
15Popɔra fuga-balei tu na toŋe chane fuga-selei chana kam wone to mo tento:
Netofa tu Helidayi na nwoŋi Ofineli sɔ-yuu kom ne to mo nii ba baŋa ne. Ba maama déem maa ye baara morro finlei-tena (24,000).
Isarele dwia yam yuu tiina bam taane
16Dedɛɛra balo déem na nii Isarele dwia yam baŋa ne to mo tento:
Ruben dwi dem yuu tu mo ye:
Zikiri bu Eliazera.
Simeon dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Maaka bu Sefatia.
17Levi dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Kemweli bu Hasabia.
Wɛ kaanem tu Zadoki maa nii Aron dwi dem baŋa ne.
18Judah dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
David zembaaro Elihu.
Isakara dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Mikayeli bu Omiri.
19Zebulun dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Obadia bu Isamaya.
Nafitali dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Azireli bu Jerimofa.
20Efrayim dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Azazia bu Hosea.
Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom yuu tu maa ye:
Pedaya bu Joweli.
21Manasɛ dwi chichworo kolo na wo Gilead laŋa kam ne to yuu tu maa ye:
Zekaria bu Yido.
Benjamin dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Abenera bu Jaaseli.
22Dan dwi dem yuu tu maa ye:
Jeroham bu Azareli.
Dedɛɛra balo déem na nii Isarele dwia yam baŋa ne to mo konto.
23David déem na jeeli Isarele dwi tiina bam ni to, o wo pɛ ba ga baara balo na ta wo yi bena finlei to. Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o pwooli we o lage o pa se ba tiini ba puli ne chalechwe sem na mae tei to ŋwaane mo. 24Zeruya bu Joaba ma bobo se o ga Isarele tiina bam se o lɔre ba ni. O nam wo wane o ga-ba o ti, bɛŋwaane Wɛ bane zaŋe de Isarele tiina bam ba keim dem konto ŋwaane mo. Ba maa wo popone ba ni na mae tei to ba ke Pɛ David lonne twanno tem wone.
Pɛ wom dedɛɛra bam taane
25Adeli bu Azimavefa déem mo nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom zela yalo maama na jege lonne to baŋa ne.
Yuzia bu Jonatan maa nii lonne zela yalo na wo kateira yam maama ne to baŋa ne.
26Kalubi bu Eziri déem mo nii balo na vare pɛ wom kare to baŋa ne.
27Rama tu Simeyi déem mo nii Vini teeni kare sem baŋa ne.
Sefama tu Zabidi maa nii Vini tio-bia de ba ŋokem baŋa ne.
28Gederi tu Baal-Hanan mo nii Olivi teeni de kaporro telo na wo wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne to.
Joasa maa nii jei selo ba na tiŋi Olivi nuga kam da to baŋa ne.
29Saron tu Sitirayi déem mo nii naane delo na wo Saron pwola kam ne to.
Adali bu Safate de maa nii naane delo na wo bwollu tem kura ne to.
30Isameli dwi tu Obili mo nii kona yam baŋa ne.
Meronofa tu Jedeya maa nii bonɛ sem baŋa ne.
31Hagiri dwi tu Jazizi déem mo nii vare-balwa bam baŋa ne.
Dedɛɛra banto maama déem mo nii Pɛ David wonnu baŋa ne ba pa‑o.
32Jonatan na ye Pɛ David nabera to déem jege yi-poro chekke ye o yei tɔnɔ poponem. O maa woli David de kwea.
