All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David. 11 They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing:
“The Lord is good!
His faithful love for Israel
will last forever.”
Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun. 12 Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts. 13Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_text:
Ba daa lɔge kaanem bimbini ba zege
1Ko na yi bene dem chane serepɛ chana kam to, dedaane Isarele tiina bam laam zoore ba tete teene wone mo. Ba maama maa ke ni dedwe ba jeeri Jerusalem wone. 2Jozadaki bu Jesua na ye Wɛ kaanem tu to, de o dwonna kaanem tiina bam, de Selateli bu Zerubabel de o chorro tem ma bobo se ba lɔ Isarele tiina Wɛ wom bimbini dem. Ko nam ye se ba taa ke zwɛɛm kaanem mo de baŋa ne ba pa Wɛ, nenɛɛne Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kolo Moses na popone na bere tei to. 3Foone maa jege-ba de balo na zoore jei sem konto ne to. De konto de, ba ta chwi bimbini dem de déem na maŋe de zege mɛ to mo. Ba ma yɔɔre ba bobo ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem de baŋa ne ba pa Baŋa Wɛ dɛ maama, tetete de dedaan-ni ne. 4Ba ta di Vwoa chwiim kuri dem mo nenɛɛne Moses tɔnɔ kom na bere tei to. Kuri dem da yam maama wone, nɔɔna bam maa yeini ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem na maŋe se de ke tei dɛ maama to. 5Ba déem ta yeini ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem delo maama na maŋe se de ke dɛ dɛ to mo, de yalo na jege se ya ke chan-doŋa maŋa ne to, ko ta woli de yalo na maŋe de kura yadwonna ya maŋa ne, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba ni tei to. Ba ta yeini ba ja ba wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra ba ba ba pa Baŋa Wɛ mo. 6Bene dem konto chane serepɛ chana kam boboa dɛ dem wone mo nɔɔna bam déem bobo se ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ka maŋa ne de ba ya ta wo bobo se ba chwi Wɛ diga kam kabiri-beira.
7Ba laam ma ŋwe lɔra de gwaro telo na toŋe dɛ totoŋa to se ba toŋe ba pa-ba. Ba ta ma kwei wodiu, de sana, de nuga ba toŋe ba pa Tura tiina de Sidon tiina se ba ma yeigi da-kwollu ba tei ne. Banto ma zage Sedare teeni na wo Lebanon peero tem ne to ye ba daare ba ja dɛ sem ba tɔge Mɛditeranea naneo kom ba vo ba yi Jopa. Pɛ Sarusi déem mo pɛ chwoŋa se konto maama ke.
Ba bobo Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm
8Ko ye bena yalei bene dem wone nɔɔna bam na jwoori ba yi Jerusalem to, mo ba bobo se ba lɔ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam. Ko maa ye bene dem konto chane selei chana kam ne mo Selateli bu Zerubabel, de Jozadaki bu Jesua, de o dwonna kaanem tiina bam, dedaane Levi dwi tiina bam, ko woli de balo maama na jwoori ba ba to chɛ de totoŋa yam. Ba déem ma kwei diga kam lɔɔm totoŋa maama ba ke Levi dwi tiina balo na yi bena finlei ba daŋe to jeŋa ne, se ba taa nii ya baŋa ne. 9Levi dwi tiina balo na nii Wɛ diga kam tontoŋena baŋa ne to mo tento: Jesua de o bia, de o chorro tem, ko woli de Kadimeli de o bia, Binnui de Hodavia mo. Levi tiina balo de na ye Henadadi dwi nɔɔna to de ma woli da.
10Lɔra bam déem na yɔɔre ba chwi Baŋa Wɛ diga kabiri-beira kam to, mo kaanem tiina bam zo ba gwaaro ye ba daare ba vo ba zege ba zega jei ne, se ba wu ba nabwanno tem. Levi tiina balo na nwoŋi Asaf diga kam ne to de ma kwei zwe ba zege da, se ba maama zuli Baŋa Wɛ nenɛɛne Isarele tiina Pɛ David déem na bere se ba taa ke tei to. 11Ba déem ma mɔɔne lei ye ba sɛ-se ba ma seini Baŋa Wɛ ye ba ke‑o lei. Ba maa tɛ ba we:
“O tiini o lamma!
O swono kolo o na jege
Isarele tiina ŋwaane to
wora mo taa wuu!”
Nɔɔna bam maama ma tiini ba tei Baŋa Wɛ de kwor-dɛa, ba na beiri Baŋa Wɛ diga kam kuri to ŋwaane. 12Konto na jege ko ke to, kaanem tiina de Levi tiina de sam yiga tiina balo na ye nɔn-kwe to ma guli boboa Wɛ diga kam déem na ye tei to ye ba tiini ba laare de wo-chechɔgɔ. Ko nam ná ye balo na daare to, ba dedɛ laare de wopwolo mo. 13Ba maama sɔɔ kom ma tiini ko di baŋa pa se nɔɔna ware se ba pɔɔre ywoni de wo-chechɔgɔ daane. Sɔɔ kom déem ma ni yiga yiga.

english_text:
Foreigners
Want To Help Rebuild the Temple
1The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel. 2 So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
3But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
4Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building. 5During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work.
Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
6 In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
7Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
8-10 A letter was also written to Artaxerxes about Jerusalem by Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors, including the judges, the governors, the officials, and the local leaders. They were joined in writing this letter by people from Erech and Babylonia, the Elamites from Susa, and people from other foreign nations that the great and famous Ashurbanipal had forced to settle in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
11This letter said:
Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
12You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations. 13You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
14We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you. 15If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place. 16If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
17King Artaxerxes answered:
Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
18After your letter was translated and read to me, 19I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations. 20And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
21I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice. 22Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
23As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city.
Work on the Temple Starts Again
24 The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_text:
Juu tiina dona chege Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm
1Judah dwi dem dedaane Benjamin dwi dem dona déem ma ni we balo na zege Babilon ne ba ba to wora ba jwoori ba lɔ Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom diga kam mo. 2Ba na nigi to, ba ma vo Zerubabel de sam dem yiga tiina tei ba ta ba we, “Debam de zuli á Tu Wɛ nenɛɛne abam na ke tei to mo. Ko zege maŋa kalo Asiria teo pɛ Esara-hadon na jaane debam o ba o yage ywo-seeni to, dé yɔɔre dé ke kaanem dé pa‑o mo. Dé nam tu se dé woli abam wone mo se dé lɔ Wɛ diga kam.” 3Zerubabel, de Jesua, de Isarele sam yiga tiina badwonna bam ma leiri-ba ba we, “Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm dae debam de abam maama totoŋe. Debam yerane mo wó lɔ diga kam dé pa Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom, nenɛɛne pɛ Sarusi na pɛ debam ni se dé ke tei to.”
4Nɔɔna balo ya na maŋe ba zoore jei sem konto ne to laam ma kwaane se ba pa Judah tiina bam vɔna pare. Ba boboŋe déem ye se foone zo-ba se ba yage totoŋe dem mo. 5Ba ta ma vo ba yo teo kom dedɛɛra se ba cheiŋi totoŋa yam, pa se ya daa ware ya vo yiga. Ba ma lɛɛre ba ke konto ko zege Peresia teo pɛ Sarusi paare dim maŋa ne se ko yi maŋa kam Darusi de daa na jwoŋi Peresia paare o di to.
Ba chege Jerusalem teo kom lɔɔm
6Pɛ Zeregese déem na tu o ji Peresia pɛ maŋa kalo to, mo Judah tiina dona bam popone tɔnɔ ba vugimi o boboŋa Judah tiina bam seeni, de Jerusalem teo kom nɔɔna seeni.
7Konto na kɛ ye Atazeregese de daa ji Peresia pɛ maŋa kalo ne to, mo Biselam, de Miteredafe, de Tabeeli, de ba yuudwonna bam popone tɔnɔ ba toŋe ba pa pɛ wom. Ba déem popone tɔnɔ kom de Aram tiina taane mo ye ba daare ba leiri ko taane dem ba ga se nɔɔna lɔre ko kuri.
8Ko ta na wora ko wora to, Rehum de Simisayi de déem ma popone tɔnɔ ba pa Pɛ Atazeregese se ko vugimi o boboŋa Jerusalem teo kom nɔɔna seeni. Rehum déem mo ye teo kom yiga tu. Simisayi de maa ye dedɛɛro wolo na nii teo kom tɔnɔ poponem baŋa ne to. Ba na popone kolo to mo tento:
9“Teo kom yiga tu Rehum, de tɔnɔ poponem dedɛɛro Simisayi, dedaane dé dwonna bam maama mo popone tɔnɔ konto. Ba maa ye dé jei sem yiga tiina, de nakwa, de dedɛɛra balo na ye Ereki tiina, de Babilon tiina, de Elam tiina to, 10ko ta woli de nɔɔna balo maama Pa-faro Asurabanipali, o yere na tiini de zaŋe to, déem na wane o di ye o fe-ba se ba vo ba jeini Samaria teene dem ne, dedaane kateiri delo na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to.”
11Tɔnɔ kolo ba déem na popone ba pa pɛ wom to mo tento:
“Debam balo na ye Pɛ Atazeregese tontoŋena, ye dé zoore Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore jei sem ne to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa‑m. 12Pɛ, dé lage se n lɔre we Juu tiina balo na nwoŋi nmo tei Babilon ne ba jwoori ba ba ywo-seeni to laam wo Jerusalem teo kom wone mo. Ba nam lage se ba jwoori ba lɔ teo kom mo. Ko nam ye te-balɔrɔ kolo nɔɔna na chuli dé teo kom to mo. Ba wora ba lɔ teo kom kabiri sem ba tia mo, se ba jwoori ba kwɛ ko kabiri-beira kam. 13Nam ta‑n yei we ba ná jwoori ba lɔ ba teo kom ba zege, ye ko kabiri sem de kwaare daane se ti, Juu tiina bam daa bá sɛ se ba taa ŋwe lampwoo dwi maama. Konto ná kea, sabia yalo pɛ wom na yeini o jwoŋi o nɔɔna tei ne to wó muri mo. 14Debam nam na ye balo n na nii dé baŋa ne to ŋwaane mo dé vae se wo-balwaaro tento yi‑m. Dé popone tento dé ma kwoori nmo 15se n pa ba buŋi n nabaara lonne twanno tem wone ba nii. Nmo wó na we teo kom konto nɔɔna swoi chichuŋu mo. Ko zege faŋa faŋa to, ba yeini ba tiini ba daane pwa de dedɛɛra balo na tei-ba to mo. Ba na ye nankɔ-nyena to ŋwaane mo pɛ se nɔɔna déem chɔge ba teo kom. 16Pɛ, nam lɔre we nmo ná pɛ chwoŋa se ba jwoori ba lɔ teo kom konto, se ko kabiri sem maama zege se ti, nmo wó ga tega kalo maama na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem ne to mo.”
17Pɛ Atazeregese de ma toŋe kwora o leiri-ba o we:
“Amo Pɛ Atazeregese mo leiri teo yiga tu Rehum, de tɔnɔ poponem dedɛɛro Simisayi, ko ta woli de ba dwonna balo na zoore Samaria ne, de jei selo maama na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to. A jɔɔne abam. 18Ba pipiri tɔnɔ kolo á na popone to ba ke debam taane wone, ye ba ta ga-ko ba bere-ne. 19Amo pɛ ni se ba buŋi dé teo kom lonne twanno tem wone ba nii. A nam seene a maane we ko na nwoŋi faŋa to, Jerusalem teo kom su de nankɔ-nyena na swoi chichuŋu to mo. Ba yeini ba daane pwa mo ye ba ware ba ja. 20A ta nɛ we pa-fwaaro mo di Jerusalem teo paare, ye ba déem tei Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem, pa se jei sem konto nɔɔna ŋwe lampwoo dwi maama ba pa-ba. 21Konto ŋwaane nam pa-na-ba ni we ba daa yé lɔ teo kom, se ko taa nii amo ná pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba lɔ. 22Nam ta‑á yei-na se á ke lela á ke amo ni dem konto, se daanem daa yé ba amo paare dim baŋa ne.”
23Ba na yɔɔre ba ga Pɛ Atazeregese tɔnɔ kom ba bere Rehum, de Simisayi, de ba dwonna bam to, mo ba ke lela ba vo Jerusalem. Ba ma fe Juu tiina bam de dam pa se ba yage teo kom lɔɔm.
24Konto to ba déem fe Juu tiina bam mo pa se ba yage Jerusalem teo Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm. Totoŋa yam daa maa ba vei yiga se ko yi maŋa kam Darusi na jwoŋi Peresia paare o di ye ko ke bena yalei to.

english_text:
1 Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did. 2 So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
3Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple? 4Give us the names of the workers!”
5But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
6Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors sent a report to Darius, 7which said:
King Darius, we wish you the best! 8We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
9We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple. 10We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
11They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
12 We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple, 13-15 took its gold and silver articles, and put them in the temple of his own god in Babylon.
They also said that during the first year Cyrus was king of Babylonia, he gave orders for God's temple to be rebuilt in Jerusalem where it had stood before. So Cyrus appointed Sheshbazzar governor of Judah and sent these gold and silver articles for him to put in the temple. 16Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
17Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_text:
Ba daa bobo se ba lɔ Wɛ diga kam
1Maŋa kam konto ne, Wɛ sampwori Hagayi de Ido bu Zekaria déem zaŋe ba ŋɔɔne Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam ba bere Juu tiina balo na zoore Judah kateiri dem ne, de Jerusalem teo kom wone to. Ba kwei Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom yere mo ba ŋɔɔne de-ba, wonto na ye wolo na nii-ba to ŋwaane. 2Selateli bu Zerubabel de Jozadaki bu Jesua na nigi ba taane dem to, mo ba bobo se ba jwoori ba lɔ Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam. Wɛ sampwori sem déem maa wo ba tei ne se ba taa woli-ba.
3Tatenayi déem mo ye Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem yiga tu. O ma tɔge de Sefa-Bozenayi, de ba dwonna yiga tiina bam o vo Juu tiina bam tei ye o bwei-ba o we, “Wɔ mo pɛ abam chwoŋa se á jwoori á lɔ Wɛ diga kam, se á daare á kwɛ-ka á zege?” 4Ba ta ma ta ba we, “Popone-na balo na wora ba lɔ-ka to yera á pa debam se dé nii.” 5Peresia teo dedɛɛra bam nam wo chege totoŋa yam, Baŋa Wɛ yi na page Juu tiina nakwa bam baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Dedɛɛra bam déem boŋe se ba popone tɔnɔ ba tole taane dem ba bere Pɛ Darusi mo, se o ná leiri-ko, se ba laam lɔre ba na wó ke tei to.
6Tatenayi, de Sefa-Bozenayi, de ba dwonna yiga tiina bam na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to na popone tɔnɔ kolo ba pa Pɛ Darusi to mo tento:
7“Pɛ Darusi, yazura taa wo n tei ne.
8Dé lage se n lɔre we debam vei Judah kateiri dem ne, ye dé na diga kalo ba na wora ba lɔ se ba pa Wɛ-kamunu kom to. Nɔɔna bam jege kandwa-zana mo ba ma lɔ-ka, ye ba kwei da-kwoli-bigila ba ke ka yera ne. Tontoŋena bam nam zuri yera mo ba toŋa de yi-seena, ye lɔɔm dem vei yiga lanyerane.
9Dé ma bwei ba nakwa dé we, ‘Wɔ mo pɛ abam chwoŋa se á jwoori á lɔ Wɛ diga kam, se á daare á kwɛ-ka á zege?’ 10Dé nam ta bwei se dé lɔre tontoŋena bam yera mo se dé popone, se n lɔre balo na wo ba totoŋa yam yiga ne to.
11Ba de ma leiri ba we, ‘Debam ye Wɛ wolo na tei wɛyuu de tega baŋa to tontoŋena mo. Dé nam wora dé jwoori dé lɔ Wɛ diga kalo Isarele pa-kamunu wodwoŋi déem na lɔge ye o fɔge o kwɛ-ka o zege to mo. 12Debam nabaara déem ya pɛ se Telaao Tu Wɛ wom bane mo zaŋe de-ba. O de ma ve-ba o ke Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza na ye Chaladea dwi tu to jeŋa ne pa se o ba o chɔge ba Wɛ diga kam. O déem ta ma kale-ba o ja o vo o tete teo se ba taa zoore da. 13Ko nam na ye tei to, Pɛ Sarusi de déem daa na jwoŋi Babilon paare o di to, o paare dim boboa bene dem wone mo o pɛ ni se Juu tiina jwoori ba lɔ Wɛ diga kam. 14Pɛ Sarusi déem kwei sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno zela yalo Pɛ Nebukadeneza ya na le Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam ne o daare o ja-te o vo o zege o tete jwona diga kam ne to mo o jwoori o pa debam. O déem ma kwei-te o ke Sesebazare jeŋa ne se o taa nii te baŋa ne. Pɛ wom ya tiŋi wonto se o taa ye Judah kateiri dem yiga tu mo, 15ye o daare o pa‑o ni se o ja zela yam konto o jwoori o vo Jerusalem o tiŋi Wɛ diga kam ne. O ta wó jwoori o lɔ Wɛ diga kam o zege ka déem na maŋe ka wo jei selo to ne. 16Sesebazare nam seene o ke konto mo, pa se o bobo o chwi Wɛ diga kam kabiri-beira Jerusalem ne. Ko na zege maŋa kam konto ne se ko yi zem to, dé yɔɔre dé wora dé lɔ Wɛ diga kam mo. Totoŋa yam nam ta wo ti.’
17Pɛ, konto ŋwaane nam dé lwoori‑m mo se n pa se ba buŋi Babilon teo lonne twanno tem wone, se ba nii Pɛ Sarusi seene o pa ni we ba jwoori ba lɔ Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam naa o wo ke konto. Nmo laam ná nɛ kolo na wora to, se n bere debam n boboŋa na jaane tei to.”

english_text:
King Cyrus' Order Is Rediscovered
1King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia. 2Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said:
This official record will show 3that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built 27 meters high and 27 meters wide, 4with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything. 5Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places.
King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
6King Darius sent this message:
Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple. 7Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
8Starting at once, I am ordering you to help the leaders by paying their expenses from the tax money collected in Western Province. 9And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil. 10I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
11If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump. 12I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully.
The Temple Is Dedicated
13Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors carefully obeyed King Darius. 14 With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia. 15On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
16The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple. 17One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel. 18Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written.
The Passover
19 Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month. 20The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
21The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel. 22For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_text:
Pɛ Darusi na leiri tei to
1Pɛ Darusi ma pa ni se nɔɔna vo ba na yeini ba tiŋi Babilon teo lonne twanno tem mɛ to ba buŋi te wone se ba nii. 2Ko déem nam ye Medea kateiri dem te-fɔrɔ Ekebatana wone mo ba nɛ tɔnɔ, ye ko wo taane mo tento:
3“Pɛ Sarusi paare dim boboa bene dem wone mo o pɛ ni na tɔge Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam seeni to. O ni dem ye se ba jwoori ba lɔ-ka se ka taa ye jeiga kalo ba na wó taa ke ba kaanem da to mo. Ba jege se ba chwi ka kabiri-beira kam, ye ba pa se diga kam wɛyuu dedɔrem taa ye naba-laara fintɔ (30), se ka kayɔlɔ seeni de taa ye naba-laara fintɔ (30). 4Ba nam wó kwei kandwa-zana mo se ba ná tiŋi-ya ye ba lɔ kabira kam kuni betɔ, se ba kwei da-kwollu gena dedoa ba lɔ ba daŋe da. Ba jege se ba le sabu dé teo paare dim sabia wone mo ba ma ŋwe Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm jene dem. 5Ko ta woli da, sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno zela yalo Pɛ Nebukadeneza déem na le Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam wone o ja o vo o tiŋi Babilon ne to ye se ba jwoori ba ja-te mo ba vo ba zege te ya na wo Wɛ diga kam jei selo wone to.”
6Pɛ Darusi laam ma pa ni o we,
“Tatenayi na ye Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri yiga tu to, de Sefa-Bozenayi, de á dwonna yiga tiina bam na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to, ta‑á yei-na se á yé twɛ ba lɔɔm jei sem! 7Yé daane-na nɔɔna bam na wora ba lɔ Wɛ diga kam to. Yage-na Juu tiina yiga tu wom de ba nakwa bam se ba jwoori ba lɔ ba Wɛ diga kam ka jeiga ne.
8Amo nam ta pɛ ni mo se abam lɔre á na wó ke tei á woli Juu tiina nakwa bam se ba lɔ ba Wɛ diga kam to. Lampwoo kolo á na lae amo yere ŋwaane Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem ne to mo á wó le ko wone á pa-ba se ko ma ŋwe ba lɔɔm jena yam maama, se kolokolo yé che totoŋa yam. 9Dɛ maama wone nam ta pa-na kaanem tiina balo na wo Jerusalem ne to ba na lage kolo maama se ba ma ke kaanem ba pa Telaao Tu Wɛ wom to. Ba ná lage na-bale, de pi-bale, de pipeili se ba zwɛ ba ma ke kaanem, naa ba ná lage mena, de yɛ, de sana, de nuga, se á yɔɔre á pa-ba. 10Ke-na konto maama á pa-ba se ba wane ba ke kaanem delo na wó pwoli Telaao Tu Wɛ wom wo to, se ba daare ba lwoori Wɛ se o pa amo de a bia yazura.
11Nɔɔno wolo nam ná ve amo ni dem, se ba le beiŋa kotu diga kam yera ne ba daare ba sare-ka ba ma zɔ‑o ba go. Ba ta wó pa kotu sɔŋɔ kom ji tampuuri. 12Wɛ wolo na kuri Jerusalem teo kom se nɔɔna zuli o yere ko wone to nam wó pa se lɛɛro yi pɛ wolo, de nabiin-dwi delo maama na wó kwaane se o leiri amo ni dem to. Lɛɛro ta wó yi balo maama na boŋe se ba chɔge Wɛ diga kalo na wo Jerusalem ne to.
Amo Darusi mo pɛ ni dento. Nɔɔno maama nam jege se o sɛ-de mo chekke.”
Ba kwei Wɛ diga kam ba pa Baŋa Wɛ
13Tatenayi na ye Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri yiga tu to, de Sefa-Bozenayi, de ba dwonna yiga tiina bam ma yɔɔre ba tɔge pɛ wom ni dem. 14Juu tiina nakwa bam daa ta ma lɔ Wɛ diga kam ba vo yiga lanyerane, ye Wɛ sampwori Hagayi de Ido bu Zekaria de maa tɔɔle Wɛ kwora ba pae-ba baare. Ba ma seene ba lɔ-ka ba ti, nenɛɛne Isarele tiina Wɛ wom na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei to, ye Peresia teo pwa Sarusi, de Darusi, de Atazeregese de pa-ba ni tei to. 15Ko nam ye Pɛ Darusi paare dim bena yaredo bene dem wone, Adare chana kam da yatɔ dɛ ne mo ba lɔge-ka ba ti.
16Isarele tiina bam maama, de ba kaanem tiina, de Levi tiina, dedaane nɔɔna balo maama na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to laam ma kwei Wɛ diga kam ba pa Wɛ de wopwolo. 17Ba déem mɛ na-bale bi mo, de pi-bale bia yalei, de pipeili bia yana ba ke kaanem ba ma lwoori Wɛ swolim ba pa Wɛ diga kam. Ba ta kwei bo-bale fuga-selei mo ba ma ke wɛleera saarem kaanem Isarele dwia fuga-yalei yam ŋwaane. 18Ba ma pɔɔre kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam kɔgɔ kɔgɔ se kɔgɔ maama taa jege ko totoŋa ba toŋe ba pae Wɛ Jerusalem wone, nenɛɛne ko na popone Moses nia tɔnɔ kom ne tei to.
Ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem
19Balo na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to déem ma di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem boboa chana kam da fuga-yana dɛ ne. 20Kaanem tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam maama nam ya kwɛ ba tete Wɛ ŋwaane mo se ba maŋe de chullu tem. Levi tiina bam ma go Atɔgebabaŋa kaanem pipeili se ba ma kwɛ nɔɔna balo na jwoori to, de ba dwonna kaanem tiina bam, de ba tete de. 21Isarele tiina balo maama na nwoŋi Babilon ne ba jwoori ba ba to ma di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem. Balo maama de na pɔɔre ba tete de wo-zɔɔna kikia yalo dwi-gɛ tiina bam na kare ba ke to, ye ba laam ba se ba zuli Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom to ma tɔge ba di kuri dem. 22Ba ta ma kwei da yarepɛ ba di Bworobworo-memene kuri dem de wopwolo. Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ se ba di ywoni de o na pipiri Asiria teo pɛ boboŋa pa se o woli-ba se ba wane ba jwoori ba lɔ Isarele tiina Wɛ wom diga kam ba zege tei to.

english_text:
Ezra Comes to Jerusalem
1-6Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest.
Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
7Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
8-9God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month. 10Ezra had spent his entire life studying and obeying the Law of the Lord and teaching it to others.
Artaxerxes Gives a Letter to Ezra
11Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
12 Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
13-14Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
15When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem. 16Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
17Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem. 18If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God. 19Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple. 20If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
21Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you. 22They will be allowed to give as much as 3.4 tons of silver, 10 tons of wheat, 2,000 liters of wine, 2,000 liters of olive oil, and all the salt you need.
23They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me. 24We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
25Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them. 26Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away.
Ezra Praises God
27Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said:
Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem. 28God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_text:
Ezera yera taane
1Ko na wora ko wora ye Atazeregese ji Peresia teo pɛ to, mo nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem wora o yere na ye Ezera. Ezera déem ye Seraya bu mo. Seraya maa ye Azaria bu. Azaria maa ye Hilikia bu. 2Hilikia maa ye Salum bu. Salum maa ye Zadoki bu. Zadoki maa ye Ahituba bu. 3Ahituba maa ye Amaria bu. Amaria maa ye Azaria bu. Azaria de maa ye Merayofa bu. 4Merayofa maa ye Zerahia bu. Zerahia maa ye Yuzi bu. Yuzi maa ye Buki bu. 5Buki maa ye Abisua bu. Abisua maa ye Finehase bu. Finehase maa ye Eleaza bu, ye Eleaza ye Wɛ kaanem yiga tu Aron bu.
6Ezera déem ye tɔnɔ tu mo, ye o zamese Wɛ nia yam Moses na jwoŋi Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom tei ne o pa-ba to lanyerane. O de ma nwoŋi Babilon ne o jwoori Jerusalem. Pɛ wom nam ya pɛ‑o kolo maama o na lage to mo, kokuri to, o Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom zaane mo wo o yuu ne. 7Isarele tiina badwonna, de ba kaanem tiina, de Levi tiina, de lein-leena, de Wɛ diga ni yerena, de Wɛ diga tontoŋena bam maa tɔge ded‑o se ba vo Jerusalem. Pɛ Atazeregese paare dim bena yarepɛ bene dem ne mo ba vei da. 8-9Ko déem ye boboa chana kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo Ezera nwoŋi Babilon teo ne se o vo Jerusalem. O ma yi Jerusalem chane senu chana kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo, o Tu Wɛ wom na to o yiga ne to ŋwaane. 10Ko nam na ye tei to, Ezera boboŋa déem jaane se o seene o yia o zamese Baŋa Wɛ nia yam, se o taa ke o tɔge-ya, ye o daare o bere Isarele tiina bam ya bera yam de ya chullu tem mo.
Pɛ Atazeregese na pɛ Ezera tɔnɔ kolo to
11Pɛ Atazeregese nam ya kwei tɔnɔ mo o pa Ezera. Ezera déem ye Wɛ nia zamesem tu mo ye o ta ye Wɛ kaanem tu. O ma zamese Baŋa Wɛ nia yalo de o chullu telo o na pɛ Isarele tiina bam to. Tɔnɔ kom wo wonnu mo tento:
12“Amo Pɛ Atazeregese ye pwa maama pa-faro mo.
Amo popone tɔnɔ konto a pa Ezera na ye kaanem tu, ye o zamese Telaao Tu Wɛ wom nia yam to. Yazura taa wo n tei ne.
13Amo pɛ ni se a paare dim jei sem maama wone, Isarele tiina, de ba kaanem tiina, de Levi tiina balo maama ná kuri se ba jwoori Jerusalem, ba jege chwoŋa se ba tɔge‑m ba viiri. 14Amo de a nakwa barepɛ bam nam toŋe‑m se n vo n nii ko na ye tei nɔɔna balo na zoore Judah de Jerusalem jei sem ne to yera ne mo. Véi n nii nɔɔna bam kikia maŋe de n Tu Wɛ nia yalo o na ke n jeŋa ne to naa ya wo maŋe. 15Nam ta kwei lu-nyenno, de sabu-seŋa kalo amo de a nakwa bam na wó pa‑m to n woli da n ja n vo, se n ma-te n ke pɛɛre n pa Isarele tiina Wɛ wom na zoore Jerusalem teo wone to. Mo dé boboŋa na lage se n ke tei to. 16Nmo ná wae lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa kalo maama Babilon kateiri ne n lae, de wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra yalo Isarele tiina bam, de ba kaanem tiina na wó pa‑m se ya woli Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam totoŋa ŋwaane to, se n ja-te n viiri.
17Nam ta‑n yei se n kwei sabu kom konto n yeigi na-bale, de pi-bale, de pipeili, de wodiu pɛɛra, de sana pɛɛra. Nmo ma‑n wó ja-te n vo abam Wɛ wom diga kam Jerusalem ne, n ke kaanem o bimbini dem baŋa ne n pa‑o. 18Lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa kalo ná daare, se nmo de n dwonna bam kwei-te á ke á na lage tei to se ko maŋe de á Tu Wɛ boboŋa yam. 19Ko nam ná ye zela yalo amo na kwei a ke n jeŋa ne se ya woli Wɛ diga kam totoŋa to, se n ja-ya n jwoori Jerusalem n pa abam Wɛ wom. 20Abam nam ná gɛ woŋo se á ma á toŋe Wɛ diga kam totoŋe delo maama, n jege chwoŋa se n jwoŋi sabu dé teo paare dim sabia yam wone.
21Amo, Pɛ Atazeregese nam ta pɛ ni dento mo a sabu tiŋina balo maama na nii Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem to: Ke-na kolo maama Wɛ kaanem tu Ezera na lage to á pa‑o lela. Wonto nam ta ye Telaao Tu Wɛ wom nia yam zamesem tu mo. 22Á wó pa‑o o na wó bwei kolo á tei ne se ko yi lu-nyenno kilo morro tetɔ de bia yana (3,400), de mena ywollu bia yatɔ (300), de sana kuriwaa bia bi (100), de nuga kuriwaa bia bi (100). Ko nam ná ye yɛ, se á yé jeeli de ni. 23Ta‑á yei-na se á kwei kolo maama Telaao Tu Wɛ wom na laga o diga kam totoŋa ŋwaane to á pa Ezera. Kokuri to, ko dae se o bane zaŋe de amo naa balo na saŋe amo kwaga ba di paare to. 24Amo nam ta pɛ ni we, ko ná ye Wɛ kaanem tiina, de Levi tiina, de lein-leena, de Wɛ diga ni-yerena, de ka tontoŋena, de balo na toŋe totoŋa yadwonna Wɛ diga kam ŋwaane to, ko dae se á jwoŋi lampwoo banto tei ne.
25Ko nam ná ye nmo Ezera, kwei swa yalo n Tu Wɛ wom na pɛ‑m to, se n kuri nɔɔna badwonna se ba taa nii balo maama na zoore Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni ye ba tɔge nmo Tu Wɛ wom nia yam to. Dedɛɛra bam konto wó tɔge chega ba di nɔɔna bam taana ba pa-ba. Balo nam na yeiri Wɛ nia yam to, se n kwei-ya n bere-ba. 26Wolo ná ve nmo Wɛ wom nia yam, de amo paare nia yam, ba jege se ba yɔɔre ba waare kotu mo. Ba ná wo go‑o, se ba mage gulu ba zeili‑o o teo wone. Ko ná dae konto, se ba vere o jejegero, naa ba vɔ‑o ba pe diga ne.”
Ezera ke Wɛ lei
27Ezera ma ta o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na ye dé nabaara Wɛ to maŋe de tia mo! Wonto mo pɛ se pɛ wom boboŋa ja se Wɛ diga kalo na wo Jerusalem wone to na zula yanto dwoŋi. 28Baŋa Wɛ ta tɔge o swono kom baŋa o pa se amo kikia su pɛ wom yi, ye o nakwa de o dedɛɛra de nege-ne. Amo Tu Wɛ zaane na wo amo yuu ne to ŋwaane mo a nɛ baare. Amo ma la Isarele yiga tiina badwonna a ke daane, a daare a pa se ba tɔge de amo ba vo Jerusalem.”

Balo na dɛ de Ezera ba jwoori Jerusalem to yera
1Pɛ Atazeregese paare dim maŋa ne mo dé zege Babilon teo ne se dé jwoori dé vo Jerusalem. Ba na jeeli sam yiga tiina balo na tɔge de amo ba jwoori to yera mo tento:
2Geresom mo nwoŋi Finehase sɔ-yuu kom ne.
Danyeli ma nwoŋi Itamara sɔ-yuu kom ne.
3Sekania bu Hatusi ma nwoŋi David sɔ-yuu kom ne.
Zekaria de baara bi de finnu (150) badwonna ma nwoŋi Parose sɔ-yuu kom ne. Baara bam konto nabaara natɔga kam déem popone ka tiŋi tɔnɔ ne mo.
4Zerahia bu Eli-hoyenayi de baara bia yalei (200) badwonna ma nwoŋi Pahafe-Moaba sɔ-yuu kom ne.
5Jahazeli bu Sekania de baara bia yatɔ (300) badwonna ma nwoŋi Zaatu sɔ-yuu kom ne.
6Jonatan bu Ebedi de baara finnu (50) badwonna ma nwoŋi Adin sɔ-yuu kom ne.
7Atalia bu Jesaya de baara fuserepɛ (70) badwonna ma nwoŋi Elam sɔ-yuu kom ne.
8Mikayeli bu Zebadia de baara funɔnɔ (80) badwonna ma nwoŋi Sefatia sɔ-yuu kom ne.
9Jeheli bu Obadia de baara bia yalei de fuga-nana (218) badwonna ma nwoŋi Joaba sɔ-yuu kom ne.
10Josifia bu Selomifa de baara bi de fuseredo (160) ma nwoŋi Bani sɔ-yuu kom ne.
11Bebayi bu Zekaria de baara finlei-nana (28) badwonna ma nwoŋi Bebayi sɔ-yuu kom ne.
12Hakatan bu Johanan de baara bi de fuga (110) badwonna ma nwoŋi Azagadi sɔ-yuu kom ne.
13Elifeleti, de Jeweli, de Semaya, de baara fuseredo (60) badwonna ma nwoŋi Adonikam sɔ-yuu kom ne.
14Yutayi, de Zakura, de baara fuserepɛ (70) badwonna ma nwoŋi Bigavayi sɔ-yuu kom ne.
Ezera kwei chwoŋa o maa vei Jerusalem
15Amo Ezera déem ma ta se dé kɔgɔ kom jeeri bu-nɔgɔ kolo na duri ko maa vei Ahava seeni to ni ne. Dé ma chwi dé vwoa dé ke da yatɔ dáane. Amo na nii to, mo a maane we Levi tiina tera dé kɔgɔ kom wone, se kaanem tiina yera mo wora. 16A laam ma toŋe a bwoŋi yiga tiina banto: Eliazera, de Areli, de Semaya, de Elinatan, de Jaribi, de Elinatan, de Natan, de Zekaria, de Mesulam. A ta ma toŋe Joyariba, de Elinatan kwaga ne, ba na ye yi-pore-nyena to ŋwaane. 17Amo laam ma toŋe-ba Ido tei ne. Wonto mo ye Levi tiina balo na zoore Kasifia ne to yiga tu. A ma bere-ba ba na wó ta kolo de Ido de o chorro na toŋe Wɛ diga kam totoŋa Kasifia ne to. A déem lage se ba le tontoŋena se ba ba ba taa toŋe ba pa Wɛ o diga kam ne. 18Dé Tu Wɛ wom nam na to debam yiga to ŋwaane mo ba toŋe Serebia se o ba dé tei. O déem ye Levi dwi tu na nwoŋi Mahili sɔ-yuu kom ne to mo. O maa ye boboŋa tu lanyerane. O bia de o chorro fuga-nana ma tɔge ded‑o ba ba. 19Ba ta pɛ se Hasabia, de Jesaya, de ba chorro finlei mo tɔge ba ba dé tei ne. Banto ye Merari sɔ-yuu kom tiina mo. 20Ko ta woli da, ba pɛ se Wɛ diga kam tontoŋena bia yalei de finlei (220) mo ba dé tei. Pɛ David de o dedɛɛra bam déem mo kuri nɔɔna bam konto nabaara se ba yeini ba toŋe ba woli Levi tiina bam. Ba ma popone ba maama yera ba tiŋi tɔnɔ ne.
Ba na ti ba yiga se ba kɛ tei to
21Dé déem na wo Ahava bu-nɔgɔ kom ni ne konto to, a ma pa ni se dé vɔ ni dé ma dé gwooni dé tete dé Tu Wɛ yiga ne. Dé ma lwoori Wɛ se o kwɛ dé chwoŋa se ka ke lam, se o daare o kwoli debam, de dé bia, dedaane dé jejegero chwoŋa kam yuu ne. 22Ko na ye tei to, dé lwoori yiga dé ta de pɛ wom we, dé Tu Wɛ wom yeini o to balo na zuli‑o to yiga ne se cham yé yi-ba mo. Dé ta tage we, Wɛ bane yeini de zaŋe de balo na ve‑o to mo. Ko laam ma pa se chaveera jege-ne se a lwoori pɛ wom se o pa debam jar-keira balo na dɔge sisein-nɔɔna baŋa ne to se ba taa yere debam chwoŋa kam yuu ne, se dé dona yé daane debam. 23Konto ŋwaane dé ma vɔ ni ye dé ja Wɛ teiŋa se o woli debam. O ma sɛ dé wɛ-lworo kom.
24Amo ma le nɔɔna fuga-balei kaanem yiga tiina bam wone. A ta ma kuri Serebia, de Hasabia, de ba chorro fuga badwonna a woli da. 25Amo laam ma maŋe lu-nyenno tem, de sabu-seŋa kam, de zela yalo maama na ye se ba ma-ya ba toŋe Wɛ diga kam totoŋa to, ye a daare a kwei-te a ke kaanem tiina bam jeŋa ne. Pɛɛra yam konto mo pɛ wom, de o nakwa bam, de o dedɛɛra bam, de Isarele tiina bam maama pɛa. 26A na jeeli wonnu telo a ke ba jeŋa ne to mo tento:
Lu-nyenno tem dunni ye kilo morro finlei (20,000) mo.
Lu-nyenno zela bi (100) dunni ye kilo fuserepɛ (70).
Sabu-seŋa kam dunni ye kilo morro tetɔ de bia yana (3,400) mo.
27Sabu-seŋa zwe finlei dunni ye kilo nana de chichworo (8.5).
Channa zele-laaro telei, te na jege yuu te maŋe de sabu-seŋa zela to.
28Amo ma ta de kaanem tiina bam a we, “Abam pɔɔre mo á ye á yera Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Zela yanto de nam pɔɔre mo ya ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem. Sabu-seŋa kam, de lu-nyenno tem maama ye nɔɔna bam wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra mo ba na kwei ba pa abam nabaara Baŋa Wɛ wom. 29Ta‑á nii-na te baŋa ne lanyerane, se á ja-te á yi Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam wone. Á ná yi da, se á kwei-te á ja zo Wɛ diga kam wone á daare á maŋe te ni kaanem tiina di sem ne. Á laam wó kwei-te á ke Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam, de Levi tiina, de Isarele sɔ-yuni yiga tiina bam jeŋa ne.”
30Amo na tage konto a ti to, kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam ma sɛ se ba ja lu-nyenno tem, de sabu-seŋa kam, de lonne zela yam konto maama ba vo Jerusalem ba tiŋi debam Tu Wɛ diga kam wone.
Ba na zaŋe ba jwoori Jerusalem tei to
31Boboa chana kam da fuga-yalei dɛ dem wone mo dé zaŋe Ahava bu-nɔgɔ kom jei sem ne se dé vo Jerusalem. Debam na wo chwoŋa yuu ne dé maa vei to mo dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ déem wo dé tei ne, ye o che debam pa se dé dona de venverena wo daane debam. 32Dé ma vo dé yi Jerusalem, ye dé maŋe da dé sii da yatɔ.
33Da yana na kɛ to, mo dé zo dé Tu Wɛ wom diga kam. Dé ma maŋe lu-nyenno tem, de sabu-seŋa kam, de lonne zela yam maama, ye dé daare dé kwei-te dé ke kaanem tu Yuria bu Meremofa jeŋa ne. Finehase bu Eleaza de maa wo o tei ne, ko woli de Levi tiina balei: Jesua bu Jozabadi, dedaane Binnui bu Noadia. 34Dé ma maŋe kolo maama dé na jaane dé ba to, ye dé jeeli-te te ni ne. Maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔ mo ba popone te dunni dem maama ba tiŋi.
35Nɔɔna balo maama na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori ba ba to ma kwei vara ba zwɛ ba ma ke kaanem ba pa Isarele tiina Wɛ wom. Ko nam ye na-bale fuga-selei (12) mo ba go Isarele tiina bam maama ŋwaane, de pi-bale funogo-seredo (96), de pipeili fuserepɛ-serepɛ (77). Ba kwei vara bam konto maama ba zwɛ ba ke kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ba ta ma kwei bo-bale fuga-selei (12) ba ke wɛleere saarem kaanem. 36Nɔɔna bam ta ma kwei pɛ wom nia yalo o na popone tɔnɔ kom ne to ba pa yiga tiina de dedɛɛra balo na nii Yuferata wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem to. Ba de ma sɛ, ye ba woli nɔɔna bam de ba Wɛ diga kam totoŋa.

english_text:
Ezra Condemns Mixed Marriages
1Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said:
Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
2Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
3This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock 4until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners.
Ezra's Prayer
5At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms, 6and prayed:
I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens. 7Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
8But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery. 9We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
10Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands 11that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things. 12 And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters.
Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
13You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home. 14Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all! 15Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_text:
Isarele tiina bam tusi kaana dim baŋa ne
1Wonnu tem konto maama na ke te kɛ to, Juu tiina yiga tiina badaara ma ba ba ta de amo ba we, “Isarele tiina bam, de ba kaanem tiina de Levi tiina badwonna wo sɛ se ba pwɛ ba tete de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na maŋe ba zoore tega kam wone to. Banto yɔɔre ba ke totoŋ-zɔɔna yalo Kanaan tiina, de Hiti tiina, de Pɛrizi tiina, de Jebusi tiina, de Amon tiina, de Moaba tiina, de Ejipti tiina, de Amori tiina bam maama na yeini ba ke to dwoŋi mo. 2Ko nam na ke tei to, Isarele tiina baara mo vei ba kwei teene dem konto bukwa se ba taa ye ba kaana. Ba ta swo teene dem bukwa mo ba pa ba bia. Konto ma pa se dwi delo ya na ye de yera Wɛ ŋwaane to laam galeme ba tete de dwia yalo na gilimi-ba to. Ko nam ye ba dedɛɛra bam de ba yiga tiina bam mo chɔge ba dwoni.”
3Ba taane dem yɔɔre de chɔge a wo mo pa se a ja a gwaaro a kaare. A ta ma vaŋe a yu-ywei, de a twana a vuuri. A ma daare a jei tega ne de wo-chechɔgɔ. 4Balo maama na kɔre foone de Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ nia yam to ma ba, ye ba de jeini amo tei ne, balo na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to na ke ba tusi tei to ŋwaane. Amo maa yɔɔre a jei de wo-chechɔgɔ konto taa, se ko yi dedaan-ni kaanem maŋa kam.
5Dedaan-ni kaanem maŋa kam na yi to, a ma zege a ya na jei mɛ de a gare-kekwarro tem to a zaŋe wɛɛne. A laam ma kuni a nadwoona, ye a daare a zeiŋi a je sem a jeeri a Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. 6A ma lwoori Wɛ ye a we:
“Amo Tu Wɛ, chaveera tiini ya jege-ne se a kwoni a yibia a nii nmo seeni. Debam wɛleera yam diini vili vili mo ya dwoni dé yuni tem na yi mɛ to. Dé na chɔge tei to maŋe ko di ko gaale wɛyuu na wo mɛ to mo. 7Se ko nwoŋi faŋa to, debam dedaane dé nabaara bam yɔɔre dé ke dé chɔge nmo yiga mo. Dé wɛleera yam na wo dé yuu ne to ŋwaane nam mo pɛ se teene dedwonna pwa jege dam debam, de dé pwa, dedaane dé kaanem tiina bam baŋa ne, pa se ba go debam badwonna, ye ba ja debam badwonna de ba vo ba yage ba teene wone. Ba ta vere debam jejegero mo, ye ba ta kwori ba ke debam chaveera, nenɛɛne ko na ye tei dé yera ne zem to.
8Leile konto debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam ke zaane debam yuu ne maŋa kukua kanto wone, ye o pa dé kɔgɔ fenfee jwoori ko nwoŋi dé kabɛɛne dem wone se ko bwoŋi o yere. O ta pɛ se dé na kugu jei o tete teo kom ne, ye dé ŋwea jwoori ka ke lam. Dé laam nɛ siu fenfee dé kabɛɛne totoŋa yam baŋa ne. 9Kokuri to, dé ye kabɛ mo. Dé Tu Wɛ wom nam wo ve debam o yage dé kabɛɛne dem wone. O dɛ o swono kom baŋa ne mo, o pa se Peresia pwa bam ke debam lanyerane. O ma pa debam chwoŋa se dé taa ŋwe ye dé wane dé jwoori dé lɔ dé Wɛ wom diga kam, dé daare dé jwoori dé kwɛ-ka pa ka zege. O ma daare o kwoli debam Jerusalem teo kom wone, de Judah jei sem maama ne.
10Debam Tu Wɛ, wonnu tento maama na ke to, dé nam daa jege bɛ mo se dé ta? Debam daa mo ve nmo nia yam, 11nmo na tɔge n ni-jwoŋina bam baŋa n kwei-ya n pa debam to. Nmo sampwori sem konto déem kaane debam ba we, ‘Nɔɔna balo na zoore tega kalo á na wó zo ka wone á jwoŋi-ka to yɔɔre ba ke totoŋ-zɔɔna mo. Tega kam ni maama maa su dedaane ba wo-yɔɔro kikia, pa se ka maama chɔge. 12Konto ŋwaane, abam yé sɛ se á bukwa zo ba bia, se á ta yé pa á bia de di ba bukwa ba ma ji ba kaana. Daa á yé woli-ba kɔtaa, naa á ke kolo na wó pa-ba yazura to. Á ná pwɛ á tete de-ba konto, á kɔgɔ kom wó ke dam, ye á di tega kam ywoni. Á ta wó daare tega kam á pa á kwaga kam se ba de taa zoore da taa wuu.’
13Tɔ. Dé Tu Wɛ, dé nam yei we dé wo-lwanno tem na wo dé yuu ne to ŋwaane mo dé nɛ waarem dento. De ko de, nmo na waare debam tei to wo yi dé ya na maŋe se dé jwoŋi-de tei to. Kokuri to, nmo yage debam badaara mo, se dé kɔgɔ fenfee taa wora se ko bwoŋi nmo yere. 14Konto to, dé wó wane dé daa ve nmo nia yam se dé di puseŋ-nyena banto bukwa na? Dé ná ke konto, nmo bane wó tiini de zaŋe de debam mo, pa se n chɔge debam maama n ti, ye dé wolowolo bá daare. 15Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye chega tu mo. Nmo nam pɛ se debam lu dé kabɛɛne dem wone pa se dé kɔgɔ fenfee zem wo n yiga ne. Dé wɛleera yam nam wo dé yuu ne mo, ye dé ba jege bora nmo tei ne.”

english_text:
The Plan for Ending Mixed Marriages
1While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
2Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said:
Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel, 3if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
4Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
5Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah. 6Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
7-8The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
9Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
10Ezra the priest stood up and said:
You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty! 11Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
12Everyone in the crowd shouted:
You're right! We will do what you say. 13But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
14Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
15Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
16Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month, 17and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year.
The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
18-19Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering:
Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers; 20Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer; 21Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim; 22Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
23Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also known as Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
24Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife.
These temple guards had foreign wives:
Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
25Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives:
Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
26Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
27Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
28Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
29Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
30Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
31-32Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah from the family of Harim;
33Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
34-37Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu from the family of Bani;
38-42Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph from the family of Binnui;
43Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
44These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_text:
Nɔɔna bam yage ba kaana balo na ye dwi-gɛ bukwa to
1Ezera déem lwoori Wɛ mo, ye o sɛ we Isarele tiina bam ke wɛleera yanto ba chɔge Wɛ yiga. O ma yɔɔre o ka yi-na, ye o vwi o yibia tega ne Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ kom ne. Isarele tiina bam kɔ-fɔrɔ ma la daane ba yi o tei ba de tɔge ba keeri dedɛ. Ko maa ye baara, de kaana, de bia mo wora konto. 2Jeheli na ye Elam dwi tu to bu Sekania ma ta de Ezera o we, “Chega ŋwaane to, debam ywori dé Tu Wɛ kwaga ne dedaane dé na di dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa banto na nwoŋi teene delo na gilimi debam to. De ko de, dé yei we teena ta wora ya pae Isarele tiina. 3Debam nam zege se dé gwoni ni mo de dé Tu Wɛ wom we, dé wó yage kaana banto maama de ba bia se ba viiri. Debam ti yiga se dé sɛ nmo, de balo maama na kɔre foone de dé Tu Wɛ nia yam ye á ta se dé ke kolo to. Nam pa se ko ke ko tɔge Wɛ nia yam na bere tei to. 4Nmo mo jege se n ke keim. Nam ta‑n jege baare, se dé zege n kwaga ne.”
5Ezera ma pɛ o zaŋe ye o pa se kaanem yiga tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam, dedaane Isarele tiina bam maama du duuri we, ba wó ke tei maama Sekania na tage to. Ba maama ma seene ba du duuri. 6O laam ma yage Wɛ diga kam jei sem ye o vo Eliasibi bu Jehohanan diga ne o peini da. O na wora konto to, o ma ve se o di wodiu, naa se o nyɔ na, o wo na chɔge de Isarele tiina balo na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to na ywori Wɛ kwaga ne tei to ŋwaane.
7Ba déem ma tɔɔle kwora pa se ka jage Jerusalem teo kom de Judah jei sem maama ne, we balo na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to maama ba ba jeeri Jerusalem teo ne. 8Nakwa de yiga tiina bam ni dem konto bere we, da yatɔ ná yia, ye wolo ná wo tɔge o jeeri da, konto tu wó ga o jejegero maama mo, se ba daare ba le‑o ba kɔgɔ kom wone.
9Da yatɔ dɛ dem na yi to, mo baara balo maama na zoore Judah de Benjamin jei sem ne to tu Jerusalem teo ne. Chane nogo chana kam da finlei dɛ ne mo ba déem jeeri Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ kom ne. Nɔɔna bam na jei da konto to, ba yera maa sae, ba jeerim dem na ye wo-chɛɔ, ye doa ta na nena dedɛ de dɛ dem ne to ŋwaane. 10Wɛ kaanem tu Ezera ma zaŋe wɛɛne ye o ta de-ba o we, “Abam seene á ywori Wɛ kwaga ne de á na di ka-gɛ se ba taa ye á kaana to. Abam wɛleera yam konto maa wo Isarele tiina bam maama yuu ne. 11Nam ve-na á wɛleera yam á nabaara Baŋa Wɛ wom yiga ne, se á daare á ke kolo na wó tɔge o boboŋa to. Pɔɔre-na á tete de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na zoore tega kanto ne to, se á daare á yage á ka-gɛ sem se ba viiri.”
12Kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama ma leiri de kwor-dɛa ba we, “Nmo taane dem ye chega mo. De nam wó ke nmo na bere se dé ke tei to! 13Dé nam na zege ywo-seeni to, dé tiini dé daga, ye dé daa ware ywo se dé zege taa, ko na ye yadɛ ye doa nena dedɛ to ŋwaane. Taane dento dae se dé kwei dɛ dedwe naa da yalei yerane se dé kwɛ-de. Ko ye debam dedɛ mo zo wɛleere dento wone. 14Nmo nam ná sɛ, pa se dé yiga tiina bam ja taane dem ba pa debam maama. Dé teene dem maama wone wolo maama ná jege dwi-gɛ tiina bukɔ o di o ke kaane, kotu wó tɔge de o teo kom nakwa, de balo na nii ba teo kom taana baŋa ne to, ba ba maŋa kalo dedɛɛra bam na kuri se ba kwɛ o taane dem to. Konto wó pa se Wɛ bane zuri de de na zaŋe debam keim dento baŋa ne tei to.”
15Nɔɔna bam maama ma sɛ taane dem konto. Asaheli bu Jonatan, de Tikeva bu Jahazeya yerane mo ve-de, ye Mesulam, de Levi dwi tu Sabetayi pu ba kwaga.
16Balo déem na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to ma sɛ se ba ke kolo ba na tage to. Wɛ kaanem tu Ezera de ma le baara badwonna na ye sɔ-yuu yiga tiina to, ye o popone ba yera o tiŋi. Chane fuga kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo ba bobo se ba nii taane dem baŋa ne. 17Ba ma kwei chane setɔ ba buŋi ba lɔre Isarele tiina balo na jege ka-gɛ sem to.
Balo na di dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa to yera
18Ba déem nɛ we, balo na nwoŋi Wɛ kaanem tiina dwi wone ye ba di dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa to mo tento:
Jozadaki bu Jesua de o chorro sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Maaseya, de Eliazera, de Jaribi, de Gedalia.
19Ba déem ma pwooli we ba wó yage ba kaana bam. Ba maama dedoa dedoa ma kwei pi-bala ba ma ke kaanem ba wɛleera yam saarem ŋwaane.
20Imera sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Hanani, de Zebadia.
21Harim sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Maaseya, de Elija, de Semaya, de Jeheli, de Yuzia.
22Pasura sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Elio-Enayi, de Maaseya, de Isameli, de Netaneli, de Jozabadi, de Elasa.
23Levi dwi tiina bam wone maa ye:
Jozabadi, de Simeyi, de Kelaya (ba ta bwoi‑o we Kelita mo), de Petahia, de Judah, de Eliazera.
24Lein-leena bam wone maa ye:
Eliasibi.
Wɛ diga ni-yerena bam wone maa ye:
Salum, de Telem, de Yuri.
25Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama wone balo na di dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa to mo tento:
Parose sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Ramia, de Izia, de Malakija, de Mijamina, de Eleaza, de Malakija, de Benaya.
26Elam sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Matania, de Zekaria, de Jeheli, de Abidi, de Jeremofa, de Elija.
27Zaatu sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Elio-Enayi, de Eliasibi, de Matania, de Jeremofa, de Zabadi, de Aziza.
28Bebayi sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Jehohanan, de Hanania, de Zabayi, de Atelayi.
29Bani sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Mesulam, de Maluki, de Adaya, de Jasubi, Seala, de Jeremofa.
30Pahafe-Mowaba sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Adana, Chelali, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Bezaleli, Binnui, de Manasɛ.
31Harim sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Eliazera, de Issiya, de Malakija, de Semaya, de Simeon, 32de Benjamin, de Maluki, de Semaria.
33Hasum sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Matenayi, de Matata, de Zabadi, de Elifeleti, de Jeremayi, de Manasɛ, de Simeyi.
34Bani sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Maadayi, de Amiram, de Yuweli, 35de Benaya, de Bedeya, de Cheluhi, 36de Vania, de Meremofa, de Eliasibi, 37de Matania, de Matenayi, de Jaasu.
38Binnui sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Simeyi, 39de Selemia, de Natan, de Adaya, 40de Makenadebayi, de Sasayi, de Sarayi, 41de Azareli, de Selemia, de Semaria, 42de Salum, de Amaria, de Josefa.
43Nebo sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye:
Jeyeli, de Matitia, de Zabadi, de Zebina, de Jadayi, de Joweli, de Benaya.
44Nɔɔna banto maama mo nam ya jege dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa ba di. Ba ma yage ba kaana bam konto de ba bia pa se ba viiri.

english_text:
Nehemiah's Prayer
1I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done.
During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa, 2when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
3They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
4When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
5 Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands. 6I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned 7by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
8 Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations. 9 But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
10Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power. 11Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_text:
Nehemia yiga na wo Jerusalem wone tei to
1Hakalia bu Nehemia mo bere taane dento.
Ko na ke tei to mo tento: Ko déem maŋe de Peresia Pɛ Atazeregese paare dim bena finlei bene dem Kisilev chana kam ne mo. Amo Nehemia maa wo Susa te-fɔrɔ kom ne. 2Amo choro Hanani ma tɔge de nɔɔna badwonna o zege Judah teo ne o ba a tei. Amo ma bwei-ba se a lɔre Juu tiina balo fee na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori sɔŋɔ to yazura bwia. A daa ma bwei-ba Jerusalem teo kom bwia. 3Ba ma ta ba bere-ne we, “Juu tiina balo na wora to wo cham de chaveera wone. Jerusalem kabiri maama sirimi, ye mini zwɛ teo kom ni bworru tem.” 4Amo na nigi tento maama to, mo a jeini tega ne a keeri.
A kwei da dedɛ mo a vɔ ni, ye a yɔɔre a keera. A maa lwoori Wɛ ye a we:
5“Telaao Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, nmo ye kamunu mo, ye dé tiini dé kɔre‑m. N zege de chega mo n swono kom baŋa ne n swoi balo na swoi‑m ye ba tɔge n nia yam to, ne n na gwoni ni se n ke n pa-ba tei to. 6Jan ja! Nii amo seeni, se n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kolo a na lwoori wea de tete maama nmo tete nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam ŋwaane to. A lage a ta jaja we debam Isarele tiina yɔɔre dé ke wɛleera dedɛ. Chega to, amo, de a nabaara de tɔge dé woli da. 7Debam tiini dé toŋe puseŋa mo de nmo. Ko ná ye nmo nia yalo de chullu telo maama n na pɛ n tontoŋeno Moses se o bere debam to, dé ve se dé tɔge-ya mo.
8Nam guli we n ya maŋe n ta de Moses n we, ‘Abam Isarele tiina bam ná wo jaane chega de amo, a lage a jage abam mo a yage teene dedwonna wone. 9Se á nam ná jwoori se á ba amo tei ye á sɛ a nia yam, amo wó ja abam a jwoori mɛ a na kuri se á ta‑á zuli-ne da to, nenɛɛne á ná maŋe á jage á vo á wo jei selo maama ne de.’
10Amo Teiru Wɛ, yé swei we banto ye n tete nɔɔna de n tontoŋena mo. Ko nam ye nmo mo kwei n dam dem n ma n vere-ba n yage. 11Nam cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom se n daare n sɛ n tontoŋena bam maama na beeri nmo zula to de ba na lwoori kolo to. Pa se pɛ wom duri a yibwona se a na yiga-veiŋa zem.”
Kanto maŋa kam ne amo zoore de pɛ wom mo a nii o wodiu baŋa ne.

english_text:
Nehemiah Goes to Jerusalem
1During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed. 2So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.”
Even though I was frightened, 3 I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
4The king asked, “What do you want me to do?”
I prayed to the God who rules from heaven. 5Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
6The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
7Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah? 8I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
9The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors. 10But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel.
Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
11Three days after arriving in Jerusalem, 12I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on. 13I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned. 14On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey. 15So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
16None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work. 17But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
18Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said.
Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
19When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
20I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_text:
Nehemia vei Jerusalem
1Ko kwaga ne, chane sena mo kɛ ye Nisan chana kam yi. Dɛ dedwe pɛ Atazeregese na jei o di wodiu to, mo a jaane sana a zo o tei se a pa‑o. Pɛ wom nam maŋe o wo nɛ amo yi-nyɔna a totoŋa baŋa ne. 2O ma bwei-ne o we, “Bɛ mo ke ye n yibia nyɔne konto? A ba boŋe we n weela. Woŋo mo daane‑m na?” O taane dem ma yɔɔre de pa a bochare di, 3pa se a leiri we, “Pɛ, Wɛ wó pa‑m momwɛ-dɛɛre. Amo wo wó ke tɛ mo ko pwoli ye teo kolo ba na suli a nabaara bam da to laam jigi di-dwonnu? Ko ni bworru tem maama de maa zwɛ zwɛ.” 4Peresia teo pɛ wom maa bwei-ne o we, “Nmo nam lage se a ke bɛ mo a pa‑m?”
A ma ware Telaao Tu Wɛ wom a wone se o woli-ne, 5ye a laam leiri pɛ wom a we, “Pɛ, nmo yi ná su de amo kikia, ye n sɛ se n ke a na lage tei to, se n toŋe-ne se a jwoori Judah teo kolo wone ba déem na suli a nabaara bam to. Amo boŋe se a ná yi da, se a jwoori a lɔ teo kom kabiri sem mo a pe.” 6Ka-pɛ wom déem jei pɛ wom saŋa ne mo. Pɛ wom ma bwei-ne a na wó dáane da tei, dedaane maŋa kalo a na wó jwoori to. O na sɛ se o toŋe-ne konto to, a ma ta a bere‑o a na wó ke kolo maama to.
7A ta lwoori pɛ wom a we, “Nmo ná sɛ se n ke-ne zaane, pa-ne twanno telo a na wó pa nmo dedɛɛra balo na tei Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore laŋa kam to. Twanno tem konto wó woli se a kɛ a yi Judah se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé daane-ne chwoŋa ne. 8A ta lwoori‑m se n pa-ne tɔnɔ se a ja vo a pa Asaf, o na nii pɛ goa kam baŋa ne to. A maa lage se o pa debam da-ŋwe se dé ma dé fɔge dé lɔ dalem jei sem na wo Wɛ diga kam yera ne to nia yam, de teo kom kabiri sem, dedaane sɔŋɔ kolo wone a na wó taa zoore to.” Pɛ wom ma pa-ne kolo maama a na lwoori o tei ne to, amo Tu Wɛ wom na to a yiga ne to ŋwaane.
9Pɛ wom déem ma pa se jar-keira yiga tiina de ba jar-keira na dɔge sisein-nɔɔna to tɔge-ne se dé vo. A laam ma vo a yi nawuura yalo na bɛ Yuferata buga kam to, ye a kwei pɛ wom twanno tem a pa dedɛɛra balo na tei laŋa kam konto to. 10Ko daare Sanbalati, wonto ye Bɛte-Horon teo tu mo. Tobia de maa ye Amon laŋa kam yiga tu. Ba na nigi we nɔɔno tua se o beeri Isarele dwi tiina lanyerane to, mo ba wo tiini ko fuli.
11A na yi Jerusalem to, a ke da yatɔ da 12ye a wo pɛ se nɔɔn-nɔɔno lɔre Wɛ na bere-ne se a ke kolo a pa Jerusalem to. Amo laam ma zaŋe tete-koro ne a nwoŋi de a yuudwonna fenfee. Bonaga kalo amo déem na diini to mo ya ye varem wolo yerane dé na kwei dé woli da. 13Ko ta na ye tete to, mo a nwoŋi a tɔge Bwolo-seeni ni dem a kɛ. A laam ma tu a gaale Juru vole dem a vo a yi Tampuuri ni dem. A na kare a vei konto to, mo a nii a na teo kom kabiri sem na sirimi tei, dedaane mini dem na chɔge teo kom ni bworru tem tei to. 14A laam ma vo a yi Buli-yi ni dem, ye a ta vo Pɛ Chɔgɔ kom seeni. Bonaga kam a na diini to ma ga chwoŋa se ka tɔge kalankula de weero tem wone ka kɛ. 15Ko ma pa se a kwei bwolo chwoŋa kam a vei a maa kɛa, ye a bare a nii teo kabira kam tete dem konto ne. A laam ma jwoori a kwei chwoŋa kalo a ya na dɛ da a vo to, ye a tɔge Bwolo-seeni ni dem a daa zo teo kom wone.
16Teo kom nakwa bam wolowolo yeiri amo ya na vei to, de a na maŋe a ke kolo maama to. A nam wo tage kolokolo de a dwonna Juu tiina bam, ko ná ye ba kaanem tiina bam, naa ba nakwa bam, naa ba yiga tiina bam, naa balo maama na wó da ba toŋe totoŋe dem to de. 17Amo laam ma ta de-ba a we, “Nii-na dé na wo lɛɛro telo wone to. Jerusalem teo kom laam jigi di-dwonnu mo, ye ko bworru tem de zwɛ zwɛ. Nam pa-na se dé jwoori dé lɔ ko kabiri sem dé zege, se dé daa yé taa jei de chaveera.” 18A ta ma ta a bere-ba a Tu Wɛ wom na to a yiga ne tei, dedaane pɛ wom na tage kolo de amo to. Ba de ma leiri ba we, “Dé wó zaŋe wɛɛne mo se dé toŋe!” Ba ma seene ba na dam se ba bobo totoŋe dem.
19Horon tu Sanbalati, de Amon tu Tobia, de Gɛsem na ye Arabi tu to ma ni dé na ti yiga se dé ke tei to. Ba ma ke debam ba mɔne ye ba we, “Abam boŋe se á ke tɛ mo? Á kikia yam nye de á boŋe se á nwoŋi Pa-faro wom kwaga ne mo.” 20A ma leiri-ba a we, “Debam ye Telaao Tu Wɛ wom tontoŋena mo. Wonto nam mo wó pa se dé vo yiga dedaane dé totoŋe maama, se dé bobo lɔɔm dem. Ko nam ná ye abam, á ba jege kolokolo se á jwoŋi Jerusalem ne ywo. Á nam ba tɔge á jege keim se á ke de debam chullu kikia.”

english_text:
Rebuilding the Wall of Jerusalem
1These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem:
The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
2The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
3The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
4Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall.
Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
5The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
6Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. 7Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
8Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section.
Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
9Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
10The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it.
Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
11Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
12Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
13Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for 440 meters, all the way to Garbage Gate.
14Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
15Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
16Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks.
Levites Who Worked on the Wall
17The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district; 18Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah; 19Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall; 20Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest; 21Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house.
Priests Who Worked on the Wall
22Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall:
Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
23Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses.
Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
24Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
25Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard.
Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall. 26He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived.
Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
27The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
28Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
29Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house.
Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
30Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them.
Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
31Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
32The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_text:
Ba jwoori ba lɔ Jerusalem kabiri sem
1Ko ye Wɛ kaanem yiga tu Eliasibi de o dwonna kaanem tiina déem mo zaŋe ba lɔ kabira kam na wo Pei Ni dem seeni to. Ba ma fɔge ba ke teo kom ni bworru tem da. Ba ta ma lɔ kabira kam ba vo ba yi Wonnu Bi di-dedɔrɔ kom, dedaane Hananeli di-dedɔrɔ kom. Ba ma kwei te maama ba pa Wɛ.
2Jeriko tiina bam ma lɔ kabira kalo na twoŋi da to.
Imiri bu Zakura de ma lɔ o twoŋi da.
3Hasena sɔ-yuu kom tiina de ma lɔ Ywona ni dem. Ba ma chwi de ywoa yam, ye ba daare ba ke de bworru tem te jei ne. Ba ta ma ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem.
4Yuria bu Meremofa, o ta na ye Hakoza naa to, de mo lɔge kabira kam o twoŋi da.
Berekia bu Mesulam, o ta na ye Mesezabela naa to, de mo lɔge o twoŋi da.
Baana bu Zadoki de maa lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi da.
5Tekoa teo kom tiina de ma nwoŋi ba lɔ ba twoŋi kabira kam. Ko daare, ba teo nakwa bam maa ve se ba ke totoŋ-dɛɛra yalo totoŋa yiga tiina bam na pɛ-ba se ba ke to.
6Ko ná ye Jesana ni dem, ko ye Pasea bu Joyada de Besodeya bu Mesulam déem mo kwɛ-de. Ba ma chwi de ywoa yam, ye ba daare ba ke de bworru tem te jei ne. Ba ta ma ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu mo se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem.
7Gibeon tu Melatia, de Meronofa tu Jadon, de Gibeon tiina bam, de Mizipa tiina mo ke daane ba lɔ kabira kam ba twoŋi da. Mizipa déem ye teo kolo Yuferata wɛ-zoore seeni laŋa dedɛɛro wom na zoore to mo.
8Harahaya bu Yuzeli déem ye sabu-seŋa gɔgɔ mo. O de ma lɔ o twoŋi da.
Hanania na yei terale nuga keim to, de ma lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi.
Banto ma fɔge ba kwɛ Jerusalem kabiri sem se ko vo ko yi Kabiri-kayɔlɔ kom seeni.
9Hura bu Refaya déem tei Jerusalem laŋa kam chichworo mo. O de ma lɔ o twoŋi da.
10Harumafa bu Jedaya de ma lɔ o twoŋi mɛ na bwola de o tete sɔŋɔ to.
Hasabeneya bu Hatusi de daa ma lɔ mɛ na twoŋi da to.
11Harim bu Malakija dedaane Pahafe-Moaba bu Hasubi de déem ma lɔ ba twoŋi kabira kam ne, ye ba daare ba kwɛ Jugu di-dedɔrɔ kom.
12Halohese bu Salum de déem na nii Jerusalem laŋa kadwoŋi kam to ma vo o lɔ o twoŋi da. O bukwa ma woli‑o de o totoŋa yam.
13Ko ná ye Bwolo-seeni ni dem, Hanun dedaane balo na zoore Zanoa teo ne to mo lɔge-de. Ba ma ke de bworru tem te jei ne ye ba ta ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem. Ba ta ma fɔge ba lɔ kabira kam se ka vo ka yi Tampuuri Ni dem. Ba na lɔge mɛ to dedɔrem wó yi jatwogo maŋem moro mo.
14Rekabi bu Malakija na nii Bɛte-Hakerem laŋa kam to ma fɔge o lɔ Tampuuri Ni dem. O ma ke de bworru tem te jei ne ye o ta ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem.
15Kola-Hozɛ bu Salum déem na nii Mizipa laŋa kam to ma fɔge o lɔ Buli-yi Ni dem. O ma pu-de ye o daare o ke de bworru tem te jei ne. O ta ma ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem. Ko ná ye Sela Chɔgɔ kom, o lɔge kabira mo pa se ka saŋe pɛ wom kaduga kam. Kabira kam ta tole ka yi nateina yalo na maa diini ya zoore David teo kom to mo.
16Azabuki bu Nehemia déem na nii Bɛte-Zura laŋa kam chichworo to ma lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi da se ka vo ka yi David yibeeli dem seeni, ka daare ka yi chɔgɔ kom, ko woli de jar-keira tiga jei sem seeni.
Levi tiina balo na lɔge kabira kam to
17Levi tiina badwonna de dɛ ba lɔ kabira kam:
Ko maa ye Bani bu Rehum mo lɔge o twoŋi daa kadwoŋi. Hasabia na ye Keila laŋa chichworo kom yiga tu to zege o laŋa kam yuu ne o lɔ o twoŋi da.
18Ko nam ná ye Keila laŋa chichworo kodwoŋi kom, Henadadi bu Binnui na ye ka yiga tu to de o chorro tem mo lɔge ba twoŋi da.
19Jesua bu Ezere déem na ye Mizipa yiga tu to ma lɔ o twoŋi kabira kam se ko maŋe de jara zela tigisim diga kam yiga ne. O ta lɔge-ka mo o vo o yi mɛ kabira kam na gugwoli to.
20Zabayi bu Baruki daa ma lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi da, o zege ka gugwolim jei sem ne o lɔ o yi kaanem tu Eliasibi sɔŋɔ ni ne mo.
21Yuria bu Meremofa wolo ta na ye Hakoza naa to de ma lɔ o twoŋi kabira kam o vo o yi Eliasibi sɔŋɔ daa kadwoŋi kam ne.
Kaanem tiina balo na lɔge kabira kam to
22Balo de déem na lɔge kabira kam ba twoŋi da to ye kaanem tiina balo na zoore Jerusalem laŋa kam ne to mo.
