5Wɔ mo pae kagoa wo bonɛ
chwoŋa se se beeri yɔɔ?
Wɔ mo bwoli-se
pa se vei se na lage mɛ to?
6Amo mo pɛ-se chwoŋa se se taa zoore kagoa kam ne,
mɛ kasolo kom na yɔɔre
ko ye yɛ yerane to.
7Ko ná ye vuvuga kalo na wo
teo kom wone to,
sento yeini se gwooni-ka mo.
Se ba jege nɔɔna balo
na wó fe-se se se toŋe to.
8Se yɔɔre se kare peero tem yuu ne mo se beeri ga-lɛɛro,
de kolo maama na zura to se se di.
9Ga-naao wó sɛ se ko toŋe
ko pa‑m na?
Tete ne, ko wó maŋe
n nabwoo ne mo na?
10Nmo wó wane n ma ŋona
n vaŋe-ko se ko va ko pa‑m na?
Ko wó sɛ se ko tɔge n kwaga ko lɔ
pempala bwollu tem ne na?
11Nmo nam ta wó ta‑n teege
ko dam-fɔrɔ kom baŋa ne,
se ko toŋe n totoŋ-dɛɛra maama
ko pa‑m na?
12Nmo ta wó ke n chega
de ga-naao we, ko wó ja n faao
ko jwoori ko zo diga ko pa‑m,
se n daare n fere n mena yam na?
13Nakelakɔgɔ yeini ko wuuri
ko vɔna de dam.
Ko vɔna koro tem nam ba maŋe
de buga ni zuna vɔna yam
na jege lam tei to.
14Ko yeini ko de ko chechara
ko yage te-kampare ne mo,
se kasolo kom fonyogo mage-ya.
15Ko nam daa wo maane we
kago-varem napɔɔna
wae ya tui ya nɔne-ya ya lɔe.
16Ko maa jege ko bia ko yaara,
ne ba dae o tete bia mo to.
Ko yiga tera de ko na wowole
ko lwei-ba kafɛ tei to.
17Ko nam ye amo Wɛ na wo pɔɔre swa a sigi a pa-ko,
ye a wo sɛ se ko jwoŋi yi-poro to ŋwaane mo.
18De ko de, ko ná zaŋe wɛɛne
se ko duri de fora,
ko wó mɔne sisein-nɔɔno
de ka diru wom mo.
19Nmo ye wolo na kwei dam
n pae sisein-nɔɔno to mo na?
Nmo mo kwoli ka ba de koro na?
20Nmo nam wae n pa ka faŋa
ne kayera na ke tei,
ye ka sii vio ka yage
se ka ma fugi nɔɔna to na?
21Ka napɔɔna yeini ya guri tega
de baare mo,
ye ka bere we ka yia seene
jara ŋwaane.
Ka ma yɔɔre ka duri
ka zo jara yam wone.
22Ka jege foone tete de mo ka mɔna.
Ka maa ba duri se-zɔɔ de kɔtaa!
23Che-kɔŋɔ wo ka saŋa ne mo
ko dɔna,
ye jara chichwei de se-zɔɔro
nyeena wea yiga ne.
24Ka ye nyare-nyare mo
se ka wurigi ka guri tega.
Ba ná wugi nabɔnɔ jara ŋwaane,
ka ware ka zege chemm.
25Ba ná yeini ba wu nabɔnɔ kom,
ka wó leiri de wopwolo mo.
Ka maa zege yiga yiga mo
ka ni jara-keim lwom,
ye ka ta ni jar-keira bam
na ke sɔɔ kolo to,
de ba yiga tiina bam kwori
na zaŋe wɛɛne tei to.
26Ko ye nmo tete yeino baŋa ne mo
kawula yarege ko vɔna
ko jaane wɛyuu ne
ko vei tega-kuri seeni na?
27Maao de nam cheigi
nmo ni taane mo,
se ko taa kare wɛyuu ne ko yaara,
ye ko sɔ ko pwogo peero yuu ne na?
28Ko yeini ko di peo yuu mo
baŋa baŋa ko sɔ ko pwogo,
ye dáane mo ko nae dalem jei.
29Ko ná wo peo kom yuu ne konto,
ko tole ko nii ko nae ko wodiu mo yiga yiga.
30Twa na wo mɛ seeni to,
dáane mo maaro tem wó taa wora.
Te bia de maa wó jeeri ba nyɔ jana.”

english_text:
The Lord Continues
I Am the Lord All-Powerful
* 1I am the Lord All-Powerful,
2but you have argued
that I am wrong.
Now you must answer me.
3Job said to the Lord:
4Who am I to answer you?
5I did speak once or twice,
but never again.
6Then out of the storm
the Lord said to Job:
7Face me and answer
the questions I ask!
8Are you trying to prove
that you are innocent
by accusing me of injustice?
9Do you have a powerful arm
and a thundering voice
that compare with mine?
10If so, then surround yourself
with glory and majesty.
* 11Show your furious anger!
Throw down and crush
12all who are proud and evil.
13Wrap them in grave clothes
and bury them together
in the dusty soil.
14Do this, and I will agree
that you have won
this argument.
I Created You
15I created both you
and the hippopotamus.
It eats only grass like an ox,
16but look at the mighty muscles
in its body 17and legs.
Its tail is like a cedar tree,
and its thighs are thick.
18The bones in its legs
are like bronze or iron.
19I made it more powerful
than any other creature,
yet I am stronger still.
20Undisturbed, it eats grass
while the other animals
play nearby.
* 21It rests in the shade of trees
along the riverbank
22or hides among reeds
in the swamp.
23It remains calm and unafraid
with the Jordan River rushing
and splashing in its face.
24There is no way to capture
a hippopotamus—
not even by hooking its nose
or blinding its eyes.
translation_text:
1 Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de Job o we:
2“Nmo wolo na mage kantɔgɔ de amo Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom to,
n laam wó sɛ n pa-ne na?
Nmo ya na gwooni-ne to,
n jege se n leiri a taane dem mo.”
3Job ma leiri Baŋa Wɛ o we:
4“Nii-ne, amo dae kolokolo n yiga ne.
A nam wó ke tɛ mo a leiri‑m?
Amo ni mɔɔre mo
ye de ware se de puri.
5A maŋe a ŋɔɔne ko daga.
Bɛ mo a daa wó ta?
A bá wane a leiri.”
6 Baŋa Wɛ maa zege vo-fɔrɔ kom wone o ŋɔɔne de Job o we:
7“Nam fɔge n zege ne baaro tei,
se a lage a bwei‑m taane mo.
Nmo de nam jege
se n leiri a bwia yam mo.
8Nmo boŋe se n kweele a chega kam n se tega ne mo na?
N ta wó lwɛ amo
se ko pa n ta‑n jege bora na?
9Nmo jeŋa toŋe wo-kamuna
ne Wɛ jeŋa kam na ke tei to na?
N wae n kwora n mumuni
ne Wɛ kwora na bage tei to na?
10Tɔ! N ná wae n ke, kwoli n tete
de nenɔŋa de kamunim,
se n bere n paare de n zula
na mae tei to.
11Kwei n ban-lom dem n lwo n yage
boyere-nyena baŋa ne
se ko pa ba maama zoore
ba tete tega ne.
12Pa balo maama
na bere ba tete kamunim to
tu ba tete tega ne,
se n ta daare n nɔne puseŋ-nyena
n se tega ne.
13La ba maama n ke daane,
se n kwei-ba n suli kasolo wone.
Vɔ-ba n daare n pe n yage
ba yibeela wone.
14N ná wane wonnu tem konto n ke,
amo laam wó sɛ a pa nmo we,
n tete dam mo wó wane‑m
de jwoŋi.
15Nam maane n nii buga wo juru Behemota na ye tei to.
Amo mo naane-ko
ne a na naane nmo de tei to.
Ko de nam di ga-lɛɛro mo
ne nabea na ke tei to.
16Ko chwoa yam tiini ya dana,
ye ko puga kam de jege ŋwanno
na jwoŋi ko yera yam maama to.
17Ko nam twe ko nabili mo tee,
ne pono dwoŋi to,
ye ko nɛ ŋwanno tem de dana chekke.
18Ko kwi sem dana
ne channa na ye tei to mo,
ye ko nachere sem nye de bei
selo ba na mɛ luuru ba ke to.
19Wonnu telo maama
amo Wɛ na naane to wone,
konto mo zege te maama yiga ne.
De ko de, wolo na naane-ko to mo wó wane
o kwei se-zɔɔ o ja o fɔɔre o yi-ko.
20Ga-lɛɛro yɔɔre te puli peero jei sem ne mo se ko taa di,
ye ga-vara dwi maama de kare dáane ba kwɛɛra.
21Ko nam yeini ko vo ko tigi
sabare kuri ne mo,
ye ko seigi buga ni
nanchan-gullu wone.
22Sabare sem maa pae ko jege woro
se ko seigi da.
Buga ni teeni dem de kaare-ko
de ke tetare ne.
23Buga na bam ná duri
ye ba popɔgele tei maama de,
ko ba kɔre foone.
Kolokolo ba daane-ko,
de Jɔdan buga na bam ná maŋe
ba wɛɛle ko ni dem tei de.
24Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ware
buga wo juru kom se o ja,
ye ko zege da ko nia.
N bá‑n wane n kwei kalanchogo
n ma n ja-ko ko momwɛ seeni.”

english_text:
The Lord Continues
Can You Catch a Sea Monster?
1 Can you catch a sea monster
by using a fishhook?
Can you tie its mouth shut
with a rope?
2Can it be led around
by a ring in its nose
or a hook in its jaw?
3Will it beg for mercy?
4Will it surrender
as a slave for life?
5Can it be tied by the leg
like a pet bird
for little girls?
6Is it ever chopped up
and its pieces bargained for
in the fish-market?
7Can it be killed
with harpoons or spears?
8Wrestle it just once—
that will be the end.
9Merely a glimpse of this monster
makes all courage melt.
10And if it is too fierce
for anyone to attack,
who would dare oppose me?
11I am in command of the world
and in debt to no one.
12What powerful legs,
what a stout body
this monster possesses!
13Who could strip off its armor
or bring it under control
with a harness?
14Who would try to open its jaws,
full of fearsome teeth?
* 15Its back is covered
with shield after shield,
16firmly bound and closer together
17than breath to breath.
When This Monster Sneezes
18When this monster sneezes,
lightning flashes, and its eyes
glow like the dawn.
19Sparks and fiery flames
explode from its mouth.
20And smoke spews from its nose
like steam
from a boiling pot,
21while its blazing breath
scorches everything in sight.
22Its neck is so tremendous
that everyone trembles,
23the weakest parts of its body
are harder than iron,
24and its heart is stone.
25When this noisy monster appears,
even the most powerful
turn and run in fear.
26No sword or spear can harm it,
27and weapons of bronze or iron
are as useless as straw
or rotten wood.
28Rocks thrown from a sling
cause it no more harm
than husks of grain.
This monster fears no arrows,
29it simply smiles at spears,
and striking it with a stick
is like slapping it with straw.
30As it crawls through the mud,
its sharp and spiny hide
tears the ground apart.
31And when it swims down deep,
the sea starts churning
like boiling oil,
32and it leaves behind a trail
of shining white foam.
33No other creature on earth
is so fearless.
34It is king of all proud creatures,
and it looks upon the others
as nothing.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ ta ma bwei Job o we:
1“Ko ta ná ye naneo wo juru Leviatan,
nmo wó wane n ma gwola
n vaŋe-ko n le na wone na?
N ta wó wane n kwei ŋona
n vɔ ko ni na?
2Nmo nam wó wane
n puri ko momwa
se n kwei ŋona n tore da,
ye n daare n kwei gwola
n gerege ko peyaa ne na?
3Leviatan kom konto wó yɔɔre
ko taa lwoori‑m
se n bwoli-ko n yage mo na?
Ko wó kwei ni-som mo
ko ŋɔɔne de nmo na?
4Ko ta wó sɛ ko pa‑m,
ye á gwoni ni daane,
se ko ŋwea maama wone
ko taa ye n kabaa na?
5Nmo wó pa ko ji kwɛɛra woŋo,
ne ba na jaane zuna
ba mae ba kwɛɛre tei to na?
N ta wó pa n sɔŋɔ busankane sem
vaŋe-ko de ŋona na?
6Nɔɔna wó wane
ba ke pipiu ko baŋa ne,
ye ba cha ko yera yam muga-muga
se ba pɔɔre-ya ba pa
ba dwonna pipim-piina na?
7N nam wó wane n kwei chichwoa dedɛ n zɔ ko yera yam,
naa n kwei chena n zɔ ko yuu kom,
se ko pa ko na zonne na?
8Nmo ná ke kokeiri n zo jaŋa de-ko,
n wó jaŋe bedwe yerane,
ye n du we,
n daa‑n bá dwoni de-ko.
9Wolo ná boŋe we
o wó wane-ko o chɔge,
kotu jege o tete mo o ni.
Kokuri, o ná yɔɔre o na-ko,
o baare maama wó ti mo.
10Chega to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jege baare
se o fe o tete o dwei
juru kom konto.
Wɔ laam nam mo wó na baare
se o dwoni de amo?
11Wɔ jene mo amo wó taa jega
se a ŋwe a pa kotu?
Kokuri to, amo mo tei tega baŋa woŋo maama.
12Amo daa ta wó taa ŋɔɔne
Leviatan taane.
Ko nɛ sem de ko yera yam dana chekke,
ye ko ya-tega kam de lana dedɛ.
13Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware o pwoni
ko tɔnɔ kom,
naa o zɔ ko ya-tana kam
na tiini ka lira to.
14Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jege baare
se kotu ja ko ni o kaŋe,
ko yeila yam na tiini
ya jege foone to ŋwaane.
15Ko kwaga poro tem
nye de tankwallo mo
ba geene ba tigisi daane.
Te maa sɔɔne daane
pa te dana ne kandwa to.
16Te tiini te sɔɔne daane mo,
pa lulua tera se vio tɔge da
ko zo ko yi ko yera yam tete.
17Te na tiini te meeli daane konto to,
nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware-te se o kore.
18Leviatan ná sii ko vio ko yage,
pwooni mo nwoŋi da
de pepele yia.
Ko yia yam de maa nyeena,
ne wea na nye te-pora ne tei to.
19Min-vogo mo yeini ko pi
ko nwoŋi ko ni dem ne.
Min-chenno de maa parese
te jaana jei maama ne.
20Nyoa de maa tae
ka nwoŋi ko momwa ne,
ne kambia na chora mini ne
ye fonyogo fufuga tei to.
21Ko ná sii vio, ko wiiri min-chala
pa ya jaane mini,
ye min-vogo de yɔɔre ko tae
ko nwoŋa ko ni dem ne.
22Ko ba kam maama zwe mo jukke de dam,
pa wolo maama ná nɛ-ko,
foone jege kotu.
23Ko yera yam jei jei tera
se na bwona.
Ya maama yɔɔre ya dana
ne luu na ye tei to mo.
24Ko bochare nam tiini de dana
ne peo naa nɔŋɔ na ye tei to mo.
25Ko ná zaŋe wɛɛne,
foone yeini de ja dedɛɛra tete mo.
Ba ná nigi ko dɔnne,
ba boboŋa yeini ya vugimi mo.
26Ba ná jeeri-ko de se-zɔɔro, naa chichwoa, naa taŋa chena,
tento maama ware-ko kolokolo
se te ke.
27Ko nii luuru se te taa nye
de ga-korro mo ko tei ne.
Channa de maa nye
de da-popwanno ko yiga ne.
28Che-tɛɛra ná jaane wɛɛne tei de,
ya muri se ya pa ko duri.
Ko daare pa napana kandwa
ye weero ko tei ne.
29Ko nii gwola se ya taa nye
de swanno mo.
Ba nam ná kwei chichwoa mo
de se ba ma jeeri-ko de jara,
ko yiga bere ka tera ya wone.
30Ko puga kam seeni ya-tana kam
nye de kanchwi mo kwoli-ka,
pa se ka tiini ka jege ni fileim-fileim.
Ko ná tuuri ko tete
ko veiŋa baŋa ne,
ko yeini ko jege bworu tem mo
ko gura.
31Ko nam ná wo naneo wo
na-luŋa ne ko yɛ na,
ko pae se na bam popɔgele
ne na na chore tei to mo.
Ko ta nye de terale nuga na wo kambia ne ka saŋe tei to mo.
32Ko ná yeini ko kɛ ko daare,
chwoŋa tigi naneo kom ne mo
napwon-pwoŋo ye ka nyeena,
nenɛɛne nɔn-kwea yu-pwei
na ye tei to.
33Juru kom konto ba kɔre kolokolo.
Ko ba jege dwoŋi
tega baŋa maama ne.
34Vara balo maama ná bere ba tete kamunim,
ko jege-ba ko gwoona mo.
Konto mo maa ye
vare-kamuna bam maama pɛ.”

english_text:
Job's Reply to the Lord
No One Can Oppose You
1Job said:
2No one can oppose you,
because you have the power
to do what you want.
3 You asked why I talk so much
when I know so little.
I have talked about things
that are far beyond
my understanding.
4 You told me to listen
and answer your questions.
5I heard about you from others;
now I have seen you
with my own eyes.
6That's why I hate myself
and sit here in dust and ashes
to show my sorrow.
The Lord Corrects Job's Friends
7The Lord said to Eliphaz:
What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth. 8So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
9Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer.
A Happy Ending
10 After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before. 11Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
12The Lord now blessed Job more than ever; he gave him 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 pair of oxen, and 1,000 donkeys.
13In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters, 14whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch. 15They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
16Job lived for another 140 years—long enough to see his great-grandchildren have children of their own— 17and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_text:
Job ni taane
1Job ma leiri Baŋa Wɛ o we:
2“A yei we n wae wonnu maama n ke.
Ba ba cho nmo yiga de kolokolo
n na jaane boboŋa se n ke to.
3Nmo ya bwei amo we:
‘N ye wɔ mo se n bwɛ
amo boboŋa na jaane tei to,
ye n ŋɔɔne wonnu telo n na yeiri to?’
Chega to, amo ŋɔɔne wonnu telo
a na wo lɔre te kuri to mo.
Te maa ye wo-kenkagela
yalo na dwoi a jaanem to.
4N ta tage de amo we,
‘Laam ta‑n ye konto chemm
se a ŋɔɔne de nmo.
Amo wó bwei‑m taane,
se n de leiri a bwia yam
n pa-ne.’
5Chega to, amo zwa ya mo nigi nmo ŋwa.
A tete laam nam mo nɛ‑m de a yia.
6Chaveera maa jege-ne de ta-yɔɔro telo a ya na kare a tɛ to.
A yɔɔre a chuli a wɛleera yam
de a wo maama,
pa se a jeini teero
de tentwarem baŋa ne.”
Tɔnɔ kom gurim
7 Baŋa Wɛ déem na ŋɔɔne de Job o ti to, mo o tage de Teman tu Elifaza o we, “A bane zaŋe de nmo, de n badwonna balei bam mo. Kokuri to, á wo tage amo yera taane se ko yɔɔre chwoŋa se ko maŋe de a tontoŋeno Job na tage tei to. 8Nam beeri-na nabɛ serepɛ, de pi-bale serepɛ á ja á vo Job tei se á kwei-te á ke zwɛɛm kaanem á tete ŋwaane. Ko kwaga seeni, a tontoŋeno Job wó lwoori-ne o pa abam. A maa wó jwoŋi o wɛ-lworo kom, se a yé waare abam de jworim delo á na ke to. Abam na tage amo yera taane tei to wo yɔɔre chwoŋa se ko yi Job na tage tei to.”
9Teman tu Elifaza, de Suuhi tu Bilidad, de Naamatia tu Zofara ma seene ba ke ne Baŋa Wɛ na bere-ba se ba ke tei to. Baŋa Wɛ de ma sɛ wɛ-lworo kolo Job na ke ba ŋwaane to.
10Job déem na lwoori Wɛ o pa o badwonna bam to kwaga ne, mo Baŋa Wɛ daa pɛ se Job jwoori o zege de dam. O ma ba o duni, ne ko ya na ye tei boboa kam ne to kuni belei. 11O chorro maama, de o nakwa, de o badwonna balo maama déem na vei ded‑o to ma ba o tei ye ba di kuri daane o sɔŋɔ ne. Ba ma ŋwane ba pa‑o ye ba zuri o bochare de lɛɛro telo maama Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe o yera ne to. Ba maama dedoa dedoa ma pa‑o lu-nyenno sabu-dala, de sabu-seŋa jafole.
12 Baŋa Wɛ ma tiini o swɛ Job swolim pa o kweela kam gare o ya na ye tei boboa kam ne to. O déem laam jege pei morro fuga-tena (14,000), de kona morro teredo (6,000), de nabɛ morro telei (2,000), de bonɛ moro (1,000). 13O ma pa Job daa lo bia fuga, bakeiri serepɛ, de bukwa batɔ. 14O déem ma bwoŋi o bukɔ-kwea kam yere we Jemima. O bukɔ wolo na saŋe to yere maa ye Kezia, ye o bukwa batɔ tu wom de yere ye Keren-Hapuke. 15Tega baŋa maama wone, kaane déem tera o lam na twɛ Job bukwa bam. Job ma pa-ba chwoŋa se ba woli ba nabwa bam wone se o ná tega, se ba chɛ o jejegero tem ba pa daane.
16Wonnu tem konto maama na ke te kɛ to, Job ta ŋwe mo o yi bena bi de finna (140) o woli da. O déem ma na o bia de ba de bia, se ko yi dwia yana laŋa ne. 17O ma tiini o kwe ye o laam te o tete toone.

english_text:
BOOK I
(Psalms 1–41)
The Way to Happiness
1God blesses those people
who refuse evil advice
and won't follow sinners
or join in sneering at God.
2Instead, they find happiness
in the Teaching of the Lord,
and they think about it
day and night.
3 They are like trees
growing beside a stream,
trees that produce
fruit in season
and always have leaves.
Those people succeed
in everything they do.
4That isn't true of those
who are evil—
they are like straw
blown by the wind.
5Sinners won't have an excuse
on the day of judgment,
and they won't have a place
with the people of God.
6The Lord protects everyone
who follows him,
but the wicked follow a road
that leads to ruin.
translation_text:
Lei Tɔnɔ 1
Lei 1–41
Chwei selei taane
1Nɔɔno wolo veiŋa na ba tɔge
puseŋ-nyena bam bera to mo,
Wɛ zaane wo wonto yuu ne lanyerane.
Kotu nam ba lage se o da
wɛleere-keira chwoŋa kam.
O maa ba lage se o taa jei
nɔn-lwɛɛna jeiŋa jei sem ne.
2Kotu za pae se Baŋa Wɛ nia yam mo jege ywoni ya pa‑o.
Wea de tete maama o yeini o boŋe ya wone zii mo lanyerane.
3Nɔɔno wom konto nye de tio kolo
na zege ko bwola de nabara
ye ko vɔɔro ba siira kɔtaa to mo.
Ko nam leiri bia mo ka maŋa ne chekke.
O na ke kolo maama to vei yiga lanyerane.
4Puseŋ-nyena bam nam dae konto!
Banto nye de swanno mo
vio na kale ko maa jia to.
5Wɛ nam ná lage o di nabiina bora,
puseŋ-nyena bam wó to mo.
Wɛleere-keira de nam bá wane ba woli
balo na jege chega Wɛ tei ne to
kɔgɔ kom wone.
6Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ fɔge o nii
balo na kɔre-o to,
de ba veiŋa maama mo.
Ko nam ná ye puseŋ-nyena bam,
banto yɔɔre ba jei mo
ba chwoŋa kam ne.

english_text:
The Lord's Chosen King
1 Why do the nations plot,
and why do their people
make useless plans?
2The kings of this earth
have all joined together
to turn against the Lord
and his chosen king.
3They say, “Let's cut the ropes
and set ourselves free!”
4In heaven the Lord laughs
as he sits on his throne,
making fun of the nations.
5The Lord becomes furious
and threatens them.
His anger terrifies them
as he says,
6“I've put my king on Zion,
my sacred hill.”
7 I will tell the promise
that the Lord made to me:
“You are my son, because today
I have become your father.
8Ask me for the nations,
and every nation on earth
will belong to you.
9 You will smash them
with an iron rod
and shatter them
like dishes of clay.”
10Be smart, all you rulers,
and pay close attention.
11Serve and honor the Lord;
be glad and tremble.
12Show respect to his son
because if you don't,
the Lord might become furious
and suddenly destroy you.
But he blesses and protects
everyone who runs to him.
translation_text:
Wɛ Dam Tu wom taane
1Bɛ mo ye logo baŋa dwi-gɛ tiina bam bane zaŋe?
Bɛ mo ye ba ke daane ba boŋe
boboŋa kafɛ ŋwaane konto?
2Ba pwa bam de ba dedɛɛra bam ma la daane,
se ba ke chichuŋu de Baŋa Wɛ
de o Dam Tu wolo o na kuri to.
3Ba laam maa we,
“Pa-na se dé chochoge
ba dam chegero tem,
se dé daare dé dole ba chaponno tem dé yage yiga yiga.”
4Baŋa Wɛ maa jei o telaao paare jeiŋa jei ne ye o mɔne-ba.
O maa nae ba boboŋa yam
na muri tei to.
5O bane ma zaŋe ba baŋa ne
ye o kaane-ba de ba keim-yɔɔro tem.
O ma tiini o fugi-ba de o ban-zɔŋɔ kom.
6O maa we, “Zion ye peo kolo
amo na pɔɔre a pa a tete to mo.
Ko yuu ne mo amo tiŋi Pɛ wolo
a na kuri to.”
Pɛ wom maa we:
7“Amo laam wó pa se Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to nwoŋi pwooni,
de o na tage de amo o we:
‘Nmo mo ye amo Bu,
ye zem amo de ji nmo Kwo.
8A Bu, nam bwei amo n nii,
se amo wó pa-m logo baŋa teene dem maama se n ta‑n tei,
se ko vo ko yi logo kom siseini ni maama.
9Nmo wó kwei luu-dedɔrɔ
n ma n wane-ba,
ye n daare n chɔge-ba,
ne kambi mo ba chochoge to.’ ”
10Konto to, abam balo na ye pwa to,
ja-na swa!
Abam balo na jege dam
logo baŋa ne to,
jwoŋi-na bera.
11Sɛ-na Baŋa Wɛ se á ta‑á kɔre‑o.
Pa-na se á yera taa sae
se á di ywoni o yiga ne.
12Chɔɔle-na o Bu wom yiga ne
á ma‑á zuli‑o,
se o bane yé zaŋe abam baŋa ne.
Ko ná dae konto, wonto wó wane o ba
o chɔge abam bedwe baŋa ne.
Balo nam na seigi ba tete
o woro wone to,
Wɛ wó ke zaane o ke
banto maama yuu ne mo.

english_text:
(Written by David when he was running from his son Absalom.)
An Early Morning Prayer
1 I have a lot of enemies, Lord.
Many fight against 2me and say,
“God won't rescue you!”
3But you are my shield,
and you give me victory
and great honor.
4I pray to you, and you answer
from your sacred hill.
5I sleep and wake up refreshed
because you, Lord,
protect me.
6Ten thousand enemies attack
from every side,
but I am not afraid.
7Come and save me, Lord God!
Break my enemies' jaws
and shatter their teeth,
8because you protect
and bless your people.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo o na duri se o lu Abisalom jeŋa ne to.
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nii amo dona na daga tei!
Balo na zege amo zega to
gaale dedɛ!
2Ba maa tɛ amo taane ba we,
Wɛ daa ba lage o jwoŋi-ne o yage.
3 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam chege amo mo
n pu se cham yé yi-ne,
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔno
jara wone tei to.
Nmo yeini n pae a yuu zeiŋi wɛɛne,
ye n pa-ne zula dedɛ.
4Amo yeini a lwoori Baŋa Wɛ
de kwor-dɛa mo.
O de maa zege peo kolo o na pɔɔre o pa o tete to yuu ne,
o leiri amo wara.
5Amo wó guni mo a peini
a taa dɔa yɔlɔ-lɔ-lɔ,
ye a dɔ a zaŋe zezeŋa ne
de yazura,
Baŋa Wɛ na teili-ne to ŋwaane.
6Jar-keira morro fuga mo ná jeeri-ne,
ye ba peene-ne jei maama
ba ke tetare ne de,
amo ta bá kɔre foone.
7Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne!
Amo Tu Wɛ, jwoŋi-ne n yage!
Nam mage a dona bam maama nia n chɔge-ba,
se ba daa yé taa jege dam amo baŋa ne.
8 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo vere nɔɔna
n yage ba cham wone.
Nam pa n swolim taa wo
n nɔɔna bam yuu ne.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.)
An Evening Prayer
1You are my God and protector.
Please answer my prayer.
I was in terrible distress,
but you set me free.
Now have pity and listen
as I pray.
2How long will you people
refuse to respect me?
You love foolish things,
and you run after
what is worthless.
3The Lord has chosen
everyone who is faithful
to be his very own,
and he answers my prayers.
4 But each of you
had better tremble
and turn from your sins.
Silently search your heart
as you lie in bed.
5Offer the proper sacrifices
and trust the Lord.
6There are some who ask,
“Who will be good to us?”
Let your kindness, Lord,
shine brightly on us.
7You brought me more happiness
than a rich harvest
of grain and grapes.
8I can lie down
and sleep soundly
because you, Lord,
will keep me safe.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
nmo mo zege amo chega kam kwaga ne.
Cham na tu de peene amo to,
nmo jwoŋi-ne n yage
se a lu de wone.
Nam ta duri amo yibwona,
se n daare n cheigi
amo wɛ-lworo kom.
2Nabiina bam, á lage
se á ta‑á ke-ne chaveera taa
se á vo á maŋe yei ne mo?
Á wó ta‑á swoi wo-yɔɔro,
ye á kwori á sɛ vwa taane
taa wuu mo na?
3Nam lɔre-na we Baŋa Wɛ kuri chega tɔgena mo
se ba taa ye o nyem.
Amo ná yeini a lwoori‑o,
o sɛ a taane dem mo.
4Nam ta‑á kɔre-na foone
se á yera de taa sae!
De konto de, yé ke-na wɛleere.
Á ná yeini á tigi á sara ne ye á sii,
se á ta‑á jege boboŋa yanto dwoŋi
á bochara wone.
5Tɔge-na chega wone á kaane
á pa Baŋa Wɛ,
se á daare á sɛ‑o de wo-dedoa.
6Nɔɔna dedɛ yeini ba bwei ba we,
“Nɔɔno wora o na wó ke debam lanyerane na?”
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, pa se n yibia jeeri debam seeni
se n lanyerane dem kwoli debam!
7Ko nam ná ye amo,
nmo ke ywoni amo bochare ne
ko dwoi banto nyem dem,
de ba na maŋe ba jege wodiiru dedɛ de sana to de.
8Amo ná yeini a guni a peini,
a wó dɔ mo ye a bochare zuri.
Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yerane mo wae
n nii amo baŋa ne,
se a yé na wo-lɔŋɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use flutes.)
A Prayer for Help
1Listen, Lord, as I pray!
Pay attention when I groan.
2You are my King and my God.
Answer my cry for help
because I pray to you.
3Each morning you listen
to my prayer,
as I bring my requests to you
and wait for your reply.
4You are not the kind of God
who is pleased with evil.
Sinners can't stay with you.
5No one who boasts can stand
in your presence, Lord,
and you hate evil people.
6You destroy every liar,
and you despise violence
and deceit.
7Because of your great mercy,
I come to your house, Lord,
and I am filled with wonder
as I bow down to worship
at your holy temple.
8You do what is right,
and I ask you to guide me.
Make your teaching clear
because of my enemies.
9 Nothing they say is true!
They just want to destroy.
Their words are deceitful
like a hidden pit,
and their tongues are good
only for telling lies.
10Punish them, God,
and let their own plans
bring their downfall.
Get rid of them!
They keep committing crimes
and turning against you.
11Let all who run to you
for protection
always sing joyful songs.
Provide shelter for those
who truly love you
and let them rejoice.
12Our Lord, you bless those
who live right,
and you shield them
with your kindness.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
cheigi amo ni taane.
Ko chɛ a yera ne ye a sisiga!
2Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo ye amo Pɛ,
pa-ne chwoŋa se a ba nmo yiga ne.
A lwoori zeinim mo nmo tei ne.
Popo, se n sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom.
3 Baŋa Wɛ, tega ná poore,
nmo yeini n cheigi amo ni taane.
Zezeŋa ne amo wó tiŋi a taane dem nmo yiga ne mo,
ye a laam taa jei a cheiga se a nii.
4A Tu Wɛ, nmo na ye tei to,
n wo ba pwoli de lwarem totoŋa.
Nɔn-balwaaro bá wane ba zo nmo tei.
5Balo na bere ba tete kamunim to
de bá wane ba zege nmo yiga ne.
Nmo chuli balo maama
na ke lwarem to.
6Ko ná ye vwa-fɔra,
nmo wó chɔge-ba mo,
ye n ve nɔn-gora
de gengan-nyena maama.
7Ko daare ko ná ye amo,
nmo jege amo swono chekke.
Konto ŋwaane, amo wó na chwoŋa
se a zo n sɔŋɔ kom.
Amo wó kuni dwoona nmo yiga ne,
ye a zuli nmo yere
nmo tete diga kam wone.
8 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se a taa tɔge
nmo chega chwoŋa kam,
amo dona na daga ba gaale to ŋwaane.
Tiŋi chwoŋa kalo na yɔɔre to
a yiga ne,
se a yé ywori ka wone.
9Ko ná ye a dona bam,
ba nia yam ba nwoŋi chega kɔtaa.
Ba beeri chɔgem yerane mo.
Ba nia maa ŋɔɔre,
ne yibeeli na puri to mo,
ye ba tɔge ni-sone baŋa ne
ba gane nɔɔna.
10A Tu Wɛ, pa ba to ba bora wone!
Pa se ba tete bobwea yam de-ba.
Ba wɛleera yam na daga to,
zeili-ba n yiga ne,
kokuri ba lɔge nmo kwaga ne mo.
11Ko daare, ko ná ye balo maama
na seigi nmo woro kom wone to,
pa se ba wo pwoli.
Pa se ba taa leeni lei de ywoni
taa wuu.
Balo na swoi nmo to,
se n ta‑n cho-ba
se ba taa zuli nmo yere de wopwolo.
12 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo seene n swɛ balo na zege chega wone to swolim.
Ko ta woli da, nmo yeini n kwei
n lanyerane dem mo,
n ma‑n cho-ba se cham yé yi-ba,
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔno
jara wone tei to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.
)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1 Don't punish me, Lord,
or even correct me
when you are angry!
2Have pity on me and heal
my feeble body.
My bones tremble with fear,
3and I am in deep distress.
How long will it be?
4Turn and come to my rescue.
Show your wonderful love
and save me, Lord.
5If I die, I cannot praise you
or even remember you.
6My groaning has worn me out.
At night my bed and pillow
are soaked with tears.
7Sorrow has made my eyes dim,
and my sight has failed
because of my enemies.
8 You, Lord, heard my crying,
and those hateful people
had better leave me alone.
9You have answered my prayer
and my plea for mercy.
10My enemies will be ashamed
and terrified,
as they quickly run away
in complete disgrace.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
yé tɔge n ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne
n bwɛ-ne.
Ta yé da n ban-lom dem ŋwaane
n waare-ne.
2Nam pa se n zaane taa wo
amo yuu ne,
a na bugi to ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe n yɔɔre-ne,
de ko na tiini ko chɛ
amo yera ne tei to.
3Foone mo tiini ko zo a bochare ne.
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo ta wó dáane mo
se n laam ba n zeini amo na?
4 Baŋa Wɛ, leiri n na ke tei to,
se n daare n ba n vere-ne n yage.
Jwoŋi-ne, nmo na yɔɔre n jege
amo swono to ŋwaane.
5Churu ne, ba ba guli nmo gula.
Nɔɔno ná tega,
kotu wó wane o tei nmo yere na?
6Amo na tiini a sisigi to mo
pɛ se a yera chɛ.
Tete dem maama ne mo a keeri dedɛ
pa se a sara kam bugi dedaane yi-na.
7A yia maama suli de yi-na,
amo wo na tiini ko chɔge to ŋwaane.
A daa ware se a taa nii lanyerane,
a dona bam na daane-ne to ŋwaane.
8Abam balo maama
na toŋe lwarem to,
lage-na jei á vo se á daare amo,
kokuri amo keira kam to
Baŋa Wɛ zwa ne.
9Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ nigi amo na
lwoori‑o se o duri amo yibwona tei to,
ye o daare o sɛ amo wɛ-lworo kom.
10Wɛ wó pa se a dona bam maama
di chaveera
ye foone zo-ba dedɛ.
Ba laam wó ma chaveera mo
ba maa kwoli ba yum,
ye ba pipiri ba jwoori kwaga.

english_text:
(Written by David.
He sang this to the Lord because of Cush from the tribe of Benjamin.)
The Lord Always Does Right
1You, Lord God,
are my protector.
Rescue me and keep me safe
from all who chase me.
2Or else they will rip me apart
like lions attacking a victim,
and no one will save me.
3I am innocent, Lord God!
4I have not betrayed a friend
or had pity on an enemy
who attacks for no reason.
5If I have done any of this,
then let my enemies
chase and capture me.
Let them trample me to death
and leave me in the dirt.
6Get angry, Lord God!
Do something!
Attack my furious enemies.
See that justice is done.
7Make the nations come to you,
as you sit on your throne
above them all.
8Our Lord, judge the nations!
Judge me and show that I
am honest and innocent.
9 You know every heart and mind,
and you always do right.
Now make violent people stop,
but protect all of us
who obey you.
10You, God, are my shield,
the protector of everyone
whose heart is right.
11You see that justice is done,
and each day
you take revenge.
12Whenever your enemies refuse
to change their ways,
you sharpen your sword
and string your bow.
13Your deadly arrows are ready
with flaming tips.
14An evil person is like a woman
about to give birth
to a hateful, deceitful,
and rebellious child.
15 Such people dig a deep hole,
then fall in it themselves.
16The trouble they cause
comes back on them,
and their heads are crushed
by their own evil deeds.
17I will praise you, Lord!
You always do right.
I will sing about you,
the Lord Most High.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o ke chega mo
David déem pane leiŋa kanto Benjamin tu Kusi ŋwaane.
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a kwei a tete mo
a seigi nmo woro wone.
Nam jwoŋi-ne n yage
balo na pare amo se ba ja to jeŋa ne.
2Ko ná dae konto, ba wó yɔɔre
ba ja-ne mo ba tore
nenɛɛne nywonnu na ke tei,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera
se kotu jwoŋi-ne o yage.
3Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo ná tusi tei maama,
ye keim-balɔrɔ ná wo a yuu ne,
4naa a ná toŋe a chɔge
a badwoŋi yiga,
naa a zeini o dono wolo
na daane‑o to,
5se nmo laam pa chwoŋa
se a dona bam pare-ne ba ja.
Pa se ba nɔne amo baŋa ne
ba se tega ne,
se a ŋwea laam ti
ye a maŋe tega kam ne.
6 Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne de ban-zɔŋɔ!
Zaŋe n che a dona bam
de ba ban-lom dem!
Zaŋe ba baŋa ne se n pa
n chega kam taa zega.
7Nam la logo baŋa dwi tiina bam
se ba gilimi nmo yiga ne.
Diini baŋa baŋa n ta‑n tei-ba.
8 Baŋa Wɛ lage o di
dwi tiina bam maama taane.
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam da
amo nɔn-ŋonne dem ŋwaane
n bore amo bora.
Ke konto Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo na jege chega to ŋwaane.
9Nmo ye wolo na ye chega tu
ye n faŋe nɔɔna bochara
de ba boboŋa n nii to.
Nam cheiŋi puseŋ-nyena bam
de ba nankɔɔre kikia yam,
se n daare n pa se nɔn-ŋona taa zega.
10Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ yeini o cho-ne
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔna
jara wone tei to mo.
O maa vere balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to mo o yaga.
11Wɛ ye wolo na bore chega bora to mo.
Dɛ maama wuu o yeini o bwɛ
balo na toŋe lwarem to.
12Banto ná wo leiri ba boboŋa,
Wɛ wó dwori o se-zɔɔ ni mo,
ye o daare o saŋe o taŋa kam lanyerane.
13O jara zela yam maŋe ya kwɛ.
O che-tɛɛra yam sele mo de vea ya pɔe.
14Nii-na! Puseŋ-nyena yeini ba ja
chanɛɛre puga mo.
Ba laam maa virigi lwarem puga,
ye ba daare ba lore vwa yerane.
15Banto yeini ba ko gwonnu mo,
ye ba tete laam daare ba to te wone.
16Lwarem delo ba na toŋe to
jwoori de tui ba tete yuu ne mo.
Ba nankɔɔre kikia mo jwoori
ya ni-ba.
17Amo wó ke Baŋa Wɛ lei,
o na yɔɔre o ke chega to ŋwaane.
A ta wó leeni a tei o yere mo,
de o na ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.
)
The Wonderful Name of the Lord
1Our Lord and Ruler,
your name is wonderful
everywhere on earth!
You let your glory be seen
in the heavens above.
2 With praises from children
and from tiny infants,
you have built a fortress.
It makes your enemies silent,
and all who turn against you
are left speechless.
3I often think of the heavens
your hands have made,
and of the moon and stars
you put in place.
4 Then I ask, “Why do you care
about us humans?
Why are you concerned
for us weaklings?”
5 You made us a little lower
than you yourself,
and you have crowned us
with glory and honor.
6 You let us rule everything
your hands have made.
And you put all of it
under our power—
7the sheep and the cattle,
and every wild animal,
8the birds in the sky,
the fish in the sea,
and all ocean creatures.
9Our Lord and Ruler,
your name is wonderful
everywhere on earth!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ yere jege zula
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye debam Teiru.
Nmo yere dem jege zula dedɛ
logo baŋa jei maama wone.
Nmo pɛ se n nenɔŋa taa nae jaja mo
wɛyuu jeiga maama ne.
2Nmo pɛ se bia tete de bu-sese mo taa tei nmo yere.
Nmo jege dam se n cheiŋi
n dona maama
pa se ba zege da chemm.
Balo maama na lɔge nmo kwaga ne to mo jaane ba nia.
3Amo yeini a nii wɛyuu kom,
de ko na ye kolo
nmo tete jea na naane to,
ye a daare a nii chana kam
de chalechwe sem,
nmo na kwei-se n zege se jei ne to.
Amo na nɛ to, a boŋe a we:
4“Ko ná ye nabiina,
bɛ mo ye n jege ba boboŋa?
Bɛ mo ke ye n yiga wo
nabiin-bia wone konto?”
5Nmo nam pɛ se nabiina
tiini ba jege paare,
ye n ta pa-ba zula,
pa se ba dam muri
nmo nyem dem fenfee mo.
6N ma-n daare n pa se ba tei
wonnu telo maama n jea na ke to,
se wonnu maama taa wo
ba dam kuri ne.
7Ko ná ye pei, de bone, de naane,
de kago-vara bam maama de,
8ko woli de zuna, de ywona,
dedaane wonnu telo maama
na wo naneero wone to,
te maama wo nabiina
dam kuri ne mo.
9 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye debam Teiru.
Nmo yere dem jege zula dedɛ
logo baŋa maama wone.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “The Death of the Son.”)
Sing Praises to the Lord
1I will praise you, Lord,
with all my heart
and tell about the wonders
you have worked.
2God Most High, I will rejoice;
I will celebrate and sing
because of you.
3When my enemies face you,
they run away and stumble
and are destroyed.
4You take your seat as judge,
and your fair decisions prove
that I was in the right.
5You warn the nations
and destroy evil people;
you wipe out their names
forever and ever.
6Our enemies are destroyed
completely for all time.
Their cities are torn down,
and they will never
be remembered again.
7You rule forever, Lord,
and you are on your throne,
ready for judgment.
8You judge the world fairly
and treat all nations
with justice.
9The poor can run to you
because you are a fortress
in times of trouble.
10Everyone who honors your name
can trust you,
because you are faithful
to all who depend on you.
11You rule from Zion, Lord,
and we sing about you
to let the nations know
everything you have done.
12You did not forget
to punish the guilty
or listen to the cries
of those in need.
13 Please have mercy, Lord!
My enemies mistreat me.
Keep me from the gates
that lead to death,
14and I will sing about you
at the gate to Zion.
I will be happy there
because you rescued me.
15 Our Lord, the nations fell
into their own pits,
and their feet were caught
in their own traps.
16You showed what you are like,
and you made certain
that justice is done,
but evil people are trapped
by their own evil deeds.
17The wicked will go down
to the world of the dead
to be with those nations
that forgot about you.
18The poor and the homeless
won't always be forgotten
and without hope.
19Do something, Lord!
Don't let the nations win.
Make them stand trial
in your court of law.
20Make the nations afraid
and let them all discover
just how weak they are.
translation_text:
Lei keim leiŋa
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó tei nmo
de a wo maama.
A ta wó ŋɔɔne
nmo wo-kenkagela yam taane
a bere nɔɔna.
2Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo wó pa se a wo pwoli,
ye a daare a di ywoni nmo ŋwaane.
A ta wó leeni mo
a zeiŋi n yere wɛɛne.
3Nmo ná zaŋe a dona baŋa ne,
ba wó pipiri mo ba duri ba kɛ.
Ba ma tiri ba to tega ne,
ye ba daare ba jei.
4Kokuri to, nmo ná di nɔɔna taane,
n yɔɔre n pae chega bora mo.
Nmo seene n bore amo bora
n pa se a jege a chega.
5Nmo yɔɔre n fugi dwi-gɛ tiina bam,
ye n daare n chɔge
puseŋ-nyena bam.
N saare ba yere mo
se nɔɔna daa yé guli ba gula
taa wuu.
6Chɔgem mo tu dé dona baŋa ne,
Ba teene dem ma ji di-dwonnu
se ko taa vei wuu,
pa se nɔɔna yɔɔre ba swei de ni ne.
7 Baŋa Wɛ nam jege o paare mo
se ko taa vei wuu.
O maa jei se o di nɔɔna taane.
8Wɛ wó tɔge o chega kam baŋa ne
o di nabiina maama taane.
O wó taa tei logo baŋa dwi tiina
ko chwoŋa ne mo.
9Ko ná ye balo na nɛ bɛɛsem to,
Baŋa Wɛ ye dalem jei mo o pa-ba.
Cham ná yi-ba, o maa ye ba dam jei,
se ba seigi o woro kom wone.
10Balo na kɔre nmo yere to wó ke
ba wo-dedoa dedaane nmo.
Kokuri to, ko ná ye balo na kwaane
se ba fɔɔre ba twɛ nmo to,
nmo Baŋa Wɛ ta wo fɔge n nwoŋi
ba kwaga ne n daare-ba.
11Leeni-na á tei Baŋa Wɛ,
se o di paare mo Zion ne!
Ta‑á tɛ o na ke tei maama to
á bere logo baŋa dwi tiina bam.
12Wɛ ye wolo na jwoori o ŋwe
nɔn-gora jene to mo.
Ko ná ye balo na wo cham wone to,
o bá fɔge o ve ba keira
kalo na jare‑o to.
13Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nam duri amo ŋwaŋa!
Nii amo dona bam na daane-ne
pa se a yaare tei!
Nmo ye wolo na wó wane n che toone se de yé ja-ne to mo.
14Konto to, amo wó zege
Zion teo pwooni ne
a zuli nmo yere jaja.
Amo wó taa chaka mo de wopwolo,
de nmo na jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane.
15 Dwi-gɛ tiina bam vei ba to gwoŋo kolo ba na koge to wone.
Kalanchogo kolo ba na tiŋi to mo jwoori ko ja-ba.
16 Baŋa Wɛ veere o tete
se ko tɔge de o chega bora borem dem mo.
Puseŋ-nyena bam nam na toŋe lwarem delo to
jwoori de jaane-ba ne kalanchogo to.
17Puseŋ-nyena bam wó vo
ba zo churu ne,
dedaane dwi tiina balo maama
na ve Wɛ to.
18Ko nam ná ye nabwona,
nɔɔna daa bá swei ba ni ne taa.
Balo de na wo cham wone to
teena bá fɔge ya ti.
19Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne!
Yé pa nabiina chwoŋa se ba ve nmo.
Ja logo baŋa dwi tiina bam
n zege n yiga ne
se n laam di ba taane.
20 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se foone yɔɔre de zo-ba,
se ba lɔre we ba ye nabiina mo
ye ba dam wo yi nmo dam dem.

english_text:
A Prayer for Help
1Why are you far away, Lord?
Why do you hide yourself
when I am in trouble?
2Proud and brutal people
hunt down the poor.
But let them get caught
by their own evil plans!
3The wicked brag about
their deepest desires.
Those greedy people hate
and curse you, Lord.
4The wicked are too proud
to turn to you
or even think about you.
5They are always successful,
though they can't understand
your teachings,
and they keep sneering
at their enemies.
6In their hearts they say,
“Nothing can hurt us!
We'll always be happy
and free from trouble.”
7 They curse and tell lies,
and all they talk about
is how to be cruel
or how to do wrong.
8They hide outside villages,
waiting to strike and murder
some innocent victim.
9They are hungry lions
hiding in the bushes,
hoping to catch
some helpless passerby.
They trap the poor in nets
and drag them away.
10They crouch down and wait
to grab a victim.
11They say, “God can't see!
He's got on a blindfold.”
12Do something, Lord God,
and use your powerful arm
to help those in need.
13The wicked don't respect you.
In their hearts they say,
“God won't punish us!”
14But you see the trouble
and the distress,
and you will do something.
The poor can count on you,
and so can orphans.
15Now break the power
of all merciless people.
Punish them for doing wrong
and make them stop.
16Our Lord, you will always rule,
but every godless nation
will vanish from the earth.
17You listen to the longings
of those who suffer.
You offer them hope,
and you pay attention
to their cries for help.
18You defend orphans
and everyone else in need,
so that no one on earth
can terrify others again.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
bɛ mo ke ye n wo yiga yiga amo tei ne?
Bɛŋwaane mo cham yi amo
ye n laam seigi n tete?
2Puseŋ-nyena bere ba tete kamunim
ye ba pare nabwona se ba ja.
Ba maa tɔge ba boboŋ-lwanno tem baŋa ne mo
ba jaane-ba.
3Puseŋ-nyena yeini ba zeiŋi ba tete mo
de ba fera na zo wonnu telo to.
Ba maa zuli kampin-nyena,
ye ba daare ba lwɛ Baŋa Wɛ.
4Puseŋ-nyena bam yiga tera
dedaane Wɛ,
ba na jege teera to ŋwaane.
Ba maa boŋe we, “Wɛ tera.”
5De ko de, ba wonnu maama
ke lanyerane.
Ba maa ware se ba ni
nmo bera yam kuri,
ye ba jege ba dona bam
ba gwoona.
6Ba maa boŋe ba we,
“Dé bá fɔge dé gɔ naga.
Dé bá fɔge dé zo cham wone kɔtaa!”
7Ba yeini ba sɔɔle lwarem yerane mo.
Ba maa fɔ vwa ye ba fugi nɔɔna.
Ba tiini ba swoi nankɔɔre
de puseŋa ŋɔŋa mo.
8Ba yeini ba vwɛ te-balwa bam ne
se ba nwoŋi ba zi
balo na tɔge-da ba kɛ to.
Ba yia seene de balo na vei yalem to,
ye ba zaŋe ba baŋa ne ba go-ba.
9Ba maa seigi gugworru wone
ne nywonnu mo tei,
se ba dale ba zi
balo na yeiri ko ni ne to.
Ba tɔge konto dwoŋi
ba jaane nabwona,
ye ba daare ba tuuri-ba ba kɛa,
ne ba wo ŋwe-choa wone mo tei.
10Ba maa jujugi balo ba na jaane to
pa se ba beiri,
ye ba dam dem yɔɔre de wane-ba.
11Ba maa boŋe ba we, “Wɛ yiga tera!
O kwoli o yibia mo ye o ba nae.”
12 Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne!
Kwei n jeŋa n ma‑n waare
puseŋ-nyena bam,
se n daare n zeini nabwona.
13Bɛ mo ye puseŋ-nyena swoi
se ba taa lwɛ Wɛ konto?
Bɛ mo ye ba tɛ ba tete ne we,
“Wɛ nam bá bwei amo”?
14Se ko ná ye nmo, a Tu Wɛ,
nmo yɔɔre n nae ba na toŋe cham
de nankɔɔre kikia yalo to.
Nmo yeini n jeeli
ba keim-balwaaro tem,
ye n daare n waare-ba.
Ko ná ye balo ba na jege ba bɛɛse to,
banto sale nmo yera ne,
nmo na ye wolo na zeini botara to ŋwaane.
15Nam chɔge puseŋ-nyena
de nɔn-balwaaro dam.
Bwei-ba ba keim-lwanno tem ŋwaane,
se ba totoŋa maama saare.
16 Baŋa Wɛ mo di paare
se ko taa vei wuu!
Dwi-gɛ tiina bam jege se ba jei mo
Wɛ tete tega kam wone.
17Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo yeini n cheigi
nabwona na lwoori‑m tei to.
Nmo ke dam n ke ba kuri ne,
de n na cheigi ba keira tei to.
18N zege botara de balo na nɛ bɛɛsem to kwaga ne,
se nabiinu wolo maama na wo logo baŋa ne to daa yé fugi-ba.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Trusting the Lord
1The Lord is my fortress!
Don't say to me,
“Escape like a bird
to the mountains!”
2You tell me, “Watch out!
Those evil people have put
their arrows on their bows,
and they are standing
in the shadows,
aiming at good people.
3What can an honest person do
when everything crumbles?”
4The Lord is sitting
in his sacred temple
on his throne in heaven.
He knows everything we do
because he sees us all.
5The Lord tests honest people,
but despises those
who are cruel
and love violence.
6He will send fiery coals
and flaming sulfur
down on the wicked,
and they will drink nothing
but a scorching wind.
7The Lord always does right
and wants justice done.
Everyone who does right
will see his face.
translation_text:
Amo wó sale Baŋa Wɛ yera ne
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo wó sale Baŋa Wɛ yera ne.
Nam daa‑n yé ta de amo we:
“Duri n vo n seigi peero jei ne,
ne zuŋa na jaane wɛɛne tei to.
2Nii puseŋ-nyena na saŋe ba tɛ,
ye ba mole chena da tei to!
Ba maa seigi ba tete,
se ba ta balo na yɔɔre
chwo-laao wone to.
3Puseŋ-nyena bam na chɔge
dé teo kom lam to,
nɔn-ŋona ware kolokolo se ba ke.”
4 Baŋa Wɛ mo wo o wɛyuu
sɔŋɔ kom ne.
O maa jei o di paare mo Wɛ telaao ne.
O yia laam dole jei maama
ya yere nabiina,
pa se o maane kolo maama
ba na ke to.
5 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o maane nɔn-ŋona
de puseŋ-nyena mo o nia.
O nam yɔɔre o chuli balo na swoi nankɔɔre kikia to mo.
6Ko ná ye puseŋ-nyena bam,
o lage o lwo min-chala
de chilibugu mo ba yuu ne,
ye o daare o pa se vo-loŋo mage-ba.
7 Baŋa Wɛ nam yɔɔre o tɔge chwoŋa chekke mo.
O maa swoi keim-laaro.
Balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to
wó ba ba na o yibia.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.
)
A Prayer for Help
1Please help me, Lord!
All who were faithful
and all who were loyal
have disappeared.
2Everyone tells lies,
and no one is sincere.
3Won't you chop off
all flattering tongues
that brag so loudly?
4They say to themselves,
“We are great speakers.
No one else has a chance.”
5But you, Lord, tell them,
“I will do something!
The poor are mistreated
and helpless people moan.
I'll rescue all who suffer.”
6Our Lord, you are true
to your promises,
and your word is like silver
heated seven times
in a fiery furnace.
7You will protect us
and always keep us safe
from those people.
8But all who are wicked
will keep on strutting,
while everyone praises
their shameless deeds.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1 Baŋa Wɛ,
zaŋe n zeini debam!
Kokuri to, balo na sɛ Wɛ to daa tera.
Balo na jege chega de Wɛ to
laam jei mo nabiina tetare ne.
2Nɔɔna maama fɔe vwa mo
ba chɔge ba dwonna yiga.
Ba maa jege ni-som
ba mae ba gane daane.
3 Baŋa Wɛ, ko ná ye balo
na jege ni-som to,
se n pu ba nia!
Ko ta woli de balo na bere ba tete kamunim ye ba we:
4“Debam ni taane mo pae se
dé wane nɔɔna maama dé di.
Dé wó taa ŋɔɔne dé na lage tei to mo,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane debam
o cheiŋi.”
5 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we:
“Amo laam wó zaŋe wɛɛne
a toŋe woŋo,
yiniga tiina na nɛ bɛɛsem
ye nabwona suuri cham wone to ŋwaane.
Amo wó vere-ba cham wone
se ba na siu,
ne ko na maŋe de-ba tei to.”
6 Baŋa Wɛ ni taane dem yɔɔre
de ye chekke mo.
De tiini de lana jase nenɛɛne
lu-nyenno telo na tiini te kwɛ to.
De nye de ba na ke lu-nyenno
mini wone kuni berepɛ
pa se digiru daa tera to mo.
7 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo wó yere nabwona
se kolokolo yé yi-ba.
Nmo ta wó ta‑n cho debam taa wuu
de nɔn-balwaaro tem kikia.
8Puseŋ-nyena bam kare mo
ba bere ba tete.
Nɔɔna maama maa zuli balo na toŋe lwarem nabiina tetare ne to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1How much longer, Lord,
will you forget about me?
Will it be forever?
How long will you hide?
2How long must I be confused
and miserable all day?
How long will my enemies
keep beating me down?
3Please listen, Lord God,
and answer my prayers.
Make my eyes sparkle again,
or else I will fall
into the sleep of death.
4My enemies will say,
“Now we've won!”
They will be greatly pleased
when I am defeated.
5I trust your love,
and I feel like celebrating
because you rescued me.
6You have been good to me, Lord,
and I will sing about you.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo ta wó dáane mo
se n laam ba n zeini-ne na?
Nmo daa‑n bá‑n guli amo gula na?
Nmo wó ta‑n seigi n yibia
de amo taa
se n vo n maŋe yei ne mo?
2Amo boboŋa jege se ya taa
daane-ne taa wuu mo na?
Dɛ maama wone amo wó taa jei
de wo-chechɔgɔ mo na?
Amo dona bam bere ba wó di wɔnɔ a baŋa ne taa
se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo?
3Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
yɔɔre n nii amo seeni,
se n leiri a wɛ-lworo kom.
Pa se a ŋwea jwoori ka ke dam,
se toone yé wane-ne de ja.
4Ko ná dae konto,
a dona bam wó ta we:
“Debam wane‑o dé di!”
Ba wó taa chaka de amo na to tei to.
5Amo nam kwei a tete
a sale nmo yera ne,
de nmo na yɔɔre n jege a swono tei to mo.
A bochare mo di ywoni dedɛ,
n na jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane.
6Amo wó leeni lei a pa Baŋa Wɛ,
o na ke-ne lanyerane to ŋwaane.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
No One Can Ignore the Lord
1 Only a fool would say,
“There is no God!”
People like that are worthless;
they are heartless and cruel
and never do right.
2From heaven the Lord
looks down to see
if anyone is wise enough
to search for him.
3But all of them are corrupt;
no one does right.
4Won't you evil people learn?
You refuse to pray,
and you gobble up
the Lord's people.
5But you will be frightened,
because God is on the side
of every good person.
6You may spoil the plans
of the poor,
but the Lord protects them.
7I long for someone from Zion
to come and save Israel!
Our Lord, when you bless
your people again,
Jacob's family will be glad,
and Israel will celebrate.
translation_text:
N bá‑n wane n gwooni Baŋa Wɛ
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Nɔn-jworru yeini ba tɛ
ba bochare ne we, “Wɛ tera.”
Ba maama chɔge mo ga zɔŋ-zɔŋ,
ba totoŋa de maa tiini ya lwara.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera ba wone
kotu na tɔge chwo-laao.
2 Baŋa Wɛ maa zege o telaao
sɔŋɔ kom ne
o tiiri o nii nabiina,
se o lɔre ba wolo jege swa
ye o tɔge Wɛ na?
3Ba maama ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone,
ye ba boboŋa yɔɔre ya chɔge mo
ga zɔŋ-zɔŋ.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam tera ba wone
o na tɔge chwo-laao,
de dedoa de.
4Wo-lwan-keira maama bá sɛ
se ba zamese swa na?
Ba jege a nɔɔna bam mo ba chɔga,
nenɛɛne ko ye wodiu mo ba di.
Ba nam ba bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere
ba zuli‑o.
5Nii-ba mo! Foone tiini de jege-ba,
kolo ŋwaane Wɛ zeini balo
na zege chega wone to mo.
6Abam wo-lwan-keira bam kwaane
se chaveera mo ja yiniga tiina,
se ba boboŋa yé jeini.
Baŋa Wɛ nam mo ke o woro kom
se banto zo ko wone ba seigi da.
7Amo nam wó lwoori Wɛ
se o zege Zion ne
o ba o vere Isarele tiina bam.
Baŋa Wɛ ná seene o pa o nɔɔna bam jwoori ba zege de dam,
Isarele dwi dem
na ye Jakob dwi dem to
wó taa chaka de wopwolo!

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
Who May Worship the Lord?
1Who may stay in God's temple
or live on the holy mountain
of the Lord?
2Only those who obey God
and do as they should.
They speak the truth
3and don't spread gossip;
they treat others fairly
and don't say cruel things.
4They hate worthless people,
but show respect for all
who worship the Lord.
And they keep their promises,
no matter what the cost.
5They lend their money
without charging interest,
and they don't take bribes
to hurt the innocent.
Those who do these things
will always stand firm.
translation_text:
Wɔ mo wó wane o zo Wɛ tei?
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
wɔ mo jege chwoŋa
se o taa zoore nmo wara-jei sem ne?
Wɔ mo wó wane o jeini peo kolo
nmo na pɔɔre n pa n tete to yuu ne?
2Ko ye wolo veiŋa na tɔge
chwo-laao chekke,
ye o jege chega
o kikia maama wone to mo.
Kotu yeini o ŋɔɔne chega
de o wo maama,
3ye o ba kare o chɔge nɔɔna yere.
O nam ba ke lwarem o yage
o fara yuu ne,
ye o ba kwaana se chaveera
di o dwonna.
4O yiga maa tera de nɔn-balwaaro,
ye o za nege balo na kɔre
Baŋa Wɛ to mo.
Konto tu yeini o tɔge o ni dem maama kwaga mo.
O nam bá yiri-de,
ne ko ná maŋe ko chamma
tetei maama ko pa‑o de.
5O maa jene o sabu mo
o pae nɔɔna,
ye o ba beeri nyɔɔre ko baŋa ne.
O nam ba sɛ se o jwoŋi dim
se o lɔ balo na jege bora to kwaga ne.
Ko ná ye balo na tɔge chwoŋa kanto dwoŋi to,
ba wó ta zege mo cheppe,
ye ba ba gɔe.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David.)
The Best Choice
1Protect me, Lord God!
I run to you for safety,
2and I have said,
“Only you are my Lord!
Every good thing I have
is a gift from you.”
3Your people are wonderful,
and they make me happy,
4but worshipers of other gods
will have much sorrow.
I refuse to offer sacrifices
of blood to those gods
or worship in their name.
5You, Lord, are all I want!
You are my choice,
and you keep me safe.
6You make my life pleasant,
and my future is bright.
7I praise you, Lord,
for being my guide.
Even in the darkest night,
your teachings fill my mind.
8 I will always look to you,
as you stand beside me
and protect me from fear.
9With all my heart,
I will celebrate,
and I can safely rest.
10 I am your chosen one.
You won't leave me in the grave
or let my body decay.
11You have shown me
the path to life,
and you make me glad
by being near to me.
Sitting at your right side,
I will always be joyful.
translation_text:
Amo teena wo Wɛ tei ne
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1A Tu Wɛ, ta‑n cho amo
se cham yé yi-ne!
A tu nmo tei se a seigi
n woro kom wone mo.
2Amo taga de Baŋa Wɛ we,
“Nmo ye amo Teiru.
Wo-laaro telo maama amo na jege to nwoŋi nmo tei ne mo.”
3Ko ná ye chega tiina balo
na zoore tega kam ne to,
ba ye nɔn-yum mo chekke.
Amo maa tiini a jege wopwolo
ba ŋwaane.
4Ko nam ná ye balo na duri
ba tɔge jwona kwaga to,
banto wo-chechɔgɔ kom
wó tiini ko gaale mo.
Amo nam bá tɔge a lwo ba na bam.
A bá bwoŋi ba jwona yam yera
se a kaane a pa-ya.
5 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ye wolo
na maŋe de amo to.
Nmo kuri chwoŋa kalo
amo na wó taa tɔge to,
ye n nii amo veiŋa baŋa ne.
6Ŋwea kalo n na pɛ-ne to
jege ywoni lanyerane.
Chega ŋwaane to, wonnu telo
nmo na tiŋi se a ba a jwoŋi to
tiini te lana.
7Amo wó tei Baŋa Wɛ
o na pa-ne kwea se a wane
a tɔge chwoŋa to ŋwaane.
Tete ne nmo ta woli-ne a boboŋa ne mo se a yé tusi.
8Amo yɔɔre a yei we Baŋa Wɛ mo
wo a tei ne maŋa maama.
O na wo a jazem seeni to ŋwaane,
o zeini-ne mo se a zege cheppe.
9Mo kokuri a jege wopwolo lanyerane.
A ŋwea maama maa jege ywoni.
Amo yera de daa bá taa sae.
10Kolo ŋwaane, amo ná tega,
n bá‑n yage-ne
se a taa wo churu ne.
Nmo bá‑n sɛ se n tete wo-pwoŋo tu wom yera pɔ.
11Nmo pɛ se a lɔre chwei selo
na pae ŋwea to se a taa tɔge-se.
Amo ná yi nmo tei,
nmo wó pa se a na ywoni dedɛ.
A ná tu a jeini nmo jazem seeni,
amo laam wó su de wopwolo dáane
se ko taa vei wuu.

english_text:
(A prayer by David.)
The Prayer of an Innocent Person
1I am innocent, Lord!
Won't you listen as I pray
and beg for help?
I am honest!
Please hear my prayer.
2Only you can say
that I am innocent,
because only your eyes
can see the truth.
3You know my heart,
and even during the night
you have tested me
and found me innocent.
I have made up my mind
never to tell a lie.
4I don't do like others.
I obey your teachings
and am not cruel.
5I have followed you,
without ever stumbling.
6I pray to you, God,
because you will help me.
Listen and answer my prayer!
7Show your wonderful love.
Your mighty arm protects those
who run to you for safety
from their enemies.
8Protect me as you would
your very own eyes;
hide me in the shadow
of your wings.
9Don't let my brutal enemies
attack from all sides
and kill me.
10They refuse to show mercy,
and they keep bragging.
11They have caught up with me!
My enemies are everywhere,
eagerly hoping to smear me
in the dirt.
12They are like hungry lions
hunting for food,
or like young lions
hiding in ambush.
13Do something, Lord!
Attack and defeat them.
Take your sword and save me
from those evil people.
14Use your powerful arm
and rescue me
from the hands of mere humans
whose world won't last.
You provide food
for those you love.
Their children have plenty,
and their grandchildren
will have more than enough.
15I am innocent, Lord,
and I will see your face!
When I awake, all I want
is to see you as you are.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1 Baŋa Wɛ,
cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom
de a na jege bora tei to.
Pore n zwa n cheigi a na keeri
a jare‑m tei to,
se ko dae vwa mo a fɔe.
2Nam zege amo kwaga ne
se a na a bora.
Pa se n yia taa nae
kolo na ye chega to.
3Nmo maane n nii
amo boboŋa na ye tei.
Nmo ma‑n fɔɔre n yi amo tei
tete ne de.
Nmo nam na faŋe-ne n nii
tei maama to, kolokolo tera.
A boboŋa maŋe ya ja we,
amo bá tusi de a ŋɔŋa kam.
4A ma che a tete se a yé zo
nankɔ-nyena chwei sem ne,
a na tɔge n ni taane na bere tei to ŋwaane.
5A nam yɔɔre a tɔge
nmo chwei sem mo.
A bere a wo ywori se wone.
6Amo Tu Wɛ, a lwoori‑m mo,
bɛŋwaane nmo mo wó leiri-ne.
Pore n zwa se n cheigi
a wɛ-lworo kom.
7Pa se nmo na yɔɔre n swoi nɔɔna tei to taa bere jaja.
Nmo yeini n kwei n jazem n ma
n vere balo na sale nmo yera ne to
n yage ba dona jeŋa ne.
8Ta‑n yere amo
nenɛɛne n tete yi-chele-bu to.
Pa se a vwɛ n woro kom wone,
ne nmo na yarege n vɔna
n kwoli-ne tei to.
9Jwoŋi-ne puseŋ-nyena bam jeŋa ne
de ba na ke chichuŋu de amo tei to.
Vere-ne a dona balo na chuli-ne
ye ba gilimi-ne se ba ja to jeŋa ne.
10Ŋwaŋa tera ba bochara ne.
Ba ni taane maa ye boyerem yerane.
11Ba pɛ amo kwaga mo ba pu.
Ba laam tu ba gilimi-ne.
Ba yia maa ye chɔɔ mo,
ye ba nii se ba dole-ne
ba de tega ne.
12Ba maa nye de nywonnu telo
wodiiru fera na jege-te to mo.
Ba dale mo se ba laam nwoŋi
ba ja-ne,
nenɛɛne nywon-pɔle na ke tei to.
13 Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne
n kwaare jara de-ba,
se n daare n de-ba tega ne.
Kwei n se-zɔɔ n ma‑n jwoŋi-ne
puseŋ-nyena bam jeŋa ne n yage.
14 Baŋa Wɛ, ma n jeŋa n vere-ne
nɔɔna bam konto dwi jeŋa ne
n yage.
Ba maa ye balo yiga na wo
logo konto yerane wone
ye ba nyɔɔre wo ŋwea kanto ne to mo.
Nam pa se ba na waarem delo
n na tiŋi ba ŋwaane to.
Pa se ba di ba su ba daare
ba pa ba bia,
se banto de tiŋi waarem
se ba bia jwa taa di.
15Ko nam ná ye amo,
a wó ba a na nmo yibia,
a na jege bora to ŋwaane.
A ná dɔ a zaŋe,
a wó su mo de ywoni,
a na nae nmo nyenyego
na ye tei to ŋwaane.

english_text:
(For the music leader. A psalm by David, the Lord's servant. David sang this to the Lord after the Lord had rescued him from his enemies, but especially from Saul.)
David's Song of Thanks
1I love you, Lord God,
and you make me strong.
2You are my mighty rock,
my fortress, my protector,
the rock where I am safe,
my shield, my powerful weapon,
and my place of shelter.
3I praise you, Lord!
I prayed, and you rescued me
from my enemies.
4Death had wrapped
its ropes around me,
and I was almost swallowed
by its flooding waters.
5Ropes from the world
of the dead
had coiled around me,
and death had set a trap
in my path.
6I was in terrible trouble
when I called out to you,
but from your temple
you heard me
and answered my prayer.
7The earth shook and shivered,
and the mountains trembled
down to their roots.
You were angry
8and breathed out smoke.
Scorching heat and fiery flames
spewed from your mouth.
9You opened the heavens
like curtains,
and you came down
with storm clouds
under your feet.
10You rode on the backs
of flying creatures
and swooped down
with the wind as wings.
11Darkness was your robe;
thunderclouds filled the sky,
hiding you from sight.
12Hailstones and fiery coals
lit up the sky
in front of you.
13 Lord Most High, your voice
thundered from the heavens,
as hailstones and fiery coals
poured down like rain.
14You scattered your enemies
with arrows of lightning.
15You roared at the sea,
and its deepest channels
could be seen.
You snorted,
and the earth shook
to its foundations.
16You reached down from heaven,
and you lifted me
from deep in the ocean.
17You rescued me from enemies,
who were hateful
and too powerful for me.
18On the day disaster struck,
they came and attacked,
but you defended me.
19When I was fenced in,
you freed and rescued me
because you love me.
20You are good to me, Lord,
because I do right,
and you reward me
because I am innocent.
21I do what you want
and never turn to do evil.
22I keep your laws in mind
and never look away
from your teachings.
23I obey you completely
and guard against sin.
24You have been good to me
because I do right;
you have rewarded me
for being innocent
by your standards.
25You are always loyal
to your loyal people,
and you are faithful
to the faithful.
26With all who are sincere,
you are sincere,
but you treat the unfaithful
as their deeds deserve.
27You rescue the humble,
but you put down all
who are proud.
28You, the Lord God,
keep my lamp burning
and turn darkness to light.
29You help me defeat armies
and capture cities.
30Your way is perfect, Lord,
and your word is correct.
You are a shield for those
who run to you for help.
31You alone are God!
Only you are a mighty rock.
32You give me strength
and guide me right.
33 You make my feet run as fast
as those of a deer,
and you help me stand
on the mountains.
34You teach my hands to fight
and my arms to use
a bow of bronze.
35You alone are my shield.
Your right hand supports me,
and by coming to help me,
you have made me famous.
36You clear the way for me,
and now I won't stumble.
37I kept chasing my enemies,
until I caught them
and destroyed them.
38I stuck my sword
through my enemies,
and they were crushed
under my feet.
39You helped me win victories,
and you forced my attackers
to fall victim to me.
40You made my enemies run,
and I killed them.
41They cried out for help,
but no one saved them;
they called out to you,
but there was no answer.
42I ground them to dust
blown by the wind,
and I poured them out
like mud in the streets.
43You rescued me
from stubborn people,
and you made me the leader
of foreign nations,
who are now my slaves.
44They obey and come crawling.
45They have lost all courage,
and from their fortresses,
they come trembling.
46You are the living Lord!
I will praise you.
You are a mighty rock.
I will honor you
for keeping me safe.
47You took revenge for me,
and you put nations
in my power.
48You protected me
from violent enemies
and made me much greater
than all of them.
49 I will praise you, Lord,
and I will honor you
among the nations.
50You give glorious victories
to your chosen king.
Your faithful love for David
and for his descendants
will never end.
translation_text:
David leiŋa
Wɛ tontoŋeno David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo Baŋa Wɛ na jwoŋi‑o o yage Pɛ Sɔɔl de o dona bam maama jeŋa ne to.
2 Samuwel 22:2-51
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
a swoi nmo.
Nmo mo ye amo dam.
2 Baŋa Wɛ nye de peo kolo
amo na dale da to mo.
O maa ye amo dam jei
dedaane amo jwoŋinu.
Amo Tu Wɛ nye de peo gugworo,
a na seigi a tete mɛ to.
O maa yeini o cho-ne
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔna
jara wone tei to.
O maa jege dam se o ma
o vere-ne cham wone.
O maa kwori o ye amo dalem jei.
3Amo yeini a bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere mo.
O de maa jwoŋi-ne o yage
a dona jeŋa ne.
Wonto maŋe se nabiina taa tei‑o mo.
4Toone déem kekare amo de vɔ.
Ko nam ya gɛ fee mo se chɔgem pu amo kwaga de ja
nenɛɛne na-fɔrɔ dwoŋi to.
5Ko nye de churu chwoŋa ŋoge ŋone mo ka vɔ amo ka tiŋi.
Toone de ma che kalanchogo
a chwoŋa ne de cheigi-ne.
6Lɛɛro na tiini te yi-ne to,
mo a bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere.
A ma keeri a jare a Tu Wɛ
se o zeini-ne.
O maa zege o sɔŋɔ kom ne
o ni amo kwora.
Amo keira kam ma yi o tei,
ka vo ka to o zwa ne.
7Tega kam baŋa maa ziziŋi
ye ka yera sae.
Peero tem kura maama de ziziŋi mo ye ya dɔna,
Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane.
8Nyoa maa tɔge o momwa ka nwoŋa.
O ta ma daare o twi min-vogo
de min-chala,
ye ya tɔge o ni ya nwoŋi
ya di wonnu bugi-bugi.
9O ma kɔɔre wɛyuu kom
nenɛɛne diga ni gɔrɔ to,
o daare o tu tega kam baŋa.
O na maa tu to,
kunkwon-lilirru wo o nɛ kuri ne mo.
10O diini cherubi mo o jaane
o maa kɛa.
Vio kom vɔna baŋa ne mo
o tɔge da o via.
11Lim mo o kwei o ma pu o tete
se ko ji woro ko pa‑o.
Kunkwon-lilirru telo na pae
do-fɔrɔ to ma kwoli‑o.
12Pwooni maa wo o yiga ne
de kale kunkwonnu tem.
Do-kandwa maa tɔge da
ya toe tega ne,
ye doa kam pepele
ka ta min-chala.
13Yuu-tu Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo zege
wɛyuu ne o bage de dam.
O kwora kam ma dɔne
ka to nɔɔna zwa ne.
14O ma ta o che-tɛɛra yam,
pa se o dona bam jage.
O mɛ doa pepelem mo o zeili-ba
ye ba duri ba jei.
15Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo bane na zaŋe
ye n bage n dona bam to,
mo naneo kom na bam pɔgele
pa ko kuri nae jaja.
Nmo na fi n momwa to,
tega kam gugworru maama
ma ziziŋi pa te tigi ja.
16 Baŋa Wɛ ma zege wɛyuu ne
o twe o jeŋa o ja amo.
O ma liiri-ne o ja o nwoŋi
na-luŋa wone.
17O yɔɔre o jwoŋi-ne mo o yage
a dona bam jeŋa ne,
kokuri to, balo na chuli amo to
tiini ba dana ba dwoi-ne.
18Amo ya wo lɛɛro wone mo
ye a dona bam chuchugi-ne.
Baŋa Wɛ nam tu o teili-ne
pa se a zege cheppe.
19O woli-ne mo o pa
a nwoŋi cham wone.
O ma yɔɔre o jwoŋi-ne o yage
se a taa wo pwooni yiga ne,
o wo na dɛ amo to ŋwaane.
20 Baŋa Wɛ ke-ne lanyerane
a na tɔge chega chwoŋa to ŋwaane.
Amo je sem na toŋe chega to,
mo o jwoori o ŋwe-ne konto.
21Amo yɔɔre a tɔge Baŋa Wɛ
chwei sem mo.
A wo ywori a Tu Wɛ kwaga ne
se a daare a toŋe lwarem.
22O nia yam maama mo amo tɔga.
A maa wo ve chullu telo o na pɛ to.
23A jege chega mo o yiga ne,
a na yeini a cho a tete
dedaane lwarem to ŋwaane.
24Ko ma pa se Baŋa Wɛ jwoori
o ke-ne lanyerane,
de a na tɔge chega chwoŋa
ye a je sem toŋe chekke to ŋwaane.
25Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
Nmo yeini n jege chega mo
de balo na jege chega ba pa‑m to.
Balo na jege bora n yiga ne to mo,
nmo yɔɔre n toŋe lanyerane
n pa-ba.
26Ko ná ye balo na jege wo-pwoŋo to,
nmo de ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo
n pa-ba.
Ko daare balo na toŋe tusim kikia to,
n ke swa mo pa ko chɛ ba yera ne.
27Nmo yeini n jwoŋi nabwona mo
n yaga.
Ko nam ná ye balo na bere ba tete kamunim to,
n yeini n vaŋe-ba mo n de tega ne.
28 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo jaane pwooni
n ba n pa-ne.
Chega to, amo Tu Wɛ, n pae se
lim delo na kwoli amo to
jwoori de ji pwooni.
29Nmo mo yeini n pa amo dam,
se a wane a zeili
a dona bam kɔgɔ maama.
N dam dem konto ta ma woli-ne,
se a wane a faŋe a gaale
a dona bam teo kabira,
ye a daare a di-ba.
30Amo Tu Wɛ chwoŋa kam
lamma fase mo!
O ni taane dem yɔɔre de ye chega mo.
O wae o cho balo na seigi
o woro kom wone to,
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔna
jara wone tei to.
31Wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera
ko ná dae Baŋa Wɛ.
Wonto yerane mo nye de peo kolo
debam na wó dale da to.
32O maa jege dam o kwoli-ne,
ye o pa se a chwoŋa tigi jase
se a taa vei ka wone.
33O ta pae se a nɛ kwaare tega mo,
nenɛɛne woŋa nɛ na ye tei to mo.
O maa cho-ne se a yé to
peero tem yuu ne.
34Wonto ta bere-ne jara keim laŋa mo,
se a taa wae a saŋe taŋa kalo
na vaŋe de dam to a tae.
35Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo pɛ-ne jara-keim nantana
se ka taa kwoli-ne,
ye n jwoŋi-ne n yage cham wone.
Nmo jazem dem teili-ne mo
se a zege cheppe.
Nmo na sɛ se n woli-ne tei to
pɛ se a ji babea.
36Nmo kwɛ chwoŋa kalo na yala to mo
n tiŋi amo yiga ne,
se a yé seeri a to tega ne.
37Amo pare a dona bam mo a ja.
A ma mage ba maama a go
pa ba wolowolo wo daare.
38A popoge-ba mo a de tega ne
pa se ba daa ware wɛɛne se ba zaŋe,
a na nɔne-ba de a naga to ŋwaane.
39 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo pa-ne dam
se a taa ma a ke jara.
N ta ma‑n pae se a dona bam ba
ba kuni dwoona amo yiga ne.
40N ta pa se foone ja
a dona bam maama
ye ba pipiri mo ba duri
ba daare-ne.
Amo ma yɔɔre a chɔge
balo na chuli-ne to.
41Ba maa beeri wolim.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam tera
se o jwoŋi-ba o yage.
Ba ma keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ,
ye o wo sɛ ba wara yam.
42Amo maa cho-ba a mumugi
pa se ba ji nenɛɛne fwogo vio
na kale tei to.
A ma lwo-ba a yage
nenɛɛne ba ye chwoŋa ni bworu to.
43Ko ná ye paweero telo
na chuli amo to,
nmo vere-ne n yage ba jeŋa ne mo.
Nmo ta ma‑n pa se a di paare
teene dedɛ baŋa ne,
se a taa tei dwi tiina balo
a ya na yeiri to.
44 Dwi-gɛ tiina ná yɔɔre
ba ni amo taane,
ba yeini ba sɛ a ni mo.
Ba ta ma gwane amo yiga ne
de foone.
45Veira bam konto vɔna yeini
ya da ya pare mo.
Ba ma zaŋe ba nwoŋi
ba dalem jei sem wone,
ye ba yera sae de foone.
46 Baŋa Wɛ seene o ŋwe!
O maa ye peo kolo
amo na dale da to.
Ko maŋe mo se dé taa tei‑o.
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Wonto nam mo jwoŋi-ne o yage!
47Wonto mo jwoori o ŋwe jene
a dona baŋa ne.
O maa jaane dwi-gɛ tiina o tui
o ke amo dam kuri ne.
48O ta jwoŋi-ne mo a dona jeŋa ne o yage.
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo mo pa-ne dam
se a di balo na chuli-ne to.
N ta ma‑n jwoŋi-ne
nankɔ-nyena jeŋa ne.
49Konto ŋwaane nam mo,
amo wó tei nmo yere,
se dwi-gɛ tiina taa yei n ni ne.
Chega ŋwaane to, Baŋa Wɛ,
amo wó leeni a tei nmo yere.
50 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o pa se o pɛ wom
di wɔnɔ mo maŋa maama.
O maa tɔge o swono kom baŋa ne
o ke pɛ wolo o na kuri to lanyerane se ko taa vei wuu.
Ko maa ye amo David
de a dwi dem mo konto.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Wonders of God and the Goodness of His Law
1The heavens keep telling
the wonders of God,
and the skies declare
what he has done.
2Each day informs
the following day;
each night announces
to the next.
3They don't speak a word,
and there is never
the sound of a voice.
4 Yet their message reaches
all the earth,
and it travels
around the world.
In the heavens a tent
is set up for the sun.
5It rises like a bridegroom
and gets ready like a hero
eager to run a race.
6It travels all the way
across the sky.
Nothing hides from its heat.
7 The Law of the Lord is perfect;
it gives us new life.
His teachings last forever,
and they give wisdom
to ordinary people.
8The Lord's instruction is right;
it makes our hearts glad.
His commands shine brightly,
and they give us light.
9Worshiping the Lord is sacred;
he will always be worshiped.
All his decisions
are correct and fair.
10They are worth more
than the finest gold
and are sweeter than honey
from a honeycomb.
11By your teachings, Lord,
I am warned;
by obeying them,
I am greatly rewarded.
12None of us know our faults.
Forgive me when I sin
without knowing it.
13Don't let me do wrong
on purpose, Lord,
or let sin have control
over my life.
Then I will be innocent,
and not guilty
of some terrible fault.
14Let my words and my thoughts
be pleasing to you, Lord,
because you are my mighty rock
and my protector.
translation_text:
Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛyuu kom bere Wɛ nenɔŋa kam na ye tei to mo.
Kunkwonnu tem de maa paale
kolo maama o jea na naane to.
2Dɛ maama yeini de kwei
kwora kam konto mo
de pae dɛ delo na saŋe-de to.
Tete maama de maa pae
se kwora kam jaga.
3Wɛyuu wonnu tento ba ŋɔɔne
botare-bia se ba taa zaŋa.
Te kwori sem maa ye chemm mo.
4De ko de, te ni taane dem
yi tega baŋa jei maama mo.
Te kwora ma jage ka yi
dɔŋɔ ni maama.
Wɛ chwi vwei mo wɛyuu kom ne
o pa wea kam
se ka taa zoore da.
5Ka laam maa yeini ka puli,
nenɛɛne ka-dooro baro na nwoŋi diga ne de wopwolo tei to,
naa babea na duri de dam
se o di yiga tei to.
6Ka maa yeini ka zaŋe wɛyuu kom
daa dedoa ne mo,
ye ka tole ka chwoŋa kam ka vo
ka yi daa kadwoŋi kam ne.
Kolokolo bá seigi ka wulim dem yiga ne.
7 Baŋa Wɛ nia yam yɔɔre
ya ye chekke mo.
Ya maa pae se nɔɔna jwoori
ba na dam.
Baŋa Wɛ bera yam jege kuri.
Ya maa pae nayeiri-nyena swa mo.
8 Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam tɔge chwoŋa.
Ka maa pae wopwolo dedɛ.
Baŋa Wɛ ni-kaana yam
bere chega mo jaja.
Ya maa pae nɔɔna yi-poro.
9Nɔɔna ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, ko lana.
Konto jege kuri se ko taa vei wuu.
Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa yam jege chega.
Ya ba tusa de fenfee de.
10Wɛ nia yam jege kuri
ya dwoi sabu-seŋa dedɛ,
ka ná maŋe ka lana tei maama de.
Ya ywomma ya dwoi tooro,
de tooro nuga maama.
11 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nia yam kaane
n tɔgena mo.
Wolo maama ná sɛ-ya,
kotu nae nyɔɔre dedɛ mo
ya ŋwaane.
12Nɔɔno wó wane o lɔre
o na tusi tei to na?
Amo ná tusi ye a yeiri ko ni ne,
se n saare a tusim dem konto
n yage n ma n chɛ-ne.
13Ta‑n cho-ne se a yé paale
a ke wo-lwanno.
Yé pa se wɛleera taa jege dam
amo baŋa ne.
Konto mo a wó wane a taa jege bora de a kikia maama,
ye a bá ywori nmo kwaga ne.
14 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se a ni taane dem
de a boboŋa maama
taa ye kolo na wó pwoli nmo wo to.
Nmo nye de peo kolo amo na sale
ko yera ne to mo.
N ta ma‑n ye amo jwoŋinu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Victory
1I pray that the Lord
will listen when you
are in trouble,
and that the God of Jacob
will keep you safe.
2May the Lord send help
from his temple
and come to your rescue
from Mount Zion.
3May he remember your gifts
and be pleased
with what you bring.
4May God do what you want most
and let all go well for you.
5Then you will win victories,
and we will celebrate,
while raising our banners
in the name of our God.
May the Lord answer
all your prayers!
6I am certain, Lord,
that you will help
your chosen king.
You will answer my prayers
from your holy place
in heaven,
and you will save me
with your mighty arm.
7Some people trust the power
of chariots or horses,
but we trust you, Lord God.
8Others will stumble and fall,
but we will be strong
and stand firm.
9Give the king victory, Lord,
and answer our prayers.
translation_text:
Dé wó sale Baŋa Wɛ yera ne
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Cham ná yi nmo,
Baŋa Wɛ wó ba o zeini‑m.
O maa ye dé nabaaro Jakob
Wɛ wom mo.
O wó taa cho‑m de n dona bam.
2O wó zege o wara-jei sem ne
o toŋe o zeini nmo.
Zion peo kom ne mo konto,
o lage o zege da o ba
o zege n kwaga ne.
3O ta wó guli
n pɛɛra yam maama gula.
Kaanem delo maama nmo na zwɛ
n pa‑o to wo su o yi.
4Wɛ wó pa n na n boboŋa
na lage kolo to,
se n na jeeli kolo maama to
seene ko ke ko pa‑m.
5Pɛ, nmo laam ná wane
dé dona bam n di,
dé wó taa chaka mo.
Dé wó zeiŋi dé tuta wɛɛne
de wopwolo
dé Tu Wɛ wom yere ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ wó ke o su n wɛ-lworo kom maama o pa‑m.
6Amo laam tu a lɔre we
Baŋa Wɛ zeini pɛ wolo o na kuri to
se o wane o dona bam.
O zege o tete telaao ne mo
o leiri pɛ wom na lwoori‑o
tei maama to.
O maa tɔge o dam-fɔrɔ jazem dem baŋa ne
o jwoŋi‑o o yage.
7Nɔɔna badwonna jege teera
ba jara-keim torokooro ŋwaane.
Badwonna de maa jege teera
ba sisein-nɔɔna ŋwaane.
Debam nam jege teera dé Tu
Baŋa Wɛ yere dem ŋwaane mo.
8Banto maa chɔɔle ba to tega ne.
Debam nam wó zaŋe wɛɛne
dé taa zege mo cheppe.
9 Baŋa Wɛ, nam pa dé pɛ wom
wane o dona bam o di.
Dé ná lwoori zeinim n tei ne,
se n leiri dé wɛ-lworo kom!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1Our Lord, your mighty power
makes the king glad,
and he celebrates victories
that you have given him.
2You did what he wanted most
and never told him “No.”
3You truly blessed the king,
and you placed on him
a crown of finest gold.
4He asked to live a long time,
and you promised him life
that never ends.
5The king is highly honored.
You have let him win victories
that have made him famous.
6You have given him blessings
that will last forever,
and you have made him glad
by being so near to him.
7 Lord Most High,
the king trusts you,
and your kindness
keeps him from defeat.
8With your mighty arm, Lord,
you will strike down all
of your hateful enemies.
9They will be destroyed by fire
once you are here,
and because of your anger,
flames will swallow them.
10You will wipe their families
from the earth,
and they will disappear.
11All their plans to harm you
will come to nothing.
12You will make them run away
by shooting your arrows
at their faces.
13Show your strength, Lord,
so that we may sing
and praise your power.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ na zeini pɛ wom tei to
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
pɛ wom wo mo pwoli,
nmo dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
O tiini o jege ywoni mo o di,
nmo na pɛ o wane o dona bam
o di to ŋwaane.
2Nmo pɛ‑o kolo o boboŋa na lage to.
Nmo ta wo ve‑o kolo maama
o na lwoori n tei ne to.
3Nmo jeeri‑o de wo-laaro,
ye n yɔɔre n swɛ o swolim.
N ma‑n kwei sabu-seŋa paare yipuga n pu o yuu ne.
4O lwoori nmo tei ne
se n ta‑n nii o ŋwea kam baŋa ne.
Nmo ma‑n seene n pa
se o na momwɛ-dɛɛre,
se o taa ŋwe taa wuu.
5O tiini o na zula dedɛ,
nmo na zeini‑o to ŋwaane.
Nmo ta daare n pa se o na nenɔŋa
de paare lanyerane.
6Chega to, nmo yeini n swɛ
o swolim mo taa wuu.
Nmo ta pɛ se o wo pwoli dedɛ,
de n na wo o tei ne to ŋwaane.
7Kokuri to, pɛ wom sale
Baŋa Wɛ yera ne mo.
O daa bá fɔge o to,
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na jege
o swono taa wuu to ŋwaane.
8Nmo lage n kwei n jeŋa mo
n ma n ja n dona bam maama.
N jazem dem wó zi-ba de chɔge.
9Nmo ná nwoŋi ye n zaŋe ba baŋa ne,
n lage n di-ba mo
dedaane min-vogo.
Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo wó di-ba
o ban-lom dem ŋwaane.
O lage o pa se o mini mo di-ba kula.
10Nmo wó pa se n dona bam bia
jei mo logo kom baŋa ne.
Ba daa bá na dwi se de daare.
11Ba bá wane ba vo yiga,
de ba ná maŋe ba jeeli totoŋ-lwanno
se ba ke ba ma chɔge nmo yiga
tei maama de.
12Nmo nam wó saŋe n taŋa
se n ta-ba,
pa se ba pipiri ba duri ba kɛ.
13Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne
se n yɔɔre n bere n dam-fɔrɔ kom!
Dé wó leeni mo dé seini‑m
de n na toŋe totoŋ-kamuna yalo to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “A Deer at Dawn.”)
Suffering and Praise
1 My God, my God, why have you
deserted me?
Why are you so far away?
Won't you listen to my groans
and come to my rescue?
2I cry out day and night,
but you don't answer,
and I can never rest.
3Yet you are the holy God,
ruling from your throne
and praised by Israel.
4 Our ancestors trusted you,
and you rescued them.
5When they cried out for help,
you saved them,
and you did not let them down
when they depended on you.
6But I am merely a worm,
far less than human,
and I am hated and rejected
by people everywhere.
7 Everyone who sees me
makes fun and sneers.
They shake their heads,
8 and say, “Trust the Lord!
If you are his favorite,
let him protect you
and keep you safe.”
9You, Lord, brought me
safely through birth,
and you protected me
when I was a baby
at my mother's breast.
10From the day I was born,
I have been in your care,
and from the time of my birth,
you have been my God.
11Don't stay far off
when I am in trouble
with no one to help me.
12Enemies are all around
like a herd of wild bulls.
Powerful bulls from Bashan
are everywhere.
13My enemies are like lions
roaring and attacking
with jaws open wide.
14I have no more strength
than a few drops of water.
All my bones are out of joint;
my heart is like melted wax.
15My strength has dried up
like a broken clay pot,
and my tongue sticks
to the roof of my mouth.
You, God, have left me
to die in the dirt.
16Brutal enemies attack me
like a pack of dogs,
tearing at my hands
and my feet.
17I can count all my bones,
and my enemies just stare
and sneer at me.
18 They took my clothes
and gambled for them.
19Don't stay far away, Lord!
My strength comes from you,
so hurry and help.
20Rescue me from enemy swords
and save me from those dogs.
21Don't let lions eat me.
You rescued me from the horns
of wild bulls,
22 and when your people meet,
I will praise you, Lord.
23All who worship the Lord,
now praise him!
You belong to Jacob's family
and to the people of Israel,
so fear and honor the Lord!
24The Lord doesn't hate
or despise the helpless
in all of their troubles.
When I cried out, he listened
and did not turn away.
25When your people meet,
you will fill my heart
with your praises, Lord,
and everyone will see me
keep my promises to you.
26The poor will eat and be full,
and all who worship you
will be thankful
and live in hope.
27Everyone on this earth
will remember you, Lord.
People all over the world
will turn and worship you,
28because you are in control,
the ruler of all nations.
29All who are rich
and have more than enough
will bow down to you, Lord.
Even those who are dying
and almost in the grave
will come and bow down.
30In the future, everyone
will worship and learn
about you, our Lord.
31People not yet born
will be told,
“The Lord has saved us!”
translation_text:
Yaara wone wɛ-lworo
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1A Wɛ, a Wɛ,
bɛ mo ke ye n yage a yera?
Nmo ye yiga yiga amo tei ne.
Bɛ mo ye n wo tu se n zeini-ne
a cham wone,
de a na tiini a lwoori‑m tetei to?
2A Tu Wɛ, dɛ maama a yeini
a keeri a lage zeina ye n chem.
Tete ne de a yeini a lwoori‑m
ye siu tera.
3De konto maama de,
n ta ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo.
N ma‑n jei n paare jeiŋa jei ne,
ye n nɔɔna Isarele tiina
de maa pa‑m tia.
4Debam nabaara bam déem ke
ba wo-dedoa de nmo mo.
N ma‑n jwoŋi-ba n yage.
5Cham na jege-ba to
mo ba keeri ba jare‑m.
Nmo ma‑n pa se ba lu de wone.
Ba na ke ba wo-dedoa dede‑m to,
nmo wo yage-ba laŋa tetare ne.
6Nɔɔna maama na yaale-ne
ye ba gwooni-ne tei to
nye de a ye kanzwɛ mo,
se a dae nabiinu.
7Nɔɔna balo maama yi na nɛ amo to mɔne mo.
Ba maa dole ba yum ba twe-ne.
8Ba tɛ ba we:
“Pa n teena taa wo Baŋa Wɛ wone
se o le‑m cham wone.
Nmo kikia ná su Baŋa Wɛ yi,
se o jwoŋi‑m o yage!”
9Nmo nam mo jaane-ne n nwoŋi
a nu puga ne de yazura.
Amo ta na ye bu-seseŋa
ye a ŋɔge a nu yele to mo
nmo nii amo baŋa ne.
10Ko zege a lora maŋa ne mo
a teena maŋe ya wo nmo wone.
Nmo ta ma‑n ye amo Tu Wɛ.
11Chanɛɛre tiini de bwola se de ja-ne.
Yé vei yiga yiga n daare-ne,
se nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera
o na wó woli-ne.
12Amo dona bam daga
ye ba gilimi-ne ne nabɛ mo tei.
Ba nye de nabɛ kamunnu
na nwoŋi Basan laŋa ne
ye se beeri jara to mo.
13Amo dona bam kaŋe ba nia mo
ba beene a baŋa,
nenɛɛne nywonnu na lage
te ja te nɔna te tore te di,
ye te tiini te laare tetei to.
14A ŋwea kam lwogi ka yage mo
ne ba na lwogi na
ba yage tega ne tei to.
Amo kwi sem maama ywori mo.
A bochare dem de maa nye
de nuga kalo na nyeene to.
15A ni dem koge mo ne kanchua tei.
A dindeilimi de maa meeri
de maŋe a ni dem wone.
Wɛ, nmo yage-ne se a to tega ne mo
se a daare a te.
16A dona bam gilimi amo
ne kukuri kɔgɔ tei to mo.
Ba ma ja a jea dedaane a nɛ maama se ba vuuri-se.
17Amo yera yam bugi
pa se a kwi sem nae jaja,
ye a ga se maama a vo a ti.
A dona bam maa yɔɔre ba nii-ne
ye ba mɔna.
18Ba ma kwei amo gwaaro tem
se ba pɔɔre-te ba pa daane,
ye ba daare ba ta jɔrɔ
