amo gare-bu wom ŋwaane.
19Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
yé ta‑n ye yiga yiga de amo.
Amo zeinnu, ba lela n woli-ne!
20Cho-ne se a dona bam se-zɔɔro
yé chɔge-ne.
Jwoŋi a ŋwea kukuri sento nia ne
n yage.
21Cho-ne se nywonnu yé ja-ne.
Nam cheiŋi nabɛ sento
se se yé chu-ne de se nyea.
Nmo laam cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom!
22Amo wó ta n taane
a nu-bia bam yiga ne
pa se n yere zaŋe.
A maa wó zege ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne
a tei n yere dem.
23Abam balo na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to,
laam tei‑o na!
Se abam, Jakob dwi dem maama,
zuli-na o yere dem!
Isarele tiina maama,
chɔɔle-na o yiga ne!
24Bɛŋwaane Baŋa Wɛ ba chuli nabwona,
o nam ba gwooni-ba.
O wo pipiri o kwaga o ya amo.
Amo ná kaase a jare‑o,
o yiga wora de amo mo.
25Amo ná zege nmo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom
tetare ne,
a wó tei‑m n keina maama ŋwaane.
Amo wó seene a ke kolo a na pwooli nmo yiga ne se a ke to,
se balo maama na kɔre nmo to taa nae.
26Nabwona wó di ba su.
Balo na tu Baŋa Wɛ tei to
wó tei‑o taa.
Yazura taa wo ba tei ne
se ko taa vei wuu!
27Logo baŋa jei maama ne
nɔɔna wó guli Baŋa Wɛ gula
ye ba pipiri ba ba o tei.
Nabiina dwi maama wó ba
ba chɔɔle o yiga ne ye ba zuli‑o.
28 Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ
logo kom maama wone.
O di paare mo teene dem maama baŋa ne.
29Logo baŋa naduna maama
wó ba ba chɔɔle o yiga ne
ba zuli‑o.
Balo ŋwea na lage ka jei to maama
wó ba ba tiiri o yiga ne.
30Debam dwi delo ta na wo kwaga ne to wó zuli‑o.
Ba jwa wó ni dé Teiru Wɛ ŋwa.
31Nɔɔna balo ba ta na wo loge to
wó ba ba lɔre Wɛ chega kam
de o na jwoŋi o nɔɔna o yage tei to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Good Shepherd
1You, Lord, are my shepherd.
I will never be in need.
2 You let me rest in fields
of green grass.
You lead me to streams
of peaceful water,
3and you refresh my life.
You are true to your name,
and you lead me
along the right paths.
4I may walk through valleys
as dark as death,
but I won't be afraid.
You are with me,
and your shepherd's rod
makes me feel safe.
5You treat me to a feast,
while my enemies watch.
You honor me as your guest,
and you fill my cup
until it overflows.
6Your kindness and love
will always be with me
each day of my life,
and I will live forever
in your house, Lord.
translation_text:
Nayero-ŋom wom taane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ
nii amo baŋa ne mo,
nenɛɛne nayero na nii o vara tei to.
Konto ŋwaane kolokolo gɛɛre
bá fɔge ko ja-ne.
2O yeini o jaane-ne mo
o vei ga-zuru jei se a sii.
O maa kale-ne pa se dé vei
mɛ seeni bwi na bwola da to.
3O pae se a ŋwea jwoori
ka jege dam mo.
O maa tɔge a yiga
pa se a tɔge chwo-laaro,
se ko pa o yere dem zaŋe wɛɛne.
4Nmo wo amo tei ne mo
maŋa maama.
A ná maŋe a tɔge jei selo na ye lim nenɛɛne toone mo de,
amo bá taa kɔre foone,
nmo na zei n gwoli dem
de n nacheiga kam
n ma‑n cho-ne to ŋwaane.
5Amo Tu Wɛ, n lage wodi-fɔrɔ mo
n pa ba saŋe ba zege
amo yiga ne se a di,
ye a dona bam zege da ba nia.
Nmo ta lwogi nuga mo amo yuu ne
n ke-ne zaane.
Nmo pɛ se a na-zoŋa kam
tiini ka su ka pɛɛle.
6Chega ŋwaane to, dɛ delo maama wone a na wó taa ŋwe to,
nmo lanyerane de n swono kom
wó taa wo amo tei ne mo.
Amo wó taa wo nmo Baŋa Wɛ
sɔŋɔ kom ne mo
se ko taa vei wuu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
Who Can Enter the Lord's Temple?
1 The earth and everything on it,
including its people,
belong to the Lord.
The world and its people
belong to him.
2The Lord placed it all
on the oceans and rivers.
3Who may climb the Lord's hill
or stand in his holy temple?
4 Only those who do right
for the right reasons,
and don't worship idols
or tell lies under oath.
5The Lord God, who saves them,
will bless and reward them,
6because they worship and serve
the God of Jacob.
7Open the ancient gates,
so that the glorious king
may come in.
8Who is this glorious king?
He is our Lord, a strong
and mighty warrior.
9Open the ancient gates,
so that the glorious king
may come in.
10Who is this glorious king?
He is our Lord,
the All-Powerful!
translation_text:
Wɔ mo wó wane o zo Wɛ diga kam wone?
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Tega kam baŋa
dedaane kolo maama na wo
ko wone to ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo.
Logo kom de ko nɔn-bia bam
maama de maa ye wonto nyem.
2Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ bobo
logo kom kuri,
ye o jare tega kam ni maama
pa se ka tigi na-fwaaro tem baŋa ne mo.
3Wɔ nam mo wó wane o di
Baŋa Wɛ tete peo kom baŋa?
Wɔ mo jege chwoŋa se o vo
o zege Wɛ tete wara-jei sem ne?
4Ko ye balo yerane
kikia na dɛ chwoŋa
ye ba bochara lana fase to mo.
Banto ba sɛ ba kaane jwona.
Ba nam ba fɔ vwa ba du duuri.
5 Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ nɔɔna bam konto swolim.
Wɛ na ye ba Vereno to,
wonto wó pa se ba na bora.
6Banto dwi dem ye balo na fɔɔre
ba twɛ Wɛ to mo.
Ba yeini ba vei Jakob Wɛ wom yiga ne mo,
ye ba lwoori‑o.
7Pore-na manchwo-peena ni dem!
Pa-na se faŋa faŋa bworru tem pore se chwoŋa taa tigi jaja!
Kokuri nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ tu Pɛ wom
lage o tɔge da mo o zo.
8Pɛ wonto ye wɔ mo
o na tiini o jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to?
O ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo,
o na ye dam maama tu wom
ye o wae o dona maama to.
9Pore-na manchwo-peena ni dem!
Pa-na se faŋa faŋa bworru tem pore se chwoŋa taa tigi jaja!
Kokuri nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ tu Pɛ wom
lage o tɔge da mo o zo.
10Pɛ wonto nam ye wɔ mo
o na tiini o jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to?
O ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo.
Wonto mo ye nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ tu Pɛ wom!

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for Guidance and Help
1I offer you my heart, Lord God,
2and I trust you.
Don't make me ashamed
or let enemies defeat me.
3Don't disappoint any
of your worshipers,
but disappoint all
deceitful liars.
4Show me your paths
and teach me to follow;
5guide me by your truth
and instruct me.
You keep me safe,
and I always trust you.
6Please, Lord, remember,
you have always
been patient and kind.
7Forget each wrong I did
when I was young.
Show how truly kind you are
and remember me.
8You are honest and merciful,
and you teach sinners
how to follow your path.
9You lead humble people
to do what is right
and to stay on your path.
10In everything you do,
you are kind and faithful
to everyone who keeps
our agreement with you.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
by forgiving each one
of my terrible sins.
12You will show the right path
to all who worship you.
13Then they will have plenty,
and their children
will receive the land.
14Our Lord, you are the friend
of your worshipers,
and you make an agreement
with all of us.
15I always look to you,
because you rescue me
from every trap.
16I am lonely and troubled.
Show that you care
and have pity on me.
17My awful worries keep growing.
Rescue me from sadness.
18See my troubles and misery
and forgive my sins.
19Look at all my enemies!
See how much they hate me.
20I come to you for shelter.
Protect me, keep me safe,
and don't disappoint me.
21I obey you with all my heart,
and I trust you, knowing
that you will save me.
22Our God, please save Israel
from all its troubles.
translation_text:
Chanɛɛre maŋa wɛ-lworo
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo
a kwei a tete a pa‑m.
2Amo Tu Wɛ, a ke a wo-dedoa
dedaane nmo.
Yé pa se chaveera di-ne.
Nam yé sɛ se a dona bam
taa jege-ne ba mɔna.
3Balo teena na daŋe
nmo baŋa ne to maama
bá na ba chaveera.
Balo nam na gane ba dwonna
yɔɔ yɔɔ to
wó yɔɔre ba di chaveera mo.
4Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
pa se a lɔre nmo chwei sem,
se a taa tɔge n bera yam a ŋwea wone.
5Bere-ne nmo chega kam,
se a wane a tɔge ka chwei sem.
Kolo ŋwaane nmo mo ye
amo Vereno Wɛ wom.
Amo teena maa wo nmo tei ne mo
dɛ dem maama wone.
6 Baŋa Wɛ, yé swei n swono kom ni ne,
de n na tiini n jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa tei to.
Nmo swono kom de n yibwona
maŋe te wora se ko nwoŋi faŋa mo.
7Ko ná ye a na lɔge nmo kwaga ne
ye a ke wɛleera yalo
a nɔn-donne maŋa ne to,
se n kwei-ya n ma‑n chɛ-ne.
Baŋa Wɛ, nam tɔge n swono kom ŋwaane
n pa se n yiga taa wo amo wone,
nmo na jege lam to ŋwaane.
8 Baŋa Wɛ lamma mo
ye o yɔɔre o ke chega.
Ko ná ye balo na tusi to,
o yeini o bere-ba chwoŋa kalo na ye chekke to.
9O maa tɔge balo na tu ba tete to yiga,
se ba taa ke kolo na maŋe to mo,
ye o daare o bere-ba o chwoŋa kam.
10Chwei selo maama Baŋa Wɛ
na tɔge to
ye o swono kom ŋwaane mo.
O maa ke o chega dedaane balo
na sɛ ba tɔge ni delo
o na gwoni de-ba to.
11Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nam da n yere dem ŋwaane
n kwei a keim-lwanno
n yage n ma‑n chɛ-ne,
de te na maŋe te daga tei maama.
12Ko ná ye wolo maama
na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to,
Wɛ wó bere kotu se o taa tɔge chwoŋa kalo na maŋe to mo.
13Wɛ ta wó pa se o di ywoni
o ŋwea wone.
O dwi dem de wó jwoŋi tega kam
ba taa tei.
14 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o lɔ o wo
o bere balo na kɔre‑o to.
O maa pae se ba lɔre o ni-gwonim dem na bere tei maama.
15Amo yeini a kwoni a nii
Baŋa Wɛ seeni mo,
se o ba o woli-ne.
Wonto yerane mo wó wane
o le-ne a dona jeŋa ne,
se a lu ba kalanchorro tem wone.
16Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
pa n yiga taa wo amo wone,
se n daare n duri amo ŋwaŋa,
a na ye a yerane ye ko tiini
ko ni-ne to ŋwaane.
17A chanɛɛre dem laam tiini
de zo-ne.
Popo, jwoŋi-ne n yage
ya maama wone.
18Nii n na a zonne dem de a chanɛɛre dem na daga tei to,
se n laam kwei a wɛleera yam maama n ma‑n chɛ-ne.
19Nii n na a dona bam laam
na puli dedɛ tei to.
Ba maa tiini ba chuli-ne
dedaane puseŋa.
20Amo nam tu se a dale
nmo woro ne mo.
Ta‑n cho a ŋwea se a na verem,
pa se a yé di a chaveera.
21A kwei a teena a daŋe nmo baŋa ne.
Nam ta‑n yere-ne,
de a na yɔɔre a tɔge chwoŋa
ye a jege chega tei to.
22Amo Tu Wɛ,
jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam n yage,
se ba nwoŋi ba chanɛɛre maama wone.

english_text:
(By David.)
The Prayer of an Innocent Person
1Show that I am right, Lord!
I stay true to myself,
and I have trusted you
without doubting.
2Test my thoughts and find out
what I am like.
3I never forget your kindness,
and I am always faithful
to you.
4I don't spend my time
with worthless liars
5or go with evil crowds.
6I wash my hands, Lord,
to show my innocence,
and I worship at your altar,
7while gratefully singing
about your wonders.
8I love the temple
where you live, and where
your glory shines.
9Don't sweep me away,
as you do sinners.
Don't punish me with death
as you do those people
who are brutal
10or full of meanness
or who bribe others.
11I stay true to myself.
Be kind and rescue me.
12Now I stand on solid ground!
And when your people meet,
I will praise you, Lord.
translation_text:
Wolo na jege bora to wɛ-lworo
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
pa se a na a bora!
Kokuri to, amo yɔɔre a tɔge chwoŋa mo a ŋwea maama wone.
A ta ma ke a wo-dedoa de nmo
ye bobwea tera.
2 Baŋa Wɛ, faŋe-ne n nii,
se n maane a boboŋa de a bochare maama na ye tei to.
3Kokuri to, amo yeini a guli
nmo na yɔɔre n jege a swono
tei to gula.
Amo ta tɔge nmo na jege chega
de amo tei to a ŋwea wone.
4A ba me de vwa-fɔra.
A maa ba tɔge
dedaane pipiri-nyena.
5A chuli balo na jeeri daane
se ba toŋe lwarem to,
ye a daare a vane puseŋ-nyena.
6 Baŋa Wɛ, amo sane a jea mo,
se ko bere we a jege bora.
A maa wó kaare nmo kaanem bimbini dem
n yere zula ŋwaane
7ye a leeni a zuli‑m
a daare a ta nmo totoŋ-kamuna yam taane jaja.
8 Baŋa Wɛ, amo tiini a swoi
nmo wara-jei sem
mɛ n na zoore to.
Ko maa ye jeiga kalo n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom na bere jaja to.
9Yé pa se a tɔge de wɛleere-keira
a ga a ŋwea.
Ta yé pa se a ŋwea ti,
nenɛɛne ko na ke nɔn-gora tei to.
10Banto ye kampin-nyena mo
ye ba je sem swoi puseŋa kikia.
11Ko nam ná ye amo,
a yɔɔre a tɔge chwoŋa mo
a ŋwea maama wone.
Konto to, duri a ŋwaŋa,
se n daare n jwoŋi-ne n yage.
12Amo laam nam zege mo cheppe,
tega kalo na mae daane to baŋa ne.
Baŋa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ná jeeri daane,
amo wó seini‑o ba tetare ne.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer of Praise
1You, Lord, are the light
that keeps me safe.
I am not afraid of anyone.
You protect me,
and I have no fears.
2Brutal people may attack
and try to kill me,
but they will stumble.
Fierce enemies may attack,
but they will fall.
3Armies may surround me,
but I won't be afraid;
war may break out,
but I will trust you.
4I ask only one thing, Lord:
Let me live in your house
every day of my life
to see how wonderful you are
and to pray in your temple.
5In times of trouble, Lord,
you will protect me.
You will hide me in your tent
and keep me safe
on top of a mighty rock.
6You will let me defeat
all my enemies.
Then I will celebrate,
as I enter your tent
with animal sacrifices
and songs of praise.
7Please listen when I pray!
Have pity. Answer my prayer.
8My heart tells me to pray.
I am eager to see your face,
9so don't hide from me.
I am your servant, Lord,
and you have helped me.
Don't turn from me in anger.
You alone keep me safe.
Don't reject or desert me.
10Even if my father and mother
should desert me,
you will take care of me.
11Teach me to follow, Lord,
and lead me on the right path
because of my enemies.
12Don't let them do to me
what they want.
People tell lies about me
and make violent threats,
13but I know I will live
to see how kind you are.
14Trust the Lord!
Be brave and strong
and trust the Lord.
translation_text:
Amo teena wo Wɛ tei ne
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ mo pa se pwooni tigi a yiga ne se a taa via.
O maa ye amo Vereno.
Bɛ nam mo wó pa
se foone taa jege-ne?
Baŋa Wɛ maa jege dam
ye o cho a ŋwea kam.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o pa
se a taa kɔre foone.
2Nɔn-balwaaro mo ná maŋe ba ba
se ba ja amo,
ye a dona bam ná boŋe
se ba chɔge-ne,
banto wó seeri mo ye ba to tega ne.
3Amo dona bam ze ná ye kɔgɔ kɔgɔ,
ye ba zaŋe se ba kwaare jara
amo baŋa ne,
amo bá taa kɔre foone de-ba.
Amo ta wó taa jege baare mo.
4Woŋo dedoa mo a lwoori
Baŋa Wɛ tei ne.
A tiini a lage se o ke konto o pa-ne.
Ko maa ye se o pa-ne chwoŋa
se a taa zoore o sɔŋɔ kom ne
taa wuu,
se ko taa nii a ŋwea kam siseini.
Dáane mo amo wó taa nii
a nae Baŋa Wɛ lam dem,
ye a ware‑o o tete di-laao kom ne.
5Cham ná tu amo baŋa,
Baŋa Wɛ wó taa cho-ne
o woro kom ne.
O maa wó pa se a seigi
o sɔŋɔ kom ne,
ye o pa se a zege de dam
peo baŋa ne.
6Amo dona bam ná gilimi-ne,
Wɛ wó zeiŋi a yuu mo
ye a di dam ba baŋa ne.
Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne mo
amo wó ke kaanem a pa‑o,
ye a ta wopwolo taane
de kwor-dɛa.
A ta wó leeni mo a maa tei‑o.
7Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a ná lwoori‑m,
popo duri amo ŋwaŋa
se n sɛ a wara yam.
8Amo bochare tɛ de bere-ne
se a ba nmo tei a ware‑m.
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo wó seene a fɔɔre a twɛ nmo.
9Konto to, yé seigi n yibia
amo tei ne.
Amo Tu Wɛ,
nmo mo ye amo zeinnu.
Nam yé ve n tontoŋeno wom
n bane na zaŋe to ŋwaane.
Nmo na ye amo Vereno to,
yé ma n kwaga n ya amo.
10A kwo de a nu ná maŋe
ba ve-ne ba yage de,
Baŋa Wɛ mo wó ke-ne
o ja-kukworo ne.
11Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
bere-ne chwoŋa se a taa tɔga.
Da amo yiga se a taa vei
chega chwoŋa kam ne,
se a dona bam yé wane amo ba ja.
12Yé sɛ se a to a dona bam jeŋa ne.
Ba boŋe se ba fɔ vwa mo
ba daŋe a yuu ne,
ye ba kare ba lage
se ba ke-ne zonne.
13De konto maama de,
amo jege chega we,
a ta na ŋwe tega baŋa ne to,
amo wó na Baŋa Wɛ na lana tei to.
14Peene n tete se n ta‑n jege teena
de Baŋa Wɛ!
Ta‑n cho n tete de baare!
Ɛɛ, pa se n teena taa wo
Baŋa Wɛ tei ne!

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for Help
1Only you, Lord,
are a mighty rock!
Don't refuse to help me
when I pray.
If you don't answer me,
I will soon be dead.
2Please listen to my prayer
and my cry for help,
as I lift my hands
toward your holy temple.
3Don't drag me away, Lord,
with those cruel people,
who speak kind words,
while planning trouble.
4 Treat them as they deserve!
Punish them for their sins.
5They don't pay any attention
to your wonderful deeds.
Now you will destroy them
and leave them in ruin.
6I praise you, Lord,
for answering my prayers.
7You are my strong shield,
and I trust you completely.
You have helped me,
and I will celebrate
and thank you in song.
8You give strength
to your people, Lord,
and you save and protect
your chosen ones.
9Come save us and bless us.
Be our shepherd and always
carry us in your arms.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó keeri a jare nmo mo,
n na ye amo dalem jei to ŋwaane.
Nmo nam ná maŋe da chemm,
amo de balo na tega
ye ba wo tega kuri ne to
wó taa ye bedwe mo.
2Amo na ŋwane n yiga ne to,
nam leiri a keira kam.
Kokuri to a zeiŋi a jea mo wɛɛne
a jeeri n wara-jei
selo na ye wose to.
3Yé pa se a tɔge dedaane
puseŋ-nyena bam
de balo na toŋe lwarem to a jei.
Nɔɔna bam konto ŋɔɔne ni-ywom mo de ba dwonna,
ye ba ta yeini ba boŋe lwarem totoŋa se ba ke ba baŋa ne.
4Nam jwoori n ŋwe ba keim-balwaaro jene dem,
pa ba na waarem delo
na maŋe de-ba to.
5Banto yiga tera Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe kolo maama to wone.
Ba maa ve o totoŋ-laaro tem.
Konto ŋwaane, o lage o yigi-ba mo
o de tega ne,
se ba daa yé jwoori ba zaŋe wɛɛne.
6Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ,
a na ŋwane o yiga ne
ye o leiri-ne to ŋwaane.
7 Baŋa Wɛ mo ye amo zeinnu.
O ta yeini o cho-ne
se cham yé yi-ne,
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔno
jara wone tei to.
Amo yɔɔre a ke a wo-dedoa ded‑o,
pa se a na dam.
A tiini a di ywoni mo
a bochare wone,
ye a ta leeni lei a ma ke o lei.
8 Baŋa Wɛ mo ye o nɔɔna bam zeinnu.
O maa ye dalem jei
o pa pɛ wolo o na tiŋi to
se wonto wane o dona bam o di.
9 Baŋa Wɛ, jwoŋi n nɔɔna bam n yage!
Swɛ balo na ye nmo nyem to swolim!
Nii ba baŋa ne taa wuu
ne nayero na nii o vara baŋa ne
ye o peili-ba o je ne tei to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Voice of the Lord in a Storm
1 All you angels in heaven,
honor the glory and power
of the Lord!
2Honor the wonderful name
of the Lord,
and worship the Lord
most holy and glorious.
3The voice of the Lord
echoes over the oceans.
The glorious Lord God
thunders above the roar
of the raging sea,
4and his voice is mighty
and marvelous.
5The voice of the Lord
destroys the cedar trees;
the Lord shatters cedars
on Mount Lebanon.
6God makes Mount Lebanon
skip like a calf
and Mount Hermon
jump like a wild ox.
7The voice of the Lord
makes lightning flash
8and the desert tremble.
And because of the Lord,
the desert near Kadesh
shivers and shakes.
9The voice of the Lord
makes deer give birth
before their time.
Forests are stripped of leaves,
and the temple is filled
with shouts of praise.
10The Lord rules on his throne,
king of the flood forever.
11Pray that our Lord
will make us strong
and give us peace.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ kwora na jege dam tei to
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛ telaao malese sem,
pa-na se Baŋa Wɛ na zula,
o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom de o dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
2Pa-na se Baŋa Wɛ na zula,
ne ko na maŋe de o yere-kamunu kom tei to.
Zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ se ko tɔge de
o na yɔɔre o ye wose tei to.
3 Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam bage mo
naneero tem baŋa ne.
Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom bage
nenɛɛne do-napana tei to mo.
O maa bage nane-fɔrɔ kom baŋa ne.
4 Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam tiini ka dana.
Ka maa bere o paare
na jege dam tei to.
5 Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam bage mo
ka jaane Lebanon teo Sedare teeni dem,
ka mage-de ka chochoge.
6O maa pae se Lebanon tega kam ziziŋi,
ne noa na wurigi tei to.
Heremon peo kom de maa ziziŋa,
nenɛɛne na-bala na faŋe tei to.
7 Baŋa Wɛ ná dɔne o kwora kam,
doa mo pepela.
8O kwora kam maa pae
se kagoa kam ziziŋa.
Kadese kagoa kam yera sae mo
Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane.
9 Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam didigi
tei-kamunnu mo.
Ka maa siiri goa wo teeni dem vɔɔro maama.
Wɛ wara-jei sem ne
nɔɔno maama wó ta we:
“Wɛ jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ!”
10 Baŋa Wɛ mo jei nane-fɔrɔ kom
baŋa ne o di paare.
Wonto mo ye Pɛ se ko taa vei wuu.
11 Baŋa Wɛ mo pae o nɔɔna bam dana.
O maa ke zaane ba yuu ne
pa ba jege yazura.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the dedication of the temple.)
A Prayer of Thanks
1I will praise you, Lord!
You saved me from the grave
and kept my enemies
from celebrating my death.
2I prayed to you, Lord God,
and you healed me,
3saving me from death
and the grave.
4Your faithful people, Lord,
will praise you with songs
and honor your holy name.
5Your anger lasts a little while,
but your kindness lasts
for a lifetime.
At night we may cry,
but when morning comes
we will celebrate.
6I felt secure and thought,
“I'll never be shaken!”
7You, Lord, were my friend,
and you made me strong
as a mighty mountain.
But when you hid your face,
I was crushed.
8I prayed to you, Lord,
and in my prayer I said,
9“What good will it do you
if I am in the grave?
Once I have turned to dust,
how can I praise you
or tell how loyal you are?
10Have pity, Lord! Help!”
11You have turned my sorrow
into joyful dancing.
No longer am I sad
and wearing sackcloth.
12I thank you from my heart,
and I will never stop
singing your praises,
my Lord and my God.
translation_text:
Lei keim leiŋa
David déem pane leiŋa kanto se ba ma ke Wɛ lei o sɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane.
1 Baŋa Wɛ, a laam wó zeiŋi nmo yere wɛɛne,
nmo na vaŋe-ne n le
cham wone to ŋwaane.
Nmo wo pɛ a dona bam pwola
se ba taa jege-ne ba mɔna.
2Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
a lwoori zeinim nmo tei ne,
ye nmo seene n pa a na yazura.
3N ta chege toone
se de yé wane-ne de ja,
pa se a daa yé taa vei churu seeni.
4Abam balo na ke á chega dedaane Baŋa Wɛ to,
ta‑á leeni-na á zuli‑o,
o yere dem na ye wose to ŋwaane.
5O bane ná zaŋe, de wó zuri lela mo.
O nam ná ke zaane o ke n yuu ne,
konto wó taa wora mo
n ŋwea maama wone.
Nmo ná keeri tete ne
wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane,
ko bá dáane.
Tega ná tu ka poore,
ko wó leiri ko ji wopwolo.
6Amo déem na zoore yalem yerane to,
mo amo tage a we,
“Amo daa bá fɔge a gɔ naga.”
7 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo na ke zaane
n ke a yuu ne to,
n pɛ se a zege de dam lanyerane.
Nmo laam na tu n seigi n yibia
de amo to,
a yiga ma nyɔne.
8 Baŋa Wɛ, amo keeri a jare‑m mo.
Nmo na ye a Teiru Wɛ to,
a ŋwane nmo yiga ne, ye a we:
9“Amo ná tega ye a yera zo
tega kuri ne ya pɔ,
nmo wó na bɛ nyɔɔre mo?
Teero tem tete wó wane te zuli‑m na?
Te wó wane te tɔɔle we
n yɔɔre n jege chega de nɔɔna na?
10 Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom,
se n duri a ŋwaŋa,
se n daare n zeini-ne.”
11Nmo pipiri a wo-chechɔgɔ kom
n pa ko leiri ko ji wopwolo
pa a sae.
N ma‑n pa se a lɔɔre
a gare-nyenyaaro tem,
se a daare a lɛ gare-nyenno
wopwolo ŋwaane.
12Amo laam wó leeni a seini nmo
de a bochare maama,
ye a daa bá taa chem.
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo wó taa ke n lei mo
se ko taa vei wuu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Protection
1I come to you, Lord,
for protection.
Don't let me be ashamed.
Do as you have promised
and rescue me.
2Listen to my prayer
and hurry to save me.
Be my mighty rock
and the fortress
where I am safe.
3You, Lord God,
are my mighty rock
and my fortress.
Lead me and guide me,
so that your name
will be honored.
4Protect me from hidden traps
and keep me safe.
5 You are faithful,
and I trust you
because you rescued me.
6I hate the worshipers
of worthless idols,
but I trust you, Lord.
7I celebrate and shout
because you are kind.
You saw all my suffering,
and you cared for me.
8You kept me from the hands
of my enemies,
and you set me free.
9Have pity, Lord!
I am hurting and almost blind.
My whole body aches.
10I have known only sorrow
all my life long, and I suffer
year after year.
I am weak from sin,
and my bones are limp.
11My enemies insult me.
Neighbors are even worse,
and I disgust my friends.
People meet me on the street,
and they turn and run.
12I am completely forgotten
like someone dead.
I am merely a broken dish.
13I hear the crowds whisper,
“Everyone is afraid!”
They are plotting and scheming
to murder me.
14But I trust you, Lord,
and I claim you as my God.
15My life is in your hands.
Save me from enemies
who hunt me down.
16Smile on me, your servant.
Have pity and rescue me.
17I pray only to you.
Don't disappoint me.
Disappoint my cruel enemies
until they lie silent
in their graves.
18Silence those proud liars!
Make them stop bragging
and insulting your people.
19You are wonderful,
and while everyone watches,
you store up blessings for all
who honor and trust you.
20You are their shelter
from harmful plots,
and you are their protection
from vicious gossip.
21I will praise you, Lord,
for showing great kindness
when I was like a city
under attack.
22I was terrified and thought,
“They've chased me
far away from you!”
But you answered my prayer
when I shouted for help.
23 All who belong to the Lord,
show how you love him.
The Lord protects the faithful,
but he severely punishes
everyone who is proud.
24All who trust the Lord,
be cheerful and strong.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
a tu a dale nmo woro ne.
Yé pa se chaveera di-ne.
Nam tɔge nmo chega kam ŋwaane
n jwoŋi-ne n yage.
2Pore n zwa se n cheigi
a wɛ-lworo kom,
se n daare n ke lela n ba
n vere-ne n yage.
Nmo wolo na ye amo dalem jei
ne peo tei to,
ta‑n cho-ne cham wone.
Nmo wolo na ye amo salem jei to,
jwoŋi-ne n yage.
3Tɔge n yere dem ŋwaane
n bere-ne chwoŋa se a taa tɔga,
nmo na ye amo dalem jei to ŋwaane.
4Vaŋe-ne n le kalanchogo kolo wone
a dona bam na saŋe a ŋwaane to.
Kokuri to, nmo yerane woro ne mo
amo wó dale.
5 Baŋa Wɛ, a kwei a jworo
a ke nmo jeŋa ne mo.
Jwoŋi-ne n yage,
se nmo ye chega tu mo.
6Ko ná ye balo yiga na wo
jwo-yɔɔro wone to,
amo chuli ba ni taane.
Ko daare amo ke a wo-dedoa
dedaane nmo Baŋa Wɛ.
7Amo wó taa chaka de wopwolo,
nmo na yɔɔre n jege
amo swono to ŋwaane.
Kokuri to, nmo nɛ amo na yaare tei,
ye n maane we ko tiini ko ni-ne.
8Nmo wo kwei-ne n ke
a dona bam jeŋa ne.
Nmo nam le-ne cham wone,
pa se a na pwola mo
se a taa zege cheppe.
9 Baŋa Wɛ, duri a yibwona,
cham na tiini de jege-ne to ŋwaane.
A yia maama suli de yi-na
wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane,
ye a momwɛ lage de ti.
10A ŋwea daare fee se ka ti
wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane,
ye a tiini a suuri mo.
Chanɛɛre mo pɛ se a yera maama bugi dedɛ,
ye a kwi sem tete de chɔge.
11Amo dona bam na daane-ne tei to
mo pae se a lwoi
a fara tete momwa ne.
A badwonna bam de kɔre foone
amo ŋwaane.
Nɔɔna ná yeini ba jeeri-ne
chwoŋa yuu ne,
ba wó duri mo ba daare-ne.
12Ba swei amo swia
ne nɔɔno wolo na tege o kɛ to mo.
Ba ke-ne ne a ye zon-kɔga kalo
daa na ba jege kuri to mo.
13Amo nigi nɔɔna dedɛ na jege
a taane ba waasa.
Ba fugi-ne jei maama ne.
Ba maa bane bana ye ba ke ni daane
se ba ja-ne ba go.
14Amo nam ke a wo-dedoa de nmo,
Baŋa Wɛ.
A maa we, “A jege nmo mo
se n ta‑n ye a Wɛ wom.”
15Amo ŋwea da yalo na wó ba to
wo nmo jea ne mo.
Nam vere-ne a dona bam jeŋa ne
n yage.
Jwoŋi-ne balo na pare-ne
se ba ja to jeŋa ne.
16Pa se n yibia jeeri amo seeni,
se a ye nmo tontoŋeno mo.
Da n swono kom ŋwaane
n vere-ne n yage.
17 Baŋa Wɛ, yé pa se a na a chaveera,
a na keeri a jare nmo to ŋwaane.
Nam pa se puseŋ-nyena bam
di chaveera,
se ba daare ba te ba vo churu
mɛ ba na wó maŋe da chemm to.
18Pu ba nia yalo na kare ya fɔe vwa to.
Kokuri to, banto jege nɔn-ŋona mo
ba twea,
de ba na bere ba tete
de boyerem tei to.
19Nmo tiini n jege wo-laaro se ko gaale,
ye n tiŋi-te se n pa
balo na kɔre nmo to.
Nmo yeini n kwei wo-laaro
n pa balo na dale
nmo woro ne to,
ye nabiina yia nae
n na ke tei n pa-ba to.
20Nɔɔna banto mo n kwei
n seigi n woro wone,
se ba dona bam daa yé wane
ba ke-ba lwarem.
Nmo yeini n kwoli-ba
n tete tei ne,
se nɔɔna yé taa jege-ba ba yaala.
21Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ,
o na yɔɔre o jege
amo swono to ŋwaane.
O ke totoŋ-kenkagele o pa-ne
o swono kom ŋwaane,
maŋa kalo a dona bam
na gilimi-ne ba pu
a teo kom ne to.
22Foone ya na jege-ne to
mo amo tage we,
“Wɛ vei yiga yiga o daare-ne!”
Baŋa Wɛ nam cheigi a na ŋwane
o yiga ne tei to,
ye o daare o duri a yibwona.
23Abam balo maama na ye
Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna to
ta‑á swoi-o-na!
Baŋa Wɛ cho balo
na jege o chega to mo.
Ko nam ná ye balo na bere ba tete kamunim to,
o yɔɔre o vaŋe ba zwa mo.
24Abam balo maama na daŋe
á teena Baŋa Wɛ baŋa ne to
ta‑á jege-na baare
se a vɔna daa yé pare!

english_text:
(A special psalm by David.)
The Joy of Forgiveness
1 Our Lord, you bless everyone
whose sins you forgive
and wipe away.
2You bless them by saying,
“You told me your sins,
without trying to hide them,
and now I forgive you.”
3Before I confessed my sins,
my bones felt limp,
and I groaned all day long.
4Night and day your hand
weighed heavily on me,
and my strength was gone
as in the summer heat.
5So I confessed my sins
and told them all to you.
I said, “I'll tell the Lord
each one of my sins.”
Then you forgave me
and took away my guilt.
6We worship you, Lord,
and we should always pray
whenever we find out
that we have sinned.
Then we won't be swept away
by a raging flood.
7You are my hiding place!
You protect me from trouble,
and you put songs in my heart
because you have saved me.
8You said to me,
“I will point out the road
that you should follow.
I will be your teacher
and watch over you.
9Don't be stupid
like horses and mules
that must be led with ropes
to make them obey.”
10All kinds of troubles
will strike the wicked,
but your kindness shields those
who trust you, Lord.
11And so your good people
should celebrate and shout.
translation_text:
Ta n wɛleera n bere Wɛ
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Ko ná ye balo Wɛ na yage
ba wɛleera o ma chɛ-ba to,
Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne,
ba wɛleera yam na saare to ŋwaane.
2Ko ná ye balo Baŋa Wɛ
na pɛ ba jege bora to,
Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne,
ba bochara na jege chega to ŋwaane.
3Amo déem na pugi a ni
de a wɛleera yam to,
a yera bugi ye a bwona mo.
Dɛ maama wone
a yɔɔre a suuri mo.
4Nmo ma‑n yɔɔre n waare-ne
wea de tete maama,
pa se a dam dem nwoŋi
de daare-ne.
Ko nye de wea na dana
ye ka zo a yera tei to mo.
5Amo laam ma ga ko ŋwa
ye a ta a wɛleera yam a bere‑m.
A daa maa wo kwaane
se a seigi-ya.
A sɛ se a chuli a keim-lwanno tem,
ye a ta te taane jaja
a bere nmo Baŋa Wɛ.
Nmo de ma‑n yage a wɛleera yam
n chɛ-ne,
pa se ya daa tera a yuu ne.
6Konto to, pwola ta ná wora,
balo na tɔge nmo chwoŋa kam to
jege se ba lwoori‑m,
se cham ná yi-ba nenɛɛne na-fɔrɔ na chuuri tei to,
se ba yé tɔge de-ko ba jei.
7Nmo mo ye amo dalem jei,
se cham yé yi-ne.
Nɔɔna gilimi-ne
ye ba tei nmo yere,
n na jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
8Amo wó bere‑m chwoŋa kalo
nmo na wó ta‑n tɔge to,
ye a taa nii n baŋa ne
se n yé to tega ne.
9Yé ta‑á toŋe-na jworim,
nenɛɛne sisein-nɔɔna na ke tei to.
Ba ná wo kwei gara
ba ke se nia ne,
se bá sɛ se taa ke se tɔge
nɔɔna na lage tei to.
10Yaara dedɛ mo yeini ya tui
puseŋ-nyena baŋa ne.
Ko daare balo na ke ba wo-dedoa
de Baŋa Wɛ to,
Wɛ swono kolo na ba leiri to
mo kwoli banto.
11Abam balo na jege chega
Wɛ yiga ne to,
zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ
o keina yam ŋwaane.
Abam balo na yɔɔre
chwo-laao wone to,
ta‑á jege-na wopwolo,
se á daare á ke sɔ-ywoŋo!

english_text:
Sing Praises to the Lord
1You are the Lord's people.
Obey him and celebrate!
He deserves your praise.
2Praise the Lord with harps!
Use harps with ten strings
to make music for him.
3Sing a new song. Shout!
Play beautiful music.
4The Lord is truthful;
he can be trusted.
5He loves justice and fairness,
and he is kind to everyone
everywhere on earth.
6The Lord made the heavens
and everything in them
by his word.
7He scooped up the ocean
and stored the water.
8Everyone in this world
should worship and honor
the Lord!
9As soon as he spoke
the world was created;
at his command,
the earth was formed.
10The Lord destroys the plans
and spoils the schemes
of the nations.
11But what the Lord has planned
will stand forever.
His thoughts never change.
12The Lord blesses each nation
that worships only him.
He blesses his chosen ones.
13The Lord looks at the world
14from his throne in heaven,
and he watches us all.
15The Lord gave us each a mind,
and nothing we do
can be hidden from him.
16 Mighty armies alone
cannot win wars for a king;
great strength by itself
cannot keep a soldier safe.
17In war the strength of a horse
cannot be trusted
to take you to safety.
18But the Lord watches over
all
who honor him
and trust his kindness.
19He protects them from death
and starvation.
20We depend on you, Lord,
to help and protect us.
21You make our hearts glad
because we trust you,
the only God.
22Be kind and bless us!
We depend on you.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ maŋe de tia
1Abam balo na tɔge
Wɛ chwoŋa to,
leeni-na de wopwolo
á tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Ko maŋe se chega tɔgena bam
mo zuli‑o.
2Kwei-na kwanno á ta
á ma á tei o yere.
Ta-na kwanno dwi dwi
á ma á kwɛɛre o yiga ne.
3Leeni-na leiŋ-doŋa á ma á tei Wɛ.
Ta-na kwanno tem lanyerane
á pa‑o,
ye á bage lei wɛɛne de wopwolo.
4Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ ni taane
ye chega mo.
O kikia yam maama yeini
ya tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane.
5O lage se keim-laaro de chega
mo taa zega,
ye o swono kom jage
ko yi logo baŋa jei maama.
6 Baŋa Wɛ kwei o ni taane mo
o ma naane wɛyuu kom.
O déem mɛ o kwora kam mo
o pa se chalechwe sem maama
ta se nwoŋi.
7O ma pa se naneo kom jege
ko siseini,
ye o ja na-fwaaro tem o vo o ke
te jeiga ne se te maŋe da.
8Ko ye se logo kom nabiina maama
taa kɔre Baŋa Wɛ mo,
se ba daare ba chɔɔle o yiga ne
ba zuli‑o.
9Kokuri to, o na puri o ni to
mo logo kom bobo ko wora.
O ni dem ŋwaane mo ko ke konto.
10 Baŋa Wɛ mo chɔge logo baŋa teene dem bana yam.
O maa pae se ba na yeini ba jeeli
se ba toŋe kolo maama to jiri kafɛ.
11Se ko daare Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa yam
wó taa zege mo taa wuu.
Wonto boboŋa yam ba gɔe
maŋa de maŋa.
12Ko ná ye teo kolo na sɛ Baŋa Wɛ
se o taa ye ba Teiru to,
yu-ywoŋo wo ba tei ne.
Banto mo o kuri se ba taa ye o nyem.
13 Baŋa Wɛ wo wɛyuu ne mo
ye o tiiri o nii logo baŋa ne
o na nabiina bam maama.
14O maa jei o paare jeiŋa jei ne mo
o yere logo kom nɔn-bia bam maama.
15Wonto mo mɔɔne nabiina maama
de ba bochara.
O yei ba keina yam maama
na ye tei to.
16Pɛ ná maŋe o jege jar-keira dedɛ,
banto bá wane ba jwoŋi‑o ba yage.
Babea de o dam dem maama
ware o tete se o jwoŋi.
17Nam yé ta‑n teene we
n sisein-nɔɔno dana,
se ka ga wó jwoŋi‑m jara wone
ka yage.
Ka dam dem ná maŋe de ye
tei maama,
ka bá wane‑m ka jwoŋi.
18Chega ŋwaane to,
Baŋa Wɛ yi page
balo na kɔre‑o to baŋa ne mo.
O maa yeini o nii balo
na jege teena ded‑o
o swono kom ŋwaane to.
19O maa yere-ba se toone yé ja-ba.
Kana ná tua, o ta wó pa se ba wori.
20Debam yɔɔre dé kwoni dé nii
Baŋa Wɛ mo.
Wonto mo ye dé zeinnu
ye o ta daare o choa debam.
21Wonto ŋwaane mo
dé jege wopwolo,
kokuri dé ke dé wo-dedoa mo
de o yere-kamunu kom.
22 Baŋa Wɛ, nam pa
se n swono kom pu debam,
se debam teena wo nmo tei ne mo.

english_text:
(Written by David when he pretended to be crazy in front of Abimelech, so that Abimelech would send him away, and David could leave.)
Honor the Lord
1 I will always praise the Lord.
2With all my heart,
I will praise the Lord.
Let all who are helpless,
listen and be glad.
3Honor the Lord with me!
Celebrate his great name.
4I asked the Lord for help,
and he saved me
from all my fears.
5Keep your eyes on the Lord!
You will shine like the sun
and never blush with shame.
6I was a nobody, but I prayed,
and the Lord saved me
from all my troubles.
7If you honor the Lord,
his angel will protect you.
8 Discover for yourself
that the Lord is kind.
Come to him for protection,
and you will be glad.
9Honor the Lord!
You are his special people.
No one who honors the Lord
will ever be in need.
10Young lions may go hungry
or even starve,
but if you trust the Lord,
you will never miss out
on anything good.
11Come, my children, listen
as I teach you
to respect the Lord.
12 Do you want to live
and enjoy a long life?
13Then don't say cruel things
and don't tell lies.
14Do good instead of evil
and try to live at peace.
15If you obey the Lord,
he will watch over you
and answer your prayers.
16But God despises evil people,
and he will wipe them all
from the earth,
till they are forgotten.
17When his people pray for help,
he listens and rescues them
from their troubles.
18The Lord is there to rescue
all
who are discouraged
and have given up hope.
19The Lord's people
may suffer a lot,
but he will always
bring them safely through.
20 Not one of their bones
will ever be broken.
21Wicked people are killed
by their own evil deeds,
and if you hate God's people
you will be punished.
22The Lord saves the lives
of his servants.
Run to him for protection,
and you won't be punished.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ lana
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo o na wo Pɛ Akisi tei ne ye o ke ne o yirisi to. Pɛ wom ma pa o viiri.
1Amo wó seini Baŋa Wɛ
maŋa maama.
Amo wó taa tei‑o mo taa.
2Amo wó zeiŋi o yere
o keina maama ŋwaane,
se balo maama vɔna na pare to ni
ye ba daare ba na wopwolo.
3Pa-na dé ke daane
dé pa Baŋa Wɛ jwoŋi zula,
ye dé zeiŋi o yere dem wɛɛne.
4Amo beeri zeina Baŋa Wɛ tei ne,
ye o sɛ o jwoŋi a wɛ-lworo kom.
Ko ná ye wonnu telo maama
a ya na fona de te to,
o vaŋe-ne mo o le te wone.
5Balo na kwoni ba nii Wɛ se o zeini-ba to mo jege wopwolo.
Ba daa bá na ba chaveera.
6A na maŋe a ye nɔn-kayaa to,
a ta lwoori Wɛ,
ye o sɛ o cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.
O ma jwoŋi-ne o yage
a cham maama wone.
7 Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam
mo cho balo na kɔre‑o to,
se cham yé wane-ba de ja.
8Nam maane-na Baŋa Wɛ á nii,
se á wó lɔre we o lana.
Balo maama na tu ba seigi o woro kom wone to jege yu-ywoŋo.
9Ta‑á kɔre-o-na, abam balo Baŋa Wɛ na kuri o pa o tete to.
Kolokolo gɛɛre bá fɔge ko ja
balo na sɛ o ni to.
10Ko ná maŋe ko ye nywonnu,
kana wó ja-te maŋa de maŋa.
Balo nam na kwaane
se ba lɔre Baŋa Wɛ to
bá fɔge ba ga wo-laaro.
11A bia bam, fɔɔre-na á yi amo tei,
se á cheigi a taane dem.
Amo wó bere abam á na wó ke tei
se á ta‑á kɔre Baŋa Wɛ.
12Abam wolo maama ná lage
se o na ŋwea ywoni,
se o daare o na momwɛ-dɛɛre
de wopwolo,
13kotu jege se o ja o tete mo
de ta-balwaaro ŋɔŋa de vwa fɔm.
14O nam yage totoŋ-lwanno keim
se o daare o taa tɔge keim-laaro,
ye o kwaane se o taa zoore
de bochare-zuru.
15Ko ná ye nɔn-ŋona,
Baŋa Wɛ yeini o nii ba baŋa ne,
ye ba keira de zo o zwa.
16Ko daare ko ná ye balo
na swoi lwarem totoŋa to,
Wɛ yeini o pipiri o kwaga mo
o ya-ba,
pa se ba daa ba jege yere
logo baŋa ne.
17Chega tɔgena bam yeini ba lwoori zeinim Baŋa Wɛ tei ne,
ye o sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom.
O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage
ba cham maama wone.
18 Baŋa Wɛ maa woli balo
vɔna na pare to,
ye o jwoŋi balo wo na pɛ to o yaga.
19Chega tɔgena bam wae ba nae cham dwi dwi.
Baŋa Wɛ nam wó le-ba o ja
o nwoŋi ya maama wone.
20 Baŋa Wɛ wó che-ba
pa se ba kua dedoa tete
bá bwori kɔtaa.
21Puseŋ-nyena bam tete
totoŋ-balwaaro tem mo
wó jwoori te go-ba.
Wɛ wó waare balo na chuli chega tɔgena bam to.
22 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o jwoŋi
balo na zuli‑o to mo o yaga.
Balo maama na seigi ba tete o woro kom wone to bá to de ba bora.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for Protection from Enemies
1Fight my enemies, Lord!
Attack my attackers!
2Shield me and help me.
3Aim your spear at everyone
who hunts me down,
but promise to save me.
4Let all who want to kill me
be disgraced
and put to shame.
Chase away and confuse
all who plan to harm me.
5Send your angel after them
and let them be like straw
in the wind.
6Make them run in the dark
on a slippery road,
as your angel chases them.
7I did them no harm,
but they hid a net
to trap me,
and they dug a deep pit
to catch and kill me.
8 Surprise them with disaster!
Trap them in their own nets
and let them fall and rot
in the pits they have dug.
9I will celebrate and be joyful
because you, Lord,
have saved me.
10Every bone in my body
will shout:
“No one is like the Lord!”
You protect the helpless
from those in power;
you save the poor and needy
from those who hurt them.
11Liars accuse me of crimes
I know nothing about.
12They repay evil for good,
and I feel all alone.
13When they were sick,
I wore sackcloth
and went without food.
I truly prayed for them,
14as I would for a friend
or a relative.
I was in sorrow and mourned,
as I would for my mother.
15I have stumbled,
and worthless liars
I don't even know
surround me and sneer.
16Worthless people make fun
and never stop laughing.
17But all you do is watch!
When will you do something?
Save me from the attack
of those vicious lions.
18And when your people meet,
I will praise you
and thank you, Lord,
in front of them all.
19 Don't let my brutal enemies
be glad because of me.
They hate me for no reason.
Don't let them wink
behind my back.
20They say hurtful things,
and they lie to people
who want to live in peace.
21They are quick to accuse me.
They say, “You did it!
We saw you ourselves.”
22You see everything, Lord!
Please don't keep silent
or stay so far away.
23Fight to defend me, Lord God,
24and prove that I am right
by your standards.
Don't let them laugh at me
25or say to each other,
“Now we've got what we want!
We'll gobble him up!”
26Disappoint and confuse
all who are glad
to see me in trouble;
disgrace and embarrass
my proud enemies who say to me,
“You are nothing!”
27Let all who want me to win
be happy and joyful.
From now on let them say,
“The Lord is wonderful!
God is glad when all goes well
for his servant.”
28Then I will shout all day,
“Praise the Lord God!
He did what was right.”
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1 Baŋa Wɛ, dwoni de balo
na ye amo dona to.
Zaŋe n kwaare jara de balo
na ke jara de amo to.
2Kwei n jara zela yam
n daare n ta‑n zei
n jara nantana kam
se n nwoŋi n zeini-ne!
3Kwei n chichwei dem
de n dwooru wom
n zeili balo na pare-ne se ba ja to.
Fɔge n ta de amo we,
nmo mo ye amo vereno.
4Pa se balo na kwaane se ba go amo to na ba chaveera.
Ba na boŋe se ba ke lwarem
amo baŋa ne to,
nam pa se ba boboŋa vugimi
se ba laam pipiri ba jwoori kwaga.
5Pa se Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam zeili-ba
se ba duri ba jage da yiga ne,
nenɛɛne vio na kale swanno
ko ja jei tei to.
6Sɛ se lim kwoli ba chwoŋa kam
se ka daare ka taa seera,
se Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam laam
pɛ ba kwaga ka pu.
7Ba tiŋi kalanchogo se ba ja-ne,
de a na wo ke kolokolo
a chɔge ba yiga to de.
Ba ma daare ba ko gwoŋo
se a to ko wone a te.
8Pa se lɛɛro pɔpɔ te to ba baŋa ne.
Pa se kalanchogo kolo ba na tiŋi
amo ŋwaane to
jwoori ko ja banto tete.
Ta pa se ba to gwoŋo kolo
ba na koge to wone,
se ba yɔɔre ba na chɔgem!
9Amo laam wó taa chaka
de wopwolo,
Baŋa Wɛ na jwoŋi-ne o yage to ŋwaane.
10Amo laam wó ta
de a dam maama we,
“Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dwoŋi tera!
N yeini n vere nabwona
balo dam na dwoi-ba to jeŋa ne n yaga.
Nmo ta jwoŋi yiniga tiina
balo na pini-ba to jeŋa ne n yaga.”
11Vwa-fɔra mo zege se ba pa maana yalo na wó lɔ amo kwaga ne to.
Ba ma maŋe wonnu telo a na yeiri te ni ne to ba pa-ne.
12Ba kwei lwarem mo ba ma ŋwe
lanyerane delo a na ke to.
Konto ŋwaane mo amo wo laam tiini ko pɛ.
13Banto déem na weele to,
amo mo zo gare-nyenyaaro.
A ta ma bere a vɔ ni.
A gwooni a tete mo ye a lwoori Wɛ.
14A ma tiini a nyɔne a yiga,
nenɛɛne a wora a keeri a choro,
naa a badwoŋi,
naa a nu lua dwoŋi mo to.
Amo yɔɔre a tu a tete mo ba ŋwaane.
15Ko daare banto tiini
ba jege wopwolo
de a laam na zo cham wone to mo.
Ba ma la daane se ba gilimi-ne
ye ba mɔna.
Nɔn-wo-korro telo a na maŋe
a yeiri to mo
laam jege amo kwaga ba chwoa.
16Amo déem na to cham wone to,
mo ba yɔɔre ba jege-ne ba twea,
ne wɛ-lwɛɛna na ke tei to.
Ba ma daare ba nyɔne ba yibia de amo.
17Baŋa Wɛ, nmo wó ta‑n zege chemm n nii
se ko vo ko maŋe yei ne mo?
Jwoŋi-ne ba jeŋa ne n yage,
de ba na kwaane se ba chɔge-ne
nenɛɛne nywonnu mo jaane-ne
se te go to.
18Amo laam wó ke nmo lei
nmo nɔɔna bam na jeeri mɛ to ne.
Amo wó zege n nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne a tei‑m.
19Yé pa se a dona bam taa chaka
amo chanɛɛre dem ŋwaane.
Ba chuli-ne kafɛ ŋwaane mo.
Yé sɛ se ba taa jege-ne ba mɔna.
20Banto ba fɔge ba ŋɔɔne yazura taane.
Ba nam fɔ vwa mo se ba chɔge
balo na beeri zurim to yiga.
21Ba maa kaŋe ba nia kayɔ-yɔlɔ
ye ba tɛ amo taane ba we,
“Yaa! Dé yia mo nɛ
nmo na ke n chɔge tei to!”
22 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam nɛ ko maama.
Yé maŋe da chemm.
Amo Tu, yé ta‑n wo yiga yiga
se n yage a yera.
23Nam zaŋe n zege n pa-ne
se a wane a na bora.
Amo Teiru Wɛ, zaŋe n ba n woli-ne!
24Tɔge n chega kam baŋa ne
n pa se a na a bora.
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
yé pa se a dona bam na chwoŋa
se ba taa chaka a chanɛɛre dem ŋwaane.
25Yé sɛ se ba fɔge ba ta we,
“Yaa! Debam seene dé na
dé fera na zo kolo to.”
Yé pa-ba pwola se ba ta we,
“Dé laam wane nɔɔno wom
dé li kula!”
26Ba na jege wopwolo
a lɛɛro tem ŋwaane to,
pa se ba yɔɔre ba di ba chaveera.
Ko ná ye balo na bere ba tete
amo baŋa ne to,
sɛ se ba yuu yaale
ye chaveera di-ba.
27Ko nam ná ye balo na zege
a kwaga ne se a di bora to,
pa se ba taa chaka de wopwolo,
se ba daare ba taa tɛ maŋa maama we,
“Baŋa Wɛ dam dem daga dedɛ!
O lage se o tontoŋeno wom
taa jege yazura mo.”
28Amo laam wó taa tɔɔle
nmo chega kam taane mo.
Dɛ dem maama wone,
amo wó taa tei‑m mo ga wuu.

english_text:
(For the music leader by David, the Lord's servant.)
Human Sin and God's Goodness
1 Sinners don't respect God;
sin is all they think about.
2They like themselves too much
to hate their own sins
or even to see them.
3They tell deceitful lies,
and they don't have the sense
to live right.
4Those people stay awake,
thinking up mischief,
and they follow the wrong road,
refusing to turn from sin.
5Your love is faithful, Lord,
and even the clouds in the sky
can depend on you.
6Your decisions are always fair.
They are firm like mountains,
deep like the sea,
and all people and animals
are under your care.
7Your love is a treasure,
and everyone finds shelter
in the shadow of your wings.
8You give your guests a feast
in your house,
and you serve a tasty drink
that flows like a river.
9The life-giving fountain
belongs to you,
and your light gives light
to each of us.
10Our Lord, keep showing love
to everyone who knows you,
and use your power to save all
whose thoughts please you.
11Don't let those proud
and merciless people
kick me around
or chase me away.
12Look at those wicked people!
They are knocked down,
never to get up again.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ swono de o chega taane
Wɛ tontoŋeno David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛleere boboŋa yerane mo su puseŋ-nyena bochare.
Ba maa bere ba ba kɔre Wɛ
de fenfee de.
2Ba na nii ba nae ba tete kamunim tei to
mo pae se ba daa ba maana
ba tusim kikia
se ba daare ba chuli-ya.
3Ba ni taane su de ta-balwaaro
dedaane vwa yerane mo.
Boboŋa daa tera ba yuu ne
se ba taa toŋe lanyerane de swa.
4Tete ne ba maa tigi ba sare ne
ba jeeli puseŋa kikia.
Ba boboŋa ma ja se ba tɔge chwoŋa kalo na ba lana to.
Ba maa ware se ba ve lwarem keim.
5 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo swono kom wora mo taa,
ye ko geene ko di wɛyuu.
Nmo na yɔɔre n zege
n chega wone tei to
mo tiini ko yala
ko gaale kunkwonnu tem.
6Nmo nɔn-ŋonne dem maa zege cheppe
nenɛɛne pe-kamunnu tem
na zege tei to.
Nmo na yeini n di chega bora tei to
de maa luuna ne naneo kom kuri na luuna tei to.
Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nii nabiina de vara maama baŋa ne mo.
7Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo swono kom tiini
ko jege lonne.
Nabiina yeini ba tui nmo tei
ba vwɛ n woro kom wone,
ne nmo na yarege n vɔna
n kwoli-ba tei to.
8Nmo pa-ba wodi-laaro
se ba taa di ba sui,
wodiiru na neene nmo sɔŋɔ kom wone to ŋwaane.
Nmo ta pa ba nyɔ
nmo bwi sem wo na mo
se ba taa jege wopwolo de yazura.
9Kokuri to, nmo ye buli-yi
delo na pae ŋwea to.
Nmo pwooni dem maa pae se
dé jege pwooni dé vei de yiga ne.
10 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se n swono kom taa wora
balo yiga na wo nmo wone to taa.
Ta zege nmo chega kam wone
n pa balo na yɔɔre
chwo-laao wone to.
11Yé pa pwola se bere-n-tete nyena
nɔ amo baŋa ne.
Yé pa puseŋ-nyena chwoŋa
se ba zeili-ne
se a yage a tega kam.
12Nii-na puseŋ-nyena bam
na to ba tigi tei!
Ba daa bá wane ba zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_text:
(By David.)
Trust the Lord
1Don't be annoyed by anyone
who does wrong,
and don't envy them.
2They will soon disappear
like grass without rain.
3Trust the Lord and live right!
The land will be yours,
and you will be safe.
4Do what the Lord wants,
and he will give you
your heart's desire.
5Let the Lord lead you
and trust him to help.
6Then it will be as clear
as the noonday sun
that you were right.
7Be patient and trust the Lord.
Don't let it bother you
when all goes well for those
who do sinful things.
8Don't be angry or furious.
Anger can lead to sin.
9All sinners will disappear,
but if you trust the Lord,
the land will be yours.
10Sinners will soon disappear,
never to be found,
11 but the poor will take the land
and enjoy a big harvest.
12Merciless people make plots
against good people
and snarl like animals,
13but the Lord laughs and knows
their time is coming soon.
14The wicked kill with swords
and shoot arrows to murder
the poor and the needy
and all who do right.
15But they will be killed
by their own swords,
and their arrows
will be broken.
16It is better to live right
and be poor
than to be sinful and rich.
17The wicked will lose all
of their power,
but the Lord gives strength
to everyone who is good.
18Those who obey the Lord
are daily in his care,
and what he has given them
will be theirs forever.
19They won't be in trouble
when times are bad,
and they will have plenty
when food is scarce.
20Wicked people are enemies
of the Lord
and will vanish like smoke
from a field on fire.
21An evil person borrows
and never pays back;
a good person is generous
and never stops giving.
22Everyone the Lord blesses
will receive the land;
everyone the Lord curses
will be destroyed.
23If you do what the Lord wants,
he will make certain
each step you take is sure.
24The Lord will hold your hand,
and if you stumble,
you still won't fall.
25As long as I can remember,
good people have never
been left helpless,
and their children have never
gone begging for food.
26They gladly give and lend,
and their children
turn out good.
27If you stop sinning
and start doing right,
you will keep living
and be secure forever.
28The Lord loves justice,
and he won't ever desert
his faithful people.
He always protects them,
but destroys the children
of the wicked.
29God's people will own the land
and live here forever.
30Words of wisdom come
when good people speak
for justice.
31They remember God's teachings,
and they never take
a wrong step.
32The wicked try to trap
and kill good people,
33but the Lord is on their side,
and he will defend them
when they are on trial.
34Trust the Lord and follow him.
He will give you the land,
and you will see
the wicked destroyed.
35I have seen brutal people
abuse others and grow strong
like trees in rich soil.
36Suddenly they disappeared!
I looked, but they were gone
and no longer there.
37Think of the bright future
waiting for all the families
of honest, innocent,
and peace-loving people.
38But not a trace will be left
of the wicked
or their families.
39The Lord protects his people,
and they can come to him
in times of trouble.
40The Lord helps his people
and saves them from the wicked
because they run to him.
translation_text:
Ke n wo-dedoa dedaane Baŋa Wɛ
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Yé pa se n boboŋa vugimi
puseŋ-nyena ŋwaane.
Nam yé ta‑n jege wo-goo
de nɔn-balwaaro tem konto.
2Banto bá dáane ye ba jei,
nenɛɛne gaao na kwaare tei to.
Ba nye de ga-lɛɛro na bá dáane
ye te te to mo.
3Se ko ná ye nmo, ke n wo-dedoa
dedaane Baŋa Wɛ
se n daare n tɔge chwo-laao.
Konto mo wó pa se n ta‑n zoore
logo kom wone de yazura,
ye kolokolo bá daane‑m.
4Beeri wopwolo Baŋa Wɛ tei ne,
se o wó ke kolo maama
n boboŋa na lage to o pa‑m.
5Kwei n totoŋa maama
n ke Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne,
se n daare n ke n wo-dedoa ded‑o,
se wonto wó woli‑m.
6Wɛ wó pa se nmo na tɔge chega tei to lɔre jaja,
nenɛɛne wɛ na puli tei to.
Nmo taane dem wó nwoŋi
de chega jaja,
nenɛɛne wea na nye
yupare baŋa ne tei to.
7Ja n wo se n ta‑n cheigi Baŋa Wɛ
na wó toŋe tei.
Pa n teena taa wo wonto wone.
Ko ná ye balo na nɛ yiga-veiŋa
de ba keim-balwaaro to,
yé ta‑n pae se n boboŋa vugimi
ba ŋwaane.
8Ja n tete ban-zɔŋɔ wone.
Nam yé ta‑n fufuga.
Konto fɔge ko chɔge wonnu mo.
9Ta‑n yei we puseŋ-nyena
lage ba jei mo.
Balo nam na ke ba teena
dedaane Baŋa Wɛ to
wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei.
10Ko bá daane se puseŋ-nyena jei.
Nmo ná maŋe n beeri-ba tetei maama, n bá‑n na-ba.
11Balo nam na tu ba tete Wɛ yiga ne to mo wó taa tei tega kam,
se ba wo tiini ko pwoli ba yiga-veiŋa de ba yazura ŋwaane.
12Puseŋ-nyena bam yeini ba bane mo se ba chɔge nɔn-laaro.
Ba ma nyɔne ba yibia de-ba.
13Dé Teiru Wɛ nam jege puseŋ-nyena bam o mɔne mo.
O yei we banto chɔgem dɛ
lage de yi.
14Puseŋ-nyena bam yeini
ba le ba se-zɔɔro mo,
ye ba daare ba saŋe ba taŋa chena,
se ba kwaane ba go nabwona de zora
dedaane balo maama na tɔge chega chwoŋa to.
15Ba tete se-zɔɔro tem mo nam
lage te jwoori te go-ba.
Ba tɛ sem de maa wó bwori.
16Chega tɔgeno ná maŋe o jege fenfee yerane o jeŋa ne,
konto gare jejegero tem maama
puseŋ-nyena bam na nɛ to.
17Kokuri to, dam delo
puseŋ-nyena bam na jege to
wó jage de jei mo.
Ko daare Baŋa Wɛ yiga
wo nɔn-ŋona wone ye o cho-ba.
18Dɛ maama wone Baŋa Wɛ nii
balo na tɔge chwo-laao chekke to baŋa ne.
Ba wó taa tei tega kam
se ko taa vei wuu.
19Cham maŋa ná yia, ko bá ni banto.
Kana maŋa ne de, ba ta wó na
ba ni-wodiu ba daare ba zege.
20Puseŋ-nyena bam nam lage ba te mo.
Baŋa Wɛ dona maama wó jage
ba jei mo,
nenɛɛne nyoa na yeini ka jei tei to.
21Puseŋ-nyena ná jene woŋo
nɔɔno tei ne,
ba daa ba sɛ se ba ŋwe-ko
ba pa kotu.
Nɔn-laaro nam yeini ba kwei wonnu mo ba pae nɔɔna zɛɛra.
22 Baŋa Wɛ na swɛ balo swolim to mo wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei.
Ko daare balo o na sɔɔle lwarem
o yage ba yuu ne to wó jei mo.
23Ko ná ye balo totoŋa na su
Baŋa Wɛ yi to,
o yeini o bere-ba chwoŋa mo
se ba taa vei yiga.
24Ba ná maŋe ba mage ba nɛ tetei maama de, ba ta bá to tega ne,
kokuri to Baŋa Wɛ mo jege
ba je sem.
25Amo kwe lanyerane.
Ko nam na zege a biini ne
se ko yi zem to,
amo ta wo nɛ nɔn-ŋona
na vei je-kora.
Ba bia de nam ba nwoŋi de zon-kwaga se ba lwoori ba di.
26Nɔn-ŋona yeini ba kwei ba wonnu
ba pae nɔɔna zɛɛra mo.
Ba maa kwori ba jene
ba pae nɔɔna badwonna.
Ba bia wó pa ba na zaane Wɛ tei ne.
27Yage totoŋ-lwanno keim se n daare n ta‑n tɔge keim-laaro!
Konto mo wó pa se nmo ta‑n zoore tega kam ne taa wuu.
28Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ lage
se chega kam mo taa zega.
O bá fɔge o lɔ balo na jege
o chega kam to kwaga ne kɔtaa.
O wó taa cho-ba se ko taa vei wuu,
ye o daare o zeili puseŋ-nyena bam dwi se ba jage ba jei.
29Chega tɔgena bam mo wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei.
Ba maa wó taa zoore da mo
taa wuu.
30Swa taane yerane mo nwoŋi
nɔn-laaro ni ne,
ye banto ŋɔŋa mo jege chega.
31Wɛ taane bera yam mo su
ba bochara maama,
ye ba bá seeri ba to
Wɛ chwoŋa wone.
32Puseŋ-nyena bam dale mo
ba beeri laŋa se ba go nɔn-laaro.
33 Baŋa Wɛ nam zege
nɔn-laaro tem kwaga ne.
Ba ná maŋe ba zo taane wone,
Wɛ wó le-ba ba dona jeŋa ne
se ba yé to ba bora wone.
34Pa n teena taa wo Baŋa Wɛ tei ne,
se n daare n ta‑n tɔge
o chwoŋa kam.
Konto mo o wó pa n na yere
se n ta‑n tei tega kam.
O maa wó zeili puseŋ-nyena
se ba jei,
ye n ta‑n jei n nia.
35Amo yi nɛ puseŋ-nyeno
na bɛɛse o dwonna tei to.
O maa bere o tete ne tei-zɔŋɔ
na zege de dam tei to.
36Ko na ke fee to, a nɛ we
kotu pɔpɔ o jei mo!
A na beeri o jeiga to,
a gɛ ko ŋwa mo,
ye o yuu daa ba nae!
37Fɔge n ta‑n nii balo keim na lamma ye ba jege chega to.
Balo na zoore de bochare-zuru to
jwa wó na ba dwi dem.
38Balo nam na chɔge Wɛ nia yam to
wó jei mo.
Puseŋ-nyena bam de
jwa bá taa jege ba dwi dem.
39 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o vere
chega tɔgena mo o yaga.
Cham maŋa ná yia,
wonto mo ye ba dalem jei
40Wɛ yeini o zeini-ba mo,
o daare o jwoŋi-ba o yaga
puseŋ-nyena bam jeŋa ne,
ba na tu ba seigi
o woro kom wone to ŋwaane.

english_text:
(A psalm by David to be used when an offering is made.)
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1When you are angry, Lord,
please don't punish me
or even correct me.
2You shot me with your arrows,
and you struck me
with your hand.
3My body hurts all over
because of your anger.
Even my bones are in pain,
and my sins 4are so heavy
that I am crushed.
5Because of my foolishness,
I am covered with sores
that stink and spread.
6My body is twisted and bent,
and I groan all day long.
7Fever has my back in flames,
and I hurt everywhere.
8I am worn out and weak,
moaning and in distress.
9You, Lord, know every one
of my deepest desires,
and my noisy groans
are no secret to you.
10My heart is beating fast.
I feel weak all over,
and my eyes are red.
11Because of my sickness,
no friends or neighbors
will come near me.
12All who want me dead
set traps to catch me,
and those who want
to harm and destroy me
plan and plot all day.
13I am not able to hear
or speak a word;
14I am completely deaf
and can't make a sound.
15I trust you, Lord God,
and you will do something.
16I said, “Don't let them laugh
or brag when I slip and fall.”
17I am about to collapse
from constant pain.
18I told you my sins,
and I am sorry for them.
19Many deadly and powerful
enemies hate me,
20and they repay evil for good
because I try to do right.
21You are the Lord God!
Stay nearby
and don't desert me.
22You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
David Wɛ-lworo jaweo ŋwaane
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
yé tɔge n ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne
n bwɛ-ne.
Ta yé da n ban-lom dem ŋwaane
n waare-ne.
2Nmo che-tɛɛra yam
yɔɔre ya zɔ-ne mo.
Nmo jaguli-zane dem
de ma mage-ne,
pa se a yera yam tiini ya chɛ.
3Amo yera yam maama wɔe mo,
n bane na zaŋe amo baŋa ne to ŋwaane.
Amo kwi sem tete ba jege yazura,
de a wɛleera yam
na daane-ne tei to.
4Kokuri to, a tusim kikia yam
na daga tei to,
ya diini baŋa baŋa ya gaale a yuu.
Ya maa tiini ya duna
ya dwoi a jaanem.
5Amo fufwollu tem tiini te lwoi
ye a yera moora,
a na toŋe jworim
de a wɛleera yam to ŋwaane.
6Amo maama gwoori mo
ye a yera yam de wiira.
Wo-chechɔgɔ yerane mo
ye amo nyem.
7Paa mo tiini ka jege-ne
pa se a teiŋa maama ba sɛa.
A yera yam maama maa wɔe.
8A tiini a bugi mo ye ko chɛ a yera ne.
A maa yeini a suuri,
lwia na jege-ne to ŋwaane.
9Amo Teiru Wɛ, nmo maŋe n yei
a boboŋa na lage kolo to maama.
A na tiini a sisigi tei to kolokolo
wo seigi nmo yiga ne.
10A bochare zage mo
ye a dam dem de wora de tia.
A yia maa beiri.
11A badwonna de a fara bam
laam lɔŋe-ne mo
a jawe-chɛɔ kom ŋwaane.
A diga tiina de ba sɛ
se ba yi amo yera.
12Balo na beeri se ba go-ne to
tiŋi kalanchorro mo se te ja-ne.
Balo na kwaane
se ba ke-ne zonne to de
ŋɔɔne daane se ba chɔge-ne.
Dɛ maama wone
ba maa bane amo bana.
13Amo nam ke nenɛɛne
a ye zɔ-kɔgɔ mo tei,
ye a ba ni ba bana yam.
A ta ke ne a ye memaa mo tei,
pa se a ni meeri.
14Amo jigi ne a ye zɔ-kɔgɔ mo.
A bá sɛ se a mage ni-kantɔgɔ de-ba.
15 Baŋa Wɛ, amo nam daŋe a teena
nmo baŋa ne mo.
Amo Teiru Wɛ, n ye wolo
na wó leiri-ba to.
16A ma lwoori we,
“Yé sɛ se ba taa chaka
amo cham wone.
A ná seeri a to tega ne,
yé sɛ se ba bere ba tete
amo baŋa ne.”
17Ko gɛ fee se a tiri a to tega ne.
Ko maa tiini ko chɛ a yera ne
ye ko ba fɔge ko tia.
18A ma bere a wɛleera jaja Wɛ yiga ne,
ye a chuli-ya.
19A dona bam nam puli dedɛ
ye ba dana.
Balo na chuli-ne kafɛ ŋwaane to
tiini ba daga.
20Ba kwei lwarem mo ba ma ŋwe
lanyerane delo maama a na ke to.
Ba ma bwɛ-ne de a na maŋe
a tɔge chwo-laao tei to de.
21 Baŋa Wɛ, yé yage a yera!
Amo Tu Wɛ, yé ta‑n wo
yiga yiga de amo.
22Nam ke lela n ba n zeini-ne.
Nmo mo ye amo Vereno.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1I told myself, “I'll be careful
not to sin by what I say,
and I'll muzzle my mouth
when evil people are near.”
2I kept completely silent,
but it did no good,
and I hurt even worse.
3I felt a fire burning inside,
and the more I thought,
the more it burned,
until at last I said:
4“Please, Lord,
show me my future.
Will I soon be gone?
5You made my life short,
so brief that the time
means nothing to you.
“Human life is but a breath,
6and it disappears
like a shadow.
Our struggles are senseless;
we store up more and more,
without ever knowing
who will get it all.
7“What am I waiting for?
I depend on you, Lord!
8Save me from my sins.
Don't let fools sneer at me.
9You treated me like this,
and I kept silent,
not saying a word.
10“Won't you stop punishing me?
You have worn me down.
11You punish us severely
because of our sins.
Like a moth, you destroy
what we treasure most.
We are as frail as a breath.
12“Listen, Lord, to my prayer!
My eyes are flooded with tears,
as I pray to you.
I am merely a stranger
visiting in your home
as my ancestors did.
13Stop being angry with me
and let me smile again
before I am dead and gone.”
translation_text:
Ŋwea ye kukua
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo tage de a tete mo we,
“Amo wó taa cho a tete mo
se a yé ke wɛleera de a ni taane.
A maa wó kwei gara a ke a ni ne,
ne puseŋ-nyena ná wo a tei ne.”
2Konto ma pa se a pu a ni chemm.
A wo tage kolokolo de fenfee de.
Ko bere ko wo woli-ne,
ye ko chɛ a yera ne ko ja gaale.
3Lwia ma tiini ya jege-ne dedɛ.
Boboŋ-fara na daane-ne tei to
nye de mini mo zwɛ a wo kom.
A laam ma ga ga a ta we:
4 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se a maane a ŋwea kam na lage ka ti tei to,
se a wane a guli we
a da yam ba daga,
ye ya duri mo lela lela ya maa kɛa.
5Nmo pɛ se a ŋwea ye kukua mo.
Amo da yam ná maŋe
ya ma tei maama de,
ya ta nye de yi-bogesem mo
nmo tei ne.
Nabiina maama momwɛ
ye vio yerane mo,
ba ná maŋe ba zege de dam
tei maama de.
6Nabiina ná tɔge chwei selo maama,
ba nye de lunlunnu yerane mo.
Ba na yaare totoŋa baŋa ne tei to
ba jege nyɔɔre.
Ba maa yeini ba lae jejegero dedɛ
ba tiŋa,
ye ba yeiri wolo na wó di-te
ba toone kwaga ne to.
7Amo Teiru Wɛ, amo daa jei
a cheiga bɛ mo?
A nam daŋe a teena nmo baŋa ne mo.
8Ja, jwoŋi-ne n ja n nwoŋi
a tusim dem wone.
Ta yé sɛ se jworru tete taa jege-ne
te gwoona.
9A ni dem jege se de meeri,
se a daa yé puri-de,
nmo mo na waare-ne to ŋwaane.
10Ja, dɔne n jaguli-zane dem
amo baŋa ne.
Nmo na yɔɔre n waare-ne tei to
pɛ se a momwɛ lage de ti mo.
11Nmo yeini n jege nɔɔna n koresa
se n pa ba yage ba tusim kikia.
N ma‑n yeini n chɔge
ba fera na zo kolo maama to,
ne tóa na mu wonnu tei to.
Chega to, nabiina maama momwɛ
ye vio yerane mo.
12Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom!
Pore n zwa se n sɛ amo keira kam.
Amo na keeri a jare nmo to,
yé maŋe da chemm.
A na zoore logo baŋa ne to,
a ye veiru mo na tu nmo sɔŋɔ kom,
ne a nabaara bam maama
de déem na ke tei to.
13Nam daa‑n yé nii-ne de ban-zɔŋɔ,
se a wane a jwoori a di ywoni,
ye a laam daare a te a kɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Help
1I patiently waited, Lord,
for you to hear my prayer.
You listened 2and pulled me
from a lonely pit
full of mud and mire.
You let me stand on a rock
with my feet firm,
3and you gave me a new song,
a song of praise to you.
Many will see this,
and they will honor and trust
you, the Lord God.
4You bless all of those
who trust you, Lord,
and refuse to worship idols
or follow false gods.
5You, Lord God, have done
many wonderful things,
and you have planned
marvelous things for us.
No one is like you!
I would never be able to tell
all you have done.
6 Sacrifices and offerings
are not what please you;
gifts and payment for sin
are not what you demand.
But you made me willing
to listen and obey.
7And so, I said, “I am here
to do what is written
about me in the book,
where it says,
8‘I enjoy pleasing you.
Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
9When your people worshiped,
you know I told them,
“Our Lord always helps!”
10When all your people met,
I did not keep silent.
I said, “Our Lord is kind.
He is faithful and caring,
and he saves us.”
11You, Lord, never fail
to have pity on me;
your love and faithfulness
always keep me secure.
12I have more troubles
than I can count.
My sins are all around me,
and I can't find my way.
My sins outnumber
the hairs on my head,
and I feel weak.
13Please show that you care
and come to my rescue.
Hurry and help me!
14Disgrace and confuse
all who want me dead;
turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
15Embarrass and shame
everyone who says,
“Just look at you now!”
16Our Lord, let your worshipers
rejoice and be glad.
They love you for saving them,
so let them always say,
“The Lord is wonderful!”
17I am poor and needy,
but, Lord God,
you care about me,
and you come to my rescue.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ maŋe de tia
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo peene mo a cheiga
Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.
O de ma pipiri o nii amo seeni
se o cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.
2O pɛ a lɛɛro tem ti mo,
ne o na vaŋe-ne o le gwoŋo kolo
na su de bworu yerane wone to.
O ma daare o ja a nɛ sem
o vo o zege peo baŋa ne,
se a wane a zege de dam.
3O ma bere-ne leiŋ-doŋa,
se a leeni a seini dé Tu Wɛ wom.
Nɔɔna dedɛ wó na Baŋa Wɛ
na toŋe tei maama to
pa se ba taa kɔre‑o,
ye ba daare ba ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o.
4Ko ná ye balo na ke ba wo-dedoa
de Baŋa Wɛ to,
Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne lanyerane.
Banto wo kwei ba chega ba pa jwona.
Ba maa wo gwaane
de balo na kaane-ya to.
5Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo tiini n toŋe wo-kenkagela dedɛ n pa debam.
N ma‑n tɔge n boboŋa ŋwaane
n ke wo-kamunnu n woli debam,
te ni na tiini te gaale jeelim to.
Amo kwaane se a ta te maama taane a bere nɔɔna ye a ga.
Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dwoŋi tera!
6Nmo yiga tera de nabiina na yeini
ba kwei vara de wodiiru
ba ma ke kaanem ba pa‑m tei to,
ne ko ná ye vara zwɛɛm kaanem
naa wɛleera saarem kaanem de.
Nmo nam pore a zwa
se a ni ko kuri chekke.
7Mo kokuri amo laam maa tɛ a we,
“Amo Tu Wɛ, nii-ne da! A tua!
Ko ke ne ko na maŋe ko popone
amo ŋwaane nmo faŋa faŋa tɔnɔ kom wone tei to mo.
8A fera yam mo ye se a toŋe
nmo boboŋa na lage tei to,
kokuri to, nmo nia yam mo tigi
amo bochare ne.”
9 Baŋa Wɛ, amo zege nmo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne mo,
se a taa bere nmo chega kam taane jaja.
Nmo tete maŋe n yei we
a wo seigi-ka de fenfee de.
10Amo wo pɛ n chega kam taane
maŋe a tei ne.
A nam yeini a tɛ nmo zeinim
de n verem taane dem
a bere nɔɔna jaja mo.
Nmo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ná jeeri daane,
amo yeini a pae ba lɔre we,
n swono kom ba leira
ye n yiga wo debam wone.
11Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo jege amo yibwona,
nam yé dɔne n jeŋa kam
amo baŋa ne kɔtaa.
Ta‑n zege amo kwaga ne,
se n pa n swono kom
de n chega kam taa cho-ne.
12Amo nɛ cham dedɛ
ye de gilimi-ne de ke tetare ne.
De daga de dwoi se a lɔre
de na mae tei to.
Amo wɛleera mo tu amo baŋa
ya ja-ne.
Amo yia daa ba nae
ye a tusi chwoŋa.
A wɛleera daga ya dwoi
a yu-ywei sem.
Konto laam maa pa se a tiini a bwona.
13Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, popo se n ba
n jwoŋi-ne n yage!
Ke lela n ba n zeini-ne.
14Ko ná ye balo na beeri amo toone to,
pa se vuvuga yi-ba se ba to tega ne.
Pa balo maama na beeri
amo chɔgem to
jwoori kwaga de ba chaveera yam.
15Sɛ se chaveera di banto dwi dem maama,
ba na tɛ ba we,
ba jeŋa zo amo to ŋwaane.
16Ko daare balo maama
na beeri nmo jei to,
pa se ba taa jege wopwolo,
se ba di ywoni nmo ŋwaane.
Ta pa se balo na swoi
se n ta‑n jwoŋi-ba to
taa tɛ maŋa maama we,
“Dé wó zeiŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere dem wɛɛne.”
17Ko nam ná ye amo, a ye nabwom mo,
ye yiniga jege-ne.
A Teiru Wɛ yiga daa ta wo
amo wone.
Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo ye a zeinnu
de a vereno.
Yé dáane se n laam ba n woli-ne!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer in Time of Sickness
1You, Lord God, bless everyone
who cares for the poor,
and you rescue those people
in times of trouble.
2You protect them
and keep them alive.
You make them happy here
in this land,
and you don't hand them over
to their enemies.
3You always heal them
and restore their strength
when they are sick.
4I prayed, “Have pity, Lord!
Heal me, though I have sinned
against you.”
5My vicious enemies ask me,
“When will you die
and be forgotten?”
6When visitors come,
all they ever bring
are worthless words,
and when they leave,
they spread gossip.
7My enemies whisper about me.
They think the worst,
8and they say,
“You have some fatal disease!
You'll never get well.”
9 My most trusted friend
has turned against me,
though he ate at my table.
10Have pity, Lord! Heal me,
so I can pay them back.
11Then my enemies
won't defeat me,
and I will know
that you really care.
12You have helped me
because I am innocent,
and you will always
be close to my side.
13 You, the Lord God of Israel,
will be praised forever!
Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ, duri amo yibwona!
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Nɔɔno wolo yiga
na wo nabwona wone to mo,
Wɛ zaane wo o yuu ne lanyerane.
Cham ná yi kotu,
Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoŋi‑o o yage.
2 Baŋa Wɛ wó cho‑o se o yé te.
O ta wó ke zaane o ke o yuu ne
de o na zoore tega kam ne tei to.
Wɛ bá sɛ se o to
o dona bam jeŋa ne.
3Konto tu ná weela,
Baŋa Wɛ wó teibi‑o mo
pa se o jaweo kom jei
ye o jwoori o na yazura.
4Amo mo tage a we,
“Baŋa Wɛ, duri amo yibwona!
A tusi mo a chɔge n yiga.
Nam ta pa se a jwoori
a na yazura.”
5A dona bam ŋɔɔne amo taane mo
de puseŋa ba we,
“O wó dáane mo se o laam te
se o yere jei logo baŋa ne?”
6Ba wone dedoa ná tu amo tei,
o yeini o ŋɔɔne ta-yɔɔro yerane mo.
O maa kare o beeri sawe-taane
se o ja o nwoŋi
o jage jei maama ne.
7Balo maama na chuli-ne to
mo jege amo taane
ba waase ba bere daane.
Ba maa boŋe lwarem mo ba pa-ne,
8ye ba we, “Ko ye jawe-chɛɔ mo
yɔɔre ko jege‑o.
O nam bá fɔge o zaŋe o na yazura.”
9Ko ná maŋe ko ye
amo badwoŋ-swono
a na pɛ wolo a chega maama
ye dé tɔge daane dé di wodiu to,
wonto tete de mo jwoori
o zege amo zega.
10Nmo Baŋa Wɛ nam
duri amo yibwona
se n daare n pa se a jwoori
a na yazura.
Amo laam wó wane a jwoori
a ŋwe a jene a dona bam baŋa ne.
11A yei we nmo wo pwoli de amo,
kokuri to, n wo pɛ a dona bam chwoŋa
se ba wane amo ba di.
12Nmo wó ta‑n zeini-ne,
a na yɔɔre a tɔge chega to ŋwaane.
N ta wó pa se a taa zege
n yiga ne taa wuu.
13Pa-na dé taa tei Baŋa Wɛ wom
na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to!
Wonto maŋe de tia mo
ko zege faŋa faŋa se ko taa vei wuu.
Ameena! Ameena!
Lei Tɔnɔ 2
Lei 42–72

english_text:
BOOK II
(Psalms 42–72)
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Longing for God
1As a deer gets thirsty
for streams of water,
I truly am thirsty
for you, my God.
2In my heart, I am thirsty
for you, the living God.
When will I see your face?
3Day and night my tears
are my only food,
as everyone keeps asking,
“Where is your God?”
4Sorrow floods my heart,
when I remember
leading the worshipers
to your house.
I can still hear them shout
their joyful praises.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I should trust you, Lord.
I will praise you again
because you help me,
6and you are my God.
I am deeply discouraged,
and so I think about you
here where the Jordan begins
at Mount Hermon
and at Mount Mizar.
7Your vicious waves
have swept over me
like an angry ocean
or a roaring waterfall.
8Every day, you are kind,
and at night
you give me a song
as my prayer to you,
the God of my life.
9You are my mighty rock.
Why have you forgotten me?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
10Even my bones are in pain,
while all day long
my enemies sneer and ask,
“Where is your God?”
11Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
Amo tiini a lage se a taa wo Wɛ tei ne
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
nmo fera tiini ya zo amo,
nenɛɛne na-nyɔm na jege feira
ye ka beeri na-zura
se ka nyɔ tei to.
2Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo tiini a lage‑m
ne na-nyɔm na jege-ne tei to.
Maŋa kɔ mo amo wó na chwoŋa
se a ba nmo tei
a zege nmo yiga ne a zuli‑m?
3Wea de tete maama a yeini
a keeri dedɛ a kane yi-na,
ye yi-na banto yerane mo
ye a ni-wodiu.
Balo na chuli amo to tɛ ba we,
“N Wɛ wom nam bɛ?”
4Amo ná yeini a guli
ko déem na ye tei to,
a wo mo tiini ko chɔge.
Kanto maŋa kam ne, amo mo
tɔge nɔn-kɔgɔ kom yiga
ye dé vo nmo diga kam
se dé zuli‑m.
Dé na maa vei to,
dé bage dedaane ywoni
ye dé kɔgɔ kom maama leeni lei
dé ma zuli nmo yere.
5Amo bwei a tete wone a we,
“Bɛ mo pɛ se a yiga nyɔne?
Bɛ mo ye a wo tiini ko chɔge?”
A nam wó pa se a teena
taa wo Wɛ tei ne mo!
A daa ta wó taa tei‑o,
wonto na ye amo Wɛ
ye o jwoŋi-ne o yage to ŋwaane.
6Chega to, amo wo tiini ko chɔge.
Amo nam wó guli nmo gula de n lanyerane dem na ye tei to.
A maa wo ywo-seeni,
Heremon dedaane Mizari
peero tem laŋa ne
mɛ Jɔdan buga kam na buli da to.
7A na wora to, a ni bwi sem
na chuuri tega ne se ke sɔɔ,
se tɔge amo baŋa
se maa kɛa de dam
pa se a to tega ne
dedaane wo-chechɔgɔ.
8Dɛ maama wone Baŋa Wɛ pae
a lɔre we o swono kom mo
wo amo tei ne.
Tete maama ne o pa se a leeni leiŋa mo a maa ware‑o,
o na ye wolo na tei a ŋwea kam to ŋwaane.
9Amo wó ta de Wɛ, o na ye peo kolo amo na sale ko yera ne to we,
“Bɛ mo ye nmo laam swei
amo swia konto?
Amo dona bam ta wó taa bɛɛse-ne
pa se a keera konto taa mo na?”
10Banto maa jege-ne ba twea
ye ba mɔna
pa se a yera chɛ ye a lage a te.
Ba maa tɛ ba we, “Nmo Wɛ wom bɛ?”
11Amo bwei a tete wone a we,
“Bɛ mo pɛ se a yiga nyɔne?
Bɛ mo ye a wo tiini ko chɔge?”
A nam wó pa se a teena
taa wo Wɛ tei ne mo!
A daa ta wó taa tei‑o,
wonto na ye amo Wɛ
ye o jwoŋi-ne o yage to ŋwaane.

english_text:
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1Show that I am right, God!
Defend me against everyone
who doesn't know you;
rescue me from each
of those deceitful liars.
2I run to you for protection.
Why do you turn me away?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
3Send your light and your truth
to guide me.
Let them lead me to your house
on your sacred mountain.
4Then I will worship
at your altar because you
make me joyful.
You are my God,
and I will praise you.
Yes, I will praise you
as I play my harp.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
1Amo Tu Wɛ, nam bere we
amo jege chega nɔɔna yiga ne!
Jwoŋi a taane dem n ŋɔɔne
dedaane balo na yeiri nmo to.
Vaŋe-ne n le puseŋ-nyena banto
na ye vwa-nyena to jeŋa ne.
2Nmo ye wolo a na seigi a tete
n woro kom wone to mo.
Bɛ mo ye n ma n kwaga n ya-ne?
Amo dona bam ta wó taa bɛɛse-ne
pa se a taa keeri konto taa mo na?
3Pa se n pwooni dem dedaane
n chega kam taa wo amo tei ne.
Tento mo wó da amo yiga
te bere-ne chwoŋa,
se a wane a vo a yi peo kolo
nmo na pɔɔre n pa n tete to yuu.
Jei selo nmo na zoore da to
mo konto.
4A ná yi da, a laam wó vo a yi
Wɛ bimbini dem teiŋa.
Amo wó fɔɔre a yi nmo tei,
nmo wolo na pae a wo pwoli to.
Amo Tu Wɛ, a laam wó ta kɔnɔ
a ma a tei‑m.
5Amo bwei a tete wone a we,
“Bɛ mo pɛ se a yiga nyɔne?
Bɛ mo ye a wo tiini ko chɔge?”
A nam wó pa se a teena
taa wo Wɛ tei ne mo!
A daa ta wó taa tei‑o,
wonto na ye amo Wɛ
ye o jwoŋi-ne o yage to ŋwaane.

english_text:
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Help
1Our God, our ancestors told us
what wonders you worked
and we listened carefully.
2You chased off the nations
by causing them trouble
with your powerful arm.
Then you let our ancestors
take over their land.
3Their strength and weapons
were not what won the land
and gave them victory!
You loved them and fought
with your powerful arm
and your shining glory.
4You are my God and King,
and you give victory
to the people of Jacob.
5By your great power,
we knocked our enemies down
and trampled on them.
6I don't depend on my arrows
or my sword to save me.
7But you saved us
from our hateful enemies,
and you put them to shame.
8We boast about you, our God,
and we are always grateful.
9But now you have rejected us;
you don't lead us into battle,
and we look foolish.
10You made us retreat,
and our enemies have taken
everything we own.
11You let us be slaughtered
like sheep,
and you scattered us
among the nations.
12You sold your people
for little or nothing,
and you earned no profit.
13You made us look foolish
to our neighbors;
people who live nearby
insult us and sneer.
14Foreigners joke about us
and shake their heads.
15I am embarrassed every day,
and I blush with shame.
16But others mock and sneer,
as they watch my enemies
take revenge on me.
17All this happened to us,
though we didn't forget you
or break our agreement.
18We always kept you in mind
and followed your teaching.
19But you crushed us,
and you covered us
with deepest darkness
where wild animals live.
20We did not forget you
or lift our hands in prayer
to foreign gods.
21You would have known it
because you discover
every secret thought.
22 We face death all day for you.
We are like sheep on their way
to be slaughtered.
23Wake up! Do something, Lord!
Why are you sleeping?
Don't desert us forever.
24Why do you keep looking away?
Don't forget our sufferings
and all our troubles.
25We are flat on the ground,
holding on to the dust.
26Do something! Help us!
Show how kind you are
and come to our rescue.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Wɛ, dé nigi
wo-kamunnu telo n na ke
n pa dé nabaara bam faŋa faŋa to ŋwa.
Ba tage te taane ba bere debam
ye dé fɔge dé cheigi.
2Nmo tete mo zeili dwi-gɛ tiina bam
ye n daare n kwei dé nabaara bam
n jeini ba tega kam baŋa ne.
Nmo yɔɔre n chɔge
dwi-gɛ tiina bam mo,
ye n pa se n tete nɔɔna bam
zoore da de yazura.
3Ba déem na wane tega kam maama ba tei to,
ko dae ba jara-keim zela
dam ŋwaane mo
naa ba tete dam ŋwaane.
Ko nam ye nmo dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
Nmo lanyerane dem ma kwoli-ba,
n yi na page ba baŋa ne to ŋwaane.
4Nmo mo ye amo Pɛ,
ye n ta ye a Wɛ wom.
Nam pa se n nɔɔna
Jakob dwi tiina bam di wɔnɔ!
5Dé wó da nmo dam dem ŋwaane
dé yigi dé dona bam
se ba jwoori kwaga.
Dé laam maa wó nɔne-ba
dé se tega ne.
6Amo bá kwei a teena a daŋe
a taŋa naa a se-zɔɔ baŋa ne.
Tento bá wane-ne te jwoŋi te yage.
7Ko nam ye nmo mo jwoŋi debam
n yage dé dona bam jeŋa ne.
Nmo ta pae se balo maama
na chuli debam to
nae ba lɛɛro mo.
8Dɛ maama wone dé yeini
dé jege teera Wɛ ŋwaane.
Dé wó taa tei o yere mo taa wuu.
9Leile konto nam nmo mɛ n kwaga mo n ya debam,
pa se dé di dé chaveera.
Dé laam ná nwoŋi se dé kwaare jara
nmo daa‑n ba tɔge
dé jar-keira bam yiga n via.
10Nmo ma‑n pa se dé duri
dé dona bam yiga ne,
pa ba de ba ba vere dé jejegero.
11N yage debam mo se ba zaŋe
dé baŋa ne
ye ba daare ba go debam
nenɛɛne dé ye pei mo to.
N ma‑n jage debam balo na daare to
n yage sa-teene wone.
12Nmo yɔɔre n kwei
n tete nɔɔna bam mo
n yeigi zɛɛra n pa ba dona bam.
N wo pɛ se ba jege yuu ba pa‑m.
13Nmo pɛ se dwi-gɛ tiina
balo na gilimi debam to
jege debam mo ba mɔna,
ye ba ta yaale debam.
14Logo baŋa dwi tiina bam
maa pae dé ye wo-mwanno.
Ba maa dole ba yuni
ba twe debam.
15Dɛ dem maama wone
chaveera mo di-ne.
A maa nae a lɛɛro ga wuu.
16Kokuri to, dé dona bam yɔɔre
ba twe debam mo,
ye ba jege debam ba gwoona.
17Debam nam wo ve nmo,
naa dé jwoori ni delo nmo na gwoni de debam to kwaga ne.
De ko de, n ta pɛ se dé na
lɛɛro tento maama.
18Dé wo lɔge nmo kwaga ne.
Dé maa wo ywori
nmo chwoŋa kam wone.
19Nmo nam yɔɔre
n chochoge debam mo,
pa se nywoŋ-kuri gilimi debam
se se di.
Nmo ta pɛ se lim mo ba
de kwoli debam.
20Debam nam ya ná nwoŋi
dé Wɛ wom kwaga ne,
ye dé daare dé pipiri dé zuli wa-gaa,
21Wɛ tete ya bá lɔre ko ni ne na?
Kokuri o maŋe o yei dé boboŋa
wo-siseigiru tem maama.
22Dé na ye o nɔɔna to mo
pae dé da toone tei dé kɛ
dɛ maama wone.
Ba kwei debam ba ma ji pei selo
ba na lage ba go to mo.
23Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne!
N ta dɔ mo na?
Zaŋe n ba n zeini debam!
Yé ma n kwaga n ya debam
taa wuu.
24Bɛ mo ye n ke n yiga dáa dáa?
Bɛŋwaane mo n yiga tere dé cham
de dé yaara yam wone?
25Debam yɔɔre dé to tega ne mo
buri-buri.
Dé yera yam maama taare
de kasolo mo.
26Konto to, zaŋe wɛɛne n ba
n zeini debam!
Jwoŋi debam n yage,
nmo na yɔɔre n jege debam swono to ŋwaane.

english_text:
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies.” A love song.)
For a Royal Wedding
1My thoughts are filled
with beautiful words
for the king,
and I will use my voice
as a writer would use
pen and ink.
2No one is as handsome as you!
Your words are always kind.
That is why God
will always bless you.
3Mighty king, glorious ruler,
strap on your sword
4and ride out in splendor!
Win victories for truth
and mercy and justice.
Do fearsome things
with your powerful arm.
5Send your sharp arrows
through enemy hearts
and make all nations fall
at your feet.
6 You are God, and you will rule
forever as king.
Your royal power
brings about justice.
7You love justice and hate evil.
And so, your God chose you
and made you happier
than any of your friends.
8The sweet aroma of the spices
myrrh, aloes, and cassia
covers your royal robes.
You enjoy the music of harps
in palaces decorated
with ivory.
9Daughters of kings are here,
and your bride stands
at your right side,
wearing a wedding gown
trimmed with pure gold.
10Bride of the king,
listen carefully to me.
Forget your own people
and your father's family. 11The king adores you.
He is your master,
so do what he desires.
12All of the richest people
from the city of Tyre
will try to influence you
13with precious treasures.
Your bride, my king,
has inward beauty,
and her wedding gown is woven
with threads of gold.
14Wearing the finest garments,
she is brought to you,
followed by her young friends,
the bridesmaids.
15Everyone is excited,
as they follow you
to the royal palace.
16Your sons and your grandsons
will also be kings
as your ancestors were.
You will make them rulers
everywhere on earth.
17I will make your name famous
from now on,
and you will be praised
forever and ever.
translation_text:
Kadiri leiŋa
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1A boboŋa yam maama su
de wo-laaro mo
se a ma a pane leiŋa
a seini pɛ wom.
A wó ma a kwora mo
a leeni pore-pore,
nenɛɛne tɔn-poponno
na wó popone tei to.
2Nmo tiini n lamma
n dwoi nɔɔna maama.
N ni taane ye ywoni yerane mo.
Wɛ ke zaane mo n yuu ne
se ko taa vei wuu.
3Dam-fɔrɔ tu, kwei n se-zɔɔ
n vɔ n teiŋa ne,
se n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ de n paare
taa bere jaja!
4Diini sisein-nɔɔno n nwoŋi pwooni
n bere n paare dem
se n daare n di wɔnɔ.
Ke kokeiri n pa se chega tɔgem,
de yibwona,
de chega bora borem taa wora.
Konto to nmo jazem dem
wó toŋe wo-kamunnu dedɛ.
5Pɛ, n che-tɛɛra yam sele mo,
se n ta-ya n zɔ n dona
ba bochara ne.
