Dwi-gɛ tiina bam de maa wó to
n yiga ne.
6Debam Tu Wɛ, n paare dem
wó taa wora taa se ko taa vei wuu.
Nmo wó ta‑n tei n nɔɔna
se ko tɔge chwoŋa chekke.
7Nmo yɔɔre n swoi chega tɔgem,
ye n daare n chuli lwarem kikia.
Konto ŋwaane mo,
n Tu Wɛ wom kuri nmo,
ye o lwo o swolim nuga kam
n yuu ne
se n di ywoni n dwoni
n dwonna bam maama.
8Talwoŋ-ywoŋa dwi dwi lwom
mo taare n gwaaro tem maama.
Nmo zoore pɛ sɔŋɔ kolo ba na mɛ tuu yeila ba kwɛ to wone,
ye dáane mo ba yeini ba tae kwanno se ko pwoli nmo wo.
9Kaana balo na wo n tei ne to
badwonna ye pwa bukwa mo.
Kaane wolo n na lage n di to
maa wo n jazem seeni
ye o yera kwɛ de sabu-seŋa
kalo na nwoŋi Ofiri to.
10A bukɔ, pore n zwa
se n cheigi a taane dem.
Ta‑n yei se n yage
n tete dwi tiina bam
de n kwo sɔŋɔ tiina bam chwei sem.
11Pɛ wom yi mo su nmo lam dem.
Wonto laam nam mo ye n teiru.
Konto ŋwaane tu n tete se n sɛ o ni.
12Tura tiina wó ja pɛɛra
ba ba nmo tei.
Naduna de maa wó taa lage
se n ke-ba lanyerane.
13Ka-pɛ wom laam wo o diga wone mo,
ye o tiini o jege lam dedɛ!
O ma zo gɔrɔ kolo ba na mɛ
sabu-seŋa ba bɛɛre ko maama to.
14Ba ma ja‑o ba vo pɛ wom tei,
ye o zo o gwaaro telo
ba na gɔgere lanyerane to.
O ka-nyaana bam
de maa kwogili‑o ba via.
15Konto dwoŋi mo ba vei
ba zo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wone
ye ba tiini ba jege wopwolo dedɛ.
16Pɛ, nmo bia bam de wó ji pwa mo,
nenɛɛne n kwoa bam de
déem na ye tei to.
N ma‑n wó pa ba taa tei teene dedɛ
tega kam maama baŋa ne.
17Dwi ná kɛ ye dedwoŋi saŋe,
amo ta wó zeiŋi n yere dem wɛɛne taa wuu.
Logo baŋa dwi tiina bam wó taa tei‑m se ko taa vei wuu mo.

english_text:
(A special song by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
God Is Our Mighty Fortress
1God is our mighty fortress,
always ready to help
in times of trouble.
2And so, we won't be afraid!
Let the earth tremble
and the mountains tumble
into the deepest sea.
3Let the ocean roar and foam,
and its raging waves
shake the mountains.
4A river and its streams
bring joy to the city,
which is the sacred home
of God Most High.
5God is in that city,
and it won't be shaken.
He will help it at dawn.
6Nations rage! Kingdoms fall!
But at the voice of God
the earth itself melts.
7The Lord All-Powerful
is with us.
The God of Jacob
is our fortress.
8Come! See the fearsome things
the Lord has done on earth.
9God brings wars to an end
all over the world.
He breaks the arrows,
shatters the spears,
and burns the shields.
10Our God says, “Calm down,
and learn that I am God!
All nations on earth
will honor me.”
11The Lord All-Powerful
is with us.
The God of Jacob
is our fortress.
translation_text:
Wɛ mo ye dé dalem jei
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛ mo ye wolo dé na seigi
o woro wone ye dé jwoŋi dam to.
O yeini o wora mo cham maŋa ne
se o woli debam.
2Konto ŋwaane dé bá taa kɔre foone,
tega kam ná maŋe ka tiini
ka ziziŋi tei de,
ye peero tem ta baga te toe
buri-buri naneo kom wone de.
3Naneero tem ná bere te wuuri
te mage puŋa tei maama,
ye te na-ŋon-dɛɛre ta mage peero tem
pa se te ziziŋi tei maama de,
dé bá taa kɔre foone.
4Nabara kadwoŋi nam wora
ka na jaane wopwolo
ka tui Wɛ tete teo kom wone,
mɛ Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom
na wora to.
5Wɛ tete mo zoore teo kom konto wone.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane-ko o chɔge.
Tega na jege ka poore to,
Wɛ wó ba o woli-ko de dam.
6Logo baŋa teene dem vuvugi mo
kafɛ ŋwaane.
Paare jei maama maa to buru-tu-tu!
Wɛ ma bage kwora pa se
tega baŋa maama nyeene.
7Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo wo
debam tei ne.
Jakob Wɛ wom maa ye
dé dalem jei.
8Ba-na á nii Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe wo-kamunnu telo logo baŋa ne
ye te tiini te jege foone to.
9O maa pa se tigura kweeli mo
logo baŋa jei maama ne.
O ma kwei jar-keira tɛ sem dedaane ba chichwoa yam o bwori.
O ma daare o vere ba jara-keim nantane sem o zwɛ de mini.
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
10“Ta‑á ye-na konto chemm,
se á maane we amo mo ye Wɛ!
Amo mo tei logo baŋa teene dem maama,
se de nɔn-bia bam taa zuli-ne.”
11Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo wo
debam tei ne.
Jakob Wɛ wom maa ye
dé dalem jei.

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
God Rules the Nations
1All of you nations,
clap your hands and shout
joyful praises to God.
2The Lord Most High is fearsome,
the ruler of all the earth.
3God has put every nation
under our power,
4and he chose for us the land
that was the pride of Jacob,
his favorite.
5God goes up to his throne,
as people shout
and trumpets blast.
6Sing praises to God our King,
7the ruler of all the earth!
Praise God with songs.
8God rules the nations
from his sacred throne.
9Their leaders come together
and are now the people
of Abraham's God.
All rulers on earth
surrender their weapons,
and God is greatly praised!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ mo tei logo baŋa maama
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Nabiin-dwi maama,
ba-na á mage japwoora,
á daare á bage tia
á zuli Wɛ de wopwolo!
2Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tiini o maŋe
se nabiina taa kɔre‑o.
O maa ye Pa-faro wolo na tei
logo baŋa maama to.
3Wonto mo wane dwi-gɛ tiina
teene dedɛ o pa debam,
pa se de nɔn-bia bam
wo debam dam kuri ne.
4O ma kuri tega kanto o pa debam
se dé taa tei,
o na tiini o swoi Jakob
de o dwi dem to ŋwaane.
Konto ŋwaane, dé jege teera
tega kam baŋa ne.
5Wɛ mo diini baŋa se o jeini
o paare jeiŋa jei ne.
Nɔɔna bam maa bage de kwor-dɛa
ba daare ba wu nabwanno,
se ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.
6Leeni-na á tei Wɛ!
Leeni-na lei á ma‑á seini‑o.
Leeni-na á tei dé Pɛ wom!
Leeni-na lei á ma‑á seini‑o.
7Kokuri to, logo baŋa maama
Pɛ wom mo ye Wɛ.
Leeni-na tia lei á zuli‑o.
8Wɛ jei o nenɔŋa paare yituŋu kom
baŋa ne,
ye o di paare logo baŋa
teene dem baŋa ne mo.
9Logo baŋa pwa de dedɛɛra maama jeeri daane mo.
Ba maa woli debam wone,
se dé maama zuli
Abaraham Wɛ wom.
Wɛ jege dam o dwoi pwa maama.
O maŋe de zula jei maama ne.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by the clan of Korah.)
The City of God
1The Lord God is wonderful!
He deserves all praise
in the city where he lives.
His holy mountain,
2 beautiful and majestic,
brings joy to all on earth.
Mount Zion, truly sacred,
is home for the Great King.
3God is there to defend it
and has proved to be
its protector.
4Kings joined forces
to attack the city,
5but when they saw it,
they were terrified
and ran away.
6They trembled all over
like women giving birth
7or like seagoing ships
wrecked by eastern winds.
8We had heard about it,
and now we have seen it
in the city of our God,
the Lord All-Powerful.
This is the city that God
will let stand forever.
9Our God, here in your temple
we think about your love.
10You are famous and praised
everywhere on earth,
as you win victories
with your powerful arm.
11Mount Zion will celebrate,
and all Judah will be glad,
because you bring justice.
12Let's walk around Zion
and count its towers.
13We will see its strong walls
and visit each fortress.
Then you can say
to future generations,
14“Our God is like this forever
and will always guide us.”
translation_text:
Zion ye Wɛ tete teo mo
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ
tiini o jege kamunim!
O yɔɔre o maŋe mo
se nɔɔna taa tei‑o
o tete teo kom wone.
Peo kolo o na pɔɔre o pa o tete to
baŋa ne mo konto.
2Peo kom tiini ko lamma mo
ko gaale
de ko na diini wɛɛne tei to.
Logo baŋa jei maama
wó di ywoni ko ŋwaane.
Zion peo kom nye de Zafon peo
kolo na wo baŋa seeni to mo.
Ko maa ye Pa-faro wom teo kom.
3Wɛ mo pɛ se ko ji dalem jei
se nɔɔna taa tui ba seigi
o woro kom wone.
4Nii-na! Logo baŋa pwa bam
ke ni daane,
ye ba nwoŋi se ba kwaare jara
de Zion teo kom.
5Ba laam na yi da to,
ba ma nii ba na ko na ye tei,
ye ko so-ba.
Foone ma ja-ba
pa se ba pipiri ba duri ba viiri.
6Dáane mo ba yera sae de foone.
Lwia maa jege-ba,
ne kaane wolo na virigi puga
se o lo to.
7Ko ta nye de nmo pɛ vo-dɛɔ zaŋe
wɛ-puli jei ne ko ba
ko chɔge nabwooru telo na nwoŋi Tarasisi ne pipiu ŋwaane to.
8Dé ya maŋe dé ni
Wɛ totoŋa yam ŋwa,
se leile konto dé tete yia
laam mo nɛ-ya.
Dé wo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tete
teo kom ne.
Debam Tu Wɛ wom teo kom
mo konto.
Wɛ wó pa ko zegem taa dana
se ko taa vei wuu.
9Debam Tu Wɛ, dé tu dé zege
nmo wara-jei sem ne,
ye dé boŋe n swono chekke kom boboŋa.
10N yere dem na zaŋe wɛɛne tei to,
konto dwoŋi mo nɔɔna wó taa tei‑m logo baŋa jei maama ne.
Nmo jazem dem jege dam,
ye n pa se chega wora
jei maama ne.
11Mo kokuri Zion tiina bam
wo pwoli dedɛ.
Judah teene dem de maa jege wopwolo,
nmo na bore chega bora to ŋwaane.
12Zaŋe-na á kaare Zion teo kom,
se á nii ko na ye tei to.
Jeeli-na ko di-dedwaaro tem ni.
13Ta maane-na kabiri selo
na lɔge se pe teo kom to ni ne,
se á daare á nii ko dalem jei sem
na dana tei to.
Konto, á wó wane á maŋe á bere
dwi delo na wo kwaga ne to
ye á we:
14Debam Tu Wɛ wom mo tento.
O wó taa nii dé baŋa ne taa wuu
se ko vo ko yi kweelim maŋa kam.

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Don't Depend on Wealth
1Everyone on this earth,
now listen to what I say!
2Listen, no matter who you are,
rich or poor.
3I speak words of wisdom,
and my thoughts make sense.
4I have in mind a mystery
that I will explain
while playing my harp.
5Why should I be afraid
in times of trouble,
when I am surrounded
by vicious enemies?
6They trust in their riches
and brag about
all their wealth.
7You cannot buy back your life
or pay off God!
8It costs far too much
to buy back your life.
You can never pay God enough
9to stay alive forever
and safe from death.
10 We see that wise people die,
and so do stupid fools.
Then their money is left
for someone else.
11The grave will be their home
forever and ever,
although they once had land
of their own.
12Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
13Here is what happens to fools
and to those who trust
the words of fools:
14They are like sheep
with death as their shepherd,
leading them to the grave.
In the morning God's people
will walk all over them,
as their bodies lie rotting
in their home, the grave.
15But God will rescue me
from the power of death.
16Don't let it bother you
when others get rich
and live in luxury.
17Soon they will die
and all their wealth
will be left behind.
18We humans are praised
when we do well,
and all of us are glad
to be alive.
19But we each will go down
to our ancestors,
never again to see
the light of day.
20Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
translation_text:
Jejegero taane
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama,
cheigi-na!
Abam balo maama na zoore
tega baŋa ne to
pore-na á zwa!
2Abam maama cheigi-na,
ko ná maŋe ko ye dedɛɛra
de nabwona de,
ko ta woli de naduna
de yiniga tiina maama.
3Amo ni taane wó bere swa lanyerane.
A boboŋ-lilirru tem de wó pa
se nɔɔna yi poore.
4Amo wó kwaane a zamese dende.
A ta wó daare a ta kɔnɔ
ye a leeni a maŋe se kuri
a bere nɔɔna.
5Lɛɛro ná to a baŋa ne,
a nam bá taa kɔre foone,
nenɛɛne kampin-nyena ná gilimi-ne ba ke tetare ne.
6Banto ke ba chega dedaane
ba jejegero mo,
ye ba jege teera de ba na ye naduna to.
7Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ŋwe
o dwoŋi jene
se o jwoŋi kotu ŋwea.
N bá‑n wane n ŋwe
n ŋwea kam kwora n pa Wɛ.
8Nabiinu ŋwea tiini ka jege kuri.
N bá‑n wane n ŋwe
se ko yi ka kwora ko ti.
9Konto to, nabiinu bá taa ŋwe taa wuu
se o yera daa yé pɔ tega kuri ne.
10Nmo wó maane we nɔɔna maama toa,
ko ná maŋe ko ye yi-pore-nyena,
de nɔn-jworru, de nayeiri-nyena de.
Ba maama wó te
ye ba daare ba jejegero ba yage
ba pa nɔɔna badwonna mo.
11Ba yibeela laam maa wó ji ba sam
mɛ ba na wó taa zoore taa wuu to.
Ba ta wó maŋe da
se ko taa vei wuu,
de ba déem na jege ba tete tega
tei maama to de.
12Nabiinu ná maŋe o jege nenɔŋa
tei maama de,
o bá maŋe tega baŋa ne taa wuu.
Nabiina de vara maama
guri bedwe mo.
13Tento mo jworru telo na boŋe
ba tete kamunni to wó guri,
ko ta woli de balo maama
na tɔge banto chwei sem to.
14Banto maama lage ba te mo,
ne pei tei to.
Toone wó ja-ba
de kale de ja vo churu.
Tega ná poore, nɔn-ŋona wó di dam ba baŋa ne.
Ba yera maa wó pɔ tega kuri ne.
Ba daa bá taa jege ba tete sam
se ba taa zoore de wone.
15Wɛ nam mo wó vere amo
toone jeŋa ne.
O wó vaŋe-ne se a taa wo o tei ne.
16Nɔɔno ná yɔɔre o ji nadum
pa se o di paare o sɔŋɔ ne,
yé pa se ko taa daane‑m.
17Kokuri, kotu ná tega,
o bá wane o ja kolokolo
o woli da o kɛ.
O jejegero tem bá tɔge‑o
te zo tega kuri.
18Kotu ta ná ŋwe, o wó boŋe we
Wɛ yɔɔre o swɛ o swolim,
nɔɔna na zuli‑o
o yiga-veiŋa ŋwaane to.
19De konto maama, o de lage o te mo
o vo o woli o nabaara bam wone.
Dáane mo o daa bá fɔge
o na wea pwooni dɛ de de dɛ.
20Nabiinu ná maŋe o jege nenɔŋa
tei maama de,
ye o yi ná wo poore,
kotu de vara maama guri bedwe mo.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
What Pleases God
1From east to west,
the powerful Lord God
has been calling together
everyone on earth.
2God shines brightly from Zion,
the most beautiful city.
3Our God approaches,
but not silently;
a flaming fire comes first,
and a storm surrounds him.
4God comes to judge his people.
He shouts to the heavens
and to the earth,
5“Call my followers together!
They offered me a sacrifice,
and we made an agreement.”
6The heavens announce,
“God is the judge,
and he is always honest.”
7My people, I am God!
Israel, I am your God.
Listen to my charges
against you.
8Although you offer sacrifices
and always bring gifts,
9I won't accept your offerings
of bulls and goats.
10Every animal in the forest
belongs to me,
and so do the cattle
on a thousand hills.
11I know all the birds
in the mountains,
and every wild creature
is in my care.
12If I were hungry,
I wouldn't tell you,
because I own the world
and everything in it.
13I don't eat the meat of bulls
or drink the blood of goats.
14I am God Most High!
The only sacrifice I want
is for you to be thankful
and to keep your word.
15Pray to me in time of trouble.
I will rescue you,
and you will honor me.
16But to the wicked I say:
“You don't have the right
to mention my laws or claim
to keep our agreement!
17You refused correction
and rejected my commands.
18You made friends
with every crook you met,
and you liked people who break
their wedding vows.
19You talked only about violence
and told nothing but lies;
20you sat around gossiping,
ruining the reputation
of your own relatives.”
21When you did all this,
I didn't say a word,
and you thought,
“God is just like us!”
But now I will accuse you.
22You have ignored me!
So pay close attention
or I will tear you apart,
and no one can help you.
23The sacrifice that honors me
is a thankful heart.
Obey me, and I, your God,
will show my power to save.
translation_text:
Wɛ wó di nɔɔna taane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom
mo dɔne o kwora.
O ma bwoŋi nabiina balo maama
na wo tega kam baŋa ne
ko zege wɛ-puli seeni se ko vo
ko yi wɛ-zoore seeni to.
2Zion mo ye teo kolo na lamma
ko dwoi teene maama to.
Wɛ maa zege dáane mo
o nyeene pwooni se de nwoŋi.
3Dé Tu Wɛ wom mo tutwoni
o maa beena.
O nam za ba vei chemm ywoo!
Min-vogo wo o yiga ne mo
ko di wonnu maama bugi-bugi.
Vo-dɛɔ de maa gilimi‑o
ko ke tetare ne.
4O ma bwoŋi wɛyuu de tega baŋa
se te ba te nii,
se o laam di o nɔɔna bam taane.
5O ma ta o we, “Bwoŋi-na
balo na ke ba chega de amo to
se ba ba ba jeeri amo yiga ne.
Banto ye balo na ke kaanem ba pa-ne
pa se dé gwoni ni daane to mo.”
6Wɛyuu kom tete tɔɔle
Wɛ chega kam taane.
Wɛ mo lage o bore nabiina bora!
Wɛ tage o we:
7“Amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam,
cheigi-na!
A lage a ŋɔɔne a bere we
á ke á tusi mo.
Amo nam mo ye Wɛ chekke.
A maa ye abam Wɛ wom.
8Amo na bwɛ abam konto to,
ko dae á na yeini á ke kaanem
á pa-ne,
naa á zwɛ pɛɛra maŋa maama
á pa-ne tei to ŋwaane.
9Ko nam dae se a jwoŋi nabɛ selo
na wo á nabwooru wone to,
de bo-bwaalo telo
na wo á bon-turu wone to.
10Kokuri to, kagoa wo vara bam maama ye amo nyem mo.
Amo mo tei naane delo maama
na wo zwonnu moro yuu ne to.
11Zuna balo maama
na jaane wɛɛne to mo
amo nii ba baŋa ne.
Amo daa ta mo tei
ga-vara maama de.
12Nenɛɛne kana mo ya ná jege-ne,
a ya bá ta a bere abam,
logo baŋa
de ko wo wonnu tem maama
na ye amo nyem to ŋwaane.
13Ko ná ye nabɛ, amo mo di se nɔna na?
Amo wó nyɔ bo-bwaalo jana na?
14Nam pa-na se pɛɛre delo
á na wó kwei á kaane á pa-ne to
taa ye lei-keim.
Tɔge-na ni delo á na pwooli de amo to,
amo na ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to ŋwaane.
15Cham ná yi abam,
lwoori-na wolim amo tei ne,
se a laam wó jwoŋi abam a yage.
Konto to, á wó zuli-ne
ne ko na maŋe se á ke tei to.”
16Wɛ ma ta de puseŋ-nyena bam o we:
“Abam ba jege chwoŋa se á tɔge
á ŋɔɔne amo nia yam taane.
Bɛ mo ye á bere we á sɛ
amo ni-gwonim dem?
17Kokuri, á wo sɛ se a korese abam
a de chwoŋa ne.
Á ta ma daare á ve a bera yam mo.
18Abam ná nɛ ŋweeno,
o kikia mo su á yi.
Á maa me de balo
na tɔge kabwoŋa kikia to.
19Á sɛ se á ni taane taa pae
lwarem mo pula.
Á kare á ŋɔɔne vwa yerane mo.
20Á yeini á ba bebara á pae á choro.
Á maa ŋɔɔne á chɔge o yiga
de o ná maŋe o ye á nu puga bu mo de.
21Abam na toŋe keim-balwaaro tento maama to,
a chem mo.
Abam ga boŋe we amo de abam maama ye bedwe mo.
Amo laam nam wó zaŋe a bwɛ abam,
se á lɔre jaja we á tusi mo.
22Abam balo yiga na tere amo wone to,
ta‑á yei-na amo taane dem ni ne!
Á ná wo leiri á wo,
amo wó zaŋe á baŋa ne
a kaare abam a yage,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera
se o jwoŋi abam o yage.
23Wolo nam ná ke lei-keim pɛɛre
o pa-ne,
kotu zuli-ne chekke mo.
Ko ná ye balo maama na seene ba yia ba tɔge chwoŋa to,
amo Wɛ wó pa ba na amo verem dem.”

english_text:
(For the music leader. A psalm by David when the prophet Nathan came to him after David had been with Bathsheba.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1 You are kind, God!
Please have pity on me.
You are always merciful!
Please wipe away my sins.
2Wash me clean from all
of my sin and guilt.
3I know about my sins,
and I cannot forget
the burden of my guilt.
4 You are really the one
I have sinned against;
I have disobeyed you
and have done wrong.
So it is right and fair for you
to correct and punish me.
5I have sinned and done wrong
since the day I was born.
6But you want complete honesty,
so teach me true wisdom.
7Wash me with hyssop
until I am clean
and whiter than snow.
8Let me be happy and joyful!
You crushed my bones,
now let them celebrate.
9Turn your eyes from my sin
and cover my guilt.
10Create pure thoughts in me
and make me faithful again.
11Don't chase me away from you
or take your Holy Spirit
away from me.
12Make me as happy as you did
when you saved me;
make me want to obey!
13I will teach sinners your Law,
and they will return to you.
14Keep me from any deadly sin.
Only you can save me!
Then I will shout and sing
about your power to save.
15Help me to speak,
and I will praise you, Lord.
16Offerings and sacrifices
are not what you want.
17The way to please you
is to be truly sorry
deep in our hearts.
This is the kind of sacrifice
you won't refuse.
18Please be willing, Lord,
to help the city of Zion
and to rebuild its walls.
19Then you will be pleased
with the proper sacrifices,
and we will offer bulls
on your altar once again.
translation_text:
Yibwona wɛ-lworo
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo Wɛ sampwora Natan na tu o tei o bwɛ‑o o tusim dem ŋwaane, de o na ke kabwoŋa de Bafeseba to.
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
da n swono kom ŋwaane
se n duri amo yibwona.
A lwoori‑m se n saare
amo wɛleera n yage,
nmo na tiini n jege nabiina ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane.
2Zare-ne se a daa yé taa jege totoŋ-lwanno,
se n daare n kwɛ-ne
se a nwoŋi tusim wone.
3Kokuri to, amo yei a wɛleera yam ni ne.
Wea de tete maama wone,
a ware a swei a tusim dem.
4Amo na ke a chɔge to,
ko ye nmo yerane yiga ne mo.
A ke lwarem dedɛ
a chɔge nmo ni dem.
Nmo jege chega de nmo na bwei amo tei to.
Nmo na pɛ a to de a bora to,
n ta jege chega.
5Ko maŋe ko zege a lora dɛ ne mo
amo su de lwarem.
A nu na jaane a puga to,
a maŋe a wo tusim ne mo.
6Nmo nam na lage kolo to mo ye
se nɔɔno taa jege chega
o bochare ne,
se o yé seigi kolokolo
nmo yiga ne.
Pa n swa yam taa sui a boboŋa
se a yi poore lanyerane.
7A lwoori‑m se n saare a wɛleera yam n yage,
se n kwɛ amo bochare
se a taa jege wo-pwoŋo fase.
8Pa-ne pwola se a daa jwoori
a ni wopwolo taane.
Nmo peene amo n pa a na chɔgem.
Laam pa a jwoori a na ywoni dedɛ
a ŋwea wone.
9Daa‑n yé pa a wɛleera taa wo
n yiga ne.
Saare amo keim-lwanno tem
n yage dáa ne.
10Amo Tu Wɛ, jwoori n naane
bochare delo na ye chekke to
n pa-ne.
Sɛ se a taa jege boboŋ-doora yalo
na tɔge nmo ni to.
11A lwoori‑m se n yé zeili-ne
nmo yiga ne.
Nam yé le n Jwori-laao kom
n daare amo.
12Sɛ se amo daa jwoori a na ywoni
a ŋwea wone,
nmo na jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane.
Woli-ne se a boboŋa jwoori
ya taa tɔge nmo nia yam.
13Amo laam wó wane
a bere wɛleere-keira
nmo chwo-laaro tem,
se ba de pipiri ba jwoori
ba ba nmo tei.
14Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo ye wolo
na jwoŋi-ne n yage to mo.
Yage n chɛ-ne se a yé maŋe de toone.
Konto to, amo wó ma a ni
a ma zuli nmo yere,
nmo na jege chega
ye n vere nɔɔna to ŋwaane.
15Amo Teiru Wɛ, pa se a ni dem
puri de taa ŋɔɔna,
se a wane a leeni a seini‑m.
16Vara kaanem nam ba pwoli nmo wo,
se a ya wó ja tento a ba a pa‑m.
Amo ná jaane varem a ba
se a zwɛ a pa‑m,
nmo bá sɛ n jwoŋi.
17Amo Tu Wɛ,
kolo yerane nmo na lage
se nɔɔno kwei o pa‑m to
mo ye bochare delo
na ba jege fia to.
Wolo ná tu o tete nmo yiga ne,
ye o ná chuli o keim-lwanno tem,
nmo bá‑n ve kotu.
18A lwoori‑m,
nmo tete lanyerane dem ŋwaane,
se n woli Zion teo kom.
Pa se Jerusalem kabiri sem jwoori
se lɔ se zege wɛɛne de dam.
19Konto ná kea, dé wó jwoori
dé ja vara dé zwɛ dé pa‑m,
pa se ko bere kaanem delo
na tɔge chwoŋa chekke
ye de pwoli nmo wo to.
Dé wó ja nabɛ dé ba dé kaane
nmo bimbini dem baŋa ne.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. He wrote this when Doeg from Edom went to Saul and said, “David has gone to Ahimelech's house.”)
God Is in Control
1 You people may be strong
and brag about your sins,
but God can be trusted
day after day.
2You plan brutal crimes,
and your lying words cut
like a sharp razor.
3You would rather do evil
than good, and tell lies
than speak the truth.
4You love to say cruel things,
and your words are a trap.
5God will destroy you forever!
He will grab you and drag you
from your homes.
You will be uprooted
and left to die.
6When good people see
this fearsome sight,
they will laugh and say,
7“Just look at them now!
Instead of trusting God,
they trusted their wealth
and their cruelty.”
8But I am like an olive tree
growing in God's house,
and I can count on his love
forever and ever.
9I will always thank God
for what he has done;
I will praise his good name
when his people meet.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ bora borem de o zaane taane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo Edom tu Doegi na vei Pɛ Sɔɔl tei o ta o bere‑o we, “David wo Abimeleka sɔŋɔ ne” to.
1Nmo wolo na ye
nɔn-kamunu to,
bɛ mo ye n bere n tete
n lwarem kikia yam ŋwaane?
Baŋa Wɛ nam zege o chega kam wone o pa-ne dɛ maama wuu.
2N dindeilimi nye de fana
kalo na tiini ka jege ni to mo,
pa se n ŋɔɔne chɔgem taane,
ye vwa yerane mo n kare n fɔe.
3N ta swoi lwarem ko dwoi lam.
N ma‑n kuri vwa fɔm
ye n daare chega ŋɔŋa.
4Wonnu telo na wae
te ke nɔɔna zonne to
mo n swoi se n ta‑n ŋɔɔne-te.
N yɔɔre n gane nɔɔna mo!
5Wɛ nam wó yɔɔre o chochoge nmo se ko ti.
O lage o zi‑m o ja o nwoŋi
n sɔŋɔ kom ne,
ye o daare o gɔ‑m o yage
se n daa yé taa ŋwe logo baŋa ne.
6Nɔn-ŋona maa wó na
kolo na to n baŋa ne to,
pa se ko so-ba dedɛ.
Ba laam wó ke wopwolo
ye ba ta we:
7“Nii-na nɔn-kamunu konto!
O wo sɛ se Wɛ taa ye o dalem jei.
O nam kwei o chega maama
o pa o jejegero tem mo.
O teena maa wo
o keim-lwanno tem baŋa ne.”
8Amo kugu jei nam wo
Wɛ wara-jei sem ne,
ne Olivi tio na tei ko tete tei
mare-mare to mo.
A ta wó taa sale Wɛ swono kom
baŋa ne mo taa wuu.
9Amo Tu Wɛ, a wó taa tei‑m taa wuu
dedaane n na ke kolo to.
Amo teena wó taa wo
n yere dem baŋa ne,
de na yɔɔre de lana to ŋwaane.
A wó taa tei‑m
n tete nɔɔna bam yiga ne.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Mahalath.”
)
No One Can Ignore God
1 Only a fool would say,
“There is no God!”
People like that are worthless!
They are heartless and cruel
and never do right.
2From heaven God
looks down to see
if anyone is wise enough
to search for him.
3But all of them
are crooked and corrupt.
Not one of them does right.
4Won't you lawbreakers learn?
You refuse to pray,
and you gobble up
the people of God.
5But you will be terrified
worse than ever before.
God will scatter the bones
of his enemies,
and you will be ashamed
when God rejects you.
6I long for someone from Zion
to come and save Israel!
Our God, when you bless
your people again,
Jacob's family will be glad,
and Israel will celebrate.
translation_text:
N bá‑n wane n gwooni Baŋa Wɛ
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Nɔn-jworru yeini ba tɛ
ba bochare ne we, “Wɛ tera.”
Ba maama yɔɔre ba chɔge mo
ga zɔŋ-zɔŋ.
Ba totoŋa de maa tiini ya tusi dedɛ.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera ba wone
o na tɔge chwo-laao.
2Wɛ ma zege o telaao sɔŋɔ kom ne
o tiiri o nii nabiina,
se o lɔre ba wolo jege swa
ye o tɔge Wɛ.
3Ba maama ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone,
ye ba boboŋa yɔɔre ya chɔge mo
ga zɔŋ-zɔŋ.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam tera ba wone
o na tɔge chwo-laao,
de dedoa de.
4Wo-lwanno keira bá sɛ
se ba zamese swa na?
Ba jege a nɔɔna bam mo ba chɔga
nenɛɛne ko ye wodiu mo ba di.
Ba nam ba bwoŋi Wɛ yere ba zuli‑o.
5Nii-ba mo!
Kolokolo tera ko na fugi-ba,
ye foone ta tiini de jege-ba.
Ko ná ye á dona balo na tu
á baŋa ne to,
Wɛ lage o chɔge-ba mo
o jage ba kwi sem.
Á maa wó pa ba di ba chaveera,
Wɛ na ve-ba to ŋwaane.
6Amo nam wó lwoori Wɛ
se o zege Zion ne
o ba o vere Isarele tiina bam.
Wɛ ná seene o pa o nɔɔna bam
jwoori ba zege de dam,
Isarele tiina na ye Jakob dwi dem to
wó taa chaka de wopwolo!

english_text:
(For the music leader. Use with stringed instruments. A special psalm that David wrote when the people of Ziph went to Saul and said, “David is hiding here with us.”)
Trusting God in Times of Trouble
1 Save me, God, by your power
and prove that I am right.
2Listen to my prayer
and hear what I say.
3Cruel strangers have attacked
and want me dead.
Not one of them cares
about you.
4You will help me, Lord God,
and keep me from falling;
5you will punish my enemies
for their evil deeds.
Be my faithful friend
and destroy them.
6I will bring a gift
and offer a sacrifice
to you, Lord.
I will praise your name
because you are good.
7You have rescued me
from all my troubles,
and my own eyes have seen
my enemies fall.
translation_text:
Wɛ ye amo zeinnu
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo Zifi tiina na vei Pɛ Sɔɔl tei ba ta ba bere‑o we, “David tu o seigi o tete debam tetare ne” to.
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
tɔge n yere dem baŋa
n jwoŋi-ne n yage.
Da n dam dem ŋwaane
n pa a na a bora.
2A Tu Wɛ, cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom,
se n daare n sɛ a ni taane dem.
3Kokuri to, veira mo zaŋe a baŋa ne.
Nankɔ-nyena bam konto
lage se ba ti a ŋwea,
ba yiga na tera Wɛ wone to ŋwaane.
4Nii-na! Wɛ mo ye amo zeinnu.
A Teiru Wɛ mo teili-ne
se a yé to tega ne.
5Wɛ wó pa se a dona bam
lwarem kikia jwoori
ya to ba yuu ne.
Wɛ, da n chega kam ŋwaane
n chɔge-ba n ti.
6Amo wó ja a wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra mo a ba
a ma a ke kaanem a pa‑m.
Baŋa Wɛ, a ta wó tei nmo yere,
de na yɔɔre de lana to ŋwaane.
7Chega to, Wɛ seene o liiri-ne
cham maama wone,
pa se a wane a dona bam a di.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Betrayed by a Friend
1Listen, God, to my prayer!
Don't reject my request.
2Please listen and help me.
My thoughts are troubled,
and I keep groaning
3because my enemies attack
with loud shouts.
They treat me terribly
and hold angry grudges.
4My heart is racing fast,
and I am afraid of dying.
5I am trembling with fear,
completely terrified.
6I wish I had wings
like a dove,
so I could fly far away
and be at peace.
7I would go and live
in some distant desert.
8I would quickly find shelter
from howling winds
and raging storms.
9Confuse my enemies, Lord!
Upset their plans.
Cruelty and violence
are all I see in the city,
10and they are like guards
on patrol day and night.
The city is full of trouble,
evil, 11and corruption.
Troublemakers and liars
freely roam the streets.
12My enemies are not the ones
who sneer and make fun.
I could put up with that
or even hide from them.
13But it was my closest friend,
the one I trusted most.
14We enjoyed being together,
when we went with others
to your house, our God.
15All who hate me are controlled
by the power of evil.
Sentence them to death
and send them down alive
to the world of the dead.
16I ask for your help, Lord God,
and you will keep me safe.
17Morning, noon, and night
you hear my concerns
and my complaints.
18I am attacked from all sides,
but you will rescue me
unharmed by the battle.
19You have always ruled,
and you will hear me.
You will defeat my enemies
because they won't turn
and worship you.
20My friend turned against me
and broke his promise.
21His words were smoother
than butter, and softer
than olive oil.
But hatred filled his heart,
and he was ready to attack
with a sword.
22Our Lord, we belong to you.
We tell you what worries us,
and you won't let us fall.
23But what about those people
who are cruel and brutal?
You will throw them down
into the deepest pit
long before their time.
I trust you, Lord!
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.
A na ŋwane n yiga ne to,
yé seigi n tete a tei ne.
2Nam pa n yiga taa wo a wone
se n daare n leiri-ne,
a cham dem na pɛ se
a yera chɛ to ŋwaane.
3A boboŋa vugimi de a dona bam
na jege-ne ba baga tei to.
Ba nye baare mo a baŋa ne
pa se lɛɛro tiini te yi-ne.
Ba maa yɔɔre ba chuli-ne
de ban-lom dedɛ.
4A wo kom maama chɔɔre mo.
A maa tiini a kɔre foone
de toone na lage de zi-ne lela tei to.
5Lwia de foone yɔɔre ya jege-ne
pa se a yera sae pɔm-pɔm.
6A maa we, “Wɛ ya ná pɛ
se a puli vɔna mo tento,
a ya wó jaane mo
nenɛɛne kunkwoŋa dwoŋi to
a vo yiga yiga se a wane a lu.”
7Tento a ya wó jaane a vo
a yi dáa dáa
se a na jeiga kagoa yuu ne se a sii.
8A ya wó ke lela a na seigim jei
se a dale,
se a dona bam vo-dɛɔ konto
daa yé wane-ne ko daane.
9Amo Teiru Wɛ, pa se vuvuga to
a dona bam tetare ne!
Ja ba bana yam n jage n yage!
Kikia yalo a na yeini a na
teo kom ne to
mo ye nankɔɔre de bobɔga yerane.
10Kikia yanto yeini ya kaare teo kom
ya vei ko kabiri sem baŋa ne
wea de tete maama ne.
Puseŋa de lwarem kikia
de maa su teo kom wo,
11ye chɔgem daga dedɛ.
Kalipera de ganem yɔɔre ya wora mo
ko yaga kam ne.
12Ko nam dae a dono mo jege-ne
o twea.
Ko ya ná ye konto,
a ya wó wane a taa cho a tete.
Ko ya ná ye a dono mo bere o tete a baŋa ne,
a ya wó wane a lɔŋe‑o.
13Se ko ye nmo wolo na ye
a yuudwoŋi to mo ke konto.
Nmo ye a badwoŋ-ywoŋo
ye dé me daane.
14Dé déem yeini dé lare daane
dé di ywoni.
Dé maa tɔge daane
de Wɛ kɔgɔ kom maama
dé beeri Wɛ wara-jei sem ne.
15Nam pa se toone pɔpɔ de ja
a dona bam!
Pa se ba vo churu lela
ŋweene ŋweene.
Kokuri to, lwarem yerane mo su
ba sam de ba bochara.
16Amo nam wó keeri a jare Wɛ mo.
Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoŋi-ne o yage.
17Dɛ maama wone, zezeŋa de wea,
de dedaan-ni ne mo
a yeini a ŋwane Wɛ yiga ne
de keira dedɛ.
Wɛ de ma yeini o cheigi
a wɛ-lworo kom.
18Nɔɔna dedɛ chuli-ne,
ye Wɛ liiri-ne o ja o nwoŋi
jara yam wone
se a wane a na yazura.
19Wɛ mo ye wolo na maŋe
o di paare faŋa faŋa to.
Wonto nam wó sɛ a lworo kom
ye o daare o waare a dona bam.
Kokuri to, banto ba sɛ
se ba leiri ba boboŋa.
Ba maa ba kɔre Wɛ.
20Amo yuudwoŋi wom zaŋe
o dwonna bam baŋa ne.
O ma yiri ni delo o na ke de-ba to.
21O yeini o ŋɔɔne ni-som ŋɔŋa
ye chɔgem boboŋa wo o yuu ne.
O ni taane swola nenɛɛne nuga to,
ye de maama laam za ke nɔɔna zonne mo
ne se-zɔɔro na ke nɔɔna zonne tei to.
22Nmo na jege lwia yalo maama to,
se n kwei-ya n pa Baŋa Wɛ,
se wonto mo wó pa‑m dam.
O bá sɛ se nɔn-ŋona tiri
ba to tega ne.
23Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo nam wó ja
puseŋ-nyena banto
n dole n yage gwoŋo kolo
na luuna to wone
se ba yera pɔ.
Ba na ye nɔn-gora de vwa-fɔra to,
n lage n pa ba te mo
ye ba ta ye nɔn-donno.
Amo tete nam wó kwei a teena mo
a daŋe nmo wone.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “A Silent Dove in the Distance.”
A special psalm by David when the Philistines captured him in Gath.)
A Prayer of Trust in God
1 Have pity, God Most High!
My enemies chase me all day.
2Many of them are pursuing
and attacking me,
3but even when I am afraid,
I keep on trusting you.
4I praise your promises!
I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
5Enemies spend the whole day
finding fault with me;
all they think about
is how to do me harm.
6They attack from ambush,
watching my every step
and hoping to kill me.
7They won't get away
with these crimes, God,
because when you get angry,
you destroy people.
8You have kept record
of my days of wandering.
You have stored my tears
in your bottle
and counted each of them.
9When I pray, Lord God,
my enemies will retreat,
because I know for certain
that you are with me.
10I praise your promises!
11I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
12I will keep my promises
to you, my God,
and bring you gifts.
13You protected me from death
and kept me from stumbling,
so that I would please you
and follow the light
that leads to life.
translation_text:
Ke n wo-dedoa dedaane Baŋa Wɛ
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo Filisi tiina na jaane‑o Gafa teo wone to.
1Amo Tu Wɛ, duri amo ŋwaŋa.
A dona mo zaŋe a baŋa ne
ye ba bɛɛse-ne dɛ dem maama wone.
2Ba maa nɔna a baŋa ne
maŋa maama,
ye ba dedɛ mo bere ba tete
ba jaŋe de-ne.
3Foone nam ná yeini de ja-ne,
a daa ta wó ke a wo-dedoa de nmo.
4A Tu Wɛ, a lage a tei nmo,
de ni delo n na tiŋi to.
A seene a ke a wo-dedoa de Wɛ.
Mo kokuri a daa bá taa kɔre foone.
Nabiina daa bá wane
ba ke amo kolokolo.
5Dɛ dem maama wone to,
ba jege-ne ba daana.
Ba boboŋa maama maa ye
se ba ke-ne lwarem.
6Ba tiŋi yi mo ba yere
a na-veili maama,
ye ba lage chwoŋa mo
se ba ma zi-ne.
Ba maa teene we
ba wó na laŋa ba go-ne.
7Ba na yɔɔre ba toŋe lwarem to,
nmo wó pa-ba chwoŋa
se ba lu na?
Amo Tu Wɛ, nam pa n bane zaŋe
de nɔɔna bam,
pa se ba na chɔgem.
8Ko ná ye lwia yalo na yeini
ya daane-ne to,
n jeeli ya maama.
N ta ma‑n la a yi-na bam
n ke kunkwolo wone
se n lɔre a na keeri tei maama.
N popone ya maama n tiŋi
n tɔnɔ kom ne.
9Dɛ dem a na wó bwoŋi Wɛ yere
se o ba o zeini-ne to,
a dona bam laam wó tutwoni
ba jwoori kwaga.
Konto maa pae se a yei we,
Wɛ mo zege a kwaga ne.
10A lage a tei Wɛ mo
de ni delo o na tiŋi to.
Chega to, a wó taa tei Baŋa Wɛ
o ni taane dem ŋwaane.
11A seene a ke a wo-dedoa de Wɛ.
Mo kokuri a daa bá taa kɔre foone.
Nabiina daa bá wane
ba ke amo kolokolo.
12Amo Tu Wɛ, a jege se a tɔge
ni delo a na dugi dede‑m to.
A maa wó ja lei-keim pɛɛra
a ba a pa‑m.
13Kokuri to, nmo mo kwoli-ne
pa a wo tege.
N ta ma‑n che-ne
pa a wo to tega ne.
N ke konto se a taa wae a vei
Wɛ chwoŋa wone
ye ŋwea pwooni wo a tei ne.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when he was in the cave while running from Saul.)
Praise and Trust in Times of Trouble
1 God Most High, have pity on me!
Have mercy. I run to you
for safety.
In the shadow of your wings,
I seek protection
till danger dies down.
2I pray to you, my protector.
3You will send help from heaven
and save me,
but you will bring trouble
on my attackers.
You are faithful,
and you can be trusted.
4My enemies are fierce,
much worse than lions!
They have spears and arrows
instead of teeth,
and they have sharp swords
instead of tongues.
5May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6 Enemies set traps for my feet
and struck me down.
They dug a pit in my path,
but fell in it themselves.
7I am faithful to you,
and you can trust me.
I will sing and play music
for you, my God.
8I feel wide awake!
I will wake up my harp
and wake up the sun.
9I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear,
and I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
10Your love reaches higher
than the heavens;
your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
11May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo o na duri o seigi peo bɔɔne wone se Sɔɔl yé ja‑o to.
1Amo Tu Wɛ, duri a ŋwaŋa.
Popo, se n duri a ŋwaŋa.
A tu nmo tei mo se a seigi a tete.
Pa se a vwɛ n woro kom wone,
ne nmo na yarege n vɔna
n kwoli-ne tei to,
se lɛɛro tem maama kɛ.
2A lage a keeri a jare
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo.
Wonto maa ye wolo
na zege a kwaga ne to.
3Wɛ wó zege o telaao ne
o toŋe zeina a ŋwaane
ye o daare o jwoŋi-ne o yage.
Ko nam ná ye balo na zaŋe
a baŋa ne to,
Wɛ wó waare-ba.
Wɛ wó pa se o swono kom yi-ne,
o na zege o chega kam wone to ŋwaane.
4A dona bam gilimi-ne
nenɛɛne a na tigi
nywonnu tetare ne
ye te lage se te tore
nabiina ya-nɔna tei to mo.
Nɔɔna bam konto yeila nye nenɛɛne chichwoa de che-tɛɛra mo.
Ba dindeilima maa nye de se-zɔɔro
telo na tiini te jege ni to.
5Amo Tu Wɛ, pa n yere zaŋe
wɛyuu maama ne!
Ta pa se n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ taa nae
logo baŋa jei maama ne!
6A dona bam tiŋi kalanchogo mo
se ba ja-ne.
A vɔna ma pare
wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane.
Ba ta ma ko gwoŋo
se a to ko wone,
ye ba tete mo jwoori ba to ko wone.
7Amo Tu Wɛ, a wo kom yɔɔre
ko da nmo mo.
Chega to, a ke a wo-dedoa dede‑m.
Konto to, a lage a leeni lei a seini‑m.
8A wó ke a tete mo daane
a zaŋe wɛɛne!
A laam wó kwei kwanno dwi dwi
a ta pa se te kwori zaŋe.
Tega ná poore,
a wó zaŋe lela a leeni lei!
9A Teiru Wɛ, a wó ke nmo lei
nɔɔna bam maama yiga ne.
A ta wó leeni lei a seini‑m
logo baŋa dwi tiina maama wone.
10N swono kom wora mo taa,
ye ko geene ko di wɛyuu.
Nmo na yɔɔre n zege
n chega wone tei to
mo tiini ko yala
ko gaale kunkwonnu tem.
11Amo Tu Wɛ, pa n yere zaŋe
wɛyuu baŋa maama ne!
Ta pa se n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ taa nae
dɔŋɔ ni maama ne!

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
A Prayer When All Goes Wrong
1Do you mighty people talk
only to oppose justice?
Don't you ever judge fairly?
2You are always planning evil,
and you are brutal.
3You have done wrong and lied
from the day you were born.
4Your words spread poison
like the bite of a cobra
5that refuses to listen
to the snake charmer.
6My enemies are fierce
as lions, Lord God!
Shatter their teeth.
Snatch out their fangs.
7Make them disappear
like leaking water,
and make their arrows miss.
8Let them dry up like snails
or be like a child that dies
before seeing the sun.
9Wipe them out quicker
than a pot can be heated
by setting thorns on fire.
10Good people will be glad
when they see the wicked
getting what they deserve,
and they will wash their feet
in their enemies' blood.
11Everyone will say, “It's true!
Good people are rewarded.
God does indeed rule the earth
with justice.”
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ wó di nabiina maama taane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Abam balo na ye dedɛɛra to,
á yeini á tɔge chega
de á na di nɔɔna taane tei to na?
Á wó sɛ á bore chega bora
á pa nabiina na?
2Aawo! Tusim kikia yerane mo
á boŋe ya boboŋa.
Á na toŋe tei to pae se nankɔɔre
sui tega kam baŋa maama.
3Puseŋ-nyena bam yeini ba tusi mo
ko zege ba lora maŋa ne.
Ba loge-ba dedaane ba maŋe
ba ywori chwoŋa wone mo
ye ba kare ba fɔe vwa.
4Ba ni taane tiini de chana,
ne basankwea vea na ye tei to mo.
Ba ma se ba zwa se ba yé cheigi,
ne kapaa de na ke tei to.
5Ka ba sɛ se ka cheigi liri-mwa tiina
balo na kwaane se ba ja-ka to,
de ba ná maŋe ba ke swa tei maama.
6Amo Tu Wɛ, nam bwori
a dona bam yeila,
ba na nye de nywon-pɔle
na lage se se tore-ne to ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ, guri ba yeila yam n yage!
7Pa se ba we nenɛɛne na
na lwogi ba ke tega ne tei to.
Ba ná tage ba chena yam,
pa se ya taa ba jege ni se ya zɔ.
8Ta pa se ba taa nye nenɛɛne
kunkwora na yeini ya ko
ya daare ya kwogila yerane tei to,
se ba ta taa nye de
bu-toa balo ba na loga
ye ba bá fɔge ba na wea pwooni to.
9Wɛ wó ke lela o saare-ba o yage,
ba nɔn-donno dedaane
ba nɔn-kwe maama,
pa se ba jei lela
ba dwoni kambia na lone lela
mini ne tei to.
10Nɔn-ŋona wo wó pwoli
nenɛɛne puseŋ-nyena bam ná nɛ
waarem delo na maŋe de-ba to.
Ba ta wó vo ba zare ba nɛ
de puseŋ-nyena jana bam.
11Nɔɔna laam maa wó ta ba we,
“Nii-na nɔn-ŋona bam
na nɛ nyɔɔre tei to.
Chega ŋwaane to, Wɛ wora
ye o bore chega bora
logo baŋa ne.”

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when Saul had David's house watched so that he could kill him.)
A Prayer for Protection
1 Save me, God! Protect me
from enemy attacks!
2Keep me safe from brutal people
who want to kill me.
3Merciless enemies, Lord,
are hiding and plotting,
hoping to kill me.
I have not hurt them
in any way at all.
4But they are ready to attack.
Do something! Help me!
Look at what's happening.
5 Lord God All-Powerful,
you are the God of Israel.
Punish the other nations
and don't pity those terrible
and rebellious people.
6My enemies return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
7They curse, and their words
cut like swords,
as they say to themselves,
“No one can hear us!”
8You, Lord, laugh at them
and sneer at the nations.
9You are my mighty fortress,
and I depend on you.
10You love me and will let me
see my enemies defeated.
11Don't kill them,
or everyone may forget!
Just use your mighty power
to make them tremble
and fall.
You are a shield
for your people.
12My enemies are liars!
So let them be trapped
by their boastful lies.
13Get angry and destroy them.
Leave them in ruin.
Then all the nations will know
that you rule in Israel.
14Those liars return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
15They search for scraps of food,
and they snarl
until they are stuffed.
16But I will sing about
your strength, my God,
and I will celebrate
because of your love.
You are my fortress,
my place of protection
in times of trouble.
17I will sing your praises!
You are my mighty fortress,
and you love me.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo Pɛ Sɔɔl na toŋe nɔɔna se ba yere David sɔŋɔ kom, se ba daare ba go‑o to.
1Amo Tu Wɛ, jwoŋi-ne
a dona bam jeŋa ne n yage!
Ta‑n cho-ne,
se balo na zege amo zega to
yé wane-ne.
2Jwoŋi-ne balo na toŋe lwarem to
jeŋa ne,
dedaane nɔn-gora de jeŋa ne.
3Nii mo! Ba dale gugworru wone mo ba cheiga,
se ba laam nwoŋi ba zi-ne ba go.
Nankɔ-nyena bam konto boŋe
se ba ke-ne zonne mo.
Baŋa Wɛ, ko nam dae we
a ke woŋo a chɔge ba yiga.
4Ba ma seene ba yia
ba duri se ba ja-ne,
ye ko dae amo mo tusi
de fenfee de.
Konto to, zaŋe wɛɛne
se n ba n zeini-ne.
Nii n na ba na ke-ne tei to.
5Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo mo ye debam Isarele tiina Wɛ wom.
Zaŋe wɛɛne se n waare
dwi-gɛ tiina bam.
Ko ná ye nɔn-ŋollo tem konto
na toŋe lwarem to,
yé duri ba yibwona kɔtaa!
6Tete ne mo a dona bam yeini
ba jwoori ywo-seeni.
Ba maa kare teo kom maama wone
ye ba wia ne kukuri tei to.
7Ta‑n cheigi ba na ŋɔɔne
boyerem ŋɔŋa tei to!
Ba ni taane dem yeini
de chɔge nɔɔna,
nenɛɛne se-zɔɔro na ke nɔɔna zonne tei to.
Ba maa boŋe we,
“Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ni dé ŋɔŋa.”
8 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam jege-ba mo
n mɔna.
N jege dwi-gɛ tiina bam maama
mo n gweela.
9Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo jege dam
se n kwoli-ne.
Amo wó kwoni a nii nmo mo,
n na ye a dalem jei to ŋwaane.
10A Tu Wɛ wom wó ba
o jwoŋi-ne o yage,
o na jege a swono taa wuu to ŋwaane.
O ta wó pa se a wane a dona bam
a di.
11Dé Teiru Wɛ, yé gare n go-ba lela,
se a nɔɔna bam gare ba swei
ba swia.
Nam ma n dam-fɔrɔ kom
n pa ba taa beeri yɔɔ yerane,
se n laam daare n pa ba to tega ne.
Nmo Wɛ yeini n cho debam,
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔna
jara wone tei to mo.
12Ba ni-wɛɛle ye tusim yerane mo.
Konto to, pa se ba na jege fia tei to de-ba tega ne.
Ba ta yeini ba sɔɔle lwarem,
ye ba fɔe vwa.
13Konto ŋwaane,
tɔge n ban-lom dem baŋa
n chɔge-ba fase, pa se ba jei.
Konto mo wó pa se logo baŋa
jei maama nɔɔna lɔre we,
Wɛ mo seene o nii debam Jakob dwi dem baŋa ne.
14Tete ne mo a dona bam yeini
ba jwoori ywo-seeni.
Ba maa kare teo kom maama wone
ye ba wia ne kukuri tei to.
15Ba maa yeini ba kare
ba beeri wodiiru se ba di.
Ba ná wo di ba su,
ba wó taa suura mo.
16Ko nam ná ye amo, a lage a leeni
a seini‑m n dam dem ŋwaane mo.
Zezeŋa maama ne mo,
a ta wó leeni de kwor-dɛa
n na jege a swono taa wuu to ŋwaane.
Kokuri to, nmo mo ye a dalem jei
mɛ a na wó wane a vo a kwoli a tete
a cham maŋa ne to.
17Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo jege dam
se n kwoli-ne.
A wó taa leeni lei mo a seini‑m.
Kokuri to, nmo mo ye a dalem jei.
Nmo ye amo Tu Wɛ wom
na jege a swono taa wuu to.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Lily of the Promise.” A special psalm by David for teaching. He wrote it during his wars with the Arameans of northern Syria,
when Joab came back and killed twelve thousand Edomites
in Salt Valley.)
You Can Depend on God
1 You, God, are angry with us!
We are rejected and crushed.
Make us strong again!
2You made the earth shake
and split wide open;
now heal its wounds
and stop its trembling.
3You brought hard times
on your people,
and you gave us wine
that made us stagger.
4You gave a signal to those
who worship you,
so they could escape
from enemy arrows.
5Answer our prayers, God!
Use your powerful arm
and give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
6Our God, you solemnly promised,
“I would gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
7The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is the symbol
of my royal power.
8Moab is merely my washbasin.
Edom belongs to me,
and I shout in triumph
over the Philistines.”
9Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress,
or lead me to Edom?
10Have you rejected us
and deserted our armies?
11Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
12You will give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Wɛ yerane wó wane dé dona o di
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo o na ke jara de Aram tiina badwonna, ye o jar-keira bam yiga tu Joaba pipiri o zaŋe Edom jar-keira morro fuga-telei (12,000) baŋa ne o go-ba Yɛ bwolo kom ne to.
1Debam Tu Wɛ,
n nwoŋi debam kwaga ne,
ye n daare n chɔge dé dam.
N bane ya mo zaŋe
debam baŋa ne.
Laam nam pa dé dam jwoori
de taa wora.
2Nmo mo sugi debam tega kam
pa ka ziziŋi,
ye n daare n pa se ka bɔke belei.
Nam jwoori n kwoni lolwe sem,
se tega kam daa yé taa ziziŋa.
3Nmo pɛ se cham yi debam
balo na ye n nɔɔna bam to,
pa ko ni debam dedɛ.
Ko nye nenɛɛne n na pɛ debam sana pa dé nyɔ
ye dé laam beiri tei to.
4Ko nam ná ye balo na kɔre nmo to,
n zeiŋi tuta mo n pa-ba,
se ba wane ba duri ba vo da
se jara yam yé yi-ba.
5Popo, leiri dé wɛ-lworo kom.
Kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom
n ma n jwoŋi debam n yage.
Konto to, n nɔn-swonnu tem
wó taa tei ba tete.
6Wɛ zege o tete diga kam ne mo o we:
“Amo wó bere a dam jaja
a chɛ chɛ Sɛkɛm laŋa kam,
ye a daare a maŋe Sukofa bwolo kom
a pɔɔre a pa a nɔɔna bam.
7Gilead laŋa kam ye amo nyem,
ko ta woli de Manasɛ laŋa kam de.
Efrayim maa nye de
a yu-gwoŋo kom.
Judah de maa nye de
a paare nacheiga kam.
8Ko ná ye Moaba laŋa kam,
dáane mo a lage a taa sane
a je sem.
A ta lage a dole a natere
Edom teo kom seeni mo,
se ko bere we a tei-ko.
A kwora maa wó bage ka yage
Filisi tiina bam seeni,
a na wane-ba a di to ŋwaane.”
9Wɔ nam mo wó ja amo o vo
teo kolo na lɔge ko pe to wone?
Wɔ mo wó ja-ne o vo
o yi Edom teo kom?
10Debam Tu Wɛ, nmo nam nwoŋi
dé kwaga ne mo na?
Dé ná nwoŋi se dé kwaare jara,
n daa‑n bá‑n tɔge dé yiga
se dé vo na?
11Ja, woli debam
se dé wane dé dona bam,
se nabiina na jege wolim delo to maama ba jege kuri.
12Wɛ nam ná wo debam tei ne,
dé wó wane dé dona bam dé di.
Wonto wó nɔne-ba o meere
o pa debam.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Under the Protection of God
1Please listen, God,
and answer my prayer!
2I feel hopeless,
and I cry out to you
from a faraway land.
Lead me to the mighty rock
high above me.
3You are a strong tower,
where I am safe
from my enemies.
4Let me live with you forever
and find protection
under your wings, my God.
5You heard my promises,
and you have blessed me,
just as you bless everyone
who worships you.
6Let the king have a long
and healthy life.
7May he always rule
with you, God, at his side;
may your love and loyalty
watch over him.
8I will sing your praises
forever, God, and will always
keep my promises.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
cheigi a keira kam,
se n daare n sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom.
2A maa zege logo kom yiga yiga ne
ye a keeri a jare‑m.
Amo teena maama ti mo.
Nam da amo yiga se n ja-ne
n vo n yi peo kolo
na diini wɛyuu ko dwoi amo to,
se a na jeiŋa jei dáane.
3Kokuri to, nmo mo ye wolo
a na seigi n woro wone to.
N ma‑n ye a dalem jei na kwoli-ne
pa se a dona ware se ba yi-ne to.
4Sɛ se amo taa zoore n sɔŋɔ kom ne
taa wuu,
se a wane a vwɛ n woro kom wone,
ne nmo na yarege n vɔna
n kwoli-ne tei to.
5Kokuri to, amo Tu Wɛ,
nmo maŋe n ni a na dugi duuri
tei maama to.
N ta ma pa se a na nyɔɔre
ne ko na maŋe se n pa
balo na kɔre‑m to.
6Pa se Pɛ wom taa jege momwɛ-dɛɛre.
Sɛ se o taa ŋwe taa
se o na dwi dedɛ.
7Wɛ, pa chwoŋa
se o jeini o paare dem ne taa
ye n nii o baŋa ne.
Nmo na zege n chega wone to,
pa se n swono kom taa cho‑o
maŋa maama.
8Konto to, amo wó taa leeni
a seini n yere dem
ye a bá yage.
Dɛ maama wone, a ta wó taa ke
a sui kolo maama
a na dugi duuri we a wó ke to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
God Is Powerful and Kind
1Only God can save me,
and I calmly wait for him.
2God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe
and the fortress
where I am secure.
3I feel like a shaky fence
or a sagging wall.
How long will all of you
attack and assault me?
4You want to bring me down
from my place of honor.
You love to tell lies,
and when your words are kind,
hatred hides in your heart.
5Only God gives inward peace,
and I depend on him.
6God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe,
and he is the fortress
where I feel secure.
7God saves me and honors me.
He is that mighty rock
where I find safety.
8Trust God, my friends,
and always tell him
each of your concerns.
God is our place of safety.
9We humans are only a breath;
none of us are truly great.
All of us together weigh less
than a puff of air.
10Don't trust in violence
or depend on dishonesty
or rely on great wealth.
11I heard God say two things:
“I am powerful,
12 and I am very kind.”
The Lord rewards each of us
according to what we do.
translation_text:
Pa n teena taa wo Wɛ baŋa ne
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo wó peene mo a taa cheigi Wɛ se o zeini-ne,
se ko ye wonto yerane mo
wó wane-ne o jwoŋi o yage.
2Wonto yerane mo ye peo kolo
amo na sale ko yera ne to.
O ta maa ye amo vereno.
O kwori o ye amo dalem jei mo.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane-ne o di.
3Abam maama wó ke chichuŋu
de nɔɔno dedoa taa
se á vo á maŋe yei ne mo?
Á lage se á mage‑o
á de tega ne mo na?
O nam nye de kabira
kalo na veele to mo.
4Á boboŋe dem maama ye
se á vaŋe‑o á de tega ne mo,
de o ya na wo wɛyuu ne tei to.
Á maa swoi vwa fɔm yerane.
Á yeini á ŋɔɔne ni-som ŋɔŋa mo,
ye á boboŋa maama ye
se á sɔɔle lwarem á pa‑o.
5Chega to, amo wó peene mo
a taa cheigi Wɛ se o zeini-ne.
Wonto yerane mo jege a teena.
6Wonto yerane mo ye peo kolo
amo na sale ko yera ne to.
O ta maa ye amo vereno.
O kwori o ye amo dalem jei mo.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane-ne o di.
7Ko ye Wɛ mo pɛ a na verem
dedaane zula.
O maa ye peo-kamunu kolo
amo na dale da
pa se a seigi o woro wone to.
8A nɔɔna bam, ke-na á wo-dedoa
dedaane Wɛ maŋa maama wone.
Pa-na se o lɔre kolo maama
na daane á boboŋa to.
Wɛ mo ye dé dalem jei.
9Nabiina maama ye vio yerane mo,
nabwona de dedɛɛra maama de.
Nmo ya ná kwei-ba
n maŋe ba dunni,
n wó na we ba ba jege yuu.
Ba nam nye de weero telo
vio na kale ko ja jei to mo.
10Yé ma n dam n pini nɔɔna.
Ta yé ta‑n jege teera de wonnu telo
n na vere n dwonna tei ne to.
Nmo jejegero tem ná puli
pa se te daga tei maama,
ta‑n yei se n yé kwei n bochare
n feiri te baŋa ne.
11Amo nigi chega kuni belei
Wɛ tei ne.
Boboa tu mo ye we: Wɛ jege dam.
Kolo na woli da ko ke belei to
maa ye we:
12Nmo Baŋa Wɛ jege nabiina swono chekke.
Nmo yeini n ŋwe nɔɔno maama mo
se ko tɔge de o totoŋa
na ye tei maama to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David when he was in the desert of Judah.)
God's Love Means More than Life
1 You are my God. I worship you.
In my heart, I long for you,
as I would long for a stream
in a scorching desert.
2I have seen your power
and your glory
in the place of worship.
3Your love means more
than life to me,
and I praise you.
4As long as I live,
I will pray to you.
5I will sing joyful praises
and be filled with excitement
like a guest at a banquet.
6I think about you, God,
before I go to sleep,
and my thoughts turn to you
during the night.
7You have helped me,
and I sing happy songs
in the shadow of your wings.
8I stay close to you,
and your powerful arm
supports me.
9All who want to kill me
will end up in the ground.
10Swords will run them through,
and wild dogs will eat them.
11Because of you, our God,
the king will celebrate
with your faithful followers,
but liars will be silent.
translation_text:
Wɛ swono kom daga
David déem pane leiŋa kanto maŋa kalo o na wo Judah kagoa kam wone to.
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
nmo seene n ye a Wɛ mo.
Nmo fera tiini ya zo-ne,
nenɛɛne na-nyɔm na jege-ne tei to.
Amo tiini a lage‑m de a wo maama,
ne te-kora na tiga ye na tera to.
2Amo na zo n wara-jei sem ne to,
a nɛ nmo de n dam dem maama,
ko woli de n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom.
3Nmo na tiini n jege amo swono to,
ko gare ŋwea kam tete ko pa-ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó ma a ni dem a pa‑m zula.
4Amo ta na jege ŋwea to,
amo wó tei‑m.
Amo wó zeiŋi a jea a lwoori‑m.
5Amo bochare laam wó zuri,
nenɛɛne a na nɛ wodi-fɔrɔ
a di a su tei to.
A maa wó daare a leeni lei
a zuli‑m de wopwolo.
6Tete ne, amo ná yeini a peini se a dɔ,
a guli nmo gula mo maŋa maama,
ye a boŋe nmo boboŋa.
7Ko zege boboa ne,
nmo maŋe n ye amo zeinnu mo.
A maa vwɛ n woro kom wone.
Mo kokuri a leeni lei de wopwolo.
8Amo wó taa sale‑m mo,
se n ma n jazem dem
n ma‑n teili-ne.
9Balo dwi maama na beeri
se ba go-ne to,
nmo wó chɔge.
Banto wó te ba vo tega kuri kuri
ba daare amo.
10Jar-keira wó ma se-zɔɔro mo
ba go-ba.
Nywoŋ-kuri maa wó ja ba yera yam se di.
11Wɛ ŋwaane mo Pɛ wom nam
wó di ywoni lanyerane.
Balo maama na yeini ba pwooli
kampwoli Wɛ yere dem ŋwaane to wó zuli‑o.
Ko daare se vwa-fɔra dwi maama nia pu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Celebrate because of the Lord
1Listen to my concerns, God,
and protect me
from my enemies' threats.
2Keep me safe from secret plots
of corrupt and evil gangs.
3Their words cut like swords,
and their cruel remarks
sting like sharp arrows.
4They fearlessly ambush
and shoot innocent people.
5They are determined to do evil,
and they tell themselves,
“Let's set traps!
No one can see us.”
6They make evil plans and say,
“We'll commit a perfect crime.
No one knows our thoughts.”
7But God will shoot his arrows
and quickly wound them.
8They will be destroyed
by their own words,
and everyone who sees them
will tremble with fear.
9They will be afraid and say,
“Look at what God has done
and keep it all in mind.”
10May the Lord bless his people
with peace and happiness
and let them celebrate.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo kwolim ŋwaane
1Amo Tu Wɛ,
cheigi amo wɛ-lworo
de a na wo cham wone tei to.
Ta‑n cho-ne a dona bam tetare ne
de ba na fugi-ne tei to.
2Ta‑n kwoli-ne,
se puseŋ-nyena na bane daane
se ba chɔge-ne tei to
yé wane ko yi-ne.
Yé sɛ se wo-lwan-keira
zo kɔgɔ wone
ba ke lwarem a yuu ne.
3Banto dindeilima yam gwoni mo
fileim-fileim
nenɛɛne se-zɔɔro nia tei to.
Ba ni taane de maa zɔ nɔɔna
nenɛɛne che-tɛɛra tei to.
4Ba yeini ba vwɛ mo
ba pɔpɔ ba ta nɔn-laaro,
ye ba ba kɔre foone.
5Ba ke dam mo da-kuri ne
se ba yɔɔre ba ke lwarem
ne ba boboŋa na jaane
se ba ke tei to.
Ba bane daane mo se ba che zaana ba dwonna ŋwaane,
ye ba we, “Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba nae
dé keina yam.”
6Ba ná jeini ba bane
keim-lwanno bana konto,
ba laam yeini ba ta mo we,
“Ko ye wo-laao mo dé bane.”
Chega to, nabiina bochare de ba boboŋa maama ba ŋwae kɔtaa.
7Wɛ nam mo wó kwei
o che-tɛɛra yam o ta-ba,
pa se ba pɔpɔ ba na zonne.
8Banto tete ni taane dem
mo lage de jwoori de di-ba,
pa se ba to tega ne.
Wolo maama ná nɛ-ba,
kotu yera wó taa sae.
9Nɔɔna maama laam maa
wó taa kɔre foone.
Ba ta wó tɔɔle Wɛ totoŋa yam tɔla,
ye ba daare ba ke o kikia yam
ba boboŋa ne.
10Nɔn-ŋona wó di ywoni mo
Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane.
Wonto wone mo ba wó na ba woro.
Balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to
wó taa jege teera
de Baŋa Wɛ na ke kolo to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David and a song for the music leader.)
God Answers Prayer
1Our God, you deserve praise
in Zion, where we keep
our promises to you.
2Everyone will come to you
because you answer prayer.
3When our sins get us down,
you forgive us.
4You bless your chosen ones,
and you invite them
to live near you
in your temple.
We will enjoy your house,
the sacred temple.
5Our God, you save us,
and your fearsome deeds answer
our prayers for justice!
You give hope to people
everywhere on earth,
even those across the sea.
6You are strong,
and your mighty power
put the mountains in place.
7You silence the roaring waves
and the noisy shouts
of the nations.
8People far away marvel
at your fearsome deeds,
and all who live under the sun
celebrate and sing
because of you.
9You take care of the earth
and send rain to help the soil
grow all kinds of crops.
Your rivers never run dry,
and you prepare the earth
to produce abundant grain.
10You water all its fields
and level the lumpy ground.
You send showers of rain
to soften the soil
and help the plants sprout.
11Wherever your footsteps
touch the earth,
a rich harvest is gathered.
12Desert pastures blossom,
and mountains celebrate.
13Meadows are filled
with sheep and goats;
valleys overflow with grain
and echo with joyful songs.
translation_text:
Debam teena wo Wɛ tei ne
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Wɛ,
ko maŋe se dé taa tei‑m
Zion teo kom wone mo.
Dé wó seene dé ke kolo maama
dé na pwooli se dé ke dé pa‑m to.
2Nmo mo ye wolo
na cheigi debam wara to mo.
Tega baŋa nɔɔna maama
wó ba nmo tei se ba zuli‑m.
3Debam wɛleera yam daga
ya dwoi dé jaanem,
ye nmo ta kwei dé tusim kikia yam,
n yage n ma n chɛ debam.
4Balo maama nmo na kuri
se ba ba ba taa zoore
nmo wara-jei sem wone to,
banto jege yu-ywoŋo!
Debam yi wó su dedaane wo-laaro
telo na wo n di-laao kom ne to.
Dé wó na zaane
nmo tete sɔŋɔ kom ne.
5Debam Tu Wɛ,
nmo mo ye debam Vereno.
Nmo yeini n sɛ dé wɛ-lworo kom,
ye n toŋe totoŋa yalo
na ke debam yaau to,
se n ma‑n vere debam.
Logo baŋa nɔɔna maama teena
wo nmo tei ne mo,
ko ta woli de balo na kare
naneero tem ne ba vei to.
6N tɔge n dam dem baŋa ne mo,
n chwi peero tem
n zege vili-vili.
Ko maa bere n dam dem
na tiini de daga tei to.
7Naneero tem na wuuri tei
ye na-ŋone sem pɔgele dedɛ to,
n pɛ se na-fwaaro tem maama
ke ziim mo.
Logo baŋa teene dem de na ke sɔɔ to,
n pɛ se de ye chemm mo.
8Balo na zoore logo baŋa
gugworru ne yiga yiga to
laam fona mo de wo-kenkagela
yalo n na ke to.
Ko na zege wɛ-puli seeni
se ko taa vei wɛ-zoore seeni to
nabiina maama wó taa leeni
wopwolo lei nmo ŋwaane.
9Nmo yiga wo tega kam wone
ye n yeini n pa doa nene
ka baŋa ne,
pa se ka ywomma lanyerane.
Nmo bwi sem su se wɛɛle.
Se na bam maa pa se
tega kam ke wodiiru dedɛ
ka pa nɔɔna bam.
Nmo na yeini n toŋe tei to
mo konto.
10Nmo ma‑n pa doa yeini
ka bugi te-kora kam.
Do-mimina kam maa yeini
ka zuri tega kam.
Nmo ma‑n tɔge konto baŋa ne
n pa pwola se wodiiru wane
te ke lanyerane.
11Faao ná yeini ko yi
bene maama wone,
nmo pa se wodiiru ye mo
kɛɛla kɛɛla.
Chwei selo maama
n na tɔge da n kɛ to,
wodiiru tem gaale mo.
12Kapwoli sem maama laam
yerege mo dedaane ga-lɛɛro.
Peero tem jei maama
de maa jege wo-laaro,
pa se ywoni wora ko ja gaale.
13Vara mo su pwoli sem maama.
Mena de maa li bwollu tem.
Ko daare ye jei sem maama
leeni de kwor-dɛa,
wopwolo na wora to ŋwaane.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm for the music leader.)
Shout Praises to God
1Tell everyone on this earth
to shout praises to God!
2Sing about his glorious name.
Honor him with praises.
3Say to God, “Everything you do
is fearsome,
and your mighty power makes
your enemies come crawling.
4You are worshiped by everyone!
We all sing praises to you.”
5Come and see the fearsome things
our God has done!
6 When God made the sea dry up,
our people walked across,
and because of him,
we celebrated there.
7His mighty power rules forever,
and nothing the nations do
can be hidden from him.
So don't turn against God.
8All of you people,
come praise our God!
Let his praises be heard.
9God protects us from death
and keeps us steady.
10Our God, you tested us,
just as silver is tested.
11You trapped us in a net
and gave us heavy burdens.
12You sent war chariots
to crush our skulls.
We traveled through fire
and through floods,
but you brought us
to a land of plenty.
13I will bring sacrifices
into your house, my God,
and I will do what I promised
14when I was in trouble.
15I will sacrifice my best sheep
and offer bulls and goats
on your altar.
16All who worship God,
come here and listen;
I will tell you everything
God has done for me.
17I prayed to the Lord,
and I praised him.
18If my thoughts had been sinful,
he would have refused
to hear me.
19But God did listen
and answered my prayer.
20Let's praise God!
He listened when I prayed,
and he is always kind.
translation_text:
Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
1Nabiina maama,
yeeri-na de wopwolo sɔɔ
á ma‑á tei Wɛ.
2Leeni-na á zuli
o yere-kamunu kom.
Seini-na o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom
se á ma‑á tei‑o.
3Ta-na á bere Wɛ we:
“Nmo tiini n toŋe wo-kenkagela naa!
N dam dem de tiini de daga
de gaale,
pa se n dona maama kɔre foone
ye ba sɛ ba pa‑m.
4Nabiina maama tiiri tega ne mo
ba zuli‑m.
Ba maama leeni ba seini‑m.
N yere dem mo ba leeni
ba seini-de.”
5Ba-na á nii á na
Wɛ na ke kolo maama to.
O yɔɔre o ke wo-kenkagela mo
o pa nabiina.
6O déem pɛ se naneo kom ji te-kora.
Dé nabaara bam déem tɔge
buga kam wo de ba nɛ ba bɛ.
Pa-na se dé ke wopwolo
o keina yam konto ŋwaane.
7Wɛ jege dam mo o ma
o di o paare taa wuu.
O yia maa dole ya nii
logo baŋa teene dem maama.
Nankɔ-nyena nam yé bere ba tete
o yiga ne.
8Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama,
seini-na debam Tu Wɛ wom.
Bage-na o tia yam á yage wɛ-wɛ!
9Wonto mo yeini o cho dé ŋwea kam.
O maa wo pɛ pwola
se dé tiri dé to tega ne.
10Dé Tu Wɛ, nmo mo faŋe debam n nii.
Nmo ta pɛ se
dé fɔge dé kwɛ chekke,
ne ba na kwɛ lu-nyenno tei to.
11N jaane debam n zo
kalanchogo wone,
ye n daare n pa se cham
jege debam de daana.
12Nmo pɛ dé dona bam pwola
pa ba jege debam ba nɔna.
Dé ma tɔge mini wone
dedaane na-fɔrɔ wone dé kɛ.
Nmo laam ma‑n pa dé vo dé jeini
jei selo na ye falalala to ne.
13Amo laam nam wó ja pɛɛra mo
a zo n diga kam wone
a ma ke zwɛɛm kaanem a pa‑m.
A ta wó ke a su a na dugi duuri
se a ke kolo a pa‑m to.
14Amo cham maŋa kam ne mo
a déem puri a ni
a du duuri dem konto.
15Amo laam lage a kwei vara
balo na nugi bigila-bigila to,
a ma a ke zwɛɛm kaanem a pa‑m.
A maa wó zwɛ pi-bale se se lwom taa ywomma nmo tei ne.
A ta wó kwei nabɛ de bo-bwaalo mo a ke kaanem.
16Abam balo maama na kɔre Wɛ to,
ba-na á cheigi woŋo.
Amo laam wó lwoni
woŋo kolo maama Wɛ na ke
o pa-ne to a bere abam.
17A ya keeri mo a jare Wɛ
se o woli-ne.
A ma puri a ni a tei‑o.
18Amo fera ya ná wo
lwarem kikia wone,
a Teiru Wɛ wom ya bá sɛ
o cheigi-ne.
19Wɛ nam seene o ni a kwora kam
ye o daare o cheigi
a wɛ-lworo kom.
20Wɛ maŋe de tia.
A na lwoori‑o to, o wo ve-ne.
O ta wo dɔne o swono kom
o daare-ne.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Tell the Nations To Praise God
1Our God, be kind and bless us!
Be pleased and smile.
2Then everyone on earth
will learn to follow you,
and all nations will see
your power to save us.
3Make everyone praise you
and shout your praises.
4Let the nations celebrate
with joyful songs,
because you judge fairly
and guide all nations.
5Make everyone praise you, God,
and shout your praises.
6Our God has blessed the earth
with a wonderful harvest!
7Pray for his blessings
to continue
and for everyone on earth
to worship our God.
translation_text:
Lei keim leiŋa
1Debam Tu Wɛ,
ta‑n duri debam yibwona,
se n zaane taa wo dé yuu ne!
Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni.
2Pa pwola se logo baŋa nɔɔna maama lɔre n chwei sem.
Sɛ se teene dem maama nɔn-bia bam
taa yei nmo na jege dam
se n vere-ba n yage tei to.
3Dé Tu Wɛ, pa se dwi maama tiina
taa tei‑m!
Sɛ se nabiina jei maama ne to
de yeini ba taa zuli‑m!
4Pa se logo baŋa teene dem maama
di ywoni ye ba leeni wopwolo lei,
nmo na yeini n tɔge chega
n nii ba baŋa ne,
ye n bere-ba chwo-laaro
se ba taa tɔge to ŋwaane.
5Dé Tu Wɛ, pa se dwi maama tiina
taa tei‑m!
Sɛ se nabiina jei maama ne to
de yeini ba taa zuli‑m!
6Tega kam ke wodiiru lanyerane.
Dé Tu Wɛ seene o ke zaane
debam yuu ne!
7Chega ŋwaane to,
Wɛ swɛ debam swolim.
Ko jege se tega baŋa nabiina maama taa kɔre‑o mo.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by David for the music leader.)
God Will Win the Battle
1Do something, God!
Scatter your hateful enemies.
Make them turn and run.
2Scatter them like smoke!
When you come near,
make them melt
like wax in a fire.
3But let your people be happy
and celebrate because of you.
4Our God, you are the one
who rides on the clouds,
and we praise you.
Your name is the Lord,
and we celebrate
as we worship you.
5Our God, from your sacred home
you take care of orphans
and protect widows.
6You find families
for those who are lonely.
You set prisoners free
and let them prosper,
but all who rebel will live
in a scorching desert.
7You set your people free,
and you led them
through the desert.
8 God of Israel,
the earth trembled,
and rain poured down.
You alone are the God
who rules from Mount Sinai.
9When your land was thirsty,
you sent showers
to refresh it.
10Your people settled there,
and you were generous
to everyone in need.
11You gave the command, Lord,
and a chorus of women told
what had happened:
12“Kings and their armies
retreated and ran,
and everything they left
is now being divided.
13And for those who stayed back
to guard the sheep,
there are metal doves
with silver-coated wings
and shiny gold feathers.”
14God All-Powerful, you scattered
the kings like snow falling
on Mount Zalmon.
15Our Lord and our God,
Bashan is a mighty mountain
covered with peaks.
16Why is it jealous of Zion,
the mountain you chose
as your home forever?
17When you, Lord God, appeared
to your people at Sinai,
you came with thousands
of mighty chariots.
18 When you climbed
the high mountain,
you took prisoners with you
and were given gifts.
Your enemies didn't want you
to live there,
but they gave you gifts.
19We praise you, Lord God!
You treat us with kindness
day after day,
and you rescue us.
20You always protect us
and save us from death.
21Our Lord and our God,
your terrible enemies
are ready for war,
but you will crush
their skulls.
22You promised to bring them
from Bashan
and from the deepest sea.
23Then we could wash our feet
in their blood,
and our dogs could chew
on their bones.
24We have seen crowds marching
to your place of worship,
our God and King.
25Singers come first,
and then the musicians,
surrounded by young women
playing tambourines.
26They come shouting,
“People of Israel,
praise the Lord God!”
27The small tribe of Benjamin
leads the way,
followed by the leaders
from Judah.
Then come the leaders
from Zebulun and Naphtali.
28Our God, show your strength!
Show us once again.
29Then kings will bring gifts
to your temple
in Jerusalem.
30Punish that animal
that lives in the swamp!
Punish that nation
whose leaders and people
are like wild bulls.
Make them come crawling
with gifts of silver.
Scatter those nations
that enjoy making war.
31Force the Egyptians to bring
gifts of bronze;
make the Ethiopians hurry
to offer presents.
32Now sing praises to God!
Every kingdom on earth,
sing to the Lord!
33Praise the one who rides
across the ancient skies;
listen as he speaks
with a mighty voice.
34Tell about God's power!
He is honored in Israel,
and he rules the skies.
35The God of Israel is fearsome
in his temple,
and he makes us strong.
Let's praise our God!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ wó wane o dona bam
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛ lage o zaŋe
o zege wɛɛne mo,
pa se o dona bam jage sae!
Balo na chuli Wɛ to wó duri
se ba lu o yiga ne.
2O lage o zeili-ba mo pa ba jei,
nenɛɛne vio na fuli nyoa tei
ye ka jei to.
Puseŋ-nyena maa wó saare
Wɛ yiga ne
ne maaro na nyeene mini wone
tei to.
3Ko nam ná ye nɔn-ŋona,
banto wó zege Wɛ yiga ne mo
ba di ywoni,
ye ba chake de wopwolo.
4Leeni-na lei se á tei Wɛ,
se á daare á seini o yere dem.
O yere mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.
O maa yeini o dɔge
kunkwonnu baŋa ne o via.
Zuli-o-na se á di ywoni o tei ne!
5O ye botara dwi maama kwo mo.
O daa ta maa zege kadeina
dwi maama kwaga ne.
Dé Tu Wɛ mo konto,
o na zoore jei selo
na ye wose to wone.
6O maa pae balo na ye ba yerane to nae dwi.
O ta maa yeini o pore peena o yaga
pa se ba na zurim ba ŋwea wone.
Ko daare nankɔ-nyena
wó taa zoore kagoa yuu
mɛ na na tera to wone mo.
7Dé Tu Wɛ, nmo déem nwoŋi
n tɔge n nɔɔna bam yiga
n ja-ba n bɛ kagoa kam.
8Maŋa kam konto ne,
tega kam déem ziziŋi mo,
ye doa de tiini ka ne chaa-chaa.
Ko maa ye nmo Wɛ yiga ne mo
ko ke konto.
Nmo ye Sinayi peo baŋa Wɛ wom mo,
ye n ta ye Isarele tiina bam Wɛ.
9Dé Tu Wɛ, n ta ma pa se doa nena
n tete tega kam baŋa ne.
Ka na jigi kapwor-pwoŋa to,
n pɛ se ka jwoori ka zura.
10N tete nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tu
ba jeini ka baŋa ne.
Nmo tɔge n zaane dem baŋa ne mo
n pa se yiniga tiina laam jega.
11Dé Teiru Wɛ wom tɔɔle o kwora mo,
ye kaana kɔgɔ kɔgɔ de pa
se ka jage jei maama ne.
12Ba maa we:
“Pwa de ba jar-keira bam
duri lela mo se ba lu.”
Ka-yorro tem de ma pɔɔre jejegero
telo banto na viiri ba daare to.
13Abam balo de na maŋe kwaga ne
ye á yere pei sem to,
á nɛ kunkwona nyenyero telo
ba na mɛ lu-nyenno ba kwoli
ye ya vɔna yam de ye sabu-seŋa mo ba mɛ ba kwoli-ya to.
14Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom na pɛ
se pwa bam jage sae konto to,
ko nye de do-kandwa mo nege
Zalemon peo kom yuu ne.
15Basan peero tem jege nenɔŋa dedɛ.
Te maa diini te yi wɛyuu baŋa baŋa.
16Pe-kamunnu tem, bɛ mo ye
á nii Wɛ tete peo kom
á gwooni-ko konto?
Wɛ kuri peo kom konto
se o di o paare dáane.
Dáane mo Baŋa Wɛ wó taa zoore
taa wuu.
17Dé Teiru Wɛ wom maa jege sisei-torokooro morro kuni morro dedɛ.
O déem tɔge de-te
o zege Sinayi peo kom ne mo
o ba o zo o wara-jei sem ne.
18O na diini wɛyuu konto to,
o kale o dona bam
o na wane-ba to o ja vo.
O ma daare o jwoŋi pɛɛra
nɔɔna tei ne,
de ba ná maŋe
ba ye nankɔ-nyena mo de.
Konto to, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ
laam wó taa zoore dáane.
19Pa-na dé taa tei dé Teiru Wɛ wom,
de o na teili debam
dɛ de ni too wone tei to.
O maa ye wolo na vere debam
o yage to.
20Debam Teiru Baŋa Wɛ wom
jwoŋi nɔɔna mo o yaga.
O maa yeini o cho debam
se toone yé wane debam de ja.
21Ko nam ná ye Wɛ dona bam,
o lage o lɔ ba yuni mo.
O ta wó chochoge ba yu-kwoli,
ba na swoi tusim kikia tei to ŋwaane.
22Dé Teiru Wɛ wom maa we:
“Amo wó ja a dona bam mo
a pa ba zege Basan seeni
ba jwoori ba ba.
Ba ta ná maŋe ba wo
naneo kom kuri kuri ne de,
amo ta wó ja-ba a nwoŋi.
23Konto wó pa abam chwoŋa
se á ma ba jana bam
á ma‑á zare á nɛ.
Á kukuri sem tete wó deilimi
a dona yera yam,
ye ba di ba na lage tei to bu su.”
24Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo ye amo Pɛ.
Nɔɔna laam nae
nmo kwaga kɔgɔ kom na twoŋi gena
ba maa vei n wara-jei sem to.
25Lein-leena mo wo kɔgɔ kom yiga ne.
Wo-magena de ma saŋe ba kwaga.
Bukɔ-pwoli maa wo ba tetare ne
ye ba jege senyɛ ba wɔe.
26Ba maa leeni ba we:
“Pa-na dé kɔgɔ kom maama
taa tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Isarele dwi tiina maama,
zuli-o-na!”
27Nii-na, Benjamin dwi dem
na muri to mo
wo ba maama yiga ne.
Judah dwi dem nakwa
de ba kɔgɔ kom maama
maa tɔge ba wora,
ko ta woli de Zebulun dwi dem
de Nafitali dwi dem
nakwa bam maama.
28Debam Tu Wɛ, pa se n dam dem
zaŋe de bere jaja!
Fɔge n toŋe de n dam dem,
ne n déem na ke n pa debam tei to.
29N na zoore n wara-jei sem
Jerusalem ne to,
logo baŋa pwa bam wó ja pɛɛra
ba ba ba pa‑m.
30Nam zaŋe n bwɛ teo kolo
na nye de ga-varem ye ko vwɛ
nanchan-gullu wone to.
Daa ta bwɛ teene delo
na bere ba tete we ba ye nabɛ
ye ba wo na-mɔre tetare ne to.
Banto jege se ba tu ba tete mo
ba daare ba ja lu-nyenno wonnu
ba ba ba pa‑m.
Pa se teene delo na swoi jara-keim to jage sae.
31Ejipti tiina wó toŋe dedɛɛra
se ba ba.
Kusi tiina de wó ba ba sɛ ba pa Wɛ.
32Logo baŋa teene dem maama,
leeni-na á tei Wɛ.
Leeni-na á seini Baŋa Wɛ.
33Wonto mo maŋe o dɔge wɛyuu baŋa kam ne faŋa faŋa o via.
Nii-na! O kwor-dɛa kam bage mo
pina-pina.
34Sɛ-na we Wɛ tiini o jege dam!
Wonto mo di paare
Isarele tiina baŋa ne.
O dam dem maa bere jaja
wɛyuu ne.
35Dé Tu Wɛ, nmo na zoore
n wara-jei sem ne to,
n yɔɔre n jege foone.
O maa ye Isarele tiina Wɛ wom,
ye o pae o nɔɔna bam jege dam de baare.
Pa-na se dé tei Wɛ!

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies.”)
God Can Be Trusted
1Save me, God!
I am about to drown.
2I am sinking deep in the mud,
and my feet are slipping.
I am about to be swept under
by a mighty flood.
3I am worn out from crying,
and my throat is dry.
I have waited for you
till my eyes are blurred.
4 There are more people
who hate me for no reason
than there are hairs
on my head.
Many terrible enemies
want to destroy me, God.
Am I supposed to give back
something I didn't steal?
5You know my foolish sins.
Not one is hidden from you.
6 Lord God All-Powerful,
ruler of Israel,
don't let me embarrass anyone
who trusts and worships you.
7It is for your sake alone
that I am insulted
and blush with shame.
8I am like a stranger
to my relatives
and like a foreigner
to my own family.
9 My love for your house
burns in me like a fire,
and when others insult you,
they insulted me as well.
10I cried and went without food,
but they still insulted me.
11They sneered at me
for wearing sackcloth
to show my sorrow.
12Rulers and judges gossip
about me,
and drunkards make up songs
to mock me.
13But I pray to you, Lord.
So when the time is right,
answer me and help me
with your wonderful love.
14Don't let me sink in the mud,
but save me from my enemies
and from the deep water.
15Don't let me be
swept away by a flood
or drowned in the ocean
or swallowed by death.
16Answer me, Lord!
You are kind and good.
Pay attention to me!
You are truly merciful.
17Don't turn away from me.
I am your servant,
and I am in trouble.
Please hurry and help!
18Come and save me
from my enemies.
19You know how I am insulted,
mocked, and disgraced;
you know every one
of my enemies.
20I am crushed by insults,
and I feel sick.
I had hoped for mercy and pity,
but there was none.
21 Enemies poisoned my food,
and when I was thirsty,
they gave me vinegar.
22 Make their table a trap
for them and their friends.
23Blind them with darkness
and make them tremble.
24Show them how angry you are!
Be furious and catch them.
25 Destroy their camp
and don't let anyone live
in their tents.
26They cause trouble for people
you have already punished;
their gossip hurts those
you have wounded.
27Make them guiltier than ever
and don't forgive them.
28 Wipe their names from the book
of the living;
remove them from the list
of the innocent.
29I am mistreated and in pain.
Protect me, God,
and keep me safe!
30I will praise the Lord God
with a song
and a thankful heart.
31This will please the Lord
better than offering an ox
or a full-grown bull.
32When those in need see this,
they will be happy,
and the Lord's worshipers
will be encouraged.
33The Lord will listen
when the homeless cry out,
and he will never forget
his people in prison.
34Heaven and earth
will praise our God,
and so will the oceans
and everything in them.
35God will rescue Jerusalem,
and he will rebuild
the towns of Judah.
His people will live there
on their own land,
36and when the time comes,
their children will inherit
the land.
Then everyone who loves God
will also settle there.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo
1Amo Tu Wɛ, ja,
jwoŋi-ne n yage!
A tiini a wo cham wone,
nenɛɛne na-fɔrɔ mo lage
ko li a yuu.
2A lage a moore mo mɔrɔ wone.
A nɛ maa ware se zege cheppe.
Amo maa yi na-luŋa jei,
ye na-ŋone mo lage se ja-ne se jei.
3A kaase ni mo a beeri wolim ye a ga.
A yera laam mo chɛ de keira kam,
a kwora de ma ko.
A yia maama suli de yi-na
a na tiini a lwoori a Tu Wɛ taa to ŋwaane.
4Balo na chuli amo kafɛ ŋwaane to
mo tiini ba daga
ba dwoi a yu-ywei sem.
Ba maa done amo vwa chwoŋa wone,
ye ba boŋe se ba chɔge-ne.
Ba fe amo se a jwoori a ja
woŋo kolo a na wo ŋɔge to
a ja a ba a pa-ba.
5Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo maŋe n yei
a na toŋe jworim delo to.
A tusim kikia bá wane ya seigi
nmo yiga ne.
6Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom,
ko ná ye balo na jege teena
nmo tei ne to,
yé sɛ se chaveera di-ba
amo ŋwaane.
Isarele dwi tiina Wɛ wom,
yé pa se balo na zuli‑m to
vɔna pare amo ŋwaane.
7Ko ye a na sɛ nmo to ŋwaane
mo nɔɔna jege-ne ba twea
ye a daa ba jege yuu ba yiga ne.
8Amo chorro laam ke nenɛɛne
ba yeiri-ne mo tei.
A daa ta maa nye de veiru
a tete nu-bia bam tei ne.
9Amo tiini a toŋe de yi-seena
a pa nmo wara-jei sem mo.
Konto ŋwaane, nɔɔna na jege nmo
ba twea tei to
mo jwoori ko tui amo baŋa ne.
10A maa yeini a keeri ye a vɔ ni,
pa se nɔɔna jege-ne ba yaala.
11A maa zoore gare-nyenyaaro
wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane
ye ba jege-ne ba mɔna.
12Teo kom nɔɔna na jeeri
mɛ maama to,
ba maa ke sawea amo ŋwaane.
Sa-nyɔra tete pane lei mo
amo ŋwaane ba leena.
13Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
ko ye nmo mo a yeini a lwoori,
se n nii amo baŋa ne de yibwona.
Jan ja! Sɛ amo wɛ-lworo kom,
se n daare n jwoŋi-ne n yage
n swono kom ŋwaane.
14Vaŋe-ne n ja n nwoŋi
mɔrɔ konto wone,
se na bam yé kwoli-ne.
Yé sɛ se balo na chuli-ne to
wane-ne ba ja.
Liiri-ne n ja n nwoŋi
na-luŋa kam wone.
15Nam yé sɛ se na-fwaaro tem
ja amo ba jei.
Yé pa se na-luŋa kam li amo.
Yé yage se a zo toone gwoŋo.
16Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
leiri amo wɛ-lworo kom,
nmo swono kom na tiini
ko lana to ŋwaane.
Nam pipiri n nii amo seeni,
se nmo tiini n duri nɔɔna yibwona mo.
17Yé ma n kwaga n ya-ne,
se amo ye nmo tontoŋeno mo,
ye a tiini a wo cham wone.
Ke lela n ba n woli-ne!
18Nam fɔɔre n ba n yi amo tei
se n jwoŋi-ne n yage.
Vere-ne a dona bam jeŋa ne n yage.
19Nmo nɛ a dona bam maama
na ke tetei.
Ba maa jege-ne ba twea ye ba yaala,
pa se a na a chaveera.
20Amo wo kom chɔɔre mo
ba toro tem ŋwaane.
A vɔna yam de ma pare.
A ya boŋe we nɔɔno wó ba
o duri amo ŋwaŋa,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo tu.
Nɔɔno tera o na wó pa a bochare zuri.
21Ba nam kwei wo-chɛɛro mo
ba ke a wodiu wone.
Na-nyɔm na jege-ne to
mo ba kwei sa-nyɔna
ba pa-ne se a nyɔ.
22Wɛ wó pa se ba wodi-fwaaro tem
jwoori te ja chɔgem te ba banto de ba badwonna bam baŋa ne,
ne kalanchogo na jaane-ba tei to.
23Wɛ wó pa se ba yia dwei,
ye ba daa ware ba nae.
Wɛ wó pa se ba yera sɔɔre taa wuu.
24Wɛ, pa se n bane zaŋe ba baŋa ne
n daare n waare-ba.
Pa se n ban-lom chɔge-ba.
25Wɛ wó pa se ba sam dem
ji di-dwonnu
se nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa yé daare
jei sem konto ne.
26Kokuri to, nmo na yeini
n vaŋe balo zwa to
mo banto beeri se ba zeili-ba.
Ko ta ná ye balo
n na ke-ba zonne to mo,
ba yeini ba ŋɔɔne ba yaara yam taane.
27Nam yé swei ba keim-balwaaro tem swia, de te dedoa de.
Yé sɛ se n jwoŋi-ba
se ba na ba chega.
28Ko ye se n saare ba yera mo,
se ya yé taa wo ŋwea tɔnɔ kom wone.
Yé pa se ba yera taa popone ya tiŋi
ya woli balo na tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa to yera wone.
29Amo Tu Wɛ, ko tiini ko ni amo,
ye a vɔna de laam pare.
Konto to, ba n jwoŋi-ne,
se a wane a zaŋe wɛɛne.
30Amo wó zaŋe a leeni leiŋa
a ma tei Wɛ yere!
A ta wó ke o lei ye a pa o yere zaŋe.
31A ná zuli‑o konto dwoŋi,
ko wó pwoli o wo
ko dwoni a ná mɛ nabea
a ma a ke kaanem a pa‑o.
Ko ná maŋe ko ye nabea
kalo na bege ka ti to,
ko ya bá yi a zula yam.
32Nabwona maa wó na
Wɛ na jwoŋi-ne tei to
ye ko pa ba wo pwoli dedɛ.
Abam balo na kɔre Wɛ to,
Wɛ wó pa á bochara fɔge
ya ke dam!
33Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o cheigi
yiniga tiina wɛ-lworo mo.
O ba swia o tete nɔɔna
na nɛ bɛɛsem to swia.
34Woŋo maama jege se ko zuli Wɛ!
Wɛyuu de tega baŋa wonnu,
ko woli de wonnu telo
na wo naneero tem wone to,
te maama wó taa tei Wɛ!
35Wɛ mo wó vere Zion teo kom o yage
ye o jwoori o lɔ
Judah teene dem maama.
O tete nɔɔna bam laam wó taa zoore jei sem konto ne.
Ba wó taa tei tega kam konto.
36O tontoŋena dwi tiina bam wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei.
Balo maama na swoi Wɛ to
wó taa zoore da.

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To be used when an offering is made.)
God Is Wonderful
1Save me, Lord God!
Hurry and help.
2Disappoint and confuse
all who want to kill me.
Turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
3Embarrass and shame those
who say, “We told you so!”
4Let your worshipers celebrate
and be glad because of you.
They love your saving power,
so let them always say,
“God is wonderful!”
5I am poor and needy,
but you, the Lord God,
care about me.
You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help!
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane
Lei 40:13-17
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ke lela
n ba n jwoŋi-ne n yage!
Ba n zeini-ne lela.
2Ko ná ye balo na beeri amo toone to,
pa se vuvuga yi-ba se ba to tega ne.
Pa balo maama na beeri amo chɔgem to
