english_text:
BOOK III
(Psalms 73–89)
(A psalm by Asaph.)
God Is Good
1God is truly good to Israel,
especially to everyone
with a pure heart.
2But I almost stumbled and fell,
3because it made me jealous
to see proud and evil people
and to watch them prosper.
4They never have to suffer,
they stay healthy,
5and they don't have troubles
like everyone else.
6Their pride is like a necklace,
and they commit sin more often
than they dress themselves.
7Their eyes bulge with fat,
and their minds are flooded
with foolish thoughts.
8They sneer and say cruel things,
and because of their pride,
they make violent threats.
9They dare to speak against God
and to order others around.
10God will bring his people back,
and they will drink the water
he so freely gives.
11Only evil people would say,
“God Most High cannot
know everything!”
12Yet all goes well for them,
and they live in peace.
13What good did it do me
to keep my thoughts pure
and refuse to do wrong?
14I am sick all day,
and I am punished
each morning.
15If I had said evil things,
I would not have been loyal
to your people.
16It was hard for me
to understand all this!
17Then I went to your temple,
and there I understood
what will happen
to my enemies.
18You will make them stumble,
never to get up again.
19They will be terrified,
suddenly swept away
and no longer there.
20They will disappear, Lord,
despised like a bad dream
the morning after.
21Once I was bitter
and brokenhearted.
22I was stupid and ignorant,
and I treated you
as a wild animal would.
23But I never really left you,
and you hold my right hand.
24Your advice has been my guide,
and later you will welcome me
in glory.
25In heaven I have only you,
and on this earth
you are all I want.
26My body and mind may fail,
but you are my strength
and my choice forever.
27All-Powerful Lord God,
those who stay far from you
will be lost,
and you will destroy those
who are unfaithful.
28It is good for me
to be near you.
I choose you as my protector,
and I will tell about
your wonderful deeds.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ lamma
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Ko na ye chega to,
Wɛ seene o ke Isarele dwi tiina bam lanyerane.
O maa yeini o zeini
balo bochara na ye chekke to mo.
2Ko nam ná ye amo,
ko ya gɛ fee mo se a naga seeri
se a daare a ywori
Wɛ chwoŋa kam ne.
3Kolo ŋwaane to,
a na nɛ puseŋ-nyena bam jejegero tem to
mo a zwe kazwe de-ba,
ba na bere ba tete to ŋwaane.
4Puseŋ-nyena bam ba nae cham
de fenfee de.
Ba ta maa damma,
ye yazura yi-ba lanyerane.
5Ko ná ye yaara yalo dwi
na yeini ya jaane nɔɔna to,
banto ba na-ya.
Jaweero de ba yi-ba
nenɛɛne nɔɔna badwonna
na na-te tei to.
6Ba na bere ba tete tei to
nye de ba kwei paare zambili
ba de ba ba ne mo.
Ba maa me de nankɔɔre totoŋa
nenɛɛne ya ye gwaaro telo
ba na zoore dɛ maama to mo.
7Ba na lage paare to ŋwaane
mo ba yeini ba toŋe lwarem yerane.
Ba bochara de maa tɔge puseŋa yerane.
8Ba maa jege nɔɔna ba mɔna,
ye ba ŋɔŋa maama ye lwarem.
Ba na bere ba tete tei to,
ba mae yaara mo ba fugi nɔɔna.
9Ba maa ŋɔɔne wo-kamuna
ba ma lwɛ Wɛ.
Ba ni taane dem maa bere
ba tete kamunim,
nenɛɛne banto mo tei l
ogo baŋa maama.
10Ko ma pa se nɔɔna bam boboŋa vugimi.
Ba maa yɔɔre ba jwoŋi ba taane maama ba pa de ye chega.
11Ba maa tɛ ba we,
“Wɛ wó wane o lɔre
kolo na jege ko toŋe to na?
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yeiri
kolo na wora to.”
12Nii-na! Mo puseŋ-nyena bam
na ye tei!
Kolokolo ba daane-ba.
Ba jejegero tem yeini te puli mo
te gaale.
13Chega ŋwaane to, amo na chege a bochare de digiru
se a yé biini a tete,
ye a ve wɛleere keim to,
ko maama ye kafɛ ŋwaane mo na?
14Amo yeini a na yaara mo
dɛ maama wuu.
A ná zaŋe zezeŋa maama ne,
ko ye cham mo a yera ne.
15Amo nam ya ná tage a we,
“Amo wó taa ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi mo,”
a ya wó taa ye pipiri-nyem mo
ye a ywori nmo bia bam kwaga ne.
16A ma tiini a kwaane se a boŋe
a lɔre ko na seene ko ye tei to.
Ko nam chana ko pa-ne
se a wane a lɔre ko kuri chekke.
17Amo nam na vei a zo Wɛ diga kam to
mo a laam tu a lɔre puseŋ-nyena bam gurim na wó taa ye tei to.
18Ko na ye chega to,
nmo yage-ba mo
pa se ba nɔne siseira baŋa.
Nmo wó pa ba seeri ba to
se ba daare ba jei.
19Yi-bogesem wone mo
chɔgem lage de to ba baŋa ne!
Foone wó taa tiini de jege-ba
ye ba ŋwea saare logo baŋa ne.
20Ba ŋwea kam lage ka jei mo,
nenɛɛne nɔɔno na dwɛ dendwɛ
o zaŋe dɔɔm wone pa de jei tei to.
Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ná zaŋe,
n daa‑n bá‑n ta‑n boŋe ba boboŋa.
21Amo wo ya chɔge dedɛ,
ye a pa wonnu tiini te daane-ne.
22A boboŋa maama tɔge jworim yerane mo.
A maa yeiri chega kam.
A na toŋe tei a pa nmo to
nye de kago-vara na yeini ba ke tei to mo.
23De konto maama de,
a ta sale nmo yera ne mo
maŋa maama.
Nmo yeini n jege amo jeŋa mo
ye dé via.
24Ko ye nmo bera yam mo yere-ne
pa se a wo chwo-laao wone.
Ko kwaga seeni,
nmo wó pa a na zula nmo tei ne.
25Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera wɛyuu ne
o na wó zeini-ne,
ko ná dae nmo.
Tega baŋa ne amo daa ba beeri nɔɔn-nɔɔno
a woli nmo wone.
26Amo yera yam wó ba ya bugi ya ti.
A boboŋa de wó ywori
chwoŋa kam ne.
Nmo Wɛ nam mo ye amo dalem jei,
pa se a bochare fɔge de jege dam.
Nmo ye wolo na maŋe de amo
taa wuu to mo.
27Chega to, balo maama na wo
yiga yiga nmo tei ne to
wó ba ba jei.
Nmo wó yɔɔre n chɔge
balo na mɛ ba kwaga ba ya nmo to.
28Se ko ná ye amo,
ko lamma mo ko pa-ne
de a na sale Wɛ yera ne tei to.
Amo pɛ se nmo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ
ji amo dalem jei,
se a daare a ta wo-kamuna yalo maama n na toŋe to,
se nɔɔna lɔre jaja!

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
A Prayer for the Nation in Times of Trouble
1Our God, why have you
completely rejected us?
Why are you so angry
with the ones you care for?
2Remember the people
you rescued long ago,
the tribe you chose
for your very own.
Think of Mount Zion,
your home;
3walk over to the temple
left in ruins forever
by those who hate us.
4Your enemies roared like lions
in your holy temple,
and they have placed
their banners there.
5It looks like a forest
chopped to pieces.
6They used axes and hatchets
to smash the carvings.
7They burned down your temple
and badly disgraced it.
8They said to themselves,
“We'll crush them!”
Then they burned every one
of your meeting places
all over the country.
9There are no more miracles
and no more prophets.
Who knows how long
it will be like this?
10Our God, how much longer
will our enemies sneer?
Won't they ever stop
insulting you?
11Why don't you punish them?
Why are you holding back?
12Our God and King,
you have ruled
since ancient times;
you have won victories
everywhere on this earth.
13 By your power you made a path
through the sea,
and you smashed the heads
of sea monsters.
14 You crushed the heads
of the monster Leviathan,
then fed him to wild creatures
in the desert.
15You opened the ground
for streams and springs
and dried up mighty rivers.
16You rule the day and the night,
and you put the moon
and the sun in place.
17You made summer and winter
and gave them to the earth.
18Remember your enemies, Lord!
They foolishly sneer
and won't respect you.
19You treat us like pet doves,
but they mistreat us.
Don't keep forgetting us
and letting us be fed
to those wild animals.
20Remember the agreement
you made with us.
Violent enemies are hiding
in every dark corner
of the earth.
21Don't disappoint those in need
or make them turn from you,
but help the poor and homeless
to shout your praises.
22Do something, God!
Defend yourself.
Remember how those fools
sneer at you all day long.
23Don't forget the loud shouts
of your enemies.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo dé teo kom ŋwaane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Wɛ, bɛ mo ye n laam yɔɔre n ve debam konto?
Bɛŋwaane mo n pɛ se n ban-lom to dé baŋa ne?
Dé nam ye n nɔɔna mo
ye n nii dé baŋa ne,
ne nayero na nii o pei-kɔgɔ tei to.
2Nam guli debam balo na ye n kɔgɔ kom to gula!
Ko nwoŋi faŋa mo n déem jwoŋi debam.
Dé maa ye dwi delo n na vere n yage
se dé taa ye n tete nyɔn-mage nɔɔna to.
Daa ta guli Zion peo kom gula,
n déem na zoore mɛ to.
3Pipiri n ba n nii dé teo kom
na yɔɔre ko ji di-dwonnu tei to.
Ba n nii dé dona bam na chɔge
n wara-jei sem
de se zela yam maama tei to.
4Jeiga kalo nmo ya na yeini
n jeeri debam to
mo n dona bam kaase tiguri-kaasa ka tetare ne.
Ba ma chwi ba jara-keim tuta dáane.
5Ba na ke jara dé teo kom
baŋa ne tei to,
ba nye de nɔɔna na mae dwoora
ba gwoni teeni dedɛ
ba de tega ne tei to mo.
6Ba déem kwei ba dwoora
de ba gwora mo
ba ma yare dɛ selo nɔɔna na fɔge ba gɔgere to.
7Ba ma kwei mini ba zwɛ
nmo wara-diga kam.
Konto to ba chɔge jeiga kalo
nɔɔna ya na zuli n yere da to
ye ba guri ka maama ba de tega ne.
8Ba déem tage ba tete boboŋa ne
ba we,
“Pa-na se dé chɔge-ba fase!”
Tega kam wone jei selo maama
nɔɔna na zuli Wɛ to
mo ba zwɛ kula.
9Dé daa ba nae wo-kenkagela yalo Wɛ na toŋe to.
Wɛ sampwori de daa maa tera
dé tei ne.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam yeiri yaara yanto
na wó dáane debam tei ne tei to.
10Debam Tu Wɛ, dé dona bam wó taa jege‑m ba mɔna taa
se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo?
Ba ta wó taa jege n yere dem
ba gwooni mo taa na?
11Bɛ mo kea ye n wo kwei n jazem dem n waare-ba?
Nam bwoli n jeŋa se n chɔge-ba fase!
12Amo Tu Wɛ, ko zege faŋa mo
nmo maŋe n ye amo Pɛ.
Kuni dedɛ n yeini n toŋe tega kam baŋa ne mo
se n jwoŋi debam n yage.
13Nmo déem mɛ n dam-fɔrɔ mo
n pɔɔre naneo kom.
N ta ma‑n chochoge naneo wo jurru tem yuni.
14Chega to, nmo mo chochoge naneo wo juru Leviatan yuni tem,
ye n daare n kwei o yera yam
n pa kagoa wo vara bam
se ba kwei ba di.
15Nmo ma‑n pa buli-yia ta
ya nwoŋi ya bura.
Ko ta ná ye bu-tole sem,
n pɛ se se we mo.
16Nmo pɛ se wea de tete pɔɔre daane
ye te maama ye nmo nyem.
N daa‑n ta ma‑n kwei chana kam de wea kam
n zege se zega jei ne.
17Nmo pɛ se tega dwi maama
jege ka siseini mo.
N ta pɛ se yadɛ dedaane te-pwoŋa wora.
18 Baŋa Wɛ, nam guli n dona bam
ya na jege‑m ba mɔna tei to.
Nɔn-jworru de maa gwooni
nmo yere dem.
19Nmo yeini n nii dé kɔgɔ kom
ne ko ye kunkwoŋa to mo.
Nam yé kwei n kunkwoŋa kam
n pa ga-vara se ba wane-ka ba di.
Yé yɔɔre n swei debam balo
na ye n nɔɔna
ye dé wo yaara wone to ni ne.
20Nam guli n na gwoni ni
se n ke kolo n pa debam to.
Kokuri to, nankɔ-nyena mo seigi
tega kam baŋa gugworru dwi maama wone.
21Yé sɛ se debam balo nɔɔna na bɛɛse to jwoori kwaga,
se chaveera ja debam.
Nam pa se nabwona de yiniga tiina bam na chwoŋa
se ba taa tei n yere dem.
22Debam Tu Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne
se n zege n chega kam kwaga ne.
Nam guli nɔn-jworru na jege‑m
ba twea dɛ maama wone tei to.
23Yé swei n dona bam na tɛ wonnu
telo ba ma yaale nmo to.
Ba ke konto mo taa ye ba ba yaga.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
Praise God for All He Has Done
1Our God, we thank you
for being so near to us!
Everyone celebrates
your wonderful deeds.
2You have set a time
to judge with fairness.
3The earth trembles,
and its people shake;
you alone keep
its foundations firm.
4You tell every bragger,
“Stop bragging!”
And to the wicked you say,
“Don't boast of your power!
5Stop bragging! Quit telling me
how great you are.”
6Our Lord and our God,
victory doesn't come
from the east or the west
or from the desert.
7You are the one who judges.
You can take away power
and give it to others.
8You hold in your hand
a cup filled with wine,
strong and foaming.
You will pour out some
for every sinful person
on this earth,
and they will have to drink
until it is gone.
9But I will always tell about
you, the God of Jacob,
and I will sing your praise.
10Our Lord, you will destroy
the power of evil people,
but you will give strength
to those who are good.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ bore chega bora
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Wɛ,
dé ke nmo lei mo.
Chega ŋwaane to, dé ke n lei,
n na tiini n bwola dedaane debam to ŋwaane.
Nɔɔna maa tɛ nmo wo-kenkagela yam taane.
Wɛ maa we:
2“Amo kuri maŋa mo a zege
se a ma a bore nabiina bora
dedaane chega.
3Tega kam baŋa ná yeini ka ziziŋi
ye nabiina yera de sae pɔm-pɔm,
ko daa ta ye amo mo fɔge a jege ka kuri diŋ-diŋ.
4A ma yeini a kaane bere-n-tete nyena we,
‘Yé ta‑á jege-na ni-wɛɛle konto!’
A daa ta maa tɛ de puseŋ-nyena we,
‘Yé ta‑á teera á dam ŋwaane.
5Nam yé ta‑á jege jaguli-zane
á dole wɛɛne.
Yé ta‑á kare á ŋɔɔne kamunim
á pa á tete.’ ”
6Logo baŋa jei maama ne
nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na jege dam
se o zeiŋi o dwoŋi nabiinu wɛɛne.
Kotu ná nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni
naa wɛ-zoore seeni,
naa o ná nwoŋi kagoa yuu mo de,
o bá wane o ke konto.
7Ko nam ye Wɛ mo bore nɔɔna bora.
O ma yeini o ja dedoa o de tega ne,
ye o daare o zeiŋi wodwoŋi wɛɛne.
8Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ zei na-zoŋa mo o jeŋa ne
ka na su de sa-dɛɛra balo
dwoa-bia na guuri ba wone to.
O ma kwei-ka o teini puseŋ-nyena
balo maama na wo logo baŋa ne to nia ne.
Ko jege se ba nyɔ Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ sana bam maama mo
se ba maama vo ba ti.
9Ko nam ná ye amo,
a ta wó taa tɛ Wɛ totoŋa yam taane taa.
A lage a leeni a seini
Jakob dwi tiina Wɛ wom mo.
Wɛ maa we:
10“Amo mo lage a chɔge puseŋ-nyena bam dam maama.
A maa wó daare a pa se
nɔn-laaro tem tiini ba na dam
se ko ja gaale.”

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.)
God Always Wins
1You, our God,
are famous in Judah
and honored in Israel.
2Your home is on Mount Zion,
the city of peace.
3There you destroyed
fiery arrows, shields, swords,
and all the other weapons.
4You are more glorious than
the eternal mountains.
5Brave warriors were robbed
of what they had taken,
and now they lie dead,
unable to lift an arm.
6God of Jacob, when you roar,
enemy chariots and horses
drop dead in their tracks.
7Our God, you are fearsome,
and no one can oppose you
when you are angry.
8From heaven you announced
your decisions as judge!
And all who live on this earth
were terrified and silent
9when you took over as judge,
ready to rescue
everyone in need.
10Even the most angry people
will praise you
when you are furious.
11Everyone, make your promises
to the Lord your God
and do what you promise.
The Lord is fearsome,
and all his servants
should bring him gifts.
12God destroys the courage
of rulers and kings
and makes cowards of them.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ dam dem taane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛ le o tete o bere
Judah dwi tiina bam.
O yere dem de maa tiini
de ye kamunu
Isarele tiina bam tei ne.
2O maa zoore Salem ne,
Zion peo kom baŋa ne.
3Dáane mo o jaane dé dona bam
che-tɛɛra yam,
de ba jara nantane,
de ba se-zɔɔro,
ko woli de ba jara-keim zela yam maama,
o ja o bwori o yage.
4Nmo nenɔŋa kam tiini ka bere jaja.
N kamunim dem daga de dwoi
peero telo n na tɔɔne te baŋa ne to.
5Nmo wane dé dona bam babɛ sem,
pa se dé vere ba jejaano maama
ba jeŋa ne.
Ba maama tege mo
ba tigi da chemm.
Ba daa ware kolokolo ba ke,
de ba na ye bembɛ tei de.
6Jakob dwi tiina bam Wɛ wom,
nmo na fugi de dona bam to
mo ba sisein-nɔɔna bam
de se dira bam
zege ba maŋe da chemm.
7Nmo yerane mo maŋe
se nɔɔna taa kɔre‑m.
Nmo bane ná zaŋe de wolo,
kotu ware se o zege
nmo yiga ne o na bora.
8Nmo nam zege Wɛ telaao ne mo
n di n dona bam taane.
Foone ma zo nabiina maama
pa se ba ye chemm.
9Debam Tu Wɛ, nmo déem zaŋe
se n di ba taane,
se n daare n jwoŋi balo na nɛ
bɛɛsem tega kam baŋa ne to
n yage.
10Nɔɔna maama wó taa tei‑m,
ko ná maŋe ko ye balo
bane na zaŋe de nmo to de.
Nmo nam wó pa ba lɔre n ban-lom dem na ye tei to chekke.
11Du-na duuri á pa á Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
se á daare á ke kolo á na pwooli
se á ke to maama.
O maŋe se nɔɔna taa kɔre‑o,
se balo na bwola ded‑o to
ja pɛɛra ba ba ba pa‑o.
12O pae se dedɛɛra gwooni ba tete mo.
Logo baŋa pwa bam de maa kɔre‑o lanyerane.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
In Times of Trouble God Is with His People
1I pray to you, Lord God,
and I beg you to listen.
2In days filled with trouble,
I search for you.
And at night I tirelessly
lift my hands in prayer,
refusing comfort.
3When I think of you,
I feel restless and weak.
4Because of you, Lord God,
I can't sleep.
I am restless
and can't even talk.
5I think of times gone by,
of those years long ago.
6Each night my mind
is flooded with questions:
7“Have you rejected me forever?
Won't you be kind again?
8Is this the end of your love
and your promises?
9Have you forgotten
how to have pity?
Do you refuse to show mercy
because of your anger?”
10Then I said, “God Most High,
what hurts me most
is that you no longer help us
with your mighty arm.”
11Our Lord, I will remember
the things you have done,
your miracles of long ago.
12I will think about each one
of your mighty deeds.
13Everything you do is right,
and no other god
compares with you.
14You alone work miracles,
and you have let nations
see your mighty power.
15With your own arm you rescued
your people, the descendants
of Jacob and Joseph.
16The ocean looked at you, God,
and it trembled deep down
with fear.
17Water flowed from the clouds.
Thunder was heard above
as your arrows of lightning
flashed about.
18Your thunder roared
like chariot wheels.
The world was made bright
by lightning,
and all the earth trembled.
19You walked through the water
of the mighty sea,
but your footprints
were never seen.
20You guided your people
like a flock of sheep,
and you chose Moses and Aaron
to be their leaders.
translation_text:
Cham maŋa wɛ-lworo
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo lage a keeri
de kwor-dɛa mo a jare Wɛ.
A ná lwoori‑o,
o wó cheigi a taane dem.
2Amo cham maŋa kam ne mo
a fɔɔre a twɛ a Teiru Wɛ tei.
Tete dem maama ne mo
a zeiŋi a je sem wɛɛne
a lwoori‑o.
Amo nam wo nɛ zurim a bochare ne.
3A ná yeini a guli Wɛ gula,
ko yeini ko pa a vuvuni mo.
A ta ná boŋe o boboŋa,
a maa ware a tete a ja.
4 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo pɛ se dɔɔm ba tui
a yia ne.
A bere a ware a ŋɔɔne de,
a wo-chechɔgɔ kom ŋwaane.
5A nam yeini a guli faŋa faŋa
da yam gula.
A ma boŋe bena yalo na kɛ to boboŋa.
6A maa we, “Tete ne mo a lage a guli
lei selo a déem na leeni to gula.
A ta wó taa boŋe wonnu tem boboŋa a bochare ne.”
Konto to, a kwaane se a ni
kolo na ke to kuri,
7ye a we, “Baŋa Wɛ wom wó ve-ne
taa wuu mo na?
O daa bá jwoori o ke-ne zaane na?
8O swono kolo na wora
debam ŋwaane to
laam yɔɔre ko ti mo na?
O kampwoli sem daa ba toŋe mo na?
9Wɛ swei se o duri dé ŋwaŋa
mo na?
O ta pɛ se o ban-zɔŋɔ kom leiri
o zaane dem yuu ne mo na?”
10Amo laam ma ta a we,
“Woŋo kolo na pɛ se a wo chɔge to mo tento:
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ba toŋe
o woli debam.”
11Amo nam wó guli wo-kamunnu telo Baŋa Wɛ na ke to gula.
Chega ŋwaane to, Baŋa Wɛ,
a bá swei wo-kenkagela yalo
nmo déem na ke to ni ne.
12A lage a boŋe n totoŋa yam maama boboŋa,
se a daare a jeeli ya maama dedoa dedoa mo.
13Debam Tu Wɛ wom,
chwoŋa kalo nmo na tɔge to
lana fase.
Wɛ dedwoŋi tera o na jege dam
ne nmo na jege dam tei to.
14Nmo yerane mo toŋe wo-kenkagela.
N ta ma pa se dwi-gɛ tiina bam
lɔre n dam dem ni ne.
15Ko ná ye n tete nɔɔna bam
na ye Jakob dedaane Josɛf
dwi dem to,
n déem kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom
n ma n vere-ba n yage.
16Debam Tu Wɛ,
na-fwaaro tem na nɛ nmo to,
foone déem jaane-te.
Na-luŋa kam yera de ma didigi.
17Kunkwonnu tem ma chuuri dedaane doa,
ye doa kam de bage pina-pina.
Ka ta daare ka pepele
jei sem maama ne.
18Nmo kwora kam na bage konto to,
vio kom tiini ko wuuri mo.
Doa kam de na pepele tei to pɛ se
pwooni yi logo baŋa jei maama.
Tega kam baŋa de ma tiini ka ziziŋi.
19Nmo déem tɔge naneo kom wo n bɛ.
Nmo chwoŋa kam maa wo
na-fwaaro tem tetare ne,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam wo nɛ
n nɛ-bwora kam.
20Nmo déem ma‑n tɔge Moses
de Aron baŋa ne
n da n nɔɔna bam yiga n vo,
ne nayero na kale o pei-kɔgɔ tei to.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
What God Has Done for His People
1My friends, I beg you
to listen as I teach.
2 I will give instruction
and explain the mystery
of what happened long ago.
3These are things we learned
from our ancestors,
4and we will tell them
to the next generation.
We won't keep secret
the glorious deeds
and the mighty miracles
of the Lord.
5God gave his Law
to Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
And he told our ancestors
to teach their children,
6so that each new generation
would know his Law
and tell it to the next.
7Then they would trust God
and obey his teachings,
without forgetting anything
God had done.
8They would be different
from their ancestors,
who were stubborn, rebellious,
and unfaithful to God.
9The warriors from Ephraim
were armed with arrows,
but they ran away
when the battle began.
10They broke their agreement
with God,
and they turned their backs
on his teaching.
11They forgot all he had done,
even the mighty miracles
12 he did for their ancestors
near Zoan in Egypt.
13 God made a path in the sea
and piled up the water
as he led them across.
14 He guided them during the day
with a cloud,
and each night he led them
with a flaming fire.
15 God made water flow
from rocks he split open
in the desert,
and his people drank freely,
as though from a lake.
16He made streams gush out
like rivers from rocks.
17But in the desert,
the people of God Most High
kept sinning and rebelling.
18 They stubbornly tested God
and demanded from him
what they wanted to eat.
19They challenged God by saying,
“Can God provide food
out here in the desert?
20It's true God struck the rock
and water gushed out
like a river,
but can he give his people
bread and meat?”
21When the Lord heard this,
he was angry and furious
with Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
22They had refused to trust him,
and they had doubted
his saving power.
23But God gave a command
to the clouds,
and he opened the doors
in the skies.
24 From heaven he sent grain
that they called manna.
25He gave them more than enough,
and each one of them ate
this special food.
26God's mighty power
sent a strong wind
from the southeast,
27and it brought birds
that covered the ground,
like sand on the beach.
28Then God made the birds fall
in the camp of his people
near their tents.
29God gave his people
all they wanted,
and each of them ate
until they were full.
30But before they had swallowed
the last bite,
31God became angry and killed
the strongest and best
from the families of Israel.
32But the rest kept on sinning
and would not trust
God's miracles.
33So he cut their lives short
and made them terrified.
34After he killed some of them,
the others turned to him
with all their hearts.
35They remembered God Most High,
the mighty rock
that kept them safe.
36But they tried to flatter God,
and they told him lies;
37 they were unfaithful
and broke their promises.
38Yet God was kind.
He kept forgiving their sins
and didn't destroy them.
He often became angry,
but never lost his temper.
39God remembered that they
were made of flesh
and were like a wind
that blows once
and then dies down.
40While they were in the desert,
they often rebelled
and made God sad.
41They kept testing him
and caused terrible pain
for the Holy One of Israel.
42They forgot about his power
and how he had rescued them
from their enemies.
43God showed them all kinds
of wonderful miracles
near Zoan in Egypt.
44 He turned the rivers of Egypt
into blood,
and no one could drink
from the streams.
45 He sent swarms of flies
to pester the Egyptians,
and he sent frogs
to cause them trouble.
46 God let worms and grasshoppers
eat their crops.
47 He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees
with hail and floods.
48Then he killed their cattle
with hail
and their other animals
with lightning.
49God was so angry and furious
that he went into a rage
and caused them great trouble
by sending swarms
of destroying angels.
50God released his anger
and slaughtered them
in a terrible way.
51 He killed the first-born son
of each Egyptian family.
52 Then God led his people
out of Egypt
and guided them in the desert
like a flock of sheep.
53 He led them safely along,
and they were not afraid,
but their enemies drowned
in the sea.
54 God brought his people
to the sacred mountain
that he had taken
by his own power.
55 He made nations run
from the tribes of Israel,
and he let the tribes
take over their land.
56 But the people tested
God Most High,
and they refused
to obey his laws.
57They were as unfaithful
as their ancestors,
and they were as crooked
as a twisted arrow.
58God demanded all their love,
but they made him angry
by worshiping idols.
59So God became furious
and completely rejected
the people of Israel.
60 Then he deserted his home
at Shiloh, where he lived
here on earth.
61 He let enemies capture
the sacred chest
and let them dishonor him.
62God took out his anger
on his chosen ones
and let them be killed
by enemy swords.
63Fire destroyed the young men,
and the young women were left
with no one to marry.
64Priests died violent deaths,
but their widows
were not allowed to mourn.
65Finally the Lord woke up,
like a soldier
startled from a drunken sleep.
66God scattered his enemies
and made them ashamed
forever.
67Then the Lord decided
not to make his home
with Joseph's descendants
in Ephraim.
68Instead he chose the tribe
of Judah,
and he chose Mount Zion,
the place he loves.
69There he built his temple
as lofty as the mountains
and as solid as the earth
he made to last forever.
70 The Lord God chose David
to be his servant and took him
from tending sheep
71and from caring for lambs.
Then God made him the leader
of Israel, his own nation.
72David treated the people fairly
and guided them with wisdom.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ de o nɔɔna bam taane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo nɔɔna bam, pore-na á zwa
se á cheigi kolo a na jege
se a ta a bere abam to.
2A lage a puri a ni mo
a ŋɔɔne botare-dende.
A ta wó ŋɔɔne faŋa faŋa
wo-siseigiru taane.
3Te maa ye wonnu telo dé kwoa
na tage ba bere debam
ye dé cheigi to.
4Debam de maa wó lwoni-te
se ba dwi dem ni.
Dé wó pa se dé bia balo
na wo kwaga ne to lɔre
Baŋa Wɛ na ke wo-kenkagela yalo to ni ne.
Dé ta wó bere-ba o dam-fɔrɔ kom na ye tei,
dedaane totoŋ-kamuna yalo
dwi maama o na ke to.
5Wɛ déem kwei o bera yam
de o nia yam mo
o pa Isarele tiina bam
na ye Jakob dwi tiina to.
O ma daare o pa dé nabaara bam ni we,
ba taa jege-ya ba bere ba bia bam.
6O ke konto se ba kwaga kam
mo lɔre o nia yam,
ko ná maŋe ko ye dwi delo
ba ta na wo loge to.
Banto de maa wó lwoni-ya
ba bere ba bia bam.
7Konto baŋa ne mo ba wó wane
ba kwei ba chega
ba daŋe Wɛ yera ne,
se ba daa yé swei o totoŋa yam ni ne
ye ba daare ba toŋe
ba tɔge o nia yam.
8Ba dae se ba taa lwoni
ba nabaara bam kikia.
Kokuri to ba kwoa déem ye zwabani-nyena
balo wo na digili to mo.
Ba wo ke ba chega dedaane Wɛ,
ye ba lɔ o kwaga ne.
9Efrayim tiina jar-keira bam
déem fɔge ba che ba tete
dedaane jara-keim zela.
De ko de, jara yam dɛ dem
laam na yi to,
ba ma pipiri ba duri ba lu.
10Ba bere ba wo ke ba tɔge Wɛ ni-gwonim dem na bere tei to.
Ba maa wo tɔge o bera yam chwoŋa.
11Ba déem swei Wɛ totoŋa yam
ni ne mo,
dedaane wo-kenkagela yalo
o na ke o bere-ba to.
12O déem ke totoŋ-kamuna
ba nabaara bam tetare ne mo.
Zoan laŋa kam na wo Ejipti ne to mo konto.
13O ma pɔɔre naneo kom belei,
ye o daare o pa ba tɔge ko wone ba bɛ.
O pɛ se na bam zege mo cheppe
jagwia de jazem maama
ba daare chwoŋa ba tetare ne.
14Wea maama ne o déem yeini o pa
se kunkwoŋo mo tɔge ba yiga
ko bere-ba chwoŋa se ba taa via.
Ko daare tete ne,
o tɔge min-vogo baŋa ne mo
o pa-ba pwooni ye ba via.
15Ba na wo kagoa yuu ne to
mo o yare peero,
pa se na ta ba nwoŋi
tega kuri kuri ne,
ye ba nyɔ ba su.
16O ma pa se na bam buri
peero tem ne
ba chuuri ba vo
ne bu-tola na duri tei to.
17De konto maama de,
ba ta yɔɔre ba ke wɛleera
ba chɔge Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ yiga
kagoa kam wone,
de ba na virigi ba kwaga
ba ya‑o tei to.
18Ba déem yɔɔre ba paale mo
ba faŋe Wɛ ba nii,
de ba na lwoori‑o se o pa-ba wodiiru telo ba fera na zo to.
19Ba ma tiini ba ŋwaane Wɛ ye ba we,
“Wɛ za wó wane o na wodiu chekke
se o pa debam kagoa kanto wone na?
20Chega to, o mage peo kom
pa se na dedɛ nwoŋi ko wone
ba chuura.
Se ko ná ye wodiu,
o za wó wane o na nɔna
o pa debam se dé do na?”
21 Baŋa Wɛ nam na nigi
ba ŋwaana yam konto to,
o bane ma tiini de zaŋe ba baŋa ne.
O ban-lom dem ma fufugi
dedaane Isarele dwi tiina bam
pa se mini to ba tetare ne.
22Kokuri, ba wo ke ba wo-dedoa
de Wɛ.
Ba maa ba jege teena we
o wó wane o jwoŋi-ba o yage.
23Wɛ ma pa wɛyuu baŋa kam ni
se ka pore nenɛɛne bworru mo tei.
24O ma pa se Manna tɔge da
ya to tega ne
pa se nɔɔna bam di.
Mena yalo na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne to mo konto.
25Konto to, nabiina déem di malese sem wodiu mo.
Wɛ déem pɛ-ba wodiu kolo maama na wó maŋe ba dim to.
26O ma pa se wɛ-puli seeni vio
zaŋe wɛyuu ne ko fuli.
Ko ta ná ye tega-kuri seeni vio kom,
o mɛ o dam mo o kale-ko
o ja o nwoŋi.
27Konto baŋa ne mo o pɛ se zuna tu
ba faare tega kam jei maama ne.
Ba déem daga dedɛ
ne naneo ni kasolo dwoŋi mo,
pa se o nɔɔna bam na nɔna ba di.
28Wɛ ma pa zuna bam jaane ba ba
ba to o nɔɔna bam tigisim
jeiga kam tetare ne,
ba na chwi ba vwoa yam mɛ to.
29Ba maama ma di ba su ba daare,
Wɛ na pɛ-ba ba fera na zo
wodiu kolo to ŋwaane.
30Wodiu kom nam ya ta na wo
ba ni ne
ye ba wo di ba su ba fera yam to,
31Wɛ bane zaŋe ba baŋa ne.
O ma go balo na tiini ba ye babɛ ba wone to.
Isarele tiina nɔn-donno tem dedɛ mo o ti konto.
32De konto maama de,
Wɛ nɔɔna bam déem ta yɔɔre
ba ke wɛleera mo.
Ba ta wo ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o,
de o na maŋe o ke wo-kenkagela
tei maama to de.
33Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ ma pa se
ba ŋwea kam ji kafɛ yerane,
pa se foone ja-ba
ye ba daare ba te lela.
34Wɛ na yeini o go ba badwonna to,
balo na daare to laam pipiri
ba fɔɔre ba yi o tei.
Ba ma seene ba yia
ba jwoori ba sɛ‑o.
35Ba déem laam guli we Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo ye ba dalem jei,
ye o ta kwori o ye ba Jwoŋinu wom.
36Ba nam na seini‑o tei to
ye ba ni-vɔɔ wone yerane mo.
Ba ma kwe ba yeila ded‑o
ye ba fɔe vwa ba pa‑o.
37Ba déem wo zege chega wone
ba pa‑o.
Ba nam wo sɛ ba tɔge ni delo
o na gwoni de-ba to.
38Konto maama de,
Wɛ ta duri ba yibwona.
O yage ba wɛleera o ma o chɛ-ba,
ye o peene o bane pa se
o wo chɔge-ba.
39O nam ke o boboŋa ne we
ba ye nabwona yerane mo.
Ba maa nye de vio mo na dole
ko kɛ tei to.
40Ba déem na beeri
kagoa kam wone to,
kuni dedɛ mo ba déem yeini
ba nwoŋi Wɛ ni dem kwaga ne,
pa se o wo tiini ko chɔge.
41Ba na faŋe‑o ba nii tei konto to
dae na-ni dedoa baŋa ne.
Ba déem nam pɛ se Isarele dwi dem
Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom yera chɛ.
42Ba ma swei o dam-fɔrɔ kom ni ne,
de o na vere-ba ba dona bam jeŋa ne tei to maama.
43Maŋa kam konto ne
Wɛ déem ke wo-kenkagela mo
Zoan laŋa kam na wo Ejipti ne to wone.
44O déem leiri na balo
na wo Ejipti bwi sem ne to mo
pa se ba ji jana.
Konto ŋwaane ba ma ga na
se ba mɔ bwi sem ne ba nyɔ.
45Wɛ déem ta pɛ se zɔɔro mo ba
te meeli Ejipti tiina bam te do.
Nanchane de ma jwoŋi jei sem maama se chɔge tega kam.
46O déem ta pɛ se kayere mo ba
se deilimi ba wodiiru
de ba teeni dem maama nyɔ!
47Ko ta ná ye ba Vini teeni dem,
de ba kaporro tem,
Wɛ déem pɛ se do-kandwa
dedaane do-fɔrɔ mo chɔge-te.
48Do-kandwa mo o mɛ o dole
ba naane dem o go.
Doa kam ma pepele ka bage
ba vare-mwa bam pa se ba de te.
49Wɛ déem pɛ se o ban-lom yɔɔre
de zaŋe ba baŋa ne mo.
O wo ma tiini ko fuli pa se
o toŋe lɛɛro ba yuu ne,
te na nye de malese kɔgɔ kolo
na jaane toone ko ba to.
50O maa wo zuri o bane de fenfee de.
O nam wo sɛ se o che
Ejipti tiina bam de toone.
O déem pɛ se jawe-chɛɔ mo ja-ba
ko go.
51O tɔge chwoŋa kam konto mo
o go ba bu-kwe sem maama.
Ham dwi dem bu-kwe sem mo konto.
52Ko daare ko ná ye o tete nɔɔna bam,
o jaane-ba mo o ja o nwoŋi
Ejipti teo kom wone.
O ma kale-ba pa ba tɔge
kagoa kam wo ba via,
ne ba ye o pei-kɔgɔ kom mo tei.
53O maa nii ba baŋa ne ye ba via,
ye foone tera ba tei ne.
Ko nam ná ye ba dona bam,
naneo kom mo kwoli-ba
pa se ba te ba maŋe na bam wone.
54Wɛ déem mo jaane o nɔɔna bam
o ja o vo o yi tega kalo
o na pɔɔre o pa o tete to.
Jei sem konto déem ye zwonnu laŋa mo,
Wɛ na mɛ o dam dem o wane-ka to.
55O ma zeili dwi-gɛ tiina bam
o daare tega kam
o pa o nɔɔna bam.
O laam ma chɛ tega kam o pa-ba,
se Isarele dwia yam maama
taa tei ba nyem,
ye ba zoore ka baŋa ne.
56Ba déem nam ta faŋe Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ba nii,
ye ba daare ba lɔ o ni dem kwaga ne.
Ba ma ve se ba tɔge o bera yam.
57Ba yɔɔre ba ke ne ba kwoa bam
de déem na ke tei to mo.
Ba mɛ ba kwaga ba ya Baŋa Wɛ
ye ba tɔge zwabania kikia.
Ba maa ye yɔɔ yerane,
nenɛɛne taŋa kalo na gugwoli
ye ka ye tei to.
58Ba déem chuchugi Wɛ bane mo,
de ba na lɔge jei selo
ba na zuli jwona da to.
Ko ma pa se o wo gweene de-ba,
ba jwona kaanem to ŋwaane.
59Wɛ ma lɔre o nɔɔna bam
na ke tei to,
ye o bane tiini o zaŋe de-ba.
O ma yɔɔre o ve Isarele tiina bam we
ba daa dae o nɔɔna.
60Ko ná ye vwei delo
Wɛ na chwi Siloo ne
ye o déem zoore da
nabiina tetare ne to,
o ma nwoŋi jei sem konto
o viiri o daare-ba.
61O ma daare o pa ba dona bam pwola se ba vere
o ni-gwonim dakaa kam na bere o dam de o nenɔŋa na mae tei to.
62Wɛ bane na tiini de zaŋe
o tete nɔɔna bam baŋa ne konto to,
o yage-ba mo pa ba tɔge
jara baŋa ne ba te.
63Mini déem mo di ba nɔn-donno tem.
Ba bukwa bam de daa ba nae baara se ba zo.
64Ba kaanem tiina bam de tege
dam toone mo,
ye ba kaana bam wo nɛ pwola
se ba keeri ba lwi.
65Baŋa Wɛ wom laam ma pɛ o zaŋe
nenɛɛne nɔɔno na zaŋe
dɔɔm wone to.
O ma kaase tiguri-kaasa,
ne babea kalo na nyɔge sana
ye o bane zaŋe to.
66Wɛ déem laam ma zeili
o dona bam pa ba jage sae,
ye o daare o ke chaveera
ba kuri ne taa wuu.
67O daa ta na lage zoorem jei to,
o ve Josɛf bu Efrayim dwi tiina laŋa kam mo.
68O ma kuri Judah dwi tiina laŋa kam,
se o taa zoore Zion peo kom baŋa ne.
Jeiga kalo o na swoi to mo konto.
69O ma fɔge o lɔ o wara-diga kam
o zege
ne wɛyuu baŋa kam na ye tei to.
O ma pa ka tiini ka dana,
ne o na naane tega baŋa kam
se ka taa wora taa wuu tei to.
70Wɛ déem ta kuri David mo.
O ma vaŋe‑o o ja
o nwoŋi vara pwola ne
se o taa ye o tontoŋeno.
71David déem ya jege pei mo o nia.
Wɛ ma pa o ji nayero wolo
na nii Jakob dwi tiina bam
baŋa ne to.
Banto maa ye Wɛ tete nɔɔna
Isarele tiina bam.
72David maa jege-ba o nii lanyerane
de o bochare maama.
O déem dɛ o swa baŋa ne mo
o kale-ba o ke daane.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Have Pity on Jerusalem
1 Our God, foreign nations
have taken your land,
disgraced your temple,
and left Jerusalem in ruins.
2They have fed the bodies
of your servants
to flesh-eating birds;
your loyal people are food
for savage animals.
3All Jerusalem is covered
with their blood,
and there is no one left
to bury them.
4Every nation around us
sneers and makes fun.
5Our Lord, will you keep on
being angry?
Will your angry feelings
keep flaming up like fire?
6Get angry with those nations
that don't know you
and won't worship you!
7They have gobbled up
Jacob's descendants
and left the land in ruins.
8 Don't make us pay for the sins
of our ancestors.
Have pity and come quickly!
We are completely helpless.
9Our God, you keep us safe.
Now help us! Rescue us.
Forgive our sins
and bring honor to yourself.
10Why should nations ask us,
“Where is your God?”
Let us and the other nations
see you take revenge
for your servants who died
a violent death.
11Listen to the prisoners groan!
Let your mighty power save all
who are sentenced to die.
12Each of those nations sneered
at you, our Lord.
Now let others sneer at them,
seven times as much.
13Then we, your people,
will always thank you.
We are like sheep
with you as our shepherd,
and all generations
will hear us praise you.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo Jerusalem ŋwaane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Wɛ,
dwi-gɛ tiina bam mo tu
ba li nmo tete tega kam de jara.
Ba laam ma biini nmo diga
kalo na ye wose to,
ye ba ta daare ba pa Jerusalem ji di-dwonnu yerane.
2Ba go n tete tontoŋena bam
ye ba yage ba yera yam pwola ne,
se duura dedaane kago-vara
laam taa tui ba di-ya.
3Ba ta pɛ se n nɔɔna bam jana mo pwori Jerusalem jei sem maama ne,
nenɛɛne ba na pwori na tei to.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa wo daare se kotu kwei twa bam o suli tega ne.
4Teene delo na bwola dedaane debam to mo gwooni debam.
Ba maa jege debam ba twea
ye ba mɔna.
5Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
n bane dem wó taa wo
debam yuu ne taa
se de vo de maŋe yei ne mo?
N ban-lom dem wó taa wora wuu mo
ne bulu mini na?
6Jwoori n ke se n bane dem zaŋe dwi-gɛ tiina bam baŋa ne,
ba na wo sɛ se ba kɔre nmo to ŋwaane.
Banto maa ba tɔge nmo yere ŋwaane ba ware ba wara.
7Ba nam yɔɔre ba ti
Jakob dwi tiina bam
ye ba daare ba chɔge
ba tega kam mo.
8Nam yé kwei dé kwoa bam wɛleera
se n ma n waare debam ya ŋwaane.
Nam ke lela n ba n duri dé yibwona,
se dé teena maama ti mo.
9Debam Tu Wɛ, ba n woli debam,
nmo na ye dé Vereno to ŋwaane.
Da nmo tete yere dem ŋwaane
n ba n vere debam n yage,
se n daare n yage dé wɛleera
n ma n chɛ debam.
10Bɛŋwaane mo dwi-gɛ tiina bam
wó taa jege debam ba gwoona
ye ba tɛ we,
“Banto Wɛ wom nam bɛ?”
Dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto pɛ se
n nɔɔna bam jana pwori.
Jan ja! Ke keim se dé nii,
se ba lɔre we n lage n ŋwe
ba wɛleera jene mo ba baŋa ne.
11Cheigi peena bam na vuvuni tei to!
Ko ná ye balo na jege se ba go-ba to,
jwoŋi ba ŋwea n yage
se ba ta taa ŋwe.
12Baŋa We, jwoori n ŋwe n jene
teene delo na bwola dedaane debam to baŋa ne kuni berepɛ,
de ba na tiini ba twe‑m tei to.
13Konto laam maa wó pa se
dé taa tei‑m taa wuu.
Dé nam ye n nɔɔna mo
ye n de nii dé baŋa ne,
ne nayero na nii o pei-kɔgɔ tei to.
Dé wó taa zuli nmo wuu,
se dé bia dedaane banto de bia
de ba ba zuli‑m taa wuu.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies of the Agreement.”)
Help Our Nation
1 Shepherd of Israel, you lead
the descendants of Joseph,
and you sit on your throne
above the winged creatures.
Listen to our prayer
and let your light shine
2for the tribes of Ephraim,
Benjamin, and Manasseh.
Save us by your power.
3Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
4 Lord God All-Powerful,
how much longer
will the prayers of your people
make you angry?
5You gave us tears for food,
and you made us drink them
by the bowlful.
6Because of you,
our enemies who live nearby
laugh and joke about us.
7Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
8We were like a grapevine
you brought out of Egypt.
You chased other nations away
and planted us here.
9Then you cleared the ground,
and we put our roots deep,
spreading over the land.
10Shade from this vine covered
the mountains.
Its branches climbed
the mighty cedars
11and stretched to the sea;
its new growth reached
to the river.
12Our Lord, why have you
torn down the wall
from around the vineyard?
You let everyone who walks by
pick the grapes.
13Now the vine is gobbled up
by pigs from the forest
and other wild animals.
14God All-Powerful,
please do something!
Look down from heaven
and see what's happening
to this vine.
15With your own hands
you planted its roots,
and you raised it
as your very own.
16Enemies chopped the vine down
and set it on fire.
Now show your anger
and destroy them.
17But help the one who sits
at your right side,
the one you raised
to be your very own.
18Then we will never turn away.
Put new life into us,
and we will worship you.
19 Lord God All-Powerful,
make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo Isarele tiina bam zeinim ŋwaane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Wɛ,
cheigi debam lworo kom!
Nmo ye Isarele dwi tiina bam nayero mo.
N yeini n tɔge Josɛf dwi tiina bam yiga n via
ne nayero na kale o pei tei to mo.
Nmo ye wolo na di paare
cherubi sem tetare laŋa ne.
Nam pa n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nyeene
ko lɔre jaja,
2ko pa Efrayim, de Benjamin,
de Manasɛ dwi tiina bam.
Zaŋe de n dam se n daare n ba
n jwoŋi debam n yage!
3Debam Tu Wɛ, pa dé jwoori
dé zege de dam!
Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni
se dé na verem.
4Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo nɔɔna bam yeini
ba lwoori zeinim n tei ne,
ye n bane zaŋe ba baŋa ne
se bɛ mo?
Ko ta wó taa ye konto mo taa
se ko vo ko maŋe yei ne mo?
5Nmo pɛ se dé na tiini dé ka
yi-na balo to mo ji
debam ni-wodiu.
Dé maa nyɔ dé yi-na bam dé su.
6Nmo ta pɛ se teene delo
na gilimi debam to
bane zaŋe debam ŋwaane.
Dé dona bam maa jege debam
ba mɔna.
7Paŋwa Tu Wɛ wom,
pa dé jwoori dé zege de dam!
Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni
se dé na verem.
8Nmo déem na jaane dé kwoa bam
n ja n nwoŋi Ejipti ne to,
ko nye de Vini tio mo n na kwei
n ja n vo se n jeiri tei to.
N zeili dwi-gɛ tiina bam
n daare ba tega kam
se n jeiri debam jei sem konto ne.
9N kwɛ tega kam n pa debam,
ye dé fɔge dé yerege dé su
tega kam maama.
10Ko nye de Vini tio vɔɔro tem
na kwoli peero tem,
ye ko nɛ sem nwoŋi se vo se yi
Sedare teeni kamunnu tem
se li-te tei to mo.
11Ko nɛ sem ta ma jage
se yi tega kam maama
ko na zege Mediterania naneo kom ni ne
se ko vo ko yi Yuferata
buga kam seeni to.
12Konto to, bɛ nam daa mo kea
ye n pa tega kam laam ji di-dwonnu?
Veira de nɛ chwoŋa se ba zo
ba vere ba boboŋa wonnu.
13Ko nye de ga-teira mo nwoŋi
kagoa wone ya vei ya nɔne
ya chɔge Vini tio kom,
ye kago-vara de vei ba di
tio-bia bam maama.
14Paŋwa Tu Wɛ wom,
pipiri n jwoori n ba debam tei!
Zege wɛyuu ne n tiiri
n nii debam seeni.
Fɔge n nii debam balo
na ye n nɔɔna to baŋa ne.
15Dé ye Vini tio kolo
nmo tete na jeiri to mo.
Nam ba n kwɛ n bu wolo
n na kɔne se o ke nɔɔno to.
16Dé dona bam gwoni nmo Vini tio kom ba de tega ne,
ye ba daare ba zwɛ-ko.
Zaŋe n bwɛ-ba se ba na chɔgem.
17Ko daare se n pa wolo n na kuri to
zege de dam,
o na ye nabiinu bu wolo n na kɔne se o ke nɔɔno to ŋwaane.
18Konto, dé daa bá jwoori
dé lɔ nmo kwaga ne.
Nam pa dé jwoori dé na ŋwea,
se dé wane dé bwoŋi n yere dem
dé pa‑m zula.
19Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ
pa dé jwoori dé zege de dam!
Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni
se dé na verem.

english_text:
(By Asaph for the music leader.
)
God Makes Us Strong
1Be happy and shout to God
who makes us strong!
Shout praises to the God
of Jacob.
2Sing as you play tambourines
and the lovely sounding
stringed instruments.
3 Sound the trumpets and start
the New Moon Festival.
We must also celebrate
when the moon is full.
4This is the law in Israel,
and it was given to us
by the God of Jacob.
5The descendants of Joseph
were told to obey it,
when God led them out
from the land of Egypt.
In a voice unknown to me,
I heard someone say:
6“I lifted the burden
from your shoulder
and took the heavy basket
from your hands.
7 When you were in trouble,
I rescued you,
and from the thunderclouds,
I answered your prayers.
Later I tested you
at Meribah Spring.
8“Listen, my people,
while I, the Lord,
correct you!
Israel, if you would only
pay attention to me!
9 Don't worship foreign gods
or bow down to gods
you know nothing about.
10I am the Lord your God.
I rescued you from Egypt.
Just ask, and I will give you
whatever you need.
11“But, my people, Israel,
you refused to listen,
and you would have nothing
to do with me!
12So I let you be stubborn
and keep on following
your own advice.
13“My people, Israel,
if only you would listen
and do as I say!
14I, the Lord, would quickly
defeat your enemies
with my mighty power.
15Everyone who hates me
would come crawling,
and that would be the end
of them.
16But I would feed you
with the finest bread
and with the best honey
until you were full.”
translation_text:
Kuri dim leiŋa
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛ mo ye wolo
na pae debam dam to.
Leeni-na de kwor-dɛa á zuli‑o!
Bage-na de wopwolo á zuli Jakob dwi tiina Wɛ wom.
2Bage-na leiŋa! Wɔ-na senyɛ,
se á daare á ta-na kwanno dwi dwi
se te kwori taa ywomma.
3Wu-na nabwanno chan-doŋa kam maŋa ne,
se ko woli de chan-pwoŋa
maŋa kam de,
dé na bobo dé kuri dim to ne.
4Jakob dwi tiina bam Wɛ wom mo pɛ ni
se á ke konto Isarele teo kom ne.
5O déem na nwoŋi se o vere Josɛf dwi tiina bam
o yage Ejipti tiina bam jeŋa ne to
mo o pɛ bera yam konto.
Amo nigi kwora mo
ye a wo lɔre ka tu.
Ka maa we:
6“Amo dɔne zela yalo ya na wo
á bakale baŋa ne to
a yage dáa ne,
ye a daare a jwoŋi á totoŋ-dɛɛra yam á jeŋa ne se á sii.
7Chanɛɛre na jaane abam ye
á lwoori wolim amo tei ne to,
a ma sɛ pa a jwoŋi abam a yage.
Doa na bage kunkwon-liliru wone to,
a tɔge da a leiri á wɛ-lworo kom.
A ta ma faŋe abam se a nii
Meriba buli-yi dem seeni.
8Amo nɔɔna bam, cheigi-na,
se amo mo lage a korese abam
Isarele tiina bam,
ko ya maŋe se á sɛ
se á cheigi amo bera yam.
9Ko dae se á daa ta‑á jege wɛ-gaa
á woli amo wone.
Yé tiiri-na tega ne á zuli wɛ delo
na ye sa-teena nyem to.
10Amo yerane mo ye abam Tu
Baŋa Wɛ wom,
a na jaane abam a ja
a nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne to.
Puri-na á nia jaja,
se a lage a ke wo-laaro dedɛ mo da a pa abam.
11De konto maama de,
amo nɔɔna bam ba lage
se ba taa cheigi amo taane dem.
Amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam
wo sɛ ba pa-ne.
12Konto ŋwaane mo a yage-ba
se ba taa ke ba tɔge
ba wo-dɛɔ kom na lage tei to.
A ma pa-ba pwola se ba toŋe
ba su ba fera.
13Ko nam ya maŋe se a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam sɛ a ni,
ye ba ta tɔge a chwei sem.
14Ba ya ná ke konto, a ya wó wane ba dona bam lela,
de a jeŋa na yɔɔre ka zo-ba tei to.
15Wolo maama de na chuli-ne to
maa wó ba o gwane
amo yiga ne de foone.
Kotu maa wó na waarem taa wuu.
16Amo nam ya wó pa abam
wodi-laaro dedaane tooro
se á ta‑á di á sui.”

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Please Do Something, God!
1When all the other gods
have come together,
the Lord God judges them
and says:
2“How long will you
keep judging unfairly
and favoring evil people?
3Be fair to the poor
and to orphans.
Defend the helpless
and everyone in need.
4Rescue the weak and homeless
from the powerful hands
of heartless people.
5“None of you know
or understand a thing.
You live in darkness,
while the foundations
of the earth tremble.
6 “I, the Most High God, say
that all of you are gods
and also my own children.
7But you will die,
just like everyone else,
including powerful rulers.”
8Do something, God!
Judge the nations of the earth;
they belong to you.
translation_text:
Wɛ bora borem taane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Wɛ mo tɔge de wɛyuu dedɛɛra badwonna
o jei ba kɔgɔ kom yiga ne.
O laam maa lage o zege
ba maama tetare ne
o di ba taane.
2O maa we:
“Abam ta wó taa bore vwa bora taa
se á vo á maŋe yei ne mo?
Á na ke tei to, á yeini á zege
puseŋ-nyena kwaga ne
pa se ba na ba bora kalo
na dae ba nyem to.
3Abam nam jege se á yiga taa wo nabwona de botara wone mo,
se á daare á zege balo na nɛ bɛɛsem de chanɛɛre to kwaga ne.
4Ko ta ná ye zora de yiniga tiina,
se á jwoŋi-ba puseŋ-nyena bam jeŋa ne á yage.”
5Dedɛɛra bam konto nam yeiri kolokolo
ye ba boboŋa tera.
Ba kare ba taane mo lim wone.
Tega kam baŋa maa ziziŋa
ka tu ka yi ka kuri maama.
6Amo déem tage a we,
“Á ye wa mo.
Abam maama ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom bia.
7De konto de, abam jege se á te mo,
nenɛɛne nabiina de dedɛɛra maama
na jege se ba te tei to.”
8Dé Tu Wɛ wom,
zaŋe wɛɛne n ke n totoŋa!
Zaŋe n di nabiina taane!
Kokuri, nmo mo tei logo baŋa teene dem maama.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph.)
God Rules All the Earth
1Our God, don't just sit there,
silently doing nothing!
2Your hateful enemies
are turning against you
and rebelling.
3They are sly, and they plot
against those you treasure.
4They say, “Let's wipe out
the nation of Israel
and make sure that no one
remembers its name!”
5All of them fully agree
in their plans against you,
and among them are
6Edom and the Ishmaelites;
Moab and the Hagrites;
7Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek;
Philistia and Phoenicia.
8Even Assyria has joined forces
with Moab and Ammon.
9 Our Lord, punish all of them
as you punished Midian.
Destroy them, as you destroyed
Sisera and Jabin
at Kishon Creek 10near Endor,
and let their bodies rot.
11 Treat their leaders as you did
Oreb and Zeeb,
Zebah and Zalmunna.
12All of them said, “We'll take
God's valuable land!”
13Our God, scatter them around
like dust in a whirlwind.
14Just as flames destroy forests
on the mountains,
15pursue and terrify them
with storms of your own.
16Make them blush with shame,
until they turn and worship
you, our Lord.
17Let them be forever ashamed
and confused.
Let them die in disgrace.
18Make them realize that you
are the Lord Most High,
the only ruler of earth!
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane
Asaf déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Debam Tu Wɛ, yé ta‑n jei
n nii konto chemm!
Yé ta‑n ke nenɛɛne
n yiga mo ga tera to!
2Nii mo! N dona bam tiini
ba vuvugi mo.
Balo na chuli‑m to
ke chichuŋu de nmo.
3Ba jege bana mo
se ba ma chɔge n nɔɔna bam.
Dé ye balo nmo na kuri
n pa n tete to,
ye banto lage ba ke swa dedaane debam.
4Ba bane daane mo ba we,
“Ba-na se dé ke daane
dé chɔge ba maama
se ba dwi dem ti,
se ba yere saare logo baŋa ne.”
5N dona bam mo yɔɔre
ba ke ni daane
se ba ywori nmo kwaga ne.
Balo na sɛ se ba tɔge daane ba ke
chichuŋu de nmo to mo tento:
6Nɔɔna balo na zoore
Edom te-nia yam ne to,
de Isameli dwi tiina bam,
de Moaba tiina bam,
de Hagiri tiina bam,
7ko ta woli de Gebale tiina,
de Amon tiina,
de Amaleki tiina bam,
de Filisi tiina bam,
de Tura teo nɔn-bia bam.
8Asiria tiina bam de mo dɛ
ba woli ba wone,
se Lot dwi tiina bam wane
ba fɔge ba na dam dedɛ.
9Nam zaŋe n chɔge banto maama
nenɛɛne n déem na toŋe tei
de Midian tiina bam to.
Ke-ba ne n na ke Sisera de Jabin yera ne tetei
ye n di-ba Kison buga kam seeni to.
10Nmo déem yɔɔre n chɔge-ba mo
Endora ne,
pa se ba yera tigi tega baŋa
ne ne popɔnɔ mo tei.
11Pa se n dona nɔn-yum tem te
nenɛɛne Oreba de Zeebi
déem na tege tetei to,
se ba dedɛɛra bam de te
ne Zeba de Zalemuna toone dem
na tɔge tei to.
12Banto balei déem mo tage ba we,
“Pa dé vere Wɛ tete tega kam pwoli sem dé taa tei!”
13Amo Tu Wɛ, pa se ba jage
jei maama ne,
nenɛɛne vio na kale weero
de ga-korro ko ja jei tei to.
14Ke-ba ne mini na di goa wo teeni
ye de tane dedaane peo yuu
gaaro tei to.
15Nmo de nam ke konto dwoŋi
n kwei vo-fɔrɔ n ma n pare-ba
se foone tiini de ja-ba.
16 Baŋa Wɛ, ta pa se chaveera
yɔɔre de ja-ba
se ba kwoli ba yibia,
ye ba daare ba sɛ ba pa n yere dem.
17Sɛ se chaveera de foone ja banto
taa wuu,
se ba daare ba yaale ba te.
18Nmo wolo yere na ye Baŋa Wɛ to,
pa se ba lɔre we nmo yerane mo
ye Yuu-tu Wɛ wom
ye n tei logo kom baŋa maama.

english_text:
(For the music leader.
A psalm by the clan of Korah.)
The Joy of Worship
1 Lord God All-Powerful,
your temple is so lovely!
2Deep in my heart I long
for your temple,
and with all that I am
I sing joyful songs to you.
3 Lord God All-Powerful,
my King and my God,
sparrows find a home
near your altars;
swallows build nests there
to raise their young.
4You bless everyone
who lives in your house,
and they sing your praises.
5You bless all who depend
on you for their strength
and all who deeply desire
to visit your temple.
6When they reach Dry Valley,
springs start flowing,
and the autumn rain fills it
with pools of water.
7Your people grow stronger,
and you, the God of gods,
will be seen in Zion.
8 Lord God All-Powerful,
the God of Jacob,
please answer my prayer!
9You are the shield
that protects your people,
and I am your chosen one.
Won't you smile on me?
10One day in your temple
is better than a thousand
anywhere else.
I would rather serve
in your house,
than live in the homes
of the wicked.
11Our Lord and our God,
you are like the sun
and also like a shield.
You treat us with kindness
and with honor,
never denying any good thing
to those who live right.
12 Lord God All-Powerful,
you bless everyone
who trusts you.
translation_text:
Wɛ zula lana dedɛ
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ!
Jei selo nmo na zoore to
tiini se lana se pa-ne!
2Nmo wara-jei sem tiini
se jege fera se pa-ne,
ye a boboŋa yeini ya wo se wone.
A maa kwaane a leeni wopwolo lei
de a wo maama de a bochare maama,
se a ma zuli nmo wolo na ye
Ŋwea Tu Wɛ wom to yere.
3Ko ná ye zuna balo na sɔ ba pworu
nmo wara-jei sem ne to tete,
ba tiini ba jege yu-ywoŋo.
Kawɛbidwoora de maa na jeiga
se ba lwei ba bia da.
Ko maa ye mɛ na bwola de
nmo kaanem bimbini dem to.
Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo mo ye amo Pɛ de a Wɛ wom.
4Balo maama na zoore
nmo wara-jei sem wone to
tiini ba jege yu-ywoŋo lanyerane.
Banto wó taa leeni tia lei mo
ba zuli‑m.
5Balo na dɛ nmo ŋwaane ba na dam to
jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ.
Banto mo ye balo na ke ba boboŋa ne
se ba vo ba yi nmo tei
Zion teo kom wone to.
6Ba na wora ba tɔge Baka bwolo kom ba kɛ to,
na-zura yeini ba buri
jei sem konto ne mo.
Doa de maa yeini ka nena
ye ka tagele jei sem maama
de chwaro.
7Ba vei yiga de dam mo ba maa kɛa,
se ba laam vo ba yi Zion teo kom
ba vo ba zege Wɛ yiga ne.
8Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ja!
Cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom.
Nmo wolo na ye Jakob Wɛ wom to
sɛ amo na lwoori kolo to.
9Debam Tu Wɛ, fɔge n nii
dé pɛ wom baŋa ne,
de o na cho debam dé cham wone to ŋwaane.
Pa n yiga taa wo pɛ wolo
nmo na kuri to wone.
10Dɛ dedwe puna puna wone
nɔɔno ná kwei
ye o wo nmo wara-jei sem ne,
ko gare o ná vei jei de jei
o ke bena moro da!
Amo tei ne, a ya ná nɛ pwola
se a taa zege nmo sɔŋɔ kom manchwo-peena yam ne
a yere jei sem konto,
ko ya wó dwoni a na wó taa zoore puseŋ-nyena tetare ne to.
11Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom
ye pwooni mo o pa debam.
O daa ta maa cho debam
dedaane cham.
O maa nii debam baŋa ne
ye o pa dé na zaane de zula lanyerane.
Ko ná ye balo na tɔge chwoŋa
ye ba ba tusi to,
o ba ve-ba wo-laaro de dedoa de.
12Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
balo maama na sɛ nmo de wo-dedoa to
seene ba jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ!

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Peace
1Our Lord, you have blessed
your land
and made all go well
for Jacob's descendants.
2You have forgiven the sin
and taken away the guilt
of your people.
3Your fierce anger is no longer
aimed at us.
4Our Lord and our God,
you save us!
Please bring us back home
and don't be angry.
5Will you always be angry
with us and our families?
6Won't you give us fresh life
and let your people be glad
because of you?
7Show us your love
and save us!
8I will listen to you, Lord God,
because you promise peace
to those who are faithful
and no longer foolish.
9You are ready to rescue
everyone who worships you,
so that you will live with us
in all your glory.
10Love and loyalty
will come together;
goodness and peace
will unite.
11Loyalty will sprout
from the ground;
justice will look down
from the sky above.
12Our Lord, you will bless us;
our land will produce
wonderful crops.
13Justice will march in front,
making a path
for you to follow.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo yazura ŋwaane
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo pɛ se n zaane wo n tega kam baŋa ne.
Nmo ma-n pa se Jakob dwi tiina bam jwoori ba zege de dam.
2N ta kwei n nɔɔna bam tusim dem mo
n yage n ma‑n chɛ-ba,
pa se ba wɛleera maama kwoli.
3Nmo ma‑n zuri n ban-lom dem
se de daa yé taa wo debam yuu ne.
4Nmo Wɛ ye debam Vereno mo.
Ja, pa se dé jwoori dé fɔge
dé zege de dam.
Daa‑n yé ma n kwaga n ya debam.
5N wó pa n bane dem taa wo debam baŋa ne taa wuu
se n ta kwei-de n daŋe
dé bia bam baŋa ne na?
6N bá‑n jwoori n pa dé fɔge
dé na yazura na?
N ná ke konto,
debam balo na ye n nɔɔna to
daa wó taa di ywoni nmo ŋwaane.
7 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se dé lɔre n na yɔɔre
n jege dé swono tei to,
se n daare n jwoŋi debam n yage.
8Amo nam wó cheigi se a ni
Yuu-Tu Baŋa Wɛ na wó ta kolo to.
O maa ŋɔɔne yazura taane mo
de o nɔɔna balo na jege chega ded‑o to.
Ko nam dae se banto jwoori
ba zo ba jworim kikia wone.
9Chega ŋwaane to, o lage o ke lela mo
o jwoŋi balo na kɔre‑o to o yage.
Konto maa wó pa se
o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa nae jaja
debam tega kam jei maama ne.
10Swono dedaane chega tɔgem
mo jeeri daane.
Nɔn-ŋonne kikia de yazura
maa kukwori daane.
11Ka-zege-ka-chega-wone mo lage
ka ta ka nwoŋi tega ne.
Ka-tɔge-chega de maa zege wɛyuu ne
ka nii tega baŋa seeni.
12Chega ŋwaane to,
Baŋa Wɛ wó pa dé na wo-laaro.
Dé tega kam de maa wó ke wodiiru
kɛɛla-kɛɛla ka pa debam.
13Chega borem mo tɔge Wɛ yiga ka via,
pa se o na chwoŋa o tɔge da.

english_text:
(A prayer by David.)
A Prayer for Help
1Please listen, Lord,
and answer my prayer!
I am poor and helpless.
2Protect me and save me
because you are my God.
I am your faithful servant,
and I trust you.
3Be kind to me!
I pray to you all day.
4Make my heart glad!
I serve you,
and my prayer is sincere.
5You willingly forgive,
and your love is always there
for those who pray to you.
6Please listen, Lord!
Answer my prayer for help.
7When I am in trouble, I pray,
knowing you will listen.
8No other gods are like you;
only you work miracles.
9 You created each nation,
and they will all bow down
to worship and honor you.
10You perform great wonders
because you alone are God.
11Teach me to follow you,
and I will obey your truth.
Always keep me faithful.
12With all my heart I thank you.
I praise you, Lord God.
13Your love for me is so great
that you protected me
from death and the grave.
14Proud and violent enemies,
who don't care about you,
have ganged up to attack
and kill me.
15But you, the Lord God,
are kind and merciful.
You don't easily get angry,
and your love
can always be trusted.
16I serve you, Lord,
and I am the child
of one of your servants.
Look on me with kindness.
Make me strong and save me.
17Show that you approve of me!
Then my hateful enemies
will feel like fools,
because you have helped
and comforted me.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ, pore n zwa
se n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom,
se amo ye nabwom mo
ye yiniga jege-ne.
2Ta‑n cho a ŋwea,
a na ke a chega de nmo to ŋwaane.
A ye n tontoŋeno mo,
ye a ta ke a wo-dedoa dede‑m.
Jwoŋi-ne n yage, se nmo mo ye amo Tu Wɛ wom.
3Amo Teiru Wɛ, duri amo yibwona,
se a yɔɔre a keeri a jare nmo mo
dɛ dem maama wone.
4Ta pa se a di ywoni.
Amo Teiru, nmo mo
a kwei a tete a pa‑m.
5Nmo Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre n lana.
N yiga maa wo nɔɔna wone
se n kwei ba wɛleera
n ma n chɛ-ba.
Ko ná ye balo maama na lwoori wolim n tei ne to,
n tiini n jege ba swono mo taa wuu.
6Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom,
de a na ŋwane n yiga ne tei to.
7Amo ná zo cham wone,
a yeini a lwoori wolim mo n tei ne.
Kokuri, a yei we nmo wó leiri
a wɛ-lworo kom.
8Amo Teiru, nmo dwoŋi tera
wa yam maama wone.
Nmo totoŋ-kamuna yam de
ba jege dwoŋi.
9Logo baŋa teene dem maama nɔɔna
wó ba ba jeeri nmo yiga ne
ba tiiri ba zuli‑m,
se ko ye nmo mo ke
teene dem maama.
Ba maa wó pa se nmo yere dem
na zula.
10Kokuri to, nmo tiini n jege dam
ye n toŋe wo-kenkagela dedɛ.
Nmo yerane mo nam ye Wɛ.
11 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se a lɔre n chwoŋa kam,
se a taa wae a vei
a tɔge n chega kam.
Ta pa se a taa jege boboŋe dedwe
a ŋwea wone
se ko pa a taa kɔre
n yere dem yerane.
12Amo Teiru Wɛ,
amo wó tiini a tei‑m
de a bochare maama.
A ta wó zuli n yere dem
se ko taa vei wuu.
13Kolo ŋwaane, nmo na tiini
n swoi amo tei to gaale.
N ma‑n che toone
se de yé wane-ne de ja.
14Amo Tu Wɛ, banegero nyena
mo zaŋe ba zege amo zega.
Nankɔɔre nyena ma ke daane
ba kwaane se ba go-ne.
A dona bam konto yiga tera de nmo.
15Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam jege nabiina ŋwaŋa,
ye n ke zaane n ke ba yuu ne.
N ma‑n yeini n peene n bane.
N swono kom gaale,
ye n chega kam de bá fɔge ka ti.
16Nam tiiri n nii amo seeni,
se n daare n duri a ŋwaŋa.
A ye n tontoŋeno mo.
Pa se a fɔge a na dam.
Chega to, a ye kabaa mo n sɔŋɔ ne.
Nam jwoŋi-ne n yage.
17Ke wo-memaŋe n bere-ne,
se ko bere we n yiga wo amo wone.
A dona bam maa wó lɔre
ko na ye tei to
ye chaveera di-ba ko ŋwaane.
Kokuri to, nmo Baŋa Wɛ mo zeini-ne
ye n ta pae se a wo zura.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by the clan of Korah.)
The Glory of Mount Zion
1Zion was built by the Lord
on the holy mountain,
2and he loves that city
more than any other place
in all of Israel.
3Zion, you are the city of God,
and wonderful things
are told about you.
4Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia,
Phoenicia, and Ethiopia
are some of those nations
that know you,
and their people all say,
“I was born in Zion.”
5God Most High will strengthen
the city of Zion.
Then everyone will say,
“We were born here too.”
6The Lord will make a list
of his people,
and all who were born here
will be included.
7All who sing or dance will say,
“I too am from Zion.”
translation_text:
Zion ye Baŋa Wɛ tete teo mo
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ tete mo chwi
Zion teo kom kuri
peo kolo o na pɔɔre o pa o tete to baŋa ne.
2O nam tiini o swoi ko taane
se ko dwoni teene delo maama
Jakob dwi tiina na zoore
de wone to.
3Zion, nmo ye Wɛ tete teo mo!
Ba yeini ba jege wo-kamuna
dwi dwi mo ba ŋɔɔna ba pa‑m.
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
4Amo ná yeini a tɛ
balo na sɛ amo to taane,
Ejipti de Babilon tiina mo
wó woli ba wone.
Nii-na, Filisi tiina, de Tura tiina,
ko ta woli de Kusi tiina,
ba maama wó ta ba we,
“Ba loge wonto Zion wone mo.”
5Ko ná ye balo na zoore Zion wone to,
ba wó taa tɛ ba taane ba we,
“Ba loge wonto de wonto maama teo kom wone mo.
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wó pa teo kom
taa jege dam.”
6 Baŋa Wɛ wó popone dwi tiina maama yera dedoa dedoa o tiŋi.
O maa wó ta we, “Ba loge wonto de Zion wone mo.”
7Ba maama wó taa kwɛɛra
ye ba leeni ba we,
“Amo kuri dem nwoŋi
Zion teo ne mo.”

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by the clan of Korah for the music leader. To the tune “Mahalath Leannoth.”
A special psalm by Heman the Ezrahite.)
A Prayer When You Can't Find the Way
1You keep me safe, Lord God.
So when I pray at night,
2please listen carefully
to each of my concerns.
3I am deeply troubled
and close to death;
4I am as good as dead
and completely helpless.
5I am no better off
than those in the grave,
those you have forgotten
and no longer help.
6You have put me in the deepest
and darkest grave;
7your anger rolls over me
like ocean waves.
8You have made my friends turn
in horror from me.
I am a prisoner
who cannot escape,
9and I am almost blind
because of my sorrow.
Each day I lift my hands
in prayer to you, Lord.
10Do you work miracles
for the dead?
Do they stand up
and praise you?
11Are your love and loyalty
announced in the world
of the dead?
12Do they know of your miracles
or your saving power
in the dark world below
where all is forgotten?
13Each morning I pray
to you, Lord.
14Why do you reject me?
Why do you turn from me?
15Ever since I was a child,
I have been sick
and close to death.
You have terrified me
and made me helpless.
16Your anger is like a flood!
And I am shattered
by your furious attacks
17that strike each day
and from every side.
18My friends and neighbors
have turned against me
because of you,
and now darkness
is my only companion.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo lwia ŋwaane
Kora bu-baara déem pane leiŋa kanto ye Ezera dwi tu Heman woli-ba.
1 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ye wolo
na vere-ne n yage to.
Amo nam keeri a jare nmo mo
wea dedaane tete maama.
2Ja, pore n zwa
n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom,
se n daare n zeini-ne.
3Chanɛɛra dedɛ tiini ya daane
a ŋwea maama mo,
pa se toone lage de ja-ne lela.
4Nɔɔna maa nii amo we
a lage a te mo
se a vo a maŋe tega kuri ne.
Amo nye de wolo dam daa na tere o tei ne to mo.
5Amo ba gare balo na maŋe ba te
ye ba tigi ba bɔɔna wone to.
A maa nye de balo
n na swei ba ni ne
ye n yiga daa tere ba wone to.
6N yɔɔre n dole-ne mo
n yage gwoŋ-chanluŋu wone,
pa se a jei yibiri wone.
7Nmo ban-lom dem yɔɔre
de wo amo yuu ne.
N ma‑n pa se cham dedɛ yi amo
ne naneo wo na-ŋone na bibili
se tɔge amo baŋa
se maa kɛa de dam tei to.
8N pwɛ amo de a badwoŋ-swonnu tem daane,
a na jigi wo-zɔɔne ba tei ne to ŋwaane.
Ko nye de a na to kalanchogo wone
ye a daa ware se a lu tei to mo.
9A laam keeri keeri
pa a yia suli de yi-na,
a wo na chɔge to ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ, dɛ maama wone
amo keeri a jare nmo mo.
A maa yeini a zeiŋi a jea
a lwoori zeinim n tei ne.
10Ko nam ná ye balo na tege to,
nmo ta toŋe wo-kenkagela
n pa-ba na?
Banto daa wó wane ba zaŋe wɛɛne
se ba taa tei‑m na?
11Balo na suli ba tigi tega kuri ne to
daa wó taa tɛ n swono kom taane na?
Balo na wo churu ne to
daa wó taa bere n na zege
n chega kam wone tei to na?
12Ba wó wane ba jeini jei selo
na ye lim yerane to wone
ba lɔre n wo-kenkagela yam
ni ne na?
Nmo ta na toŋe wo-laaro telo to
wó bere jei selo nɔɔna na swei woŋo maama ni ne to na?
13 Baŋa Wɛ, ko nam ná ye amo,
a yeini a keeri a gwori nmo mo.
Zezeŋa maama a yeini
a lwoori wolim mo n tei ne.
14Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, bɛ nam mo kea
ye n ve-ne konto?
Bɛ mo ye n laam pipiri n kwaga
n ya amo?
15Ko na maŋe ko zege
a nɔn-donne maŋa ne to
a yɔɔre a yaare taa mo
ye toone tiini de bwola a tei ne.
Nmo pɛ se chanɛɛra yɔɔre
ya fugi-ne mo,
pa se a dam maama ti.
16Nmo ban-lom dem dwoi
amo jaanem.
N ta na lwogi lɛɛro telo
amo yuu ne to mo
lage te pa a ŋwea kam chɔge.
17Chanɛɛra yam konto tiini
ya daane-ne dɛ maama wone.
Ya ma kaare a maama ya pu
ne na-fwaaro to.
18Nmo pɛ se a fara de a badwoŋ-swonnu maama lɔŋe-ne.
Leile konto yibiri yerane mo
wo amo tei ne.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Ethan the Ezrahite.)
The Lord's Agreement with David
1 Our Lord, I will sing
of your love forever.
Everyone yet to be born
will hear me praise
your faithfulness.
2I will tell them, “God's love
can always be trusted,
and his faithfulness lasts
as long as the heavens.”
3You said, “David, my servant,
is my chosen one,
and this is the agreement
I made with him:
4 David, one of your descendants
will always be king.”
5Our Lord, let the heavens
now praise your miracles,
and let all your angels
praise your faithfulness.
6None who live in the heavens
can compare with you.
7You are the most fearsome
of all who live in heaven;
all the others fear
and greatly honor you.
8You are Lord God All-Powerful!
No one is as loving
and faithful as you are.
9You rule the roaring sea
and calm its waves.
10You crushed the monster Rahab,
and with your powerful arm
you scattered your enemies.
11The heavens and the earth
belong to you.
And so does the world
with all its people
because you created them
12and everything else.
Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon
gladly praise you.
13You are strong and mighty!
14Your kingdom is ruled
by justice and fairness
with love and faithfulness
leading the way.
15Our Lord, you bless those
who join in the festival
and walk in the brightness
of your presence.
16We are happy all day
because of you,
and your saving power
brings honor to us.
17Your own glorious power
makes us strong,
and because of your kindness,
our strength increases.
18Our Lord and our King,
the Holy One of Israel,
you are truly our shield.
19In a vision, you once said
to your faithful followers:
“I have helped a mighty hero.
I chose him from my people
and made him famous.
20 David, my servant, is the one
I chose to be king,
21and I will always be there
to help and strengthen him.
22“No enemy will outsmart David,
and he won't be defeated
by any hateful people.
23I will strike down and crush
his troublesome enemies.
24He will always be able
to depend on my love,
and I will make him strong
with my own power.
25I will let him rule the lands
across the rivers and seas.
26He will say to me,
‘You are my Father
and my God,
as well as the mighty rock
where I am safe.’
27 “I have chosen David
as my first-born son,
and he will be the ruler
of all kings on earth.
28My love for him will last,
and my agreement with him
will never be broken.
29“One of David's descendants
will always be king,
and his family will rule
until the sky disappears.
30Suppose some of his children
should reject my Law
and refuse my instructions.
31Or suppose they should disobey
all of my teachings.
32Then I will correct
and punish them
because of their sins.
33But I will always love David
and faithfully keep all
of my promises to him.
34“I won't break my agreement
or go back on my word.
35I have sworn once and for all
by my own holy name,
and I won't lie to David.
36His family will always rule.
I will let his kingdom last
as long as the sun 37and moon
appear in the sky.”
38You are now angry, Lord,
and you have turned your back
on your chosen king.
39You broke off your agreement
with your servant, the king,
and you completely destroyed
his kingdom.
40The walls of his city
have been broken through,
and every fortress
now lies in ruins.
41All who pass by
take what they want,
and nations everywhere
joke about the king.
42You made his enemies powerful
and let them celebrate.
43But you forced him to retreat
because you did not fight
on his side.
44You took his crown
and threw his throne
in the dirt.
45You made an old man of him
and put him to shame.
46How much longer, Lord?
Will you hide forever?
How long will your anger
keep burning like fire?
47Remember, life is short!
Why did you empty our lives
of all meaning?
48No one can escape the power
of death and the grave.
49Our Lord, where is the love
you have always shown
and that you promised
so faithfully to David?
50Remember your servant, Lord!
People make jokes about me,
and I suffer many insults.
51I am your chosen one,
but your enemies chase
and make fun of me.
52Our Lord, we praise you
forever. Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ swono wora taa wuu
Ezera dwi tu Etan déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo wó taa leeni mo a seini Baŋa Wɛ swono kikia yam,
ye a bá yage.
Amo ni taane dem wó pa se
nɔɔna maama de ba bia bam
lɔre nmo na zege n chega kam wone tei to.
2Chega to, n swono kom wora mo
taa wuu ye ko bá jei.
Maŋa maama n zege n chega wone,
nenɛɛne wɛyuu kom na fɔge
ko jege dam taa wuu tei to.
3Nmo, Baŋa Wɛ tage n we:
“Amo ke ni-sɛɛm mo
de Pɛ wolo a na kuri to.
Wonto ye a tontoŋeno David
ye a dugi duuri dedaane‑o we:
4Nmo dwi dem wó taa wora
taa wuu, de bá jei,
pa se n bia wone nɔɔno mo
wó taa di paare
se ko taa vei wuu.”
5Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
wɛyuu kom maama mo lage
ko seini nmo totoŋ-kamunnu tem.
Chega to, wɛyuu malese sem
maa gilimi se tei nmo,
de n na zege de chega to ŋwaane.
6Wɛyuu kom maama na tigi palalala to,
nmo dwoŋi tera.
Ko nam ná ye wa de malese maama,
ba wolowolo ba mae
de nmo Baŋa Wɛ!
7Malese sem ná jeeri nmo yiga ne,
se wó taa kɔre foone de nmo mo,
nmo na tiini n maŋe de zula
n dwoi balo maama na wora to ŋwaane.
8Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo ba jege dwoŋi!
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na jege dam
nenɛɛne nmo to.
Nmo keina maama wone mo
n zege n chega kam wone.
9Ko ná ye naneo kom
de ko pɔgelem dem,
nmo mo jege dam ko baŋa ne.
Ko na-ŋone sem ná fufugi dedɛ,
n yeini n pa ko ke ziim mo.
10Nmo déem jaane naneo wo juru Rahaba n chochoge.
N ta mɛ n dam dem
n zeili n dona bam maama
pa ba jage.
11Wɛyuu dedaane tega baŋa maama
ye nmo nyem mo.
Logo baŋa de woŋo kolo maama na wo ko wone to,
ko ye nmo mo naane te maama.
12Logo kom wɛ-baŋa seeni
dedaane tega-kuri seeni
ye nmo mo naane se maama.
Tabora peo kom de Heremon peo kom tei nmo yere dem,
ne nɔɔna na leeni de wopwolo tei to.
13N jeŋa kam tiini ka jege dam!
N jazem dem maa wo wɛɛne,
n na di n dona to ŋwaane.
14Nmo paare dem jege dam,
n na tɔge chega
n tei n nɔɔna bam to ŋwaane.
Nmo na ke tei to,
n bere n swono kom
de n chega kam na ye tei to
maŋa maama.
15Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
balo na yei se ba zuli n yere dem to
jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ.
Nmo lanyerane dem mo kwoli-ba
ba veiŋa maama wone.
16Dɛ dem maama wone ba yeini
ba tei n yere de wopwolo.
Ba maa pa‑m zula,
n na tɔge chega yerane to ŋwaane.
17Nmo mo ye wolo na pae debam
dam de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to.
Nmo na yeini n ke zaane
debam yuu ne to
mo pa dé di wɔnɔ.
18Dé Pɛ wom ye wolo
Baŋa Wɛ na kuri to.
O maa cho debam dé cham wone
ne jara-keim nantana mo tei.
Dé Pɛ wom ye Isarele dwi dem
Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom mo tei‑o.
Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim de Pɛ David
19Faŋa faŋa to, n déem veere n tete
de n ni-jwoŋina bam ye n we:
“Amo zeini bembea dedoa
pa se o jwoŋi dam.
Chega to, a kuri nɔn-doŋo
nabwona wone
ye a daare a zeiŋi‑o se o na zula.
20Amo nɛ a tontoŋeno David,
ye a le‑o se o ji pɛ.
A ma lwo a tete swolim nuga kam
o yuu ne, se a ma tiŋi‑o paare.
21Amo mo lage a pa o zege cheppe.
A ta wó twe a jeŋa
se a pa o na dam.
22O dona bá fɔge ba zaŋe o baŋa ne
ba wane‑o.
Puseŋ-nyena de nam bá wane
ba bɛɛse‑o.
23Amo wó zeili o sebanyena o yiga ne,
ye a daare a chɔge-ba.
A ta wó mage balo maama na chuli‑o to a de tega ne.
24Amo wó taa zege o kwaga ne
maŋa maama.
A swono kom de wó taa wo o tei ne.
A ta wó pa o na dam de zula
amo tete yere ŋwaane.
25Ko ná ye teene delo na wo
naneero tem kwaga ne to,
dedaane delo na wo
bu-faaro tem kwaga ne to,
a wó pa o dam se o taa tei-de
o woli o paare dem wone.
26Pɛ David wó taa bwoi a yere
ye o we,
‘Nmo mo ye amo Kwo.
N ta maa ye amo Wɛ wom.
N ye peo kolo na ye amo dalem jei to mo
ye a na verem n tei ne.’
27Chega to, a lage a pa o ji
amo bu-kwea mo.
O wó di paare se ko taa dwoi
logo baŋa pwa bam maama.
28A swono kom wó taa wo o tei ne
taa wuu.
A daa bá fɔge a lɔ ni-sɛɛm delo
a na ke ded‑o to kwaga ne.
29Amo wó pa o dwi dem taa wora
taa wuu, de bá jei,
pa se o bia wone nɔɔno taa di paare,
nenɛɛne wɛyuu kom na wora
taa wuu tei to.
30Dɛ delo o bia bam wó lɔ
amo nia yam kwaga ne,
ye ba ve se ba taa tɔge
amo chwei sem.
31Ba wae ba yage a bera yam,
ye ba ve a ni-kaana yam.
32Ba ná ke konto,
amo wó waare-ba
ba tusim dem ŋwaane.
Chega to, a lage a tiini a mage-ba
ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane mo.
33De konto maama de,
a daa bá chɔge a swono kom
a na jege de David to.
Amo ta wó taa zege
a chega kam kwaga ne a pa‑o.
34Amo na gwoni ni delo a pa‑o to mo
a bá fɔge a lɔ de kwaga ne.
A bá kwane kampwola kalo
a na pwooli ded‑o to.
35Bedwe baŋa ne mo a dugi duuri
ded‑o a tete yere dem ŋwaane,
ye ko ti.
A bere a bá fɔ vwa ded‑o.
36Chega to, amo wó pa o dwi dem
taa wora taa wuu, de bá jei,
pa se o bia wone nɔɔno
taa di paare taa wuu,
nenɛɛne wea kam na zege
wɛyuu ne tei to.
37David de o dwi paare dem
wó taa zege de dam.
De ta wó bere Wɛ chega kam jaja
nenɛɛne chana kam na wo
wɛyuu ne ka nae jaja tei to.”
Wo-chechɔgɔ leiŋa
38 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo bane laam nam zaŋe mo.
Ko ná ye pɛ wolo nmo tete na kuri to,
nmo mɛ n kwaga n ya wonto,
ye n ve‑o.
39N ta ma chɔge ni delo n na gwoni
de n tontoŋeno wom to
ye n daare n dole o paare yipuga kam n de tega ne
pa kasolo taare ka maama.
40Nmo pɛ se o teo kom kabiri sem
bwori se to tega ne.
Dam jei selo ya na wó kwoli‑o to
laam jigi di-dwonnu.
41Veira balo maama
na tɔge da ba kɛ to
de yeini ba pɛ o jejegero mo
ba ja ba viiri.
Teene delo na gilimi debam to nɔn-bia bam
maa jege dé pɛ wom ba gwoona.
42N ma-n pa se o dona bam na dam
dedaane zula.
Ba maa tiini ba jege wopwolo
ye ba kwɛɛra.
43O na kwaare jara to,
n pɛ o jwoori kwaga
o dona bam yiga ne.
N wo sɛ se n woli‑o jara yam wone
ye o dona bam di‑o.
44N kwei o paare zela yam
n dole n yage,
pa se o daa ba jege nenɔŋa.
45N ta pɛ se kokweero mo yi‑o lela,
ye o jege o chaveera o di.
Wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane
46Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ!
Konto to, ko wó taa ye tento mo taa na?
N wó ta‑n seigi n tete
maŋa maama mo na?
N bane na tiini de zaŋe to,
n bá‑n pa de zuri lela na?
47Yé swei we amo ŋwea kam
ye kukua mo.
Bɛ mo ye n pa se nabiina maama ŋwea ye kafɛ yerane konto?
48Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na ŋwe
ye o wane o lu toone jeŋa ne.
Nɔɔno maama jege se o te
ye o daare o zo tega kuri.
49Baŋa Wɛ, nmo déem dugi duuri we
n swono kom wó taa wo
Pɛ David tei ne.
N swono kom konto
laam nam jei mo na?
N ta zege n chega kam kwaga ne na?
50Amo Teiru Wɛ, amo wolo na ye
n tontoŋeno to nɛ a chaveera,
Nɔɔna jege-ne ba ke ba mɔna dedɛ.
Laam nam guli amo gula.
51Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ!
Amo mo ye Pɛ wolo
nmo na kuri to.
Ko ye n dona bam mo jege-ne
ba twea.
Amo ná vei mɛ maama,
ba yeini ba mɔne-ne dedɛ.
52 Baŋa Wɛ maŋe de tia
se ko taa vei wuu!
Ameena! Ameena!
