english_text:
BOOK IV
(Psalms 90–106)
(A prayer by Moses, the man of God.)
God Is Eternal
1Our Lord, in all generations
you have been our home.
2You have always been God—
long before the birth
of the mountains,
even before you created
the earth and the world.
3At your command we die
and turn back to dust,
4 but a thousand years
mean nothing to you!
They are merely a day gone by
or a few hours in the night.
5You bring our lives to an end
just like a dream.
We are merely tender grass
6that sprouts and grows
in the morning,
but dries up by evening.
7Your furious anger frightens
and destroys us,
8and you know all our sins,
even those we do in secret.
9Your anger is a burden
each day we live,
then life ends like a sigh.
10 We can expect seventy years,
or maybe eighty,
if we are healthy,
but even our best years
bring trouble and sorrow.
Suddenly our time is up,
and we disappear.
11No one knows the full power
of your furious anger,
but it is as great as the fear
that we owe to you.
12Teach us to use wisely
all the time we have.
13Help us, Lord! Don't wait!
Pity your servants.
14When morning comes,
let your love satisfy
all our needs.
Then we can celebrate
and be glad for what time
we have left.
15Make us happy for as long
as you caused us trouble
and sorrow.
16Do wonderful things for us,
your servants,
and show your mighty power
to our children.
17Our Lord and our God,
treat us with kindness
and let all go well for us.
Please let all go well!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ de nabiina taane
Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses wɛ-lworo
1Baŋa Wɛ,
ko na zege faŋa faŋa to,
nmo mo maŋe n pa debam jeiŋa jei
se dé taa zoore n woro kom wone.
2Peero tem ya ta na tera to,
nmo maŋe n ye Wɛ mo.
N maŋe n wora mo
ye n ta wo naane tega kam
de logo baŋa maama.
Nmo ba jege pulim,
ye n nam ta ba jege gurim.
3Nmo pae nabiina jwoori
ba jiri teero mo,
ye n we: “Nɔn-bia bam,
jwoori-na á ji teero!”
4Bena moro dae kolokolo
nmo tei ne!
Yanto nye dedaane dɛ dedoa
na ke lela de kɛ tei to mo.
Ya nye de awa yalei naa yatɔ
tete-koro ne mo ya pa‑m.
5Nmo yeini n pa se dé ŋwea kam ba ka kweeli lela,
nenɛɛne dendwea na ti
ye ka jei tei to mo.
Nabiina nye de ga-lɛɛro
na nwoŋi te-pora ne to mo.
6Zezeŋa ne mo te yeini te puli
ye te lana.
Ko daare dedaan-ni maŋa ne
te wó kwaare mo.
7Chega to, nmo ban-zɔŋɔ kom yeini
ko jaane debam ko chɔga,
pa se dé tiini dé kɔre foone.
8Debam wɛleera mo jare
nmo yiga ne.
Keim-balwaaro telo
dé na ke dé seigi to
de maa lɔre jaja nmo tei ne.
9Dé ŋwea kam da yam maa kɛa
ye ya laam ba ya kweeli,
nmo ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane.
Dé bena yam na tu ya ti tei to
maa nye de dé suuri
ye dé daare dé te mo tei.
10Nabiinu ŋwea wae ka ye
nenɛɛne bena fuserepɛ mo.
Yazura ná wora,
badwonna bere ba yi bena funɔnɔ.
De ná maŋe dé jege teera yalo,
dé ŋwea kam yeini ka jaane
yaara de wo-chechɔgɔ yerane mo ka tui.
Dé da yam pɔpɔ ya ti mo,
ye dé daare dé jei lela.
11Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware se o lɔre
nmo ban-zɔŋɔ kom na daga tei to.
N bane dem jaane foone mo de tui
de ma de fugi nɔɔna.
12Nam woli debam se dé jeeli
dé da yam ni
se dé lɔre ya na muri tei to.
Ko maa wó pa dé ja swa.
13Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, jwoori n ba lela
n woli debam!
Yé dáane!
Duri debam ŋwaŋa
se dé ye n tontoŋena mo.
14Zezeŋa ná yia,
pa n swono kom su
debam bochara.
Dé laam wó taa leeni de wopwolo,
ye ywoni wora se ko vo
ko yi dé ŋwea kam kweelim.
15Nmo déem na pɛ dé na yaara
da yalo wone to,
nam jwoori n pa dé na wopwolo
se ko yi da yam konto ni.
Pa dé di ywoni
se ko maŋe de bena yalo
dé wo ya na chɔge to.
16Nam zaŋe n toŋe wo-kamunnu
n pa debam balo
na ye n tontoŋena to.
Pa dé bia bam lɔre n na tiini
n jege nenɔŋa tei to.
17Debam Teiru Wɛ,
pa n zaane taa wo debam yuu ne!
Ja, pa dé totoŋa yam ke lanyerane.
Ɛɛ, pa ya tiini ya ke lanyerane.

english_text:
The Lord Is My Fortress
1Live under the protection
of God Most High
and stay in the shadow
of God All-Powerful.
2Then you will say to the Lord,
“You are my fortress,
my place of safety;
you are my God,
and I trust you.”
3The Lord will keep you safe
from secret traps
and deadly diseases.
4He will spread his wings
over you
and keep you secure.
His faithfulness is like
a shield or a city wall.
5You won't need to worry
about dangers at night
or arrows during the day.
6And you won't fear diseases
that strike in the dark
or sudden disaster at noon.
7You will not be harmed,
though thousands fall
all around you.
8And with your own eyes
you will see the punishment
of the wicked.
9The Lord Most High
is your fortress.
Run to him for safety,
10and no terrible disasters
will strike you
or your home.
11 God will command his angels
to protect you
wherever you go.
12 They will carry you
in their arms,
and you won't hurt your feet
on the stones.
13 You will overpower
the strongest lions
and the most deadly snakes.
14The Lord says, “If you love me
and truly know who I am,
I will rescue you
and keep you safe.
15When you are in trouble,
call out to me.
I will answer and be there
to protect and honor you.
16You will live a long life
and see my saving power.”
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ mo ye o nɔɔna dalem jei
1Wolo maama ná zoore Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ woro kom wone,
Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom wó kwoli kotu pa se o na siu.
2Amo wó ta Baŋa Wɛ taane mo we,
“Wonto mo ye amo dalem jei,
amo na wó seigi o woro kom wone to ŋwaane.
O maa ye amo Tu Wɛ,
ye a ke a wo-dedoa ded‑o.”
3Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ wó taa cho‑m
se zaana dwi maama
yé wane‑m ya ja.
Jawe-chɛɛro de bá na chwoŋa
se te daane‑m.
4O lage o yarege o vɔna mo
o kwoli n maama,
se n seigi o woro kom wone.
O na zege de chega to ŋwaane,
o wó taa kaare‑m
ye o daare o cho‑m
ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔno
jara wone tei to.
5Nmo bá‑n ta‑n kɔre tete dem
dedaane de foone maama.
Che-tɛɛra mo ná jaana
ya tɔge n seeni wea ne de,
nmo bá‑n kɔre foone.
6Ko ta ná ye jaweero telo na lage
se te ja‑m lim wone to,
naa cham delo na wó ba wea tetare ne se de chɔge‑m to,
nmo bá‑n kɔre foone de wo-balwaaro tem konto maama.
7Nɔɔna moro naa morro fuga
ná wo nmo tei ne,
ye ba maama ná maŋe ba te
jara wone,
kolokolo bá yi‑m.
8Nmo nam mo wó zege da n nii
n na waarem na wó ba
puseŋ-nyena bam baŋa ne tei to.
9Nmo pɛ se Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ
ji nmo dalem jei,
pa se n zoore o woro kom wone.
10Konto ŋwaane,
lwarem daa bá wane‑m de ja.
Kolokolo de bá chɔge‑m
n sɔŋɔ kom ne.
11 Baŋa Wɛ wó toŋe o malese sem
nmo tei ne,
se ba taa cho‑m de cham
n chwoŋa maama wone,
12se ba daare ba ma ba jea
ba lwori‑m,
se n yé mage n naga de kandwɛ
n to tega ne.
13Nmo wó ta‑n jege dam
nywonnu de basankwe baŋa ne,
se n wane n nɔne te baŋa ne.
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
14“Amo wó jwoŋi wonto a yage,
o na jege amo swono to ŋwaane.
Amo wó taa cho‑o,
o na sɛ amo de wo-dedoa to ŋwaane.
15O ná bwoŋi amo yere se a woli‑o,
amo wó sɛ a cheigi o wɛ-lworo kom.
O ta ná wo cham wone,
a wó le‑o de wone,
a daare a pa o yere zaŋe.
16Amo wó ke a su o boboŋa yam
se a pa‑o momwɛ-dɛɛre,
ye a daare a pa o lɔre
amo verem dem na ye tei to.”

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the Sabbath.)
Sing Praises to the Lord
1It is wonderful to be grateful
and to sing your praises,
Lord Most High!
2It is wonderful each morning
to tell about your love
and at night to announce
how faithful you are.
3I enjoy praising your name
to the music of harps,
4because everything you do
makes me happy,
and I sing joyful songs.
5You do great things, Lord.
Your thoughts are too deep
6 for an ignorant fool
to know or understand.
7Though the wicked sprout
and spread like grass,
they will be pulled up
by their roots.
8But you will rule
over all of us forever,
9and your hateful enemies
will be scattered
and then destroyed.
10You have given me
the strength of a wild ox,
and you have chosen me
to be your very own.
11My eyes have seen,
and my ears have heard
the doom and destruction
of my evil enemies.
12Good people will prosper
like palm trees,
and they will grow strong
like the cedars of Lebanon.
13They will take root
in your house, Lord God,
and they will do well.
14They will be like trees
that stay healthy and fruitful,
even when they are old.
15And they will say about you,
“The Lord always does right!
God is our mighty rock.”
translation_text:
Wɛ zula leiŋa
Ba déem pane leiŋa kanto Wɛ siu dɛ ŋwaane.
1Ko maŋe se dé taa ke
Baŋa Wɛ lei!
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ,
dé wó leeni dé tei nmo yere.
2Zezeŋa maama ne dé wó ta
n swono kom taane.
Tete ne de, dé ta wó bere
n na yɔɔre n zege
n chega kam wone tei to.
3Dé wó kwei kwanno de gwa zela dwi dwi mo
dé taa pae se te kwori zaŋa
ye dé leeni dé zuli nmo.
4Kokuri to, nmo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ
se a di ywoni,
de n na ke totoŋa yalo maama to.
A lage a leeni a seini‑m de wopwolo,
wonnu telo maama
n jea na ke to ŋwaane.
5Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo toŋe totoŋ-zana dedɛ.
Nmo boboŋa yam de tiini ya lira.
6Balo na gɛ boboŋa to yeiri we
tento wó ba ba baŋa.
Nɔn-jworru dwi dem
de maa ba ni ko kuri.
7Puseŋ-nyena ná maŋe ba puli dedɛ
ne gaaro na kwi tei to,
ye nɔn-balwaaro de ná vei yiga mo de,
ba maama wó ba ba jei mo.
8Nmo Baŋa Wɛ nam jege n paare
n di mo se ko taa vei wuu.
9 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dona bam jege
se ba yɔɔre ba na chɔgem mo.
Puseŋ-nyena bam maama
maa wó jage ba jei.
10Nmo nam pɛ se
a tiini a na dam mo,
ne ga-naao na dana tei to.
N ta ma lwo nuga a yuu ne
pa se a yera yam zuri lanyerane.
11A dona bam na to tega ne to,
a yia mo nɛ ba chɔgem dem konto.
Ko ná ye puseŋ-nyena balo
na dwoni de amo to,
a zwa ma ni ba na duri ba kɛ
ye ba chwoosi tei to.
12Nɔn-ŋona wó taa jege nyɔɔre mo
ne suŋu na ye tei to.
Ba wó taa damma
ne Lebanon teo Sedare teeni
na zege te ma da te ma da tei to.
13Ba nye ne ba kugu mo wo
Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to.
Ba maa wó taa zoore de yazura
Wɛ wara-jei sem ne.
14Ba kokweero maŋa ne
ba ta wó taa jege nyɔɔre,
ne teeni delo na leiri bia to mo.
Maŋa maama yazura wó yi-ba,
ye ba ke totoŋ-laaro.
15Ba maa wó taa tɛ jaja we,
“Baŋa Wɛ toŋe chega mo.
Tusim tera o tei ne.
O maa nye de peo kolo
amo na dale da to.”

english_text:
The Lord Is King
1Our Lord, you are King!
Majesty and power
are your royal robes.
You put the world in place,
and it will never be moved.
2You have always ruled,
and you are eternal.
3The ocean is roaring, Lord!
The sea is pounding hard.
4Its mighty waves are majestic,
but you are even more majestic,
and you rule over all.
5Your decisions are firm,
and your temple will always
be beautiful and holy.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ mo tei wonnu maama
1 Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ!
Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ mo ye gɔrɔ kolo
o na zo to.
Dam-fɔrɔ maa wo o jeŋa ne.
O naane logo kom
pa se ko zege mo ga cheppe.
Ko bá fɔge ko gɔ maŋa de maŋa.
2 Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo paare dem maŋe
ko nwoŋi faŋa faŋa mo,
ye nmo maŋe n wora mo taa wuu.
3Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ!
Nii na-fwaaro tem
na dɔne de kwor-dɛa tei!
Te na-ŋone sem tiini
se wuuri dedɛ!
4Naneero tem ná maŋe
te wuuri de baare,
ye te ná dɔne de dam tei maama,
nmo nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nam mo dwoi tento maama.
Baŋa Wɛ mo jege dam wɛyuu ne!
5Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ!
Nmo nia yam yɔɔre ya zege mo.
Nmo sɔŋɔ kom ye se
ko taa ye wose mo
se ko taa vei wuu.

english_text:
The Lord Punishes the Guilty
1 Lord God, you punish
the guilty.
Show what you are like
and punish them now.
2You judge the earth.
Come and help us!
Pay back those proud people
for what they have done.
3How long will the wicked
celebrate and be glad?
4All of those cruel people
strut and boast,
5and they crush and wound
your chosen nation, Lord.
6They murder widows,
foreigners, and orphans.
7Then they say,
“The Lord God of Jacob
doesn't see or know.”
8Can't you fools see?
Won't you ever learn?
9God gave us ears and eyes!
Can't he hear and see?
10God instructs the nations
and gives knowledge to us all.
Won't he also correct us?
11 The Lord knows how useless
our plans really are.
12Our Lord, you bless everyone
that you instruct and teach
by using your Law.
13You give them rest
from their troubles,
until a pit can be dug
for the wicked.
14You won't turn your back
on your chosen nation.
15Justice and fairness
will go hand in hand,
and all who do right
will follow along.
16Who will stand up for me
against those cruel people?
17If you had not helped me, Lord,
I would soon have gone
to the land of silence.
18When I felt my feet slipping,
you came with your love
and kept me steady.
19And when I was burdened
with worries,
you comforted me
and made me feel secure.
20But you are opposed
to dishonest lawmakers
21who gang up to murder
innocent victims.
22You, Lord God, are my fortress,
that mighty rock
where I am safe.
23You will pay back my enemies,
and you will wipe them out
for the evil they did.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ bore chega bora
1 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye wolo
na jwoori o ŋwe jene
wɛle-keira baŋa ne to mo.
Nam pa n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nye
ko taa lɔre jaja!
2Nmo ma‑n ye wolo na bore chega bora logo baŋa ne to.
Konto to, zaŋe wɛɛne
se n waare boyere-nyena bam
se ko maŋe de ba kikia.
3 Baŋa Wɛ, puseŋ-nyena bam
wó taa chaka taa
se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo?
4Balo na toŋe lwarem to
yɔɔre ba ŋɔɔne ni-wɛɛle mo!
Nii ba na bere ba tete kamunim tei!
5 Baŋa Wɛ, ba jege n tete nɔɔna bam mo ba bɛɛsa.
Chega to, ba ke balo na ye n nyɔn-mage nɔɔna to mo zonne.
6Ba maa jaane kadeina
dedaane veira ba goe,
ye ba ta goe botara de ba woli da.
7Ba laam maa tɛ ba we,
“Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Jakob dwi tiina Wɛ to
ba nae dé kikia yam.
O yiga nam tera dé totoŋa yam wone.”
8Amo nɔɔna balo boboŋa
na muri to,
nam fɔge á boŋe-na á nii!
Á ye jworru mo. Á bá ja swa na?
9Wolo wom na ke zwa
o pa nabiina to tete
ye zɔ-kɔgɔ mo na?
Wonto ta wó pa-ba yia,
se o tete laam daare
o taa ye lilwei na?
10O na ye wolo na vaŋe logo baŋa teene dem zwa to,
o bá waare abam de mo na?
Wolo wom na kwei chega
o bere nɔɔna to tete
wó ga yiyiu na?
11 Baŋa Wɛ nam maŋe o yei
nabiina na boŋe ba ja kolo to.
O yei we ba boboŋa yam ye kafɛ mo.
12 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ná yeini
n korese wolo maama,
kotu tiini o jege yu-ywoŋo,
nmo na kwei n nia yam
n ma n bere‑o to ŋwaane.
13N ta yeini n pa kotu na siu
de yaara yalo na wó yi‑o to,
se ba laam ko gwoŋo se puseŋ-nyena to ko wone ba te.
14Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ bá fɔge
o ve o nɔɔna bam.
O bá dole-ba o yage,
ba na ye o nyɔn-mage nɔɔna to ŋwaane.
15Maŋa kam konto ne, ba daa ta
wó da chega kam ŋwaane
ba bore nɔɔna bora.
Balo maama na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to
wó sɛ ba tɔge chega kam konto mo.
16Wɔ mo wó zaŋe o zege o pa amo,
se o dwoni de puseŋ-nyena bam konto?
Wɔ mo wó che amo
de balo na toŋe lwarem to?
17Ko ya ná dae Baŋa Wɛ mo tu
o woli-ne,
tento amo ya tega,
ye a vo churu a maŋe da chemm.
18A nam kaase ni a we,
“A lage a seeri a to tega ne mo!”
A na tage konto to, nmo Baŋa Wɛ
tɔge n swono kom ŋwaane
n teili-ne n jwoori n ja-ne n zege.
19Lwia ná tiini ya jege-ne,
nmo wó pa a bochare jwoori
de zuri mo.
20Nmo dedaane teo kom dedɛɛra balo na kweele chega to
bá wane á me daane.
Banto mo yeini ba tiŋi nia yalo
na pae pwola se lwarem fɔge
de taa pula to.
21Ba maa ke ni daane
se ba che nɔn-laaro chwoŋa,
ye ba daare ba pae se balo na wo ke kolokolo ba tusi to ga ba ŋwea.
22Ko daare, Baŋa Wɛ nam mo ye
amo dalem jei.
O maa nye de peo kolo
amo na sale ko yera ne to.
23Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoori
o ŋwe ba wɛleera yam jene.
Chega to, o lage o yɔɔre
o chɔge-ba mo
ba totoŋ-lwanno tem ŋwaane.

english_text:
Worship and Obey the Lord
1Sing joyful songs to the Lord!
Praise the mighty rock
where we are safe.
2Come to worship him
with thankful hearts
and songs of praise.
3The Lord is the greatest God,
king over all other gods.
4He holds the deepest part
of the earth in his hands,
and the mountain peaks
also belong to him.
5The ocean is the Lord's
because he made it,
and with his own hands
he formed the dry land.
6Bow down and worship
the Lord our Creator!
7 The Lord is our God,
and we are his people,
the sheep he takes care of
in his own pasture.
Listen to God's voice today!
8 Don't be stubborn and rebel
as your ancestors did
at Meribah and Massah
out in the desert.
9For forty years
they tested God and saw
the things he did.
10Then God got tired of them
and said,
“You never show good sense,
and you don't understand
what I want you to do.”
11 In his anger, God told them,
“You people will never enter
my place of rest.”
translation_text:
Zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ á daare á ta‑á sɛ o ni
1Pa-na se dé leeni lei selo
na ywona to
dé maa tei Baŋa Wɛ de wopwolo!
Dé maa wó bage de kwor-dɛa
dé tei Baŋa Wɛ,
o na ye dé dalem jei
ye dé na verem o tei ne to ŋwaane.
2Pa-na se dé vo o yiga dé ke o lei,
ye dé leeni lei dé zuli‑o
de wopwolo.
3Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo seene
o ye Wɛ-kamunu kom!
O maa ye Pa-faro,
ye o dwoi wa yam maama wuu.
4Tega kam kuri wo
wonto ja-bɔŋɔ ne mo.
Peero tem tete yupara
maa ye o nyem.
5Wonto mo tei naneo kom,
o na ke-ko to ŋwaane.
O daa ta mɛ o tete jea
o ke tega baŋa maama.
6Pa-na se dé vwei dé yibia tega ne
dé zuli Baŋa Wɛ!
Dé wó vo dé kuni dwoona o yiga ne,
o na ye dé Keiru wom to ŋwaane.
7Kokuri to, o ye debam Tu Wɛ mo.
Dé maa ye wonto nɔn-kɔgɔ kom.
O maa yeini o nii debam baŋa ne
ne nayero na nii o pei tei to.
Abam zem nam jege
se á ni Wɛ kwora:
8“Á yé pa á wo ke dam,
ne á nabaara déem na ke tei
Meriba de Massa ne,
maŋa kalo ba na wo
kagoa kam yuu ne to.
9Jei sem konto ne mo
á nabaara bam déem kwaane
se ba maŋe amo ba nii.
Ba déem nam maŋe ba na
amo na toŋe a pa-ba tei to.
10Konto ŋwaane mo amo bane zaŋe
de á nabaara bam konto taa,
se ko vo ko yi bena finna.
A maa we: ‘Ba ye balo na yeini
ba paale ba tusi to mo.
Ba maa ba sɛa se ba tɔge
amo chwei sem.’
11Mo kokuri amo tɔge
a ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane
a du duuri a pa-ba a we,
‘Amo bere a bá pa-ba chwoŋa
se ba zo amo woro kom wo ba sii.’ ”

english_text:
Sing a New Song to the Lord
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
Everyone on this earth,
sing praises to the Lord,
2sing and praise his name.
Day after day announce,
“The Lord has saved us!”
3Tell every nation on earth,
“The Lord is wonderful
and does marvelous things!
4The Lord is great and deserves
our greatest praise!
He is the only God
worthy of our worship.
5Other nations worship idols,
but the Lord created
the heavens.
6Give honor and praise
to the Lord,
whose power and beauty
fill his holy temple.”
7 Tell everyone of every nation,
“Praise the glorious power
of the Lord.
8He is wonderful! Praise him
and bring an offering
into his temple.
9Everyone on earth, now tremble
and worship the Lord,
majestic and holy.”
10Announce to the nations,
“The Lord is King!
The world stands firm,
never to be shaken,
and he will judge its people
with fairness.”
11Tell the heavens and the earth
to be glad and celebrate!
Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures
12and the fields to rejoice
with all their crops.
Then every tree in the forest
will sing joyful songs
13to the Lord.
He is coming to judge
all people on earth
with fairness and truth.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ mo ye logo baŋa maama Pɛ
1 Tigisim 16:23-33
1Leeni-na leiŋ-doŋa
á ma‑á tei Baŋa Wɛ.
Nabiina maama, leeni-na á pa-o-na.
2Leeni-na á zeiŋi o yere dem.
Dɛ maama wone se á tɔɔle-na
o taane we o ye verem tu.
3Ta-na jaja se dwi maama tiina lɔre we
o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom gaale.
Pa-na se nɔɔna maama ni
o totoŋ-kamunnu tem ŋwa.
4Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ jege kamunni mo.
O ma seene o maŋe dedaane tia.
Nɔɔna jege se ba taa kɔre‑o
se ko dwoni wa yam maama.
5Wa yalo dwi-gɛ tiina na zuli to
ye jwona mo.
Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo
naane wɛyuu maama.
6Kamunni dedaane paare mo
wo o tei ne.
Dam de nenɔŋa de maa wo
o tete diga kam ne.
7Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama,
kwei-na zula á pa Baŋa Wɛ.
O na jege dam de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to ŋwaane,
kwei-na zula á pa‑o.
8O yere dem na maŋe de tia to ŋwaane,
kwei-na zula á pa‑o,
Ja-na pɛɛra á zo
o diga kam konkɔlɔ wone
á ma‑á zuli‑o.
9Zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ
se ko tɔge de o na tiini
o jege lam tei to.
Nabiina maama jege
se ba taa kɔre‑o
ye ba yera sae mo.
10Ta-na jaja se dwi maama tiina ni we,
“Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ!”
O naane logo kom
pa se ko zege mo ga cheppe.
Ko bá fɔge ko gɔ maŋa de maŋa.
O ta wó tɔge chega mo
o ma bore nɔɔna maama bora.
11Pa se wɛyuu kom taa di ywoni!
Pa se tega kam baŋa
taa jege wopwolo!
Ta pa se naneo kom taa wuura,
konto de wonnu telo maama
na wo ko wone to.
12Pa se kare dedaane se wodiiru tem maama taa chaka!
Teeni delo maama na wo goa ne to
laam wó leeni lei-ywei.
13De maa wó leeni de tei Baŋa Wɛ,
kokuri to, o maa beene se o di
logo baŋa maama taane mo.
O na ye chega Tu to mo o lage
o ba o tɔge o chega kam
o ma o bore logo baŋa dwi maama bora.

english_text:
The Lord Brings Justice
1The Lord is King!
Tell the earth to celebrate
and all islands to shout.
2Dark clouds surround him,
and his throne is supported
by justice and fairness.
3Fire leaps from his throne,
destroying his enemies,
4and his lightning is so bright
that the earth sees it
and trembles.
5Mountains melt away like wax
in the presence of the Lord
of all the earth.
6The heavens announce,
“The Lord brings justice!”
Everyone sees God's glory.
7Those who brag about
the useless idols they worship
are terribly ashamed,
and all the false gods
bow down to the Lord.
8When the people of Zion
and of the towns of Judah
hear that God brings justice,
they will celebrate.
9The Lord rules the whole earth,
and he is more glorious
than all the false gods.
10Love the Lord
and hate evil!
God protects his loyal people
and rescues them
from violence.
11If you obey and do right,
a light will show you the way
and fill you with happiness.
12You are the Lord's people!
So celebrate and praise
the only God.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ paare dem lana!
1 Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ.
Logo baŋa maama di-na ywoni!
Teene delo na wo naneo ni ne to
wó taa chaka de wopwolo.
2Kunkwon-lilirru mo kaare‑o
te ke tetare ne.
O paare dem jege dam,
o na tɔge chega o tei nɔɔna to ŋwaane.
3O ná maa vei mɛ maama,
mini mo wó taa tɔge o yiga,
pa se balo maama na dwoni ded‑o to na chɔgem.
4O na pae se doa pepele tei to
maa pae se pwooni yi
logo baŋa jei maama.
Tega kam baŋa maa nae
ye ka ziziŋa.
5 Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne mo
logo baŋa peero tem saare
te to buri-buri,
o na tei tega kam baŋa maama to ŋwaane.
6Wɛyuu kom tete tɔɔle
Wɛ chega kam taane mo,
se nabiina maama taa nae
o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom.
7Balo maama na zuli jwona to
lage ba di ba chaveera mo.
Ba jege ni-wɛɛle ba ŋɔɔna
ba jwo-yɔɔro tem ŋwaane mo.
Wa-yɔɔro tem maama nam jege
se te pipiri te ba
te zuli Baŋa Wɛ mo!
8Balo na zoore Zion de Judah
teene dedwonna dem ne to
laam wó ni ko kuri ye ba di ywoni,
Baŋa Wɛ na bore chega bora to ŋwaane.
9Kokuri to, nmo Baŋa Wɛ
ye Yuu-tu Wɛ wom na tei
logo kom baŋa maama to mo.
Nmo tiini n jege yere n dwoi
wa yadwonna yam maama wuu.
10Abam balo maama
na swoi Baŋa Wɛ to,
ta‑á chuli-na lwarem totoŋa.
Ko ná ye Wɛ tete nɔɔna bam,
o yeini o cho-ba mo,
ye o vere-ba puseŋ-nyena jeŋa ne
o yaga.
11Pwooni mo wó nye nɔn-laaro yiga ne.
Ywoni maa wó yi balo
na yɔɔre chwo-laao to.
12Abam balo na jege chega
Wɛ yiga ne to
ke-na wopwolo de Baŋa Wɛ
na ke kolo to,
se á daare á ke o lei,
o na ye wo-pwoŋo tu to ŋwaane.

english_text:
The Lord Works Miracles
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
He has worked miracles,
and with his own powerful arm,
he has won the victory.
2The Lord has shown the nations
that he has the power to save
and to bring justice.
3God has been faithful
in his love for Israel,
and his saving power is seen
everywhere on earth.
4Tell everyone on this earth
to sing happy songs
in praise of the Lord.
5Make music for him on harps.
Play beautiful melodies!
6Sound the trumpets and horns
and celebrate with joyful songs
for our Lord and King!
7Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures,
and the earth to shout
with all its people.
8Order the rivers
to clap their hands,
and all the hills
to sing together.
9Let them worship the Lord!
He is coming to judge
everyone on the earth,
and he will be honest
and fair.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ toŋe wo-kenkagela!
1Leeni-na leiŋ-doŋa
á ma á tei Baŋa Wɛ,
se o yɔɔre o toŋe wo-kenkagela mo.
O mɛ o tete dam-fɔrɔ kom
na ba jege dwoŋi to mo
o yɔɔre o di wɔnɔ.
2 Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se nabiina lɔre we
o jege dam se o vere nɔɔna o yage.
Dwi-gɛ tiina bam ma na
o na zege o chega wone tei to.
3O daa ta jege o ni-gwonim dem we
o wó taa swoi Isarele dwi tiina bam,
ye o toŋe chega de-ba.
Logo baŋa ni maama ne,
nabiina yɔɔre ba lɔre
debam Tu Wɛ wom na jege dam
se o vere nɔɔna o yage tei to mo.
4Logo baŋa wonnu maama,
bage-na de wopwolo á tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Ta‑á chaka de ywoni
ye á leeni-na tia lei!
5Ta-na kwanno á ma á kwɛɛre
Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne,
se á daare á leeni á seini‑o.
6Wu-na nabwanno dwi dwi
se te sɔɔ taa zaŋa.
Véi-na Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye á Pɛ to
yiga ne,
á bage de wopwolo á zuli‑o.
7Naneo kom de ko wo wonnu tem maama
jege se te taa wuuri te ke sɔɔ mo!
Logo kom baŋa de ko nɔn-bia
de jege se ba bage de baare mo.
8Bu-tola dwi maama
wó mage ka je mo.
Peero tem de maa wó tɔge daane
te leeni wopwolo lei.
9Ba maama seini Baŋa Wɛ,
de o na maa beene
se o di nabiina taane to.
Wɛ lage o da chega ŋwaane mo
o bore logo baŋa dwi maama bora.

english_text:
Our Lord Is King
1 Our Lord, you are King!
You rule from your throne
above the winged creatures,
as people tremble
and the earth shakes.
2You are praised in Zion,
and you control all nations.
3Only you are God!
And your power alone,
so great and fearsome,
is worthy of praise.
4You are our mighty King,
a lover of fairness,
who sees that justice is done
everywhere in Israel.
5Our Lord and our God,
we praise you
and kneel down to worship you,
the God of holiness!
6Moses and Aaron were two
of your priests.
Samuel was also one of those
who prayed in your name,
and you, our Lord,
answered their prayers.
7 You spoke to them
from a thick cloud,
and they obeyed your laws.
8Our Lord and our God,
you answered their prayers
and forgave their sins,
but when they did wrong,
you punished them.
9We praise you, Lord God,
and we worship you
at your sacred mountain.
Only you are God!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ ye Wo-pwoŋo Tu mo
1 Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ!
Logo baŋa dwi maama
jege se ba taa kɔre‑o mo
ye ba yera sae.
Wɛ di paare cherubi sem
tetare laŋa ne mo.
Tega baŋa maama wó ziziŋi!
2 Baŋa Wɛ jei de kamunni mo
Zion ne.
O jege dam logo baŋa teene dem
maama baŋa ne.
3Ko maŋe se nɔɔna maama
taa tei o yere dem,
de na ye kamunu
ye de ta jege foone to ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wo-pwoŋo tu!
4Dé Pɛ wom jege dam!
O nam swoi se chega kam mo taa toŋa.
O maa pae se wonnu taa tɔge chwoŋa Isarele teo ne,
se ko dedɛɛra bam de taa bore chega bora ba pa nɔɔna.
5Tei-na dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ
se á zeiŋi o yere dem.
Kuni-na nadwoona á zuli‑o,
o na ye wo-pwoŋo tu to ŋwaane.
6Moses de Aron déem wo
Wɛ kaanem tiina bam wone mo.
Samuwel de déem maa jege
Wɛ yere dem o ma o ware‑o.
Banto déem lwoori zeinim
Baŋa Wɛ tei ne
ye o sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom.
7Wɛ déem zege kunkwoŋo kolo
na zege deiki to wone mo
o ŋɔɔne de-ba.
Ba déem ma toŋe ba tɔge
o nia yam de bera yalo
o na pɛ-ba se ba taa tɔge to.
8Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo déem yeini n leiri ba wɛ-lworo.
N déem yeini n kwei
n nɔɔna bam wɛleera
n ma‑n chɛ-ba mo.
Ba nam ná toŋe lwarem,
n déem ma‑n yeini n vaŋe ba zwa.
9Tei-na dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ
ye á zeiŋi o yere dem.
Yi-na peo kolo o na pɔɔre
o pa o tete to á zuli‑o.
Kokuri to, debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ
ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo.

english_text:
(A psalm of praise.)
The Lord Is God
1Shout praises to the Lord,
everyone on this earth.
2Be joyful and sing
as you come in
to worship the Lord!
3You know the Lord is God!
He created us,
and we belong to him;
we are his people,
the sheep in his pasture.
4Be thankful and praise the Lord
as you enter his temple.
5 The Lord is good!
His love and faithfulness
will last forever.
translation_text:
Lei keim leiŋa
1Tega baŋa nabiina maama,
bage-na de kwor-dɛa
á tei Baŋa Wɛ se á di ywoni!
2Zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ dedaane wopwolo!
Ba-na o yiga ne
ye á leeni lei selo na ywona to.
3Sɛ-na de á wo maama we Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o ye Wɛ chekke.
Dé maa ye o nyem.
Dé ye o nɔɔna mo.
O maa yeini o nii debam baŋa ne
ne nayero na nii o pei-kɔgɔ tei to.
4Ba-na á twɛ o diga kam de lei keim.
Zo-na o konkɔlɔ kom wone de zula.
Ke-na o lei,
á daare á zeiŋi o yere dem.
5Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ lamma!
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
O maa yeini o zege
o chega kam kwaga ne
o zeini nɔɔna de ba kwaga maama taa wuu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A King and His Promises
1I will sing to you, Lord!
I will celebrate your kindness
and your justice.
2Please help me learn
to do the right thing,
and I will be honest and fair
in my own kingdom.
3I refuse to be corrupt
or to take part
in anything crooked,
4and I won't be dishonest
or deceitful.
5Anyone who spreads gossip
will be silenced;
no one who is conceited
will be my friend.
6I will find trustworthy people
to serve as my advisors;
only an honest person
will serve as an official.
7No one who cheats or lies
will have a position
in my royal court.
8Each morning I will silence
any lawbreakers I find
in the countryside
or in the city of the Lord.
translation_text:
Pɛ wom na pwooli se o ke kolo to
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo wó leeni
a seini n swono kom
de n na bore chega bora tei to.
Amo wó leeni a tei
nmo Baŋa Wɛ yere dem.
2A ta wó taa cho a tete mo
se a yé tusi chwoŋa kam wone.
Nmo nam bá‑n ba n woli-ne lela na?
Amo tete sɔŋɔ kom ne
a wó taa toŋe a tɔge chega kam.
3Ko nam ná ye wo-yɔɔro dwi maama,
a bá ke-te a boboŋa ne.
A maa chuli tusim kikia,
ye a ba me de balo na ke-ya to.
4A ta wó pwɛ a tete
de balo boboŋa na ywori to,
ye a ma a kwaga a ya
lwarem kikia maama.
5Wolo maama ná bae o dwoŋi bebara,
amo wó chɔge kotu a yage.
Ko ta ná ye balo
na bere ba tete kamunim to,
amo bá pa-ba pwola se ba toŋe.
6Amo yiga nam wó taa wo
balo na toŋe chega to wone mo.
A lage a pa-ba chwoŋa mo
se ba taa zoore amo tei ne.
Wolo maama ná yɔɔre o tɔge chwoŋa,
kotu wó taa toŋe o pa-ne.
7Amo bá sɛ se kampin-nyena
taa zoore a sɔŋɔ kom ne.
Vwa-fɔra de nam bá taa twɛ-ne.
8Zezeŋa maama wone
amo wó chɔge balo na toŋe
puseŋa tega kam ne to a yage.
A ta wó che balo na toŋe
lwarem dwi maama to
se ba yé zo Baŋa Wɛ tete teo kom wone.

english_text:
(A prayer for someone who hurts and needs to ask the Lord for help.)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen.
2Don't hide from me
in my time of trouble.
Pay attention to my prayer
and quickly give an answer.
3My days disappear like smoke,
and my bones are burning
as though in a furnace.
4I am wasting away like grass,
and my appetite is gone.
5My groaning never stops,
and my bones can be seen
through my skin.
6I am like a lonely owl
in the desert
7or a restless sparrow
alone on a roof.
8My enemies insult me all day,
and they use my name
for a curse word.
9Instead of food,
I have ashes to eat
and tears to drink,
10because you are furious
and have thrown me aside.
11My life fades like a shadow
at the end of day
and withers like grass.
12Our Lord, you are King forever
and will always be famous.
13You will show pity to Zion
because the time has come.
14We, your servants,
love each stone in the city,
and we are sad to see them
lying in the dirt.
15Our Lord, the nations
will honor you,
and all kings on earth
will praise your glory.
16You will rebuild
the city of Zion.
Your glory will be seen,
17and the prayers of the homeless
will be answered.
18Future generations must also
praise the Lord,
so write this for them:
19“From his holy temple,
the Lord looked down
at the earth.
20He listened to the groans
of prisoners,
and he rescued everyone
who was doomed to die.”
21All Jerusalem should praise
you, our Lord,
22when people from every nation
meet to worship you.
23I should still be strong,
but you, Lord, have made
an old person of me.
24You will live forever!
Years mean nothing to you.
Don't cut my life in half!
25 In the beginning, Lord,
you laid the earth's foundation
and created the heavens.
26They will all disappear
and wear out like clothes.
You change them,
as you would a coat,
but you last forever.
27You are always the same.
You are God for all time.
28Every generation of those
who serve you
will live in your presence.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo cham ŋwaane
Nɔɔno wolo na nɛ cham pa se o bugi ye o tiini o lwoori Baŋa Wɛ de keira to déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom.
Pa chwoŋa se a keira kam
to n zwa ne.
2Cham na yi amo to,
yé virigi n kwaga n ya-ne.
Nam pore n zwa n cheigi
a wɛ-lworo kom.
A ná keeri a jare‑m,
se n ke lela n leiri-ne.
3Kokuri to, da yalo a na jege to
wora ya jei mo,
nenɛɛne nyoa na yeini ka jei lela tei to.
A kwi sem tete de yɔɔre se wɔe
nenɛɛne mini mo jege-se
de zwɛ tei to mo.
4Amo wo kom maama chɔge mo
nenɛɛne gaaro na yeini
te kwaare tei to.
A ni dem de nam daa ba ywomma
dedaane wodiu.
5A maa yɔɔre a suura,
lwia na jege-ne to ŋwaane.
Ko maa pae a yera kwi sem yɔɔre
se nae jaja.
6A maa nye de a ye
kagoa wo kunkworo,
de ko na jei di-dwonnu wone tei to.
7Amo yia ba vei dɔɔne seeni.
A nye de zuŋa kalo mo na jaane
ka vo ka jeini nayuu ne
ka yerane tei to.
8Dɛ dem maama wone
a dona bam jege-ne mo ba twea.
Balo na chuli-ne to ma bwoŋi a yere
ba sɔɔle lwarem
ba yage a baŋa ne.
9Amo laam mɛ tentwarem mo
a ma a ji a ni-wodiu,
ye a yi-na lura na balo
a na jege a nyɔ to wone.
10Nmo ban-lom dem ŋwaane mo
pɛ ko ke-ne konto.
Kokuri to, n gɔge-ne mo
ye n dole-ne n yage dáa dáa.
11Amo ŋwea da yam lage ya ti lela,
nenɛɛne lunluŋu na yeini ko jei
dedaan-ni seeni tei to.
A ŋwea kam daa bá dáane
ne gaaro na yeini te kwaare tei to.
12 Baŋa Wɛ, ko nam ná ye nmo,
nmo wó ta‑n di n paare dem mo taa wuu.
N yere dem wó zaŋe mo wɛ-wɛ
se ko taa vei wuu.
13N wó zaŋe n duri
Zion tiina bam ŋwaŋa.
Kokuri to, maŋa kam yɔɔre ka yi mo
se n laam duri ba yibwona.
14Ko ná ye kandwa yalo
ba déem na mɛ ba lɔ teo kom to,
debam na ye n tontoŋena to
yiga wo ya wone.
Dé wo kom yɔɔre ko chɔge mo
teo kom ŋwaane,
dedaane ko na jigi di-dwonnu
tei maama to de.
15 Baŋa Wɛ, dwi-gɛ tiina bam
wó ba ba taa kɔre n yere dem.
Logo baŋa pwa bam maama
wó taa tei‑m,
n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
16Kolo ŋwaane, Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoori
o lɔ Zion teo kom,
pa se o veere o tete mo
ye o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa bere jaja.
17Yiniga tiina ná lwoori wolim
o tei ne,
o wó sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom.
O bá ve se o woli-ba.
18Nam popone wonnu tento maama
n tiŋi,
se dwi delo maama na wó saŋe kwaga to lɔre
Baŋa Wɛ totoŋ-kamunnu tem
na ye tei to,
ye ba daare ba taa tei‑o.
19 Baŋa Wɛ zege o wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne mo
o dole o yia o nii
logo kom baŋa na ye tei to.
20O ma yɔɔre o ni peena bam
na vuvuni tei to,
ye o daare o jwoŋi balo
ba na lage ba go to ŋwea
o yage se ba taa ŋwe.
21Konto to, nɔɔna wó taa tei‑o Zion ne,
pa se o yere dem zaŋe
Jerusalem teo kom maama wone.
22Logo baŋa teene dem nɔn-bia bam
de dwi delo maama ná jeeri daane
se ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ,
ko wó ke konto.
23Amo nɔn-donne maŋa kam ne mo
Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se amo dam ti.
O pɛ se a ŋwea kam tiini ka ke kukua.
24A ma lwoori‑o a we, “Amo Tu Wɛ,
yé pa se a te lela ye a dɛ wo yi.
Nmo tete bena yam nam
wó taa vei yiga mo wuu.
25Faŋa faŋa to, nmo déem mo chwi
tega kam kuri,
ye n ta kwori n ma n jea
n naane wɛyuu wonnu maama.
26Wonnu tem konto maama
wó ba te chɔge.
Ko daare nmo ta wó ta‑n wora taa.
Tento maama wó ba te zareme
ne gɔrɔ na yeini ko zareme tei to.
Nmo nam wó le-te n dole n yage,
ne nmo na kwei gare-dwoŋo
n tiŋi dáa ne tei to.
27Nmo nam ta wó ta‑n ye
ne n na maŋe n ye tei to mo.
N bena yam bá fɔge ya ti.
28Debam balo na ye n tontoŋena to bia bam
wó taa zoore nmo tei ne de yazura,
ye ba dwi tiina bam wó taa jei
n woro kom wone.”

english_text:
(By David.)
The Lord's Wonderful Love
1With all my heart
I praise the Lord,
and with all that I am
I praise his holy name!
2With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
I will never forget
how kind he has been.
3The Lord forgives our sins,
heals us when we are sick,
4and protects us from death.
His kindness and love
are a crown on our heads.
5Each day that we live,
he provides for our needs
and gives us the strength
of a young eagle.
6For all who are mistreated,
the Lord brings justice.
7He taught his Law to Moses
and showed all Israel
what he could do.
8 The Lord is merciful!
He is kind and patient,
and his love never fails.
9The Lord won't always be angry
and point out our sins;
10he doesn't punish us
as our sins deserve.
11How great is God's love for all
who worship him?
Greater than the distance
between heaven and earth!
12How far has the Lord taken
our sins from us?
Farther than the distance
from east to west!
13Just as parents are kind
to their children,
the Lord is kind
to all who worship him,
14because he knows
we are made of dust.
15We humans are like grass
or wild flowers
that quickly bloom.
16But a scorching wind blows,
and they quickly wither
to be forever forgotten.
17The Lord is always kind
to those who worship him,
and he keeps his promises
to their descendants
18who faithfully obey him.
19God has set up his kingdom
in heaven, and he rules
the whole creation.
20All of you mighty angels,
who obey God's commands,
come and praise your Lord!
21All of you thousands
who serve and obey God,
come and praise your Lord!
22All of God's creation
and all that he rules,
come and praise your Lord!
With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ swono kom na daga tei to
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we,
“Tei Baŋa Wɛ!”
O yere dem na ye wose to,
amo wó tei‑o se ko nwoŋi
a bochare-yi ne.
2Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we,
“Tei Baŋa Wɛ!”
A bá fɔge a swei o na ke-ne lanyerane tetei maama to.
3Wonto mo yeini o yage
a wɛleera maama o ma chɛ-ne.
O ta maa pa-ne yazura
a jaweero maama wone.
4O jwoŋi amo mo o ja o nwoŋi
toone dam wone.
O maa tɔge o swono kom
dedaane o yibwona yam baŋa
o zeini-ne se a di paare
ne pɛ tei to.
5O yeini o pa a ŋwea kam maama
su de wo-laaro,
pa se ka jwoori ka na dam-doore,
ne maao na jege dam tei to.
6 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o tɔge chega mo
o pa se balo nɔɔna na jege-ba
ba bɛɛsa to na ba bora.
7O déem pɛ se Moses
lɔre o chwei sem.
O ta ma pa se Isarele tiina bam
lɔre o totoŋ-naga na ye tei to.
8 Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege yibwona
dedaane zaane o maa zeini nɔɔna.
O yeini o peene o bane mo.
O swono kom maa tiini ko daga.
9Ko dae we o lage o taa bwɛ nɔɔna
maŋa maama mo.
O ban-zɔŋɔ kom wó ba ko zuri.
10Dé wɛleera yam ya na maŋe
se dé na waarem delo to,
o wo sɛ se o ke debam
se ko maŋe de-ya.
O wo sɛ se dé ŋwe
dé totoŋ-balwaaro jene dem
ne ko na maŋe se de na tei to.
11Ko ná ye balo na kɔre Wɛ to,
o swono kom tiini ko daga
ko pa-ba!
O swono kom daga ko gaale,
nenɛɛne wɛyuu kom na diini vili-vili
ko gaale tega kam baŋa tei to mo.
12O ta ma yage dé wɛleera yam
o ma chɛ debam,
o daare o dole-ya o yage yiga yiga,
se ko yi wɛ-puli dedaane wɛ-zoore
na ye yiga yiga daane tei to.
13 Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege
balo na kɔre‑o to yibwona,
ne kwo na yeini o duri
o bia yibwona tei to.
14Kokuri to, o yei lanyerane we
dé tiini dé bwona lage lage.
Ko ye teero mo o mɛ o mɔ debam.
15Ko ná ye nabiina,
ba da yam ye fenfee yerane mo,
ne ga-lɛɛro na wora
ye te jei lela tei to.
Ba yeini ba jege dam
maŋa fenfee yerane mo,
ne gaao punnu na ye tei to.
16Lon-wea vio ná tu ko dole te baŋa ne,
te wó kwaare ye te jei lela,
nenɛɛne te ya ga maŋe
te tera mo to.
17Ko nam ná ye balo
na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to,
o swono kom wo ba tei ne mo
taa wuu ko pa-ba.
O maa zege o chega kam kwaga ne
o zeini ba de ba kwaga kam
se ko taa vei wuu.
18O ke konto o pae balo na jege chega de o ni-gwonim dem
ye ba sɛ ba tɔge o bera yam to mo.
19 Baŋa Wɛ jei wɛyuu ne mo
o di o paare.
O maa tei maama wuu!
20Abam balo na ye Baŋa Wɛ malese to,
ba-na á tei‑o!
Abam balo na tɔge o nia yam
á toŋe á pa‑o de baare to,
tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
21Abam balo na wo
o wɛyuu kɔgɔ kom wone to,
tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
Abam balo na ye o tontoŋena
ye á ke o boboŋa na lage kolo to,
tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
22 Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa na ke
woŋo kolo maama to,
ba-na á tei‑o,
á ná maŋe á wo o paare dim
jei selo maama ne.
Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we,
“Tei Baŋa Wɛ!”

english_text:
The Lord Takes Care of His Creation
1I praise you, Lord God,
with all my heart.
You are glorious and majestic,
dressed in royal robes
2and surrounded by light.
You spread out the sky
like a tent,
3and you built your home
over the mighty ocean.
The clouds are your chariot
with the wind as its wings.
4 The winds are your messengers,
and flames of fire
are your servants.
5You built foundations
for the earth, and it
will never be shaken.
6You covered the earth
with the ocean that rose
above the mountains.
7Then your voice thundered!
And the water flowed
8down the mountains
and through the valleys
to the place you prepared.
9Now you have set boundaries,
so that the water will never
flood the earth again.
10You provide streams of water
in the hills and valleys,
11so that the donkeys
and other wild animals
can satisfy their thirst.
12Birds build their nests nearby
and sing in the trees.
13From your home above
you send rain on the hills
and water the earth.
14You let the earth produce
grass for cattle,
plants for our food,
15wine to cheer us up,
olive oil for our skin,
and grain for our health.
16Our Lord, your trees
always have water,
and so do the cedars
you planted in Lebanon.
17Birds nest in those trees,
and storks make their home
in the fir trees.
18Wild goats find a home
in the tall mountains,
and small animals can hide
between the rocks.
19You created the moon
to tell us the seasons.
The sun knows when to set,
20and you made the darkness,
so the animals in the forest
could come out at night.
21Lions roar as they hunt
for the food you provide.
22But when morning comes,
they return to their dens,
23then we go out to work
until the end of day.
24Our Lord, by your wisdom
you made so many things;
the whole earth is covered
with your living creatures.
25But what about the ocean
so big and wide?
It is alive with creatures,
large and small.
26 And there are the ships,
as well as Leviathan,
the monster you created
to splash in the sea.
27All of these depend on you
to provide them with food,
28and you feed each one
with your own hand,
until they are full.
29But when you turn away,
they are terrified;
when you end their life,
they die and rot.
30You created all of them
by your Spirit,
and you give new life
to the earth.
31Our Lord, we pray
that your glory
will last forever
and that you will be pleased
with what you have done.
32You look at the earth,
and it trembles.
You touch the mountains,
and smoke goes up.
33As long as I live,
I will sing and praise you,
the Lord God.
34I hope my thoughts
will please you,
because you are the one
who makes me glad.
35Destroy all wicked sinners
from the earth
once and for all.
With all my heart
I praise you, Lord!
I praise you!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ jege kamunim.
1Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we,
“Tei Baŋa Wɛ!”
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo tiini n jege kamunim!
Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ dedaane paare
mo kwoli‑m.
2Pwooni mo gilimi nmo maama
de kaare,
ne nɔɔno na pugi gɔrɔ tetei to.
Nmo daa‑n ta ma‑n lware
wɛyuu kom,
nenɛɛne ba na lware gɔrɔ
ba ma pu vwei tei to.
3Nmo tiŋi bei wɛyuu kunkwonnu tem baŋa ne,
se n ma‑n lɔ wɛyuu diga
n pa n tete.
N ta pae kunkwonnu tem tete
jiri toroko te pa‑m
se n ta‑n dɔge te baŋa ne,
ye vio kom kale‑m
ko jaane ko vei yiga.
4Nmo jege vio kom mo
n ma n toŋe n totoŋa maama.
N ta pae se doa kam pepela
se ka mini dem taa ye
n tontoŋeno.
5Nmo déem fɔge n chwi
tega baŋa kuri dem,
pa se ka zege mo ga cheppe
ye ka daa ba gɔe.
6Nmo daa‑n ta ma‑n pae se
na-fwaaro kwoli logo kom,
ne gɔrɔ na kwoli-ko tei to.
Na-fwaaro tem bere te kwoli
peero tem de.
7Nmo nam na bage-te de kwor-dɛa to,
na-fwaaro tem duri te kɛ lela.
Nmo na bage ne do-napana tei to,
te ma duri se te lu.
8Na bam déem pɛɛle peero tem seeni
ba daare ba chuuri ba tole
bwollu tem wone
ba vo ba maŋe jei selo
nmo na pɛ se ba peini da to.
9Nmo ma‑n tiŋi siseina n pa na bam
se ba yé lɛɛne-ya,
se na-fwaaro tem daa yé li
logo kom te di.
10Nmo mo pae se buli-yia
tae bwollu tem ne,
ye bu-nwaro de maa tɔge
peero tem laara ne te kɛa.
11Bwi sem konto mo pae
vara dwi maama yera zuri.
Kagoa wo bonɛ sem
de maa nyɔ na ba sui.
12Bwi sem ni ne mo
zuna sɔ ba pworu da.
Ba maa dɔge teeni nɛ sem ne
ba leena.
13Nmo yeini n zege
n wɛyuu diga kam ne mo
n pae se doa nena
se ka yi peero tem.
Ko maa pae se tega kam
nyɔ na ka sui,
ye ka ke wodiiru lanyerane.
14Nmo ma‑n pae se ga-lɛɛro nwoŋi
se vara taa di.
N ta pae se tega kam
taa ke wodiiru dwi dwi,
se nabiina taa vara
ye ba daare ba di.
15Tega kam maa pae sana se
nɔɔna taa nyɔa ye ba di ywoni.
Ka ta pae nuga
se ba yibia taa nyeena,
ye ka pae mena
se ba bochara ke dam.
16Teeni delo Baŋa Wɛ na jeiri o zege to
yeini de nae na mo dedɛ,
ko ná maŋe ko ye Sedare teeni delo na wo Lebanon peero tem ne to.
17Zuna yeini ba sɔ ba pworu
teeni dem konto nɛ ne.
Buga ni zuna de wó taa zoore
de wone.
18Peero telo na dɔra to mo ye
jei selo kagoa wo bone
na beeri se wodiu to.
Pe-ware de maa seigi
peero tem gugworru ne.
19Nmo ke chana kam mo
se ka pɔɔre bene maama
de de chane sem.
Wea kam de maa yei maŋa kalo
ka na wó zo diga to.
20Nmo mo pae se tega yeini ka yi
pa se lim wora
ye kago-vara de nwoŋi ba beera.
21Tete ne nywonnu de wó nwoŋi
te kare te beeri wodiu ye te suura.
Ko ye Wɛ mo pa-te te ni-wodiu.
22Tega ná yeini ka jege ka poora,
nywonnu tem wó jwoori mo
te vo te peini te peiga jei ne chemm.
23Ko daare se nabiina de laam nwoŋi ba diga ne
ba vo ba totoŋa ni,
se tega kam jwoori ka yi.
24Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo tiini n ke wonnu dwi dwi
ye te daga dedɛ.
Nmo na ye boboŋa tu to mo
pɛ se n ke tento maama.
Tega baŋa maama su mo
dedaane wonnu telo nmo na naane to.
25Nii naneo kom mo!
Ko tigi mo ga palalala
ye ko yala lanyerane.
Wonnu dwi dwi maa wo ko wone,
te ná ye wo-kamuna
de wo-baloa maama de,
ye te daga te gaale jeelim.
26Nabwooru maa tɔge naneero tem wone te bɛa.
Naneo wo juru Leviatan
de maa wora,
n na naane-ko n ke da
se ko taa kwɛɛre to.
27Wonnu tento maama n na ke to
jege n teena mo,
se n pa-ba ba ni-wodiu ko maŋa ne.
28Nmo ná yeini n kwei-ko n pa-ba,
ba wó jwoŋi ye ba daare ba di.
Nmo ná puri n jataala yam
se n pa-ba wodiu,
ba wó jwoŋi wo-laaro tem
ye ba di ba su.
29Nmo nam ná pipiri n daare-ba,
foone mo yeini de ja-ba.
N ná le siu ba yera ne,
ba jege se ba te mo,
ye ba jwoori ba ji teero.
30Nmo nam ná ke n siu kom
woŋo kolo yera ne,
ko wó taa jege ŋwea mo.
N yeini n tɔge keim dem konto baŋa ne
n pae se tega baŋa fɔge ka kwɛ mo.
31 Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa wora taa wuu,
se o taa jege wopwolo de o na ke wonnu telo maama to.
32Wonto mo ná yɔɔre o nii
tega baŋa seeni,
foone wó ja-ka se ka yera taa sae.
O ná twe o jeŋa o dwei peero tem,
te wó tɔre min-vogo
ye nyoa zaŋe gulululu.
33Amo ná lwoori a wo a ŋwea wone,
a lage a leeni mo a tei Baŋa Wɛ.
A maa wó zuli‑o taa
se a ŋwea ba ka ti.
34A ná leeni konto dwoŋi,
Wɛ wó pa se a boboŋa yam
taa pwoli o wo,
kokuri to, ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo pae
a di ywoni.
35Ko nam ná ye wɛle-keira maama,
pa se ba jei tega kam baŋa ne,
se puseŋ-nyena de daa yé taa wora.
Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we,
“Tei Baŋa Wɛ!”
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
The Lord Can Be Trusted
1 Praise the Lord
and pray in his name!
Tell everyone
what he has done.
2Sing praises to the Lord!
Tell about his miracles.
3Celebrate and worship
his holy name
with all your heart.
4Trust the Lord
and his mighty power.
5Remember his miracles
and all his wonders
and his fair decisions.
6You belong to the family
of Abraham, his servant;
you are his chosen ones,
the descendants of Jacob.
7The Lord is our God,
bringing justice
everywhere on earth.
8He will never forget
his agreement or his promises,
not in thousands of years.
* 9 God made an eternal promise
10 to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
11when he said, “I'll give you
the land of Canaan.”
12At the time there were
only a few of us,
and we were homeless.
13We wandered from nation
to nation, from one country
to another.
14 God did not let anyone
mistreat our people.
Instead he protected us
by punishing rulers
15and telling them,
“Don't touch my chosen leaders
or harm my prophets!”
16 God kept crops from growing
until food was scarce
everywhere in the land.
17 But he had already sent Joseph,
sold as a slave into Egypt,
18 with chains of iron
around his legs and neck.
19Joseph remained a slave
until his own words
had come true,
and the Lord had finished
testing him.
20 Then the king of Egypt
set Joseph free
21 and put him in charge
of everything he owned.
22Joseph was in command
of the officials,
and he taught the leaders
how to use wisdom.
23 Jacob and his family
came and settled in Egypt
as foreigners.
24 They were the Lord's people,
so he let them grow stronger
than their enemies.
25They served the Lord,
and he made the Egyptians plan
hateful things against them.
26 God sent his servant Moses.
He also chose and sent Aaron
27to his people in Egypt,
and they worked miracles
and wonders there.
28 Moses and Aaron obeyed God,
and he sent darkness
to cover Egypt.
29 God turned their rivers
into streams of blood,
and the fish all died.
30 Frogs were everywhere,
even in the royal palace.
31 When God gave the command,
flies and gnats
swarmed all around.
32 In place of rain,
God sent hailstones
and flashes of lightning.
33He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees,
and he made splinters
of all the other trees.
34 God gave the command,
and more grasshoppers came
than could be counted.
35They ate every green plant
and all the crops that grew
in the land of Egypt.
36 Then God took the life
of every first-born son.
37 When God led Israel from Egypt,
they took silver and gold,
and no one was left behind.
38The Egyptians were afraid
and gladly let them go.
39 God hid them under a cloud
and guided them by fire
during the night.
40 When they asked for food,
he sent more birds
than they could eat.
41 God even split open a rock,
and streams of water
gushed into the desert.
42God never forgot
his sacred promise
to his servant Abraham.
43When the Lord rescued
his chosen people from Egypt,
they celebrated with songs.
44 The Lord gave them the land
and everything else
the nations had worked for.
45He did this so that his people
would obey all his laws.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ jege chega de o nɔɔna
1 Tigisim 16:8-22
1Ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei,
se á daare á tei o yere!
Pa-na se logo baŋa dwi tiina lɔre
o na toŋe kolo maama to.
2Leeni-na tia lei á pa‑o!
Ta-na kwanno á tei‑o!
Bere-na nɔɔna o totoŋ-kamunnu
na ye tei to.
3Ta‑á jege-na teera
o yere dem na ye wose to ŋwaane.
Abam balo na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to,
se á di-na ywoni.
4Véi-na Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne
se o pa á jwoŋi dam.
Ta‑á fɔɔre-na á twɛ‑o maŋa maama wone.
5Jwoori á guli-na
o totoŋ-kamunnu tem,
dedaane o wo-kenkagela yam gula,
se á yé swei o bora borem dem
o na pɛ abam to swia.
6Chega to, á ye balo
Wɛ na kuri o pa o tete mo.
Á maa ye Wɛ tontoŋeno Abaraham bia bam,
ye á kwori á ye Jakob dwi dem.
7Wonto nam mo ye
debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.
O maa tei logo baŋa maama
de chega.
8O na gwoni o ni de o nɔɔna bam tei to,
o ta wó ke se ko tɔge-de taa wuu.
O bá kwane o ni se ko taa vei wuu,
dwia moro na wó saŋe to.
9Wɛ déem gwoni o ni dem konto mo de Abaraham,
ye o daare o du duuri
o ma gwoni ni de Izaak.
10Jakob na tu o wora to,
Wɛ ma fɔge o ke ni-gwonim dem
o pa‑o,
se o de o kwaga kam taa tɔge-de
taa wuu.
11Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we:
“Amo lage a pa nmo
Kanaan tega kam mo,
se nmo de n dwi dem jwoŋi-ka
á ta‑á tei.”
12Ba kɔgɔ kom déem ta ba daga.
Ba maa ye nɔɔna fenfee yerane,
ye ba kare Kanaan tega kam ne
ba beera ne veira mo tei.
13Ba maa tole teene dem maama wone
de dwi tiina maama wone.
14De konto de, Wɛ déem wo pɛ pwola
se nɔɔna bɛɛse-ba.
Banto ŋwaane mo o déem kaane pwa
ye o we:
15“Yé dwei-na nɔɔna banto,
se amo mo kuri-ba a pa a tete.
Nam yé pa-na ko chɛ
amo sampwori sem yera.”
16 Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ se kana to
Kanaan tega kam baŋa,
ye ba wodiiru maama jei.
17O nam ya toŋe nɔɔno mo
se o lwoori o yi Ejipti.
Josɛf mo konto, ba na yeigi‑o
ba de kabɛɛne wone to.
18Ba déem kwei chaponno mo
ba ma vɔ o nɛ sem
ye ba daare ba kwei luu
ba ma ja o ba dem.
19 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem déem mo faŋe‑o
de nii,
se ko yi maŋa kalo
o na wuuri o ta kolo to ji chega.
20Ejipti Pa-faro wom laam ma pa ni
se ba pore‑o ba yage.
21Pɛ wom ma pa wonto ji dedɛɛro
o sɔŋɔ kom ne,
se o taa tei o jejegero tem maama o nia.
22Pɛ wom déem ta pɛ‑o dam
se o taa korese o nakwa bam,
se ba jwoŋi swa o tei ne.
23Jakob de o kwaga kam déem ma vo
Ham dwi tiina teo Ejipti ne
ba ji veira ba zoore da.
24 Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ
se o nɔɔna bam puli dedɛ,
pa se ba damma ba dwoi
ba dona Ejipti tiina bam.
25Wɛ ta ma pa se banto boboŋa pipiri
se ba laam taa chuli o nɔɔna bam,
se ba daare ba ke swa ba bɛɛse-ba.
26 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma toŋe
o tontoŋeno Moses ba tei ne.
O ta ma kuri Aron
se o da o woli Moses.
27Banto balei mo déem toŋe wo-kenkagela yalo Wɛ na pɛ-ba to
nɔɔna bam tetare ne.
Chega to, ba ke Wɛ totoŋ-kamunnu
Ham dwi tiina teo Ejipti ne.
28 Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ se lim mo kwoli
ba tega kam maama.
Ba nam wo sɛ Wɛ ni taane dem.
29O ma pa se ba bwi sem na maama
ji jana,
pa se ywona yam maama te.
30Nanchane déem ma yo
se jwoŋi ba teo kom maama,
dedaane pɛ sɔŋɔ peiga jei sem.
31Wɛ ta ma pa ni,
ye zɔɔro dedaane yeena laam ba
ya jwoŋi ba teo kom jei maama
ya su.
32O ma pa se doa ji do-kandwa ya ne,
ye doa pepele ka bage
ba teo kom maama.
33O ma tɔge konto baŋa
o chɔge ba Vini teeni dem
dedaane ba kaporro tem.
O ma kaare kaare ba teo kom teeni dem maama
o de tega ne.
34O ta ma puri o ni o ta,
ye kayere laam wuuri se ba.
Se kɔgɔ kom daga se gaale jeelim.
35Se ma meeli tega kam maama
se di ga-lɛɛro de wodiiru tem
maama kula.
36Ko kwaga ne to,
Baŋa Wɛ go Ejipti tiina
bu-kwea maama mo.
Bakeira kalo maama ba na dɛ yiga
ba lo sɔŋɔ maama wone to mo
o goa.
37 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ja Isarele tiina bam o nwoŋi Ejipti ne,
ye ba zeŋe lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa wonnu dedɛ ba ja viiri.
Ba dwia yam maama wone nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo maŋe kwaga ne.
38Ba na viiri to,
Ejipti tiina bam wo déem pwoli,
ba ya na kɔre foone de-ba to ŋwaane.
39Wɛ ma kwei kunkwoŋo
o ma o kwoli o nɔɔna bam.
O ma daare o kwei min-vogo
o pa-ba,
se tete ne ba taa jege pwooni
ba tetare ne.
40Ba ma lwoori‑o se o pa-ba wodiu
se ba di,
ye o pa lwi jaane se yi-ba.
O ma daare o pa se bworobworo
nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ko to ko pa-ba,
se ba di ba su.
41O ta ma pa se peo kodwoŋi yare,
ye na ta ba nwoŋi ba chuura.
Na bam déem tole ba zo
kagoa kam wone mo
ba dura ne bu-tola mo tei.
42 Baŋa Wɛ déem na toŋe konto maama to,
ko ye o na guli ni-gwonim delo
o na ke dedaane o tontoŋeno Abaraham to ŋwaane mo.
43 Baŋa Wɛ déem jaane o nɔɔna
balo o na kuri to
o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti ne.
Ba nwoŋi konto
ye ba leeni mo ba di ywoni,
ba daare ba bage de wopwolo baŋa baŋa.
44O ma kwei dwi-gɛ tiina teene
o pa o nɔɔna bam,
ye ba laam jwoŋi nɔɔna bam tega kam ba tei,
ba daare ba di ba wodiiru tem.
45Wɛ déem ke tento maama o pa-ba,
se ba wane ba taa sɛ o nia yam mo,
ye ba daare ba taa toŋe
ba tɔge o bera yam maama.
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
A Nation Asks for Forgiveness
1 We will celebrate
and praise you, Lord!
You are good to us,
and your love never fails.
2No one can praise you enough
for all the mighty things
you have done.
3You bless those people
who are honest and fair
in everything they do.
4Remember me, Lord,
when you show kindness
by saving your people.
5Let me prosper with the rest
of your chosen ones,
as they celebrate with pride
because they belong to you.
6We and our ancestors
have sinned terribly.
7 When they were in Egypt,
they paid no attention
to your marvelous deeds
or your wonderful love.
And they turned against you
at the Red Sea.
8But you were true to your name,
and you rescued them to prove
how mighty you are.
9 You said to the Red Sea,
“Dry up!”
Then you led your people across
on land as dry as a desert.
10You saved all of them
11and drowned every one
of their enemies.
12 Then your people trusted you
and sang your praises.
13But they soon forgot
what you had done
and rejected your advice.
14 They became greedy for food
and tested you there
in the desert.
15So you gave them
what they wanted,
but later you destroyed them
with a horrible disease.
16 Everyone in camp was jealous
of Moses and of Aaron,
your chosen priest.
17Dathan and Abiram rebelled,
and the earth opened up
and swallowed them.
18Then fire broke out
and destroyed all
of their followers.
19 At Horeb your people
made and worshiped the statue
20of a bull, instead of you,
their glorious God.
21You worked powerful miracles
to save them from Egypt,
but they forgot about you
22and the fearsome things
you did at the Red Sea.
23You were angry and started
to destroy them,
but Moses, your chosen leader,
begged you not to do it.
24 They would not trust
you, Lord,
and they did not like
the promised land.
25They would not obey you,
and they grumbled
in their tents.
26So you threatened them
by saying, “I'll kill you
out here in the desert!
27 I'll scatter your children
everywhere in the world.”
28 Your people became followers
of a god named Baal Peor,
and they ate sacrifices
offered to the dead.
29They did such terrible things
that you punished them
with a deadly disease.
30But Phinehas helped them,
and the sickness stopped.
31Now he will always
be highly honored.
32 At Meribah Spring
they turned against you
and made you furious.
33Then Moses got into trouble
for speaking in anger.
34 Our Lord, they disobeyed you
by refusing to destroy
the nations.
35Instead they were friendly
with those foreigners
and followed their customs.
36Then they fell into the trap
of worshiping idols.
37 They sacrificed their sons
and their daughters to demons
38 and to the gods of Canaan.
Then they poured out the blood
of these innocent children
and made the land filthy.
39By doing such gruesome things,
they also became filthy.
40 Finally, Lord, you were angry
and terribly disgusted
with your people.
41So you put them in the power
of nations that hated them.
42They were mistreated and abused
by their enemies,
43but you saved them
time after time.
They were determined to rebel,
and their sins caused
their downfall.
44You answered their prayers
when they were in trouble.
45You kept your agreement
and were so merciful
46that their enemies
had pity on them.
47 Save us, Lord God!
Bring us back
from among the nations.
Let us celebrate and shout
in praise of your holy name.
48 Lord God of Israel,
you deserve to be praised
forever and ever.
Let everyone say, “Amen!
Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ lamma!
1Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei,
se o tiini o lamma.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
2Wɔ mo wó wane o lwoni
Baŋa Wɛ totoŋ-kamunnu tem?
Wɔ mo yi se kotu wane o tei‑o
se ko maŋe?
3Ko ná ye balo na toŋe chega
ba pa ba dwonna
ye ba yɔɔre ba ke kolo na maŋe to,
Wɛ wó ke zaane o ke ba yuu ne.
4Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nam guli amo gula,
ne n na boŋe se n ke n nɔɔna lanyerane tei to.
Nmo ná tu se n jwoŋi-ba n yage,
se n ta‑n yei amo de ni ne.
5A laam wó tɔge de balo
n na kuri to
se a na yiga-veiŋa.
A ta wó da a na wopwolo kolo
n teo kom nɔɔna na nae to,
ye a tɔge de n tete nɔɔna bam
a taa jege teera nmo ŋwaane.
6Debam ke wɛleera mo,
ne dé nabaara bam de déem
na ke tei to.
Dé sage chwoŋa
ye dé tiini dé toŋe lwarem.
7Dé nabaara bam déem na wo
Ejipti ne to,
ba yiga tera wo-kenkagela yalo
nmo na ke to wone.
Ba ma swei swono kolo
nmo na jege de-ba to ni ne.
Ba déem na vei ba yi
Nane-soŋo kom ni ne to,
mo ba lɔge nmo kwaga ne.
8De konto maama de,
Wɛ déem ta jwoŋi-ba mo o yage
o tete yere dem ŋwaane,
se o wane o bere
o dam-fɔrɔ kom na ye tei to.
9O ma bage Nane-soŋo kom pa se
ko na bam pwɛ ba daare te-kora.
O laam ma pa o nɔɔna bam
nɔne te-kora kam baŋa ne
ba bɛ na-fɔrɔ kom,
ne ka na ye kagoa mo ba bɛ tei to.
10O déem jwoŋi-ba o yage
balo na chuli-ba to jeŋa ne ,
se ba dona daa yé taa jege dam
ba baŋa ne.
11Na-fwaaro tem déem jwoori
te ke daane
te pu ba dona bam maama.
Ba dona bam wolowolo
maa wo lugi na bam wone.
12Konto kwaga ne
o nɔɔna bam laam sɛ we
o taane dem ye chega mo,
ye ba daare ba leeni ba tei‑o.
13Ko déem nam wo dáane
ye ba swei o na ke tei o pa-ba to.
Ba daa wo sɛ
se ba cheigi Wɛ bera yam.
14Ba maa na wo kagoa yuu ne to,
ba fera yam déem ware ya ja,
ye ba daare ba maŋe Wɛ ba nii.
15Wɛ ma pa-ba ba na beeri kolo to,
ye o ta kwei jawe-chɛɔ o woli da
o ke ba yuu ne.
16Nɔɔna bam na pugi ba vwoa
kagoa wone to,
ba déem jege kazwe
de Moses de Aron.
Aron nam ye kaanem tu wolo Baŋa Wɛ tete na kuri to.
17Konto ŋwaane mo tega kam
déem yare belei
ka pɔpɔ ka li Datan,
ka daare ka suli Abiram
de o kɔgɔ kom.
18Mini déem mo to banto
kwaga tɔgena bam tetare ne,
pa se de zwɛ puseŋ-nyena bam konto maama kula.
19Ba na kɛ ba yi Sinayi peo kom to
mo ba déem kwei luu
ba mɔ na-mɔra nyenyego
ye ba daare ba zuli-ko.
20Konto to, ba déem nwoŋi Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne
ye ba pipiri ba zuli na-bala nyenyego kom konto,
de ka na ye varem wolo na done gaao to de.
21-22Ba déem swei ba Tu Wɛ wom swia,
de o na ye wolo
na jwoŋi-ba o yage
ye o ta ke wo-kamunnu Ejipti ne,
de wo-kenkagela Nane-soŋo kom
ni ne o pa-ba to.
23Konto ŋwaane Wɛ boboŋa ma ja
se o chɔge-ba.
Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses nam zege
ba de Wɛ tetare laŋa ne,
pa se o che Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom
se o daa yé chɔge-ba.
24Nɔɔna bam déem ta ma gwooni
te-ywoŋa kalo Wɛ na lage
o pa-ba to.
Kokuri to, ba wo sɛ we Wɛ wó seene o ke o tɔge o ni dem.
25Ba maa maŋe ba vwoa yam wone
ye ba poone Wɛ.
Ba maa wo sɛ se ba ke
Baŋa Wɛ ni dem ne.
26Ko ma pa Wɛ seene o yia
o du duuri we,
o lage o pa ba te kagoa kam yuu ne,
27ye o daare o jage ba kwaga kam
o yage dwi-gɛ tiina bam tetare ne,
se ba te sa-teene wone.
28Wɛ nɔɔna bam déem ta kwei ba tete
ba sale Baal-Peora jwoni dem yera ne mo.
Ba ma tɔge ba di wodiiru telo
ba na kaane ba pa chira to.
29Ba totoŋ-naga kam konto
déem mo chuchugi Wɛ bane,
ye o pa se jawe-chɛɔ to ba tetare ne.
30Finehase nam zaŋe o che chwoŋa
se jawe-chɛɔ kom daa yé
chɔge nɔɔna bam.
31O keim dem konto ŋwaane mo
Wɛ pɛ se o na chega,
o de o kwaga kam
se ko taa vei wuu.
32Ba déem ta na wo Meriba
buli-yi dem seeni to,
mo ba daa ta chuchugi Wɛ bane.
Ba keim dem konto
déem jaane daanem mo de ba
de pa Moses.
33Kokuri, o déem wo boŋe o yi
ye o ta ta-yɔɔ,
nɔɔna bam na pɛ o bane zaŋe to ŋwaane.
34Ba maa wo chɔge dwi-gɛ tiina balo
déem na zoore te-ywoŋa kam wone to,
ne Baŋa Wɛ ya na pɛ-ba ni
se ba ke tei to.
35Ba nam gwaane de dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto mo,
pa se ba lɛɛre ba ke ba tɔge
banto chullu tem.
36Ba déem ta tɔge ba kaane
banto jwona yam,
ye konto mo jaane chɔgem
ko ba ba yuni ne.
37Ba déem jege ba tete bia mo
ba kaane ba pa tangwana.
38Konto to, ba go balo
na wo maŋe se ba te to,
de ba na kwei ba bia,
bakeiri de busankane,
ba ma ba kaane Kanaan tiina jwona yam tei to.
Jana bam konto pɛ se ba ja
ba tega kam mo ba chɔge.
39Ba ta ma biini ba tete
de ba totoŋ-zɔɔna yam konto.
Ba keina yam bere we
ba daa ba jege chega de Wɛ.
40 Baŋa Wɛ ban-lom dem déem yɔɔre
de zaŋe o nɔɔna bam baŋa ne mo,
pa se o ve balo ya na ye
o tete nyɔn-mage nyem to.
41O ma kwei-ba o ke
dwi-gɛ tiina bam jeŋa ne.
Balo na chuli-ba to mo
laam di paare ba baŋa ne.
42Ba dona bam konto ma tiini
ba bɛɛse-ba,
de ba na di dam ba baŋa ne tei to.
43Kuni dedɛ mo Wɛ yeini o vere-ba
ba dona jeŋa ne o yage.
Ba boboŋa nam jaane mo
se ba lɔ Wɛ kwaga ne.
Ko ma pa se ba bugi ba jei
ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane.
44Konto maama wone de,
Wɛ nɔɔna bam na yeini
ba keeri ba jare‑o to,
o yiga ta wo ba yaara yam wone mo.
45O ma tɔge o ni-gwonim dem
baŋa ne o duri ba ŋwaŋa,
pa se o bane dem zuri
o swono kom ŋwaane.
46O déem pɛ se balo na yeini
ba wane-ba ba di to
jege ba yibwona mo.
47Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, jan ja!
Jwoŋi debam n yage!
Le debam dwi-gɛ tiina bam
tetare ne n ke daane,
se n pa dé jwoori dé tete teo kom.
Dé laam wó ke nmo lei,
n yere dem na ye wose to ŋwaane,
ye dé daare dé taa tei‑m
n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
48Pa-na dé taa tei Baŋa Wɛ wom
na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to!
Wonto maŋe de tia mo
ko zege faŋa faŋa
se ko taa vei wuu.
Pa-na se nɔɔna maama ta we,
“Ameena!”
Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
BOOK V
(Psalms 107–150)
The Lord Is Good to His People
1 Shout praises to the Lord!
He is good to us,
and his love never fails.
2Everyone the Lord has rescued
from trouble
should praise him,
3everyone he has brought
from the east and the west,
the north and the south.
4Some of you were lost
in the scorching desert,
far from a town.
5You were hungry and thirsty
and about to give up.
6You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
7At once he brought you
to a town.
8You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
9To everyone who is thirsty,
he gives something to drink;
to everyone who is hungry,
he gives good things to eat.
10Some of you were prisoners
suffering in deepest darkness
and bound by chains,
11because you had rebelled
against God Most High
and refused his advice.
12You were worn out
from working like slaves,
and no one came to help.
13You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
14He brought you out
of the deepest darkness
and broke your chains.
15You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
16He breaks down bronze gates
and shatters iron locks.
17Some of you had foolishly
committed a lot of sins
and were in terrible pain.
18The very thought of food
was disgusting to you,
and you were almost dead.
19You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
20By the power of his own word,
he healed you and saved you
from destruction.
21You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
22You should celebrate
by offering sacrifices
and singing joyful songs
to tell what he has done.
23Some of you made a living
by sailing the mighty sea,
24and you saw the miracles
the Lord performed there.
25At his command a storm arose,
and waves covered the sea.
26You were tossed to the sky
and to the ocean depths,
until things looked so bad
that you lost your courage.
27You staggered like drunkards
and gave up all hope.
28You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
29He made the storm stop
and the sea be quiet.
30You were happy because of this,
and he brought you to the port
where you wanted to go.
31You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
32Honor the Lord
when you and your leaders
meet to worship.
33If you start doing wrong,
the Lord will turn rivers
into deserts,
34 flowing streams
into scorched land,
and fruitful fields
into beds of salt.
35But the Lord can also turn
deserts into lakes
and scorched land
into flowing streams.
36If you are hungry,
you can settle there
and build a town.
37You can plant fields
and vineyards that produce
a good harvest.
38The Lord will bless you
with many children
and with herds of cattle.
39Sometimes you may be crushed
by troubles and sorrows,
until only a few of you
are left to survive.
40But the Lord will take revenge
on those who conquer you,
and he will make them wander
across desert sands.
41When you are suffering
and in need,
he will come to your rescue,
and your families will grow
as fast as a herd of sheep.
42You will see this because
you obey the Lord,
but everyone who is wicked
will be silenced.
43Be wise! Remember this
and think about the kindness
of the Lord.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o nii o nɔɔna baŋa ne
1Pa se dé ke-na
Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o lamma.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
2 Baŋa Wɛ na vere balo
o ja nwoŋi cham wone to
jege se ba taa tɛ ko taane jaja,
o na jwoŋi-ba ba dona jeŋa ne to ŋwaane.
3Ba na jage ba yi logo baŋa
sapɛ sena sem to
mo o lage-ba o ke daane
o ja jwoori ba tete teo kom.
4Ba badwonna déem kare
kagoa wone mo
ba beeri yɔɔ yerane.
Ba beeri chwoŋa ba ga
se ba wane ba yi teo
ye ba daare ba jeini ko wone.
5Kana dedaane na-nyɔm
ma tiini ko chɛ-ba.
Ba déem gɛ fee mo se ba te.
6Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane mo
ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ.
O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage
ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.
7O ma ja-ba o de chwoŋa kalo
na yɔɔre to wone,
pa se ba vo ba yi teo kolo
ba na wó taa zoore ko wone to.
8Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo,
o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane.
O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela
o pa nabiina.
9O goe nɔɔna na-nyɔm,
ye o daare o pae kana na jege balo to wo-laaro,
se ba taa di ba sui.
10Ba badaara déem ye peena mo
ba na vɔge-ba de chegero.
Ba maa jei lim wone
de wo-chechɔgɔ.
11Kokuri to, ba déem ve
Wɛ kwora kam mo.
Ba maa jege Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ bera yam ba gwoona.
12O ma pa se ba yera chɛ
de totoŋ-dɛɛra.
Ba ma chɔɔle ba to tega ne
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se o woli-ba.
13Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane,
mo ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ.
O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage
ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.
14O ma ja-ba o nwoŋi lim delo
na kwoli-ba to wone.
O ma kɔ ba chegero tem o yage
se ba sii.
15Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo,
o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane.
O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela
o pa nabiina.
16Ko ná ye ni bworru telo
ba na mɛ channa ba ke
ye te fɔge te pe teo kom to,
Baŋa Wɛ popoge-te o de tega ne.
O ta daare o ja te luuru tem
o kɔ o yage.
17Nɔɔna bam badaara tɔge jworim mo.
Ba déem nɛ cham dedɛ
ba zwabania kikia
de ba tusim ŋwaane.
18Ba daa ba lage wodiu se ba di,
ye ko gɛ fee se ba te.
19Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane mo
ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ.
O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage
ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.
20O ma toŋe o kwora se ka yi-ba,
ye ba na ba yazura.
O ma jwoŋi-ba toone jeŋa ne o yage.
21Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo,
o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane.
O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela
o pa nabiina.
22Ko maŋe se ba ja lei-keim pɛɛra
ba ke kaanem ba pa‑o.
Ba wó guli o totoŋ-kamuna yam,
ye ba daare ba leeni de wopwolo
ya ŋwaane.
23Ba badaara déem diini nabwooru mo
ba tɔge naneo kom wo ba via.
Ba ma kare ba beeri
na-fwaaro tem baŋa ne
ye ba na nyɔɔre pipiu ŋwaane.
24Ba ma na Baŋa Wɛ totoŋa yam
na daga tei na-luŋa jei sem ne to.
25O yeini o pa ni
ye vo-dɛɔ zaŋe ko fuli dedɛ.
Na bam ma foore ba di baŋa,
pa se na-ŋone jwoŋi
naneo kom jei maama.
26Na bam ma dole nabwooru tem
ba yage wɛɛne,
ye te jwoori te tu tega kuri kuri.
Yuŋina bam vɔna ma pare,
cham na tiini de ja-ba to ŋwaane
27Ba yeini ba kare ba jijiri mo
ne sa-nyɔra na ke tei to
Ba swa muri
pa se ba yeiri ba na wó ke tei to.
28Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane mo
ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ.
O ma vere-ba o yage
ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.
29O laam ma pa vo-dɛɔ kom
maŋe da chemm.
Na-ŋone sem de ya na fufugi to
ke ziim.
30Yuŋina bam wo ma pwoli,
ba na nɛ siu ba cham dem wone to ŋwaane.
Wɛ ma ja-ba o ja o yi bubɛ delo
ba ya na lage ba yi to.
31Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo,
o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane.
O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela
o pa nabiina.
32Ko maŋe se ba vo ba zege
Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne
ba zeiŋi o yere,
se ba daare ba zuli‑o
nakwa bam yiga ne.
33 Baŋa Wɛ déem mo pɛ se bwi we fase
ye jei sem ji kagoa yerane.
O ma pa se buli-yia na bam jei
ye tega kam maama ko.
34Tega kalo ya na ke wodiiru lanyerane to ma ji
tega kalo na ye yɛ yerane to mo,
balo ya na zoore ka baŋa ne to
puseŋa kikia ŋwaane.
35 Baŋa Wɛ nam ta pɛ
se kagoa pipiri ka ji jei selo
bwi na daga da to mo.
Na dedɛ de buri ba bugi te-kora.
36O ma ja balo kana na wɔe to
o pa-ba jeiŋa jei
tega kam konto baŋa ne.
Ba ma bobo teo kuri
se ba taa zoore ko wone.
37Ba ma va kare ba du wodiiru
se wone,
ye ba che kadwi
se ba ma jeiri Vini teeni.
Ba na dugi kolo maama to
ke wodiiru lanyerane.
38 Baŋa Wɛ maa swɛ ba swolim
pa se ba kɔgɔ kom puli dedɛ.
Ba vara bam de daga
ba maa vei yiga.
39Ba laam ta ma daare ba na cham
de wo-chechɔgɔ,
ye ba dona bɛɛse-ba,
pa se ba na ba chaveera.
40 Baŋa Wɛ nam pae se nɔn-yum
di ba chaveera mo,
ye o daare o pae ba kare kagoa
yuu ne ba beeri yɔɔ yerane.
41Ko nam ná ye nabwona,
o yeini o jwoŋi-ba o ja nwoŋi
ba yaara yam wone.
O maa pae ba dwi dem puli dedɛ
ne pei-kɔgɔ to.
42Nɔn-laaro mo nii ba na Wɛ kikia
ye ba wo pwoli dedɛ.
Puseŋ-nyena nia yam maama
nam yɔɔre ya pu mo.
43Wolo maama ná ye swa tu,
kotu jege se o taa guli
kikia yam konto maama,
se o yé swei Baŋa Wɛ swono kom
na wora taa wuu to ni ne.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by David.)
With God on Our Side
1Our God, I am faithful to you
with all my heart,
and you can trust me.
I will sing
and play music for you
with all that I am.
2I will start playing my harps
before the sun rises.
3I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear;
I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
4Your love reaches higher
than the heavens,
and your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
5Our God, may you be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6Answer my prayers
and use your powerful arm
to give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
7Our God, from your holy place
you made this promise:
“I will gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
8The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is my symbol
of royal power.
9Moab is merely my washbasin,
and Edom belongs to me.
I shout with victory
over the Philistines.”
10Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress
or lead me to Edom?
11Have you rejected us?
You don't lead our armies.
12Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
13Only you give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Wɛ wo debam tei ne
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo Tu Wɛ, a wo kom yɔɔre ko da nmo mo.
Konto to, a lage a leeni lei
a seini‑m de a wo maama.
2A ta wó kwei kwanno dwi dwi mo a ta
se te kwori zaŋe baŋa baŋa.
Tega ná poore,
a wó zaŋe lela a leeni lei!
3 Baŋa Wɛ, a wó ke nmo lei
nɔɔna bam maama yiga ne.
A ta wó leeni lei a seini‑m
logo baŋa dwi tiina maama tetare ne.
4N swono kom zege mo taa,
ye ko geene ko di wɛyuu.
Nmo na zege n chega wone tei to
mo tiini ko yala se ko gaale kunkwonnu tem.
5Amo Tu Wɛ, pa n yere zaŋe
wɛyuu maama ne!
Pa se n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ taa nae
logo baŋa jei maama ne!
6Popo, leiri a wɛ-lworo kom.
Kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom
n ma n jwoŋi debam n yage.
Konto to, n nɔn-swonnu tem
wó taa tei ba tete.
7Wɛ zege o tete diga kam ne mo
o ta we:
“Amo wó bere a dam jaja
a chɛ chɛ Sɛkɛm laŋa kam,
ye a daare a maŋe Sukofa bwolo kom
a pɔɔre a pa a nɔɔna bam.
8Gilead laŋa kam ye amo nyem,
ko ta woli de Manasɛ laŋa kam de.
Efrayim maa nye de a yu-gwoŋo kom.
Judah de maa nye de
a paare nacheiga kam.
9Ko ná ye Moaba laŋa kam,
dáane mo a lage a taa sane a je sem.
A ta lage a dole a natere
Edom teo kom seeni mo,
se ko bere we a tei-ko.
A kwora maa wó bage ka yage
Filisi tiina bam seeni,
a na wane-ba a di to ŋwaane.”
10Wɔ nam mo wó ja amo o vo
teo kolo na lɔge ko pe to wone?
Wɔ mo wó ja-ne o vo
o yi Edom teo kom?
11Debam Tu Wɛ, nmo nam nwoŋi
dé kwaga ne mo na?
Dé ná nwoŋi se dé kwaare jara,
n daa‑n bá‑n tɔge dé yiga
se dé vo na?
12Ja, woli debam
se dé wane dé dona bam.
Nabiina na jege wolim delo to maama ba jege kuri.
13Wɛ nam ná wo debam tei ne,
dé wó wane dé dona bam dé di.
Wonto wó nɔne-ba o meere
o pa debam.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1I praise you, God!
Don't keep silent.
2Destructive and deceitful lies
are told about me,
3and hateful things are said
for no reason.
4I had pity and prayed
for my enemies,
but their words to me
were harsh and cruel.
5For being friendly and kind,
they paid me back
with meanness and hatred.
6My enemies said,
“Find some worthless fools
to accuse him of a crime.
7Try him and find him guilty!
Consider his prayers a lie.
8 Cut his life short
and let someone else
have his job.
9Make orphans of his children
and a widow of his wife;
10make his children beg for food
and live in the slums.
11“Let the people he owes
take everything he owns.
Give it all to strangers.
12Don't let anyone be kind to him
or have pity on the children
he leaves behind.
13Bring an end to his family,
and from now on let him be
a forgotten man.
14“Don't let the Lord forgive
the sins of his parents
and his ancestors.
15Don't let the Lord forget
the sins of his family,
or let anyone remember
his family ever lived.
16He was so cruel to the poor,
homeless, and discouraged
that they died young.
17“He cursed others.
Now place a curse on him!
He never wished others well.
Wish only trouble for him!
18He cursed others more often
than he dressed himself.
Let his curses strike him deep,
just as water and olive oil
soak through to our bones.
19Let his curses surround him,
just like the belt and clothes
he wears each day.”
20Those are the cruel things
my enemies wish for me.
Let it all happen to them!
21Be true to your name, Lord God!
Show your great kindness
and rescue me.
22I am poor and helpless,
and I have lost all hope.
23I am fading away
like an evening shadow;
I am tossed aside
like a crawling insect.
24I have gone without eating,
until my knees are weak,
and my body is bony.
25 When my enemies see me,
they say cruel things
and shake their heads.
26Please help me, Lord God!
Come and save me
because of your love.
27Let others know that you alone
have saved me.
28I don't care if they curse me,
as long as you bless me.
You will make my enemies fail
when they attack,
and you will make me glad
to be your servant.
29You will cover them with shame,
just as their bodies
are covered with clothes.
30I will sing your praises
and thank you, Lord,
when your people meet.
31You help everyone in need,
and you save them from death.
translation_text:
David wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane
1Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo na maŋe se a taa tei‑m to,
yé ta‑n ye chemm.
2Puseŋ-nyena de nɔn-ŋollo jege amo kwaga mo ba chwoa.
Ba maa fɔe vwa ba daŋe a baŋa ne.
3Sebaŋa ta-dwoa yerane mo
ba mɛ ba gilimi-ne.
A maa wo ke kolokolo
ye ba daa ta jege dedaane-ne.
4Ba maa zage-ne ni-chɛɛre,
de amo na duri ba ŋwaŋa
tei maama to de.
Amo nam ta wó taa lwoori Wɛ
a pa-ba mo.
5A ná yeini a ke-ba lanyerane,
ba wó jwoori ba ke-ne zonne.
A ta ná jege ba swono,
ba maa wó ja puseŋa ba jeeri-ne.
6Nam beeri puseŋ-nyeno
se kotu di a dono wom taane.
Ta pa se o seba-nyeno zaŋe
o saŋe‑o.
7Ba maa ná di o taane dem,
se ba ta we, o toa.
Kwei o wɛ-lworo tete
se ko taa ye wɛleere.
8Pa se o ŋwea da yam ti lela.
Ta pa se nɔɔno wodwoŋi
leiri wonto yuu ne
o taa toŋe o totoŋa yam.
9Sɛ se o bia ji botara mo,
se o kaane wom de ji kadeim.
10Pa se o bia taa kare jei maama
ba lwoori wodiu se ba di.
Ba maa wó taa zoore
di-dwonnu wone,
ye ba yeini ba nwoŋi dáa ne
ba lwoori wolim.
11Sɛ se o na di jene
nɔɔno wolo tei ne to
zaŋe o ba o jwoŋi a dono wom jejegero tem maama,
se veira de ba ba vere o na yaare o na kolo maama to ba taa tei.
12Yé pa pwola se nɔɔn-nɔɔno
duri kotu de o bia balo
o na tege o daare to yibwona.
13Nam pa se o dwi dem maama saare,
se dwi delo na saŋe to
swei ba swia lela.
14 Baŋa Wɛ, yé fɔge n swei
o nabaara bam na ke wɛleera yalo dwi maama to.
Nam yé saare o nu tusim kɔtaa.
15Ta‑n guli ba wɛleera yam konto taa,
se n daare n pa se ba dwi dem
daa yé taa jege yere logo baŋa ne.
16Kokuri to, a dono wom yiga tera
nabwona wone
se o taa ke-ba lanyerane.
O nam bɛɛse yiniga tiina
de balo wo na chɔge to mo,
pa ba vo ba te.
17O maa swoi se o taa sɔɔle lwarem
o yage o dwonna baŋa ne.
Nam pa se sensɔle-balɔrɔ
taa dɔge o tete yuu ne!
O maa ba fɔge o lage se
o ke zaane nɔɔn-nɔɔno yuu ne.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno de nam bá ke zaane
kotu yuu ne!
18O me de sɔɔlem taane mo,
nenɛɛne de ye gɔrɔ kolo
o na jege o zoore to.
De maa nye de na balo
o na yeini o nyɔa
pa se ba tu o wo to,
de nuga kalo o na mɛ
o turi o yera to.
19Nam pa se o sensɔle-balɔrɔ kom
meeli o yera,
ne gɔrɔ kolo o na zo to.
Pa se ko taa nye de kila
kalo o na vɔga o teiŋa ne to.
20Ko ná ye balo na jege amo kwaga
ba chwo
ye ba ta zage-ne ni-chɛɛre to,
Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se ba jwoori
ba na waarem konto dwoŋi.
21Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nam da n yere dem ŋwaane
n nii amo baŋa ne lanyerane.
Jwoŋi-ne n yage,
n swono kolo na ye chekke to ŋwaane.
22Kokuri to, amo tiini a bwona mo lage-lage
ye yiniga de jege-ne.
A bochare de maa tiini de di.
23A lage a jei lela mo,
nenɛɛne lunluŋu na yeini ko ke tei dedaan-ni seeni to.
Ba lage ba peili-ne ba yage dáa ne,
nenɛɛne kayera dwoŋi to.
24A nadwoona maa mage daane
a kana na tiini ka wɔe to ŋwaane.
A yera yam tiini ya bugi,
pa se ya daare kwi yerane mo.
25Balo na dwoni de amo to
jege-ne ba gwoona.
Ba maa ná yeini ba na-ne,
ba dole ba yuni tem mo
amo ŋwaane.
26Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ba n zeini-ne!
Da n swono kom ŋwaane
n jwoŋi-ne n yage.
27Pa se a dona bam na n dam dem,
se ba wane ba lɔre we
ko ye nmo mo woli-ne.
28Ba laam wó wane ba sɔɔle lwarem
ba yage amo yuu ne,
se nmo nam wó ke zaane mo
n ke a yuu ne.
Ba ná boŋe se ba bɛɛse-ne,
ba maa wó na ba chaveera.
A nam wó di ywoni mo,
a na ye nmo tontoŋeno to ŋwaane.
29Chega to, chaveera wó di balo
na jege a kwaga kam ba chwo to.
Kuri-nɔrɔ maa ye gɔrɔ kolo
ba na wó zo to.
30A lage a puri a ni
a tiini a ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo.
A maa wó zege nɔn-kɔgɔ tetare ne
a tei‑o.
31Kokuri to, o yeini o zege nabwom jazem seeni se o woli‑o.
O ta maa yeini o vere kotu o yaga
balo na lage ba pa o to
de o bora to jeŋa ne.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Lord Gives Victory
1 The Lord said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right side,
until I make your enemies
into a footstool for you.”
2The Lord will let your power
reach out from Zion,
and you will rule
over your enemies.
3Your glorious power
will be seen on the day
you begin to rule.
You will wear the sacred robes
