and shine like the morning sun
in all of your strength.
4 The Lord has made a promise
that will never be broken:
“You will be a priest forever,
just like Melchizedek.”
5The Lord is at your right side,
and when he gets angry
he will crush
the other kings.
6He will judge the nations
and crack their skulls,
leaving piles of dead bodies
all over the earth.
7He will drink from any stream
that he chooses, while winning
victory after victory.
translation_text:
Pɛ wolo Baŋa Wɛ na kuri to taane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ tage
de amo Teiru wom o we:
“Ba n jeini amo jazem seeni,
se amo laam wane n dona bam
a ke nmo dam kuri ne
se n ta‑n tei-ba.”
2 Baŋa Wɛ wó pa n paare dam-fɔrɔ kom yale ko yi jei maama.
Nmo wó di paare Zion ne
ye n wane n dona bam
na gilimi abam to.
3N ná zaŋe n nwoŋi de dam
dɛ delo wone,
nmo nɔɔna bam wó tɔge n kwaga
de wopwolo
Wɛ tete zwonnu tem yuu ne.
Tega ná poore tetete,
nmo nɔn-donno tem wó ba nmo tei,
ne nyɔnɔ na yeini ko to
zezeŋa ne tei to.
4 Baŋa Wɛ dugi duuri mo
ye o daa bá fɔge o za o ni.
O tage o we, “Nmo wó ta‑n ye amo kaanem tu taa wuu,
ne Melkizedeka faŋa faŋa
na ye tei to.”
5Dé Teiru Wɛ wom maa wo
n jazem seeni.
O ban-zɔŋɔ dɛ dem ne
o wó wane pwa o de tega ne.
6O lage o di dwi-gɛ tiina bam taane,
ye o waare-ba
se ba twa bam mo faare
tega kam jei maama ne.
Ko ta ná ye logo baŋa maama pwa bam
o lage o chochoge
ba yu-kwoli sem mo.
7O ná wo chwoŋa yuu ne o via,
bu-nɔgɔ wó taa wora,
ye o nyɔ na se o yera taa zura.
Konto ŋwaane,
o wó kwoni o yuu wɛɛne,
ye o zege de dam.

english_text:
Praise the Lord for All He Has Done
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all my heart
I will thank the Lord
when his people meet.
2The Lord has done
many wonderful things!
Everyone who is pleased
with God's marvelous deeds
will keep them in mind.
3Everything the Lord does
is glorious and majestic,
and his power to bring justice
will never end.
4The Lord God is famous
for his wonderful deeds,
and he is kind and merciful.
5He gives food to his worshipers
and always keeps his agreement
with them.
6He has shown his mighty power
to his people
and has given them the lands
of other nations.
7God is always honest and fair,
and his laws can be trusted.
8They are true and right
and will stand forever.
9God rescued his people,
and he will never break
his agreement with them.
He is fearsome and holy.
10 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the first step
to wisdom and good sense.
God will always be respected.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ totoŋ-kamuna yam taane
1Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Amo wó ke Baŋa Wɛ lei
de a wo maama
Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne,
ne nɔn-laaro ná jeeri daane.
2 Baŋa Wɛ tiini o toŋe
totoŋ-kamuna dedɛ.
Balo maama wo na pwoli
de o kikia to
wó taa boŋe ya boboŋa mo
maŋa maama.
3O totoŋa yam jege zula mo
dedaane nenɔŋa.
O na zege o chega wone tei to
wó taa wora wuu.
4O na yɔɔre o ke
wo-kenkagela yalo to,
nɔɔna wó taa guli ya gula.
Baŋa Wɛ ye zaane tu
de yibwona tu mo.
5O maa pae balo na kɔre‑o to
ba ni-wodiu.
O na gwoni o ni de o nɔɔna bam tei to,
o ta wó ke se ko tɔge de
o ni-gwonim dem taa wuu.
6O déem kwei dwi-gɛ tiina
ya na tei tega kalo to
o pa o nɔɔna bam,
se ba wane ba lɔre
o na toŋe de dam tei to.
7O na yeini o ke totoŋa yalo to
jege chega.
Ya maa pae se chega kam toŋa.
O bera yam maama maŋe
se nɔɔna taa tɔge-ya mo.
8Ya wó taa zega
se ko taa vei wuu.
Ya maŋe se nɔɔna ke ba chega
dedaane-ya,
se ba daare ba ke
ya na bere tei to mo.
9Wɛ déem ke woŋo se o vere
o nɔɔna bam o yage.
Ko ná ye ni delo
o na gwoni de-ba to,
o bá yiri-de kɔtaa.
O yere dem yɔɔre de ye wose mo,
ye de tiini de jege foone dedɛ.
10Nabiina na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ mɛ to,
yi-poro de puli dáane mo.
Balo maama na toŋe ba tɔge
o bera yam to
wó taa jege yeino lanyerane.
Wɛ maŋe se nɔɔna taa tei‑o
se ko taa vei wuu.

english_text:
God Blesses His Worshipers
1Shout praises to the Lord!
The Lord blesses everyone
who worships him and gladly
obeys his teachings.
2Their descendants will have
great power in the land,
because the Lord blesses
all who do right.
3They will get rich and prosper
and will always be remembered
for their fairness.
4They will be so kind
and merciful and good,
that they will be a light
in the dark for others
who do the right thing.
5Life will go well for those
who freely lend
and are honest in business.
6They won't ever be troubled,
and the kind things they do
will never be forgotten.
7Bad news won't bother them;
they have decided
to trust the Lord.
8They are dependable
and not afraid,
and they will live to see
their enemies defeated.
9 They will always be remembered
and greatly praised,
because they were kind
and freely gave to the poor.
10When evil people see this,
they angrily bite their tongues
and disappear.
They will never get
what they really want.
translation_text:
Wɛ woli nɔn-ŋona
1Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Nɔɔno wolo ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ
ye o pae se Wɛ nia yam
jege ywoni ya pa‑o,
Wɛ zaane wo kotu yuu ne lanyerane.
2O bia bam tete wó na yere
tega kam baŋa ne.
Wɛ wó yɔɔre o swɛ nɔn-ŋona
dwi dem swolim.
3Kotu sɔŋɔ kom wó na jejegero
dwi dwi.
Nɔɔna maa bá fɔge ba swei
o nɔn-ŋonne kikia ni ne.
4Ko ná ye balo na yɔɔre
chwo-laao wone ba vei to,
pwooni wó zeiŋi de pa-ba,
de ba na maŋe ba wo
lim jei wone to de.
Ko wó ke konto ko pa nɔn-ŋom wolo maama
na jege nɔɔna yibwona
ye o pae se chega toŋa to.
5Ko ta ná ye wolo wo na ywomma
pa se o jene wonnu mo
o pa o dwonna,
ye o totoŋe maama toŋe
de tɔge de chwoŋa to,
wonnu wó ke lanyerane
te pa kotu mo.
6Nɔn-ŋom nam bá fɔge o seeri o to.
Nɔɔna de bá swei o swia
se ko taa vei wuu.
7Kwor-balɔrɔ nam ná yi‑o,
o bá taa kɔre foone.
O jege baare mo
ye o wo kom yɔɔre ko da Baŋa Wɛ.
8O boboŋa maa zege chega kam wone
ye foone ba jege‑o.
O laam maa wó ba
o wane o dona o di.
9Kotu pɔɔre o wonnu
o pa yiniga tiina zɛɛra mo.
O nɔn-ŋonne dem wó taa wo
o tei ne maŋa maama.
O maa wó tiini o na dam,
pa se nɔɔna zeiŋi o yere dem wɛɛne.
10Puseŋ-nyena wó na konto maama
ye ba bana taa zaŋa ko ŋwaane.
Ba maa wó done ba nwa
lwia ŋwaane,
ye ba taa bugi ba jia.
Puseŋ-nyena bam fera ná zo
woŋo kolo maama,
ba nam bá na-ko kɔtaa.

english_text:
The Lord Helps People in Need
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Everyone who serves him,
come and praise his name.
2Let the name of the Lord
be praised now and forever.
3From dawn until sunset
the name of the Lord
deserves to be praised.
4The Lord is far above
all of the nations;
he is more glorious
than the heavens.
5No one can compare
with the Lord our God.
His throne is high above,
6and he looks down to see
the heavens and the earth.
7God lifts the poor and needy
from dust and ashes,
8and he lets them take part
in ruling his people.
9When a wife has no children,
he blesses her with some,
and she is happy.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ lamma!
1Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Abam balo na ye o tontoŋena to,
tei-o-na!
Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ yere dem!
2Pa-na se dé tei Baŋa Wɛ yere dem,
ko zege leile se ko taa vei wuu.
3Ko na zege wɛ-puli seeni
se ko vo ko yi wɛ-zoore seeni to,
ko maŋe se jei maama nɔɔna mo
taa tei Baŋa Wɛ.
4 Baŋa Wɛ jege dam mo logo baŋa
teene dem maama baŋa ne.
O nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nae jaja mo
wɛyuu kom maama ne.
5Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ dwoŋi tera.
O maa jei o paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne wɛ-wɛ,
6ye wɛyuu de tega kam maama wo kuri kuri.
O laam maa tiiri o nii
o nae te maama.
7 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o zeini yiniga tiina mo
pa se ba nwoŋi bworu wone
ba na jeiŋa jei.
O ta ma le nabwona
tampuuri baŋa ne
se ba wane ba na ba tete.
8O ma ja-ba o vo o jeini
teo kom dedɛɛra tei ne,
se nɔɔna taa nege-ba.
9Ko nam ná ye kadega de,
Wɛ wó pa kotu lo bia,
se o wane o di ywoni
o sɔŋɔ kom wone.
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
The Lord Works Wonders
1 God brought his people
out of Egypt, that land
with a strange language.
2He made Judah his holy place
and ruled over Israel.
3 When the sea looked at God,
it ran away,
and the Jordan River
flowed upstream.
4The mountains and the hills
skipped around like goats.
5Ask the sea why it ran away
or ask the Jordan
why it flowed upstream.
6Ask the mountains and the hills
why they skipped like goats!
7Earth, you will tremble,
when the Lord God of Jacob
comes near,
8 because he turns solid rock
into flowing streams
and pools of water.
translation_text:
Wɛ na wo o nɔɔna tei ne tei to
1Wɛ déem le Isarele tiina bam na ye Jakob dwi tiina to
Ejipti tiina bam jeŋa ne,
pa se ba nwoŋi dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto tetare ne.
2Wɛ déem na ke konto to,
o laam pɛ se Judah dwi tiina
kateiri dem mo ji o wara-jei.
O ma di paare Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne.
3Naneo kom déem nii ko na
ko na ye tei to mo,
ye ko tutwoni dáa ko daare pwola.
Jɔdan buga kam de ma pipiri
ka kɛ dáa.
4Peero tem de zwonnu tem
déem ziziŋi mo,
nenɛɛne pi-bale na faŋe wɛɛne
tei to.
5Naneo, ta‑n tɛa, bɛ mo ke ye
n tutwoni n daare pwola?
Jɔdan buga kam,
bɛ mo ye n pipiri n kɛ dáa?
6Ko ta ná ye peero tem
de zwonnu tem,
bɛ mo ye abam de faŋe wɛɛne
nenɛɛne pei to?
7Tega kam baŋa, ko nam maŋe
se n yera taa sae mo,
Wɛ na tu n tei to ŋwaane.
Chega to, Jakob dwi tiina Wɛ wom fɔɔre o twɛ nmo mo.
8Wonto déem pɛ se peo leiri
ko ji chɔgɔ.
Peo kom tete ma ji buli-yi,
pa na ta ba nwoŋi da.

english_text:
The Lord Deserves To Be Praised
1We don't deserve praise!
The Lord alone deserves
all of the praise,
because of his love
and faithfulness.
2 Why should the nations ask,
“Where is your God?”
3Our God is in the heavens,
doing as he chooses.
4 The idols of the nations
are made of silver and gold.
5They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
6Their ears can't hear,
and their noses can't smell.
7Their hands have no feeling,
their legs don't move,
and they can't make a sound.
8Everyone who made the idols
and all who trust them
are just as helpless
as those useless gods.
9People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
10Family of Aaron the priest,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
11All of you worship the Lord,
so you must trust him
to help and protect you.
12The Lord will not forget
to give us his blessing;
he will bless all of Israel
and the family of Aaron.
13 All who worship the Lord,
no matter who they are,
will receive his blessing.
14I pray that the Lord
will let your family
and your descendants
always grow strong.
15May the Lord who created
the heavens and the earth
give you his blessing.
16The Lord has kept the heavens
for himself,
but he has given the earth
to us humans.
17The dead are silent
and cannot praise the Lord,
18but we will praise him
now and forevermore.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo ye Wɛ chekke
1Ko dae debam mo
maŋe de zula,
se nmo, Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo.
Ko maŋe se nɔɔna taa tei
nmo yere,
nmo swono kom na gaale
ye n ta jege chega to ŋwaane.
2Bɛ mo ye dwi-gɛ tiina bam
bwei daane ba we,
“Ba Wɛ wom bɛ?”
3Debam Tu Wɛ wom nam wo
telaao ne mo.
O maa toŋe kolo maama
o wo na dɛ to.
4Ko nam ná ye banto jwona yam,
ko ye lu-nyenno
dedaane sabu-seŋa mo
nabiina kwei ba mɔ-ya de ba jea.
5Ya maŋe ya jege nia,
ya nam ba ŋɔɔna.
Ya ze jege yia mo de,
ya nam ba nae.
6Zwa mo ba jega,
ye ya ba ni kolokolo.
Ya momwa de ba ni lwom.
7Ya ta jege je,
ye ya ware ya ma-se
ya dwei wonnu.
Ko ná ye ya nɛ sem,
ya ware ya ma-se ya vo jei jei.
Ya kwori bá wane sɔɔ se se ke.
8Balo maama na ke jwo-yɔɔro to
wó ba ba taa nye de-ya.
Balo de na ke ba wo-dedoa
de-ya to wó ji nɔn-yɔɔro mo.
9Isarele nɔn-kɔgɔ kom,
ke-na á wo-dedoa
dedaane Baŋa Wɛ!
Wonto mo ye á zeinnu
ye o ta daare o cho abam.
10Aron dwi tiina bam,
ke-na á wo-dedoa
dedaane Baŋa Wɛ!
Wonto mo ye á zeinnu
ye o ta daare o cho abam.
11Abam balo maama
na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to,
ke-na á wo-dedoa ded‑o!
Wonto mo ye á zeinnu
ye o ta daare o cho abam.
12 Baŋa Wɛ yeini o guli debam gula
pa se o swɛ debam swolim.
Chega to, o wó swɛ Isarele tiina bam swolim,
ko fɔge ko dae Aron dwi tiina bam de.
13Balo maama na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to mo
o lage o swɛ ba maama swolim,
ba ná maŋe ba ye nabwona
naa naduna mo de.
14 Baŋa Wɛ wó pa abam
de á dwi dem puli dedɛ.
15O maa ye wolo na naane wɛyuu
de tega baŋa to mo.
Wonto wó swɛ abam swolim lanyerane.
16Wɛyuu kom maama
ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo.
O nam kwei tega kam baŋa
o ke nabiina jeŋa ne.
17Ko dae balo na tege to mo
wae ba tei Baŋa Wɛ.
Ba nia nam meeri mo tega kuri ne.
18Se ko ná ye debam balo na ŋwe to,
dé wó taa tei Baŋa Wɛ,
ko zege leile se ko taa vei wuu.
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
When the Lord Saves You from Death
1I love you, Lord!
You answered my prayers.
2You paid attention to me,
and so I will pray to you
as long as I live.
3Death attacked from all sides,
and I was captured
by its painful chains.
But when I was really hurting,
4I prayed and said, “Lord,
please don't let me die!”
5You are kind, Lord,
so good and merciful.
6You protect ordinary people,
and when I was helpless,
you saved me
7and treated me so kindly
that I don't need
to worry anymore.
8You, Lord, have saved
my life from death,
my eyes from tears,
my feet from stumbling.
9Now I will walk at your side
in this land of the living.
10 I was faithful to you
when I was suffering,
11though in my confusion I said,
“I can't trust anyone!”
12What must I give you, Lord,
for being so good to me?
13I will pour out an offering
of wine to you,
and I will pray in your name
because you
have saved me.
14I will keep my promise to you
when your people meet.
15You are deeply concerned
when one of your loyal people
faces death.
16I worship you, Lord,
just as my mother did,
and you have rescued me
from the chains of death.
17I will offer you a sacrifice
to show how grateful I am,
and I will pray.
18I will keep my promise to you
when your people
19gather at your temple
in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Lei keim
1Amo swoi Baŋa Wɛ
o na yeini o cheigi-ne
ye o sɛ amo wɛ-lworo kom to ŋwaane.
2O yeini o pore o zwa mo
o ni amo ni taane.
Mo kokuri, amo wó ware‑o
se ko taa nii a ŋwea siseini.
3Toone déem kekare amo de vɔ.
A maa kɔre foone
churu veiŋa ŋwaane.
Cham de wo-chechɔgɔ yerane mo
ya ye amo nyem.
4Amo laam ma kaase
a bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere a we,
“Ja, amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ!
Jwoŋi-ne n yage!”
5 Baŋa Wɛ jege ŋwaŋa de zaane mo
o maa zeini nɔɔna.
O tiini o duri nɔɔna yibwona.
6Ko ná ye nabwona,
Baŋa Wɛ yeini o cho-ba
se ba yé to.
Amo déem na tiini
a wo cham wone to,
o jwoŋi-ne o yage.
7Amo wó ta a tete ne se a jwoori
a sii de bochare-zuru,
Baŋa Wɛ na tiini o ke zaane
o ke amo yuu ne to ŋwaane.
8Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo jwoŋi a ŋwea kam
toone jeŋa ne n yage.
N chugi n jwoŋi-ne,
se a daa yé keeri a ka yi-na
se a ta yé seeri a to tega ne.
9Mo kokuri, amo wó taa jege
a ŋwea tega baŋa ne
ye a kɔre Baŋa Wɛ.
10A ta ke a wo-dedoa de Wɛ mo,
ye a we, “Cham tiini de jege-ne.”
11A boboŋa na vugimi to,
a maa we,
“Nabiina maama ye vwa-fɔra mo.”
12Bɛ mo amo bere a lage a kwei
a pa Baŋa Wɛ,
de o na tiini o ke zaane
o ke a yuu ne to?
13A na wó ke kolo to mo tento:
Amo wó zeiŋi zoŋa mo
de ka wo wo-nyɔɔro,
a maa ke‑o lei o verem ŋwaane,
ye a daare a bwoŋi o yere
a maa zuli‑o.
14Amo wó vo a zege Baŋa Wɛ
nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne,
se a ke kolo maama a na gwoni ni ded‑o we a wó ke to.
15Ko ná ye balo na jege chega
de Baŋa Wɛ to,
ba dedoa ná tega,
ko tiini ko jege kuri ko pa‑o.
16Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
a ye n tontoŋeno mo.
Chega to, a ye kabaa mo n sɔŋɔ ne.
Nmo nam bwoli ŋone selo
ya na vɔge-ne to.
17Amo wó ja lei-keim pɛɛre mo
a ba a ke kaanem a pa‑m,
ye a daare a bwoŋi nmo Baŋa Wɛ yere a maa zuli‑m.
18Amo wó zege Baŋa Wɛ
nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne,
se a ke kolo maama a na gwoni ni ded‑o we a wó ke to.
19Amo wó vo Jerusalem teo kom tetare ne,
se a ke Baŋa Wɛ lei
o tete wara-jei sem ne.
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1 All of you nations,
come praise the Lord!
Let everyone praise him.
2God's love for us is wonderful;
his faithfulness never ends.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
1Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama
ba-na á tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Nabiina na nwoŋi
teene delo maama wone to,
zuli-o-na.
2Kokuri to,
Wɛ na jege dé swono tei to
tiini ko dana se ko gaale.
O chega zegem dem maa wó taa wora se ko taa vei wuu.
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
The Lord Is Always Merciful
1 Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
2Let Israel shout,
“God is always merciful!”
3Let the family of Aaron
the priest shout,
“God is always merciful!”
4Let every true worshiper
of the Lord shout,
“God is always merciful!”
5When I was really hurting,
I prayed to the Lord.
He answered my prayer,
and took my worries away.
6 The Lord is on my side,
and I am not afraid
of what others can do to me.
7With the Lord on my side,
I will defeat
my hateful enemies.
8It is better to trust the Lord
for protection
than to trust anyone else,
9including strong leaders.
10Nations surrounded me,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
11They attacked from all sides,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
12They swarmed around like bees,
but by the power of the Lord,
I got rid of them
and their fiery sting.
13Their attacks were so fierce
that I nearly fell,
but the Lord helped me.
14 My power and my strength
come from the Lord,
and he has saved me.
15From the tents of God's people
come shouts of victory:
“The Lord is powerful!
16With his mighty arm
the Lord wins victories!
The Lord is powerful!”
17And so my life is safe,
and I will live to tell
what the Lord has done.
18He punished me terribly,
but he did not let death
lay its hands on me.
19Open the gates of justice!
I will enter and tell the Lord
how thankful I am.
20Here is the gate of the Lord!
Everyone who does right
may enter this gate.
21I praise the Lord
for answering my prayers
and saving me.
22 The stone that the builders
tossed aside
has now become
the most important stone.
23The Lord has done this,
and it is amazing to us.
24This day belongs to the Lord!
Let's celebrate
and be glad today.
25 We'll ask the Lord to save us!
We'll sincerely ask the Lord
to let us win.
26 God bless the one who comes
in the name of the Lord!
We praise you from here
in the house of the Lord.
27The Lord is our God,
and he has given us light!
Start the celebration!
March with palm branches
all the way to the altar.
28The Lord is my God!
I will praise him and tell him
how thankful I am.
29Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
translation_text:
Lei keim
1Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o lamma.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
2Pa-na se Isarele tiina bam tɔge
ba ta we:
“O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.”
3Pa-na se Wɛ kaanem tu Aron dwi tiina bam de tɔge ba ta we:
“O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.”
4Pa-na se balo maama na kɔre Wɛ to de tɔge ba ta we:
“O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.”
5Amo wo ya na tiini ko pɛ to,
a ma lwoori Baŋa Wɛ.
O ma sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom
pa se a jwoori a na a tete.
6 Baŋa Wɛ mo zege amo kwaga ne.
Konto to,
a daa bá taa kɔre foone.
Nabiina lage ba ke amo bɛ mo?
7Chega ŋwaane to,
Baŋa Wɛ mo wo amo tei ne
se o zeini-ne.
Ko ná ye balo na chuli-ne to,
ba lage ba to mo ye a nii-ba.
8Nɔɔno ná vei
o dale Baŋa Wɛ woro ne,
konto gare o teena
ná wo nabiina baŋa ne.
9Nɔɔno ná vei
o dale Baŋa Wɛ woro ne,
konto gare o teena
ná wo dedɛɛra baŋa ne.
10 Dwi-gɛ tiina maama mo
ya gilimi amo ba ke tetare ne.
Baŋa Wɛ yere dem dam ŋwaane
amo nam wane-ba a yigi
a de tega ne.
11Chega ŋwaane to,
ba yɔɔre ba gilimi-ne,
ye a wane-ba a yigi a de tega ne,
Baŋa Wɛ yere dem dam ŋwaane.
12Ba yɔɔre ba meeli-ne mo
nenɛɛne twe na meeli nɔɔna tei to.
Ba nam jei mo lela
nenɛɛne sabare selo
mini na zwɛ to mo.
A ma wane-ba a yigi a de tega ne,
Baŋa Wɛ yere dem dam ŋwaane.
13Ba ya tiini ba jege-ne ba peena.
Ko ma gɛ fee mo se a to tega ne.
Baŋa Wɛ nam yɔɔre
o da o zeini-ne mo.
14 Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wolo na yeini
o pa-ne dam
ye o ta kwori o cho amo
cham wone.
O maa ye wolo na jwoŋi-ne
o yage to.
15Cheigi-na! Wɛ nɔn-laaro tem
zege ba vwoa wone
ba bage ywoni de wɔnɔ ŋwaane mo ye ba we:
“Baŋa Wɛ jazem dem mo
toŋe wo-kamuna!
16Chega ŋwaane to,
Baŋa Wɛ jazem dem jege dam!
O ma tɔge de baŋa ne
o toŋe wo-kamuna!”
17Amo bá te, a lage a taa ŋwe mo.
Amo laam maa wó taa tɔɔle
a bere nɔɔna
Baŋa Wɛ na ke
totoŋ-kamuna yalo to.
18 Baŋa Wɛ ya tiini o pa
ko chɛ a yera ne.
De konto maama de,
o wo pɛ se toone ja-ne.
19“Pore-na manchwoŋo ni dem
á pa-ne
se a zo Wɛ wara-jei sem
mɛ nɔn-laaro na yeini ba zoore to.
Se amo wó zo dáane mo
a ke Baŋa Wɛ lei.”
20“Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei di-nia yam
mo tento.
Wɛ nɔn-laaro tem yerane mo
jege chwoŋa se ba tɔge da
ba vo ba zuli‑o.”
21“Amo nam wó ke nmo Baŋa Wɛ lei,
nmo na sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom
ye n jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane.”
22Kandwɛ delo lɔra bam na ve to
laam jwoori de ba de ji kandwɛ
delo na pae diga kam damma to.
23Konto ye Baŋa Wɛ keim mo.
Ko maa ye wo-kenkagele
ko pa debam.
24Zem mo ye Baŋa Wɛ
totoŋ-kamuna dɛ dem!
Pa-na se dé taa chaka de wopwolo
de ŋwaane.
25Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ,
dé lwoori nmo tei ne
se n jwoŋi debam n yage!
Pa se dé totoŋa taa vei yiga lanyerane!
26“Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ wolo na tu
o yere ŋwaane to swolim.
Debam zege Baŋa Wɛ
wara-jei sem ne mo
se dé ke o zaane dé yage n yuu ne!”
27 Baŋa Wɛ seene o ye
debam Tu Wɛ wom mo.
O maa pae pwooni taa wo
dé tei ne.
Konto to, di-na kuri á ma‑á zuli‑o!
Kwei-na varem á vɔ de ŋone
á ja á vo á lei
kaanem bimbini dem nyea ne.
28Nmo mo ye amo Tu Wɛ wom.
Amo wó ke nmo lei dedɛ.
Chega to, amo wó tei nmo yere
pa se de zaŋe wɛɛne,
n na ye amo Tu Wɛ to ŋwaane.
29Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei,
se o lamma.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_text:
In Praise of the Law of the Lord
1Our Lord, you bless everyone
who lives right
and obeys your Law.
2You bless all those
who follow your commands
from deep in their hearts
3and who never do wrong
or turn from you.
4You have ordered us always
to obey your teachings;
5I don't ever want to stray
from your laws.
6Thinking about your commands
will keep me from doing
some foolish thing.
7I will do right and praise you
by learning to respect
your perfect laws.
8I will obey all of them!
Don't turn your back on me.
9Young people can live
a clean life
by obeying your word.
10I worship you
with all my heart.
Don't let me walk away
from your commands.
11I treasure your word
above all else;
it keeps me from sinning
against you.
12I praise you, Lord!
Teach me your laws.
13With my own mouth,
I tell others the laws
that you have spoken.
14Obeying your instructions
brings as much happiness
as being rich.
15I will study your teachings
and follow your footsteps.
16I will take pleasure
in your laws
and remember your words.
17Treat me with kindness, Lord,
so that I may live
and do what you say.
18Open my mind
and let me discover
the wonders of your Law.
19I live here as a stranger.
Don't keep me from knowing
your commands.
20What I want most
and at all times
is to honor your laws.
21You punish those boastful,
worthless nobodies who turn
from your commands.
22Don't let them sneer
and insult me
for following you.
23I keep thinking about
your teachings, Lord,
even if rulers plot
against me.
24Your laws are my greatest joy!
I follow their advice.
25I am at the point of death.
Let your teachings
breathe new life into me.
26When I told you my troubles,
you answered my prayers.
Now teach me your laws.
27Help me to understand
your teachings,
and I will think about
your marvelous deeds.
28I am overcome with sorrow.
Encourage me,
as you have promised to do.
29Keep me from being deceitful,
and be kind enough
to teach me your Law.
30I am determined to be faithful
and to respect your laws.
31I follow your rules, Lord.
Don't let me be ashamed.
32I am eager to learn all
that you want me to do;
help me to understand more.
33Point out your rules, Lord,
and I won't disobey
even one of them.
34Help me to understand your Law;
I promise to obey it
with all my heart.
35Direct me by your commands!
I love to do what you say.
36Make me want to obey you,
rather than to be rich.
37Take away my foolish desires,
and let me find life
by walking with you.
38I am your servant!
Do for me what you promised
to those who worship you.
39Your wonderful teachings
protect me from the insults
that I hate so much.
40I long for your teachings.
Be true to yourself
and let me live.
41Show me your love
and save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
42Then I will have an answer
for everyone who insults me
for trusting your word.
43I rely on your laws!
Don't take away my chance
to speak your truth.
44I will keep obeying your Law
forever and ever.
45I have gained perfect freedom
by following your teachings,
46and I trust them so much
that I tell them to kings.
47I love your commands!
They bring me happiness.
48I love and respect them
and will keep them in mind.
49Don't forget your promise
to me, your servant.
I depend on it.
50When I am hurting,
I find comfort in your promise
that leads to life.
51Conceited people sneer at me,
but I obey your Law.
52I find true comfort, Lord,
because your laws have stood
the test of time.
53I get furious when evil people
turn against your Law.
54No matter where I am,
your teachings
fill me with songs.
55Even in the night
I think about you, Lord,
and I obey your Law.
56You have blessed me
because I have always followed
your teachings.
57You, Lord, are my choice,
and I will obey you.
58With all my heart
I beg you to be kind to me,
just as you have promised.
59I pay careful attention
as you lead me,
and I follow closely.
60As soon as you command,
I do what you say.
61Evil people may set a trap,
but I obey your Law.
62Your laws are so fair
that I wake up and praise you
in the middle of the night.
63I choose as my friends
everyone who worships you
and follows your teachings.
64Our Lord, your love is seen
all over the world.
Teach me your laws.
65I am your servant, Lord,
and you have kept your promise
to treat me with kindness.
66Give me wisdom and good sense.
I trust your commands.
67Once you corrected me
for not obeying you,
but now I do obey.
68You are kindhearted,
and you do good things,
so teach me your laws.
69My reputation is being ruined
by conceited liars,
but with all my heart
I follow your teachings.
70Those liars have no sense,
but I find happiness
in your Law.
71When you corrected me,
it did me good
because it taught me
to study your laws.
72I would rather obey you
than to have a thousand pieces
of silver and gold.
73You created me
and put me together.
Make me wise enough to learn
what you have commanded.
74Your worshipers will see me,
and they will be glad
that I trust your word.
75Your decisions are correct,
and you were right
to punish me.
76I serve you, Lord.
Comfort me with your love,
just as you have promised.
77I love to obey your Law!
Have mercy and let me live.
78Put down those proud people
who hurt me with their lies,
because I have chosen
to study your teachings.
79Let your worshipers come to me,
so they will learn
to obey your rules.
80Let me truly respect your laws,
so I won't be ashamed.
81I long for you to rescue me!
Your word is my only hope.
82I am worn out from waiting
for you to keep your word.
When will you have mercy?
83My life is wasting away
like a dried-up wineskin,
but I have not forgotten
your teachings.
84I am your servant!
How long must I suffer?
When will you punish
those troublemakers?
85Those proud people reject
your teachings,
and they dig pits
for me to fall in.
86Your laws can be trusted!
Protect me from cruel liars.
87They have almost killed me,
but I have been faithful
to your teachings.
88Show that you love me
and let me live,
so that I may obey
your commands.
89Our Lord, you are eternal!
Your word will last as long
as the heavens.
90You remain faithful
in every generation,
and the earth you created
will keep standing firm.
91All things are your servants,
and the laws you made
are still in effect today.
92If I had not found happiness
in obeying your Law,
I would have died in misery.
93I won't ever forget
your teachings,
because you give me new life
when I follow them.
94I belong to you,
and I have respected your laws,
so keep me safe.
95Brutal enemies are waiting
to ambush and destroy me,
but I obey your rules.
96Nothing is completely perfect,
except your teachings.
97I deeply love your Law!
I think about it all day.
98Your laws never leave my mind,
and they make me much wiser
than my enemies.
99Thinking about your teachings
gives me better understanding
than my teachers,
100and obeying your laws
makes me wiser than those
who have lived a long time.
101I obey your word
instead of following a way
that leads to trouble.
102You have been my teacher,
and I won't reject
your instructions.
103Your teachings are sweeter
than honey.
104They give me understanding
and make me hate all lies.
105Your word is a lamp
that gives light
wherever I walk.
106Your laws are fair,
and I have given my word
to respect them all.
107I am in terrible pain!
Save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
108Accept my offerings of praise
and teach me your laws.
109I never forget your teachings,
although my life is always
in danger.
110Some merciless people
are trying to trap me,
but I never turn my back
on your teachings.
111They will always be
my most prized possession
and my source of joy.
112I have made up my mind
to obey your laws forever,
no matter what.
113I hate anyone
whose loyalty is divided,
but I love your Law.
114You are my place of safety
and my shield.
Your word is my only hope.
115All you worthless people,
get away from me!
I am determined to obey
the commands of my God.
116Be true to your word, Lord.
Keep me alive and strong;
don't let me be ashamed
because of my hope.
117Keep me safe and secure,
so that I will always
respect your laws.
118You reject all deceitful liars
because they refuse
your teachings.
119As far as you are concerned,
evil people are garbage,
and so I follow your rules.
120I tremble all over
when I think of you
and the way you judge.
121I did what was fair and right!
Don't hand me over to those
who want to mistreat me.
122Take good care of me,
your servant,
and don't let me be harmed
by those conceited people.
123My eyes are weary from waiting
to see you keep your promise
to come and save me.
124Show your love for me,
your servant,
and teach me your laws.
125I serve you,
so let me understand
your teachings.
126Do something, Lord!
They have broken your Law.
127Your laws mean more to me
than the finest gold.
128I follow all your commands,
but I hate anyone
who leads me astray.
129Your teachings are wonderful,
and I respect them all.
130Understanding your word
brings light to the minds
of ordinary people.
131I honestly want to know
everything you teach.
132Think about me and be kind,
just as you are to everyone
who loves your name.
133Keep your promise
and don't let me stumble
or let sin control my life.
134Protect me from abuse,
so I can obey your laws.
135Smile on me, your servant,
and teach me your laws.
136When anyone disobeys you,
my eyes overflow with tears.
137Our Lord, you always do right,
and your decisions are fair.
138All your teachings are true
and trustworthy.
139It upsets me greatly
when my enemies neglect
your teachings.
140Your word to me, your servant,
is like pure gold;
I treasure what you say.
141Everyone calls me a nobody,
but I remember your laws.
142You will always do right,
and your teachings are true.
143I am in deep distress,
but I love your teachings.
144Your rules are always fair.
Help me to understand them
and live.
145I pray to you, Lord!
Please answer me.
I promise to obey your laws.
146I beg you to save me,
so I can follow your rules.
147Even before sunrise,
I pray for your help,
and I put my hope
in what you have said.
148I lie awake at night,
thinking of your promises.
149Show that you love me, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
150People who disobey your Law
have made evil plans
and want to hurt me,
151but you are with me,
and all your commands
can be trusted.
152From studying your laws,
I found out long ago
you made them to last forever.
153I have not forgotten your Law!
Look at the trouble I am in,
and rescue me.
154Be my defender and protector!
Remember your promise
and save my life.
155Evil people won't obey you,
and so they have no hope
of being saved.
156You are merciful, Lord!
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
157I have a lot of brutal enemies,
but still I never turn
from your laws.
158Those unfaithful people
who refuse to obey you
are disgusting to me.
159Remember how I love your laws,
and show your love for me
by keeping me safe.
160All you say can be trusted;
your teachings are true
and will last forever.
161Rulers are cruel to me
for no reason.
But with all my heart
I respect your words,
162because they bring happiness
like treasures taken in war.
163I can't stand liars,
but I love your Law.
164I praise you seven times a day
because your laws are fair.
165You give peace of mind
to all who love your Law.
Nothing can make them fall.
166You are my only hope
for being saved, Lord,
and I do all you command.
167I love and obey your laws
with all my heart.
168You know everything I do.
You know I respect every law
you have given.
169Please, Lord, hear my prayer
and give me the understanding
that comes from your word.
170Listen to my concerns
and keep me safe,
just as you have promised.
171If you will teach me your laws,
I will praise you 172and sing
about your promise,
because all your teachings
are what they ought to be.
173Be ready to protect me
because I have chosen
to obey your laws.
174I am waiting for you
to save me, Lord.
Your Law makes me happy.
175Keep me alive,
so I can praise you,
and let me find help
in your teachings.
176I am your servant,
but I have wandered away
like a lost sheep.
Please come after me,
because I have not forgotten
your teachings.
translation_text:
Wɛ ni taane dem jege wolim dedɛ
Alef
1Balo na yɔɔre ba tɔge chwoŋa ye ba ba tusi to mo,
Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne lanyerane.
Banto yeini ba sɛ
Baŋa Wɛ nia yam mo chekke.
2Ko ta ná ye balo na toŋe
ba tɔge Wɛ bera yam
ye ba fɔɔre ba twɛ‑o
de ba wo maama to,
Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne.
3Banto ba sɛ ba toŋe lwarem kikia kɔtaa,
ye ba nam yɔɔre ba tɔge
Wɛ chwoŋa chekke mo.
4Nmo Baŋa Wɛ maŋe n pa
se n chullu tem mo tigi jaja.
Ko maa jege se nɔɔna taa toŋe
ba tɔge-te maŋa maama.
5Pa se a totoŋ-naga taa tɔge
nmo kwora na bere kolo to!
6Amo ná seene a yia
se a taa sɛ n ni-kaana yam,
chaveera bá ja-ne ya ŋwaane.
7A ná zamese n chega taana yam,
a laam wó taa tei‑m
de a wo maama.
8Chega to, amo wó taa sɛ
a ke nmo nia yam mo.
Yé ma n kwaga n ya amo.
Bet
9Nɔn-doŋo wó ke tɛ mo
se o ŋwea kam yɔɔre chwoŋa?
O jege se o taa cho o tete,
ne nmo ni taane dem na bere
se o ke tei to mo.
10Amo kwei a wo maama mo
a kwaane se a fɔɔre a twɛ nmo.
Nam yé pa se a ywori
nmo ni-kaana yam kwaga ne.
11Amo kwei n ni taane dem mo
a ke a bochare ne,
se ko che-ne se a yé tusi
a chɔge nmo yiga.
12 Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo maŋe dedaane tia mo!
Bere-ne se a lɔre n nia yam chekke.
13Amo jege n chullu telo
n na pɛ debam to mo
a yeini a tɛ a bere nɔɔna jaja.
14Amo tiini a di ywoni mo
n bera yam ŋwaane,
ne ya pɛ a ye nadum mo tei.
15A wó taa jege n chullu tem
a boboŋa ne,
se a daare a tɔge n nɛ-bwora kam chekke.
16A maa wó pa se n nia yam
taa jege ywoni ya pa-ne,
se a daa yé swei n taane dem swia.
Gimel
17Amo Tu, a lwoori‑m
se n ta‑n ke lanyerane n pa-ne.
Amo laam maa wó taa jege ŋwea
ye a sɛ a tɔge n taane dem
na bere tei to.
18Pa se a yia puri,
se a wane a lɔre wo-kenkagela
yalo n taane dem na bere to.
19Amo ye veiru mo logo baŋa ne.
Yé seigi n ni-kaana yam amo tei ne,
se a yé wane a lɔre-ya.
20Maŋa maama wone n bera yam tiini ya jege fera mo ya pa-ne.
21Ko ná ye balo na bere ba tete kamunim to,
nmo yeini n waare-ba mo.
Sensɔle-balɔrɔ maa wo ba yuu ne,
ba na ve nmo ni-kaana yam to ŋwaane.
22Yé pa se ba toro naa ba yu-yaalem
yi amo,
kokuri to, amo sɛ a tɔge
nmo bera yam mo.
23Pa-bia tete ná maŋe ba beeri chwoŋa
se ba chɔge-ne mo de,
amo ta wó taa jege n nia yam
a boboŋa ne.
24Nmo bera yam mo tiini
ya pae amo na ywoni.
Ya maa bere-ne chwo-laao
se a taa tɔga.
Daleta
25Amo laam to tega ne,
ye toone lage de ja-ne.
Nam tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne
n pa a jwoori a na ŋwea.
26A tage a ŋwea na ye tei to maama
a bere‑m,
ye nmo de leiri a taane dem.
Laam nam bere-ne n nia yam lanyerane.
27Woli-ne se a wane a ni
n chullu tem kuri,
se ko pae a taa boŋe
n totoŋ-kenkagela yam boboŋa.
28Amo wo-chechɔgɔ kom
mo lage ko go-ne.
Nam tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne
n pa a jwoori a na dam.
29Pa se a nwoŋi vwa dwi maama wone,
se n daare n tɔge n zaane dem baŋa ne
n pa a taa yei nmo nia yam.
30Amo kuri se a taa zege de chega mo a pa‑m.
A ta maa yeini a guli
nmo chullu tem gula.
31Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo sɛ a tɔge n bera yam mo.
Yé pa chaveera di amo!
32Amo seene a yia mo se a ke
n ni-kaana yam na bere kolo to.
Konto to, woli-ne
se a ni ya kuri lanyerane.
Hee
33Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, bere-ne
se a wane a lɔre n nia yam kuri.
Amo ba lage se a lɔ ya dedoa tete kwaga ne.
34Nam pa se a yi poore,
se a wane a sɛ nmo ni taane dem.
Amo zege se a yɔɔre a tɔge-de
de a wo maama mo.
35Pa n ni-kaana yam taa bere-ne chwoŋa se a taa via.
Kokuri to, amo tiini a ni
ya ywoni lanyerane.
36Pa se a boboŋa taa tɔge n bera yam,
se a fera yé zo jejegero wone.
37Dɔne amo yia wo-yɔɔro baŋa ne.
Pa se a na ŋwea n chwoŋa kam tɔgem ŋwaane.
38Amo Tu, a ye n tontoŋeno mo.
Nam ke n na gwoni ni se n ke kolo
ye n pwooli se n ke tei
de balo na kɔre nmo to.
39A kɔre foone de balo na jege-ne
ba yaale to mo.
Yé pa a na chaveera ba ŋwaane.
Kokuri nmo tete ni taane dem lana dedɛ.
40Nii a na tiini a lage
se a taa tɔge n chullu tem tei!
Tɔge n chega kam ŋwaane
n pa a ŋwea jwoori ka na dam.
Wawu
41Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
pa n swono kom yi amo,
se n daare n jwoŋi-ne n yage,
ne n na gwoni ni se n ke tei to.
42Konto wó pa se a wane a leiri
balo na jege-ne ba twe to,
a na ke a chega n taane dem wone to ŋwaane.
43Yé pa se n chega taane dem jei
amo ni ne,
se a teena maama wo
nmo bora borem dem ne mo.
44Amo lage se a taa sɛ nmo nia yam maŋa maama mo
se ko taa vei wuu.
45Amo laam vei mo
ye kolokolo ba daane-ne,
a na tiini a lage n chullu tem to ŋwaane.
46A ta wó taa tɛ n bera yam a bere pwa,
ye chaveera bá ja-ne ya ŋwaane.
47Amo wo mo pwoli dedɛ
de nmo ni-kaana yam,
a na tiini a swoi-ya to ŋwaane.
48Chega to, a swoi n nia yam
ye a nege-ya lanyerane.
A maa wó taa boŋe ya wone mo zii.
Zayin
49Yé zaŋe n swei ni delo n na tiŋi
de amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to,
se a teena maama wo dáane mo.
50A ná wo cham wone,
n ni taane dem yeini de pa
a bochare peini tega ne mo,
ye a ŋwea jwoori ka na dam.
51Banegero nyena jege amo mo
ba ke ba mɔna.
Amo nam wo sɛ se a yage
n nia yam tɔgem.
52Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo chullu tem maŋe te wora mo
se ko nwoŋi faŋa.
A ná yeini a guli te gula,
te pae a bochare tigi tega ne mo.
53Amo wo mo wiira dedɛ
dedaane puseŋ-nyena bam
na ve n nia yam to.
54A ná zoore mɛ maama logo baŋa ne,
a yeini a leeni wopwolo lei mo
nmo bera yam ŋwaane.
55 Baŋa Wɛ, a ta ná yeini a peini tete ne,
a guli n yere dem gula mo.
Konto to, a lage a taa tɔge n nia yam.
56Amo na yeini a ke tei to mo tento:
a yɔɔre a sɛ a tɔge n chullu tem mo.
Het
57 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yerane mo ye wolo
na maŋe de amo to.
A boboŋa jaane se a taa tɔge
n nia yam mo.
58A nam lwoori‑m
de a wo maama mo
se n yiga taa wo a wone.
Tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne
n pa n zaane taa wo a yuu ne.
59Amo maane a nii
a ŋwea na ye tei to,
pa se a yɔɔre a pipiri
a tɔge n bera yam.
60A seene a yia mo ye a ke lela
se a taa sɛ n ni-kaana yam.
61Puseŋ-nyena kwaane mo
se ba soge-ne se a tusi,
ne ba vɔge-ne mo de ŋone
ba ja tei to.
Amo nam bá swei nmo nia yam ni ne.
62Tete-koro ne mo a yeini a zaŋe
se a ke nmo lei dedɛ,
nmo chullu tem na zege
chega baŋa ne to ŋwaane.
63Ko ná ye a yuudwonna balo
a na tɔge de-ba to,
banto kɔre nmo mo
ye ba ta sɛ n chullu tem.
64 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo swono kom mo
yi logo baŋa jei maama.
Konto to, bere-ne se a wane
a lɔre n nia yam.
Tet
65Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
a ye n tontoŋeno mo.
Nmo seene n tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne
n ke lanyerane n pa-ne.
66Nam pa se a taa jege yiyiu
dedaane swa
se a wane a tɔge chwo-laao.
Kokuri to, amo pɛ n ni-kaana yam chega mo dedɛ.
67Maŋa kalo nmo ta na
wo korese-ne to,
a kare a tusi chwoŋa mo.
Leile konto amo laam yɔɔre a sɛ
n ni taane dem mo.
68Nmo tiini n lamma,
ye n keina de lana dedɛ.
Konto to, bere-ne se a lɔre
n nia yam chekke.
69Banegero nyena yeini ba fɔ vwa mo
ba daŋe a yuu ne.
Amo nam ta wó taa tɔge nmo chullu tem mo de a wo maama.
70Banto boboŋa jei mo
ye ba ba jege yibwona.
Ko nam ná ye amo,
a tiini a di ywoni n nia yam ŋwaane.
71Amo na nɛ koresem delo to
tiini de woli-ne dedɛ,
de ko na pɛ a zamese
n bera yam to ŋwaane.
72Nia yalo nmo na bere debam to
tiini ya jege kuri ya pa-ne,
ya dwoi sabu-seŋa
de lu-nyenno maama.
Yod
73Nmo jea mo naane amo,
ye ya fɔge ya pa a zega.
Konto to, pa a yi poore
se a wane a ni
n ni-kaana yam kuri.
74Balo dwi maama na zuli nmo to
ná nɛ amo, ba wo wó pwoli,
de amo teena na wo nmo taane dem wone to ŋwaane.
75 Baŋa Wɛ, amo yei we
nmo na yeini n boŋe n ja
kolo maama to
ye chekke mo.
Nmo na korese-ne tei to
yɔɔre ko jege chega.
76Pa n swono kom yi amo
se a bochare laam peini tega ne
ne n na tiŋi n ni se n ke tei
n pa amo wolo na ye
n tontoŋeno to.
77Ta pa n yibwona yi amo
se a wane a na ŋwea chekke.
Kokuri to, a tiini a di ywoni
n nia yam ŋwaane.
78Pa banegero nyena bam
di chaveera,
se banto fɔge vwa mo
ba ma chɔge-ne.
Ko nam ná ye amo,
amo wó taa guli
n chullu tem gula mo.
79Pa se balo na kɔre nmo to
fɔɔre ba yi amo tei,
se ba wane ba me de nmo bera yam.
80Pa se a yɔɔre a taa tɔge
nmo nia yam ye tusim tera.
Konto baŋa ne, chaveera bá di amo.
Kaf
81Amo yɔɔre a nii mo
se n vere-ne n yage.
A teena maama de maa wo
nmo taane dem baŋa ne.
82A kwaane a nii mo se a na we
ni delo n na tiŋi to
seene de ji chega, ye a ga.
Maŋa kɔ mo nmo wó ba
n zeini-ne,
se a bochare peini tega ne?
83Amo yera yam kwaare mo
nenɛɛne lɔa na koge tei to.
De ko de, amo ta wo swei
n bera yam ni ne.
84Amo Tu Wɛ,
amo wó taa cheigi‑m taa
se ko vo ko maŋe yei ne mo?
Ko ná ye balo na jege-ne ba daana to,
maŋa kɔ mo nmo wó zaŋe
n waare-ba?
85Banegero nyena bam yeini
ba ve nmo nia yam mo,
ye ba boŋe se ba ja-ne,
ne ba na koge gwoŋo
se a to ko wone tei to.
86Nmo ni-kaana yam maama
ye se dé pa-ya chega mo.
Nam ba n zeini-ne,
se nɔɔna tɔge vwa baŋa ne mo
ba bɛɛse-ne.
87Ko ya gɛ fee yerane mo
se ba go-ne.
Amo maa wo dole nmo chullu tem
a yage.
88Nam da n swono kom ŋwaane
n pa se a taa jege a ŋwea
ye a toŋe a tɔge
n bera yam maama.
Lameda
89 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ni taane dem
wó taa jege kuri taa wuu
wɛyuu jei maama ne.
90Dwi dedwe wó kɛ,
se dedwoŋi de saŋe de ba.
Nmo nam zege n chega wone mo
taa wuu.
Nmo ta ke tega kam baŋa
se ka taa wora taa wuu.
91De zem maama
nmo nia yam ta jege kuri.
Wonnu maama de jege
se te taa toŋe te pa‑m mo.
92Amo ya ná wo di ywoni
nmo nia yam tɔgem ŋwaane,
tento wɛɛne yaara ya wó go-ne.
93Amo ba lage a fɔge a swei
nmo chullu tem swia,
tento na pɛ se a ŋwea ke dam to ŋwaane.
94Jwoŋi-ne n yage,
se a ye nmo nɔɔno mo.
A maa tiini a nege n chullu tem.
95Puseŋ-nyena bam beeri chwoŋa mo
se ba ja amo ba go.
Amo nam wó taa jege n bera yam
a boboŋa ne mo.
96Amo nɛ we
woŋo maama wó ba ko kɛ,
ko ná maŋe ko lamma tei de.
Nmo ni-kaana yam nam jage
jei maama ne mo,
ye ya ba jege siseini.
Mem
97Nii amo na swoi n nia yam tei!
Amo jege ya boboŋa mo
dɛ dem maama wone.
98Nmo ni-kaana yam mo pae
a jege swa a dwoi a dona maama,
a na jege ya boboŋa
maŋa maama to ŋwaane.
99A maa jege yi-poro a dwoi
balo na jege-ne ba zamese to tete,
a na yeini a guli n bera yam gula to ŋwaane.
100Amo yi poore se ko dwoni
nɔn-kwe tete de,
a na toŋe a tɔge n chullu tem to ŋwaane mo.
101Amo ba sɛ se a taa tɔge
lwarem chwoŋa,
pa se a taa ke n ni taane dem
na bere kolo to.
102Amo wo pipiri a lɔ
n nia yam kwaga ne,
nmo tete na bere-ne
se a lɔre ya kuri to ŋwaane.
103Nmo ni taane dem tiini
de ywomma de pa-ne,
se ko dwoni tooro na sona tei to!
104Nmo chullu tem pae
a yi poore lanyerane.
Mo kokuri amo laam chuli
chwoŋa kalo maama
na ye vwa chwoŋa to.
Nun
105Nmo taane dem mo yeini
de pa-ne pwooni pa a vei de wone,
ne min-zwoŋo na nye
pwooni chwoŋa ne tei to.
106Amo maŋe a du duuri mo we
amo wó toŋe a tɔge n nia yam
de ya na yɔɔre ya jege chega tei to.
Amo bá yiri a ni dem konto.
107Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
cham tiini de zo-ne dedɛ.
Konto to, tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne
n pa a ŋwea jwoori ka ke dam.
108 Baŋa Wɛ, sɛ se n jwoŋi
a wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra yam,
a na lage a ma-ya a zuli nmo to ŋwaane.
Nam ta bere-ne n chullu tem.
109A yeini a dole a ŋwea kam mo a yage,
ye a daa ta ba swei n nia yam swia.
110Puseŋ-nyena bam kwaane mo
se ba ja-ne,
ne ba tiŋi kalanchogo mo tei.
Amo nam wo pipiri a lɔ
n chullu tem kwaga ne.
111Nmo bera yam wó taa jege lonne
ya pa-ne taa wuu.
Yanto mo pae a di ywoni lanyerane.
112Amo yɔɔre a boŋe a ja mo we
amo wó taa tɔge n nia yam
na bere kolo to taa
se a ŋwea ba ka ti.
Sameka
113Ko ná ye balo na jege
boboŋa yalei to,
amo yeini a chuli-ba mo.
Amo ta ma daare a ja
se a taa swoi n nia yam.
114Nmo mo ye amo dalem jei.
Nmo ta ma‑n cho-ne cham wone.
Nmo taane dem yerane wone mo
amo teena wora.
115Abam balo na ke lwarem
á daŋe a yuu ne to,
lage-na jei da a yiga ne!
Kokuri a boboŋa maŋe ya ja
se a taa tɔge ni-kaana yalo
amo Tu Wɛ wom na pɛ-ne to mo.
116 Baŋa Wɛ, da n ni dem ŋwaane
n pa a ŋwea na dam.
Amo teena na wo nmo tei ne to,
yé pa se chaveera di-ne ko ŋwaane.
117Fɔge n ta‑n jege-ne mɔpe,
se cham yé yi-ne.
Konto mo wó pa se amo yiga taa wo
n nia yam wone maŋa maama.
118Ko ná ye balo na yeini ba lɔ
n nia yam kwaga ne to,
n yɔɔre n ve-ba mo.
Ba boboŋa maama
ye vwa yerane mo.
119Nmo nii puseŋ-nyena balo maama
na wo tega baŋa ne to
se ba taa ye weeru mo n yiga ne.
Mo kokuri amo swoi n bera yam.
120Amo yera mo tiini ya sae
a na kɔre foone de nmo to ŋwaane.
Nmo na di nɔɔna taane tei to
maa pae a fona dedɛ.
Ayin
121Amo ke kolo na lamma
ye ko jege chega to mo.
Yé yage-ne se a to
balo na bɛɛse-ne to jeŋa ne.
122Amo ye n tontoŋeno mo.
Ta‑n zege n pa-ne,
se lanyerane yi amo.
Yé sɛ se banegero nyena bam
taa bɛɛse-ne.
123Amo kwaane a nii mo taa
se n vere-ne n yage,
se ni delo nmo na tiŋi to
seene de ji chega.
124Da n swono kom ŋwaane
n ba n woli amo
na ye n tontoŋeno to.
Bere-ne se a wane a lɔre
n nia yam chekke.
125Ta pa a yi poore
se a wane a lɔre n bera yam,
a na ye n tontoŋeno to ŋwaane.
126 Baŋa Wɛ, maŋa kam yi
se n zaŋe n ke keim,
nɔɔna na ve n nia yam to ŋwaane.
127Chega to, amo tiini a swoi
n ni-kaana yam.
Ya jege kuri ya dwoi sabu-seŋa,
ne ka ná maŋe ka lana tei de.
128Konto ŋwaane a yeini a tɔge
n chullu tem maama mo.
Amo ta chuli chwoŋa kalo maama
na ye vwa chwoŋa to.
Pei
129Nmo bera yam ye
berem-kenkagela mo.
Mo kokuri a yɔɔre a tɔge-ya.
130Nɔɔna ná tu ba lɔre
n taane dem kuri,
ba wó na pwooni
se ko pa ba yia puri.
De ta pae nayeiri-nyena jaane swa.
131Amo tiini a jege
nmo ni-kaana yam fera,
nenɛɛne na-nyɔm mo jege-ne to.
132Ja, nii amo seeni
se n duri a yibwona,
ne n na yeini n ke tei
n pa balo na zuli nmo yere to.
133Tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne
n pa se a yɔɔre a tɔge chwoŋa.
Yé sɛ se wɛleera na dam
amo baŋa ne.
134Ko ná ye balo na jege-ne ba bɛɛsa to,
jwoŋi-ne ba jeŋa ne n yage,
se a wane a taa sɛ n chullu tem.
135Pa n yibia jeeri amo seeni
se n ke-ne zaane,
a na ye n tontoŋeno to ŋwaane.
Bere-ne se a wane a lɔre
n nia yam chekke.
136Amo kane yi-na mo bare-bare,
a na nɛ nɔɔna na ve
n nia yam tɔgem to ŋwaane.
Tesade
137 Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo jege chega lanyerane.
Nmo chullu tem de yɔɔre
te tɔge chwoŋa mo.
138Nmo na pɛ debam bera yalo
se dé taa tɔge to
tiini ya ye chekke mo,
ye ya maŋe se dé sɛ-ya.
139Ko tiini ko daane-ne mo
dedaane a dona bam na swei
nmo taane dem swia to.
140Nmo ni taane dem tiini de jege kuri.
Amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to
tiini a swoi-de dedɛ.
141Amo tiini a muri
ye nɔɔna jege-ne ba gwoona.
Amo nam ba fɔge a swei
n chullu tem ni ne.
142Nmo na zege n chega wone tei to
wó taa wora mo taa wuu.
Nmo ni-kaana yam de yɔɔre
ya ye chekke mo.
143Yaara de cham mo to amo baŋa ne.
Nmo ni-kaana yam nam pae
a di ywoni dedɛ.
144Nmo bera yam yɔɔre ya ye
chega mo se ko taa vei wuu.
Pa se a yi poore lanyerane
se a wane a na ŋwea chekke.
Qofa
145Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo keeri a jare nmo
de a bochare maama!
Nam leiri a wɛ-lworo kom,
se a wane a taa tɔge n nia yam.
146Ja, jwoŋi-ne n yage
ne a na lwoori‑m tei to,
se a taa ke a tɔge n bera yam.
147Amo yeini a dɔ a zaŋe
ye tega ta wo poore,
se a lwoori zeinim nmo tei ne.
A kwei a teena a daŋe
n taane dem baŋa ne mo.
148Tete dem maama wone
dɔɔm ba tui a yia ne,
ye a boboŋa yɔɔre ya wo
n ni taane dem wone mo.
149 Baŋa Wɛ, da n swono kom ŋwaane
n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.
Ta tɔge n chega chwoŋa baŋa ne
n pa a ŋwea jwoori ka na dam.
150Balo na swoi puseŋa kikia to
laam twɛ amo mo
se ba ke-ne zonne.
Banto yiga bere ka tera de n nia yam.
151Ko nam ná ye nmo, Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo wo amo tei ne mo.
Nmo ni-kaana yam maama
maa yɔɔre ya ye chekke.
152Ko na zege faŋa faŋa to
mo a maane n bera yam wone we
n pɛ ya zege mo taa wuu.
Resa
153Nii cham na tiini de jege-ne tei to
se n daare n vere-ne n yage.
Kokuri to, amo ba swei
nmo nia yam swia.
154Zaŋe n zege a kwaga ne
se n ŋɔɔne n pa-ne,
ye n daare n jwoŋi-ne n yage.
Tɔge n ni taane dem baŋa ne
n pa a na ŋwea.
155Puseŋ-nyena bam bá fɔge
ba na verem,
ba yiga na tere n nia yam wone to ŋwaane.
156 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo tiini n ye yibwona tu.
Tɔge n chwo-laaro tem ŋwaane
n pa a ŋwea jwoori ka na dam.
157Amo dona bam de balo
na bɛɛse-ne to mo tiini ba gaale.
De konto maama de
amo ba ywori a daare nmo bera yam.
158Ko ná ye balo na nwoŋi
n chega kam kwaga ne to,
amo chuli-ba mo,
ba na ve n ni taane dem to ŋwaane.
159 Baŋa Wɛ, nii amo na swoi
n chullu tem tei!
Nam da n swono kom ŋwaane
n pa a na ŋwea chekke.
160Nmo taane dem maama yɔɔre
de ye chega mo.
Nmo chega taana yam maama
de maa wora taa wuu.
Sin
161Dedɛɛra jege-ne mo ba yaare
kafɛ ŋwaane.
Amo nam nege n taane dem mo
de a bochare maama.
162Amo tiini a di ywoni mo
nmo ni taane dem ŋwaane,
nenɛɛne a na pɛ jejegero dedɛ tei to.
163Amo tiini a chuli vwa dwi maama.
Ko daare a swoi nmo nia yam mo lanyerane.
164Kuni berepɛ mo dɛ maama wone
amo wó zuli nmo,
n nia yam na zege de chega to ŋwaane.
165Ko ná ye balo na swoi n nia yam to,
n yeini n pa ba bochare zuri lanyerane mo.
Kolokolo tera ko na wó pa
se banto to tega ne.
166 Baŋa Wɛ, amo teena wo
nmo yerane wone mo
se n vere-ne n yage.
Amo sɛ a ke n ni-kaana yam
na bere kolo to.
167Amo yɔɔre a tɔge n bera yam mo,
kokuri a tiini a swoi-ya dedɛ.
168Amo toŋe a tɔge n chullu tem
de n bera yam.
Nmo maŋe n yei amo totoŋ-naga maama ni ne.
Tawe
169 Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi amo na keeri
a jare nmo tei to!
Tɔge n taane dem baŋa ne
n pa a na yi-poro.
170Cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom,
se n daare n da n ni dem ŋwaane
n jwoŋi-ne n yage.
171Amo wó puri a ni mo
se a taa ma-de a tei nmo,
nmo na bere-ne se a lɔre
n nia yam kuri to ŋwaane.
172Amo ta wó leeni a seini
n ni taane dem mo,
nmo ni-kaana yam maama
na ye chekke to ŋwaane.
173Kwei n jeŋa kam n ma‑n zeini-ne,
amo na kuri se a sɛ
n chullu tem to ŋwaane.
174 Baŋa Wɛ, amo yɔɔre a nii mo
se n vere-ne n yage.
Nmo nia yam mo pae a di ywoni.
175Sɛ se amo yɔɔre a taa ŋwe,
se a taa tei‑m a ŋwea kam wone.
Pa se n nia yam taa jege wolim
ya pa-ne.
176Amo tusi chwoŋa mo ye a jei
ne pi-jia dwoŋi to.
Pa n yiga taa wo amo wolo
na ye n tontoŋeno to wone,
kokuri to, amo bere a wo swei
n ni-kaana yam ni ne.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1When I am in trouble, I pray,
2“Come and save me, Lord,
from deceitful liars!”
3What punishment is fitting
for you deceitful liars?
4Your reward should be
sharp and flaming arrows!
5But I must live as a foreigner
among the people of Meshech
and in the tents of Kedar.
6I have spent too much time
living among people
who hate peace.
7I am in favor of peace,
but when I speak of it,
all they want is war.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane
1Amo cham maŋa kam ne mo a keeri a jare Baŋa Wɛ
se o zeini-ne.
O ma cheigi-ne
ye o leiri a wɛ-lworo kom.
2A maa we:
“Jwoŋi-ne balo na fɔ vwa
ba daŋe a yuu ne to,
de balo na jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ to
jeŋa ne n yage.”
3Abam balo na gane nɔɔna to,
Wɛ lage o waare abam tetɛ mo?
O bá tiini o waare abam mo na?
4O lage o ma che-tɛɛra yalo
nia na ye chechwɛ to mo
o zɔ abam.
O ta wó kwei min-chala
o ma o zwɛ abam.
5Lɛɛro mo jege-ne!
A zoore Meseka teo ne,
de Kedare tiina tetare ne mo.
6Amo tiini a dáane nɔɔna banto tei ne,
ye ba ba beeri ni-mɔrɔ de nɔɔna.
7Ko ná ye amo,
a lage se a taa zoore de-ba
de bochare-zuru.
Amo nam ná yeini a ŋɔɔne,
banto beeri jara keim yerane mo!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Will Protect His People
1I look to the hills!
Where will I find help?
2It will come from the Lord,
who created heaven and earth.
3The Lord is your protector,
and he won't go to sleep
or let you stumble.
4The protector of Israel
doesn't doze
or ever get drowsy.
5The Lord is your protector,
there at your right side
to shade you from the sun.
6You won't be harmed
by the sun during the day
or by the moon at night.
7The Lord will protect you
and keep you safe
from all dangers.
8The Lord will protect you
now and always
wherever you go.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ wó nii o nɔɔna baŋa ne
1Amo yeini a kwoni
a yuu wɛɛne mo
a nii peero tem seeni.
Yein-seeni mo amo wó na zeinim?
2Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo wó zeini-ne.
Wonto mo naane wɛyuu dedaane tega kam baŋa maama.
3Wɛ lage o taa cho‑m mo
se n yé tiri n to tega ne.
Wɛ wó nii nmo baŋa ne
maŋa maama
ye o bá fɔge o dɔ.
4O na ye wolo na nii
Isarele tiina baŋa ne to,
o ba buga, o nam ba dɔa.
5Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo
na cho nmo to mo.
O wó taa wo n jazem seeni
bwola bwola
se o pa n na woro.
6O bá sɛ se wea kam daane‑m
dɛ dem wone,
naa se chana kam ke‑m kolokolo
tete ne.
7 Baŋa Wɛ wó taa cho nmo
de lwarem dwi maama,
se kolokolo yé chɔge n ŋwea kam.
8Ko zege zem se ko taa vei wuu
Baŋa Wɛ wó taa nii nmo baŋa ne,
ne n ná ma‑n zoore n diga
naa n ná ma‑n nwoŋi pwooni de.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
A Song of Praise
1It made me glad when they said,
“Let's go to the house
of the Lord!”
2Jerusalem, we are standing
inside your gates.
3Jerusalem, what a strong
and beautiful city you are!
4Every tribe of the Lord
obeys him and comes to you
to praise his name.
5David's royal throne is here
where justice rules.
6Jerusalem, we pray
that you will have peace,
and that all will go well
for those who love you.
7May there be peace
inside your city walls
and in your palaces.
8Because of my friends
and my relatives,
I will pray for peace.
9And because of the house
of the Lord our God,
I will work for your good.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ wó pa dé taa zoore de yazura
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo wo mo tiini
ko pwoli dedɛ
de ba na tage de amo ba we,
“Pa-na se dé vo Baŋa Wɛ
diga kam” to.
2Jerusalem, dé laam tu
dé zege ywo mo,
teo kom manchwo-peena ni ne.
3Jerusalem ye teo kolo na fɔge ko lɔ
pa se ko lamma
ye ko jege dam to mo.
4Isarele dwia yam na ye
Baŋa Wɛ nyem to
yeini ba tui ywo
se ba ke Baŋa Wɛ lei
ne o na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei to.
5Ko maa ye teo kolo wone
pwa na jeini ba paare yitunnu
baŋa ne
ba bore bora
ba pa ba nɔɔna to mo.
Pwa banto nwoŋi Pɛ David
dwi dem wone mo.
6Ta lwoori-na Wɛ
se o nii Jerusalem baŋa ne
se nɔɔna taa zoore da de yazura.
Wɛ wó pa se balo na lage
teo kom konto ni taane to
na yiga-veiŋa.
7Wɛ wó pa se yazura taa wora
teo kom wo jei maama ne,
se ko dam jei sem de fɔge
se zege lanyerane.
8Amo chorro de a yuudwonna bam ŋwaane,
amo wó ta we,
“Yazura taa wo á tei ne.”
9Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ŋwaane,
amo beeri kolo maama
na wó pa á na yiga-veiŋa to mo.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Mercy
1Our Lord and our God,
I turn my eyes to you,
on your throne in heaven.
2Servants look to their master,
but we will look to you,
until you have mercy on us.
3Please have mercy, Lord!
We have been insulted
more than we can stand,
4and we can't take more abuse
from those proud,
conceited people.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ, duri debam yibwona!
1Amo kwoni a yia wɛɛne
a nii nmo Baŋa Wɛ mo.
Nmo ye wolo paare na di
Wɛ telaao ne to mo.
2Ne kabɛ de ka-nyaana
na beeri yibwona
ba teira tei ne tei to,
debam de nii dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ seeni konto mo
se o ba o duri dé yibwona.
3 Baŋa Wɛ, popo
tɔge n zaane dem baŋa
n duri debam ŋwaŋa.
Kokuri to, dé dona tiini
ba twe debam se ko gaale.
4Chega to, dé yera yam laam mo chɛ
de naduna na jege debam ba mɔna
ye zwabani-nyena
de gwooni debam tei to.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1The Lord was on our side!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“The Lord was on our side!
Otherwise, the enemy attack
3would have killed us all,
because it was furious.
4We would have been swept away
in a violent flood
5of high and roaring waves.”
6Let's praise the Lord!
He protected us from enemies
who were like wild animals,
7and we escaped like birds
from a hunter's torn net.
8The Lord made heaven and earth,
and he is the one
who sends us help.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ na nii o nɔɔna baŋa ne tei to
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1 Baŋa Wɛ ya ná wo zege
debam kwaga ne,
dé ya wó ke tɛ mo?
Isarele tiina bam jege
se ba leiri ba ta we:
2“Baŋa Wɛ ya ná wo zege
debam kwaga ne
maŋa kalo dé dona bam
na jeeri debam de jara to,
3tento ba ya ligi debam mela,
ba ban-lom na zaŋe
debam baŋa ne to ŋwaane.
4Tento wɛɛne dé dona ya kale debam ba ja jei,
ne na-fɔrɔ na chuuri
ye ko chwooli wonnu tei to.
5Ba ya wó wuuri ba zaŋe
dé baŋa ne mo
se dé dwi ti.”
6Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei,
de o na wo sɛ
se dé dona ma ba yeila
ba ma chɔge debam to.
7Dé nam lugi ba jeŋa ne
ne zuŋa na lugi zun-choro wone tei to.
Ba dam dem chɔge mo
pa se dé jwoŋi dé tete dé yage!
8Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo
zeini debam.
Wonto mo naane wɛyuu
dedaane tega kam baŋa maama.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord's People Are Safe
1Everyone who trusts the Lord
is like Mount Zion
that cannot be shaken
and will stand forever.
2Just as Jerusalem is protected
by mountains on every side,
the Lord protects his people
by holding them in his arms
now and forever.
3He won't let the wicked
rule his people
or lead them to do wrong.
4Let's ask the Lord to be kind
to everyone who is good
and completely obeys him.
5When the Lord punishes
the wicked,
he will punish everyone else
who lives an evil life.
Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ cho o nɔɔna se cham yé yi-ba
1Balo na ke ba wo-dedoa
de Baŋa Wɛ to
nye de Zion peo kom
na zege de dam tei to mo.
Peo kom konto ba bibiga.
Ko wora mo se ko taa vei wuu.
2Nenɛɛne peero na gilimi Jerusalem te pu tei to,
konto mo Baŋa Wɛ de kaare
o nɔɔna bam o pu,
se kolokolo yé yi-ba ko zege zem
se ko taa vei wuu.
3Puseŋ-nyena daa bá di paare
tega kalo Wɛ na pɛ o nɔɔna bam to baŋa ne.
Ko ná ke konto,
ba wae ba soge Wɛ nɔɔna bam
se ba toŋe lwarem.
4 Baŋa Wɛ, ke lanyerane n pa
nɔn-ŋona dwi dem,
de balo na tɔge chwo-laao to.
5Ko nam ná ye balo na tusi
ba ywori nmo chwoŋa kam ne to,
yɔɔre n waare-ba ne n na ke puseŋ-nyena tei to.
Yazura taa wo
Isarele tiina bam tei ne!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Celebrating the Harvest
1It seemed like a dream
when the Lord brought us back
to the city of Zion.
2We celebrated with laughter
and joyful songs.
In foreign nations it was said,
“The Lord has worked miracles
for his people.”
3And so we celebrated
because the Lord had indeed
worked miracles for us.
4Our Lord, we ask you to bless
our people again,
and let us be like streams
in the Southern Desert.
5We cried as we went out
to plant our seeds.
Now let us celebrate
as we bring in the crops.
6We cried on the way
to plant our seeds,
but we will celebrate and shout
as we bring in the crops.
translation_text:
Debam teena wo Baŋa Wɛ tei ne
1Maŋa kalo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ
se dé jwoori dé jeini
Zion teo kom ne to,
ko nye de dendwea mo dé dwɛ.
2Mwanno déem su debam ni mo.
Dé maa leeni wopwolo lei.
Dwi-gɛ tiina laam maa tɛ
debam taane ba we,
“Baŋa Wɛ mo ke wo-kamunnu dedɛ o pa-ba.”
3Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ seene o ke
wo-kamunnu o pa debam,
ye ko pwoli dé wo!
4 Baŋa Wɛ, pa se dé jwoori
dé taa jege yu-ywoŋo,
nenɛɛne doa ná nega
pa se nabare jwoori se jege na
tega-kuri seeni kagoa kam ne tei to.
5Nam pa se balo na vei
ba du wo-dwa ba kare ne
ye wo-chechɔgɔ jege-ba to
laam ba ba zage ba wodiiru tem
ye ba bage de wopwolo sɔɔ.
6Balo na keeri wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane
ye ba jege ba wo-dwa bam
ba maa vei se ba du to
laam wó jwoori maŋa kadwoŋi ne
de ba wodiiru tem
ye ba bage de wopwolo sɔɔ ba yaga.

english_text:
(A song by Solomon for worship.)
Only the Lord Can Bless a Home
1Without the help of the Lord
it is useless to build a home
or to guard a city.
2It is useless to get up early
and stay up late
in order to earn a living.
God takes care of his own,
even while they sleep.
3Children are a blessing
and a gift from the Lord.
4Having a lot of children
to take care of you
in your old age
is like a warrior
with a lot of arrows.
5The more you have,
the better off you will be,
because they will protect you
when your enemies
attack you in court.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ nii o nɔɔna baŋa ne
Solomon déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Nɔɔno ná jege o sɔŋɔ
ye ko dae Baŋa Wɛ mo lɔge-ko,
lɔra bam ná toŋe tei maama,
ba totoŋa yam ye kafɛ mo.
Ko ná dae Baŋa Wɛ mo nii
teo baŋa ne,
balo na yere-ko to de ke
kafɛ yerane mo.
2Nmo ná gwoni tega
n vo n totoŋa ni ne
se n toŋe taa n na n ni-wodiu
se ko chɛ n yera tei maama,
ko bá taa jege kuri ko pa‑m.
Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo nii
o nɔn-swonnu tem baŋa ne,
ne ba ná peini tete ne mo de.
3Bia ye Wɛ pɛɛre mo
o na kwei o pa debam.
Bia balo dé na loge to
ye Wɛ mo ke zaane dé yuu ne.
4Nmo na loge bakeiri selo
n nɔn-donne maŋa ne to
nye de bembea na zei che-tɛɛra
o jeŋa ne tei to mo.
5Wolo maama ná jege bia dedɛ
ne o che-kɔŋɔ na su de chena tei to,
kotu tiini o jege yu-ywoŋo mo.
Wonto ná vei o jeeri o dona teo kom manchwo-peena ni ne,
chaveera bá di‑o.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Rewards His Faithful People
1The Lord will bless you
if you respect him
and obey his laws.
2Your fields will produce,
and you will be happy—
all will go well.
3Your wife will be as fruitful
as a grapevine,
and just as an olive tree
is rich with olives,
your home will be rich
with healthy children.
4This is how the Lord will bless
everyone who respects him.
5I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion
and let Jerusalem prosper
as long as you live.
6May you live long enough
to see your grandchildren.
Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Wɛ zaane wo balo na kɔre‑o to yuu ne
1Ko ná ye balo maama
na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ
ye ba tɔge o chwei sem to,
Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne!
2Nmo wó di n totoŋa nyɔɔre
pa se n ta‑n zoore de yazura
de wopwolo.
3Nmo kaane wó taa lore bia mo
o pa‑m,
nenɛɛne tei-ŋoŋo na leiri
bia dedɛ tei to.
Nmo bia bam wó taa kaare‑m
nenɛɛne teeni na puli
ye de ke nɔɔna tei to.
4Chega to, wolo maama ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ,
Wɛ wó ke zaane kotu yuu ne.
5 Baŋa Wɛ wó zege Zion ne
o swoli nmo swolim.
Maŋa maama ye n ta ŋwe to,
Wɛ wó pa n maane we
Jerusalem teo kom vei yiga lanyerane.
6Wɛ wó pa n ta‑n ŋwe
se n di wodiu n naaro jeŋa ne.
Yazura taa wo
Isarele tiina bam tei ne!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Protection
1Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
But they have not defeated me,
3though my back is like a field
that has just been plowed.”
4The Lord always does right,
and he has set me free
from the ropes
of those cruel people.
5I pray that all who hate
the city of Zion
will be made ashamed
and forced to turn and run.
6May they be like grass
on the flat roof of a house,
grass that dries up
as soon as it sprouts.
7Don't let them be like wheat
gathered in bundles.
8And don't let anyone
who passes by say to them,
“The Lord bless you!
I give you my blessing
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ na wó ke Isarele tiina dona bam tei to
1Ko na maŋe ko zege
amo biini ne to
mo a dona bam yɔɔre
ba jege-ne ba daana.
Isarele tiina bam jege se ba leiri
ba ta we:
2“Ko na maŋe ko zege amo biini ne to
mo a dona bam yɔɔre
ba jege-ne ba daana,
ye ba wo wane-ne ba ja chɔge.
3Amo kwaga kam laam nye
de bwolo mo
ba na mɛ nabɛ ba ma lɔ pempala
ba tiŋi.
4 Baŋa Wɛ nam yɔɔre
o tɔge chwoŋa chekke mo.
O ma gwoni puseŋ-nyena bam ŋone sem
se a wane a lu ba jeŋa ne.”
5Balo maama na chuli Zion teo kom to mo
Wɛ wó pa ba na ba chaveera,
pa se ba pipiri ba jwoori kwaga.
6Wɛ wó pa se ba jei lela,
nenɛɛne diga nayuu gaaro
na kwaare te te lela tei to.
7Zagena bam yiga tera
gaaro tem konto wone.
Ba maa ba gaane-te ba tiŋa.
8Balo na tɔge banto seeni ba kɛ to
bá sɛ se ba sɔɔle Wɛ swolim
ba pa-ba.
Ba bá ta nenɛɛne,
“Baŋa Wɛ swolim taa wo á baŋa ne.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Trusting the Lord in Times of Trouble
1From a sea of troubles
I cry out to you, Lord.
2Won't you please listen
as I beg for mercy?
3If you kept record of our sins,
no one could last long.
4But you forgive us,
and so we will worship you.
5With all my heart,
I am waiting, Lord, for you!
I trust your promises.
6I wait for you more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
Yes, I wait more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
7Israel, trust the Lord!
God is always merciful
and has the power to save you.
8 Israel, the Lord will save you
from all your sins.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ jege debam ŋwaŋa
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
a zege na-luŋa kuri ne mo
a keeri a jare nmo.
2Amo Teiru, cheigi amo keira kam!
Ja, pore n zwa se n cheigi
amo wɛ-lworo kom.
3 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ya ná jeeli
nɔɔna tusim kikia n tiŋi,
nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá na bora
n yiga ne.
4Nmo nam kwei nɔɔna wɛleera
n ma n chɛ-ba,
se ko pa dé taa kɔre‑m mo.
5Amo zege a cheigi de a wo maama
se Baŋa Wɛ laam ba o zeini-ne.
Amo teena nam wo
o taane dem wone mo.
6Amo yɔɔre a yere a nii mo
se amo Teiru Wɛ laam ba
o zeini-ne,
ko dwoi tete yerena bam na jege teena
se tega laam ba ka poore tei to.
Chega to, a teena wo Baŋa Wɛ wone,
ko dwoi yerena bam na jege teena
we tega kam wó ba ka poore tei to.
7Isarele tiina bam,
pa-na se á teena taa daŋe
Baŋa Wɛ baŋa ne.
Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ swono kom
ba fɔge ko tia.
O maa yɔɔre o vere nɔɔna
o yage chekke.
8Wonto tete mo lage o jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam
ba tusim kikia yam maama wone
o yage.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Trust the Lord!
1I am not conceited, Lord,
and I don't waste my time
on impossible schemes.
2But I have learned to feel safe
and satisfied,
like a young child
in its mother's arms.
3People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
now and forever.
translation_text:
Bochare-zuru taane
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
amo wo zeiŋi a tete.
A maa wo boŋe kamunni
a pa a tete.
A nam ba jeeli wo-kamuna yalo
na dwoi a jaanem to jeila.
2Amo nam jei mo chemm,
ye a bochare zuri,
nenɛɛne bu-seseŋa na ye tei
o nu nɛ baŋa ne to.
3Isarele tiina bam,
pa-na se á teena taa daŋe
Baŋa Wɛ baŋa ne,
ko zege zem se ko taa vei wuu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Is Always with His People
1Our Lord, don't forget David
and how he suffered.
2Mighty God of Jacob,
remember how he promised:
3“I won't go home
or crawl into bed
4or close my eyelids,
5until I find a home for you,
the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
6 When we were in Ephrath,
we heard that the sacred chest
was somewhere near Jaar.
7Then we said, “Let's go
to the throne of the Lord
and worship at his feet.”
8Come to your new home, Lord,
you and the sacred chest
with all its power.
9Let victory be like robes
for the priests;
let your faithful people
celebrate and shout.
10David is your chosen one,
so don't reject him.
11 You made a solemn promise
to David, when you said,
“I, the Lord, promise
that someone in your family
will always be king.
12If they keep our agreement
and follow my teachings,
then someone in your family
will rule forever.”
13You have gladly chosen Zion
as your home, our Lord.
14You said, “This is my home!
I will live here forever.
15I will bless Zion with food,
and even the poor will eat
until they are full.
16Victory will be like robes
for the priests,
and its faithful people
will celebrate and shout.
17 I will give mighty power
to the kingdom of David.
Each of my chosen kings
will shine like a lamp
18and wear a sparkling crown.
But I will disgrace
their enemies.”
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem zula
1Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
guli Pɛ David gula,
de o na yaare totoŋa baŋa ne
tei to.
2O déem dugi duuri mo
de nmo Baŋa Wɛ wom
na ye Jakob dwi tiina
Dam maama Tu wom to.
O ma pwooli o we:
3“Amo bá sɛ se a zo a diga,
naa se a peini a sara ne,
4naa se dɔɔne ba amo yia ne
de fenfee de,
5ko ná dae we amo nɛ jeiga
a pa Baŋa Wɛ,
pa se Jakob dwi tiina
Dam maama Tu Wɛ wom
taa zoore da.”
6Nii-na! Dé déem na wo Eferata ne to,
mo dé nigi Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ŋwa.
Dé ma na-ka Jeerim kare sem ne.
7Pa-na se dé vo Baŋa Wɛ
wara-jei sem ne,
se dé kuni dwoona o yiga ne
dé zuli‑o.
8 Baŋa Wɛ, nam zaŋe
n ba n zo n jeiŋa jei sem ne!
Tɔge de n ni-gwonim dakaa kam
n ba n ta‑n zoore da,
se n dam dem bere ja!
9Pa se n kaanem tiina bam
zo nɔn-ŋonne ne,
ne ba zo gare-laaro mo to.
Pa se n tete nɔɔna bam
taa chaka de wopwolo.
10Nam da n tontoŋeno David ŋwaane
se n yé fɔge n ve wolo n laam
na tiŋi se o di paare
n nɔɔna baŋa ne to.
11Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ déem
dugi duuri de Pɛ David
ye o daa bá jwoori o ni dem
kwaga ne.
O maa we: “Nɔɔno wó nwoŋi
n dwi dem wone mo o ji pɛ.
12Nmo dwi dem ná sɛ ni-gwonim delo a na ke de-ba to
ye ba tɔge bera yalo a na pɛ-ba to,
banto wó taa di nmo paare dem mo se ko taa vei wuu.”
13 Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o kuri Zion mo
se o pa ko taa ye o jeiŋa jei.
14O maa we:
“Ywo mo ye amo jeiŋa jei
mɛ amo na wó taa zoore
taa wuu to.
15Amo wó pa se Zion tiina bam jeŋa
taa jega se ko gaale.
Ba yiniga tiina bam de tete
wó taa di ba sui mo.
16Ba kaanem tiina bam wó taa pae a verem dem yi nɔɔna.
Amo tete nɔɔna balo na wo teo kom wone to
wó taa leeni de wopwolo
taa wuu.
17Ywo-seeni mo amo wó pa
se David dwi paare dem
taa zege de dam.
A ta wó pa se wolo amo na tiŋi
se o ji pɛ to
taa jege pwooni o ŋwea wone.
18Amo wó pa se chaveera di
o dona bam.
O tete paare dem nam
wó taa jege nenɔŋa lanyerane.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Living Together in Peace
1It is truly wonderful
when the people of God
live together in peace.
2It is as beautiful as olive oil
poured on Aaron's head
and running down his beard
and the collar of his robe.
3It is like the dew
from Mount Hermon,
falling on Zion's mountains,
where the Lord has promised
to bless his people
with life forevermore.
translation_text:
Zurigaluu mo tei dam
David déem pane leiŋa kanto.
1Nii-na! Balo na ye nu-biu to
ná zoore daane de ni dedwe,
ko tiini ko lamma
pa ba di ywoni lanyerane.
2Ni-ywom dem konto nye de
Wɛ swolim nuga mo
ba kwei ba lwo Aron yuu ne
pa se ka duri ka bɔɔre
o twana yam maama
ka ta tu ka yi o gwaaro tem
nia yam de.
3Nu-biu swono ta maa nye de
Heremon nyɔnɔ kom dwoŋi
na toe Zion peo yuu ne tei to.
Ko maa ye dáane mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ ni
se o swolim taa wo
o nɔɔna baŋa ne,
pa se ba na ŋwea taa wuu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Praising the Lord at Night
1Everyone who serves the Lord,
come and offer praises.
Everyone who has gathered
in his temple tonight,
2lift your hands in prayer
toward his holy place
and praise the Lord.
3The Lord is the Creator
of heaven and earth,
and I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion.
translation_text:
Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
1Nii-na!
Abam balo maama na ye
Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena to,
tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
Abam balo na zege o wara-jei sem ne á zuli‑o tete ne to,
tei-o-na!
2Zeiŋi-na á jea wɛɛne
á jeeri Wɛ diga kam,
á ma‑á seini Baŋa Wɛ.
3 Baŋa Wɛ mo naane wɛyuu
de tega baŋa maama,
ye wonto wó zege Zion ne
o swɛ abam swolim.

english_text:
In Praise of the Lord's Kindness
1Shout praises to the Lord!
You are his servants,
so praise his name.
2All who serve in the temple
of the Lord our God,
3come and shout praises.
Praise the name of the Lord!
He is kind and good.
4He chose the family of Jacob
and the people of Israel
for his very own.
5The Lord is much greater
than any other god.
6He does as he chooses
in heaven and on earth
and deep in the sea.
7The Lord makes the clouds rise
from far across the earth,
and he makes lightning
to go with the rain.
Then from his secret place
he sends out the wind.
8The Lord killed the first-born
of people and animals
in the land of Egypt.
9God used miracles and wonders
to fight the king of Egypt
and all of his officials.
10He destroyed many nations
and killed powerful kings,
11including King Sihon
of the Amorites
and King Og of Bashan.
He conquered every kingdom
in the land of Canaan
12and gave their property
to his people Israel.
13The name of the Lord
will be remembered forever,
and he will be famous
for all time to come.
14The Lord will bring justice
and show mercy to all
who serve him.
15 Idols of silver and gold
are made and worshiped
in other nations.
16They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
17They are completely deaf,
and they can't breathe.
18Everyone who makes idols
and all who trust them
will end up as helpless
as their idols.
19Everyone in Israel,
come praise the Lord!
All the family of Aaron
20and all the tribe of Levi,
come praise the Lord!
All of his worshipers,
come praise the Lord.
21Praise the Lord from Zion!
He lives here in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!
1Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!
Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ yere dem!
Abam balo na ye o tontoŋena to,
tei-o-na!
2Ko maa ye abam balo na zege
Baŋa Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne
ye á toŋe á pa‑o
o wara-jei sem ne to.
3Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ,
se o tiini o lamma.
Leeni-na lei á seini o yere dem,
ko na pae ywoni to ŋwaane.
4Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ kuri
Jakob dwi dem mo
se ba taa ye o tete nɔɔna.
Isarele tiina bam ye o tete
nyɔn-mage nyem mo.
5Chega ŋwaane to, a lɔre we
Baŋa Wɛ jege dam.
O maa ye Wɛ-kamunu o dwoi
wa yam maama wuu.
6Ko ná ye wɛyuu ne mo
naa tega kam baŋa ne ywoo,
naa naneero tem wone mo de,
dedaane te kuri kuri jei sem maama,
Baŋa Wɛ yeini o toŋe o fera
na lage tei maama to mo.
7O maa pae se kunkwonnu tigisa
logo baŋa ni maama ne.
O ta maa pae se doa nena
ye ka ta yeini ka pepela.
Ko ta ná ye vio kom,
o yeini o pore-ko mo
se ko nwoŋi
ko dole jei maama ne.
8Wɛ déem mo mage bu-kwea dwi maama Ejipti teo ne,
pa se nabiina dedaane vara
wo-kwe sem maama te.
9O ma ke wo-kenkagela
dedaane totoŋ-kamuna
Ejipti tiina bam tetare ne,
ye o tɔge ya baŋa o chɔge
Ejipti Pa-faro wom
dedaane o nakwa bam maama.
10O déem wane teene dedɛ mo o di,
ye o daare o ti pwa-kamuna momwɛ.
11Ko déem ye Amori tiina Pɛ Sihon,
de Basan teo Pɛ Oga,
dedaane Kanaan tiina pwa badwonna bam maama mo konto.
12O laam ma kwei ba tega kam
o pa o nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam
se ba taa tei taa wuu.
13 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yere dem
wó taa wora mo taa wuu.
Ko zege zem se ko vo ko yi
dwi delo na saŋe to maama,
nɔɔna wó taa guli n yere dem gula.
14Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ wó zege
o nɔɔna bam kwaga ne
pa se ba na ba bora.
O maa wó duri o tontoŋena bam yibwona.
15Jwona yalo dwi-gɛ tiina bam
na jege ba kaane to
ye lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa mo
ba mɛ ba ke-ya.
Nabiina mo mɔɔne-ya de ba jeŋa.
16Ya maa jege nia
ye ya ware ya ŋɔɔne.
Ya ta jege yia. Ya nam ba nae de.
17Ya maa jege zwa
ye ya ware ya cheigi taane.
Siu de nam ba tɔge ya momwa ne ko nwoŋa.
18Balo maama na mɔɔne jwona to
wó ba ba taa nye de-ya.
Balo de na ke ba wo-dedoa de-ya to
wó ji nɔn-yɔɔro mo.
19Isarele dwi tiina bam,
tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
Aron dwi dem de,
abam de tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
20Levi dwi tiina bam, tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!
Abam balo maama na kɔre
Baŋa Wɛ to,
zaŋe-na á tei‑o!
21Balo maama na wo Zion ne to,
tei-na Baŋa Wɛ,
o na zoore Jerusalem ne to ŋwaane!
Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_text:
God's Love Never Fails
1 Praise the Lord! He is good.
God's love never fails.
2Praise the God of all gods.
God's love never fails.
3Praise the Lord of lords.
God's love never fails.
4Only God works great miracles.
God's love never fails.
5 With wisdom he made the sky.
God's love never fails.
6 The Lord stretched the earth
over the ocean.
God's love never fails.
7 He made the bright lights
in the sky.
God's love never fails.
8He lets the sun rule each day.
God's love never fails.
9He lets the moon and the stars
rule each night.
God's love never fails.
10 God struck down the first-born
in every Egyptian family.
God's love never fails.
11 He rescued Israel from Egypt.
God's love never fails.
12God used his great strength
and his powerful arm.
God's love never fails.
13 He split the Red Sea apart.
God's love never fails.
14The Lord brought Israel safely
through the sea.
God's love never fails.
15He destroyed the Egyptian king
and his army there.
God's love never fails.
16The Lord led his people
through the desert.
God's love never fails.
17Our God defeated mighty kings.
God's love never fails.
18And he killed famous kings.
God's love never fails.
19 One of them was Sihon,
king of the Amorites.
God's love never fails.
20 Another was King Og of Bashan.
God's love never fails.
21God took away their land.
God's love never fails.
22He gave their land to Israel,
the people who serve him.
God's love never fails.
23God saw the trouble we were in.
God's love never fails.
24He rescued us from our enemies.
God's love never fails.
25He gives food to all who live.
God's love never fails.
26Praise God in heaven!
God's love never fails.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ swono kom taane
1Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o lamma.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
2Dé ke-na Wɛ wom
na tei wa maama to lei.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
3Dé ke-na yuu tiina maama
Yuu-tu lei.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
4Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei!
Wonto mae o tete dam mo
o ke totoŋ-kamuna.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
5O déem tɔge o yeino kom ŋwaane mo
o ke wɛyuu kom maama.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
6O ta ma jare tega kam ni maama
pa se ka tigi
na-fwaaro tem baŋa ne.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
7O ke wo-nyen-kamuna yam
wɛyuu ne.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
8O ma pa se wea kam
taa pae pwooni dɛ dem wone.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
9Se chana kam de chalechwe sem
taa nii tete dem baŋa ne.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
10Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei!
O déem go Ejipti tiina
bu-kwe sem maama.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
11O ma daare o ja Isarele tiina bam
o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
12O mɛ o dam-fɔrɔ kom mo
o ke totoŋ-kamunnu tem konto.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
13O déem pɛ se Nane-soŋo kom
pɔɔre belei mo.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
14O ma pa Isarele tiina bam
da na bam tetare ne ba kɛ.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
15Ko nam ná ye Ejipti Pa-faro wom
de o jar-keira bam,
o pɛ naneo kom lini-ba mo.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
16Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei!
O déem tɔge o nɔɔna bam yiga
se ba taa tɔge kagoa kam wone mo ba via.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
17O ma ti pwa-kamuna momwɛ.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
18Chega ŋwaane to, o go pwa balo
na jege yere to.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
19Amori tiina Pɛ Sihon déem ye
ba dedoa mo.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
20Basan teo Pɛ Oga maa ye wodwoŋi.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
21O kwei banto tega kam mo
o pa o nɔɔna bam.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
22O ma kwei-ka o pa
Isarele dwi tiina bam
se ba taa tei-ka wuu,
ba na ye o tontoŋena to ŋwaane.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
23Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei!
Wonto mo guli debam gula,
dedaane dé ná wo cham wone.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
24O ma vere debam o yage
dé dona bam jeŋa ne.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
25Wonto mo pae nabiina
de vara maama ba ni-wodiu.
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.
26Pa se dé ke-na
Telaao Tu Wɛ wom lei!
O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_text:
A Prayer for Revenge
1Beside the rivers of Babylon
we thought about Jerusalem,
and we sat down and cried.
2We hung our small harps
on the willow trees.
3Our enemies had brought us here
as their prisoners;
now they wanted us to sing
and entertain them.
They insulted us and shouted,
“Sing about Zion!”
4Here in a foreign land,
how can we sing
about the Lord?
5Jerusalem, if I forget you,
let my right hand go limp.
6Let my tongue stick
to the roof of my mouth,
if I don't think about you
above all else.
7Our Lord, punish the Edomites!
On the day Jerusalem fell,
they shouted,
“Completely destroy the city!
Tear down every building!”
8 Babylon, you are doomed!
I pray the Lord's blessings
on anyone who punishes you
for what you did to us.
9May the Lord bless everyone
who beats your children
against the rocks!
translation_text:
Wo-chechɔgɔ leiŋa
1Dé déem yeini dé jei
Babilon teo bwi sem ni ne
dé ka yi-na mo,
dé na guli dé teo Zion gula to ŋwaane.
2Dé ma kwei dé kwanno tem mo
dé pale nabare sem ni
teeni dem nɛ yera ne
dé yage da.
3Kolo ŋwaane, dé dona
déem daane debam mo
se dé leeni leiŋa dé pa-ba.
Ba maa jege debam ba bɛɛsa
se ba pa dé leeni wopwolo lei
ye ba we,
“Leeni-na leiŋa na vei
Zion teo kom seeni to
á bere debam.”
4Debam nam na zoore
sa-teo wone konto to,
dé wó ke tɛ mo se dé leeni leiŋa
kalo na vei Baŋa Wɛ seeni to?
