Ba maa tae ba chena ye ba goe nɔɔna.
17Ba nam lage ba di á mena de á wodiiru maama mo.
Ko ná ye á bia, ba wó go ba maama,
bakeiri dedaane busankane.
Ba ta wó di á vara maama,
ye ba chɔge á Vini teeni de á kaporro.
Ko ná ye teene delo na lɔge de pe
ye á ya boŋe se á seigi de wone to,
ba wó chɔge-de jara-keim baŋa ne mo.”
18 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we, “Maŋa kam konto ná yia, amo bá yɔɔre a chɔge abam maama a ti konto. 19Nɔɔna bam ná bwei nmo Jeremia ba we, ‘Bɛŋwaane mo dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se tento maama yi debam?’, se n ta de-ba we, ‘Ko ke abam konto, á na nwoŋi amo Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne ye á daare á jege wa-yɔɔro á zuli á tete tega kam ne to ŋwaane mo. Mo kokuri abam nam wó vo sa-teo se á ta‑á toŋe á pa veira.’
20Tɔɔle-na kwora kanto se Jakob dwi tiina bam maama ni.
Nam pa-na se ka yi Judah laŋa kam maama.
21Cheigi-na Wɛ taane dem,
se á ye jworru mo ye á ta ga boboŋa.
Abam jege yia, ye ya ba nae.
Á ma‑á jege zwa, ye á ba ni taane kuri.
22Ko ya maŋe se á ta‑á kɔre amo Baŋa Wɛ,
ye á yera sae de amo.
Amo mo ke naneo ni kasolo a ma a che-ko.
Konto ma ji naneo kom siseini se ko taa vei wuu.
Naneo kom na-ŋone ná maŋe se diini wɛɛne tei,
ye se ná wuuri tei maama de,
na bam bá gaale siseini delo a na tiŋi a pa-ba to.
23Amo nɔɔna bam nam tiini ba jege yi-dɛɛre dedɛ,
ye ba zwa de ba ni.
Ba lɔge amo kwaga ne mo,
ye ba pipiri ba viiri ba daare-ne.
24Ba ba tɛ daane we,
‘Pa-na se dé taa kɔre dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ.
Kokuri to, duum doa maŋa ná yeini ka yi,
ye kwea doa maŋa de yi,
wonto mo pae se doa nena ka maŋa ne chekke.
O maa da ko ŋwaane o pa dé zage mena lanyerane.’
25Wonnu tem konto nam wo ke,
á wɛleera yam ŋwaane.
Á tusim kikia yam de ma che abam
de wo-laaro tento maama.
26Puseŋ-nyena mo tɔge ba gwaane de a nɔɔna bam.
Ba dale mo ye ba vwɛ,
ne nɔɔno na vwɛ tei se o ja zuŋa to.
Ko nam ye kalanchorro mo ba choa se ba ja nabiina.
27Banto sam dem su de vwa kikia mo,
ne zun-bora na su de zuna tei to.
Ba laam ma da keina yam konto baŋa ne
ba ji dedɛɛra, ye ba ta dum.
28Ba ma yɔɔre ba nu bigila bigila,
ye ba ba sɛ se ba yage lwarem kikia.
Ko ná ye botara dedaane nabwona,
puseŋ-nyena bam bá zege ba kwaga ne
se ba jaŋe ba di bora ba pa-ba.
29A nam ná waare-ba ba keim dem konto ŋwaane,
ko dae ko chwoŋa ne mo na?
Amo bá jwoori a ŋwe ba wɛleera jene,
ba dwi dem na ye puseŋ-nyena to ŋwaane na?”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
30“Woŋo kolo na didigi yera to mo jege ko ke tega kanto ne.
Ko maa tiini ko ye wo-zɔɔne.
31Sampwori sem pworisi vwa yerane mo.
Kaanem tiina bam de ma kwei ba tete dam
ba nii nɔɔna bam baŋa ne.
A nɔɔna bam ma yɔɔre ba lage ko na ye tei konto to.
Wonnu tento maama kweelim ná yia,
abam lage á ke tetɛ mo?”

english_text:
A Warning for the People of Jerusalem
The Lord said:
1Run for your lives,
people of Benjamin.
Get out of Jerusalem.
Sound a trumpet in Tekoa
and light a signal fire
in Beth-Haccherem.
Soon you will be struck
by disaster from the north.
2Jerusalem is a lovely pasture,
3but shepherds will surround it
and divided up,
then let their flocks
eat all the grass.
4Kings will tell their troops,
“If we reach Jerusalem
in the morning,
we'll attack at noon.
But if we arrive later,
5we'll attack after dark
and destroy its fortresses.”
6I am the Lord All-Powerful,
and I will command these armies
to chop down trees
and build a ramp up to the walls
of Jerusalem.
People of Jerusalem,
I must punish you
for your injustice.
7Evil pours from your city
like water from a spring.
Sounds of injustice and violence
echo within your walls;
victims are everywhere,
wounded and dying.
8Listen to me,
you people of Jerusalem
and Judah.
I will abandon you,
and your land will become
an empty desert.
9I will tell your enemies
to leave your nation bare
like a vine stripped of grapes.
I, the Lord All-Powerful,
have spoken.
Jeremiah's Anger
10I have told the people
that you, Lord,
will punish them,
but they just laugh
and refuse to listen.
11Your anger against Judah
flames up inside me,
and I can't hold it in
much longer.
The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away
The Lord answered:
Don't hold back my anger!
Let it sweep away everyone—
the children at play
and all adults,
young and old alike.
12 I'll punish the people of Judah
and give to others
their houses and fields,
as well as their wives.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
13Everyone is greedy and dishonest,
whether poor or rich.
Even the prophets and priests
cannot be trusted.
14 All they ever offer
to my deeply wounded people
are empty hopes for peace.
15They should be ashamed
of their disgusting sins,
but they don't even blush.
And so, when I punish Judah,
they will end up on the ground,
dead like everyone else.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
16The Lord said:
My people, when you stood
at the crossroads,
I told you, “Follow the road
your ancestors took,
and you will find peace.”
But you refused.
17I also sent prophets
to warn you of danger,
but when they sounded the alarm,
you paid no attention.
18So I tell all nations on earth,
“Watch what I will do!
19My people ignored me
and rejected my laws.
They planned to do evil,
and now the evil they planned
will happen to them.”
20People of Judah,
you bring me incense from Sheba
and spices from distant lands.
You offer sacrifices of all kinds.
But why bother?
I hate these gifts of yours!
21So I will put stumbling blocks
in your path,
and everyone will die,
including parents and children,
neighbors and friends.
An Army from the North
22The Lord said,
“Look toward the north,
where a powerful nation
has prepared for war.
23Its well-armed troops are cruel
and never show mercy.
Their galloping horses sound
like ocean waves
pounding on the shore.
This army will attack you,
lovely Jerusalem.”
24Then the people said,
“Just hearing about them
makes us tremble with fear,
and we twist and turn in pain
like a woman giving birth.”
25The Lord said,
“Don't work in your fields
or walk along the roads.
It's too dangerous.
The enemy is well armed
26and attacks without warning.
So mourn, my people, as though
your only child had died.
Wear clothes made of sackcloth
and roll in the ash pile.”
The Lord's People Must Be Tested
The Lord said:
27Jeremiah, test my people
as though they were metal.
28And you'll find they are hard
like bronze and iron.
They are stubborn rebels,
always spreading lies.
* 29-30Silver can be purified
in a fiery furnace,
but my people are too wicked
to be made pure,
and so I have rejected them.
translation_text:
Judah tiina dona wó gilimi ba kaare Jerusalem
1Benjamin dwi tiina bam, duri-na se á lu!
Duri á nwoŋi-na á daare Jerusalem teo kom!
Wu-na nabwanno á kaane Tekoa nɔn-bia bam,
se á daare á tɔre mini Bɛte-Hakerem ne
se de nyoa kam ji ni-kaana ka pa nɔɔna bam.
Kokuri lɛɛro mo lage te zege baŋa seeni te ba ywo-seeni.
Ko nam wó ja chɔgem dedɛ ko ba.
2Jerusalem teo ya nye de a bukɔ-laao mo,
ye o tiini o jege ŋwaane o pa-ne!
Amo nam wó chɔge‑o.
3Pwa de ba jar-keira mo lage ba ba
ba jeeri abam de jara.
Ba wó chwi ba vwoa ba gilimi teo kom,
ne nayera de ba vare-kɔgɔ kom tei to.
Kɔgɔ maama wó jeini ko jeiga ne,
se ba di ba na lage mɛ to.
4Ba maa wó ta ba jar-keira bam we,
“Ti-na á yiga se dé ja jara yam se dé yi teo kom.
Pa-na se dé zaŋe ba baŋa ne wea tetare ne.”
Ba ta wó ta we, “Maŋa tiini ka kɛ.
Wɛ dem guni ye tega lage ka yi.
5Konto ŋwaane dé wó zaŋe dé li-ba tete ne mo,
se dé chɔge ba sɔ-fwaaro tem maama!”
6Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ de ma ta o we:
“Zage-na teeni dem á de tega ne,
ye á daare á lɔ taara
á yeiri Jerusalem kabiri sem teiŋa ne.
Amo wó waare ko nɔn-bia bam,
ba na yɔɔre ba sɛ puseŋa totoŋa to ŋwaane.
7Ne vole na yeini de buri na tei to,
konto mo amo nɔɔna bam de yɔɔre ba ke lwarem.
Jei maama ne, nankɔɔre de vuvuga totoŋa sɔɔ mo zaŋa.
Jaweero de zonne mo jege nɔɔna bam,
ye amo nae te maama!
8Jerusalem tiina bam,
cheigi-na amo ni-kaana yam.
Ko ná dae konto,
amo wó dole abam a yage mo.
A ta maa wó pa se á teo kom ji di-dwonnu,
se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane da o zo.”
Isarele tiina bam ve Wɛ ni-kaana yam
9Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“Jeremia, pa se ba kwaane ba lare
nɔɔna balo ta na daare Isarele tiina bam wone to,
se ba wolowolo daa yé daare,
nenɛɛne ba na lare Vini tio-bia tei,
ye kolokolo wo daare tio kom yera ne tei to.”
10Amo nam ná ŋɔɔne de nɔɔna bam,
nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ se o jwoŋi nmo ni-kaana yam.
Ba zwa yam kwareme mo,
ye ba ve se ba cheigi taane.
Ba yiga daa tera Baŋa Wɛ taane dem wone,
ye ba ba ni de ywoni.
11Amo de bane tiini de fuli
ne Baŋa Wɛ bane na zaŋe tei to mo,
pa se a daa ware a tete se a ja.
Baŋa Wɛ ma leiri o we:
“Kwei a ban-lom dem
n lwo teo kom nɔn-bia bam maama yera ne,
ko ná maŋe ko ye bia bam na kwɛɛre pwooni ne to,
de nɔn-donno tem na kare ba jeeri daane to.
A bane dem bá muri nɔɔn-nɔɔno,
de kan-banna, de ba kaana bam,
de nɔn-kwe, de balo na gɛ fee se ba te to maama de.
12Amo wó kwei ba sam dem, de ba kare sem,
dedaane ba kaana bam,
a pa nɔɔna badwonna se ba taa tei.
Chega to, a lage a yɔɔre a waare
balo na zoore tega kanto wone to mo.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
13“Ba wone nɔɔna maama pini o dwoŋi mo
se o ma ji nɔɔno.
Nɔn-kamuna, de nɔn-balwa maama ke konto dwoŋi mo.
Wɛ kaanem tiina tete de o sampwori sem
de maa yeini ba tɔge vwa kikia.
14Ba nii a nɔɔna bam zonne dem
nenɛɛne de ye mɔle yerane mo tei.
Ba maa we, ‘Yazura taa wo á tei ne.’
Yazura nam tera se ya yi a nɔɔna bam.
15Ko ya maŋe se chaveera taa jege-ba
ba wo-zɔɔna kikia yam ŋwaane.
Ko nam ba sae ba yera.
Ba maŋe ba yeiri chaveera na ye kolo to.
Konto ŋwaane, ba de wó to tega ne mo,
nenɛɛne nɔɔna maama na toe tei to.
Amo ná tu a waare-ba,
ba kweelim jeiga mo konto.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Isarele tiina ve Wɛ chwoŋa kam
16 Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“A nɔɔna bam, vei á zege-na chwo-pwɛa yam ne
se á ta‑á fɔge á nia.
Nam ta bwei-na se á lɔre
á nabaara chwei sem déem na ye tei to.
Kuri-na chwo-laao kom,
se á ta‑á vei ka wone,
se á bochara zuri.
Abam ma ve ye á we, ‘Dé bá tɔge-ka.’
17Amo ta ma toŋe a tontoŋena á tei ne,
se ba taa yere abam.
A maa we, ‘Cheigi-na se á ni nabɔnɔ kom kwori!’
Abam ta maa we, ‘Dé bá cheigi.’
18Tɔ, dwi tiina maama, cheigi-na lanyerane!
Abam balo na nii to,
lɔre-na kolo na lage ko ke a nɔɔna bam yera ne to.
19Tega baŋa maama, cheigi-na ywo-seeni.
Amo lage a pa se lɛɛro mo yi a nɔɔna bam,
ba pale-kia yam ŋwaane.
Ba yɔɔre ba swoi se ba taa ve a taane mo.
Ba ma virigi ba kwaga ba ya amo nia yam.
20Ko ná ye talwoŋ-ywoŋa kalo ba na jaane ba nwoŋi Seba ne to,
de nu-ywoŋa kam ba na jaane ba nwoŋi teo yiga yiga to,
amo yiga tera se wone.
Amo bá jwoŋi á zwɛɛm pɛɛra yam,
kokuri to, ya wo su a yi.
21Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam lage a kwei da-bunnu mo
a tiŋi nɔɔna banto chwoŋa ne.
Kwoa de ba bia laam maa wó gare ba to.
Balo de na ye fara daane to,
de ba badwonna de maa wó jei.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Jar-keira wó nwoŋi baŋa seeni ba ba
22 Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“Kwoni á nii-na baŋa seeni!
Te-fɔrɔ nɔɔna mo maa beene abam baŋa.
Ba nam ti ba yiga mo ba nwoŋi yiga yiga
se ba ba ba jeeri abam de jara.
23Ba zei ba tɛ dedaane ba chichwoa mo ba beena.
Ba nam tiini ba jege puseŋa mo,
ye ba ba jege nɔɔna yibwona kɔtaa!
Ba wurigi ba sisein-nɔɔna
ne naneo na-ŋona na wuuri tei to mo.
Ba ke ba tete ba ke daane
se ba kwaare jara de abam Jerusalem tiina bam.”
Nɔɔna bam ma ta ba we:
24“Debam nigi nɔɔna bam konto ŋwa mo,
pa se dé vɔna pare.
Foone tiini de jege debam mo,
nenɛɛne kaane na virigi puga se o lo
ye ko ke‑o tei to.
25Nam yé ta‑á kare á vei pwola ne yɔɔ yɔɔ,
Á nam yé ta‑á kare chwo-fare sem ne á via,
kokuri, dé dona bam wo jei maama ne mo,
ye ba zei se-zɔɔro ba mae ba fugi debam.”
Amo Jeremia maa we:
26“Amo nɔɔna bam, zo-na gare-nyenyaaro,
ye á bibili tentwarem wone
á wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane.
Ta‑á keeri-na nenɛɛne nɔɔno na gɛ o bu-doa
ye o keeri o lua tei to.
Kokuri, dé dona bam wó pɔpɔ ba zaŋe dé baŋa ne mo.”
Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we:
27“A pɛ nmo ni mo
se n faŋe a nɔɔna bam n nii.
Nmo nam ná faŋe-ba,
n wó lɔre ba na ye nɔɔna dwi delo to,
ne nɔɔno na faŋe luuru dwi dwi o nii tei to.
28Ba maama ye zwabani-nyena mo.
Ba maa kare ba bae da-bebara.
Ba wo maa tiini ko dana
ko dwoi channa de luuru na ye tei to.
Ba maa yɔɔre ba jege daane ba chɔga.
29Mini fonyogo kom tiini ko dana chekke,
se ko le weero lu-nyenno tem wone.
Ba nam ná maŋe ba kwaane tei,
ko maama ye kafɛ mo.
Ba maa ware ba le puseŋ-nyena bam
a nɔɔna bam wone.
30Ba wó taa bwoi a nɔɔna bam we,
lu-nyenno telo ba na ve to mo,
kokuri to, amo Baŋa Wɛ maŋe a ve-ba mo.”

english_text:
Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple
(Jeremiah 26.1-6)
1-3The Lord told me to stand by the gate of the temple and tell the people who were going in that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said:
Pay attention, people of Judah! Change your ways and start living right, then I will let you keep on living in your own country. 4Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you. 5I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other. 6Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods. 7Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
8But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies. 9You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you. 10And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning? 11 You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
12 Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
13While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen. 14Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh. 15And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes.
Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
16Jeremiah, don't pray for these people! I, the Lord, would refuse to listen. 17Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem? 18 Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me. 19But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
20And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops.
It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
21The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah:
I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
22At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me. 23Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.” 24But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other. 25Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me. 26But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were!
Slaughter Valley
The Lord said:
27Jeremiah, no matter what you do, the people won't listen. 28So you must say to them:
People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
29Shave your head bald
and throw away the hair.
Sing a funeral song
on top of a barren hill.
You people have made me angry,
and I have abandoned you.
30You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me. 31 At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this. 32So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room, 33and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off. 34 When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_text:
Jeremia zege Wɛ diga kam ne o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora
1 Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Jeremia ni delo to mo tento:
2Vei n zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ni ne, se n tɔɔle kwora kanto we:
Judah tiina bam, Baŋa Wɛ taane mo tento. Abam balo maama na tɔge Wɛ diga kam manchwo-peena yam á zoore ka wone se á zuli‑o to, nam cheigi-na! 3Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to nam tage o we:
“Leiri-na á kikia yam se á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laaro. Amo de wó pa abam chwoŋa se á ta‑á zoore tega kanto ne. 4Nam yé ta‑á tɛ á pa daane we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wo debam tei ne! Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wo debam tei ne!’ Á yeini á tɛ konto dwoŋi ye á boŋe we kolokolo bá yi abam. Á jege á tete á gana mo konto! 5Nam yɔɔre á leiri-na á kikia yam se á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laaro, ye á daare á toŋe de chega da-tei ne. 6Yé ta‑á jege-na veira á bɛɛsa, de botara, dedaane kadeina. Yé zaŋe-na á go balo na wo maŋe se ba te to. Yé ta‑á zuli wa-yɔɔro, se ya wó chɔge abam. 7Á ná seene á leiri á kikia konto dwoŋi, amo de wó sɛ se á ta‑á zoore tega kanto wone, a na kwei-ka a pa á nabaara bam se ba taa tei taa wuu to.
8Nam nii-na á na ke tei! Á jege á tete á gana, de á na tɔge ta-yɔɔro tei to. 9Á yeini á ŋɔna, ye á goe nɔɔna. Á tɔge kabwoŋa kikia. Á ma‑á daare á fɔ vwa taane dim baŋa ne. Á ma‑á zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa á pae Baal jwoni dem, ye á ta tɔge wa-yɔɔro telo á ya na yeiri to. 10Á yeini á toŋe totoŋ-vɛɛsa yam konto dwoŋi ye á laam ba á zo amo tete diga kam wone se á zuli-ne. Á ke konto ye á boŋe we kolokolo bá yi abam, amo na wo á tei ne to ŋwaane. 11Abam boŋe se á pipiri diga kanto ba na mae amo yere ba bwoi-ka to, se ka ji ŋweena tigisim jeiga mo na? Lɔre-na we amo nii a nae á na ke tei maama to. Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
12Nam véi-na Siloo se á nii bɛ mo kea. Ko ye jeiga kalo a na bobo a kuri se nɔɔna taa zuli a yere da to mo. Amo nam pɛ se ka yɔɔre ka chɔge mo, amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam na tɔge lwarem kikia to ŋwaane. 13Tɔ. Abam na yeini á jege wonnu tento maama á ke to, amo yɔɔre a ŋɔɔne de abam mo titwon-twono ye á ba cheiga. A ta ma kwaane a bwoi abam, ye á ve se á leiri-ne. Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. 14Nam lɔre-na se amo na ke tei Siloo ne to, a ta wó ke konto mo amo tete diga kalo na wora a yere zula ŋwaane to baŋa ne. Ka ye diga kalo á na tiini á kwei á teena á daŋe ka baŋa ne to. A ya kwei-ka a pa abam de á nabaara bam mo. A nam wó chɔge-ka. 15Abam Judah tiina bam, a lage a le abam mo a dole a yage yiga yiga, nenɛɛne a déem na ke tei dedaane á chorro Efrayim tiina bam maama to.”
Judah tiina bam na ve Baŋa Wɛ tei to
16“Konto ŋwaane Jeremia, yé lwoori amo Baŋa Wɛ n pa-ba. Yé ŋwane a yiga ne ba ŋwaane, naa n kwaane se n kwoori-ne n pa-ba. Kokuri to, a bá cheigi n wɛ-lworo kom konto. 17Nam dole n yi se n na kolo ba na jege ba ke Jerusalem teo wone dedaane Judah teene dem maama wone to. N wo nɛ ba na ke tei to na? 18Ba bia kare ba puuri da-dwa mo, ba baara maa dwéi mini, ye ba kaana bam de choe muni se ba ma ba fɔge maasa. Ba kwei maasa yam ba ma ji pɛɛra ba pa jwoni delo ba na bwoi we ‘Telaao Pa-kana kam’ to mo. Ba ta maa yeini ba lwoi sana ba pa ba wa-yɔɔro tem. Ba mae ba keina yam konto mo ba twe amo pa se a bane zaŋe. 19Ko nam ye amo mo ba keina yam chɔge na? Ko dae ba tete yera mo ko zoore na? Ba yeiri we ba tete chaveera mo ba kare ba beera.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
20Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo we, “Mo kokuri amo wó tiini a lwo a ban-lom jei sem konto maama baŋa ne. Ko ná ye nabiina, de vara, de teeni, de wodiiru telo na ke tega kam baŋa ne to maama, te maama wó chɔge! Kolokolo bá che amo ban-lom dem.”
21Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage tento o we:
“Á ná laga, ja-na á zwɛɛm pɛɛra yam, de á kaanem yadwonna yam á ba á di nɔna yam maama, se a yiga tera ya wone. 22Amo déem na jaane á nabaara bam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne ye a daare a ŋɔɔne de-ba to, a wo pɛ-ba ni se ba kwei zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de kaanem dwi dwi ba pa-ne. 23Amo déem na pɛ-ba ni delo to mo tento: ‘Ta‑á sɛ-na amo ni, se a taa ye abam Wɛ wom, se á de ta‑á ye amo nɔɔna. Ta‑á tɔge-na chwei selo a na tiŋi a pa abam to, se á ŋwea ke lanyerane ka pa abam.’ 24Abam nabaara bam déem ma ve. Ba bere ba wo cheigi-ne de. Ba maa jege yi-dɛɛre ye ba tɔge keim-lwanno telo maama ba boboŋa na lage to. Ko ma pa se ba pipiri ba jwoori kwaga, ye ba ya maŋe se ba vo yiga mo. 25Ko na zege abam nabaara bam déem na maŋe ba nwoŋi Ejipti ne to se ko yi zem, amo yeini a toŋe a sampwori sem mo á tei ne maŋa maama. 26Abam ma‑á yɔɔre á ve se á cheigi ba taane. Á zwabania kikia yam kɛ á nabaara bam déem na ke tei to.
27Jeremia, nmo nam ná tage tento maama n bere a nɔɔna bam, ba bá cheigi n taane. N ma‑n ná bwoŋi-ba, ba bá leiri‑m. 28Nam vei n ta de-ba we, ‘Dwi dento tiina bam ba sɛ ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ni. Ba ve Wɛ koresem se ba wane ba leiri ba wo. Chega kam de ma jei ba tei ne, ye ba daa ba tɛ-ka. 29A nɔɔna bam, nam cheeri-na á yum, se á daare á dole á yu-ywei sem á yage. Ta diini-na peo yuu ne, á jeini da á leeni luseim lei. Kokuri abam ye dwi delo Baŋa Wɛ na ve to mo, o bane na tiini de zaŋe de abam to ŋwaane.’ ”
30 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we:
“Judah tiina bam tiini ba toŋe lwarem amo yiga ne. Ba kwei wo-zɔɔna yalo ba na zuli to ba zege diga kalo na wora a yere zula ŋwaane to wone, ye ba da ko ŋwaane ba biini-ka. 31Ba lɔge wara-jei bimbina mo ba zege Tofete ne na wo Ben-Hinom bwolo kom wone to. Ba maa yeini ba kwei ba bia ba zwɛ mini wone ba ke kaanem da. Amo nam wo fɔge a pa-ba ni se ba ke konto. Keim dem konto dwoŋi nam ya bere de tera a boboŋa ne. 32Nam lɔre-na we maŋa lage ka yi se nɔɔna daa yé taa bwoi jei sem konto we Tofete, naa Ben-Hinom bwolo kom. Ba laam wó taa bwoi-ko we ‘Ba-gwono bwolo’ mo. Kokuri, nɔɔna wó taa tigi Tofete ne se ba suli-ba, se ko dwoni pwola kalo na wó taa wora se ba suli-ba to. 33Zuna de kago-vara mo wó ba ba di nɔɔna bam yera, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá daare se o zeili-te o yage. 34Amo wó pa se wopwolo de mwanno sɔɔ maama ti Jerusalem teo chwei sem ne, de Judah teene dem maama wone. Kadiri ywoni de daa bá taa wora. Kokuri to, abam tega kam laam lage ka ji di-dwonnu mo.”

english_text:
1Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem 2who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
3Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken.
The People Took the Wrong Road
4The Lord said:
People of Jerusalem,
when you stumble and fall,
you get back up,
and if you take a wrong road,
you turn around and go back.
5So why do you refuse
to come back to me?
Why do you hold so tightly
to your false gods?
6I listen carefully,
but none of you admit
that you've done wrong.
Without a second thought,
you run down the wrong road
like horses running blindly
into battle.
7Storks, doves, swallows,
and thrushes
all know when it's time
to fly away for the winter
and when to come back.
But you, my people,
don't know what I demand.
8You say, “We are wise
because we have the teachings
and laws of the Lord.”
But I say that your teachers
have turned my words
into lies!
9Your wise men
have rejected what I say,
and so they have no wisdom.
Now they will be trapped
and put to shame;
they won't know what to do.
10 I'll give their wives and fields
to strangers.
Everyone is greedy and dishonest,
whether poor or rich.
Even the prophets and priests
cannot be trusted.
11 All they ever offer
to my deeply wounded people
are empty hopes for peace.
12They should be ashamed
of the way they live,
but they don't even blush.
And so, when I punish Judah,
they will end up on the ground,
dead like everyone else.
13I will wipe them out.
They are vines without grapes;
fig trees without figs or leaves.
They have not done a thing
that I told them!
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The People and Their Punishment
14The people of Judah
say to each other,
“What are we waiting for?
Let's run to a town with walls
and die there.
We rebelled against the Lord,
and we were sentenced to die
by drinking poison.
15We had hoped for peace
and a time of healing,
but all we got was terror.
16Our enemies have reached
the town of Dan in the north,
and the snorting of their horses
makes us tremble with fear.
The enemy will destroy Jerusalem
and our entire nation.
No one will survive.”
17“Watch out!” the Lord says.
“I'm sending poisonous snakes
to attack you,
and no one can stop them.”
Jeremiah Mourns for His People
18I'm burdened with sorrow
and feel like giving up.
19In a foreign land
my people are crying.
Listen! You'll hear them say,
“Has the Lord deserted Zion?
Is he no longer its king?”
I hear the Lord reply,
“Why did you make me angry
by worshiping useless idols?”
20The people complain,
“Spring and summer
have come and gone,
but still the Lord
hasn't rescued us.”
21My people are crushed,
and so is my heart.
I am horrified and mourn.
22If medicine and doctors
may be found in Gilead,
why aren't my people healed?
translation_text:
1 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we:
“Maŋa kam konto ne, ba wó jwoori ba ko Judah tiina pwa de ba nakwa bam yibeela ba le ba kwi. Ba ta wó ko ba le Wɛ kaanem tiina kwi, de Wɛ sampwori sem kwi, dedaane Jerusalem tiina bam maama kwi ba yibeela yam ne. 2Ba kwi sem laam maa wó taa jare se tigi pwola ne se wea, de chana dedaane chalechwe sem mage-se. A nɔɔna bam nam ya swoi se ba taa zuli tento mo. Ba ma lwoori wolim te tei ne ye ba ke kaanem ba pa-te. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá suli ba kwi sem. Se wó taa tigi tega baŋa ne mo pare-pare, ne popɔnɔ tei. 3Dwi-balɔrɔ tiina bam konto badaara nam wó wori. Amo nam ná pɛ se banto jage ba vo ba jeini sa-teo kolo maama ne, ba wó taa beeri toone da, se ko dwoni ba ŋwea.”
Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Wɛleere dedaane waarem taane
4“Ta de nɔɔna bam we, Baŋa Wɛ mo tage o we:
Ne nɔɔna ná yeini ba to tega ne,
ba bá pɛ ba zaŋe se ba zege wɛɛne mo na?
Nɔɔno nam ná ywori o chwoŋa ye o maane ko ni ne,
kotu bá jwoori o pipiri o to chwoŋa ne mo na?
5Bɛŋwaane mo a nɔɔna bam nwoŋi amo kwaga ne?
Jerusalem tiina bam yɔɔre ba vae amo.
Ba maa yeini ba gorege vwa mo,
ye ba ve se ba pipiri ba jwoori amo tei.
6Amo yɔɔre a cheigi mo se a ni ba ni taane.
Ba wolowolo nam ba tɛ chega.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ se o leiri o wo
o daare o yage o lwarem kikia.
O ba boŋa o nii o kikia na ye tei to.
Ba maama yɔɔre ba mage ba yum ba tɔge chwo-yɔɔ mo,
ne sisein-nɔɔna na duri se vei jara wone tei to.
7Zuna dwi dwi maŋe ba yei ba maŋa kam ná yia
se ba zaŋe ba vo jeiga kadwoŋi ba taa jei da.
Ko ná ye buga ni zuna, de kunkwona,
de kawɛbidwoora, de koŋwaaro,
ba maama yei ba chwei sem konto.
Ko nam ná ye amo tete nɔɔna bam,
ba yɔɔre ba yeiri chwei selo amo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba se ba taa tɔge to mo.
8Abam nam kare á tɛ nenɛɛne,
‘Debam yia poore!
Dé jege Baŋa Wɛ nia yam dé tei ne!’
Ko nam na seene ko ye tei to,
balo na jege abam ba bere to pipiri amo nia yam
pa se ya ji vwa mo ya pa abam.
9Á yi-pore-nyena bam konto lage ba ja ba nia mo,
chaveera na wó ja-ba to ŋwaane.
Chwoŋa bá taa wora se ba lu.
Kokuri to, ba ve Baŋa Wɛ ni mo.
Ba yi-poro kom nam bɛ?
10Konto ŋwaane mo a lage a kwei ba kaana a pa nɔn-gɛ,
se ba kare de ji nɔɔna badwonna nyem.
Ba wone nɔɔno maama pini o dwoŋi mo
se o ma ji nɔɔno.
Nɔn-kamuna, de nɔn-balwa maama ke konto dwoŋi mo.
Wɛ kaanem tiina tete de o sampwori sem
de yeini ba tɔge vwa kikia yam konto mo.
11Ba nii a nɔɔna bam zonne dem
nenɛɛne de ye mɔle yerane mo tei.
Ba maa we, ‘Yazura taa wo á tei ne.’
Yazura nam tera se ya yi a nɔɔna bam.
12Ko ya maŋe se chaveera taa jege-ba
ba wo-zɔɔna kikia yam ŋwaane.
Ko nam ba sae ba yera.
Ba maŋe ba yeiri chaveera na ye kolo to.
Konto ŋwaane, ba de wó to tega ne mo,
nenɛɛne nɔɔna maama na toe tei to.
Amo ná tu a waare-ba,
ba kweelim jeiga mo konto.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
13 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we:
“Amo wó kwei ba faao wodiiru tem a ja viiri.
Tio-bia daa bá daare ba Vini teeni dem yera ne.
Mɔɔro de bá taa wo ba kaporro tem yuu ne.
Teeni vɔɔro tem maama de maa wó kwaare.
Kolo maama a ya na pɛ-ba to laam wó jei ba tei ne.”
Nɔɔna bam maa we:
14“Bɛŋwaane mo ye dé ta jei ywo-seeni?
Pa-na se dé duri dé vo teene delo na lɔge de pe to
dé gilimi de wone.
Kokuri to, dé ná tege dáane,
ko wó taa gara.
Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage o tiŋi mo
se debam maama te.
O ma kwei na-chɛɛra o pa debam
se dé nyɔ dé te.
Ko maa ye dé na tusi o yiga ne to ŋwaane mo
o ke konto maama dé yera ne.
15Debam ya teene yazura mo,
ye ko wo ke debam lanyerane.
Dé ta maa beeri se dé na zurim,
ye dé jwoori dé na vuvuga yerane.
16Debam dona bam sisein-nɔɔna napɔna kwori
mo dɔne Dan teo ne yiga yiga.
Ba sisei sem keira ma pa se Judah tiina bam yera sae.
Dé dona bam beene se ba chɔge dé tega kam mo,
de ka woŋo maama,
dedaane Jerusalem teo kom,
de ko nɔn-bia bam maama.”
17 Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“Nii-na ywo-seeni!
A lage a toŋe basankwe mo
se se ba á tetare ne.
Se wó ba se done abam,
ye á bá wane-se á che.”
Jeremia keeri Judah tiina bam ŋwaane
18Amo wo na jei tei to laam kɛ jaanem.
A vɔna de ma pare.
19Cheigi-na, se á wó ni a nɔɔna bam na keeri tei
tega kam ni maama ne to.
Ba maa we, “Baŋa Wɛ viiri o daare Zion mo na?
Dé Pɛ wom daa tera mo na?”
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
“A nɔɔna bam zuli jwona yalo ba jea na mɔɔne to,
dedaane jwo-yɔɔro telo na ye dwi-gɛ tiina nyem to mo.
Bɛŋwaane mo ba ke konto
pa se a bane zaŋe de-ba?”
Nɔɔna bam daa ma keeri ba we:
20“Yadɛ de kwea maŋa tu te kɛ,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ta wo jwoŋi debam o yage.”
21Ko tiini ko jege-ne ko ni
de ko na nigi a nɔn-swonnu tem tei to.
Lwia mo tiini ya jege-ne,
ye a keeri dedɛ.
22Terale nuga tere Gilead ne mo
se ba ma ba lɛ a nɔɔna bam ŋɔna na?
Liri keiru de nam mo tere dáane na?
De konto maama de, a nɔɔna bam ta wo nɛ yazura.

english_text:
1I wish that my eyes
were fountains of tears,
so I could cry day and night
for my people
who were killed.
2I wish I could go into the desert
and find a hiding place
from all who are treacherous
and unfaithful to God.
The Lord Answers Jeremiah
3The Lord replied:
Lies come from the mouths
of my people,
like arrows from a bow.
With each dishonest deed
their power increases,
and not one of them will admit
that I am God.
4Jeremiah, all your friends
and relatives
tell lies about you,
so don't trust them.
5They wear themselves out,
always looking for a new way
to cheat their friends.
6Everyone takes advantage
of everyone else,
and no one will admit
that I am God.
7And so I will purify
the hearts of my people
just as gold is purified
in a furnace.
I have no other choice.
8They say they want peace,
but this lie is deadly,
like an arrow that strikes
when you least expect it.
9Give me one good reason
not to punish them
as they deserve.
I, the Lord All-Powerful,
have spoken.
Jeremiah Weeps for His People
10I weep for the pastureland
in the hill country.
It's so barren and scorched
that no one travels there.
No cattle can be found there,
and birds and wild animals
have all disappeared.
11I heard the Lord reply,
“When I am finished,
Jerusalem and the towns of Judah
will be piles of ruins
where only jackals live.”
Why the Land Was Destroyed
12I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
13The Lord said:
I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings. 14They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did. 15So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink. 16I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them.
The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
17The Lord All-Powerful said,
“Make arrangements now
for the women who are paid
to weep at funerals,
especially the women
who can cry the loudest.”
18The people answered,
“Let them come quickly
and cry for us,
until our own eyes
are flooded with tears.
19Now those of us on Zion cry,
‘We are ruined!
We can't stand the shame.
Our homes have been destroyed,
and we must leave our land.’
20“We ask you women
to pay attention
to what the Lord says.
We will teach you a funeral song
that you can teach
your daughters and friends:
21‘We were in our fortress,
but death sneaked in
through our windows.
It even struck down
children at play
and our strongest young men.’
22“The Lord has told us
the ground will be covered
with dead bodies,
like ungathered stalks of grain
or manure in a field.”
What the Lord Likes Best
23The Lord says:
Don't brag about your wisdom
or strength or wealth.
24 If you feel you must brag,
then have enough sense
to brag about worshiping me,
the Lord.
What I like best
is showing kindness,
justice, and mercy
to everyone on earth.
25-26Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_text:
1Amo yuu ya ná wó wane ko ji vole,
se a yia de ji buli-yia,
amo ya wó keeri wea de tete maama,
ba na go a nɔɔna balo to ŋwaane.
2Amo ya wó lage jei kagoa yuu ne,
mɛ chwo-veila na vei ba sii to a vo da.
A laam maa wó vo dáa a daare a nɔɔna bam.
Kokuri to, ba maama nwoŋi Wɛ kwaga ne,
ye ba tɔge puseŋa kikia.
Baŋa Wɛ na leiri Jeremia tei to
3 Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento:
“Ne nɔɔna na saŋe tɛ tei to,
konto mo a nɔɔna bam de ti ba yiga
se ba taa fɔe vwa.
Ba na kwaane se ba na dam tega kam ne tei to,
ko dae chega mo ba tɔga,
se vwa yerane mo.
Ba maa toŋe lwarem ba daŋe da-baŋa ne,
ye ba yiga tera de amo.
4Ta‑á yei-na á badwonna bam ni ne.
Nam yé kwei-na á teena á daŋe á chorro baŋa ne.
Kokuri to, á dwi tiina bam maama
kare ba pini daane mo.
Nɔɔna maama de maa bae da-bebara.
5Ba maa jege ba badwonna ba gana.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba tɛ chega o pae o dwoŋi.
Ba maa pae se ba nia yam me de vwa-fɔra.
Ba maama swoi se ba taa ke wɛleera,
ye ba ware ba yage.
6Ba maa yeini ba tɔge vuvuga kikia
ba daŋe da-baŋa ne,
ye ba ta gane ba dwonna ba woli da.
Ba ba sɛ se ba taa kɔre amo.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
7Mo kokuri Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tage tento:
“Nii a na lage a ke tei to!
A lage a ma mini mo a faŋe a nɔɔna bam a nii,
ye a le wo-yɔɔro ba wone
se a daare a kwɛ-ba.
Bɛ mo amo daa wó ke,
a nɔɔna bam wɛleera yam ŋwaane?
8Kokuri to, ba ni taane nye de chena yalo ba na sole to mo.
Ba maa kare ba fɔe vwa yerane.
Nɔɔno maama mae yazura taane mo o ware o dwoŋi,
ye o laam che kalanchogo se o ma o ja kotu.
9A ná waare-ba ba kikia yam ŋwaane,
ko dae ko chwoŋa ne mo na?
Amo bá jwoori a ŋwe ba wɛleera jene,
ba dwi dem na ye puseŋ-nyena to ŋwaane na?”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Amo ma ta a we:
10“Amo wó keeri peero tem ŋwaane mo.
A maa wó chwoosi kagoa pwola kam ŋwaane,
ka laam na jigi kapwor-pwoŋa to ŋwaane.
Nɔɔna nam daa ware jei sem konto ne
se ba tɔge ba kɛ.
Naane daa tera dáane de keera.
Zuna de vara dwi maama viiri ba daare jei sem konto.”
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
11“Amo wó pa se Jerusalem ji di-dwoŋ-koro,
se nywoŋ-kuri taa kare dáane se via.
Amo ta wó pa se Judah teene dem taa ye yɔɔ yerane,
se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane de wone o zo.”
12Swa tu wora o na yei keim dento kuri na? Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se nɔɔno lɔre ko kuri se kotu wane o bere debam na? Bɛŋwaane mo ye dé tega kam tiini ka ji kagoa konto, pa se nɔɔna daa ware ka wone se ba tɔge ba kɛ?
13 Baŋa Wɛ ma leiri o we:
“Amo nɔɔna bam na ve bera yalo a na pɛ-ba to ŋwaane mo ko ye konto ba yera ne. Ba maa wo sɛ se ba tɔge amo nia yam, ye ba ywori a chwei sem wone. 14Ba nam jege yi-dɛɛre mo ye ba yɔɔre ba zuli Baal jwona yam, nenɛɛne ba kwoa na bere-ba se ba taa ke to.” 15Mo kokuri, Isarele tiina Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tage tento o we, “Amo wó pa a nɔɔna bam na yaara dedɛ. Ko maŋe se ba di wodi-chɛɔ ye ba daare ba nyɔ na-chɛɛra mo. 16A nam ta wó jage-ba a yage sa-teene ne yiga yiga, mɛ ba de ba kwoa na wo nigi de ŋwa to! A ta wó toŋe jar-keira ba baŋa ne se ba ba ba zeili-ba taa, se ko yi ba maama chɔgem.”
Jerusalem tiina keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ
17Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento:
“Boŋe-na á nii kolo na jege ko ke to,
se á daare á bwoŋi kaana balo
na yei luseim mɔɔnem to
se ba ba.”
Amo maa we:
18Tɔ. Pa se ba ke lela ba ba
ba leeni luseim lei,
se se vaŋe debam dedɛ.
Konto wó pa se debam yi-na tiini ba taa nwoŋa.
19Jerusalem tiina bam yɔɔre ba keeri mo ye ba we,
“Lɛɛro yi debam ywoo!
Chaveera tiini ya ba debam baŋa ne!
Dé jege se dé nwoŋi dé daare dé tega kam mo,
dé sam dem maama na chɔge to ŋwaane.”
20Kaana bam, nam cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ taane dem.
Pa-na se o botara kam zo á boboŋa.
Bere-na á bukwa de á badwonna ba na wó ke tei
ba leeni luseim tento dwoŋi to:
21“Toone laam dɔɔle dé takworru tem ne mo
de zo dé sɔ-fwaaro tem wone.
Ko ná ye dé bia ya na wo teo kom chwei sem ne ba kwɛɛre to,
dedaane nɔn-donno telo na wo yaga kam ne to,
toone go-ba mo.”
22 Baŋa Wɛ na bere-ne se a ta kolo mo tento:
“Twa wó taa tigi jase mo jei maama ne,
nenɛɛne popɔnɔ na yeini ko tigi kare sem ne tei to.
Ko ta wó taa nye de men-pwoa yalo nɔɔno na zage o tiŋi,
ye nɔɔna tera se ba la-ya ba ke diga ne to mo.”
23 Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento:
“Swa tiina dae se ba taa mage ba nyɔɔna
de ba swa yam.
Dedɛɛra nam yé mage ba nyɔɔna
de ba dam dem.
Naduna de nam taa yei se ba yé mage ba nyɔɔna
ba dum dem baŋa ne.
24Nɔɔno nam ná boŋe se o taa mage o nyɔɔne,
kotu jege se o teere woŋo konto yerane baŋa ne mo:
O wó mage o nyɔɔne we o yɔɔre o yei amo,
ye o lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.
A maa ye wolo swono kom na daga taa wuu tu to.
Amo nam lage se chega de lanyerane keim mo taa toŋa tega baŋa ne.
Keina yanto dwoŋi mo ye yalo na pwoli amo wo to.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
25 Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta o we, “Chega to, maŋa lage ka yi se amo waare balo dwi maama na gwoni ba peina ye ba laam ba kɔre amo to mo. 26Banto nam mo ye Ejipti tiina, de Judah tiina, de Edom tiina, de Amon tiina, de Moaba tiina, dedaane balo na cheeri ba yuni ye ba zoore kagoa yuu ne to. Kokuri banto maama ba tɔge pein-gwoŋa ni-sɛɛm delo amo na tiŋi to. Isarele dwi tiina bam de tete maŋe ba ba tɔge ni dem konto.”

english_text:
The Lord Talks about Idols
1-2The Lord said:
Listen to me,
you people of Israel.
Don't follow the customs
of those nations
who become frightened
when they see something strange
happen in the sky.
3Their religion is worthless!
They chop down a tree,
carve the wood into an idol,
4cover it with silver and gold,
and then nail it down
so it won't fall over.
5An idol is no better
than a scarecrow.
It can't speak,
and it has to be carried,
because it can't walk.
Why worship an idol
that can't help or harm you?
Jeremiah Praises the Lord
6Our Lord, great and powerful,
you alone are God.
7 You are King of the nations.
Everyone should worship you.
No human anywhere on earth
is wiser than you.
8Idols are worthless,
and anyone who worships them
is a fool!
9Idols are made by humans.
A carver shapes the wood.
A metalworker hammers out
a covering of gold from Uphaz
or of silver from Tarshish.
Then the idol is dressed
in blue and purple clothes.
10You, Lord, are the only true
and living God.
You will rule for all time.
When you are angry
the earth shakes,
and nations are destroyed.
11You told me to say
that idols did not create
the heavens and the earth,
and that you, the Lord,
will destroy every idol.
12With your wisdom and power
you created the earth
and spread out the heavens.
13The waters in the heavens roar
at your command.
You make clouds appear—
you send the winds
from your storehouse
and make lightning flash
in the rain.
14People who make idols
are so stupid!
They will be disappointed,
because their false gods
are not alive.
15Idols are merely a joke,
and when the time is right,
they will be destroyed.
16But you, Israel's God,
created all things,
and you chose Israel
to be your very own.
Your name is the Lord
All-Powerful.
Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
17I said to the people of Judah,
“Gather your things;
you are surrounded.
18The Lord said these troubles
will lead to your capture,
and he will throw you
from this land
like a rock from a sling.”
19The people answered,
“We are wounded
and doomed to die.
Why did we say
we could stand the pain?
20Our homes are destroyed;
our children are dead.
No one is left
to help us find shelter.”
21But I told them,
“Our leaders were stupid failures,
because they refused
to listen to the Lord.
And so we've been scattered
like sheep.
22“Sounds of destruction
rumble from the north
like distant thunder.
Soon our towns will be ruins
where only jackals live.”
Jeremiah Prays
23I know, Lord, that we humans
are not in control
of our own lives.
24Correct me, as I deserve,
but not in your anger,
or I will be dead.
25Our enemies refuse
to admit that you are God
or to worship you.
They have wiped out our people
and left our nation
lying in ruins.
So get angry
and sweep them away!
translation_text:
Jwona kaanem na chɔge nɔɔna tei to
1Abam Isarele dwi tiina bam maama, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ taane. 2Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“Abam yé lwoni-na dwi-gɛ tiina bam kikia.
Yé nii-na wo-kenkagela yalo na wo wɛyuu ne to,
se á pa se ya so abam,
nenɛɛne dwi-gɛ tiina na yeini ba fone de-ya tei to.
3Banto na ke tei de ba chullu tem to ba jege kuri.
Ba yeini ba vo goa wone ba gwoni daa mo,
se gɔgɔ kwei o dwooru o ma o kwɛ-ka se ka ji jwoni.
4Ba maa wó kwei sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno
ba ma fɔge-de ba kaare,
ye ba daare ba ma chena ba mage-de ba ja daane,
se de yé kwori de to yera yera.
5Wa-yɔɔro tem konto nye de nabiinu nyenyego
nɔɔno na kwei o chwi o kaduga ne,
se o ma o saare zuna tei to mo.
Ya ware ya ŋɔɔne.
Ya maa ware ya vo ya tete ne.
Nɔɔna jege se ba taa zeŋe-ya mo ba beera.
Konto ŋwaane, yé ta‑á fona de-ya.
Ya bá wane abam ya chɔge,
ya nam bá wane ya woli abam.”
6Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dwoŋi tera.
Nmo mo yɔɔre n jege kamunim.
Nmo yere dem ye yere-zɔŋɔ mo,
n dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
7Nmo ye dwi tiina maama Pɛ.
Nɔɔna maama jege se ba taa kɔre‑m mo.
Nmo maŋe se n jwoŋi ba zula yam.
Ko ná ye tega baŋa teene dem maama pwa bam
dedaane ba swa tiina bam,
nmo dwoŋi tera ba maama wone.
8Ba maama ba jege boboŋa.
Ba maa tɔge jworim yerane mo.
Bera yalo ba na jwoŋi ba jwona tei ne to ye kafɛ mo.
9Ba yeini ba yeigi lu-nyenno Tarasisi ne,
ye ba ta yeigi sabu-seŋa Yupaza ne,
se gwaro kwei-te ba ma ba kwɛ jwona yam.
Ba ma daare ba gɔgere-ya
de gare-yia yalo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia,
de nasoŋ-pupwia to.
Nabiina ma swa mo ba mɔɔne-ya.
10Chega ŋwaane nam,
Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo ye Wɛ chekke!
O maa ye Ŋwea Tu Wɛ wom.
O paare dem wora taa wuu.
O bane nam ná zaŋe,
tega baŋa maama ziziŋi mo.
O ban-lom dem konto dwoi
logo baŋa dwi maama jaanem.
11Ta-na se ba lɔre ne Baŋa Wɛ mo we, “Ko dae abam wa yam mo naane wɛyuu dedaane tega baŋa. Ya nam wó jei tega baŋa ne, de wɛyuu maama ne.”
12 Baŋa Wɛ nam kwei o dam dem mo
o ke tega kam baŋa.
O ma daare o kwei o swa yam
o naane logo kom maama.
O ma da o boboŋa baŋa ne o lware wɛyuu kom
pa se ko tigi palalala.
13Wonto ná zege wɛɛne o bage o kwora,
wɛyuu baŋa na bam yeini ba wuuri mo.
O wae o pae se kunkwonnu zege
logo baŋa kweelim jei sem ne
te tae te nwoŋa.
O maa pae se doa nena ye ka pepela.
O ná pore o diga kam,
vio mo wó nwoŋi da ko jage ko yi jei maama.
14Jwo-kaana bam maama jworim dem gaale mo,
ye ba boboŋa tera.
Chaveera wó ja gɔgɔ kolo maama na gɔgere jwona to,
o jwona yam na ba jege ŋwea to ŋwaane.
Ya ye wo-yɔɔro mo.
15Ya ba jege kuri.
Ya maŋe se nɔɔna taa jege-ya ba mɔna mo.
Ya waarem maŋa kam ná yia,
ya maama wó chɔge mo fase.
16Wolo Jakob dwi tiina bam na zuli to
nam dae ne yanto na ye tei to.
Wonto mo ye woŋo maama Naano wom.
Isarele dwi tiina bam de ye balo
o na kuri se ba taa ye wonto tete nyem to mo.
O yere mo ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.
Lɛɛro wó ba Jerusalem tiina baŋa ne
17Nam ke-na á zela á ke daane,
se á duri á daare á teo kom,
á dona na gilimi abam ba ke tetare ne to ŋwaane.
18 Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo o we:
“Amo lage a kwei abam balo na zoore tega kam ne to
a dole a yage mo,
nenɛɛne nɔɔna ná mɛ napana ba dole kandwɛ ba yage tei to.
A maa wó pa se lɛɛro yi abam
pa se ko ni abam ko ja gaale.”
A maa we:
19Lɛɛro wo a yuu ne!
Nii ko na zoore a yera tei.
A zonne dem ba tia!
A ya boŋe we, “Jaweo mo jege-ne,
a laam wó ba a wori.”
20Ko nam na ye tei to,
a vwei dem yɔɔre de chɔge mo.
Ŋone selo ya na vɔge-de to laam kɔga.
A bia bam maama ma jei ba daare-ne.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera se kotu chwi a vwei dem o pa-ne,
naa o lɔ diga se a zo ka wone.
21Dé yiga tiina bam boboŋa tege mo.
Ba ba bwei se ba lɔre Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa.
Konto nam mo pɛ se ba zo gɛɛre wone,
ye dé kɔgɔ kom maama de jage ko jei.
22Cheigi-na! Ba jege taane ba beena!
Tiguri-kaasa mo nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kodwoŋi ne.
Ba jar-keira mo gwɛ ba beene debam baŋa.
Ba keim dem konto nam wó pa se
Judah laŋa kam ji di-dwonnu mo.
Nywoŋ-kuri yerane maa wó taa zoore ka teene dem wone.
23Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo yei we ko ná ye nabiina,
dé wolowolo ba zei o tete ŋwea.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware se o lɔre chwoŋa kalo
kotu na wó kwei to.
24Konto to, Baŋa Wɛ, ta‑n jege-ne n koresa.
Nam tɔge chega chwoŋa n korese-ne,
se n ná dɛ n ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa n ke konto,
a bá wori.
25Ko nam ná ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo na ba kɔre nmo to,
de balo maama na ve nmo to,
pa se n ban-lom dem to ba baŋa ne.
Kokuri to, banto tiini ba chɔge debam Isarele tiina bam mo.
Ba ma wane debam ba di
ye ba daare ba pa se dé teo kom ji di-dwonnu ko zega.

english_text:
Judah Has Broken the Lord's Agreement
1-3The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem:
I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says. 4My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people. 5Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live.
“Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
6Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah:
Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you. 7Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors 8have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired.
You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
9The Lord said to me:
Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me. 10They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
11Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers. 12-13Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
14Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
15Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah:
You are my chosen people,
but you have no right
to be here in my temple,
doing such evil things.
The sacrifices you offer me
won't protect you from disaster,
so stop celebrating.
16Once you were like an olive tree
covered with fruit.
But soon I will send a noisy mob
to break off your branches
and set you on fire.
17I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots.
The Plot To Kill Jeremiah
* 18Some people plotted to kill me.
And like a lamb
being led to the butcher,
I knew nothing
about their plans.
19But then the Lord told me
that they had planned
to chop me down like a tree—
fruit and all—
so that no one would ever
remember me again.
20 I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful,
you always do what is right,
and you know every thought.
So I trust you to help me
and to take revenge.”
21Then the Lord said:
Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me. 22But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death. 23And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_text:
Nɔɔna bam chɔge Wɛ ni-gwonim dem
1 Baŋa Wɛ daa na pɛ Jeremia ni delo to mo tento:
2“Guli ni delo a déem na gwoni de a nɔɔna bam to. Ta daare n ŋɔɔne de Jerusalem teo kom tiina de Judah tiina bam maama. 3Ta de-ba ne amo Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom mo tage a we: Amo déem gwoni ni de á nabaara bam. A nam sɔɔle lwarem a yage wolo maama na ve se o ke de na bere tei to yuu ne mo. 4A déem na jaane á nabaara bam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne ye a ke ni-gwonim delo de-ba to mo konto. Teo kom konto ya ye min-vogo yaara jei mo ko pa-ba. A déem tage de-ba a we, ‘Sɛ-na amo ni se á daare á ta‑á tɔge chullu telo maama a na pɛ abam to. Á ná ke konto, á wó ta‑á ye amo tete nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye abam Wɛ. 5Amo laam maa wó ke a su a déem na dugi duuri de á nabaara bam se a pa-ba tega kalo na ywomma de varem de kɔnɔ to.’ Tega kam konto baŋa ne mo abam laam zoore zem tento.” Amo ma leiri a we, “Ɛɛ, Baŋa Wɛ, pa se ko seene ko ke konto.”
6 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we:
“Vei n tɔɔle kwora kanto Jerusalem chwei sem ne de Judah teene dem maama wone se n ta we: Guli-na ni delo amo déem na gwoni to, se á ta‑á tɔge de na bere tei to. 7Amo déem na yɔɔre a ja á nabaara bam á nwoŋi Ejipti ne to mo a maŋe a kaane-ba taa se ko yi zem. A maa yeini a ta de-ba a we, ‘Sɛ-na amo ni dem.’ 8Ba nam wo sɛ. Ba bere ba wo cheigi-ne de. Ba maa jege yi-dɛɛre ye ba tɔge keim-lwanno telo maama ba boboŋa na lage to. Konto ŋwaane mo a nam pɛ se waarem delo maama ni-gwonim dem na bere to ba ba baŋa, ba na ve se ba tɔge ni delo amo na gwoni de-ba to ŋwaane.”
9 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de amo o we:
“Jerusalem teo kom tiina de Judah tiina bam maama mo ke ni daane se ba yé sɛ ba pa-ne. 10Ba nwoŋi amo kwaga ne ye ba yɔɔre ba sɛ se ba ke ba nabaara wɛleera yam dwoŋi mo. Banto de déem ve se ba cheigi amo taane dem. Ba laam ma tɔge wa-yɔɔro kwaga se ba zuli-ya. Isarele dwi tiina bam, de Judah dwi tiina bam maama mo chɔge ni-gwonim delo amo na ke de ba nabaara bam to. 11Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo we: ‘A lage a pa se chɔgem mo ba ba baŋa ne se ba yé lu. Ba nam ná kaase ba jare amo tei maama de, a bá cheigi ba keira kam. 12Jerusalem tiina bam dedaane Judah tiina bam maama laam maa wó vo wa-yɔɔro telo ba na zuli to tei se ba lwoori wolim ya tei ne. Ya nam bá wane-ba ya che cham delo na wó to ba yuu ne to. 13Abam Judah dwi tiina bam, nii á kikia na ye tei! Abam teene dem na mae tei to, á jwona de ye konto mo. Bimbina yalo á na kaane Baal jwo-yɔɔ kom ya baŋa ne to de maa mae de chwei selo na wo Jerusalem teo kom wone to.’
14Konto ŋwaane Jeremia, yé kwaane se n lwoori-ne n pa nɔɔna banto. Nam yé ŋwane a yiga ne ba ŋwaane, se ba cham maŋa ná yia, amo bá cheigi ba wɛ-lworo kom.
15A nɔn-swonno tem daa ba jege chwoŋa
se ba jeeri a diga kam wone.
Ba dedɛ mo ke puseŋa kikia.
Á boŋe we, á ná sugi a yia de á vara kaanem dem,
cham daa bá ba á baŋa ne mo na?
Yé ta‑á jege-na wopwolo,
se ko ba jege kuri.
16Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam ya pɛ se á nye de Olivi tio
kolo na ke vɔɔro lanyerane
ye ko tio-bia bam de tiini ba lana to mo.
A nam wó bage mo ne do-fɔrɔ tei,
ye a pa se mini ja tio kom konto de di.
Ko nɛ sem maama de maa wó chochoge.
17Amo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ déem mo jeiri abam á tega kam ne, ne tio tei to. Amo nam sɔɔle lwarem mo a yage á yuu ne. Kokuri to, Isarele dwi tiina de Judah dwi tiina bam maama pɛ se a bane zaŋe mo, de ba na zuli Baal jwoni dem to.”
Nɔɔna na boŋe se ba go Jeremia tei to
18 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma pa se a yia puri se a wane a lɔre ko kuri. O ma pa se a taa yei nɔɔna bam keim-lwanno tem ni ne. 19A ya yeiri we ba ke ni-sɛɛm daane se ba go amo mo. A maa nye de pipeila kalo ba na wó ja ba vo ba go ye ka yeiri kolo na wora ko ke to mo. Ba déem ma ta ba we:
“Pa-na se dé chɔge tio kom de ko bia maama.
Dé wó pa se o momwɛ ti logo baŋa ne,
se nɔɔna daa yé taa guli o gula.”
20Ko nam ná ye nmo, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo yeini n bore chega bora mo.
N ta ma‑n faŋe nɔɔna bochara de ba boboŋa
se n lɔre ya na ye tei to.
Nam zaŋe n waare-ba,
se n ma n ŋwe a jene ba baŋa ne.
Kokuri to, a kwei a woŋo maama
a ke nmo jeŋa ne mo.
21Anatofe teo tiina déem beeri amo mo se ba go, ye ba tɛ ba we a yé taa pworisi Baŋa Wɛ yere ŋwaane, se a ná ve, ba wó go-ne. 22Mo kokuri, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tage ba taane o we, “Amo wó waare-ba mo. Ba nɔn-donno tem wó te jara wone mo, se kana laam go ba bia bam, bakeiri de busankane maama. 23Maŋa kam ná yi se a waare Anatofe tiina bam, a laam wó pa se lɛɛro to ba baŋa ne, ye ba wolowolo bá daare.”

english_text:
Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
1Whenever I complain
to you, Lord,
you are always fair.
But now I have questions
about your justice.
Why is life easy for sinners?
Why are they successful?
2You plant them like trees;
you let them prosper
and produce fruit.
Yet even when they praise you,
they don't mean it.
3But you know, Lord,
how faithful I've always been,
even in my thoughts.
So drag my enemies away
and butcher them like sheep!
4How long will the ground be dry
and the pasturelands parched?
The birds and animals
are dead and gone.
And all of this happened because
the people are so sinful.
They even brag, “God can't see
the sins we commit.”
The Lord Answers Jeremiah
5Jeremiah, if you get tired
in a race against people,
how can you possibly run
against horses?
If you fall in open fields,
what will happen in the forest
along the Jordan River?
6Even your own family
has turned against you.
They act friendly,
but don't trust them.
They're out to get you,
and so is everyone else.
The Lord Is Furious with His People
7I loved my people and chose them
as my very own.
But now I will reject them
and hand them over
to their enemies.
8My people have turned against me
and roar at me like lions.
That's why I hate them.
9My people are like a hawk
surrounded and attacked
by other hawks.
Tell the wild animals
to come and eat their fill.
10My beautiful land is ruined
like a field or a vineyard
trampled by shepherds
and stripped bare
by their flocks.
11Every field I see lies barren,
and no one cares.
12A destroying army
marches along desert roads
and attacks everywhere.
They are my deadly sword;
no one is safe from them.
13My people, you planted wheat,
but because I was furious,
I let only weeds grow.
You wore yourselves out
and gained only shame!
The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
14The Lord said:
I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land. 15But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands. 16They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people. 17However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
Jeremia jege taane de Baŋa Wɛ
1 Baŋa Wɛ, amo ná yeini a kwei taane a pa‑m,
n yeini n nii de baŋa ne de chega mo.
De ko de, a lage a bwei bwia nmo bora borem dem seeni.
Bɛ mo tei pa se puseŋ-nyena vei yiga?
Bɛŋwaane mo vwa-nyena ŋwea ke lanyerane?
2Nmo jeiri-ba ne ba ye teeni mo tei.
Ba ma ke bonno ye ba zege de dam,
se ba daare ba taa leiri bia.
Maŋa maama n taane wo ba nia ne.
Ba bochara nam ba tɔge nmo.
3Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam maŋe n yei-ne.
N ma‑n yere-ne ye n ta faŋe a boboŋa
se n lɔre a na swoi‑m tei to.
Yɔɔre n vaŋe nɔɔna bam konto,
ne ba na vaŋe pia ba vei se ba go tei to.
Pɔɔre-ba n zege dáa ne
se n le dɛ dedwe n chɔge-ba.
4Debam tega kam wó taa ye te-kora konto taa na?
Nii gaaro na kwaare jei maama ne tei!
Vara de zuna maama maa wora ba toa,
dé nɔɔna bam puseŋa kikia ŋwaane.
Ba nam ta jege ni mo ba tɛ ba we,
“Baŋa Wɛ bá na kolo na lage ko ke debam to.”
Baŋa Wɛ na leiri Jeremia tei to
5“Nmo nam ná kwaane n duri n dwoni de nabiina n ga,
n wó ke tetɛ mo n duri n dwoni de sisein-nɔɔna se n di?
Nmo ná vei te-kampare baŋa ne n saare n toe,
ko laam nam ná ye punnu na li mɛ Jɔdan buga kam ni ne to,
ko bá ke dwono mo na?
6Nmo tete chorro telo á na ye dwi daane to
mo ba jege chega dede‑m.
Ba maa chiŋi‑m ye ba bage ba yage wɛ-wɛ.
Konto to, ba ná maŋe ba ŋɔɔne ni-som de nmo,
yé kwei n chega n pa-ba.
7Amo nam wó nwoŋi a tete dwi tiina bam kwaga ne.
A yiga daa bá taa wo nɔɔna balo na ye a nyem to wone.
Ko ye balo a na tiini a swoi to mo
a lage a kwei-ba a ke ba dona bam jeŋa ne.
8Nɔɔna balo a tete na kuri to mo pipiri
ba dwoni de amo,
ne nywonnu na ye tei goa ne to.
Ba maa laare de sɔɔ ba yage a yera ne.
Ko ma pa se a chuli-ba.
9Amo laam pɛ se a tete nɔɔna bam ji nenɛɛne kalwoŋo na ye tei,
ye duura gilimi-ko ba zɔge to mo.
Nam bwoŋi kago-vara bam se ba de ba
ba di ba su ba boboŋa.
10Yiga tiina dedɛ mo wó ba se ba nɔ ba chɔge
te-ywoŋa kalo a na jeiri a nɔɔna bam ka wone to.
Ba nam wó pa se a te-ywoŋa kam konto laam ji kagoa.
11Jei sem maama wó ji kapwor-pwoŋo,
de di-dwonnu yerane mo.
Tega kam maama laam wó ji kagoa mo,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yiga bá taa wo ka wone.
12Nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ wó ba
ba meeli kagoa zwonnu tem maama yuu ne
se ba kwaare jara de a nɔɔna bam.
Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó tɔge jar-keira bam konto baŋa
a chɔge tega kam jei maama.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lu ba jeŋa ne.
13Amo nɔɔna bam ná dugi mena,
ba wó jwoori ba gwei men-kayale mo.
Ba maa wó yaare de totoŋ-chɛɛre
ye ba bá na nyɔɔre ba totoŋa baŋa ne.
Chaveera wó ja-ba de ba na wó zage wodiu fenfee kolo to.
Kokuri to, amo ban-lom mo zaŋe ba baŋa ne.”
14 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, “Ko ná ye teene delo maama na gilimi tega kalo a na kwei a pa a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam se ba taa tei ye ba boŋe se ba chɔge-ka to, amo lage a gɔ-ba ba jei sem ne a dole a yage mo. A laam maa wó le Judah dwi tiina bam ba wone a jwoŋi a yage. 15Amo nam ná gɔge dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto a dole a yage ye ko ke fee, a daa wó duri ba ŋwaŋa, se a ja-ba a jwoori ba tete teene dem, se ba jwoori ba jeini da. 16Ko nam maŋe se ba zamese amo tete nɔɔna bam chwei sem se ba tɔge-se. Ba déem soge amo nɔɔna bam pa se ba ma Baal yere ba du duuri. Ba laam jege se ba ma amo yere dem mo ba du duuri, ye ba we, ‘Ne Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ná sɛ.’ Ba ná ke konto maama, ba de wó wane ba na jeiŋa jei amo nɔɔna bam wone. 17Ko daare, teo kolo maama ná ve amo ni, amo wó yɔɔre a gɔ-ba mo a yage, se a daare a chɔge-ba fase!”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_text:
Jeremiah's Linen Shorts
1The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.” 2So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
3Then the Lord said, 4“Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.” 5And that's what I did.
6Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.” 7I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
8Then the Lord said:
9Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem. 10The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts. 11These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me.
Wine Jars
The Lord said:
12Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.”
They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
13Then say to them:
I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets. 14Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
15People of Judah,
don't be too proud to listen
to what the Lord has said.
16You hope for light,
but God is sending darkness.
Evening shadows already deepen
in the hills.
So return to God
and confess your sins to him
before you trip and fall.
17If you are too proud to listen,
I will weep alone.
Tears will stream from my eyes
when the Lord's people
are taken away as prisoners.
18The Lord told me to tell you
that your king and his mother
must surrender their thrones
and remove their crowns.
19The cities in the Southern Desert
are surrounded;
no one can get in or out.
Everyone in Judah
will be taken away.
20Jerusalem, you were so proud
of ruling the people of Judah.
But where are they now?
Look north, and you will see
your enemies approaching.
21You once trusted them to help,
but now I'll let them rule you.
What do you say about that?
You will be in pain
like a woman giving birth.
22Do you know why
your clothes were torn off
and you were abused?
It was because
of your terrible sins.
23Can you ever change
and do what's right?
Can people change the color
of their skin,
or can a leopard
remove its spots?
If so, then maybe you can change
and learn to do right.
24I will scatter you,
just as the desert wind
blows husks from grain
tossed in the air.
25I won't change my mind.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
You rejected me
and worshiped false gods.
* 26You were married to me,
but you were unfaithful.
You even became a prostitute
by worshiping disgusting gods
on hilltops and in fields.
27So I'll rip off your clothes
and leave you naked and ashamed
for everyone to see.
You are doomed!
Will you ever be worthy
to worship me again?
translation_text:
Judah dwi dem na wó na chɔgem delo to
13:1–20:18
Jɔgɔ memaŋe
1 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, “Véi n yeigi jɔgɔ kolo ba na mɛ gare-fefale ba sɔ to, se n daare n vɔ-ko n teiŋa ne. Nam yé pa se na dwei-ko.” 2Amo de ma vo a ke tei Baŋa Wɛ na bere-ne se a ke to, ye a vɔ-ko a teiŋa ne.
3 Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma pa amo ni ye o we, 4“Kwei jɔgɔ kom na vɔge n teiŋa ne to n ja n vo Perata, se n beeri peo gugworo n kwei-ko n seigi ko wone.” 5Amo ma seene a vo a seigi-ko Perata jei sem ne, ne Baŋa Wɛ na bere-ne we a ke tei to.
6Ko na ke da yalei to, Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, “Nam zaŋe n jwoori n vo Perata, se n le jɔgɔ kom a na tage a bere‑m se n vo n seigi to.” 7A ma seene a jwoori Perata, ye a vo a ko a le jɔgɔ kom ko seigim jeiga kam ne. A na nii to, de ko pɔge mo. Ko daa ba jege totoŋe.
8 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, 9“Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: A lage a chɔge wonnu telo Jerusalem tiina de Judah dwi tiina bam maama na mage ba nyɔɔna te baŋa ne to mo. 10Puseŋ-nyena bam konto yɔɔre ba ve se ba cheigi amo taane mo. Ba ma ke wo-dɛɔ ba beeri wa-yɔɔro se ba zuli. Amo nam ná waare-ba a ti, ba de wó ji nenɛɛne jɔgɔ konto na ye tei ye ko daa ba jege kuri to mo. 11Amo ya le Isarele dwi tiina bam de Judah dwi tiina bam maama se ba sale amo yera ne, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na wó vɔ jɔgɔ o teiŋa ne tei to mo. A kuri-ba se ba taa zuli-ne mo, se a na yere. Ba nam ve-ne mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.”
Sana kɔɔra memaŋe
12“Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei de Isarele tiina bam to mo tento: ‘Abam sana kɔɔra bam maama ye se á lɛɛre-ba á su de sana mo!’ Ba wó jwoori ba leiri‑m ba ta we, ‘Debam maŋe dé yei we, dé jege se dé lɛɛre dé sana kɔɔra bam maama dé su de sana mo.’ 13Ba ná tage konto, se n leiri-ba n ta we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ nam tage o we: Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Judah laŋa kam ne to nyɔ sana ba su pa se ba bugi. A lage a ke konto a waare pwa balo na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to, de kaanem tiina bam, de sampwori sem, de Jerusalem tiina bam maama mo. 14A laam maa wó kwei-ba a mage daane se ba chochoge ne kɔɔra mo tei. Ko ná ye ba nɔn-kwe de ba bia bam, ba maama wó na chɔgem. A nam bá duri ba ŋwaŋa naa a leiri a boboŋa kɔtaa! A lage a waare-ba mo.’
Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.”
Jeremia kaane nɔɔna bam de ba kamunim dem
15Cheigi-na se á ni
kolo Baŋa Wɛ na tage de abam to.
Yé ta‑á jege-na kamunim.
16Kwei-na á zula á pa-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom
se cham yé yi abam.
Ko ná dae konto,
Baŋa Wɛ wó pa lim yi abam
ye á seeri á to peero tem yuu ne,
tega na yi to ŋwaane.
Abam ná jege teena se pwooni ba á baŋa ne,
Wɛ wó pa se lim ba de kwoli jei maama,
se á ta‑á jei yibiri wone.
17Abam nam ná ve se á cheigi Wɛ taane dem,
amo wó vo a seigi a yerane a ka yi-na mo,
abam na bere á tete kamunim to ŋwaane.
Amo wó kane yi-na yerane mo.
A yibia maa wó taa chuuri de yi-na,
ba na jaane Baŋa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom
ba maa jei to ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we:
18“Kwei amo ni n vo n pa pɛ wom de o nu wom we,
‘Zaŋe-na á paare yitunnu tem ne á tu tega ne.
Kokuri to, abam paare yipwi sem lage se dɔne á yuni ne
se to tega ne mo.
19Teene delo na wo Judah tega-kuri seeni to maama pe.
Ba dona kaare-de mo ba pu
ye nɔɔna daa ba jege chwoŋa se ba zo teo kom wone
naa ba nwoŋi ko pwooni ne.
Ba zi Judah tiina bam maama ba ja ba kɛ.
Ba ma kale-ba ba vo sa-teo yiga yiga.’ ”
20Jerusalem tiina bam, kwoni-na á nii
jar-keira balo na nwoŋi baŋa seeni
ba beene á baŋa ne to.
Nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo Wɛ na ke n jeŋa ne
se n ta‑n nii-ba to nam bɛ?
Á déem nam tiini á jege teera ba baŋa ne mo.
21 Baŋa Wɛ lage o pa se á na di badwoŋo de balo to
jwoori ba di dam mo abam baŋa ne.
Ko laam wó taa ye tetɛ mo á yera ne?
Ko bá tiini ko ni abam,
ne kaane na virigi puga se o lo
ye ko ni‑o tei to mo na?
22Nmo nam wae n bwei n tete ne we,
“Bɛ mo pɛ se tento maama yi-ne?”
Ko ye n wɛleera yam na gaale to ŋwaane mo.
Mo kokuri n gwaaro kaare te daare‑m
ye nɔɔna zi‑m ba chɔge.
23Nɔn-zwono wó wane o leiri o ye-daa se ka peere na?
Gweeru de nam wó wane o zare o yera
se ya daa yé popore na?
Abam de bá wane á leiri á wo
se á ta‑á ke wo-laaro,
á na yɔɔre á me de lwarem kikia to ŋwaane.
24 Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“Amo nam lage a pa se á jage mo,
nenɛɛne vio na nwoŋi kagoa ne
ko kale weero ko ja jei tei to.
25Amo boboŋa jaane se a ke konto mo á yera ne.
Ko nam wó seene ko ke.
Kokuri to, abam swei amo swia mo,
ye á daare á tɔge jwo-yɔɔro kwaga.
26Amo wó pa á tiini á di á chaveera
nenɛɛne ba na le kaane gwaaro
ba daare‑o de kuri-nɔrɔ tei to.
27Jerusalem tiina bam, amo nii a na
wo-zɔɔna yalo maama á na jege á ke to.
Á nwoŋi amo kwaga ne
ye á daare á tɔge wa-yɔɔro kwaga,
ne kaane na yage o baro
ye o vo o beeri bɔɔla
se o ke kabwoŋa de-ba
kare sem ne de zwonnu yuu ne tei to mo.
Á fera tiini ya zo totoŋ-vɛɛsa,
ye á ba jege chaveera ya ŋwaane.
Lɛɛro yi abam!
Á wó biini á tete taa
se á laam jwoori á na kwɛɛm yei ne mo?”

english_text:
The Land Dries Up
1When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
2Judah and Jerusalem weep
as the land dries up.
3Rulers send their servants
to the storage pits for water.
But there's none to be found;
they return in despair
with their jars still empty.
4There has been no rain,
and farmers feel sick
as they watch cracks appear
in the dry ground.
5A deer gives birth in a field,
then abandons her newborn fawn
and leaves in search of grass.
6Wild donkeys go blind
from starvation.
So they stand on barren hilltops
and sniff the air,
hoping to smell green grass.
The Lord's People Pray
7We rejected you and did evil,
so we deserve to be punished.
But if you rescue us, Lord,
everyone will see
how great you are.
8You're our only hope;
you alone can save us now.
You help us one day,
but you're gone the next.
9Did this disaster
take you by surprise?
Are you a warrior
with your hands tied?
You have chosen us,
and your temple is here.
Don't abandon us!
The Lord's Answer
10My people,
you love to wander away;
you don't even try
to stay close to me.
So now I will reject you
and punish you for your sins.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
Lying Prophets
11The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people. 12They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
13I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
14The Lord answered:
They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
15Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger. 16And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
17Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this.
So I told them:
“Tears will flood my eyes
both day and night,
because my nation suffers
from a deadly wound.
18In the fields I see the bodies
of those killed in battle.
And in the towns I see crowds
dying of hunger.
But the prophets and priests
go about their business,
without understanding
what has happened.”
Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
19Have you rejected Judah, Lord?
Do you hate Jerusalem?
Why did you strike down Judah
with a fatal wound?
We had hoped for peace
and a time of healing,
but all we got was terror.
20We and our ancestors are guilty
of rebelling against you.
21If you save us, it will show
how great you are.
Don't let our enemies
disgrace your temple,
your beautiful throne.
Don't forget that you promised
to rescue us.
22Idols can't send rain,
and showers don't fall
by themselves.
Only you control the rain,
so we put our trust in you,
the Lord our God.
translation_text:
Da-kore taane
1 Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Jeremia kwora kalo da-kore seeni to mo tento:
2“Judah laŋa kam maama ye ŋɔɔ mo de keira.
Ka teene dem nɔn-bia bam jwoori kwaga mo.
Ba maa jei tega ne wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane.
Jerusalem tiina bam de maa chwoosi wɛ-wɛ.
3Naduna bam toŋe ba kabɛ,
se ba vo ba beeri na ba ba ba pa-ba.
Kabɛ sem ná yi buli selo maama,
se yeini se ko mo ye na tera.
Ba laam maa wó zeŋe ba kɔɔra bam
ba jwoori sɔŋɔ de je-kore,
ye wo-chechɔgɔ de chaveera yerane jege-ba.
4Doa daa ba nena,
pa se tega kam maama bage lolwe.
Mo kokuri vala bam vɔna pare.
Ba maa vɔ ba je ba yum ne.
5Woŋa mo loge ka bu pwola ne,
ye ka duri ka daare‑o,
gaao na tera jei jei ne to ŋwaane.
6Bonɛ laam zege zwonnu tem yuni ne mo,
se sii se dwoi nenɛɛne nywoŋ-kuri na sii tei to.
Se yɔɔre se leesi jei maama se nii mo,
se gaao ná zege ko wo jei selo ne.
Wodiu nam tera se se di.”
Nɔɔna bam maa tɛ ba we:
7“Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
dé wɛleera yam yɔɔre ya le debam mo ya zege dáa ne.
De ko de, dé nam lwoori‑m mo,
se n ta da ko baŋa n woli debam,
nmo tete yere dem ŋwaane.
Chega to, dé nwoŋi nmo kwaga ne kuni dedɛ,
ye dé tusi dé chɔge nmo yiga.
8Nmo yerane baŋa ne mo
Isarele tiina bam jege ba teena.
Cham ná yeini de yi debam,
n ma‑n ye dé Jwoŋinu.
Bɛ mo ye n ke ne n ye veiru mo
dé teo kom wone?
Ko nye de n peini debam tei ne tete dedoa yerane mo.
Tega daa na poore to, n ma‑n kwei chwoŋa n kɛ.
9N ke ne n ye nabwom mo,
naa babea kalo na ware ka nɔɔna se ka jwoŋi ka yage to.
Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam wo debam tei ne mo.
Dé yɔɔre dé ye n tete nɔɔna mo chekke.
Nam yé viiri n daare debam!”
10 Baŋa Wɛ ma leiri o ta nɔɔna bam taane o we:
“Ba swoi se ba taa kare jei maama ne mo ba beera.
Ba ba jaane ba tete se ba maŋe amo tei ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo yi daa ba sui ba kikia yam.
Amo laam wó guli ba wɛleera de ba lwarem kikia,
se a waare-ba ya ŋwaane.”
11 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we:
“Yé lwoori amo se a pa nɔɔna banto jwoori ba na lam. 12Ba ná maŋe ba vɔ ba nia se ba kaase ba jare-ne de, amo bá cheigi ba wɛ-lworo kom. Ba nam ná ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra de wodiiru pɛɛra se ba pa-ne de, a bá jwoŋi-te. A lage a pa se ba te jara wone mo, se jawe-chɛɛro de kana de ja-ba te go.”
13Amo de ma leiri a we:
“Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo sampwori sem yeini se ta de-ba se we, ‘Wonnu maama wó ke lam te pa abam. Á bá zo jara wone. Kana de nam bá ja abam, se yazura yerane mo wó taa wora.’ ”
14 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma leiri-ne o we:
“Sampwori sem konto tɔge amo yere baŋa mo se fɔe vwa yerane. Amo wo tiŋi-ba se ba taa ye a sampwori. A nam wo toŋe-ba a nɔɔna bam tei ne. Amo maŋe a wo pɛ-ba a kwora. Ba yi-nɛɛre totoŋa de veera yalo ba na jege ba tɛ ba bere abam to maama ba jege kuri. Ko ye ba tete boboŋa mo gane-ba pa se ba ŋɔɔna. 15Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo: Ko nam ná ye sampwori selo amo na wo toŋe-ba ye ba jege amo yere ba fɔe vwa we jara de kana bá ba á teo kom ne to, amo wó pa se banto tete te jara wone, ye kana de go-ba. 16Ko ta ná ye balo ba na pworisi vwa de-ba to, kana de jara mo wó go banto de, pa se ba yera taa tigi Jerusalem chwei sem jei maama ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá daare se o kwei nɔɔna bam konto o suli tega ne. Ko wó ke konto ko pa banto tete, de ba kaana, de ba bia maama. A yɔɔre a lage a pa se lɛɛro to ba baŋa ne, ne ko na maŋe de ba lwarem kikia tei to mo.”
17 Baŋa Wɛ ma pa-ne ni se a vo a ta de nɔɔna bam we:
“Wea de tete maama wone a yia su de yi-na mo.
A keira kam bá wane ka kwori.
Ko nam ye amo nɔn-swonnu tem ŋwaane mo.
Ba tiini ba na zonne,
ye de zo ba yera lanyerane.
18A ná nwoŋi a vo pwola ne,
a yɔɔre a nae nɔɔna mo na tege jara wone
ye ba tigi jei maama.
Amo nam ná zo teo kom wone de,
a nae nɔɔna mo kana na jege-ba ka goe.
Sampwori sem de kaanem tiina bam maa kare jei maama ne mo ba toŋa.
Ba nam yeiri ba na jege kolo ba toŋe to.”
Nɔɔna bam na lwoori Baŋa Wɛ tei to
19“Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yɔɔre n virigi n kwaga
n ya Judah tiina bam mo na?
Nmo laam neese debam Zion tiina mo na?
Bɛ mo ye n kwei zonne delo na ba jei to
n ke dé yera ne?
Dé ya jege teena we dé wó na yazura mo.
Wo-laaro nam wo tu dé tei ne.
Dé ma teene se dé na fɔgem,
ye lɛɛro yerane mo to dé baŋa ne.
20Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, dé sɛ we dé ye puseŋ-nyena.
Dé ta sɛ we dé nabaara bam tusi dedɛ.
Debam maama yɔɔre dé ke dé chɔge nmo yiga mo.
21Nmo tete yere dem ŋwaane,
yé nwoŋi debam kwaga ne.
Yé yaale n tete teo kom mɛ n na di paare to.
Nam yé yiri ni delo n déem na gwoni de debam to.
22 Dwi-gɛ tiina jwona yam wae ya pae doa nena na?
Doa nam zege wɛyuu ne ka nene ka tete ne na?
Chega to, debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
ko ye nmo yerane mo wae konto n ke.
Mo kokuri, dé teena tigi nmo baŋa ne.”

english_text:
The People of Judah Will Die
1 The Lord said to me:
Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away. 2 And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said:
Some of you are going to die
of horrible diseases.
Others are going to die in war
or from starvation.
The rest will be led away
to a foreign country.
3I will punish you
in four different ways:
You will be killed in war
and your bodies dragged off
by dogs,
your flesh will be eaten by birds,
and your bones will be chewed on
by wild animals.
4 This punishment will happen
because of the horrible things
your King Manasseh did.
And you will be disgusting
to all nations on earth.
5People of Jerusalem,
who will feel sorry for you?
Will anyone bother
to ask if you are well?
6My people, you abandoned me
and walked away.
I am tired of showing mercy;
that's why I'll destroy you
7by scattering you like straw
blown by the wind.
I will punish you with sorrow
and death,
because you refuse
to change your ways.
8There will be more widows
in Judah
than grains of sand on a beach.
A surprise attack at noon!
And the mothers in Jerusalem
mourn for their children.
9A mother is in deep despair
and struggles for breath.
Her daylight has turned
to darkness—
she has suffered the loss
of her seven sons.
I will kill anyone who survives.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
Jeremiah Complains
10I wish I had never been born!
I'm always in trouble
with everyone in Judah.
I never lend or borrow money,
but everyone curses me
just the same.
11Then the Lord replied,
“I promise to protect you,
and when disaster comes,
even your enemies
will beg you for help.”
The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated
The Lord told me to say:
12People of Judah,
just as you can't break iron
mixed with bronze,
you can't defeat the enemies
that will attack
from the north.
13I will give them
everything you own,
because you have sinned
everywhere in your country.
14My anger is a fire
that cannot be put out,
so I will make you slaves
of your enemies
in a foreign land.
Jeremiah Complains Again
15You can see how I suffer
insult after insult,
all because of you, Lord.
Don't be so patient
with my enemies;
take revenge on them
before they kill me.
16When you spoke to me,
I was glad to obey,
because I belong to you,
the Lord All-Powerful.
17I don't go to parties
and have a good time.
Instead, I keep to myself,
because you have filled me
with your anger.
18I am badly injured
and in constant pain.
Are you going to disappoint me,
like a stream that goes dry
in the heat of summer?
The Lord Replies
19Then the Lord told me:
Stop talking like a fool!
If you turn back to me
and speak my message,
I will let you be my prophet
once again.
I hope the people of Judah
will accept what you say.
But you can ignore their threats,
* 20because I am making you strong,
like a bronze wall.
They are evil and violent,
but when they attack,
21I will be there to rescue you.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
Lɛɛro wó to Judah tiina baŋa ne
1 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we:
“Moses de Samuwel tete ya ná tu se ba lwoori-ne, a bá duri nɔɔna banto ŋwaŋa. Pa se ba lage jei da a yiga ne, se a daa yé taa na-ba! 2Ba nam ná bwei‑m ba we, ‘Dé nam véi yein-seeni?’ se n ta de-ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
Balo na ye se ba te to wó te mo.
Balo maa na ye se ba te jara wone to wó te jara wone.
Balo de na ye se kana go-ba to,
kana wó go-ba mo.
Balo maa na ye se ba kale to,
ba wó kale-ba ba vo sa-teo mo.’ ”
3 Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
“A nam lage a toŋe lɛɛro dwi dwi kuni bena mo ba baŋa ne. Se-zɔɔro wó go-ba jara wone. Kukuri maa wó tuuri ba yera yam se ja se kɛ. Duura de wó ba ba zɔge ba yera, ye kago-vara laam di ba yera yalo ta na daare to nyelamm. 4Amo lage a pa se ba ji wo-zɔɔna mo logo baŋa teene maama yiga ne, Judah teo pɛ Hezekia bu Manasɛ na toŋe kolo Jerusalem wone to ŋwaane.”
5 Baŋa Wɛ daa ta maa we:
“Jerusalem tiina bam, wɔ nam mo wó ŋwane o pa abam?
Wɔ mo lage o keeri o pa abam?
Wɔ mo wó zege se o ware abam?
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera!
6Abam yɔɔre á ve amo mo,
ye á nwoŋi a kwaga ne kuni dedɛ.
Konto ŋwaane, amo tete mo lage a twe a jeŋa
a gorege abam a ja a chɔge.
Amo daa bá duri abam yibwona kɔtaa!”
7“A lage a chaare-ba,
ne nɔɔno na chaare mena
ye vio kom kale weero ko yage tei to mo.
