Amo wó waare-ba konto dwoŋi
ba teene dem maama ne.
A wó chɔge a nɔɔna bam tete, de ba bia de,
ba na wo sɛ se ba pipiri
ba yage ba lwarem kikia to ŋwaane.
8A ta wó pa se ba teo kadeina taa daga
ba dwoi naneo ni kasolo na ye tei to.
Wea ná bega, a wó toŋe lɛɛro ba nɔn-donno tem baŋa ne,
se ba niina tiini ba yaare ba toone ŋwaane.
Bedwe baŋa ne mo a lage a pa se chanɛɛre yɔɔre de ja-ba,
pa se foone tiini de zo-ba.
9Kaane wolo na loge bia barepɛ to wó beiri,
ye o bochɔŋɔ fwei,
ba maama na tege to ŋwaane.
Ko nye de wea tetare ne mo wɛ zo de pa wonto.
Chaveera maa jege‑o,
o na tu o ga o bia bam to ŋwaane.
Ko ná ye balo ta na daare to,
amo wó pa se ba dona go-ba jara wone.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Jeremia poone Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne
10A nu, lɛɛro mo jege-ne! Bɛŋwaane mo n loge-ne? Mɛ maama a ná via, nɔɔna yɔɔre ba chuli-ne mo. Amo wo vei a jene woŋo nɔɔno tei ne, a nam wo jene woŋo a pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno. De ko de, nɔɔna maama done-ne mo.
11 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, “Amo nam lage a jwoŋi nmo se ko ke lanyerane ko pa‑m mo. Cham dedaane vuvuga ná tu ya daane n dona, ba laam wó ba ba lwoori wolim n tei ne.
12Abam nye de luuru telo na gwaane de channa to. Á bá wane á bwori luuru telo na nwoŋi baŋa seeni to. 13A nam lage a kwei á jejegero de á dunni maama mo a pa á dona zɛɛra se ba chɛ ba pa daane, á na tiini á ke wɛleera á teo kom jei maama ne to ŋwaane. 14Amo wó pa se á dona kwei abam ba ja ba vo sa-teo kolo á ya na yeiri ko ni ne to, se á ji ba kabɛ dáane. Kokuri to, a ban-lom dem nye de mini na lage de di abam kula tei to mo!”
Amo maa we:
15Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo maŋe n yei a na yaare tei maama to.
Guli amo gula se n ta‑n nii amo baŋa ne.
Nam pa se ko zo balo na chuli-ne to yera!
Yé duri ba yibwona
se n pa ba na chwoŋa ba go-ne.
Ko ye nmo ŋwaane mo
a nɛ yaara ba tei ne.
16Nmo taane dem na to a zwa ne to,
a ke-de a wone mo pa se a ŋwe.
Dento mo pɛ-ne wopwolo
ye a wo de tiga.
Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo yere dem mo leigi amo yera ne.
17Amo wo sɛ se a me de balo na kare ba beeri jalam-jalam to.
A wo tɔge de-ba se dé taa kare dé nyɔ sana.
A nam pwɛ a tete a jeini dáa ne mo a yerane,
ko na ye nmo mo tei-ne to ŋwaane.
Nmo pɛ se a bane zaŋe de banto kikia yam.
18Bɛŋwaane nam mo ye amo yaara yam ba fɔge ya tia?
Bɛ mo ke ye a zonne dem de ba fɔge de tia?
Nmo na woli amo tei to
nye de nabara na we te-pwoŋa ne,
de buli-yi na yeini de ko tei to mo.
19Mo kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ tage tento:
“Nmo ná yage n ta-yɔɔro tem konto,
ye n jwoori n ba amo tei,
a laam wó pa se n jwoori n zege chekke
se n ta‑n toŋe n pa-ne.
Nmo ná ŋɔɔne taane delo na jege kuri to,
n wó ta‑n ye a ni-jwoŋinu.
Nɔɔna bam laam maa wó ba ba tɔge nmo kwaga.
Ko dae se n ta‑n tɔge banto kwaga.
20Amo wó pa se n ta‑n nye de kabira kalo ba na mɛ channa ba lɔ to mo
se n che nɔɔna banto de ba keim-balwaaro tem.
Ba wó chiŋi jara de nmo.
Ba nam bá wane‑m ba di.
Kokuri to, amo wo n tei ne
se a jwoŋi‑m a yage.
21Amo wó jwoŋi‑m a yage
nankɔ-nyena bam jeŋa ne,
se ba yé wane‑m ba ke lwarem.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_text:
Jeremiah Must Live His Message
1The Lord said to me:
2Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family. 3I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here. 4They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
5When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah. 6Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads. 7No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
8Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating. 9 Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations. 10They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
11Then tell them I have said:
People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods. 12And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind. 13So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
14A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt. 15Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go.
Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors. 16But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
17I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me. 18I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies.
The Lord Gives Strength
I prayed to the Lord:
19Our Lord, you are the one
who gives me strength
and protects me like a fortress
when I am in trouble.
People will come to you
from distant nations and say,
“Our ancestors worshiped
false and useless gods,
20worthless idols
made by human hands.”
21Then the Lord replied,
“That's why I will teach them
about my power,
and they will know that I
truly am the Lord.”
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Jeremia chwei selo se o tɔge to
1 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma pa amo ni ye o we:
2“Yé di bukɔ n ma‑n ji n kaane, naa n lo bia teo konto ne. 3Ko ná ye bia balo ba na loge jei sento wone to, de ba niina, de ba kwoa, amo Baŋa Wɛ jege taane se a ta ba ŋwaane we: 4Jawe-chɛɛro mo lage te ja-ba se ba te. Ba bá na nɔɔna se ba keeri ba lwi, naa balo na wó suli-ba to. Ba yera wó taa tigi tega baŋa ne, ne popɔnɔ mo tei. Jara wone mo ba lage ba te, se kana de go-ba. Ba yera yam maa wó ji wodiiru ya pa zuna de kago-vara.”
5 Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“Jeremia, yé vei n zo ba lwi wone se n da n keeri de-ba. Kokuri to, amo yiri a swolim de a swono kom ba tei ne, ye a daa bá duri ba yibwona. 6Naduna de nabwona maama wó te tega kanto wone mo. Ba nam bá na nɔɔna se ba suli-ba, naa se ba keeri ba lwi. Ba bá gwe ba yera yam, naa ba cheeri ba yuni lwi sem ŋwaane. 7Nɔɔna daa bá toŋe wodiu se ko vo lwi sem na wo mɛ to. Ko ná maŋe ko ye nɔɔno nu de o kwo lua de, nɔɔna bá vo ba yi kotu yera se ba weeri o yi-na.
8Nam yé zo sɔŋɔ kolo wone ba na di wodi-fɔrɔ kɛɛla-kɛɛla to. Yé woli ba wone se n ta‑n di ye n nyɔa. 9Amo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo na ye Isarele tiina bam Wɛ wom to mo tage tento: Amo lage a pa se wopwolo de ywoni sɔɔ ti nɔɔna bam tei ne. Ba daa bá kwɛɛre kadiri kwɛɛra. Nmo de n badwonna ta ná ŋwe, á wó na amo na lage a ke-ba tei to.
10Nmo nam ná vei n ta wonnu tem konto maama n bere nɔɔna bam, ba wó bwei‑m we, ‘Bɛŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ ke se chanɛɛre dento ba debam baŋa ne? Bɛ mo dé ke dé tusi? Dé chɔge dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ yiga tetɛ seeni mo?’ 11Laam ta de-ba we, ‘Á nabaara bam na nwoŋi amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane mo a ke konto. Ba ma kuri se ba tɔge wa-yɔɔro ye ba zuli-ya. Ba yɔɔre ba ve-ne mo ye ba wo sɛ a nia yam. 12Abam keim-lwanno nam bere ya dwoi á nabaara bam na ke tei to! Á yɔɔre á ke á tɔge á wo-dɛɔ kom na lage puseŋa kikia yalo to mo, ye á ba cheigi amo taane. 13Konto ŋwaane, a lage a le abam mo tega kanto ne, se a daare a dole abam a yage sa-teo ne yiga yiga, mɛ abam de á nabaara bam ya na yeiri ko ni ne to. Abam laam ná wo jei sem konto ne, á wó ta‑á zuli á wa-yɔɔro tem maŋa maama, wea de tete. Amo nam bá duri á ŋwaŋa kɔtaa.’ ”
Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta o we:
14“Chega to, maŋa lage ka yi se balo ná lage ba du duuri, ba daa yé ta we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi debam Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne to yere dem.’ 15Ba laam wó taa tɛ we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kom ne, dedaane jei selo maama o na jage-ba to yere dem mo.’ Kokuri to amo wó seene a ja-ba a ba se ba jwoori ba taa jei tega kalo wone a na pɛ ba nabaara se ba taa tei to.
16Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: A laam lage a toŋe ywon-jara dedɛ mo se ba vo nɔɔna banto tei ba ja-ba. A ta maa wó pa se tɔɔna dedɛ vo ba ja-ba. Ba wó vo peero de zwonnu tem maama baŋa ba beeri-ba ba le bɔɔna de gugworru wone ba go. 17Amo yɔɔre a yere-ba mo jei maama wone. Ba bá wane ba seigi amo yiga ne. A maa nae wɛleera yalo ba na jege ba ke to. 18Amo nam wó jwoori a ŋwe ba wɛleera de ba puseŋa kikia jene kuni belei. Kokuri to, ba chɔge amo tega kanto mo de ba jwona yalo na ba jege ŋwea ye a yɔɔre a chuli-ya to. Ba ta ma su a tete tega kam konto de ba wo-zɔɔna kikia yam.”
Amo maa we:
19Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo mo ye amo dam de a dalem jei.
Cham ná lage de yi-ne,
a yeini a duri a seigi nmo woro wone mo.
Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama nam wó ba nmo tei
se ba zuli nmo.
Ba maa wó zege tega baŋa jei maama ne
ba ba ba ta we,
“Dé nabaara déem jege wa-yɔɔro mo ba zula.
Yanto nam wo wane-ba ya woli.
20Nɔɔna wó wane ba tete wa ba ke na?
Ba ná ke-ya, ya bá taa ye wa chekke!”
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
21“Amo laam nam wó yɔɔre a pa se ba lɔre
a dam dem na mae tei to.
Konto laam mo wó pa se ba taa yei we
amo yere mo ye Taa-wuu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Punish Judah
The Lord said:
1People of Judah,
your sins cannot be erased.
They are written on your hearts
like words chiseled in stone
or carved on the corners
of your altars.
* 2One generation after another
has set up pagan altars
and worshiped the goddess Asherah
everywhere in your country—
on hills and mountains,
and under large trees.
3So I'll take everything you own,
including your altars,
and give it all
to your enemies.
4You will lose the land
that I gave you,
and I will make you slaves
in a foreign country,
because you have made my anger
blaze up like a fire
that won't stop burning.
Trust the Lord
5I, the Lord, have put a curse
on those who turn from me
and trust in human strength.
6They will dry up like a bush
in salty desert soil,
where nothing can grow.
7But I will bless those
who trust me, the Lord.
8 They will be like trees
growing beside a stream—
trees with roots that reach
down to the water,
and with leaves
that are always green.
They bear fruit every year
and are never worried
by a lack of rain.
9You people of Judah
are so deceitful
that you even fool yourselves,
and you can't change.
10 But I know your deeds
and your thoughts,
and I will make sure
you get what you deserve.
11You cheated others,
but everything you gained
will fly away, like birds
hatched from stolen eggs.
Then you will discover
what fools you are.
Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
12Our Lord, your temple
is a glorious throne
that has stood on a mountain
from the beginning.
13You are a spring of water
giving Israel life and hope.
But if the people reject
what you have told me,
they will be swept away
like words written in dust.
14You, Lord, are the one I praise.
So heal me and rescue me!
Then I will be completely well
and perfectly safe.
15The people of Judah say to me,
“Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us
what the Lord has said.
So why hasn't it come true?”
16Our Lord, you chose me
to care for your people,
and that's what I have done.
You know everything I have said,
and I have never once
asked you to punish them.
17I trust you for protection
in times of trouble,
so don't frighten me.
18Keep me from failure
and disgrace,
but make my enemies fail
and be disgraced.
Send destruction to make
their worst fears come true.
Resting on the Sabbath
19-20The Lord said:
Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said:
I am the Lord, so pay attention. 21-24 If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred!
I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey, 25then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem, 26and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
27But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_text:
Waarem delo na maŋe de Judah tiina wɛleera yam to
1“Judah tiina bam yɔɔre ba me de ba wɛleera, nenɛɛne nɔɔno mo kwei luu o sare-ya o tiŋi ba bochara ne. Ko ta nye nenɛɛne ba kwei kandwɛ-fole mo ba popone-ya ba tiŋi ba bimbina yam nyea ne. 2Ba bia de yeini ba boŋe ba jwona bimbina yam de ba Asera nyenyego dɛ sem boboŋa mo. Ba ke wonnu tem konto se ba taa maa zula ba jwona yam teeni maama kuri ne, de zwonnu tem maama yuu ne, 3ko ta woli de peero tem na wo gaao ne to yuu ne. Mo kokuri, amo lage a kwei á dunni, de á jejegero maama a pa á dona se ba chɛ ba pa daane, se ko ŋwe á wɛleera yam jene, á na ke-ya tega kam jei maama ne to. 4Ko ye abam tete yiga mo pa se á lage á ga tega kalo a na kwei a pa abam to. A maa wó pa se á dona kwei abam ba ja ba vo sa-teo kolo á ya na yeiri ko ni ne to, se á ji ba kabɛ dáane. Kokuri to, á pɛ se a ban-lom dem tiini de fuli á baŋa ne, ne mini delo na lage de di abam taa wuu tei to!”
Taana yadwonna
5 Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento:
“Amo sɔɔle lwarem mo a yage
balo na kwei ba chega ba pa nabiina to yuu ne.
Ba maa boŋe we ba dam zege ba tete yera ne mo.
Ba laam ma pipiri ba yage amo Baŋa Wɛ.
6Ba nye nenɛɛne kagoa wo punnu mo.
Tento zege kago-yoro ne mo,
mɛ yɛ yerane na wora,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba zoore da to.
Lanyerane ná maŋe de ba,
nɔɔna dwi dem konto ba nae-de.
7Ko nam ná ye balo na kwei ba chega
ba pa amo Baŋa Wɛ to,
amo wó swɛ banto swolim.
Banto ke ba wo-dedoa de amo mo.
8Ba nye de tio kolo na zege ko bwola de buga ni,
ye ko bonno zo tega lanyerane
te yi na chekke to mo.
Wulim wɛ ná yia,
ko bá kɔre foone.
Da-kore ná maŋe ko ba,
ko ta jege vɔ-lɛɛro maŋa maama,
ye ko yɔɔre ko leiri bia mo.
9Nabiinu bochare mo ba jege chega
de dwoi woŋo maama.
De tiini de chɔge mo,
ye nɔɔna ware-de se ba yɔɔre.
Wɔ mo wae-de o lɔre o tia?
10Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam yɛ nabiinu maama boboŋa.
A maa faŋe ba bochara a nia.
A maa pae nɔɔna maama ba kikia ŋweero,
se ko maŋe de chwoŋa kalo ba na tɔge to.
11Nɔɔno ná pini o dwonna se o ma o duni,
ko nye de luga na vwɛ chechara yalo ka na wo de to baŋa ne
se ka lwei-ya tei to mo.
O nɔn-donne maŋa ne mo
o jejegero tem wó ti.
Kotu laam maa wó ba o kweeli
ne nɔn-jworo na kweeli tei to.”
Jeremia wɛ-lworo
12Ko na zege faŋa faŋa to,
Baŋa Wɛ paare jeiŋa jei sem debam na zuli‑o da to
zeiŋi wɛɛne de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ mo.
13Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yerane baŋa ne mo
Isarele tiina bam jege teena.
Balo maama nam na nwoŋi nmo kwaga ne to wó na ba chaveera.
Balo na ve nmo to wó jei mo
ne nɔɔna yera na popone ya tiŋi kasolo ne
ye ya saare tei to.
Kokuri to ba ve nmo wolo na ye buli-yi
delo na pae ŋwea to mo.
14Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, yɔɔre-ne
se a seene a na yazura.
Jwoŋi-ne n yage,
se a seene a zo n woro wone.
Kokuri to, nmo mo amo yɔɔre a seina.
15Nii mo! Nɔɔna mo tɛ de amo ba we,
“Kolokolo ta wo ke debam.
Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam nam bɛ?
Pa se ka ji chega se dé nii!”
16A wo yage totoŋe delo n na kwei n pa-ne
se a ta nii n nɔɔna bam to.
A nam ba kare a beeri ba chɔgem.
Nmo yɔɔre n yei a na ye tei to,
de kwora kalo a na jege a ŋɔɔne to.
17Yé pa se foone ja-ne.
Cham ná lage de yi amo,
nmo mo ye amo dalem jei.
18Pa se balo na chuli-ne to di chaveera.
Nam che amo se a yé na a chaveera.
Pa se banto vɔna pare
ye ko dae amo.
Pa se lɛɛro yi banto
se ba tiini ba na chɔgem dedɛ.
Wɛ siu dɛ taane
19 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we, “Zaŋe n vo teo kom manchwoŋo ni delo ba na bwoi we ‘Nɔn-bia bam Ni’ ye Judah tiina pwa bam tɔge da ba zoore teo kom wo ye ba jwoori ba nwoŋi to n ta‑n zege da n tɔɔle amo kwora kam. Nam ta vei n zege Jerusalem teo manchwo-nia yam maama ne n ke konto. 20Laam ta de Judah tiina pwa bam de ba nɔn-bia bam, de balo maama na zoore Jerusalem teo ne ye ba yeini ba tɔge nia yam konto ba kɛ to we, ‘Cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kanto! 21Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Wɛ siu dɛ dem ne, ta‑á yei-na se á yé ta‑á zeŋe zela. Nam yé zeŋe-na zela á tɔge Jerusalem teo manchwo-nia yanto á kɛ. 22Yé zeŋe-na zela á ja á nwoŋi á sam ne, naa á ke totoŋe de totoŋe Wɛ siu dɛ dem ne! Nam pɔɔre-na dɛ dem konto á pa Baŋa Wɛ, ne amo na pɛ á nabaara bam ni se ba ke tei to. 23De ko de, ba wo sɛ amo ni dem konto. Ba ma ve se ba cheigi a taane. Ba bochara digili mo, ye ba wo sɛ koresem.
24 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we: Nam ta‑á yei-na se á sɛ amo ni. Yé ta‑á zeŋe-na zela á tɔge teo kom manchwo-nia yam á zo ko wo siu dɛ dem ne. Pɔɔre-na dɛ dem konto á pa amo se á yé toŋe de wone. 25Abam ná ke konto, á teo kom pwa balo na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to wó taa wora mo taa ye ba tɔge nia yanto wone ba kɛa. Ba nakwa bam de wó taa tɔge ba kwaga. Pwa bam konto dedaane Jerusalem teo kom tiina de Judah tiina bam maama wó yeini ba di sisei-torokooro de sisein-nɔɔna baŋa ne ba tɔge manchwo-nia yam konto ba kɛ. Teo kom tete de maa wó taa sui de nɔɔna taa wuu. 26Nɔɔna de wó nwoŋi Judah teene dem maama wone, de Jerusalem nawuura yam wone, de Benjamin laŋa kam ne, de wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne, de zwonnu laŋa kam seeni, de tega-kuri kagoa kam seeni, ba zo Jerusalem teo kom wo. Ba laam maa wó taa jaane zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de wodiu pɛɛra, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa, dedaane lei keim pɛɛra ba tui ba kaane ba pae Baŋa Wɛ o wara-jei sem ne. 27Ko daare, abam ná wo sɛ se á cheigi a kwora kam, ye á ve se á pɔɔre Wɛ siu dɛ dem á pa‑o pa se á jaane zela á tɔge manchwo-nia yam á zoore teo kom wo siu dɛ dem ne, nam lɔre-na we, amo wó tɔre mini se de ja manchwo-nia yam. De laam maa wó lɔgese de ja á sɔ-fwaaro tem de di kula. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane-de se o dwei.’ ”

english_text:
Jeremiah Goes to the Pottery Shop
1The Lord told me, 2“Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
3I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel. 4And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
5Then the Lord told me to say:
6People of Israel, I, the Lord, have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay. 7If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation, 8and that nation turns from its evil, I will change my mind.
9If I promise to make a nation strong, 10but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
11So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
12But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
13So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
14The snow
on Lebanon's mountains
never melts away,
and the streams there
never run dry.
15But you, my people,
have turned from me
to burn incense
to worthless idols.
You have left the ancient road
to follow an unknown path
where you stumble over idols.
16Your land will be ruined,
and every passerby
will look at it with horror
and make insulting remarks.
17When your enemies attack,
I will scatter you like dust
blown by an eastern wind.
Then, on that day of disaster,
I will turn my back on you.
The Plot against Jeremiah
18Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.”
Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
19Please, Lord, answer my prayer.
Make my enemies stop
accusing me of evil.
20I tried to help them,
but they are paying me back
by digging a pit to trap me.
I even begged you
not to punish them.
21But now I am asking you
to let their children starve
or be killed in war.
Let women lose
their husbands and sons
to disease and violence.
22These people have dug pits
and set traps for me, Lord.
Make them scream in fear
when you send enemy troops
to attack their homes.
23You know they plan to kill me.
So get angry and punish them!
Don't ever forgive
their terrible crimes.
translation_text:
Jeremia vei kamɔ-mɔro sɔŋɔ
1 Baŋa Wɛ daa na pɛ Jeremia ni delo to mo tento:
2“Nam zaŋe n vo kamɔ-mɔro wom sɔŋɔ. N ná yi da, amo wó pa‑m a kwora.” 3Amo ma seene a vo kamɔ-mɔro wom tei. A na yi o sɔŋɔ to, a nɛ we o jei mɛ o na yeini o mɔɔne o kamwaro tem to mo o toŋa. 4O ná mɔɔne kamɔgɔ kolo, ye ko ná wo dɛ chwoŋa lanyerane, o laam wó jwoori o fɔge o mɔ dɔgɔ kom se ko ji kamɔgɔ kodwoŋi, ne o boboŋa yam na tɔge tei to.
5 Baŋa Wɛ laam ma pa amo ni dento o we:
6“Isarele dwi tiina bam, amo de ba jege chwoŋa se a ke de abam ne kamɔ-mɔro na ke tei de o dɔgɔ to na? Dɔgɔ kom na ye tei kamɔ-mɔro jeŋa ne to, abam Isarele tiina bam de ye konto mo amo jeŋa ne. 7Amo wó wane a pa kwora we teo kolo, naa paare dam delo gɔ de yage, naa se a vaare-de a de tega ne, naa a chɔge-de. 8Amo nam na kaane teo kolo to nɔn-bia ná pipiri ba yage ba lwarem kikia yam, amo de wó leiri a boboŋa mo, se a daa yé chɔge-ba ne a ya na boŋe se a ke tei to. 9Ko daare, amo nam wó wane a pa kwora we a lage a fɔge a lɔ teo kolo a zege, naa a jeiri-ko te-ywoŋa jei ne. 10Teo kom konto nɔɔna nam ná toŋe lwarem kikia a yiga ne, ye ba daare ba ve se ba cheigi amo kwora, amo de wó leiri a boboŋa mo, se a daa yé ke-ba lanyerane ne a ya na boŋe se a ke tei to.
11Jeremia, nmo nam véi n kaane balo na zoore Jerusalem ne to de Judah tiina bam maama. Ta de-ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo maŋe a ke a boboŋa ne se a toŋe lɛɛro abam baŋa ne. A boboŋa jaane se a chɔge abam mo. Mo kokuri abam maama jege se á yage chwo-balwaaro telo á na tɔge to. Leiri-na á boboŋa de á lwarem kikia yam.’ 12Ba nam wó leiri ba ta we, ‘Yé ta‑n jege n tete n yaara, se dé lage dé taa ke dé zwabania kikia yam mo, ne dé boboŋa na lage tei to.’ ”
13 Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento:
“Vei n bwei dwi-gɛ tiina bam se n nii,
nɔɔno wora o na nigi woŋo konto dwoŋi ŋwa na?
Isarele dwi dem ya nye de bukɔ-pwola mo.
Ba laam ke kolo na tiini ko ye wo-zɔɔne to.
14Lebanon peero yuni tem peere mo maŋa maama.
Te nyɔnɔ kom ba fɔge ko wea.
Ko ná ye bwi selo na nwoŋi peero tem ne yiga yiga se kɛ to,
se na-zura bam yeini ba duri ba ti na?
15Ko nam ná ye amo tete nɔɔna bam,
ba yɔɔre ba swei amo ni ne mo.
Ba maa ke kaanem ba zwɛ ba pae jwo-yɔɔro.
Jwona yam konto ma soge-ba
pa se ba ywori chwo-laaro tem ne.
Ba ma yage ba nabaara chwei sem déem na ye tei to.
Ba ma lɛɛre ba tɔge chwo-memene selo na wo kwɛ to.
16Ko ma pa se ba tega kam yɔɔre ka chɔge.
Nɔɔna maa jege-ka ba yaala
maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu.
Balo maama ná tɔge ko jei ne ba kɛ,
ko wó ke-ba yaau se ba taa dole ba yuni.
17Ne vio kolo na nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni
ye ko kale fwogo ko ja jei tei to,
mo a lage a pa a nɔɔna bam de jage ba dona yiga ne.
A nam wó ma a kwaga a ya-ba mo.
Lɛɛro ná to ba baŋa ne,
a yiga bá taa wo ba wone.”
Ba na boŋe se ba chɔge Jeremia tei to
18Nɔɔna bam badwonna ma ta ba we, “Pa-na se dé ke ni daane se dé lɔre dé na wó ke tei dé chɔge Jeremia to. Wɛ kaanem tiina ta wó taa wora se ba bere debam Wɛ nia yam. Yi-pore-nyena de wó taa wora se ba zamese debam. Wɛ sampwori de wó pa se dé ni Wɛ kwora kam. Nam pa-na se dé ba bebara dé daŋe o baŋa ne. Dé daa bá taa cheigi o ni taane.”
Amo ma lwoori Wɛ a we:
19“Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi-ne!
Nii a sebanyena banto na tɛ amo taane tei!
20Ko lana se nɔɔno kwei lwarem
o jwoori o ŋwe lanyerane keim na?
Banto nam yɔɔre ba gwaare gwoŋo mo
se amo to ko wone.
Guli amo déem na tiini a lwoori‑m tei ba fɔgem ŋwaane to.
A ma zege nmo yiga ne ye a lwoori‑m
se n zuri n bane de-ba.
21Laam nam pa se kana ni ba bia.
Dole-ba n yage se ba te jara wone.
Pa se ba kaana ga ba bia,
ye ba daare ba ji kadeina.
Ta pa se jawe-chɛɛro go ba nɔn-kweero tem,
se ba nɔn-donno de te jara-keim baŋa ne.
22Pa se keira zaŋe ba sam dem wone bugi-bugi,
ba dona mo na pɔpɔ ba zaŋe ba baŋa ne to ŋwaane.
Kokuri to, ba koge gwoŋo mo ba tiŋi se amo to da,
ye ba daare ba che kalanchorro jei maama se te ja-ne.
23Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam maŋe n yei
ba na boŋe se ba go-ne tei to.
Yé kwei ba totoŋ-balwaaro tem n ma‑n chɛ-ba.
Nam yé saare ba wɛleera yam kɔtaa!
Pa se ba to n dam kuri ne,
se n daare n tɔge n ban-lom dem baŋa ne n waare-ba.”

english_text:
Jeremiah and the Clay Jar
1The Lord said:
Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests 2 and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
3I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked. 4-5 The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that. 6So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
7You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies. 8I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks. 9And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
10Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching. 11Then tell them that I have also said:
I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
12-13I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods.
Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
14I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people, 15“Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_text:
Jeremia na lɔge kikeira tei to
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta de amo o we, “Vei kamɔ-mɔro tei n yeigi kikeira, se n daare n bwoŋi Isarele nakwa bam badaara de kaanem yiga tiina bam badwonna, 2se á maama vo Ben-Hinom bwolo kom mɛ seeni na bwola de teo kom ni delo ba na bwoi we ‘Tampuuri Ni’ to. Abam ná yi da, se n kwei kwora kalo amo na wó ta a bere‑m to n pa-ba. 3Ta de-ba ne, ‘Judah tiina pwa bam, de Jerusalem teo nɔɔna bam, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage tento:
Cheigi-na! Amo lage a pa se lɛɛro mo tiini te ba teo konto baŋa. Ko ta wó pa se balo maama ná nigi ko ŋwa, se ba nia mɔɔre. 4Ko nam ye Judah tiina bam na yage amo to ŋwaane mo. Ba ma pipiri bwolo konto se ko ji jwona kaanem jei ye ba zwɛ wonnu ba pa-ya. Banto tete de ba nabaara, de Judah pwa bam nam ya yeiri jwo-yɔɔro tem konto ni ne. Ba laam ma yɔɔre ba go balo na wo maŋe se ba te to. 5Ba ta lɔge bimbina mo se ba ma ba zuli Baal jwoni dem, ye ba laam kwei ba bia ba zwɛ mini wone ba ke kaanem ba pa-de. Amo nam wo fɔge a pa-ba ni naa a ta de-ba se ba ke konto. Keim dem konto dwoŋi nam ya bere de tera a boboŋa ne. 6Nam lɔre-na we maŋa beene se nɔɔna daa yé taa bwoi jei sento we Tofete, naa Ben-Hinom bwolo kom. Ba laam wó taa bwoi-ko we “Ba-gwono bwolo” mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. 7Kokuri to, a lage a pa se Jerusalem teo tiina de Judah tiina bam maama boboŋa ji kafɛ mo. Amo wó yage se ba dona wane-ba ba di ye ba daare ba go-ba. Ba twa wó taa tigi jei maama ne, se zuna de kago-vara taa tui ba di. 8Amo wó yɔɔre a chɔge Jerusalem teo kom. Nɔɔna wó taa jege-ko ba yaala. Balo maama ná tɔge ko jei ne ba kɛ, ko wó ke-ba yaau ye ba yaale-ko ko chanɛɛre dem ŋwaane. 9Jerusalem dona bam wó kaare teo kom ba pu se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé lu ko wone. Teo kom nɔɔna bam laam wó di ba dwonna ya-nɔna, ba dona bam na tiini ba peene-ba ye wodiu tera se ba di to ŋwaane. Ba bere ba wó di ba tete bia ya-nɔna de.’ ”
Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de amo o we:
10“Laam kwei kikeira kam n de n chochoge se nɔɔna balo na tɔge dede‑m ba nwoŋi teo kom wone to taa zege ba nia. 11Ta de-ba we, ‘Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo lage a chochoge te-fɔrɔ konto, de ko nɔn-bia bam, ne kikeira kanto na chochoge tei to mo. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane-ko o la o ke daane. Nɔɔna wó taa tigi Tofete ne se ba suli-ba, se ko dwoni pwola kalo na wó taa wora se ba suli-ba to. 12Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo wó yɔɔre a pa se teo konto de ko nɔn-bia bam taa nye de Tofete na ye tei to mo. 13A nam wó pa se Jerusalem sam dem de Judah pwa bam sɔ-fwaaro tem maama de chɔge, ne Tofete na biini de twa tei to. Kokuri to ba yeini ba di sam dem konto nayuni ne mo, ye ba zwɛ wonnu ba ma ke kaanem ba pa chalechwe, ne se ga ye wa mo to. Ba ta ma kwei sana pɛɛra ba pa wa yadwonna.’ ”
Jeremia daa na ŋɔɔne Wɛ kwora tei to
14Jeremia ma zege Tofete ne o jwoori o zo teo kom wone. Baŋa Wɛ nam ya toŋe‑o Tofete ne se o pworisi o kwora mo. O laam ma vo o zege Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei konkɔlɔ kom ne, ye o ta de nɔɔna bam maama o we, 15“Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage tento: Amo seene a lage a pa se lɛɛro mo ba teo konto baŋa, de ko nawuura yam baŋa, ne a na pwooli we a wó ke tei maama to. Ko nam ye ba na se ba zwa, ye ba ve se ba cheigi amo taane dem to ŋwaane mo a lage a ke-ba konto.”

english_text:
Pashhur Arrests Jeremiah
1Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said, 2and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple. 3The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said:
No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything. 4You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia. 5He will clean out the royal treasury and take everything else of value from Jerusalem.
6Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried.
Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
7You tricked me, Lord,
and I was really fooled.
You are stronger than I am,
and you have defeated me.
People never stop sneering
and insulting me.
8You have let me announce
only injustice and death.
Your message has brought me
nothing but insults
and trouble.
9Sometimes I tell myself
not to think about you, Lord,
or even mention your name.
But your message burns
in my heart and bones,
and I cannot keep silent.
10I heard the crowds whisper,
“Everyone is afraid.
Now's our chance
to accuse Jeremiah!”
All of my so-called friends
are just waiting
for me to make a mistake.
They say, “Maybe Jeremiah
can be tricked.
Then we can overpower him
and get even at last.”
11But you, Lord,
are a mighty soldier,
standing at my side.
Those troublemakers
will fall down and fail—
terribly embarrassed,
forever ashamed.
12 Lord All-Powerful,
you test those who do right,
and you know every heart
and mind.
I have told you my complaints,
so let me watch you
take revenge on my enemies.
13I sing praises to you, Lord.
You rescue the oppressed
from the wicked.
14 Put a curse on the day I was born!
Don't bless that day.
15Put a curse on the man
who told my father, “Good news!
You have a son.”
16May that man be like the towns
you destroyed without pity.
Let him hear shouts of alarm
in the morning
and battle cries at noon.
17He deserves to die
for not killing me
before I was born.
Then my mother's body
would have been my grave.
18Why did I have to be born?
Was it just to suffer
and die in shame?
translation_text:
Jeremia de Pasura taane
1Yimera bu Pasura déem mo ye kaanem tu wolo na nii Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem totoŋa yam baŋa ne to. O ma ni Jeremia na pworisi o pa Jerusalem tei to. 2O ma pa ni se ba ja Wɛ sampwora Jeremia ba mage, se ba daare ba ja‑o ba vɔ de chegero. Ba déem lugi dɛ mo ba ke o nɛ ne ye ba pe‑o se ko maŋe de Benjamin Ni dem na wo Wɛ diga kam baŋa seeni to. 3Tega na poore to, Pasura ma pa se ba bwoli‑o ba yage. Jeremia ma ta o bere‑o o we, “Baŋa Wɛ laam leiri n yere dem mo. De daa dae ‘Pasura’. De laam wó taa ye ‘Ba fugi-ne jei maama ne’ mo. 4Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
Amo wó pa se á dona ba ba fugi nmo de n badwonna bam maama. Nmo wó ta‑n zege n nii mo ye á dona bam go-ba de se-zɔɔro. A nam ta wó kwei Judah tiina bam maama a ke Babilon teo pɛ wom jeŋa ne, se o kale-ba o ja o vo Babilon, naa o go-ba jara-keim baŋa ne. 5A ta wó pa ba dona bam chwoŋa se ba zo Jerusalem teo kom ba vere ko jejegero tem maama. Ko ná ye wonnu telo nɔɔna na yaare ba na to, de telo na tiini te jege lonne to, de wo-laaro telo Judah pwa bam na nɛ to, ba dona bam wó pɛ te maama ba ja ba vo Babilon ba chɛ ba pa daane. 6Ko ná ye nmo Pasura, ba lage ba ja nmo, de n sɔŋɔ tiina maama mo ba kale ba vo Babilon. Dáane mo nmo wó te, se ba daare ba ke‑m da. Ko ta wó taa ye bedwe mo de n badwonna bam maama, kokuri to, n pworisi vwa mo n bere-ba.”
Jeremia daa poone Wɛ yiga ne
7 Baŋa Wɛ, nmo soge amo mo,
pa se a ji nmo tontoŋeno.
Amo de ma pa nmo chwoŋa
se n soge-ne konto.
Nmo dam dem wane amo de di.
Nɔɔna maama laam jege-ne mo ba mɔna.
Ba maa twe-ne dɛ maama wone.
8Amo ná yeini a puri a ni
se a ŋɔɔne taane,
kolo yerane a na tɔɔle to
ye vuvuga de lɛɛro taane mo!
Baŋa Wɛ kwora kalo a na jege se a tɔɔle to
ma ja toro de kuri-nɔrɔ yerane
ka ba ka pa-ne.
9Amo nam ná tage a tete ne a we,
“Amo daa bá boŋe Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa,
a nam daa bá tɔɔle o kwora kam,”
o taane dem laam yeini de daane-ne
ne mini na vevela a wone tei to mo.
Ko nye de mini mo jege a kwi sem de zwɛa.
A ná kwaane se a che o kwora kam
se a daa yé tɔɔle-ka,
a ware a tete se a ja.
10Amo yɔɔre a ni nɔɔna na jege a taane mo
ba waasa ye ba we:
“Ba fugi debam jei maama ne!
Nam pa se dé ba bebara dé daŋe o baŋa ne!
Dé wó pa se o to de o bora.”
Amo badwoŋ-swonnu tem maama
de maa lage se a seeri a to.
Ba maa we:
“Pa-na dé soge‑o se o ke o sa chwoŋa.
Dé laam wó wane dé di dam o baŋa ne
se dé jwoori dé ŋwe jene o baŋa ne.”
11 Baŋa Wɛ nam zege a tei ne mo, ne babea tei.
Konto ŋwaane mo balo na bɛɛse-ne to
wó seeri ba to tega ne.
Ba bá yi amo yuu.
Ba nam wó di chaveera.
Nɔɔna bá fɔge ba swei banto yuu na yaale tei to.
12Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yeini n faŋe
balo na ye nɔn-ŋona to mo n nii.
N maŋe n yei ba bochara
de ba boboŋa na ye tei to.
Nam zaŋe n waare-ba n pa-ne,
se n jwoori n ŋwe jene ba baŋa ne.
Kokuri to, a kwei a taane dem a ke nmo jeŋa ne mo.
13Nam leeni-na leiŋa á pa Baŋa Wɛ!
Tei-na o yere!
Kokuri to o yeini o jwoŋi nabwona mo
o yage puseŋ-nyena jeŋa ne.
14A nam wó sɔɔle lwarem mo
a yage a lora dɛ dem baŋa ne!
Dɛ dem a nu na loge-ne to dae wopwolo dɛ!
15Ko ta ná ye wolo na tu o pa a kwo kwora,
pa se o de wo pwoli, ye o ta ded‑o o we,
“Ba loge bakeira ba pa‑m” to,
a wó sɔɔle lwarem a yage kotu de yuu ne.
16Wɛ wó pa se kotu na chɔgem
ne faŋa faŋa teene delo Baŋa Wɛ na chɔge,
ye o wo jaane de ŋwaŋa to mo.
Zezeŋa ne, kotu wó ni keira mo na zaŋe bugi-bugi.
Wea tetare ne, tiguri-kaasa wó to o zwa ne.
17Kotu ya ná go-ne ye a tigi a nu puga ne mo,
ko ya wó taa gara.
A nu puga kam ya wó lɛɛre ka ji a yibeeli.
O ya wó taa jege a puga kam taa wuu.
18Bɛŋwaane mo ba bere ba lo-ne?
A ŋwea kam yɔɔre ka su de cham
de wo-chechɔgɔ mo.
Amo laam maa wó ba a kweeli de chaveera!

english_text:
The Lord Will Fight against Jerusalem
1King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.”
So they came to me and said, 2 “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
3-7I told them that the Lord God of Israel had told me to say to King Zedekiah:
The Babylonians have surrounded Jerusalem and want to kill you and your people. You are asking me to save you, but you have made me furious. So I will stretch out my mighty arm and fight against you myself. Your army is using spears and swords to fight the Babylonians, but I will make your own weapons turn and attack you. I will send a horrible disease to kill many of the people and animals in Jerusalem, and there will be nothing left to eat. Finally, I will let King Nebuchadnezzar and his army fight their way to the center of Jerusalem and capture everyone who is left alive, including you and your officials. But Nebuchadnezzar won't be kind or show any mercy—he will have you killed! I, the Lord, have spoken.
8 Then I told them that the Lord had said:
People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death. 9The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city. 10I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Warns the King of Judah
* 11Pay attention, you that belong
to the royal family.
12Each new day, make sure
that justice is done,
and rescue those
who are being robbed.
Or else my anger will flame up
like a fire that never goes out.
13Jerusalem,
from your mountaintop
you look out over the valleys
and think you are safe.
But I, the Lord, am angry,
14and I will punish you
as you deserve.
I'll set your palace on fire,
and everything around you
will go up in smoke.
translation_text:
Wɛ wó waare Judah pwa de yiga tiina
21:1–29:32
Wɛ ve Zedekia na lwoori‑o kolo to
1 Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Jeremia ni delo to mo tento. Pɛ Zedekia déem toŋe Malakia bu Pasura, de Maaseya bu Zefania na ye Wɛ kaanem tu to se ba vo Jeremia tei ba ŋɔɔne ded‑o. Ba ma lwoori‑o ba we, 2“Lwoori Baŋa Wɛ se o jwoŋi debam o yage. Pɛ Nebukadeneza bobo se o kwaare jara dedaane dé teo kom mo. Dɛ delo, Baŋa Wɛ daa wó duri dé ŋwaŋa se o ke wo-kenkagele ne o na ke tei faŋa to, se o zeili Nebukadeneza se o jwoori o viiri o daare debam.”
3Jeremia déem ma kwei Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam o ma o leiri-ba o we, “Véi-na á ta de Zedekia we, 4‘Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento:
Babilon teo pɛ wom de o jar-keira bam laam kaare á teo kom ba pu. Ko nam ná ye jara zela yalo á na jege á ma‑á jeeri-ba to, a lage a pa ya jwoori ya ba á baŋa ne, pa se á kwaleme-ya á tiŋi á teo kom tetare ne mo. 5Amo tete mo wó tɔge a dam baŋa ne a toŋe wo-kamunnu ye a kwaare jara de abam, a bane na tiini de fuli á baŋa ne to ŋwaane. 6A nam wó pa se ko zo balo maama na zoore teo konto wone to yera. Ko ná ye nabiina de vara bam maama, jawe-chɛɛro mo lage te go-ba. 7Ko kwaga ne, amo Baŋa Wɛ wó kwei Judah teo pɛ Zedekia, de o nakwa, dedaane teo konto nɔɔna balo maama jawe-chɛɛro tem, de jara yam, de kana kam ta na wo go-ba to, a ke Pɛ Nebukadeneza jeŋa ne, de abam dona balo na beeri á gom to jeŋa ne. Wonto bere o bá duri ba ŋwaŋa de fenfee de ye o pa se ba maama ga ba ŋwea. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’
8Daa‑n ta ta de nɔɔna bam we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: Amo zem pɛ abam chwoŋa mo se á kuri chwei selei tetare ne: kuri-na ŋwea, naa toone. 9Wolo maama ná maŋe teo konto wone, jara, naa kana, naa jawe-chɛɔ mo wó go kotu. Wolo nam ná nwoŋi teo kom wone o vo o sɛ o pa Babilon tiina bam, kotu wó jwoŋi o tete o yage. 10Ko na ye tei to, amo boboŋa jaane ya ti se a pa lɛɛro mo yi teo konto, ye ko dae lam. A lage a kwei-ko a ke Babilon teo pɛ jeŋa ne, se o zwɛ-ko kula! Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ ”
Judah teo pwa bam taane
Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de amo o we:
11-12“Nam ta tento n woli da n bere balo na ye Judah teo Pɛ sɔŋɔ tiina ye ba nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento:
Dɛ maama wone, se á ta‑á ke chega de balo á na nii to.
Abam ná maane we ba vere nabwom wolo,
se á jwoŋi kotu á yage wolo na bɛɛse‑o to jeŋa ne.
Á ná wo ke konto, a bane wó zaŋe de di abam ne mini tei to,
á lwarem kikia yalo á na kare á ke to ŋwaane.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane mini dem konto o dwei.
13Jerusalem pɛ sɔŋɔ kom,
amo nwoŋi abam kwaga ne mo!
Á sɔŋɔ kom dɔge peero yuu ne,
ko jeeri bwolo kolo na wo ko kuri ne to.
Abam laam maa tɛ we,
“Wɔ mo wó wane o yi se o chɔge debam?
Wɔ mo wó wane o zo dé dalem jei sento wone?”
14Amo nam wó waare abam
se ko maŋe de á totoŋa na ye tei to.
Ko ná ye á sɔ-fɔrɔ kom,
amo wó pa se ko di sem ja mini,
se mini dem di woŋo kolo maama na bwola da to kula!
Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ ”

People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death. 9The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city. 10I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Warns the King of Judah
* 11Pay attention, you that belong
to the royal family.
12Each new day, make sure
that justice is done,
and rescue those
who are being robbed.
Or else my anger will flame up
like a fire that never goes out.
13Jerusalem,
from your mountaintop
you look out over the valleys
and think you are safe.
But I, the Lord, am angry,
14and I will punish you
as you deserve.
I'll set your palace on fire,
and everything around you
will go up in smoke.

* 11Pay attention, you that belong
to the royal family.
12Each new day, make sure
that justice is done,
and rescue those
who are being robbed.

like a fire that never goes out.
13Jerusalem,

you look out over the valleys
and think you are safe.
But I, the Lord, am angry,

as you deserve.

and everything around you
will go up in smoke.

english_text:
The Lord Will Fight against Jerusalem
1King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.”
So they came to me and said, 2 “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
3-7I told them that the Lord God of Israel had told me to say to King Zedekiah:
The Babylonians have surrounded Jerusalem and want to kill you and your people. You are asking me to save you, but you have made me furious. So I will stretch out my mighty arm and fight against you myself. Your army is using spears and swords to fight the Babylonians, but I will make your own weapons turn and attack you. I will send a horrible disease to kill many of the people and animals in Jerusalem, and there will be nothing left to eat. Finally, I will let King Nebuchadnezzar and his army fight their way to the center of Jerusalem and capture everyone who is left alive, including you and your officials. But Nebuchadnezzar won't be kind or show any mercy—he will have you killed! I, the Lord, have spoken.
8 Then I told them that the Lord had said:
People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death. 9The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city. 10I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Warns the King of Judah

to the royal family.

you look out over the valleys
and think you are safe.

14and I will punish you
as you deserve.

english_text:
The Lord Will Punish the King of Judah
1-3The Lord sent me to the palace of the king of Judah to speak to the king, his officials, and everyone else who was there. The Lord told me to say:
I am the Lord, so pay attention! You have been allowing people to cheat, rob, and take advantage of widows, orphans, and foreigners who live here. Innocent people have become victims of injustice, and some of them have even been killed. But now I command you to do what is right and see that justice is done. Rescue everyone who has suffered from injustice.
4If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots. 5 But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins. 6Listen to what I think about it:
The palace of Judah's king
is as glorious as Gilead
or Lebanon's highest peaks.
But it will be as empty
as a ghost-town
when I'm through with it.
7I'll send troops to tear it apart,
and its beautiful cedar beams
will be used for firewood.
8People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?” 9Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.”
King Jehoahaz
The Lord said:
10King Josiah is dead,
so don't mourn for him.
Instead, mourn for his son
King Jehoahaz,
dragged off to another country,
never to return.
11-12 Jehoahaz became king of Judah after his father King Josiah died. But Jehoahaz was taken as a prisoner to a foreign country. Now I, the Lord, promise that he will die there without ever seeing his own land again.
King Jehoiakim
The Lord told me to say:
* 13King Jehoiakim, you are doomed!
You built a palace
with large rooms upstairs.
14You put in big windows
and used cedar paneling
and red paint.
But you were unfair
and forced the builders to work
without pay.
* 15More cedar in your palace
doesn't make you a better king
than your father Josiah.
He always did right—
he gave justice to the poor
and was honest.
16That's what it means
to truly know me.
So he lived a comfortable life
and always had enough
to eat and drink.
17But all you think about
is how to cheat
or abuse or murder
some innocent victim.
18 Jehoiakim, no one will mourn
at your funeral.
They won't turn to each other
and ask,
“Why did our great king
have to die?”
19You will be given a burial
fit for a donkey;
your body will be dragged
outside the city gates
and tossed in the dirt.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
King Jehoiachin and the People of Jerusalem
The Lord told me to say:
20People of Jerusalem,
the nations you trusted
have been crushed.
Go to Lebanon and weep;
cry in the land of Bashan
and in Moab.
21When times were good,
I warned you.
But you ignored me,
just as you have done
since Israel was young.
22Now you will be disgraced
because of your sins.
Your leaders will be swept away
by the wind,
and the nations you trusted
will be captured and dragged
to a foreign country.
23Those who live in the palace
paneled with cedar
will groan with pain
like women giving birth.
24 King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger. 25I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you. 26You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die, 27longing to return home.
28Jehoiachin, you are unwanted
like a broken clay pot.
So you and your children
will be thrown into a country
you know nothing about.
29Land of Judah, I am the Lord.
Now listen to what I say!
30Erase the names
of Jehoiachin's children
from the royal records.
He is a complete failure,
and so none of them
will ever be king.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
Judah pwa bam taane
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta de amo o we, “Zaŋe n vo Judah teo pɛ sɔŋɔ se n ta amo kwora n pa-ba we: 2‘Judah teo pɛ wolo na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to, ko woli de nakwa bam, de balo maama na tɔge manchwo-peena yanto ba kɛ to, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ taane dem! 3Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
Ta‑á tɔge-na chega de á na ke nɔɔna tei to. Á ná maane we ba vere nabwom wolo, se á jwoŋi kotu á yage wolo na bɛɛse‑o to jeŋa ne. Ko ná ye veira balo na zoore á tei ne to, de botara, de kadeina, se á yé bɛɛse-ba naa á ke-ba lwarem. Nam yé zaŋe-na á go balo na wo maŋe se ba te to jei sento ne. 4Abam ná sɛ amo nia yam konto, á teo kom pwa balo na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem ne to wó taa wora mo taa, ye ba tɔge nia yanto seeni ba kɛa. Pwa bam konto dedaane ba nakwa wó yeini ba di sisei-torokooro de sisein-nɔɔna baŋa ne ba tɔge manchwo-peena yanto ba kɛ mo, ye ba nɔɔna bam de tɔge ba kwaga. 5Abam nam ná wo sɛ amo nia yam konto, amo tage a du de a tete yere we, sɔ-fɔrɔ konto lage ko ji di-dwoŋo mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ ”
6 Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo se ko vo Judah teo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom seeni:
“Sɔ-fɔrɔ kom konto tiini ko lana amo yia ne,
ne Gilead laŋa kam
de Lebanon peero tem na ye tei to mo.
Amo nam wó pa se ko ji ne kagoa dwoŋi,
se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé taa zoore ko wone.
7Amo mo lage a toŋe jar-keira
se ba ba ba chɔge-ko.
Ba wó taa jege ba jara zela mo,
se ba gwoni Sedare ywoa yam
ba dole-ya ba de mini wone.
8Ko kwaga ne dwi-gɛ tiina dedɛ wó tɔge teo konto seeni se ba kɛ, ye ba bwei daane ba we, ‘Bɛŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ chɔge teo kom tento dwoŋi, ye ko ya ye teo kamunu mo?’ 9Ba maa wó leiri-ba ba ta we, ‘Ko ye ba na ve ni delo ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na gwoni de-ba to, ye ba daare ba zuli wa-gɛ to ŋwaane mo o ke-ba konto.’ ”
Pɛ Jehohaza yera taane
10Yé ta‑á keeri-na pɛ wolo na tege to ŋwaane,
naa á ta‑á nyɔne yiga.
Ko nam ná ye á pɛ wolo ba na kale
ba jege ba vei sa-teo yiga yiga to,
se á ta‑á keera wonto ŋwaane.
Wonto daa bá jwoori ywo-seeni,
se o ma o yi o na o nabaara tega kam.
11Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ jege kwora se o pa Josia bu Jehohaza wolo na leiri o kwo yuu ne o di Judah teo paare, ye ba laam kale‑o ba ja ba viiri to. Wɛ kwora kam mo tento: “O daa bá jwoori ywo-seeni. 12O lage o te sa-teo ne mo yiga yiga, se o daa yé na o nabaara tega kam.”
Pɛ Jehoyakim taane
Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we:
13“Lɛɛro wo wolo na tɔge vwa chwoŋa
se o ma o lɔ o sɔ-fɔrɔ kom to yuu ne.
O ta ma ke kampina se o ma o yale-ko o zege.
O ma daare o pa se o nɔɔna toŋe zɛɛra mo ba pa‑o,
ye o ba sɛ o ŋwe-ba ba totoŋa ŋwaane.
14Wonto maa tɛ o we, ‘Amo wó lɔ sɔ-fɔrɔ mo a pa a tete,
de ko nayuu di selo na yala to.’
O ta ma ke takworru dedɛ ko wone,
se o daare o kwei Sedare dɛ
o ma o kwɛ ko di sem.
O laam ma kwei sonno dwi dwi o ma o kwɛ-ko.
15Nmo na ye pɛ to,
ko ye n na mɛ da-ŋonno
n lɔ sɔ-fɔrɔ to ŋwaane mo na?
Boŋe n nii n kwo Josia na ye tei to.
Wonto déem tɔge chwoŋa de o na ke nɔɔna tei to.
O maa nae o dɛ dɛ wodiu pa se ko maŋe ded‑o,
ye wonnu tɔge chwoŋa te pa‑o.
16O déem jwoŋi nabwona taane o ŋɔɔne o pa-ba.
Mo kokuri wonnu maama kwei chwoŋa te pa‑o.
O keina yam konto bere we o yɔɔre o yei amo.
Ko dae konto na?”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
17“Ko nam ná ye nmo,
n boboŋa yam jaane ya ti
se n ma vwa mo n duni.
N ma‑n goe balo na wo maŋe se ba te to,
ye n daare n jege n nɔɔna bam n bɛɛsa de dam.”
18Konto ŋwaane, Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo Josia bu Jehoyakim na ye Judah teo pɛ to seeni to mo tento:
“O ná tega, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá keeri o lua.
Ba bá ta nenɛɛne, ‘Lɛɛro mo yi debam!’
Ba wo nam bá chɔge de o toone dem,
se ba keeri we ba tu wom de o nenɔŋa jei.
19Ba lage ba suli‑o
ne ba na suli bonaga tei to mo.
Ba wó tuuri‑o mo
ba ja ba nwoŋi Jerusalem teo kom wone,
se ba kɛ ba dole‑o ba yage teo kom kabira kwaga ne.
20Jerusalem tiina bam, véi-na Lebanon laŋa kam á laare dáane,
Pa-na se á kwori zege Basan ne se zaŋe wɛɛne.
Véi-na Abarim peero tem wone se á keeri.
Kokuri to á fara bam maama daa tera jei jei
se ba woli abam.
21Wonnu maama ya ta na vei lanyerane te pae abam to,
mo a kaane abam.
Abam ma ve ye á we, ‘Dé bá cheigi nmo ni-kaana yam.’
Abam nam maŋe á ye konto mo
se ko zege á biini ne.
Á yeini á ba sɛ á pae amo.
22Abam yiga tiina bam maama lage ba jei,
ne vio mo kale-ba ko ja jei tei to.
Ba maa wó ja á fara bam ba viiri ba vo sa-teo.
Chaveera laam wó di abam ye á yuu yaale,
á puseŋa kikia yam ŋwaane.
23Abam jege dalem jei á sɔ-fwaaro tem wone,
de á na mɛ Lebanon teo da-ŋonno á lɔ-te to.
Ko nam bá dáane se abam tiini á keeri,
ne kaane wolo na virigi puga ye ka wɔe tei to.”
Pɛ Jehoyachin taane
24 Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento:
“Jehoyakim bu Jehoyachin na ye Judah teo pɛ to, a lage a vaŋe nmo mo a le a yage, ne n ye jafole delo na bere amo dam ye a vaŋe-de a le a jazem jeŋa ne tei to mo. 25A maa wó kwei‑m a ke balo na beeri‑m se ba go to jeŋa ne. Nmo nam yɔɔre n kɔre foone de-ba mo. A nam lage a kwei‑m a pa Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza de o jar-keira mo. 26A ta wó kwei nmo de n nu a dole a yage sa-teo ne yiga yiga. Ba wo loge abam teo kom konto ne. Á nam wó maŋe dáane se á te. 27Á daa bá jwoori tega kanto á fera na wo ka wone to.”
28Jehoyachin nye de zon-kɔga kalo na ba jege kuri to mo.
O maa ye wolo nɔɔna maama na vae to.
Ko seene ko ke‑o konto mo na?
Bɛ mo ke ye ba lage ba ja o de o bia bam
ba dole ba yage sa-teo kolo ba na yeiri to wone?
29Tega baŋa tiina bam, tega baŋa tiina bam,
nam cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam!
30 Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:
“Popone-na Jehoyachin yere dem á tiŋi,
se ko bere nenɛɛne o ya ba jege bia.
Wonto ŋwea maama wone,
ko bá ke lanyerane ko pa‑o.
Ko ta ná ye o bia bam de,
ba wolowolo bá di paare Judah tiina baŋa ne,
ne ba nabaaro David déem na di paare tei to.”

english_text:
A Message of Hope
The Lord said:
1 You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep. 2You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
3I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation. 4I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
5 Someday I will appoint
an honest king
from the family of David,
a king who will be wise
and rule with justice.
6As long as he is king,
Israel will have peace,
and Judah will be safe.
The name of this king will be
“The Lord Gives Justice.”
7A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt. 8Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land.
Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
9When I think of the prophets,
I am shocked, and I tremble
like someone drunk,
because of the Lord
and his sacred words.
10Those unfaithful prophets
misuse their power
all over the country.
So God turned the pasturelands
into scorching deserts.
The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
11The Lord told me to say:
You prophets and priests
think so little of me, the Lord,
that you even sin
in my own temple!
12Now I will punish you
with disaster,
and you will slip and fall
in the darkness.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
13The prophets in Samaria
were repulsive to me,
because they preached
in the name of Baal
and led my people astray.
14 And you prophets in Jerusalem
are even worse.
You're unfaithful in marriage
and never tell the truth.
You even lead others to sin
instead of helping them
turn back to me.
You and the people of Jerusalem
are evil like Sodom
and Gomorrah.
15You prophets in Jerusalem
have spread evil everywhere.
That's why I, the Lord, promise
to give you bitter poison
to eat and drink.
The Lord Gives a Warning
The Lord said:
16Don't listen to the lies
of these false prophets,
you people of Judah!
The message they preach
is something they imagined;
it did not come from me,
the Lord All-Powerful.
17These prophets go to people
who refuse to respect me
and who are stubborn
and do whatever they please.
The prophets tell them,
“The Lord has promised
everything will be fine.”
18But I, the Lord, tell you
that these prophets
have never attended a meeting
of my council in heaven
or heard me speak.
19They are evil! So in my anger
I will strike them
like a violent storm.
20I won't calm down,
until I have finished
what I have decided to do.
Someday you will understand
exactly what I mean.
21I did not send these prophets
or speak to them,
but they ran to find you
and to preach their message.
22If they had been in a meeting
of my council in heaven,
they would have told
you people of Judah
to give up your sins
and come back to me.
23I am everywhere—
both near and far,
24 in heaven and on earth.
There are no secret places
where you can hide from me.
25These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name. 26But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on? 27They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal. 28Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them. 29My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
30-32These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken.
News and Nuisance
The Lord said to me:
33Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
34If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest. 35Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?” 36It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
37If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?” 38But if you disobey me and say, “Here is news from the Lord,” 39I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors. 40You will never be free from your shame and disgrace.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoŋi o nɔɔna o yage
1 Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento:
“Lɛɛro taa wo yiga tiina balo na nii a nɔɔna bam to yuu ne! Banto nye de nayera balo na jege a pei sem ba chɔga to mo, pa se se jage jei maama ne.”
2Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom nam na tage nayera bam konto taane tei to mo tento:
“Abam na zeili amo pei sem pa se jage, ye á wo nii se baŋa ne chekke to, amo lage a waare abam mo, á lwarem kikia yam ŋwaane. 3Ko ná ye amo nɔɔna balo ta na daare ye a zeili-ba jei selo maama ne to, amo lage a jwoori a la-ba se ba nwoŋi mɛ maama ba na vei to mo, se ba jwoori ba tete tega kam ne. Ba laam maa wó puli dedɛ. 4A ta wó beeri nayera balo yiga na wo ba wone to a pa-ba, se ba taa nii ba baŋa ne. Konto wó pa se foone daa yé ja a nɔɔna bam, ye ba wolowolo de bá jei.”
5 Baŋa Wɛ mo taga o we:
“Maŋa lage ka yi
se David dwi dem puli naga dedoa,
ye kotu wó taa ye nɔn-ŋom mo.
Amo wó tiŋi wonto se o di paare,
ye o taa nii a nɔɔna baŋa ne de yi-poro.
O ta wó taa tɔge chega de o na ke nɔɔna tei to mo
tega kam maama ne.
6O paare dim maŋa ne, Judah tiina wó na verem,
ye Isarele tiina maama taa zoore de yazura.
Nɔɔna maa wó taa bwoi o yere we,
‘Baŋa Wɛ mo bore debam bora de chega.’
7Chega to, maŋa lage ka yi se balo ná lage ba du duuri, se ba daa yé ta we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi debam Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne to yere dem.’ 8Ba laam wó taa tɛ we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kom ne, dedaane jei selo maama o na jage-ba to yere dem.’ Kokuri to ba laam wó taa zoore ba tete tega kam ne mo.”
Vwa sampwori sem taane
9A wo yɔɔre ko pɛ mo
de sampwori sem kikia yam.
A yera maa didigi de ba keim dem.
Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ tete ŋwaane,
de taane delo o na ŋɔɔne banto seeni to ŋwaane mo,
amo nye de nɔɔno na nyɔge sana o bugi to.
10Tega kam maama su de balo na lɔge Wɛ kwaga ne to mo.
Sampwori sem duri ba tɔge lwarem kikia.
Ba na jege dam ba ke tei to yɔɔre ko ba tɔge chwoŋa.
Mo kokuri Wɛ sɔɔle lwarem o yage tega kam baŋa ne,
pa se ka keeri wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane.
Pwoli sem maama laam jigi te-kora yerane.
11“Sampwori sem de kaanem tiina bam ba gare daane,
ba wolowolo yeiri Wɛ.
Ba bere ba ja ba totoŋ-lwanno tem
ba zo amo wara-jei sem wone mo ba ke.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
12“Konto ŋwaane, ba chwei sem wó taa ye lim mo,
ye se taa seera.
Nɔɔna wó pare-ba chwei sem konto wone,
pa se ba to tega ne.
Maŋa kam ná yi se a waare-ba,
a laam wó pa se lɛɛro to ba baŋa ne.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
13“Amo nii a na sampwori selo na wo Samaria ne
ye ba jege wo-zɔɔne delo ba ke to.
Ba yeini ba ma Baal jwoni dem yere mo
ba pworisa.
Ba na ke tei konto to
ma pa se a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam tusi.
14Ko nam ná ye sampwori selo na wo Jerusalem teo kom ne to de,
amo ta nɛ we banto ke wo-zɔɔne ko ja gaale.
Ba kare ba tɔge kabwoŋa kikia mo,
ye ba ta swoi se ba taa toŋe vwa.
Ba yɔɔre ba woli ba dwonna mo
se ba taa ke totoŋ-balwaaro,
pa se nɔɔna ware ba wɛleera yam ba yage.
Ba maama jigi ne Sodom teo tiina na ye tei to mo a yiga ne.
Chega to, Jerusalem tiina bam
ye ne Gomora teo tiina déem na ye tei to mo.”
15Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam na tage sampwori sem konto taane tei to mo tento:
“Amo wó pa ba na yaara dedɛ.
Ko maŋe se ba di wodi-chɛɔ
ye ba daare ba nyɔ na-chɛɛra mo.
Kokuri to, Jerusalem sampwori sem kikia ŋwaane mo
nɔɔna swei amo swia tega kam jei maama ne.”
16Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam na tage tei to mo tento:
“Jerusalem tiina bam, yé cheigi-na sampwori sento na pworisi tei de abam to. Ba pae se á jege teena kafɛ mo. Ko maa ye ba tete boboŋa mo ba jege ba tɛ ba bere abam, se ba wo nigi taane amo Baŋa Wɛ ni ne. 17Ba swoi se ba taa tɛ de balo na ve amo taane to we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ tage we, abam wó na yazura.’ Ko ta ná ye zwabani-nyena bam de, ba tɛ de-ba mo we, ‘Cham bá ba á baŋa kɔtaa!’
18Sampwori sem konto wɔ nam mo me de Baŋa Wɛ,
se kotu maane o lɔre Baŋa Wɛ kwora?
Ba wɔ mo bere o cheigi se o ni o taane dem?
19Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ bane wó zaŋe lela,
ne vo-dɛɔ na zaŋe tei to mo.
Ko nam wó taa nye de vo-kekara
na chugi nɔn-balwaaro yuu ne tei to mo.
20 Baŋa Wɛ bane nam ná zaŋe de-ba,
ko ná dae we o ke o su o boboŋa yam mo,
o bochare dem ta bá zuri.
Maŋa kam nam ná yia,
abam laam wó ni ko kuri lanyerane.
21Amo wo toŋe sampwori sem konto.
De ko de, ba duri ba vo nɔɔna tei
se ba ŋɔɔne amo yere ŋwaane.
Amo nam wo kwei a taane a pa-ba,
ye ba ta kare ba pworisa ba bere nɔɔna.
22Ba nam ya ná me de amo chekke,
ba ya wó tɔɔle amo taane dem
ba bere a nɔɔna bam.
Ba ya wó pa se a nɔɔna bam pipiri
ba yage ba vwa chwei sem,
de ba lwarem kikia yam.”
23 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma bwei o we:
“Abam boŋe we a ye Wɛ delo na wo jeiga dedoa bwola bwola yerane to mo na? Á yeiri we amo wo yiga yiga de jei maama ne na? 24Gugworo wora logo baŋa ne se nɔɔno seigi ko wone ye a bá na kotu na? Á yeiri we amo yɔɔre a su wɛyuu kom de tega kam maama mo na?”
Kwora kalo Baŋa Wɛ na tage to mo konto.
25“Amo nigi vwa yalo sampwori sento na kare ba pworisi amo yere ŋwaane to. Ba yɔɔre ba tɛ mo ba we, ‘Wɛ ŋɔɔne de amo dendwɛ wone!’ 26Ko nam ye vwa mo ba jege ba pworisa. Ba tete boboŋa mo gane-ba pa se ba ŋɔɔna. Ba wó ke konto taa se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo? 27Ba maa kwaane se ba pa amo nɔɔna bam swei amo yere dem, de ba na lwoni ba dendwea yam ba bere daane tei to. Ba ke nenɛɛne ba nabaara de déem na ke tei ye ba swei amo yere dem ba daare ba zuli Baal jwoni dem to mo. 28Tɔ. Sampwora ná dwɛ dendwɛ, se kotu ta o bere de na seene de ye tei to. Sampwora kalo nam ná jwoŋi amo taane, se kotu yɔɔre o bere-de chekke. Taana yanto dae bedwe, ne men-swanno na dae mena yam chekke tei to!”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
29“Amo taane zwɛ wonnu ne mini na ke tei to mo. De ta maa nye de swoli na jege kandwa-zana de lɔe muga-muga tei to. Ko dae konto na?
30Konto to, ko ná ye sampwori selo na kare ba jene da-taana ba ŋɔɔne, ye ba we ko ye amo kwora mo ba jege ba ŋɔɔne to, amo nwoŋi ba kwaga ne. 31Chega to, amo yiga tera sampwori selo na ŋɔɔne ba tete taane ye ba tɛ ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento’ to wone. 32Nii-na! Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage a we: A chuli balo na dwɛ dendwea ye ba daare ba pworisi vwa ya ŋwaane to. Ba na yɔɔre ba fɔe vwa ba bere a nɔɔna bam tei to maa pae se ba tusa. Amo wo kuri sampwori sem konto. A ta wo toŋe-ba a nɔɔna bam tei ne. Ba bere ba ba woli a nɔɔna bam de fenfee de.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we:
33“Nɔɔna banto wone, naa ba sampwori sem wone, naa ba kaanem tiina wone dedoa ná bwei‑m o we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ daa kwei zele dɔ mo se o pa dé zeŋe?’, se n ta de kotu we, ‘Abam mo ye zele delo na daane Baŋa Wɛ to mo! Baŋa Wɛ we o lage dole abam mo o yage!’
34Sampwora kalo, naa kaanem tu wolo, naa nɔɔno wolo maama nam ná tage o we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ kwei zele dento mo o pa-ne’, amo wó waare kotu mo de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama.
35Abam nam na maŋe se á bwei daane tei to mo tento: ‘Baŋa Wɛ leiri debam o we bɛ mo?’ naa ‘Baŋa Wɛ tage o we bɛ mo?’. 36Á nam daa yé ta‑á tɛ we, ‘Zele delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ debam to mo tento.’ Kokuri to, abam tete kwora mo ye zele delo na daane abam to. Á tɔge konto baŋa á kweele dé Tu Wɛ wom taane dem á yage tega ne, ye wonto mo ye Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ de Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. 37Abam nam ná yeini á vo sampwora tei, se á bwei‑o nenɛɛne: ‘Baŋa Wɛ leiri‑m o we bɛ mo?’ naa ‘Baŋa Wɛ tage o we bɛ mo?’ 38Á nam ta ná tɛ á we ‘Zele delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ debam to mo tento’, ta‑á yei-na we amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Abam ta na tage we ‘Zele delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ debam to mo tento’, ye a maŋe a kaane abam we á daa yé ta‑á tɛ konto dwoŋi to ŋwaane, 39amo yɔɔre a lage a gɔ abam a dole a yage yiga yiga mo. A ta wó zeili á teo kom maama amo déem na pɛ abam de á nabaara bam to se á viiri amo yiga ne. 40A laam maa wó pa se á na chaveera yalo na bá fɔge ya ti to. Abam bá swei á na wó yaale tei to ni ne.”

english_text:
Jeremiah Has a Vision of Two Baskets of Figs
1 The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple. 2One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
3“Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?”
“Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
4Then the Lord told me to say:
5People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia, 6where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down. 7I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
8The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt. 9I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted. 10War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_text:
Mɔɔro dwia yalei taane
1Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza déem jaane Judah teo pɛ Jehoyakim bu Jehoyachin Jerusalem ne mo o kale o ja o vo Babilon. O ta kale Judah nakwa bam, de ba teo gwaro, de ba lura bam maama mo o ja o viiri. Konto kwaga ne mo Baŋa Wɛ le wonnu o bere-ne. O ma pa se a na mɔɔro tetwaro telei, te na zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam yiga ne. 2Tetɔgɔ dedoa su de mɔɔro na lana to. Te maa ye telo na lwoori yiga te ke to mo. Tetɔgɔ kodwoŋi kom wo mɔɔro tem ma pɔ, te yɔɔre te wo maŋe de dim!
3 Baŋa Wɛ ma bwei amo o we, “Jeremia, bɛ mo n nii n na?” Amo ma leiri‑o a we, “Mɔɔro dwia yalei mo a nɛa. Tedwonna tiini te lana. Tetem tem ba lana. Te yɔɔre te dae ba ke ni ne.”
4 Baŋa Wɛ déem ma pa amo ni o we:
5“Amo Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: Mɔɔro telo na lana to zege te pae Judah tiina balo a na kale a ja a vo a yage Babilon teo wone to mo. Nɔɔna bam konto lana amo yiga ne. 6Amo wó taa nii ba baŋa ne pa se ko ke lanyerane ko pa-ba. A ta wó jwoori a ja-ba a jwoori a ba ywo-seeni. A lage a fɔge a lɔ-ba a zege mo, se a daa bá vaare-ba a de tega ne a yage. A maa wó jeiri-ba te-ywoŋa jei ne, se a bá vuuri-ba a gɔ a yage. 7A maa wó pa se ba boboŋa ja se ba taa kɔre amo wolo na ye Baŋa Wɛ wom to. Ba laam maa wó taa ye amo tete nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye ba Wɛ. Kokuri to, ba lage ba jwoori amo tei de ba bochare maama mo.
8Amo Baŋa Wɛ daa ta maa we: Ko daare ko ná ye Judah teo pɛ Zedekia, de o nakwa bam, de nɔɔna balo maama ta na daare Jerusalem teo kom wone to, de balo na duri ba vo Ejipti teo ba zoore da to, amo lage a ke-ba ne mɔɔro telo na pɔga ye te dae se ba di to mo. 9A lage a pa se lɛɛro ba ba baŋa mo, se ba ji wo-zɔɔna logo baŋa teene maama yia ne. Nɔɔna maama wó neese-ba mo, ye ba ta lɔŋe-ba. Ba ta maa wó taa ye sinseira nɔɔna nia ne. Mɛ maama amo na wó pa se ba jage ba yi da to, nɔɔna wó taa mɔne-ba, ye ba daare ba mae ba yere ba sɔɔle lwarem ba pa daane. 10A lage a pa se ba te jara wone mo, se kana de jawe-chɛɛro de ja-ba te go, se ko ta nii maŋa kalo ba yere na saare tega kalo a déem na kwei a pa ba de ba nabaara bam to wone.”

english_text:
Seventy Years of Exile
1-2 In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, which was the first year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia, the Lord told me to speak to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. So I told them:
3For 23 years now, ever since the thirteenth year that Josiah was king, I have been telling you what the Lord has told me. But you have not listened.
4The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen. 5They told you that the Lord had said:
Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors. 6I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
7But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did. 8You refused to listen to me, 9and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you. 10 I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night. 11 This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for 70 years.
12When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever. 13My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened. 14I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves.
The Cup Full of God's Anger
15The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some. 16They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
17I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some. 18I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words. 19The second place I went was Egypt, where everyone had to drink from the cup, including the king and his officials, the other government workers, the rest of the Egyptians, 20and all the foreigners who lived in the country.
Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod. 21Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, 22and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea. 23-24After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert, 25Zimri, Elam, Media, 26and the countries in the north, both near and far.
I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
27The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
28The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink. 29Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.”
30The Lord told me to say:
From my sacred temple
I will roar like thunder,
while I trample my people
and everyone else
as though they were grapes.
31My voice will be heard
everywhere on earth,
accusing nations of their crimes
and sentencing the guilty
to death.
Disaster Is Coming
32The Lord All-Powerful says:
You can see disaster spreading
from far across the earth,
from nation to nation
like a horrible storm.
33When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn.
The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
34The Lord's people are his flock,
and you leaders
were the shepherds.
But now it's your turn
to be butchered like sheep.
You'll shatter like fine pottery
dropped on the floor.
So roll on the ground,
crying and mourning.
35You have nowhere to run,
nowhere to hide.
* 36-37Listen to the cries
of the shepherds,
as the Lord's burning anger
turns peaceful meadows
into barren deserts.
38Like a lion leaving its den,
the Lord has abandoned
his people
to the destruction of war.
translation_text:
Judah tiina wó maŋe sa-teo ne bena fuserepɛ
1Judah teo pɛ Josia bu Jehoyakim paare dim bena yana bene dem wone mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ Jeremia kwora se o ta o bere Judah tiina bam maama. Bene dem konto ne mo Babilon teo Pɛ Nebukadeneza de déem bobo se o di o paare.
2Wɛ sampwora Jeremia na tage kolo o bere balo na zoore Jerusalem ne to dedaane Judah tiina bam maama to mo tento:
3Ko zege Judah teo Pɛ Amon bu Josia paare dim bena fuga-yatɔ bene dem ne, se ko yi zem, amo yɔɔre a tɛ de abam Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ne kwora kalo maama se a pa abam to mo. Abam nam ba cheiga. 4Baŋa Wɛ nam yɔɔre o toŋe o sampwori sem mo á tei ne maŋa maama se ba ŋɔɔne de abam, ye á ta ba sɛ ba taane dem. Á maŋe á ba cheigi-ba de. 5Baŋa Wɛ maa yeini o tɔge banto baŋa o ta we, “Abam maama pipiri-na á yage chwo-balwaaro telo á na vei se wone to, se á daa yé ta‑á tɔge lwarem kikia. Á ná ke konto, á wó ta‑á zoore tega kalo amo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei a pa abam de á nabaara bam se á ta‑á tei-ka taa wuu to ne. 6Nam yé tɔge-na wa-yɔɔro kwaga, se á zuli-ya. Yé pa-na se a bane zaŋe de á je na ke wonnu telo to. Abam ná sɛ amo ni konto, amo de bá chɔge abam.
7 Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Abam nam wo sɛ amo taane dem, ye á chuchugi a bane de á je na ke wonnu telo to. Á keim dem konto ma pa se á na chɔgem delo laam na tu á baŋa tento to. 8Konto ŋwaane, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Abam na wo cheigi amo taane dem to, 9amo de wó bwoŋi dwia yalo na zoore baŋa seeni to nɔɔna bam maama, de amo tontoŋeno Nebukadeneza wolo na ye Babilon teo Pɛ to se ba ba. A maa wó toŋe-ba se ba ke jara de abam balo na zoore tega kanto wone to, de teene delo maama na gilimi abam to. Ba wó yɔɔre ba chɔge á tega kam maama de jei selo na gilimi abam to fase, pa se ka maama ji di-dwonnu yerane. Nɔɔna wó taa jege-ka ba yaala, ye ba dole ba yuni ka ŋwaane. 10Amo wó pa se wopwolo de ywoni sɔɔ maama ti jei sem maama ne. Kadiri ywoni de daa bá taa wora. Nɔɔna daa bá taa choe muni naa ba tɔre mini. 11Tega kam maama jilli wó ji di-dwonnu mo ne kagoa tei. Judah tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina balo maama na gilimi-ba to maa wó taa wo Babilon teo pɛ dam kuri ne bena fuserepɛ.
12Bena fuserepɛ sem nam ná yia, amo wó waare Babilon teo pɛ de o teo kom maama ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane. Amo ta wó pa se lɛɛro ba Babilon tiina tega kam maama baŋa ne pa se ka ji di-dwonnu se ko taa vei wuu. 13A lage a pa se cham delo maama a na tage se ko vo Babilon tega kam seeni to mo seene de yi-ba. Waarem delo maama na popone de tiŋi tɔnɔ konto wone to, dedaane wonnu telo maama Jeremia na pworisi o pa dwi-gɛ tiina bam maama to wó yi-ba. 14Pa-kamuna de dwia yadwonna dedɛ mo wó di dam Babilon tiina bam baŋa ne pa se ba ji ba kabɛ. Amo wó jwoori a ŋwe ba keim-balwaaro tem jene se ko maŋe de ba je na ke wonnu telo to.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom
15Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom ma ta de amo o we, “Nii na-zoŋa a jeŋa ne de ka wo sana bam. Ka su de a ban-zɔŋɔ kom mo ka pɛɛle. Nam jwoŋi-ka n vo n pa dwi tiina balo maama amo na pɛ se n vo ba tei to, se ba nyɔ ka wo sana bam. 16Ba ná nyɔga, ba wó yirisi mo, jara yalo amo na wó pa se ya to ba tetare ne to ŋwaane.”
17Amo ma seene a jwoŋi na-zoŋa kam Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne. A ma kwei ka wo sana bam a pa dwi tiina balo maama o na pɛ se a vo ba tei to, ye ba nyɔ. 18A vei Jerusalem mo, de Judah teene dedwonna dem, de ba pwa de ba nakwa bam tei. A ma pa ba nyɔ na-zoŋa kam wo sana bam, se ko bere we ba lage ba na chɔgem ye ba teene dem ji di-dwonnu yerane. Nɔɔna wó taa jege-ba ba yaala ye ba mae ba yera ba sɔɔle lwarem ba pa daane. Ko ta ye konto mo de zem maama.
19Nɔɔna balo amo ta na pɛ ba nyɔ na-zoŋa kam wo sana bam to mo tento:
