8Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home. 9I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes. 10The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them. 11Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
12I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve. 13It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve. 14-15But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
The Lord Will Be Honored
16The Lord said:
17Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean. 18They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people 19and scattered them throughout the nations, just as they deserved. 20Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
21I care what those foreigners think of me, 22so tell the Israelites that I am saying:
You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name 23and to show foreign nations that I am holy. Then they will know that I am the Lord God. I have spoken.
24I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home. 25I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols. 26 I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts, 27because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings. 28You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
29I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve. 30Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food. 31You will remember your evil ways and hate yourselves for what you've done. 32People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
33After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them. 34Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren. 35Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people. 36Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
37I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep. 38The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_text:
Isarele peero tem taane
1“Nabiinu, pworisi taane n pa Isarele teo peero tem se n ta we, ‘Abam Isarele teo peero tem, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora. 2Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Abam dona bam laam chake abam ŋwaane mo ye ba tɛ ba we, “Faŋa faŋa peero tem laam jigi debam nyem mo.” ’
3Konto ŋwaane, pworisi se n ta we. ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Á dona bam nwoŋi jei maama ne ba ba ba chɔge á laŋa kam maama, pa se ka ji dwi-gɛ tiina bam nyem. Nɔɔna maa bae bebara ba pa abam ye ba jege abam ba yaala. 4Konto ŋwaane, Isarele peero tem, cheigi-na Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tage tento mo de abam peero tem, de zwonnu tem, dedaane á gugworru de bwollu tem. O kwora kam ta wó yi á teene delo maama á dona bam na chɔge pa de ji di-dwonnu ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa ba zoore de wone, pa se dwi-gɛ tiina balo na gilimi abam to laam vere á wonnu ba daare ba jege abam ba twe to. 5Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo tɔge a ban-lom baŋa ne mo a ta taane a chɔge dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto maama, ko fɔge ko dae Edom teo kom. Kokuri ba chake mo abam chɔgem ŋwaane, ye ba ta kuri se ba vere tega kalo abam na kɔne á vara da to se ka taa ye banto nyem.’
6Nam ta pworisi Isarele tega kam taane n ta de ka peero de ka zwonnu tem, dedaane ka gugworru, de ka bwollu tem we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo ŋɔɔne ko tɔge a ban-lom dem ŋwaane mo de dwi-gɛ tiina bam na tiini ba twe abam tei to. 7Konto ŋwaane, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ laam nam tage tento mo: Amo dugi duuri mo de yi-seena we, amo wó pa dwi-gɛ tiina balo na gilimi abam to na ba chaveera.
8Ko daare abam Isarele peero tem, teeni daa ta wó kwi vɔɔro á yuu ne, ye te ke bia lanyerane se amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam taa jege ba di. Kokuri, ko bá dáane de ba na jwoori ba tete teo. 9Amo yiga wo abam wone, se a woli abam. Nɔɔna wó va tega kam ye ba du wodiiru ka baŋa ne. 10Amo wó pa Isarele dwi tiina bam puli jei maama ne. Ba maa wó fɔge ba lɔ ba teene delo ya na chɔge to ba zege, se ba taa zoore de wone. 11A ta wó pa se nabiina de vara puli de kɔgɔ dedɛ á tega kam baŋa ne, ye ba daare ba lo bia. Nɔɔna dedɛ wó taa zoore á teene dem wone mo ne faŋa kam na ye tei to, ye á tiini á na yu-ywoŋo se ko dwoni faŋa kam. Abam laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom. 12A maa wó pa se a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam jwoori ba taa zoore á tega kam baŋa ne. Á tega kam wó taa ye ba nyem mo ye ba tei-ka. Te-ywoŋa kam konto nam daa bá pa se ba dwi ti.
13Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Nɔɔna kare ba tɛ abam taane ba we, “Á tega kam jege nabiina mo ka lira, pa se á teo kom ga ko bia.” 14Konto ŋwaane, amo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage we, ko na zege leile se ko taa vei to, tega kam daa bá li nabiina, pa se á teo kom ga ko bia. 15Amo daa bá pa se á ni dwi-gɛ tiina bam na jege abam ba mɔna tei to. Nɔɔna daa bá taa jege abam ba yaala se á ni ko zonne. Á teo kom de nam daa bá jwoori kwaga abam ŋwaane. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.’ ”
16 Baŋa Wɛ kwora daa ta ma yi amo we:
17“Nabiinu, maŋa kalo Isarele tiina bam ya na zoore ba tete tega kam baŋa ne to, mo ba digiri-ka de ba totoŋ-zɔɔna kikia yam. Amo nii a na ba kikia yam pa ya nye de kaane na wora o ke o chana zarem ye ko ye tei to mo. 18Amo ma yɔɔre a lwo a ban-lom ba baŋa ne a ma a waare-ba, ba na chɔge tega kam de ba nɔn-gora de ba jwona kaanem kikia yam to ŋwaane. 19Amo ma jage-ba pa ba vo yiga yiga se a yage-ba logo baŋa teene dem maama wone, ye a daare a waare-ba se ko maŋe de ba kikia yam na ye tei to. 20Ba nam na yeini ba vo ba gwaane de dwi-gɛ tiina jei selo maama ne to, ba de maa jege a yere dem na ye wose to ba yaala. Kokuri, nɔɔna yeini ba tɛ ba taane ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna bam mo tento. De ko de, o nam fe o le-ba tega kalo o ya na pɛ-ba to ne.’ 21Amo yiga nam wo a yere dem zula wone, de Isarele dwi tiina bam na pɛ dwi-gɛ tiina jege-de ba yaale tei to.
22Konto ŋwaane, ta de Isarele dwi tiina bam we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo na lage a jwoŋi abam a yage to dae abam totoŋa ŋwaane. Ko nam ye amo na laga se a tete yere dem na zula to ŋwaane mo. Kokuri, abam tiini á pa se dwi-gɛ tiina balo á na zoore ba tetare ne to yaale-de mo. 23A nam wó yɔɔre a bere dwi-gɛ tiina bam we amo yere-kamunu kom abam na yaale ba maama yiga ne to ye wose mo. Logo baŋa teene dem maama laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom, ne a ná tɔge abam baŋa ne a bere-ba jaja we a seene a ye wose mo. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.
24Amo nam wó ja abam a nwoŋi teene dedwonna dem maama ne, ye a la abam a ke daane se a ja abam a jwoori a ba a yage a tete teo kom ne. 25A laam maa wó lwo na-ŋona á yera ne a ma a kwɛ abam de á wo-zɔɔna de á jwona kaanem kikia yam. 26A ta wó pa á ta‑á jege bochare-doore de boboŋ-doora se á ma á zuli-ne. A maa wó pa se á wo daa yé ke dam, ye a daare a pa á yi taa bwona. 27A nam lage a kwei a Jworo mo a ke á bochara ne. Konto maa wó pa á fera taa wo a nia yam de a bera yam tɔgem wone. 28Abam daa maa wó ta‑á zoore tega kam a na kwei a pa á nabaara bam to, se á ta‑á ye amo nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye abam Wɛ. 29A nam wó vere abam a ja a nwoŋi á wo-zɔɔna kikia yam ne. A maa wó pa se á tega kam ke wodiiru dedɛ, se kana daa yé ja abam. 30Á teeni dem wó taa ke bia dedɛ de pa abam, ye á kare wodiiru de puli lanyerane, se ko pa dwi-gɛ tiina daa yé taa jege abam ba yaale we, kana jege abam ka goe. 31Á ta maa wó guli á totoŋ-vɛɛsa yam, de á kikia yalo na wo tɔge chwoŋa to gula. Á fera nam wó nwoŋi á tete, wɛleera de totoŋ-vɛɛsa yalo maama á ya na ke to ŋwaane. 32Isarele dwi tiina bam, nam lɔre-na we ko dae abam totoŋ-laaro ŋwaane mo a lage a ke tento maama a pa abam. Abam yuni nam maŋe se de tiiri tega ne mo de chaveera á kikia yam ŋwaane. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.
33Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ta na tage tei to mo tento: Dɛ delo ne amo na wó kwɛ abam a ti de á tusim kikia yam maama to a laam wó pa á jwoori á ta‑á zoore á teene dem wone. Á maa wó fɔge á lɔ jei selo ya na jigi di-dwonnu to. 34Abam daa wó ta‑á vare á tega kalo ya na tigi kafɛ to baŋa ne, se nɔɔna daa yé taa nii-ka ne ka ga ye kagoa mo. 35Ba maa wó taa tɛ we, “Tega kanto ya na tigi kafɛ to laam nye de Eden te-laao kom déem na ye tei to mo. Nii-na! Teene delo ya na chɔge ye de sam ji di-dwonnu to laam fɔge de lɔ de pe de dam, ye nɔɔna dedɛ zoore de wone!” 36Dwi-gɛ tiina balo ta na daare ye ba gilimi abam jei sem to laam wó lɔre we amo Baŋa Wɛ mo fɔge a lɔ teo kolo maama ya na chɔge to a zege, ye a jwoori a va tega kalo maama ya na tigi kafɛ to. Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. A nam wó seene a ke kolo a na tage se a ke to.’
37Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo daa wó pa Isarele dwi tiina bam chwoŋa se ba lwoori wolim amo tei ne. A maa wó leiri ba wɛ-lworo kom ye a pa se ba kɔgɔ kom puli ne vare-kɔgɔ na daga tei to. 38Ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wó taa daga lanyerane, ne vara dedɛ déem na yeini ba su Jerusalem teo kom kura dim maŋa ne se ba kwei-ba ba ma ke kaanem tei to mo. Konto mo nɔɔna wó yɔɔre ba su teene delo ya na zege di-dwonnu yerane to. Ba laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_text:
Dry Bones Live Again
1Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones. 2The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out. 3He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?”
I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
4He then told me to say:
Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you, 5“I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live. 6I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
7I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together! 8I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
9The Lord said:
Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
10 As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
11The Lord said:
Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future. 12So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel, 13and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord. 14My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
Judah and Israel Together Again
15The Lord said:
16Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.” 17Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick. 18And when your people ask you what this means, 19tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
20Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone 21and then say:
I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live. 22I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations. 23They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
24-25 Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did. 26I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time, 27 and I will live among my people and be their God. 28Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_text:
Kwi-kore taane
1 Baŋa Wɛ dam dem déem tu amo baŋa, pa se o tɔge o Jworo baŋa o kwei-ne o vo o zege bwolo kodwoŋi tetare ne. Kwi dedɛ jage se yɔɔre se faare bwolo kom jei maama. 2Baŋa Wɛ ma ja-ne pa dé yɛ kwi sem wone dé kare dé via. Amo ma nii a na kwi zanzam na tigi bwolo kom tega jei maama ne. Se nam tiini se ko mo. 3O ma bwei-ne o we, “Nabiinu, nmo na nɛ kwi sento to, n boŋe we se wó jwoori se na ŋwea na?” Amo de ma leiri‑o a we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yerane mo wó wane taane dento n ta.”
4O laam ma ta de amo o we, “Pworisi n ta taane de kwi sento we, ‘Abam kwi-kore, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kalo o na jege se o ta de abam to! 5Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei de kwi sento to mo tento: Amo lage a pa siu mo zo abam wone, se á ta‑á jege ŋwea. 6A nam wó kwei ŋwanno a ba abam maama, ye a daare a kwei ya-nɔna de ya-tane a ma a kwoli abam. A maa wó sii siu a yage á yera ne se ko pa á ta‑á ŋwe. Abam laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.’ ”
7Amo ma yɔɔre a pworisi taane ne Wɛ na pɛ-ne ni se a ke tei to. A ta na wora a pworisi konto to, mo a nigi sɔɔ kare-kare. Kwi sem mo bobo se se taa tui se tete ne, ye se twoŋi daane! 8A ta na zege a nii to, mo a nɛ we ŋwanno de ya-nɔna tu te meeli kwi sem, ye ya-tane de kwoli-se. De ko de, siu ta wo zo se wone.
9 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, pworisi n ta de vio kom we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Vio, zaŋe n nwoŋi logo baŋa sapɛ sena sem maama ne n ba n dole siu n yage nɔɔna banto ba ya na go to wone se ba laam na ŋwea.’ ” 10Amo de ma pworisi ne o na pɛ-ne ni se a ke tei to. Siu ma seene ko zo twa bam wone. Ba ma pɛ ba zaŋe ba zege ba nɛ baŋa ne ye ba ŋwe. Ba yɔɔre ba ye jar-keira kɔ-fɔrɔ mo.
11 Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de amo o we:
“Nabiinu, kwi sento bere Isarele dwi tiina bam maama na nye tei to mo. Ba kare ba tɛ we, ‘Debam kwi sem koge se peere mo, ye dé teena maama ti. Debam teo kom daa ba jege jwa.’ 12Konto ŋwaane, pworisi n ta taane de-ba we: ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo nɔɔna bam, amo tete mo lage a puri á yibeela yam, se a pa á bi. A laam maa wó ja abam a jwoori a ba a yage Isarele tega kam ne. 13Amo nɔɔna bam, á wó ba á lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom, ne a ná seene a puri yibeela yam á ya na tigi ya wone to pa á nwoŋi pwooni. 14A maa wó kwei a Jworo a ke abam wone se ko pa á na ŋwea, ye a daare a pa á jwoori á jeini á tete tega kam baŋa ne. Abam laam maa wó da ko baŋa ne á lɔre we amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto, ye a seene a ke a na tage we a wó ke tei to. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.’ ”
Isarele teo de Judah teo taane
15 Baŋa Wɛ kwora daa ma yi amo we:
16“Nabiinu, beeri daa se n popone ka baŋa ne we, ‘Judah, de Isarele tiina balo na ye o yera nɔɔna to nyem.’ Ta beeri daa kadwoŋi se n popone kanto baŋa ne we, ‘Josɛf bu Efrayim nyem, de Isarele tiina balo na ye wonto de yera nɔɔna to nyem.’ 17Laam ja se nia yam n ba n twoŋi daane se ya taa ye daa dedoa nmo jeŋa ne.
18Nmo dwi tiina bam ná bwei se ba lɔre n keim dem kuri, 19se n ta de-ba we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo lage a kwei Josɛf daa kam na wo Efrayim jeŋa ne to mo, se a pa ka twoŋi de Judah daa kam, se banto maama ji daa dedoa. Ba laam maa wó taa ye dedoa amo jeŋa wone.’ 20Nam ta‑n zei dɛ selei sem konto n jeŋa ne se nɔɔna bam maama na. 21Nmo laam ma‑n wó ta de-ba we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo lage a le Isarele tiina bam mo a ja a nwoŋi teene delo maama wone ba ya na zoore to. A maa wó la-ba a ja a nwoŋi logo baŋa sapɛ maama ne se ba jwoori ba jeini ba tete teo kom wone. 22Ba ná jwoori ba tega kam ne konto, a lage a pa ba maama ji teo dedoa ye ba zoore Isarele peero jei sem ne. Pɛ dedoa mo wó taa nii ba maama baŋa ne. Ba daa bá fɔge ba pɔɔre ba tete se ba ji teene delei. 23Ba nam daa bá biini ba tete de ba jwo-yɔɔro tem, de ba wo-zɔɔna de zwabania kikia yam. Amo tete mo lage a jwoŋi-ba a yage de ba na ywori a chwoŋa kam ne ba tusi tei to. Ba maa wó taa ye amo nɔɔna se amo de taa ye ba Wɛ wom.
24Amo tontoŋeno David nam mo wó taa ye ba pɛ. Nɔɔno dedoa wó taa nii ba maama baŋa ne, ne nayero na kɔne o pei sem tei to mo. A nɔɔna bam maa wó taa toŋe ba tɔge a nia yam de a bera yam. 25Ba wó taa zoore tega kalo a déem na kwei a pa a tontoŋeno Jakob to wone, mɛ seeni á nabaara de déem na zoore da to. Ba de ba dwi delo na saŋe ba kwaga to laam maa wó taa zoore tega kam konto ne se ko taa vei wuu, ye amo tontoŋeno David de taa ye ba dedɛɛro taa wuu. 26Amo nam wó gwoni ni mo de a nɔɔna bam bochare-zuru ŋwaane. Ni-gwonim dem konto wó taa zega se ko taa vei wuu. Amo lage a jeini-ba ba tega kam ne mo se ba taa wora chɔpe, ye ba puli de kɔgɔ. A maa wó pa se a wara-jei sem taa wo ba tetare ne se ko taa vei wuu. 27Amo maa wó taa zoore ba tei ne se a taa ye ba Wɛ, ye ba de ye amo tete nɔɔna. 28Logo baŋa teene dem maa wó lɔre we amo Baŋa Wɛ mo kuri Isarele tiina bam se ba taa ye amo tete nyem, ne a wara-jei sem ná wo ba tetare ne se ko taa vei wuu.’ ”

english_text:
Gog Invades Israel
1The Lord said:
2 Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
3I, the Lord God, am your enemy, 4and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords. 5Your army includes soldiers from Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya, 6as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!
7So keep your troops prepared to fight, 8because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land. 9But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
10When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan 11to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks. 12You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property. 13The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
14I, the Lord God, know that when you see my people Israel living in peace, 15you will lead your powerful cavalry from your kingdom in the north. 16You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy.
Judgment on Gog
17The Lord said to Gog:
Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming. 18When you invade Israel, I will become furious, 19and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel. 20Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse. 21I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other. 22I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur. 23I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_text:
Goga taane
1 Baŋa Wɛ kwora daa ma yi amo we:
2“Nabiinu, pipiri n yibia n jeeri Magoga teo pɛ Goga na tei Meseka de Tubal to. Pworisi taane n chɔge‑o, 3se n ta we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo dwoni de nmo mo, nmo Goga na ye Meseka de Tubal yuu tu to. 4Amo lage a pa se n za n kikia yam mo. A maa wó kwei gwoli a ja‑m n peyaa seeni, ye a daare a vaŋe nmo de n jar-keira bam maama, de á sisein-nɔɔna de balo na diini-se to. Banto maama vɔge jara-keim zela mo ba zege diŋ-diŋ. Ba maa ye kɔ-fɔrɔ zanzam, ye ba zei se-zɔɔro de jara nantane. 5Peresia tiina, de Kusi tiina, de Puti tiina de wó tɔge ba taa wo ba wone, ye ba de jege ba jara nantane de ba yu-gwonnu. 6Gomera jar-keira bam maama de maa wora, ko woli de baŋa seeni teo Bɛte-Togarama jar-keira bam maama. Ba tu ba woli abam wone, se á jar-keira kɔgɔ kom tiini ko taa daga.
7Nmo Goga, de jar-keira kɔgɔ kolo maama na wo n tei ne to nam jege se á che á tete mo. Nmo wó ta‑n nii ba baŋa ne. 8Ko ná tu ko dáane fee, ba wó bwoŋi abam se á ti á yiga jara ŋwaane. Bena yam ná yi ya ti, á laam wó vo á kwaare jara de Isarele tiina bam, de ba ya na nwoŋi jara wone ye ba ba ba sii to de. Ba ma nwoŋi sa-teene dedɛ ne mo ba jwoori sɔŋɔ, ye ba laam zoore ba tete teo peero jei sem ne mɛ ya na tigi kafɛ to de bochare-zuru. 9Nmo de n jar-keira bam, de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na wo n tei ne to nam wó vo á jeeri-ba de jara mo, ne vo-dɛɔ na pɔpɔ ko zaŋe tei to. Abam wó li tega kam baŋa maama ne kunkwoŋo dwoŋi to.
10Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Maŋa kam konto ne, boboŋa wó taa kare n yuu ne ya via, se n da ko ŋwaane n jeeli lwarem se n ke. 11Nmo wó ta n tete ne we, “A lage a vo a ke chichuŋu de nɔɔna bam konto ye ba zoore chemm mo. Ba teene dem tiini de bwona lage-lage, ye kabiri wo chege-de. Bworru de nam tera se ba taa pe-de. 12A nam wó vo a chɔge jei selo ya na ye di-dwonnu ye nɔɔna laam fɔge ba kwɛ-te to. A maa wó vere nɔɔna bam wonnu tem. Ba déem ye peena mo sa-teene wone, ye ba jwoori ba tete teo ba zoora tega kalo na wo logo baŋa tetare ne to wone. Ba maa jege vara de jejegero dedɛ.”
13Nmo ná nwoŋi se n kwaare jara, Seba tiina, de Dedan tiina, de pipim-piina balo na nwoŋi Tarasisi de ko nawuura yam seeni to wó bwei ba we, “Nmo tu se n vere debam mo na? N lage n jar-keira bam mo n ke daane se á ba á vere debam lu-nyenno, de sabu-seŋa, dedaane dé vara, de dé jejegero, se á zeŋe wonnu dedɛ á ja á viiri na?” ’
14Konto ŋwaane, nabiinu, pworisi n chɔge Goga we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, ye a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam zoore ba tega kam wone chemm mo, nmo bá maane ko ni ne na? 15Nmo wó zaŋe n nwoŋi n baŋa seeni teo kom ne n tɔge de n kɔ-fɔrɔ kom na ye teene dedɛ nɔɔna to n vo n kwaare jara de Isarele tiina bam. Abam jar-keira kɔ-fɔrɔ zanzam wó taa diini sisein-nɔɔna mo ba via. 16Á wó vo á zaŋe amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne mo ne kunkwoŋo na li tega kam baŋa maama tei to. Goga, da yam ná yi ya ti, amo lage a pa se n vo n kwaare jara de a tete teo kom, se dwi-gɛ tiina bam lɔre amo na ye wolo to, ne a ná tɔge nmo baŋa ne a bere jaja we a ye wose mo ye ba na.
17Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: Ko dae nmo taane mo a déem ŋɔɔne ko tɔge Isarele sampwori sem na ye a tontoŋena to baŋa ne na? Ba déem kwei bena dedɛ mo ba pworisi we, amo lage a pa nmo ke chichuŋu de-ba. 18Ko nam na wó taa ye tei maŋa kam konto ne to mo tento: Goga ná jeeri Isarele teo kom de jara, amo ban-lom dem wó wiiri ba baŋa ne. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. 19A lage a da a ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane a ta jaja we, dɛ dem konto ne tega kam wó tiini ka ziziŋi mo Isarele laŋa kam ne. 20Ko maa wó pa se naneo wo ywona, de zuna balo na kare ba jaane wɛɛne to, de kago-vara, de tega-veila, de logo baŋa nabiina maama wó fom amo yiga ne. Peero tem de te gugworru maama wó sirimi, ye kabiri maama de to buri-buri. 21A maa wó pa se jara ba ya jeeri Goga amo tete peero tem maama yuu ne. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. Nɔɔno maama wó kwei o se-zɔɔ o beeri o dwoŋi se o go. 22Amo nam wó tɔge jawe-chɛɛro, de nɔn-gora baŋa ne mo a yɔɔre a waare‑o. A maa wó pa do-fɔrɔ ba ka mage‑o, se a ta dole do-kandwa de chilibugu a yage o yera ne, de o jar-keira bam yera ne, de dwi-gɛ tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom na wo o tei ne to de yera ne. 23Konto baŋa ne mo amo wó pa se logo baŋa teene dedɛ lɔre amo na ye kamunu ye a ta ye wose tei to. A maa wó veere a tete ba yiga ne. Ba laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.’ ”

english_text:
Gog Is Defeated
The Lord said:
1Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him:
You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy! 2I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel. 3I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand, 4 and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh 5of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
6I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
7My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel. 8The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.
9When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years. 10They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Burial of Gog
The Lord said:
11After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.” 12The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land. 13Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen. 14After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean. 15Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army” 16near the town of “Gog's Army.” After that, the land will be pure again.
17 Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to hold a feast on Israel's mountains and offer sacrifices there. So invite all the birds and wild animals to come from every direction and eat the meat of sacrifices and drink the blood. The birds and animals 18will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls. 19I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk. 20They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
Israel Will Be Restored
The Lord said:
21When I punish the nations of the earth, they will see the brightness of my glory. 22The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God. 23Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them. 24Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.
25Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy. 26They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me. 27Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.
28My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land. 29Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
1“Nabiinu, pworisi taane n chɔge Goga se n ta we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Goga, amo dwoni de nmo, nmo wolo na ye Meseka, de Tubal yuu tu to. 2A lage a pa se n za n kikia yam mo. A maa wó kale‑m, se a pa n nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kom mɛ n ya na wora to se n ba n kwaare jara Isarele peero tem baŋa ne. 3A laam maa wó fere taŋa kalo n na zei n jagwia ne to a de tega ne, ye a daare a pa se n chena yam n na zei n jazem ne to de lwei ya to tega ne. 4Isarele peero tem yuu ne mo n lage n te, nmo de n jar-keira bam maama, de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na wo n tei ne to. Abam yera yam laam maa wó ji duura, de zuna dwi maama, de kago-vara ni-wodiu. 5Nmo yera yam wó yɔɔre ya taa tigi pwola ne mo pare-pare. Amo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. 6Amo lage a tɔrege mini mo a de Magoga de balo na zoore chemm naneo kom ni ne to wone. Ba laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.
7Amo lage a pa se a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam taa yei amo yere dem ni ne mo. A daa bá pa-ba chwoŋa se ba yaale-de, de na yɔɔre de ye wose to ŋwaane. Logo baŋa teene dem maama de maa wó lɔre we amo Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Wo-pwoŋo Tu ye a nii Isarele teo kom baŋa ne. 8Nii-na! Maŋa lage ka yi se wonnu tento seene te ke! Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. Ko ye maŋa kalo amo na maŋe a ta ka taane to mo.
9Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, Isarele tiina bam wó nwoŋi ba sam dem ne ba vo ba pɛ jara zela yalo jar-keira bam na tega ba daare to, se ba kwei-ya ba ma dwei mini. Ba maa wó kwei ba jara nantane sem, de ba tɛ sem, de ba chena yam, de ba jara-keim gwola yam, de ba chichwoa yam, se ba taa jege-te ba dwei mini bena yarepɛ. 10Ba daa bá vo gaao se ba puuri da-dwa, naa ba zo goa wone se ba gwoni dɛ, ba na wó taa jege jara zela yam ba ma ba dwei mini to ŋwaane. Konto to, Isarele tiina bam wó yiri ba jene balo déem na vere-ba to baŋa ne, de ba na vere banto de wonnu to. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.
11Maŋa kam konto ne, amo wó kwei tega Isarele laŋa kam ne a pa Goga, se ba suli o de o jar-keira bam da. Ka maa wó taa ye chwo-veila bwolo kom ne, nɔɔna na tɔge mɛ ba vei naneo kom wɛ-puli seeni to mo. Ba yibeela yam nam wó che chwoŋa kam mo se nɔɔna daa yé wane ba tɔge da ba kɛ, ba na wó suli Goga de o kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama da to ŋwaane. Konto ŋwaane ba wó taa bwoi jei sem we, “Goga nɔn-kɔgɔ bwolo” mo.
12Isarele tiina bam wó kwei chane serepɛ mo ba suli twa bam ba ti, se ba wane ba kwɛ tega kam. 13Teo kom nɔn-bia bam maama nam mo wó suli twa bam. Ko maa wó pa ba jwoŋi yere dɛ delo ne amo na wó bere a nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom jaja to. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. 14Ba maa wó kuri nɔɔna se ba taa kare tega kam ni maama ba beera, se ba nii ba na twa balo ta na tigi pwola ne to. Ba maa ná nɛ-ba, nɔɔna badaara wó suli-ba mo se ko kwɛ tega kam. Ba wó taa ke konto mo chane serepɛ. 15Ba ná kare tega kam ne ba via, ye ba dedoa ná nɛ nabiinu kua, kotu wó ke maana mo o tiŋi ka yera ne. Bayɛ maa wó ba ba kwei kua kam ba vo ba suli Goga nɔn-kɔgɔ bwolo kom ne. 16Ba wó tɔge chwoŋa kam konto mo ba kwɛ tega kam. Teo kodwoŋi nam wó taa wo jei sem konto ne, ko yere na ye Hamona.’
17Ko nam ná ye nmo, nabiinu, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei de nmo to mo tento: Bwoŋi zuna dwi maama, de kago-vara bam se n ta we, ‘Nwoŋi-na jei maama á ba á jeeri daane Isarele peero tem yuu ne, se á di kaanem kuri delo a na ke se a pa abam to. Ko ye kuri-fɔrɔ mo a ke dáane, se a pa abam di nɔna, ye á daare á nyɔ jana á su. 18Á wó di babɛ ya-nɔna ye á daare á nyɔ tega baŋa dedɛɛra jana. Ba wó taa nye de pi-bale, de pipeili, de bo-bale, de na-bale mo ba pɛ abam se á di, ye ba maama nugi bigila-bigila ne Basan vara bam na ye tei to mo. 19Abam ná tu á di kuri delo amo na wó ke a pa abam to, á wó di nabiina yera lara se á yera ba ya sɔɔre, ye ba jana bam á na wó nyɔ to de maa wó pa á bugi. 20Wodiu kolo amo na wó pa abam se á di to, abam wó kuri sisein-nɔɔna de balo ya na diini-se to nɔna mo á di á boboŋa.’ Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.
21Amo nam wó pa se a nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom bere jaja logo baŋa dwi maama tetare ne. Ba maama wó na a na tɔge a dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane a yɔɔre a waare-ba tei to. 22Ko maa na wó zege maŋa kam konto ne se ko taa vei to, Isarele dwi tiina bam wó lɔre we amo mo ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. 23Dwi-gɛ tiina bam de maa wó lɔre we Isarele tiina bam na ke wɛleera ye ba nwoŋi amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane mo amo déem dole-ba a yage sa-teo ne yiga yiga. A laam ma le a yiga ba wone, ye a ke-ba ba dona jeŋa ne, pa se ba maama te jara wone. 24A déem waare-ba se ko maŋe de ba totoŋ-zɔɔna de ba zwabania kikia yam na ye tei to mo. Amo yiga daa tera ba wone.
25Konto ŋwaane, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo wó pa se Jakob dwi dem jwoori ba taa jege yu-ywoŋo, ye a duri Isarele tiina bam maama ŋwaŋa. A maa wó seene a yia se a zeiŋi a yere dem na ye wose to wɛɛne. 26Ba ná tu ba jeini ba tete tega kam wone ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa ba fugi-ba, ba laam wó swei chaveera yalo maama ba ya na nɛ to, de zwabania kikia yalo ba na ke ba chɔge amo yiga to ni ne. 27Amo wó le-ba a ja a nwoŋi teene delo ba ya na zoore de wone to, se a jwoŋi-ba ba dona jeŋa ne. A maa wó tɔge ba baŋa ne a bere jaja we a ye wose, se dwi-gɛ tiina dedɛ taa zege ba nia. 28Amo nɔɔna bam laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Kokuri, amo ya mo dole-ba a yage teene dedwonna wone, ye a nam daa wó ja-ba a jwoori a jeini ba tete teo kom wone. A daa bá yage ba dedoa tete de se kotu daare jei sem konto ne. 29Amo daa bá le a yiga ba wone. A nam lage a lwo a Jworo mo a yage Isarele dwi tiina bam baŋa ne. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.”

english_text:
Ezekiel Sees the Future Temple in Jerusalem
1-2 Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and 14 years after the Babylonians had captured Jerusalem, the Lord's power took control of me on the tenth day of the first month. The Lord showed me some visions in which I was carried to the top of a high mountain in Jerusalem. I looked to the south and saw what looked like a city full of buildings. 3 In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other. 4The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.”
The East Gate
5 The first thing I saw was an outer wall that completely surrounded the temple area. The man took his measuring stick, which was three meters long, and measured the wall; it was three meters high and three meters thick. 6-7Then he went to the east gate, where he walked up steps that led to a long passageway. On each side of this passageway were three guardrooms, which were three meters square, and they were separated by walls two and a half meters thick. The man measured the distance between the opening of the gate and the first guardroom, and it was three meters, the thickness of the outer wall.
At the far end of this passageway, I saw an entrance room that faced the courtyard of the temple itself. There was also a distance of three meters between the last guardroom and the entrance room 8-9at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter. 10The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
11Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide. 12In front of the guardrooms, which were three meters square, was a railing about 50 centimeters high and 50 centimeters thick. 13The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters. 14He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide. 15Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was 25 meters. 16The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees.
The Outer Courtyard
17The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw 30 rooms built around the outside of the courtyard. These side rooms were built against the outer wall, and in front of them was a sidewalk that circled the courtyard. 18This was known as the lower sidewalk, and it was 25 meters wide.
19I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was 50 meters.
The North Gate
20Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard. 21This gate also had three guardrooms on each side of a passageway. The measurements of these rooms, the walls between them, and the entrance room at the far end of the passageway were exactly the same as those of the east gate. The north gate was also 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide, 22and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it. 23Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was 50 meters.
The South Gate
24The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates. 25There were windows in the guardrooms of this gate and in the entrance room, just like the others, and this gate was also 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide. 26Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway. 27And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also 50 meters.
The Gates Leading to the Inner Courtyard
28We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall. 29-30In fact, everything along the passageway was also the same size, including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, the entrance room at the far end, and the windows. This gate, like the others, was 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide. 31The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
32Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others. 33The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide. 34The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
35Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others, 36including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, and the entrance room. There were also windows in this gate. It was 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide, 37and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
38-39Inside the entrance room of the north gate, I saw four tables, two on each side of the room, where the animals to be sacrificed were killed. Just outside this room was a small building used for washing the animals before they were offered as sacrifices to please the Lord or sacrifices for sin or sacrifices to make things right. 40Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room. 41So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed, 42-43and where the meat was placed until it was sacrificed on the altar.
Next to the tables in the entrance room were four stone tables 50 centimeters high and 75 centimeters square; the equipment used for killing the animals was kept on top of these tables. All around the walls of this room was a 75-millimeter shelf.
The Rooms Belonging to the Priests
44The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south. 45He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple, 46and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.”
The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
47Now the man measured the inner courtyard; it was 50 meters square. I also saw an altar in front of the temple.
48We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters. 49The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_text:
Jerusalem nadoŋo kom taane
1 Baŋa Wɛ dam dem déem tu amo baŋa. Ko ye bene delo ba na kale debam ba vo sa-teo yiga yiga ye bena finlei-yanu kɛ to boboa chana kam da fuga dɛ dem ne mo konto. Ko nam ye Jerusalem teo totoore dem kwaga ne bena fuga-yana bene dem ne mo. Baŋa Wɛ dam dem na tu amo baŋa dɛ dem konto ne to mo o jaane-ne o vo o bere-ne Jerusalem na ye tei to. 2Wɛ ma veere wonnu o bere-ne ye o pa a vo Isarele tega kam seeni se a zege peo na tiini ko dɔra to yuu ne. Amo na nii tega-kuri seeni to, mo a nɛ sam dedɛ na lɔge de zega, ne te-fɔrɔ mo zege de sam to. 3O na jaane-ne pa a fɔɔre a yi da to, mo a nɛ nɔɔno na zega, ye o nyeena ne channa na ye tei to. Kotu yɔɔre o zege manchwo-peo kom ni ne mo, ye o zei ŋona de kasogo o jeŋa ne, ne ba na ma-te ba maŋe wonnu tei to. 4Nɔɔno wom laam ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, fɔge n puri n yia se n nii, n daare n pore n zwa se n cheigi kolo maama a na lage a bere‑m to. Kokuri, konto ŋwaane mo ba jaane‑m ba ba ywo-seeni. Tole kolo maama n na nɛ to n bere Isarele tiina bam.”
Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ wɛ-puli seeni ni dem
5Amo ma nii a na kabira na lɔge ka che Wɛ diga kam jei sem maama. Nɔɔno wom na zei kasogo kolo to dedɔrem déem ye naba-laara yatɔ mo. O ma kwei-ko o maŋe kabira kam na lira tei to. Ka maŋem déem nam ye kasogo dedoa. Ka dedɔrem baŋa maŋem de maa ye kasogo dedoa.
6O laam ma vo o yi Wɛ diga kam ni delo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to. O ma dɔɔle nateina yam o di, ye o daare o maŋe manchwo-ni dem seeni na dɔra tei to. De maŋem dem déem ye kasogo dedoa mo. 7Gugworru teredo déem mo zege te geene tetare chwoŋa kam ka sɛ selei sem ne. Te dedɔrem baŋa maŋem ye kasogo dedoa mo. Te kayɔlɔ baŋa maŋem de maa ye kasogo dedoa. Kabira kalo na chege ka pɔɔre gugworru tem maama daane to maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu. Napɔrɔ kolo na jeeri Wɛ diga kam to manchwo-ni maŋem de maa ye kasogo dedoa.
8Nɔɔno wom ta ma maŋe napɔrɔ kom tete. 9Ko wo kom maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni nana, ye ko taara yam maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem belei. Napɔrɔ kom ni dem déem jeeri Wɛ diga kam tete mo.
10Gugworru tetɔ tetɔ maa wo tetare chwoŋa kam sɛ selei sem maama ne. Te maama mae daane mo, ye taala yalo na wora to de maa mae daane. 11O ta ma maŋe chwoŋa kalo na tɔge ni dem seeni to. Ka na yala tei to maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuga. Ka dedɔrem baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuga-betɔ. 12Gugworo maama yiga ne, gengaŋ-tua mo zege da ye ka maŋe de jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa. Gugworru tem tete maama maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni beredo se sɛ sena sem maama baŋa ne. 13Nɔɔno wom daa ma zege gugworo dedoa kwaga kabira kam seeni, o tɔge tetare chwoŋa kam seeni o maŋe o zo gugworo kodwoŋi kwaga kabira kam. Ko maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finlei-benu. 14O laam ma jeeli napɔrɔ kom wɛ-baŋa maŋem dem. Ko maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuseredo. Napɔrɔ kom déem jeeri konkɔlɔ kolo na wo ko sɛ setɔ sem ne to mo. 15Pwola kalo ba na tɔge da ba kɛ, ko zege pwooni yiga ni dem ne se ko yi napɔrɔ kom ni dem to maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finnu. 16Gugworru tem de te taala yam déem jege takworru mo te kabiri sem yera maama ne. Napɔrɔ kom de maa jege takworru konto dwoŋi. Konkwara nyenyero mo gɔgere te tigi taala yam maama yera ne.
Da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom
17Nɔɔno wom ma ja-ne pa dé zo Wɛ diga kam da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom. Amo ma nii a na di selo na lɔge da to, de ko pwola kalo na fɔge ka kwɛ to. Di sem ke daane se ye fintɔ mo. Se déem lɔge se jeeri pwola kam mo ye se kaare konkɔlɔ kom maama. 18Pwola kam maa tigi ka tɔge konkɔlɔ kom nia yam maama, pa se ka dedɔrem maŋe de-ya. Kuri seeni pwola kam mo konto. 19O ma maŋe pwola kalo na tigi konkɔlɔ kom nia yalei yam tetare laŋa ne to. Ko na zege wɛ-puli seeni ni dem se ko taa vei baŋa seeni ni dem to, ko maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi mo.
Baŋa seeni ni dem
20Nɔɔno wom daa ma maŋe ni delo na jeeri baŋa seeni ye de tole de vei da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom to. 21Gugworru tetɔ tetɔ na wo tetare chwoŋa kam sɛ sem ne to, de te taala yam, ko woli de napɔrɔ kom maama maŋem ye bedwe mo de wɛ-puli seeni ni dem na ye tei to. Ni dem diga kam ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finnu mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. De taa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei-benu ko kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 22Ka takworru tem, de napɔrɔ kom, dedaane konkwara nyenyero telo na gɔgere te tigi ka kabiri sem yera ne to maama yɔɔre te ye bedwe mo de wɛ-puli seeni ni dem na ye tei to. Ka maa jege nateina yarepɛ na diini ya vei ka wone. Nɔɔna ná diini ba yi da, ka napɔrɔ kom wó taa wo ba yiga ne mo. 23Ni dedwoŋi de maa wora de na vei de zoore tetare konkɔlɔ kom wone, ye de jeeri baŋa seeni ni dem. Ni dedwoŋi de maa wo konkɔlɔ kom wɛ-puli seeni. Nɔɔno wom ma maŋe pwola kalo na tigi ni dedwe ne, se ko yi ni dedwoŋi dem ne to. Ko maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi.
Tega-kuri seeni ni dem
24Nɔɔno wom laam ma tɔge a yiga pa dé vo konkɔlɔ kom tega-kuri dem seeni. Amo ma nii a na ni delo na jeeri tega-kuri seeni to. O ma maŋe de taala yam, de de napɔrɔ kom. Te maama maŋem dem yɔɔre de ye bedwe de nia yadwonna yam na ye tei to mo. 25Ni dem diga kam de de napɔrɔ kom maa jege takworru ne nia yadwonna yam takworru tem na ye tei to. Diga kam ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finnu mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. Ka ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei-benu mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 26Ka maa jege nateina yarepɛ na diini ya vei ka wone. Nɔɔna ná diini ba yi da, ka napɔrɔ kom wó taa wo ba yiga ne mo. Ka taala yam maa jege konkwara nyenyero na gɔgere te tigi ya yera ne to, konkwara dedoa saŋa maama ne. 27Wɛ diga kam tetare konkɔlɔ kom de maa jege ni delo na jeeri tega-kuri seeni to. Nɔɔno wom ma maŋe pwola kalo na tigi tega-kuri seeni nia yalei yam tetare laŋa ne to. Ko maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi.
Nia yalo na vei ya zoore tetare konkɔlɔ kom wone to
28O daa ma tɔge tega-kuri ni dem seeni o ja-ne pa dé zo Wɛ diga tetare konkɔlɔ kom wone. O ma maŋe tega-kuri seeni ni dem, ye dento de nia yadwonna yam maŋem ye bedwe. 29De gugworru tem, de taala yam, de napɔrɔ kom maama maŋem dem ye bedwe de nia yadwonna yam mo. Ni dem diga kam, de napɔrɔ kom kabiri maama maa jege takworru se yera ne. Ka maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finnu dedɔrem baŋa ne. Ka ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei-benu mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 30Tetare konkɔlɔ kom saŋa maama jege ka napɔrɔ mo. Te maama ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finlei-benu mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. Te ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 31Napɔrɔ kom nam jeeri da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom mo. Konkwara nyenyero déem gɔgere mo te tigi kabiri sem yera ne. Nateina nana de maa tole ya diini ni dem konto ne.
32Nɔɔno wom daa ma ja-ne o vo o yi tetare konkɔlɔ kom wɛ-puli seeni saŋa kam. O ma maŋe ka ni dem. De de maŋem yɔɔre de ye ne yadwonna yam maŋem na ye tei to mo. 33De gugworru tem, de taala yam, de napɔrɔ kom maama maŋem ye bedwe de nia yadwonna yam mo. Ni dem diga kam, de napɔrɔ kom kabiri maama maa jege takworru se yera ne. Ka maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finnu dedɔrem baŋa ne. Ka ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei-benu mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 34Napɔrɔ kom jeeri da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom mo. Konkwara nyenyero déem maa gɔgere te tigi kabiri sem yera ne. Nateina nana de maa tole ya diini ni dem konto ne.
35O daa ma ja-ne pa dé yi baŋa seeni ni dem, ye o maŋe-de. Dento de maŋem ye bedwe de nia yadwonna yam na mae tei to, 36dedaane de gugworru tem, de taala yam, de napɔrɔ kom maama mo. Diga kam kabiri sem maama maa jege takworru se yera ne. Ka maŋem dem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finnu mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. Ka ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei-benu mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 37Napɔrɔ kom jeeri da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom mo. Konkwara nyenyero déem mo gɔgere te tigi ko kabiri sem yera ne. Nateina nana de maa tole ya diini ni dem konto ne.
Kaanem vara kwɛɛm diga
38Diga kadwoŋi de ka ni maa wo konkɔlɔ ni dem konto napɔrɔ kom teiŋa ne. Ka wone mo ba yeini ba zare vara balo ba na wó go ba ma ke zwɛɛm kaanem to. 39Tabollo tena mo zege napɔrɔ kom ne. Te telei mo zege diga kam saŋa dedoa seeni, ye telei de zege saŋa kadwoŋi kam ne. Te baŋa ne mo ba nam goe vara balo ba na wó ma ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem, de wɛleere saarem kaanem, de wɛleere jene kaanem to. 40Tabollo tena ta mo wo napɔrɔ kom pwooni yiga ne, mɛ nɔɔna na diini ba tɔge baŋa seeni ni dem to. Telei maa wo ni dem saŋa dedoa seeni, ye telei de wo saŋa kakam kam ne. 41Ko maa na ye tei to, tabollo nana mo wora. Tena mo wo napɔrɔ kom wone, ye tena de wo pwooni yiga kam ne. Te maa ye se ba go kaanem vara bam mo te baŋa ne. 42Tabollo tena maa wora ba na sare kandwa ye ba ma-ya ba ke-te to. Ba mae tento mo ba chae zwɛɛm kaanem vara bam. Tabollo tem konto dedɔrem baŋa maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa de chicheiro mo. Te kayɔlɔ baŋa maŋem de ta ye konto mo. Te wɛ-baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa. Fane selo ba na mae ba gwona vara balo ba na wó ma ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem de kaanem dwi maama to mo ba kwei ba tiŋi tabollo tem konto baŋa ne. 43Gwoli de maa meeli diga kam wo kabira yera maama ne. Se ye da-yiga noa maŋem mo. Tabollo tem nam wora se ba ná go vara bam, se ba kwei nɔna yam mo ba daŋe te baŋa ne.
Kaanem tiina bam di sem
44Wɛ diga tetare konkɔlɔ kom wone di selei maa wora, se na wo konkɔlɔ ni dem pwooni yiga ne to. Se dedoa yeiri ni delo na wo baŋa seeni to mo ye ka jeeri tega-kuri seeni. Diga kadwoŋi kam de maa yeiri ni delo na wo tega-kuri seeni to, ye ka jeeri baŋa seeni. 45Nɔɔno wom laam ma ta de amo o we, “Diga kalo na jeeri tega-kuri seeni to ye kaanem tiina balo na nii Wɛ diga kam baŋa ne to nyem mo. 46Ko daare kalo na jeeri baŋa seeni to maa ye kaanem tiina balo na nii kaanem bimbini dem baŋa ne to de nyem. Banto nam ye Zadoki diga kam tiina mo. Levi dwi dem maama wone nɔɔna banto yerane mo jege chwoŋa se ba fɔɔre ba twɛ Baŋa Wɛ tei se ba taa toŋa ba pa‑o.”
47Nɔɔno wom laam ma maŋe tetare konkɔlɔ kom. Ko yɔɔre ko mae da ko mae da mo, dedɔrem baŋa, de kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. Ko maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bi bi. Kaanem bimbini dem maa zege Wɛ diga kam yiga ne.
Wɛ diga kam
48O laam ma ja-ne o vo o yi Wɛ diga kam tete napɔrɔ kom. O ma maŋe ko taala yalei yam na wo ni dem sɛ selei sem ne to. Ya na lira tei to ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu mo. Napɔrɔ kom ni dem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem fuga-bena kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. Ka sɛ kabiri sem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem betɔ betɔ saŋa maama baŋa ne mo. 49Napɔrɔ kom maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. Ko ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem fuga-belei mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. Nateina mo dɔɔle ya diini ya yi diga kam ni. Ywoa yalei na wo taala yam teiŋa ne to déem maa chwi ya zege ni dem saŋa maama ne.

english_text:
1Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was 3 meters wide, 2five meters long, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was two and a half meters. The main room itself was 20 meters by 10 meters.
3-4Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide, 3 meters long, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was 3.5 meters. Then he measured the most holy place, and it was 10 meters square.
The Storage Rooms of the Temple
5The man measured the wall of the temple, and it was three meters thick. Storage rooms two meters wide were built against the outside of the wall. 6There were three levels of rooms, with 30 rooms on each level, and they rested on ledges that were attached to the temple walls, so that nothing was built into the walls. 7The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
8The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms. 9The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls 10and the nearest buildings ten meters away. 11One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms.
The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
12I noticed another building: It faced the west end of the temple and was 35 meters wide, 45 meters long, and had walls over 2.5 meters thick.
13The man measured the length of the temple, and it was 50 meters. He then measured from the back wall of the temple, across the open space behind the temple, to the back wall of the west building; it was 50 meters. 14The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also 50 meters.
15Finally, the man measured the length of the west building, including the side rooms on each end, and it was also 50 meters.
The Inside of the Temple
The inside walls of the temple's porch and main room 16were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood. 17The paneling stopped just above the doorway. These walls were decorated 18-20with carvings of winged creatures and had a carving of a palm tree between the creatures. Each winged creature had two faces: A human face looking at the palm tree on one side, and a lion's face looking at the palm tree on the other side. These designs were carved into the paneling all the way around the two rooms.
21The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle.
The Wooden Altar
In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like 22a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.”
The Doors in the Temple
23Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors, 24and each door had two sections that could fold open. 25The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors. 26The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_text:
1Nɔɔno wom laam ma ja-ne o zo di-yuu kom. O ma maŋe taala yalei yam na wo ka ni dem sɛ selei sem ne to. Ya dedoa na lira tei to ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem beredo mo. 2Ka ni dem maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni kuni fuga mo. Ka sɛ kabiri sem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem benu benu saŋa maama baŋa ne. O ta ma maŋe diga kam tete. Ka dedɔrem baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finna. Ka kayɔlɔ baŋa maŋem de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finlei. 3O laam ma vo o zo di-yun-gala kam. O ma maŋe taala yalei yam na wo ka ni dem sɛ selei sem ne to. Ya dedoa dedoa maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem belei. Ni dem tete ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni beredo mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. Ka sɛ kabiri sem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem berepɛ berepɛ. 4O laam ma maŋe di-yun-gala kam tete, de ka na lɛɛne ka yi di-yuu kom to. Ko maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei dedɔrem baŋa ne. Ko ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. O ma ta de amo o we, “Diga kanto mo tiini ka ye wose Wɛ ŋwaane.”
5Nɔɔno wom laam ma maŋe Wɛ diga kabira kam ni na ye tei to. Ka na lira tei to ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem beredo mo. Di-balwa balo na lɔge ba yeiri Wɛ diga kabira kam pwooni yiga seeni to ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bena bena mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 6Di-balwa bam konto lɔge ba daŋe da-baŋa mo kuni betɔ. Se maa ye di fintɔ mo gena maama ne. Ba nam na lɔge di-kamunu kom kabira kam tei to, ba pɔɔre mɛ di-balwa bei sem na wó peini da to mo, se ba daa yé lu bɔɔna kabira kam yera ne ba lɔ. 7Di selo na lɔge se daŋe baŋa gene sem ne to yala se dwoi selo na wo kuri dem ne to, se ko tɔge Wɛ diga kabira kam na ye tei ko zege tega kam seeni ko taa diini baŋa seeni to. Nateina mo zege kuri gene sem ne ya dɔɔle ya tɔge tetare gene sem seeni, ya kɛ ya di baŋa seeni gene di sem.
8Amo ma nii a na we ba lɔge bimbini mo na kaare Wɛ diga kam maama. Di-balwa bam déem chwi bimbini dem baŋa ne mo, ye de maŋem dem ye kasogo dedoa. Jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni beredo mo konto. 9Di-balwa bam kabiri sem liliru maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni kuni benu mo. Ko daare, pwola kalo na tigi Wɛ diga kam di-balwa bam, 10dedaane konkɔlɔ kom di sedwonna sem laŋa ne to ya ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei mo ka kayɔlɔ baŋa ne, se ko ja ko kaare Wɛ diga kam ni maama. 11Nia mo wora ya na tɔge ya zoore di-balwa bam wone, ne nɔɔno ná zege pwola kam ne o beene da. Ni dedoa zege Wɛ diga kam baŋa seeni mo, ye dedwoŋi dem zege ka tega-kuri seeni. Pwola kalo na daare to kayɔlɔ baŋa maŋem dem laam maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem benu ko kaare Wɛ diga kam maama.
12Diga kadwoŋi déem wo Wɛ diga kam wɛ-zoore seeni ka na jeeri konkɔlɔ kom. Ka maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuserepɛ kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. Ka kabira kam liliru maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem benu se ko kaare ko pu. Ka dedɔrem baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni kuni funogo.
13Nɔɔno wom laam ma maŋe Wɛ diga kam. Ka ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bi mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ kom pwola kayɔlɔ maŋem de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bi, se ko vo ko yi diga kam de ka kabira kam maama. 14Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ pwola kalo na wo ka wɛ-puli seeni to, de ka yiga kam seeni de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bi kayɔlɔ baŋa ne.
15Nɔɔno wom daa ma maŋe diga kalo na wo Wɛ diga kam wɛ-zoore seeni ye ka jeeri konkɔlɔ kom to, ko woli de di selo na yeiri ka sɛ selei sem to. Ko maama maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi.
Ko ta ná ye Wɛ diga napɔrɔ kom, de ka di-yuu kom, dedaane di-yun-gala kam, 16ba kwei da-pelwaro mo ba kwoli di setɔ sem maama wo kabira kam, ko zege ka tega kam seeni se ko yi takworru tem na wo mɛ to. Di sem nia yam, de se takworru tem, dedaane se gugworru tem maama mo ba fɔge ba kwɛ konto dwoŋi ba zege. 17Ko ta ná ye ni delo na zoore di-yuu kom to, ba ma kwɛ kabira kalo na wo de baŋa kam seeni to. Ba ma gɔgere Wɛ diga kam wo kabiri sem maama. 18Ko nam ye cherubi de konkwara nyenyero mo ba gɔgere ba ke da, pa se cherubi maama gɔgere ko saŋe konkwara. Ba nam ke cherubi maama pa ka jege yibi selei mo. 19Cherubi maama yibia kalo na ye nabiinu yibia to wó jeeri konkwara mo daa dedoa ne, ye ka yibia kalo na ye nywoŋo yibia to jeeri konkwara kadwoŋi na saŋe to. Te ke konto dwoŋi mo te kaare diga kam wo maama. 20Ko na zege tega ne se ko ja ko di jeiga kalo na wo ni dem baŋa seeni to, ba yɔɔre ba gɔgere cherubi, de konkwara nyenyero mo Wɛ di-yuu kom kabiri sem yera ne.
21Ni delo na zoore di-yuu kom to sɛ sena sem mae daane mo. Delo dem maa na zoore di-yun-gala kam wo to de ye konto dwoŋi. 22Kaanem bimbini delo ba na mɛ daa ba ke to maa zege da. De maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni betɔ wɛ-baŋa ne. De dedɔrem dem baŋa seeni de de kayɔlɔ baŋa seeni de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem belei belei. Bimbini dem nyea yam, de de kuri dem seeni, dedaane de sɛ sem maama ye dɛ mo ba mɛ ba ke. Nɔɔno wom ma ta de amo o we, “Tabolo konto mo ye kolo na zege Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to.”
23Ni delo na zoore di-yuu kom to, de delo na zoore di-yun-gala kam to maama jege bworru telei telei mo. 24Bworo maama jege vɔna yalei mo pa ko wae ko piri ko tete ko ke daane. 25Ba ta ma gɔgere cherubi de konkwara nyenyero di-yuu kom ni-bworru tem yera ne, ne ba na ke tei kabiri sem yera ne to. Ba mɛ dɛ mo ba tei pwoŋa Wɛ diga napɔrɔ kom pwooni yiga ne. 26Takworru maa wo napɔrɔ kom ni sɛ selei sem ne, ye ba gɔgere konkwara nyenyero ba ke da. Wɛ diga di-balwa bam de se pwei sem de déem kwɛ konto dwoŋi mo.

english_text:
The Sacred Rooms for the Priests
1-2After the man and I left the temple and walked back to the outer courtyard, he showed me a set of rooms on the north side of the west building. This set of rooms was 50 meters long and 25 meters wide. 3On one side of them was the 10 meters of open space that ran alongside the temple, and on the other side was the sidewalk that circled the outer courtyard. The rooms were arranged in three levels 4with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and 50 meters long. 5The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level. 6The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard. 7-8To the north was a privacy wall 25 meters long, 9-10and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms.
There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building. 11These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them. 12The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.
13The man then said to me:
These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right. 14When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people.
The Size of the Temple Area
15After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area. 16He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was 250 meters long. 17-19Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each 250 meters long, 20and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.
translation_text:
Kaanem tiina bam di
1Nɔɔno wom daa ma ja-ne o vo baŋa seeni se dé zo da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom. O ma bere-ne diga kalo na lɔge ka yeiri Wɛ diga tetare konkɔlɔ kabira kam na jeeri baŋa seeni to. 2Diga kam ni déem wo baŋa seeni mo. Ka maŋem dem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni kuni bi dedɔrem baŋa ne. Ka ta ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finnu mo kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 3Pwola maa wo ka yiga ne, ne nɔɔno ná wo tetare konkɔlɔ kom seeni. Pwola kam na yala tei to ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finlei mo. Diga kam saŋa kadwoŋi kam ma jeeri pwola kalo na tigi da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom ne to. Ka maa jege di na lɔge gene setɔ ye se daŋe da-baŋa ne to. 4Di sem yiga ne tetare chwoŋa mo tigi da. Ka maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem fuga ka kayɔlɔ baŋa ne, de jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi ka dedɔrem baŋa ne. Di sem nia yam yɔɔre ya jeeri baŋa seeni mo. 5Di sem na lɔge tei to, selo na wo baŋa seeni to muri selo na wo tetare dem seeni to mo. Selo de maa na wo tetare ne to de daa maa muri selo na wo kuri dem seeni to. 6Di sem na lɔge gene setɔ da-baŋa ne konto to, ba wo chwi ywoa yalo na wó teili-se to, ne konkwallo tem di sedwonna na jege tei to. Ko ma pa di selo na lɔge se zege baŋa ne to muri selo na wo kuri dem ne to. 7Kabira kadwoŋi maa zege ka maŋe de di sem, de da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom. Ka ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem finnu mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. 8Di selo gena na yeiri da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom to maŋem ye jatwogo de noa ni finnu mo dedɔrem baŋa ne. Gena kalo na lɔge Wɛ diga kam teiŋa ne to dedɔrem maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bi. 9Di selo na wo kuri seeni to jege ni na wo se wɛ-puli seeni, ne nɔɔno ná nwoŋi da-yiga konkɔlɔ jei sem ne ye kotu maa zoore se wone. 10Ni dem konto maa wo konkɔlɔ kabira kam na bobo mɛ to ne.
Di sedwonna maa wo Wɛ diga da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom tega-kuri seeni, ye se yɔɔre se jeeri diga kadwoŋi kam. 11Tetare chwoŋa mo tigi se yiga ne. Di sem konto nam yɔɔre se nye de selo na wo baŋa seeni to mo. Se maŋem dem maama yɔɔre de ye bedwe de baŋa seeni di sem na ye tei to mo. Se nia yam de maa ye bedwe de nia yalo na wo baŋa seeni di sem ne to. 12Tega-kuri di sem maa jege ni delo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni se ko maŋe de kabira kam na bobo mɛ seeni ka lɔ ka zege to.
13Nɔɔno wom laam ma ta de amo o we, “Di sento na wo Wɛ diga tetare konkɔlɔ kom baŋa seeni, de selo na wo ko tega-kuri seeni to ye wose mo. Dáane mo Baŋa Wɛ kaanem tiina balo na bwola ded‑o to wó yeini ba di kaanem wodiu kolo na tiini ko ye wose to. Ba maa wó tiŋi wonnu telo na ye wose to di sem konto wone, ne ko ná ye wodiu kaanem ŋwaane, de wɛleera saarem kaanem, de wɛleera jene kaanem ŋwaane. Kokuri to, di sem ye wose mo Wɛ ŋwaane. 14Kaanem tiina bam ná yeini ba zo Wɛ diga kam tete, ba daa bá wane ba nwoŋi ka jei sem ne, se ba zo da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom, ye ba wo lɔɔre ba kaanem gwaaro tem ba tiŋi di sem konto wone. Ba maa wó yeini ba kwei gwaaro tedwonna ba zo, se ba laam wane ba yi nɔɔna bam na wo mɛ seeni to.”
15O na maŋe woŋo kolo dwi maama na wo Wɛ diga jei sem ne o ti to, mo o jaane-ne pa dé tɔge wɛ-puli seeni ni dem dé nwoŋi pwooni. O laam ma maŋe pwola kalo na kaare dáane maama to. 16O kwei kasogo kolo o ya na jege o maŋe wonnu tem maama to mo o maa maŋe wɛ-puli seeni saŋa kam. Ka ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bia yanu mo. 17O ta ma kwei kasogo kom o maŋe baŋa seeni saŋa kam. Ka de ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bia yanu mo. 18O daa ma maŋe tega-kuri seeni saŋa kam. Ka de ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bia yanu mo. 19O ma pipiri o vo o maŋe wɛ-zoore seeni saŋa kam. Ka de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem bia yanu. 20O déem tɔge chwoŋa kam konto mo o maŋe Wɛ diga kam jei sem de kabira kalo na kaare-ka to. Ka sɛ sem mae da se mae da mo, jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bia yanu yanu. Kabira kam déem lɔge ka che Wɛ diga kam, se ko pɔɔre wonnu telo na ye wose to, de telo na wora dɛ dɛ totoŋa ŋwaane to daane mo.

english_text:
The Lord's Glory Returns to the Temple
1The man took me back to the east gate of the temple, 2 where I saw the brightness of the glory of Israel's God coming from the east. The sound I heard was as loud as ocean waves, and everything around was shining with the dazzling brightness of his glory. 3This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River.
I immediately bowed with my face to the ground, 4and the Lord's glory came through the east gate and into the temple. 5The Lord's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord's glory had filled the temple.
6The man was standing beside me, and I heard the Lord say from inside the temple:
7Ezekiel, son of man, this temple is my throne on earth. I will live here among the people of Israel forever. They and their kings will never again disgrace me by worshiping idols at local shrines or by setting up memorials to their dead kings. 8Israel's kings built their palaces so close to my holy temple that only a wall separated them from me. Then these kings disgraced me with their evil ways, and in my fierce anger I destroyed them. 9But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.
10The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it, 11then if they are truly sorry, describe for them the design and shape of the temple, the gates, the measurements, and how the buildings are arranged. Explain the regulations about worshiping there, then write down these things, so they can study and obey them.
12The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple.
The Altar
13 According to the official standards, the altar in the temple had the following measurements: Around the bottom of the altar was a gutter 50 centimeters wide and 50 centimeters deep, with a 25-centimeter ledge on the outer rim. 14-17The altar rested on a base and had three sections, each one of them square. The bottom section was 8 meters on each side and one meter high. The middle section was 7 meters on each side and 2 meters high, and it had a 25-centimeter rim around its outer edge. The top section, which was 6 meters on each side and 2 meters high, was the place where sacrifices were burned, and the four corners of the top section looked like the horns of a bull. The steps leading up to the altar were on the east side.
The Dedication of the Altar
18 The Lord God said:
Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do: 19The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin. 20Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me. 21Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.
22The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull. 23Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them, 24and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.
25Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them. 26The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use. 27From then on, the priests will use this altar to offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices to ask my blessing. Then I will be pleased with the people of Israel. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_text:
Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taane
1Nɔɔno wom ma ja-ne pa dé vo Wɛ diga kam ni delo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to. 2A ma nii a na we Isarele tiina Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom zege wɛ-puli seeni mo ko maa beena. Wɛ na dɔne o kwori tei to, ko nye de naneo na-fwaaro na chuuri ye te wuuri tei to mo. Tega baŋa jei maama déem ma li de o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom pwooni. 3Wɛ na le wonnu telo o bere-ne to yɔɔre te nye de veera yalo a ya na nɛ ye o ba se o chɔge Jerusalem teo kom to mo. Te maa nye de yalo a ya na nɛ Chebara buga kam ni ne to. Amo ma to a vwi a yibia tega ne. 4Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ma tɔge ni delo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to ne ko zo Wɛ diga kam wone. 5Vio laam ma fuli ko gɔ-ne ko zege wɛɛne. Ko ma ja-ne ko ja zo Wɛ diga kam tetare konkɔlɔ kom ne, ye amo de na we Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom mo yɔɔre ko su Wɛ diga kam ni maama.
6Nɔɔno wom na zege a saŋa ne konto to, mo a nigi nɔɔno wodwoŋi na zege Wɛ diga kam wone o ŋɔɔne de amo. 7Kotu ma ta o we, “Nabiinu, jeiga kanto mo ye amo paare yituŋu na wó chwi mɛ to. Ka wó taa ye amo jeiŋa jei. Amo wó maŋe ywo-seeni mo se a de Isarele tiina bam taa zoore daane se ko taa vei wuu. Isarele dwi tiina bam, de ba pwa bam maama daa bá toŋe ba chɔge amo yere dem na ye wose to, de ba na kare ba zuli jwo-yɔɔro de ba pwa balo na tege to yibeela yam. 8Ba pwa bam déem lɔge ba sɔ-fwaaro mo pa te yeiri amo tete diga kam kabira ne. Ko nye de kabira yerane mo chege amo de banto daane. Ba ma tɔge ba totoŋ-vɛɛsa yam ŋwaane ba chɔge amo yere dem na ye wose to. Konto ma pa se a tɔge a ban-lom dem baŋa ne a yɔɔre a chɔge-ba. 9Ba nam jege se ba yage jwo-yɔɔro kaanem, se ba daare ba yage ba pwa yibeela yam zula. Ba ná ke konto, amo laam wó taa zoore ba tetare ne taa wuu.
10Nabiinu, fɔge n maŋe Wɛ diga kam yera seina na ye tei to n bere Isarele tiina bam. Ko maa wó pa se chaveera ja-ba ba tusim kikia ŋwaane. Pa se ba na ka zega kam maŋem na ye tei to. 11Chaveera maa ná jaane-ba ba kikia yam maama ŋwaane, se n pa ba lɔre Wɛ diga kam na zega tei, de ka nia yam, de ka maŋem dem maama na ye tei to. Ta pa ba lɔre ka di sem na tigisi se lɔ tei to, se n daare n ta de-ba ka chullu tem na bere kolo to. Nam popone wonnu tem konto maama n tiŋi se ba maane Wɛ diga kam nyenyego na ye tei to, ye ba daare ba taa tɔge ka chullu tem.
12Wɛ ni delo na wora o diga kam ŋwaane to mo tento: Peo yuu jei selo ka na lɔge to de pwola kalo maama na kaare da to tiini ka ye wose mo Wɛ ŋwaane. Chega to, Wɛ ni delo na wora o diga kam ŋwaane to mo konto.”
Kaanem bimbini dem
13Kaanem bimbini dem maŋem na ye tei to mo tento, ne ko ná tɔge jatwogo de noa ni maŋem chekke. Ko nam ye da-yiga noa maŋem mo twoŋi jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dem wone. Bimbini dem kuri seeni gwoŋo mo tigi da, ko na luuna ko yi jatwogo de noa ni maŋem, ye ko ta yala se ko yi jatwogo de noa ni maŋem. De maa jege nia na kaare de maama pa se ya yala se ko maŋe de da-yiga noa maŋem kuni betɔ. Bimbini dem wɛ-baŋa maŋem na ye tei to mo tento: 14Ko na zege de kuri seeni gwoŋo kom ne se ko taa diini ko yi de tetare fera kam to, bimbini dem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni belei mo wɛ baŋa seeni. Fera kam tete kayɔlɔ baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa. Ko maa na zege tetare fera kam ne se ko taa diini ko yi baŋa seeni fera kam to, ko ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bena mo wɛ baŋa ne, ye fera kam konto de ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa ka kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 15Bimbini dem baŋa kam mɛ seeni ba na zwɛ kaanem dem to maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bena wɛ baŋa ne se ko woli da. Nyea yana ta maa zege de nia yam sɛ sena sem ne. 16Bimbini dem baŋa kam mɛ ba na zwɛ kaanem dem to sɛ sem maama mae da se mae da. Ko maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem fuga-belei dedɔrem baŋa ne de ko kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. 17Bimbini dem tetare seeni maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni fuga-bena de dedɔrem baŋa ne, de de kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. De maa jege ni na ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem chicheiro kayɔlɔ baŋa ne. De fera kam kayɔlɔ nam maŋe de jatwogo de noa ni maŋem dedoa ko ja kaare ka maama. Nateina déem diini bimbini dem wɛ-puli seeni ya yi de baŋa seeni.
18 Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Ba ná lɔge kaanem bimbini dem, chullu telo ba na wó tɔge se ba zwɛ vara, ba daare ba kwei ba jana bam ba miisi bimbini dem yera ne to mo tento: 19Nmo wó kwei na-bala n pa kaanem tiina bam se ba ma ba ke wɛleere saarem kaanem. Banto ye Zadoki diga kam tiina mo na jege chwoŋa se ba fɔɔre ba twɛ amo tei se ba taa toŋa ba pa-ne to. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. 20Nmo laam ma‑n wó pwori jana bam wone se n kwei-ba n taare bimbini dem nyea yana yam ne, dedaane de tetare seeni nia yana yam ne, de fera kalo na kaare bimbini dem maama to ne. Nmo wó tɔge chwoŋa kam konto mo se n fɔge n kwɛ bimbini dem kaanem totoŋa yam ŋwaane. 21Nmo ta ma‑n wó ja na-bala kam n na mɛ n ke wɛleere saarem kaanem dem to nɔna n vo n zwɛ jeiga kalo na maŋe ye ka wo dáa dáa de Wɛ diga kam tete to ne.
22Tega ná poore, n ta wó ja bo-bala kalo na ba jege gɛɛ ka yera ne to mo n ba se n kwei-ka n ke wɛleere saarem kaanem. Ke konto n ma n fɔge n kwɛ bimbini dem Wɛ ŋwaane, ne n na ke tei de na-bala kam to. 23Nmo ná kwɛ-de n ti, n laam wó le na-bala de pi-bala mo n vara bam wone, te na ba jege gɛɛ te yera ne to. 24Nmo wó kwei-te n kaane Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne mo. Wɛ kaanem tiina bam de wó kwei yɛ ba zezage vara bam nɔna yam baŋa ne, ye ba daare ba zwɛ-ya ba pa Baŋa Wɛ.
25Kwei da yarepɛ se dɛ maama ne, n ja bo-bala n ba n ma n ke wɛleere saarem kaanem. Nmo ta wó beeri na-bala de pi-bala mo se n ma tento de n ke kaanem dem. Te nam ba jege se te taa jege gɛɛ te yera yam ne. 26Ba nam wó kwei da yarepɛ mo ba ma ba kwɛ bimbini dem Wɛ ŋwaane. Ba maa wó tɔge chwoŋa kam konto ba pɔɔre-de ba zege dáa ne kaanem totoŋa yam ŋwaane. 27Da yam konto ná lage ya ti, pa da nana dɛ dem yi se ko taa via, kaanem tiina bam jege se ba kwei abam zwɛɛm pɛɛra yam, de á nu-biu pɛɛra yam ba ma ke kaanem ba pa-ne bimbini dem baŋa ne.
