Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people. 37This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods 38and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts. 39With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land.
Part Three: The Time of the End
40At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another, 41and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
42The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt, 43and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia. 44But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction. 45After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_text:
1Bene dem Medea tu Darusi bobo se o di paare to, mo amo déem kuri se a zege Mikayeli kwaga ne se a pa o na dam.”
Teene delei pwa bam jege daane
Maleka kam ta ma ta ka we:
2“Amo laam wó pa se n lɔre kolo na ye chega to. Pwa batɔ daa ta wó zaŋe ba di Peresia paare dem. Banto paare dim maŋa kam ná kɛ, bana tu wom wó ba o jwoŋi paare. O wó tiini o taa ye nadum o dwoi o dwonna bam. O nam ná mɛ o jejegero tem o na dam o ti, o wó chiŋi nɔɔna maama se ba ke jara de Girisi paare laŋa kam. 3Pa-dedɛɛro laam maa wó zaŋe ye o jege paare o di de dam-fɔrɔ. O nam wó taa ke tei maama o na lage to mo. 4O paare dem ná yɔɔre de jeini, de wó pɔpɔ de ti mo. Ba maa wó pɔɔre o paare dem kuni bena mo se de jage de yi tega baŋa sapɛ sena sem maama ne. O bia nam bá di ba kwo paare dem, se de lage de gɔ mo pa se nɔn-gɛ di-de. Paare dem ná pɔɔre konto, de nam daa bá taa jege boboa dam dem dwoŋi.
5Tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom maa wó tiini o na dam. O jar-keira yiga tiina bam dedoa de daa wó taa dana o dwoi‑o, pa se o vo o jwoŋi o tete paare o taa di de dam-fɔrɔ. 6Bena yalei nam ná kɛ ya ke da, pwa balei bam wó ke ni-sɛɛm daane. Tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom bukɔ wó zo baŋa seeni pɛ wom, se ko pa ba ni-sɛɛm dem kwaare chekke. Bukɔ wom dam nam bá dáane, ye o baro de paare dam ti. Ba maa wó go bukɔ wom, de balo na woli‑o to, de o baro wom, de o bu wom de.
7Maŋa kam konto ne, bukɔ wom yera nɔɔno dedoa wó leiri o kwo yuu ne o taa tei tega-kuri seeni paare dem. Kotu nam wó ke jara de baŋa seeni pɛ wom de o jar-keira bam mo, ye o daare o zo o teo dam jei sem o di‑o jara yam wone. 8Ko kwaga ne, o wó vere baŋa seeni pɛ wom teo jwona, de ba sabu-seŋa zela, de lu-nyenno zela o ja o vo o tiŋi o tete teo Ejipti ne. Ko maa wó ke bena dedɛ se o daa boŋe se o ke jara de baŋa seeni pɛ wom. 9Konto kwaga ne, baŋa seeni pɛ wom de wó zaŋe o vo o kwaare jara de tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom. Ba nam wó fe‑o se o pipiri o jwoori sɔŋɔ. 10Baŋa seeni pɛ wom bu-baara laam wó ke ba tete ba ke daane ba la jar-keira kɔgɔ dedɛ, se ba ke jara de kuri seeni pɛ wom. Ba kɔgɔ kom wó yɔɔre ba mage jara taa ba vo ba yi tega-kuri seeni teo dam jei sem.
11Tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom wó nwoŋi de bane se o ke jara de baŋa seeni pɛ wom de o kɔ-fɔrɔ kom. O maa wó wane-ba o di. 12Tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom ná nɛ wɔnɔ konto, o laam wó tiini o bere o tete. O wó go o dona morro dedɛ, ye o dam nam bá dáane. 13Baŋa seeni pɛ wom wó jwoori o la jar-keira kɔgɔ na daga ko dwoi boboa kɔgɔ kom o ke daane mo. Ko ná wora ko wora, o wó pa o kɔ-fɔrɔ kom konto nwoŋi de ba jara zela dedɛ, pa se ba yɔɔre yiga ba taa mage jara ba via.
14Maŋa kam konto ne, nɔɔna dedɛ wó nwoŋi tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom kwaga ne. Nmo tete nɔɔna bam wone nankɔ-nyena de wó kwaane se ba dwoni ded‑o, ba na lage ba pa se veera yam ji chega to ŋwaane. Ba nam wó ga ko ŋwa. 15Baŋa seeni pɛ wom de o jar-keira kɔgɔ kom laam wó ba ba kaare teo kom dam jei sedwonna ba pu, ye ba daare ba wane-ko ba di. Tega-kuri seeni jar-keira bam daa bá wane-ba ba zeili, ba ná maŋe ba ye babɛ tei de. 16Baŋa seeni pɛ wom wó taa toŋe o fera mo, ye ba bá wane‑o ba che. O ta wó vo o yi te-ŋoŋa kam ye dam wo o jeŋa ne se o chɔge-ka. 17O boboŋa wó ja se o tɔge de o jar-keira bam maama o ba o ke ni-sɛɛm de tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom. O bere o wó kwei o bukɔ o pa pɛ wom konto, se o wane o na chwoŋa o tɔge da o chɔge tega-kuri seeni paare laŋa kam. O boboŋa nam bá seene ya maŋe daane.
18Ko kwaga ne, baŋa seeni pɛ wom wó vo o kwaare jara de dwi tiina balo na zoore naneo ni ne to mo. O maa wó wane ba dedɛ o di. Dwi-gɛ dedɛɛro wodwoŋi nam mo lage o zaŋe o baŋa ne o pa o teera yam jei, se chaveera jwoori ya ja‑o. 19O laam maa wó pipiri se o jwoori o vo o tete teo kom o seigi o dam jei sem ne. O ná via, o wó chɔɔle o to tega ne o jei, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá ni o ŋwa.
20Wolo na wó saŋe o kwaga o ji baŋa seeni teo kom pɛ to de laam wó toŋe lampwoo-jwoŋinu se o fe nɔɔna o la sabu, se o paare taa jege nenɔŋa lanyerane. O de nam bá dáane. O wó ba o te lela mo, ye ko dae jara wone naa vuvuga baŋa ne.
21Nɔn-yɔɔ wolo kuri na dae paare dwi to mo laam wó ji baŋa seeni teo kom pɛ se o leiri wodwoŋi wom yuu ne. Wonto wó kwei swa de ni-som mo o pɔpɔ o ba o vere paare dem o pa o tete. 22O nam wó yɔɔre o chɔge jar-keira balo maama na wó dwoni ded‑o to mo, de Wɛ kaanem yiga tu wom de. 23O ta wó ke ni-sɛɛm de teene dedwonna, ye ko ye swa mo o ke se o ma o gane-ba. O dam dem wó fɔge de taa daga, ye balo na wo o kwaga ne to de ye fenfee yerane. 24O maa wó pɔpɔ o zaŋe teene delo jejegero na tiini te daga to baŋa ne o kwaare jara de-ba se o vere ba wonnu. O kwoa déem wo wane o keim dem konto dwoŋi ba ke. O maa wó pɔɔre jejegero de zela yalo o na vere to o pa o kwaga tɔgena bam. O ta wó ke o boboŋa ne se o chɔge teene dedwonna dam jei sem. O keina yam konto nam bá dáane se ya ti.
25Pɛ wom wó tiini o na baare se o la kɔgɔ dedɛ o ke daane se ba vo ba ke jara de tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom. Wonto de nam wó la jar-keira kɔgɔ kolo na tiini ko dana ko gaale to. De ko de, tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom bá wane o dono wom, nɔɔna na wó baare o kwaga ne to ŋwaane. 26Ko nam ye o tete sɔŋɔ tiina mo lage ba de‑o tega ne. O jar-keira bam dedɛ wó te jara wone, ye o kɔgɔ kom maama ba ko jei. 27Pwa balei banto wó jeini daane se ba taa lara. Ba nam bá taa jege boboŋ-laaro ba pae daane. Ba wó taa jege daane ba fɔ vwa se lwarem laam ba. Ba kikia yam nam bá ja kuri, kokuri to, ba kweelim maŋa kam jege se ka yi mo. 28Baŋa seeni pɛ wom wó zaŋe o taa maa jwoori o tete teo kom de jejegero telo maama o na vere to. O ta ná wo chwoŋa ne, o boboŋa wó ja se o chɔge Wɛ nɔɔna bam na tɔge chwoŋa kalo ba zuli Wɛ to. O maa wó yɔɔre o toŋe o fera mo ba baŋa ne, se o laam kɛ o vo o yi o teo kom.
29Maŋa kam ná yi ka ti, baŋa seeni pɛ wom wó jwoori o vo se o ke jara de tega-kuri seeni teo kom. Wonnu nam daa bá ke lanyerane te pa‑o ne boboa jara yam na ke tei to. 30Nɔɔna wó zege wɛ-zoore seeni ba tɔge naneo kom baŋa de nabwooru ba ba se ba ke jara ded‑o. Konto wó pa se o fom, ye o tutwoni se o jwoori sɔŋɔ. O ta ná wo chwoŋa ne o vei to, o laam wó kwei o ban-zɔŋɔ kom o daŋe Wɛ nɔɔna bam yuu ne mo, se o pa ko chɛ ba yera ne. Ko daare balo na ve se ba tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa kam to mo o yiga wó taa wo ba wone. 31O jar-keira bam wó zaŋe ba zo Wɛ diga kam de ka dam jei sem se ba chɔge-ka. Ba wó che nɔɔna se ba daa yé taa ke dɛ maama kaanem dem da, ye ba daare ba kwei wo-zɔɔne delo na chɔge Wɛ yere to ba zege Wɛ wara-jei sem ne. 32Pɛ wom wó kwei ni-som mo o soge balo na nwoŋi Wɛ kwaga ne to o ke o yera ne. Ko nam ná ye balo na ke ba chega de ba Wɛ to, ba bá sɛ ba pa‑o.
33Yi-pore-nyena bam wó taa bere nɔɔna dedɛ se ba lɔre yeino chwoŋa. Ko nam ná yi yiga, ba wó pa ko chɛ banto yera ne. Ba badwonna wó te jara wone, ye ba zwɛ ba badaara de mini. Ba ta wó zi ba badwonna ba vɔ, ye ba vere badwonna jejegero ba daare-ba. 34Wɛ nɔɔna bam ná zo cham dem konto wone, ba wó na wolim fenfee yerane mo. Balo na wó ba se ba woli ba wone to nam wó taa jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ. 35Yi-pore-nyena bam badwonna wó to ba yaara yam ŋwaane. Wɛ nam wó tɔge ko baŋa ne o fɔge o kwɛ o nɔɔna bam se ba taa lana jase se ko vo ko yi kweelim maŋa kam. Kokuri to, kweelim maŋa kam ta lage ka yi mo.
36Baŋa seeni teo pɛ wom lage o toŋe o fera mo. O wó taa zeiŋi o tete wɛɛne, ye o daare o bere o tete we o dwoi wɛ dwi maama. O ta wó ta wo-zɔɔna o chɔge Wɛ wolo yerane na ye Wɛ chekke to yere. O nam wó na chwoŋa se o ke konto se ko vo ko yi maŋa kalo Wɛ ban-lom dem na wó ke ko ti to. Wɛ nam wó seene o ke se ko su o na boŋe se o ke tei to mo. 37Pɛ wom yiga bá taa wo o nabaara wa yam wone, de jwoni delo kaana na swoi se ba zuli to wone. O maŋe o bá nii wɛ de wɛ se de taa jege kuri de pa‑o. O nam wó taa bere o tete we wonto mo dwoi wa yam maama. 38O nam wó yage wa yanto yam, ye o leiri o kwei wɛ delo na nii dam jei to mo o taa zula. O nabaara déem nam yeiri wɛ dem konto. O maa wó kwei sabu-seŋa, de lu-nyenno, de kandwa-nyenno, de pɛɛra yalo na tiini ya ke sabu to o pa-de. 39Dwi-gɛ tiina wɛ dento wó woli‑o se o ke jara o vere o dona dam jei sem. Balo maama ná sɛ ba pa‑o, o wó zuli banto lanyerane. O ta wó pa ba taa nii nɔɔna dedɛ baŋa ne, ye o daare o kwei tega kalo o na vere o dona tei ne to o pɔɔre o pa-ba.
40Kweelim maŋa ná yia, tega-kuri seeni pɛ wom wó nwoŋi o ke jara ded‑o. Baŋa seeni pɛ wom maa wó ja jar-keira kɔgɔ dedɛ se o vo o jeeri‑o de dam. Ba badwonna wó taa dɔge sisein-nɔɔna baŋa ne, ye badwonna wo sisei-torokooro yuu ne, ko daare badwonna yɛ nabwooru ba via. O laam wó vo o kwaare jara teene dedɛ baŋa ne, pa se o chwooli-ba ne na-fɔrɔ na chwooli wonnu tei to. 41O ta wó ja jara o vo o yi te-ŋoŋa kam, ye o daare o pa se nɔɔna morro dedɛ to jara yam wone. Se ko ná ye Edom, de Moaba, de Amon kateiri delo ta na daare to, teene dem konto wó lu o jeŋa ne. 42O dam dem wó jage de yi teene dedɛ mo, ye Ejipti teo kom tete de bá lu o jeŋa ne. 43O maa wó jwoŋi Ejipti tiina sabu-seŋa kam, de ba lu-nyenno tem, de ba lonne zela maama o taa tei, ye o daare o pa Libia teo kom de Kusi teo kom taa wo o dam kuri ne. 44Kwora nam wó nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni de baŋa seeni ka ba pa se o fom ka ŋwaane. O maa wó kwei o ban-lom dem o zaŋe o nwoŋi mo se o taa chɔge nɔɔna dedɛ fase. 45Ko kwaga ne, o wó vo o chwi o paare nenɔŋa vwoa yam nane-fɔrɔ kom de Wɛ tete peo kolo na ye wose to tetare laŋa ne mo. Ko nam na ye tei to, toone wó ba de yi‑o, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó wane o woli‑o.”

english_text:
Part Four: The Dead Will Rise to Life
1 Michael, the chief of the angels, is the protector of your people, and he will come at a time of terrible suffering, the worst in all of history. And your people who have their names written in The Book will be protected. 2 Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace. 3 Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
4 Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it.
The End of Time
5Daniel wrote:
I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side. 6The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
7 The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
8I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?”
The angel in my vision then replied:
9Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time. 10 Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand. 11 There will be 1,290 days from the time that the daily sacrifices are stopped, until someone sets up the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction. 12God will bless everyone who patiently waits until 1,335 days have gone by.
13So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_text:
Kweelim maŋa kam taane
1“Maŋa kam konto ná yia, malese sem yiga tu Mikayeli wó zaŋe o nwoŋi. Wonto mo ye wolo na nii nmo dwi tiina bam baŋa ne to. Lɛɛro nam mo wó tiini te taa wora maŋa kam konto ne. Ko na zege á teo kom boboa maŋa ne se ko taa via, nɔɔna ta wo nɛ lɛɛro tento dwoŋi. De ko de, nmo nɔɔna balo maama yera na popone ya tiŋi tɔnɔ kom wone to wó na verem. 2Nɔɔna balo na tege ba tigi tega kuri ne to dedɛ wó jwoori ba bi. Ba badwonna wó bi ba na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to, ye badaara de bi ba na chaveera de yaalem se ko taa vei wuu. 3Nɔɔna balo na fɔge ba jege Wɛ swa yam to wó taa nye de pwooni mo ne wɛyuu pwooni na ye tei to. Balo na woli nɔɔna se ba taa tɔge chega chwoŋa to maa wó taa nyeena ne wɛyuu pwooni na ye tei to taa wuu. 4Ko nam ná ye nmo Danyeli, nmo jege se n seigi taane dento na wo tɔnɔ kom wone to mo, se ko taa nii kweelim maŋa kam. Nɔɔna dedɛ wó taa kare ba vei yiga de kwaga, se ba kwaane ba lɔre wonnu tento kuri.”
5Amo Danyeli laam ma kwoni a yuu se a nii, ye a na nɔɔna balei mo na zega ba woli da. Ba dedoa zege buga kam bubɛ dedoa ne mo, ye wodwoŋi wom de zege dedwoŋi dem ne. 6Nɔɔna balei bam dedoa ma bwei wolo na zo gare-fefale ye o yaara o tete nabara kam baŋa ne to o we, “Ko lage ko dáane tetɛ mo se wo-kenkagela yanto maama ke ya ti?”
7Wolo na zo gare-fefale ye o yaara o tete nabara kam baŋa ne to ma zeiŋi o je selei wɛɛne, ye o du duuri Taa-wuu Wɛ wom yere ŋwaane o we, “Wonnu tento maama lage te dáane nenɛɛne maŋa kadwoŋi laŋa ne, de maŋa kuni belei laŋa ne, ko woli de maŋa chichworo laŋa ne mo. Wɛ nɔn-laaro tem yaara yam ná ke te ti, mo wonnu tento maama kweelim de wó yi.”
8Amo na nigi o taane dem to, a déem wo lɔre de kuri. A maa bwei‑o a we, “Amo tu, kweelim maŋa kam lage ka guri tetɛ mo?” 9O de ma leiri-ne o we:
“Danyeli, pa dé tiŋi taane dem, kokuri to, taane dento laam kwoli mo pa se de seigi se ko taa nii kweelim maŋa kam. 10Cham maŋa kam wó pa se nɔɔna dedɛ fɔge ba kwɛ mo se ba taa lana jase. Puseŋ-nyena maa wó taa vei yiga ba ke ba kikia, ye ba bá ni wonnu tento kuri. Balo na jege Wɛ swa yam to yerane mo wó ni te kuri.
11Ko zege maŋa kalo ne ba na wó che nɔɔna se ba daa yé taa ke dɛ maama kaanem dem, ye ba daare ba kwei wo-zɔɔne delo na chɔge Wɛ yere to ba zege, ko lage ko ke da moro de bia yalei de funogo (1,290) mo. 12Wolo maama nam ná zuri o yera o cheigi se ko yi da moro de bia yatɔ de fintɔ-yanu yam (1,335) kweelim maŋa kam, kotu wó tiini o na yu-ywoŋo!
13Ko nam ná ye nmo Danyeli, yɔɔre n ta‑n vei de yazura se ko yi n kweelim maŋa. N momwɛ wó ba de ti. Nmo nam ta wó jwoori n bi kweelim maŋa kam ne se n jwoŋi ŋweero telo na tigi te cheigi‑m to.”

english_text:
1 I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me.
Hosea's Family
2The Lord said, “Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.” 3So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
4 Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom, 5and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
6Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel. 7But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
8After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son. 9Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.”
Hope for Israel
10 Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.” 11Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_text:
1 Baŋa Wɛ kwora kalo o na pɛ Beeri bu Hosea to mo tento. Ko maa ye maŋa kalo Yuzia, de Jotam, de Ahaz, de Hezekia déem na saŋe daane ba di Judah teo paare to mo. Maŋa kam konto ne Jehoasa bu Jeroboam de déem di paare Isarele teo kom ne.
Hosea kaane de o bia taane
2 Baŋa Wɛ déem na bobo o kwei o kwora o pa Hosea se o lwoni o bere Isarele tiina bam to mo o tage ded‑o o we, “Nam zaŋe n swo kaane na ye ka-tola to. Wonto wó lo bia o tusim dem baŋa ne o pa‑m, ye ba maama lage ba ywori nmo kwaga ne mo. Amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam de nam ye konto dwoŋi mo. Ba kare ba tusi mo dedɛ ye ba ywori amo Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne.”
3Hosea ma seene o vo o di kaane. O déem ye Dibilayim bukɔ mo, o yere mo Gomera. O ma ja puga o lo bakeira o pa‑o. 4Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Hosea o we, “Pa bu wom yere we ‘Jezerele’. Kokuri to, ko bá dáane a lage a pa cham yɔɔre de yi Jehu dwi dem de wonto déem na tiini o toŋe nɔn-gora totoŋa Jezerele teo kom ne tei to ŋwaane. Konto baŋa ne amo wó pa se o dwi dem paare ti Isarele teo kom ne. 5Dɛ dem konto ne a lage a chɔge Isarele jar-keira bam mo de ba dam maama Jezerele bwolo kom ne.”
6Gomera daa ma ja puga ye o lo bukɔ. Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Hosea o we, “Pa bu wom yere we ‘Lo-Ruhama’. Kokuri to, amo daa bá taa jege Isarele dwi tiina bam swono. A daa bá yage ba wɛleera a ma chɛ-ba. 7Ko nam ná ye Judah dwi tiina bam, amo wó taa jege ba swono ye a jwoŋi-ba a yage ba cham wone. Amo wolo na ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to mo wó jwoŋi-ba, ye ko dae ba jara zela ŋwaane, naa ba sisein-nɔɔna ŋwaane, naa balo na yei jara keim chekke to ŋwaane.”
8Gomera bukɔ wom na waare o tu tega to, o daa ma kwei puga o lo bakeira kadwoŋi. 9Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Hosea o we, “Pa bu wom yere we ‘Lo-Ammi’. Kokuri to, abam daa seene á dae amo nɔɔna. Amo de maa dae abam de Wɛ.”
Isarele tiina wó jwoori ba na verem
10Ko jwa na wó taa ye tei to, Isarele tiina bam wó puli ba taa daga dedɛ ne naneo ni kasolo bia na daga tei to, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ga o lɔre ba ni na mae tei. Ko ná ye jeiga kalo Wɛ ya na tage de-ba we, ba dae o nɔɔna to, jeiga kam konto ne nɔɔ, o wó ta de-ba we, “Abam ye Ŋwea Tu Wɛ wom bia mo.” 11Dɛ dem konto ne, Judah tiina bam de Isarele tiina bam wó jwoori ba ke daane, kɔgɔ dedoa. Ba wó kuri yuu tu dedoa ba wone se o taa nii-ba. Ba wó taa tei ba tega kam de yazura. Chega to, Jezerele dɛ dem konto wó taa ye dɛ-kamunu.

english_text:
1So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.”
The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
2Accuse! Accuse your mother!
She is no longer my wife,
and now I, the Lord,
am not her husband.
Beg her to give up prostitution
and stop being unfaithful,
3or I will strip her naked
like the day she was born.
I will make her barren
like a desert,
and she will die of thirst.
4You children are the result
of her unfaithfulness,
and I'll show you no pity.
5Your mother was unfaithful.
She was disgraceful and said,
“I'll run after my lovers.
Everything comes from them—
my food and drink,
my linen and wool,
my olive oil and wine.”
6I, the Lord, will build
a fence of thorns
to block her path.
7She will run after her lovers,
but not catch them;
she will search,
but not find them.
Then she will say, “I'll return
to my first husband.
Life was better then.”
8She didn't know that her grain,
wine, and olive oil
were gifts from me,
as were the gold and silver
she used in worshiping Baal.
9So I'll hold back the harvest
of grain and grapes.
I'll take back
my wool and my linen
that cover her body.
10Then I'll strip her naked
in the sight of her lovers.
No one can rescue her.
11I'll stop Israel's celebrations—
no more New Moon Festivals,
Sabbaths, or other feasts.
12She said, “My lovers gave me
vineyards and fig trees
as payment for sex.”
Now I, the Lord, will ruin
her vineyards and fig trees;
they will become clumps of weeds
eaten by wild animals.
13I'll punish her for the days
she worshiped Baal
and burned incense to him.
I'll punish her for the times
she forgot about me
and wore jewelry and rings
to attract her lovers.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
The Lord Will Help Israel
14Israel, I, the Lord,
will lure you into the desert
and speak gently to you.
15 I will return your vineyards,
and then Trouble Valley
will become Hopeful Valley.
You will say “Yes” to me
as you did in your youth,
when leaving Egypt.
16I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master. 17I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.” 18And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war. 19I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness, 20and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
21I will command the sky to send rain on the earth, 22and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley. 23 I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_text:
1Konto ŋwaane, á wó bwoŋi á chorro Isarele tiina bam we, ‘A nɔɔna’, de ‘A bu-swonnu’.
Isarele tiina na ke ba chɔge tei to
2A bia bam, bwɛ-na á nu wom! Taane wora debam laŋa ne. O daa dae amo kaane wom chekke. Amo de daa dae o baro wom. Kwoori-o-na se o yage o kabwoŋa kikia yam, se o daa yé taa kare o chɔge o tete de baara. 3O ná wo sɛ se o ke konto, a wó choore o yera zela a daare‑o, ne o nu de o kwo na loge‑o tei to. A ta wó pa o ŋwea taa ye kafɛ, ne te-kora na tigi ye na tera tei to mo. Konto baŋa ne mo na-nyɔm wó go‑o. 4Amo bá taa jege o bia bam ŋwaŋa, o na tole o lo-ba to ŋwaane. 5Ba nu wom ywori o baro wom kwaga ne. O ma lo o bia bam de chaveera. O maa we, “A wó nwoŋi a vo a bɔɔla bam tei. Ko ná ye wodiu, de na, de gwaaro, de nuga, de sana de, banto wó ke ba pa-ne.” 6Konto ŋwaane, a lage a zage sabare mo a kwei a maa che o chwoŋa. A ta wó lɔ kabira a maa pe‑o, se o daa yé wane o nwoŋi pwooni. 7Kaane wom wó kwaane se o pare o bɔɔla bam, ye o nam bá yi-ba. O wó beeri ba jei, ye o yi bá peere-ba. O laam maa wó ta o tete ne we, “Yage se a jwoori a vo a baro wom tei, ne ko déem na ye tei to. A boboa kam yɔɔre ka gare a zem na ye tei to.” 8O nam wo ke o boboŋa ne we ko ye amo mo pɛ‑o mena yam, de sa-doora bam, de nuga kam. A ta ma pa‑o lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa dedɛ, ye o kwei-te o ma zuli Baal jwona yam.
9Mo kokuri, mena yam ná tu ya be, ye sa-doora bam de ná bega, a lage a yiri a pɛɛra yam konto mo. Ko ta ná ye gwaaro telo a na pɛ‑o se o ma kwoli o chaveera to, a wó jwoori a jwoŋi-te o tei ne. 10A ta wó choore o teiŋa zela a daare‑o, pa se o di o chaveera o bɔɔla bam yiga ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o jwoŋi‑o amo jeŋa ne o yage. 11A wó che kwɛɛra yalo o na di ywoni ya baŋa ne to, ko ná maŋe ko ye kuri delo maama o na yeini o guli o di to. Bene bene kura, de chan-doŋa kura, de siu dɛ maama kura mo konto. 12Ko ná ye Vini teeni dem, dedaane kaporro tem o bɔɔla bam na pɛ‑o to, a lage a chɔge-te mo. O tage o we, te ye ŋweero telo o na jwoŋi o baara bam tei ne kabwoŋa ŋwaane to mo. Amo nam wó pa se o kare sem konto ji goa. Kago-vara wó taa tui ba di teeni dem. 13A wó waare‑o de o na zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa o ke kaanem o pa Baal jwona yam ya zula da yam ne to ŋwaane. O maa yeini o kwɛ o tete de zambila, de jafola se o ma tɔge o bɔɔla bam kwaga. O na ke tei maama to, o yɔɔre o swei amo swia mo.
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
14Konto ŋwaane, a laam lage a kwoori‑o mo se a ja‑o a zo kagoa kam wone, se a daare a ma swono taane a ŋɔɔne ded‑o. 15Dáane mo a wó jwoori a kwei o Vini teeni kare sem a ke o jeŋa ne. A ta wó pa se Akore bwolo kom pipiri ko ji teena jeiga ko pa‑o. Kaane wom laam wó leeni lei ne o déem na ke tei ye o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne o biini maŋa ne to.
16 Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento: Dɛ dem konto ne, nmo wó jwoori n bwoŋi-ne we n baro. N daa bá fɔge n bwoŋi-ne we n Baal jwoni dem. 17Amo ta wó che Baal yere dem n ni ne, se n yé lwoori wolim Baal jwona yam tei ne. 18Dɛ dem konto ne a wó ke ni-sɛɛm dedaane kago-vara bam, de zuna bam, de tega-veila bam se ko che a nɔɔna bam se ba yé na chɔgem. A ta wó chɔge jara zela maama, ko ná ye tɛ de se-zɔɔro, se tigura daa yé zaŋe tega kam baŋa ne. Konto laam wó pa nɔɔna maama sii de yazura. 19Amo wó pa se n ji a kaane ye n ta‑n wo a tei ne taa wuu. Amo wó tɔge chega, de swono, de ŋwaŋa baŋa ne mo a ke konto. 20Dé wó taa jege chega dé pa daane, ye dé bá jwoori da-kwaga. Nmo de wó ba n sɛ we amo mo ye n Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.
21 Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento: Dɛ dem konto ne amo wó leiri ba wɛ-lworo kom. A wó ta de wɛyuu kunkwonnu tem se te pa doa taa nena tega kam baŋa ne. 22Tega kam de wó sɛ ye ka ke mena, de sa-doora, de nu-doŋa lanyerane. Tento maama wó leiri de wopwolo te we, “Wɛ mo duga.” 23Chega to, amo wó pa se a nɔɔna bam fɔge ba na kugu jei tega kam baŋa ne se ba taa ye a tete nyem. Ko ná ye wolo ba ya na bwoi o yere we “Swono tera” to, amo mo wó taa swoi kotu. Ko ta ná ye balo ba ya na bwoi-ba we “Ba dae amo nɔɔna” to, amo laam wó ta de-ba we, ba seene ba ye a nɔɔna mo. Ba de maa wó leiri ba we, “Nmo ye debam Tu Wɛ wom mo.”

english_text:
God's Love Offers Hope
1Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
2So I paid 15 pieces of silver and about 150 kilograms of grain for such a woman. 3Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
4It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God. 5But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_text:
Hosea de o kaane jwoori ba ke daane
1 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de amo o we, “N kaane wom ye ka-bworo ye baaro wodwoŋi mo swoi‑o. De ko de, jwoori n vo n bere‑o nmo na jege o swono tei to. Ko ye bedwe de amo Baŋa Wɛ de na swoi Isarele tiina bam tei to mo, de ba na maŋe ba ywori a kwaga ne ye ba zuli wa yadwonna tei to de. Ba ta swoi se ba taa kwei kekan-wogila ba pae ba jwona.”
2 Baŋa Wɛ na tage konto to, a ma kwei lu-nyenno sabu-dala fuga-yanu, de chaara ywollu tenu, se a ŋwe a ma jwoori a jwoŋi‑o. 3A ma ta ded‑o we, “Nmo laam wó ta‑n zoore de amo mo taa, ye n yage ka-tola de kabwoŋa kikia. A de wó zuri a yera a pa‑m.”
4Mo Isarele tiina bam na wó taa zoore taa tei ye ba ba jege pɛ naa pa-bu to. Ba bá na chwoŋa se ba ke kaanem, naa ba zuli ba kandwa naa ba jwona, naa ba ma kaanem gare-wogo kom ba ke yi-nɛɛre kikia. 5Maŋa kam konto ná kɛ, Isarele tiina bam wó jwoori ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei, de ba pɛ wolo na nwoŋi David dwi dem wone to tei. Ba laam wó tiini ba kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, ye o de wó ke-ba lanyerane.

english_text:
Israel Is Unfaithful
1Israel, listen
as the Lord accuses
everyone in the land!
No one is faithful or loyal
or truly cares about God.
2Cursing, dishonesty, murder,
robbery, unfaithfulness—
these happen all the time.
Violence is everywhere.
3And so your land is a desert.
Every living creature is dying—
people and wild animals,
birds and fish.
The Lord Warns the Priests
4Don't accuse just anyone!
Not everyone is at fault.
My case is against you,
the priests.
5You and the prophets
will stumble day and night;
I'll silence your mothers.
6You priests have rejected me,
and my people are destroyed
by refusing to obey.
Now I'll reject you and forget
your children, because you
have forgotten my Law.
7By adding more of you priests,
you multiply the number
of people who sin.
Now I'll change your pride
into shame.
8You encourage others to sin,
so you can stuff yourselves
on their sin offerings.
9That's why I will punish
the people for their deeds,
just as I will punish
you priests.
10Their food won't satisfy,
and having sex at pagan shrines
won't produce children.
My people have rebelled
11and have been unfaithful
to me, their Lord.
God Condemns Israel's Idolatry
My people, you are foolish
because of too much pleasure
and too much wine.
12You expect wooden idols
and other objects of wood
to give you advice.
Lusting for sex at pagan shrines
has made you unfaithful
to me, your God.
13You offer sacrifices
on mountaintops and hills,
under oak trees, and wherever
good shade is found.
Your own daughters
and daughters-in-law
sell themselves for sex.
14But I won't punish them.
You men are to blame,
because you go to prostitutes
and offer sacrifices with them
at pagan shrines.
Your own foolishness
will lead to your ruin.
15Israel, you are unfaithful,
but don't lead Judah to sin.
Stop worshiping at Gilgal
or at sinful Bethel.
And quit making promises
in my name—the name
of the living Lord.
16You are nothing more
than a stubborn cow—
so stubborn that I, the Lord,
cannot feed you like lambs
in an open pasture.
17You people of Israel
are charmed by idols.
Leave those people alone!
18You get drunk, then sleep
with prostitutes;
you would rather be vulgar
than lead a decent life.
19And so you will be swept away
in a whirlwind
for sacrificing to idols.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ bwɛ Isarele tiina bam
1Isarele dwi tiina bam, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam! O jege taane de abam balo na zoore tega kanto wone to. Tega kam maama wone, nɔɔna ba tɔge chega naa swono kikia, ye ba ba kɔre Wɛ de. 2Á swoi sɔla, de vwa fɔm, de nɔn-gora, de ŋweene, dedaane kabwoŋa kikia dedɛ. Nɔɔna bam ke nankɔɔre totoŋa mo maŋa maama, ye ba goe ba dwonna se ko ja kɛ jeŋa. 3Konto mo tei tega kam koga ka peere pa se balo maama na zoore ka wone to bugi. Kago-vara, de zuna, de naneo wo ywona yam maama de lage te te.
4Yé ta‑á jege-na daane á bwɛa, se á pa ko ye nɔɔno wodwoŋi yiga. Ko nam ye abam kaanem tiina bam mo amo lage a bwɛ. 5Wea de tete maama á yeini á tiri á to tega ne mo. Sampwori sem de ma da ba to tega ne. Amo nam lage a chɔge á dwi dem mo. 6A nɔɔna bam lage ba na chɔgem, ba na ba jege yeino to ŋwaane. Abam yɔɔre á ve mo se á me de amo. Mo kokuri amo de wó ve abam se á yé ta‑á ye kaanem tiina á pa-ne. Amo ta wó nwoŋi á bia bam kwaga ne. Ko nam ye á na ve á Tu Wɛ bera yam to ŋwaane mo.
7Kaanem tiina bam kɔgɔ kom na daga tetei to, ba lwarem totoŋa yam de daga konto dwoŋi mo pa se ba tusi ba chɔge amo yiga dedɛ. Ba ma pa zula yalo ya na maŋe de-ba to leiri ya ji chaveera ba yuu ne. 8Wɛleera yalo a nɔɔna bam na ke to mo ye kaanem tiina bam ni-wodiu. Banto fera zo nɔɔna bam tusim kikia yam mo. 9Ko nam lage ko ke nɔɔna bam de kaanem tiina bam bedwe mo. Amo wó waare ba maama chwei selo ba na tɔge to ŋwaane. A ta wó jwoori a ŋwe ba kikia yam jene ba yuu ne. 10Ba na wó jwoŋi wodiu kolo ba di to bá zuri ba kana. Ba ná maŋe ba tɔge kabwoŋa kikia ba jwona kaanem jei sem ne mo de, ba dwi dem bá puli. Kokuri to, ba lɔge Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne mo ye ba daare ba tɔge wa-yɔɔro.
Baŋa Wɛ chuli jwona kaanem
Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we:
11Sa-dɛɛra de sa-bwona mo pɛ se
a nɔɔna bam boboŋa maama jei.
12Ba maa boŋe se ba jwoŋi swa
ba nwoŋi da-kora na ye jwoni to tei ne mo.
Ba daa ba jege ba tete boboŋe.
Voro bia laam mo bere-ba kolo na maŋe se ba ke to.
Kabwoŋa boboŋa mo pae se ba tusi konto dwoŋi.
Ba ma yage ba Tu Wɛ wom
ba daare ba kwei ba tete ba pa wa yadwonna.
13Peero tem yupare baŋa ne mo
ba yeini ba ke ba kaanem.
Ba maa zwɛ ba pɛɛra zwonnu tem yuu ne,
mɛ teeni dwi dwi na wora ye de woro kom ye tima-tima to.
Konto mo tei á bukwa bam zo tolo wone,
ye á bu-kaana de tɔge kabwoŋa kikia.
14Amo nam bá waare á bukwa bam ba tolo kikia yam ŋwaane.
A ta bá waare á bu-kaana bam ba kabwoŋa kikia de ŋwaane.
Kokuri to, á baara bam tete de peini de ka-tole mo.
Ba maa tɔge de-ba ba ke kaanem ba pa jwona.
Chega to, “Swa-mura tu ba jege sɔŋɔ.”
15Isarele tiina bam, á yeini á zo tolo wone.
Nam yé pa-na se Judah dwi tiina bam de tɔge á na-bɔŋa kam,
se banto de wɛleera taa wo ba yuu ne.
Yé zaŋe-na á vo Giligal naa Bɛte-Aven se á zuli-ne.
Yé ma-na Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere dem á du duuri.
16Isarele tiina bam ye zwabani-nyena mo,
ne na-chwa na ye tei to.
Baŋa Wɛ laam wó wane o nii ba baŋa ne
ne pipeili dwoŋi tei na?
17Efrayim dwi tiina bam me de jwona kaanem.
Le-na á tete ba wone á daare-ba.
18Ba ná nyɔge sana ba su,
ba laam yɔɔre ba tɔge kabwoŋa kikia mo.
Ba swoi kuri-nɔrɔ ba dwoi zula.
19Vo-dɛɔ lage ko ba ko kale-ba mo ko pu
ko ja ko jage.
Ba na ke kaanem ba pae jwona tei to
wó guri-ba chaveera wone mo.

english_text:
Israel and Judah Will Be Judged
The Lord said:
1Listen, you priests!
Pay attention, Israel!
Listen, you members
of the royal family.
Justice was your duty.
But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor
you trapped the people.
2At the place of worship
you were a treacherous pit,
and I will punish you.
3Israel, I know all about you,
and because of your unfaithfulness,
I find you unacceptable.
4Your evil deeds are the reason
you won't return to me,
your Lord God.
And your constant craving for sex
keeps you from knowing me.
5Israel, your pride
testifies to your guilt;
it makes you stumble,
and Judah stumbles too.
6You offer sheep and cattle
as sacrifices to me,
but I have turned away
and refuse to be found.
7You have been unfaithful
to me, your Lord;
you have had children
by prostitutes.
So at the New Moon Festival,
you and your crops
will be destroyed.
The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
8Give a warning on the trumpet!
Let it be heard in Gibeah,
Ramah, and sinful Bethel.
Benjamin, watch out!
9I, the Lord, will punish
and wipe out Israel.
This is my solemn promise
to every tribe of Israel.
10Judah's leaders are like crooks
who move boundary markers;
that's why I will flood them
with my anger.
11Israel was brutally crushed.
They got what they deserved
for worshiping useless idols.
12Now I, the Lord,
will fill Israel with maggots
and make Judah rot.
13When Israel and Judah saw
their sickness and wounds,
Israel asked help from Assyria
and its mighty king.
But the king cannot cure them
or heal their wounds.
14So I'll become a fierce lion
attacking Israel and Judah.
I'll snatch and carry off
what I want,
and no one can stop me.
15Then I'll return to my temple
until they confess their guilt
and worship me,
until they are desperate
and beg for my help.
translation_text:
Lɛɛro wó yi Isarele tiina de Judah tiina
1Wɛ kaanem tiina bam, cheigi-na taane dento!
Abam Isarele dwi tiina bam de pore á zwa se á cheigi-de.
Pa-diga tiina bam, á de cheigi-na!
Abam wo taane wone mo,
de á na kweele chega á yage tega ne jei maama ne to ŋwaane.
Ko nye de á kwei kalanchogo mo á che Mizipa teo wone tei,
ye á daare á dole ŋwe-choa á jare Tabora peo kom yuu maama.
2Zwabani-nyena bam tiini ba swoi nɔɔna gom.
Amo nam wó waare ba maama.
3Amo maŋe a yei Efrayim dwi tiina bam
de Isarele tiina bam maama na ye tei to.
Kolokolo tera ba na wó seigi amo yiga ne.
Isarele dwi tiina bam laam tu ba tɔge kabwoŋa kikia mo,
pa se ba biini ba tete.
4Ba kikia yam konto chɔge-ba mo,
ye ba daa ware se ba jwoori Wɛ tei.
Ba boboŋa yeini ya zo jwona kaanem wone.
Ba daa maa ba kɔre Baŋa Wɛ de fenfee tete de.
5Isarele tiina bam na bere ba tete kamunim tei to
bere we ba ba jege bora.
Ba maa yeini ba tiri ba to tega ne
ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane,
ko ná maŋe ko ye Efrayim dwi tiina bam de.
Judah tiina bam de ma da ba kwaga ba to.
6Ba ma kwei ba vara ba ja ba vo
ba ma ke kaanem se ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.
Ba nam bá na‑o,
o na nwoŋi ba tei ne to ŋwaane.
7Ba baare Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne mo.
Bia balo ba na loge to dae o nyem.
Chan-doŋa kuri dim ná yia,
ba de ba tega kam wó na chɔgem lela.
Jara chuga Judah teo de Isarele teo wone
8Wu-na jara-keim nabwanno Gibea teo wone!
Kaane-na Rama nɔn-bia bam!
Mage-na tiguri-kaasa Bɛte-Aven ne!
Benjamin dwi tiina bam, cho-na á tete!
9Efrayim tiina bam waarem dɛ dem lage de yi,
se ba tiini ba na chɔgem.
Amo na jege wonnu telo a tɛ a bere Isarele dwi tiina bam to seene te ye chega mo.
Te wó yɔɔre te ba te ke.
10Judah tiina nakwa bam jigi nenɛɛne
balo na di ba zo ba dwonna siseini wone tei to mo.
A ban-lom dem wó zaŋe ba baŋa ne,
ne na-fɔrɔ na chuuri ko chɔge wonnu tei to.
11Lɛɛro lage te yi Efrayim tiina bam.
Amo wó waare-ba pa se ba na chɔgem,
ba boboŋa na jaane se ba zuli jwona to ŋwaane.
12Amo lage a chɔge Efrayim tiina bam,
ne kenkaao na chɔge gwaaro tei to mo.
A ta wó pa se Judah tiina bam ji wo-popɔnɔ.
13Efrayim tiina bam na maane jaweo kolo na jege-ba to,
ye Judah tiina bam de lɔre ko na zo ba yera tei to,
mo Efrayim tiina bam lwoori wolim Asiria teo kom tei ne.
Ba ma boŋe we Asiria pa-faro wom wó zeini-ba.
Wonto nam bá wane abam o yɔɔre.
O bá pa se á yera zuri.
14Amo wó zo Efrayim tiina bam de Judah tiina bam wo
nenɛɛne nywoŋo na zo vara wone tei to mo.
Amo tete wó tore ba yera yam yera-yera,
ye a daare a ja-ba a viiri.
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó wane o jwoŋi-ba a jeŋa ne o yage.
15Amo laam wó jwoori a tete jeiga kam a daare-ba
pa ba na ba waarem dem ba ti.
Ko ná zo ba yera konto dwoŋi,
ba laam wó seene ba yia ba beeri amo jeiga.

english_text:
The Lord's People Speak
1Let's return to the Lord.
He has torn us to shreds,
but he will bandage our wounds
and make us well.
2In two or three days
he will heal us
and restore our strength
that we may live with him.
3Let's do our best
to know the Lord.
His coming is as certain
as the morning sun;
he will refresh us like rain
renewing the earth
in the springtime.
The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
4People of Israel and Judah,
what can I do with you?
Your love for me disappears
more quickly than mist
or dew at sunrise.
5That's why I slaughtered you
with the words
of my prophets.
That's why my judgments blazed
like the dawning sun.
6 I'd rather for you to be faithful
and to know me
than to offer sacrifices.
7At a place named Adam,
you betrayed me
by breaking our agreement.
8Everyone in Gilead is evil;
your hands are stained
with the blood of victims.
9You priests are like a gang
of robbers in ambush.
On the road to Shechem
you murder and commit
other horrible crimes.
10I have seen a terrible thing
in Israel—
you are unfaithful
and unfit to worship me.
11People of Judah,
your time is coming too.
The Lord Wants To Help Israel
I, the Lord, would like to make
my nation prosper again
translation_text:
Isarele tiina bam seene ba leiri ba boboŋa na?
Nɔɔna bam maa we:
1“Pa-na se dé jwoori dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei.
Wonto mo tore dé yera yam yera-yera,
o nam wó jwoori o yɔɔre debam.
O ma pa dé na zonne,
se o laam pa dé na yazura.
2Ko ná ke da yalei,
o wó jwoŋi debam dé cham wone o yage.
Ko ná yi da yatɔ wɛɛne
o wó pa dé jwoori dé bi de yazura
se dé taa wo o tei ne.
3Pa-na dé seene dé yia,
se dé taa me de Baŋa Wɛ!
O laam wó veere o tete o bere debam,
ne wɛ na jege de pula te-pora ni ne tei to.
O wó ba o zeini debam,
ne duum doa na bugi tega tei to mo.”
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
4“Efrayim dwi tiina bam,
amo nam wó ke abam tɛ mo?
Judah dwi tiina bam de,
amo lage a ke abam de tɛ mo?
Á na swoi amo tei to mo ba jege fera.
Ko nye de kunkwoŋo kolo na tui zezeŋa ne
ye ko jei lela to.
Ko ta nye de nyɔnɔ kolo na toa ye ko ba dáane to.
5Konto ŋwaane a lage a toŋe a sampwori sem mo á tei ne,
se a tɔge ba baŋa ne a pa á na chɔgem.
A ta wó kwei a ni taane dem a ma a go abam.
A lage a pɔpɔ a nwoŋi mo a waare abam
ne wɛ na puli te-pora ni ne tei to.
6Á ya ná jege da-swono,
konto ya wó pwoli amo wo
ko dwoni á ná ke kaanem á pa-ne.
Á ya ná me de amo na ye á Tu Wɛ wom to,
ko wó taa gara á ná kwei vara á zwɛ se á zuli-ne.
7Ko ná ye ni delo amo na gwoni de-ba to,
ba déem yiri-de
maŋa kalo ba na wo Adama teo ne to.
Chega to, ba seene ba nwoŋi amo kwaga ne.
8Gilead ye teo kolo kom puseŋ-nyena na su ko wone to mo.
Ba maa yeini ba go nɔɔna jaja.
9Wɛ kaanem tiina bam nye de venverena na seigi ba tete
se ba laam zaŋe ba vere nɔɔna to mo.
Ko ná maŋe ko ye Sɛkɛm chwoŋa ni ne,
ba go nɔɔna balo na tɔge da ba kɛ to.
Ko ye lwarem mo ba jege ba ke.
10Amo nɛ totoŋ-zɔɔne Isarele dwi tiina bam tetare ne.
Efrayim tiina bam biini ba tete mo
de ba na bwoori jwona kaanem baŋa ne tei to.
11Abam Judah dwi tiina bam,
ko ta ye bedwe mo de abam.
Á maŋa kam ná yia,
amo lage a yɔɔre a waare abam mo.

english_text:
1and to heal its wounds.
But then I see the crimes
in Israel and Samaria.
Everyone is deceitful;
robbers roam the streets.
2No one realizes
that I have seen their sins
surround them like a flood.
3The king and his officials
take great pleasure
in their sin and deceit.
4Everyone burns with desire—
they are like coals in an oven,
ready to burst into flames.
5On the day their king
was crowned,
his officials got him drunk,
and he joined
in their foolishness.
6Their anger is a fire
that smolders all night,
then flares up at dawn.
7They are flames
destroying their leaders.
And their kings are powerless;
none of them trust me.
8The people of Israel
have mixed with foreigners;
they are a thin piece of bread
scorched on one side.
9They don't seem to realize
how weak and feeble they are;
their hair has turned gray,
while foreigners rule.
10I am the Lord, their God,
but in all of their troubles
their pride keeps them
from returning to me.
No Help from Foreign Nations
The Lord said:
11Israel is a senseless bird,
fluttering back and forth
between Egypt and Assyria.
12But I will catch them in a net
as hunters trap birds;
I threatened to punish them,
and indeed I will.
13Trouble and destruction
will be their reward
for rejecting me.
I would have rescued them,
but they told me lies.
14They don't really pray to me;
they just howl in their beds.
They have rejected me for Baal
and slashed themselves,
in the hope that Baal
will bless their crops.
15I taught them what they know,
and I made them strong.
Now they plot against me
16and refuse to obey.
They are more useless
than a crooked arrow.
Their leaders will die in war
for saying foolish things.
Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_text:
Amo nam ná lage se a zeini a nɔɔna bam
se ba jwoori ba taa jege yu-ywoŋo,
1ye a ná lage se a pa Isarele tiina bam na yazura,
a yeini a jwoori a na ba wɛleera yam mo.
Efrayim dwi tiina bam de Samaria tiina bam
lwarem kikia seene ya lɔre mo jaja.
Ba maa yeini ba gane ba dwonna.
Ba ma bwori nɔɔna sam ba zoore ba vere ba wonnu.
Venverena de ma zi nɔɔna teo kom pwooni yiga ne ba jwoŋi ba wonnu.
2Ba nam wo maane we amo wó guli ba lwarem kikia yam konto.
Ba totoŋ-balwaaro tem yɔɔre te ja-ba mo.
Te nae amo yiga ne maŋa maama.”
Ba na gane pɛ wom tei to
Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we:
3“Nɔɔna yeini ba toŋe lwarem mo
ba ma pwoli pɛ wom wo.
Ba maa tɔge vwa baŋa ne
ba pwoli nakwa bam wo.
4Ba maama tɔge kabwoŋa kikia mo.
Ba maa tiini ba jege ban-lom,
ne jugu diga wo mini na guguli tei to.
5Pɛ wom na wora o di o kuri dem dɛ delo ne to,
ba pɛ se o nakwa bam nyɔ sana mo ba su,
pa ba yeiri ba tete jeiga.
Pɛ wom tete de tɔge de nɔn-jworru o kwɛɛre mo.
6Ba maa twɛ pɛ wom yera
ye ba boŋe se ba de‑o.
Tega ná yi, ba ban-zɔŋɔ kom guguli mo
ne mini na guguli tei to.
Tega daa ná poore, ko ma yɔɔre ko di,
ne min-vogo na jaane wɛyuu ne tei to.
7Ba bane ma tiini de fuli dedɛ
pa ba yɔɔre ba go ba yiga tiina bam.
Ba pwa bam maama da ma to tega ne,
ye ba wolowolo wo lwoori wolim amo tei ne.
Isarele dwi tiina de dwi-gɛ tiina taane
8Efrayim tiina bam gwaane ba tete de dwi-gɛ tiina bam mo.
Ba nye de maase delo ba na fɔge ba le
ye de wo bege de ti to mo.
9Sa-teena mo tu ba vere ba dam,
ye ba wo maane ko ni ne.
Ba yuu de laam peere
ye ba wo lɔre ko ni ne.
10Isarele tiina bam na bere ba tete kamunim tei to
bere we ba ba jege bora.
Ba nɛ kolo maama na yi-ba to,
ye ba ta ve se ba jwoori ba ba amo tei.
Amo mo ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom
ye ba ba lwoori wolim amo tei ne.
11Efrayim tiina bam ba jege swa.
Ba yeini ba ke ne kunkwoŋa na kare ka lɔgese teeni tei to mo.
Boboa to, ba vei Ejipti tiina bam tei mo,
se ba woli-ba,
ye ba daa lɛɛne ba duri ba vo Asiria tiina bam de tei.
12Ba nam na maa vei to,
a lage a ma ŋwe-choa mo a che-ba a ja ne zuna tei.
A ta wó waare-ba,
lwarem dem ba na ke to ŋwaane.
13Lɛɛro wo ba yuu ne!
Kokuri to, ba pipiri ba viiri amo tei ne.
Cham wó yi-ba,
ba na lɔge amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane.
A ya lage a vere-ba mo a yage,
ba nam fɔge vwa ba pa-ne.
14Ba ba yeini ba lwoori-ne de ba wo maama.
Ba tigi ba gadworu baŋa ne
ye ba laam chwoosa.
Ba maa yeini ba bɛ ba yera ba wara wone
se ba na wodiu de sana mo.
Ba nwoŋi amo kwaga ne mo konto.
15Amo mo korese-ba se a pa ba na dam.
De ko de, ba ta jege boboŋ-balwaaro de amo.
16Ba na beeri wolim to,
ba ba kwoni ba yum wɛɛne.
Ba nye de taŋa kalo na gugwoli to mo.
Ba nakwa bam wó to jara wone,
ba na bere ba tete kamunim to ŋwaane.
Mo kokuri Ejipti tiina bam wó taa jege-ba ba mɔna.”

english_text:
Israel Rejects the Lord
The Lord said:
1Sound a warning!
Israel, you broke our agreement
and ignored my teaching.
Now an eagle is swooping down
to attack my land.
2Israel, you say, “We claim you,
the Lord, as our God.”
3But your enemies
will chase you for rejecting
our good agreement.
4You chose kings and leaders
without consulting me;
you made silver and gold idols
that led to your downfall.
5City of Samaria, I'm angry
because of your idol
in the shape of a calf.
When will you ever
be innocent again?
6Someone from Israel built
that idol for you,
but only I am God.
And so it will be smashed
to pieces.
7If you scatter wind
instead of wheat,
you will harvest a whirlwind
and have no wheat.
Even if you harvest grain,
enemies will steal it all.
8Israel, you are ruined,
and now the nations
consider you worthless.
9You are like a wild donkey
that goes its own way.
You've run off to Assyria
and hired them as allies.
10You can bargain with nations,
but I'll catch you anyway.
Soon you will suffer abuse
by kings and rulers.
11Israel, you have built
many altars where you offer
sacrifices for sin.
But these altars have become
places for sin.
12My instructions for sacrifices
were written in detail,
but you ignored them.
13You sacrifice your best animals
and eat the sacrificial meals,
but I, the Lord,
refuse your offerings.
I will remember your sins
and punish you.
Then you will return to Egypt.
14Israel, I created you,
but you forgot me.
You and Judah built palaces
and many strong cities.
Now I will send fire to destroy
your towns and fortresses.
translation_text:
Isarele tiina bam jwona kaanem
1“Wu-na jara nabwanno!
Maao mo jaane wɛyuu ne ko foore
se ko chaale amo Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna bam.
Kokuri to, ba chɔge ni delo a na gwoni de-ba to.
Ba ta ma nwoŋi a bera yam kwaga ne.
2Isarele tiina bam mo lwoori-ne
ye ba tɛ ba we, ‘Nmo mo ye debam Wɛ,
ye dé me dede‑m.’
3Banto nɔɔ ta mo ve se ba taa tɔge chwo-laaro.
Mo kokuri ba dona wó pare-ba se ba ja.
4Ba tete ne mo, ba tiŋi ba pwa.
Ba wo ke amo ko wone.
Ba ta kuri yiga tiina
ye a wo pɛ-ba chwoŋa.
Ba kwei lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa mo ba ma mɔ jwona.
Ko lage ko ja chɔgem mo ko ba ko pa ba tete.
5Ko ná ye Samaria tiina bam,
a chuli jwoni delo ba na mɔɔne
ye de jege na-mɔra nyenyego to.
A ban-lom zaŋe ba baŋa ne!
Ba wó taa biini ba tete taa tento
se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo?
6Isarele teo tu gɔgɔ mo mɔɔne jwoni dem,
ko dae wɛ chekke.
Chega to, na-mɔra jwoni delo Samaria tiina na zuli to
lage de ba de chochoge mura-mura mo.
7Ba na dugi kolo to nye de vio mo.
Wodiu kolo ba na wó na ko baŋa ne to wó ji vo-dɛɔ.
Mena yalo na wó ke ba kare sem ne to
ye men-tintworru mo.
Ya bá wane ya ke muni.
Ba ya ná maŋe ba na wodiiru chekke,
sa-teena mo wó ba ba vere-te.
8Isarele teo kom wó ba ko ti.
Ko daa ba jege kuri dwi-gɛ tiina bam wone,
ne kam-boro tei.
9Isarele tiina bam jaane ba tete ba vo ba pa Asiria teo kom tiina mo,
ne kagoa wo bonaga na vei ka tete boboŋa veiŋa tei to.
Ko nye de Efrayim tiina bam kwei sabu mo
ba vo ba beeri bɔɔla tei.
10Ba ná maŋe ba vo ba beeri dwi-gɛ tiina bam wone
se ba na wolim ba tei ne,
amo ta lage a la-ba mo a ke daane se a waare-ba.
Pa-faro wom wó zaŋe ba baŋa ne
o pa se ko tiini ko zo ba yera.
11Efrayim dwi tiina bam lɔge kaanem bimbina dedɛ
ba wɛleera saarem ŋwaane.
Bimbina yam konto laam jigi jei selo
ba na yeini ba toŋe wɛleera da to mo.
12Amo popone a bera yam dedɛ a tiŋi
se ba wane ba lɔre ya maama.
Ba nam nii-ya pa ya ye wo-veiro mo ba tei ne.
13Ba maa yeini ba ja ba pɛɛra ba ba
ba ma ke kaanem ba pa-ne,
ye ba daare ba di ya nɔna yam.
Amo Baŋa Wɛ yi nam wo su de ba pɛɛra yam konto.
A laam wó guli ba na tusi tei to,
ye a daare a waare-ba ko ŋwaane.
A ta wó pa ba jwoori Ejipti teo kom.
14Kokuri to, Isarele tiina bam swei
amo wolo na ye ba Keiru wom to ni ne,
ye ba daare ba lɔ sɔ-fwaaro ba pa ba tete.
Judah dwi tiina bam de lɔge dam jei dedɛ mo
ba teene dem wone.
Amo nam wó pa se mini zwɛ ba teene dem,
de ba dam jei sem maama kula!”

english_text:
Israel Will Be Punished
1Israel, don't celebrate
or make noisy shouts
like other nations.
You have been unfaithful
to your God.
Wherever grain is threshed,
you behave like prostitutes
because you enjoy
the money you receive.
2But you will run short
of grain and wine,
3and you will have to leave
the land of the Lord.
Some of you will go to Egypt;
others will go to Assyria
and eat unclean food.
4You won't be able to offer
sacrifices of wine
to the Lord.
None of your sacrifices
will please him—
they will be unclean
like food offered to the dead.
Your food will only be used
to satisfy your hunger;
none of it will be brought
to the Lord's temple.
5You will no longer be able
to celebrate the festival
of the Lord.
6Even if you escape alive,
you will end up in Egypt
and be buried in Memphis.
Your silver treasures
will be lost among weeds;
thorns will sprout in your tents.
7 Israel, the time has come.
You will get what you deserve,
and you will know it.
“Prophets are fools,” you say.
“And God's messengers
are crazy.”
Your terrible guilt
has filled you with hatred.
8Israel, the Lord sent me
to look after you.
But you trap his prophets
and flood his temple
with your hatred.
9 You are brutal and corrupt,
as were the men of Gibeah.
But God remembers your sin,
and you will be punished.
Sin's Terrible Results
10 Israel, when I, the Lord,
found you long ago
it was like finding
grapes in a barren desert
or tender young figs.
Then you worshiped Baal Peor,
that disgusting idol,
and you became as disgusting
as the idol you loved.
11And so, Israel, your glory
will fly away like birds—
your women will no longer
be able to give birth.
12Even if you do have children,
I will take them all
and leave you to mourn.
I will turn away,
and you will sink down
in deep trouble.
13Israel, when I first met you,
I thought of you as palm trees
growing in fertile ground.
Now you lead your people out,
only to be slaughtered.
Hosea's Advice
14Our Lord, do just one thing
for your people—
make their women unable
to have children
or to nurse their babies.
The Lord's Judgment on Israel
15Israel, I first began
to hate you because
you did evil at Gilgal.
Now I will chase you
out of my house.
No longer will I love you;
your leaders betrayed me.
16Israel, you are a vine
with dried-up roots
and fruitless branches.
Even if you had more children
and loved them dearly,
I would slaughter them all.
Hosea Warns Israel
17Israel, you disobeyed my God.
Now he will force you to roam
from nation to nation.
translation_text:
Isarele tiina bam wó na waarem
1Isarele tiina bam, á yé ta‑á chake de wopwolo,
ne dwi-gɛ tiina bam na di ba kura yam tei to.
Kokuri to, á lɔge á Tu Wɛ wom kwaga ne,
ye á ta tɔge wa-yɔɔro.
Á swoi se á ta‑á jwoŋa kabworim kikia sabu
mena ferem jei sem maama ne.
2Abam nam na wó fere mena yalo to bá yi á dim.
Á ta na wó ŋoke Vini tio-bia se á na sana balo to bá yi abam.
3Isarele tiina bam bá na chwoŋa
se ba maŋe Baŋa Wɛ tega kam wone.
Efrayim tiina bam wó jwoori ba zo kabɛɛne wone mo,
ne ko déem na ke-ba Ejipti ne tei to.
Ba badwonna wó vo Asiria teo kom
ye ba di wodiu kolo ya na chuli se ba di to.
4Dáane ba bá taa kwei sana ba ke pɛɛra
ba ma ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.
Kaanem delo maama ba na wó ke ba pa‑o to bá su o yi.
Ba pɛɛra yam konto wó taa nye de
wodiu kolo ba na di lua sɔŋɔ ne to.
Wolo maama ná di-ko,
kotu wó digiri o tete chullu tem seeni.
Wodiu kom konto nam wó su banto kana yerane mo.
Ko bá lɛɛne ko vo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem wo.
5Dɛ dem ná tu de yi se á di kuri á zuli Baŋa Wɛ
ne á ya na yeini á ke tei to,
á laam wó ke tetɛ mo?
6Nii-na! Ba ná maŋe ba duri ba jage da yiga ne
se ba lu cham wone,
Ejipti tiina bam ta wó ja-ba.
Ba ta wó suli-ba Memfisi teo wone.
Man-chaŋa wó nwoŋi ka li ba lu-nyenno jejegero tem,
ye sabare de li ba di sem.
7Isarele tiina bam waarem maŋa kam yi ka ti.
Ba laam wó jwoŋi kolo na maŋe de ba lwarem kikia yam to.
Ba taa yei ko ni ne!
Ba boŋe we Wɛ sampwora kam yirisi mo.
Ba ta maa nii nɔn-popore nyem pa o ye chichwoo.
Ba yeini ba yaale Wɛ tontoŋena konto dwoŋi,
ba lwarem kikia na daga
ye ba nankɔɔre de gaale to ŋwaane.
8Sampwora kam nam ye Wɛ tontoŋeno mo.
O tu se o yere Efrayim tiina bam.
O nam ná vei mɛ maama,
ba yeini ba cho o chwoŋa.
O ná maŋe o wo Wɛ diga kam ne,
ba yeini ba chuli‑o mo.
9Ba tiini ba chɔge ba tete de totoŋ-zɔɔna,
ne ba déem na ke tei Gibea ne to.
Wɛ nam wó guli ba lwarem kikia yam,
ye o daare o waare-ba ya ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
10“Amo déem na bobo a na Isarele tiina bam to,
ba nye de Vini tio-bia mo na puli ba nwoŋi kagoa wone to.
A na nɛ á nabaara bam to,
ko nye de a nɛ mɔ-lelea na bega kaporo yuu ne to mo.
Ba nam na tu ba yi Baal-Peora jei sem to,
ba ma kwei ba tete ba pa wo-zɔɔne dem konto.
Ba tete laam jigi wo-zɔɔna
se ko maŋe de jwoni delo ba na zuli to.
11Efrayim tiina bam nenɔŋa lage ka jei mo,
ne zuŋa na jaane ka di wɛyuu tei to.
Bu-lore de pu-jara daa bá taa wora ba wone.
12Ba ná maŋe ba lo bia ye ba kɔne-ba,
amo wó pa se ba maama te,
pa se ba wolowolo daa yé daare.
Lɛɛro wó ba ba baŋa,
amo kwaga na wó ya-ba to ŋwaane.
13A nɛ Isarele teo kom na zege te-ywoŋa jei ne tei,
ne Tura teo kom na ye tei to.
Efrayim tiina bam nam jege se ba ja ba bia ba nwoŋi
se nɔɔna mo go-ba.”
14Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
a nam wó lwoori‑m
se n ke-ba tetɛ mo?
Kɔ ba lora kam,
se n daare n pa ba yele na de ko.
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
15“Giligal ne mo ba maŋe ba bobo ba lwarem kikia yanto.
Mo kokuri a laam chuli-ba.
Amo lage a zeili-ba se ba nwoŋi a tega kam baŋa ne,
ba lwarem totoŋa yam ŋwaane.
A daa bá taa jege ba swono.
Ba nakwa bam maama baare amo kwaga.
16Efrayim tiina bam weele mo.
Ba nye de tei-koro mo na koge ko zege ŋɔɔ
ye ko ba leiri bia to.
Ba nam ná maŋe ba lo,
a wó go ba bu-swonnu tem konto.”
17Amo Wɛ wom wó ve-ba,
de ba na wo sɛ o bera yam to ŋwaane.
Mo kokuri, ba wó taa kare ba beera
dwi-gɛ tiina bam wone.

english_text:
1You were a healthy vine
covered with grapes.
But the more grapes you grew,
the more altars you built;
the better off you became,
the better shrines you set up
for pagan gods.
2You are deceitful and disloyal.
So you will pay
for your sins,
because the Lord will destroy
your altars and images.
3“We don't have a king,”
you will say.
“We don't fear the Lord.
And what good are kings?”
4Israel, you break treaties
and don't keep promises;
you turn justice
into poisonous weeds
where healthy plants should grow.
5All who live in Samaria tremble
with concern for the idols
at sinful Bethel.
The idol there was the pride
of the priests,
but it has been put to shame;
now everyone will cry.
6It will be taken to Assyria
and given to the great king.
Then Israel will be disgraced
for worshiping that idol.
7Like a twig in a stream,
the king of Samaria
will be swept away.
8 The altars at sinful Bethel
will be destroyed
for causing Israel to sin;
they will be grown over
with thorns and thistles.
Then everyone will beg
the mountains and hills
to cover and protect them.
The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
9 Israel, you have never
stopped sinning
since that time at Gibeah.
That's why you
will be attacked at Gibeah.
10Your sins have doubled,
and you are rebellious.
Now I have decided
to send nations to attack
and put you in chains.
11Once you were obedient
like a calf
that loved to thresh grain.
But I will put a harness
on your beautiful neck;
you and Judah must plow
and cultivate the ground.
12 Plow your fields,
scatter seeds of justice,
and harvest faithfulness.
Worship me, the Lord,
and I will send my saving power
down like rain.
13You have planted evil,
harvested injustice, and eaten
the fruit of your lies.
You trusted your own strength
and your powerful forces.
14So war will break out,
and your fortresses
will be destroyed.
Your enemies will do to you
what Shalman did to the people
of Beth-Arbel—
mothers and their children
will be beaten to death
against rocks.
15Bethel, this will be your fate
because of your evil.
Israel, at dawn your king
will be killed.
translation_text:
1Isarele tiina bam déem nye de Vini tio
kolo kom na leigi tio-bia zɔrɔtɔtɔ to mo.
Ba nam na tiini ba puli dedɛ tei to,
ba kaanem bimbina yam de ye konto mo.
Ba tega kam maa na fɔge ka ke wodiiru lanyerane tei to,
ba kandwa yam ba na chwi ba jege ba zuli to mo
ba fɔge-ya se ya de taa tiini ya lamma.
2Ba ba jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ.
Mo kokuri ba jege se ba ŋwe ba wɛleera yam jene.
Baŋa Wɛ tete wó bwori ba kaanem bimbina yam,
ye o daare o yigi ba jwona kandwa yam o de tega ne.
3Ba nam wó taa ŋɔɔne ba we,
“Dé ba jege pɛ,
Baŋa Wɛ kɔrɔ na tera debam wone to ŋwaane.
Dé nam ya ná jege pɛ,
wonto wó wane o ke bɛ mo o pa debam?”
4Ba ni taane dem konto ye kafɛ mo.
Ba maa tɔge vwa baŋa ne ba gwoni ni
ye ba ta daare ba yiri-de.
Konto ŋwaane, nɔɔna tiini ba jege da-taane,
ne man-chaŋa na li tega tei to.
5Nɔɔna balo na zoore Samaria teo wone to yera sae mo
ye ba wo chɔge de na-mɔra jwoni dem
ba ya na zuli Bɛte-Aven ne to.
Banto de balo na ke kaanem ba pa-de to wó keeri de ŋwaane,
de na wó jei ba tei ne,
dedaane de nenɔŋa kam maama to.
6Nɔɔna wó zeŋe-de ba ja vo Asiria teo kom
se de ji jejegero de pa pa-faro wom.
Isarele dwi tiina bam wó di ba chaveera
de ba na zuli jwoni delo na ye da-kora to.
7Chega to, ba wó kale Samaria tiina bam de ba pɛ wom
ba ja vo jeiga yiga yiga,
ne na-dura na zeŋe da-kwolo ba ja viiri tei to.
8Jei selo Isarele tiina bam na toŋe puseŋa kikia
ye ba zuli jwona zwonnu yuu ne mɛ to
wó ba se chɔge.
Sabare de ga-cheiŋo wó nwoŋi te li bimbina yam maama.
Ba laam wó lwoori peero tem de zwonnu tem we,
te to ba baŋa ne te kwoli-ba.
Baŋa Wɛ wó waare Isarele tiina bam
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
9“Isarele tiina bam, ko zege maŋa kalo á na ke lwarem Gibea ne to se ko ba ko yi zem,
á yɔɔre á toŋe wɛleera mo maŋa maama.
Ko dae keim dem konto ŋwaane mo
jara déem yi puseŋ-nyena bam Gibea ne na?
10Amo boboŋa yam ná jaane ya ti,
a wó waare nɔn-lwanno tento mo.
Teene dedwonna wó ke ni daane
ba ba ba kwaare jara de-ba.
Ba maa wó vɔ-ba de chegero,
ba na tiini ba tusi ba daŋe da-baŋa ne to ŋwaane.
11Efrayim tiina bam déem nye de na-chwɛ
delo na wae de nɔne mena to mo.
Amo tete laam nam wó daŋe yɔgesa de ba ne,
se a pa de vaŋe naan-vɔrɔ.
Judah dwi tiina bam de jege se ba va!
Jakob dwi tiina bam de wó chɛ tega se ko zo ba yera.
12Nam kwaane-na á chɛ tega,
ye á daare á du chega á pa á tete,
se á wó na swolim á kikia baŋa ne.
Maŋa mo tento se á pipiri á ba amo tei.
Amo Baŋa Wɛ laam wó ke zaane á yuu ne,
ne doa na nena tei to.
13Abam nam na ke tei to,
á dugi lwarem yerane mo,
pa se á na lɛɛro á kikia baŋa ne.
Á na me de vwa fɔm to ŋwaane,
á nɛ nyɔɔre delo na maŋe de vwa to.
Á kwei á chega á daŋe á tete dam baŋa ne,
de á jar-keira na tiini ba daga tei to ŋwaane mo.
14Konto ŋwaane jara wó pɔpɔ ya to á wone,
pa se á dam jei sem maama chɔge.
Ko wó tiini ko zo á yera
ne ko na ke tei dɛ dem Saleman na chɔge
Bɛte-Arabel teo kom to.
Ba déem yigi niina de ba bia
ba de tega ne
ye ba daare ba nɔ-ba ba go.
15Ko ta lage ko ke abam Bɛtel tiina bam konto dwoŋi mo,
de puseŋa kikia yalo abam na ke to ŋwaane.
Dɛ dem konto ná yia,
Isarele tiina pɛ wom wó yɔɔre o te ko nɛ sem ni ne.”

english_text:
God's Love for His People
1 When Israel was a child,
I loved him, and I called
my son out of Egypt.
2But as the saying goes,
“The more they were called,
the more they rebelled.”
They never stopped offering
incense and sacrifices
to the idols of Baal.
3I took Israel by the arm
and taught them to walk.
But they would not admit
that I was the one
who had healed them.
4I led them with kindness
and with love,
not with ropes.
I held them close to me;
I bent down to feed them.
5But they rejected me,
and so must return to Egypt;
now Assyria will rule them.
6War will visit their cities,
and their plans will fail.
7My people are determined
to reject me for a god
they think is stronger,
but he can't help.
8 Israel, I can't let you go.
I can't give you up.
How could I possibly destroy you
as I did the towns of Admah
and Zeboiim?
I just can't do it.
My feelings for you
are much too strong.
9Israel, I won't lose my temper
and destroy you again.
I am the Holy God—
not merely some human,
and I won't stay angry.
10I, the Lord, will roar like a lion,
and my children will return,
trembling from the west.
11They will come back,
fluttering like birds from Egypt
or like doves from Assyria.
Then I will bring them
back to their homes.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Israel and Judah Compared
12Israel is deceitful to me,
their loyal and holy God;
they surround me with lies,
and Judah worships
other gods.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ jege o nɔɔna swono
1“Amo swoi Isarele ko nwoŋi o biini ne mo.
A ma bwoŋi a bu-swono kom se o nwoŋi Ejipti ne o ba.
2A nam na tiini a kwoori Isarele dwi dem
se de jwoori de ba amo tei to
mo ba yɔɔre ba ma ba kwaga ba ya amo.
A nɔɔna bam ma ke kaanem ba pa Baal jwona yam,
ye ba kwei pɛɛra ba zwɛ ba zuli jwona yadwonna.
3Amo mo taase Efrayim tiina bam pa ba lɔre veiŋa.
A ma ja ba jea se ba taa via.
Ba nam wo maane we ko ye amo mo nii ba baŋa ne.
4A ma tɔge swono wone a korese-ba,
ne a vaŋe-ba de ŋone mo to.
A kwei-ba mo a daŋe a nyɔɔne baŋa ne.
A ma tiiri tega ne a pa-ba wodiu se ba di.
5Ba nam wó jwoori ba vo Ejipti.
Asiria tiina de wó taa tei-ba,
ba na ve se ba pipiri ba jwoori amo tei to ŋwaane.
6Jara wó to ba teene dem wone.
Ba dona wó bwori ba teene dem ni bworru
ba de tega ne.
Jara yam wó yɔɔre ya chɔge a nɔɔna bam,
de ba na tɔge ba tete boboŋa tei to.
7Ba boboŋa jaane se ba ja ba tete ba nwoŋi amo tei ne.
Ba ma lwoori wolim wɛyuu ne.
De ko de, Wɛ bá le-ba ba cham wone.
8Efrayim dwi tiina bam,
a nam wó wane a yage abam mo na?
A bá wane a dɔne a jeŋa Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne.
A bá sɛ se á na chɔgem,
nenɛɛne chɔgem delo na yi Adema de Zeboyiim tei to.
A boboŋa bá pa-ne chwoŋa se a ke konto,
a na tiini a jege abam ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane.
9A bá pa a ban-lom zaŋe á baŋa ne.
A daa bá chɔge Efrayim dwi tiina bam.
Kokuri to, a ye Wɛ mo,
ye a dae nabiinu na ye tei to.
Amo ye Wo-pwoŋo Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo
ye a wo abam tetare ne.
A bá ba á tei de ban-zɔŋɔ.
10Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó suuri ne nywoŋo mo tei,
pa se a bia bam laam ba ba pu amo kwaga.
Chega to, a ná suuri konto dwoŋi,
ba wó zege wɛ-zoore seeni ba ba
ye ba yera sae.
11Ba badwonna wó nwoŋi Ejipti ne ba jwoori amo tei,
ye ba yera sae ne zuna na pipeigi ba vɔna se ba jaane tei to.
Ba badaara wó zege Asiria teo wone ba ba,
ne kunkwon-puli dwoŋi tei.
A laam wó ja-ba a jwoori ba sam
se ba taa wora.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
Baŋa Wɛ jege taane de Isarele tiina bam
Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we:
12“Efrayim dwi tiina bam jaane vwa mo ba ba amo tei.
Isarele tiina bam maa tiini ba jege-ne ba gana.
Judah tiina bam nam tɔge Wɛ kwaga mo ba kare ba beera.
Ba jege chega de Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom.

english_text:
1All day long Israel chases
wind from the desert;
deceit and violence
are found everywhere.
Treaties are made with Assyria;
olive oil is taken to Egypt.
Israel and Judah Condemned
2The Lord also brings charges
against the people of Judah,
the descendants of Jacob.
He will punish them
for what they have done.
3 Even before Jacob was born,
he cheated his brother,
and when he grew up,
he fought against God.
4 At Bethel, Jacob wrestled
with an angel and won;
then with tears in his eyes,
he asked for a blessing,
and God spoke to us there.
5God's name is the Lord,
the Lord God All-Powerful.
6So return to your God.
Patiently trust him,
and show love and justice.
7Israel, you enjoy cheating
and taking advantage
of others.
8You say to yourself, “I'm rich!
I earned it all on my own,
without committing a sin.”
The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
9 Israel, I, the Lord,
am still your God,
just as I have been
since the time
you were in Egypt.
Now I will force you
to live in tents once again,
as you did in the desert.
10I spoke to the prophets—
often I spoke in visions.
And so, I will send my prophets
with messages of doom.
11Gilead is terribly sinful
and will end up ruined.
Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal
on altars made of stones,
but those stones will be scattered
in every field.
12 Jacob escaped to Syria
where he tended sheep
to earn himself a wife.
13 I sent the prophet Moses
to lead Israel from Egypt
and to keep them safe.
14Israel, I will make you pay
for your violent crimes
and for insulting me.
translation_text:
1Efrayim tiina bam ni-wodiu ye vio mo.
Ba maa yeini ba pare vio na nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni to
se ba kwaane ba ja-ko.
Vwa de puseŋa kikia mo ba jege ba toŋe maŋa maama.
Ba maa jaane ba tete ba vei ba ke ni-sɛɛm de Asiria tiina,
ye ba daare ba ke nuga pipiu de Ejipti tiina.”
2 Baŋa Wɛ ti o yiga mo se o bwɛ Judah tiina bam.
O lage o waare Jakob dwi tiina bam ba totoŋe nɛ ŋwaane mo.
O maa wó jwoori o ŋwe ba tusim kikia yam jene ba yuu ne.
3Jakob ta na wo o nu puga wone to,
o déem zo jaŋa mo de o choro Esawu,
de ba na ye yeywa daane to.
O ta na ke nɔɔno to
mo o dwoni de Wɛ.
4O ma jaŋe de Wɛ maleka kam o wane-ka o di.
O déem keeri mo lanyerane
se o wane o na Wɛ swolim.
Bɛtel ne mo o jeeri de Wɛ,
ye Wɛ de ŋɔɔne ded‑o.
5Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo konto.
Baŋa Wɛ mo o yere, de na maŋe de zula!
6Abam nam maŋe se á jwoori á Tu Wɛ wom tei.
Fɔge-na á ta‑á tɔge swono de chega,
ye á jege Baŋa Wɛ teena maŋa maama.
7Á pipiina bam jege bwɛ selo na muri to mo.
Ba maa swoi se ba taa pini ba yeilla bam.
8Efrayim tiina bam maa tɛ ba we,
“Nii-na dé na duni tei!
Dé nɛ jejegero dé pa dé tete!
Dé na toŋe tei maama dé na nyɔɔre to,
nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá na dé tusim se o ma o bwɛ debam.”
9Amo mo ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo wom na jaane abam
a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone to.
A ta wó pa á jwoori á ta‑á zoore vwoa wone,
ne á déem na zoore tei kagoa kam wone to.
10Amo déem ŋɔɔne de a sampwori sem.
A ma veere wonnu dedɛ a bere-ba.
A tɔge ba baŋa mo
a pa a nɔɔna bam lɔre a boboŋa.
11Puseŋa kikia daga Gilead ne mo na?
Balo na zoore da to nam lage ba jei mo!
Giligal ne ba yeini ba ma nabɛ mo
ba ke kaanem ba pa jwona na?
Ba kaanem bimbina kandwa yam wó sirimi tega ne,
ye ba dogele-ya ba tiŋi ba kare ne.
12Jakob déem duri o vo o zoore Aram ne mo.
O ma toŋe o pa nɔɔno wodwoŋi
se o pa‑o kaane se o di.
O yeini o yere pei mo
se ko taa ye o kaane wom kwora.
13 Baŋa Wɛ déem mo tɔge o sampwora baŋa ne
o jwoŋi Isarele dwi tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti ne.
Wɛ ta ma pa se o sampwora kam taa nii ba baŋa ne.
14Efrayim tiina bam nam tiini ba chuchugi Wɛ bane.
Ba jege se ba na waarem ba lwarem kikia ŋwaane mo.
Ba Teiru wom wó jwoori o ŋwe ba wɛleera yam jene ba yuu ne,
ba na yaale‑o tei to ŋwaane.

english_text:
Israel Is Doomed
The Lord said:
1When your leaders spoke,
everyone in Israel trembled
and showed great respect.
But you sinned by worshiping Baal,
and you were destroyed.
2Now you continue to sin
by designing and making
idols of silver
in the shape of calves.
You are told to sacrifice
to these idols—
yes, even to kiss them.
3And so, all of you will vanish
like the mist or the dew
of early morning,
or husks of grain in the wind
or smoke from a chimney.
4I, the Lord, have been your God
since the time
you were in Egypt.
I am the only God you know,
the only one who can save.
5 I took care of you
in a thirsty desert.
6I fed you till you were satisfied,
then you became proud
and forgot about me.
7Now I will attack like a lion,
ambush you like a leopard,
8and rip you apart like a bear
robbed of her cubs.
I will gnaw on your bones,
as though I were a lion
or some other wild animal.
9Israel, you are done for.
Don't expect help from me.
10 You wanted a king and rulers.
Where is your king now?
What cities have rulers?
11 In my anger, I gave you a king;
in my fury, I took him away.
Israel's Terrible Fate
The Lord said:
12Israel, your terrible sins
are written down
and stored away.
13You are like a senseless child
who refuses to be born
at the proper time.
14 Should I, the Lord, rescue you
from death and the grave?
No! I call death and the grave
to strike you like a plague.
I refuse to show mercy.
15No matter if you prosper
more than the other tribes,
I, the Lord, will wipe you out,
just as a scorching desert wind
dries up streams of water.
I will take away
your precious treasures.
16Samaria will be punished
for turning against me.
It will be destroyed in war—
children will be beaten
against rocks,
and pregnant women
will be ripped open.
translation_text:
Lɛɛro wó yi Isarele tiina bam
1Efrayim yiga tiina bam déem na puri ba ni ba ta taane to,
lwia mo jaane Isarele dwia yadwonna yam,
ba na tiini ba kɔre Efrayim dwi dem to ŋwaane.
Ba nam ke ba tusi de ba na zuli Baal tei to.
Konto mo tei ba maŋe se ba te.
2Ba daa ta tiini ba tusi ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Ba yeini ba kwei lu-nyenno mo ba ma mɔ jwona se ba zuli-ya.
Ba maa tɔge ba boboŋa na lage tei to,
ye ba pa se gwaro mo fɔge te ke wonnu tem.
Ba yeini ba ta jwo-kaana bam konto taane ba we,
ba ye balo na kukwori na-mɔre to mo.
3Mo kokuri nɔɔna bam konto bá dáane ye ba jei.
Ba wó taa nye de kunu kolo na tui zezeŋa ne
ye ko jei lela to,
naa nyɔnɔ kolo na toa ye ko ba dáane to mo.
Ba ta wó taa nye de vio na kale swanno telo ko ja viiri to,
naa nyoa na tɔge natwoŋo ka nwoŋi ka kɛ to mo.
4Amo mo ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo wom na jaane abam
a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone to.
Wɛ dedwoŋi tera á na jege se á lɔre-de
ye ko dae amo.
Jwoŋinu wodwoŋi maa tera ko ná dae amo.
5Abam déem na beeri kagoa wone
mɛ na ye te-kora yerane to,
amo mo nii á baŋa ne.
6A nam na pɛ á kwoa bam wodiu se ba di to,
ba di ba su ba ta daare.
Ba na di ba su konto to,
ba laam ma bere ba tete kamunim,
ye ba swei amo ni ne.
7Mo kokuri a lage a pɔpɔ a ba ba baŋa ne
nenɛɛne nywoŋo dwoŋi tei.
A ta wó che ba chwoŋa,
ne gweeru na peini o che chwoŋa tei to.
8Amo wó zaŋe ba baŋa ne
nenɛɛne nywoŋ-kura kalo ba na vere ka bia ba daare-ka tei to,
ye a daare a kaare ba nyɔɔna.
A ta wó chɔge-ba lela ko nɛ sem ni ne.
A maa wó tore-ba yera yera,
ne nywoŋo na tore vara tei to,
naa kago-varem na yeini o ke tei to.
9Isarele tiina bam, lɛɛro wo á yuu ne!
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó zeini abam.
10Á pɛ wom bɛ?
Wonto wó wane o jwoŋi abam na?
Se balo na ye nakwa á teene dem maama ne to
de wó wane abam ba zeini na?
Abam déem nam lage pwa de nakwa
se ba taa nii abam baŋa ne.
11Amo ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne mo
a déem tiŋi pɛ a pa abam.
A nam ta daare a le wonto á wone,
a ban-lom na fuli á baŋa ne to ŋwaane.
12Efrayim tiina bam tusim kikia yam mo wo ba yuu ne.
Ba wɛleera yam maama popone ya tiŋi mo,
se ba yɔɔre ba na waarem ya ŋwaane.
13Ko nye de kaane na virigi puga se o lo tei to.
Isarele dwi dem nam nye de bu-chechɔgɔ mo.
Bu wom lora maŋa ná yia,
o bá sɛ se o virigi o ba o nu yiga.
14Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam wó vere-ba toone jeŋa ne a yage na?
Amo wó jwoŋi-ba se ba yé zo churu mo na?
Toone, n dam dem nam daa bɛ?
N daa‑n bá wane n chɔge-ba na?
Amo nam bá duri a nɔɔna bam ŋwaŋa.
15Ba ná maŋe ba puli lanyerane
ba dwoni ba chorro tem tei,
Baŋa Wɛ ta wó pa vo-loŋo nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni
ko ba ko chɔge-ba.
Vio kom wó zege kagoa kam wone
ko ba ko we ba bwi sem maama.
Ko maa wó pa se ba ga wonnu telo maama na jege lonne te pa-ba to.
16Samaria tiina bam ye se ba na waarem,
ba na nwoŋi ba Tu Wɛ wom kwaga ne to ŋwaane.
Ba dona wó go-ba jara wone.
Ba maa wó yigi ba bu-sese ba de tega ne ba go,
ye ba daare ba lɔ ba kapwi ba pwi seeni ba go.

english_text:
Turn Back to the Lord
1Israel, return! Come back
to the Lord, your God.
Sin has made you fall.
2Return to the Lord and say,
“Please forgive our sins.
Accept our good sacrifices
of praise instead of bulls.
3Assyria can't save us,
and chariots can't help.
So we will no longer worship
the idols we have made.
Our Lord, you show mercy
to orphans.”
The Lord Promises To Forgive
4Israel, you have rejected me,
but my anger is gone;
I will heal you and love you
without limit.
5I will be like the dew—
then you will blossom like lilies
and have roots like a tree.
6Your branches will spread
with the beauty
of an olive tree
and with the aroma
of Lebanon Forest.
7You will rest in my shade,
and your grain will grow.
You will blossom
like a vineyard
and be famous as the wine
from Lebanon.
8Israel, give up your idols!
I will answer your prayers
and take care of you.
I am that glorious tree,
the source of your fruit.
9If you are wise, you will know
and understand what I mean.
I am the Lord, and I lead you
along the right path.
If you obey me,
we will walk together,
but if you are wicked,
you will stumble.
translation_text:
Isarele tiina ná leiri ba wo, Wɛ wó yɔɔre-ba.
1Isarele tiina bam, pipiri-na
á jwoori á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei.
Á wɛleera yam mo pɛ se á tiri á to tega ne.
2Kwei-na wɛ-lworo á yi Baŋa Wɛ tei.
Ta-na ded‑o we:
“Yage dé wɛleera yam maama n ma n chɛ debam,
se n ke debam zaane ye n jwoŋi debam.
Dé laam wó zuli nmo yere,
pa se ko ji pɛɛre ko pa nmo,
se ko leiri na-bale sem dé na ma dé ke kaanem to yuu ne.
3Asiria tiina bam bá wane debam ba jwoŋi ba yage.
Dé daa bá di sisein-nɔɔna baŋa dé zo jara wo.
Ko ná ye wonnu telo dé je na mɔɔne to,
dé daa bá kwei-te dé ma ji dé wa dé zuli.
Nmo yerane mo jege yibwona n pae botara.”
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
4“Amo wó yɔɔre a nɔɔna bam,
de ba na nwoŋi amo kwaga ne to de.
A maa wó taa swoi-ba de a wo maama.
Amo laam peene a bane mo
se de daa yé zaŋe ba baŋa ne.
5Amo wó pa se Isarele tiina bam bochara zuri,
ne doa na zuri te-kora tei to.
Ba wó taa jege nenɔŋa nenɛɛne kantɔgela na ye tei to.
Ba kuri wó ja tega lanyerane,
ne Lebanon laŋa kam tei-ŋonno tei.
6Ba ta wó puli lanyerane,
ne tio na kwi vɔɔro tei to.
Ba lam de Olivi tio lam mo wó taa nye daane.
Ba wó taa jege ywoni,
ne Lebanon teeni lwom na ywomma tei to.
7Ba wó jwoori ba taa zoore amo woro kom kuri ne,
ye ba du mena ba na wodiiru dedɛ.
Ba ŋwea maa wó ke lanyerane,
ne Vini tio na leiri bia dedɛ tei to.
Ba yere de wó zaŋe jei maama ne,
ne Lebanon teo sana bam na jege yere tei to.
8Efrayim tiina bam, amo yiga wo jwona wone na?
Amo mo wó jwoŋi á wara yam,
ye a nii á baŋa ne.
A jege woro a pa abam,
ne tio kolo na kwi vɔɔro maŋa maama to mo.
Á na nɛ wo-laaro telo to nwoŋi amo tei ne mo.”
9Abam wolo maama ná jege boboŋa,
kotu jege se o ni taane dento kuri.
Wolo ná jege yi-poro,
kotu jege se o ke-de o bochare ne.
Baŋa Wɛ chwei sem yɔɔre se ye chega.
Nɔn-ŋona wó taa tɔge-se.
Ko nam ná ye balo na ve Wɛ to,
banto wó chɔɔle ba to se wone.

english_text:
1I am Joel the son of Pethuel.
And this is the message
the Lord gave to me.
Locusts Cover the Land
2Listen, you leaders
and everyone else
in the land.
Has anything like this
ever happened before?
3Tell our children!
Let it be told
to our grandchildren
and their children too.
4Swarm after swarm of locusts
has attacked our crops,
eating everything in sight.
5Sober up, you drunkards!
Cry long and loud;
your wine supply is gone.
6 A powerful nation
with countless troops
has invaded our land.
They have the teeth and jaws
of powerful lions.
7Our grapevines and fig trees
are stripped bare;
only naked branches remain.
8Grieve like a young woman
mourning for the man
she was to marry.
9Offerings of grain and wine
are no longer brought
to the Lord's temple.
His servants, the priests,
are deep in sorrow.
10Barren fields mourn;
grain, grapes, and olives
are scorched and shriveled.
11Mourn for our farms
and our vineyards!
There's no wheat or barley
growing in our fields.
12Grapevines have dried up
and so has every tree—
figs and pomegranates,
date palms and apples.
All happiness has faded away.
Return to God
13Mourn, you priests who serve
at the altar of my God.
Spend your days and nights
wearing sackcloth.
Offerings of grain and wine
are no longer brought
to the Lord's temple.
14Tell the leaders and people
to come together
at the temple.
Order them to go without eating
and to pray sincerely.
15 We are in for trouble!
Soon the Lord All-Powerful
will bring disaster.
16Our food is already gone;
there's no more celebrating
at the temple of our God.
17Seeds dry up in the ground;
no harvest is possible.
Our barns are in bad shape,
with no grain
to store in them.
18Our cattle wander aimlessly,
moaning for lack of pasture,
and sheep are suffering.
19I cry out to you, Lord.
Grasslands and forests are eaten
by the scorching heat.
20Wild animals have no water
because of you;
rivers and streams are dry,
and pastures are parched.
translation_text:
1 Baŋa Wɛ mo kwei taane dento o pa Petuweli bu Joweli:
Kayere kɔgɔ na yo tega kam tei to
2Abam balo na ye nakwa to, cheigi-na!
Balo maama de na zoore tega kam wone to,
cheigi-na taane dento.
Abam na zaŋe pa á ŋwe to,
á ta nɛ konto woŋo dwoŋi na ke á yibia ne na?
Á kwoa bam de déem nɛ ko dwoŋi na?
3Ta-na taane dento á bere á bia,
se banto de ta-de se ba de bia ni de ŋwa,
ye banto de daa wó lwoni ba bere ba de bia.
4Kayere kɔgɔ kɔgɔ tu se saŋe da-kwaga ne mo.
Se kɔgɔ kom kodwoŋi na deilimi se daare kolo ye se kɛ to,
mo kayere kɔro telo na saŋe to tu se di maama nyɔ!
5Sa-nyɔra bam, zaŋe-na dɔɔm wone se á ta‑á keera,
kokuri sa-ywoŋo daa tera se á nyɔ.
6Kayere sem nye de jar-keira na mage kɔgɔ tei to mo,
ye se tiini se yo tega kam ni maama ne.
Se tiini se daga,
ye se ta dana se ko gaale.
Se yeila yam di mo filam filam,
nenɛɛne nywoŋo yeila na ye tei to.
7Se yɔɔre se chɔge Vini teeni dem,
dedaane kaporro tem maama.
Se lɔɔre teeni dem kwaga mo,
ye se laam daare teeni dem fem yerane,
pa de zega pwona pwona.
8Ta‑á keeri-na nenɛɛne bukɔ-pwola
kalo na gɛ ka baro to na wó taa keeri o lua tei to.
9Kokuri to, wodiu de sana daa tera
se ba ma ba ke pɛɛra Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.
Wɛ kaanem tiina bam keeri mo ga bɔge-bɔge
kolo ŋwaane pɛɛra daa tera se ba ma zuli Baŋa Wɛ.
10Kare sem maama chɔge,
ye tega kam baŋa maama ye yiniga mo puna.
Wodiiru tem maama ti.
Sa-ywoŋo ti, ye nuga de daa tera.
11Vala bam, abam de pa se á wo chɔge!
Ta‑á keeri-na se ko zaŋe wɛɛne bɔge bɔge,
kokuri, mena yam maama chɔge.
Faao kom wo jaane kuri.
12Vini teeni dem dedaane kaporro tem maama kwaare kwaare mo te zega.
Teeni dem maama koga pa se de ba leiri bia:
Pomegara teeni, de kaligwonnu,
de konkware sem maama yɔɔre se te mo.
Nɔɔna bam teena maama de ma ti.
Ko ye se nɔɔna bam mo chuli ba wɛleera
13Wɛ kaanem tiina bam,
abam balo na yeini á toŋe Baŋa Wɛ bimbini dem ŋwaane to,
lɛ-na gare-nyenyaaro se á daare á ta‑á keera.
Ko ye se á zo Wɛ diga mo tete ne,
ye á laam keeri se ko taa nii te-pora maŋa,
kokuri wodiiru de sana tera
se á kaane á pa á Tu Wɛ wom.
14Ta-na se nɔɔna bam jeeri ba vɔ ni Wɛ ŋwaane!
Bwoŋi-na ba maama se ba la daane ba zuli Wɛ.
Ko ná ye nakwa bam,
dedaane balo maama na zoore tega kam ne to,
pa-na se ba ba ba jeeri Wɛ diga kam ne,
se ba maama keeri ba jare‑o dáane.
15 Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom tiini ko bwola dedɛ!
De ná yia,
ko wó taa ye Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom mo pɛ se chɔgem ba.
Dɛ dem wó tiini de taa ye lɛɛro na!
16Dé yɔɔre dé zege dé nii mo,
ye dé wodiiru jege te chɔga.
Debam Tu Wɛ zula diga kam ywoni maama ti.
17Wo-dwa bam maama maŋe tega ne mo ba pɔ.
Dé tuli sem maama laam chɔge mo se zega,
wodiu na tera se dé tiŋi to ŋwaane.
18Vara bam maama keeri kana mo.
Ba maa beeri yɔɔ yerane, ba tɔge wodiu kwaga.
Bone de pei sem maama yɔɔre se yaare mo.
