19 Baŋa Wɛ, amo nam wó keeri a jare nmo mo!
Kokuri to, ko nye de mini mo zwɛ gaao maama kula!
Teeni dem maama de maa kwaare de zega.
20Kago-vara tete de keeri mo ba jare nmo,
kokuri to, bwi sem koge mo
ye na daa tera se ba nyɔ.
Chega to, mini zwɛ gaao kom maama mo kula!

english_text:
Locusts and an Enemy Army
1Sound the trumpet on Zion,
the Lord's sacred hill.
Warn everyone to tremble!
The judgment day of the Lord
is coming soon.
2It will be dark and gloomy
with storm clouds overhead.
Troops will cover the mountains
like thunderclouds.
No army this powerful
has ever been gathered before
or will be gathered again.
3Fiery flames surround them;
no one escapes.
Before they invaded,
the land was like Eden;
now only a desert remains.
4 They look like horses
and charge like cavalry.
5They roar over mountains
like noisy chariots,
or a mighty army
ready for battle.
They are a forest fire
that feasts on straw.
6The very sight of them
is frightening.
7They climb over walls
like warriors;
they march in columns
and never turn aside.
8They charge straight ahead,
without pushing each other;
even arrows and spears
cannot make them retreat.
9They swarm over city walls
and enter our homes;
they crawl in through windows,
just like thieves.
10 They make the earth tremble
and the heavens shake;
the sun and moon turn dark,
and stars stop shining.
11 The Lord God leads this army
of countless troops,
and they obey his commands.
The day of his judgment
is so terrible
that no one can stand it.
The Lord's Invitation
12The Lord said:
It isn't too late.
You can still return to me
with all your heart.
Start crying and mourning!
Go without eating.
13Don't rip your clothes
to show your sorrow.
Instead, turn back to me
with broken hearts.
I am merciful, kind, and caring.
I don't easily lose my temper,
and I don't like to punish.
14I am the Lord your God.
Perhaps I will change my mind
and treat you with mercy.
Then you will be blessed
with enough grain and wine
for offering sacrifices to me.
15Sound the trumpet on Zion!
Call the people together.
Show your sorrow
by going without food.
16 Make sure that everyone
is fit to worship me.
Bring adults, children, babies,
and even bring newlyweds
from their festivities.
17 Tell my servants, the priests,
to cry inside the temple
and to offer this prayer
near the altar:
“Save your people, Lord God!
Don't let foreign nations
make jokes about us.
Don't let them laugh and ask,
‘Where is your God?’ ”
The Lord Will Bless the Land
18The Lord was deeply concerned
about his land
and had pity on his people.
19In answer to their prayers
he said,
“I will give you enough grain,
wine, and olive oil
to satisfy your needs.
No longer will I let you
be insulted by the nations.
20An army attacked from the north,
but I will chase it
into a scorching desert.
There it will rot and stink
from the Dead Sea
to the Mediterranean.”
The Lord works wonders
21and does great things.
So tell the soil to celebrate
22and wild animals
to stop being afraid.
Grasslands are green again;
fruit trees and fig trees
are loaded with fruit.
Grapevines are covered
with grapes.
23People of Zion,
celebrate in honor
of the Lord your God!
He is generous and has sent
the autumn and spring rains
in the proper seasons.
24Grain will cover
your threshing places;
jars will overflow
with wine and olive oil.
The Lord Will Rescue His People
25I, the Lord your God,
will make up for the losses
caused by those swarms
and swarms of locusts
I sent to attack you.
26My people, you will eat
until you are satisfied.
Then you will praise me
for the wonderful things
I have done.
Never again will you
be put to shame.
27Israel, you will know
that I stand at your side.
I am the Lord your God—
there are no other gods.
Never again will you
be put to shame.
The Lord Will Work Wonders
The Lord said:
28 Later, I will give my Spirit
to everyone.
Your sons and daughters
will prophesy.
Your old men
will have dreams,
and your young men
will see visions.
29In those days I will even give
my Spirit to my servants,
both men and women.
30I will work wonders
in the sky above
and on the earth below.
There will be blood and fire
and clouds of smoke.
31 The sun will turn dark,
and the moon
will be as red as blood
before that great
and terrible day
when I appear.
32 Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_text:
Kayere kɔgɔ na bere Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom tei to
1Zaŋe-na á wu tigura nabɔnɔ kom,
se ko sɔɔ kom zaŋe Wɛ tete peo Zion yuu ne.
Ko ye se foone tiini de ja balo maama na zoore tega kam baŋa ne to,
kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom lage de yi lela mo.
De tiini de bwola dedɛ.
2Dento dɛ dem wó taa ye lim yerane mo.
Kunkwonnu tem wó zwori
te li tega kam maama!
Kokuri to, nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ mo maa beena,
ye ba kwoli zwonnu laŋa kam maama.
Ko zege faŋa faŋa, lɛɛro konto dwoŋi ta wo yi logo kom,
ye ko dwoŋi de nam ta bá fɔge ko ke.
3Ba nye de min-vogo na di yiga de kwaga maama tei to mo.
Ba yiga ne to, tega kam nye de Eden telaao kom mo.
Ba kwaga seeni to, ka maa nye de kagoa wo kasolo kom.
Kolokolo bá wane ko lu ba tei ne.
4Ba ta nye de sisein-nɔɔna mo,
ye ba yɔɔre ba duri lela,
nenɛɛne sisei selo ba na ma ba ke jara to.
5Ba na diini peero tem yupara to,
ba tiini ba duri dedɛ.
Ba sɔɔ kom nye de sisei-torokooro sɔɔ mo.
Ba nɛ sem na dɔne tei to
nye de mini na yeini de zwɛ ga-korro
pa ko dɔne tei to mo.
Ba ta saŋe da-kwaga mo
nenɛɛne jar-keira na lage se ba ke jara tei.
6Nɔɔna dwi maama ná nɛ-ba,
foone mo yeini de tiini de zo-ba,
ye ba yiga maama nyɔne!
7Nɔɔna bam ná yi mɛ maama,
ba yeini ba yɔɔre yiga kam mo
nenɛɛne bembɛ na kwaare jara tei to.
Ba ta wae ba faŋe ba gaale kabiri sem
ba zoore teene dem ba jaana.
Ba maama tɔge ba chwoŋa mo,
ye ba ba fɔge ba ywori ba daare-ka.
8Ba ba yeini ba peene daane.
Nɔɔno maama tɔge o chwoŋa mo.
Kolokolo ware ba yiga se ko che,
ko ná maŋe ko ye chichwoa de chena maama de.
9Ba ná yi teo kolo maama,
ba wó meeli-ko mo,
ye ba dɔɔle ko kabiri sem baŋa ne.
Ba maa yeini ba ŋɔ ba zo ko di sem wone,
nenɛɛne ŋweena na ke tei to.
10Tega kam baŋa maa ziziŋi ba yiga ne.
Wɛyuu kom de maa sua.
Wea kam de chana kam maama ma ji lim.
Chalechwe sem pwooni de daa maa tera.
11 Baŋa Wɛ di o jar-keira bam yiga.
O kwora kam maa tiini ka zaŋa de baare!
Ko ná ye kɔ-fɔrɔ kolo na tɔge o kwaga ye ba sɛ o ni to,
n bá‑n wane n jeeli n lɔre ba ni.
Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom jege foone dedɛ!
Wɔ mo wó wane o zege de wone?
Leiri-na á bochara yam
12 Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo o we:
“De konto maama, maŋa ta wo kɛ.
Jwoori-na á ba amo tei ne dedaane á wo maama.
Ta‑á vɔ-na á nia ye á keera,
se á ba amo yiga ne de á wo-chechɔgɔ.
13Pa-na se á wom tem seene te chɔge,
ye ko dae á na vaŋe á gwaaro á kaare kaare tei to yerane.”
Jwoori-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei,
kokuri to o zaane dem gaale,
ye o jege nɔɔna yibwona.
O maa yeini o peene o bane,
ye o swono gaale.
O ba swoi se o taa toŋe waarem nɔɔna baŋa ne.
14Wɔ mo wó wane o lɔre?
Dɛ delo abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wó leiri o boboŋa,
se o daare o duri abam ŋwaŋa,
ye o ke zaane á yuu ne.
Abam laam maa wó neene de wodiiru dedaane sana,
se á ma‑á ke kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ.
15Wu-na nabɔnɔ kom Zion peo kom yuu ne.
Ta-na se nɔɔna bam jeeri ba vɔ ni Wɛ ŋwaane!
Bwoŋi-na ba maama se ba la daane ba zuli Wɛ.
16Pa-na se á kɔgɔ kom maama kwɛ ba tete Wɛ ŋwaane,
se ba daare ba jeeri Wɛ yiga ne.
Bwoŋi-na nɔn-kwe se ba nwoŋi ba ba,
ko ta woli de bia de bu-sese selo ta na ŋɔge ba niina yela to de.
Baaro de kaane wolo na zo daane leile to de wó yage ba bwoŋ-yeila dim mo,
ye ba daare ba nwoŋi ba di sem ne
ye ba da ba jeeri dáane.
17Se ko ná ye kaanem tiina bam na toŋe ba pae Baŋa Wɛ to,
banto ye se ba zo Wɛ diga kam ne mo.
Ba laam maa wó taa zege diga kam ni dem dedaane kaanem bimbini dem tetare laŋa ne mo,
ba keera ye ba lwoori Wɛ ba we:
“Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, duri n nɔɔna bam ŋwaŋa se n yé waare-ba.
Yé sɛ se dwi-gɛ tiina bam taa jege n nɔɔna bam ba twea,
ye ba mɔne-ba se ba taa tɛ ba we, ‘Abam Wɛ dem nam bɛ?’ ”
Baŋa Wɛ jwoori o ke zaane ba yuu ne
18 Baŋa Wɛ nam bere we o yiga wo o tega kam wone mo.
O ma duri o nɔɔna bam ŋwaŋa.
19O ma leiri-ba o ta o we,
“A lage a pa á na wodiiru mo, de sa-ywoŋo, dedaane nuga.
Abam laam ma‑á wó di á boboŋa á su.
Amo daa bá sɛ se dwi-gɛ tiina bam taa ke abam ba mɔna.
20Ko ná ye nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo na nwoŋi baŋa seeni ko ba á baŋa ne to,
amo wó zeili-ba a ja vo a yage kagoa yuu ne,
se ba daa yé daane abam.
A lage a kale balo na wo kɔgɔ kom yiga ne ba maa vei to
a ja vo se ba to Yɛ naneo kom wone mo.
Ko ta ná ye balo na maŋe kwaga ne ba vei to,
a lage a ja-ba a vo se ba to Mediterania naneo kom ne mo.
Ba kɔgɔ kom laam maa wó pɔ,
se ba lwom taa zaŋe jei maama ne.”
Baŋa Wɛ seene o toŋe wo-kenkagela!
21Tega kam yé taa kɔre foone
se ka daare ka taa chake de wopwolo.
Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ seene o toŋe wo-kenkagela!
22Kago-vara bam de yé taa kɔre foone,
kokuri pwola kam maama su mo dedaane ga-lɛɛro.
Teeni dem de maa lei bia zwase!
Mɔɔro dedaane Vini tio-bia wora mo yɔɔ!
23Zion tiina bam, ta‑á jege-na wopwolo!
Ta‑á di-na ywoni dedaane Baŋa Wɛ na ke kolo o pa abam to.
Kokuri, wonto mo tɔge o zaane dem baŋa ne
o pa se doa taa nena dedɛ ka pa abam.
O ma pa abam duum doa, de faao ni doa kam de
se ko maŋe dedaane o ya na yeini o ke tei to mo.
24Mena ferem jei sem lage se su dedaane wodiiru mo,
se sana de nuga de taa daga se gaale.
Baŋa Wɛ mo we:
25“A nam wó jwoori a ŋwe á wodiiru telo kayere sem ya na chɔge
bena yalo wone se kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ na tu abam baŋa ne to.
Ko ye amo mo déem toŋe-se abam tetare ne,
ne jar-keira tei.
26Abam laam wó ta‑á di á sui,
á wodiiru na wó gaale to ŋwaane.
Abam laam maa wó seini á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yere,
de amo na toŋe wo-kenkagela a pa abam tei to.
Amo nɔɔna bam daa bá di ba chaveera.
27Abam Isarele tiina bam laam wó lɔre we amo mo wo abam tetare ne.
Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom,
ye wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera se de dwoni de amo.
Chega to, a nɔɔna bam daa bá di ba chaveera.”
Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom taane
28“Ko maama kwaga ne,
amo wó lwo a Jworo nabiina maama baŋa ne.
Konto nam wó pa se á bu-baara de á bukwa taa pworisi amo kwora kam,
se á nɔn-kwe de dwɛ dendwea amo ŋwaane,
ko daare se abam nɔn-donno na wo-kenkagela yalo a na wó veere a bere-ba to.
29Chega to, da yam konto ne a lage a lwo a Jworo mo a tontoŋena baŋa ne,
baara de kaana de.
30Amo ta wó pa se wo-kenkagela taa nae wɛyuu ne
dedaane tega baŋa ne.
Kanto maŋa kam ne jana wó taa wora, de mini,
de nyoa kalo na tiini ka zwora to.
31Wea kam wó ba ka vaŋe ka li lim,
ye chana kam de ji nasoŋo ne jana tei.
Ko laam daare se Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom ba ko yi,
se o nenɔŋa kam de bere jaja.
32Dɛ dem konto ne,
wolo maama na wó bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere
o ma lwoori zeinim to wó na verem.
Zion peo kom yuu ne de Jerusalem teo kom maama wone mo
nɔɔna badaara wó lu cham dem wone,
ne Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o ta tei to.
Ko ná ye balo na wó wori to,
balo Baŋa Wɛ na bwoŋi se ba taa ye o nyem to
wó taa wo ba wone.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Judge the Nations
1At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again. 2Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land 3and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
4 You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened. 5You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples. 6You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
7But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you. 8I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment in Judgment Valley
9Say to the nations:
“Get ready for war!
Be eager to fight.
Line up for battle
and prepare to attack.
10 Make swords out of plows
and spears out of garden tools.
Strengthen every weakling.”
11Hurry, all you nations!
Come quickly.
Ask the Lord to bring
his warriors along.
12You must come now
to Judgment Valley,
where the Lord will judge
the surrounding nations.
13 They are a field of ripe crops.
Bring in the harvest!
They are grapes piled high.
Start trampling them now!
If our enemy's sins were wine,
every jar would overflow.
14Crowds fill Decision Valley.
The judgment day of the Lord
will soon be here—
15no light from the sun or moon,
and stars no longer shine.
16 From the heart of Jerusalem
the Lord roars like a lion,
shaking the earth and sky.
But the Lord is a fortress,
a place of safety
for his people Israel.
God Will Bless His People
17I am the Lord your God.
And you will know I live on Zion,
my sacred hill,
because Jerusalem will be sacred,
untouched by foreign troops.
18On that day, fruitful vineyards
will cover the mountains.
And your cattle and goats
that graze on the hills
will produce a lot of milk.
Streams in Judah
will never run dry;
a stream from my house
will flow in Acacia Valley.
19Egypt and Edom were cruel
and brutal to Judah,
without a reason.
Now their countries will become
a barren desert,
20but Judah and Jerusalem
will always have people.
21I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion.
I will punish the guilty
and defend the innocent.
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ wó bore dwi tiina maama taane
1“Nii-na! Maŋa kam konto ne,
amo wó pa se Jerusalem de Judah tiina bam
jwoori ba taa jege yu-ywoŋo lanyerane.
2Amo wó pa se dwi-gɛ tiina bam maama ba
ba jeeri bwolo kolo ba na bwoi we ‘Jehosafate bwolo’ to ne.
Ba ná tu ba wora, a laam wó di ba taane,
de ba na ke amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam tei to.
Kolo ŋwaane ba ya jaane-ba
ba jage ba vo teene dedwonna ne,
ye ba daare ba jwoŋi ba tega kam ba tei.
3 Dwi-gɛ tiina bam tage jɔrɔ mo a nɔɔna bam ŋwaane
se ba nii wɔ mo wó jwoŋi-ba.
Ba ma yeini ba kwei bakeiri sem
ba yeigi ba ma tɔge ka-bworo kwaga,
ye ba daare ba kwei busankane sem ba yeigi
se ba jwoŋi sana ba taa nyɔa.
4Tura tiina, de Sidon tiina, dedaane Filisi tiina na wo jei selo maama ne to, abam boŋe se á ke amo tetɛ mo? Á lage se á yiri á jene mo amo baŋa ne na? Konto nam ná ye á boboŋe dem, lɔre-na we amo wó ke lela a jwoori a ŋwe kolo á na ke amo baŋa ne to. 5Abam vere lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa jejegero tem na ye amo tete lonne nyem to á ja á vo á tiŋi á jwona di sem wone. 6Abam ta ma kwei Jerusalem de Judah tiina bam á ja á vo á yeigi á pa Girisi tiina. Á ke konto se ba vo yiga yiga mo ba daare ba tete teo kom se á ta‑á tei.
7Nam nii-na! Amo laam lage a jwoori a ja a nɔɔna bam mo se ba nwoŋi jei selo maama ne á na yeigi-ba to a ja a ba sɔŋɔ. A ta maa wó pipiri kolo á na toŋe ba baŋa ne to, se ko jwoori ko ba abam tete yuu ne. 8A lage a kwei abam bia mo a yeigi a pa Judah tiina bam. Banto laam wó kwei á bia bam ba yeigi ba pa Sabea tiina bam na zoore sa-teo ne yiga yiga to.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage tento maama.
9Tɔɔle-na kwora kanto se ka yi dwi tiina maama:
“Ti-na á yiga jara-keim ŋwaane!
Bwoŋi-na á babɛ sem de á jar-keira bam maama
se ba zaŋe ba la daane,
ba daare ba vo ba kwaare jara de ba dona bam.
10Kwei-na á vaane dem se á ma‑á lu jara-keim se-zɔɔro,
se á kwei á lare sem á pa se ji chichwoa.
Pa-na se nabwonu maama taa tɛ we, ‘A ye babea!’
11Dwi maama tiina, ke-na lela á nwoŋi á teene dem ne
á ba á jeeri tento se á ke jara!”
Baŋa Wɛ, nmo de ja n jar-keira bam n nwoŋi n jeeri!
12Dwi-gɛ tiina bam maama jege se ba zaŋe
ba vo ba jeeri Jehosafate bwolo kom ne mo.
Dáane mo amo Baŋa Wɛ lage a jeini
a di dwi-gɛ tiina balo maama na gilimi abam to taane.
13Nɔn-balwaaro tem maŋa yia se ba na chɔgem!
Konto to, kwei-na á sekware
á ja á zo ba wone á ma á gaane-ba,
nenɛɛne ba na yeini ba gwei mena yalo na bege tei to.
Nam ta nɔne-na ba baŋa ne,
nenɛɛne ba na ke tei ba ŋoke Vini tio-bia to.
Maŋa kam yia! Sana bam su ba wɛɛle!
14Nɔn-kɔgɔ mo jeeri Bora Borem bwolo kom ne,
kɔgɔ kolo na tiini ko gaale dedɛ to.
Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom lage de ba lela mo,
se o bore ba bora dáane.
15Wea kam dedaane chana kam maama wó ji lim.
Chalechwe sem pwooni de daa bá taa nyeena.
16 Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo zaŋe Zion peo kom yuu ne ka suura.
O kwor-dɛa maa bage Jerusalem teo kom wone,
pa se tega baŋa dedaane wɛyuu maama ziziŋi.
Ko nam ná ye o tete nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam,
Baŋa Wɛ mo ye ba dalem jei,
se ba sale o yera ne.
Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ o nɔɔna bam swolim
Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we:
17“Abam Isarele tiina bam laam wó lɔre we amo mo ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.
A maa zoore a tete peo Zion yuu ne mo.
Amo ta ma pɔɔre Jerusalem se ko taa ye a tete teo kom.
Veira daa bá wane-ko ba di maŋa de maŋa.
18Maŋa kam konto ná yia,
Vini teeni delo á na wó jeiri peero jei sem ne to
wó pa á na sa-sona dedɛ.
Á vara de maa wó puli ba su zwonnu laŋa kam maama,
pa se nayela de gaale.
Judah wo bwi sem maama de maa wó su se wɛɛle.
Bu-nɔgɔ wó zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne
ka duri ka vo ka yi Sitim bwolo kom ka bugi tega kam.
19Ejipti teo kom nam lage ko ji di-dwonnu jei mo,
se Edom de taa ye kagoa yerane.
Kokuri ba déem tiini ba toŋe puseŋa Judah tiina bam yera ne.
Ba ma zo ba tega kam ba go balo na wo maŋe se ba te to.
20Ko nam ná ye Jerusalem teo kom dedaane Judah laŋa kam maama,
nɔɔna wó taa zoore da maŋa maama mo se ko taa vei wuu.
21Amo laam maa wó jwoori a ŋwe nɔn-gora tusim dem jene,
amo na wo ŋwe-de to ŋwaane.
Chega to, amo Baŋa Wɛ zoore Zion wone.”

english_text:
1 I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel, 2 and I said:
When the Lord roars
from Jerusalem,
pasturelands and Mount Carmel
dry up and turn brown.
Judgment on Syria
3 The Lord said:
I will punish Syria
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They dragged logs with spikes
over the people of Gilead.
4Now I will burn down the palaces
and fortresses of King Hazael
and of King Benhadad.
5I will break through
the gates of Damascus.
I will destroy the people
of Wicked Valley
and the ruler of Beth-Eden.
Then the Syrians will be dragged
as prisoners to Kir.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Philistia
6 The Lord said:
I will punish Philistia
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They dragged off my people
from town after town
to sell them as slaves
to the Edomites.
7That's why I will burn down
the walls and fortresses
of the city of Gaza.
8I will destroy the king of Ashdod
and the ruler of Ashkelon.
I will strike down Ekron,
and that will be the end
of the Philistines.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Phoenicia
9 The Lord said:
I will punish Phoenicia
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They broke their treaty
and dragged off my people
from town after town
to sell them as slaves
to the Edomites.
10That's why I will send flames
to burn down the city of Tyre
along with its fortresses.
Judgment on Edom
11 The Lord said:
I will punish Edom
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They killed their own relatives
and were so terribly furious
that they showed no mercy.
12Now I will send fire to wipe out
the fortresses of Teman
and Bozrah.
Judgment on Ammon
13 The Lord said:
I will punish Ammon
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
In Gilead they ripped open
pregnant women,
just to take the land.
14Now I will send fire to destroy
the walls and fortresses
of Rabbah.
Enemies will shout and attack
like a whirlwind.
15Ammon's king and leaders
will be dragged away.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
1Amo Amosi ye nayero mo na nwoŋi Tekoa, ye a laam bere taane dento. Yuzia déem na ye Judah teo pɛ, ye Jehoasa bu Jeroboam de ye Isarele tiina pɛ, ye ko daare bena yalei se tega kam ziziŋi to mo Wɛ le wonnu tento ya na seigi to o bere-ne.
2Amosi ma ta o we:
“Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo zaŋe Zion peo kom yuu ne ka suura.
O kwor-dɛa maa bage Jerusalem teo kom wone.
Ga-lɛɛro tem nayera na kale ba vara ba vei mɛ to wora te kora.
Kamele peo kom gaao de ma kwaare.”
Damasika tiina taane
3 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Damasika nɔɔna bam yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba.
Ba nɔne Gilead tiina bam mo
pa se ba twanno peere.
4Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento:
Amo wó pa se mini zwɛ Pɛ Hazayeli
na lɔge sɔ-fɔrɔ kolo to,
se a daare a zwɛ Pɛ Ben-Hadadi
dam jei sem.
5Amo wó chɔge Damasika teo
ni bworru tem,
se a daare a go ko nɔn-bia bam
a vo a yi Aven bwolo kom.
Ko ta ná ye pɛ wolo na di paare Bɛte-Eden teo kom ne to,
amo wó zeili‑o mo pa se o lage jei.
Amo ta wó pa ba kale
Siria tiina bam
ba ja ba vo Kiri teo
se ba ji peena da.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
Filisi tiina taane
6 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Gaza teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba.
Ba jaane teo kodwoŋi nɔn-bia maama
ba kale-ba ba vo ba ke
Edom tiina jeŋa ne.
7Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento:
Amo wó pa se mini ja Gaza teo kom,
ye de zwɛ ko dam jei sem.
8Ko ná ye Asedodi teo kom
nɔn-bia bam,
de wolo na di paare
Asekelon teo kom ne to,
amo wó chɔge-ba,
se a daare a ma a dam-fɔrɔ
a waare Ekoron teo kom tiina.
Filisi tiina balo maama na daare to maa wó te.”
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
Tura tiina taane
9 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Tura teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba.
Ba jaane teo kodwoŋi
nɔn-bia maama mo
ba kale ba vo ba ke
Edom tiina jeŋa ne.
Konto to, ba yage ba ni-gwonim dem ba ya na ke de teo kom konto to.
10Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento:
Amo wó pa se mini di Tura teo kom,
ye de zwɛ ko dam jei sem mo.”
Edom tiina taane
11 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Edom nɔɔna bam yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba.
Ba zeili ba chorro tem mo se ba go.
Ba maa ba jege ba ŋwaŋa
de fenfee de,
ye ba wo pɛ se ba ban-zɔŋɔ kom zuri.
12Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento:
Amo wó pa se mini ja
Teman teo kom maama,
ye de zwɛ Bozera dam jei sem.”
Amon tiina taane
13 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Amon teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba.
Ba na beeri tega se ba woli ba tega wone ye ba kwaare jara to,
mo ba lɔge Gilead kapwi sem
ba pwi seeni ba go-se.
14Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento:
Amo wó pa se mini ja Raba teo kom,
ye de zwɛ ko dam jei sem.
Nɔɔna laam maa wó kaase tiguri-kaasa jara dɛ dem konto ne.
Jara yam maa wó tiini ya ba
ba baŋa ne,
nenɛɛne vo-dɛɔ na chɔge wonnu tei to.
15Amo ta wó pa se ba ja Amon
teo kom pɛ de o nakwa bam
ba kale ba vo teene dedwonna ne
se ba ji peena da.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_text:
Judgment on Moab
1 The Lord said:
I will punish Moab
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They made lime from the bones
of the king of Edom.
2Now I will send fire to destroy
the fortresses of Kerioth.
Battle shouts and trumpet blasts
will be heard as I destroy Moab
3with its king and leaders.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Judah
4The Lord said:
I will punish Judah
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They have rejected my teachings
and refused to obey me.
They were led astray
by the same false gods
their ancestors worshiped.
5Now I will send fire on Judah
and destroy the fortresses
of Jerusalem.
Judgment on Israel
6The Lord said:
I will punish Israel
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They sell honest people for money,
and the needy are sold
for the price of sandals.
7They smear the poor in the dirt
and push aside
those who are helpless.
My holy name is dishonored,
because fathers and sons sleep
with the same young women.
8They lie down beside altars
on clothes taken
as security for loans.
And they drink wine in my temple,
wine bought with the money
they received from fines.
9 Israel, the Amorites were there
when you entered Canaan.
They were tall as cedars
and strong as oaks.
But I wiped them out—
I destroyed their branches
and their roots.
10I had rescued you from Egypt,
and for forty years I had led you
through the desert.
Then I gave you the land
of the Amorites.
11 I chose some of you
to be prophets
and others to be Nazirites.
People of Israel,
you know this is true.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
12But you commanded the prophets
not to speak their message,
and you pressured the Nazirites
into drinking wine.
13And so I will crush you,
just as a wagon full of grain
crushes the ground.
14No matter how fast you run,
you won't escape.
No matter how strong you are,
you will lose your strength
and your life.
15Even if you are an expert
with a bow and arrow,
you will retreat.
And you won't get away alive,
not even if you run fast
or ride a horse.
16You may be brave and strong,
but you will run away,
stripped naked.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
Moaba tiina taane
1 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Moaba teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba.
Ba yaale Edom teo pɛ
de ba na puri o yibeeli dem,
ye ba ta zwɛ o kwi
pa se ji tentwarem to.
2Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento:
Amo wó pa se mini ja
Moaba teo kom maama
ye de daare de zwɛ
Keriofa dam jei sem.
Jar-keira bam ta na wora
ba kaase tiguri-kaasa,
ye ba wu nabwanno to,
mo Moaba tiina bam wó te
jara wone.
3Amo wó ba a go Moaba tiina
pɛ wom
de ba teo kom dedɛɛra maama.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
Judah tiina taane
4 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Judah tiina bam tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba.
Ba gwooni amo Baŋa Wɛ berem dem
ye ba wo sɛ a nia yam.
Ba tɔge wa yalo ba nabaara
déem na tɔge to,
ye ya gane-ba pa se ba ywori
amo chwoŋa kam ne.
5Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento:
Amo wó pa se mini ja
Judah teene dem
ye de zwɛ Jerusalem dam jei sem.”
Isarele tiina taane
6 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Se abam, Isarele tiina bam, á yeini á tiini á ke wɛleera á daŋe da-baŋa ne.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare abam.
Jena ŋwaane mo Isarele tiina
jege nɔn-ŋona ba yeiga,
pa se ba ji kabɛ.
Ba ta ma yeigi nabwona balo
na ware ba naga natera jena
ba ŋwe to.
7Ba ta nii yiniga tiina mo
se ba taa ye kafɛ,
nenɛɛne nɔɔna na nɔne
tega kasolo baŋa ne tei to.
Ba maa yeini ba che nabwona chwoŋa
se ba yé na ba bora.
Nɔɔno de o kwo sɛ se ba peini
de kaba-kana dedoa,
ye ba yaale amo yere dem
na ye wose to.
8Nɔɔna maa fe nabwona
pa ba kwei ba gwaaro
ba ma tiŋi daare jena ŋwaane.
Ba maa tigi te baŋa ne jei selo
ba na zuli ba wɛ da to.
Ba wɛ dem sɔŋɔ kom ne mo
ba yeini ba nyɔ sana.
Ko maa ye sabu-jena yalo
ba na jwoŋi to mo
ba mae ba yeigi sana bam konto.
9Nii-na, Isarele tiina bam!
Abam ŋwaane mo amo déem zeili Amori tiina bam.
Banto ya ye nɔn-sawaara mo,
ye ba ta dana,
nenɛɛne tei-kamunnu na ye tei to.
A ma yɔɔre a chɔge-ba,
nenɛɛne nɔɔno na guri tio
de ko bonno maama tei to.
10Amo déem ya jaane abam
a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne,
ye a kwei bena finna a to á yiga ne,
pa se dé vei kagoa kam wone.
A laam ma kwei Amori tiina
tega kanto a pa abam,
se ka taa ye á tete nyem.
11A ma daare a kuri
abam nɔn-donno tem wone
se ba badwonna taa ye sampwori
ba pa-ne,
se ba badaara de taa ye Naziri tiina na pɔɔre ba tete
amo ŋwaane to.
Isarele tiina bam, ko dae konto na?
Ko ye amo Baŋa Wɛ mo ŋɔɔna.
12Abam nam soge Naziri tiina bam
pa ba nyɔ sana.
Á ma kwori á fe amo sampwori sem se ba pu ba ni
de amo kwora kam.
13Konto ŋwaane amo nam wó ke abam tento:
Amo wó ba a nɔne abam
a ke a naga kuri ne,
ne toroko na zeŋe mena dedɛ
ye ko nɔne tega ko moore tei to.
14Balo na wae ba duri lela to bá lu.
Dedɛɛra dam wó jei.
Babɛ de bá wane ba vere ba tete
ba yage.
15Che-tara wó chichei ba ga.
Balo na wae ba duri chekke to
bá wane ba duri ba lu.
Nɔɔna balo na diini sisein-nɔɔna to de bá wane ba vere ba tete
ba yage.
16Dɛ dem konto ne, babɛ wó de
ba jara zela ba yage,
ye ba daare ba duri se ba lu.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_text:
1People of Israel,
I rescued you from Egypt.
Now listen to my judgment
against you.
2Of all nations on earth,
you are the only one
I have chosen.
That's why I will punish you
because of your sins.
The Work of a Prophet
3Can two people walk together
without agreeing to meet?
4Does a lion roar in the forest
unless it has caught
a victim?
Does it growl in its den
unless it is eating?
5How can anyone catch a bird
without using a net?
Does a trap spring shut
unless something is caught?
6Isn't the whole city frightened
when the trumpet
signals an attack?
Isn't the Lord the one who brings
disaster on a city?
7Whatever the Lord God
plans to do,
he tells his servants,
the prophets.
8Everyone is terrified
when a lion roars—
and ordinary people
become prophets
when the Lord God speaks.
Samaria Is Doomed
9Here is a message
for the leaders
of Philistia and Egypt—
tell everyone to come together
on the hills of Samaria.
Let them see the injustice
and the lawlessness
in that city.
10The Lord has said
that they don't even know how
to do right.
They have become rich
from violence and robbery.
11And so the Lord God has sworn
that they will be surrounded.
Enemies will break through
their defenses
and steal their treasures.
12The Lord has promised
that only a few from Samaria
will escape with their lives
and with some broken pieces
of their beds and couches.
It will be like when a shepherd
rescues two leg bones
and part of a sheep's ear
from the jaws of a lion.
The Altars at Bethel
13The Lord God All-Powerful
told me to speak this message
against Jacob's descendants:
14 When I, the Lord, punish Israel
for their sins,
I will destroy the altars
at Bethel.
Even the corners of the altar
will be left in the dirt.
15I will tear down winter homes
and summer homes.
Houses decorated with ivory
and all other mansions
will be gone forever.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
Isarele tiina maŋe waarem
1Isarele dwi tiina bam, cheigi-na taane delo Baŋa Wɛ na jege se o ta to. Ko ye taane delo o na ŋɔɔne o pa abam dwi dem maama o na kale o ja nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne to mo. O maa we:
2“Amo kuri abam yerane mo a le dwi maama na wo logo baŋa ne to wone, ye a nii á baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane mo amo jege se a waare abam á keim-lwanno tem ŋwaane.”
3Nɔɔna balei wó taa vei daane ye ba wo ŋɔɔne ba maŋe daane na?
4Nywoŋo ná wo zi woŋo, ko wó suuri gaao ne na?
Nywoŋo-balaŋa ná wo jaane woŋo, ko wó taa ŋuuri ko tiga jei ne na?
5Nɔɔno ná wo chege kalanchogo o tiŋi, ko wó wane zuŋa ko ja na?
Kalanchogo nam wae ko pɔpɔ ko faŋe wɛɛne ye kolokolo tera se ko ja na?
6Ba ná wugi tigura nabɔnɔ teo wone, foone bá ja nɔɔna bam na?
Baŋa Wɛ ná wo pɛ chwoŋa, chɔgem wó wane de ba teo wone na?
7Ko ye chega mo, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ bá ke woŋo ye o wo le o boboŋe dem konto o bere o tontoŋena balo na ye o sampwori to.
8Nywoŋo nam seene ko suuri! Wɔ mo bá taa kɔre foone?
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam ŋɔɔne ja! Wɔ mo wó ve se o tɔɔle o taane dem?
Samaria teo chɔgem
9Nam tɔɔle-na kwora se ka yi balo na zoore Ejipti de Asedodi sɔ-fwaaro tem wone to we, “Jeeri-na daane Samaria peero tem yuu ne se á nii á lɔre wo-yɔɔro de lwarem delo Isarele tiina bam na ke ba pa daane to.” 10Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, “Nɔɔna banto yeiri chega chwoŋa tɔgem. Ba yeini ba vere nɔɔna wonnu de dam ba vei ba sui ba sɔ-fwaaro tem. 11Konto ŋwaane ba dona wó ba ba gilimi ba teo kom pa se ba chɔge ba dam jei sem ye ba vere ba jejegero ba sɔ-fwaaro tem wone.”
12 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
“Nywoŋo ná jaane pia se ko di, nayero wó kwaane se o jwoŋi pia kam ko ni ne, ko ná maŋe ko ye ka nɛ selei de ka zwa chichworo yerane de. Ko nam ye bedwe mo de Isarele tiina balo na zoore Samaria wone to. Ba ná maŋe ba na verem, ba jejegero fenfee yerane mo wó daare, nenɛɛne jangɔŋɔ naga chichworo naa pulu na zareme tei to.”
13Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
“Cheigi-na, se á kaane Jakob dwi tiina bam we: 14Dɛ dem amo na wó waare Isarele tiina bam ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane to, amo wó chɔge Bɛtel kaanem bimbina yam ye a pa se ya nyea yam maama bwori ya to tega ne. 15Amo wó yɔɔre a chɔge ba sam dem maama. Ko ná ye sɔŋɔ kolo ba na lɔge teo kamunu wone naa teo balaŋa wone to, de kolo ba na kwei tuu yeila ba ma kwɛ to de, amo wó chochoge ba sɔ-fwaaro tem maama.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_text:
The Women of Samaria
The Lord said:
1You women of Samaria
are fat cows!
You mistreat and abuse
the poor and needy,
then you say to your husbands,
“Bring us more drinks!”
2I, the Lord God, have sworn
by my own name
that your time is coming.
Not one of you will be left—
you will be taken away
by sharp hooks.
3You will be dragged through holes
in your city walls,
and you will be thrown
toward Harmon.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Israel Refuses To Obey
The Lord said:
4Come to Bethel and Gilgal.
Sin all you want!
Offer sacrifices the next morning
and bring a tenth of your crops
on the third day.
5Bring offerings to show me
how thankful you are.
Gladly bring more offerings
than I have demanded.
You really love to do this.
I, the Lord God, have spoken!
How the Lord Warned Israel
6 I, the Lord, took away the food
from every town and village,
but still you rejected me.
7Three months before harvest,
I kept back the rain.
Sometimes I would let it fall
on one town or field
but not on another,
and pastures dried up.
8People from two or three towns
would go to a town
that still had water,
but it wasn't enough.
Even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
9I dried up your grain fields;
your gardens and vineyards
turned brown.
Locusts ate your fig trees
and olive orchards,
but even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
10I did terrible things to you,
just as I did to Egypt—
I killed your young men in war;
I let your horses be stolen,
and I made your camp stink
with dead bodies.
Even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
11 I destroyed many of you,
just as I did the cities
of Sodom and Gomorrah.
You were a burning stick
I rescued from the fire.
But even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
12Now, Israel, I myself
will deal with you.
Get ready to face your God!
13I created the mountains
and the wind.
I let humans know
what I am thinking.
I bring darkness at dawn
and step over hills.
I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_text:
1Cheigi-na a taane dem, abam kaana balo na nwoŋi Samaria to. Á na nugi tei to nye de Basan naane dem mo. Abam yeini á daane nabwona, ye á bɛɛse yiniga tiina. Á ta daare á fe á banna se ba pa abam sana se á nyɔ á su.
2Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na ye wose to nam dugi de o tete mo o we:
“Maŋa lage ka yi se nɔɔna zi abam ba vaŋe á momwa ba ja kɛ. Ba wó vaŋe á maama ba ja kɛ ne ba na mɛ gwoli ba ja ywona tei to. 3Ba wó le abam á sam dem ne ba ja tɔge kabiri sem na bwori mɛ to laŋa ne ba kɛ ba de abam ba yage Haremon seeni.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
Isarele tiina na yeini ba ve Wɛ ni dem tei to
4“Nam ta‑á tui-na Bɛtel se á ve Wɛ ni! Véi-na Giligal de, se á ve Wɛ ni á daŋe da-baŋa ne! Kwaane-na á ta‑á zuli Wɛ ne á na lage se á ke tei to. Á lage se á kwei á vara á ma á kaane á pa Wɛ zezeŋa maama. Á lage se á ja á Wɛ-teiri pɛɛra yam á ba á pa Wɛ da yatɔ maama. 5Kwei-na bworobworo á ja á ba se á pa Wɛ se ko taa ye abam lei keim. Ko daare á wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra yam, á jege se á mage á nyɔɔna ya ŋwaane se nɔɔna maama lɔre á na ke tei to. Wonnu telo abam Isarele tiina bam na lage se á ta‑á ke to mo konto.”
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
6“Amo nam mo pɛ se kana zo á teene dem maama wone. De ko de, á ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
7“Chane setɔ ta na daare se á pe á wodiiru to, amo pɛ se doa wo nege ye á wodiiru chɔge. Amo pɛ doa ne teo dedoa ne ye ka wo nege kodwoŋi ne. Ka ta nege kara dedoa ne ye kadwoŋi mena kwaare kwaare. 8Nɔɔna ma nwoŋi ba teo wone ba kare teene dedwonna ba lage na se ba nyɔ, ye na bam wo yi ba nyɔɔm. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
9“Amo ta pɛ se jaweero ba te chɔge abam kare sem wodiiru. Kayere maa yeini se di á teeni maama, pa se á kaporro tem de á Olivi tio-bia de á Vini tio-bia bam maama chɔge. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
10“Amo pɛ jawe-chɛɛro ba abam baŋa, ne amo déem na ke tei a ma a chɔge Ejipti tiina bam faŋa faŋa to. Amo pɛ á nɔn-donno te jara wone, ye nɔɔna kale á sisein-nɔɔna bam maama ba ja ba viiri. Twa yera lwom ma zaŋe de su á na tigi mɛ maama to. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
11“Amo chɔge abam badwonna ne a na chɔge Sodom de Gomora tiina tei to. Abam balo na daare ye á wori to déem jwoŋi á ŋwea ne daa kalo na jaane mini ye ba le-ka de wone tei to. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
12“Isarele tiina bam, nam lɔre-na we amo lage a waare abam konto dwoŋi mo. Amo nam na lage a toŋe konto á yera ne to ŋwaane, ti-na á yiga se á ba á zege amo yiga ne.”
13Nii-na!
Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na mɔɔne peero tem.
O ma daare o pa vio zaŋe ko dola.
O ma pɔɔre o boboŋa o pa nabiina lɔre ya na ye tei to.
O pae te-pora leiri ka jiri lim.
Wonto mo gwɛ peero baŋa ne
o vei o kare logo baŋa maama.
Ko nam ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo ke konto!

english_text:
Turn Back to the Lord
1Listen, nation of Israel,
to my mournful message:
2You, dearest Israel, have fallen,
never to rise again—
you lie deserted in your own land,
with no one to help you up.
3The Lord God has warned,
“From every ten soldiers
only one will be left;
from a thousand troops,
only a hundred will survive.”
4The Lord keeps saying,
“Israel, turn back to me
and you will live!
5Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel
or even to Beersheba.
Gilgal will be dragged away,
and Bethel will end up
as nothing.”
6Turn back to the Lord,
you descendants of Joseph,
and you will live.
If you don't, the Lord
will attack like fire.
Bethel will burn to the ground,
and no one can save it.
7You people are doomed!
You twist the truth
and trample on justice.
8 But the Lord created the stars
and put them in place.
He turns darkness to dawn
and daylight to darkness;
he scoops up the ocean
and empties it on the earth.
9God destroys mighty soldiers
and strong fortresses.
Choose Good Instead of Evil!
The Lord said:
10You people hate judges
and honest witnesses;
11you abuse the poor and demand
heavy taxes from them.
You have built expensive homes,
but you won't enjoy them;
you have planted vineyards,
but you will get no wine.
12I am the Lord, and I know
your terrible sins.
You cheat honest people
and take bribes;
you rob the poor of justice.
13Times are so evil
that anyone with good sense
will keep quiet.
14If you really want to live,
you must stop doing wrong
and start doing right.
I, the Lord God All-Powerful,
will then be on your side,
just as you claim I am.
15Choose good instead of evil!
See that justice is done.
Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful,
will be kind to what's left
of your people.
Judgment Is Coming
16This is what the Lord has sworn:
Noisy crying will be heard
in every town and street.
Even farmers will be told
to mourn for the dead,
together with those
who are paid to mourn.
17Your vineyards will be filled
with crying and weeping,
because I will punish you.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
When the Lord Judges
18You look forward to the day
when the Lord comes to judge.
But you are in for trouble!
It won't be a time of sunshine;
all will be darkness.
19You will run from a lion,
only to meet a bear.
You will escape to your house,
rest your hand on the wall,
and be bitten by a snake.
20The day when the Lord judges
will be dark, very dark,
without a ray of light.
What the Lord Demands
21 I, the Lord, hate and despise
your religious celebrations
and your times of worship.
22I won't accept your offerings
or animal sacrifices—
not even your very best.
23No more of your noisy songs!
I won't listen
when you play your harps.
24But let justice and fairness
flow like a river
that never runs dry.
25 Israel, for forty years
you wandered in the desert,
without bringing offerings
or sacrifices to me.
26Now you will have to carry
the two idols you made—
Sakkuth, the one you call king,
and Kaiwan, the one you built
in the shape of a star.
27I will force you to march
as captives beyond Damascus.
I, the Lord God All-Powerful,
have spoken!
translation_text:
Isarele tiina na jege se ba leiri ba wo tei to
1Isarele dwi tiina bam, cheigi-na, se a lage a leeni abam lua luseim leiŋa mo:
2“Isarele dwi dem nye de busankan-pwola na to tega ne to mo.
O daa bá zaŋe.
O tigi tega ne
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri ko ni ne,
se o ja‑o se o zaŋe.”
3Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ta maa we:
“Abam teo dedoa ná pɛ nɔɔna morro
nwoŋi ba vo ba kwaare jara,
nɔɔna bi yerane mo wó jwoori
ye ba ŋwe.
Á teo kodwoŋi ná pɛ
nɔɔna bi nwoŋi,
nɔɔna fuga yerane mo wó jwoori.”
4 Baŋa Wɛ maa tɛ de Isarele dwi dem o we:
“Jwoori-na á ba amo tei
se á ta‑á ŋwe.
5Nam yé ta‑á kare á beeri amo jei
Bɛtel ne.
Yé ta‑á véi-na Giligal.
Yé beeri-na á vo Beeriseba de.
Ko nam ná ye Giligal,
ba wó ja ko nɔn-bia
ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi.
Ko ta ná ye Bɛtel tiina,
lɛɛro mo wó yi-ba.”
6Nam fɔɔre-na á yi Baŋa Wɛ tei
se á ta‑á ŋwe!
Á ná wo sɛ se á jwoori,
Wɛ bane wó zaŋe
Josɛf dwi dem baŋa ne,
ye o daare o chɔge-ba
ne mini na zwɛ wonnu tei to.
Bɛtel maama mo wó chɔge,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o dwei mini dem.
7Lɛɛro wó ba abam baŋa ne,
á na yeini á pipiri chega kam
pa se ka ji vwa to ŋwaane.
Chega kam dae kolokolo
ka pae abam!
8 Baŋa Wɛ mo ke chalechwe
dwi dwi o tigisi daane.
Wonto mo pae se tete leiri
ko jiri te-pora.
O maa pae se wea jiri tete.
Wonto mo yeini o kwoori
naneero tem na bam
o jwoori o lwoi tega kam baŋa ne.
O yere mo Baŋa Wɛ.
9O yeini o pae se chɔgem tui
dedɛɛra baŋa ne mo lela,
ye o daare o chɔge ba dam jei sem.
10Abam nam chuli balo na di taane
de chega to mo,
á ta maa vae balo na tɛ chega to
ni taane.
11-12Abam bɛɛse yiniga tiina,
ye á fe-ba se ba kwei ba mena
ba ma ŋwe lampwoo dedɛ.
Amo yei abam wɛleera yam
na daga tei,
de á na tiini á chɔge
amo nia yam tei to.
Konto ŋwaane á bá ta‑á zoore
sɔ-fwaaro telo á na lɔge to wone.
Ko ná ye Vini teeni á na dugi
á kadwi sem wone
ye de tiini de lana to,
á daa bá nyɔ de tio-bia sana bam.
Abam daane nɔn-laaro
ye á fe-ba se á jwoŋi dim.
Á maa yeini á vere yiniga tiina
de ba bora.
13Konto ŋwaane, boboŋa tiina
wó taa ye chemm,
kokuri to, ko ye lwarem maŋa mo.
14Yage-na totoŋ-lwanno keim,
á daare á ta‑á ke wo-laaro,
se á ta‑á ŋwe.
Ko maa wó pa se Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ taa wo abam tei ne,
nenɛɛne abam na yeini á tɛ tei to.
15Ta‑á chuli lwarem á daare
á ta‑á swoi kolo na lamma to.
Á nakwa bam jege se
ba taa tɔge chega mo
de ba na di nɔɔna taane tei to.
Dɛ delo, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ
wó duri á ŋwaŋa,
abam balo na daare
ye á ye Josɛf dwi dem to.
16Abam na tusi to ŋwaane, dé Teiru Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei mo tento:
“Nɔɔna keira wó zaŋe
teo kom pwola maama ne.
Ba wó taa keeri ba we,
‘Lɛɛro! Lɛɛro!’.
Ba ta wó ware vala bam
se ba taa tɔge ba keera
ko woli de balo na wae luseim
ba leeni to.
17Wopwolo bá taa wo á kare sem maama wone,
keira yerane mo wó taa wora,
amo na wó tɔge abam tetare ne
a waare abam to ŋwaane.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom taane
18Abam balo na jege teena
se Baŋa Wɛ borem dɛ dem
ba de yi to,
lɛɛro taa wo á yuu ne!
Bɛŋwaane mo á lage
se Baŋa Wɛ dɛ dem ba?
Dɛ dem konto wó taa ye yibiri mo
de pae abam,
se de bá ja pwooni de ba.
19Ko wó taa ye nenɛɛne nɔɔno ná duri se o lu nywoŋo jeŋa ne tei to mo.
O ma duri o vo o jeeri ga-naao
na cheiŋi‑o to.
O ma daare o vo o yi sɔŋɔ se
o daŋe o jeŋa kabira baŋa ne,
ye tega-veilu laam done‑o
o jeŋa seeni!
20Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ borem dɛ dem
wó taa ye yibiri dedaane lim mo.
Pwooni bá taa wora de fenfee de.
Wɛ na chuli wonnu telo to
Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
21“Amo chuli abam na yeini á di
kura yalo maama amo ŋwaane to.
Amo yi ba sui de abam na jeeri daane se á zuli-ne tei to.
22Abam ná jaane zwɛɛm pɛɛra
naa wodiu pɛɛra
se á ba á kaane á pa-ne,
amo bá jwoŋi-ya.
Ko ta ná ye vare-begela yalo
á na jege se á ke yazura kaanem
á pa-ne to,
amo yiga tera de-ya.
23Ja-na á tia lei sem á vo daa!
Se ye sɔɔ mo amo zwa wone.
Á ná kwei kwanno
se á ma á tei amo yere,
amo bá cheigi abam lei sem,
de se ná maŋe se ywomma
tei maama de.
24Nam pa-na se chega borem
de lanyerane keim taa wora
maŋa maama,
ne bu-dura na duri ka via
ye ka ba we tei to.
25Isarele dwi tiiina bam, bena finna yalo abam déem na wo kagoa kam wone ye á zuli-ne to, ko dae vara bam naa pɛɛra yam á na kwei á ma á ke kaanem á pa-ne to ŋwaane mo á ke konto. 26Abam laam nam jege á jwona yalo abam tete na mɔɔne-ya to á zeŋe á maa kɛa. Á maa bwoi ya dedoa we abam pɛ Sakuti. Dedwoŋi dem maa ye á jwoni Kayiwan, á na zuli-de ne chalechoa tei to. 27Á na zuli jwona yanto to ŋwaane, amo wó ja abam a nwoŋi á teo kom wone a kale a vo jei selo na gaale Damasika to.”
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, o yere na ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ to mo tage konto maama.

english_text:
Israel Will Be Punished
1Do you rulers in Jerusalem
and in the city of Samaria
feel safe and at ease?
Everyone bows down to you,
and you think you are better
than any other nation.
But you are in for trouble!
2Look what happened
to the cities of Calneh,
powerful Hamath,
and Gath in Philistia.
Are you greater than any
of those kingdoms?
3You are cruel, and you forget
the coming day of judgment.
4You rich people lounge around
on beds with ivory posts,
while dining on the meat
of your lambs and calves.
5You sing foolish songs
to the music of harps,
and you make up new tunes,
just as David used to do.
6You drink all the wine you want
and wear expensive perfume,
but you don't care about
the ruin of your nation.
7So you will be the first
to be dragged off as captives;
your good times will end.
8The Lord God All-Powerful
has sworn by his own name:
“You descendants of Jacob
make me angry by your pride,
and I hate your fortresses.
And so I will surrender your city
and possessions
to your enemies.”
9If only ten of you survive
by hiding in a house
you will still die.
10As you carry out a corpse
to prepare it for burial,
your relative in the house
will ask, “Are there others?”
You will answer, “No!”
Then your relative will reply,
“Be quiet! Don't dare mention
the name of the Lord.”
11At the Lord's command,
houses great and small
will be smashed to pieces.
12Horses can't gallop on rocks;
oceans can't be plowed.
But you have turned justice
and fairness
into bitter poison.
13You celebrate the defeat
of Lo-Debar and Karnaim,
and you boast by saying,
“We did it on our own.”
14But the Lord God All-Powerful
will send a nation to attack
you people of Israel.
They will capture Lebo-Hamath
in the north,
Arabah Creek in the south,
and everything in between.
translation_text:
Isarele dwi dem na wó na lɛɛro telo to
1Abam balo na zoore Zion ne
ye á di ywoni to,
lɛɛro yi abam!
Abam balo na zoore Samaria peo yuu ne de bochare-zuri to,
lɛɛro yi abam!
Abam pae á ye nɔn-kamuna
á te-fɔrɔ kom ne.
Isarele dwi tiina yeini ba tui abam tei ba lwoori wolim.
2Véi-na Kalenɛ teo kom
á nii ko na ye tei to.
Véi-na Hamafa te-fɔrɔ kom,
á daare á kɛ Gafa teo kom
Filisi tiina na zoore mɛ to.
Abam teene dem gare
teene dem konto na?
Abam laŋa kam yala ka dwoi
banto nyem na?
3Á ba jeini á jeeli we
chɔgem wó ba abam baŋa.
Abam kikia maama nam vaŋe lɛɛro dɛ dem mo
pa se de twɛa.
4Á yeini á ma tuu yeili
á kwɛ á gadworu tem
pa se te lana dedɛ.
Á laam maa tigi á konkwallo tem ne á sii ywoni yerane.
Á yeini á done pipeili nɔna,
de na-mɔre nɔna mo á sui.
5Abam swoi se á ta‑á leeni lein-doora,
ye á tae á kwanno,
nenɛɛne Pɛ David
déem na leeni tei to.
6Abam maa swoi se á ta‑á nyɔ sana dedɛ á sui.
Á maa yeini á kwei nu-ywoŋa kalo na jege kwora to
á ma á turi á yera.
Á yiga nam tera de Josɛf dwi dem na wora de chɔga tei to.
7Konto ŋwaane ba wó da yiga mo
ba ja abam
ba nwoŋi á teo kom wone
ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi.
Abam yera na zoora tei to,
de á ywoni dem maama
wó jei mo bedwe baŋa ne!
8Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ dugi o tete yere ŋwaane o ta konto mo.
Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ maa we:
“A wo mo nwoŋi Jakob dwi dem de ba na pae ba tete kamunim tei to.
A yiga tera de ba sɔ-fwaaro tem!
Amo wó kwei ba teo kamunu kom
de ba jejegero tem maama
a ke ba dona jeŋa ne.”
9Nɔɔna fuga ná daare sɔŋɔ kolo wone ye ba seigi da, ba maama wó te. 10Too wom choro kolo na tu se o nii o lua totoŋa baŋa ne to ná zo sɔŋɔ kom se o kwei too wom o ja nwoŋi, o wó bwei nɔɔno wolo yerane na wori ye o seigi sɔŋɔ kom gugworo wone to o we, “Nɔɔno daa tɔge o wo nmo tei ne na?” Nɔɔno wom maa wó leiri o we, “Aawo!” Too wom choro kom laam maa wó ta we, “Yé ke sɔɔ! Yé zaŋe n bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere, se o wó ni n kwora!”
11Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ lage o pa ni mo,
se o pa sɔ-kamuna de sɔ-balwa
maama mumugi mura-mura.
12Sisein-nɔɔna wae se wurigi
peero gugworru ne na?
Ba nam wae ba kwei naane
ba vare naneo wone na?
Konto maama ware ko ke.
Abam nam pɛ se chega kam leiri
ka ji chɔŋɔ,
ye lanyerane keim ji wo-chɛɛre.
13Abam ta bere á tete we,
á mage jara de Lo-Debara teo kom á wane-ba.
Á ta kwori á we,
“Debam mɛ dé dam mo
dé di Karenayim teo kom!”
14Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage o we:
“Isarele dwi dem, amo lage a pa
teo kodwoŋi dwi tiina mo
zaŋe ba kwaare jara de abam.
Nɔɔna banto wó tiini ba bɛɛse abam
á tega kam maama wone,
ko zege Lebo-Hamafa ne,
se ko taa vei Araba nabara kam na wo mɛ to.”

english_text:
A Vision of Locusts
1The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested. 2In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
3Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.”
A Vision of Fire
4The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean. 5Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
6Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.”
A Vision of a Measuring Line
7The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall. 8Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?”
“A measuring line,” I answered.
The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more. 9Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.”
Amos and Amaziah
10Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long. 11Here is what he is saying:
‘Jeroboam will be put to death,
and the people will be taken
to a foreign country.’ ”
12Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet. 13Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
14I answered:
I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees. 15But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel. 16And here you are, telling me not to preach! 17Now, listen to what the Lord says about you:
Your wife will become
a prostitute in the city,
your sons and daughters
will be killed in war,
and your land will be divided
among others.
You will die in a country
of foreigners,
and the people of Israel
will be dragged
from their homeland.
translation_text:
Kayere taane
1Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na le kolo o bere-ne to mo tento:
Dɛ dedwe ba na zage pɛ wom mena ba ti, ye kare sem wodiiru tedwonna ta wora te kwi to, mo Wɛ toŋe kayere se se ba se chɔge tega kam. 2Amo ma nii a na we kayere sem deilimi wo-lɛɔ dwi maama na wo tega kam ne to mo nyɔ! Amo laam maa we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, popo, yage n ma n chɛ n nɔɔna bam! Nmo ná wo ke konto, Jakob dwi dem daa bá wane ba wori, ba na tiini ba bwona to ŋwaane.”
3 Baŋa Wɛ ma sɛ ye o leiri o boboŋa. O maa we, “Nmo na nii n na tei to daa bá ke.”
Mini taane
4Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa na veere kolo o bere-ne to mo tento:
Amo nɛ we Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ boŋe se o tɔre min-lɔŋɔ o ma waare o nɔɔna bam. Mini dem ma di naneo kom maama nyɔ, ye de laam wora de di tega kam. 5Amo laam maa we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, a lwoori‑m se n yage! N ná wo yage konto, Jakob dwi dem daa bá wane ba wori, ba na tiini ba bwona to ŋwaane.”
6Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ma leiri o boboŋa ye o we, “Nmo na nii n na tei to de daa bá ke.”
Lɔra ŋona taane
7Wɛ daa ta na le kolo o bere-ne to mo tento:
Amo nii a na kabira kalo lɔra bam na kwei ŋona ba ma lɔ-ka ba fɔge ba zege deiki to mo. A ta ma na we Baŋa Wɛ zege ka teiŋa ne ye o zei lɔra ŋona kam o jeŋa ne. 8Baŋa Wɛ ma bwei-ne o we, “Amosi, bɛ mo n nɛa?” Amo ma leiri a we, “Amo nɛ lɔra ŋona mo.”
O laam maa we, “Amo wó kwei lɔra ŋona kanto mo a maŋe a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam se ko bere we ba ba zege chekke. Amo nam daa bá yage ba wɛleera a ma chɛ-ba. 9Amo lage a chɔge jei selo maama Izaak dwi tiina bam na diini ba ke kaanem to mo. Isarele tiina wara-jei selo na ye wose to maama wó ji di-dwonnu mo. Amo ta wó zaŋe a tɔge jara baŋa ne a chɔge Pɛ Jeroboam paare dem.”
Amosi dedaane Amazia taane
10Amazia déem ye kaanem tu mo Bɛtel ne. Wonto ma toŋe kwora o pa Isarele tiina pɛ Jeroboam o we, “Amosi jege nmo ta-balwaaro mo o ŋɔɔna debam Isarele tiina teo kom tetare ne. O ni taane dem lage de soge nɔɔna bam pa se ba lɔ nmo kwaga ne mo. 11O maa tɛ o we, ‘Jeroboam wó te jara wone, se ba daare ba ja Isarele tiina bam ba nwoŋi ba tete teo kom wone ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi.’ ”
12Amazia laam ma toŋe o ta de Amosi o we “Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu, ko maŋe konto! Laam jwoori n vo n tete teo Judah, se n ta‑n pworisi dáane. Nmo ma‑n wó ta‑n nae n ni-wodiu da. 13Daa‑n yé pworisi Bɛtel ywo-seeni. Jei sento ye pɛ wom tete wara-jei mo, ye dé teo kom maama zuli da!”
14Amosi ma leiri Amazia o we:
“Amo maŋe a dae sampwora! A wo nwoŋi sampwori selo na pworisi ŋweero ŋwaane to kɔgɔ kom wone. Amo ye nayero mo! A maa kale a vara. A ta maa nii kaporro baŋa ne ye a pore kapera yam. 15Baŋa Wɛ ma le-ne a vara bam kwaga ne, ye o ta o we, a véi a pworisi a bere omo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam.
16Nam cheigi Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam!
Nmo mo tage n we,
a yé pworisi a chɔge Isarele tiina bam,
se a yé tɔɔle kwor-lɔŋɔ a pa-ba.
17 Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento:
Amazia, nam lɔre se n kaane
wó ji ka-bworo
o taa kare teo kom ne
o beeri baara.
Nmo bia bam wó te jara wone,
bakeiri de busankane sem maama.
Ba maa wó pɔɔre nmo tega kam
ba pa nɔɔna badwonna.
Nmo tete nam wó te dwi-gɛ teo ne.
Ba maa wó seene ba ja
Isarele tiina bam ba nwoŋi
ba tete teo kom wone
ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi.”

english_text:
A Basket of Fruit
1The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit 2and asked, “Amos, what do you see?”
“A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied.
Then he said,
“This is the end
for my people Israel.
I won't forgive them again.
3Instead of singing
in the temple,
they will cry and weep.
Dead bodies will be everywhere.
So keep silent!
I, the Lord, have spoken!”
Israel Is Doomed
The Lord said:
4You people crush those in need
and wipe out the poor.
5You say to yourselves,
“How much longer before the end
of the New Moon Festival?
When will the Sabbath be over?
Our wheat is ready,
and we want to sell it now.
We can't wait to cheat
and charge high prices
for the grain we sell.
We will use dishonest scales
6and mix dust in the grain.
Those who are needy and poor
don't have any money.
We will make them our slaves
for the price
of a pair of sandals.”
7I, the Lord, won't forget
any of this,
though you take great pride
in your ancestor Jacob.
8Your country will tremble,
and you will mourn.
It will be like the Nile River
that rises and overflows,
then sinks back down.
9On that day, I, the Lord God,
will make the sun
go down at noon,
and I will turn daylight
into darkness.
10Your festivals and joyful singing
will turn into sorrow.
You will wear sackcloth
and shave your heads,
as you would at the death
of your only son.
It will be a horrible day.
11I, the Lord, also promise you
a terrible shortage,
but not of food and water.
You will hunger and thirst
to hear my message.
12You will search everywhere—
from north to south,
from east to west.
You will go all over the earth,
seeking a message
from me, the Lord.
But you won't find one.
13Your beautiful young women
and your young men
will faint from thirst.
14You made promises
to the goddess Ashimah
at Samaria;
you made vows to other gods
at the shrines
of Dan and Beersheba.
So now you will fall
and never get up.
translation_text:
Tetɔgɔ na su de tio-bia to memaŋe
1Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ma le woŋo kodwoŋi o bere-ne. Amo ma nii a na tetɔgɔ ye tio-bia na bege to ya su ko ni. 2O ma bwei-ne o we, “Amosi, bɛ mo n nɛa?” Amo ma leiri a we, “Tetɔgɔ mo a nɛa, ye ko su de tio-bia na bege to.”
Baŋa Wɛ laam maa we:
“A nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam kikia laam bege ya yi se a waare-ba. Amo nam daa yage ba wɛleera a ma chɛ-ba. 3Maŋa kam konto ná yia, pɛ sɔŋɔ wopwolo lei sem wó ji keira mo. Twa wó taa tigi teo kom jei maama ne, ye ba daare ba zeŋe-ba ba ja nwoŋi chemm.”
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
Isarele tiina lɛɛro tem taane
4Abam balo na pini nabwona
ye á vere ba wonnu to,
ko woli de abam balo na yaare
á teo kom yiniga tiina
pa se ba chɔge ba ti to,
cheigi-na!
5Abam yeini á tɛ á we, “Dé lage se Wɛ siu dɛ dem naa chan-doŋa kuri dem ti lela se dé jwoori dé vo dé kwei dé mena yam dé taa yeiga. Dé maa wó kwei bwɛ selo na muri to dé ma pini dé yeilla bam dé jwoŋi ba sabia dedɛ. 6Dé ta wó kwei mena yalo na gwaane de swanno to dé laam yeigi-ya dé jwoŋi sabu dedɛ. Dé ta wae dé beeri yiniga tu wolo na ware o jene o ŋwe to, se dé yeigi kotu dé ma dé ji dé kabaa, o jene dem ná maŋe de mae de o naga natera yam yerane.”
7 Baŋa Wɛ na ye wolo Jakob dwi tiina na jege o teena to, o mɛ o tete yere mo o du duuri o we:
“Amo bere a bá fɔge a swei wo-balwaaro telo ba na kare ba ke to. 8Ba kikia yam konto wó pa se tega kam ziziŋi. Nɔɔna balo maama na zoore tega kam ne to wo maa wó chɔge. Tega kam jei maama wó ziziŋi ka zaŋe wɛɛne ye ka daare ka to, nenɛɛne Naili buga kam na yeini ka pɛɛle ye ka toe tei Ejipti ne to.”
9Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we:
“Maŋa kam konto ná yia, a lage a pa wɛ vo de zo wea tetare ne, pa se yibiri taa wo jei maama ne wea maŋa ne. 10A maa wó pipiri abam kura dim se ya leiri ya ji lwi. Á wopwolo lei sem de wó ji luseim. Abam wó zo gare-nyenyaaro, ye á daare á cheeri á yuni wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane. Á maa wó tiini á keeri se ko taa nye de nɔɔno na gɛ o bu-doa ye o keeri o bu wom lua tei to. De dɛ ná yia, ko wó tiini ko taa chamma ko pae abam!”
11Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ta maa we:
“Nii-na! Maŋa lage ka yi ye a pa se kan-ware ba logo baŋa. Kana kam konto bá taa ye nɔɔna na gɛ wodiu se ba di naa ba gɛ na se ba nyɔ to ŋwaane. Ko nam wó taa ye we ba gɛ amo Baŋa Wɛ taane mo se ba ni. 12Tega kam jei maama ne mo nɔɔna wó taa kare ba lage Baŋa Wɛ taane se ba cheigi. Ko zege Yɛ naneo kom seeni se ko vo ko yi Mediterania naneo kom, ko ta woli de tega kam baŋa seeni de ka wɛ-puli seeni maama, ba wó beeri jei maama konto se ba nii ba ga wó ni Wɛ kwora mo ye ba nam bá na-ka.
13Kanto maŋa ne, na-nyɔm wó go abam nɔn-donno de busankan-pwoli tete. 14Ko ta ná ye balo na kwei Samaria jwona yam yera ba ma du duuri to, de balo na tɛ ba we, ‘Dan jwoni dem yere ŋwaane’, naa ‘Beeriseba jwoni dem yere ŋwaane’ to, nɔɔna bam konto wó to. Ba nam daa bá jwoori ba zaŋe wɛɛne.”

english_text:
Judgment on Israel
1I saw a vision of the Lord
standing by the temple altar,
and he said,
“Shake the columns
until the tops fall loose,
and the doorposts crumble.
Then make the pieces fall
on the people below.
I will take a sword and kill
anyone who escapes.
2“If they dig deep into the earth
or climb to the sky,
I'll reach out and get them.
3If they escape to the peaks
of Mount Carmel,
I'll search and find them.
And if they hide from me
at the bottom of the ocean,
I'll command a sea monster
to bite them.
4I'll send a sword to kill them,
wherever their enemies
drag them off as captives.
I'm determined to hurt them,
not to help them.”
His Name Is the Lord
5When the Lord God All-Powerful
touches the earth, it melts,
and its people mourn.
God makes the earth rise
and then fall,
just like the Nile River.
6He built his palace in the heavens
and let its foundations
rest on the earth.
He scoops up the ocean
and empties it on the earth.
His name is the Lord.
The Lord Is God
7Israel, I am the Lord God,
and the Ethiopians
are no less important to me
than you are.
I brought you out of Egypt,
but I also brought
the Philistines from Crete
and the Arameans from Kir.
8My eyes have seen
what a sinful nation you are,
and I'll wipe you out.
But I will leave a few
of Jacob's descendants.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
9At my command, all of you
will be sifted like grain.
Israelites who remain faithful
will be scattered
among the nations.
And the others will be trapped
like trash in a sifter.
10Some of you are evil,
and you deny
that you will ever get caught.
But you will be killed.
The Lord's Promise to Israel
11 In the future, I will rebuild
David's fallen kingdom.
I will build it from its ruins
and set it up again,
just as it used to be.
12Then you will capture Edom
and the other nations
that are mine.
I, the Lord, have spoken,
and my words will come true.
13You will have such a harvest
that you won't be able
to bring in all of your wheat
before plowing time.
You will have grapes left over
from season to season;
your fruitful vineyards
will cover the mountains.
14I'll make Israel prosper again.
You will rebuild your towns
and live in them.
You will drink wine
from your own vineyards
and eat the fruit you grow.
15I'll plant your roots deep
in the land I have given you,
and you won't ever
be uprooted again.
I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_text:
Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá lu Baŋa Wɛ waarem wone
1Amo daa na nii to, mo a nɛ we Baŋa Wɛ zege bimbini dem teiŋa ne. O laam ma pa ni o we:
“Tiini n mage Wɛ diga kam nayuu bei sem de dam pa se diga kam kuri maama ziziŋi. Zage bei sem n pa se maama to nɔɔna bam yuni ne se go-ba. Amo nam wó pa se balo na daare ye ba ŋwe to te jara wone, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé lu.
2Ba ná maŋe ba ko tega mo se ba zo churu, amo wó yi da a vaŋe-ba a ja a nwoŋi. Ba ze ná diini telaao ne, amo wó ja-ba a tu tega. 3Ba nam ná kwaane ba di Kamele peo kom yuu ba seigi da, amo ta wó beeri ba jei a daare a zi-ba. Ba nam ze ná zo naneo kuri kuri mo se ba seigi amo yiga ne de, amo wó pa naneo wo juru kom done-ba ko go. 4Ba dona bam ná jaane-ba ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi, a ta wó pa ba te jara wone. Kokuri to, a boboŋa jaane se a chɔge-ba mo, se a daa yé woli-ba.”
5Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ maa ye wolo
na yɔɔre o dwei tega kam
ye ka maama ziziŋi to.
Nɔɔna balo maama na wo ka baŋa ne to maa keeri bɔge-bɔge.
Tega kam maa zaŋe wɛɛne,
ye ka jwoori ka toe,
nenɛɛne Naili buga kam na yeini ka su ka pɛɛle
ye ka jwoori ka toe tei to mo.
6 Baŋa Wɛ lɔge o sɔŋɔ mo.
Ko nayuu kom wo wɛyuu ne mo
baŋa baŋa,
ko kugu kom maa wo tega baŋa ne.
Wonto mo yeini o kwoori
naneero tem na bam
o jwoori o lwoi tega kam baŋa ne.
O yere mo Baŋa Wɛ!
7 Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we:
“Isarele tiina bam, á yé ta‑á boŋe-na we abam gare Kusi tiina bam amo yiga ne. Ko ye chega mo we a vere abam a ja nwoŋi Ejipti ne. Amo nam jaane Filisi tiina bam a nwoŋi Kiriti ne mo, ye a ta kwori a ja Aram tiina bam a nwoŋi Kiri ne. Ko dae konto na? 8Amo wolo na ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ to nɛ abam Isarele teo kom na ye tei ye ko tiini ko tusi to. A nam lage a chɔge ko nɔn-bia bam maama pa se ba jei mo tega kam baŋa ne. Ko nam na ye tei to, a bá fɔge a chɔge Jakob dwi dem maama a ti.
Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
9Amo lage a pa se Isarele tiina bam mo na yaara teene dedwonna dem maama wone. Ko wó ta nye de ba na zezɛ muni yɔlɔ wone se weero nwoŋi tei to mo. Amo wó pa se ba le nɔn-yɔɔro tem maama ba daare nɔn-ŋona bam. 10Amo nɔɔna balo maama na tusi to mo lage ba te jara wone, ko ná maŋe ko ye balo na tɛ ba we, Wɛ bá sɛ se kolokolo yi-ba to.”
Isarele teo kom na wó jwoori ko zege tei to
11“Dɛ dem konto ná yia, amo wó fɔge a lɔ Pɛ David sɔŋɔ kom na chɔge to. A maa wó jwoori a kwɛ ko kabiri sem pa se ko di-dwonnu tem jwoori te ji sɔ-doŋo. 12Ko maa wó pa se Isarele tiina laam di Edom laŋa kalo ta na daare to, dedaane teene delo maama ya na ye amo nyem to. Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto, ye a wó pa se wonnu tento maama seene te ke.”
13 Baŋa Wɛ daa ta maa we:
“Nii-na! Maŋa lage ka yi
se wodiu taa ke lela
á kare sem ne,
ko dwoi balo na wó taa wora
se ba zage-ko to.
Á Vini tio-bia bam maa wó taa daga
ba dwoi á na wó taa wae
á ma balo á ke sana
se á laam ba á jwoori á du to.
Vini teeni delo á na wó jeiri
zwonnu jei sem ne to
wó pa á na sa-sona dedɛ
se ko gaale.
14Amo ta wó pa a nɔɔna
Isarele tiina bam
jwoori ba tega kam ne
ba jeini de dam.
Ba laam wó jwoori
ba fɔge ba lɔ ba teene dem,
ye ba taa zoore de wone.
Ba maa wó taa jeiri teeni
ba kare sem ne,
se ba taa nyɔ Vini tio-bia
sa-sona bam,
ye ba di tio-bia balo na leiri da to.
15Amo tete mo lage a jeini
a nɔɔna bam tega kalo
a na pɛ-ba to wone.
Ba nam ná jeini ka wone,
a daa bá le-ba maŋa de maŋa.”
Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo tage konto maama.

english_text:
Edom's Pride and Punishment
1 The Lord God gave Obadiah
a message about Edom,
and this is what we heard:
“I, the Lord, have sent
a messenger
with orders for the nations
to attack Edom.”
2The Lord said to Edom:
I will make you the weakest
and most despised nation.
3You live in a mountain fortress,
because your pride
makes you feel safe from attack,
but you are mistaken.
4I will still bring you down,
even if you fly higher
than an eagle
or nest among the stars.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
5If thieves break in at night,
they steal
only what they want.
And people who harvest grapes
always leave some unpicked.
But, Edom, you are doomed!
6Everything you treasure most
will be taken from you.
7Your allies can't be trusted.
They will force you out
of your own country.
And your best friends
will trick and trap you,
even before you know it.
8Edom, when this happens,
I, the Lord, will destroy
all your marvelous wisdom.
9Warriors from the city of Teman
will be terrified,
and you descendants of Esau
will be wiped out.
The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
10You were cruel to your relatives,
the descendants of Jacob.
Now you will be destroyed,
disgraced forever.
11You stood there and watched
as foreigners entered Jerusalem
and took what they wanted.
In fact, you were no better
than those foreigners.
12Why did you celebrate
when such a dreadful disaster
struck your relatives?
Why were you so pleased
when everyone in Judah
was suffering?
13They are my people,
and you were cruel to them.
You went through their towns,
sneering and stealing
whatever was left.
14In their time of torment,
you ambushed refugees
and handed them over
to their attackers.
The Lord Will Judge the Nations
15The day is coming
when I, the Lord,
will judge the nations.
And, Edom, you will pay in full
for what you have done.
16I forced the people of Judah
to drink the wine of my anger
on my sacred mountain.
Soon the neighboring nations
must drink their fill—
then vanish without a trace.
Victory for Israel
17The Lord's people who escape
will go to Mount Zion,
and it will be holy.
Then Jacob's descendants
will capture the land of those
who took their land.
18Israel will be a fire,
and Edom will be straw
going up in flames.
The Lord has spoken!
19The people of Israel
who live in the Southern Desert
will take the land of Edom.
Those who live in the hills
will capture Philistia,
Ephraim, and Samaria.
And the tribe of Benjamin
will conquer Gilead.
20Those who return from captivity
will control Phoenicia
as far as Zarephath.
Captives from Jerusalem
who were taken to Sepharad
will capture the towns
of the Southern Desert.
21Those the Lord has saved
will live on Mount Zion
and rule over Edom.
Then the kingdom will belong
to the Lord.
translation_text:
Lɛɛro na wó yi Edom tiina tei to
1Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na veere wonnu telo o bere Obadia ye te ye Edom tiina yera taane to mo tento:
Dé nigi kwora kanto Baŋa Wɛ tei ne mo. O toŋe nɔɔno se o vo logo baŋa teene dem wone mo se o ta we, “Zaŋe-na se dé vo dé kwaare jara dedaane Edom tiina bam.”
Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo de Edom tiina bam:
2“Nii ywo! Amo lage a pa se á teo kom mo tiini ko taa bwona teene dem maama wone. Nɔɔna wó taa jege abam ba tiini ba yaala. 3Abam bere á tete kamunim. Á nam jege á tete mo á gana. Á zoore peero bɔɔna wone, dedaane peero tem yuu ne wɛ-wɛ. Á boŋe á wone we, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane abam o vaare o de tega ne. 4Abam ná maŋe á di wɛyuu, nenɛɛne maao na jaane wɛ-wɛ tei to, naa á ná lage á sɔ pwogo chalechwe sem tetare ne de, amo ta wó vaare abam a de tega ne.”
Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.
5“Lɛɛro mo wo á baŋa ne! Ŋweena ná tu á sɔŋɔ se ba ŋɔ tete ne, ba bá ŋɔ wonnu telo yerane ba na beeri to mo na? Nɔɔna ná tu se ba gwori Vini tio-bia, ba yeini ba ba gwori ba daare tio-bia badwonna na? 6Ko nam ná ye Esawu dwi tiina bam, á dona wó beeri ba buŋi á jei sem maama ne ba vere wonnu telo maama na jege kuri te pa abam to mo ba daare abam. 7Á fara bam tete mo lage ba zeili abam se á nwoŋi á duri á daare á tega kam. Balo na gwoni ni de abam to tete lage ba lɔ á kwaga ne mo se ba wane abam ba di. Á badwoŋ-swonnu tem wó che kalanchogo se ba ma ba ja abam, ye á yeiri ko ni ne.”
8 Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we:
“Dento dɛ dem ná yia, amo wó chɔge swa tiina balo maama na zoore Edom ne to, dedaane yi-pore-nyena na wo Esawu peero tem seeni to. 9Ko ná ye nɔn-babɛ selo na zoore Teman teo wone to, foone wó ja-ba. Ko daare balo maama na ye Esawu dwi dem to wó jei mo.”
Esawu dwi tiina na chɔge Jakob dwi tiina tei to
10“Abam déem tiini á ke puseŋa de á chorro tem na ye Jakob dwi dem to ye á go-ba. Konto ŋwaane mo abam wó di á chaveera, ye á daare á na chɔgem se ko taa vei wuu. 11Veira déem na tu ba fe ba zo Jerusalem teo wone se ba vere ko jejegero ba ja ba viiri to, á zege mo á nia ye á wo chege-ba. Veira bam konto na pɔɔre wonnu tem ba pa daane to, abam dedaane banto maama maŋe á ba gare daane.
12Abam ya dae se á ta‑á mɔne á chaka de lɛɛro na yi á chorro tem tei to.
Abam ya dae se á ta‑á jege wopwolo dedaane Judah tiina bam na nɛ chɔgem tei to.
Abam ya dae se á ta‑á mage á nyɔɔna de banto cham dem.
13Abam ya dae se á tɔge á zo amo nɔɔna bam teo kom wone
dɛ delo wone ba na nɛ ba lɛɛro tem to.
Abam ya dae se á ta‑á jege Judah tiina bam á mɔna
de ba na nɛ cham delo ba lɛɛro dɛ dem ne to.
Abam ya dae se á tɔge á pɛ ba jejegero á ta‑á tei
ba lɛɛro dɛ dem ne.
14Abam ya dae se á zege chwo-pwɛa yam ne se á go balo na duri se ba lu jara yam wone to.
Abam ya dae se á ja balo ta na daare to á ke ba dona bam jeŋa ne
ba cham dɛ dem ne.”
Baŋa Wɛ borem dɛ dem lage de yi
15“Amo Baŋa Wɛ dɛ dem lage de yi se a di logo baŋa dwi maama taane. Edom tiina bam, á de wó na á nyem, nenɛɛne á na ke nɔɔna badwonna tei to. Á keim-balwaaro tem lage te jwoori te to á tete yuu ne mo. 16Abam déem na wo amo tete peo kom yuu ne ye á nyɔ sana á su tei to, konto dwoŋi mo dwi-gɛ tiina bam de wó su de a ban-zɔŋɔ kom. Ba wó tiini ba nyɔ taa ba su, pa se ba yera laam saare logo baŋa ne. 17Ko daare Zion peo kom ne mo nɔɔna wó na verem. Jei sem konto wó taa ye wose se pa-ne. Jakob dwi tiina bam wó jwoori ba jwoŋi ba tega kam balo na vere-ka to tei ne ba taa tei. 18Jakob dwi dem wó chɔge ba dona ne mini na zwɛ wonnu tei to mo. Josɛf dwi tiina bam wó taa nye de min-vogo mo. Ba wó di Esawu dwi tiina bam kula, ne mini na yeini de zwɛ ga-korro tei to. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá daare Esawu dwi tiina bam wone.”
Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.
19Isarele tiina balo na zoore tega-kuri seeni kagoa kam ne to mo wó zo Esawu peero jei sem ne ba taa zoore da. Balo de na zoore wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne to maa wó jwoŋi Filisi tiina tega kam ba taa tei. Ba ta wó jwoŋi Efrayim laŋa kam de Samaria laŋa kam. Benjamin dwi dem wó jwoŋi Gilead laŋa kam ba taa tei. 20Isarele tiina balo maama ya na jage to wó jwoori ba zo Kanaan tega kam. Ba kɔgɔ kom wó jeini tega kam maama ne se ko vo ko yi Zarefate. Jerusalem tiina balo na jage ye ba wo Sefarade ne to de wó vo ba jeini teene delo na wo tega-kuri seeni kagoa kam ne to. 21Babɛ selo na jwoŋi ba nɔɔna ba yage to mo wó di Zion peo kom yuu. Ba wó taa tei Esawu peero laŋa kam maama. Kanto maŋa kam ne, Baŋa Wɛ mo wó di paare o nɔɔna baŋa ne.

english_text:
Jonah Runs from the Lord
1 One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai, 2to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
3Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
4But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces. 5The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter.
All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep. 6The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
7Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
8They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
9Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
10When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
11The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
12Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
13The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute. 14So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.” 15Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down. 16The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
17 The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_text:
Jonah ve Wɛ ni
1 Baŋa Wɛ déem mo ŋɔɔne de Amitayi bu Jonah o we, 2“Zaŋe n vo Ninevɛ te-fɔrɔ kom n ta‑n kaane ko nɔɔna bam we, ba lwarem dem gaale amo yiga ne.”
3Jonah ma ve ye o zaŋe o duri se o vo Tarasisi. O déem vei Jopa mo se o ná nɛ nabworo na maa vei jei sem konto, se o duri o lu Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. O laam ma ŋwe o sabu, ye o da o zo nabworo kom ne.
4 Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se vo-dɛɔ zaŋe ko mage na bam dedɛ. Vio kom na tiini ko fufugi konto to, nabworo kom maa ga fee se ko bwori. 5Foone ma tiini de ja nabworo kom yuŋina bam, ye ba dedoa dedoa bobo o kaase o lwoori o teo wɛ se de jwoŋi‑o de yage. Ba ma daare ba dole ba zela ba yage na bam ne se nabworo kom taa pwona.
Jonah déem nam ya tu nabworo kom kuri gugworo ne mo o tigi da, ye o dɔ o kɛ. 6Yuŋina bam yiga tu wom ma vo o na‑o, ye o bwei‑o o we, “Bɛ mo ye nmo tigi n dɔa? Nmo de zaŋe n bwoŋi n Wɛ yere, se dɛ delo wonto wó duri dé ŋwaŋa, se dé yé maŋe na banto wone.”
7Nabworo yuŋina bam ma bane daane ba we, “Pa-na se dé ta jɔrɔ se dé lɔre wolo ŋwaane cham dento na yi debam to.” Ba na tage to, ko ma ja Jonah. 8Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Ta‑n tɛa, wɔ mo pɛ se lwarem dento ba debam baŋa? Bɛ totoŋe mo nmo jega se n toŋe ywo? Nmo nwoŋi yei ne mo? Nmo dwi ye dɔ mo?”
9Jonah ma leiri o we, “Amo ye Hiburu dwi tu mo. Amo nam tɔge Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo na tei wɛyuu ye o kwori o ke tega baŋa de naneo maama to mo.” 10Ba na nigi konto to, foone déem ma tiini de ja nɔɔna bam. Kokuri to, Jonah ya maŋe o ta o bere-ba we o kwaane se o duri o lu Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne mo. Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Bɛ mo ye nmo ke keim dento?”
11Nabworo yuŋina bam ma bwei‑o ba we, “Bɛ mo dé wó ke de nmo se naneo kom ke ziim?” Vio kom déem yɔɔre ko taa tiini ko dana ko pa-ba mo pa se ba bwei‑o konto. 12Jonah ma leiri o we, “Ja-na amo á dole á de naneo kom wone, se ko wó ke ziim ko pa abam. Ko ye chega, amo yiga mo pɛ se abam zo vo-dɛɔ konto wone.”
13Ba maa wo sɛ ye ba ya ta kwaane ba yuŋa de ba dam maama se nabworo kom wane ko bɛ buburu baŋa, ye ba ware. Vio kom ma bole ye ko fɔge ko tiini ko dana ko ja gaale. 14Ba ma kaase ba bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere ba we, “Jan ja, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ! Dé lwoori‑m, yé chɔge debam dé na lage dé le nɔɔno wom ŋwea to ŋwaane. Kokuri to, nmo ná wo pɛ chwoŋa, tento maama bá ke.” 15Nɔɔna bam ma dole Jonah ba de naneo kom wone, ye ko de ke ziim bedwe baŋa ne. 16Ba na nɛ kolo maama na ke to, mo Wɛ kɔrɔ zo-ba lanyerane. Ba ma kwei kaanem ba ke ba pa Baŋa Wɛ, ye ba ta pwooli se ba taa zuli‑o.
17Ko nam ná ye Jonah, Baŋa Wɛ toŋe ywoni kamunu mo pa se de ba de li‑o. O maa wo ywoni dem wone da yatɔ wea de tete maama.

english_text:
Jonah's Prayer
1From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
2When I was in trouble, Lord,
I prayed to you,
and you listened to me.
From deep in the world
of the dead,
I begged for your help,
and you answered my prayer.
3You threw me down
to the bottom of the sea.
The water was churning
all around;
I was completely covered
by your mighty waves.
4I thought I was swept away
from your sight,
never again to see
your holy temple.
5I was almost drowned
by the swirling waters
that surrounded me.
Seaweed had wrapped
around my head.
6I had sunk down deep
below the mountains
beneath the sea.
I knew that forever,
I would be a prisoner there.
But, you, Lord God,
rescued me from that pit.
7When my life was slipping away,
I remembered you—
and in your holy temple
you heard my prayer.
8All who worship worthless idols
turn from the God
who offers them mercy.
9But with shouts of praise,
I will offer a sacrifice
to you, my Lord.
I will keep my promise,
because you are the one
with power to save.
10 The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_text:
Jonah ware Wɛ
1Jonah déem maa wo ywoni dem puga wone, ye o ware o Tu Baŋa Wɛ o we:
2“Amo Tu, amo na wo cham ne to,
a bwoŋi nmo yere ye n seene n leiri-ne.
Twa gugworru jei sem ne kuri kuri mo
a keeri a lage zeina n tei ne,
ye n ni a keira kam.
3N dole-ne n de luŋu luŋu naneo kuri ne chekke,
mɛ na bam na kaare-ne ba pu to.
Na-ŋon-kamuna ma bibili amo baŋa ne se kɛa.
4Amo ya boŋe we n zeili-ne n yiga ne mo,
pa se a daa yé na nmo tete diga kam dɛ de dɛ.
5Na bam kwoli-ne ye ba kerege-ne.
Naneo kom de ma pu amo maama.
Na wone gaaro tem de déem jujugi amo yuu maama.
6A ma tu na wone a dwei pelwaaro kura,
mɛ chwoŋa na tera se nɔɔno wane o lu kɔtaa to.
Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam jaane-ne,
ye a nwoŋi gwoŋo wone de a ŋwea.
7A na tu a maane we a toone yi de ti to,
mo a guli Baŋa Wɛ gula
ye a ke wɛ-lworo se n jwoŋi-ne.
Nmo ma‑n seene n zege n tete diga kam ne
n ni a lworo kom.
8Jwona ye wo-yɔɔro mo.
Balo maama na zuli-ya to
dole ba chega de nmo mo ba yage.
9Amo nam wó taa leeni tia lei mo a pa‑m.
A ta wó kwei kaanem mo a pa‑m,
se a daare a ke kolo a na pwooli se a ke a pa‑m to.
Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na pae nɔɔna na verem to mo!”
10Konto maama kwaga ne mo, Baŋa Wɛ laam ŋɔɔne de ywoni dem se de vo de twi Jonah de de buburu baŋa ne. De ma seene de vo de ke konto.

english_text:
Jonah Goes to Nineveh
1Once again the Lord told Jonah 2to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
3Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it. 4 After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
5They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
6When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust. 7-9Then he and his officials sent out an order for everyone in the city to obey. It said:
None of you or your animals may eat or drink a thing. Each of you must wear sackcloth, and you must even put sackcloth on your animals.
