1Yezu déem ma maŋe memaŋe dedwoŋi o bere nɔɔna bam ye o we, 2“Wɛ telaao paare dem nam nye de pɛ wodwoŋi na lage se o ke kadiri o pa o bu. 3Pɛ wom ya tage nɔɔna badwonna mo se ba ba ba tɔge ba di kadiri dem. Dɛ dem na tu de yi to, o ma toŋe o tontoŋena se ba vo ba bwoŋi nɔɔna bam konto se ba ba. Ba maa wo sɛ se ba ba. 4O laam ma jwoori o toŋe o tontoŋena badwonna se ba vo nɔɔna bam tei. O maa we ba ta de nɔɔna bam we, ‘Ba-na, se amo ti woŋo maama yiga, ye a pa ba go na-bale de naane delo na nugi lanyerane to. Nam ba-na se dé di kadiri dem wodiu kom.’
5Nɔɔna balo ba na bwoŋi konto to yiga maa tera. Ba ma zaŋe ba vo ba boboŋa jei. Ba dedoa vei o kara mo. Dedoa ma vo se o ke o pipiu. 6Nɔɔna badaara bam ma ja pɛ wom tontoŋena bam ba bɛɛse ba go.
7Pɛ wom bane ma tiini de zaŋe. O ma toŋe o babɛ pa se ba vo ba go nɔn-gora bam konto ye ba daare ba zwɛ ba teo kom maama. 8O laam ma ta de o tontoŋena bam o we, ‘Kadiri dem woŋo maama ti ko yiga se dé di. Amo nam na tage se nɔɔna balo ba ba tɔge ba di to ya wo maŋe de kuri dem. 9Konto ŋwaane nwoŋi-na á vo teo kom pwooni, se á ná nɛ nɔɔno wolo maama, se á bwoŋi‑o se o ba o tɔge o di.’ 10O tontoŋena bam ma nwoŋi ba beeri teo kom maama ba la nɔɔna balo maama ba na nɛ to, ko ná ye nɔn-laaro naa nɔn-balwaaro de. Pɛ wom sɔŋɔ kom ma tiini ko su de nɔɔna bam.
11Pɛ wom laam ma nwoŋi se o zaane nɔɔna bam. O ma na nɔɔno dedoa na wora o na wo zo gare-ŋoŋo kolo na maŋe de kadiri dim to. 12Pɛ wom ma bwei‑o o we, ‘A badwoŋi, nmo ke tɛ mo n tɔge n wo ywo-seeni, ye nmo wo zo gɔrɔ kolo na lamma to?’ Nɔɔno wom maa ba jege taane se o ta. 13Pɛ wom laam ma ta de o tontoŋena o we, ‘Ja-na nɔɔno wonto á vɔ o jea de o nɛ, se á ja‑o á nwoŋi á de á yage lim jei ne, yaara na wo mɛ to, pa se o keeri ye o done o nwa.’
14Tɔ. Ko bere we, Wɛ bwoŋi nɔɔna dedɛ se ba ba o tei, ye ba fenfee yerane mo o kuri o guuri o nɔɔna bam wone.”
Lampwoo ŋweem taane
Maake 12:13-17; Luka 20:20-26
15 Farisi tiina bam laam ma zaŋe ba vo se ba bane ba nii ba na wó ke tei ba pa Yezu ŋɔɔne o tusi se ba ja‑o to. 16Ba ma le ba tɔgena badwonna se ba tɔge de Pɛ Herodi kwaga nɔɔna badwonna se ba vo Yezu tei. Ba ma vo ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Berem tu, dé yei we nmo ye chega tu, ye n yeini n bere nɔɔna Wɛ chwoŋa chekke. Nmo yiga tera de nɔɔna na boŋe kolo ba pa nmo to, ye n ta ba pɔɔre nɔɔna daane de n na ke-ba tei to. 17Dé nam lage se dé bwei nmo dé nii, debam Juu tiina ná ŋwe lampwoo dé pa logo kom Pa-faro wom, ko chɔge debam chullu na?” 18Yezu ma lɔre ba na jege boboŋ-balɔrɔ konto to, ye o leiri-ba o we, “Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Bɛ nam mo ye á lage se á ja-ne? 19Nam bere-ne sabu-dale delo dé na yeini dé ma ŋwe lampwoo to.” Ba ma le sabu-dale dem ba bere‑o. 20O ma nii ye o we, “Wɔ nyenyego de o yere mo ba sare ba yage de baŋa ne?” 21Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Ko ye Pa-faro wom mo.”
O laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko lamma. Á nam ta‑á ŋwe kolo na ye Pa-faro wom nyem to á pa‑o, se á daare á ta‑á pae Wɛ kolo de na ye o nyem to.” 22O na leiri-ba konto to, ko ma so-ba dedɛ. Ba laam ma yage o tei ye ba viiri.
Wɛ telaao ŋwea na wó taa ye tei to
Maake 12:18-27; Luka 20:27-40
23Dɛ dem konto ne, Saduka tiina badwonna déem ma zaŋe ba vo Yezu tei. Banto mo bere we, nɔɔno ná tega, o daa bá jwoori o bi. 24Ba ma vo ba ta de Yezu ba we, “Berem tu, Moses déem bere we, nɔɔno ná tega ye o de o kaane ba jege bia, o nyaane mo jege se o di kadeim dem se ba lo bia o zembaaro wom ŋwaane. 25Tɔ. Nu-bia barepɛ ya mo zoore debam teo ne. Ba nakwe wom ma di kaane ye o te o daare‑o ye o wo loge bu. Wolo na saŋe to laam ma di kaane wom. 26O de ma te, ye ko ke ba maama konto dwoŋi. 27Ba maama na tege to, kaane wom de laam ma te. 28Dé nam lage dé bwei dé nii, ba maama na di kaane wom to, ba laam ná tu ba bi toone wone, banto wɔ mo wó taa tei kaane wom?”
29Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam tiini á tusi mo. Abam nam wo lɔre Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom berem dem, ye á ta yeiri Wɛ dam dem na ye tei to. 30Kokuri, nɔɔna ná tu ba bi toone wone, banto lage ba taa nye de Wɛ malese sem na ye tei to mo, ye ba ba di kaana, naa ba zo banna de. 31Ko nam ná ye twa biim dem, abam maŋe á wo gage kolo Wɛ na tage o bere abam ye ko popone o tɔnɔ kom ne to na? 32O nam tage we, ‘Amo ye Abaraham Wɛ, de Izaak Wɛ, de Jakob Wɛ mo.’ Ko bere we banto daa ta jege ŋwea mo o tei ne, kolo ŋwaane Baŋa Wɛ ye ŋwea tiina nyem mo se o dae twa nyem.”
33Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na nigi Yezu berem dem na ye tei to, ko ma tiini ko ke-ba yaau.
Wɛ nia yam wone dɔ mo dana de dwoi maama?
Maake 12:28-37; Luka 20:41-44
34 Farisi tiina bam déem ma lɔre Yezu na ke tei ye o pa Saduka tiina bam daa ware taane ba ta to. Ba laam ma gwaane daane se ba na chwoŋa ba ja‑o. 35Ba wo dedoa na ye Wɛ nia yam zamesem tu to ma zaŋe o bwei‑o o we, 36“Berem tu, Wɛ nia yam maama wone dɔ mo tiini de dana de dwoi?” 37Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Ta‑n swoi n tu Baŋa Wɛ, de n bochare maama, de n wo maama, de n boboŋa maama. 38Dento nam mo ye Wɛ ni delo na ye yiga tu ye de dana to. 39Delo na saŋe to de tɔge konto dwoŋi ye de we: Ta‑n swoi n dwoŋi se ko maŋe de n tete. 40Moses de faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem bera yam maama yɔɔre ya zege nia yalei yanto yera ne mo.”
41 Farisi tiina badwonna déem ma ba ba gilimi daane. Yezu ma zaŋe o bwei-ba o we, 42“Ko ná ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, abam boŋe we o jege se o nwoŋi wɔ dwi wone mo?” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “O wó taa ye Pɛ David dwi tu mo.” 43Yezu laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko nam wó ke tɛ mo ko taa ye konto? Wɛ Sin-laao kom pɛ se David ŋɔɔne Wɛ Dam Tu wom taane ye David bwoŋi‑o we, o Teiru. Faŋa faŋa to David tage o we:
44‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tage de amo Teiru wom o we,
Ba n jeini amo jazem seeni
se a laam wane n dona bam
a ke nmo dam kuri ne se n ta‑n tei-ba.’
45David nam na seene o bwoŋi Wɛ Dam Tu wom o we o Teiru to, dé nam wó ke tɛ mo ye dé daa ta bwoi‑o we David dwi tu mo?”
46Yezu nam na tage konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa ma ware se o leiri kolokolo. Ko ma zege dɛ dem konto ne nɔɔna maama kɔre se ba daa bwei‑o taane.

english_text:
Jesus Condemns the Pharisees and the Teachers of the Law of Moses
(Mark 12.38-40; Luke 11.37-52; 20.45-47)
1Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
2The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses. 3So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
4They pile heavy burdens on people's shoulders and won't lift a finger to help. 5 Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see. 6They love the best seats at banquets and the front seats in the synagogues. 7And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
8But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters. 9Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven. 10None of you should be called the leader. The Messiah is your only leader. 11 Whoever is the greatest should be the servant of the others. 12 If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
13-14You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
15You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
16You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple. 17You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
18You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar. 19Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred? 20Anyone who swears by the altar also swears by everything on it. 21And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there. 22 To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
23 You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either. 24You blind leaders! You strain out a small fly but swallow a camel.
25You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness. 26You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
27 You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth. 28That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
29You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people. 30And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets. 31But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets. 32So keep on doing everything they did. 33 You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
34I will send to you prophets and wise people and experts in the Law of Moses. You will kill them or nail them to a cross or beat them in your synagogues or chase them from town to town. 35 That's why you will be held guilty for the murder of every good person, beginning with the good man Abel. This also includes Barachiah's son Zechariah, the man you murdered between the temple and the altar. 36I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things!
Jesus Loves Jerusalem
(Luke 13.34,35)
37Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me. 38 And now your temple will be deserted. 39 You won't see me again until you say,
“Blessed is the one who comes
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
Lɛɛro wó yi pipiri-nyena
Maake 12:38-40; Luka 20:45-47; 11:37-54
1Yezu laam ma ŋɔɔne de o kwaga tɔgena bam de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama. 2O ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko ná ye Farisi tiina bam de Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam, banto mo tu ba leiri Moses yuu ne, ye ba jege chwoŋa se ba pa nɔɔna lɔre o berem dem kuri. 3Konto ŋwaane, á jege se á ta‑á tɔge kolo maama ba na bere abam to. Ko nam ná ye ba kikia yam, se á yé zaŋe á ta‑á lwoni-ya, kolo ŋwaane ba tete nam ba tɔge kolo ba na bere nɔɔna to. 4Ba na yeini ba ke tei to, ko nye de ba fe nɔɔna se ba zeŋe zela yalo dum na dwoi ba zeŋem to, ye ba tete yiga tera se ba twori zela yam fenfee de ba zeiŋi. 5Ko ta woli da, ba yeini ba bere ba kikia mo jaja se nɔɔna maama taa nae. Ba yeini ba bere ba tete nɔɔna tei ne we ba jege Wɛ tɔnɔ kom swono, de ba na tiini ba vɔ-ko ba yera ne jaja to. Ba maa tiini ba ke zɔla ba gwaaro nia ne se ko pa nɔɔna taa nege-ba. 6Ba ná yeini ba vo nɔɔno sɔŋɔ se ba di kuri, ko ye jei-laao jei ne mo ba lage se ba taa jei da. Ba ná zo ba jeerim di sem, ba daa ta lage jei-kamunu mo se ba jeini yiga ne. 7Ba ná vei yaga, ba lage se nɔɔna maama taa tui ba tei-ba mo, ye ba ta lage se nɔɔna taa bwoi-ba we ‘Berem tu’.
8Ko nam ná ye abam, á yé ta‑á boŋe se nɔɔna taa bwoi abam we ‘Berem tu’, kolo ŋwaane á maama ye nu-bia mo daane, ye á jege Berem Tu dedoa mo. 9Á na ye nu-bia logo baŋa ne to, se á yé ta‑á jege á wolowolo á bwoi we á kwo. Abam maama ye Kwo dedoa mo. Wonto ye Baŋa Wɛ mo. 10Ko woli da, á yé ta‑á boŋe se nɔɔna taa bwoi abam we ‘Yiga tiina’, kokuri á Yiga tu ye dedoa mo. Wonto maa ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom.
11Abam nɔn-kamunu mo ye wolo na ye tontoŋeno á wone to. 12Wolo maama ná zeiŋi o tete, konto tu wó ba o tu tega mo. Wolo nam ná tu o tete, Wɛ wó zeiŋi konto tu.
13Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á yeini á che chwoŋa á pa nɔɔna ware se ba zo Wɛ telaao paare dem wone. Abam tete ba sɛ se á vo á zo da, ye á daare á che balo maama na boŋe se ba zo da to chwoŋa.
[14Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á yeini á gane kadeina se á jwoŋi wonnu ba tei ne. Á maa bere á tete de á na tiini á ware Wɛ tei to. Konto ŋwaane Wɛ wó tiini o waare abam se ko dwoni á dwonna.]
15Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á yeini á beeri logo jei maama mo se á nii, á wó wane á na dwi-gɛ tu dedoa se o ba o sɛ Wɛ na. Wonto nam ná tu o sɛ, á maa wó bere‑o á tete chullu tem pa se o tiini o ji te-seŋa nyem se ko dwoni abam tete na ye tei to.
16Lɛɛro yi abam! Abam nye de lilwoa na vaŋe ba dwonna lilwoa to mo. Á yeini á bere nɔɔna we, nɔɔno ná dugi duuri Wɛ diga kam ŋwaane, konto ba bere kolokolo. Á ma daare á bere we, nɔɔno nam ná dugi de sabu-seŋa kalo na wo Wɛ diga kam wone to, ko ye fefeo mo konto tu tei ne. 17Abam ye jworru telo yia na ware wonnu ya lɔre to mo. Ko ye diga kam na ye Wɛ tete nyem to ŋwaane mo pa se sabu-seŋa kam de ye o nyem. Ko bere we tento wone kɔ mo damma ko dwoi? 18Abam daa ta bere we, nɔɔno ná dugi de Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem, konto ba bere kolokolo. Á ma daare á bere we, nɔɔno ná dugi de pɛɛra yalo maama na tigi bimbini dem baŋa ne to, ko ye fefeo mo ko pa konto tu. 19Abam yia ware ya na kolo na ye chega to. Ko ye bimbini dem na ye Wɛ nyem to mo pa se pɛɛra yam de ye Wɛ nyem. Tento wone kɔ mo damma ko dwoi? 20Mo kokuri, nɔɔno wolo ná dugi de bimbini dem, ko bere we konto tu dugi de bimbini dem tete ko woli de woŋo kolo maama na tigi de baŋa ne to mo. 21Wolo de na dugi de Wɛ diga kam to seene o du de Wɛ tete de mo, Wɛ na zoore ka wone to ŋwaane. 22Nɔɔno wolo daa ta ná dugi de Wɛ telaao kom, konto tu dugi de Wɛ paare dim jei mo. Wɛ tete na jeini dáane to, ko bere we konto tu dugi de Baŋa Wɛ de mo.
23Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Ko ná ye dwoa wo-sworru, te ná maŋe te ye fenfee tei de, á yeini á pɔɔre Wɛ-teiri á pa‑o. Ko lamma. Ko daare á yiga tera de Wɛ nia yadaara yalo na tiini ya jege yuu to, nenɛɛne chega tɔgem, de da-ŋwaŋa durim, de wo-pwoŋo kikia. Ko ya maŋe se á ta‑á ke wonnu tem konto mo á woli tedaara tem wone. 24Abam seene á nye de lilwoa balo na vaŋe ba dwonna lilwoa to mo. Abam ná yeini á lage á nyɔ na, á kwaane mo se á leeri-ba, se pwoŋo-memeeno kolo ná wora, se á le-ko á yage. Á yiga nam tera de wo-kamunu kolo á na lage á li to, ko ná maŋe ko ma de kone de.
25Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á ná lage á di wodiu, á yeini á tɔge á chullu tem á fɔge á se á na-zwe de á kabeili, ko ná maŋe ko ye se kwɛ mo de. Ko daare wodiu kolo á na di se wone to maa ye kampina de puseŋa. 26Farisi tu, nmo nye de lilwei mo tei. Nmo maŋe se n da yiga n se n zoŋa wo mo, se ka kwaga de daa yé taa jege digiru.
27Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á nye de yibeela yalo ba na fɔge ya kwaga se ya taa lamma nɔɔna yia ne to mo. Yibeela yam konto wo ma su de twa kwi, ye ya tiini ya ye digiru yerane. 28Abam de nam ye konto mo. Á pae á jege chega nɔɔna yia ne, ye lwarem yerane mo su á wo, dedaane pipira kikia.
29Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena. Á yeini á fɔge á ke faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem yibeela, ye á daare á pa se nɔn-ŋona bam de yibeela yam tiini ya kwɛ lanyerane. 30Á ma daare á bere we, á ya ná wora á kwoa nakwa bam maŋa kam ne, á bá sɛ á tɔge de-ba á go Wɛ sampwori sem. 31Abam tete ni mo bere we á ye balo na go Wɛ sampwori sem to bia. Bia nam tɔge ba kwoa kikia mo. 32Tɔ. Nam kwaane á toŋe á kwoa nakwa bam na ke wo-lwanno telo ba daare to se ko vo ko ti. 33Abam nye de basankwe mo de á kwoa maama. Á bere á bá lu te-seŋa waarem dem wone. 34Mo kokuri a lage a toŋe a sampwori abam tei ne, de yi-pore-nyena, de Wɛ tɔnɔ zamesem tiina de. Abam wó ja ba badaara á go, ye ko wó taa ye dagara yuu ne mo á wó go badaara de. Á ma‑á wó ja badaara á jeerim di sem ne á fere, ye á daare á pare-ba á ja kaage teene. 35Á na wó bɛɛse Wɛ nɔɔna konto to, Wɛ waarem dem wó ba á baŋa, nenɛɛne ko ye abam tete mo go nɔn-ŋona balo maama ba na maŋe ba go logo baŋa ne to. Konto zege Abel wolo na ye nɔn-ŋom ye Kain go‑o to, se ko ba ko woli de Barakia bu Zekaria abam kwoa na go‑o Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem de o tete diga kam tetare laŋa ne to. 36A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, kikia yam konto waarem dem maama jege se de ba zem nɔɔna bam baŋa ne mo.
Yezu wo chɔge Jerusalem tiina ŋwaane
Luka 13:34-35
37Ei! Jerusalem tiina bam, á yeini á go Wɛ sampwori selo o na toŋe abam tei ne to ye á dole-ba de kandwa. Kuni dedɛ mo a ya lage se a la abam nɔn-bia a ke daane se a taa nii á baŋa ne, nenɛɛne chworo na kukwori ko bia ko ke ko vɔna kuri ne tei to. Abam maa ba sɛa. 38Tɔ. Wɛ laam wó dɔne o je abam teo kom baŋa ne se ko ji di-dwonnu. 39Nam ta‑á yei-na we, á daa bá na-ne se ko taa vei maŋa kalo á na wó ta we, ‘Dé Teiru Wɛ wó swɛ wolo na tu o yere ŋwaane to swolim.’ ”

english_text:
The Temple Will Be Destroyed
(Mark 13.1,2; Luke 21.5,6)
1After Jesus left the temple, his disciples came over and said, “Look at all these buildings!”
2Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.”
Warning about Trouble
(Mark 13.3-13; Luke 21.7-19)
3 Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
4Jesus answered:
Don't let anyone fool you. 5Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
6You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end. 7 Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes. 8But this is just the beginning of troubles.
9 You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations. 10Many will give up and will betray and hate each other. 11Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people. 12Evil will spread and cause many people to stop loving others. 13 But if you keep on being faithful right to the end, you will be saved. 14When the good news about the kingdom has been preached all over the world and told to all nations, the end will come.
The Horrible Thing
(Mark 13.14-23; Luke 21.20-24)
15 Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand! 16If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains. 17 If you are on the roof of your house, don't go inside to get anything. 18If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat. 19It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children. 20And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath. 21 This will be the worst time of suffering since the beginning of the world, and nothing this terrible will ever happen again. 22If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
23Someone may say, “Here is the Messiah!” or “There he is!” But don't believe it. 24False messiahs and false prophets will come and work great miracles and signs. They will even try to fool God's chosen ones. 25But I have warned you ahead of time. 26 If you are told the Messiah is out in the desert, don't go there! And if you are told he is in some secret place, don't believe it! 27The coming of the Son of Man will be like lightning that can be seen from east to west. 28 Where there is a corpse, there will always be vultures.
When the Son of Man Appears
(Mark 13.24-27; Luke 21.25-28)
29 Right after those days of suffering,
“The sun will become dark,
and the moon
will no longer shine.
The stars will fall,
and the powers in the sky
will be shaken.”
30 Then a sign will appear in the sky. And there will be the Son of Man. All nations on earth will weep when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. 31At the sound of a loud trumpet, he will send his angels to bring his chosen ones together from all over the earth.
A Lesson from a Fig Tree
(Mark 13.28-31; Luke 21.29-33)
32Learn a lesson from a fig tree. When its branches sprout and start putting out leaves, you know summer is near. 33So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come. 34I can promise you that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all this happens. 35The sky and the earth won't last forever, but my words will.
No One Knows the Day or Time
(Mark 13.32-37; Luke 17.26-30,34-36)
36No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows. 37 When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived. 38People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat. 39 They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
40Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left. 41Two women will be together grinding grain, but only one will be taken. The other will be left. 42So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come. 43 Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in. 44Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.
Faithful and Unfaithful Servants
(Luke 12.35-48)
45Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time? 46Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job. 47You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns. 48But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late. 49Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk. 50If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. 51This servant will then be punished and thrown out with the ones who only pretended to serve their master. There they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.
translation_text:
Lɛɛro wó ba logo baŋa
Maake 13:1-23; Luka 21:5-24
1Yezu laam ma nwoŋi Wɛ diga kam ne se o viiri. O na maa kɛ konto to, o kwaga tɔgena bam ma ba o tei se ba pa o maane Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm dem na ye tei to. 2O ma ta de-ba o we, “Á nɛ ka na ye tei to na? A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, ka maama wó ba ka to ka saare tega ne. Kandwɛ dedwe daa bá daare de dwoŋi baŋa ne.”
3Yezu déem ma vo o jeini Olivi peo kom yuu ne. O na wora konto to, o kwaga tɔgena bam yerane ma vo o tei, ye ba bwei‑o ba we, “Maŋa kɔ mo Wɛ diga kam lage ka ba ka chɔge konto? Bɛ mo lage ko pa debam maana se dé lɔre we maŋa kam yi se n jwoori n ba logo baŋa, se ko maama laam ba ko kweeli?” 4Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Fɔge-na á che á tete se á yé pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno chwoŋa se o gane abam. 5Kokuri nɔɔna dedɛ wó ba abam tei ye ba ma amo yere ba ta de abam we, banto mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom. Konto dwoŋi mo ba wó gane nɔɔna dedɛ. 6Ko ta woli da, á wó ba á na tigura na wora abam jei sem ne, ye á kwori á ni ka ŋwa teene dedwonna ne. Nam yé pa-na se lwia taa jege abam, kokuri wonnu tem konto jege se te ke mo, ye ko dae we ko yi logo kom tiim mo. 7Dwi tiina wó zaŋe ba ke jara de ba dwonna dwi-gɛ tiina, ye teo de ko dwoŋi teo wó zaŋe te mage jara. Kana de maa wó ba ka taa wora jei dedɛ ne, ye tega de wó ziziŋi jei sedwonna ne. 8Wonnu tem konto maama nam nye de kaane na virigi puga, ye cham daa ta wo kwaga ne to mo.
9Konto maŋa kam ne nɔɔna wó ja abam ba ke dedɛɛra jeŋa ne se ba bɛɛse abam, ye ba daare ba go abam. Abam na ye amo nyem to ŋwaane, logo baŋa nɔɔna maama wó taa chuli abam. 10Nɔɔna dedɛ wó ba ba za ba boboŋa de amo. Nɔɔna badaara maa wó ko da-kura ba bere daane, ye ba badwonna de wó taa chuli daane. 11Nɔɔna dedɛ wó ba ba bere we ba ye Wɛ sampwori ye ba seene ba dae. Ba maa wó gane nɔɔna dedɛ. 12Totoŋ-lwanno maa wó ba te tiini te gaale, ye nɔɔna dedɛ swono de chɔge. 13Wolo maama nam ná jege pu-dɛa se ko vo ko kweeli, Wɛ wó jwoŋi konto tu ŋwea. 14Ko woli da, nɔɔna wó beeri logo baŋa jei maama ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam we, Wɛ lage o di paare o nɔɔna baŋa ne, se ko taa ye maana nabiina maama tei ne, se logo kom kweelim laam yi.
15Abam nam wó ba á na wo-zɔɔne delo na chɔge Wɛ yere to na wó ba ko zege Wɛ tete diga kam ne. Wɛ sampwora Danyeli maŋe o ta wo-zɔɔne dem konto taane.” A tɛ abam wolo ná gaga, se n kwaane n ni ko kuri lanyerane.
16“Abam ná nɛ wo-lɔŋɔ kom konto, se abam balo na zoore Judea ne to ke lela á nwoŋi á duri á vo peero jei á seigi da. 17Nɔɔno nam ná wo nayuu ne, se o yé tu o zege se o kwaleme o wonnu o diga wone. 18Nɔɔno wolo nam ná wo kara ne, se o daa yé jwoori sɔŋɔ se o kwei o gare-laao o zo. 19Kanto maŋa kam ne ko wó tiini ko taa ye lɛɛro kaana balo na jege pwi to tei ne, de balo na jege bia ye ba ŋɔge yele to tei ne. 20Nam ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ se cham durim dem konto yé ba doa nenem maŋa ne, naa á siu dɛ dem ne. 21Kokuri yaara yalo na lage ya ba maŋa kam konto ne to wó taa chamma ya dwoi yalo na maŋe ya ke boboa ne se ko ba ko yi zem to. Yanto nam ná kea, ya dwoŋi daa tera ya na wó ba konto dwoŋi. 22Wɛ ya ná wo pɛ se yaara yam da yam tiri, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ya bá wori. O nam wó pa se yaara yam da yam tiri, o tete nɔɔna bam o na kuri to ŋwaane.
23Kanto maŋa kam ne, nɔɔno wolo maama ná tage de abam o we, ‘Nii Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, o wo ywo-seeni’, se á yé sɛ konto tu. 24Nɔɔna badaara wó zaŋe ba bere we ba ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom ye ba dae, ye ba badwonna de bere we banto mo ye Wɛ sampwori ye ba dae. Ba maa wó ke wo-kenkagela yalo na wó so nɔɔna to, ye chwoŋa ya ná wora, yanto ya wó wane ya soge Wɛ tete nɔɔna balo o na kuri to de. 25Nii-na, amo nam wuuri a ta a bere abam mo ye ka maŋa kam ta wo yi.
26Ko woli da, nɔɔna ná tage de abam ba we, ‘Nii-na Wɛ Dam Tu wom na tu o wora kagoa yuu ne’, se á yé zaŋe á vo dáane. Ba nam daa ta ná we, ‘Nii‑o da, o zo sɔŋɔ konto o seigi’, se á yé sɛ. 27Kokuri amo Nabiin-bu wom ná seene a lage a ba logo baŋa dɛ delo ne, ko wó taa nye de doa na pepele wɛyuu ne se ko zege bira-kwaga ne ko vo ko yi sam-yiga to. 28Chega ŋwaane to, wo-too na tigi mɛ to, duura de wó gilimi da mo.
Nabiin-bu wom tutuuri dem taane
Maake 13:24-37; Luka 21:25-33; 17:26-30, 34-36; 12:41-48
29Yaara yam konto maŋa kam ná tu ka kɛ,
ko bá dáane ye wea kam laam ji nazwono tim-tim.
Chana kam de daa bá fuŋi
se pwooni taa wora.
Chalechwe sem de wó kwori wɛyuu ne se to tega ne,
ye wɛ-baŋa de wó ziziŋi pa se ko wonnu maama leiri.
30Nɔɔna laam wó na wo-kenkagele wɛyuu ne se ko bere we Nabiin-bu wom maa beena. Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama maa wó taa keera, de ba na nɛ Nabiin-bu wom na maa beene to. O wó taa dɔge kunkwonnu baŋa ne o beena de dam, ye nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ tiini ko wo o tei ne. 31Nabɔnɔ maa wó tiini ko taa wui wɛ-wɛ, ye o laam pa se Wɛ malese sem nwoŋi se ba se zege logo baŋa dɛ sena sem ne, se se la nɔɔna balo Wɛ na kuri ye ba wo jei maama ne to se ke daane.
32Nam maane-na á nii kaporo na ye tei to. Konto ná yeini ko wora ko kwi vɔɔro, á yeini á lɔre we ko twɛ yadɛ maŋa mo. 33Ko maa ye bedwe mo de á ná nɛ wonnu tento maama ná wora te ke, se á lɔre we maŋa kam laam twɛ ka ti mo. 34A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, wonnu tem konto maama wó ba te ke ye abam dwi dem ta wo ti. 35Wɛyuu de tega baŋa maama wó ba te jei, ye amo taane dem ta wó taa jege chega se ko taa vei wuu.
36Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam yeiri dɛ delo Nabiin-bu wom na lage o jwoori o ba to, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri dɛ dem wone maŋa kam o na wó ba to, ko ná maŋe ko ye Wɛ malese sem naa o Bu wom tete de. Ko nam ye a Kwo Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo yei. 37Nabiin-bu wom na wó ba to, ko dɛ dem wó pɔpɔ de ba nɔɔna baŋa nenɛɛne ko déem na ke Noah maŋa kam ne tei to mo. 38Kanto maŋa kam ne ye na-fɔrɔ daa ta wo wɛɛle ko lim tega kam to, nɔɔna wora yɔɔ yerane mo. Ba maa yɔɔre ba di ba wodiiru, ye ba daare ba di kaana, ye kaana de zoore banna, se ko vo ko yi dɛ dem Noah na zo nabwor-kamunu kom wone to. 39Ba ta maa wo lɔre woŋo kolo na lage ko ba ko ke to, ye na bam wɛɛlem dem laam pɔpɔ de ba de pɛ ba maama. Nabiin-bu wom de wó pɔpɔ o ba konto dwoŋi mo. 40Kanto maŋa kam ne nɔɔna balei ná wo kara ne ba toŋa, Wɛ wó chaale ba dedoa o daare wodwoŋi wom. 41Kaana balei de ná wora ba choe muni nɔŋɔ ne, Wɛ wó chaale ba dedoa o daare wodwoŋi wom.
42Konto ŋwaane fɔge-na á che á tete, se á yeiri dɛ dem á Teiru wom na wó ba to. 43Á nam maŋe á yei we, sɔŋɔ tu ya ná lɔre maŋa kalo ŋweeno na lage o ba tete ne to, o ya wó taa nii o sɔŋɔ kom se ŋweeno wom yé na chwoŋa o ba o ŋɔ. 44Konto ŋwaane abam jege se á che á tete mo, se Nabiin-bu wom lage o ba maŋa kam á na ba jege o teena to mo.
45Abam jege se á ta‑á tɔge chega de á boboŋ-dɛɛra, nenɛɛne tontoŋeno wolo yuu tu na yage o totoŋa o pa‑o ye o daare o beeri to. O tu wom ma le‑o se o taa nii o dwonna tontoŋena bam baŋa ne se o daare o taa pa-ba ba ni-wodiu. 46Kotu sɔŋɔ tu wom ná jwoori o ba, de o ke kolo maama o na pɛ‑o se o ke to, wopwolo laam wó taa wo tontoŋeno wom konto tei ne. 47A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, o tu wom laam wó pa se o taa nii o jejegero maama baŋa ne mo.
48O nam ná ye tontoŋeno-balɔrɔ, wonto ya wó boŋe we omo tu wom wó dáane ye o jwoori. 49O maa wó taa jege o dwonna tontoŋena bam mo o maga, ye o daare o tɔge de sa-nyɔra o di ye o nyɔ sana de-ba. 50Sɔŋɔ tu wom laam wó jwoori o ba dɛ dem tontoŋeno wom na ba jege o teena de maŋa kalo o na wó ba o zo to. 51O tu wom nam ná tu o peere‑o konto, o laam wó zeili‑o o sɔŋɔ kom wone, ye o daare o pa se o tɔge de pipiri-nyena o na yaara dedɛ jei selo ne ba na wó taa keera ye ba done ba nwa to.

english_text:
A Story about Ten Young Women
1 The kingdom of heaven is like what happened one night when ten young women took their oil lamps and went to a wedding to meet the groom. 2Five of them were foolish and five were wise. 3The foolish ones took their lamps, but no extra oil. 4The ones who were wise took along extra oil for their lamps.
5The groom was late arriving, and the young women became drowsy and fell asleep. 6Then in the middle of the night someone shouted, “Here's the groom! Come to meet him!”
7When the women got up and started getting their lamps ready, 8the foolish ones said to the others, “Let us have some of your oil! Our lamps are going out.”
9Those who were wise answered, “There's not enough oil for all of us! Go and buy some for yourselves.”
10While the foolish ones were on their way to get some oil, the groom arrived. The five who were ready went into the wedding, and the doors were closed. 11 Later the others returned and shouted, “Sir, sir! Open the door for us!”
12But the groom replied, “I don't even know you!”
13So, my disciples, always be ready! You don't know the day or the time when all this will happen.
A Story about Three Servants
(Luke 19.11-27)
14 The kingdom is also like what happened when a man went away and put his three servants in charge of all he owned. 15The man knew what each servant could do. So he handed 5,000 coins to the first servant, 2,000 to the second, and 1,000 to the third. Then he left the country.
16As soon as the man had gone, the servant with the 5,000 coins used them to earn 5,000 more. 17The servant who had 2,000 coins did the same with his money and earned 2,000 more. 18But the servant with 1,000 coins dug a hole and hid his master's money in the ground.
19Some time later the master of those servants returned. He called them in and asked what they had done with his money. 20The servant who had been given 5,000 coins brought them in with the 5,000 that he had earned. He said, “Sir, you gave me 5,000 coins, and I have earned 5,000 more.”
21“Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
22Next, the servant who had been given 2,000 coins came in and said, “Sir, you gave me 2,000 coins, and I have earned 2,000 more.”
23“Wonderful!” his master replied. “You are a good and faithful servant. I left you in charge of only a little, but now I will put you in charge of much more. Come and share in my happiness!”
24The servant who had been given 1,000 coins then came in and said, “Sir, I know that you are hard to work for. You harvest what you don't plant and gather crops where you haven't scattered seed. 25I was frightened and went out and hid your money in the ground. Here is every single coin!”
26The master of the servant told him, “You are lazy and good-for-nothing! You know I harvest what I don't plant and gather crops where I haven't scattered seed. 27You could have at least put my money in the bank, so I could have earned interest on it.”
28Then the master said, “Now your money will be taken away and given to the servant with 10,000 coins! 29 Everyone who has something will be given more, and they will have more than enough. But everything will be taken from those who don't have anything. 30 You are a worthless servant, and you will be thrown out into the dark where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”
The Final Judgment
31 When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all his angels, he will sit on his royal throne. 32The people of all nations will be brought before him, and he will separate them, as shepherds separate their sheep from their goats.
33He will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left. 34Then the king will say to those on his right, “My father has blessed you! Come and receive the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world was created. 35 When I was hungry, you gave me something to eat, and when I was thirsty, you gave me something to drink. When I was a stranger, you welcomed me, 36and when I was naked, you gave me clothes to wear. When I was sick, you took care of me, and when I was in jail, you visited me.”
37Then the ones who pleased the Lord will ask, “When did we give you something to eat or drink? 38When did we welcome you as a stranger or give you clothes to wear 39or visit you while you were sick or in jail?”
40The king will answer, “Whenever you did it for any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you did it for me.”
41Then the king will say to those on his left, “Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels! 42I was hungry, but you did not give me anything to eat, and I was thirsty, but you did not give me anything to drink. 43I was a stranger, but you did not welcome me, and I was naked, but you did not give me any clothes to wear. I was sick and in jail, but you did not take care of me.”
44Then the people will ask, “Lord, when did we fail to help you when you were hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in jail?”
45The king will say to them, “Whenever you failed to help any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you failed to do it for me.”
46 Then Jesus said, “Those people will be punished forever. But the ones who pleased God will have eternal life.”
translation_text:
Bukwa fuga memaŋe
1Kanto maŋa kam ne, Wɛ telaao paare dem wó taa nye tento mo:
Bukwa fuga mo wora. Ba ma zaŋe ba vo se ba jeeri nɔɔno wodwoŋi na di kaane o jege o beena. Ba ma kwei ba min-zwonnu ba woli da ba ja vo. 2Bukwa bam banu maa ye jworru, ye banu bam de jege swa. 3Jworru tem maa wo ke nuga ba woli da se ba taa ke ba min-zwonnu tem ne. 4Ko daare swa tiina bam ma ke nuga wonnu wone ba zia. 5Kan-baro wom ma tiini o dáane ye o wo tu, pa se ba maama peini ba dɔ.
6Tega na tu ka kweere to, nɔɔna ma tɔɔle ba we, ‘Kan-baro wom maa beena! Zaŋe-na á nwoŋi á jeeri‑o.’ 7Bukwa bam ma zaŋe ba tɔre ba min-zwonnu tem. 8Jworru tenu tem min-zwonnu tem maa lage te dwei. Ba ma ta de ba dwonna swa tiina bam we, ba ke nuga ba pa-ba, se ba min-zwonnu tem lage te dwei. 9Swa tiina bam ma leiri ba we, ‘Nuga kam ba daga se ka yi debam maama. Konto ŋwaane, abam de véi-na nuga tiina tei á yeigi.’
10Ba laam ma kɛ se ba yeigi. Ba na kɛ ba daare to mo kan-baro wom yia. Badaara bam na maŋe ba ti ba yiga to ma tɔge de kan-baro wom ba vo ba zo kadiri dim sɔŋɔ kom. Ba ma pe manchwoŋo kom ni. 11Ko na ke fee to mo jworru tem laam tua, ye ba bwoŋi kan-baro wom ba we, ‘Debam tu, nam pore se dé zo!’ 12O ma leiri-ba o we, ‘Chega ŋwaane to, a nam yeiri abam kɔtaa.’
13Mo kokuri á jege se á ta‑á cho á tete, kolo ŋwaane á yeiri dɛ delo Nabiin-bu wom na wó jwoori o ba to, ye á ta yeiri dɛ dem wone maŋa kam o na wó yi to.
Tontoŋena batɔ memaŋe
Luka 19:11-27
14Ko woli da, Wɛ telaao paare dem wó taa nye de sɔŋɔ tu wodwoŋi na lage o nwoŋi o beeri. O ma bwoŋi o tontoŋena ye o pɔɔre o wonnu o pa-ba se ba taa nia. 15O ma pɔɔre sabu ywollu morro tenu (5,000) o pa ba dedoa, ye o daare o pa dedoa ywollu morro telei (2,000). O ma pa dedoa kam de ywollu moro dedoa (1,000). O nam pɛ-ba sabu kom se ko maŋe de ba boboŋa dam na mae tei to mo. O laam ma daare o viiri. 16Tontoŋeno wolo na jwoŋi ywollu morro tenu tem to ma kwei o sabu kom o ma ke o pipiu, ye o na ywollu morro tenu nyɔɔre o woli da. 17Ywollu morro telei tu wom de ma na ywollu morro telei nyɔɔre o woli da. 18Ko daare ywollu moro dedoa kam tu wom ma kwei sabu kolo o tu wom na pɛ‑o to o ko gwoŋo o suli da.
19Ko na dáane to, sɔŋɔ tu wom ma jwoori. O laam ma bwoŋi o tontoŋena bam se ba jeeli o sabu kom ba nii. 20Ywollu morro tenu tu wom ma ja ywollu morro tenu nyɔɔre dem o woli da o vo o pa‑o. O ma ta de o tu wom o we, ‘Amo tu, nii. Nmo pɛ-ne ywollu morro tenu mo ye a jege ywollu morro tenu se a woli da a pa‑m.’ 21O tu wom ma leiri‑o o we, ‘Nmo ke chega ye n ta jege jawala de nmo na ke a boboŋa na lage tei to. Nmo seene n tɔge chwoŋa de nmo na wae n nii amo wonnu fenfee baŋa ne tei to. Amo laam wó pa se n ta‑n nii amo wonnu dedɛ baŋa ne. Nam pa se dé di ywoni daane.’
22Ywollu morro telei tu wom de ma vo o tei, ye o ta ded‑o o we, ‘Amo tu, nmo pɛ-ne ywollu morro telei mo, ye a na ywollu morro telei se a woli da a pa‑m.’ 23O tu wom ma leiri‑o o we, ‘Nmo ke chega ye n ta jege jawala de nmo na ke a boboŋa na lage tei to. Nmo seene n tɔge chwoŋa de nmo na wae n nii amo wonnu fenfee baŋa ne tei to. Amo laam wó pa se n ta‑n nii amo wonnu dedɛ baŋa ne. Nam pa se dé di ywoni daane.’
24Ywollu moro dedoa kam tu wom laam ma vo o ta de o tu wom o we, ‘Amo tu, amo yei we nmo ye keim-chɛ-nyeno mo. Nmo yeini n jwoŋi nyɔɔre wonnu telo nmo yera na wo chɛ te baŋa ne to, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na zage mena yalo o tete na wo dugi to. 25Mo kokuri a kɔre foone de nmo, ye a kwei nmo sabu kom a vo a suli tega ne. Nii-ko da n jwoŋi.’ 26O tu wom ma ta ded‑o o we, ‘Nmo ye tontoŋeno-balɔrɔ mo, ye n jege jawɔrɔ dedɛ. Nmo na boŋe we amo ye keim-chɛ-nyeno ye a lage nyɔɔre delo na dae a totoŋa nyem to, 27ko ya maŋe se n kwei a sabu kom mo n pa sabu jenna. Nmo ya ná ke konto, amo ya wó ba a jwoŋi-ko de nyɔɔre. 28Nam jwoŋi-na sabu ywollu moro dedoa kam o tei ne, se á daare á kwei-te á pa wolo na jege ywollu morro fuga kam to. 29Kokuri, nɔɔno ná maŋe o jege woŋo, o ta wó jwoŋi kodwoŋi o woli da se ko tiini ko gaale. Nɔɔno wolo nam na maŋe o ba jege kolokolo to laam wó ba o ga kolo fenfee o ya na jege to mo. 30Ko nam ná ye tontoŋeno-kayaa kanto, se á ja‑o á nwoŋi á de á yage lim jei ne, mɛ yaara na tiini ya wora pa se nɔɔna keeri ye ba done ba nwa to.’
Nabiin-bu wom wó ba o pɔɔre nɔɔna daane
31Nabiin-bu wom nam ná jwoori o ba de o dam-fɔrɔ kom, ye Wɛ malese sem maama tɔge se wora o tei ne, o laam wó ba o jeini o dam-fɔrɔ paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne. 32Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama maa wó la daane o yiga ne. O laam maa wó pɔɔre-ba kuni belei, ne nayero na pɔɔre o pei de o bone daane tei to. 33O wó pɔɔre pei sem mo pa se taa wo o jazem seeni, ye o daare o yage bone dem o jagwia seeni. 34Nabiin-bu wom na ye Pɛ konto to, o maa wó ta de balo na wo o jazem seeni to o we, ‘Abam balo amo Kwo Wɛ na swɛ á swolim to, á ba-na á tɔge á di paare delo o na maŋe o tiŋi o pa abam ko zege logo baŋa boboa ne to. 35Kolo ŋwaane, kana déem jaane amo ye á pa-ne wodiu ye a di. Na-nyɔm ma ja-ne ye á kwei na á teini-ne. Amo ma ba abam sam ye á ke-ne veiru lanyerane. 36A maa ba jege gɔrɔ se a zo ye á pa-ne gɔrɔ. A maa ba jege yazura ye á nii amo baŋa ne. Ba ma ke-ne peena diga ne ye á ba á woli-ne.’ 37Wɛ nɔn-ŋona bam laam wó zaŋe ba bwei‑o ba we, ‘Dé Teiru, debam mo ke konto na? Maŋa kɔ mo debam nɛ kana jege nmo ye dé pa n di wodiu, naa na-nyɔm jege‑m ye dé pa‑m na? 38Maŋa kɔ mo dé ke nmo veiru konto, naa dé pa nmo gɔrɔ ye n zo, 39naa maŋa kɔ mo nmo ba jege yazura, naa n wo peena diga ne ye dé ba dé woli‑m konto?’ 40Pɛ wom laam maa wó leiri o ta-ba we, ‘A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam na ke konto dwoŋi á ma á woli amo nɔɔna bam to, ko ná maŋe ko ye wolo na tiini o muri ba maama wone to de, ko ye amo mo á ke konto.’
41O maa wó daare o ta de balo na wo o jagwia seeni to we, ‘Véi-na dáa a tei ne, se abam mo ye balo Wɛ sɔɔlem na wo á baŋa ne to. Kɛ-na á vo mini delo wo Wɛ na maŋe o tiŋi se o pa setaana pɛ de o kwaga tɔgena se ba zo ye de bá dwei maŋa de maŋa to. 42Kolo ŋwaane, kana déem jaane amo ye á wo pɛ-ne wodiu se a di. Na-nyɔm de ma ja-ne ye á wo pɛ-ne na se a nyɔ. 43A ma ba á sam ye á wo ke-ne veiru. A maa ba jege gɔrɔ ye á wo pɛ-ne kodwoŋi se a zo. A maa ba jege yazura ye ba ta ke-ne peena diga ne, ye á wo tu se á woli-ne.’ 44Ba maa wó leiri ba bwei‑o we, ‘Dé Teiru, maŋa kɔ mo debam ke nmo konto? Maŋa kɔ mo dé nɛ kana de na-nyɔm na jege nmo, naa n na ye veiru, naa n ba jege yazura, naa ba ke‑m peena diga ne, ye dé wo tu dé zeini‑m?’ 45O maa wó ta-ba o we, ‘A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam na ve se á woli amo nɔɔna bam, ko ná maŋe ko ye wolo na tiini o muri ba maama wone to de, ko ye amo mo á ve se á woli.’ 46Banto laam maa wó kɛ ba vo cham delo na bá fɔge de ti to wone. Ko daare Wɛ nɔn-ŋona bam maa wó zo o tei ba na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to.”

english_text:
The Plot To Kill Jesus
(Mark 14.1,2; Luke 22.1,2; John 11.45-53)
1When Jesus had finished teaching, he told his disciples, 2 “You know two days from now will be Passover. This is when the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies and nailed to a cross.”
3At that time the chief priests and the nation's leaders were meeting at the home of Caiaphas the high priest. 4They planned how they could sneak around and have Jesus arrested and put to death. 5But they said, “We must not do it during Passover, because the people will riot.”
At Bethany
(Mark 14.3-9; John 12.1-8)
6Jesus was in the town of Bethany, eating at the home of Simon, who had leprosy. 7 A woman came in with a bottle of expensive perfume and poured it on Jesus' head. 8But when his disciples saw this, they became angry and complained, “Why such a waste? 9We could have sold this perfume for a lot of money and given it to the poor.”
10Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said:
Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing for me. 11 You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me. 12She has poured perfume on my body to prepare it for burial. 13You may be sure that wherever the good news is told all over the world, people will remember what she has done. And they will tell others.
Judas and the Chief Priests
(Mark 14.10,11; Luke 22.3-6)
14Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve disciples. He went to the chief priests 15 and asked, “How much will you give me if I help you arrest Jesus?” They paid Judas 30 silver coins, 16and from then on he started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus.
Jesus Eats the Passover Meal with His Disciples
(Mark 14.12-21; Luke 22.7-13; John 13.21-30)
17On the first day of the Festival of Thin Bread, Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, “Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal?”
18Jesus told them to go to a certain man in the city and tell him, “Our teacher says, ‘My time has come! I want to eat the Passover meal with my disciples in your home.’ ” 19They did as Jesus told them and prepared the meal.
20-21When Jesus was eating with his twelve disciples that evening, he said, “One of you will surely hand me over to my enemies.”
22The disciples were very sad, and each one said to Jesus, “Lord, you can't mean me!”
23 He answered, “One of you men who has eaten with me from this dish will betray me. 24The Son of Man will die, as the Scriptures say. But it's going to be terrible for the one who betrays me! That man would be better off if he had never been born.”
25Judas said, “Teacher, you surely don't mean me!”
“That's what you say!” Jesus replied. But later, Judas did betray him.
The Lord's Supper
(Mark 14.22-26; Luke 22.14-23; 1 Corinthians 11.23-25)
26During the meal Jesus took some bread in his hands. He blessed the bread and broke it. Then he gave it to his disciples and said, “Take this and eat it. This is my body.”
27Jesus picked up a cup of wine and gave thanks to God. He then gave it to his disciples and said, “Take this and drink it. 28 This is my blood, and with it God makes his agreement with you. It will be poured out, so that many people will have their sins forgiven. 29From now on I am not going to drink any wine, until I drink new wine with you in my Father's kingdom.” 30Then they sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives.
Peter's Promise
(Mark 14.27-31; Luke 22.31-34; John 13.36-38)
31 Jesus said to his disciples, “During this very night, all of you will reject me, as the Scriptures say,
‘I will strike down
the shepherd,
and the sheep
will be scattered.’
32 But after I am raised to life, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.”
33Peter spoke up, “Even if all the others reject you, I never will!”
34Jesus replied, “I promise you before a rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you don't know me.” 35But Peter said, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never say I don't know you.”
All the others said the same thing.
Jesus Prays
(Mark 14.32-42; Luke 22.39-46)
36Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. When they got there, he told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
37Jesus took along Peter and the two brothers, James and John. He was very sad and troubled, 38and he said to them, “I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.”
39Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
40He came back and found his disciples sleeping. So he said to Peter, “Can't any of you stay awake with me for just one hour? 41Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.”
42Again Jesus went to pray and said, “My Father, if there is no other way, and I must suffer, I will still do what you want.”
43Jesus came back and found them sleeping again. They simply could not keep their eyes open. 44He left them and prayed the same prayer once more.
45Finally, Jesus returned to his disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners. 46Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.”
Jesus Is Arrested
(Mark 14.43-50; Luke 22.47-53; John 18.3-12)
47Jesus was still speaking, when Judas the betrayer came up. He was one of the twelve disciples, and a large mob armed with swords and clubs was with him. They had been sent by the chief priests and the nation's leaders. 48Judas had told them ahead of time, “Arrest the man I greet with a kiss.”
49Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Hello, teacher.” Then Judas kissed him.
50Jesus replied, “My friend, do what you came for.”
The men grabbed Jesus and arrested him. 51One of Jesus' followers pulled out a sword. He struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
52But Jesus told him, “Put your sword away. Anyone who lives by fighting will die by fighting. 53Don't you know that I could ask my Father, and he would at once send me more than twelve armies of angels? 54But then, how could the words of the Scriptures come true, which say this must happen?”
55 Jesus said to the mob, “Why do you come with swords and clubs to arrest me like a criminal? Day after day I sat and taught in the temple, and you didn't arrest me. 56But all this happened, so that what the prophets wrote would come true.”
All Jesus' disciples left him and ran away.
Jesus Is Questioned by the Council
(Mark 14.53-65; Luke 22.54,55,63-71; John 18.13,14,19-24)
57After Jesus had been arrested, he was led off to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The nation's leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses were meeting there. 58But Peter followed along at a distance and came to the courtyard of the high priest's palace. He went in and sat down with the guards to see what was going to happen.
59The chief priests and the whole council wanted to put Jesus to death. So they tried to find some people who would tell lies about him in court. 60But they could not find any, even though many did come and tell lies. At last, two men came forward 61 and said, “This man claimed he could tear down God's temple and build it again in three days.”
62The high priest stood up and asked Jesus, “Why don't you say something in your own defense? Don't you hear the charges they are making against you?” 63But Jesus did not answer. So the high priest said, “With the living God looking on, you must tell the truth. Are you the Messiah, the Son of God?”
64 “That is what you say!” Jesus answered. “But I tell all of you,
‘Soon you will see
the Son of Man
sitting at the right side
of God All-Powerful
and coming on the clouds
of heaven.’ ”
65 The high priest then tore his robe and said, “This man claims to be God! We don't need any more witnesses! You have heard what he said. 66What do you think?”
They answered, “He is guilty and deserves to die!” 67 Then they spit in his face and hit him with their fists. Others slapped him 68and said, “You think you are the Messiah! So tell us who hit you!”
Peter Says He Doesn't Know Jesus
(Mark 14.66-72; Luke 22.56-62; John 18.15-18,25-27)
69While Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, a servant girl came up to him and said, “You were with Jesus from Galilee.”
70But in front of everyone Peter said, “That isn't so! I don't know what you are talking about!”
71When Peter had gone out to the gate, another servant girl saw him and said to some people there, “This man was with Jesus from Nazareth.”
72Again Peter denied it, and this time he swore, “I don't even know that man!”
73A little while later some people standing there walked over to Peter and said, “We know you are one of them. We can tell it because you talk like someone from Galilee.”
74Peter began to curse and swear, “I don't know that man!”
Right then a rooster crowed, 75and Peter remembered that Jesus had said, “Before a rooster crows, you will say three times you don't know me.” Then Peter went out and cried bitterly.
translation_text:
Juu yiga tiina ke ni daane se ba go Yezu
Maake 14:1-2; Luka 22:1-2; Jɔn 11:45-53
1Yezu déem na tage wonnu tem konto maama o ti to, o laam ma ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, 2“Abam yei we ko daare da yalei mo se Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem ba de yi, ye ba laam wó ja amo Nabiin-bu wom ba ke dedɛɛra jea ne se ba pa-ne dagara yuu ne ba go.”
3Juu tiina nakwa bam de ba kaanem yiga tiina bam ma jeini daane Kayafa sɔŋɔ ne. Wonto maa ye ba kaanem yuu tu wom. 4Ba ma bane daane se ba nii ba na wó ke swa yalo ba ma ja Yezu se ba pa o te to. 5Ba na wora ba bɛa konto to, ba ma ta ba we, “Dé nam ba jege se dé ja‑o kuri dem maŋa ne, se ko wó ja bobɔga ko ba nɔɔna bam tetare ne.”
Kaane wodwoŋi zuli Yezu
Maake 14:3-11; Jɔn 12:1-8
6Yezu déem maa wo Bɛtania ne nɔɔno wodwoŋi o yere na ye Simon to sɔŋɔ ne. Wonto déem ya ye nayɔŋɔ mo. 7Yezu na wora o di wodiu maŋa kalo to mo kaane wodwoŋi tu o tei. O maa jege kaboa na su de terale nuga kalo sabu na daga to. O ma vo o lwo nuga kam Yezu yuu ne se o ma ke‑o zula. 8Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam na nɛ konto to, ba maa ba jege wopwolo ye ba tɛ ba we, “Bɛ mo ye o chɔge nuga kam konto? 9Dé ya wó wane dé yeigi-ka dé na sabu dedɛ se dé ma woli yiniga tiina.”
10Yezu ma lɔre ba na tɛ kolo to. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Bɛ mo ye á jege kaane wom á daana? O na ke-ne zula tei to nam ye keim-laao mo o ke o pa-ne. 11Ko nam ná ye yiniga tiina, banto wó taa wora maŋa maama mo se abam taa pa-ba zeinim. Ko daare amo bá taa wora de abam taa taa. 12Kaane wom na lwogi nuga kam amo yera ne tei to bere we o kwɛ amo yera yam mo se ba laam kwei-ne ba suli. 13A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, ba na wó tɔɔle amo kwor-ywoŋa kam logo baŋa jei selo maama ne to, nɔɔna wó ta kaane wom konto taane se ba taa guli o gula.”
14Yezu nɔɔna fuga-balei bam wo dedoa yere na ye Judas Yisakara to laam ma zaŋe o vo Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam tei. 15O ma bwei-ba o we, “Amo ná bere abam chwoŋa ye á ja Yezu, á wó ŋwe-ne bɛ mo?” Ba ma jwoŋi o taane dem ye ba ga lu-nyenno sabu-dala fintɔ ba pa‑o. 16Ko zege maŋa kam konto ne Judas ma kwaane o lage chwoŋa se o ja Yezu o ke ba jeŋa ne.
Yezu di kuri wodiu de o kwaga tɔgena bam
Maake 14:12-26; Luka 22:7-23; Jɔn 13:21-30; 1 Korinti 11:23-25
17Ko ma ba ko yi dɛ delo ba na bobo se ba di Bworobworo-memene kuri dem. Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo ba bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo lage se dé di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem jeiga kɔ ne mo se dé vo dé kwɛ woŋo maama dé pa nmo?” 18O ma leiri-ba o we, “Zaŋe-na á zo teo kom wo se á ta de nɔɔno wodwoŋi we, Berem tu wom we, o maŋa kam yia. O nam lage o tɔge de o kwaga tɔgena bam o ba wonto sɔŋɔ mo se ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem wodiu.” 19O kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo ba ke o na tage kolo to ye ba kwɛ kuri dem wonnu tem ba ti.
20Tega ma ba ka yi. Yezu de o nɔɔna fuga-balei bam laam ma jeini se ba di wodiu kom. 21Ba na wora ba di to, Yezu laam ma ta o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam dedoa mo lage o yeigi amo o pa nɔɔna.” 22Ba na nigi konto to, ba wo ma chɔge dedɛ ye ba bobo se ba taa bwei‑o ba saŋe daane we, “Amo Teiru, ko nam dae amo mo n tɛ konto, se wɔ mo nam?” 23O ma leiri-ba o we, “Nɔɔno wolo na tɔge de amo o lu zoŋa dedoa wone to mo wó yeigi amo o pa nɔɔna. 24Ko nam jege se Nabiin-bu wom vo o te se ko maŋe de Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na wuuri ko bere o taane tei to mo. Ko nam wó taa ye lɛɛro mo ko pa nɔɔno wolo na wó yeigi Nabiin-bu wom o pa to. Ba ya ná maŋe ba wo loge nɔɔno wom konto, ko ya gara.”
25Judas wolo na lage o yeigi‑o o pa to laam ma ta o we, “Berem tu, se ko nam dae amo mo n tɛa.” Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Ko wo n tei ne.”
26Ba na wora ba di maŋa kalo to Yezu ma kwei bworobworo ye o ke Wɛ lei ko ŋwaane. O ma daare o fɔ-ko o pa o kwaga tɔgena bam ye o we, “Jwoŋi-na á di, se konto ye a yera yam mo.”
27O daa ma kwei zoŋa de ka wo sa-soŋo, ye o ke Wɛ lei ko ŋwaane. O ma kwei o pa-ba ye o we, “Abam maama jwoŋi-na á nyɔ. 28Banto mo ye amo jana balo na lage ba pwori se ko jwoŋi nɔɔna dedɛ ba wɛleera wone to. Ko maa bere we Wɛ gwoni ni se o yage nɔɔna wɛleera mo o ma chɛ-ba jana bam konto ŋwaane. 29Ta‑á yei-na we, amo daa bá nyɔ sana banto dwoŋi se ko taa vei maŋa kam abam na wó tɔge de amo á jeini amo Kwo Wɛ paare dem wone se dé daa nyɔ sa-doora dáane to.”
30Ba laam ma leeni ba tei Wɛ, ye ba daare ba nwoŋi ba kɛ Olivi peo kom seeni.
Yezu wuuri o bere Piita na wó ve‑o tei to
Maake 14:27-31; Luka 22:31-34; Jɔn 13:36-38
31Yezu laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Tete dento ne abam maama wó jwoori amo kwaga ne, ne Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na maŋe ko bere tei we:
‘Amo wó mage nayero wom,
pa se o pei-kɔgɔ kom maama jage ko jei.’
32Ko daare, Wɛ ná jwoori o bi-ne, amo wó lwoori abam a vo Galili.”
33Yezu na tage konto to, Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nɔɔna maama ná maŋe ba jwoori nmo kwaga ne, amo bá fɔge a ke konto.” 34Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, tete dento ye chebɛɔ ta ná wo keeri, nmo wó fo kuni betɔ we n yeiri amo.” 35Piita laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo bere a bá fo we a yeiri nmo, ko ná maŋe ko ye ba ná lage ba go amo de nmo maama de.” Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam maama de ma ta konto dwoŋi.
Yezu tiini o lwoori o Kwo Wɛ
Maake 14:32-42; Luka 22:39-46
36Yezu laam ma zaŋe o tɔge de o kwaga tɔgena bam o vo jeiga kadwoŋi gaare na wora ye ba bwoi-de we Gɛsemane to. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Ta‑á jei-na ywo se a vo dáa a ware Wɛ se a ba.” 37O ma pa Piita de Zebedi bia balei bam tɔge‑o ba vo. O wo ma tiini ko chɔge ye o yera sɔɔre. 38O ma ta de nɔɔna batɔ bam o we, “Amo wo mo tiini ko chɔge se ko yi a toone. Á nam zege-na ywo á ta‑á kwogili-ne.”
39O laam ma fofɔ o vo dáa. O ma vwi o yibia tega ne o wora o lwoori Wɛ ye o we, “Amo Kwo, nmo ná sɛ, se n pa chanɛɛre delo na lage de ba amo baŋa ne to kɛ de daare-ne. Nam ke kolo na tɔge nmo boboŋa to, ye ko dae amo boboŋa na lage kolo to.” 40O na ti to, o ma jwoori o vo o tɔgena batɔ bam tei. O ma na we ba tigi ba dɔa. O ma zaŋe-ba ye o ta de Piita o we, “Bɛ mo ye abam ware se á kwogili-ne se ko maŋe de awa dedoa yerane? 41Fɔge-na á che á tete se á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ, se á yé to cham delo na wó soge á boboŋa to wone. Á boboŋa lage se ya sɛ Wɛ ye á yera laam bwona.”
42Yezu daa ma jwoori o vo dáa, ye o lwoori Wɛ o we, “Amo Kwo, chanɛɛre dem ná bá wane de le amo baŋa ne de yage, ye de ná jege se de zo-ne maama, amo ta sɛ se ko ke nmo boboŋa yam na lage tei to.” 43O daa ma jwoori o vo o yi de ba ta dɔa, dɔɔm na tiini de jege-ba to ŋwaane. 44O ma jwoori o vo dáa se o lwoori Wɛ o ke kuni betɔ, ne o ya na maŋe o ta kolo to. 45O daa ma jwoori o kwaga tɔgena bam tei ye o ta de-ba o we, “Á ta tigi á dɔa mo na? Nii-na! Maŋa kam yia se ba ja amo Nabiin-bu wom ba ke nɔn-chechɔgero jea ne. 46Zaŋe-na se dé vo. Nɔɔno wolo na lage o yeigi-ne o pa to maa beena.”
Ba jaane Yezu
Maake 14:43-50; Luka 22:47-53; Jɔn 18:3-12
47Yezu ta na wora o ŋɔɔne konto to mo Judas wolo na ye o nɔɔna fuga-balei bam wo dedoa to laam tu o yi o tei. Nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ ma tɔge ded‑o ko ba, ye ba zei se-zɔɔro de da-lwanno. Ko maa ye Juu tiina nakwa bam de ba kaanem yiga tiina bam mo toŋe-ba. 48Judas ya maŋe o pa kɔgɔ kom maanem se ba ma ja Yezu ye o we, “Amo ná vei a kukwori nɔɔno wolo, se á vo á ja konto tu.”
49O laam ma yɔɔre o yi Yezu tei o jɔɔne‑o ye o we, “Berem tu, denlei naa”, ye o daare o kukwori‑o lanyerane. 50Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo badwoŋi, nam ke kolo nmo na lage n ke to.”
Nɔɔna bam laam ma ba ba zi Yezu ba ja lanyerane. 51Nɔɔna balo na maŋe ba wo Yezu tei ne to dedoa ma le o seo o ma zage kaanem yuu tu wom tontoŋeno zwɛ o de tega ne. 52Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Jwoori n ke n seo kom ko pwolo ne. Nɔɔno wolo ná swoi jara, kotu wó te jara wone mo. 53Ta‑n yei we, amo ya ná lage nɔɔna se ba woli-ne, a ya wó ta de a Kwo mo, ye o pɔpɔ o toŋe malese kɔgɔ kuni fuga-belei se se ba se woli-ne. 54Amo nam ya ná ke konto, Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na bere we ko jege se ko ke amo tei to daa wó wane ko ke na?”
55Yezu laam ma bwei kɔgɔ kom o we, “Abam na kwei seene de da-lwanno á ba se á ja amo to, amo ye ŋweeno mo na? Dɛ maama wuu amo yeini a jei Wɛ diga kam ne mo a bere nɔɔna. Abam nam maa wo jaane-ne. 56Tento maama nam ke se ko pa faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem na popone kolo Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to mo ba ko seene ko ke.”
Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam na nigi konto to, ba ma duri ba viiri ba daare‑o.
Ba di Yezu taane
Maake 14:53-65; Luka 22:54-55, 63-71; Jɔn 18:13-14, 19-24
57Nɔɔna balo na tu ba ja Yezu to ma ja‑o ba vo ba kaanem yuu tu Kayafa sɔŋɔ mɛ Wɛ nia zamesem tiina de ba nakwa bam na maŋe ba gilimi to. 58Piita ma dale o tɔge ba kwaga o da o vo o yi kaanem yuu tu wom sɔŋɔ. O ma kɛ o zo konkɔlɔ kom o jeini de sɔŋɔ kom tontoŋena bam se o nii kolo na lage ko ke to. 59Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba nakwa kɔgɔ kom maama maa kwaane se ba na chwoŋa ba tɔge vwa ŋwaane ba ma saŋe Yezu, se ba laam pa o te. 60Nɔɔna dedɛ ma zaŋe ba fɔ vwa ba pa‑o, ye ba daa ta wo wane se ba na chwoŋa. Ko kwaga seeni mo nɔɔna balei ma zaŋe ba ba, ye ba ta ba we, 61“Nɔɔno wonto tage o we, omo wó wane o yigi debam Wɛ diga kam maama o de tega ne, ye o jwoori o ma da yatɔ o fɔge o lɔ-ka.” 62Kaanem yuu tu wom na nigi konto to, o laam ma zaŋe o bwei Yezu o we, “Nɔɔna banto balei na tage kolo ba pa nmo to, nmo ba jege taane se n leiri na?” 63Yezu ma maŋe da chemm. Kaanem yuu tu wom laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “A ke nmo de Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ daane se n ta chega n bere debam, nmo ye Wɛ Bu Krista wolo dé na teena se o ba to mo na?” 64Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Mo kolo nmo na tage to. Nam ta‑á yei-na we, ko zege leile konto abam wó ba á na Nabiin-bu wom, o na jei Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ jazem seeni, ye á ta daare á na‑o, o na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne o maa beene kunkwonnu baŋa ne.” 65Kaanem yuu tu wom na nigi konto to, o ma zaŋe o kaare o tete gwaaro se ko bere we o wo chɔge de Yezu ni taane dem. O ma ta o we, “Nii, wonto ŋɔɔne o twe Wɛ yere dem de o na pɛ se o ma de Wɛ to. Dé daa ba lage se nɔɔna zaŋe ba ŋɔɔne o taane, se abam maama maŋe á ni o na ŋɔɔne Wɛ o chɔge to. 66Konto to, abam we bɛ mo?” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “O maŋe se o te mo.”
67Ba laam ma twe lileeru ba yage o yia ne, ye ba mage‑o lanyerane. Badaara ma lɔ o popɔŋɔ, 68ye ba we, “Wɛ Dam Tu wom, nam lɔre n bere debam wolo na mage‑m to.”
Piita seene o ve Yezu
Maake 14:66-72; Luka 22:56-62; Jɔn 18:15-18, 25-27
69Konto maŋa kam ne, Piita maa jei konkɔlɔ kom wone. Kaanem yuu tu wom sɔŋɔ ka-nyaane ma vo o tei, ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo de tɔge de Yezu, Galili tu wom mo.” 70O ma fo ba maama yiga ne o we, “Amo yeiri n taane dem kuri.”
71O ma zaŋe o nwoŋi manchwoŋo ni. Busankana kadwoŋi de ma na‑o, ye o ta de nɔɔna balo na wora to o we, “Nɔɔno wonto tɔge de Nazarete tu Yezu mo.” 72Piita ma du duuri ye o ta fo o we, “Amo bere a yeiri nɔɔno wom konto.”
73Ko na ke fee to, nɔɔna badwonna ma vo ba ta de Piita ba we, “Nmo seene n ye ba kɔgɔ kom wo dedoa mo. Nmo ŋɔŋa kam na ye tei to mo bere we n seene n nwoŋi dáane.” 74O laam ma sɔɔle o pa o tete se ko bere o chega ye o we, “Amo bere a yeiri nɔɔno wom konto.” O na tage konto to, chebɛɔ ma pɔpɔ ko keeri. 75Piita laam ma guli Yezu ya na tage kolo ded‑o o we, “Nmo wó fo kuni betɔ we n yeiri amo, ye chebɛɔ laam keeri.” O na guli konto to, o laam ma nwoŋi ye o tiini o keeri lanyerane.

english_text:
Jesus Is Taken to Pilate
(Mark 15.1; Luke 23.1,2; John 18.28-32)
1Early the next morning all the chief priests and the nation's leaders met and decided that Jesus should be put to death. 2They tied him up and led him away to Pilate the governor.
The Death of Judas
(Acts 1.18,19)
3 Judas had betrayed Jesus, but when he learned that Jesus had been sentenced to death, he was sorry for what he had done. He returned the 30 silver coins to the chief priests and leaders 4and said, “I have sinned by betraying a man who has never done anything wrong.”
“So what? That's your problem,” they replied. 5Judas threw the money into the temple and then went out and hanged himself.
6The chief priests picked up the money and said, “This money was paid to have a man killed. We can't put it in the temple treasury.” 7Then they had a meeting and decided to buy a field that belonged to someone who made clay pots. They wanted to use it as a graveyard for foreigners. 8This is why people still call that place “Field of Blood.” 9 So the words of the prophet Jeremiah came true,
“They took
the thirty silver coins,
the price of a person
among the people of Israel.
10They paid it
for a potter's field,
as the Lord
had commanded me.”
Pilate Questions Jesus
(Mark 15.2-5; Luke 23.3-5; John 18.33-38)
11Jesus was brought before Pilate the governor, who asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
“Those are your words!” Jesus answered. 12And when the chief priests and leaders brought their charges against him, he did not say a thing.
13Pilate asked him, “Don't you hear what crimes they say you have done?” 14But Jesus did not say anything, and the governor was greatly amazed.
The Death Sentence
(Mark 15.6-15; Luke 23.13-26; John 18.39—19.16)
15During Passover the governor always freed a prisoner chosen by the people. 16At that time a well-known terrorist named Jesus Barabbas was in jail. 17So when the crowd came together, Pilate asked them, “Which prisoner do you want me to set free? Do you want Jesus Barabbas or Jesus who is called the Messiah?” 18Pilate knew the leaders had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
19While Pilate was judging the case, his wife sent him a message. It said, “Don't have anything to do with that innocent man. I have had nightmares because of him.”
20But the chief priests and the leaders convinced the crowds to ask for Barabbas to be set free and for Jesus to be killed. 21Pilate asked the crowd again, “Which of these two men do you want me to set free?”
“Barabbas!” they shouted.
22Pilate asked them, “What am I to do with Jesus, who is called the Messiah?”
They all yelled, “Nail him to a cross!”
23Pilate answered, “But what crime has he done?”
“Nail him to a cross!” they yelled even louder.
24 Pilate saw that there was nothing he could do and that the people were starting to riot. So he took some water and washed his hands in front of them and said, “I won't have anything to do with killing this man. You are the ones doing it!”
25Everyone answered, “We and our own families will take the blame for his death!”
26Pilate set Barabbas free. Then he ordered his soldiers to beat Jesus with a whip and nail him to a cross.
Soldiers Make Fun of Jesus
(Mark 15.16-21; John 19.2,3)
27The governor's soldiers led Jesus into the fortress and brought together the rest of the troops. 28They stripped off Jesus' clothes and put a scarlet robe on him. 29They made a crown out of thorn branches and placed it on his head, and they put a stick in his right hand. The soldiers knelt down and pretended to worship him. They made fun of him and shouted, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” 30Then they spit on him. They took the stick from him and beat him on the head with it.
Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross
(Mark 15.22-32; Luke 23.27-43; John 19.17-27)
31When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross. 32On the way they met a man named Simon who was from Cyrene, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross.
33They came to a place named Golgotha, which means “Place of a Skull.” 34 There they gave Jesus some wine mixed with a drug to ease the pain. But when Jesus tasted what it was, he refused to drink it.
35 The soldiers nailed Jesus to a cross and gambled to see who would get his clothes. 36Then they sat down to guard him. 37Above his head they put a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, “This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.” 38The soldiers also nailed two criminals on crosses, one to the right of Jesus and the other to his left.
39 People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and 40 shouted, “So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days! If you are God's Son, save yourself and come down from the cross!”
41The chief priests, the leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said, 42“He saved others, but he can't save himself. If he is the king of Israel, he should come down from the cross! Then we will believe him. 43 He trusted God, so let God save him, if he wants to. He even said he was God's Son.” 44The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus.
The Death of Jesus
(Mark 15.33-41; Luke 23.44-49; John 19.28-30)
45At noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until three o'clock. 46 Then about that time Jesus shouted, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you deserted me?”
47Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, “He's calling for Elijah.” 48 One of them at once ran and grabbed a sponge. He soaked it in wine, then put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus.
49Others said, “Wait! Let's see if Elijah will come and save him.” 50Once again Jesus shouted, and then he died.
51 At once the curtain in the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, and rocks split apart. 52Graves opened, and many of God's people were raised to life. 53They left their graves, and after Jesus had risen to life, they went into the holy city, where they were seen by many people.
54The officer and the soldiers guarding Jesus felt the earthquake and saw everything else that happened. They were frightened and said, “This man really was God's Son!”
55 Many women had come with Jesus from Galilee to be of help to him, and they were there, looking on at a distance. 56Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of James and John were some of these women.
Jesus Is Buried
(Mark 15.42-47; Luke 23.50-56; John 19.38-42)
57That evening a rich disciple named Joseph from the town of Arimathea 58went and asked for Jesus' body. Pilate gave orders for it to be given to Joseph, 59who took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth. 60Then Joseph put the body in his own tomb that had been cut into solid rock and had never been used. He rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb and went away.
61All this time Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting across from the tomb.
62On the next day, which was a Sabbath, the chief priests and the Pharisees went together to Pilate. 63 They said, “Sir, we remember what this liar said while he was still alive. He claimed in three days he would come back from death. 64So please order the tomb to be carefully guarded for three days. If you don't, his disciples may come and steal his body. They will tell the people he has been raised to life, and this last lie will be worse than the first one.”
65Pilate said to them, “All right, take some of your soldiers and guard the tomb as well as you know how.” 66So they sealed it tight and placed soldiers there to guard it.
translation_text:
Judas go o tete
Maake 15:1; Luka 23:1-2; Jɔn 18:28-32
1Tega na tu ka poore tetete to, Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba teo kom nakwa bam maama ma ke ni daane se ba pa Yezu te. 2Ba ma ja‑o ba vɔ, ye ba ja‑o ba vo ba ke gɔmena tu wom jeŋa ne, o yere na ye Pilata to.
3Judas wolo na yeigi Yezu o pa nɔɔna bam to ma lɔre we ba di o taane se ba pa o to mo. O wo laam ma chɔge de o na ke kolo to, ye o jwoori o kwei lu-nyenno sabu-dala fintɔ kom se o pa kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba nakwa bam. 4O ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo ke a tusi, de a na yeigi nɔɔno wolo na wo ke kolokolo to a pa abam, ye á lage á go‑o to.” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Debam yiga tera, se ko nam tɔge nmo mo.”
5O laam ma kwei sabu kom o ja vo o de o yage Wɛ diga kam wone, ye o daare o viiri. O ma vo o kuuri o tete o go.
6Kaanem yiga tiina bam déem ma kwei sabu-dala yam ye ba we, “Sabu konto ye jana nyem mo. Ko nam chula se dé gwaane-ko Wɛ diga sabia bam wone.” 7Ba ma bwɛ daane ye ba ma-ko ba yeigi tega kadwoŋi ka yere na ye ‘Kamɔ-mɔro tega’ to, se ba ma ke veira yibeela jeiga. 8Konto ŋwaane mo nɔɔna jege jeiga kam konto ba bwoi we ‘Jana tega’ se ko ba ko yi zem.
9-10Konto ma pa se Wɛ sampwora Jeremia déem na bere kolo faŋa faŋa to ba ko ji chega de o na we, “Ba kwei lu-nyenno sabu-dala fintɔ kom mo ba ma yeigi kamɔ-mɔro tega kam, ne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ne ni se a ke tei to. Ko maa ye sabu kolo Isarele dwi tiina na sɛ se ba ma leini nɔɔno wom to mo.”
Pilata bwei Yezu taane
Maake 15:2-15; Luka 23:3-5, 13-25; Jɔn 18:33–19:16
11Yezu ma zaŋe o zege gɔmena tu Pilata yiga ne. Gɔmena tu wom ma bwei‑o o we, “Nmo mo ye Juu tiina bam pɛ na?” Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Ko wo nmo tei ne.” 12Ko daare Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba nakwa bam na ŋɔɔne o taane ba pa‑o to, o wo leiri kolokolo. 13Pilata ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo wo nigi ba na ŋɔɔne kolo maama ba pa nmo to na?” 14Yezu maa wo sɛ se o leiri ba taane dem delodelo. Ko ma pa se gɔmena tu wom tiini o ye yaau ded‑o.
15Bene maama Juu tiina kuri maŋa ná yeini ka yi, gɔmena tu wom yeini o le peeno dedoa mo o pa nɔn-kɔgɔ kom, nenɛɛne banto na lage wolo to. 16Kanto maŋa kam ne peeno wodwoŋi maa wora, ye nɔɔna maama yei o keim-balwaaro ni ne. O yere mo Barabas. 17Nɔɔna bam na tu ba la daane to, Pilata ma bwei-ba o we, “Abam lage se amo yage banto wɔ mo a pa abam? Ko ye Barabas mo naa Yezu wolo ba na bwoi‑o we Krista to mo?” 18O bwei konto kolo ŋwaane o yei we ko ye wo-goo ŋwaane mo ba jaane Yezu ba ke o jeŋa ne.
19Pilata na jei o taane dim jei sem ne to, o kaane ma toŋe ni o pa‑o o we, “Yé zaŋe n ke nɔɔno wom konto kolokolo, o na jege chega to ŋwaane. Tete dento ne amo tiini a na yaara dedɛ dendwɛ wone nɔɔno wom konto ŋwaane.”
20Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba nakwa bam ma soge nɔn-kɔgɔ kom se ba ta de Pilata we, o yage Barabas o pa-ba, se o daare o pa ba go Yezu. 21Pilata daa ma jwoori o bwei-ba o we, “Nɔɔna banto balei wone abam lage se a yage wɔ mo a pa abam?” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Barabas.” 22Pilata laam ma bwei-ba o we, “Ko nam ná ye Yezu wolo ba na bwoi‑o we Krista to, abam we a ke‑o tɛ mo?” Ba maama ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Pa‑o dagara yuu ne n go.” 23O ma jwoori o bwei-ba o we, “Wonto chɔge bɛ mo?” Ba laam ma tiini ba laare baŋa baŋa ba we, “Pa‑o dagara yuu ne n go.”
24Pilata ma lɔre we ko ba jege kuri se o taa ŋɔɔne taa taa, ko na lage ko ja bobɔga ko ba to ŋwaane. O ma jwoŋi na o sane o jea nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama yiga ne, ye o we, “Amo yiga tɔge ka tera nɔɔno wonto toone dem wone. Ko ye abam yiga mo.” 25Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama ma leiri‑o ba we, “Yage se o toone dem taa wo debam de dé bia yuu ne.”
26O laam ma yage Barabas o pa-ba. O ma pa ba fere Yezu, ye o pa-ba chwoŋa se ba ja‑o ba vo ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go.
Ba jaane Yezu ba vo ba pa dagara yuu ne
Maake 15:16-41; Luka 23:26-49; Jɔn 19:2-3, 17-30
27Gɔmena tu wom soja tiina bam laam ma ja Yezu ba vo ba zo o sɔŋɔ kom konkɔlɔ. Soja tiina kɔgɔ kom maama ma gilimi‑o da. 28Ba ma le o gwaaro tem, ye ba daare ba zo‑o gare-soŋo. 29Ba ma kwei sabare ba ma sɔ yipuga ba pu o yuu ne. Ba ma kwei kasogo ba ma ji nacheiga ba ke o jazem ne. Ba laam ma ke‑o kachaare ye ba vei ba kuni dwoona o yiga ne ba tɛ ba we, “Juu tiina pɛ, denlei naa!” 30Ba ma daare ba twe lileeru ba yage o yera ne, ye ba jege kasogo kom ba lɔe o yuu ne.
31Ba na ke‑o ba mɔne ba ti to, ba ma le gare-soŋo kom ye ba jwoori ba zo‑o o tete gɔrɔ kom. Ba laam ma ja‑o ba nwoŋi ba vo se ba pa‑o dagara yuu ne.
32Ba na jege‑o ba maa kɛ to, ba ma jeeri nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere na ye Simon ye o nwoŋi Kurene to. Soja tiina bam ma fe‑o se o kwei dagara kam o zeŋe se ba vo. 33Ba maama ma vo ba yi jeiga kadwoŋi ba na bwoi we ‘Goligota’ to. Yere dem konto kuri mo ye ‘Yu-kwoli-champoa Peo’. 34Ba na yi da to, ba ma kwei liri sedwoŋi se ni na chana to ba guuri sana wone ba pa Yezu se o nyɔ. O ma laŋe o nii ye o wo nyɔge.
35Ba laam ma ja‑o ba pa dagara kam yuu ne. Ba na page‑o konto to, ba ma kwei o gwaaro tem se ba pɔɔre-te ba pa daane. Ba ma ta jɔrɔ se ba nii wɔ mo wó twori kolo o na lage to. 36Ba laam ma jeini se ba taa daane‑o.
37Ba déem ma meeli tɔnɔ dagara kam yuu ne se ko bere kolo o na ke o chɔge ye ba go‑o to. Ko déem popone we:
WONTO YE YEZU,
JUU TIINA PƐ MO.
38Ba ma daare ba ja ŋweena balei ba pa dagare sedwonna baŋa ne. Ba ma chwi dedoa Yezu jazem ne. Wowom maa wo o jagwia ne. 39Nɔɔna balo na tɔge da ba kɛ to maa nia ye ba gɔgese ba yuni ye ba twe‑o. Ba maa yaale‑o, 40ye ba we, “Nmo ya boŋe se n yigi Wɛ diga kam mo n de tega ne, se n daare n ma da yatɔ n jwoori n fɔge n lɔ-ka. Tɔ. Nmo ná seene n ye Baŋa Wɛ Bu, se n laam vere n tete. Kwaane n tu da dagara kam yuu ne se dé nii.”
41Juu tiina nakwa bam, de ba kaanem yiga tiina, de ba zamesem tiina bam de maa ke‑o ba mɔna konto, ye ba tɛ daane ba we, 42“O yeini o jwoŋi nɔɔna ŋwea, ye o laam ware o tete ŋwea o jwoŋi. O maa bere we o ye Isarele dwi tiina pɛ. O laam nam tu dagara kam yuu ne leile se dé nii, se dé wó sɛ we o ye chega tu. 43O ta bere we o teege Wɛ baŋa ne. Wɛ nam ná seene o lage o ni taane, se o laam jwoŋi‑o o yage, o na pɛ se o ye Wɛ Bu to ŋwaane.”
44Ŋweena balo na tɔge ba pa dagare sem baŋa ne to de maa jege‑o ba twea konto dwoŋi.
45Ko ma vo ko yi maŋa kam wɛ na tu de wo yupare baŋa ne to. Tega kam maama ma ba ka ji lim se ko vo ko yi wɛ-guni maŋa ne. 46Ko na yi nenɛɛne luu batɔ to mo Yezu laare baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa o we, “Eli, Eli, lema sabaktani?” Taane dento kuri mo, “Amo Wɛ, amo Wɛ, bɛ mo ke ye n yage a yera?”
47Nɔɔna balo na zege da ye ba ni taane dem to badwonna ma boŋe we, o bwoi Elija mo se o ba. 48Ba dedoa ma ke lela o duri o vo o kwei sɔsɔɔ. O ma de-ko sa-nyɔna wone, ye o daare o ke-ko kasogo ni ne o vo o tei o pa Yezu se o nyɔ. 49Nɔɔna badaara bam na nɛ konto to, ba maa we, “Yage se dé cheigi dé nii, Elija wó ba o jwoŋi‑o o yage na.”
50Yezu daa ma jwoori o kaase baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa. O laam ma pa o siu ti.
51Yezu na tege konto to, gare-jale delo na leigi de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to ma kaare belei, ko zege ko baŋa ne ko tu ko kwaare ko kuri ne. Tega kam maa ziziŋa ye pelwaaro bage te yare. 52Yibeela yam ma puri. Ko daare Wɛ tete nɔɔna balo ya na tege to dedɛ ma jwoori ba bi, 53ye ba nwoŋi ba yibeela yam wone. Yezu tete na tu o bi toone wone to kwaga ne, banto laam ma vo ba zo Wɛ teo Jerusalem pa se nɔɔna dedɛ na-ba.
54Soja tiina bam yiga tu de o nɔɔna balo na wora ba yere Yezu to ma na tega kam ziziŋim dem de kolo maama na ke to. Foone ma tiini de zo-ba, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto ya seene o ye Baŋa Wɛ Bu mo.”
55Kaana dedɛ de déem tɔge ba wora, ba na zege yiga yiga ye ba nia. Banto déem ya tɔge de Yezu mo ba nwoŋi Galili ba ba, ye ba yeini ba tɔge ba zeini‑o. 56Mary wolo ba na bwoi we Magadala to maa tɔge o wo kaana bam konto wone, dedaane Mary wodwoŋi wolo na ye Jemsi de Josɛf nu to, ko woli de Zebedi bia bam nu.
Ba ke Yezu yera yam yibeeli wone
Maake 15:42-47; Luka 23:50-56; Jɔn 19:38-42
57Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora, o yere mo Josef, o na nwoŋi Arimatea ye o kwori o ye nadum. Wonto de déem ya tu o ji Yezu tɔgeno. Tega déem na lage ka yi to, 58o ma zaŋe o vo Pilata tei se o lwoori‑o chwoŋa se o vo o kwei Yezu yera yam o suli. Pilata ma sɛ, ye o pa ni se ba kwei yera yam ba pa‑o. 59Josɛf laam ma vo o kwei Yezu yera yam o pipiri-ya de gare-jale delo na lamma to. 60O ma daare o kwei-ya o ja vo o tiŋi peo bɔɔne wone. Dento maŋe de ye o tete nyem mo, ye ba déem lugi-de peo yera ne mo. De ye yibeeli-doore mo. O na tiŋi yera yam da to, o laam ma bibili kandwɛ-polɔgɔ kamunu o ma pe bɔɔne dem ni, ye o daare o viiri. 61O na wora o fɔge-de konto to, Mary Magadala de Mary wodwoŋi wom maa jei yibeeli dem ni seeni ba nia.
Ba yɔɔre ba yere yibeeli dem
62Dɛ dem Juu tiina na yeini ba ti ba yiga se ba siu dɛ dem laam yi to ma kɛ. Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam laam ma zaŋe ba vo Pilata tei. 63Ba ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Debam tu, dé maane we, vwa-nyeno wom ta na wora maŋa kalo to, o déem tage o we, omo wó jwoori o bi da yatɔ dɛ ne. 64Konto ŋwaane, nam pa ni se nɔɔna wuuri ba vo ba kwoni yibeeli dem ni se ba fɔge ba taa nia se ko vo ko yi da yatɔ dɛ dem. Ko ná dae konto, o tɔgena bam wó wane ba vo ba kwei‑o ba ja viiri, ye ba daare ba ta de nɔɔna we, o bi toone wone mo. Konto maa wó pa se ba vwa yam tiini ya ji chega se ko dwoni boboa kam ne.” 65Pilata ma sɛ ye o we, “Nam ja-na nɔɔna á vo se ba kwaane ba taa nia se ko maŋe de abam na yei tei to.”
66Ba ma kɛ ba vo yibeeli dem ne, ye ba kwoni de ni kandwɛ-kamunu kom na pe to. Ba ma daare ba yage nɔɔna bam da se ba taa yere-de.

english_text:
Jesus Is Alive
(Mark 16.1-8; Luke 24.1-12; John 20.1-10)
