44Around noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until the middle of the afternoon. 45 The sun stopped shining, and the curtain in the temple split down the middle. 46 Jesus shouted, “Father, I put myself in your hands!” Then he died.
47When the Roman officer saw what had happened, he praised God and said, “Jesus must really have been a good man!”
48A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home. 49 All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched.
Jesus Is Buried
(Matthew 27.57-61; Mark 15.42-47; John 19.38-42)
50-51There was a man named Joseph, who was from Arimathea in Judea. Joseph was a good and honest man, and he was eager for God's kingdom to come. He was also a member of the council, but he did not agree with what they had decided.
52Joseph went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body. 53He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used. 54It was Friday, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
55The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb. 56 Then they went to prepare some sweet-smelling spices for his burial. But on the Sabbath they rested, as the Law of Moses commands.
translation_text:
Pilata bwei Yezu taane
Matiyu 27:1-2, 11-26; Maake 15:1-15; Jɔn 18:28–19:16
1Juu tiina nakwa kɔgɔ kom maama déem ma zaŋe ba ja Yezu ba ja vo gɔmena tu Pilata tei. 2Ba ma bobo se ba taa ŋɔɔne taane dem ba pa‑o ye ba we, “Debam nɛ nɔɔno wonto na jege dé teo kom nɔɔna mo o gane-ba pa ba tusi. O maa bere-ba we ba yé taa lae lampwoo ba pae logo kom Pa-faro wom. O maa kwori o bere o tete we o ye pɛ mo, Wɛ Dam Tu wom.”
3Pilata na nigi konto to, o ma bwei Yezu o we, “Nmo mo ye Juu tiina bam pɛ na?” Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo na tage kolo to mo konto.”
4Pilata ma ta de Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam, de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama o we, “Amo wo nɛ nɔɔno wonto na ke kolo o chɔge to se a bwei‑o se o leiri.” 5Ba ma tiini ba ŋɔɔne taane dem ye ba kwaane ba ta ba we, “O nam yeini o tole Judea teene dem maama o pae se bobɔga to nɔɔna bam wone. O déem bobo o ke konto dwoŋi Galili ne mo ye o laam yi ywo-seeni.”
6Pilata na nigi konto to, o ma bwei-ba se o nii nɔɔno wom ye Galili tu mo na. 7O na tu o lɔre we Yezu nwoŋi teo kolo Herodi na tei to, o ma pa se ba ja‑o ba vo wonto tei se o di taane dem, kolo ŋwaane Herodi de tɔge o wo Jerusalem ne maŋa kam konto ne.
8Pɛ Herodi na nɛ Yezu to, o maa jege wopwolo dedɛ, kolo ŋwaane o ya maŋe o ni o ŋwa ye o tiini o lage se o na‑o. O maa lage se o nii, Yezu wó ke wo-kenkagele o bere‑o na. 9O ma kwaane o bwei‑o wonnu dedɛ. Yezu maa wo sɛ se o leiri‑o kolokolo. 10Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba zamesem tiina bam maa tɔge ba zege da ye ba tiini ba ŋɔɔne taane dem de baare ba pa‑o. 11Herodi de o soja tiina bam laam ma twe Yezu dedɛ, ye ba jege‑o ba mɔna. Ba ma pa o zo gare-nyenno, ye ba daare ba pa se o jwoori o vo Pilata tei. 12Dɛ dem konto ne Herodi de Pilata ma di badwoŋo daane, ye ba déem ya chuli daane mo.
13Pilata ma pa se Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam, de ba nakwa bam, de nɔɔna bam maama la daane o tei ne. 14O ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam na saŋe nɔɔno wonto amo tei ne to, á tɛ á we o ye wolo na gane á teo kom nɔɔna bam pa ba tusi to. Amo nam bwei‑o mo abam tei ne se a nii, ye a wo nɛ kolo o na ke o chɔge ye á ja‑o ko ŋwaane to. 15Herodi de wo nɛ kolo o na chɔge to. Mo kokuri o pɛ se o jwoori o ba debam tei. Á ta‑á yei we kolokolo tera ko na wó pa se ba ja‑o ba go. 16Konto ŋwaane amo wó pa se o na waarem mo ye a daare a yage‑o.”
[ 17Pilata déem nam jege se o le peeno dedoa o pa-ba ba kuri dem ŋwaane.] 18Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama laam ma laare de kwor-dɛa ba we, “Ko ná ye nɔɔno wonto, ja‑o n go. Dé nam lage se n le Barabas n yage n pa debam.” 19Barabas maa ye wolo ba déem na ke peena diga ne o na ke jara de ba teo kom dedɛɛra ye o go nɔɔna to ŋwaane.
20Pilata maa lage se o le Yezu o yage. O daa ma ta de nɔɔna bam se ba sɛ konto. 21Ba ma chem, ye ba tiini ba laare baŋa baŋa ba we, “Nam pa‑o dagara yuu ne n go.”
22O daa ta ma ta de-ba o ke betɔ o we, “Bɛŋwaane mo? Bɛ wo-lɔŋɔ mo o kea? Amo wo nɛ kolo o na ke o chɔge pa se ko maŋe se dé go‑o to. Konto to, amo wó pa se o na waarem ye a daare a yage‑o.”
23Ba daa ta maa tiini ba kwaana ba laare de kwor-dɛa ye ba tɛ de baare ba we, ba jege se ba pa‑o dagara yuu ne mo ba go. Ba na tiini ba ŋɔɔne de ni-dɛɛre konto to, 24ko ma pa se Pilata sɛ se o ke kolo ba na lage to. 25O ma pa ni we, ba le nɔɔno wolo ba na lage se o yage o pa-ba to. Wonto mo ye wolo ba ya na jaane ba ke peena diga ne o na ke jara de ba teo kom dedɛɛra ye o go nɔɔna to ŋwaane. O ma daare o ke Yezu ba jeŋa ne se ba wane ba ke‑o ne ba boboŋa na lage tei to.
Ba jaane Yezu ba vo ba pa dagara yuu ne
Matiyu 27:32-56; Maake 15:21-41; Jɔn 19:17-30
26Soja tiina laam ma ja Yezu ba maa kɛa. Ba na maa vei to, ba ma na nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Simon. O nwoŋi Kurene mo. O déem ya nwoŋi gaao mo o ba o yi teo wo o maa kɛa. Ba ma zi‑o ye ba daare ba daŋe dagara kam o bakala baŋa ne pa se o zeŋe-ka o tɔge Yezu kwaga o ja vo. 27Teo kom nɔn-kɔgɔ déem maa tɔge Yezu kwaga. Kaana de maa tɔge ba wora ye ba tiini ba keeri dedɛ o ŋwaane. 28Yezu ma pipiri o nii-ba ye o we, “Jerusalem kaana bam, yé ta‑á keeri-na amo ŋwaane. Á nam ta‑á keeri á pae á tete de á bia. 29Ko nam wó ba ko yi maŋa kam abam na wó ta we, ‘Kaane wolo maama na ye kadega to ye yu-ywoŋo tu mo. Wolo na maŋe o wo loge bu pa o ŋɔge yele to jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ.’ 30Yaara maŋa kam konto ná yia, nɔɔna wó lwoori peero tem de zwonnu tem we, te to ba baŋa ne te kwoli-ba. 31Ta‑á nii-na ba na ke wo-lwanno tei leile konto. Mini na jege da-lɛa de di konto to, ko ná tu ko ye da-kora, ko bá tiini ko taa ye lɛɛro ko dwoi konto na?”
32Ba déem ma ja ŋweena balei ba vo se ba woli de Yezu ba go. 33Ba ma vo ba yi jeiga kalo yere na ye ‘Yu-kwoli-champoa Peo’ to. Ba laam ma ja Yezu ba pa dagara kam yuu ne. Ba ma ja ŋweena bam de ba pa dagare sedwonna baŋa ne. Ba ma chwi dedoa Yezu jazem ne. Wowom maa wo o jagwia ne. 34Ba na page Yezu dagara kam yuu ne konto to, o ma lwoori Wɛ o we, “Amo Kwo, yage n ma n chɛ-ba, se ba yeiri woŋo kolo ba na ke to.”
Ba ma kwei o gwaaro tem se ba pɔɔre ba pa daane. Ba ma ta jɔrɔ se ba nii wɔ mo wó twori kolo o na lage to.
35Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maa zege da ba nia. Juu tiina nakwa bam nam ke‑o ba mɔna ye ba we, “O yeini o jwoŋi nɔɔna ŋwea. O ná seene o ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wolo o na kuri to, o nam jege se o jwoŋi o tete ŋwea mo.”
36Soja tiina bam de maa ke‑o ba mɔna, ye ba jege sa-nyɔna ba suŋi o yiga ne. 37Ba maa we, “Nmo ná seene n ye Juu tiina bam pɛ, se n jwoŋi n tete ŋwea se dé nii.”
38Ba déem ya popone tɔnɔ se ko bere kolo o na chɔge ye ba go‑o to ba meeli o baŋa ne, ye ko we:
WONTO YE JUU TIINA PƐ MO.
39Ŋweena balo na tɔge ba page da to dedoa maa jege Yezu o twea ye o we, “Ko dae we nmo mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista na? Nam jwoŋi n tete ŋwea se n daare n jwoŋi debam de n woli da.”
40Ŋweeno wodwoŋi wom ma bwɛ o badwoŋi wom o we, “Nmo ba kɔre Wɛ na? Debam maama jege waarem dedwe mo se dé te. 41Ko ná ye debam, dé waarem dem jege chega, kolo ŋwaane keim-balwaaro telo dé na ke to, ko maŋe se dé te mo. Ko daare nɔɔno wonto wo ke kolokolo o chɔge.” 42O ma daare o ta de Yezu o we, “Nmo ná tu n ba n di paare dem, se n guli amo gula.” 43Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, zem dɛ dem ne nmo wó taa wo amo tei ne Wɛ ywoni jei sem ne.”
44Ko ma vo ko yi maŋa kam wɛ na tu de wo yupare baŋa ne to. Tega kam maama ma ba ka ji lim se ko vo ko yi wɛ-guni maŋa ne. 45Wea kam daa ba jege pwooni. Gare-jale delo na leigi de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to ma kaare belei. 46Yezu laam ma laare de kwor-dɛa o we, “Amo Kwo, a kwei a jworo a ke nmo jeŋa ne.” O na tage konto to, o ma daare o te.
47Soja tiina bam yiga tu na nɛ kolo na ke to, o ma tei Wɛ ye o we, “Nɔɔno wonto seene o ye nɔn-ŋom mo chekke.”
48Nɔɔna balo maama na tu ba la daane se ba nii kolo na lage ko ke to de ma na ko na ke tei to. Ba na nɛ to, ba ma jwoori ba viiri ye ba wo chɔge dedɛ. 49Ko daare balo maama na maŋe ba yei‑o to, de kaana balo ya na tɔge ded‑o ba nwoŋi Galili ba ba to maa zege dáa ne ba nia.
Ba ke Yezu yera yam yibeeli wone
Matiyu 27:57-61; Maake 15:42-47; Jɔn 19:38-42
50-51Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora, o yere mo Josɛf. O nwoŋi Judea teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Arimatea. O maa ye Juu tiina nakwa kɔgɔ kom nɔɔno. O maa kwori o ye nɔn-ŋom ye o tɔge chega Wɛ tei ne. Ba kɔgɔ kom ya na ke ni daane se ba ja Yezu to, o wo sɛ ba na boŋe se ba ke‑o kolo to. O maa jege teena we Wɛ paare dem wó ba o nɔɔna baŋa. 52O ma zaŋe o vo Pilata tei o lwoori chwoŋa se o vo o kwei Yezu yera yam o suli. 53Pilata na sɛ to, Josɛf ma vo o pare Yezu yera yam dagara kam yuu ne. O ma kwei gare-jale o ma pipiri o yera yam, ye o daare o ja vo o tiŋi-ya peo bɔɔne wone. Dento maa ye yibeeli delo ba déem na lugi-de peo yera ne ye ba maŋe ba wo ke nɔɔno da to.
54Dɛ dem Josɛf na ke konto to maa ye dɛ delo Juu tiina bam na jege se ba ti ba yiga ba siu dɛ dem ŋwaane to. Tega lage ka yi pa se ba siu dɛ dem laam bobo.
55Kaana balo ya na tɔge de Yezu ba nwoŋi Galili to déem ma da Josɛf kwaga ba vo ba na yibeeli dem jei de o na tiŋi Yezu yera yam da tei to. 56Ba na nɛ konto to, ba ma jwoori ba vo sɔŋɔ. Ba ma vo ba lage terale nuga dwi dwi se ba ma turi Yezu yera yam. Ba siu dɛ dem laam na yi to, ba ma sii de ba totoŋa yam, ne Wɛ ni dem na bere tei to.

english_text:
Jesus Is Alive
(Matthew 28.1-10; Mark 16.1-8; John 20.1-10)
1Very early on Sunday morning the women went to the tomb, carrying the spices they had prepared. 2When they found the stone rolled away from the entrance, 3they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus, 4and they did not know what to think.
Suddenly two men in shining white clothes stood beside them. 5The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, “Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive? 6 Jesus isn't here! He has been raised from death. Remember that while he was still in Galilee, he told you, 7‘The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life.’ ” 8Then they remembered what Jesus had said.
9-10Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened. 11The apostles thought it was all nonsense, and they would not believe.
12But Peter ran to the tomb. And when he stooped down and looked in, he saw only the burial clothes. Then he returned, wondering what had happened.
Jesus Appears to Two Disciples
(Mark 16.12,13)
13That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem. 14As they were talking and thinking about what had happened, 15Jesus came near and started walking along beside them. 16But they did not know who he was.
17Jesus asked them, “What were you talking about as you walked along?”
The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy. 18Then the one named Cleopas asked Jesus, “Are you the only person from Jerusalem who didn't know what was happening there these last few days?”
19“What do you mean?” Jesus asked.
They answered:
Those things that happened to Jesus from Nazareth. By what he did and said he showed that he was a powerful prophet, who pleased God and all the people. 20Then the chief priests and our leaders had him arrested and sentenced to die on a cross. 21We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.
22Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning, 23but did not find the body of Jesus. They came back, saying they had seen a vision of angels who told them that he is alive. 24Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
25Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said? 26Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?” 27Jesus then explained everything written about himself in the Scriptures, beginning with the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets.
28When the two of them came near the village where they were going, Jesus seemed to be going farther. 29They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
30After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them. 31At once they knew who he was, but he disappeared. 32They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?” 33So they got up and returned to Jerusalem.
The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together. 34And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter. 35Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread.
What Jesus' Followers Must Do
(Matthew 28.16-20; Mark 16.14-18; John 20.19-23; Acts 1.6-8)
36While Jesus' disciples were talking about what had happened, Jesus appeared and greeted them. 37They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
38But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt? 39Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
40After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet. 41The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?” 42They gave him a piece of broiled fish. 43He took it and ate it as they watched.
44Jesus said to them, “While I was still with you, I told you that everything written about me in the Law of Moses, the Books of the Prophets, and in the Psalms had to happen.”
45Then he helped them understand the Scriptures. 46He told them:
The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death. 47They also say that all people of every nation must be told in my name to turn to God, in order to be forgiven. So beginning in Jerusalem, 48you must tell everything that has happened. 49 I will send you the one my Father has promised, but you must stay in the city until you are given power from heaven.
Jesus Returns to Heaven
(Mark 16.19,20; Acts 1.9-11)
50 Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them. 51As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven. 52After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy. 53They spent their time in the temple, praising God.
translation_text:
Yezu bi toone wone
Matiyu 28:1-10; Maake 16:1-8; Jɔn 20:1-10
1Wɛ na wora de puli dɛ dem na saŋe siu dɛ dem to, kaana bam ma zaŋe ba gwoni tega ba vo yibeeli dem jei sem. Ba maa jege terale nwi selo ba na lage ba ma turi Yezu yera yam to. 2Ba na yi jei sem to, ba ma na we kandwɛ delo ya na pe bɔɔne dem ni to bibili de tigi dáa ne. 3Ba ma vo ba zo bɔɔne dem wo. Ba maa wo nɛ dé Teiru Yezu yera yam da. 4Ba boboŋa ma vugimi de ba na wó ke tei. Ba na zege da konto to, nɔɔna balei ma pɔpɔ ba nwoŋi ba zege ba tei ne, ye ba zo gwaaro telo na nyeene pele-pele to. 5Foone ma ja kaana bam. Ba ma tiiri ba chɔɔle ba yuni tega ne. Nɔɔna bam laam ma ta de-ba ba we, “Bɛŋwaane mo á kare á beeri wolo na ŋwe to twa wone? 6O nam tere ywo. Wɛ bi‑o mo. Guli-na kolo o déem na tage de abam maŋa kalo o ta na wo Galili ne to, 7ye o we, ba jege se ba ja omo Nabiin-bu wom ba ke nɔn-chechɔgero jeŋa ne, se ba daare ba pa‑o dagara yuu ne ba go, ye o laam jwoori o bi da yatɔ dɛ ne.”
8Nɔɔna bam na tage konto to, kaana bam laam ma guli Yezu ya na tage kolo to. 9Ba ma zege yibeeli dem jei sem ne ba jwoori ba vo ba ta de Yezu nɔɔna fuga-dedoa kam, de balo maama na tɔge ba wora to. 10Kaana bam konto mo ye Mary Magadala, de Joanna, de Mary wolo na ye Jemsi nu to, ko woli de kaana balo na tɔge de-ba to. Banto maama maa wora ba tɛ kolo na ke to ba bere Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam. 11Nɔɔna bam na nigi to, ba maa wo pɛ se kaana bam taane dem jege kuri, ye ba wo sɛ ba ni. 12Ko daare Piita ma zaŋe lela o duri o vo yibeeli dem jei sem se o nii. O na yi da to, o ma tiiri o nii bɔɔne dem wone ye o na gare-jale dem yerane na tigi da. O ma jwoori o viiri ye ko ke‑o yaau de kolo na ke to.
Yezu na veere o tete tei to
Maake 16:12-13
13Dɛ dem konto ne mo Yezu tɔgena bam balei maa wo chwoŋa ne ba maa vei teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Emayus. Teo kom konto ye nenɛɛne mɛɛla yarepɛ mo de Jerusalem. 14Ba na maa vei to, ba maa ŋɔɔne kolo maama na ke to. 15Ba na ŋɔɔne ye ba bwɛ daane konto to, Yezu ma to ba wone o tɔge de-ba o via. 16Ba na tɔge daane konto to, ba yia ma pugimi pa se ba wo lɔre‑o.
17Yezu ma bwei-ba o we, “Bɛ wonnu mo abam jege á ŋɔɔna ye á via?” Ba na nigi konto to, ba ma zege ye ba yiga nyɔne. 18Ba dedoa yere mo Kelopasa. O ma ta de Yezu o we, “Nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Jerusalem ne to maŋe ba lɔre wo-kamunnu telo na ke da leile konto to. Bɛ nam mo ye nmo yerane wo nigi?” 19O ma bwei-ba o we, “Bɛ wonnu mo konto?”
Ba ma leiri ba we, “Ko ye kolo na ke Nazarete tu Yezu to mo. O ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu mo ye Wɛ dam wo o tei ne. Nɔɔna bam maama pɛ se o kikia de o ni taane maama taa jege dam, ye Wɛ de bere we konto ye chega. 20Debam kaanem yiga tiina bam de dé teo kom nakwa bam ma zaŋe ba ja‑o ba saŋe, pa se ba ve o bora, ye ba we o maŋe se o te. Ba laam ma daare ba pa‑o dagara yuu ne ba go. 21Debam nam ya jege teena we wonto mo ye wolo na wó ŋwe Isarele dwi tiina bam wɛleera jene o ma jwoŋi-ba o yage to. De konto maama, zem mo jege da yatɔ konto na ke to. 22Kolo na daare to mo ye debam kɔgɔ kom kaana badwonna vei o yibeeli dem jei sem ba na kolo na sɔɔre debam yera to. Ba ma vo tetete 23ye ba wo nɛ o yera yam da. Ba ma jwoori ba ba ba ta ba bere debam we ba nɛ wo-kenkagele mo. Ba ma na Wɛ malese, ye se ta de-ba we Yezu daa ta ŋwe mo. 24Debam nɔɔna bam badwonna de ma zaŋe ba vo yibeeli dem ne. Ba ma na we ko seene ko ye nenɛɛne kaana bam na tage tei to. Ko daare Yezu tete mo ba wo nɛ.”
25Yezu laam ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, “Á boboŋa tera na? Bɛ mo ye á ware á sɛ Wɛ kwora kalo o sampwori sem na yeini ba tɔɔle faŋa faŋa to? 26Ko dae mo Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom na jege se o na yaara yalo, ye o daare o di Wɛ telaao o jwoŋi o paare to na?” 27O laam ma maŋe kolo maama na popone o ŋwaane ko tiŋi Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to o bere-ba. O ma bobo o pa ba lɔre Moses berem dem kuri, ye o daare o bere-ba faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem berem dem kuri na ye tei to.
28Ba na maa vei to, ba ma vo ba twɛ teo kolo ba na lage ba vo to. Yezu ma ke ne o na maa kɛ yiga mo tei. 29Nɔɔna bam maa wo sɛ ye ba kwoori‑o ba we, “Tega lage ka yi. Nam zo n peini debam tei ne.” O ma sɛ ye o da o zo.
30O ma jeini se o di wodiu de-ba. O ma kwei bworobworo ye o ke Wɛ lei ko ŋwaane. O laam ma fɔ bworobworo kom o maŋe o pa-ba. 31O na ke konto to, ba yia daa wo pugimi ye ba laam lɔre‑o. Ba na lɔre‑o to, o ma pɔpɔ o jei ba yiga ne ye ba daa wo nɛ‑o. 32Ba laam ma ta daane ba we, “Nmo wo nɛ na? Dé na tɔge daane chwoŋa ne ye o ŋɔɔne o bere debam Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wonnu tem kuri na ye tei to, dé ya ba tiini dé jege wopwolo na?”
33Ba ma zaŋe lela ba jwoori ba vo Jerusalem teo kom wo. Ba na yi da to, ba ma na o nɔɔna fuga-dedoa kam de nɔɔna badwonna bam na lage daane jeiga dedoa. 34Banto maa tɛ ba we, “Ko ye chega mo. Dé Teiru Yezu seene o bi toone wone. O tu o bere o tete de Simon mo.” 35Nɔɔna balei bam de ma maŋe kolo na ke chwoŋa ne to ba bere-ba. Ba ma daare ba maŋe Yezu na fɔge bworobworo kom ye ba laam lɔre‑o tei to.
Yezu bere o tete o tɔgena bam
Matiyu 28:16-20; Maake 16:14-20; Jɔn 20:19-23; Kikia 1:9-11
36Yezu tɔgena bam ta na wora ba ŋɔɔne konto to, Yezu tete ma pɔpɔ o ba o zege ba tetare ne. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Yazura taa wo á tei ne.” 37Ba bochare ma di ye foone ja-ba dedɛ. Ba ma boŋe we ba nɛ chiru mo. 38O ma ta de-ba o we, “Bɛŋwaane mo á yera sae konto? Bɛ mo ye á jege bobwea amo ŋwaane? 39Fɔge-na á nii amo jea de a nɛ na ye tei to. Ko seene ko ye amo. Taane-na amo á nii. Chira ba jege ya-nɔna de kwi ne á na nae amo na ye tei to.”
40O na tage konto to, o ma bere-ba o jataala de o nɛ sem. 41Ko na tiini ko jege wopwolo ko pa-ba to, ba ta ware ba sɛ we ko ye chega, ye ba ja ba nia. O ma bwei-ba o we, “Á jege wodiu ywo-seeni se dé di na?” 42Ba ma twori ywon-saŋe ba pa‑o. 43O ma jwoŋi-de o di ba yibia ne.
44O laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Wonnu telo na ke amo to tɔge taane delo amo na maŋe a ta a bere abam maŋa kalo a ta na wo abam tetare ne to. Amo déem tage we, kolo maama na popone amo ŋwaane Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom ne to jege se ko ji chega, ko ná ye kolo Moses de faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem na popone to, de kolo na popone Wɛ Seinim Lei tɔnɔ kom ne to maama.”
45O ma daare o pa se ba wo poore se ba wane ba lɔre Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na bere kolo to kuri. 46O ma ta o bere-ba o we, “Ba popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne ba we, Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom lage o na yaara dedɛ mo o te, ye o laam jwoori o bi toone wone da yatɔ dɛ ne. 47Ba daa ta popone we, o tɔgena wó vo logo baŋa dwi maama tei, ye ba da o yere ŋwaane ba bere nɔɔna we ba jege se ba leiri ba wo mo se Wɛ laam yage ba wɛleera o ma chɛ-ba. Á nam jege se á bobo Jerusalem ne mo á ta‑á tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam konto. 48Abam ye balo na nɛ kolo maama na ke to, ye á jege se á zege chega kam konto kwaga ne á bere nɔɔna. 49Amo nam wó toŋe wolo wom amo Kwo na pwooli o ŋwaane to se o ba abam tei. Wonto wó pa se á na dam delo na nwoŋi Wɛ tei to. Á nam ta ta‑á wora teo kom wone, se á laam wó jwoŋi dam dem konto.”
50Yezu laam ma ja-ba o nwoŋi teo kom wone o ja vo o yi Bɛtania seeni. O ma zeiŋi o jea wɛyuu ne ye o swɛ ba swolim. 51O na wora o ke Wɛ zaane o yage ba yuu ne konto to, o ma yage ba tei ye Wɛ kwei‑o o ja di telaao. 52Ba ma kuni dwoona ba zuli‑o ye ba laam daare ba jwoori Jerusalem de wopwolo dedɛ. 53Ba na wora to, ba wo fɔge ba kwɛ Wɛ diga kam veiŋa, ye ba tei Wɛ maŋa maama.

english_text:
The Word of Life
1In the beginning was the one
who is called the Word.
The Word was with God
and was truly God.
2From the very beginning
the Word was with God.
3And with this Word,
God created all things.
Nothing was made
without the Word.
Everything that was created
4received its life from him,
and his life gave light
to everyone.
5The light keeps shining
in the dark,
and darkness has never
put it out.
6 God sent a man named John,
7who came to tell
about the light
and to lead all people
to have faith.
8John wasn't this light.
He came only to tell
about the light.
9The true light that shines
on everyone
was coming into the world.
10The Word was in the world,
but no one knew him,
though God had made the world
with his Word.
11He came into his own world,
but his own nation
did not welcome him.
12Yet some people accepted him
and put their faith in him.
So he gave them the right
to be the children of God.
13They were not God's children
by nature or because
of any human desires.
God himself was the one
who made them his children.
14The Word became
a human being
and lived here with us.
We saw his true glory,
the glory of the only Son
of the Father.
From him the complete gifts
of undeserved grace and truth
have come down to us.
15John spoke about him and shouted, “This is the one I told you would come! He is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
16Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another. 17The Law was given by Moses, but Jesus Christ brought us undeserved kindness and truth. 18No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is truly God and is closest to the Father, has shown us what God is like.
John the Baptist Tells about Jesus
(Matthew 3.1-12; Mark 1.1-8; Luke 3.15-17)
19-20The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.” 21 Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
22Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
23 John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
24Some Pharisees had also been sent to John. 25They asked him, “Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet?”
26John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know. 27Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.” 28John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany.
The Lamb of God
29The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said:
Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world! 30He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.” 31I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
32I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him. 33Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.” 34I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God.
The First Disciples of Jesus
35The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him. 36When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!” 37John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
38When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?”
They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
39Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
40One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter. 41The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
42Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.”
Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
43-44The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. There he met Philip, who was from Bethsaida, the hometown of Andrew and Peter. Jesus said to Philip, “Follow me.”
45Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
46Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?”
Philip answered, “Come and see.”
47When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
48“How do you know me?” Nathanael asked.
Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
49Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
50Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater. 51 I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_text:
Wɛ Bu Yezu Krista taane
1Boboa ne ye kolokolo daa ta tera to, de Botara kam maŋe ka wora mo. Ka maŋe ka wo Wɛ tei ne. Wolo na ye Botara kam to de Wɛ maama ye bedwe mo. 2O maŋe o wo Wɛ tei ne mo boboa kam ne. 3Baŋa Wɛ déem dɛ wonto ŋwaane mo o ke wonnu maama. Kolokolo nam tera Wɛ na kea, ye ko wo zege wonto yera ne. 4Wonto mo pɛ nabiina na ŋwea. Ŋwea kam konto nam ta mo pae nabiina na pwooni. 5Pwooni dem konto na tu to, de zeili lim. Lim daa ware pwooni dem konto de zeili.
6Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora Wɛ na toŋe‑o, o yere mo Jɔn. 7O déem tu se o ta wolo na ye pwooni dem to taane mo o bere nɔɔna, se nabiina maama wane ba lɔre‑o se ba daare ba sɛ‑o. 8Jɔn tete dae pwooni dem. O nam tu se o ta wonto taane mo o bere nɔɔna.
9Jɔn na wora konto to, wolo wom na ye pwooni dem chekke to déem lage o nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo o ba logo baŋa. Wonto mo pae nabiina maama na pwooni se ba yia wane ba poore. 10O déem ma ba logo baŋa o wora. Wɛ ya dɛ o ŋwaane mo o ke logo baŋa. De konto de, nabiina daa ta wo lɔre‑o. 11O ma ba o tete teo, ye o dwi tiina wo jeeri‑o lanyerane. 12Ko daare balo maama na sɛ‑o to, o ma pa-ba chwoŋa se ba ji Wɛ bia. Banto ye balo na dɛ o yere ŋwaane ba ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o to mo. 13Ba na jigi Wɛ bia konto to, ko dae nabiina mo loge-ba, ye ko dae ka-laga ŋwaane, naa nabiina boboŋa ŋwaane. Ko ye Wɛ tete boboŋa ŋwaane mo ba jigi Wɛ bia.
14Konto to, Botara kam déem jigi nabiinu. O ma ba o zoore debam nabiina wone. Dé ma na o dam na mae tei. O dam dem daga lanyerane, o na ye dé Kwo Wɛ Bu-doa kam to ŋwaane. Wɛ zaane de chega maama tiini te wo o tei ne.
15Jɔn déem ŋɔɔne wonto taane, ye o ta de kwor-dɛa o we, “Mo wolo wom amo na maŋe a ta o taane a we, Nɔɔno wodwoŋi wó saŋe amo kwaga o ba. Wonto ye kamunu o dwoi amo, kolo ŋwaane o maŋe o wora ye amo ta tera.”
16Wɛ Bu wom tiini o jege Wɛ zaane lanyerane, ye o daare o pae debam maama zeinim taa taa. 17Ko ná ye Wɛ nia yam, o déem pɛ ya tɔge Moses jeŋa mo ya ba debam tei. Ko nam ná ye Wɛ zaane de o chega kam, o pɛ te tɔge o Bu Yezu Krista jeŋa mo te ba. 18Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ta wo maŋe o na Baŋa Wɛ. Ko daare o Bu-doa kam mo pɛ se dé lɔre‑o. Wonto ye Wɛ. O maa wo dé Kwo Baŋa Wɛ takeiri ne.
Jɔn ŋɔɔne Yezu yera taane
Matiyu 3:1-12; Maake 1:1-8; Luka 3:1-17
19Jɔn déem na pɛ se nɔɔna lɔre Yezu tei to mo tento. Juu tiina balo na zoore Jerusalem ne to ma toŋe ba kaanem yiga tiina, de Levi dwi tiina se ba vo Jɔn tei. Ba ma vo ba bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo bere we n ye wɔ mo?” 20Jɔn ma yɔɔre o leiri-ba o we, “Ko dae amo mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom.”
21Ba ta ma jwoori ba bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo nam bere n tete we n ye wɔ mo? Nmo ye Elija mo na?” O ma leiri-ba o we, omo dae.
Ba daa ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo ye Wɛ sampwora kalo ya na maŋe se o ba to mo na?” O maa we, “Aawo.”
22Ba laam ma ta ba we, “Nam ta n bere debam nmo na ye wolo to. Dé jege se dé ja nmo ni taane mo dé vo dé ta dé bere balo na toŋe debam to. Nmo lage n ta n tete taane we bɛ mo?”
23Ba na bwei‑o konto to, Jɔn ma da Wɛ sampwora Izaya taane dem ŋwaane o leiri-ba o we, “Amo ye wolo na kaase a kwora kagoa yuu ne we:
‘Pa-na se chwoŋa kalo dé Teiru wom na lage o ba o tɔge da to
fɔge ka yɔɔre lanyerane.’ ”
24Nɔɔna badwonna de tɔge ba wora, ba na nwoŋi Farisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone. 25Ba ma bwei Jɔn ba we, “Nmo nam ná seene n dae Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, naa Elija, naa Wɛ sampwora kalo ya na maŋe se o ba to, wɔ mo pɛ nmo chwoŋa se n pa nɔɔna sɛɛm?”
26Jɔn ma leiri-ba o we, “Ko ná ye amo, a yeini a ma na mo a pa nɔɔna sɛɛm. Abam nam na zege to, nɔɔno wo á wone ye á yeiri‑o. 27Wonto lage o saŋe amo kwaga o ba, ye amo wo maŋe se a le o nɛ natera a pa‑o.”
28Konto maama déem ke Bɛtania ne, Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ ne mɛ Jɔn na pae nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane to.
Jɔn bere we Yezu ye Wɛ Pipeila kam
29Tega na poore to, Jɔn ma na Yezu na vei o maa beene o tei. O ma ta de balo na wora to o we, “Nii-na Wɛ Pipeila kalo na saare nabiina wɛleera to. 30Amo ya tage a we, ‘Nɔɔno wó saŋe amo kwaga o ba, ye o ye kamunu o dwoi amo, kolo ŋwaane o maŋe o wora ye amo ta tera.’ Ko nam ye wonto taane mo a tɛa. 31Amo tete déem maŋe a yeiri‑o, ye a laam ba a lɔre‑o. Amo nam tu se a pa amo dwonna Isarele dwi tiina bam mo lɔre‑o. Konto ŋwaane mo a yeini a kwei na a pa nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane.”
32-33Jɔn daa ta ma ŋɔɔne Yezu yera taane o bere-ba o we, “Amo ya yeiri Wɛ Bu wom na ye wolo to. Wɛ nam mo toŋe-ne se a ba a ma na a pa nɔɔna sɛɛm. O na toŋe-ne to, o ma ta o we, amo ná nɛ Sin-laao kom tu ko wo nɔɔno wolo baŋa ne, wonto mo ye wolo na wó kwei Sin-laao kom o ma pa nɔɔna jwoŋi sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane to. Amo laam nɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom na nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ko tu ko ba ko wo Yezu baŋa ne, ye ko nye de kunkwoŋa tei. 34Amo seene a na kolo Wɛ na tage to, ye a tɛ abam chekke we Yezu mo ye Wɛ Bu wom.”
Yezu bwoŋi nɔɔna se ba taa tɔge‑o
35Tega na poore to, Jɔn de o tɔgena balei daa ta maa wora. 36Jɔn ma na Yezu na vei o maa kɛa. O ma ta o we, “Nii-na Wɛ Pipeila kam.” 37Jɔn tɔgena balei bam ma ni o na tage kolo to. Ba ma pɛ ba pu Yezu kwaga. 38Yezu ma pipiri o nii o na ba na tɔge‑o to. O ma bwei-ba o we, “Á beene amo tei mo na?” Ba ma leiri ba we, “Ɛɛ, Rabi, n zoore yei ne mo?” (‘Rabi’ kuri mo ‘Berem tu’.) 39O ma leiri-ba o we, “Ba-na á nii.”
Ba ma tɔge ded‑o ba vo ba na mɛ o na zoore to. Ko ye dedaan-ni ne mo. Ba ma maŋe o tei ne ba ti dɛ dem.
40Nɔɔna banto dedoa yere mo Anduru. O ye Simon Piita nyaane mo. Anduru de o dwoŋi ya nigi Jɔn na tage Yezu taane tei, ye ba daare ba tɔge Yezu. 41Ba na jwoori to, Anduru ma ke lela o vo o zembaaro Simon tei. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Debam nɛ Wɛ Dam Tu wom.” (Yere dem konto de ‘Krista’ ye bedwe mo.)
42O laam ma ja‑o o vo Yezu tei. Yezu ma nii o yibia ne ye o we, “Nmo ye Simon wolo na ye Jɔn bu to mo. Nmo yere laam wó taa ye Kefa mo.” Yere dem konto de Piita ye bedwe mo.
43Tega déem na poore to, Yezu ma ja boboŋa se o vo Galili. O ma vo o na Filipi, ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Ba n ta‑n tɔge amo.”
44Filipi déem nwoŋi Bɛtasida mo, teo kolo Anduru de Piita na zoore da to. 45O laam ma zaŋe o vo o na nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Natanayel. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Debam nɛ wolo wom Moses na popone o taane faŋa faŋa Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom ne ye Wɛ sampwori de déem popone ba ta o taane to. Wonto ye Yezu mo. O maa ye Josɛf bu. O nwoŋi Nazarete mo.”
46Natanayel ma ta ded‑o o we, “Wo-laao tera ko na wó nwoŋi Nazarete ne. A fɔ vwa na?” Filipi ma ta o we, “Nam ba se dé vo dé nii.”
47Ba na maa vei to, Yezu ma na Natanayel na maa beene o tei. O ma ta o taane o we, “Wonto seene o ye Juu tu mo chekke, ye o wo lana.” 48Natanayel ma bwei‑o o we, “Nmo ke tɛ mo n yei amo?” O ma leiri‑o o we, “A ya nɛ nmo maŋa kam nmo na wo kaporo kom kuri ne ye Filipi laam ba o bwoŋi‑m to mo.” 49Natanayel ma leiri‑o o we, “Berem tu, nmo ye Wɛ Bu mo, ye n ta ye Isarele dwi tiina Pɛ.” 50Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo na sɛ amo konto to, ko ye amo na tage a we, a nɛ nmo kaporo kom kuri ne to ŋwaane mo na? Nmo nam wó na wo-kenkagela yalo na tiini ya dana ya dwoi konto to.”
51O laam ma ta o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam wó na Nabiin-bu wom na zege wɛyuu de tega baŋa laŋa ne tei to. Abam ta wó na Wɛ telaao ni na pore, ye Wɛ malese tɔge da se diini wɛ, ye se kwori se tu se tui tega baŋa.”

english_text:
Jesus at a Wedding in Cana
1Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee. 2Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
3When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
4Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
5Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
6At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about 100 liters. 7Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled, 8he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.”
The servants did as Jesus told them, 9and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over 10and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
11This was Jesus' first miracle, and he did it in the village of Cana in Galilee. There Jesus showed his glory, and his disciples put their faith in him. 12 After this, he went with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples to the town of Capernaum, where they stayed for a few days.
Jesus in the Temple
(Matthew 21.12,13; Mark 11.15-17; Luke 19.45,46)
13 Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem. 14There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables. 15So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
16Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
17 The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
18The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
19 “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
20The leaders replied, “It took 46 years to build this temple. What makes you think you can rebuild it in three days?”
21But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple. 22And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus.
Jesus Knows What People Are Like
23In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles. 24But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him. 25No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_text:
Yezu vei kadiri Kana ne
1Da yatɔ dɛ dem déem na yi to, ba maa wora ba ke kadiri Galili teo kodwoŋi ne, ko yere mo Kana. Yezu nu maa tɔge o wora. 2Ba déem bwoŋi Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam mo se ba de ba da. 3Ba na wora to, sa-soŋo kom ba na jege ba nyɔ to ma ti. Yezu nu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ba daa ba jege sana se ba nyɔ.” 4Yezu ma leiri o we, “A nu, nam yage a yera. Amo maŋa kam ta wo yi.” 5O nu wom laam ma ta de wodi-keira bam o we, “O ná tage kolo maama, se á ke.”
6Kambi-zɛ seredo déem maa zege da. Kikeiri-bia finlei naa fintɔ mo wó su se dedoa. Se ya maŋe se zege da mo se nɔɔna taa mae se wo na bam ba se ba jea de ba nɛ, ne Juu tiina chullu tem na bere tei to. 7Yezu ma ta de wodiu keira bam se ba mɔ na ba su kambi sem ni. Ba ma mɔ ba pɛɛle se ni. 8O daa ma ta-ba o we, ba laam mɔ kambi sem wone ba ja ba vo ba pa wolo na nii kuri dem baŋa ne to. Ba ma seene ba ke konto. 9O ma nyɔ na bam, dedaane ba maŋe ba ji sa-soŋo mo. O ma yeiri sana bam konto na nwoŋi mɛ, ye wodi-keira balo na mɔɔne na bam to mo yei. Nɔɔno wolo na nii kuri dem baŋa ne to laam ma bwoŋi kan-baro wom o ta ded‑o o we, 10“Nɔɔno maama yeini o pa sa-ŋona mo yiga ye ba nyɔ. Ba laam ná yeini ba nyɔ ba su, o ma pa-ba sa-yɔɔ se ba nyɔ. Nmo nam kwei sa-ŋona bam n zege, se n laam daare n kwei n pa debam kwaga ne. Ko kuri mo bɛ?”
11Mo Yezu na dɛ yiga o ke wo-kenkagele delo. O déem ke-de Galili teo Kana wone mo, se ko bere nɔɔna o na jege dam delo to. O kwaga tɔgena bam na nɛ to, ba ma ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o.
12Konto déem na kɛ to, Yezu, de o nu, de o nyaana, de o kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo Kaparenia ba ke da fenfee da.
Yezu na zo Wɛ diga kam o ke kolo to
Matiyu 21:12-13; Maake 11:15-17; Luka 19:45-46
13Ko déem ma daare fee se Juu tiina di ba kuri delo yere na ye Atɔgebabaŋa to. Yezu ma zaŋe o vo Jerusalem. 14O na yi da to, o ma vo o zo Wɛ diga kam. O ma na nɔɔna na jege naane, de pei, de kunkwon-puura ba yeiga ka konkɔlɔ kom ne. Nɔɔna balo na leini sabia to de maa jei da. 15O ma kwei ŋone o ma ke fena, ye o daare o zeili pei sem de naane dem maama pa de nwoŋi lela. O ma ja sabu-leinna bam tabollo o pipiri o de tega ne pa se ba sabu-mumugu kom jage. 16O ma daare o ta nɔɔna balo de na yeigi kunkwon-puura bam to o we, “Nam kwei-ba á ja á nwoŋi ywo-seeni. Amo bá sɛ se á pa amo Kwo Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom taa ye pipiu jeiga.”
17Yezu na ke tei konto to, o kwaga tɔgena bam ma guli ko na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne tei ko we, “Amo tiini a toŋe de yi-seena a pa nmo wara-jei sem mo.”
18Juu tiina bam laam ma bwei Yezu ba we, “Bɛ ŋo wo-kenkagele mo nmo wó ke se ko pa dé maane we nmo jege chwoŋa se n zeili nɔɔna bam konto?” 19Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam ná mage Wɛ diga kanto maama á de tega ne, amo wó jwoori a kwei da yatɔ mo a ma lɔ-ka a zege.” 20Ba laam ma ta ba we, “Ba kwei bena finna-yaredo (46) mo ba ma ba lɔ Wɛ diga kanto ba ti. Nmo nam lage n ke tɛ mo n ma da yatɔ yerane n ma‑n pa ka zege?” 21Yezu nam na ŋɔɔne Wɛ diga kam taane konto to, ko ye o tete yera yam taane mo o taga. 22Ko déem na tu ko yi maŋa kam Yezu na tega, ye o jwoori o bi da yatɔ dɛ ne to, o kwaga tɔgena bam laam guli o na tage tei to. Ba ma sɛ kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to de Yezu ni taane dem.
23Yezu déem ma maŋe Jerusalem ne se o tɔge o di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem o ti. Nɔɔna dedɛ ma na wo-kenkagela yalo o na ke to, pa se ba da o yere ŋwaane ba ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o. 24Yezu déem nam wo yage o wo o pa-ba, kolo ŋwaane o yei nɔɔna maama na ye tei to. 25O maa ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno bere‑o nabiina na ye tei to, o na maŋe o yei kolo na wo nabiinu maama bochare ne to ŋwaane.

english_text:
Jesus and Nicodemus
1There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader. 2One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
3Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
4Nicodemus asked, “How can a grown man ever be born a second time?”
5Jesus answered:
I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit. 6Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God. 7Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above. 8Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
9“How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
10Jesus replied:
How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things? 11I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say. 12 If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
13 No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there. 14 And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert. 15Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
16God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die. 17God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them! 18No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
19The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light. 20People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done. 21But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do.
Jesus and John the Baptist
22Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
23-24 John had not yet been put in jail. He was at Aenon near Salim, where there was a lot of water, and people were coming there for John to baptize them.
25John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing. 26They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
27John replied:
No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it. 28 You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
29At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad. 30Jesus must become more important, while I become less important.
The One Who Comes from Heaven
31God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others. 32He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him. 33But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful. 34The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
35 The Father loves the Son and has given him everything. 36Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_text:
Nikodema vei Yezu tei
1Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora, o yere mo Nikodema. O nwoŋi Farisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone mo. O maa tɔge o ye Juu tiina bam yiga tu dedoa. 2Dɛ dedwe o ma zaŋe o vo Yezu tei tete ne, ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Berem tu, dé yei we Wɛ mo toŋe nmo se n ba n bere nɔɔna o chega kam. Dé nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo nmo na ke to. Ko ma pa dé lɔre we Wɛ mo seene o wo nmo tei ne, pa nmo wae wo-kenkagela yam n ke.” 3Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, ba ná wo jwoori ba lo nɔɔno wolo, konto tu bere o bá lɔre Wɛ paare dem na ye tei to.” 4Nikodema ma bwei‑o o we, “Nɔɔno ná ye nɔn-kweo, ba wó ke tɛ mo ba lo‑o? O nam bá wane o jwoori o zo o nu wo se o lo‑o.”
5Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Chega ŋwaane to, ba ná wo dɛ na baŋa ba lo nɔɔno wolo, ye ba kwori ba wo dɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom baŋa ba lo‑o, konto tu bá wane o woli Wɛ paare dem wone. 6Nabiina ná yeini ba lo nɔɔno, ko ye logo baŋa momwɛ mo o jega. Ko daare ko ná ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom, konto mo pae nɔɔno jege Wɛ telaao ŋwe-doŋa kam. 7Yé ta‑n ye yaau de amo na tage kolo we, abam jege se ba jwoori ba lo abam to. 8Ko ná ye vio, ko yeini ko dole mɛ de mɛ ko na lage to mo. N ma‑n yeini n ni ko sɔɔ kom, ye n yeiri ko na nwoŋi mɛ, de ko na maa vei mɛ to. Ko ye bedwe mo de Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ wolo maama ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to.”
9Nikodema ma bwei o we, “Ko wó ke tɛ mo ko taa ye konto?” 10Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo ye wolo na zamese Isarele dwi tiina bam to mo. Bɛ mo ye n yeiri tento? 11Chega ŋwaane to, dé yeini dé ta wonnu telo dé na yei to mo, ye dé kwori dé ŋɔɔne kolo dé na nɛ to dé bere nɔɔna. De konto de, á ta ba sɛ debam berem dem. 12Amo tage logo baŋa wonnu taane a bere abam, ye á ba sɛ amo ni. Konto to, amo ná ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao wonnu taane a bere abam, á wó ke tɛ mo á sɛ amo ni? 13Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na diini Wɛ telaao, ko ná dae wolo wom na maŋe o tu o ba to yerane. Ko ye Nabiin-bu wom mo konto.
14Moses déem na wo kagoa wone faŋa faŋa to, o ma pale channa basankwea daa yuu ne, ye o zeiŋi-ka wɛɛne se o nɔɔna yé na chɔgem. Ba nam jege se ba kwei Nabiin-bu wom de ba zeiŋi wɛyuu ne konto mo, 15se ko pa nɔɔno wolo maama na ke o wo-dedoa ded‑o to na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.”
16Wɛ tiini o jege nabiina swono ye o toŋe o Bu-doa se o ba logo baŋa, se wolo maama na ke o wo-dedoa ded‑o to daa yé na chɔgem, se o daare o na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to. 17Wɛ na toŋe o Bu wom se o ba logo baŋa konto to, ko dae se o di nabiina taane o vane ba bora. Ko nam ye se o jwoŋi-ba o yage mo. 18Wolo maama na ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom to bá to de o bora. Ko daare wolo maama na ba lage se o sɛ‑o to maŋe o to mo, o na ve Wɛ Bu-doa kam to ŋwaane. 19Wɛ na di nabiina taane tei to mo tento: Wɛ pɛ se wolo na ye pwooni tu to ba logo baŋa o wora. Nabiina nam swoi lim ba dwoi pwooni dem, kolo ŋwaane ba kikia ba lana. 20Nɔɔno wolo maama na ke keim-balwaaro to wó chuli pwooni dem mo, ye o bá sɛ se o nwoŋi de yiga ne, se o keim-balwaaro tem ba te taa nae jaja. 21Wolo maama na tɔge chega chwoŋa to nam wó nwoŋi pwooni dem yiga ne, se nɔɔna lɔre we o kikia maama tɔge Wɛ boboŋa mo.
Jɔn daa ŋɔɔne Yezu yera taane
22Konto déem na kɛ to, Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo ba beeri Judea te-balwa bam wone. O ma dáane de-ba jei sem konto ne, ye o pa nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ yere ŋwaane. 23Jɔn maa wo Ayinon seeni. Teo kom konto bwola dedaane Salim. O na wora to mo o yeini o pae nɔɔna sɛɛm, na na daga jei sem konto ne to ŋwaane. Nɔɔna dedɛ déem yeini ba tui o tei maŋa maama se ba jwoŋi sɛɛm. 24Maŋa kam konto ne ba ta wo jaane Jɔn ba pe.
25Jɔn tɔgena badwonna déem ma mage ni-kantɔgɔ de Juu tu wodwoŋi de nɔɔna na jege se ba zare ba tete tei se ko tɔge ba chullu tem chekke to. 26Ba ma vo Jɔn tei ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Berem tu, dé nɛ nɔɔno wolo daama na wo nmo tei ne ye n wo Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ dedwoŋi dem ne to. Nmo tage o taane n bere debam. Leile konto o laam wora o pa nɔɔna sɛɛm, ye nɔɔna dedɛ tiini ba vei o tei ba daare debam. Ko lana na?” 27Jɔn ma leiri-ba o we, “Ko wo chɔge. Nɔɔno ná tɔge chwoŋa kalo, ko ye Wɛ mo tiŋi-ka o pa‑o. 28Abam tete wó zege amo kwaga ne de a na tage a we, amo dae Wɛ Dam Tu wom, se ko ye Wɛ mo toŋe-ne se a tɔge o Bu wom yiga a ba. 29Ko nye de nɔɔno ná di kaane, ko ye kan-baro wom tete mo tei kaane wom. O yiŋinu wom wó taa zege dáa ne mo ye o cheiga. O laam ná nigi kan-baro wom kwora, o wó taa jege wopwolo lanyerane. Tɔ. Amo de jege wopwolo de Yezu na tu ye a ni o kwora to. Amo tiini a jege wopwolo se ko ja gaale. 30Yezu yere dem jege se de taa zaŋa mo, se amo yere dem taa wo tega ne.
31Wolo wom na nwoŋi Wɛ tei o ba to mo ye nɔn-kamunu o dwoi nɔɔno maama. Ko daare wolo na nwoŋi logo baŋa to ye logo baŋa nyem mo. O ni taane de maa ye logo baŋa nyem. Wolo wom na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao to nam mo dwoi maama. 32O yeini o tɛ kolo o na lɔre Wɛ tei ne to mo o bere nɔɔna. De konto de, nɔɔna ba sɛ o berem dem. 33Nɔɔno wolo nam ná sɛ o berem dem, konto tu sɛ we Wɛ ye chega mo. 34Kolo ŋwaane, ko ná ye wolo wom Wɛ na toŋe to, Wɛ pɛ‑o o Sin-laao kom mo se ko tiini ko gaale, pa se ko ye Wɛ tete ni taane mo o tɛa. 35Dé Kwo Wɛ swoi o Bu wom. O ma pa se woŋo maama dam wo o jeŋa ne. 36Nɔɔno wolo na ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom to jege ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to. Ko daare nɔɔno wolo na ve Wɛ Bu wom to bá fɔge o na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. Wɛ ban-lom nam wó taa wo o baŋa ne taa.”

english_text:
1Jesus knew that the Pharisees had heard that he was winning and baptizing more followers than John was. 2But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself.
Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
3Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again. 4This time he had to go through Samaria, 5 and on his way he came to the town of Sychar. It was near the field that Jacob had long ago given to his son Joseph. 6-8The well that Jacob had dug was still there, and Jesus sat down beside it because he was tired from traveling. It was noon, and after Jesus' disciples had gone into town to buy some food, a Samaritan woman came to draw water from the well.
Jesus asked her, “Would you please give me a drink of water?”
9 “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
10Jesus answered, “You don't know what God wants to give you, and you don't know who is asking you for a drink. If you did, you would ask me for the water that gives life.”
11“Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water? 12Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
13Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will get thirsty again. 14But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
15The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
16Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
17-18The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.”
“That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
19The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet. 20My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
21Jesus said to her:
Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem. 22You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world. 23But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him. 24God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
25The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
26“I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
27The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
28The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people, 29“Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?” 30Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
31While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
32But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
33His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
34Jesus said:
My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do. 35You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
36Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together. 37So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.” 38I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
39A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.” 40They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
41Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say. 42They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!”
Jesus Heals an Official's Son
(Matthew 8.5-13; Luke 7.1-10)
43-44 Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left 45 and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
46 While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick. 47And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
48Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
49The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
50Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
51Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!” 52He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
53The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
54This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_text:
Samaria tiina kaane lɔre Yezu
1 Farisi tiina bam déem ma ni we Yezu wora o pae nɔɔna dedɛ tɔge o kwaga ko dwoi Jɔn, ye o ta kwori o pa-ba sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane. 2Ko nam dae Yezu tete mo pɛ ba jwoŋi sɛɛm, se ko ye o kwaga tɔgena bam mo ke konto. 3Yezu na maane we Farisi tiina bam lɔre konto to, o ma zaŋe Judea ne o jwoori o maa vei Galili. 4O na maa vei konto to, o jege se o tɔge Samaria wo mo o kɛ.
5O ma vo o yi Samaria teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Suchare. Ko bwola de tega kalo Jakob déem na kwei o pa o bu Josɛf faŋa faŋa to. 6Jakob déem jege vole jei sem konto ne. De ta maa wora de zem maama. Yezu na vei taa konto to, o ma bugi. O ma vo o jeini vole dem ni ne. Wea maa wo yupare baŋa ne. 7-8Yezu maa jei da konto, ye o kwaga tɔgena bam ya maŋe ba kɛ teo kom wo se ba yeigi wodiu. Samaria tiina kaane wodwoŋi laam ma ba se o mɔ na. Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, o ke na o pa‑o se o nyɔ. 9Kaane wom ma ta de Yezu o we, “Nmo ye Juu tu mo, ye amo ye Samaria tiina kaane. Bɛ mo ye n ta we, a ke na a pa‑m?” Kaane wom tage konto kolo ŋwaane ko ke‑o yaau mo, kokuri Juu tiina de Samaria tiina ware daane. 10Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo nam yeiri pɛɛre delo Wɛ na lage o pa nmo to. Amo taga se n ke na n pa-ne, ye n yeiri amo na ye wolo to. Nmo ya ná yei, nmo tete ya wó bwei amo, ye a pa nmo na balo na jege ŋwea ba pae nabiina to.”
11Kaane wom ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, nmo ba jege gwoŋo, ye vole dem luuna. Nmo nam wó ke tɛ mo n mɔ na balo na jege jworo ba pae nabiina to? 12Nmo nam bá wane n ta‑n dwoi dé nabaaro Jakob wolo déem na koge vole dento o pa debam to. Wonto tete, de o bia, de o vara maama déem mɔɔne na ywo-seeni mo faŋa faŋa ye ba nyɔa.” 13O ma leiri‑o o we, “Ko ná ye vole dento na bam, nɔɔno wolo maama ná nyɔge-ba, na-nyɔm ta wó ja kotu mo. 14Ko nam ná ye na balo amo na wó pa nɔɔna to, na-nyɔm daa bá ja wolo na nyɔge-ba to. Na bam a na wó pa to wó ji buli-yi o yera ne, ye de wó taa bura na balo na wó pa‑o ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.” 15Kaane wom daa ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, pa-ne na bam konto dwoŋi, se na-nyɔm daa yé ja-ne se a taa tui ywo a mɔɔne na.”
16Yezu ma ta‑o o we, o véi o bwoŋi o baro se o da o ba. 17Kaane wom ma leiri we, omo ba jege baro. O ma ta o we, “Nmo na tage kolo to ye chega mo. 18Nmo nam zo banna banu mo, ye nmo na wo nɔɔno wolo tei ne leile to seene o dae n baro. Ko ye chega mo n tage n bere-ne.” 19Kaane wom ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, amo lɔre we n ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu mo. 20Debam Samaria tiina nabaara bam déem tui peo konto yuu mo ba ware Wɛ. Ko daare abam Juu tiina bere we, ko maŋe se nɔɔna taa ware Wɛ Jerusalem teo ne mo.”
21Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Kaane, jwoŋi a taane dem. Maŋa wó ba ye nɔɔna ná lage ba ware dé Kwo Wɛ, ko bá taa ye peo kom yuu ne, naa Jerusalem teo wone. 22Abam Samaria tiina yeiri wolo á na zuli to. Debam Juu tiina nam yei wolo dé na zuli to, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ yeini o da Juu tiina bam jeŋa mo o vere nabiina. 23Ko daare maŋa maa beena leile konto, ye balo na seene ba zuli dé Kwo Wɛ chekke to wó tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo ba zuli‑o de ba bochara de chega. Mo dé Kwo Wɛ na lage se nabiina taa zuli‑o tei to. 24Wɛ ye siu mo. Balo maama na lage ba pa‑o zula to jege se ba tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane ba zuli‑o de ba bochara de chega.”
25Kaane wom ma ta o we, “Amo yei we Wɛ Dam Tu wolo yere na ye Krista to mo wó ba. O nam ná tua, o wó ta Wɛ chega kam maama o bere debam.” 26Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Ko ye amo mo konto, a zege a ŋɔɔne de nmo.”
27Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam laam ma jwoori ba ba. Ba na nɛ Yezu na zege o ŋɔɔne de kaane konto to, ko ma tiini ko ke-ba yaau. De konto de, ba wolowolo nam wo bwei ba we, “Bɛ mo nmo laga?” naa “Bɛ mo ye n ŋɔɔne de kaane wom?”
28Kaane wom laam ma yage o kɔɔro wom ye o daare o vo teo kom wo. O na yi da to, o ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, 29“Ba-na á nii nɔɔno, o na tage amo na ke kolo maama to o bere-ne. A yeiri wonto mo wó taa ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom naa wɔ mo.” 30O na tage o bere-ba konto to, ba ma nwoŋi teo kom wone ba maa vei Yezu tei.
31Konto déem na wora ko ke to, Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam ma lwoori‑o se o di wodiu. 32O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo maŋe a jege wodiu se a di, ye abam yeiri ko ni ne.” 33O kwaga tɔgena bam laam ma bwei daane ba we, “Nɔɔno ga mo jaane wodiu o ba o pa‑o na?” 34Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko ná ye amo ni-wodiu, ko ye se a tɔge wolo wom na toŋe-ne to boboŋa mo, se a toŋe o totoŋa yam a ti. 35Abam yeini á tɛ á we, ‘Ko daare chane sena mo se dé zage mena.’ Amo nam tɛ abam se á fɔge á nii kadwi sem na ye tei. Se nye de se mena yam bege ya ti, ye ya laam daare zagem mo. 36Maŋa kam yia se nɔɔna vo ba zage mena yam, se ba daare ba jwoŋi ba ŋweero. Wodiiru telo ba na jege se ba la ba ke daane to mo ye nɔɔna balo Wɛ na jwoŋi pa se ba na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to. Konto to, nɔɔno wolo na dugi mena yam to de wolo na zage-ya to maama wó tɔge daane ba di ywoni. 37Taane dento ye chega mo: ‘Nɔɔno mo dugi mena, wodwoŋi laam ma zage.’ 38Amo toŋe abam se á vo á la nɔɔna á pa Wɛ. Ko ye nenɛɛne abam wo vage mena yam, ye á laam wó vo á zage-ya. Nɔɔna badwonna mo vage-ya, ye abam di nyɔɔre ba totoŋa yam baŋa ne.”
39Samaria tiina kaane wom ya tage o bere o teo kom tiina we, Yezu tage omo na ke kolo maama to o bere-o. Ko ma pa Samaria tiina dedɛ ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu. 40Samaria tiina bam ma vo Yezu tei ba lwoori‑o se o dáane ba tei ne. O ma ke da yalei de-ba.
41Nɔɔna dedɛ daa ta ma ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o, o ni taane dem ŋwaane. 42Ba ma ta de kaane wom ba we, “Dé laam ke dé wo-dedoa ded‑o, ye ko dae nmo na tage kolo n bere debam to ŋwaane, se debam tete nigi o taane, ye dé kwori dé lɔre we, wonto mo seene o ye nabiina Vereno wom.”
Yezu yɔɔre dedɛɛro wodwoŋi bu
43Da yalei yam déem na kɛ konto to mo Yezu zaŋe o maa vei Galili laŋa kam. 44Yezu tete nam mo yeini o tɛ o we, ba ba nege Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu o tete teo ne. 45Yezu na vei o yi Galili to, nɔɔna ma jeeri‑o lanyerane, kolo ŋwaane ba ya na vei Jerusalem se ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem to, ba nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo maama o na ke da to.
46Yezu laam ma jwoori o vo Galili teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Kana. Ko maa ye jei selo o ya na pɛ na bam ji sa-soŋo da to. O na yi da to, dedɛɛro wodwoŋi maa wora o na nwoŋi Kaparenia, ye o bu laam daare sɔŋɔ ne, o ba jege yazura. 47O na lɔre we Yezu nwoŋi Judea ne o ba Galili to, o ma vo o tei o lwoori‑o se o vo Kaparenia o yɔɔre o bu wom, o na lage o te to ŋwaane. 48Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Abam ná wo nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo na bere we Wɛ toŋe-ne to, abam bá fɔge á sɛ amo.” 49Dedɛɛro wom daa ma ta o we, “Amo tu, pa se dé vo lela ye amo bu wom daa ta wo tege.” 50Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Véi, se n bu wom daa bá te.”
Nɔɔno wom ma ke o wo-dedoa de Yezu na tage tei to, ye o zaŋe o viiri. 51O ta na wo chwoŋa ne o maa vei sɔŋɔ to mo o tontoŋena jeeri‑o, ye ba ta ba we, “N bu wom yera yam gara.” 52O ma bwei-ba o we, “Maŋa kɔ mo ko gare bu wom yera ne?” Ba ma ta ba we, “Ko ye diim, wea tetare ne mo, o paa kam yage‑o.” 53Ba na tage konto to, nɔɔno wom ma guli we ko ye maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔ mo Yezu tage o we, o bu wom daa bá te. O de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama laam ma ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ.
54Konto to, Yezu na nwoŋi Judea ne o jwoori o ba Galili ye o ke wo-kenkagele delo to mo ke kuni belei.

english_text:
Jesus Heals a Sick Man
1Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival. 2In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
3-4Many sick, blind, lame, and paralyzed people were lying close to the pool.
5Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for 38 years. 6When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
7The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
8Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!” 9Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
10 When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
11But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
12They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?” 13But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
14Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.” 15The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him. 16They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
17But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.” 18 Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God.
The Son's Authority
19Jesus told the people:
I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do. 20The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed. 21Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
22The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone. 23The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him. 24I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
25I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live! 26The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son. 27And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
28Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man, 29 and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
30I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself.
Witnesses to Jesus
31If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth. 32But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true. 33 You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth. 34I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved. 35 John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
36But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
37 The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face. 38You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
39 You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me, 40but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
41I don't care about human praise, 42but I do know that none of you love God. 43I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own. 44How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
45Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you. 46Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me. 47But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_text:
Yezu yɔɔre jaweeno siu dɛ ne
1Dɛ dedwe Yezu ma zaŋe o vo Jerusalem se o tɔge o di Juu tiina kuri dedwoŋi. 2Chɔgɔ kodwoŋi mo wora, ko na bwola de teo kom ni delo yere na ye ‘Pei Ni dem’ to. Ko yere de Juu tiina taane dem mo ye Bɛtezada. Ba déem tei pwei senu mo chɔgɔ kom ni ne. 3Jaweena dedɛ déem yeini ba tigi pwei sem kuri ne. Badaara ye lilwoa, de gwane, de gwaaro. [Ba tigi da ba cheiga se Wɛ maleka mo ba o pɔgele na bam. 4Na bam ná pɔgele konto dwoŋi, jaweeno wolo na wó lwoori yiga o tu na bam wone to wó na yazura de jaweo kolo maama na jege‑o to.]
5Nɔɔno wodwoŋi mo wora o na ye jaweeno nenɛɛne bena fintɔ-nana (38). 6Yezu ma na o na tigi da to, ye o maane we o weele ko dáane. O ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, “Nmo lage se n na yazura na?” 7Jaweeno wom ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo tu, chɔgɔ kom na bam ná yeini ba pɔgele konto dwoŋi, amo ba jege nɔɔno wolo na wó kwei-ne o ja tu na bam wone to. Amo ná yeini a kwaane se a tu, nɔɔno mo wó tu lela o daare amo.” 8Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Zaŋe wɛɛne se n kwei n sara kam n ta‑n via.” 9O na tage konto to, nɔɔno wom ma seene o na yazura bedwe baŋa ne, ye o kwei o sara kam o maa via.
Ko déem ye Juu tiina siu dɛ ne mo konto kea. 10Konto ŋwaane Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam ma ta de nɔɔno wom ba we, “Zem ye debam siu dɛ mo, ye ko chula se nɔɔno taa toŋe totoŋa. Konto ŋwaane, yé ta‑n zei n sara kam.” 11O ma leiri-ba o we, “Nɔɔno wolo na pɛ amo na yazura to mo tage we, a kwei a sara kam a taa via.” 12Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nɔɔno wom konto ye wɔ mo, ye o ta konto?” 13O maa yeiri wolo na pɛ o na yazura yam to, kolo ŋwaane Yezu zo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wo pa o daa wo nɛ‑o.
14Ko na ke fee to, Yezu ma vo Wɛ diga kam o na‑o da. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nii mo! Nmo laam nɛ yazura. Nam daa‑n yé ke wɛleere. Ko ná dae konto, wo-lɔŋɔ kolo na dwoi konto to daa wó ke nmo.” 15Nɔɔno wom laam ma vo o ta de Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam o we, ko ye Yezu ya mo yɔɔre omo.
Yezu jege dam
16Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam déem maa wora ba daane Yezu, o na yɔɔre jaweeno ba siu dɛ dem ne to ŋwaane. 17Yezu ma ta-ba o we, “Amo Kwo Wɛ yeini o ke kolo o boboŋa na lage to mo maŋa maama, ko woli de zem de. Amo de nam jege se a ke konto mo.”
18O na tage konto to, ko ma pa Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam tiini ba boŋe o gom. Ko nam dae we o na chɔge ba siu dɛ chullu tem yerane to ŋwaane, se ko ye o na tage we, Wɛ ye omo tete Kwo mo to. O keim dem konto ma pa se o de Wɛ ye bedwe mo.
19Yezu ma ta-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, amo na ye Wɛ Bu wom to, a bá wane a ke kolokolo a tete ne, se kolo yerane a na nae a Kwo tei ne to mo a yeini a ke. A Kwo na ke kolo to mo amo de wó ke. 20Kokuri Baŋa Wɛ swoi o Bu wom, ye o maa bere‑o kolo maama o tete na ke to. O nam wó bere‑o wo-kamunnu telo na dwoi tento to se o ke, pa se ko ke abam yaau. 21Baŋa Wɛ na bi nɔɔna toone wone ye o pa-ba ŋwea tei to, konto dwoŋi o Bu wom de wó pa balo o na lage to na ŋwea o Kwo Wɛ tei ne. 22Ko woli da, Baŋa Wɛ tete bá di nɔɔn-nɔɔno bora. O nam seene o pa o Bu wom chwoŋa se o taa di nɔɔna bora. 23Konto wó pa se nɔɔna maama zuli Wɛ Bu wom, ne ba na zuli o Kwo tete tei to. Wolo maama na ba zuli Wɛ Bu wom to ta ba zuli o Kwo na toŋe‑o to de.”
24Yezu ta ma ta o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, wolo maama na nigi amo taane ye o daare o ke o wo-dedoa de wolo na toŋe-ne to jege ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to. O daa bá to bora borem dɛ dem ne. O maŋe o jege ŋwea mo Wɛ tei ne, ye toone daa bá wane de ja‑o Wɛ yiga ne. 25Chega ŋwaane to, maŋa maa beena leile konto, ye balo na ba jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to wó ni amo kwora. Balo na sɛ-ka to wó daare ba na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam. 26Baŋa Wɛ tete na ye ŋwea tu to, o ma pa se amo wolo na ye o Bu wom to de ji ŋwea tu. 27O ma kwori o pa-ne chwoŋa se a taa bore nabiina bora, amo na ye Nabiin-bu wom to ŋwaane. 28Yé pa se ko ke abam yaau de amo na tage kolo to. Maŋa maa beena, ye twa balo maama na wo ba yibeela wone to wó ni amo kwora, 29ye ba zaŋe ba nwoŋi ba yibeela yam wone. Balo maama na ke lanyerane to wó bi ba taa ŋwe Wɛ tei ne. Ko daare balo maama na ke wo-lwanno to wó bi, ye ba laam na chɔgem Wɛ tei ne. 30Amo bá wane a ke kolokolo amo tete ne. Amo tɔge a Kwo ni mo a maa bore nɔɔna bora. Konto ŋwaane a borem dem yɔɔre de ye chega mo, kolo ŋwaane amo ba kwaane se a ke tei amo tete boboŋa na lage to. Baŋa Wɛ nam toŋe-ne, ye a ke kolo o na lage to mo.”
31Yezu ta ma ta de Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam o we, “Amo tete yerane ya ná bere a chega kam, ko bá bere we a taane dem seene de ye chega. 32Nɔɔno wodwoŋi nam zege amo chega kam kwaga ne, ye a yei we wonto jege chega de o na tɛ amo taane tei to. 33Abam ya toŋe nɔɔna Jɔn tei ne. O ma ta chega o bere-ba amo ŋwaane. 34Ko ná ye amo, a ya ba lage se nabiinu zaŋe o bere we a jege chega. Amo nam tage Jɔn taane abam ŋwaane mo, se ko wane ko woli abam se á na verem. 35Jɔn déem nye de kanea na jege mini ye ka pae pwooni tei to. Abam ma sɛ se á ta‑á tɔge o berem dem de wopwolo, ne nɔɔna na swoi mini pwooni tei to, ye á daa wo peene se á da-o.
36Amo nam jege woŋo kolo na wó bere we a jege chega to ye ko dwoi Jɔn na tage tei to. Totoŋa yam amo Kwo Wɛ na pɛ-ne se a toŋe a ti to, ko ye yanto mo a jege a ke, ye yanto mo pa-ne chega we, Wɛ mo seene o toŋe-ne. 37Ko woli da, amo Kwo Wɛ tete de zege amo chega kam kwaga ne mo. Abam nam wo fɔge á ni o kwora, naa á nɛ o yibia na nye tei to. 38Abam wo jwoŋi o taane dem á ke á bochara ne, kolo ŋwaane á wo sɛ wolo wom o na toŋe to. 39Abam yeini á kwaane á zamese Wɛ twanno tem, kolo ŋwaane á boŋe we á wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne tento ŋwaane mo. Ko nam ye amo yera taane mo twanno tem konto tete na tɛa. 40Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á ba amo tei, se ko pa á na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.
41Amo nam ba boŋe se nabiina pa amo zula. 42Ko ná ye abam, amo yei á wo. A yei we Wɛ swono tera á bochara ne. 43Amo nam jaane a Kwo yere mo a ba, ye abam nam ve se á jeeri-ne. Nɔɔno wolo nam ná jaane o tete yere o ba, á wó jeeri konto tu. 44Abam nam lage se á ta‑á jwoŋi zula mo da-tei ne, ye á ba lage se á ke kolo na wó pa á na zula Wɛ wolo na ba jege dwoŋi to tei ne. Konto mo á ve se á sɛ Wɛ.
45Ko dae we amo mo wó saŋe abam a Kwo Wɛ tei ne. Ko ye Moses mo lage o saŋe abam, ye abam ya boŋe we á wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne wonto ŋwaane mo. 46Abam ya ná seene á sɛ Moses na tage tei to, á ya wó sɛ amo de, kolo ŋwaane wonto popone amo yera taane mo. 47Abam nam maŋe á wo sɛ o na popone tei to. Konto to, abam bere á bá sɛ amo na tage kolo to.”

english_text:
Feeding Five Thousand
(Matthew 14.13-21; Mark 6.30-44; Luke 9.10-17)
1Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias. 2A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him. 3-4It was almost time for the Jewish festival of Passover, and Jesus went up on a mountain with his disciples and sat down.
5When Jesus saw the large crowd coming toward him, he asked Philip, “Where will we get enough food to feed all these people?” 6He said this to test Philip, since he already knew what he was going to do.
7Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
8Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said, 9“There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
10The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About 5,000 men were in the crowd. 11Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
12The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted. 13The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
14After the people had seen Jesus work this miracle, they began saying, “This must be the Prophet who is to come into the world!” 15Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone.
Jesus Walks on the Water
(Matthew 14.22-27; Mark 6.45-52)
16That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake. 17They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them, 18and a strong wind was making the water rough.
19When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified. 20But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!” 21The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed.
The Bread That Gives Life
22The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day 23some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks. 24They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus. 25They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
26Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted. 27 Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
28“What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
29Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
30They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do? 31 For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
32Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven. 33And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
34The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
35Jesus replied:
I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty. 36I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me. 37Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
38I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me, 39and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day. 40My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
41The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven. 42They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
43Jesus told them:
