9When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it. 10Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.” 11Simon Peter got back into the boat and dragged the net to shore. In it were 153 large fish, but still the net did not rip.
12Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord. 13Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish. 14This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death.
Jesus and Peter
15When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?”
Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!”
“Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
16Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?”
Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!”
“Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
17Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?”
Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.”
Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep. 18I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
19Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!”
Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
20 Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?” 21When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
22Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.” 23So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
24This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
25Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_text:
Yezu veere o tete de o kwaga tɔgena
1Konto kwaga ne Yezu déem daa ma jwoori o veere o tete de o tɔgena bam Tiberia naneo kom ni ne. O na ke tei to mo tento: 2Simon Piita déem wora, de Tomas wolo ba na bwoi we ‘Yeywɛ’ to. Natanayel de maa wora, o na nwoŋi Galili teo Kana to, dedaane Zebedi bia bam, de Yezu kwaga tɔgena badwonna balei. Banto bam maama maa wo daane. 3Simon Piita ma ta de o dwonna bam o we, o maa vei se o ja ywona mo. Ba ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Dé wó tɔge de nmo dé vo.” Ba ma zaŋe ba vo ba zo ba nabworo kom. Tete dem konto ne ba ma kwaane se ba ja ywona, ye ba wo nɛ kolokolo ba ja.
4Tega na wora ka poore to, Yezu maa zege naneo kom ni ne, ye ba wo lɔre‑o. 5O ma bwoŋi-ba o we, “A badwonna bam, abam wo jaane ywona na?” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Dé wo nɛ kolokolo.”
6O laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Nam de-na á bora kam nabworo kom jazem seeni, se á wó ja.” Ba ma seene ba ke konto, ye ba daa ware se ba vaŋe bora kam ba de nabworo kom wone, ywona yam na tiini ya daga to ŋwaane. 7Yezu kwaga tɔgeno wolo o na swoi to ma ta de Piita o we, “Debam Teiru wom mo.”
Simon Piita na lɔre we ko ye ba Teiru wom konto to, o ma kwei o gɔrɔ kolo o ya na le to o ma kwoli o tete. O ma faŋe o chu na bam wone. 8Kwaga tɔgena badaara bam ma ja nabworo kom ba ba ba yi na bam ni, ye ba vaŋe bora kam de ka ywona yam ba woli da. Ba ya dae yiga yiga de buburu kom, nenɛɛne naba-laara bi mo tei. 9Ba na bɛ bubɛ dem to, ba ma na min-chala na wora, ye ywona wo ya baŋa ne. Bworobworo de maa wora. 10Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Twori-na ywona yalo á na jaane leile to yadaara á ja á ba.”
11Simon Piita laam ma vo o zo nabworo kom wo o vaŋe bora kam o tuuri o de tega ne. Ka su de ywon-kamuna yerane mo, ya maama ye bi de finnu-yatɔ (153). De konto de, ya wo pɛ se bora kam kaare. 12Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Ba-na á saare á ni.” O kwaga tɔgena bam maama ma kɔre se ba bwei‑o ba nii wonto ye wɔ mo, kolo ŋwaane ba maŋe ba yei we ko ye ba Teiru wom mo. 13Yezu ma zaŋe o vo o kwei bworobworo kom o pa-ba, ye o daare o ke ywona yam de konto.
14Yezu na bi toone wone to, konto mo ke kuni betɔ o na veere o tete de o kwaga tɔgena bam to.
Yezu na ŋɔɔne de Piita tei to
15Ba na di ba ti to, Yezu laam ma ta de Simon Piita o we, “Jɔn bu Simon, nmo swoi amo n dwoi banto na?” O ma leiri o we, “Amo Teiru, ɛɛ, nmo yei we amo jege nmo swono.” Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nam ta‑n nii amo pipeili sem baŋa ne.”
16O ma jwoori o bwei Piita o ke belei o we, “Simon wolo na ye Jɔn bu to, nmo swoi amo na?” O ma leiri o we, “Amo Teiru, ɛɛ, nmo yei we amo jege nmo swono.” Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nam ta‑n nii amo pei sem baŋa ne.”
17O daa ma bwei Piita o ke kuni betɔ o we, “Simon wolo na ye Jɔn bu to, nmo jege amo swono na?” Piita wo ma chɔge de Yezu na bwei‑o o ke kuni betɔ o we, o jege o swono na to. O ma ta de Yezu o we, “Amo Teiru, nmo yei wonnu maama. Konto ŋwaane, nmo yei we amo jege nmo swono.” Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ta‑n nii amo pei sem baŋa ne. 18A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, nmo déem na ye nɔn-doŋo to, nmo yeini n vɔ n gwaaro n tete ne mo lanyerane, ye n daare n vei n na lage mɛ to. Ko daare nmo nam ná kwe, n laam wó zeiŋi n jea mo wɛɛne, ye nɔɔno wodwoŋi vɔ-te o pa‑m, ye o daare o ja‑m o vo nmo na ba lage mɛ se n vo to.” 19Yezu déem tage konto se ko bere Piita na wó te toone delo dwi se ko pa Wɛ na zula to mo. O laam ma daare o ta de Piita o we, “Ta‑n tɔge-ne.”
20Piita ma pipiri o kwaga ne o na Yezu kwaga tɔgeno wolo o na swoi to na tɔge-ba. Wonto mo ye wolo ya na jeini o sale Yezu wodiu kom dim maŋa ne ye o bwei‑o o we, “Amo Teiru, wɔ mo lage o yeigi nmo o pa?” to. 21Piita na nɛ‑o konto to, o ma bwei Yezu o we, “Amo Teiru, bɛ mo lage ko ke nɔɔno wonto?” 22Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo ná lage se nɔɔno wonto taa ŋwe se ko taa vei maŋa kam amo na wó jwoori a ba to, konto dae nmo yiga. Nmo za-n ta‑n tɔge-ne.”
23Konto ŋwaane mo pɛ se Yezu tɔgena bam déem jege taane ba ŋɔɔne we, Yezu kwaga tɔgeno wom konto bá te maŋa de maŋa. Yezu nam wo tage o we, o bá te. O nam ya tage o we, “Amo ná lage se o taa ŋwe se ko taa vei maŋa kam amo na wó jwoori a ba to, konto dae nmo yiga.”
24Yezu kwaga tɔgeno wolo o na tage o taane konto to mo ye amo wolo na bere Wɛ chega kam ye a daare a popone-ka a tiŋi to. Nɔɔna maama yei we amo na bere tei to seene ko ye chega mo.
25Yezu ta ke wonnu dedɛ o woli da. Te maama dedoa dedoa nam ya ná lage te popone te tiŋi, a boŋe we logo baŋa ya bá na jei se twanno tem konto peini da.

english_text:
1 Theophilus, I first wrote to you about all that Jesus did and taught from the very first 2until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
3For 40 days after Jesus had suffered and died, he proved in many ways that he had been raised from death. He appeared to his apostles and spoke to them about God's kingdom. 4 While he was still with them, he said:
Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do. 5 John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.
Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
6While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
7Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls. 8 But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.” 9 After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him, 10but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky.
Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them. 11They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.”
Someone To Take the Place of Judas
12-13 The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James.
After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
14The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers. 15One day there were about 120 of the Lord's followers meeting together, and Peter stood up to speak to them. 16-17He said:
My friends, long ago by the power of the Holy Spirit, David said something about Judas, and what he said has now happened. Judas was one of us and had worked with us, but he brought the mob to arrest Jesus. 18 Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out. 19When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
20 In the book of Psalms it says,
“Leave his house empty,
and don't let anyone
live there.”
It also says,
“Let someone else
have his job.”
21-22 So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
23Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias. 24Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen 25to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.” 26They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_text:
Yezu na ke kolo ye o laam jwoori Wɛ telaao to
Maake 16:19-20; Luka 24:49-53
1Amo badwoŋi Teofila, amo maŋe a da yiga a popone tɔnɔ a pa nmo. Tɔnɔ kom konto wone mo a popone wonnu telo maama Yezu déem na ke to, ye a kwori a popone o na yeini o bere nɔɔna tei to. 2Amo popone o na ke tei ko zege maŋa kalo o na bobo o totoŋa yam to se ko vo ko yi dɛ dem Wɛ na kwei‑o o ja di wɛyuu to. O ta na wo diini Wɛ telaao konto to, o ma tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao dam ŋwaane o ŋɔɔne de o totoŋa nakwa balo o na kuri to, ye o bere-ba o ni se ba taa tɔga. 3O toone dem kwaga ne o daa ma kwei o tete o bere o nɔɔna bam kuni dedɛ. O na ke tei konto to bere lanyerane we o seene o bi toone wone. Da finna mo o tontoŋena bam déem wane ba na‑o, ye o ŋɔɔne Wɛ paare dem taane o bere-ba.
4Dɛ dedwe Yezu na wora o bere-ba konto to, o ma kaane-ba o we, ba yé zaŋe ba nwoŋi Jerusalem wone. O maa we, “Cheigi-na se a Kwo Wɛ laam zeini abam, ne o na pwooli se o ke o pa abam ye amo maŋe a bere abam ko taane to. 5Jɔn déem yeini o kwei na mo o ma pa nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane. Ko laam daare da fenfee mo se Wɛ pa abam o Sin-laao kom se á ma á jwoŋi sɛɛm.”
6Yezu de o tontoŋena bam déem na gilimi daane konto to, ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Debam Teiru, nmo laam wó pa se debam Isarele tiina bam jwoori dé di paare logo baŋa ne leile konto mo na?” 7Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Ko dae se abam mo lɔre maŋa kalo wonnu tem na wó ke to. Amo Kwo Wɛ nam mɛ o tete dam mo o tiŋi da yam pa se woŋo maama ke ko maŋa ne. 8Wɛ Sin-laao kom nam wó ba abam baŋa pa se á jwoŋi dam Wɛ tei ne. Abam laam wó daare á zege amo chega kam kwaga ne á bere nɔɔna jei maama ne. Ko wó taa ye Jerusalem ne, ko woli de Judea de Samaria teene dem maama ne, de logo baŋa jei maama ne.”
9Yezu déem na ŋɔɔne konto de-ba o ti to, Wɛ ma kwei‑o o jege o diini wɛyuu ye ba zege ba nii‑o. Kunkwoŋo ma ba ko li‑o pa se ba daa ware ba na‑o. 10O na maa viiri konto to, ba daa ta ma kwoni ba yuni ba nii wɛɛne. Ba na wora ba nii konto to, nɔɔna balei ma pɔpɔ ba ba ba zege ba tei ne. Ba déem zo gare-pwonnu mo. 11Ba ma ta ba we, “Galili tiina bam, bɛ mo ye á zege ywoba á kwoni á nii wɛɛne? Abam na nɛ kolo to, ko ye Wɛ mo kwei Yezu o ja di telaao. Wonto tete nam wó seene o jwoori o ba konto dwoŋi, ne abam na nɛ o na maa viiri tei to.”
12Yezu tontoŋena bam laam ma zege peo kom ba na wo ko yuu ne to ba jwoori ba vo Jerusalem teo kom wo. Peo kom konto yere mo Olivi peo ye ko bwola dedaane teo kom nenɛɛne naba-laara moro. 13Ba ma vo ba zo teo kom ba kɛ ba vo sɔŋɔ kolo ba na zoore da to. Nɔɔna bam konto ye Piita, de Jɔn, de Jemsi, de Anduru, ko woli de Filipi de Tomas, dedaane Batoloma de Matiyu, ko woli de Jemsi wolo na ye Alafayu bu to, de Simon wolo na nwoŋi Zɛlota tigisim wone to, dedaane Judas wolo na ye Jemsi bu to. 14Maŋa maama banto déem yeini ba la daane de ni dedwe, ye ba ware Wɛ. Kaana badwonna dedaane Yezu nyaana de o nu Mary tɔge ba wora de-ba.
Ba kuri nɔɔno wodwoŋi se o leiri Judas yuu ne
15Dɛ dedwe balo maama na ye nu-bia Yezu ŋwaane to ma gilimi daane jeiga dedoa, ko maŋe de nɔɔna bi de finlei (120). Ba na wora konto to, Piita ma zaŋe ba wone o zege wɛɛne se o ŋɔɔne. 16O maa we, “Amo nu-bia bam, ko ná ye Judas wolo na bere Yezu dona bam chwoŋa se ba ja‑o to, Wɛ Sin-laao kom déem maŋe ko pa se Pɛ David ŋɔɔne wonto taane faŋa faŋa. Kolo na popone ko tiŋi Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne wonto ŋwaane to mo jege se ko ba ko ji chega. 17Judas déem tɔge o wo debam kɔgɔ kom wone mo, kolo ŋwaane Yezu tete kuri‑o se o taa tɔge o toŋe Wɛ totoŋa yam.”
18Judas na ke tei to, o déem kwei sabu kolo o na jwoŋi o keim-balɔrɔ kom baŋa ne to o ma yeigi tega. Ko ye dáane mo o vei o te. O déem to tega ne mo. O puga ma bage ye o loro pi te nwoŋi. 19Nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Jerusalem ne to ma ni kolo na ke‑o to, pa se ba bwoŋi tega kam konto we ‘Akɛladam’ de ba tete taane. Konto kuri mo ye ‘Jana tega’.
20Piita ta ma ta o we, “Ko nam popone Wɛ Seinim Lei tɔnɔ kom ne ko we:
‘Wɛ wó pa se wonto sɔŋɔ kom ji di-dwonnu,
pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa yé daare ko wone.’
Ko daa ta popone ko we:
‘Wɛ wó pa se nɔɔno wodwoŋi leiri wonto yuu ne
o taa toŋe o totoŋa yam.’
21Ko na ye konto to, ko maŋe se dé kuri nɔɔno dedoa se o woli debam Yezu tontoŋena bam wone. Konto tu nam jege se o taa ye wolo na tɔge o wo debam kɔgɔ kom wone maŋa maama dé Teiru Yezu déem na tɔge de debam o beeri to mo, 22ko zege maŋa kam Jɔn na bobo o pa nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane to se ko vo ko yi maŋa kam Yezu na yage debam tei o di Wɛ telaao to. Dé na lage dé kuri nɔɔno wolo to wó zege dé Teiru Yezu chega kam kwaga ne de o na bi toone wone tei to.”
23Piita na tage konto o ti to, ba ma le nɔɔna balei yera. Dedoa mo ye Josɛf wolo ba na bwoŋi we Basaba ye ba daa ta bwoi‑o we Jusitu to. Wodwoŋi wom maa ye Matias. 24Ba laam ma lwoori Wɛ ba we, “Dé Teiru Wɛ, nmo maŋe n yei nɔɔna maama bochara na ye tei to. Konto ŋwaane dé lwoori nmo tei ne se n bere debam nɔɔna banto balei wone nmo na kuri wolo 25se o ji nmo tontoŋeno to, se o taa toŋe totoŋa yalo Judas na kwei o yage ye o daare o vo o na maŋe se o vo mɛ to.”
26Ba na lwoori Wɛ ba ti to, ba ma ta jɔrɔ se ba kuri yera yam konto yalei wone. Ba na tage ba kuri wolo to mo ye Matias. Ba laam ma pa se o taa tɔge o ye Yezu totoŋa nakwe o woli ba kɔgɔ fuga-dedoa kam wone.

english_text:
The Coming of the Holy Spirit
1 On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place. 2Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting. 3Then they saw what looked like fiery tongues moving in all directions, and a tongue came and settled on each person there. 4The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
5Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem. 6And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages. 7They were excited and amazed, and said:
Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee? 8Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages? 9Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia, 10Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, parts of Libya near Cyrene, Rome, 11Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
12Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
13Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.”
Peter Speaks to the Crowd
14Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd:
Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say! 15You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning. 16But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
17 “When the last days come,
I will give my Spirit
to everyone.
Your sons and daughters
will prophesy.
Your young men
will see visions,
and your old men
will have dreams.
18In those days I will give
my Spirit to my servants,
both men and women,
and they will prophesy.
19“I will work miracles
in the sky above
and wonders
on the earth below.
There will be blood and fire
and clouds of smoke.
20The sun will turn dark,
and the moon
will be as red as blood
before the great
and wonderful day
of the Lord appears.
21Then the Lord
will save everyone
who asks for his help.”
22Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this. 23 God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross. 24 But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power. 25 What David said are really the words of Jesus,
“I always see the Lord
near me,
and I will not be afraid
with him at my right side.
26Because of this,
my heart will be glad,
my words will be joyful,
and I will live in hope.
27The Lord won't leave me
in the grave.
I am his holy one,
and he won't let
my body decay.
28He has shown me
the path to life,
and he makes me glad
by being near me.”
29My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here. 30 But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
31David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay. 32All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
33Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
34 David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side, 35until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.” 36Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
37When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
38Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. 39This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
40Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.” 41On that day about 3,000 believed his message and were baptized. 42They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together.
Life among the Lord's Followers
43Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked. 44 All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had. 45They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need. 46Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely, 47while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_text:
Wɛ Sin-laao kom tu ko zeini Yezu tontoŋena bam
1Dɛ dem Juu tiina bam na yeini ba di ba kuri delo yere na ye Pɛntekɔse to ma ba de yi. Yezu tontoŋena bam maama maa wo daane jeiga dedoa. 2Sɔɔ ma pɔpɔ ko nwoŋi wɛyuu ne nenɛɛne vo-dɛɔ na fuli tei to. Sɔŋɔ kom ba na jei ko wone to ni maama ma su de sɔɔ kom konto. 3Ba ma na wonnu ne min-vɔɛ mo tei, ye te pwɛ te jeini ba dedoa dedoa yuu ne. 4Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma ba ba maama tei ne de dam, ye ba bobo se ba taa ŋɔɔne taana dwi dwi, nenɛɛne Sin-laao kom na pɛ-ba dam se ba ŋɔɔne taane delo to.
5Kanto maŋa kam ne Juu tiina dedɛ déem tu ba wo Jerusalem teo kom ne. Ba maa ye balo na kɔre Wɛ lanyerane ye ba nwoŋi jei maama logo baŋa ne. 6Balo na wora to déem ma ni sɔɔ kom na ke tei to, ye kɔgɔ dedɛ laam ba ko la daane jeiga kam ne. Ba ma nii ba na Yezu nɔɔna bam na zega ba ŋɔɔne taana dwi dwi, ye kɔgɔ kom nɔɔno maama ni o tete taane. Ba maama maa yeiri kolo na ke to. 7Ba yera ma sɔɔre ye ba ye yaau. Ba maa tɛ ba we, “Nii-na. Banto maama ye Galili tiina mo ye ba zege ba ŋɔɔne tento dwoŋi. 8Ko nam ke tɛ mo ye debam maama ni ba na ŋɔɔne debam dedoa dedoa dwi taane? 9Dé nwoŋi jei dwi dwi mo. Debam badwonna nwoŋi Patia, de Media, de Elam, ko woli de Mesopotamia, de Judea, de Kapadokia, dedaane Pontusi, de Asia teene dem maama. 10Dé badwonna ta nwoŋi Firijia, de Panfilia, de Ejipti, de Libia teene delo na bwola de Kurene to. Dé badwonna maa nwoŋi Rom. 11Debam ye Juu tiina mo, ko woli de dwi-gɛ tiina balo laam na sɛ Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to. Debam badwonna maa nwoŋi Kiriti, de Arabia. De konto de, debam maama nam ta ni ba na mae debam dedoa dedoa taane ba ŋɔɔne wo-kamunnu telo Wɛ na ke to.” 12Nɔɔna bam na ye yaau ye ba boboŋa vugimi konto to, ba maa bwei daane ba we, “Keim dento kuri mo bɛ?”
13Ba badaara nam maa jege Yezu tontoŋena bam ba mɔna ye ba tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔna banto nyɔge sana mo ba su.”
14Piita laam ma zaŋe wɛɛne dedaane o dwonna fuga-dedoa bam. O ma ŋɔɔne de kwor-dɛa o ta de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom o we:
“Amo badwonna bam, Juu tiina de abam balo maama na zoore Jerusalem ne to, cheigi-na se a ta keim dento kuri a bere abam. 15Abam na boŋe we nɔɔna banto nyɔge sana mo ba su to, ko nam dae konto. Ko daa ta ye tetete mo. Wea ta wo bege se ba nyɔ sana. 16Ko nam ye kolo Wɛ sampwora Joweli déem na ŋɔɔne ko taane to mo. 17O déem tɔɔle Wɛ kwora o we:
‘Logo baŋa kweelim da yam ná yia,
amo Wɛ wó lwo a Jworo mo nabiina maama baŋa ne.
Konto nam wó pa se á bia de á bukwa taa pworisi amo kwora kam,
se abam nɔn-donno na wo-kenkagela yalo a na wó veere a bere-ba to,
ko daare se á nɔn-kwe de dwɛ dendwa amo ŋwaane.
18Chega to, da yam konto ne
a lage a lwo a Jworo mo a tontoŋena baŋa ne, baara de kaana de,
pa se ba pworisi amo kwora kam.
19Amo ta wó pa se wo-kenkagela taa nae wɛyuu ne,
ye a daare a ke maana tega baŋa ne.
Kanto maŋa kam ne jana wó taa wora, de mini,
de nyoa kalo na tiini ka zwora to.
20Wea kam wó ba ka vaŋe ka ji lim,
ye chana kam de ji nasoŋo ne jana tei.
Ko laam daare se Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom ba ko yi,
se o nenɔŋa kam de bere jaja.
21Dɛ dem konto ne, wolo maama na wó bwoŋi dé Teiru Wɛ wom yere
o ma lwoori zeinim to wó na verem.’
22A badwonna Isarele tiina bam, cheigi-ne. A lage a ta Nazarete tu Yezu taane. Wɛ tɔge wonto baŋa ne mo o ke wo-kamunnu, de wo-kenkagela, de maana se ko bere abam we o seene o nwoŋi Wɛ tei. Abam tete nam maŋe á yei konto, kolo ŋwaane wonnu tem konto maŋe te ke abam tei ne. 23Wɛ maŋe o yei ko na wó taa ye tei to. O boboŋa déem ya maŋe ya ja pa se ba ja Yezu ba ke abam jeŋa ne. Abam ma daare á tɔge nɔn-balwaaro jeŋa mo á pa se ba ja‑o ba pa dagara yuu ne. Konto mo á mɛ á go‑o. 24Wɛ nam mo bi‑o toone wone. Toone déem wo wane de cheiŋi‑o de yage yibeeli dem wone. Mo kokuri Wɛ jwoŋi‑o toone yaara yam wone o yage.
25Faŋa faŋa to Pɛ David tage Wɛ Bu wom taane o we:
‘Amo nɛ a Teiru Wɛ a tei ne maŋa maama.
O maa wo a jazem seeni mo se o zeini-ne se a zege cheppe.
26Mo kokuri a jege wopwolo lanyerane,
ye amo ni taane dem de jege ywoni.
Amo ye nabiinu mo ye a nam jege teena Wɛ tei ne.
27Kolo ŋwaane amo ná tega,
nmo Wɛ bá‑n yage-ne se a taa wo churu ne.
Nmo bá‑n sɛ se n tete Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom yera pɔ.
28Nmo pɛ se a lɔre chwei selo na pae ŋwea to se a taa tɔge-se.
Amo ná yi nmo tei, nmo wó pa se a na ywoni dedɛ.’
29A nu-bia bam, mo kolo debam nabaaro David déem na tage to. Amo nam lage a ŋɔɔne wonto taane mo jaja a bere abam we o tega. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli, ye o yibeeli ta wora de zem maama. 30O déem nam ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu mo. Wɛ déem dugi duuri o pa‑o we, omo wó pa se o dwi tiina bam dedoa zaŋe o di paare o jeiŋa kam jei ne. David ma guli Wɛ na gwoni o ni ded‑o konto to. 31O ma wuuri o lɔre kolo Wɛ na wó ke to. Konto ŋwaane mo o tage o we, ‘Wɛ wo sɛ se o yage‑o churu ne. O yera yam de nam wo pɔge.’ O na tage konto to, ko ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista toone biim taane mo o taga. 32Chega to, Wɛ mo bi Yezu wom tete, ye debam maama zege chega kam konto kwaga ne. 33Wɛ na bi‑o konto to, o ma daare o pa se o vo o jeini o jazem seeni. Yezu laam ma jwoŋi Sin-laao kom o Kwo Wɛ tei ne, ne Wɛ na pwooli se o pa‑o tei to. Abam zem nam na nae wonnu telo ye á kwori á ni telo to ye Yezu mo pɛ te ke. 34Ko dae David tete mo Wɛ kwei o ja di telaao. Wonto nam tage o we:
‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tage de amo Teiru o we:
Ba n jeini amo jazem seeni
35se a laam wane nmo dona maama
a ke nmo dam kuri ne se n ta‑n tei-ba.’
36Tɔ. Isarele dwi tiina maama nam jege se ba taa yei lanyerane we, ko ná ye Yezu wom abam na jaane á pa dagara yuu ne á go to, ko ye wonto tete mo Wɛ laam pɛ se o taa ye Dam Tu Krista wom ye o kwori o ye debam Teiru.”
37Nɔɔna bam na nigi Piita na tage kolo konto to, ko ma tiini ko chɔge ba wo dedɛ. Ba ma bwei Piita de o dwonna totoŋa nakwa bam ba we, “Dé nu-bia bam, dé nam wó ke tɛ mo?” 38Piita ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam maama jege se á leiri á wo de á keim-balwaaro tem, se á daare á jwoŋi sɛɛm Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane, se Wɛ wó yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam. Wɛ laam wó pa se o Sin-laao kom taa wo abam tei ne. 39Mo Wɛ na pwooli se o ke tei to, ye o tiŋi o ni dem konto o pa abam de á bia, ko woli de balo maama ta na ba ŋwae to. Ko maa ye balo maama debam Teiru Baŋa Wɛ na bwoŋi se ba taa tɔge‑o to mo.”
40Piita ta ma jwoori o fɔge o ma taane dedɛ o kaane-ba o we, ba kwaane ba jwoŋi ba tete zem nɔɔna bam wone de ba na tusi tei to. 41Nɔɔna bam dedɛ ma sɛ o taane dem, ye ba daare ba jwoŋi sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane. Dɛ dem konto ne nɔɔna dedɛ mo tu ba woli Yezu tɔgena kɔgɔ kom wone, ko maŋe de nɔɔna morro tetɔ (3,000). 42Ba ma tiini ba seene ba yia ba pa Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam bera yam. Ba maama maa woli daane de ni-sɛɛm dedoa, ye ba kwori ba tɔge daane ba di wodiu ne Yezu ya na fɔge bworobworo o pa o kwaga tɔgena bam pa ba di tei to. Ba ma kwori ba tɔge daane ba ware Wɛ maŋa maama.
43Nɔɔna maama déem maa kɔre Wɛ lanyerane. Wɛ ma pa Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam dam se ba taa ke wo-kenkagela de maana dedɛ. 44Yezu tɔgena bam maama maa yeini ba la daane ye ba kwori ba jege ba wonnu ba maŋe ba pa daane. 45Ba maa yeini ba kwei ba jejegero de ba zela ba yeiga, ye ba maŋe te sabu kom ba ma woli nɔɔno maama ne ba dedoa dedoa na lage tei to. 46Dɛ maama ba maa yeini ba tigisi daane Wɛ diga kam wone. Ba ta ma kwori ba tɔge daane ba di wodiu ba sam ne ko maŋe de Yezu ya na bere o kwaga tɔgena bam tei to. Ba maa maŋe ba wodiiru ba pa daane, ye ba jege wopwolo lanyerane dedaane boboŋe dedwe. 47Ba maa tei Wɛ maŋa maama. Nɔɔna maama maa pae ba ye nɔn-ŋona. Dɛ maama wuu dé Teiru wom maa pae se balo na tu ba na verem to woli ba kɔgɔ kom wone.

english_text:
Peter and John Heal a Lame Man
1The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple. 2A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
3The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money. 4But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
5The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something. 6But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.” 7Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up.
At once the man's feet and ankles became strong, 8and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God. 9Everyone saw him walking around and praising God. 10They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man.
Peter Speaks in the Temple
11While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch. 12Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said:
Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious? 13 The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
14 You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free, 15and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done. 16You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
17My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing. 18But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise. 19So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven. 20Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah. 21But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
22 Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you. 23 No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
24Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening. 25 You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.” 26God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_text:
Gɔrɔ kodwoŋi nɛ yazura Yezu ŋwaane
1Dɛ dedwe mo Piita de Jɔn déem zaŋe ba vo Wɛ diga kam maŋa kalo nɔɔna na yeini ba ware Wɛ to. Wɛ-guni maŋa ne mo konto. 2Ba ma vo ba yi wara-jei sem ni dem ba na bwoi we ‘Ni-laao’ to. Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem tigi da o na maŋe o ye gɔrɔ o biini ne to. Nɔɔna maa yeini ba zeiŋi‑o ba vo ba jeini da dɛ maama se o taa lwoori sabia nɔɔna balo na tɔge da ba zo diga kam to tei ne. 3Nɔɔno wom ma na Piita de Jɔn na maa zoora. O ma lwoori-ba se ba pa‑o woŋo. 4Ba ma yɔɔre ba nii‑o. Piita laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nii debam seeni!” 5O ma seene o nii-ba ye o jege teena se ba pa‑o woŋo. 6Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo ba jege sabia se a pa‑m. A nam wó pa nmo a na jege wolim delo to. A tɛ nmo Nazarete tu Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane, zaŋe n ta n via.”
7Piita na tage konto o ti to, o laam ma ja o jazem o woli‑o pa se o zaŋe wɛɛne. O na zaŋe konto bedwe baŋa ne to mo o nɛ sem de o nakwollu tem maama ke dam lanyerane. 8Nɔɔno wom ma faŋe wɛɛne o jwoori o ba o chu o nɛ baŋa ne ye o bobo se o taa via. O ma tɔge-ba o zo Wɛ diga kam wo. O maa via ye o faŋa wɛɛne ye o tei Wɛ. 9Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ma na o na vei ye o zuli Wɛ. 10Ba ma lɔre we nɔɔno wom konto mo ye lwoonu wolo ya na jei wara-jei sem Ni-laao kom ne to. Ba na lɔre‑o to, ko ma tiini ko kagele-ba ye ba yeiri kolo na ke‑o to.
11Nɔɔno wom ma yɔɔre o meeli Piita de Jɔn. Nɔɔna bam maama maa ye yaau. Ba ma zaŋe ba duri ba vo ba tei, konkɔlɔ kom na jege napɔrɔ mɛ to, ko yere mo Solomon napɔrɔ kom. 12Piita na nɛ nɔɔna bam konto to, o ma ta de-ba o we:
“A badwonna Isarele tiina bam, bɛŋwaane mo abam ye yaau de kolo na ke to? Bɛ mo ye abam yɔɔre á nii debam konto? Abam boŋe we ko ye debam dam mo pɛ o zaŋe o vei na? Á boŋe we ko ye debam na kɔre Wɛ lanyerane to ŋwaane mo na? 13Ko nam na ye tei to, Abaraham Wɛ wom, de Izaak de Jakob Wɛ wom na ye dé nabaara maama Wɛ to laam mo pɛ se o tontoŋeno Yezu jwoŋi paare. Abam jaane wonto mo á pa ba go‑o. Pilata déem boŋe se o yage‑o ye abam nam wo sɛ. 14Yezu Krista ye Wo-pwoŋo Tu mo de Chega Tu. Abam nam ve‑o, ye á daare á lwoori Pilata se o le nɔn-goro mo o yage o pa abam. 15Abam na ke tei to, á go wolo na ye ŋwea tu to mo. Wɛ ma daare o bi‑o toone wone, ye debam zege chega kam konto kwaga ne. 16Ko ye Yezu yere dem ŋwaane mo pɛ gɔrɔ kom na dam o yera ne. Dé na ke dé wo-dedoa de Yezu to mo pɛ ko ke ne á na nɛ tei, ye á maŋe á yei nɔɔno wom to. Ko ye wo-dedoa kalo na tɔge Yezu ŋwaane to mo pɛ o laam na yazura chekke abam maama yiga ne.
17Amo nu-bia bam, abam de á yiga tiina bam na ke Yezu tei to, amo yei we abam ya yeiri woŋo kolo á na ke to. 18Faŋa faŋa to Wɛ déem pɛ o sampwori sem maama tɔɔle o kwora se bere nɔɔna we o Dam Tu Krista jege se o yaare mo. Abam na ke‑o tei to mo pɛ se Wɛ taane dem seene de ji chega. 19Konto ŋwaane nam leiri-na á wo se á daare á pipiri á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ, se Wɛ wó yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam. 20Konto to, dé Teiru Wɛ wó wane o pa se abam bochara taa zura maŋa de maŋa, ye o laam daare o toŋe o Dam Tu Krista wom, o na maŋe o tiŋi‑o o pa abam to. Yezu mo konto. 21O jege se o taa wo telaao ne se ko taa vei maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó fɔge o kwɛ wonnu maama to, ne o na maŋe o pa o sampwori sem tɔɔle o kwora faŋa faŋa tei to. 22Ko ye nenɛɛne Moses déem na tage o we, ‘Abam Teiru Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se abam dwi tu dedoa mo zaŋe o taa ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu o pa abam, ne o na toŋe amo Moses tei to. Wonto nam ná tua, abam jege se á sɛ taane delo maama o na wó ta o bere abam to. 23Wolo maama nam ná wo sɛ kolo Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu wom na wó bere to, ba jege se ba le kotu mo Wɛ nɔɔna bam wone ba yage pa se o dwi ti.’
24Mo kolo Moses déem na tage to. Ko ná ye Samuwel de balo maama na saŋe o kwaga to, Wɛ sampwori sem maama de déem tɔɔle konto dwoŋi mo. Balo maama na jege Wɛ kwora ba tɔɔle to déem bere kolo na wó ke zem da yanto wone to mo. 25Wɛ kwora kam o déem na pɛ o sampwori sem se ba tɔɔle to ye abam nyem mo. Wɛ ni dem o déem na gwoni o pa dé nabaara bam to de daa ta ye abam nyem. O déem gwoni ni de Abaraham o we, ‘Ko wó tɔge nmo dwi tiina ŋwaane mo pa amo swɛ logo baŋa dwi maama swolim.’ 26Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ na pɛ o tontoŋeno wom zaŋe o ba to, o bobo o toŋe‑o abam tei ne mo se o ke abam zaane de o na wae o pa se abam dedoa dedoa yage o keim-lwanno tem to.”

english_text:
Peter and John Are Brought in Front of the Council
1The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived. 2These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death. 3It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night. 4But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about 5,000 followers of the Lord.
5The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem. 6The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family. 7They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
8Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
9You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed. 10But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life. 11 He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all. 12Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
13The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus. 14But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
15The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other, 16“What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen. 17But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.” 18So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
19Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him? 20We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
21-22The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than 40 years old, and everyone was praising God for what had happened.
Peter and Others Pray for Courage
23As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them. 24 When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said:
Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. 25 And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say:
“Why are all the Gentiles
so furious?
Why do people
make foolish plans?
26The kings of earth
prepare for war,
and the rulers
join together
against the Lord
and his Messiah.”
27 Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah. 28They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
29Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message. 30Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
31After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message.
Sharing Possessions
32 The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other. 33In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers, 34and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money 35to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
36-37Joseph was one of the followers who had sold a piece of property and brought the money to the apostles. He was a Levite from Cyprus, and the apostles called him Barnabas, which means “one who encourages others.”
translation_text:
Ba jaane Piita de Jɔn
1Piita de Jɔn déem na wora ba ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi ba bere nɔɔna bam to, Juu tiina badwonna ma zaŋe ba ba ba tei. Banto mo ye Juu tiina kaanem tiina, dedaane Wɛ diga kam soja tiina dedɛɛro wom, de Saduka tiina badwonna. 2Ba bane tiini de zaŋe de Yezu nɔɔna bam de ba na bere tei ba we, Yezu bi toone wone ye konto bere we twa wó jwoori ba bi ba taa ŋwe. 3Ba ma ja Piita de Jɔn ba ke peena diga ne. Tega na maŋe ka yi to, ba ma yage-ba da se tega poore. 4Ko daare kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna dedɛ ma sɛ taane delo ba na nigi to. Balo na sɛ to kɔgɔ kom déem ma ba ko yi nenɛɛne nɔɔna morro tenu (5,000).
5Tega na poore to, Juu tiina yiga tiina bam, de ba nakwa bam, de ba zamesem tiina bam ma la daane Jerusalem ne. 6Ba ma jeeri dedaane Anas wolo na ye ba kaanem yuu tu wom to, de Kayafa, de Jɔn, de Alezanda, de baara balo na tɔge ba ye kaanem yuu tu wom sɔŋɔ tiina to. 7Ba ma pa se Piita de Jɔn ba ba zege ba yiga ne. Ba ma bwei-ba ba we, “Abam ke tɛ mo á wae á ke konto? Bɛ ŋo dam mo á jege á ma á ke? Wɔ yere ŋwaane mo á ma á ke?”
8Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam ma ba Piita tei de dam. O ma leiri-ba o we, “Dé teo kom yiga tiina de nakwa bam, cheigi-na! 9Abam zem na bwei debam kolo taane to, ko ná ye debam na zeini gɔrɔ kom pa se o na yazura tei to, 10dé wó pa se abam de Isarele dwi tiina bam maama lɔre ko na ke tei. Ta‑á yei-na we Nazarete tu Yezu Krista yere dem ŋwaane mo pɛ se nɔɔno wonto yɔɔre o na yazura ye o laam ba o zege abam yiga ne. Abam nam page Yezu Krista dagara yuu ne á go, ye Wɛ nam bi‑o toone wone. 11Wonto mo ye wolo Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na maŋe ko ta o taane we:
‘Kandwɛ delo abam lɔra bam na ve to
laam mo jwoori de ba de ji
kandwɛ delo na pae diga kam dana to mo.’
12Yezu Krista yerane mo wae o jwoŋi nɔɔna o yaga. Nɔɔno wodwoŋi yere daa tera logo baŋa ne Wɛ na pɛ nabiina se dé wane dé na verem o ŋwaane.”
13Juu tiina nakwa bam na nɛ Piita de Jɔn na jege baare de ba na ŋɔɔne tei to, ko ma ke-ba yaau de ba na ye nɔn-yɔɔro ye ba dae tɔn-yeena to ŋwaane. Ba ma jeeli we banto ya me de Yezu mo. 14Ba na nɛ gɔrɔ kom na zege Piita de Jɔn tei ne ye o jege yazura to, ba maa ware kolokolo se ba daa ta. 15Ba ma ta-ba we, ba nwoŋi ba kɔgɔ kom ne se ba daare. Ba laam maa wora ba bane daane se ba nii. 16Ba ma bwei daane ba we, “Dé nam wó ke nɔɔna bam konto tɛ mo? Nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Jerusalem ne to lɔre we banto mo ke wo-kenkagele dem konto. Dé daa bá wane dé ta we, vwa. 17Dé nam na lage se keim dento yé jage de vo yiga to, dé jege se dé kaane nɔɔna bam mo se ba daa yé ŋɔɔne de nɔɔn-nɔɔno Yezu yere ŋwaane.”
18Ba laam ma jwoori ba bwoŋi-ba, ye ba zo. Ba ma ta-ba we, ba ba jege chwoŋa se ba daa tɔge Yezu yere ŋwaane ba ŋɔɔna, naa se ba taa bere nɔɔna konto dwoŋi. 19Piita de Jɔn ma leiri-ba ba we, “Ko maŋe se dé sɛ abam mo naa Wɛ mo? Kɔ mo lana Wɛ yiga ne? Abam tete boŋe-na á nii. 20Debam nam bá wane dé yage kolo dé na nɛ ye dé kwori dé ni to ŋɔŋa.”
21Juu tiina nakwa bam laam ma fɔge ba kaane-ba dedɛ ye ba daare ba yage-ba pa ba viiri. Ba déem wo nɛ kolo kom ba na wó vaŋe ba zwa ko baŋa ne to, kolo ŋwaane teo kom nɔɔna maama tiini ba tei Wɛ de woŋo kolo na ke to. 22Kokuri nɔɔno wolo wo-kenkagele dem na ke o baŋa ne ye o na yazura to dwoi bena finna.
Yezu tɔgena tiini ba lwoori Wɛ
23Ba maa na yage Piita de Jɔn konto to, ba ma jwoori ba vo ba kɔgɔ kom tei. Ba ma ta de-ba Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba teo kom nakwa bam na tage kolo to. 24Ba na nigi konto to, ba maama ma woli daane ba ware Wɛ ye ba we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ke wɛyuu, de tega baŋa, de naneo, de wonnu telo maama na zoore te wone to. 25Dé nabaaro David déem mo ye nmo tontoŋeno. Nmo déem ma pa se n Sin-laao kom tɔge David ŋwaane ye o ta nmo kwora o we:
‘Bɛ mo ye logo baŋa dwi-gɛ tiina bam bane zaŋe?
Bɛ mo ye ba ke daane ba boŋe boboŋa kafɛ ŋwaane?
26Ba pwa bam de ba dedɛɛra bam ma la daane
se ba ke chichuŋu dedaane Baŋa Wɛ
de o Dam Tu Krista wom.’
27Ko seene ko ke konto mo. Teo konto ne mo Herodi de Pontusi Pilata jeini daane de Isarele dwi tiina, de dwi-gɛ tiina, se ba ŋɔɔne Yezu taane ba ma chɔge‑o, ye wonto ye n tontoŋeno-laao nmo na tiŋi‑o se o ba to. 28Ba na bane daane konto to, ba nam jege se ba ke kolo maama na maŋe ko wo n boboŋa ne ye n dam na wó pa se ko ke to. 29Dé Teiru Wɛ, nii ba na lage ba yaare debam tei to! Debam nam mo ye n tontoŋena. Nam pa debam chwoŋa se dé wane dé taa ŋɔɔne nmo kwora kam de baare. 30Nam twe n je-dɛa kam se n pa nɔɔna taa nae yazura, ye n pa se wo-kenkagela de maana taa ke nmo tontoŋeno-laao Yezu yere ŋwaane.”
31Ba na ware Wɛ ba ti to, jeiga kam ba na lage daane mɛ to maa ziziŋa. Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam ma ba ba maama tei de dam, ye ba ŋɔɔne Wɛ kwora kam de baare.
32Yezu tɔgena bam kɔgɔ kom maama boboŋa de ba ŋwea maama déem ye bedwe mo. Ba wolowolo wo tage we, o yerane mo tei o wonnu. Ba maama maŋe wonnu telo ba na jege to mo ba pa daane. 33Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam maa jege dam-fɔrɔ, ye ba fɔge ba bere dé Teiru Yezu chega kam we o seene o bi toone wone. Wɛ ma zeini ba maama de o zaane dem lanyerane. 34Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera ba kɔgɔ kom wone o na ye yiniga tu. Balo na jege kare naa di to wó yeigi-se mo, 35ye ba daare ba kwei sabu kom ba ja ba ba ke Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam jeŋa ne. Ba laam ma maŋe sabu kom ba pa nɔɔno wolo maama ne o na lage tei to.
36Ko na ye konto to, Levi tu wodwoŋi na nwoŋi Kupirus to, o yere mo Josef, déem ma zaŋe o yeigi o kara. Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam déem maa bwoi‑o we Banabas, ko kuri mo kwogilim tu. 37O ma yeigi o kara o kwei ka sabu kom o ke Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam jeŋa ne.

english_text:
Peter Condemns Ananias and Sapphira
1Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property. 2But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves.
So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles, 3Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit? 4The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
5 As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened. 6Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
7Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband. 8Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?”
“Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
9Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!” 10At once she fell at Peter's feet and died.
When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband. 11The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened.
Peter's Unusual Power
12The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch. 13No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
14Many men and women started having faith in the Lord. 15Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them. 16A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed.
Trouble for the Apostles
17The high priest and all the other Sadducees who were with him became jealous. 18They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail. 19But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said, 20“Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.” 21So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching.
The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail. 22The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said, 23“We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.” 24The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
25Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!” 26The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
27When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them, 28 “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
29Peter and the apostles replied:
We don't obey people. We obey God. 30You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life 31and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven. 32We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
33When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles. 34But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while. 35Then he said to the council:
Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men. 36Not long ago Theudas claimed to be someone important, and about 400 men joined him. But he was killed, and all his followers were scattered. That was the end of that.
37Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
38So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail. 39 But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God.
The council members agreed with what he said, 40and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
41The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus. 42Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_text:
Anania de Safira taane
1Ko daare nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora, o yere mo Anania. O kaane de yere mo Safira. O ma kwei ba wonnu tedwonna o yeigi, 2ye o daare o twori sabu kom wone se o taa jega. O kaane wom maa yei o na ke tei to. Anania ma kwei o na twori o daare kolo to o ke Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam jeŋa ne. 3O na ke konto to, Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Anania, bɛ mo ke ye nmo pa se setaana pɛ wae n bochare konto dwoŋi, pa se n fɔ vwa de Wɛ Sin-laao kom de nmo na twori kara kam sabu kom wone n pa n tete to? 4Maŋa kam nmo ta na wo yeigi kara kam to, ko ya ye nmo nyem mo. Nmo nam na kwei n yeigi to, sabu kom ta ye nmo nyem. Bɛŋwaane mo n boŋe n bochare ne we nmo wó ke keim dem konto? Nmo na fɔge vwa konto to, n ke n chɔge Wɛ yiga mo, se ko dae nabiina yerane.” 5Anania na nigi konto to, o ma to tega ne o te. Ko déem ma pa se foone ja balo maama na lɔre ko ni ne to. 6Nɔn-donno na wora to ma zaŋe ba vo ba pipiri too wom, ye ba daare ba kwei‑o ba ja nwoŋi ba suli.
7Ko na ke fenfee nenɛɛne awa batɔ to, o kaane wom de daa ma ba o zo Piita ba tei. O daa ta ma wo lɔre kolo na ke to. 8Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ta n bere-ne, mo sabu kolo nmo de n baro wom na jwoŋi á kara kam ŋwaane to na?” O ma sɛ ye o we, “Ɛɛ, ko maama mo tento.”
9Piita laam ma bwei‑o o we, “Bɛŋwaane mo nmo de n baro wom boŋe se á maŋe Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ Sin-laao kom á nii? Leile konto, nɔɔna balo ya na kwei n baro wom ba suli to ta zege diga kam ni ne. Ba nam wó zeŋe nmo de ba ja nwoŋi.” 10O na tage konto o ti to bedwe baŋa ne mo kaane wom to tega ne Piita yiga ne ye o te. Nɔn-donno tem ma ba te nii de o tega. Ba ma kwei‑o ba ja nwoŋi ba suli o baro wom saŋa ne.
11Foone déem ma ja Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna bam de balo maama de na nigi kolo na ke to.
12Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam déem ma pa se maana de wo-kenkagela dedɛ ke nɔɔna tetare ne. Yezu nɔɔna bam maama déem yeini ba tigisi daane de ni dedwe Solomon napɔrɔ kom ne. 13Balo yiga na tere ba kɔgɔ kom wone to nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo sɛ o tɔge o woli ba wone. Ko daare teo kom nɔɔna bam maama maa pae se Yezu nɔɔna bam ye nɔn-ŋona. 14Nɔɔna dedɛ déem tu ba sɛ dé Teiru Yezu, baara de kaana maama. Ba ma tɔge ba woli o kɔgɔ kom wone. 15Yezu nɔɔna bam na ye konto to, nɔɔna maa zeŋe jaweena ba nwoŋi ba tiŋi chwei sem nia ne. Ba déem tiŋi-ba sare de gungwollu baŋa ne se Piita ná maa tɔge da o kɛa, se o lunluŋu yerane wane ko tɔge ba badwonna baŋa. 16Nɔɔna dedɛ maa yeini ba nwoŋi Jerusalem nawuura yam maama wone ba jaane jaweena de balo chichiri na daane-ba to ba tui, pa ko gare ba maama yera ne.
Ba jege Yezu tontoŋena bam ba yaara
17Juu tiina kaanem yuu tu wom de o nɔɔna bam maama déem ma na kolo na ke to. Banto déem tɔge ba ye Saduka tiina kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna mo. Ba maa tiini ba jege wo-goo de Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam. 18Ba laam ma zaŋe ba ja-ba ba vo ba ke peena diga kalo ba na pe ŋweena da to. 19Tega na yi to, Baŋa Wɛ maleka ma ba ka pore peena diga kam nia yam, pa se Yezu tontoŋena bam nwoŋi pwooni. Ka ma ta de-ba ka we, 20ba véi ba zo Wɛ diga kam se ba taa bere nɔɔna bam Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam taane chekke. 21Ba ma seene ba sɛ Wɛ maleka kam ni. Tega na poore tetete to, ba ma vo ba zo Wɛ diga kam ba wora ba bere nɔɔna bam.
Kaanem yuu tu wom de o nɔɔna bam laam ma bwoŋi Juu tiina nakwa bam maama pa se ba tigisi daane. Ba ma daare ba toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo ba le Yezu tontoŋena bam peena diga kam ne ba ja ba ba pa-ba. 22Ba nɔɔna bam na yi da to mo ba wo nɛ Yezu tontoŋena bam. Ba ma jwoori ba vo Juu tiina nakwa bam tei ye ba we, 23“Dé na yi da to, peena diga kam nia mo pe de dam. Nɔɔna balo na wora ba nii jei sem se nɔɔna yé lu to maa zege da. Dé nam na pore diga kam to, dé wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno ka wone.”
24Kaanem yiga tiina bam dedaane Wɛ diga kam soja tiina dedɛɛro wom na nigi konto to, ba boboŋa ma vugimi. Ba maa yeiri kolo na lage ko ke se ko kweeli to. 25Nɔɔno wodwoŋi laam ma ba o zo ba na wo mɛ to o ta de-ba o we, “Nii-na, nɔɔna balo abam ya na jaane á ke peena diga ne to laam wo Wɛ diga kam ne ba zege ba bere nɔɔna bam.”
26Dedɛɛro wom na nigi konto to, o de o nɔɔna bam ma zaŋe ba vo ba ja Yezu tontoŋena bam ba ba. Ba ma wo mɛ dam ba zi-ba, kolo ŋwaane ba kɔre mo we nɔɔna bam wó dole-ba de kandwa.
27Ba laam ma pa se ba zo ba zege Juu tiina nakwa bam kɔgɔ kom yiga ne. Kaanem yuu tu wom laam ma bwei-ba se o nii. 28O ma ta o we, “Debam maŋe dé kaane abam se á daa yé ta‑á bere kolokolo nɔɔno wonto yere ŋwaane. Nii abam na ke tei to. Á pɛ se á berem dem yerane mo jage Jerusalem maama wone, ye á ta lage á pa se wonto toone dem taa ye debam yiga.” 29Piita de o dwonna nakwa bam ma leiri ba we, “Debam jege se dé sɛ Wɛ ni mo, se ko dae nabiina yerane. 30Baŋa Wɛ wom dé nabaara na tɔge to mo bi Yezu toone wone. Ko ye abam ya mo jaane‑o á pa dagara yuu ne á go. 31Wɛ mo seene o bi‑o o daare o pa se o jeini o jazem seeni, se o taa ye debam Yiga tu, de dé Vereno. Konto wae ko pa se Isarele tiina na chwoŋa ba leiri ba wo se Wɛ laam yage ba wɛleera o ma chɛ-ba. 32Debam nam mo zege chega kam konto kwaga ne, ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom de tɔge ko zege ka kwaga ne. Kokuri Wɛ pɛ se o Sin-laao kom taa wo balo na sɛ o ni to tei ne.”
33Juu tiina nakwa bam na nigi Yezu tontoŋena bam na tage kolo to, ba bane ma tiini de zaŋe de-ba. Ba boboŋa ma ja se ba go-ba. 34Ba kɔgɔ kom nɔɔno dedoa laam ma zaŋe se o ŋɔɔne, o yere mo Gamaleli. O maa ye Farisi tu ye o ta ye Wɛ nia yam bereno. Nɔɔna maama maa pa‑o zula. O na zaŋe ba kɔgɔ kom wone to, o ma ta se ba ja Yezu tontoŋena bam ba nwoŋi pwooni se ba cheigi fee. 35O ma daare o ta de nakwa bam kɔgɔ kom o we, “Amo dwonna Isarele tiina bam, á ta‑á yei á tete de á na boŋe se á ke nɔɔna banto tei to. 36Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo zaŋe debam logo ne, o yere mo Teudas. O ma bere o tete we o ye nɔn-kamunu. Nɔɔna dedɛ déem ma tɔge o kwaga, ko maŋe de nɔɔna bia yana (400). Ba déem nam go‑o mo ye o tɔgena bam jage da yiga ne. Kolokolo daa maa wo daare. 37Konto kwaga ne, Galili tu wodwoŋi de daa ma zaŋe, o yere mo Judas. Maŋa kam ba déem na wora ba gare dé logo kom nɔn-bia to mo o zaŋe o la kɔgɔ o ke o kwaga ne. Ba ma go wonto de. O de kwaga tɔgena bam ma jage da yiga ne. 38Konto ŋwaane mo a nam tɛ abam se á yé zaŋe á ke nɔɔna banto kolokolo. Nam yage-na ba yera, kolo ŋwaane ba boboŋa de ba totoŋa maama ná tɔge nabiina yerane ŋwaane, ya wó taa ye kafɛ mo. 39Ko nam ná ye Wɛ kikia mo, abam bá wane á che-ba. Á nam wó ba á lɔre we, á ke chichuŋu de Wɛ mo.”
Gamaleli na tage konto o ti to, ba ma sɛ o taane dem. 40Ba ma bwoŋi Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam pa se ba jwoori ba zo ba tei. Ba ma fere-ba de kaasa ye ba daare ba kaane-ba se ba daa yé ŋɔɔne kolokolo Yezu yere ŋwaane kɔtaa. Ba laam ma yage-ba se ba viiri.
41Yezu tontoŋena bam ma nwoŋi nakwa bam tei ne ye ba jege wopwolo lanyerane de Wɛ na pɛ se ba maŋe se ba na yaara Yezu yere ŋwaane to. 42Dɛ maama wuu ba maa yeini ba tigisi daane Wɛ diga kam ne, ye ba daare ba tole sam ba bere nɔɔna Wɛ chega kam. Ba maa tɛ Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ba bere nɔɔna we Yezu mo seene o ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom.

english_text:
Seven Leaders for the Church
1A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
2The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables. 3My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things. 4We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
5This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch. 6These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work. 7God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord.
Stephen Is Arrested
8God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people. 9But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him. 10But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him. 11So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
12They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
13Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses. 14We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.” 15 Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_text:
Ba le nɔɔna barepɛ totoŋa yam ŋwaane
1Maŋa kam konto ne Yezu tɔgena bam kɔgɔ kom maa wora ko pula dedɛ. Ba kɔgɔ kom wone Juu tiina balo na ye veira ye ba ŋɔɔne Girisi tiina taane dem to maa jege balo na ŋɔɔne ba tete Juu tiina taane dem to ba poona. Woŋo kolo ŋwaane ye ba poona konto to ye sabu kolo ba na yeini ba maŋe ba pa kadeina se ba maa lage ba ni-wodiu dɛ maama to. Veira bam maa we ba kadeina bam ba jwoŋi kolo na maŋe de-ba to. 2Yezu tontoŋena fuga-balei bam ma bwoŋi ba kɔgɔ kom maama ba ke daane ye ba ta ba we, “Ko wo maŋe se debam tete mo yage Wɛ kwora kam berem se dé daare dé taa nii wodiiru tem sabu kom. 3Dé nu-bia bam, abam nam jege se á le nɔɔna barepɛ á wone se dé pa ba taa nii wonnu tento baŋa ne. Banto wó taa ye balo á na yei we Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo ba tei ne lanyerane ye ba jege boboŋ-dɛɛra to. 4Ko nam ná ye debam tete, dé wó seene dé yia mo Wɛ warem de o kwora kam berem baŋa ne.”
5Ba na tage konto to, ko ma pwoli ba kɔgɔ kom maama wo. Ba ma nii ba kuri nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Stiiven. Wonto maa tiini o jege wo-dedoa de Yezu ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo o tei ne lanyerane. Ba ma kuri Filipi, de Porokora, de Nikano, de Timon, de Pamena, de Nikola wolo na nwoŋi Antioka ye o ye dwi-gɛ tu na tu o sɛ Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to ba woli da. 6Ba ma le-ba ba ja vo ba zege Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam yiga ne. Ba ma ware Wɛ ba pa-ba ye ba kwei ba jea ba daŋe ba baŋa ne.
7Wɛ kwora kam déem ma fɔge ka jage ka yi jei maama. Yezu nɔɔna bam kɔgɔ kom ma puli dedɛ Jerusalem ne. Juu tiina kaanem tiina dedɛ de déem ma ba ba sɛ Yezu chega kam.
Ba jaane Stiiven
8Stiiven déem maa ye nɔɔno wolo Wɛ na pɛ‑o zaane de dam dedɛ to. O tiini o ke wo-kenkagela yalo na bere Wɛ dam to mo o bere nɔɔna. 9Nɔɔna badwonna nam wora ba na mage ni-kantɔgɔ ded‑o. Banto nwoŋi Juu tiina kɔgɔ kolo ba na bwoi we ‘Libatiina’ to wone. Ba déem nwoŋi Kurene de Alɛzandaria mo. Ba ma tɔge ba woli de Juu tiina badaara na nwoŋi Kilikia de Asia teene dedwonna to. 10Ba nam na zaŋe ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ ded‑o to, o ma ŋɔɔne de swa taane, ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ‑o dam tei to, pa se ba daa ware o taane ba leiri. 11Ba laam ma nwoŋi ba ke ni dedaane nɔɔna badwonna pa se ba fɔ vwa ba ta o taane ba we, “Debam nigi nɔɔno wonto na ŋɔɔne o chɔge Moses de Wɛ yuu.”
12Ba na jege Stiiven ba yaala konto to, ko ma pa se Juu tiina bam, de ba nakwa bam, de ba zamesem tiina bam maama bane zaŋe ded‑o. Ba ma zaŋe ba zi‑o ba ja vo ba nakwa kɔgɔ kom yiga ne se ba di o taane. 13Ba ma pa se nɔɔna badwonna zo ba fɔ vwa ba pa‑o, ye ba ta ba we, “Maŋa maama nɔɔno wonto yɔɔre o ŋɔɔne ta-balwaaro o pae Wɛ diga kam, de Wɛ nia yam. 14Dé ma ni o na tage tei o we, Nazarete tu Yezu mo wó ba o chɔge Wɛ diga kam, ye o daare o pipiri chwei selo maama Moses déem na bere dé nabaara se dé taa tɔge to.”
15Juu tiina nakwa balo maama na jei da to laam ma yɔɔre ba nii Stiiven. Ba ma nii ba na o yibia na nye de maleka yibia tei to.

english_text:
Stephen's Speech
1The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
2 Stephen answered:
Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran. 3God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.” 4 Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran.
After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live. 5 God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children. 6 God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated 400 years. 7 But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
8 God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons. 9 These men were our ancestors.
Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him 10 and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
11 Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat. 12But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time. 13 It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
14 Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were 75 of them. 15 His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did. 16 Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
17 Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased. 18Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph. 19 He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
20 During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home. 21 Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son. 22Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
23 When Moses was 40 years old, he wanted to help the Israelites because they were his own people. 24One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian. 25Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
26The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
27But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge? 28Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?” 29 When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
30 Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai. 31Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said, 32“I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
33The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy. 34With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
35 This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
36 In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for 40 years. 37 Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.” 38 Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us. 39But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
40 The people said to Aaron, “Make some gods to lead us! Moses led us out of Egypt, but we don't know what's happened to him now.” 41 Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
42 God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those 40 years in the desert. 43Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
44 The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen. 45 Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David. 46 He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel. 47 And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
48But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
49 “Heaven is my throne,
and the earth
is my footstool.
What kind of house
will you build for me?
In what place will I rest?
50I have made everything.”
51 You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did. 52Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him. 53Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it.
Stephen Is Stoned to Death
54When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious. 55 But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side. 56Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
57The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen 58and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
59As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!” 60He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_text:
Stiiven na tole o kwora tei to
1Juu tiina kaanem yuu tu wom ma zaŋe o bwei Stiiven o we, “Wonnu telo ba na tage ba pa nmo to ye chega mo naa vwa mo?” 2Stiiven laam ma leiri o we:
“A nu-bia de a kwoa bam, cheigi-na amo. Faŋa faŋa to Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tu o veere o tete debam nabaaro Abaraham tei ne. Konto maŋa kam ne Abaraham déem ta zoore Mesopotamia ne mo. O daa ta wo vei se o taa zoore Haran ne. 3Wɛ déem ma ta ded‑o o we, o yage o tete teo kom de o sɔŋɔ tiina, se o daare o vo jei selo omo na wó bere‑o to. 4O ma seene o zaŋe o nwoŋi Chaladea tiina teo kom o vo o yi Haran o zoore da. O na wo dáane to, o kwo ma te. Wɛ ma pa se o daa nwoŋi o fɔɔre o vo o yi teo konto mɛ abam na zoore zem to. 5Wɛ nam wo pɛ Abaraham tega ywo-seeni se o taa tei, de fenfee de o wo pɛ‑o. Wɛ nam pwooli mo we, omo wó pa‑o tega kanto se o taa tei, ye o ná tega o daare, se o dwi tiina ta taa tei-ka. Wɛ tiŋi o ni dem konto ye Abaraham ta ba jege bu. 6Wɛ na tage kolo ded‑o to mo tento: ‘Abaraham, nmo dwi tiina wó vo ba taa zoore sa-teo ne. Ba wó taa ye kabɛ mo teo kom konto ne, pa se nɔɔna bɛɛse-ba taa, bena bia yana (400). 7Amo Wɛ nam wó pa se teo kolo nɔɔna na fe-ba se ba toŋe kabɛ totoŋa to na waarem. Konto kwaga ne ba laam wó nwoŋi teo kom konto ne ba ba ba taa zuli amo jei sento ne.’ 8Wɛ ma daare o gwoni ni de Abaraham. O ma pa se Abaraham dwi tiina taa gwoni ba peina se ko bere we ba sɛ o ni dem konto. Abaraham ma ba o lo Izaak. Da nana dɛ ne o ma gwoni o peini. Izaak de déem ma ba o lo Jakob. Jakob ma lo dé nabaara fuga-balei bam.
9Nabaara bam dedoa yere mo Josɛf. O chorro tem maa jege puseŋa ded‑o. Konto ŋwaane mo ba jaane‑o ba yeigi ba pa o vo Ejipti se o taa ye kabaa. Wɛ ta maa wo o tei ne. 10O ma pa se o nwoŋi cham maama wone de yazura. Josɛf na tu o zege Ejipti Pa-faro wom yiga ne to mo Wɛ pɛ‑o swa pa se o kikia su Pɛ wom yi lanyerane. Pɛ wom ma pa se o ji o sɔŋɔ kom tu de Ejipti teo kom maama yuu tu.
11Kana déem ma ba ka wora Ejipti de Kanaan teene dem maama ne. Ko ma tiini ko chɛ ba yera ne. Dé nabaara bam déem maa ware se ba na wodiu ba di. 12Jakob déem ma ni we wodiu wo Ejipti ne. O ma toŋe dé nabaara bam pa se ba vo ba nii. 13Konto kwaga ne, ba daa ma jwoori ba vo ba ke belei. Josɛf laam ma pa se o chorro tem lɔre‑o. Ejipti Pa-faro wom de laam ma ba o lɔre Josɛf sɔŋɔ tiina bam. 14Josɛf ma daare o toŋe ni o pa o kwo Jakob se o de o sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama ba o tei Ejipti ne. Ba maama déem ye nɔɔna fuserepɛ-banu (75) mo. 15Jakob ma seene o zaŋe o vo Ejipti. Dáane mo wonto tega. Dé nabaara bam de ma ba ba te. 16Ba ma ja ba yera yam ba jwoori ba vo Sɛkɛm ba suli-ba yibeeli delo ne Abaraham déem na yeigi de sabu Hamora bia bam tei ne to.
17Maŋa kam ma twɛ se Wɛ ke o su o na pwooli de Abaraham se o ke kolo to. Maŋa kam konto ne debam nɔɔna balo na wo Ejipti ne to maa tiini ba wora ba pula dedɛ. 18Pa-faro wodwoŋi de daa ma zaŋe se o taa tei Ejipti. O maa yeiri Josɛf ni ne. 19O déem maa jege debam nabaara bam o bɛɛsa. Swa mo o kea ye o fe-ba se ba kwei ba bu-sese ba yage pwooni yiga ne se ko pa ba te.
20Konto maŋa kam ne mo ba loge Moses. O déem maa ye bu-laao chekke Wɛ yiga ne. Ba maa jege‑o ba kɔna o kwo sɔŋɔ ne chane setɔ. 21Ba laam ma ja‑o ba nwoŋi ba tiŋi pwooni ne. Pa-faro wom bukɔ ma kwei‑o o jege o nia, ne o ye o tete bu mo tei. 22Ba ma bere Moses Ejipti tiina yi-poro kom maama. O ma ji nɔn-babea o ni taane de o kikia maama baŋa ne.
23Moses déem na yi bena finna to, o ma boŋe se o vo o nii o dwonna Isarele tiina bam na ye tei. 24O na vei to, o ma na Ejipti tu wodwoŋi na jege Isarele tu o maga. Moses ma vo se o woli o tete dwi tu wom jara yam wone. O ma mage Ejipti tu wom o go. 25O déem ya boŋe we o tete dwi tiina bam wó lɔre we Wɛ lage o pa se wonto mo jwoŋi-ba Ejipti tiina bam jeŋa ne o yage. Ba ma ware se ba lɔre konto. 26Tega na poore to, o daa ma na Isarele tiina balei na jege daane. O ma kwaane se o lwɛ-ba ye o ta de-ba o we, ‘Amo nɔɔna bam, abam ye chorro mo daane. Bɛ mo ke ye abam jege daane konto?’
27O na tage de-ba konto to, wolo wom na dana to ma yigi Moses o yage dáa ne. O ma bwei Moses o we, ‘Wɔ mo pɛ nmo chwoŋa se n ta‑n ye debam yuu tu, se n daare n ŋɔɔne debam taane? 28Nmo nam boŋe se n go amo mo, ne n diim na go Ejipti tu wom tei to na?’ 29Moses na nigi konto to, o laam ma duri o nwoŋi Ejipti ne o vo o zoore Midian teo ne. Dáane mo o di kaane ye ba lo bia balei.
30Bena finna déem na kɛ to, Wɛ maleka ma ba ka nwoŋi Moses yiga ne. Ko déem ye kagoa yuu ne mo Moses wora, ko bwola de Sinayi peo kom. O ma na min-vogo na jege sabare ko di, ye maleka kam wo dáane. 31Moses yera ma sɔɔre de o na nɛ kolo to. O ma fɔɔre o yi mini dem se o nii. O laam ma ni Baŋa Wɛ kwora ye ka we, 32‘Amo mo ye nmo nabaara bam Wɛ wom. Amo mo ye Abaraham Wɛ, de Izaak, de Jakob Wɛ.’ Foone ma ja Moses ye o ware se o daa nii. 33Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we, o le o natera yam se jei selo o na zege da to ye omo tete nyem mo. 34Wɛ daa ma ta o we, ‘Amo nɛ a nɔɔna bam na wo Ejipti ne ye ba yaare tei to. A ma kwori a ni ba na kona tei to. Amo laam tu ba tei mo se a jwoŋi-ba a yage. Nii ywo, a lage a toŋe‑m se n jwoori Ejipti.’ ”
35Stiiven ta ma ta o we, “Moses déem ye wolo Isarele tiina bam na ve‑o to. Ba déem bwei‑o ba we, ‘Wɔ mo pɛ nmo chwoŋa se n ta‑n ye debam yuu tu se n daare n ŋɔɔne debam taane?’ Moses nam ta mo ye wolo Wɛ na toŋe‑o se o taa tei o nɔɔna bam, se o daare o jwoŋi-ba o yage to. Wɛ ma toŋe maleka ye ka nwoŋi o yiga ne sabare wone ka bere‑o konto. 36Moses déem ma ke wo-kenkagela de maana Ejipti ne, pa se o wane o ja Wɛ nɔɔna bam o nwoŋi. Ba ma tɔge Nane-soŋo kom ba bɛ ba daare ba beeri kagoa kam wone taa, bena finna, ye Moses ta ke wo-kenkagela dedɛ ba tei ne. 37Moses ta mo ye wolo na tage de Isarele dwi tiina bam o we, ‘Wɛ wó toŋe o ni-jwoŋinu abam tei ne, ne o na toŋe amo Moses tei to. Wonto wó nwoŋi abam tete dwi dem wone mo.’ 38Moses mo ye wolo na tɔge o wo Isarele dwi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone kagoa kam yuu ne to. O maa tɔge o wora dedaane dé nabaara bam, de maleka kalo na ŋɔɔne ded‑o Sinayi peo kom yuu ne to. Wonto mo jwoŋi Wɛ botare selo na pae ŋwea to se o ke debam jeŋa ne.
39De konto maama, dé nabaara bam ma ve se ba sɛ Moses ni. Ba ma yigi‑o ba yage dáa ne, ye ba daare ba boŋe se ba jwoori ba vo Ejipti. 40Ba ma ta de Aron ba we, ‘Mɔ jwona n pa debam se ya taa tɔge dé yiga. Ko nam ná ye Moses wolo na jaane debam o nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne to, dé yeiri woŋo kolo na yi‑o to.’ 41Maŋa kam konto ne ba ma seene ba mɔ kamɔgɔ pa ko nye de na-mɔra, ye ba pa ko ye ba jwoni. Ba maa jege-de ba kaana. Ba ma daare ba ke kuri ba pa ba tete de ba na mɛ ba jea ba mɔ kolo to. 42Ba na kaane jwoni dem konto to, mo Wɛ mɛ o kwaga o ya-ba. O ma yage-ba se ba taa zuli chalechwe selo na wo wɛyuu ne to. Ko ke nenɛɛne ko na maŋe ko popone Wɛ sampwori sem tɔnɔ kom ne we:
‘Isarele dwi tiina bam, á déem na wo kagoa kam wone bena finna
ye á kwei vara de pɛɛra dwi dwi á ma á ke kaanem to,
ko dae amo mo á kaane á pa konto.
43Ko nam ye Moleka jwoni dem wara-vwei mo abam zeŋe,
dedaane chalechoa kalo na ye abam jwoni Refana to.
Tento maama nam ye kamwaro telo á na ke
se á ta‑á zuli-te mo.
Konto ŋwaane amo wó ja abam a nwoŋi á teo kom wone
a kale a vo jei selo na gaale Babilon to.’
44Debam nabaara bam na beeri kagoa kam wone to, ba déem jege Wɛ wara-vwei dem ba via. Wɛ déem ya bere Moses o na wó ke tei o pu vwei dem to. Ba déem seene ba ke-de ne Wɛ na tage tei to. 45Ko kwaga seeni to, dé nabaara bam mo jwoŋi vwei dem ba kwoa tei ne ba zeŋe-de ba ja ba tɔge Josua. Ba ma vo ba wane teene delo Wɛ na lage o pa-ba se ba taa zoore da to. Wɛ déem zeili tega kam konto nɔɔna bam o yage ba yiga ne. Vwei dem maa wora taa, se ko ba ko yi David na zaŋe o ji pɛ maŋa kalo to. 46O kikia ma su Wɛ yi ye o lwoori Wɛ se o pa‑o chwoŋa se o lɔ diga o ma leiri vwei dem yuu ne, se Wɛ taa zoore da Jakob dwi tiina bam tetare ne. 47Ko nam ye David bu Solomon mo lɔge diga o pa Wɛ. 48Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam ba zoore di selo nabiina na lɔge to wone. Wɛ sampwora dedoa déem tage o we:
49‘Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento:
Wɛyuu kom mo ye amo paare yituŋu.
Ko daare tega baŋa kam maa ye amo na chwi a nɛ mɛ to.
Abam wó ke tɛ mo á lɔ diga á pa-ne?
Jeiga kɔ mo amo wó vo a peini da a sii?
50Ko dae amo tete je mo
a mɛ a ke wonnu tento maama na?’
51Abam jege yi-dɛɛre dedɛ. Á bochara de nye de balo na ba tɔge Wɛ to bochara. Abam zwa mo kwareme ye á ba ni Wɛ kwora kam. Abam de á nabaara bam kikia maama ye bedwe mo. Abam ba sɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom na bere chega kalo to. 52Wɛ sampwori sem wolowolo tera abam nabaara bam na wo zeili kotu. Ba déem go balo na wuuri ba ta we Wɛ wó toŋe Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom se o ba to. Leile konto abam nam mo kwei wonto á ke nɔɔna jeŋa ne pa ba go‑o. 53Abam ye balo na jwoŋi Wɛ nia yalo o na tɔge malese jeŋa o pa abam to mo. De konto de, á ta wo sɛ-ya.”
54Stiiven na tage konto o ti to, ko ma pa se Juu tiina nakwa bam bane fuli dedɛ o baŋa ne, ye ba done ba yeila o ŋwaane. 55Wɛ Sin-laao kom maa wo Stiiven tei ne lanyerane.
