19 Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says,
“I am the one to take revenge
and pay them back.”
20 The Scriptures also say,
“If your enemies are hungry,
give them something to eat.
And if they are thirsty,
give them something
to drink.
This will be the same
as piling burning coals
on their heads.”
21Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_text:
Ko na maŋe se dé taa zuli Wɛ tei to
1A nu-bia bam, Wɛ na tiini o jege abam ŋwaŋa konto to, a lwoori abam se á kwei á tete á ke kaanem á pa Wɛ ye á daa ta ŋwe, se ko pwoli o wo lanyerane. Konto mo ye zulim delo na maŋe se á ke á pa‑o to. 2Á yé pa se á boboŋa taa tɔge nabiina chwei sem. Pa-na se Wɛ pipiri abam de o na pɛ á jege boboŋ-doora tei to. Abam laam wó ba á lɔre Wɛ boboŋa na lage se á ke kolo to, ye á lɔre we ko tiini ko lana chekke ye ko pwoli o wo.
3Wɛ na pɛ-ne o zaane dem se a taa ye o tontoŋeno to, a lage a ta de abam maama se á yé ta‑á boŋe kamunim á pa á tete se á ta‑á dwoi á na maŋe á ye tei to. Á nam boŋe á nii se á lɔre totoŋe delo Wɛ na lage se á ke to, se ko maŋe de o na pɛ abam dedoa dedoa jege wo-dedoa ye ka mae tei to. 4Nabiinu yera ye woŋo dedoa mo ye ya laam pɔɔre teiri teiri. Ya daa maama jege ka totoŋa mo. 5Ko nam ye bedwe mo de debam balo na me de Yezu Krista to. Dé tiini dé daga ye dé nam ye kɔgɔ dedoa. Debam maama dedoa dedoa maa toŋa dé woli daane. 6Wɛ pɛɛra yalo dé na jwoŋi to ye teiri teiri mo, se ko tɔge Wɛ na ke zaane debam yuu ne tei to. Wɛ ná pɛ wolo wae o tɔɔle o kwora kam, konto tu jege se o tɔge o na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to o ma tɔɔle-ka. 7Wɛ ná pɛ wolo toŋa o woli o dwonna, konto tu jege se o taa toŋa konto mo. Wolo Wɛ ná pɛ se o bere o dwonna Wɛ chega kam, se o kwaane o taa ke konto. 8Wɛ ná pɛ wolo wae o pa se o dwonna bochara peini tega ne, o jege se o taa ke konto mo. Wolo na pɔɔre o wonnu o pae o dwonna to jege se o ma o wo-ywoŋo mo o woli-ba lanyerane. Wolo nam na ye nɔɔna yiga tu to jege se o taa seene o yia ko ŋwaane mo. Wolo nam na duri o dwonna yiniga to jege se o taa ke de wopwolo mo.
9Á yé ta‑á jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ de á na jege nɔɔna swono tei to. Nam ta‑á chuli-na wo-lwanno maama, se á daare á ta‑á jege wo-laaro á bochara ne. 10Á na ye nu-bia Yezu ŋwaane to, se á ta‑á jege da-swono konto dwoŋi. Á ta ta‑á swoi da-zula. 11Á na toŋe á pa Wɛ tei to, á yé pa se jawɔrɔ ja abam. Kwei-na á bochara maama á ta‑á ma á toŋa á pa dé Teiru wom. 12Á na jege Wɛ teena tei to, se á ta‑á jege wopwolo ko ŋwaane. Cham ná tu abam baŋa, se á vɔ pu-dɛa. Kwaane-na á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ lanyerane. 13Pɔɔre-na á wonnu á pa balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna ye yiniga jege-ba to. Ta‑á jeeri-na nɔɔna á sam ne lanyerane.
14Ko ná ye balo na jege abam ba bɛɛse to, se á sɔɔle Wɛ swolim á pa-ba. Á nam yé sɔɔle lwarem á chɔge-ba. 15Ko ná ye balo na jege wopwolo to, se á tɔge á ta‑á jege wopwolo. Ko ná ye balo yi-nyɔna na jege-ba to, se á pa á yiga de nyɔne de-ba. 16Ta‑á jege-na boboŋe dedwe á pa daane. Á yé ta‑á bere á tete. Gwooni-na á tete se á ta‑á zoore de nabwona. Á yé ta‑á boŋe kamunim á pa á tete.
17Nɔɔno ná ke lwarem o yage á yuu ne, se á yé jwoori á ke‑o konto dwoŋi. Nam kwaane-na se á ta‑á ke kolo na tɔge chwoŋa nɔɔna maama yia ne to. 18Kwaane-na lanyerane se á ta‑á zoore dedaane nɔɔno maama de ywoni, ne á na wae tei to.
19A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, á yé ke á boboŋa ne se á jwoori á chɔge balo na ke lwarem ba yage á yuu ne to. Nam yage-na se Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom ba ba baŋa. Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we:
“Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo wó jwoori a ŋwe nɔɔna keim-balwaaro jene,
pa se ba na kolo na maŋe de-ba to.”
20Ko nam ta popone we:
“Nmo dono kana ná wɔe,
se n pa‑o wodiu se o di.
Na-nyɔm ná jege‑o,
se n pa‑o na se o nyɔ.
Kikia yam konto wó pa se chaveera tiini ya ja‑o,
ne Wɛ zeiŋi mini mo o yuu ne to.”
21Abam nam yé pa se lwarem wane abam. Ta‑á tɔge-na keim-laaro se te wane lwarem dam te chɔge.

english_text:
Obey Rulers
1 Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power. 2People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished. 3Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it. 4After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you.
If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is. 5But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
6 You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters. 7Pay all that you owe, whether it is taxes and fees or respect and honor.
Love
8Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands. 9 In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.” 10No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands.
The Day When Christ Returns
11You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord. 12Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light. 13So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous. 14Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_text:
Dé na wó sɛ dé pa dedɛɛra tei to
1Abam maama jege se á sɛ á pa dedɛɛra balo na tei á teene dem to, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jege dam se o taa tei nɔɔna ye Wɛ wo pɛ kotu chwoŋa. Dedɛɛra balo na wora to ye Wɛ mo tiŋi-ba. 2Wolo maama ná ve dedɛɛra bam konto, kotu boŋe se o chɔge Wɛ boboŋa yam mo. Balo na ke konto dwoŋi to wó na chɔgem. 3Dedɛɛra bam nam ba pae se foone jege balo na ke keim-laaro to. Foone nam wó ja balo na tɔge keim-balwaaro to mo. Nmo ná ba lage se foone taa jege‑m de dedɛɛra bam, n jege se n ta‑n ke keim-laaro mo se ko pa n na zula ba tei ne. 4Wɛ nam tiŋi dedɛɛra bam se ba taa toŋe ba pa‑o abam fɔgem ŋwaane mo. Abam nam ná ke wo-balwaaro, se á ta‑á kɔre foone, kolo ŋwaane dedɛɛra bam seene ba jege dam se ba taa maa chɔge nɔɔna. Banto mo ye balo Wɛ na tiŋi se ba tɔge o ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane ba ma waare balo na ke lwarem to. 5Konto ŋwaane mo á jege se á sɛ ba ni. Ko ye abam boboŋa na pae á lɔre we á tɔge chega chwoŋa to ŋwaane mo, se ko dae á na kɔre Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom to yerane ŋwaane.
6Ko ta tɔge konto ŋwaane mo á wó ta‑á ŋwe lampwoo. Dedɛɛra bam toŋe ba pa Wɛ mo de ba na seene ba yia ba totoŋa yam baŋa ne to. 7Nam ta‑á ŋwe kolo maama ba na maŋe se ba jwoŋi á tei ne to á pa-ba. Ko ná ye wolo na jwoŋi á yuu lampwoo to, naa wolo de na jwoŋi á wonnu lampwoo to, se á ŋwe á lampwoo maama á pa-ba. Ko ná ye wolo na maŋe se á ta‑á kɔre‑o to, se á ta‑á kɔre‑o. Ko ná ye wolo na maŋe de zula to, se á ta‑á zuli‑o.
Da-swono taane
8Abam nam yé ta‑á jege-na nɔɔn-nɔɔno jene, se jene delo á na wó ta‑á jege to mo ye á na wó ta‑á jege á dwonna swono tei to. Wolo maama na swoi o dwoŋi to seene o tɔge Wɛ nia yam mo. 9Wɛ nia yam bere we, “N yé ke kabwoŋa, n yé go nɔɔno, n yé ŋɔ, n yé pa n yi su n dwonna wonnu.” Nia yanto dedaane Wɛ nia yam maama nam tɔge ni dedwe mo. Dento dem nam mo we, “Ta‑n swoi n dwoŋi se ko maŋe de n na swoi n tete tei to.” 10Nmo ná jege n dwoŋi swono, n daa‑n bá‑n wane n ke‑o n chɔge. Wɛ nia yam maama nam zege swono kom konto yera ne mo.
11Ta‑á ke-na konto, se abam yei we Wɛ maŋa kam yia. Ta‑á cho-na á tete se dɔɔm yé taa jege abam. Maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó ba o jwoŋi dé ŋwea to daare fee se ka yi, ye ko daa dae nenɛɛne maŋa kalo dé déem na bobo dé ke dé wo-dedoa ded‑o to. 12Maŋa kam laam daare fee se ka yi, ne tega na lage ka poore tei to. Tete dem lage de kɛ se wea pwooni taa wora. Konto ŋwaane, á pa dé de kikia yalo na ye lim nyem to dé yage, se dé daare dé ma Wɛ dam dé che dé tete se dé wane dé tɔge pwooni chwoŋa kam. 13Pa-na dé tɔge chwoŋa se ko maŋe de balo na wo wea pwooni ne to. Á nam pa-na dé yage paweeni, de sa-nyɔre, de bwoŋa, de wo-digiru kikia maama. Á yé ta‑á jaane daane naa á ta‑á ke wo-goo daane. 14Pa-na se abam ŋwea dedaane dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwea taa ye bedwe. Nam yé ta‑á boŋe á na wó ke tei se á ta‑á tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo á fera na zoore to.

english_text:
Don't Criticize Others
1 Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours. 2Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables. 3But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone. 4What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
5Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind. 6Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
7Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves. 8Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord. 9This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living. 10 Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us. 11 In the Scriptures God says,
“I swear by my very life
that everyone will kneel down
and praise my name!”
12And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do.
Don't Cause Problems for Others
13We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith. 14The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
15If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for. 16Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ. 17God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit. 18If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people. 19We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
20Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat. 21It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord. 22What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts. 23But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_text:
Dé yé taa yaale dé dwonna
1Nɔɔno wolo ná jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ye o boboŋa ta ná ba dana Wɛ yiga ne, se á jwoŋi konto tu lanyerane. Á nam yé mage ni-kantɔgɔ ded‑o de o na boŋe tei to. 2Nɔɔno wó taa wora o boboŋa na dana o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane pa se o ba chuli kolokolo dim. Ko daare nɔɔno wodwoŋi boboŋa na ba dana de o wo-dedoa kam to wó taa chuli nɔna. 3Wɛ nam jwoŋi ba maama. Wolo wom na ba kuri o di to yé zaŋe o gwooni wolo wom na ba di woŋo maama to. Wolo nam na ba di woŋo maama to yé zaŋe o yaale wolo na ba chuli o di to, kotu na ye Wɛ nyem to ŋwaane. 4Nmo ye wɔ mo se n yaale nɔɔno wodwoŋi tontoŋeno kikia? Ko ye o tu wom mo jege se o nii, o ke chega naa o wo ke. Wolo na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to ke lanyerane, dé Teiru wom na wae o pa o zege de chega to ŋwaane.
5Nɔɔno wó taa wora o na pɔɔre dɛ o pa de dwoi da yadwonna. Ko daare nɔɔno wodwoŋi maa wora o na ba kuri da yam daane. Nɔɔno maama nam na boŋe tei de tei to, o jege se o taa zege ko baŋa ne mo. 6Nɔɔno wolo na kuri dɛ se de taa ye dɛ-kamunu to yeini o ke konto dé Teiru wom ŋwaane mo. Wolo na di woŋo maama to ke konto o ma zuli dé Teiru wom, o na yeini o ke Wɛ lei wodiu kom baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Wolo nam na ba di woŋo maama to de ke konto o ma zuli dé Teiru wom ye o ke Wɛ lei. 7Debam wolowolo ba ŋwe o tete yerane ŋwaane. Wolo ná tega, ko bá taa ye o tete yerane ŋwaane. 8Dé ze ná ŋwe, dé ŋwe dé Teiru wom ŋwaane mo. Dé nam ná tega, ko ta ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane. Mo kokuri, dé ná ŋwe naa dé ná tega, dé ta ye dé Teiru wom nyem mo. 9Yezu Krista déem na tega ye o jwoori o bi o na ŋwea to, ko ye se o na chwoŋa se o taa ye balo na tege to Teiru, de nɔn-ŋwena de Teiru wom mo.
10Ko na ye konto to, bɛ mo ye n yaale n nu-bu? Ko daare nmo, bɛ mo ye n gwooni n nu-bu? Debam maama nam wó ba dé zege Wɛ yiga ne se o di debam taane. 11Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we:
“Amo Baŋa Wɛ na ye ŋwea tu to,
ko seene ko ye chega mo we,
nabiina maama wó ba ba kuni nadwoona amo yiga ne,
ye ba puri ba ni ba sɛ ba pa amo.”
12Ko bere we debam maama wó ba dé zege Wɛ yiga ne se dé tole dé kwora dé bere‑o.
13Konto ŋwaane, dé daa yé taa yaale dé dwonna yuu. Nam pa se á boboŋa ja se á yé ke kolo na wó pa á nu-bu wo chɔge naa ko pa o tusi to. 14Amo na me de dé Teiru Yezu to, amo yei lanyerane we wodiu tera ko tete na jege digiru Wɛ tei ne. Nɔɔno nam ná pɛ se woŋo kolo ye wo-digiru, ko seene ko ye wo-digiru ko pa nɔɔno wom konto mo. 15Nmo nam ná pɛ se n nu-bu wo chɔge de nmo na di wodiu kolo to, ko bere we n daa‑n ba tɔge swono chwoŋa ded‑o. Yé pa se nmo na di wodiu kolo to chɔge nɔɔno Wɛ yiga ne, ye kotu ye wolo Yezu Krista na tege o ŋwaane to. 16Yé pa se nɔɔna na chwoŋa se ba yaale woŋo kolo na lana nmo tei ne to. 17Debam na ye Wɛ paare dem nɔɔna tei to ba tɔge wodiiru dim ŋwaane. Ko nam tɔge keim-laaro ŋwaane mo, de bochare-zuru de wopwolo ŋwaane, ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pae debam tei to. 18Wolo maama nam ná sɛ o tɔge Yezu Krista konto dwoŋi, konto tu wó pwoli Wɛ wo ye nɔɔna de wó pa‑o chega.
19Konto ŋwaane pa-na dé kwaane dé taa ke kolo maama na pae nɔɔna jege ywoni daane ye ko fɔge-ba Wɛ chwoŋa ne to. 20Yé pa se wodiiru dim chɔge totoŋa yalo Wɛ na ke de nɔɔna to. Wodiiru dwi maama maŋe de dim mo. Nmo nam ná di kolo na wó pa se n dwoŋi wo chɔge ko ŋwaane to, se n yage wodiu kom konto dim. 21Ko lana se n yé ke kolo maama na wó pa se n nu-bu tusi Wɛ chwoŋa ne to, ko ná ye nɔm dim, naa sana nyɔɔm, naa kolo maama.
22Nmo boboŋa ná jaane tei n wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane, se n pa ko taa ye nmo de Wɛ laŋa ne. Nɔɔno wolo ná yei kolo na lana se o ke to ye o ba jege boboŋa yalei ko ŋwaane, konto tu yuu ywomma. 23Ko daare nɔɔno wolo ná jege bobwea de o na di wodiu kolo to, konto tu bá na bora Wɛ tei ne. Ko bere we o ba jege wo-dedoa o dim dem wone. Kikia yalo maama na ba tɔge wo-dedoa keim to ye wɛleera mo.

english_text:
Please Others and Not Yourself
1If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves. 2We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them. 3 Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.” 4 And the Scriptures were written to teach and encourage us by giving us hope. 5God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ. 6Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
7Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you. 8I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came, 9 so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say,
“I will tell the nations
about you,
and I will sing praises
to your name.”
10 The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
11 Again the Scriptures say,
“Praise the Lord,
all you Gentiles.
All you nations, come
and worship him.”
12 Isaiah says,
“Someone from David's family
will come to power.
He will rule the nations,
and they will put their hope
in him.”
13I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope.
Paul's Work as a Missionary
14My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other. 15But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace! 16He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
17Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God. 18In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him. 19Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum. 20But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation. 21 It is just as the Scriptures say,
“All who haven't been told
about him
will see him,
and those who haven't heard
about him
will understand.”
Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
22 My work has always kept me from coming to see you. 23Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you. 24So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
25-26 I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people. 27 This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles. 28After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain. 29And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
30My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me. 31Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing. 32Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit. 33I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_text:
Dé na wó fɔge daane tei to
1Debam balo boboŋa na dana Wɛ yiga ne to jege se dé taa woli balo boboŋa ta na ba dana to mo, de ba boboŋa na daane-ba tei to. Dé yé taa tɔge dé tete boboŋa keim. 2Debam maama nam jege se dé taa ke kolo na tɔge dé dwoŋi boboŋa na lage tei to mo, ye dé ke‑o lanyerane se ko pa o fɔge o tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa. 3Yezu Krista tete nam wo lage lanyerane o pa o tete. Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ tɔnɔ kom bere Yezu taane de ko na we, “Nɔɔna na jege nmo ba twea tei to mo jwoori ko tui amo baŋa.” 4Kolo maama déem na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone to ye se ko bere debam Wɛ chega kam mo. Kolo na popone da to yeini ko pa dé na pu-dɛa de baare, pa se dé jege teena Wɛ tei ne.
5Wɛ mo ye wolo na pae nɔɔna pu-dɛa de baare to, ye wonto wó pa abam taa jege boboŋe dedwe daane, ne Yezu Krista na lage tei to. 6Ko laam wó pa se abam maama sɛ daane ye á jege ni dedwe á ma‑á zuli Wɛ wom na ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Kwo to.
7Jwoŋi-na daane lanyerane, ne Yezu Krista na jwoŋi abam tei to. Konto wó pa se Wɛ na zula. 8Amo nam tɛ abam we, Yezu Krista déem tu se o toŋe o pa Juu tiina bam mo Wɛ chega kam ŋwaane, se ko pa Wɛ na pwooli de ba nabaara bam tei to taa jege chega. 9Konto ma kwori ko pa dwi-gɛ tiina bam de ba ba zuli Wɛ, o na jege ba ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane, ne Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na bere tei ko we:
“Amo wó tei nmo,
se dwi-gɛ tiina taa yei n ni ne.
A ta wó leeni a zeiŋi nmo yere.”
10Ko ta popone we:
“Abam dwi-gɛ tiina bam, tɔge-na de Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama
se á ta‑á chaka de wopwolo.”
11Ko ta we:
“Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama,
ba-na á tei Baŋa Wɛ.
Pa-na se nabiina na nwoŋi teene delo maama wone to taa zuli‑o.”
12Izaya de déem we:
“Jesse dwi dem tu dedoa wó zaŋe o ba
se o taa tei logo baŋa teene dem,
ye banto wó taa jege teena o tei ne.”
13Wɛ nam ye teena tu, ye wonto wó pa abam taa jege wopwolo de bochare-zuru, á na jege wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam laam wó pa se á na jege teena de Wɛ tei to fɔge ko puli ko ja gaale.
Pɔɔl kwaane o toŋe o pa dwi-gɛ tiina
14A nu-bia bam, amo tei ne a yei lanyerane we abam tɔge keim-laaro yerane mo ye á tiini á jege yeino dwi maama pa se á wae á bere daane Wɛ chega kam. 15Amo nam na popone se a bere abam taana yadwonna tei to, a ke de a wo maama mo se a pa á guli-ya. Amo ke konto de Wɛ na pɛ-ne zaane se a taa toŋe totoŋe delo to. 16O ta ma pa-ne chwoŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista tontoŋeno dwi-gɛ tiina bam wone. Amo na toŋe a pa Wɛ tei to mo ye a yeini a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam se a wane a jwoŋi dwi-gɛ tiina a ke-ba Wɛ jeŋa ne, se ba pa o wo pwoli, o Sin-laao kom na fɔge ko kwɛ ba bochara to ŋwaane.
17Konto ŋwaane, amo na me de Yezu Krista to, a jege chwoŋa se a bere a tete de a na toŋe a pa Wɛ tei to. 18Amo nam kɔre chaveera se a ŋɔɔne kolokolo ye ko dae Yezu Krista na tɔge amo baŋa ne o ke kolo to. Ko ye Yezu mo pɛ se dwi-gɛ tiina bam da amo ŋwaane ba sɛ Wɛ, de amo ni taane de a kikia yam na bere-ba tei to. 19O ma pa se ba ba ba sɛ Wɛ, de o na dɛ o Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane o pa se ba na wo-kenkagela de maana yalo na bere o dam to. Konto dwoŋi mo a zege Jerusalem ne a tole jei maama a vo a yi Ilirikum, ye a tiini a tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kalo na bere Yezu Krista chega kam to. 20Amo boboŋa déem ya maŋe ya ja se a kwaane a taa tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam jei selo ne ba ta na wo lɔre Yezu Krista taane dem to mo. Amo ba lage se a taa toŋe a gwaane de totoŋe delo nɔɔno wodwoŋi na maŋe o ke to. 21Ko nam ye ko na maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne tei to we:
“Ba ta na wo tage o taane ba bere balo to
laam wó ba ba lɔre-de.
Balo ta na wo nigi o ŋwa to
laam wó ba ba ni o chega kam kuri.”
22Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo amo gɛ laŋa kuni dedɛ se a ba abam tei. 23Ko daare leile konto amo daa ba jege chwoŋa se a taa toŋe jei sem konto ne. Amo na jege abam fera bena dedɛ se a ba a na abam to, 24amo laam boŋe se a ba maŋa kalo a na wó zaŋe a vo Sapeeni to. Amo lage se a tɔge abam tei, se a wane a di wopwolo de abam da fenfee. Abam laam wó wane á woli-ne se a kwei chwoŋa a kɛ. 25Leile konto amo lage a vo Jerusalem se a toŋe a woli Yezu nɔɔna bam dáane. 26Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna balo na wo Makedonia ne de Akaya ne to mo mɛ ba boboŋa se ba la sabu ba ma woli Yezu nɔɔna balo na wo Jerusalem ne ye yiniga jege-ba to. 27Ko ye ba tete boboŋa mo ba mɛ ba ke konto. Ko nam maŋe se ba woli-ba konto dwoŋi, kolo ŋwaane Juu tiina bam ya maŋe ba kwei Wɛ wo-laaro mo ba chɛ de dwi-gɛ tiina bam. Konto ŋwaane dwi-gɛ tiina bam jege se ba de daa woli Juu tiina bam de wonnu telo na wó fɔge ba yera to.
28Amo ná ti totoŋe dento ye a kwei sabu kom maama a ke nɔɔna bam jeŋa ne, amo laam wó tɔge abam tei se a daare a vo Sapeeni. 29Amo nam yei we, a ná tu abam tei, amo wó taa jege Yezu Krista dam se o swɛ abam swolim ko ja gaale.
30A nu-bia bam, amo lage a kwoori abam dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane, de swono kolo Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ debam to ŋwaane, se á ta‑á woli-ne a totoŋ-chɛɛra wone de á na lwoori Wɛ á pa-ne tei to. 31Lwoori-na Wɛ se o jwoŋi-ne balo na wo Judea ne ye ba ve Yezu to jeŋa ne, se o daare o pa se Yezu nɔɔna balo na wo Jerusalem ne to sɛ totoŋa yalo amo na wó ke a pa-ba Wɛ ŋwaane to. 32Wɛ ná sɛ, amo laam wó wane a ba abam tei de wopwolo, se a daare a na ywoni abam tei ne. 33Bochare-zuru Tu Baŋa Wɛ wó taa wo abam tei ne. Ameena.

english_text:
Personal Greetings
1I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae. 2Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
3 Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me, 4but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches. 5Greet the church that meets in their home.
Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
6Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
7Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
8Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
9Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us.
Greet my dear friend Stachys.
10Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ.
Greet Aristobulus and his family.
11Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine.
Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
12Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord.
Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
13 Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
14Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
15Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
16Be sure to give each other a warm greeting.
All of Christ's churches greet you.
17My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them! 18They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better. 19I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil. 20Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
21 Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
22I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
23-24 Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings.
Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too.
Paul's Closing Prayer
25Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret, 26but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith. 27 And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_text:
1Amo lage a bere abam dé nu-bu Fwibi chega na ye tei to. Wonto ye kaane wolo na toŋe o woli Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Kɛnkaria ne to. 2Abam nam jege se á jwoŋi‑o lanyerane dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, ne ko na maŋe se Yezu nɔɔna taa ke tei to. Á ta‑á pa‑o wolim delo maama o na lage abam tei ne to, kokuri to o maŋe o toŋe o woli nɔɔna dedɛ, de amo de.
3Jɔɔne-na Pirisila de Akwila á pa-ne. Banto mo tɔge de amo ye dé toŋe dé pa Yezu Krista. 4Ba ya sɛ se ba da toone tei amo ŋwaane. Amo nam ke-ba lei, ye ko dae amo yerane, se ko ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo maama na tu ba sɛ Yezu to de mo ke ba lei.
5Jɔɔne-na Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na jeeri ba sɔŋɔ kom ne to á pa-ne.
Jɔɔne-na amo badwoŋ-swono Epanitu, wolo na dɛ yiga o sɛ Yezu Krista Asia teene dem maama wone to.
6Jɔɔne-na Mary wolo na tiini o toŋe o pa abam to.
7Jɔɔne-na amo chorro Andarika de Junia. Banto ya tɔge de amo ba wo peena diga ne. Ba maa jege yere lanyerane Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam tei ne, ye ba sɛ Yezu Krista ba daare amo.
8Jɔɔne-na Ampaliata wolo a na tiini a jege o swono dé Teiru wom ŋwaane to.
9Jɔɔne-na Yubana wolo na tɔge de debam o toŋe Yezu Krista totoŋa to, dedaane amo badwoŋ-swono Setache.
10Jɔɔne-na Apɛla wolo na jege pu-dɛa de o na tɔge Yezu Krista tei to.
Jɔɔne-na Arisobulu sɔŋɔ tiina bam.
11Jɔɔne-na amo choro Hɛrodion.
Jɔɔne-na balo na ye Nakisa sɔŋɔ tiina ye ba ye dé Teiru wom nyem to á pa-ne.
12Jɔɔne-na Tirifana de Tirifosa, kaana balo na tiini ba toŋe dé Teiru wom totoŋa to.
Jɔɔne-na Perisa, kaane wolo de na tiini o toŋe o pa dé Teiru wom ye a jege o swono to.
13Jɔɔne-na Rufus wolo na yɔɔre o ye dé Teiru wom nyem to, de o nu wom na ke amo ne o tete bu tei to.
14Jɔɔne-na Asinkaritu, de Felegon, de Hɛmesi, de Pataroba, de Hɛmasa, dedaane de nu-bia balo maama na wo ba tei ne to.
15Jɔɔne-na Filologa, de Julia, de Neria de o nakɔ, de Olimpa, dedaane Yezu nɔɔna balo maama na wo ba tei ne to.
16Á ná jeeri daane, se á ta‑á kukwori daane á pa Wɛ zula. Yezu Krista kɔgɔ kom na wo jei selo maama ne to de jɔɔne abam.
17A nu-bia bam, a lage a kwoori abam se á fɔge á che á tete de balo na pɔɔre nɔɔna pa se ba jaane daane ye ba to tusim wone to. Banto nam mo yaale berem delo abam na maŋe á lɔre to. Konto ŋwaane yɔɔre á nyaŋe-ba. 18Nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi ba tɔge dé Teiru Yezu Krista na lage kolo to, ye ba daare ba tɔge ba fera na zoore wonnu telo to. Ba yeini ba ŋɔɔne botare-ywei mo, ye ba ma ni-sone ba gane balo na ba jege swa to ba pipiri ba boboŋa. 19Nɔɔna maama yei abam na tɔge Wɛ lanyerane tei to, ye konto mo pa se amo tiini a jege wopwolo abam ŋwaane. Amo nam lage se abam yia poore de kolo na lana to, se á daare á ta‑á yei á tete se lwarem yé chɔge abam.
20Wɛ wolo na pae nɔɔna bochare-zuru to bá dáane se o ba o chɔge setaana pɛ wom nenɛɛne á na kwei á nɛ á nɔ o baŋa ne tei to.
Dé Teiru Yezu zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.
21Amo dwoŋi tontoŋeno Timoti de jɔɔne abam.
Amo dwi tiina Lukia, de Jason, de Sosipata de jɔɔne abam.
22Amo Tɛtius mo popone Pɔɔl ni taane dento a tiŋi, ye a jɔɔne abam dé Teiru wom ŋwaane.
23Gayus wolo amo Pɔɔl na zoore o sɔŋɔ ne ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama de jeeri da to jɔɔne abam.
Erasitu wolo na ye teo kom dedɛɛro ye o nii ko sabu baŋa ne to, dedaane de nu-bu Kwatus de jɔɔne abam.
[24Dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo abam maama tei ne. Ameena.]
25Dé ke Wɛ lei. Wonto dam dem mo pae á fɔge á zege lanyerane de á na sɛ Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kalo amo na tɔɔle Yezu Krista ŋwaane to. Konto mo abam laam tu á lɔre Wɛ chega kalo déem na seigi o wone faŋa faŋa to. 26Leile konto Wɛ tɔge o sampwori sem déem na popone wonnu telo ba tiŋi to ŋwaane o ma pa se o chega kam konto ba ka lɔre jaja. Wɛ wolo na jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu to laam mo pɛ ni se logo baŋa dwi maama na chwoŋa ba lɔre o chega kam, se ba daare ba ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o ye ba tɔge o ni. 27Wonto yerane mo ye swa maama tu ye o ba jege dwoŋi. Zula taa wo o tei ne Yezu Krista ŋwaane se ko taa vei wuu. Dé ke Wɛ lei. Ameena.

english_text:
1From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
2 To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
3My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
4I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus, 5who helps you speak and understand so well. 6Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true. 7You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return. 8And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent. 9God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ.
Taking Sides
10My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think. 11Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other. 12 They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
13Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name? 14 I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius. 15Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name. 16 I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else. 17Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power.
Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
18The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work. 19 As God says in the Scriptures,
“I will destroy the wisdom
of all who claim
to be wise.
I will confuse those
who think they know
so much.”
20 What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish? 21 God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him.
Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach. 22Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise. 23But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish. 24Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen. 25Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
26My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families. 27But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
28What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important. 29God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him. 30You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy. 31 So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl wolo Wɛ na kuri-ne de o tete boboŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto, ye dé nu-bu Sɔsɔdane mo tɔge o woli-ne. 2Dé popone se dé pa abam balo na ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á zoore Korinti ne to mo. Abam maa ye balo Wɛ na kuri se á ta‑á ye wose Yezu Krista ŋwaane to. O ma le abam se á ta‑á ye o nɔɔna, ko woli de balo na wo jei maama ne ye ba zuli Yezu Krista to. Wonto maa ye ba maama Teiru, ye o ye debam de Teiru.
3Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
4Maŋa maama amo yeini a ke Wɛ lei abam ŋwaane, de o na ke zaane abam yuu ne Yezu Krista ŋwaane to. 5Abam na me de Yezu to, Wɛ seene o woli abam de yuu-yeino maama se á ta‑á wae á ŋɔɔne o taane dem, ye á kwori á yei o chega kam maama. 6Konto to, Yezu Krista taane dem dé déem na tage de abam to tiini de ji chega abam tei ne. 7Á nɛ Wɛ pɛɛra yalo maama á na lage to ye á cheigi dé Teiru Yezu Krista se o jwoori o ba se dé na‑o. 8Wonto wó taa nii abam baŋa ne taa, se á wae á ta‑á zege lanyerane se ko taa vei o dɛ-kamunu kom, se tusim daa yé taa wo abam de Wɛ laŋa ne. 9Wɛ zege o chega wone mo, ye wonto mo kuri abam se á me de o bu Yezu Krista na ye debam Teiru wom.
Korinti tiina jege popɔra daane
10A nu-bia bam, a lwoori abam dé Teiru Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane se á ta‑á jege ni-mɔrɔ, se á yé ta‑á pɔɔre daane. Kwaane-na á ke á boboŋa daane se á ke ni dedwe. 11Kokuri, Cheloa ba sɔŋɔ tiina badaara tage de amo we, á mage ni-kantɔgɔ mo daane. 12Ko na ye tei to, abam badaara we, á tɔge Pɔɔl mo. Abam badwonna maa we, á tɔge Apolo. Badwonna maa we, ba tɔge Piita. Badwonna de maa we, ba tɔge Yezu Krista. 13Á na pɔɔre pɔɔre Yezu Krista konto to, ko jege kuri na? Amo Pɔɔl mo tege dagara kam yuu ne naa wɔ mo? Á na jwoŋi sɛɛm to, á jwoŋi se á sɛ Pɔɔl mo na? 14A ke Wɛ lei, kolo ŋwaane amo wo pɛ abam wolowolo sɛɛm, ko ná dae Kirisipu de Gayus yerane. 15Konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ta we, á jwoŋi sɛɛm amo ŋwaane. 16A ya swei woŋo fee. A pɛ Stefana sɔŋɔ tiina de sɛɛm. Ko daare konto kwaga ne, wolo ná woli da, a daa ware a guli. 17Yezu Krista toŋe-ne se a taa tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam mo a bere nɔɔna, ye ko dae se a taa pae nɔɔna sɛɛm. A na ŋɔɔne Wɛ taane tei to, ko dae logo baŋa swa mo a maa ŋɔɔna. A ya ná ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi, a ya wó kwoli Yezu yere, pa se o toone dem dagara kam yuu ne ya bá taa jege chega nɔɔna tei ne.
Wɛ swa yam gare nabiina swa
18Ko ye chega mo we, Yezu toone dem dagara kam yuu ne ye jworim taane mo balo yiga na tera de Wɛ to tei ne. Ko nam ná ye debam balo o na jwoŋi o yage to tei ne, ko bere Wɛ tete dam jaja mo. 19Ko nam maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we:
“Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó chɔge swa tiina bam boboŋa,
ye a daare a pa yi-pore-nyena bam yi-poro kom yaale.”
20Swa tiina swa yam daa jege kuri na? Tɔn-yeena, de nɔɔna balo na yei ŋɔŋa to yi-poro kom jege kuri na? Wɛ nam bere debam we, logo baŋa swa yam maama ye jworim mo. 21Wɛ tete swa ŋwaane mo pae nabiina bá wane ba ma ba tete swa ba lɔre‑o. O nam ke o boboŋa ne se o tɔge taane delo dé na bere nɔɔna ye ba pae de ye jworim to ŋwaane mo o ma jwoŋi balo na sɛ-de to o yage. 22Juu tiina lage se ba na wo-kenkagela yalo na bere Wɛ chega kam to mo. Girisi tiina maa lage se ba cheigi taane delo na wó bere-ba swa to. 23Ko ná ye debam, dé ŋɔɔne Yezu Krista wolo na tege dagara yuu ne to taane mo. Taane dem konto maa ye ta-balɔrɔ mo Juu tiina tei ne. De maa ye jworim mo de pae dwi-gɛ tiina. 24Ko daare debam balo Wɛ na kuri to tei ne, ko ná ye Juu tiina de dwi-gɛ tiina de, taane dem konto mo pae de lɔre we, Yezu Krista ye Wɛ dam tu, de o swa tu. 25Woŋo kolo nɔɔna na pae ko ye jworim Wɛ tei ne to gare nabiina swa maama, ye kolo na bwomma o tei ne to dana ko dwoi nabiina dam.
26A nu-bia bam, boŋe-na á nii á déem na ye tei ye Wɛ laam ba o kuri abam to. Ko dae á dedɛ yi déem mo poore, nenɛɛne nabiina na lage yi-poro kolo to. Ko dae á dedɛ mo ye dedɛɛra, naa á dedɛ mo nwoŋi naduna sam. 27Wɛ nam paale o kuri wonnu telo nabiina na pae te ye wo-jworru to mo, se o ma pa chaveera di swa tiina. O ma kuri wonnu telo nabiina na pae te ye wo-bwonnu to, se o ma pa chaveera di dedɛɛra. 28O ma daare o kuri wo-yɔɔro de wo-korro telo maama nabiina na gwooni to, se o ma pa wonnu telo nabiina na pae te jege nyɔɔre to ji kafɛ. 29Wɛ kuri wonnu tento dwoŋi mo, se nabiina yé na chwoŋa se ba taa jege fia o yiga ne. 30Wɛ nam mo pɛ se abam me de Yezu Krista. Konto ŋwaane mo swa yalo Yezu na jwoŋi Wɛ tei ne to laam jigi debam swa. Wonto mo pae dé jege chega Wɛ tei ne, ye dé bochara fɔge ya kwɛ fase. O ma daare o kwei o tete ŋwea o ma vere debam wɛleera jeŋa ne o yage. 31Konto to, kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to ye chega mo, de ko na we, “Wolo ná boŋe se o taa mage o nyɔɔne, se o pa ko taa ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane.”

english_text:
Telling about Christ and the Cross
1Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise. 2In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
3 At first, I was weak and trembling with fear. 4When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power. 5That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
6We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear. 7We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began. 8 The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross. 9 But it is just as the Scriptures say,
“What God has planned
for people who love him
is more than eyes have seen
or ears have heard.
It has never even
entered our minds!”
10God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God. 11You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind. 12But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
13Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people. 14This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish. 15People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others. 16 The Scriptures ask,
“Has anyone ever known
the thoughts of the Lord
or given him advice?”
But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_text:
1A nu-bia bam, a déem na tu abam tei to, amo wo bere a tete se a pa a ni taane de a swa taa gare abam, de a na tɔɔle Wɛ taane dem a bere abam tei to. 2A wo ke a boboŋa ne se a bere abam kolokolo, ko ná dae Yezu Krista de o toone dem dagara kam yuu ne to taane yerane. 3A na wo abam tei ne to, a déem tiini a bwona de abam, ye foone tiini de jege-ne, ye a yera sae. 4A ŋɔŋa kam de a na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam tei to dae swa mo a kea se a pa á sɛ taane dem. Ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom de o dam mo pɛ se á lɔre we, taane dem ye chega. 5Konto to, á na ke á wo-dedoa de Yezu to, ko tɔge Wɛ dam dem ŋwaane mo, se ko dae nabiina swa ŋwaane.
6Dé nam yeini dé bere balo boboŋa na kweere to mo swa, ye ko dae nabiina swa, naa logo baŋa dedɛɛra bam swa. Banto wó ba ba ti de ba dam dem maama. 7Debam na bere swa yalo to ye Wɛ swa mo. Nabiina nam yeiri ya ni ne, Wɛ na seigi-ya ba yiga ne to ŋwaane. Faŋa faŋa ye logo baŋa ta tera to, Wɛ déem maŋe o ke o boboŋa ne se dé da swa yam konto ŋwaane mo dé na paare o tei ne. 8Logo baŋa dedɛɛra bam wolowolo nam wo lɔre ya kuri. Ba ya ná yei, ba ya bá ja Wɛ telaao paare tu Yezu ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go. 9Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere o swa yam taane we:
“Wɛ fɔge o ke wo-laaro o tiŋi,
se o pa balo na swoi‑o to.
Nabiina yi wo nɛ wonnu tem konto dwoŋi,
ye ba zwa wo nigi te ŋwa.
Ba maa ba jege te boboŋa de.”
10De ko de, Wɛ dɛ o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo o ma pa dé lɔre wonnu tem konto. Wɛ Sin-laao kom yeini ko da woŋo maama naga mo. Ko maa yei Wɛ wo de o boboŋa de. 11Wɔ mo wó wane o lɔre nɔɔno wodwoŋi boboŋa, ye ko dae o tete jworo? Ko nam na ye konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri Wɛ boboŋa, ko ná dae o tete Jworo kom yerane. 12Jworo kolo Wɛ na ke debam bochara ne to dae logo baŋa nyem. Ko nam nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo se ko pa dé lɔre wo-laaro telo o na pɛ debam zɛɛra to.
13Dé yeini dé bere nɔɔna chega kam konto, ye botare selo dé na ŋɔɔne to dae nabiina swa botare. Ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo bere debam botare selo na maŋe se dé taa ŋɔɔne to. Dé tɛ chega kalo na ye Wɛ nyem to dé bere balo o Jworo kom na wo ba bochara ne to mo. 14Wɛ Jworo kom na tere wolo bochare ne to ba sɛ se o jwoŋi ko wo-laaro tem. Te maama ye wo-jworru mo o tei ne. O bá wane o lɔre te kuri, kolo ŋwaane ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo bere te kuri chekke. 15Wolo maama Wɛ Jworo kom na wo o bochare ne to mo wae o yei woŋo maama kuri chekke. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane o mage banto puga o nii. 16Ko ye chega mo, de Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na bere tei we:
“Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lɔre Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa,
se o bere‑o o na wó ke tei to.”
Dé Teiru Yezu Krista boboŋa dedaane debam boboŋa nam ye bedwe mo.

english_text:
Working Together for God
1My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned. 2 So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot, 3because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
4 Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave? 5Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen. 6 I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow. 7What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow. 8The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do. 9Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building.
Only One Foundation
10God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build, 11because Christ is the only foundation. 12-13Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw. 14We will be rewarded if our building is left standing. 15But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
16 All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you. 17Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
18Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise. 19 This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.” 20 The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.” 21-22So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you, 23and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_text:
Wɛ tontoŋena na toŋe ba pa Wɛ tei to
1A nu-bia bam, amo déem na wo abam tei ne to, a ware a ŋɔɔne Wɛ taane de abam ne Jworo kom na wo balo tei ne to. A déem ŋɔɔne de abam nenɛɛne á ye balo logo baŋa wonnu fera na jege-ba to ye á ta ye bu-balɛ mo Yezu Krista tei ne. 2A déem na bere abam wo-mwaalo telo to nye de a pɛ abam nayela mo se á nyɔ. A déem wo pɛ abam wodiu, kolo ŋwaane á déem wo yi ko dim. De zem de, á daa ta wo yi wodiu dim, 3kolo ŋwaane á ta ye balo logo baŋa wonnu fera na jege-ba to mo. Abam jege wo-goo ye á mage ni-kantɔgɔ daane. Konto bere we logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro fera mo ta jege abam, ye á tɔge balo ta na yeiri Wɛ to kikia. A fɔ vwa na? 4Abam dedoa ná tɛ o we, o tɔge Pɔɔl mo, ye wodwoŋi de ná we, o tɔge Apolo mo, ko dae balo na yeiri Wɛ to kikia mo konto na?
5Wɔ mo ye Apolo? Wɔ mo ye amo Pɔɔl? Debam maama ye Wɛ tontoŋena mo, ye Wɛ dɛ debam ŋwaane mo o pa á sɛ Yezu Krista. Debam maama toŋe kolo dé Teiru wom na pɛ debam se dé ke to mo. 6Amo Pɔɔl mo dugi wonnu abam bochara ne. Apolo ma yage na da, ye te puli. Ko daare ko ye Wɛ mo pɛ te be. 7Mo kokuri, wolo na dugi to, de wolo na yage na da to maama dae kolokolo. Wɛ yerane mo wae o pae o taane dem ke dam nɔɔna bochara ne. 8Wolo na dugi to de wolo na yage na to maama ye bedwe mo. Wɛ wó pa ba maama jwoŋi ba ŋweero ko maŋe de ba na toŋe tei to mo. 9Debam maama toŋe daane mo dé pa Wɛ. Abam nye de Wɛ kara kalo dé na dugi ka wone to mo.
Abam daa ta nye de diga kalo Wɛ na wora o lɔ to mo. 10Wɛ na zeini amo se a toŋe totoŋe delo to ye amo beiri diga kam kuri mo, ne lɔro na yei o totoŋa chekke tei to. Nɔɔno wodwoŋi de maa wora o lɔa o daŋe da. Wolo maama nam na lage se o lɔ o daŋe da to jege se o taa yei o na lɔ tei to mo. 11Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o beiri diga kam kuri, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ maŋe o pa Yezu Krista ji kuri delo yerane na ye chekke to mo o beiri-ka. 12Wolo na wó lɔ o daŋe da to wae o kwei sabu-seŋa, naa lu-nyenno, naa kandwa-nyenno, naa dɛ, naa ga-korro o maa lɔa. 13Nɔɔno maama na toŋe kolo to nam wó ba ko lɔre jaja. Yezu Krista tutuuri dɛ dem ná yia, de wó ba de mini mo. Mini dem mo wó bere nɔɔno maama totoŋa na ye tei. 14Balo na mɛ wo-laaro ba lɔ ye mini dem wo wane de di to wó jwoŋi ba ŋweero. 15Ko daare balo mini dem na wane de di ba lɔɔm dem to wó ga woŋo maama. Nɔɔna bam tete bá te. Ba nam wó taa nye de mini na di nɔɔno ye o wori tei to mo.
16Wɛ Jworo kom na wo abam bochara ne to, á nye de Wɛ tete diga kalo o na zoore ka wone to mo. Á yeiri konto na? 17Wolo nam ná chɔge Wɛ diga kam, Wɛ wó chɔge kotu de. Wɛ diga kam ye wose mo. Abam tete nam mo ye o diga kam konto.
18Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé zaŋe o gane o tete. Abam wolo ná boŋe we o jege swa, ne zem logo baŋa swa na ye tei to, konto tu jege se o jwoori o ji nɔn-jworo mo, se o laam wane o na swa chekke. 19Kokuri logo baŋa swa yam ye jworim mo Wɛ yiga ne. Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Wɛ vugimi swa tiina swa yam pa ya jwoori ya ja-ba.” 20Ko daa ta popone we, “Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o yei swa tiina na boŋe ba ja kolo to. O yei we ba boboŋa yam ye kafɛ mo.” 21Konto ŋwaane, nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé zaŋe o mage o nyɔɔne de o na tɔge nabiinu wolo to. Woŋo maama ye abam nyem mo. 22Ko ná ye amo Pɔɔl, de Apolo, de Piita, debam de ye abam nyem mo. Ko nam ná ye logo baŋa, de ŋwea, de toone, de zem, de jwa de, abam mo tei te maama. 23Yezu Krista nam mo tei abam, ye Wɛ tei Yezu Krista tete de.

english_text:
The Work of the Apostles
1Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways. 2And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for, 3it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself. 4I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge. 5So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
6Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other. 7What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag? 8Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
9It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us. 10Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected. 11Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live. 12 We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient. 13When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
14I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children. 15Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus, 16 and I want you to be like me. 17This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
18Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging. 19But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power. 20God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power. 21What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_text:
Yezu Krista tontoŋena taane
1Abam na boŋe tei to, á jege se á ta‑á yei we debam ye Yezu Krista tontoŋena mo. Wɛ nam kwei o chega kalo ya na seigi nabiina yiga ne to o ke debam jeŋa ne se dé taa nii ka baŋa ne. 2Nmo nam ná kwei n wonnu n ke nɔɔno jeŋa ne se o taa nii te baŋa ne, ko maŋe se konto tu taa ye jawala tu mo. 3-4Ko ná ye amo, abam naa nabiina maama ná di amo taane tei de tei, a yiga tera. Amo boboŋa ne, kolokolo tera a na ke a chɔge. De konto de, a bá wane a ta we a yɔɔre a jege chega, a na bá wane a bore a tete bora to ŋwaane. Wolo yerane na wó bore amo bora to mo ye dé Teiru wom. 5Konto ŋwaane, cheigi-na dé Teiru wom, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wuuri o di o dwoŋi taane. O ná tua, o wó ja pwooni o ba o pa woŋo kolo maama na seigi lim wone to taa nae jaja. Wonto wó pa nɔɔna boboŋ-lilirru tem lɔre jaja. Maŋa kam konto ne mo nɔɔno maama wó na zula yalo na maŋe se o na Wɛ tei ne to.
6A nu-bia bam, ko ye abam ŋwaane mo a kwei a tete dedaane Apolo a ma maŋe a bere abam, se á wane á nii debam á ma lɔre á na wó ta‑á tɔge tei to, se á yé sa chwoŋa de kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone to. Konto to, nam yé bere-na á tete kamunim se á zuli nɔɔno ye á daare á gwooni o dwoŋi. 7Ko ná ye nmo, wɔ mo pɛ‑m kanto zega kam jei? Bɛ mo n jega ye n wo jwoŋi-ko Wɛ tei ne? Nmo nam na jwoŋi to, bɛ mo kea ye n mage n nyɔɔne ko baŋa ne, ne nmo tete mo mɛ n dam de n swa n ma n na-ko tei?
8Abam boŋe we, á maŋe á jege kolo maama á na lage to, á kwori á ye naduna, ye á ta boŋe we abam di paare á daare debam. Ko ya maŋe se á seene á di paare, se debam de taa tɔge dé ye pwa. 9Amo na boŋe tei to, ko nye de Wɛ kwei debam balo na ye o totoŋa nakwa to o zege kwaga kwaga mo, nenɛɛne ba na jaane balo ba vei se ba go to mo. Debam ye balo na jigi nɔn-mwanno to mo woŋo maama tei ne, de nabiina de malese de tei ne. 10Debam jigi nɔn-jworru mo Yezu Krista ŋwaane, ye abam pa á ye swa tiina mo o tei ne. Debam maa bwomma, ye abam pae á dana. Nɔɔna zuli abam, ye ba daare ba ba nege debam. 11De zem de, kana de na-nyɔm jege debam, ye dé zo gare-zenzwanno. Nɔɔna maa bɛɛse debam, ye dé ba jege dé tete diga se dé peini da. 12Dé mae dé tete jea mo dé toŋa pa dé yera nyɔna. Nɔɔna ná jege debam ba twea, dé yeini dé kwei Wɛ zaane mo dé ma swɛ ba swolim. Nɔɔna ná bɛɛse debam, dé yeini dé vɔ pu-dɛa mo. 13Nɔɔna ná yaale debam, dé yeini dé jwoori dé tɛ wo-ŋonno mo de-ba. Dé jigi logo baŋa weero mo. De zem maama, dé ye wo-yɔɔro mo nɔɔno maama tei ne.
14Amo na popone kolo to, a popone se ko woli abam se á tɔge chwo-laao mo, á na ye amo bu-swonnu to ŋwaane, se ko dae we a lage se chaveera mo ja abam. 15A yei we nɔɔna morro dedɛ mo wó taa wora ba na nii abam baŋa ne se ba kale abam ba de Yezu Krista chwoŋa kam ne. De ko de, á kwoa nam ba daga. Amo yerane mo ye á kwo, de amo na tɔge Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam baŋa ne a pa á na ŋwe-doŋa Yezu Krista ŋwaane to. 16Mo kokuri, a lwoori abam se á ta‑á lwoni amo totoŋ-naga kam. 17Konto ŋwaane mo a lage a toŋe Timoti á tei ne. Wonto ye a bu-swono, ye o jege jawala de o na tɔge dé Teiru Yezu tei to. Wonto wó guli o bere abam amo na yeini a tɔge Yezu Krista chwoŋa kam tei to, ne ko na maŋe de chega kalo amo na bere Yezu kɔgɔ kom jei maama ne tei to.
18Abam badaara pae á tete kamunni mo, ye á daa ba teene we amo wó jwoori abam tei. 19Wɛ ná sɛ, a nam wó ba abam tei leile. A ná tua, a laam wó wane a lɔre dam delo kamun-nyena bam na seene ba jega, ye ko dae ba ŋɔŋa yerane to. 20Wɛ paare dem pae dam mo, se ko dae ni-ŋɔŋa yerane. 21Ko daare abam tei ne mo se á bwɛ á nii, a ba a vaŋe á zwɛ, naa a bere swono se a fɔge a ke abam lanyerane?

english_text:
Immoral Followers
1 I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother. 2You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
3-4I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too. 5You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
6 Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough? 7 Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed. 8 So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
9In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people. 10But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols. 11I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them! 12Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members? 13 God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_text:
Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wone wo-zɔɔna taane
1Amo nam nigi abam labaare we, abam wone nɔɔno dedoa kare o ke bwoŋa mo. Baaro mo tigi de o kwo kaane. Balo na yeiri Wɛ to de maŋe ba ba sɛ ba ke wo-zɔɔna yanto dwoŋi. 2O na ke konto to, bɛ mo ye á pae á tete kamunni? Ko ya maŋe se á wo chɔge ko ŋwaane, se á daare á le nɔɔno wom konto á wone. 3Amo tete mo tera abam tei ne, ye á boboŋa tiini ya wo amo yuu ne. Konto to, amo maŋe a ve baaro wonto bora o chɔgem dem ŋwaane, ne a wo abam tei ne mo tei. 4-5Mo kokuri a tɛ abam dé Teiru Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane we, á ná tigisi daane á ti, se á ma amo boboŋa yam dedaane de Teiru Yezu dam dem na wora de abam konto to á ma á kwei nɔɔno wom á ke setaana pɛ jeŋa ne. Konto baŋa ne, setaana pɛ ná chɔge nɔɔno wom yera o wo-zɔɔna fera yalo o na jege to ŋwaane, konto tu jworo kom laam wó wane ko na verem dé Teiru Yezu dɛ-kamunu kom ne.
6Abam teera yam ba lana. Á yei we sabɔle fenfee ná wora bworobworo mun-lɛɛre wone, ko laam wó pa te maama fole mo. Keim-lɔŋɔ de ye konto mo. 7Konto ŋwaane, le-na sabɔl-dwoori dem á wone, se de yé lɔgese á maama. Konto mo wo-digiru bá taa wo á wone, ye á laam wó ta‑á ye nenɛɛne bworobworo mun-lɛɛre delo ba na wo ke sabɔle de wone to. Á seene á ye wose mo, kolo ŋwaane Yezu Krista kwei o tete o kaane Wɛ á wɛleera saarem ŋwaane, pa o nye de pipeila kalo ba déem na yeini ba goe Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem ŋwaane to. 8Pa-na dé ke ne banto na ke tei ye ba le sabɔl-dwoori maama ba sam ne ba dole ba yage to. Ko ná ye debam, pa-na dé le lwarem kikia dedaane totoŋ-balwaaro maama dé wone, ye dé daare dé taa jege wo-pwoŋo de chega, ye wo-digiru daa bá taa wo dé wone. Konto nye de ba déem na yeini ba kwei bworobworo kolo na ba jege sabɔle ko wone to mo ba ma ba di Bworobworo-memene kuri dem.
9Amo déem na dɛ yiga a popone tɔnɔ kolo a pa abam to, a tage de abam se á yé ta‑á tɔge dedaane balo na kare ba ke kabwoŋa to. 10Amo na kaane abam konto to, ko dae balo na yeiri Wɛ ye ba ye ka-lagena, naa nɔn-kwollu, naa venverena, naa jwo-kaana to taane mo a tɛa. Abam bá wane á pwɛ á tete de logo baŋa nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi. 11Amo nam na popone kolo to kuri mo ye se á yé ta‑á tɔge de wolo maama na bere we o ye á nu-bu ye o ye ka-lageno, naa nɔn-kwolo, naa jwo-kaano, naa nɔn-tweeno, naa sa-nyɔro, naa venvereno to. Ko ná ye nɔɔno wonto dwoŋi, se á pwɛ á tete de kotu, se á bere á yé di wodiu dedaane‑o de.
12-13Ko ná ye balo na dae dé nu-bia Yezu ŋwaane to, amo bá wane a di banto taane. Ko ye Wɛ mo wó di ba taane. Abam nam jege se á di balo na wo á kɔgɔ kom wone to taane. Konto ŋwaane, zeili-na wo-lwan-keiru wom á wone.

english_text:
Taking Each Other to Court
1When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people? 2Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems? 3Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters. 4Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church? 5I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another? 6Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
7When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed. 8But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.
9Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual 10will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others. 11Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God.
Honor God with Your Body
12 Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me. 13You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies. 14God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
15Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't! 16 Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.” 17But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
18Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is. 19 You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own. 20God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_text:
Yezu kɔgɔ kom taana kwɛɛm
1Abam wolo ná jege taane de o dwoŋi, ye á ye nu-biu Yezu ŋwaane, bɛ mo ye nmo wó ja taane dem n vo kɔɔte, se balo na yeiri Wɛ to di abam taane dem? Ko nam maŋe se Wɛ nɔɔna bam mo di á taane dem. 2Wɛ nɔɔna bam mo wó ba ba di nabiina maama taane. Á yeiri konto na? Konto ŋwaane, bɛ mo kea ye á ware á di ta-balwa á pa á tete? 3Á yeiri we debam mo wó di malese sem taane na? Konto to, dé bá wane zem taana yam dé di na? 4Abam nam ná jege taane konto dwoŋi á wone, bɛ mo ye á ja á vo balo na dae kolokolo Yezu nɔɔna bam yiga ne to tei? 5A tage tento maama se chaveera mo ja abam. Ko wó taa ye chega we, swa tu tere abam wone se o wane o fɔge abam balo na ye nu-biu to daane na? 6Abam na yeini á ke tei to ba lana. Abam wone nɔɔno dedoa yeini o saŋe o nu-bu kɔɔte ne, pa se balo na yeiri Wɛ to di o taane.
7Abam nam ná saŋe daane konto, ko bere we á maŋe á ga bora mo. N nu-bu ná ke‑m wo-lɔŋɔ, naa o ná ŋɔge‑m, ko ya lana se n yage n ma n chɛ‑o mo. 8Ko nam na ye tei to, abam tete yeini á ke wo-lwanno mo, ye á ŋɔne daane, dedaane á nu-bia bam de. 9Á yeiri we balo na ba tɔge chwo-laao to bá na jeiŋa jei Wɛ paare dem ne na? Yé zaŋe-na á gane á tete. Balo na ye ka-lagena, naa jwo-kaana, naa ka-ziina, naa baywallo, naa balo na peini de-ba to, 10naa ŋweena, naa nɔn-kwollu, naa sa-nyɔra, naa nɔn-tweena, naa venverena to bá na jeiŋa jei Wɛ woro kom ne. 11Abam badaara déem ke konto dwoŋi mo. Wɛ nam saare á wɛleera yam maama, se á ta‑á ye wose ye á jege chega o tei ne. Wɛ dɛ dé Teiru Yezu de o Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane mo o ke konto o pa abam.
Dé yera yam chɔgem taane
12Abam badaara we, kolokolo daa tera ko na chula á tei ne. Amo nam tɛ we, ko dae woŋo maama mo jege nyɔɔre ko pa abam. Amo ná tage a we, kolokolo daa tera ko na chula amo tei ne, amo nam bá sɛ se a pa kolokolo taa jege dam se ko wane ko fe amo. 13Abam yeini á we, Wɛ ke wodiu de kana mo se ba taa zeini daane. Maŋa nam wó ba ye Wɛ ja wodiu de kana maama o chɔge. Wɛ nam wo mɔɔne dé yera yam o pa debam se dé taa mae dé ke kabwoŋa. Wɛ mɔɔne dé yera yam se dé Teiru Yezu mo taa tei-ya, ye dé kwori dé taa ma-ya dé toŋe dé pa‑o. 14Wɛ mɛ o dam mo o bi dé Teiru Yezu toone wone. Maŋa nam wó ba ye o bi debam de toone wone.
15Á yeiri we á yera yam ye Yezu Krista yera yam daa dedoa mo na? Abam yera yam de Yezu yera yam na ye bedwe konto to, á yé zaŋe á kwei-ya á ma á peini de ka-tola, kokuri á yera yam de wonto yera yam wó ji bedwe mo. 16Kokuri, wolo ná peini de ka-tola, kotu de ka-tola kam maama laam jigi woŋo dedoa mo. Á yeiri konto na? Wɛ tɔnɔ kom tage we, “Banto balei wó ji yera dedoa mo.” 17Wolo nam ná me de dé Teiru Yezu, kotu jworo de Yezu jworo maama ye bedwe mo.
18Nam yage-na kabwoŋa kikia maama. Keim-balwaaro telo maama nɔɔno na wó ke to, o bá ke o yage o yera wone. Nɔɔno nam ná ke kabwoŋa, konto ye keim-balɔrɔ kolo o na ke o yage o yera wone to mo. 19Á yeiri we á yera yam nye de Wɛ tete diga kam ye o Sin-laao kom mo zoore ka wone na? Wɛ seene o ke o Jworo kom á bochara ne mo. Konto ŋwaane, á daa ba tei á tete. 20Á ye Wɛ nyem mo. O yeigi abam de o kwora mo. Konto ŋwaane, kwei-na á yera yam á ma á toŋe se ko pa Wɛ na yere.

english_text:
Questions about Marriage
1Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?” 2Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral. 3Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex. 4A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself. 5So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control. 6In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter. 7I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
8My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am. 9But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
10 I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband 11should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
12I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her. 13If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him. 14Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
15If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace. 16And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower?
Obeying the Lord at All Times
17In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you. 18 If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised. 19Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands. 20So don't try to change what you were when God chose you. 21Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should. 22When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ. 23God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else. 24Stay what you were when God chose you.
Unmarried People
25I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness. 26We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are. 27If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married. 28It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
29My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not. 30It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke. 31It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
32I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord. 33But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife. 34So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband. 35What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
36But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that. 37But it is better to have self-control and to make up your mind not to marry. 38It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
39A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord. 40However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_text:
Banna de ba kaana taane
1A lage a leiri á na popone á bwei amo taana yalo to mo a pa abam.
Baaro ná wane o ja o tete kaana baŋa ne, ko wó taa lana. 2Ko nam ba lana se baara taa lage kaana yɔɔ yɔɔ. Konto ŋwaane, ko maŋe se baaro maama taa jege o tete kaane, se kaane maama de taa jege o tete baro. 3Baaro yé zaŋe o ve se o peini de o kaane. Kaane nam yé ve se o peini de o baro. 4Kaane ba tei o tete yera, ko ye o baro mo tei-ya. Baaro de nam ba tei o tete yera, ko ye o kaane de mo tei-ya. 5Yé zaŋe-na á ve se á ta‑á tigi daane, ko ná dae we á maama mo sɛ se á yage da-peiga, se á wane á seene á yia á lwoori Wɛ se ko taa vei maŋa kalo á na lage to. Maŋa kam konto ná yia, se á jwoori á ta‑á tigi daane. Ko ná dae konto, setaana pɛ wó soge abam pa á tusi, á na ware á tete á ja to ŋwaane.
6Amo na popone banna de kaana taane konto to, a tage se ko woli abam mo, se ko dae we a lage a fe abam. 7Amo ya wó taa lage se nɔɔno maama taa ye ne amo na ye tei to. Wɛ pɛɛra nam ye teiri teiri mo ye o pa nɔɔno maama o nyem.
8Ko daare abam balo na ye badeina de kadeina to, a lage a ta de abam we, ko lana se á ta‑á ye á yerane konto, ne amo de na ye tei to. 9Á nam ná ware á tete á ja, ko maŋe se á di kaana naa á zo banna mo. Konto gare á ná pae ka-laga fera tiini ya zo abam. 10-11Ko ná ye banna de ba kaana, ko ye fefeo mo se kaane yé yage o baro, se baro de yé yage o kaane. Konto dae amo tete ni, ko ye dé Teiru Yezu mo pɛ-ne ni dem konto. Kaane nam ná maŋe o yage o baro, ko maŋe se o jwoori o vo o baro wom tei mo se ba fɔge daane. Ko ná dae konto, o daa yé zaŋe o zo baro wodwoŋi.
12Ko daare baaro wolo na tɔge Yezu to ná jege kaane wolo na ba tɔge Yezu to, ye kaane wom ná sɛ se ba taa zoore daane, baaro wom ba jege chwoŋa se o yage o kaane wom. Ko ye amo mo pɛ ni dem konto, se ko dae dé Teiru Yezu mo pɛ-de. 13Kaane wolo nam ná tɔge Yezu ye o baro ná ba tɔge Yezu, ye o baro wom ná sɛ se ba taa zoore daane, se o yé zaŋe o yage o baro wom. 14Wɛ mo le baro wolo na wo sɛ Yezu to pa o ji o nyem, o kaane wom na tɔge Yezu to ŋwaane. Wɛ ta kwori o le kaane wolo na wo sɛ Yezu to pa o ji o nyem, o baro wom na tɔge Yezu to ŋwaane. Ko ya ná dae konto, ba bia bá taa ye ba yera Wɛ ŋwaane. Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ mo le ba bia bam pa ba ye o nyem.
15Wolo wom na ba tɔge Yezu to ná boŋe se o viiri, ko ná maŋe ko ye kaane wom naa baro wom de, se á yage‑o se o viiri. Wolo na daare ye o tɔge Yezu to laam wó taa tei o tete. Wɛ na bwoŋi debam se dé taa tɔge‑o to, ko ye se dé taa zoore daane de wo-zuru mo. 16Kaane, nmo na tɔge Yezu to, n wó ke tɛ mo n lɔre we, n wó wane n jwoŋi n baro wom n ke Wɛ jeŋa ne, naa n bá‑n wane n jwoŋi‑o? Baro, n de wó ke tɛ mo n lɔre we, n wó wane n kaane wom n jwoŋi n ke Wɛ jeŋa ne, naa n bá‑n wane n jwoŋi‑o?
17Abam déem na ye tei ye Wɛ bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, á ta ta‑á ye konto, se ko maŋe de dé Teiru wom na mɔɔne abam tei to. Mo kolo a na bere Yezu kɔgɔ kom jeiga maama ne to. 18Wɛ déem na bwoŋi abam to, á wolo déem ná maŋe o gwoni o peini, konto tu yé kwaane se o taa seigi o tete o peini dem gwonim ŋwaane. Ko daare wolo déem nam ná maŋe o wo gwoni o peini, o daa yé kwaane se o gwoni-de. 19Kokuri peini delo na gwoni de delo na wo gwoni to maama ba ke kolokolo. Woŋo kolo na jege kuri to mo ye se nɔɔno seene o yia de Wɛ nia yam tɔgem.
20Nɔɔno maama déem na ye tei ye Wɛ bwoŋi‑o to, ko maŋe se o ta taa ye konto mo. 21Wɛ déem ná bwoŋi wolo ye o ye kabaa, se kotu yé pa ko taa daane‑o. O nam ná nɛ chwoŋa se o taa tei o tete, se o sɛ se ko taa ye konto. 22Wolo maama déem na ye nɔɔno kabaa ye Wɛ bwoŋi‑o se o taa tɔge dé Teiru Yezu to, konto tu laam tei o tete, dé Teiru wom na jwoŋi‑o to ŋwaane. Wolo de déem na tei o tete ye Wɛ bwoŋi‑o to, konto tu laam nye de kabaa mo Yezu Krista tei ne. 23Á ye Wɛ nyem mo. O yeigi abam de o kwora mo. Mo kokuri yé zaŋe-na á ji kabɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno tei ne.
24Konto ŋwaane, a nu-bia bam, abam maama déem na ye tei ye Wɛ bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, se á ta ta‑á ye konto o yiga ne.
25Ko daare bukwa balo ta na wo zo banna to, dé Teiru Yezu wo pɛ-ne o ni ba ŋwaane. Amo nam ye wolo dé Teiru wom na duri a yibwona pa se a zege a chega wone to mo. Amo boboŋa na jaane tei to mo tento: 26Amo boŋe we, yaara yalo na wo debam baŋa ne leile to ŋwaane, ko lamma se nɔɔno taa ye o na maŋe o ye tei to mo. 27Konto to, nmo ná jege kaane, se n yé zaŋe n yage‑o. Nmo nam ná ba jege kaane, se n yé zaŋe n ta‑n kwaane se n di kaane. 28Ko dae we, n ná di kaane, n ga n ke wo-lɔŋɔ. Ko nam ta dae we, bukɔ ná zo baro, o ke wo-lɔŋɔ. Banna de ba kaana nam bá sii logo baŋa yaara yam wone. Konto mo a ba lage se á yaare konto dwoŋi.
29A nu-bia bam, a na tɛ konto de abam kolo ŋwaane to mo ye maŋa kam daa ba tiini ka daga se dé maa toŋe Wɛ totoŋa. Ko zege leile konto ko taa via, ko maŋe se balo na jege kaana to taa zoore ne ba wo di kaana mo tei. 30Ko maŋe se balo wo na chɔge to taa zoore ne ba wo wo chɔge mo tei. Balo wo na pwoli to de taa zoore ne ba wo wo pwoli mo tei. Balo na yeigi wonnu to taa zoore ne ba ba tei wonnu tem konto mo tei. 31Balo na ye pipim-piina logo baŋa ne to taa zoore ne ba yi wo su ba jejegero tem mo tei. Kokuri logo baŋa de ko wonnu maama lage te ti mo.
32Amo ba lage se lwia taa jege abam. Wolo na ba jege kaane to yeini o kwei o boboŋa maama o pa dé Teiru Yezu mo, se o taa toŋe o pwoli o wo. 33Wolo na jege kaane to yeini o kwei o boboŋa o ke logo baŋa wonnu wone mo, ye o kwaane o taa toŋa o pwoli o kaane wo. 34Konto bere we, o boboŋa ye yalei mo. Ko ye bedwe mo de busankana, naa kaane wolo na ba jege baro to. Wonto kwei o boboŋa maama mo o pa dé Teiru Yezu, o na lage se o yera de o jworo maama taa ye Wɛ nyem to ŋwaane. Ko daare kaane wolo na jege baro to kwei o boboŋa o ke logo baŋa wonnu wone mo, ye o kwaane se o taa toŋe o pwoli o baro wom wo.
35Amo nam tɛ botare sento se ko woli abam mo. A ba kwaane se ko taa ye fefeo á tei ne. Amo nam lage se a pa á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laao mo, se á seene á yia á ta‑á toŋa á pa dé Teiru Yezu ye á ba jege boboŋa yalei ko wone.
36Nɔɔno wolo ná boŋe we, o wo ke o katɔgɔ lanyerane, ye o fera ná tiini ya zo‑o pa o daa ware o tete o ja, ko maŋe se kotu kwaane o di‑o mo, ne o na boŋe tei to. O ná ke konto, o wo ke wo-lɔŋɔ. 37Nɔɔno wolo nam ná jege boboŋ-dɛɛra ye o wae o tete o jaana, ye kotu ná ke o boboŋa ne we, ko dae fefeo se o di katɔgɔ kom, ye o ná wo di‑o, o ke lanyerane mo. 38Konto to, wolo na di o katɔgɔ to ke lanyerane. Wolo de nam na yage o katɔgɔ kom ye o wo di‑o to tiini o ke lanyerane. 39Kaane ná jege baro, ye o baro wom ta ná ŋwe, o ba jege chwoŋa se o yage‑o. O baro wom nam ná tega, o laam jege chwoŋa se o zo o na lage wolo to. O nam jege se o tɔge dé Teiru wom boboŋa mo o zo baro wodwoŋi. 40Amo nam boŋe we, o ná jei o yerane, o wó taa jege wopwolo dedɛ ko dwoi o daa ná zo baro. Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo amo tei ne, ye a boŋe we konto mo pɛ-ne boboŋa yam konto.

english_text:
Food Offered to Idols
1In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others. 2In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all. 3But God has no doubts about who loves him.
4Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God. 5Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords. 6We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
7Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience. 8But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
9Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything. 10You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols. 11Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for. 12When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ. 13So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_text:
Jwona wodiiru taane
1A lage a ta jwona wodiiru taane mo.
