Dé yei we, dé maama jege yeino. Nam ta‑á yei-na we, nɔɔno ná jege yeino, ko pa‑o kamunni mo. Nɔɔno nam ná jege swono, ko pae zeinim mo. 2Nɔɔno wolo ná boŋe we o yei o tia, ko bere we o ta yeiri kolo na maŋe se o taa yei to mo. 3Wolo nam na swoi Wɛ to, Wɛ yei o de.
4Ko ná ye jwona wodiu kom dim taane dem, dé yei we jwona ba ŋwe, ye Wɛ dedoa yerane mo wora. 5Nabiina jege wonnu tedwonna mo ba maa bwoi we ‘wa’, ko ná ye tega baŋa wonnu naa wɛyuu wonnu de. Wonnu tento daga dedɛ ye nɔɔna bwoi-te we, ba wa de ba yuu tiina. 6Ko nam ná ye debam, Wɛ dedoa yerane mo wora. Debam Kwo wom na ke woŋo maama ye dé ŋwea wo o tei ne to mo konto. Ko daa ta woli da, debam Teiru ye dedoa mo, ye wonto mo ye Yezu Krista. Wɛ na dɛ wolo ŋwaane o ke woŋo maama ye dé ŋwe o ŋwaane to mo wonto.
7Ko nam dae nɔɔno maama mo yei we jwona ba jege dam. Nɔɔna badaara déem me de jwona kaanem mo, ye ba laam ba ba sɛ Wɛ. Konto ŋwaane ba kɔre foone ye ba boŋe we, ba ná di jwoni wodiu, ko wó taa ye nenɛɛne ba jwoori ba sɛ jwona kaanem mo. Ba boboŋa ta na wo kweere Wɛ seeni to, ba boŋe we ba ke ba chɔge mo. 8Wodiu dim dae kolokolo debam de Wɛ laŋa ne. Dé ná chuli wodiiru naa dé ba chula, dé bá jwoŋi kolokolo naa dé ga kolokolo Wɛ yiga ne. 9Ko daare abam balo na ba chuli wodiu dim to, se á ta‑á yei se á wó wane á pa balo boboŋa na wo kweere Wɛ seeni to ke ba tusi, de abam na di jwona wodiiru tem to ŋwaane. 10Nmo wolo na jege yeino ye n boboŋa kweere to ná vei n zo jwoni diga n tɔge n di de wodiu kom, ye n nu-bu wolo boboŋa ta na wo kweere to ná nɛ‑m, konto bá wane ko pa se o boboŋa ja se o de vo o tɔge o di na? 11Konto to, o ná dɛ o di jwoni wodiu kom konto, ko dae nmo mo mɛ n yeino kom n ma n chɔge n nu-bu wolo boboŋa na wo kweere ye o ta ye wolo Yezu Krista na tega o ŋwaane to na? 12Nmo ná yeini n ke keim-balɔrɔ kom konto dwoŋi n chɔge n nu-bia wo, ye n ja ba boboŋa yalo na wo kweere to n chɔge, n ke tusim n chɔge Yezu Krista yiga mo. 13Mo kokuri, wodiu dim ná lage ko pa amo nu-bu tusi, a daa bá fɔge a do nɔna. A ba lage se a pa a nu-bu ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone.

english_text:
The Rights of an Apostle
1I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him. 2Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
3When people question me, I tell them 4that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink. 5We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do. 6Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job? 7Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
8-9 I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox? 10No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
11 When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you. 12If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
13 Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered? 14 In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
15But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this. 16I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed. 17If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do. 18What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
19I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible. 20When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them. 21And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ. 22When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can. 23I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings.
A Race and a Fight
24 You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win! 25 Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever. 26I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air. 27I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl kwaane se o jwoŋi nɔɔna o ke-ba Wɛ jeŋa ne
1Amo ba jege chwoŋa se a kuri a na lage kolo to na? Amo dae Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe mo na? A wo nɛ dé Teiru Yezu Krista tete mo na? Abam na me dedaane dé Teiru Yezu tei to, ko dae amo na toŋe a pa‑o to ŋwaane mo na? 2Nɔɔna badaara ná maŋe ba boŋe we, amo dae Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe chekke, abam bá wane á ve we, amo dae konto. Abam na me dedaane dé Teiru Yezu tei to mo seene ko bere we, amo ye o tontoŋeno chekke.
3Nɔɔna ná lage ba bwei amo ba nii, amo na wó leiri-ba tei to mo tento: 4Amo ba jege chwoŋa se a jwoŋi a ni-wodiu a totoŋa yam baŋa ne na? 5Amo ba jege chwoŋa se a ke nenɛɛne dé Teiru Yezu totoŋa nakwa babam bam, de o nyaana, de Piita na yeini ba ke tei, ye ba jege ba kaana balo de na sɛ Yezu pa ba tɔge daane ba toŋe Wɛ totoŋa to na? 6Amo de Banabas yerane nam mo jege se dé taa toŋa dé lage dé tete ni-wodiu na? 7Nɔɔno ná ye soja tu, o bá wane o jwoori o ŋwe o tete. Nɔɔno ná jege o kara, o ba di ka wonnu na? Nɔɔno ná jege naane o tɔga, o ba di de nayela na?
8A nam tɔge logo baŋa memaŋa yanto yerane baŋa ne mo a ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi na? Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom de maŋe ko bere bedwe mo. 9Ko popone Wɛ nia yalo o na pɛ Moses to tɔnɔ kom wone we, “Nmo ná jege nabea n ma n toŋe n faao, yé vɔ ka ni se ka yé di men-bia bam.” Wɛ bera yam konto zege nabɛ yerane ŋwaane mo na? 10Ko na ye chega to, o tage konto se ko woli debam mo. Ko bere we nɔɔno wolo na vare to de wolo na fere mena o le to maama teene we ba wó na ba teiri mo. 11Debam na toŋe abam tei ne to, ko nye de dé dugi Wɛ chega kam mo á bochara ne. Ko nam wo maŋe se dé jwoŋi dé ni-wodiu abam tei ne na? 12Abam na sɛ se á ta‑á pae nɔɔna badwonna ba ni-wodiu to, ko ya wo maŋe se debam ta dwoi konto na? De ko de, debam nam wo bwei se dé jwoŋi dé ni-wodiu abam tei ne, ne ko ya na jege chwoŋa se dé ke tei to. Dé nam vɔge dé wo woŋo maama baŋa ne, se ko yé wane ko kweele Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam ko yage tega ne.
13Ko ná ye balo na toŋe Wɛ totoŋa o diga kam ne to, ba yeini ba jwoŋi ba ni-wodiu dáane mo. Balo de na jwoŋi vara ba kaane ba pa Wɛ to de jwoŋi ba teiri ko wone mo. Á yeiri konto na? 14Ko nam ye bedwe mo de balo de na tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to. Dé Teiru Yezu pɛ ni we, ba de jwoŋi ba ni-wodiu dáane.
15De ko de, amo nam wo bwei se a jwoŋi kolokolo abam tei ne. Ko nam ta dae we a popone tento se a bobo a taa jwoŋi-te leile mo. Amo nam wó te mo, se a bá za a na ye tei to. A bá sɛ a pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno chwoŋa se o chɔge woŋo kolo a na jege teera ko ŋwaane to. 16A nam bá wane a mage a nyɔɔne a na tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to ŋwaane. Konto ye fefeo mo se a ke. Amo ya ná yage Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam tɔɔlem, ko wó taa ye lɛɛro mo a tei ne. 17A nam ya ná tɔɔle-ka a tete fera ŋwaane, a ya wó taa teene se a jwoŋi ŋweero ka baŋa ne. Ko nam dae a tete boboŋa mo a ke, se ko ye Wɛ mo kwei-de o ke amo jeŋa ne. 18Ko na ye konto to, bɛ ŋweero mo amo wó jwoŋi? Amo nyɔɔre mo ye we, a yeini a tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam zɛɛra, ye a ba bwei se a jwoŋi kolokolo ko ŋwaane, ne a ya na jege chwoŋa se a ke tei to.
19A tei a tete mo ye a dae nɔɔn-nɔɔno kabaa. Amo tete nam mo pɛ a ji kabaa a pa nɔɔna maama, se a wane a na chwoŋa a jwoŋi nɔɔna dedɛ a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. 20Amo na wo Juu tiina bam tei ne to, a de tɔge a zoore ne Juu tu mo tei, se a wane a na chwoŋa a jwoŋi-ba a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. Wɛ nia yalo o na tɔge Moses baŋa ne o pa Juu tiina bam to daa ba tei amo. Amo nam na zoore de Juu tiina to, a dɛ a sɛ-ya mo, se a wane a na chwoŋa a jwoŋi ya na tei balo to a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. 21Ko daare ko ná ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo na ba tɔge Wɛ nia yam to, a na wo ba tei ne to, a tɔge a zoore ne banto mo tei, se a wane a na chwoŋa a jwoŋi-ba a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. Ko nam dae we a yiga tera dedaane Wɛ nia yam, se Yezu Krista nia yam mo tei amo. 22Ko nam ná ye balo boboŋa na wo kweere Wɛ seeni to, a yeini a ji ne banto de mo tei, se a wane a na chwoŋa a jwoŋi-ba a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. Amo ná wo nɔɔna balo maama tei ne, a yeini a ji ne banto mo tei, ye a kwaane a ke a na wó ke tei se a jwoŋi ba badaara a yage.
23Amo na ke tei maama to ye Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane mo, se a wane a na a teiri ka wo-laaro tem baŋa ne. 24Nɔɔna ná kwaane ba duri se ba di yiga, ba maama wó kwaane se ba di mo, ye ba dedoa yerane mo wó di o jwoŋi pɛɛre dem. Abam yeiri konto na? Nam kwaane-na konto dwoŋi se á wane á di yiga á jwoŋi pɛɛre dem. 25Nɔɔno wolo maama na lage se o duri to yeini o tiini o seene o yia mo o ke o tete o ke daane. Banto nam yeini ba ke konto se ba jwoŋi pɛɛre, ye ba pɛɛre dem konto bá dáane de chɔge mo. Ko daare debam pɛɛre delo dé na lage dé jwoŋi to bá fɔge de chɔge maŋa de maŋa. 26Konto mo pae a ba yeini a duri ne wolo na duri yɔɔ yɔɔ to dwoŋi. A nam ba ke jara ne wolo na yeiri jara keim to. 27Amo nam peene a tete mo se a pa a yera lɔre we, amo mo tei-ya. A ke konto se ko yé wane ko pa a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam a bere nɔɔna, se a tete laam ba a ga pɛɛre dem.

english_text:
Don't Worship Idols
1 Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea. 2This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses. 3 All of them also ate the same spiritual food 4 and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ. 5 But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
6What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things. 7 They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols. 8 Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about 23,000 died. Don't do shameful things as they did. 9 And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes. 10 Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel. 11These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
12Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall. 13 You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
14My friends, you must keep away from idols. 15I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about. 16 When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ? 17By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
18 Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there? 19Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all? 20 No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons. 21You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table. 22 We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord.
Always Honor God
23 Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful. 24We should think about others and not about ourselves. 25However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from. 26 The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
27If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from. 28-29But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience? 30If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
31When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God. 32Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church. 33I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_text:
Jwona kaanem taane
1A nu-bia bam, ta‑á guli-na kolo na ke dé kwoa nakwa balo déem na dɛ Moses kwaga ba nwoŋi Ejipti ne to. Wɛ déem mo wo ba maama tei ne, ye o pa kunkwoŋo kom kwoli-ba. O ta ma pɔɔre naneo kom kuni belei o daare chwoŋa pa ba maama tɔge da ba kɛ. 2Konto maama déem na ke to, ko nye de banto maama jwoŋi sɛɛm se ba taa ye Moses tɔgena. 3-4Wɛ déem ke wo-kenkagela o woli ba maama bedwe mo. O ma pa ba di wodiu dedoo mo, ye ba nyɔ na bedwe. Na balo ba maama déem na nyɔge to nwoŋi peo kodwoŋi yera mo, ye peo kom konto mo ye wo-kenkagele Wɛ na kea se ko bere we, Yezu Krista tete mo tɔge o wo ba tei ne. 5De konto de, ba dedɛ kikia déem wo su Wɛ yi. O ma pa ba te ba maŋe kagoa kam ne.
6Wonnu tento maama na ke to, te ke se te bere debam mo se dé yé pa dé fera taa zoore wo-zɔɔna, nenɛɛne banto na ke tei to. 7Yé ta‑á ye jwo-kaana ne banto badaara déem na ye tei to. Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Nɔɔna bam déem lɛɛre ba di wodi-fɔrɔ mo ye ba nyɔa, ba daare ba zaŋe ba kwɛɛre yɔɔ yɔɔ.” 8Yé zaŋe-na á pa dé taa tɔge dé ke kabwoŋa, ne banto badaara déem na ke tei ye ba morro finlei-tetɔ (23,000) te dɛ dedwe wone to. 9Yé pa-na dé faŋe Baŋa Wɛ dam dé nii, ne banto badaara déem na ke tei ye basankwe done-ba se go to. 10Yé ta‑á poona-na de Wɛ, ne banto badaara na ke tei ye toone maleka kam go-ba to.
11Wonnu tento maama déem ke dé kwoa nakwa bam se te taa ye maana mo te pa debam. Te nam popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne se ko wane ko kaane debam balo ta na ŋwe ye logo baŋa kweelim da yam bwola to mo. 12Wolo na boŋe we o zege lanyerane to taa yei, se o wó to. 13Woŋo kolo maama na ke abam ye ko soge á boboŋa se á tusi to tui nɔɔna maama baŋa mo. Wɛ na ye chega tu to, o bá sɛ se woŋo kolo na soge á boboŋa to taa dana ko dwoi á jaanem. O nam wó pa abam dam se á wane á zege ye á daare á na chwoŋa á nwoŋi ko wone.
14Konto ŋwaane, a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, le-na á tete jwona kaanem wone. 15A ŋɔɔne tento dwoŋi de abam, á yi na poore to ŋwaane. Nam boŋe-na á nii, a taane dem ye chega na. 16Dé ná yeini de di Yezu Krista gula wodiu kom, dé yeini dé kwei zoŋa mo dé ke Wɛ lei, ye dé daare dé nyɔ ka wone. Dé na ke konto to, ko bere we debam maama tɔge dé sɛ we, Yezu Krista jana bam nwoŋi debam ŋwaane mo. Dé daa ta na yeini dé kwei bworobworo kom dé fɔ fɔ dé di to, ko bere we debam maama tɔge de sɛ we, o yera yam chɔge debam ŋwaane mo. Ko dae konto na? 17Debam maama na fɔge fɔge bworobworo dedoo kom dé di to bere we debam maama ye nɔɔno dedoa mo, dé ya ze maŋe dé daga tei maama de.
18Boŋe-na Isarele tiina bam déem na kaane wonnu ba pa Wɛ ye ba daare ba di te wone to, se á ma á lɔre lɔra. Balo maama na dɛ ba di to wo tɔge ba sɛ kaanem dem mo na?
19Amo na tage tei to bere bɛ mo? Ko bere we wodiu kolo ba na mɛ ba kaane jwona to jege kuri mo na? Ko bere we jwona yam tete jege kuri mo na? 20Aawo, ko dae konto. A na tage tei to mo ye a lage a bere we, jwo-kaana na kwei wonnu telo ba ma ba ke kaanem to, ba kwei ba pae chichiri mo se ko dae Wɛ. Amo nam ba lage se abam tɔge á me de chichiri. 21Ko wo maŋe se á nyɔ dé Teiru Yezu Krista zoŋa kam wone, se á daare á vo á nyɔ chichiri zoŋa wone. Abam nam bá wane á jeini á di dé Teiru wom gula wodiu kom, ye á daare á vo á da á di wodiu kolo na wó pa á me de chichiri to. 22Yé pa-na dé ke kolo na wó zaŋe dé Teiru wom wo to. Debam wó taa dana dé dwoi‑o na?
Wodiu dim taane
23Abam na we, kolokolo tera ko na chula debam tei ne to, ko ye chega. Ko nam dae we, woŋo maama mo jege nyɔɔre ko pa debam. Ko ta dae we, woŋo maama mo pae zeinim. 24Á wolowolo yé taa lage lanyerane o pa o tete. O nam jege se o taa lage lanyerane mo o pa o dwonna de.
25Á jege chwoŋa se á yeigi nɔna yalo maama ba na jege ba yeigi yaga ne to á di. Nam yé bwei-na ya bwia á nii, ya ye jwoni nɔna mo na, se lwia wó zo á boboŋa ya ŋwaane. 26Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Logo baŋa de ko wonnu maama ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo.” 27Nɔɔno wolo na ba tɔge Yezu Krista to ná bwoŋi nmo se n vo o sɔŋɔ n di wodiu ded‑o, ye n ná sɛ n vo, o ná kwei wodiu kolo de kolo maama o zege n yiga ne, se n di. Yé zaŋe n bwei ko bwia, se lwia wó zo n boboŋa ko ŋwaane. 28Nɔɔno nam ná tage de nmo o we, wodiu konto ye ba mɛ ba kaane jwoni mo, se n daa yé di, kolo ŋwaane lwia wó zo nɔɔno wom boboŋa. 29Ko dae se n yage ko dim lwia na wó zo nmo tete boboŋa to ŋwaane, se ko ye lwia na wó ja nɔɔno wodwoŋi wom to ŋwaane mo.
Abam wó wane á bwei amo we, bɛŋwaane mo dé wó yage dé na jege chwoŋa se dé ke kolo to, lwia na wó zo nɔɔno wodwoŋi boboŋa to ŋwaane? 30Abam ta wó bwei amo we, dé na ke Wɛ lei wodiu kom ŋwaane ye dé daare dé di to, bɛ mo ye nɔɔno wodwoŋi daa wó yaale debam ko ŋwaane?
31Ko nam na ye tei to, woŋo kolo maama á na ke to, ko ná ye dim naa nyɔɔm naa kikia yalo maama, ko maŋe se á ta‑á ke kolo maama na wó pa Wɛ yere zaŋe wɛɛne ko ŋwaane to mo. 32Yé ta‑á ke-na kolo na wó chɔge nɔɔna boboŋa to, ko ya ze ye Juu tiina, naa dwi-gɛ tiina, naa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna de. 33Ta‑á ke-na ne amo na ke tei to. Woŋo kolo maama amo na ke to, a kwaane se ko taa pwoli nɔɔna maama wo mo. Amo ba lage lanyerane a pa a tete. A lage lanyerane a pa nɔɔna maama mo, se ko wane ko pa Wɛ jwoŋi-ba o yage.

english_text:
1 You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.
Rules for Worship
2I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you. 3Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ. 4This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
5But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head. 6A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
7 Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men. 8 It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman. 9He wasn't created for her. She was created for him. 10And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
11As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other. 12It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything. 13Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head. 14Isn't it unnatural and disgraceful for men to have long hair? 15But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head. 16This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said.
Rules for the Lord's Supper
17Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this. 18I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true. 19You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
20When you meet together, you don't really celebrate the Lord's Supper. 21You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk. 22Don't you have homes where you can eat and drink? Do you hate God's church? Do you want to embarrass people who don't have anything? What can I say to you? I certainly cannot praise you.
The Lord's Supper
(Matthew 26.26-29; Mark 14.22-25; Luke 22.14-20)
23I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself.
He took some bread in his hands. 24Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
25 After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
26The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
27But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood. 28This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink. 29If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink. 30This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died. 31If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished. 32But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
33My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating. 34If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together.
After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_text:
1Ta‑á lwoni-na amo kikia, ne amo na lwoni Yezu Krista tei to.
Baaro de kaane yuu tu na ye wolo to
2Abam ke chega lanyerane dedaane á na yeini á guli amo gula, ye á kwori á tɔge chega kalo a na bere abam to. 3Amo nam lage se abam lɔre we, Yezu Krista mo ye baaro maama yuu tu, ye baaro de maa ye o kaane yuu tu. Baŋa Wɛ nam mo ye Yezu Krista de yuu tu. 4Konto to, á ná tigisi daane se á ware Wɛ, ye baaro ná zaŋe o lwoori Wɛ, naa o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam, ye o ná mɛ woŋo o kwoli o yuu, konto tu yaale o yuu tu wom mo. 5Kaane de nam ná zaŋe o lwoori Wɛ, naa o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam, ye o ná wo mɛ woŋo o kwoli o yuu, o de yaale o yuu tu wom mo. O ná ke konto, o de wolo na cheeri o yuu to ye bedwe mo. 6Kaane ná wo sɛ se o kwoli o yuu, ko ya maŋe se o chɔ-ko mo, naa o cheeri-ko. Ko nam na jege chaveera se kaane ke konto to, ko maŋe se o taa kwoli-ko mo. 7Baara nam ba jege se ba kwoli ba yuni, kolo ŋwaane banto mo bere Wɛ seina de o dam na ye tei. Ko nam ná ye kaana, banto mo bere baara dam na ye tei. 8Kokuri, Wɛ mɛ baaro yera mo o ke kaane, se ko dae kaane yera mo o mɛ o ke baaro. 9Ko woli da, Wɛ wo ke baaro kaane zeinim ŋwaane, o ke kaane mo baaro zeinim ŋwaane. 10Konto ŋwaane mo kaana jege se ba taa kwoli ba yuni, se ko bere dam delo na tei-ba to. Konto wó pa Wɛ malese sem na zula.
11Ko nam ná ye debam balo na me de dé Teiru Yezu to, kaana bá wane ba taa tei ba tete baara tei ne, ye baara de nam bá wane ba taa tei ba tete kaana tei ne. 12Wɛ déem seene o ma baaro yera mo o ke kaane, ye kaana de nam mo lore baara. Woŋo maama nam nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo.
13Abam tete nam boŋe-na konto wone á nii. Kaane ná zaŋe se o ware Wɛ, ye o ná wo kwei woŋo o ma kwoli o yuu, ko ye ko chwoŋa ne na? 14Ko ba jege bobwea nabiina tei ne we, baaro yu-ywei ná tiini se dɔra, ko pa o tete chaveera mo. A fɔ vwa na? 15Ko nam ná ye kaane, o yu-ywei ná tiini se nwoŋi se daga, ko pa‑o lam mo. Ko ye o de Wɛ pɛɛre mo se se taa daga ye se kwoli o yuu. 16Nɔɔno wolo nam ná wo sɛ amo berem dem konto ye o mage ni-kantɔgɔ de baŋa ne, konto tu taa yei we, debam maama tɔge kanto chwoŋa kam mo. Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom jei maama ne to de tɔge-ka mo. Chwoŋa kadwoŋi daa tera ka woli da.
Yezu Krista gula wodiu kom dim
Matiyu 26:26-29; Maake 14:22-25; Luka 22:14-20
17Kolo maama amo na lage a ta de abam to, a bá wane a ta we á ke lanyerane. Abam ná yeini á tigisi daane Wɛ ŋwaane, á chɔgem mo dwoi á fɔgem. 18Yiga to, amo nigi we, á ná tigisi daane se á zuli Wɛ, á yeini á jege da-popɔra mo. Amo boŋe we ko seene ko ye chega mo. 19Dɛ delo, popɔra wó taa wo abam tei ne se ko pa balo na tɔge chega to taa nae jaja. 20Á na yeini á tigisi daane tei to, á yé ta‑á boŋe we, á jeeri se á di dé Teiru Yezu gula wodiu kom mo. 21Kolo ŋwaane nɔɔno maama yeini o gare o di o tete wodiu mo o ti lela. Ko maa pae se kana jege abam badwonna, ye á badwonna nyɔ á su. 22Abam nam ba jege sam se á di dim konto dwoŋi de wone na? Á nam boŋe se á chɔge Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom yuu mo na? Á lage se á pa chaveera ja yiniga tiina balo na wo á kɔgɔ kom wone to mo na? Bɛ mo amo nam wó ta de abam? Á ke lanyerane na? A bá wane a ta we, á ke lanyerane.
23Amo lɔre dé Teiru Yezu gula wodiu kom dim chega kam o tete tei ne mo, ye a daare a bere abam chega kam konto, nenɛɛne Yezu na ke kolo dɛ dem ba na boŋe se ba ja‑o to. Tete dem konto ne o ma kwei bworobworo, 24ye o ke Wɛ lei ko ŋwaane o daare o ja-ko o fɔ fɔ. O ma ta de o tontoŋena bam o we, “Amo yera yam mo tento, ya na ye abam nyem. Ta‑á ke-na konto dwoŋi se á ta‑á ma á guli amo gula.” 25Ba na di ba ti to, o daa ma kwei zoŋa, ye o ta ke konto dwoŋi. O maa we, “Zoŋa kam bere we, Wɛ tɔge amo jana bam ŋwaane o gwoni ni-doore dedaane nabiina mo. Maŋa maama á ná lage á nyɔ konto dwoŋi, se á ke amo na ke tei to, se á ma á guli amo gula.” 26Kokuri to, maŋa maama á ná di bworobworo konto dwoŋi ye á nyɔ zoŋa kam wone, á ke á bere nɔɔna mo dé Teiru wom toone dem na ye tei. Ta‑á ke-na konto se ko taa vei maŋa kam o na wó jwoori o ba to.
27Ko na ye konto to, nɔɔno wolo ná di dé Teiru wom gula bworobworo kom naa o nyɔge zoŋa kam wone, ye o ke ne o yiga tera ko wone mo tei, konto tu ke keim-balɔrɔ mo o ma yaale dé Teiru wom yera yam de o jana bam. 28Konto ŋwaane to, nɔɔno maama jege se o taa yei o tete mo yiga, se o laam di bworobworo kom o daare o nyɔ zoŋa kam wone. 29Nɔɔno wolo nam ná di ye o kwori o nyɔ, ye o ná wo lɔre dé Teiru Yezu yera yam kuri chekke, konto tu vaŋe taane mo o pa o tete, de o na di ye o kwori o nyɔ tei to. 30Konto nam mo pae se á dedɛ weela ye á bwona, ye á badwonna de toa. 31Debam nam ya ná yeini dé bwɛ de tete, Wɛ ya daa bá bwɛ debam kolokolo baŋa ne. 32Ko nam na ye tei to, dé Teiru wom yeini o korese debam mo se o pa dé jwoori dé to chwoŋa ne, se dé yé ba dé ga bora o tei ne, nenɛɛne balo na yeiri‑o to na wó ga bora o borem dɛ dem ne tei to.
33Konto ŋwaane, a nu-bia bam, á ná tigisi á ti se á di wodiu kom konto dwoŋi, se á zuri á yera á cheigi da-tei ne. 34Wolo kana ná wɔe, se kotu di sɔŋɔ ne se o daare o ba, se ko yé wane ko pa Wɛ bwɛ abam á tigisim dem baŋa ne.
Ko daare ko ná ye taana yalo na daare to, amo ná tua, a wó pɔɔre ya laŋa a bere abam.

english_text:
Spiritual Gifts
1My friends, you asked me about spiritual gifts. 2I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk. 3Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
4 There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit. 5There are different ways to serve the same Lord, 6and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
7The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others. 8Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit. 9To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick 10or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean. 11But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us.
One Body with Many Parts
12 The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does. 13Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
14Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts. 15Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body? 16Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body? 17If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing. 18But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
19A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part. 20It takes many parts to make a single body. 21That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet. 22In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest. 23We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts, 24but we don't have to be modest about other parts.
God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable. 25He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others. 26If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
27Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body. 28 First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages. 29Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles. 30Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean. 31I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_text:
Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pae zeinim tei to
1A nu-bia bam, a lage a ta a bere abam Wɛ Sin-laao kom na toŋe tei de tei to mo chekke. 2Guli-na maŋa kalo á ta na yeiri Wɛ ye á déem tɔge jwo-yɔɔro to, nenɛɛne á boboŋa na yeini ya gane abam se á sa chwoŋa tei to. 3Konto ŋwaane mo a lage a pa á lɔre we, Wɛ Sin-laao kom bá wane ko gane abam. Konto to, nɔɔno ná sɔɔle o chɔge Yezu yuu, ko dae Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo pɛ o ta konto. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane o ta we, Yezu mo ye o Teiru, ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom tere o tei ne.
4Wɛ pɛɛra ye teiri teiri mo, ye o Sin-laao kom dedoa yerane mo jege-ya ko pae nɔɔna. 5Wɛ totoŋa ye teiri teiri mo, ye dé Teiru wolo dé na toŋe dé pa‑o to ye dedoa yerane mo. 6Wɛ na zeini nɔɔna de yu-punnu telo maama to ye teiri teiri mo. Wɛ nam ye dedoa yerane mo, ye wonto nam mo pae nɔɔno maama o yu-punnu tem se o taa maa toŋa. 7Wɛ mo pae nɔɔno maama o Sin-laao kom se o wane o taa tɔge ko zeinim baŋa ne o woli o dwonna. 8Wɛ wae o tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa o pa nɔɔna badwonna ŋɔɔne swa taane ba bere ba dwonna. Nɔɔna badwonna de maa wae ba ŋɔɔne yeino taane o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane. 9Konto nam ta mo pae nɔɔna badwonna yɔɔre ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ye ko ta pae badwonna dam se ba taa maa yɔɔre jaweena. 10Ko ta pae badwonna dam se ba taa maa ke wo-kenkagela, ko daare se badwonna taa wae ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam. Ko ta pae nɔɔna badwonna wae ba pɔɔre Wɛ Sin-laao kom totoŋa de chichiri totoŋa daane. Ko ta pae badwonna wae ba ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ dwi dwi, ye badwonna de ta maa wae ba tɛ ta-gɛ sem konto kuri ba bere ba dwonna. 11Wɛ pɛɛra yanto maama ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom dedoa yerane mo jege-ya ko pae nɔɔna. Ko nam jege-ya konto dwi dwi mo ko pɔɔre ko pae nɔɔno de nɔɔno, se ko maŋe de ko boboŋa na jaane tei to.
Yezu nɔɔna bam maŋe se ba nii da-baŋa ne
12Boŋe-na á nii nabiinu yera na ye tei to. Ya ye woŋo dedoo mo ye ya laam pɔɔre teiri teiri. Yera yam pɔɔrem dem daga dedɛ ye ya maama laam ye yera bedwe. Yezu Krista de o kɔgɔ kom maama de ye konto mo. 13Debam balo maama na sɛ Yezu to jwoŋi sɛɛm pa dé ji kɔgɔ dedoo mo. Dé ya ze maŋe dé ye Juu tiina naa dwi-gɛ tiina, naa dé ye kabɛ naa balo na tei ba tete to, ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom tete mo zeini debam maama. Wɛ Sin-laao kom ye dedoa yerane, ye wonto mo Wɛ lwogi o ke debam maama bochara ne.
14Ko nam ye chega mo we nabiinu yera pɔɔrem daga, se ko dae we ya ba jege pɔɔrem. 15Naga ná tage ka we, ka dae jeŋa, se konto ŋwaane yera yam ba tei-ka, konto bá seene ko pa ka ta dae yera yam nyem. 16Zwɛ de nam ná we, de dae yi, se yera yam ba tei-de, konto bá seene ko pa de ta dae yera yam nyem. 17Yera yam maama nam ya ná ye yi yerane, ya wó ke tɛ mo ya taa ni taane? Ya nam ya ná ye zwɛ yerane, ya wó ke tɛ mo ya taa ni lwom? 18Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ mo ke-ya teiri teiri konto, ko maŋe de o boboŋa na lage tei to. 19Ya maama nam ya ná ye pɔɔrem bedwe, ya wó ke tɛ mo ya ji yera? 20Ko nam na ye konto to mo pae pɔɔrem dem daga ye ya maama laam ye yera bedwe.
21Konto ŋwaane, yi bá wane de ta de jeŋa we, “A ba lage‑m”. Yuu de ba jege chwoŋa se ko ta de naga we, ko ba lage-ka. 22Chega ŋwaane to, dé bá wane dé dole dé yage dé yera yam daa kalo maama dé na pae ka bwona to. 23Ko nam ná ye dé yera yam daa kalo maama dé na boŋe we ka ba tiini ka jege kuri to mo, dé yeini dé zuli-ka lanyerane. Daa kalo maama na ba lana ye ka jege chaveera to, dé yeini dé fɔge dé kwoli-ka mo. 24Ko daare dé yera yam daa kalo maama na lana to, dé daa ba fɔge dé nii ka baŋa ne. Wɛ mo ke nabiinu yera yam maama o ke daane, ye o pae daa kalo ya na gɛ zula to na zula lanyerane. 25Konto ŋwaane popɔra tera yera yam wone. Ya maama nii da-baŋa ne mo. 26Ko ná chana yera yam daa kalo yera ne, yera yam maama wó tɔge ya na cham dem konto dwoŋi mo. Daa kalo ná nɛ zula, yera yam maama de wó tɔge ya na wopwolo mo.
27Abam maama ye Yezu Krista yera yam mo, ye á dedoa dedoa ye ya pɔɔrem dem dwi dwi mo. 28Kɔgɔ kolo na tɔge Yezu to wone, Wɛ ke nɔɔno maama o jeiga ne mo. Da-yiga to ye Yezu totoŋa nakwa mo. Balo na ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋina to maa saŋe. Balo na ke betɔ to maa ye Wɛ chwo-berena bam. Ko woli de balo na ke wo-kenkagela to, de balo na jege Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam se ba taa maa yɔɔre jaweena to. Ko ta woli de balo na zeini nɔɔna to, de balo na nii Wɛ totoŋa yam baŋa ne to, de balo na wae ba ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ dwi dwi to. 29Ko nam dae we abam maama ye Yezu totoŋa nakwa, naa Wɛ ni-jwoŋina, naa balo na bere o chega kam to. Ko ta dae we abam maama mo wae á ke wo-kenkagela, 30naa á ta‑á yɔɔre jaweena, naa á wae á ŋɔɔne Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ sem, naa á wae á tɛ se kuri. 31Nam kwaane-na á seene á yia se á na Wɛ pɛɛra yalo na tiini ya jege kuri lanyerane to.
Ko daare a nam lage a bere abam chwoŋa kalo na tiini ka lana ka dwoi maama to mo.

english_text:
Love
1What if I could speak
all languages of humans
and even of angels?
If I did not love others,
I would be nothing more
than a noisy gong
or a clanging cymbal.
2 What if I could prophesy
and understand all mysteries
and all knowledge?
And what if I had faith
that moved mountains?
I would be nothing,
unless I loved others.
3What if I gave away all
that I owned
and let myself
be burned alive?
I would gain nothing,
unless I loved others.
4Love is patient and kind,
never jealous, boastful,
proud, or 5rude.
Love isn't selfish
or quick tempered.
It doesn't keep a record
of wrongs that others do.
6Love rejoices in the truth,
but not in evil.
7Love is always supportive,
loyal, hopeful,
and trusting.
8Love never fails!
Everyone who prophesies
will stop,
and unknown languages
will no longer
be spoken.
All that we know
will be forgotten.
9We don't know everything,
and our prophecies
are not complete.
10But what is perfect
will someday appear,
and what isn't perfect
will then disappear.
11When we were children,
we thought and reasoned
as children do.
But when we grew up,
we quit our childish ways.
12Now all we can see of God
is like a cloudy picture
in a mirror.
Later we will see him
face to face.
We don't know everything,
but then we will,
just as God completely
understands us.
13For now there are faith,
hope, and love.
But of these three,
the greatest is love.
translation_text:
Swono na ye tei to
1Amo ná maŋe a wae a ŋɔɔne nabiina taane dwi dwi, de malese sem taane de, ye swono ná tera a tei ne, ko nye de sɔɔ mo a ke, ne ba na mage kwaŋa de konkɔŋɔ pa te ke sɔɔ tei to. 2Amo ná maŋe a jege Wɛ pɛɛre delo na pae se a wae a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to, ye a kwori a yei chega kalo maama na seigi nɔɔna yiga ne to, de yeino maama kuri, ye a ta ná jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ se a taa wae a pae peero zaŋe te kugu jei ne te vei te to mɛ a na lage to, ye swono ná tera a tei ne, a ye kafɛ mo. 3Amo ná kwei a jejegero maama a maŋe a pa yiniga tiina, ye a ta kwori a sɛ se ba kwei a yera ba de mini ne, ye swono ná tera a tei ne, ko ta maŋe ko ba jege nyɔɔre ko pa-ne.
4Swono tu jege wo-zuru mo ye o nege nɔɔna lanyerane. Swono tu ba jege puseŋa naa fia, ye o ba pae o tete kamunni. 5O maa ba jege boyerem, ye ko dae o tete yerane wonnu mo o laga. O ta kwori o jege ban-peno. Nɔɔno ná ke‑o lwarem, o ba yeini o kwei o ke o wone. 6Swono tu ba jege wopwolo keim-lwanno baŋa ne, o jege wopwolo chega baŋa ne mo. 7Swono tu wae o vɔ o wo de woŋo maama. O maa jege wo-dedoa, de teena, de pu-dɛa wonnu maama baŋa ne.
8Swono ba ti kɔtaa. Wɛ kwora kam tɔɔlem wó ba ko kɛ. Wɛ pɛɛre delo nɔɔna na maa ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ to de wó ba de kweeli. Yeino de wó ba ko kɛ. 9Leile konto, yeino kolo dé na jege to ye chichworo mo. Wɛ kwora kalo dé na tɔɔle to de ye ka chichworo mo. 10Ko daare maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó fɔge wonnu maama pa te suuri to, wo-chichwooru tem maama wó jei mo.
11Amo busɔɔne maŋa ne, a déem ŋɔɔne ne bu mo tei. A boboŋa maa nye de bu boboŋa, ye a jeeli ne bu tei. A nam na ke nɔɔno to, a kwei busɔɔne wonnu tem konto maama a yage. 12Leile konto dé laam na lɔre Wɛ chega kam tei to ta nye de niu mo dé jege dé nii ko wone liira liira. Ko daare maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó fɔge wonnu maama to, dé wó ba dé taa nae jaja mo. Leile konto yeino kolo a na jege to ye chichworo mo. Maŋa kam konto ne, a laam wó ba a taa yei wonnu maama a tia, se ko maŋe de Wɛ na yei amo o ti tei to.
13Ko daare leile konto, wonnu tetɔ mo wó taa wora taa, te ye wo-dedoa, de teena, de swono mo. Kolo nam na dwoi te maama to mo ye swono.

english_text:
Speaking Unknown Languages and Prophesying
1Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy. 2If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands. 3But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
4By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church. 5I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
6My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching? 7If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp? 8If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
9This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind. 10There are many different languages in this world, and all of them make sense. 11But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other. 12If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
13When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean. 14For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless. 15Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
16Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”? 17You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped. 18I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you. 19But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak 10,000 words in a language that others don't know.
20My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies. 21 In the Scriptures the Lord says,
“I will use strangers
who speak unknown languages
to talk to my people.
They will speak to them
in foreign languages,
but still my people
won't listen to me.”
22Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers. 23Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy? 24But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying. 25They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.”
Worship Must Be Orderly
26My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means. 27No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean. 28If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
29Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully. 30If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak. 31Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged. 32A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak. 33God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order.
When God's people meet in church, 34the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches. 35If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
36God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
37If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded. 38So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing. 39My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know. 40But do everything properly and in order.
translation_text:
Wɛ pɛɛra yadwonna taane
1Konto ŋwaane, kwaane-na se á ta‑á jege swono, se á daare á seene á yia se á jwoŋi Wɛ pɛɛra yalo o Sin-laao kom na pae nɔɔna to á woli da, ye ko fɔge ko dae Wɛ kwora kam tɔɔlem. 2Nɔɔno wolo ná jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam se o taa maa pɔpɔe o ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ, kotu ŋɔɔne de Wɛ mo. Ko dae we o ŋɔɔne o bere nabiina, ba na ba ni o taane dem kuri to ŋwaane. Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo pae o ŋɔɔne wo-siseigiru. 3Ko daare nɔɔno wolo na wae o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to ŋɔɔne o bere nabiina mo. O ni taane dem maa zeini-ba se ba taa fɔge ba zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa. 4Wolo na ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ sem to fɔge o tete mo. Wolo nam na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to fɔge Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama mo.
5Amo ya wó taa lage se á maama taa wae á ŋɔɔne Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ mo, ye a nam tiini a lage se á ta‑á wae á tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam mo ko ja gaale. Wolo na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to tiini o jege zeina o dwoi wolo na ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ sem to, se ko ná dae nɔɔno ná wora ye o wae o taane dem kuri o tɛa, se ko wane ko zeini Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama. 6Mo kokuri, a nu-bia bam, amo ná tu abam tei, ye a ná ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ yerane, á wó na bɛ nyɔɔre mo amo tei ne? Kolo na wó woli abam to mo ye se a ŋɔɔne taane delo Wɛ na le o bere-ne to, naa de pa abam yuu-yeino, naa de bere abam Wɛ kwora, naa de pa á lɔre o chega kam. 7Ko ná maŋe ko ye wo-korro telo na jege sɔɔ to, ko de ta ye bedwe mo de nɔɔno ná jege wua o wui yɔɔ yɔɔ, naa o jege kɔnɔ o tae yɔɔ yɔɔ. O ná ke konto, nɔɔna wó ke tɛ mo ba ni ko ywoni? 8Nɔɔno ná jege jara nabɔnɔ o wui yɔɔ yɔɔ, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lɔre ko na ye tei, se o chichei o zege jara ŋwaane. 9Ko nam ta ye bedwe mo de n ni taane ná dae jaja, nɔɔna wó ke tɛ mo ba lɔre n na tɛ kolo to kuri chekke? Konto nam bere we n ŋɔɔne n yage gaao wone mo. 10Taana dwi dwi mo wora logo baŋa ne, ye taan-taane tera de na ba jege kuri de pa de tiina. 11Nɔɔno nam ná ŋɔɔne taane de amo ye a ba ni de kuri, konto bere we debam maama balei ye veira mo da-tei ne. 12Ko ye konto mo de abam de. Abam ná seene á yia se á jwoŋi Wɛ pɛɛra yalo Sin-laao kom na pae to, kwaane-na se á tiini á ta‑á lage yalo na wó wane ya zeini se Yezu kɔgɔ kom wane ko zege lanyerane to. 13Konto ŋwaane, abam wolo ná wae o ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ, kotu nam lwoori Wɛ se o taa wae se kuri de o tɛa.
14Nmo ná mɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gaa n ma n ware Wɛ, ko ye n jworo mo ŋɔɔna, se nmo tete boboŋa tɔge ya tere ko wone. 15Kolo na maŋe se n ke to mo ye se n yeini n ware Wɛ de n jworo de n boboŋa maama, se n daare n ta‑n leeni de n jworo de n boboŋa maama n seini Wɛ. 16Ko nam ná dae konto, ye n ná mɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gaa n ma n zuli Wɛ n jworo wone, nɔɔna balo na jei ba cheigi to bá wane ba ni ko kuri. Konto ŋwaane, ba wó ke tɛ mo ba tɔge ba sɛ nmo na ke Wɛ lei tei to se ba de ta we, “Ameena”? 17Nmo na ke Wɛ lei tei to ná maŋe ko lamma tei, ko bá zeini balo na jei ba cheigi to.
18Ko ná ye amo, a ke Wɛ lei de o na pɛ-ne dam se a taa ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ a dwoi abam maama to. 19Ko daare Yezu kɔgɔ kom ná tigisi daane ye a wo ba wone, a tiini a lage se a taa mae a tete boboŋa mo a ŋɔɔne a bere-ba. A ná ŋɔɔne botare senu fenfee konto dwoŋi, ko gare a ná ŋɔɔne Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gaa botare-bia morro dedɛ ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri se kuri.
20A nu-bia bam, pa-na á boboŋa kweere, se á daa yé ta‑á jege bu-balwa boboŋa. Ko nam ná ye keim-lwanno seeni, ta ta‑á nye de bu-sese na yeiri te ni ne to. 21Ko popone Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom wone we:
“Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó toŋe sa-teena mo
se ba ba ba ŋɔɔne amo kwora de abam.
Dwi-gɛ tiina wó ŋɔɔne ta-veiri de abam.
De konto de, á ta bá sɛ a ni.”
22Konto mo Wɛ mae ta-gɛ o maa bere o dam balo na wo sɛ‑o to tei ne, ye ko dae balo na sɛ‑o to tei ne. Ko daare Wɛ kwora kam tɔɔlem dem mo bere o dam balo na sɛ‑o to tei ne, ye ko dae balo na wo sɛ‑o to tei ne. 23Konto ŋwaane, abam kɔgɔ kom maama ná tigisi daane Wɛ zula ŋwaane, ye á maama ná wora á ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ, ye veira badwonna naa balo na wo sɛ Wɛ to laam ná tu ba zo á wo, nɔɔna bam konto bá ta we, abam yirisi mo na? 24Abam maama nam ná tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam á bere daane, ye veira naa balo na wo sɛ Wɛ to ná tu ba zo á wo, banto wó lɔre we Wɛ dam mo wo á tei ne. Ba dedoa na nigi kolo abam maama tei ne to wó pa o lɔre we, o tusi mo ye o bá na bora Wɛ tei ne. 25Boboŋ-lilirru telo maama ya na seigi o wone to laam wó ba ya jare pwooni yiga ne mo ja. O maa wó vwi o yibia tega ne o zuli Wɛ, ye o sɛ we, Wɛ seene o wo á tei ne.
Yezu kɔgɔ kom tigisim dem na wó da chwoŋa tei to
26A nu-bia bam, dé daa ta wó ta bɛ mo de abam? Á ná tigisi daane se á zuli Wɛ, ko ya maŋe se ko taa ye kolo na wó zeini á kɔgɔ kom maama to mo. Abam dedoa mo wó zaŋe wɛɛne o mɔ leiŋa. Dedoa de maa wó zaŋe o bere Wɛ taane. Wodwoŋi de maa wó zaŋe o ta chega kalo Wɛ na le o bere‑o to. Wodwoŋi de maa wó zaŋe o ŋɔɔne Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gaa. Wodwoŋi de maa wó zaŋe o ta ta-gaa kam kuri o bere á kɔgɔ kom. 27Abam badaara ná lage á pɔpɔ á ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ, ko maŋe se á ta‑á ye balei naa batɔ yerane mo. Ko maŋe se á ta‑á zaŋe á ŋɔɔne á daare á pa daane mo, se á dedoa zaŋe o ta ŋwɛ sem kuri. 28Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ná tere á wone se o wane o ta ta-gɛ sem kuri, wolo ya na lage o ŋɔɔne-se to maŋe se o yage mo, se o ná wo o yerane, se o taa ŋɔɔne-se de Wɛ. 29Ko nam ná ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋina balo na wae ba tɔɔle o kwora kam to, ko maŋe se balei naa batɔ mo zaŋe ba ŋɔɔne dedoa dedoa, se badaara bam taa cheiga se ba laam bwɛ ba nii. 30Wɛ chega kam ná tu balo na jei ba cheigi to dedoa yuu ne se o ta o bere, ko maŋe se wolo na zege o ŋɔɔne to mo pu o ni se o dwoŋi wom ta-ka. 31Konto to, abam maama wae á tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam dedoa dedoa, se ko pa á zamese Wɛ chega kam da-tei ne, ye á bochara ke dam. 32Wɛ ni-jwoŋina balo na jwoŋi dam se ba taa tɔɔle o kwora kam to wae ba tete ba jaana ka tɔɔlem dem baŋa ne. 33Wɛ lage se woŋo maama taa jege ywoni mo, se o ba lage boremaa boremaa keim.
34Abam ná tigisi daane wɛ-di sem wone, ko maŋe se kaana taa jei chemm mo se ba taa cheiga. Mo ko na ye tei Yezu kɔgɔ kom jeiga maama ne. Ba ba jege chwoŋa se ba da ba ŋɔɔne. Ko maŋe se ba taa tu ba tete tega ne, ne Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom na maŋe ko bere tei to mo. 35Ba ná lage se ba lɔre kolo kuri, ba jege se ba bwei ba banna mo sɔŋɔ ne. Ko tiini ko ye chaveera mo se kaane zaŋe o ŋɔɔne á tigisim dem ne.
36Wɛ kwora kam ga zege abam tei ne mo ka jage jei maama na? Abam yerane mo ka yi ka kweeli na? 37Abam wolo ná boŋe we o Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu, naa o boboŋa kweere Wɛ Sin-laao kom pɛɛra seeni, kotu jege se o taa yei we, amo na popone kolo a pa abam to ye dé Teiru wom kwora mo. 38Nɔɔno wolo maama ná ve amo ni dem konto, se á yé pa á yiga taa wo konto tu wone.
39A nu-bia bam, kwaane-na á seene á yia Wɛ kwora kam tɔɔlem baŋa ne. Yé ta‑á chuli-na Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ sem ŋɔŋa. 40Nam ta‑á ke-na woŋo maama se ko taa tɔge chwoŋa, ne ko na maŋe se ko taa ye tei to.

english_text:
Christ Was Raised to Life
1My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted. 2You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
3 I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is:
Christ died for our sins,
as the Scriptures say.
4 He was buried,
and three days later
he was raised to life,
as the Scriptures say.
5 Christ appeared to Peter,
then to the twelve.
6After this, he appeared
to more than five hundred
other followers.
Most of them are still alive,
but some have died.
7He also appeared to James,
then to all of the apostles.
8 Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
9 I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle. 10But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me. 11But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same.
God's People Will Be Raised to Life
12If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life? 13If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life. 14And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith. 15If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
16So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life. 17Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins. 18And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost. 19If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
20But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life. 21Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ. 22Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us. 23But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns. 24Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
25 Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power, 26and the last enemy he destroys will be death. 27 When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ. 28After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
29 If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people? 30And why do we always risk our lives 31and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this. 32 What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life,
“Let's eat and drink.
Tomorrow we die.”
33Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you. 34Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God.
What Our Bodies Will Be Like
35Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?” 36Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground. 37Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up. 38This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have. 39People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike. 40Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others. 41The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
42That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever. 43These ugly and weak bodies will become beautiful and strong. 44As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
45 The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit. 46We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body. 47The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven. 48Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven. 49Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
50My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever. 51 I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed. 52It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again. 53Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay. 54 The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true,
“Death has lost the battle!
55 Where is its victory?
Where is its sting?”
56Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin. 57But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
58My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_text:
Yezu Krista biim taane
1A nu-bia bam, a lage se a pa á guli Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam a na maŋe a tɔɔle a bere abam to mo. Abam maŋe á jwoŋi-ka ye á zege ka chega kam kwaga ne. 2Amo na pɛ á lɔre Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam konto to, Wɛ tɔge ka baŋa ne mo o vere abam o yage, nenɛɛne á ná wo jwoori ka kwaga ne. Naa á sɛ Yezu kafɛ ŋwaane mo na?
3Wɛ chega kalo na dwoi maama to ye kalo amo na jwoŋi ye a laam daare a lwoni a bere abam to mo. Kanto nam mo tento:
Yezu Krista tege debam wɛleera ŋwaane mo, ne Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na maŋe ko ta tei to. 4Ba ma suli‑o. Da yatɔ dɛ ne o ma jwoori o bi toone wone, ye konto de ta ye Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na wuuri ko ta kolo to mo. 5O na bi to, Piita ma na‑o, ye o tontoŋena fuga-balei bam de na‑o. 6Konto kwaga ne, o tɔgena dedɛ ma na‑o bedwe baŋa ne, ba na dwoi nenɛɛne nɔɔna bia yanu (500). Nɔɔna bam konto dedɛ ta mo ŋwe ye ba fenfee te. 7Jemsi de daa ma na‑o, ye ko daare pa o totoŋa nakwa bam maama na‑o.
8Ko na kweeli to, o laam ma veere o tete de amo, de amo na maŋe a nye de wolo ba na loga ye o lora maŋa ta wo yi to de mo. 9Ko na ye tei to, amo tiini a muri Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam maama wone. A muri se ba taa bwoi-ne we Yezu tontoŋeno, kolo ŋwaane a déem bɛɛse o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom mo. 10Wɛ tete zaane dem nam mo pɛ se a ji a na ye wolo zem to. O na ke-ne zaane tei to dae kafɛ. Amo tiini a toŋe a pa‑o, se ko dwoni o tontoŋena bam maama. Ko nam dae a tete dam ŋwaane mo a wae a toŋa. Ko ye Wɛ zaane dem o na ke a yuu ne to ŋwaane mo.
11Debam balo na ye Yezu tontoŋena to maama yeini de bere chega dedoa mo. Ko ná ye amo na bere kolo to, naa banto de na bere kolo to, ko ye chega kalo abam na sɛ to mo.
Twa biim taane
12Debam maama na tɔɔle Wɛ chega kam we, Yezu Krista bi toone wone to, bɛ nam mo ye abam badwonna tɛ á we, twa biim tera? 13Ko ya ná ye chega we twa biim tera, ko bere we Yezu Krista tete de wo bi mo. 14Wonto nam ya ná wo bi toone wone, kokuri mo debam na bere Wɛ chega kam tei to ye kafɛ mo, ye abam na ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to de ye kafɛ. 15Ko ta bere we, dé na bere Wɛ chega kam tei to, ko ye vwa mo dé fɔge dé pa‑o, kolo ŋwaane dé yeini dé bere nɔɔna we, Wɛ mo bi Yezu Krista toone wone. Twa biim nam ya ná seene de tera, kokuri mo Wɛ wo bi Yezu. 16Twa biim ná tera, ko bere we Yezu Krista de maŋe o wo bi mo. 17Wonto ya ná wo bi toone wone, ko bere we abam na ke á wo-dedoa ded‑o tei to ye kafɛ mo, ye á wɛleera yam ta wo á yuu ne. 18Ko ta bere we, balo na sɛ Yezu Krista ye ba laam te to gɛ ba ŋwea mo Wɛ tei ne. 19Ko ná ye logo baŋa ŋwea kanto yerane ŋwaane mo dé jege teena Yezu Krista wone, ko bere we dé tiini dé ye zora mo nɔɔna maama tei ne.
20Ko nam seene ko ye chega mo we, Yezu Krista bi toone wone. Wonto mo ye wolo na dɛ yiga o bi o vo Wɛ tei, se ko bere we balo de na me ded‑o ye ba te to de wó bi toone wone. 21Toone zege nabiinu dedoa yera ne mo de wora. Ko ta ye bedwe mo de twa biim de na zege nabiinu dedoa yera ne tei to. 22Nabiina ŋwea de Adam ŋwea na ye bedwe to ŋwaane mo pae se ba maama toa. Ko ta ye konto dwoŋi mo de balo maama ŋwea de Yezu Krista ŋwea na ye bedwe to wó bi ba na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. 23Nɔɔno maama de o na tu tei to mo. Yezu Krista nam mo dɛ yiga o bi o vo Wɛ tei. Ko daare balo de na ye o nɔɔna to wó bi maŋa kam o na wó jwoori o ba to. 24Ko laam daare se logo baŋa wonnu maama mo ti. Maŋa kam konto ne mo Yezu Krista wó wane wonnu telo maama na jege dam nabiina baŋa ne to o pa te dam dem ti, ko ná ye wɛyuu dedɛɛra, naa tega baŋa dedɛɛra maama. O maa wó daare o kwei woŋo kolo maama o na tu o di paare ko baŋa ne to o ke o Kwo Wɛ jeŋa ne. 25Ko nam fe mo se Yezu di paare taa, se ko taa vei maŋa kam Wɛ na wó wane o dona maama o ke o dam kuri ne to. 26Toone nam mo ye o dono wolo o na wó wane o ma kweeli to. 27Wɛ tɔnɔ kom bere we, “Wɛ kwei wonnu maama o ke wonto dam kuri ne se o taa tei-te.” Ko nam na we, o taa tei wonnu maama to ba lage ko bere we, o tei Wɛ tete mo o woli da. Ko ye Wɛ mo kwei wonnu tem maama o ke Yezu dam kuri ne. 28Maŋa kalo Yezu na wó ba o taa tei wonnu maama to mo o laam wó kwei o tete o ke Wɛ jeŋa ne se o taa tei‑o, o na ye Wɛ Bu wom to ŋwaane. Kolo ŋwaane Wɛ ye wolo na maŋe o ke wonnu maama o Bu wom dam kuri ne to mo. Konto to, Wɛ mo tei wonnu maama de o dam maama.
29Abam nɔɔna badwonna yeini ba jwoŋi sɛɛm ba pa twa. Twa biim nam ná tera, bɛ nyɔɔre mo wó taa wora ba sɛɛm dem baŋa ne? Bɛ mo ye ba yeini ba jwoŋi sɛɛm twa bam ŋwaane konto? 30Twa biim nam ná tera, bɛ ŋwaane mo ye debam ba kɔre se dé yaare dé te Wɛ ŋwaane? 31A nu-bia bam, dɛ maama amo yeini a tɔge toone tei mo a kɛa. Ko ye chega mo. Amo tiini a jege teera abam baŋa ne dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane. Konto mo pɛ a ta konto dwoŋi. 32Efesia ywo-seeni ba ke amo, nenɛɛne kago-vara mo chiŋi jara se ba ja nɔɔna tei. Amo na sɛ se a yaare konto to, ko ná ye logo baŋa ŋwea kanto yerane ŋwaane, bɛ nyɔɔre mo a wó na? Twa biim nam ná tera, dé ya wó ta we, “Pa-na se dé taa di dé ni ne, kokuri to dé yeiri dé jwa wó te na.”
33Yé pa-na ba gane abam se á tusi. Ko ye chega mo we, “Nmo ná me de nɔn-balwaaro, ba keim-balwaaro tem wó tɔge te lɔgese‑m.” 34Pa-na á boboŋa jwoori ya taa tɔge chwoŋa, se á daare á yage keim-lwanno tem. Abam badaara ta yeiri Wɛ. A tage konto se ko pa chaveera mo zo abam.
Nɔɔna na wó bi de yera yalo to
35Abam dedoa wó bwei we, “Ko wó ke tɛ mo se twa bi? Ba yera yam wó taa ye tetɛ mo?”
36N gɛ boboŋa mo na? N ná kwei woŋo n du tega ne, ko nye de ba na suli too tei to mo. Nmo ná wo dugi-ko, ko bá puli ko nwoŋi. 37Nmo na dugi woŋo kolo to de woŋo kolo na wó puli ko nwoŋi to ba nye daane. Nmo na kwei kolo n du to nye de wo-gaa mo, ne ko ná ye men-dwa naa woŋo kolo maama. 38Wo-dwi dem ná nwoŋi, Wɛ mo wó pa-de yera, ne o boboŋa na lage tei to. Wɛ nam ta mo pae wo-dwi maama de tete nyenyego.
39Ko dae we woŋo maama ya-nɔna mo ye bedwe. Nabiina, de vara, de zuna, de ywona maama jege ba ya-nɔna yera yera mo. 40Wɛyuu wonnu de wora mo, ye tega baŋa wonnu de wora. Wɛyuu wonnu tem jege te lam mo, ye tega baŋa wonnu tem de jege te lam. 41Wea kam jege ka lam mo, ye chana kam de jege ka lam. Chalechwe sem de maa jege se lam, ye se lam dem nam dwoi daane.
42Tento maama bere twa biim na ye tei to mo. Nɔɔno ná tega, o yera yalo ba na suli to ye yera yalo na wó pɔ to mo. O yera yalo nam na bi toone wone to daa bá pɔ maŋa de maŋa. 43Ba na suli yera yalo to jege gɛɛre, ye yalo na bi to jege nenɔŋa dedɛ. Yera yalo ba na suli to bwona, ye yalo na bi to dana. 44Yera yalo ba na suli to ye logo baŋa ŋwea nyem mo, ko daare yalo na bi to ye ŋwe-doŋa kam nyem mo. Ne logo baŋa yera yam na wora tei to, ŋwe-doŋa kam yera de jege se ya taa wora mo. 45Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Boboa ne to Adam mo jwoŋi siu kolo na pae ŋwea to.” Ko daare Adam wolo na kweeli to jege jworo kolo na pae ŋwea to mo. 46Ko nam ye logo baŋa ŋwea mo yeini ka tui yiga, ye Wɛ telaao ŋwe-doŋa kam laam saŋe ka tui. 47Wɛ mɛ teero mo o ke nabiinu wolo na tu yiga to. Konto ŋwaane, wonto ye tega baŋa nyem mo. Nabiinu wolo nam na saŋe to nwoŋi Wɛ telaao mo. 48Nabiina maama ye tega baŋa nyem mo, ye ba nye de Wɛ na mɛ teero o ke nɔɔno wolo to mo. Nɔɔna balo maama nam na ye Wɛ telaao nyem to nye de wolo na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao to mo. 49Debam na maŋe dé jege tega baŋa nɔɔno wom nyenyego to, dɛ wora dé wó ba dé taa jege Wɛ telaao nɔɔno wom nyenyego.
50A nu-bia bam, a lage a ta a bere abam we, dé logo baŋa yera yam bá wane ya na jeiŋa jei Wɛ woro kom ne. Ya na bá dáane ye ya pɔ to, ya bá wane ya maŋe de ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to. 51Fɔge-na á cheigi, se a lage a ta Wɛ chega kalo ya na seigi to a bere abam. Debam maama bá te. Dé nam ná tega naa dé ta wo tege, dé yera yam maama jege se ya leiri mo. 52Ko wó pɔpɔ ko ke ne yi na bogese tei to mo, maŋa kam ba na wó wu Wɛ nabɔnɔ kolo na kweeli to. Nabɔnɔ kom ná wuga, twa wó bi ba zaŋe de yera yalo na ba jege pɔm to, ye debam yera yam maama wó leiri. 53Kokuri, dé yera yalo na wó pɔ to jege se ya ji yalo na bá pɔ to mo. Dé yera yalo toone na wae to jege se ya ji yalo toone na ware to mo. 54Konto maama ná seene ko leiri, ko laam wó pa kolo na popone Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom wone to ji chega we, “Wɛ wane toone de de dam maama o di.”
55“Toone, n dam dem daa bɛ?
N daa‑n wó wane a nɔɔna bam n chɔge na?”
56Ko ye nɔɔna wɛleera ŋwaane mo toone jege dam se de chɔge-ba. Wɛleera de nam jwoŋi ya dam Wɛ nia yam baŋa ne mo. 57Dé ke Wɛ lei de o na pae se dé jwoŋi zeinim dé Teiru Yezu Krista tei ne se dé wane toone dam maama to.
58Konto to, a nu-bi-swonnu bam, fɔge á zege-na lanyerane de pu-dɛa. Chɛ-na dé Teiru wom totoŋa yam baŋa ne maŋa maama, kolo ŋwaane á yei we totoŋa yalo maama á na toŋe á pa dé Teiru wom to dae kafɛ.

english_text:
A Collection for God's People
1 When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do. 2That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come. 3Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them. 4If you think I should go along, they can go with me.
Paul's Travel Plans
5 After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you 6and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next. 7If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit. 8 I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost, 9because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
10 When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am. 11Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
12I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can.
Personal Concerns and Greetings
13Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong. 14Show love in everything you do.
15 You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you 16to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
17I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you. 18They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
19 Greetings from the churches in Asia.
Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
20All the Lord's followers send their greetings.
Give each other a warm greeting.
21I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
22I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
23I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
24I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_text:
Sabu tiŋim taane
1Ko daare á na wó ta‑á lae sabu tei á ma á zeini Wɛ nɔɔna to mo tento. Ta‑á ke-na nenɛɛne amo na tage a bere Yezu kɔgɔ kolo maama na wo Galatia te-nia yam ne se ba taa ke tei to. 2Wɛ siu dɛ maama ne se nɔɔno maama twori nyɔɔre delo o na nɛ to wone o tiŋi, se ko pa amo ná tua, se ko daa yé taa jege se á la sabu. 3Amo ná tu abam tei, a laam wó toŋe á na kuri nɔɔna balo to de twanno, se ba ja á sabu kom ba ja vo Jerusalem. 4Ko nam daa ná maŋe se amo tete mo vo, dé wó tɔge daane dé vo.
Pɔɔl lage se o na Korinti tiina
5A lage se a da Makedonia mo se a laam daare a ba abam tei. 6Amo ná tua, a lage se a dáane fee abam tei ne. Dɛ dedwoŋi ne a wó ti yadɛ dem. Abam laam wó wane á woli-ne se a vo a daa na wó vo mɛ to. 7Amo ba lage se a wuuri a ba a na abam, se ko bá pa-ne chwoŋa se a dáane ye a daa vo jeiga kadwoŋi. Wɛ ná sɛ, a ya lage se a dáane abam tei ne mo. 8Konto ŋwaane, a lage a maŋe Efesia ywo-seeni mo se ko vo ko yi Pɛntekɔse kuri dem maŋa. 9Chwoŋa pore lanyerane ka pa-ne se a taa toŋe ywo-seeni de dam, ye nɔɔna dedɛ nam wora ba kwaana se ba che a yiga.
10Timoti nam ná tu abam tei, se á ta‑á nii o baŋa ne se o bochare taa tiga. Kokuri o de toŋe dé Teiru wom totoŋa yam mo, ne amo de na ke tei. 11Yé pa-na se nɔɔn-nɔɔno gwooni‑o. Kwaane-na se á woli‑o o chwoŋa baŋa ne, se o wane o vo de yazura o jwoori o ba amo tei. Amo nam nii‑o mo chwoŋa ne se o ba de dé nu-bia bam.
12Ko nam ná ye dé nu-bu Apolo, amo tiini a kwoori‑o mo se o tɔge de dé nu-bia bam o ba abam tei. De ko de, o ta wo boŋe o ja se o ba leile. O nam ná nɛ chwoŋa maŋa de maŋa, o wó ba.
13Ta‑á cho-na á tete se á fɔge á zege lanyerane de á na tɔge Wɛ chega kam tei to. Ta‑á jege-na baare de dam. 14Ta‑á pa-na á kikia maama tɔge de swono.
15A nu-bia bam, á maŋe á yei Stefana de o sɔŋɔ tiina na yɔɔre ba tɔge Wɛ tei to. Banto mo dɛ yiga ba sɛ Yezu Akaya ne, ye ba kwei ba tete maama ba toŋe ba zeini Wɛ nɔɔna. 16Konto to, a lwoori abam se á kwei á tete á ta‑á tɔge nɔɔna bam konto dwonna ni, dedaane balo na tɔge ba toŋe Wɛ totoŋa ne banto tei.
17Amo jege wopwolo de Stefana, de Fɔtunata, de Achaku na tu amo tei to. Banto mo pɛ a wo lɔre we abam tera. 18Banto mo pɛ a wo tiga, ne ba na ke abam de tei to. Ko ná ye nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi, ko maŋe se á ta‑á jege ba chega.
19Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama na wo Asia te-nia yam wone to jɔɔne abam. Akwila de Pirisila, de Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na jeeri ba sɔŋɔ ne to de jɔɔne abam lanyerane dé Teiru wom yere ŋwaane. 20Dé nu-bia bam maama de jɔɔne abam.
Á ná jeeri daane, se á ta‑á kukwori daane Wɛ ŋwaane.
21Amo Pɔɔl tete mo mɛ a jeŋa a popone jɔɔnem dento a ma jɔɔne abam.
22Nɔɔno wolo maama ná ba jege dé Teiru wom swono, Wɛ wó yaale kotu o yiga ne.
Dé Teiru wom wó ba.
23Dé Teiru Yezu zaane dem taa wo á tei ne.
24Amo swono taa wo á tei ne Yezu Krista ŋwaane.

english_text:
1 From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Paul Gives Thanks
3Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort. 4He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble. 5We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives. 6We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours. 7You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
8 My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain. 9In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life. 10God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again. 11Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers.
Paul's Change of Plans
12We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world. 13I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely, 14just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
15I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me— 16 once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea. 17Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others? 18God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.” 19 This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
20Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God. 21And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us 22and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
23God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you. 24We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl wolo Wɛ na tiŋi-ne de o tete boboŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto, ye dé nu-bu Timoti mo tɔge o woli-ne. Dé popone se dé pa abam balo na ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á zoore Korinti ne to, ko woli de Wɛ nɔɔna balo na zoore Akaya teene dem maama ne to.
2Dé Kwo Wɛ, dedaane dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Wɛ na tiini o zeini debam tei to
3Pa-na dé ke Wɛ lei. Wonto mo ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Kwo, ye o daa ta ye debam Kwo wolo na jege dé ŋwaŋa to. O maa ye Wɛ wolo na zeini nɔɔna dedɛ se ba bochara peini tega ne. 4Dé ná wo yaara yalo maama wone, wonto mo yeini o pa dé bochara peini tega ne, se ko pa dé wane dé zeini balo de na wo yaara dwi maama wone to se ba de bochara peini tega ne. Dé wó tɔge zeinim delo Wɛ na maŋe o pa debam tete to baŋa ne dé zeini dé dwonna bam konto. 5Yezu Krista na tiini o yaare to, debam de tɔge dé na ya dwoŋi. Dé na me ded‑o to, dé ta wó tɔge dé na zeinim dedɛ Wɛ tei ne, nenɛɛne o na zeini Yezu Krista tei to. 6Konto ŋwaane, debam ná wo yaara wone, ko ye se ko zeini abam mo se á bochara peini tega ne, se ko daare ko pa Wɛ jwoŋi abam ŋwea. Wɛ nam ná pɛ dé bochara peini tega ne, ko ye se abam de na zeinim konto dwoŋi, se á wane á na dam á vɔ á wo á zege lanyerane de yaara yalo dwoŋi debam de na nɛ to. 7Mo kokuri dé tiini dé jege abam teena, kolo ŋwaane dé yei we, abam na tɔge á na debam yaara yam dwoŋi to, á wó tɔge á na zeinim Wɛ tei ne, ko maŋe de o na zeini debam tei to.
8Dé nu-bia bam, dé lage dé pa abam maane dé na kare Asia teene dem ne ye dé na yaara tei to. Dé na nɛ cham delo to tiini de dana de dwoi debam jaanem, ye dé boŋe we, dé wó ga dé ŋwea. 9Dé nam na zege toone yiga ne konto to, ko ye se ko pa dé daa yé taa boŋa dé tete dam na ye tei to, se dé daare dé ke dé wo-dedoa de Wɛ, o na jege dam se o pa nɔɔna bi toone wone to ŋwaane. 10Wɛ nam seene o jwoŋi debam yaara yalo na lage ya pa dé na toone to wone, ye o ta wó yɔɔre o jwoŋi debam konto dwoŋi. Dé nam tiini dé jege teena Wɛ tei ne we, o ta wó jwoŋi debam toone jeŋa ne. 11Abam nam wó zeini debam de á na lwoori Wɛ á pa debam tei to. Konto to, nɔɔna dedɛ ná lwoori Wɛ pa dé na zeinim, ko wó pa se nɔɔna dedɛ de seene ba ke‑o lei de o na jwoŋi ba wɛ-lworo kom to.
Pɔɔl na leiri o boboŋa tei to
12Debam na jege teera tei to mo ye dé na tɔge chwoŋa abam tetare ne ye chaveera tera dé tei ne. Dé maa jege wo-pwoŋo mo ye dé yɔɔre dé bere dé wo de abam. Wɛ zaane dem mo zeini debam pa dé ye konto. Debam wo tɔge nabiina swa ŋwaane. Debam tɔge chwoŋa konto dwoŋi de nɔɔna maama ye ko fɔge ko ye abam ŋwaane. 13Dé na popone kolo dé pa abam to ba jege wo-siseigiru. Á wó wane á ga-te ye á ni ko kuri. 14Abam nam maŋe á lɔre debam na ye tei to fenfee yerane mo. Amo maa boŋe we, á wó ba á tiini á lɔre debam fase, se dɛ dem dé Teiru Yezu Krista na wó jwoori o ba to, abam laam wó ta‑á jege teera debam ŋwaane, ne debam na jege teera de abam tei to.
15Amo na tiini a yei konto lanyerane to, a boŋe a ja se a bobo a ba abam tei, se ko pa á na zeinim kuni belei. 16Kokuri a boŋe se a tɔge abam tei mo a vo Makedonia, se a ná maa jwoori dáane, se a daa tɔge á tei, se á laam wane á woli-ne se a kɛ Judea seeni. 17Amo na boŋe se a ke konto ye a wo wane a na chwoŋa to, á pae se amo jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ mo na? Amo ná yeini a boŋe se a ke keim delo, á pae se ko ye amo tete fɔgem yerane mo na? Á nam pae se amo ye wolo na tɛ o gwaane daane we, “Ɛɛ, ɛɛ”, de “Aawo, aawo” to mo na? 18Wɛ nam jege chega ye o yei we debam na tɛ kolo de bere abam to dae nia yalei, nenɛɛne “Ɛɛ” de “Aawo” na gwaane daane tei to. 19-20Debam nam na bere abam Wɛ chega kam tei to, amo de Silas de Timoti pɛ se á lɔre Yezu Krista wolo na ye Wɛ Bu wom to taane chekke. Wonto seene o dae nia yalei tu konto dwoŋi. Wonto nam mo ye wolo na sɛ Wɛ ni dem de “Ɛɛ” yerane to. Wɛ na pwooli de o nɔɔna bam tei maama to mo jigi chega o tei ne. Konto ŋwaane, de ná yeini de ware Wɛ, dé tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane dé we, “Ameena”, se ko pa Wɛ taa jege zula debam tei ne.
21Ko ye Wɛ mo pae se dé tɔge de abam dé zege lanyerane Yezu Krista ŋwaane. Ko ta ye wonto mo kuri debam se dé taa ye o nyem. 22O ma zeini debam de dam, se o ma ke maana o bere we, dé seene dé ye o nyem. O ma daare o ke o Sin-laao kom debam bochara ne, se konto da yiga ko tiŋi chwoŋa se ko pa dé lɔre we, dé laam wó ba dé na Wɛ wo-laaro tem maama.
23Wɛ yei amo wo, ye wonto wó zege amo kwaga ne de a na tɛ chega a bere abam tei to. Amo na zage a boboŋa se a daa yé ba abam tei Korinti ne to, ko ye se a yé pa á na á chaveera mo. 24Ko nam dae we debam lage se dé fe abam de á na wó sɛ Wɛ chega kam tei to, kolo ŋwaane abam maŋe á sɛ‑o de pu-dɛa. Dé nam lage se dé woli abam, se á ta‑á jege ywoni Wɛ ŋwaane mo.

english_text:
1I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful. 2If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad? 3The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy. 4At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you.
Forgiveness
5I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones. 6Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
