21Ko kwaga ne a laam ma zaŋe a tole a vo Siria de Kilikia jei sem. 22Ko nam ná ye Yezu Krista tɔgena balo na tigisi daane Judea te-nia yam ne to, banto yi déem ta wo nɛ amo. 23Ba nam nigi nɔɔna badaara na tɛ amo taane ba we, “Nɔɔno wolo déem na bɛɛse debam to laam zage o kikia, ye o wora o tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam se o pa nɔɔna ba ba sɛ Yezu Krista. Ko nam ye Yezu chwoŋa kam konto mo o déem kwaana se o ya chɔge-ka.” 24Ba na nigi amo taane konto to, ko ma pa ba zuli Wɛ lanyerane.

english_text:
1 Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus. 2But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
3Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised. 4We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves. 5But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
6 Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message. 7They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews. 8God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
9James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews. 10They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do.
Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
11When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong. 12He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles. 13He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled. 14But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said:
Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
15We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles. 16 But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
17When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't! 18But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first. 19It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God.
I have been nailed to the cross with Christ. 20I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me. 21I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl de Yezu totoŋa nakwa taane
1Bena fuga-yana na kɛ to, a ma jwoori a vo Jerusalem. A ma tɔge de Banabas a vo, ye a ja Titusi a woli da. 2Ko nam ye Wɛ mo bere-ne pa a vo dáane. A ma vo a na balo na ye nenɛɛne Yezu tɔgena yiga tiina to. A na nɛ-ba to, a ma pa debam yerane mo jeini dé ŋɔɔne daane, se a pa ba lɔre kwor-ywoŋa kalo amo na yeini a tɔɔle a bere dwi-gɛ tiina bam to. A ba lage se a déem na tɔge chwoŋa kalo to, de a na wo kalo wone leile to ji kafɛ.
3Titusi wolo na tɔge de amo o vo Jerusalem to maa ye Girisi tu. Ba nam wo fe‑o ba pa se o gwoni o peini, ne Juu tiina bam na ke tei to. 4Nɔɔna badaara nam wora ba na pae se ba ye Yezu tɔgena ye ba dae to. Nɔɔna bam konto ya ŋɔge mo ba zo Yezu kɔgɔ kom wo, se ba maane debam ba nii dé na jege dé tete ye dé me de Yezu Krista tei to. Ba nam lage se ba pa dé jwoori dé ji kabɛ mo Juu tiina chullu tem ŋwaane ye de maŋe dé le dé tete te wone. 5Dé nam wo pɛ ba na chwoŋa se ba ke konto dwoŋi de fenfee de, se ba yé wane ba chɔge chega kalo abam na maŋe á tɔge Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane á sɛ to.
6Amo déem na vei a ŋɔɔne de balo na ye nenɛɛne Yezu tɔgena yiga tiina to, ba wo tage-ne we, amo berem dem muri, naa de gɛ kolokolo se a woli da. Nɔɔna bam konto ná seene ba ye yiga tiina, naa ba ná dae, ko dae kolokolo amo tei ne. Wɛ nam ba kuri nɔɔna daane de ba na pae ba tete ye tei to. 7Banto nam nɛ we, Wɛ seene o tiŋi-ne se a kwei o kwor-ywoŋa kam a ja vo a bere dwi-gɛ tiina, se ko maŋe de o na ke-ka Piita jeŋa ne se o ma bere Juu tiina tei to. 8Piita maa ye Yezu totoŋa nakwe se o vo o woli Juu tiina bam. Amo de maa ye o tontoŋeno se a vo a woli dwi-gɛ tiina. Ko maama nam ye Wɛ dam ŋwaane mo. 9Jemsi, de Piita, de Jɔn balo na ye nenɛɛne Yezu tɔgena dedɛɛra to ma lɔre we, ko ye Wɛ mo pɛ-ne zaane se a taa toŋe totoŋe dem konto. Konto ŋwaane ba ma sɛ amo de Banabas dedaane dé na toŋe de-ba tei to, ye ba ja dé jea. Debam maama ma sɛ we, amo de Banabas jege se dé vo dwi-gɛ tiina jei sem ne mo dé bere-ba Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Banto de maa wó vo ba tɔɔle-ka Juu tiina jei sem ne. 10Woŋo kodwoŋi yerane ŋwaane mo ba lwoori debam se dé yé swei ko ni ne. Ko ye se dé kwaane dé woli yiniga tiina balo na wo ba kɔgɔ kom wone to. Amo ya maŋe a lage se a ke konto dwoŋi mo.
Chullu tɔgem taane
11Ko daare maŋa kalo Piita na tu Antioka ye a na‑o to, a laam ma bwɛ‑o nɔɔna yiga ne se a bere‑o we, o daa ba tɔge chega chwoŋa. 12O na bobo o yi Antioka to, o yeini o jeini de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na sɛ Yezu to o di ba wodiu. Ko daare nɔɔna badwonna Jemsi na toŋe to laam ma ba dáane. Banto na yi to, Piita ma pipiri o boboŋa ye o ve se o taa tɔge o di wodiu dwi-gɛ tiina tei ne. O pɔɔre o tete konto, kolo ŋwaane o kɔre balo na bere we, wolo maama na tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa to jege se o gwoni o peini, ye o tɔge Juu tiina chullu tem na ye tei to. 13Juu tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Yezu to badaara de tɔge ba jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ, nenɛɛne Piita na ye tei to. Ko laam ma pa se Banabas de sɛ ba kikia yam, ye o kɔre se o tɔge chwoŋa chekke. 14Konto mo a nɛ we, ba daa ba tɔge chega kalo Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam na bere to. A laam ma zege ba maama yiga ne ye a ta de Piita a we, “Nmo ye Juu tu mo. N kikia nam tɔge dwi-gɛ tiina chwei mo, ne n dae Juu tu mo tei. Bɛ mo ye n laam boŋe se n fe dwi-gɛ tiina bam se ba taa sɛ Juu tiina chullu tem?”
15Ko ye chega mo, ba loge debam Juu tiina dwi wone mo, ye dé dae dwi-gɛ tiina balo na yeiri Wɛ nia yam to. 16De konto de, dé laam tu dé lɔre we, nɔɔno wó na chega Wɛ tei ne mo de o na ke o wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista to, se ko dae o kikia na tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam to ŋwaane. Konto to, dé tu dé ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ Yezu Krista, se ko pa dé na chega Wɛ tei ne. Dé daa ba nia Wɛ nia yam tɔgem kikia na ye tei to, kolo ŋwaane dé yei we, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o na chega Wɛ tei ne o kikia na tɔge o ni-kaana yam tei to ŋwaane.
17Debam balo na me de Yezu Krista to jege teena we, dé wó na chega Wɛ tei ne. Debam nam ná tu dé ji nɔn-chechɔgero Wɛ ni-kaana yam seeni, konto wó bere we Yezu tete mo gane debam se dé tusi mo na? Konto bere ko bá taa ye chega. 18Wolo nam ná pipiri o jwoori o sɛ Juu tiina chullu tem, o na maŋe o yage te tɔgem te na bá wane te pa o na chega Wɛ tei ne to ŋwaane, konto tu seene o ye wolo na tusi Wɛ chwoŋa ne to mo. 19Amo nam tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam ŋwaane a le a tete ya dam kuri ne. Ko nye de a tega mo Wɛ ni-kaana yam seeni, se a wane a na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. 20Ba déem na page Yezu Krista dagara yuu ne pa se o te wɛɛne to, ko nye de amo tɔge ded‑o mo a te. Amo tete daa ba jege ŋwea, ye Yezu Krista nam mo wo a bochare ne o ŋwe. Amo na jege ŋwea logo baŋa ne tei to, ko ye amo na ke a wo-dedoa a sɛ Wɛ Bu Yezu to ŋwaane mo. Wonto jege amo swono, ye o sɛ se o te se o wane o jwoŋi a ŋwea o yage. 21Amo bá sɛ se a ve Wɛ zaane dem o na pɛ-ne to. Nɔɔno nam ná wane o na chega Wɛ tei ne de o na tɔge o ni-kaana yam tei to, ko ya wó bere we Yezu Krista toone dem ye kafɛ mo.

english_text:
Faith Is the Only Way
1You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you? 2I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him? 3How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you? 4Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing? 5God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
6 The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith. 7 And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham. 8 Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him. 9This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
10 Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.” 11 No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
12 The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands. 13 But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse. 14And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit.
The Law and the Promise
15My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement. 16That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ. 17 What I am saying is that the Law cannot change or cancel God's promise made 430 years before the Law was given. 18 If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
19What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people. 20There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him.
Slaves and Children
21Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law. 22But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
23The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith. 24In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God. 25But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
26All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus. 27And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes. 28Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman. 29 So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_text:
Dé na wó na chega Wɛ tei ne tei to
1Abam Galatia tiina boboŋa tera á yuu ne. Bera mo tulimi abam pa se á swa daa tera? Ba déem tɔɔle ba bere abam jaja ko na ke tei ye Yezu Krista te dagara kam yuu ne to. 2Amo lage se a bwei abam woŋo kodwoŋi yerane mo a nii: Abam déem na sɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom se ko taa wo á tei ne to, bɛ mo pɛ ko ke? Ko ye abam kikia na tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam to ŋwaane mo na? Aawo. Ko ye á na sɛ o kwor-ywoŋa kam á na nigi to ŋwaane mo. 3Bɛ mo ye á boboŋa jei konto? Abam na bobo se á tɔge Yezu to, á dɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane mo á tɔge‑o. Á laam boŋe se á pipiri á da á tete dam ŋwaane mo se á vo á ti na? 4Wonnu telo maama na yi abam to wó ji kafɛ mo á tei ne na? Aawo. Te bá wane te ji kafɛ! 5Wɛ nam woli abam de o Sin-laao kom, ye o daare o ma o dam o ke wo-kenkagela á tei ne. O na ke konto to, ko ye á kikia na tɔge o nia yam to ŋwaane mo na? Aawo. Ko nam ye á na sɛ o kwor-ywoŋa kam á na nigi to ŋwaane mo.
6Ko ná ye Abaraham, ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne ko we, Wonto ke o wo-dedoa de Baŋa Wɛ, ye konto ŋwaane mo Wɛ pɛ o na chega. 7Konto wó pa á lɔre we, Abaraham dwi tiina chekke ye balo na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ to mo. 8Faŋa faŋa to ba maŋe ba popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, Wɛ wó pa dwi-gɛ tiina de na chega o tei ne, ba na ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. Mo kokuri Wɛ ma pa Abaraham wuuri o lɔre o kwor-ywoŋa kam na wó taa ye tei to. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo wó da nmo baŋa ne mo a swɛ logo baŋa dwi maama swolim.” 9Konto to, balo maama de na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ne Abaraham déem na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo wó jwoŋi swolim Wɛ tei ne.
10Ko nam ná ye balo na tiini ba jege boboŋa we, ba wó na chega Wɛ ni-kaana yam tɔgem ŋwaane to, Wɛ sɔla ta wó taa wo ba baŋa ne mo. Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne ko we, “Wolo maama ná wo sɛ se o toŋe o tɔge kolo maama na popone ko ke Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom wone to, Wɛ wó sɔɔle lwarem o yage kotu baŋa ne.”
11Dé nam yei lanyerane we, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá na chega Wɛ tei ne de o ná tɔge o nia yam yerane. Ko nam popone we, “Wolo na jege chega Wɛ tei ne to wó na ŋwea o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane.” 12Wɛ ni-kaana yam nam ba tɔge wo-dedoa keim na ye tei to. Ya nam tɔge nɔɔno kikia na ye tei to mo, ne ko na popone we, “Wolo kikia na yɔɔre ya tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam to wó na ŋwea ya baŋa ne.”
13Dé ya lage dé na chɔgem, dé kikia na wo tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam maama to ŋwaane. Yezu Krista nam tege dagara kam yuu ne mo o ma ŋwe de wɛleera jene, ye o le debam chɔgem dem konto wone. Wɛ ma pa se Yezu leiri debam yuu ne, ye o na chɔgem delo na maŋe de debam to. Ko ye nenɛɛne ko na popone we, “Wolo maama ba ná leigi daa yuu ne ba go, Wɛ sɔɔle lwarem mo o yage kotu yuu ne.” 14Yezu Krista déem sɛ se o na chɔgem dem konto, se ko wane ko pa dwi-gɛ tiina de na chwoŋa se ba na Wɛ swolim o ŋwaane, ne Abaraham na nɛ Wɛ swolim tei to. Konto ŋwaane, debam wó wane dé jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom, ne Wɛ na pwooli se o pa debam tei to, dé na ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ‑o to ŋwaane.
Wɛ ni-kaana yam kuri na ye tei to
15A nu-bia bam, a lage a ma logo baŋa chega mo a ma bere abam Wɛ chega kam na ye tei to. Nɔɔna balei ná ke ni-sɛɛm, ye ba ná gwoni ni ba pa daane, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o chɔge ba ni dem konto, naa o ke woŋo kodwoŋi o daa woli da. 16Wɛ déem pwooli se o zeini Abaraham de wo-laaro, se o daare o zeini o dwi dem de. Ko na popone Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom ne tei to, ko wo popone we, “o dwi tiina.” Ko nam popone we, “o dwi dem” mo. Konto ba bere we nɔɔna dedɛ taane mo ba ŋɔɔna. Ko nam ye nɔɔno dedoa taane mo, ye dwi tu wom konto ye Yezu Krista mo. 17Wɛ déem gwoni ni de Abaraham ye o pwooli kampwola de ŋwaane. Konto kwaga ne, bena bia yana de fintɔ (430) laam na kɛ to, o daa ma kwei o ni-kaana yam o pa Juu tiina. Amo na lage se á lɔre kolo to mo ye we, Wɛ ni-kaana yam konto ware ya chɔge ni-gwonim delo o ya na maŋe o pa Abaraham to. Ya ta maa ware ya pa o kampwola kam ji kafɛ. 18Wɛ nɔɔna bam ya ná wae ba jwoŋi o wo-laaro tem o ni-kaana yam ŋwaane, ko ya daa bá taa ye o kampwola kam ŋwaane. Dé nam yei we, Wɛ déem zeini Abaraham o kampwola kam ŋwaane mo.
19Ko na ye konto to, bɛŋwaane mo Wɛ kwei o ni-kaana yam o ke o nɔɔna jeŋa ne? O kwei-ya o woli de o kampwola kam se ya wane ya pa dé lɔre tusim na ye tei to mo. Ya déem jege se ya taa wora se ko vo ko yi maŋa kam Abaraham dwi tu wom na wó ba logo baŋa to mo. Wonto maa ye wolo Wɛ na tiŋi o ni dem o ŋwaane to. Wɛ déem tɔge o malese jeŋa mo o kwei o nia yam o pa o nɔɔna bam, ye yiŋinu mo wora ba tetare laŋa ne. 20Yiŋinu maŋe se o taa wora nɔɔna balei laŋa ne mo. Wɛ nam na ye ŋo dedoa to mo pa se o tete gwoni o ni de Abaraham ye yiŋinu tera.
21Konto maama nam bere we Wɛ ni-kaana yam de o kampwola kam ware ya maŋe daane mo na? Aawo, ko bá ye konto. Ni-kaane tera de na wó wane de pa nɔɔna na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. Ni-kaane konto dwoŋi ya ná wora, dé ya wó wane dé tɔge de baŋa ne dé na chega Wɛ tei ne. 22Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere debam we, nabiina maama wo wɛleera dam kuri ne mo, ye ba daa ba jege chwoŋa se ba tɔge da ba ma jwoŋi ba tete. Konto to, ko ye balo na ke ba wo-dedoa ba sɛ Yezu Krista to mo wó jwoŋi wo-laaro telo Wɛ na pwooli se o pa-ba to, Yezu na jege ba chega to ŋwaane.
23Ko daare maŋa kam Wɛ ta na wo pore chwoŋa se dé ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ Yezu to mo Wɛ ni-kaana yam cheiŋi debam, ye dé laam ba dé lɔre wo-dedoa chwoŋa kam na ye tei to. 24Konto mo Wɛ ni-kaana yam déem jege debam ya kwɛa, se ko vo ko yi maŋa kam dé na lɔre Yezu Krista to, se dé laam na chega Wɛ tei ne dé wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane. 25Wɛ laam na pore chwoŋa se dé ke dé wo-dedoa de Yezu to, woŋo daa tera ko na wó taa tei debam.
26Abam na me de Yezu Krista to, á maama ye Wɛ bia, á na jege wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. 27Abam wolo maama na jwoŋi sɛɛm pa se o me de Yezu Krista to laam nye de Yezu tete mo. 28Konto to, popɔra tera Juu tu de dwi-gɛ tu laŋa ne. Popɔra ta tera kabaa de wolo na tei o tete to laŋa ne. Ko ná ye baaro naa kaane de, popɔra ta tera. Abam na me de Yezu Krista to, á maama ye ŋo dedoa mo. 29Abam na ye Yezu nyem to, ko pa se á tɔge á ye Abaraham dwi tiina mo. Á maa wó jwoŋi wo-laaro, nenɛɛne Wɛ déem na pwooli kampwola de Abaraham tei to.

english_text:
1Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs. 2This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set. 3This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
4But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law, 5 so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children. 6 Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father. 7You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised.
Paul's Concern for the Galatians
8Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real. 9But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers? 10You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years. 11I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
12My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me 13when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick. 14My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself. 15Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me. 16Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
17Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention. 18It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you. 19My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you. 20I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled.
Hagar and Sarah
21Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says? 22 In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free. 23The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
24All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave. 25Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
26 But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave. 27 The Scriptures say about her,
“You have never had children,
but now you can be glad.
You have never given birth,
but now you can shout.
Once you had no children,
but now you will have
more children than a woman
who has been married
for a long time.”
28My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was. 29 But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today. 30 The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.” 31My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_text:
1Ko nye de bu wolo na wó ba o jwoŋi o kwo sɔŋɔ o taa tei to mo. Wonto ta ná ye nɔn-doŋo, ba maa yeini ba ke‑o ne kabaa mo tei, ye ba nam yei we wonto mo wó ba o taa tei o kwo wonnu maama. 2O na ye nɔn-doŋo konto to, nɔɔna mo wora ba na nii o wonnu baŋa ne ba pa‑o, se ko taa vei maŋa kam o kwo na kuri se o taa tei o wonnu tem to. 3Ko ye bedwe mo de debam de. Dé boboŋa déem ta na wo kweere se dé lɔre Wɛ chega kam na ye tei to, logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro mo tei debam ne dé ye kabɛ mo tei. 4Ko daare maŋa kam dé Kwo Wɛ na kuri to na seene ka yi to mo o déem toŋe o tete Bu se o ba logo baŋa. O na tu to, ko ye kaane mo loge‑o, ye o sɛ o tɔge Wɛ nia yam, 5se o wane o jwoŋi balo bam ni-kaana yam na tei to. O ma ŋwe dé wɛleera jene se ko pa dé wane dé ji Wɛ bia. 6Dé na seene dé ye Wɛ bia to, o ma toŋe o Bu wom Jworo kom se ko ba ko taa wo dé bochara ne, ye ko pae dé bwoi Wɛ we, “Dé Kwo, Baba.” 7Konto maa bere we, dé daa dae kabɛ, se dé laam ye Wɛ sɔŋɔ bia mo. Dé nam na ye Wɛ bia konto to, Wɛ wó pa dé jwoŋi o wo-laaro tem maama dé taa tei.
Pɔɔl jege lwia Galatia tiina ŋwaane
8Faŋa faŋa to abam déem ya yeiri Wɛ, pa se logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tei abam ne á ye kabɛ mo tei. Wo-yɔɔro tem konto pae se te ye wa mo ye te dae kolokolo. 9Ko daare leile konto mo abam laam tu á lɔre Wɛ. Ko na ye chega to, Wɛ mo pɛ abam chwoŋa se á lɔre‑o. Ko na ye konto to, bɛ mo ye á laam boŋe se á daa jwoori á ta‑á zuli logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro telo na ba jege dam ye te ye yiniga yerane to? Bɛŋwaane mo á lage se á jwoori á ba á ta‑á ye te kabɛ? 10Abam yeini á wae á kuri da yadwonna se á ta‑á zuli-ya, ko woli de chane sedwonna, de bena yadwonna de. 11Amo jege lwia mo a pae abam. Dɛ delo amo totoŋa yam maama a na toŋe a pa abam to wó ji kafɛ mo.
12A nu-bia bam, a lwoori abam se á ta‑á lwoni-ne de a na tɔge Wɛ tei to. Kokuri amo déem jigi ne á na ye tei to mo. Amo déem na wo abam tei ne to, á wo ke kolokolo á ma á chɔge a yiga. 13Á wó wane á guli we, amo na bobo a ba abam tei ye a tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere abam to, ko ye jaweo mo jege-ne ye a ke konto. 14De konto de, a jaweo kom na tiini ko daane abam tei to, á wo sɛ se á yaale-ne. Abam nam ke-ne lanyerane, ne a ye Wɛ maleka mo tei. Ko maa nye de á na wó zuli Yezu Krista tete tei to. 15Abam déem jege wopwolo de amo. Amo yei lanyerane we, á ya ná wae á yera, á ya wó fɔ á pa-ne, ne ko ya ná wó wane ko woli-ne. Bɛ nam mo kea ye á wopwolo kom chɔge? 16Amo na pɛ se á lɔre chega kam to ŋwaane mo pɛ se a ji abam dono na?
17Ko nam ná ye nɔɔna balo na pipiri Wɛ chega kam ye amo maŋe a ta ba taane to, banto kwaane ba ke abam lanyerane mo se á boboŋa tɔge-ba, ye ba nam ba boŋe se ba zeini abam. Ba lage se ba chɔge amo de abam mo daane, se á daare á ta‑á ke banto lanyerane. 18Nɔɔno ná ke o dwonna lanyerane, ye o ná seene o boŋe se o woli-ba, konto lana. Ko seene ko lana maŋa maama mo, ye ko ba jege se ko taa ye maŋa kalo yerane amo na wó taa wo abam tei ne to.
19A bia bam, amo toŋe abam ŋwaane pa se ko chɛ a yera ne, ne kaane na virigi puga tei to mo. Amo wó taa jege lwia konto a pa abam, se ko vo ko yi maŋa kam á na wó ta‑á jege Yezu Krista kikia á ŋwea ne to. 20Amo tiini a lage se a taa wo abam tei ne mo leile konto. Dé ya ná wae dé na daane, dé ya wó wane dé ŋɔɔne daane se dé ke ni dedwe. Ko nam na ye tei to, a yeiri a na wó ke tei se a zeini abam.
Hagara de Sara taane
21Abam balo na boŋe se á kwei á tete á pa Wɛ ni-kaana yam to daa ta wo lɔre Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom na bere tei to. 22Wɛ tɔnɔ kom bere debam we, dé nabaaro Abaraham déem jege bia balei. Kaane wodwoŋi na ye kabaa o sɔŋɔ ne to mo loge bakeira dedoa o pa‑o. Ko daare o tete kaane wom de ma lo bakeira o woli da. O tete nenɔŋa kaane wom yere mo Sara, ko daare kabaa kam yere mo Hagara. 23Bakeira kalo kabaa kam na loge to lora tɔge nabiina chwoŋa na ye tei to mo. Ko daare bakeira kalo o nenɔŋa kaane wom na loge to lora nam tɔge Wɛ kampwola kam ŋwaane mo. 24Ko maa ye memaŋe mo de kaana bam konto, se ko bere debam chwei selei tɔgem na ye tei to. Kaana balei bam ta bere debam Wɛ na gwoni ni de o nɔɔna kuni belei tei to mo. Hagara mo bere ni-gwonim delo Wɛ na ke o pa Juu tiina bam Sinayi peo kom yuu ne to. Balo na tɔge ni-gwonim dem konto nye de kabɛ mo, ne Hagara de o bia na ye kabɛ tei. 25Sinayi peo kom wo Arabia ne mo, ye jei sem konto ye Hagara de o bia bam nyem. Juu tiina de nam tɔge ni-gwonim delo Wɛ na ke dáane to mo. Konto to, Jerusalem na wora zem to de ko nɔn-bia bam maama de ye kabɛ mo, de Wɛ ni-kaana yam na tei-ba to. 26Ko nam ná ye Wɛ teo Jerusalem kom chekke, konto ye teo kolo debam na ye ko nɔn-bia to mo. Ko maa nye de debam nu wolo na loge debam ye dé dae kabɛ, ne Sara déem na loge bu ye o dae kabaa tei to. 27Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we:
“Nmo wolo na ye kadega
ye n ta wo jaane puga n lo bu to,
bage n yage de wopwolo,
nmo na wó di ywoni to ŋwaane.
Kokuri kaane wolo baro ya na yage‑o to
laam wó ba o taa jege bia,
se ko dwoni kaane wolo de o baro ta na wo daane to.”
28A nu-bia bam, ko ná ye abam, á laam jigi Wɛ tete sɔŋɔ kom bia o kampwola kam ŋwaane mo, nenɛɛne Sara bu Izaak lora kam na tɔge tei to. 29Faŋa faŋa to Abaraham bu wolo lora na tɔge nabiina chwoŋa to mo bɛɛse o bu wolo lora na tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao kom chwoŋa to. Wɛ tete bia bam ta nae bɛɛsem konto dwoŋi de zem maama. 30Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere debam we, “Zeili kaane wolo na ye kabaa to de o bu-baaro wom se ba viiri. Kolo ŋwaane kaane wonto bu wom bá tɔge de n tete nenɔŋa kaane bu wom o pɔɔre nmo wonnu tem o taa tei.”
31A nu-bia bam, dé na ye Wɛ bia tei to mo bere we dé nye de Abaraham tete nenɔŋa kaane wom bia ye dé tei de tete, se dé yé taa nye de kabaa kam bia.

english_text:
Christ Gives Freedom
1Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
2I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised. 3If you do, you must obey the whole Law. 4And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace. 5But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ. 6If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
7You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth. 8And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you. 9 A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough, 10but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
11My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised. 12I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
13My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love. 14 All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself. 15But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves.
God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
16If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires. 17 The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should. 18But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
19People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds. 20They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are 21envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
22God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful, 23gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways. 24And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires. 25God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit. 26But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_text:
Dé na wó taa tei dé tete tei to
1Yezu Krista na jwoŋi debam o yage to, ko ye se dé taa tei dé tete mo. Konto ŋwaane, á fɔge á che á tete se á daa yé sɛ á tɔge chwoŋa kalo na wó pa á jwoori á ji kabɛ.
2Nam cheigi-na amo Pɔɔl na lage a ta kolo de abam to. Á ná kwei á tete á pa Juu tiina chullu tem ye á tɔge ba na gwoni ba peina tei to, á daa ba jege nyɔɔre Yezu Krista tei ne. 3Amo lage a ta a bere abam jaja we, abam wolo maama ná sɛ se ba gwoni o peini, konto tu jege se o sɛ Wɛ nia yam maama se o daare o taa toŋe o tɔge-ya. 4Abam balo na boŋe se á na chega Wɛ tei ne o nia yam tɔgem ŋwaane to yiga nam le mo de Yezu Krista, ye o zaane dem daa tere á tei ne.
5Ko daare Wɛ Sin-laao kom nam wo debam balo na ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ Yezu to tei ne, ye dé jege teena lanyerane we, dé wó na chega Wɛ tei ne. 6Dé na me de Yezu Krista to, dé ná gwoni dé peina, naa ya ná wo gwoni, ko dae kolokolo. Woŋo kolo nam na ye wo-chɛɔ to mo ye se dé taa jege wo-dedoa de Yezu, se ko pa dé taa tɔge da-swono kikia lanyerane.
7Abam déem yɔɔre á tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa lanyerane. Wɔ nam mo chege á chwoŋa se á daa yé ta‑á tɔge chega kam? 8Ko bere ko bá taa ye Wɛ mo chege abam konto. Wonto nam mo bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o. 9Ko nye ne dé na yeini dé tɛ dé we, “Sabɔle fenfee ná wora bworobworo mun-lɛɛre wone, ko wó pa de maama fole mo.” 10Debam maama na me de dé Teiru Yezu Krista to, a yei we dé wó taa jege boboŋa bedwe. Wolo wom na jege abam boboŋa o chɔge to nam jege se o na chɔgem de o keim-lɔŋɔ kom, o na maŋe o ye tei de.
11A nu-bia bam, amo ba bere we, nɔɔno ná tɔge Wɛ, o jege se o gwoni o peini. Amo ya ná bere konto dwoŋi, nɔɔna bá bɛɛse-ne de a berem dem, kolo ŋwaane amo na bere Yezu toone dem dagara kam yuu ne tei to ya bá taa ye ta-balɔrɔ nɔɔna tei ne. 12Amo nam na boŋe tei to, ko ya lana se balo na jege abam ba daana to tiini ba gwoni ba tete yera, ye ko dae ba peina gwonim yerane.
Wɛ Sin-laao kom na zeini debam tei to
13A nu-bia bam, Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, ko ye se á laam ta‑á tei á tete mo. Á na seene á tei á tete konto to, á nam yé pa se á kikia taa tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo maama á fera na zo to. Nam ta‑á yei-na se á ta‑á tɔge swono chwoŋa se á ta‑á ma woli daane. 14Kokuri Wɛ nia yam maama bere woŋo dedoa mo we, nɔɔno maama jege se o taa swoi o dwoŋi se ko maŋe de o na swoi o tete tei to. 15Abam nam ná yeini á ke daane ne vara mo chiŋi ye ba done daane tei to, á ta‑á yei se á wó ba á chɔge á tete de á dwi maama.
16Nam cheigi-na kolo kom a na lage a ta to. Pa-na se Wɛ Sin-laao kom taa cho abam Wɛ chwoŋa wone, se á yé ta‑á sɛ á tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo á fera na zoore to. 17Kolo ŋwaane debam nabiina boboŋa na lage kolo to ba jege fera ko pa Wɛ Sin-laao kom. Wɛ Sin-laao kom de fera na zoore kolo to de nam ba jege fera debam boboŋa wone. Ko maa bere we wonnu tem konto telei boboŋa ware ya maŋe daane. Ko ma pa se dé daa ware dé boboŋa wonnu dé ke. 18Wɛ Sin-laao kom nam ná cho abam, Wɛ ni-kaana yam daa ba jege se ya taa tei abam.
19Ko ná ye kikia yalo nabiina boboŋa na lage to, yanto wae ya lɔre jaja. Ya tɔge wo-zɔɔna keim de wo-digiru kikia yalo maama na tɔge ka-laga chwoŋa to mo. 20Ya ta tɔge jwona kaanem de liri kikia. Ya pae se nɔɔna chuli daane ye ba jaane daane. Ya maa pa-ba puseŋa, de ban-zɔŋɔ, ye ba lage kamunim ba pa ba tete. Ya maa pae se nɔɔna pɔɔre daane yera yera. 21Ya daa ta pae se nɔɔna wo gweena de ba dwonna, ba daare ba ye sa-nyɔra, ye ba ke poweeni de. Ya maa daare ya pae se ba ke wo-yɔɔro tedaara konto dwoŋi. Amo nam ta wó fɔge a kaane abam a woli da we, abam balo na yeini á ke wonnu tento dwoŋi to bá tɔge á na jeiŋa jei Wɛ paare dem wone.
22Ko daare Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pae se nɔɔna ye tei to, konto pae se nɔɔna jege swono mo, de wopwolo, de bochare-zuru, de ban-peno, de da-zula, de ka zeini daane, de wo-dedoa keim, 23de ka-taa-nege-daane, de ka-ja-n-tete. Ni-kaane nam tera de na vae keim-laaro tento dwoŋi. 24Ko ná ye debam balo na ye Yezu Krista nyem to, dé maŋe dé pa se dé tete boboŋa daa ba tei debam, se dé daa yé taa tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo dé fera na zoore to. 25Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ dé na ŋwe-doŋa to, dé pa-na se ko taa cho debam dé ŋwea wone. 26Dé nam yé bere dé tete de dé dwonna, se dé yé lwɛ-ba, naa dé ke-ba puseŋa.

english_text:
Help Each Other
1My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself. 2You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
3If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong. 4Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others. 5We each must carry our own load.
6Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
7You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant. 8If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life. 9Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up. 10We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord.
Final Warnings
11You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
12Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ. 13They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised. 14But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
15It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
16If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
17 On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
18My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_text:
Dé na jege se dé taa zeini daane tei to
1A nu-bia bam, á ná lɔre we nɔɔno ke keim o tusi, abam balo na jege Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam to wó pa se o jwoori o tɔge chwoŋa, ye á ta zuri á yera se á ta‑á nege‑o. Á nam ta‑á yei á tete, se ko yé wane ko soge abam se á de tɔge á tusi. 2Ta‑á woli-na daane se á ta‑á yaara á pa daane. Á ná yeini á ke konto dwoŋi, á wó ta‑á tɔge Yezu Krista ni dem o na bere to.
3Abam wolo ná bere o tete kamunni ye o dae kolokolo, konto tu gane o tete mo. 4Nɔɔno maama jege se o taa nii o tete kikia na ye tei to mo. Konto tu nam ná nɛ we o kikia yam lana, o laam wó wane o taa jege teera de o tete na ke kolo to, ko dae se o kwei o maŋe de o dwoŋi kikia na ye tei to. 5Kokuri nɔɔno maama jege se o kikia taa tɔge o tete na ye tei to mo.
6Nɔɔno wolo ba na zamese‑o Wɛ taane to jege se o pɔɔre wo-laaro telo o na tu o na to o pa o berem tu wom mo.
7Á yé gane á tete, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o kwoli o na ke kolo to Wɛ yiga ne. Nɔɔno kikia na wó pa o na nyɔɔre delo to nye de valo na dugi o kara, ye o jege se o jwoori o ba o zage wonnu telo dwi o na dugi to mo. 8Nɔɔno nam ná tɔge kikia yalo o tete boboŋa na lage to yerane, o nyɔɔre mo wó taa ye toone na wó chɔge‑o to. Ko daare nɔɔno nam ná tɔge kikia yalo Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ‑o se o taa ke to, konto tu nyɔɔre mo wó taa ye Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo o Sin-laao kom na wó pa‑o to. 9Konto ŋwaane, dé nam yé pa se jawɔrɔ zo debam se dé yage wo-laaro keim. Dé ná fɔge dé zege konto dwoŋi, dé laam wó ba dé na nyɔɔre delo na lana to. 10Konto ŋwaane, dé ná nɛ chwoŋa maŋa de maŋa, dé jege se dé taa ke wo-laaro mo dé pa nɔɔna maama, ko fɔge ko dae dé nu-bia balo de na jege wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista to.
11Ta‑á nia, amo tete laam na mɛ a jeŋa a popone botare-bi-kamuna yanto se a pa abam.
12Ko ná ye nɔɔna balo na kwaane se ba fe abam se á gwoni á peina Juu tiina chullu tem ŋwaane to, banto ye balo na lage se ba na yere mo nɔɔna tei ne, de ba na ke ba tete tei to. Ba nam ba lage se nɔɔna taa bɛɛse-ba. Konto ŋwaane mo ba bá sɛ se ba bere nɔɔna we, Wɛ wó jwoŋi-ba Yezu Krista na tege dagara kam yuu ne to ŋwaane. 13Balo bam nam na sɛ peina gwonim to tete nam ba tɔge Wɛ nia yam chekke. Ba nam lage se ba pa abam de gwoni á peina mo se ko pa ba na chwoŋa ba taa paale we, abam tɔge á sɛ se á gwoni á peina ne banto tei. 14Ko nam ná ye amo, woŋo kolo yerane amo na wó paale-ko to ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista na tege dagara kam yuu ne se o jwoŋi nɔɔna tei to. Ko maa nye de amo de tɔge ded‑o mo a te, se ko bere we logo baŋa boboŋa daa tera a bochare ne, ye logo baŋa nɔɔna yiga tera amo wone, ne a ye too mo tei. 15Nmo ná gwoni n peini, naa n ná wo gwoni-de, konto dae kolokolo. Woŋo kolo nam na ye wo-chɛɔ to mo ye se n jwoŋi ŋwe-doŋa Wɛ tei ne. 16Ko nam ná ye balo na tɔge ŋwe-doŋa chwoŋa kam to, Wɛ wó pa ba na bochare-zuru, ye o daare o duri ba ŋwaŋa lanyerane, ko woli de balo maama na ye o tete nɔɔna chekke to.
17Amo daa ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno jwoori o daane-ne, kokuri amo na maŋe a jege kalwanno telo a yera ne to bere we Yezu mo tei-ne.
18A nu-bia bam, dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo á bochara ne. Ameena.

english_text:
1 From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus.
To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
2I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
3Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven! 4Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people. 5God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children. 6God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
7-8 Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding, 9and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways. 10Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
11God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us. 12He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him. 13Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God. 14The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised.
Paul's Prayer
15I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people. 16So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers. 17I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God. 18My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
19I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used 20 when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven. 21There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well. 22 God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything. 23The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl wolo Wɛ na tiŋi-ne de o tete boboŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto. A popone se a pa abam balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna ye á zoore Efesia ne to. Abam maa ye balo na tɔge Yezu Krista de á wo maama to.
2Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Wɛ na zeini o bia tei to
3Baŋa Wɛ wolo na ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Kwo to maŋe de teem. O yɔɔre o swɛ debam swolim, ye o fɔge dé bochara de wo-laaro telo maama na ye o Sin-laao kom nyem ye te nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne to, dé na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. 4Boboa ne ye logo baŋa daa ta tera to, Wɛ tɔge Yezu ŋwaane mo o kuri debam se dé taa jege wo-pwoŋo o yiga ne ye tusim tera. 5O na jege debam swono to mo o wuuri o ke o boboŋa ne se o pa dé tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane dé ji o bia. Mo o boboŋa na lage se o ke kolo to. 6Konto ŋwaane Wɛ maŋe se o na zula lanyerane de o zaane dem na ba jege dwoŋi to. Wɛ kwei o zaane dem konto o pa debam zɛɛra, dé na ye balo na me de o Bu-swono Yezu to ŋwaane.
7Dé na me ded‑o konto to, o mɛ o toone jana bam mo o ŋwe dé wɛleera jene, se ko pa Wɛ saare dé wɛleera yam. Mo Wɛ zaane dem na tiini de beiŋi tei, 8ye o ma-de o zeini debam se ko ja gaale, ye o pa dé na swa de yi-poro lanyerane. 9O ma pa dé lɔre o chega kalo déem na seigi to. Mo o na lage se o ke kolo to, se ko pa dé lɔre we, o boboŋa maŋe ya ja se o tɔge Yezu ŋwaane mo o fɔge wonnu maama o ke daane. 10O nam boŋe se, maŋa kam o na lage to ná yi ka ti, se o pa o boboŋa seene ya ke, se wonnu maama mo ke daane se Yezu Krista taa ye te maama yuu tu, ko ná ye telaao wonnu tem, de tega baŋa wonnu tem maama de.
11Dé na me de Yezu to ŋwaane mo Wɛ kuri debam se dé taa ye o nyem. Konto mo ye kolo Wɛ na maŋe o ke o boboŋa ne se o ke o pa debam to. O maa ye wolo na pae se wonnu maama yɔɔre te ke nenɛɛne o boboŋa na lage tei to. 12Ko ná ye debam balo na dɛ yiga dé kwei dé teena dé daŋe Yezu Krista baŋa ne to, Wɛ déem kuri debam se dé taa ye balo na wó pa o na zula o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane to mo. 13Ko woli de abam balo laam na tu á sɛ Wɛ chega kam to, abam nigi Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kalo na pɛ á na verem to, ye á ke á wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista. Á na me ded‑o konto to, Wɛ ma ke o Sin-laao kom á bochara ne, nenɛɛne o na pwooli se o ke tei to, ye ko ye maana mo ko pa abam se ko bere we á seene á ye o nyem. 14Wɛ Sin-laao kom na wo dé bochara ne to, ko dɛ yiga ko tiŋi chwoŋa se ko pa dé lɔre we, dé laam wó ba dé na wo-laaro telo maama Wɛ na tiŋi se o pa debam to. Ko ta bere debam we, maŋa wó yi se Wɛ fɔge o jwoŋi debam balo maama na ye o nyem to. Ko maama wó pa se Wɛ na zula o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
Pɔɔl lwoori Wɛ o pa-ba
15Wɛ na tiini o zeini abam konto to, amo yeini a ke‑o lei abam ŋwaane maŋa maama. Amo nigi abam taane we, á tɔge dé Teiru Yezu de á wo-dedoa, ye á kwori á jege Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama swono. 16Konto ŋwaane mo a ke Wɛ lei ye a kwori a lwoori‑o a pa abam. 17Baŋa Wɛ maa ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Yuu-tu, ye o ye debam Kwo wom na jege paare telaao ne to. A maa yeini a lwoori‑o se o tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa o zeini abam de swa de boboŋ-dɛɛra, se á wane á lɔre o chega kam maama. 18Wɛ wó pa á yia poore se á wane á lɔre o na kuri abam se á ta‑á jege teena o tei ne tei to, se á daare á lɔre o wo-laaro tem na tiini te beiŋi tei ye o tiŋi o ni se o kwei-te o pa balo na ye o nyem to. 19Wɛ wó pa se á lɔre o dam dem na daga de gaale tei, ye o ma-de o zeini debam balo maama na sɛ‑o to. O dam-fɔrɔ kom konto bere o na wae o toŋe totoŋ-kamunnu tei to. 20O déem mɛ-de o bi Yezu Krista toone wone mo, ye o daare o ma-de o zeiŋi‑o o pa o jeini o jazem seeni telaao ne. 21Konto mo Yezu Krista laam tei wonnu telo maama na jege dam nabiina baŋa ne to. Ko ná ye dedɛɛra maama, de paare maama, o dam dem dwoi te maama. Ko ná ye zem wonnu tem dam mo, naa jwa wonnu telo na lage te ba to, Yezu dwoi woŋo kolo maama na jege yere ko pa nabiina to. 22Wɛ ma kwei wonnu maama o ke Yezu Krista dam kuri ne, ye o daare o tiŋi‑o se o taa ye o kɔgɔ kom yuu tu, se o taa tei wonnu maama o pa-ba. 23Yezu kɔgɔ kom konto nam mo nye de o yera yam, ye ko pae se o ŋwea jege kuri. Yezu tete de maa pae se woŋo maama na wo jei maama ne to jege kuri.

english_text:
From Death to Life
1 In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God. 2You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God. 3Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
4-5But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you. 6God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven. 7God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done. 8You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own. 9It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about. 10God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are.
United by Christ
11Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised. 12At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God, 13and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
14Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body 15 to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace. 16 On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body. 17 Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God. 18And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
19You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God. 20You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone. 21Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord. 22And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_text:
Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam taane
1Abam déem ye balo na ve Wɛ ni, ye á to tusim chwoŋa ne to mo. Ko ma pa se á ŋwea tera Wɛ tei ne. 2Á déem ma tɔge chwei selo na ye logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem nyem to, ye á daare á tɔge setaana pɛ wolo na tei wɛyuu telaŋ-pwolo chichiri sem to. Wonto maa ye setaane delo laam na tei balo na ve Wɛ ni to. 3Debam maama déem tɔge nɔɔna bam konto chwei sem mo, ye dé ke wo-zɔɔna yalo dé fera na zoore to. Dé ma yeini dé tɔge wo-zɔɔna keim, ne dé boboŋa de dé yera na lage tei to mo. Debam na maŋe dé ye tei to mo bere we, Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom ya jege se ko ba debam baŋa, nenɛɛne nɔɔna badaara de na ye tei to.
4Ko daare Wɛ nam tiini o jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa se ko gaale. O maa tiini o swoi debam dedɛ. 5Konto ŋwaane mo o pɛ debam o ŋwe-doŋa kam, dé na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. Wɛ na zeini debam konto to, ko ye maŋa kalo dé déem na tɔge tusim chwoŋa ye dé ba jege ŋwea o tei ne to mo. Wɛ nam mɛ o zaane dem mo o jwoŋi abam o yage. 6Dé na me de Yezu Krista to, Wɛ ma pa dé tɔge ded‑o dé bi dé na o ŋwe-doŋa kam, ye o daare o zeiŋi debam se dé tɔge de Yezu dé na jeiŋa jei telaao ne. 7Wɛ na ke debam lanyerane Yezu ŋwaane konto to ye se ko taa bere nɔɔna maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu we, o zaane dem tiini de beiŋi. 8Wɛ zaane dem mo o mɛ o jwoŋi abam o yage, á na jege wo-dedoa de Yezu to ŋwaane. O nam tɔge de ŋwaane o chɛ abam zɛɛra mo, 9ye ko dae abam kikia ŋwaane, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o ke teera Wɛ yiga ne. 10Wɛ ye debam Keiru mo. Dé na me de Yezu Krista to, o ma fɔge debam de o ŋwe-doŋa kam, se dé taa tɔge keim-laaro chwoŋa kalo o na maŋe o tiŋi o pa debam se dé da to.
11Abam nam jege se á guli á déem na ye tei ye Wɛ ta wo jwoŋi abam to. Ba wo loge abam Juu tiina wone. Á ye dwi-gɛ tiina mo. Balo na bere ba tete we ba ye Wɛ nɔɔna ye ba gwoni ba peina to mo yaale abam de á na yeiri peina gwonim to. Banto na gwoni ba yera tei to nam tɔge nabiina kikia mo. 12Kanto maŋa kam ne, abam de Yezu Krista déem yeiri da-jei. Ko ná ye Isarele dwi tiina kɔgɔ kom, á déem tere ba wone. Ko ta ná ye Wɛ nia yalo o na gwoni de o nɔɔna ye ya tɔge o kampwola kam ŋwaane to, abam yiga ta tɔge ka tera de-ya. Á déem na jege á ŋwea logo baŋa ne tei to, Wɛ tera á tei ne, ye á ba jege teena kolokolo baŋa ne. 13Ko daare abam laam tu á me de Yezu Krista. Wonto toone jana bam ŋwaane ma pa se á ba á yi Wɛ tei, ye á ya maŋe á ye balo na ye yiga yiga ded‑o to mo.
14Yezu Krista mo ye bochare-zuru tu ye o pa se ywoni wo debam laŋa ne, de o na pɛ Juu tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina bam ba ba ji bedwe to. O ma saare siseini delo na pwɛ-ba ye ba chuli daane to. 15O na sɛ se ba go o yera to mo pɛ se Juu tiina ni-kaana yam ji kafɛ, de ya na bere chullu telo maama to. Konto baŋa ne mo o fɔge Juu tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina bam o ke daane, se ba maama ji Wɛ kɔgɔ dedoa, ba na me ded‑o to ŋwaane. 16Ba maama na ye kɔgɔ dedoa konto to, o ma fɔge ba de Wɛ daane. O tɔge o toone dem dagara yuu ne ŋwaane mo o pa se ba daa ba chuli daane.
17Yezu Krista na tu to, o ma pa dé lɔre Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam we, debam maama fɔge daane, ko ná ye abam dwi-gɛ tiina balo déem na ye yiga yiga ded‑o to, naa debam Juu tiina balo na maŋe dé bwola ded‑o to de. 18Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo debam maama jege chwoŋa se dé taa vei Wɛ tei, Wɛ Sin-laao kom na ye dedoa ye ko wo dé maama tei ne to ŋwaane.
19Abam balo na ye dwi-gɛ tiina to daa dae veira, nenɛɛne balo yiga na tera Wɛ nɔɔna bam wone to. Abam laam ye tembia mo Wɛ nɔɔna bam wone, ye á tɔge á ye Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom bia. 20Á tɔge á ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna mo, ye kɔgɔ kom konto nye de o tete sɔŋɔ kom. Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwa bam de Wɛ sampwori sem mo chwi sɔŋɔ kom kuri, ye ko maama zege Yezu ŋwaane. Wonto mo ye kandwɛ-zane delo na pae diga kam zega dana to. 21O maa pae se sɔŋɔ kom lɔɔm maama tɔge daane lanyerane, ye o pa ko puli dedɛ se ko taa ye dé Teiru wom wara-jei. 22Abam tete de tɔge de Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama á woli o kɔgɔ kom wone, á na me de Yezu to ŋwaane. Konto mo á nye de Wɛ sɔŋɔ kolo o na wora o lɔa, ye o laam wó tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane o taa zoore ko wone to.

english_text:
Paul's Mission to the Gentiles
1Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles. 2You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you. 3In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways. 4 As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ. 5No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets. 6And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
7God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news. 8I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured. 9 God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind. 10Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
11God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done. 12Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith. 13This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you.
Christ's Love for Us
14I kneel in prayer to the Father. 15All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him. 16God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers 17and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love. 18 I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep. 19I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
20-21I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl na toŋe o pa dwi-gɛ tiina tei to
1Konto ŋwaane mo amo Pɔɔl yeini a lwoori Wɛ a pa abam. Amo na toŋe Yezu Krista totoŋa a pa abam dwi-gɛ tiina to laam mo pɛ se ba ke-ne peena diga ne. 2Abam wó ta‑á yei amo ni ne, de Wɛ na pɛ se a toŋe a pa abam o zaane dem ŋwaane to. 3Abam nam nigi we, Wɛ mo le chega kalo déem na seigi o wone to o bere-ne. Amo maŋe a popone chega kam konto taane fenfee. 4Abam nam ná gaga amo na popone kolo to, á wó lɔre amo boboŋa na zo Yezu Krista chega kam tei to. 5Faŋa faŋa to, Wɛ wo pɛ se nabiina lɔre o chega kam konto. O laam tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa mo o le-ka o bere Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam de o ni-jwoŋina bam. 6Wɛ chega kam konto tɔge o kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane mo, ye ka bere we, dwi-gɛ tiina balo na me de Yezu Krista to wó tɔge de Juu tiina ba jwoŋi wo-laaro telo Wɛ na tiŋi se o pa o nɔɔna bam to. Ba na me de Yezu Krista to, ba de ye Wɛ tete kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna mo, ye ba laam wó jwoŋi kolo maama Wɛ na pwooli se o pa o nɔɔna bam to.
7Wɛ tɔge o zaane dem ŋwaane mo o zeini-ne de o dam-fɔrɔ kom se a taa toŋe o kwor-ywoŋa kam totoŋa. 8Amo nam mo ye wolo na tiini a muri Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama wone, ye Wɛ daa ta pa-ne totoŋ-ŋom dem konto, se a taa vei dwi-gɛ tiina tei a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere-ba, se ba lɔre Yezu Krista wo-laaro tem na tiini te beiŋi ye te ba jege tiim to. 9Amo maa jege se a pa nabiina maama mo lɔre Wɛ chega kam jaja, de Wɛ na pɛ se ka tɔge chwei selo to. Wonto mo naane wonnu maama. Ko zege boboa ne, chega kam konto maŋe ka seigi o wone. 10O ma seigi-ka se ko ba ko yi zem maŋa kam, se o laam tɔge Yezu kɔgɔ kom ŋwaane o pa se dedɛɛra balo maama na jege dam wɛ-baŋa jei sem ne to lɔre o swa yam na daga yera yera tei to. 11O maa tɔge o boboŋa yalo o na maŋe o ja faŋa faŋa to, ye o laam pa se ya seene ya ke dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane. 12Dé na me de Yezu Krista to, o maa pae dé jege baare. O ta ma pa debam chwoŋa se dé taa vei Wɛ tei ye dé ba kɔre foone, dé na ke dé wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. 13Abam nam yé pa se á boboŋa chɔge de amo na yaare tei abam ŋwaane to, se ko ye abam yuu zeiŋim ŋwaane mo.
Yezu swono kom na ye tei to
14Konto ŋwaane mo amo yeini a kuni dwoona dé Kwo Wɛ yiga ne. 15Ko ná ye Wɛ telaao ne, naa logo baŋa ne, balo maama nɔɔna na jege-ba ba bwoi we ba kwoa to kuri nwoŋi dé Kwo Wɛ wone mo. 16Wɛ zaane dem na tiini de beiŋi to ŋwaane, amo yeini a lwoori‑o mo se o tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa o pa á bochara na dam, 17se Yezu Krista taa tigi á boboŋa ne, de á na ke á wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. Amo ta lwoori‑o mo se o pa á ta‑á jege swono kolo na wó pa á nɛ tiini se kwaare tega ne to, 18se á wane á tɔge de Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama á lɔre Yezu Krista swono kom na mae tei to. Yezu Krista swono kom na tiini ko gaale tei to nye de woŋo na tiini ko yala ye ko dɔra, ko daare ko ye baŋa baŋa ye ko luuna dedɛ to mo. 19O swono kom maa dwoi se nabiina lɔre ko na ye tei to ba ti. Wɛ nam wó pa se abam lɔre-ko, se Wɛ ŋwea kam laam su á bochara maama.
20Pa-na se dé zuli Wɛ wom na wae wonnu maama o ke to, de o na yeini o zeini debam de o dam dem se ko tiini ko dwoni kolo dé boboŋa na laga ye dé lwoori‑o to. 21Debam balo na ye o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ye dé me de Yezu Krista to, Wɛ maŋe se o taa nae zula debam tei ne maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_text:
Unity with Christ
1As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own. 2 Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other. 3Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace. 4All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people. 5We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism. 6There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
7Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us. 8 As the Scriptures say,
“When he went up
to the highest place,
he led away many prisoners
and gave gifts to people.”
9When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth. 10This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
11Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers, 12so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong. 13This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
14We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place. 15Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head 16 of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love.
The Old Life and the New Life
17As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people. 18Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right, 19and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
20-21But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him. 22 You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits. 23Let the Spirit change your way of thinking 24 and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy.
Rules for the New Life
25 We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth. 26 Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry 27and don't give the devil a chance.
28If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
29Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
30Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
31Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude. 32 Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_text:
Yezu Krista nɔɔna bam ye kɔgɔ dedoa
1Amo na wo peena diga ne dé Teiru wom ŋwaane to, a lwoori abam se á pa á totoŋ-naga taa tɔge chwoŋa, se ko maŋe de Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á ye tei to. 2Ko maŋe se abam ta‑á gwooni á tete mo, se á ta‑á nege daane maŋa maama, se á daare á ta‑á jege ban-peno, ye á woli daane de swono. 3Seene-na á yia se á ta‑á jege boboŋe dedwe, ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom na zeini abam ye á fɔge daane de bochare-zuru tei to. 4Yezu nɔɔna bam ye kɔgɔ dedoa mo. Wɛ Sin-laao kom de maa ye dedoa, ne Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o ye á jege teenem bedwe ded‑o tei to. 5Debam maama jege Teiru dedoa mo. Dé na sɛ‑o de wo-dedoa tei to de maa ye bedwe. Dé na jwoŋi sɛɛm tei to de ye bedwe mo. 6Wɛ ye dedoa mo, ye o ye debam maama Kwo. Wonto maa ye dé maama Yuu-tu. O maa tɔge debam maama baŋa o toŋa, ye o kwori o me de dé maama.
7Wɛ nam tɔge o zaane dem ŋwaane mo o zeini debam maama dedoa dedoa, se ko maŋe de Yezu Krista na lage se o pɔɔre o pɛɛra yam tei to. 8Ko nam popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we,
“O na diini wɛyuu to mo
o kale o dona bam o na wane-ba to o ja vo.
O ma daare o pɔɔre o pɛɛra yam
o pa o nɔɔna bam.”
9Ko na popone we, “o diini wɛyuu” to, ko kuri mo bɛ? Ko bere we o ya maŋe o tu tega baŋa ye o yi ka kuri. 10Wolo na tu tega baŋa konto to daa ta mo diini wɛyuu o kɛ Wɛ telaao wonnu tem maama yiga, se o wane o pa wonnu telo maama na wora to taa jege kuri.
11Ko ye wonto tete nam mo woli nɔɔna de o pɛɛra yam,
se ba badaara taa ye o totoŋa nakwa,
se badaara de taa ye o ni-jwoŋina,
se badaara de taa tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam,
se badaara taa nii o nɔɔna baŋa ne,
ye badaara de ba bere-ba o chega kam.
12Yezu Krista nam woli o nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi se ba wane ba na dam mo se ba taa toŋe ba zeini daane, se ko pa o kɔgɔ kom maama fɔge ko ke daane lanyerane. 13Konto ŋwaane, debam maama laam wó ba dé taa ye bedwe, de dé na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom ye dé yei o chega kam tei to. Dé boboŋa laam maa wó tiini ya be lanyerane, se Yezu Krista ŋwea kam taa sui dé bochara maama.
14Dé boboŋa daa bá taa bwona, nenɛɛne bu-balɛ boboŋa na ye tei to. Dé daa bá pa se dé boboŋa taa vei yiga de kwaga de nɔɔna berem, ne vio na fuli wonnu ko yage yiga de kwaga tei to. Dé daa bá sɛ dé tɔge nɔɔna balo na ke swa ba gane ba dwonna se ba tusi to. 15Dé nam wó taa bere Wɛ chega kam mo ye dé jege da-swono, se ko pa dé boboŋa kweere ye dé me de Yezu Krista na ye debam Yuu-tu to. 16Yezu kɔgɔ kom maa nye de o yera mo, ye wonto mo pae se o yera yam jei sem maama toŋe ya woli daane. Ya nam ye teiri teiri mo ye ya maama kwaare daane ya toŋa. Konto ŋwaane, wolo maama na ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔno to ná toŋe totoŋe delo Yezu na pɛ‑o to, ko wó pa se o kɔgɔ kom maama tɔge da-swono ŋwaane ko fɔge daane lanyerane.
Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam taane
17Amo nam lage a kaane abam dé Teiru Yezu ŋwaane, se á daa yé ta‑á tɔge chwei selo dwi-gɛ tiina na tɔge de ba boboŋ-yɔɔro tem to. 18Banto boboŋa ye lim mo, ye ba ŋwea ba tɔge Wɛ ŋwea kam na ye tei to, kolo ŋwaane ba wo lɔre Wɛ chega kam mo, ba na jege yi-dɛɛre to ŋwaane. 19Ba maa ba kɔre chaveera ye ba tiini ba ke wo-zɔɔna kikia, de wo-digiru kikia yalo maama ba fera na zoore ka-laga ŋwaane to ko ja gaale.
20Abam nam na lɔre Yezu Krista chega kam to, ko dae se á ta‑á tɔge kikia yanto dwoŋi. 21Á na nigi Yezu taane to, ba seene ba bere abam o chega kam chekke. 22Ba ma bere abam se á yage á ŋwe-dwoŋa kam de ka na pɛ á ye tei to. Á ŋwe-dwoŋa kam konto lage ka chɔge abam mo, de ka na gane abam se á fera taa zoore wo-yɔɔro telo na ba jege kuri to. 23Á boboŋa maama nam jege se ya pipiri ya ji nadoora mo, 24se á daare á tɔge Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo o na ke o pa abam to. Ŋwe-doŋa kam konto nye de Wɛ tete ŋwea mo, ye ka pa á tɔge chega chwoŋa de wo-pwoŋo chwoŋa chekke.
25Konto ŋwaane pa-na dé yage vwa fɔm, se dé daare dé taa tɛ chega dé bere daane, dé maama na ye kɔgɔ dedoa to ŋwaane. 26Abam wolo ná jege ban-zɔŋɔ de o dwoŋi, se kotu yé pa ko ji wɛleere o tei ne. O nam jege se o le-de o wone lela ye wɛ daa ta wo zo. 27Á yé pa setaana pɛ na laŋa o chɔge abam. 28Wolo na lage ŋweene to daa yé taa ŋɔna. O nam jege se o taa toŋe o pa o tete mo de jawala, se o daare o wane o zeini yiniga na jege balo to.
29Á yé pa se á ni taane taa jege lwarem. Nam ta‑á ŋɔɔne-na botare selo na wó fɔge nɔɔna ne ba na lage tei, ye se daare se zeini-ba lanyerane. 30Á yé pa se Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo chɔge de á na ke kolo to, kokuri Wɛ tɔge ko ŋwaane o ma ke maanem o pa abam se ko bere we á ye o nyem mo, se o dɛ dem ná yia, se o laam jwoŋi abam o ti. 31Yage-na puseŋa, de ban-lom, de wo-zɔŋɔ, se á daare á yage ni-kantɔgɔ, de toro, ko woli de keim-lwanno dwi maama. 32Ta‑á nege-na daane se á daare á ta‑á jege da-ŋwaŋa. Ta‑á ma‑á chɛ daane, ne Wɛ na yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam Yezu Krista ŋwaane tei to.

english_text:
1Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children. 2 Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
3You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy. 4Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are. 5Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God.
Living as People of Light
6Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things. 7So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
8You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light 9and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful, 10as you try to please the Lord. 11Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are. 12It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark. 13But the light will show what these things are really like. 14Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say,
“Wake up from your sleep
and rise from death.
Then Christ will shine on you.”
15Act like people with good sense and not like fools. 16 These are evil times, so make every minute count. 17Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do. 18Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life. 19 When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart. 20Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything.
Wives and Husbands
21Honor Christ and put others first. 22 A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord. 23A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body. 24Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
25 A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it. 26He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water. 27Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
28In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself. 29None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church, 30because we are each part of his body. 31 As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.” 32This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church. 33So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_text:
Da-swono taane
1Abam na maŋe á ye Wɛ bu-swonnu to, se á ta‑á lwoni o kikia. 2Ta‑á tɔge-na swono chwoŋa, ne Yezu Krista na jege debam swono tei to. Wonto déem ma sɛ se o leiri debam yuu ne o te dé wɛleera ŋwaane. O ma kwei o tete o ke Wɛ jeŋa ne se o ji kaanem delo lwom na ywomma de pa Wɛ to.
3Á nam yé pa kikia yalo maama na tɔge ka-laga to, naa wo-zɔɔna dwi maama taa wo á tei ne. Á yé pa á yi taa sui á dwonna wonnu. Nam yé pa se wonnu tem konto taane taa wo á wone. Ko maŋe se Wɛ tete nɔɔna mo yage kikia yanto dwoŋi. 4Ko ná ye vɛɛsa taane, de wo-jworru dwi maama taane, tento wo maŋe de abam, se á nam ta‑á ke Wɛ lei. 5Ta‑á yei-na lanyerane we, nɔɔno wolo maama ná tɔge wo-zɔɔna keim, naa ka-laga kikia, naa wolo ná ye nɔn-kwolo, konto tu bá fɔge o na kolokolo Yezu Krista de Baŋa Wɛ paare dem seeni. Nɔɔno ná pae o yi su wonnu, ko bere we o pa tento mo zula ne jwona tei to.
6Nam yé pa-na se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chwoŋa o gane abam de ta-yɔɔro. Keim-balwaaro tem konto dwoŋi mo lage te pa se Wɛ ban-lom dem zaŋe de balo na ve o ni to. 7Konto ŋwaane lɔŋe-na balo na ke konto dwoŋi to. 8Abam déem ya yeiri Wɛ pa se á wo lim wone. Abam nam na tu á me de dé Teiru Yezu Krista to, ko pɛ se pwooni laam wo á tei ne. Ta‑á tɔge-na chwoŋa se ko maŋe de balo na ye pwooni dem nyem tei. 9Ko ná ye kikia yalo maama na tɔge pwooni dem chwoŋa to, yanto mo ye wo-laaro telo maama na jege chega to. 10Á na maa tɔge chwo-laao konto to, se á kwaane á lɔre kolo na pwoli dé Teiru Yezu wo to. 11Ja-na á tete se á lɔŋe wo-yɔɔro telo na ye lim dem nyem to, se á daare á pa nɔɔna lɔre jaja we, wonnu tem konto ba lana. 12Kokuri wonnu telo Wɛ-lwɛɛna bam na yeini ba seigi ba ke to tiini te jege chaveera se dé ŋɔɔne te taane. 13Á nam ná pɛ se Wɛ pwooni dem ba de bere wonnu tem konto maama kuri jaja, nɔɔna wó lɔre te na seene te ye tei to. 14Kokuri woŋo kolo maama kuri na lɔre jaja to laam wo pwooni yiga ne mo. Konto ŋwaane mo ba yeini ba tɛ ba we:
“Dondɔɔno, zaŋe wɛɛne,
se n bi toone wone,
se Yezu Krista mo nye pwooni n baŋa ne.”
15Ta‑á yei-na á tete de á totoŋ-naga na ye tei to, se á ta‑á jege boboŋ-dɛɛra, ye ko dae nenɛɛne balo na wo lɔre Wɛ chega kam to. 16Zem da yanto jege keim-balwaaro dedɛ. Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ ná pɛ abam chwoŋa se á toŋe kolo, se á pa ko ja kuri lanyerane. 17Yé ta‑á tɔge-na jworim chwoŋa, se á nam kwaane á lɔre kolo dé Teiru Yezu na lage se á ta‑á ke to.
18Yé ta‑á ye balo na nyɔ sana ba su ba bugi to, se konto pae kachaare yerane mo. Nam pa-na se Wɛ Sin-laao kom su á bochara lanyerane. 19Ta‑á ŋɔɔne-na Wɛ seinim lei, de Yezu kɔgɔ kom lei sem, de Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ abam lei selo to á bere daane. Ta‑á leeni-na Wɛ tia lei sem konto á pa dé Teiru Yezu Krista de á wo maama, 20se á ta‑á tɔge o ŋwaane á ke dé Kwo Wɛ lei maŋa maama, de woŋo kolo maama o na pɛ abam to.
Baara de ba kaana na wó ta nege daane tei to
21Á na kɔre Yezu Krista to, se á ta‑á sɛ á pa daane.
22Kaana jege se ba taa sɛ ba pa ba banna, ne ba na sɛ dé Teiru Yezu tei to. 23Kolo ŋwaane kaane baro mo ye o yuu tu, ne Yezu Krista de na ye o kɔgɔ kom yuu tu tei to. O kɔgɔ kom maa nye de o yera yam mo, ye o ye ba fɔgeno. 24Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna bam na sɛ ba pa‑o konto to, ko maŋe se kaana de sɛ ba pa ba banna mo wonnu maama baŋa ne.
25Ko nam ná ye kan-banna, se á ta‑á swoi á kaana, ne Yezu Krista de na jege o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom swono ye o sɛ se o leiri ba yuu ne o te tei to. 26O na tege ba ŋwaane konto to, ko ye se o saare ba bochara wo-digiru mo, se ba taa ye wose Wɛ ŋwaane. O tɔge Wɛ botare sem ŋwaane mo o zare-ba de na. 27O fɔge o kwɛ-ba konto se o kɔgɔ kom laam wane ko ba ko zege o yiga ne de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ. Ko wó taa jege lam, ye digiru de chɔgem tera ko tei ne de fenfee de. Konto to, o nɔɔna bam wó taa ye wose o yiga ne ye tusim tera.
28Ko ná maŋe ko ye kan-banna, ba jege se ba taa swoi ba kaana, nenɛɛne ba na lage ba tete yera yam tei to. Nɔɔno wolo nam na swoi o kaane to bere we o swoi o tete mo. 29Kokuri nɔɔno tera o na vae o yera kwɛɛm. O nam wó nii ya baŋa ne, ye o di wodiu o ma kɔne-ya. Ko ye bedwe mo de Yezu Krista na nii debam balo na ye o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom to baŋa ne, 30dé na tɔge dé nye de o yera yam to ŋwaane. 31Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere debam we, “Baaro ná di kaane, o boboŋa daa ba tɔge o kwo de o nu boboŋa. O laam yeini o me de o kaane wom mo, ye ba balei bam ji yera dedoa.” 32Taane dem konto bere wo-lilirru mo. Amo laam kwei-de a ma ŋɔɔne Yezu Krista de o kɔgɔ kom taane mo. 33Ko ta ye chega mo we, abam kan-baro maama jege se o taa swoi o kaane, ne o na swoi o tete tei to. Kaane maama de jege se o taa nege o baro mo.

english_text:
Children and Parents
1 Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says, 2 “Obey your father and your mother, 3and you will have a long and happy life.”
4 Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord.
Slaves and Masters
5 Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ. 6Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do. 7Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people. 8You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
9 Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites.
The Fight against Evil
10Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong. 11 Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks. 12We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world. 13So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
14 Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor. 15 Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet. 16Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one. 17 Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
18Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people. 19Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news. 20I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should.
Final Greetings
21-22 I want you to know how I am getting along and what I am doing. This is why I am sending Tychicus to you. He is a dear friend, as well as a faithful servant of the Lord. He will tell you how I am doing, and he will cheer you up.
23I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower! 24May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_text:
Bia de ba tiina taane
1Ko nam ná ye bia, á na sɛ dé Teiru Yezu to, ko maŋe se á ta‑á sɛ á tiina ni. Konto nam mo tɔge chega chwoŋa.
2“Ta‑á nege-na á kwoa de á niina.”
Wɛ ni-kaana yam maama wone, dento mo ye boboa ni delo Wɛ na pwooli kampwola o woli de wone to. 3O na pwooli o we tei to mo ye:
“Nmo ná nege n kwo de n nu,
Wɛ wó pa se n na ywoni de momwɛ-dɛɛre tega kam baŋa ne.”
4Ko daare ko ná ye bia kwoa, se á yé ta‑á tiini á chana á bia baŋa ne se ko chuchugi ba bane. Nam ta‑á kɔne-na á bia lanyerane, se á pa ba lɔre dé Teiru Yezu chega kam, se ba taa tɔge-ka.
Yuu tiina de ba kabɛ taane
5Ko ná ye balo na ye kabɛ to, se á ta‑á toŋe á tɔge á yuu tiina boboŋa. Ta‑á kɔre-na-ba ye á toŋe de jawala, nenɛɛne á na wó toŋe á pa dé Teiru Yezu tei to. 6Ko nam dae ba na zege ba nii abam maŋa kalo to yerane mo á wó ta‑á toŋe konto se á jwoŋi zula ba tei ne. Maŋa maama ta‑á toŋe-na de á wo maama, se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to, nenɛɛne á ye Yezu Krista tete kabɛ mo tei. 7Ta‑á toŋe-na de wopwolo ye á pa se ko taa ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, ye ko dae nabiina yerane ŋwaane. 8Kokuri á yei we, nɔɔno maama wó na nyɔɔre dé Teiru wom tei ne de keim-laaro telo maama o na ke to, ko ná ye kabaa mo naa nɔɔno de nɔɔno de.
9Ko daare ko ná ye yuu tiina balo na tei kabɛ to, se abam de ta‑á ke á kabɛ lanyerane konto dwoŋi, se á yé ta‑á fugi-ba, kolo ŋwaane á yei we á jege á Teiru wom telaao ne, ye wonto mo tei abam de á kabɛ sem de. Wonto nam tɔge chega de o na ke nɔɔna maama tei to ye o ba kuri-ba daane.
Zega zegem taane
10Amo na lage a ta kolo a kweeli to mo ye se á ta‑á jege baare de á na me de dé Teiru Yezu tei to. Pa-na se o dam-fɔrɔ kom taa wo abam tei ne lanyerane. 11Kwaane-na á jwoŋi Wɛ zeinim dem maama, se á wane á fɔge á che á tete ne á na lage á mage jara tei to, se setaana pɛ swa kikia maama yé wane abam. 12Jara yam konto nam dae debam de dé dwonna nabiina jara yam dwoŋi. Dé nam jege se dé kwaane dé ke dé jara yam dedaane chichiri-lwanno telo maama na jege dam wɛ-baŋa jei sem ne to. Banto mo ye setaana pɛ jeŋa dedɛɛra, ye ba jege dam logo baŋa lim jei sem ne. 13Konto ŋwaane, jwoŋi-na Wɛ jara zela dwi maama á ma á fɔge á che á tete, se lɛɛro maŋa kam ná yia, se á wane á chichei á fɔge á zege de baare, ye ko maama ná ti, á ta wó ta‑á zega á zega kam jei ne.
