14Nam fɔge-na á zege de baare, se á ta‑á jege Wɛ chega kam, ne á na vɔge á gwaaro de tankila tei to, se á daare á ta‑á zege á nɔn-ŋonne ne, nenɛɛne á na kwei nantana á ma á kwoli á nyɔɔne jara wone tei to. 15Ta ta‑á cho-na á tete nenɛɛne á zo natera yalo na woli á veiŋa to, se á wane á vo jei maama á bere nɔɔna kwor-ywoŋa kalo na pae ba de Wɛ fɔge daane to. 16Ko woli da, ta‑á jege-na wo-dedoa de Wɛ se ko taa nye de nantana kalo á na zei á je ne se á ma che á tete de wo-lwanno tu wom che-tɛɛra na jege mini to. 17Wɛ na jwoŋi abam o yage tei to, se á pa ko taa nye de jara yu-gwoŋo mo á puga á yuu ne. Ma-na Wɛ kwora kam á woli á tete, se kanto nye de se-zɔɔ kolo Wɛ Sin-laao kom na ke abam jeŋa ne to mo. 18Á na zege de baare konto to, se á ta‑á ware Wɛ ye á lwoori zeinim o tei ne. Á na ware Wɛ maŋa maama to, se á pa ko taa ye o Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane. Ta‑á jege-na á tete se á vɔ á wo lanyerane ye á lwoori Wɛ á pa o nɔɔna bam maama. 19Ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ á pa amo de se, a ná nɛ chwoŋa se a ta taane, se o pa-ne o ni taane delo a na wó ŋɔɔne to, se a daare a na baare a bere nɔɔna o kwor-ywoŋa kam, pa se ba lɔre o chega kalo ya na seigi ba yia ne to. 20Ko ye kwor-ywoŋa kam konto ŋwaane mo Wɛ tiŋi-ne se a leiri Yezu yuu ne a taa bere nɔɔna. Ba laam ke-ne peena diga ne a na bere-ka to ŋwaane. Nam ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ se o zeini-ne se a taa wae a tɔɔle-ka de baare, ne ko na maŋe se a taa ke tei to.
21Amo nam lage se abam lɔre amo ni ne de a na wora a ke kolo to. Konto ŋwaane a lage a toŋe dé nu-bu-swono Tichika se o ba abam tei, se o fɔge o ta amo taane maama de abam. Wonto toŋe o pa dé Teiru Yezu de jawala. 22Amo lage se o pa abam lɔre kolo na wora ko ke debam to, se ko pa á bochara peini tega ne.
23Dé Kwo Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa dé nu-bia bam maama yazura, se ba taa jege da-swono de boboŋ-dɛɛra. 24Ko ná ye balo na yɔɔre ba jege dé Teiru Yezu Krista swono ba ba yaga to, Wɛ zaane dem taa wo ba maama tei ne.

english_text:
1 From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus.
To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
3Every time I think of you, I thank my God. 4And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy. 5This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it. 6God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
7You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail. 8God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
9I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand 10how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day, 11Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God.
What Life Means to Paul
12My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news. 13 The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ. 14Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
15Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help. 16They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him. 17But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail. 18But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad.
I will keep on being glad, 19because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe. 20I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
21If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more. 22I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful. 23It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better. 24-25But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith. 26Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
27Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
28Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen, 29and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him. 30 You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl mo popone tɔnɔ konto ye Timoti wo amo tei ne. Debam ye Yezu Krista kabɛ mo. Dé popone se dé pa abam balo maama na wo Filipi ne ye á tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane á ye Wɛ nɔɔna to, ko woli de á kɔgɔ kom yiga tiina bam de ko wolim tiina bam de.
2Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Pɔɔl na lwoori Wɛ tei to
3Maŋa maama amo na guli abam gula, a yeini a ke a Tu Wɛ lei mo abam ŋwaane. 4Maŋa maama amo na lwoori Wɛ a pa abam maama to, a yeini a di ywoni, 5de abam na tɔge á toŋe á woli-ne de Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam totoŋa yam, ko zege boboa ne ko ba ko yi zem to. 6Amo yei lanyerane we, Wɛ mo ye wolo wom na maŋe o bobo se o kwɛ abam bochara to, ye wonto wó yɔɔre o taa ke konto se ko vo ko ti dɛ dem Yezu Krista na wó jwoori o ba to. 7Amo tiini a jege abam swono a bochare ne. Konto ŋwaane ko maŋe se amo taa jege á boboŋa a yuu ne, kokuri abam maama tɔge á na Wɛ zaane dem, ne amo de na nɛ tei to. Leile konto, ko ná ye ba na vɔge-ne de chaponno ba ke peena diga ne to, naa maŋa kalo amo na kare a beeri jei maama a ŋɔɔne chega a pa Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam, maŋa maama mo Wɛ ke zaane o ke a yuu ne, ye abam de tɔge á na o zaane dem konto dwoŋi. 8Abam maama na jege fera amo tei ne to tɔge Yezu Krista tete na jege abam swono tei to mo. Wɛ wó zege amo kwaga ne we konto ye chega.
9Amo na lwoori Wɛ a pa abam tei to ye se abam swono kom mo fɔge ko puli dedɛ, ko woli de yeino, se á ta‑á wae á lɔre kolo maama na tɔge chega to. 10Konto mo á wó wane á kuri kolo na lamma chekke se á ke, ye Yezu Krista dɛ dem ná yia, se digiru yé taa wo á bochara ne, se á daare á na bora Wɛ yiga ne. 11Ko woli da, á kikia maama wó taa tɔge chwo-laao lanyerane, Yezu Krista na zeini abam to ŋwaane. Konto wó pa se Wɛ na zula de teem.
Yezu Krista dwoi woŋo maama
12A nu-bia bam, a lage se á lɔre we, yaara yalo na yi amo to nam pɛ se Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam jage ka yi yiga mo. 13Ko na ke amo tei to pɛ se soja tiina balo na nii pɛ wom sɔŋɔ kom to, de balo maama na wora to lɔre we, ko ye amo na tɔge Yezu Krista to ŋwaane mo ba vɔge-ne de chaponno ba ke peena diga ne. 14Ko woli da, amo na wo peena diga ne to pɛ se dé nu-bia bam dedɛ tiini ba dale dé Teiru wom, pa se ba tiini ba jege baare ba maa bere Wɛ kwora kam, ye ba ba kɔre foone.
15Ko ye chega mo we nɔɔna badaara tɔge wo-goo de ni-kantɔgɔ baŋa ne mo ba tɔɔle Yezu Krista kwora kam. Ko daare badaara nam bere-ka de ba boboŋ-laaro mo. 16Banto bere-ka de swono mo, kolo ŋwaane ba yei we Wɛ tiŋi-ne se a zege o kwor-ywoŋa kam kwaga ne mo. 17Badwonna bam nam bere Yezu kwora kam se ko pa ba tete mo kamunni, ye ba ba jege wo-pwoŋo. Ba nam boŋe we, ba wó wane ba chɔge amo yuu mo, amo na wo peena diga ne to ŋwaane. 18Ko nam ba chɔga. Amo ta jege wopwolo de ba maama na tɔɔle Yezu Krista kwora kam ba bere nɔɔna tei to. Ba ná bere-ka de boboŋ-laaro naa boboŋ-balwaaro de, ko ye Yezu taane dem mo ba bera.
Amo nam wó tiini a taa jege wopwolo, 19kolo ŋwaane a yei we, Wɛ wó jwoŋi-ne o yage, abam na lwoori‑o á pa-ne tei, de Yezu Krista Sin-laao kom na pa-ne zeinim tei to ŋwaane. 20Amo tiini a jege teena we, a bá zaŋe a ke kolokolo na wó pa a na a chaveera. Amo nam wó taa jege pu-dɛa se, a ta ná ŋwe naa a ná tega, se Yezu Krista na zula a kikia maama baŋa ne. 21Amo tei ne, a ŋwea ye Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo. A nam ná tega, ko wó taa ye nyɔɔre mo ko pa-ne. 22Amo nam ta ná jege ŋwea logo baŋa ne, a totoŋe dem wó wane de woli nɔɔna lanyerane. Konto to, a yeiri a na wó twori kolo se a daare kolo. 23Wonnu tento telei mo pae a boboŋa vugimi. Kolo na jege fera ko pa-ne to mo ye se a yage logo baŋa, ye a daare a vo Yezu Krista tei a taa wora. Konto wó tiini ko taa lana amo tei ne. 24Ko daare, amo ta ná wo logo baŋa ne, ko wó taa jege zeinim dedɛ ko pa abam. 25A yei we konto ye chega, ye ko pɛ a lɔre we, ko maŋe se a taa wo logo baŋa ne. Amo wó taa wo abam maama tei ne se ko pa á fɔge á tɔge Wɛ chega kam, ye á tiini á di ywoni ka ŋwaane. 26Konto to, amo ná jwoori a ba a wo abam tei ne, ko wó pa se á tiini á ta‑á zuli Yezu Krista de wopwolo amo ŋwaane.
27Kolo maama ná lage ko ke, se abam nii á kikia yam se á pa ya taa tɔge de Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam na bere tei to. Konto to, amo ná nɛ chwoŋa se a ba abam tei, naa a ná wo nɛ, amo ta wó lɔre we, abam zege lanyerane de boboŋe dedwe, ye á tɔge daane á kwaana á toŋa á pa chega kalo Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam na bere to. 28Amo daa ta wó lɔre we, abam dona bam wo nɛ chwoŋa se ba pa foone ja abam de fenfee de. Á na jege á tete tei to wó pa ba maane we, Wɛ wó ba o chɔge-ba ye o daare o jwoŋi abam o yage. Wɛ tete mo wó pa ko ke. 29Wɛ na zeini abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o tei to, ko dae se á sɛ Yezu Krista de á wo-dedoa yerane, ko ye se á kwori á na yaara de mo o ŋwaane. 30Abam déem nɛ amo na toŋe a pa Wɛ ye a yaare tei to, ye á ta kwori á ni we, ko ye bedwe mo de zem. Abam laam tɔge á toŋe konto dwoŋi ye á yaara.

english_text:
True Humility
1Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others. 2Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person. 3Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves. 4Care about them as much as you care about yourselves 5and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
6Christ was truly God.
But he did not try to remain
equal with God.
7Instead he gave up everything
and became a slave,
when he became
like one of us.
8Christ was humble.
He obeyed God and even died
on a cross.
9Then God gave Christ
the highest place
and honored his name
above all others.
10 So at the name of Jesus
everyone will bow down,
those in heaven, on earth,
and under the earth.
11And to the glory
of God the Father
everyone will openly agree,
“Jesus Christ is Lord!”
Lights in the World
12My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved. 13God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
14Do everything without grumbling or arguing. 15 Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world, 16as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
17Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you. 18In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me.
Timothy and Epaphroditus
19I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you. 20I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does. 21The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus. 22But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news. 23I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me. 24And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
25I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me, 26but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick. 27In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
28Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer. 29Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve. 30He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_text:
Yezu Krista na tu o tete tei to
1Abam na me de Yezu Krista to mo pae á jege pu-dɛa. O swono kom maa pae á bochara zuri. Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta maa pae se á me daane de wopwolo. Á maa jege da-ŋwaŋa de swono. 2Ko na seene ko ye konto to, a lwoori abam se á ta‑á jege boboŋe dedwe daane, de swono bedwe, se á daare á ta‑á jege ni-sɛɛm á pa daane. Abam ná ke á tɔge konto dwoŋi, ko wó pa amo tiini a taa jege wopwolo. 3Á yé mage á nyɔɔna naa á lage kamunim á pa á tete. Nam gwooni-na á tete á pa daane, se á ta‑á nege á dwonna maama lanyerane. 4Nɔɔno maama jege se o boŋe o nii o na wó woli o dwoŋi tei to, ko dae we se o woli o tete yerane. 5Á boboŋa yam jege se ya taa ye nenɛɛne Yezu Krista na boŋe tei to mo.
6Ko ná ye wonto, o maŋe o jege Wɛ nyenyego mo.
O dedaane Baŋa Wɛ ye bedwe,
ye o wo ke o boboŋa ne se o fe o tete
se ba taa mae daane.
7O nam na ke tei to,
o tiŋi tento maama dáa ne mo,
ye o pa o tete ji ne kabaa tei.
O déem ma ba o nye de nabiina.
8O na tu o jege nabiina nyenyego konto to,
o déem tu o tete ye o sɛ Wɛ ni o ba o te.
Ko nam dae toone de toone,
ko ye ba page‑o dagara yuu ne mo pa se o te.
9Konto ŋwaane Wɛ laam ma zeiŋi Yezu yuu wɛ-wɛ de zula,
ye o daare o pa‑o yere delo na dwoi yera maama to.
10Mo kokuri maŋa wó ba se nɔɔna maama kuni dwoona
ba zuli Yezu o yere-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane.
Balo na wo telaao ne, naa tega baŋa ne, naa tega kuri ne to maama
jege se ba kuni nadwoona mo ba zuli‑o.
11Ba maama ni taane wó ta jaja we,
Yezu Krista ye ba Teiru.
Konto wó pa dé Kwo Wɛ na zula lanyerane.
Dé wó pa pwooni taa wora logo baŋa ne
12Konto ŋwaane, a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, ko maŋe se á maane á nii maŋa kalo amo ya na wo á tei ne ye á sɛ amo ni to. Amo nam na tera leile to, á jege se á tiini á ta‑á sɛ amo ni se ko ja gaale. Ta‑á kɔre-na Wɛ lanyerane ye á yera sae, se á kwaane á pa o na jwoŋi abam o yage tei to ja kuri lanyerane. 13Kolo ŋwaane Wɛ mo yeini o ke dam á bochara ne, pa se á lage kikia yalo na wó su o yi ye á wane-ya á ke. 14Woŋo kolo maama á na kea, se á yé ta‑á poona, naa á mage ni-kantɔgɔ ko baŋa ne. 15Konto mo á wó ta‑á jege chega Wɛ tei ne, ye lwarem bá taa wo á bochara ne. Á wó ta‑á ye Wɛ bia balo na ba jege tusim ye á zoore nɔn-balwaaro balo boboŋa na ba tɔge chwoŋa to tetare ne. Á wó ta‑á jege pwooni á pa logo baŋa, ne chalechwe tei, 16de á na ŋɔɔne Wɛ ŋwea botara kam á bere nɔɔna tei to. Á ná ke konto dwoŋi, ko wó bere we, amo na chɛ a toŋe Wɛ totoŋa abam ŋwaane tei to dae kafɛ. Amo wó taa jege teera de abam, dɛ dem Yezu Krista na wó jwoori o ba to.
17Abam na kwei á wo-dedoa á sɛ Yezu to nye de á kwei woŋo mo á ma á kaane Wɛ ye ko pwoli o wo. Dɛ delo amo laam wó ga a ŋwea, pa se ka ji wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre ka woli abam kaanem dem wone ka pa Wɛ. Amo ná lage a te se ko pa Wɛ zula konto, amo wó taa jege wopwolo, ye a lage se abam de na wopwolo ko ŋwaane. 18Ɛɛ, ko maŋe se abam de taa jege wopwolo lanyerane, se dé maama tɔge daane dé na ywoni dedɛ.
Timoti de Epafarodi taane
19Debam Teiru Yezu ná sɛ, amo boŋe se a toŋe Timoti se o ba abam tei leile. Konto wó wane ko pa se, o ná jwoori o ba o pa-ne abam labaare, se a daa yé taa jege lwia a pa abam. 20Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera amo tei ne o na jege amo boboŋa yam dwoŋi, ye o yiga wo abam wone, ko ná dae Timoti yerane. 21Balo maama na daare to lage ba tete wonnu yerane mo, ye ba ba lage Yezu Krista wonnu tem. 22Ko nam ná ye Timoti, abam maŋe á yei o wo na tɔge chega tei to. O déem tɔge de amo o tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam, nenɛɛne bu na lage se o tɔge o kwo o toŋe tei to. 23Mo kokuri a boŋe se a toŋe‑o abam tei ne, ne amo ná lɔre we, ba wó pore-ne ba yage, naa ba bá pore-ne. 24Dé Teiru wom nam pɛ a jege teena we, ba wó pore-ne ba yage leile ye a laam ba abam tei.
25Amo boŋe we ko ya maŋe se a toŋe Epafarodi se o jwoori o ba abam tei. Wonto ye dé nu-bu mo. O ma tɔge de amo o toŋe Wɛ totoŋa, ye dé kwori dé chana ya baŋa ne. O maa ye abam tontoŋeno wolo á na le á wone se o ba o woli-ne a yaara yam ŋwaane to. 26Abam fera laam maa jege‑o, ye o lage se o daa na abam. O wo ya chɔge de á na lɔre we, o ya ba jege yazura to. 27Ko ye chega mo we, o ya weela ye o da toone tei o kɛ. Wɛ nam mo duri o yiniga. Ko nam dae wonto yiniga yerane mo o duri. Wɛ duri amo de yiniga, de o na pɛ o wori ye amo wo daa wo tiini ko chɔge ko daŋe da-baŋa ne to. 28Konto ŋwaane, amo yɔɔre a lage se o yi abam tei lela, se á ta‑á jege wopwolo de á na jwoori á na‑o to, ye amo de lwia yam laam jei. 29O ná tua, se á jeeri‑o lanyerane de wopwolo dedɛ, o na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to ŋwaane. Ko maŋe se á ta‑á nege nɔɔna nenɛɛne wonto dwoŋi tei. 30Kokuri o ya dɛ toone tei o kɛ Yezu Krista totoŋa yam ŋwaane mo. O déem lage o ga o ŋwea de o na leiri abam yuu ne se o taa toŋa o woli-ne to.

english_text:
Being Acceptable to God
1Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
2Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you. 3But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done, 4although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else. 5 I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses. 6 And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
7But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless. 8Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ 9and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ. 10All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did, 11so that somehow I also may be raised to life.
Running toward the Goal
12I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize. 13My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead. 14I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done. 15All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you. 16But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
17 My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you. 18I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again 19that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
20But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ 21 has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_text:
Chwo-laao tɔgem
1A nu-bia bam, a jege kolo fenfee na daare to se a ta a woli da. Wɛ wó pa á ta‑á jege wopwolo dé Teiru wom ŋwaane. Amo na maŋe a popone kolo a ma bere abam to, ko bá taa chamma se a jwoori a bere-te abam, se ko wane ko che abam wo-lwanno wone. 2Fɔge-na á che á tete de wo-lwan-keira balo na kwaane se ba taa gwoni nɔɔna yera ba yage to. Banto ye vara mo. 3Debam nam mo ye Wɛ nɔɔna chekke, ye ko dae dé na gwoni dé peina to ŋwaane, ne banto na bere tei to. Debam tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo dé zuli Wɛ. Yezu Krista mo ye wolo dé na maa teere to, ye dé bá ke dé boboŋa de chullu telo na bere we nɔɔna yera gwonim jege kuri ko pa Wɛ. 4Ko ya ná ye we logo baŋa chullu tem jege kuri, amo tete ya wó na chwoŋa lanyerane se a ke a teena te wone. Nɔɔno wolo ná boŋe se o tɔge logo baŋa chullu tem, kotu taa yei we, amo mo dwoni nɔɔna maama chullu tem tɔgem seeni. 5Amo déem na nɛ da nana to mo ba gwoni a peini, ne Juu tiina chullu tem na bere tei to. Ba na loge-ne to, a ye Isarele tu mo, ye a nwoŋi Benjamin dwi tiina bam wone. Amo yɔɔre a ye Hiburu dwi tu chekke mo. Ko ná ye Wɛ nia yam tɔgem, amo déem wo Farisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone mo. 6Amo na toŋe de yi-seena a pa Wɛ tei to, a tiini a bɛɛse Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna. Ko ta ná ye Wɛ ni-kaana yam sɛɛm, amo déem tɔge chwoŋa chekke ye tusim tera.
7Amo déem pɛ wonnu tem konto maama jege nyɔɔre te pa-ne, ye a laam boŋe a lɔre we, te ye kafɛ mo amo yiga ne, a na sɛ Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. 8Chega ŋwaane to, woŋo kolo maama amo na jege to, a pa ko ye kafɛ mo a yiga ne, amo laam na tu a me de Yezu Krista wolo na ye amo Teiru to ŋwaane. Konto tiini ko jege kuri ko pa-ne ko dwoi woŋo maama. Wonto ŋwaane mo a kwei a woŋo maama a yage dáa ne. A pa te maama ye weero mo a yiga ne, se a wane a jwoŋi Yezu Krista a ke a bochare ne, 9se ko pa a ji o nyem. Konto to, amo wó taa jege chega Wɛ tei ne, a na ke a wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. Ko bá taa ye amo tete kikia de a na tɔge Wɛ nia yam tei to ŋwaane. Ko nam ye Wɛ tete mo pae a jege chega o tei ne, ye ko zege amo na ke a wo-dedoa de Yezu to ŋwaane. 10Woŋo kolo amo na tiini a lage to ye se a me de Yezu Krista mo, se a kwori a lɔre dam-fɔrɔ kolo Wɛ na mɛ o bi‑o toone wone to. Amo ta lage se a tɔge a na o yaara yam dwoŋi, se a daare a taa nye ded‑o de o na sɛ o te nabiina ŋwaane to. 11Konto to, amo wó wane a maŋe se Wɛ bi amo de toone wone.
Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem taane
12Ko nam dae we amo maŋe a yi Wɛ chega kam maama. Ko ta dae we a bochare kwɛ de ti maama, ye lwarem daa tera. Amo nam na ke tei to, a kwaane mo a yigi se a vo yiga, se a laam wane a jwoŋi nyɔɔre Yezu Krista tei ne a ke a jeŋa ne. Kokuri ko ye nyɔɔre dem konto ŋwaane mo o déem jwoŋi-ne o ke o tete jeŋa ne. 13A nu-bia bam, amo na boŋe tei to, ko dae we a maŋe a yi se a jwoŋi-de a ke a jeŋa ne. Amo nam na ke kolo to, a yeini a le wonnu telo na maŋe te kɛ to a boboŋa ne, se a daare a yigi a vo a yi wonnu telo na wo a yiga ne to. 14Amo na tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa tei to, a yɔɔre a kwaana se a duri a vo yiga mo se a laam vo a yi kweelim jeiga kam. Amo na me de Yezu Krista to, a laam wó vo a na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. Ŋwea kam kanto ye pɛɛre delo Wɛ na bwoŋi-ne se a ba o tei a jwoŋi to mo.
15Ko ná ye debam balo boboŋa na kweere de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to, ko maŋe se debam maama sɛ we, amo na tage tei to ye chega mo. Abam badaara boboŋa nam ná ba tɔge konto dwoŋi, Wɛ wó pa á lɔre woŋo kolo na ye chega to. 16De konto de, ko maŋe se dé yɔɔre dé taa tɔge chwoŋa kalo dé na maŋe dé lɔre we ka ye chega to mo.
17A nu-bia bam, ko maŋe se á ta‑á lwoni amo kikia yam mo, se á maane á nii balo na tɔge chwo-laao, nenɛɛne dé na bere abam se á ta‑á tɔge tei to. 18Amo lage se a jwoori a bere abam wonnu telo a na maŋe a ta kuni dedɛ to mo. Ko maa pae a kane yi-na de lwia yalo amo na jege abam ŋwaane to. Ko ye we nɔɔna dedɛ wo á wone ba kikia na bere we ba chuli Yezu Krista dagara kam toone dem. 19Ko kweelim jei ne Wɛ wó chɔge banto de ba dwi maama. Ba yeini ba zuli wonnu telo fera na jege-ba to ko dwoi Wɛ. Ba maa jege teera de kolo na maŋe de ba chaveera to, ye logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro boboŋa jege-ba. 20Ko nam ná ye debam, dé kugu jei wo Wɛ telaao woro kom ne mo. Konto ŋwaane, dé cheigi dé Vereno wom se o nwoŋi dáane mo o ba. Debam Teiru Yezu Krista mo konto. 21O ná tua, o laam wó kwei dé logo baŋa yera yam o pa ya leiri ya taa nye de o tete yera yam na tiini ya jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to. O wó ma o dam-fɔrɔ kolo na pae o wae woŋo maama o taa tei to o ke konto.

english_text:
1Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy.
Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
2Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other. 3And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
4Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad. 5Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here. 6Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God. 7Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
8Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise. 9You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you.
Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
10The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it. 11I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have. 12I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little. 13Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
14It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time. 15 My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return. 16 Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once. 17I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
18 I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God. 19I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus! 20May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen.
Final Greetings
21Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus.
The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
22All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
23I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_text:
Kikia yalo na maŋe de Yezu nɔɔna to
1A nu-bia bam, a swoi abam lanyerane ye á fera jege-ne. Abam pae amo ywoni jege wopwolo, ye a kwori a jege teera de abam. A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, kwaane-na á fɔge á zege lanyerane dé Teiru wom ŋwaane.
2A nam lwoori Yuodia de Sintika lanyerane se á ta‑á jege boboŋe dedwe, á maama na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to ŋwaane. 3Ko ta ná ye nmo wolo na ye a dwoŋi tontoŋeno chekke to, a lwoori‑m se n zeini kaana banto se ba taa sɛ daane, kolo ŋwaane ba déem tɔge de amo ye dé tiini dé toŋe dé bere nɔɔna Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Kelɛmɛn de nɔɔna badaara na wo a tei ne to de déem toŋe konto dwoŋi. Wɛ maŋe o popone banto yera o ŋwe-doŋa kam tɔnɔ kom wone.
4Ta‑á jege-na wopwolo maŋa maama dé Teiru wom ŋwaane. Amo ta wó jwoori a ta we, á ta‑á jege wopwolo. 5Pa-na se nɔɔna maama lɔre á na zuri á yera mo tei. Kokuri dé Teiru wom bá dáane ye o ba. 6Yé zaŋe-na á ta‑á jege lwia de kolokolo. Kolo maama nam ná ke ko pa abam, se á ta‑á ware Wɛ á bere‑o kolo á na lage to, ye á lwoori wolim o tei ne, ye á ta kwori á ke‑o lei. 7Konto mo Wɛ wó pa á bochara taa zura se ko taa dwoi nabiina na wó wane ba lɔre ko na ye tei to, se kolokolo yé wane ko chɔge á bochara de á boboŋa maama, á na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane.
8A nu-bia bam, amo ta jege fenfee se a ta a woli da. Ta‑á jege-na boboŋa konto dwoŋi:
ko ná ye woŋo kolo maama na ye chega to,
de woŋo kolo na jege zula,
de woŋo kolo na yɔɔre chwoŋa,
de woŋo kolo na ba jege tusim,
de woŋo kolo na pwoli nɔɔna wo,
de woŋo kolo na jege teem nɔɔna tei ne,
se á ta‑á jege-na wonnu tem konto boboŋa.
Ko maa ye wonnu telo maama na lana ye nɔɔna seini-te to boboŋa mo. 9Ta‑á toŋe-na á tɔge wonnu telo amo na bere abam ye á sɛ-te to. Abam maŋe á lɔre amo ni taane dem de a kikia maama na bere wonnu tem konto tei. Á ná seene á tɔge-te, bochare-zuru tu Baŋa Wɛ wó taa wo á tei ne.
Lei keim
10Amo tiini a jege wopwolo dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, kokuri ko dáane ye abam daa wo guli a gula se á woli-ne, ye leile konto á laam jwoori á zeini-ne. Ko nam dae we abam ba jege a boboŋa mo ya, ko ye á wo nɛ chwoŋa mo se á woli-ne. 11Amo na tɛ konto dwoŋi to, ko dae we amo na gɛ kolokolo to ŋwaane mo. Woŋo kolo maama ná ke-ne, a maŋe a lɔre mo ye a ba gwooni kolokolo. 12Yiniga ná jege-ne, amo yei a na wó ja a tete tei. A jeŋa nam ná jega, a ta yei a na wó ke tei. Kolo maama ná yi-ne, a maŋe a yei ko kuri. Wodiiru ná daga pa a di a boboŋa, naa kana ná jege-ne, ye a jejegero ná daga, naa te ná muri, amo ta yei chwoŋa kalo a na wó da to. 13A wae wonnu tem maama a ke, a na me de Yezu Krista ye o ke dam a bochare ne to ŋwaane. 14De konto de, á ke lanyerane de á na woli-ne de a yaara yam to.
15Abam Filipi tiina tete de yei lanyerane we, maŋa kalo a na nwoŋi Makedonia ye a bobo a wora a tɛ Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere nɔɔna to, ko ye abam yerane mo woli-ne. Yezu nɔn-kɔgɔ kodwoŋi daa tera ko na woli-ne se dé yaare dé pa daane, ko ná dae abam yerane. 16Amo déem na wo Tɛsaloni ne to, abam toŋe kolo amo na gɛ to á pa-ne, ye ko dae kuni bedwe yerane. 17Ko nam dae we amo yi zo á pɛɛra yam tete mo, se ko ye nyɔɔre delo abam na wó na Wɛ tei ne ya ŋwaane to mo. Konto mo pɛ-ne wopwolo. 18Amo jene daa tera abam yuu ne. Abam maŋe á ke se ko gaale á pa-ne. Amo laam nɛ pɛɛra yalo á na ke Epafarodi jeŋa ne se o ja ba o pa-ne to, ye a daa bá ga kolokolo. Abam pɛɛra yam nye de woŋo kolo lwom na ywomma ye á kwei á ma kaane Wɛ to mo. Wɛ wó jwoŋi á kaanem dem ye de ta wó pa o wo pwoli. 19Amo Tu Wɛ wó pa abam kolo maama á na gɛ to, de o na jege wo-laaro telo na tiini te beiŋi ye te jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Yezu Krista tei ne to.
20Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye debam Kwo to maŋe de zula maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.
21Jɔɔne-na Wɛ nɔɔna balo na me de Yezu Krista to maama á pa-ne. Dé nu-bia balo na wo amo tei ne to de jɔɔne abam. 22Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama jɔɔne abam, ko fɔge ko dae balo na zoore Rom Pa-faro wom sɔŋɔ ne to.
23Debam Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa o zaane dem taa wo á bochara ne.

english_text:
1From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
2To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ.
I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
A Prayer of Thanks
3Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. 4We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people, 5because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
6The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness 7 from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you. 8He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you.
The Person and Work of Christ
9We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives. 10Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better. 11His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
12I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light. 13God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son, 14 who forgives our sins and sets us free.
15 Christ is exactly like God,
who cannot be seen.
He is the first-born Son,
superior to all creation.
16Everything was created by him,
everything in heaven
and on earth,
everything seen and unseen,
including all forces
and powers,
and all rulers
and authorities.
All things were created
by God's Son,
and everything was made
for him.
17God's Son was before all else,
and by him everything
is held together.
18 He is the head of his body,
which is the church.
He is the very beginning,
the first to be raised
from death,
so that he would be
above all others.
19God himself was pleased
to live fully in his Son.
20 And God was pleased
for him to make peace
by sacrificing his blood
on the cross,
so that all beings in heaven
and on earth
would be brought back to God.
21You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things. 22But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent. 23But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message.
Paul's Service to the Church
24I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church. 25God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you. 26For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people. 27God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
28We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature. 29This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl wolo Wɛ na tiŋi-ne de o tete boboŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto, ye dé nu-bu Timoti mo tɔge o woli-ne. 2Dé popone se dé pa abam balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna ye á zoore Kolosia ne to. Abam maa ye dé nu-bia balo na tɔge Yezu Krista de á wo maama to.
Dé Kwo Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Lei keim
3Maŋa kalo maama debam ná yeini dé lwoori Wɛ dé pa abam, dé ta ke Wɛ lei abam ŋwaane. Wonto maa ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Kwo. 4Kokuri to, dé lɔre abam na jege wo-dedoa de Yezu, ye á kwori á jege Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama swono tei to. 5Konto maa pae se á jege teena we, á wó na ywoni Wɛ tei ne. Ko ye abam na bobo á ni Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to mo pɛ á lɔre we, o tiŋi ywoni dem konto telaao ne o pa abam. Wɛ kwora kam konto maa ye ta-ŋom delo na seene de ye chega to mo. 6O kwor-ywoŋa kam konto laam jage ka yi logo baŋa jei maama, ye ka fɔge nɔɔna lanyerane, ne ka na maŋe ka fɔge abam tei, ko zege maŋa kalo á na bobo á lɔre Wɛ zaane dem na seene de ye tei to. 7Ko ye Epafera déem mo bere abam Wɛ chega kam konto. Wonto maa ye debam nu-bu-swono ye o toŋe de o wo maama o pa Yezu Krista debam ŋwaane. 8Wonto ta mo tage o bere debam Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ abam taa jege swono á bochara ne tei to.
9Abam na yɔɔre á tɔge Yezu konto to, dé yeini dé lwoori Wɛ mo maŋa maama dé pa abam, ko zege maŋa kam dé na lɔre abam ni ne to. Dé lwoori‑o se o pa á ta‑á yei o boboŋa na lage tei to, se o daare o pa á na swa de yi-poro maama, ne o Sin-laao kom na pae tei to. 10Abam laam wó wane á tɔge chwoŋa se ko maŋe de dé Teiru wom na lage tei to, ye á kikia maama wó su o yi. Dé lwoori Wɛ se o woli abam se á ta‑á ke totoŋ-laaro dwi dwi lanyerane, se á boboŋa taa pula maŋa maama Wɛ taane wone. 11Wɛ nam wó tɔge o paare dem ŋwaane o woli abam de o dam-fɔrɔ kom, se á wane á fɔge á zege lanyerane, ye á jege pu-dɛa wonnu maama baŋa ne. 12Á wó wane á ta‑á ke dé Kwo Wɛ lei de wopwolo, kolo ŋwaane o pɛ abam chwoŋa se á tɔge á na wo-laaro telo o na tiŋi se o pa nɔɔna balo na ye o nyem to. Wɛ nɔɔna bam jeiŋa jei maa tiini de jege pwooni lanyerane o tei ne. 13Dé Kwo Wɛ ma vere debam lim wone o yage, se wo-lwanno daa yé taa jege dam dé baŋa ne. O ma daare o ja debam o zo o tete Bu-swono kom paare dem wo. 14Ko nam ye o Bu Yezu mo kwei o ŋwea o ma ŋwe dé wɛleera jene, pa se Wɛ yage-ya o ma chɛ debam.
Wɛ Bu Yezu na ye wolo to
15Yezu yɔɔre o jege Baŋa Wɛ nyenyego, ye nabiina yia na‑o. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ba nae Baŋa Wɛ tete. O ye Wɛ Bu-doa mo ye o zege wonnu telo maama Wɛ na naane to yiga ne. 16Wɛ dɛ wonto ŋwaane mo o ke wonnu maama. Te maa ye wonnu telo maama na wo wɛyuu ne de tega baŋa ne to, de telo nɔɔna na wae ba nae de yia, de telo ba na ba nae to, ko woli de malese, de wonnu telo maama na jege dam nabiina baŋa ne to. Ko ná ye wonnu telo maama na wora to, Wɛ dɛ Yezu ŋwaane mo o ke-te se ko pa o na zula te baŋa ne. 17Yezu maŋe o wora mo boboa ne ye kolokolo ta tera. Ko ye wonto ŋwaane mo wonnu maama jege kuri lanyerane ye te toŋe te tɔge daane. 18Ko ná ye Yezu nɔɔna bam tei ne, wonto mo ye ba yuu tu, ye ba kɔgɔ kom nye de o yera yam mo. O ta maa ye ba pulim jei. Ko ye Yezu mo dɛ yiga o bi toone wone ye o na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam, se ko pa o taa wo wonnu maama yiga ne. 19Baŋa Wɛ tete boboŋa mo lage se o Bu Yezu taa nye ded‑o fase. 20Wɛ boŋe se o da o Bu wom ŋwaane mo o jwoori o ke wonnu maama o tete jeŋa ne. O Bu Yezu na tege dagara kam yuu ne ye o jana nwoŋi to mo pɛ se wonnu maama jwoori te fɔge daane de Wɛ, ne ko ná ye logo baŋa wonnu tem de wɛyuu wonnu tem maama de.
21Ko nam ná ye abam, á déem ye Wɛ dona mo. Abam boboŋa de á kikia maama déem lage wo-lwanno yerane mo pa se á ba lage Wɛ ni taane. 22Ko daare leile konto, Wɛ laam pɛ se abam ded‑o fɔge daane, o Bu wom na jigi nabiinu ye o daare o te to ŋwaane. Wɛ ke konto se á wane á ba á zege o yiga ne de wo-pwoŋo, ye á ye nɔn-laaro balo na ba jege tusim to. 23Abam nam jege se á yɔɔre á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ chega kam de á wo-dedoa, se á yé ywori ka wone. Á yé pa se á boboŋa leiri de teena yalo á na jege Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane to. Ka ye Wɛ kwora kalo abam na maŋe á ni ye ba tɔɔle-ka dɔŋɔ ni maama ne to mo. Wɛ nam kuri amo mo se a taa ye o tontoŋeno ye a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam konto.
Pɔɔl na toŋe o pa Yezu nɔɔna tei to
24Amo na yaare tei abam ŋwaane to mo yeini ko pa-ne wopwolo. Ko na chɛ amo yera ne tei to ye Yezu Krista na yaare o daare tei to mo konto. Amo yaara yam nam mo wó woli Yezu yaara yam wone se ko pa o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na zeinim lanyerane. 25O nɔɔna bam nye de o tete yera mo, ye Wɛ tiŋi-ne se a taa toŋa a pa-ba. Amo na toŋe tei a pa abam to mo ye a yeini a kwaane a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam maama jilli. 26Ko zege faŋa faŋa to, Wɛ chega kam konto déem seigi nabiina tei ne, ye Wɛ laam le-ka o bere o tete nɔɔna bam. 27Ko ye Wɛ tete boboŋa na lage tei to o ma pa ba lɔre o chega kam konto. O lage se logo baŋa dwi maama tiina mo lɔre o chega kam na tiini ka jege lam tei to. Wɛ chega kalo déem na seigi ye ka laam ba ka lɔre jaja to mo ye we, Yezu Krista wo abam bochara ne, pa se á jege teena we á wó na nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Wɛ tei ne. 28Konto ŋwaane debam yeini dé tɔɔle Yezu Krista taane mo dé bere nɔɔna maama. Dé tɔge Wɛ chega kalo maama dé na yei to dé maa kaane-ba, ye dé daare dé bere-ba chekke, se ko pa ba maama laam wane ba zege Wɛ yiga ne, de ba na me de Yezu ye ba boboŋa kweere to. 29Amo nam kwaane a fe a tete a toŋe konto, pa se ko chɛ a yera ne. Ko nam ye dam-fɔrɔ kolo Yezu na yeini o ke a bochare ne to mo a mae a toŋe konto.

english_text:
1I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me. 2I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery, 3but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him. 4I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk. 5Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong.
Christ Brings Real Life
6You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him. 7Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
8Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
9God lives fully in Christ. 10And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority. 11Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body. 12 And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death. 13 You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
14 God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross. 15There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
16 Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival. 17These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
18Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires. 19 They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God.
Christ Brings New Life
20You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as, 21“Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”? 22After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up? 23Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_text:
1A lage a ta a bere abam amo na tiini a toŋe tei abam ŋwaane to mo. A ta toŋe a pa Wɛ nɔɔna balo na wo Ladika ne to, de nɔɔna balo yi na wo nɛ amo to maama. 2Amo yeini a zeini Wɛ nɔɔna bam se ko pa ba wane ba taa jege baare, se ba daare ba me daane de swono. Konto wó pa ba zege lanyerane de ba na tiini ba yei Wɛ chega kam tei to. Ba maa wó ba ba lɔre Wɛ chega kalo ya na seigi to, ye kanto nam mo ye Yezu Krista tete. 3Wonto mo ye wolo na pae se nɔɔna wane ba lɔre Wɛ swa de yeino maama na ye tei, ye te jege nyɔɔre dedɛ to.
4A nam tage konto a bere abam se á yé pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno gane abam, de o ná maŋe o ŋɔɔne swa taane tei maama de. 5Amo na seene a tera abam tei ne to, amo boboŋa mo wora abam tei ne. Konto ŋwaane, ko pɛ-ne wopwolo de amo na lɔre we, abam zege lanyerane de ni dedwe de á na yɔɔre á jege wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista tei to.
Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam taane
6Abam nam na sɛ Yezu Krista se o taa ye abam Teiru to, se á yɔɔre á ta‑á ye ded‑o konto dwoŋi. 7Nam sale-na á tete ded‑o se o fɔge abam de dam. Kwaane-na se á ta‑á jege o chega kam á bochara ne, ne ba na maŋe ba bere abam tei to. Á nam ta‑á ke Wɛ lei se ko gaale.
8Abam ta‑á yei se nɔɔna wó kwaane ba ma ba tete swa ba gane abam, ye swa yam konto dae Yezu Krista nyem. Ya nam ye nabiina boboŋa yalo na tɔge logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem dedaane dé nabaara chullu tem ŋwaane mo. Ya maama maa ye kafɛ. 9Ko nam ná ye Yezu Krista, o déem na ye nabiinu to, Wɛ boboŋa de o jworo maama wo o tei ne. 10O nam tei woŋo kolo maama na jege dam nabiina baŋa ne to mo. Abam na me ded‑o to, á maŋe á na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam fase.
11Abam na tu á me de Yezu Krista to, o le á boboŋ-lwanno se te daa yé taa jege dam á baŋa ne. Abam na fɔge á kwɛ konto to, ko nye de ba na gwoni nɔɔno peini tei to. Ko nam na ke abam tei to dae nabiinu keim, se ko ye Yezu keim ŋwaane mo. 12Kokuri, abam na jwoŋi sɛɛm to, ko bere we ba ya suli abam de, nenɛɛne Yezu Krista na tega ye ba suli‑o tei to mo. Ko kwori ko bere we, á jwoori á bi á na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam, kolo ŋwaane á sɛ we Wɛ dam daga, de o na mɛ-de o bi Yezu toone wone to.
13Abam déem ya ba jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne, á na tɔge keim-balwaaro to ŋwaane. Á déem wo maŋe de Wɛ nɔɔna bam na ye tei to. De konto de, Wɛ laam pɛ se á na o ŋwe-doŋa kam, á na me de Yezu to ŋwaane. Ko ná ye debam balo maama na ye Wɛ nɔɔna to, o yage dé wɛleera maama o ma chɛ debam. 14Yezu na tege dagara kam yuu ne to, Wɛ ma pa se o nia yam de ya chullu tem maama na bere we dé ke dé chɔge tei to daa yé taa wo dé yuu ne. O ma saare dé wɛleera maama, Yezu na leiri dé yuu ne o te to ŋwaane. 15Yezu ma wane dedɛɛra balo maama na jege dam nabiina baŋa ne to, ye o chɔge ba dam maama. O toone dem dagara kam yuu ne to mo Wɛ mɛ o bere nɔɔna jaja we, dedɛɛra bam konto maama wo o dam kuri ne, ne o na wane o dona ye o ja-ba o vɔ tei to.
16Konto ŋwaane, abam yé pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chwoŋa o yaale abam de á na di kolo ye á nyɔ kolo to. Á yé pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno bere abam á na wó pɔɔre da yalo se ya taa ye da-kamuna yalo á na wó ma á zuli Wɛ to, ko ze ná ye chan-doŋa ŋwaane, naa siu dɛ ŋwaane. 17Chullu tem konto dwoŋi daa ba jege kuri. Te déem ye lunluŋu mo se te wuuri te bere chega kalo na lage ka ba to. Chega kam konto nam zege Yezu Krista yera ne mo. 18Á yé sɛ á pa nɔɔna balo na bere we, á jege se á ta‑á yaare á tete, naa se á ta‑á zuli malese. Banto boŋe se ba vere nyɔɔre delo á na jege Wɛ tei ne to mo. Ba yeini ba tɛ nenɛɛne, Wɛ mo guri o chega o bere-ba, ye ba boboŋa nam dae Wɛ nyem. Ko nam ye ba tete kamunim boboŋa mo ba jega, ye ko ye kafɛ. 19Banto nam daa ba jege meem de Yezu. Wonto nam mo ye debam Yuu-tu, ye dé me ded‑o nenɛɛne nɔɔno yera na twoŋi de o yuu tei to. Yezu ŋwaane mo dé jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne, ye dé gwaane daane dé toŋa dé tɔge chwoŋa kalo Wɛ na lage to. Wɛ maa woli debam se dé toŋe dé vo yiga. Ko nye de nɔɔno yera na jege pɔɔrem dwi dwi, ye ya ke totoŋa bedwe, ye ya ke ya ke da tei to mo.
20Abam na sɛ Yezu Krista to, ko nye de á tɔge ded‑o á te. Konto ŋwaane logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro daa ba jege dam á baŋa ne. Bɛ mo ye á nam ta ke nenɛɛne á ye logo baŋa nyem? Bɛ mo ye á sɛ chullu telo na bere we, 21“Yé dwei konto”, naa “Yé ta‑n di konto”, naa “Yé ja konto”? 22Chullu tento dwoŋi wora wodiiru yerane ŋwaane mo. Wodiiru nam ba jege kuri taa taa. Nmo ná di n ti, mo ko maama. Chullu telo ba na bere abam konto dwoŋi to ye nabiina boboŋa mo. Te wo nwoŋi Wɛ tei. 23Te nam bere nɔɔna ba na wó fe ba tete ba zuli Wɛ tei to, de ba na jege se ba yaare ba tete ye ba waare ba yera tei to. Chullu tem konto dwoŋi bere we te jege kuri, ye te nam ye kafɛ. Te ware te woli nɔɔna se ba ja ba tete de wo-zɔɔna yalo ba fera na zoore to.

english_text:
1 You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side. 2Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth. 3You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God. 4Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
5Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols. 6God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things. 7And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way. 8But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others. 9 And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
10 Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better. 11It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
12 God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient. 13 Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you. 14Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
15Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful. 16 Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God. 17Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him.
Some Rules for Christian Living
18 A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
19 A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
20 Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
21 Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
22 Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart. 23Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master. 24In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you. 25 But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_text:
1Abam na nɛ Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam to, ko nye de á tɔge de Yezu Krista mo á jwoori á bi toone wone. Yezu laam jege o jeiŋa jei Wɛ jazem seeni. Abam na me ded‑o to, pa-na se Wɛ telaao wonnu tem taa jege fera á tei ne. 2Pa-na se á boboŋa tiini ya zo wo-laaro tem konto, ye ko dae logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem. 3Abam na yage wɛleera chwoŋa to, ko nye de á ye twa mo ya tei ne. Á ŋwe-doŋa kam ye Yezu Krista nyem mo, ye Wɛ jege-ka o kwola o tei ne. 4Á ŋwea kam de Yezu Krista ye bedwe mo. Konto ŋwaane, o ná jwoori o ba o bere o tete jaja de o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom, abam de wó tɔge ded‑o á ta‑á jege o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom dwoŋi.
Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kikia yam taane
5Abam nam jege se á chɔge logo baŋa boboŋ-lwanno mo á bochara ne, se á daa yé zaŋe á sɛ-te. Ko ná ye kabwoŋa mo, naa wo-zɔɔna keim, naa ka-laga kikia, naa ko ná ye á fera na zoore wo-yɔɔro tei, naa á yi su wonnu tei to, se á yé sɛ á tɔge boboŋa yam konto dwoŋi. Nmo nam ná pae n yi su wonnu, ko bere we n pa tento mo zula ne jwona tei to. 6Ko nam na ye tei to, kikia yanto dwoŋi ŋwaane mo Wɛ bane wó zaŋe nabiina baŋa ne. 7Abam tete ŋwea déem tɔge chwei sento dwoŋi mo. 8Ko daare leile konto, abam nam jege se á de wo-balwaaro tem konto maama mo á yage. Yage-na ban-zɔŋɔ de ban-lom maama. Á yé ta‑á boŋe nɔɔna chɔgem. Á yé ta‑á twe nɔɔna. Á yé pa se ta-zɔɔna taa wo á ni ne. 9Yé zaŋe-na á fɔ vwa á pa daane. Kokuri abam dole á ŋwe-dwoŋa kam á yage de ka kikia maama, 10ye á laam daare á jege ŋwe-doŋa mo. Wɛ mo ye á ŋwe-doŋa kam keiru. O maa wora o fɔge-ka se ka taa nye de o tete ŋwea, se á wane á lɔre o na ye tei to chekke. 11Konto ŋwaane, ko ná ye balo na jege Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam to, pɔɔrem tera ba wone. Juu tiina de dwi-gɛ tiina maama ye bedwe mo. Balo peina na gwoni to de balo na wo gwoni to de maama ye bedwe. Balo na ye veira to de balo yi na wo poore to, ko woli de kabɛ de balo na tei ba tete to maama ye bedwe mo. Ba maama ŋwea wora Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo ye o me de ba maama.
12Wɛ mo kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem, ye o jege abam swono. Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á jege-na da-ŋwaŋa, de da-zula. Ta‑á gwooni-na á tete da-tei ne, se á ta‑á nege daane de ban-peno. 13Ta‑á zuri-na á yera á pa daane. Abam wolo ná jege o dwoŋi taane, se á yage á ma á chɛ daane, ne dé Teiru Yezu na yage abam wɛleera o ma chɛ abam tei to. 14Konto maama wone ta‑á jege-na da-swono, se ko pa á wane á tɔge chwoŋa de ni dedwe. 15Pa-na se á boboŋa maama taa tɔge bochare-zuru, ne Yezu Krista na pɛ á jege tei to. Abam na ye kɔgɔ dedoa to, Wɛ kuri abam se á ta‑á tɔge daane de bochare-zuru konto dwoŋi mo. Maŋa maama se á ta‑á ke Wɛ lei. 16Pa-na se Yezu Krista taane dem tiini de zo abam bochara de fɔge-ya lanyerane. Á ta‑á mae boboŋ-dɛɛra á bere daane Wɛ chega kam, se ko pa á lɔre chwoŋa kalo na lana to. Ta‑á leeni-na Wɛ seinim lei, de Yezu kɔgɔ kom lei, de Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ abam lei selo to. Ta‑á leeni-na konto á pa Wɛ, ye á ke‑o lei. 17Woŋo kolo maama abam na wora á ke de á ni, naa de á jeŋa to, se á pa ko taa ye dé Teiru Yezu yere ŋwaane, ye á daare á tɔge o ŋwaane á ta‑á ke dé Kwo Wɛ lei.
Nɔɔna maama na jege se ba tɔge chwoŋa kalo to
18Kaana jege se ba sɛ ba pa ba banna, ne ko na maŋe de balo na tɔge dé Teiru Yezu to.
19Ko nam ná ye kan-banna, se á ta‑á swoi á kaana, se á yé ta‑á ke keim-chɛɛre de-ba.
20Ko nam ná ye bia, á na sɛ dé Teiru Yezu to, ko maŋe se á sɛ á tiina ni mo maŋa maama, se konto mo lamma Wɛ tei ne.
21Ko daare ko ná ye bia tiina, se á yé ta‑á chuchugi á bia bana, se konto wó pa ba boboŋa chɔge chwoŋa kalo na lana to wone.
22Ko ná ye balo na ye kabɛ to, se á ta‑á toŋe á tɔge á yuu tiina boboŋa woŋo maama baŋa ne. Ko nam dae ba na zege ba nii abam maŋa kalo to yerane mo á wó ke konto se á jwoŋi zula ba tei ne. Maŋa maama ta‑á toŋe-na de á wo maama, á na kɔre dé Teiru wom to ŋwaane. 23Woŋo kolo maama á na toŋe to, se á ta‑á toŋe de jawala. Pa-na se á na ke tei to taa ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, ye ko dae nabiina yerane ŋwaane. 24Kokuri á yei we dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam nyɔɔre delo o na tiŋi se o pa o nɔɔna bam to. Wonto mo ye á yuu tu wolo á na toŋe á pa to. 25Ko daare wolo maama na ke o chɔge to wó jwoori o na chɔgem se ko maŋe de o kikia yam na ye tei to. Wɛ nam tɔge chega de o na ke nɔɔna maama tei to ye o ba kuri-ba daane.

english_text:
1 Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
2Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful. 3Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this. 4Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
5 When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time. 6 Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions.
Final Greetings
7 Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me. 8I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along. 9 Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
10 Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you. 11Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
12 Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely. 13I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
14 Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
15Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
16After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
17 Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
18I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
Don't forget that I am in jail.
I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_text:
1Ko ná ye yuu tiina balo na tei kabɛ to, se á ta‑á tɔge chega de á na ke-ba tei to. Á nam ta‑á yei we, abam de jege wolo na tei abam to Wɛ telaao ne.
2Abam maama nam tiini á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ, se á pa á boboŋa maama taa wora, ye á kwori á ke‑o lei. 3Á nam ta‑á lwoori Wɛ konto á pa debam de, se o pa dé na chwoŋa se dé taa tɔɔle o kwora kam dé bere nɔɔna Yezu Krista chega kam na ye tei to. Ko nam ye amo na bere Yezu chega kam to ŋwaane mo pɛ se a laam wo peena diga ne. 4Lwoori-na Wɛ á pa-ne se a wane a pa nɔɔna lɔre chega kam konto maama fase. Mo totoŋe delo Wɛ na pɛ-ne se a ke to.
5Ko ná ye balo na ba tɔge Yezu to, se á ta‑á yei á na wó tɔge chwoŋa kalo á ke-ba tei to. Wɛ ná pɛ abam chwoŋa se á toŋe kolo, se á pa ko ja kuri lanyerane. 6Pa-na se á ni taane taa jege ywoni de mwanno, se á daare á ta‑á yei á na wó leiri nɔɔna maama taane tei to.
7A lage a toŋe dé nu-bu-swono Tichika se o ba abam tei. Wonto toŋe o pa dé Teiru Yezu de o wo maama, ne debam de na toŋe tei to. 8O ná tua, o laam wó ta amo taane maama o bere abam. A lage se o pa abam bochara mo peini tega ne, de á na wó lɔre kolo na wora ko ke debam to. 9Debam nu-bu-swono Onesima de wó tɔge o ba. O déem nwoŋi abam kɔgɔ kom wone mo, ye dé yei o wo lanyerane. Banto balei wó ta woŋo kolo maama na wora ko ke debam tei ne to ba bere abam.
10Arisaka wolo na tɔge de amo o wo peena diga ne to jɔɔne abam. Maake wolo na ye choro de Banabas to de jɔɔne abam. Abam maŋe á jwoŋi ni se, o ná tua, se á jeeri‑o lanyerane. 11Yesua wolo yere dedwoŋi na ye Jusitu to de jɔɔne abam. Ko ná ye Juu tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Yezu to, nɔɔna banto batɔ yerane mo ye balo na tɔge ba toŋe Wɛ paare dem totoŋa ba woli amo. Ba kwaane ba pa se a bochare ke dam lanyerane.
12Epafera wolo na nwoŋi abam kɔgɔ kom wone ye o toŋe o pa Yezu Krista to de jɔɔne abam. O kwaane mo o lwoori Wɛ maŋa maama o pa abam, se á wane á zege lanyerane de baare, se á boboŋa kweere de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem, ye á tɔge Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to maama. 13Amo tete mo zege o chega kam kwaga ne we, o tiini o toŋe o pa abam, de nɔɔna balo na zoore Ladika de Hirapoli ne to.
14Debam badwoŋ-swono Luka wolo na ye dɔkta tu to, dedaane Demas jɔɔne abam.
15Jɔɔne-na dé nu-bia balo na tɔge Yezu ye ba zoore Ladika ne to á pa debam, ko woli de Numifa, de Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na yeini ko tigisi o sɔŋɔ ne to.
16Abam ná jwoŋi amo tɔnɔ konto ye á ná gage á ti, se á laam pa-ko Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na zoore Ladika ne to se ba de ga. Ko daare se abam de jwoŋi amo tɔnɔ kodwoŋi Ladika kɔgɔ kom tei ne á ga á nii.
17Ta-na á bere Achipu se o kwaane o ti totoŋe delo dé Teiru Yezu na pɛ‑o se o ke to.
18Amo Pɔɔl tete mo mɛ a jeŋa a popone jɔɔnem dento na kweeli to. Abam yé zaŋe á swei amo na wo peena diga ne tei to.
Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.

english_text:
1 From Paul, Silas, and Timothy.
To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
2We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray, 3we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
4My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people. 5When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you. 6 So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
7You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia. 8And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it. 9Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God. 10They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl dedaane Silas de Timoti mo popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa abam Tɛsaloni tiina balo na ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á tɔge á ye dé Kwo Baŋa Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu Krista nyem to.
Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Tɛsaloni tiina na tɔge Wɛ tei to
2Maŋa maama dé yeini dé ke Wɛ lei á maama ŋwaane, ye dé kwori dé lwoori‑o dé pa abam. 3Dé ná vei dé Kwo Wɛ yiga, dé yeini dé guli á na yɔɔre á tɔge dé Teiru Yezu Krista tei to. Abam na ke á wo-dedoa ded‑o tei to mo pae á toŋe lanyerane. Á na swoi‑o tei to mo pae á toŋe pa ko chɛ á yera. Á na jege teena ded‑o tei to mo pae á zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa.
4Dé nu-bia bam, dé yei we Wɛ mo swoi abam, ye o daare o kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem. 5Kokuri, dé déem na kwei Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé ja ba dé tɔɔle dé bere abam to, ko dae ni taane yerane mo dé tu dé bere. Wɛ dam wo debam tei ne, de o Sin-laao kom de, ye dé zege o chega kam kwaga ne. Á déem nɛ dé na zoore abam tetare ne ye dé ke tei to. Ko maa ye se ko zeini abam mo.
6Á déem lwoni debam de dé Teiru wom na ye tei to. Á na jwoŋi Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to, ko pɛ se á na yaara dedɛ. Á nam ta jwoŋi-ka de wopwolo, Wɛ Sin-laao kom na zeini abam to ŋwaane. 7Ko ma pa se á dwonna lɔre á na ye tei to, ye Yezu nɔɔna balo na zoore Makedonia de Akaya teene dem ne to maama ta lwoni abam kikia. 8Abam na tɔɔle dé Teiru wom kwora kam á bere nɔɔna tei to, ka yi Makedonia de Akaya ka gaale ka kɛ ka yi jei maama, ye nɔɔna maama lɔre á na ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei. Mo kokuri dé daa ba jege se dé ta abam kolokolo. 9Nɔɔna bam tete yeini ba tɛ á na jeeri debam lanyerane tei to. Ba lɔre á na yage jwona kaanem mo se á daare á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ. Ba maa tɛ á laam na toŋe á pa Wɛ wom na ye chega tu de ŋwea tu to, 10ye á kwori á cheigi o Bu wom se o jwoori o ba. Wɛ bi‑o toone wone mo, ye o lage o nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne o ba logo baŋa. Wonto mo ye Yezu wolo na wó jwoŋi debam Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom na wó ba nɔɔna baŋa to wone.

english_text:
Paul's Work in Thessalonica
1My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted. 2 As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble. 3We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone. 4God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
5You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed. 6We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us. 7But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby. 8We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
9My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone. 10Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord. 11You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children. 12We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
13We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you. 14 My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
15 Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else. 16They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them.
Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
17My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person. 18We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us. 19After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us? 20You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_text:
Pɔɔl na woli Tɛsaloni tiina tei to
1Dé nu-bia bam, abam tete yei lanyerane we, dé na tu abam tei to, ko dae kafɛ ŋwaane. 2Á yei debam na maŋe dé na yaara dedɛ Filipi ne tei to, ye dé laam ba abam tei. Ba déem bɛɛse debam ye ba twe debam dedɛ. Dé na tu abam tei to, nɔɔna déem kwaane se ba che dé chwoŋa. De ko de, dé Tu Wɛ nam pɛ debam pu-dɛa se dé ŋɔɔne o kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere abam de baare. 3Dé na yeini dé kwoori abam se á tɔge Wɛ to, ko dae we dé ŋɔɔne tusim laŋa ne mo, naa dé jege boboŋ-balwaaro mo. Ko dae swa mo dé kea se dé gane abam wolowolo. 4Aawo. Dé yeini dé ŋɔɔne ne Wɛ na lage se dé taa ŋɔɔne tei to mo, kokuri wonto mo kuri debam ye o kwei o kwor-ywoŋa kam o ke dé jeŋa ne se dé taa tɔɔle-ka. Ko ye Wɛ mo maŋe dé boboŋa se o nii. Dé nam na ŋɔɔne tei to, dé lage se dé pwoli o wo, ye ko dae nabiina wo mo dé lage dé pwoli. 5Á yei lanyerane we, dé wo tu se dé ŋɔɔne ni-sone ŋɔŋa de abam. Dé maa wo kwaane se dé kwoli nɔɔna swa se dé na wonnu ba tei ne. Wɛ nam mo wó zege dé chega kam kwaga ne. 6Ko ná ye abam, naa nɔɔno wolo maama de, dé wo ke dé boboŋa ne se nabiina taa pae debam zula.
7Dé na ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwa to, dé ya jege chwoŋa se dé daane abam. Dé nam wo ke konto. Dé déem jege abam lanyerane, ne kaane na jege o bia o nii tei to. 8Dé na jege abam swono lanyerane to, dé sɛ se dé kwei Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé maŋe dé bere abam, ye dé kwei dé ŋwea maama de mo dé woli da dé ke á jeŋa ne, á na tiini á tigi dé boboŋa ne to ŋwaane.
9Dé nu-bia bam, guli-na debam déem na toŋe dé pa abam ye ko chɛ dé yera ne tei to. Dé na wora dé tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere abam to, dé ba lage se dé daane abam de fenfee de. Konto ŋwaane mo dé yeini dé tiini dé toŋe wea de tete maama se dé ma na dé ni-wodiu. 10Abam wó wane á bere nɔɔna debam chega we, dé tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane. Wɛ de wó wane o zege de kwaga ne. Dé na ke tei de abam balo na sɛ Yezu Krista to, dé yɔɔre dé tɔge chwoŋa mo. Dé kikia maama déem jege chega ye dé wo jaane kolokolo dé chɔge. 11Á yei we dé jaane abam de je selei mo, ne kwo na yeini o jege o bia tei to. 12Dé déem kwoori abam se á bochara zuri. Dé ma daare dé kaane abam se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa se ko maŋe de Wɛ na lage tei to. Kokuri Wɛ mo kuri abam se á zo o woro kom wo ye á na paare o tei ne.
13Woŋo kodwoŋi daa ta wora ye dé ke Wɛ lei maŋa maama abam ŋwaane. Ko ye dé na jaane Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé ba dé tɔɔle dé bere abam to, á sɛ ye á jwoŋi-ka lanyerane. Á ma sɛ we ko ye Wɛ kwora mo, se ko dae nabiina nyem. Ko ye chega mo, ka seene ka ye Wɛ tete kwora mo, ye ka fɔge abam balo na sɛ Yezu to boboŋa.
14Dé nu-bia bam, ko ná ye yaara yalo na ke abam to, konto dwoŋi mo maŋe ko ke Wɛ kɔgɔ kolo maama na wo Judea te-nia yam ne to. Ko maama ye bedwe mo. Á déem nɛ yaara á dwi tiina bam jea ne. Juu tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Yezu Krista to de nɛ yaara ba tete Juu tiina bam tei ne. 15Ko ná ye Juu tiina bam, banto dwi mo go dé Teiru Yezu de Wɛ sampwori selo déem na tɔɔle o kwora to, ye ba kwori ba bɛɛse debam de. Ba maa yɔɔre ba chuchugi Wɛ bane. Ba yeini ba done nɔɔna maama mo. 16Ba déem kwaane se ba che debam se dé yé tɔɔle Wɛ kwora dé bere dwi-gɛ tiina balo na dae Juu tiina to, se ka wane ka jwoŋi-ba ka yage. Ba na ve Wɛ kwora kam konto to, ko ma pa ba keim-lwanno tem fɔge te puli te daŋe da-baŋa ne. Ko laam yi se Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ ba ba baŋa ko chɔge-ba.
Pɔɔl lage se o ni ba labaare
17Dé nu-bia bam, dé na yage abam ye ko ke fee to, dé jege lwia dedɛ dé pa abam. Ko nam dae we dé boboŋa mo pɔɔre daane, se ko ye dé yia na ware ya na daane to mo. Dé déem tiini dé kwaane se dé jwoori dé ba dé na abam. 18Chega to, dé lage se dé ba abam tei. Amo Pɔɔl ya kwaane se a ba, ye ko dae bedwe yerane. Ko nam ye setaana pɛ mo chege dé chwoŋa. 19Ko seene ko ye abam boboŋa mo tiini ya wo debam tei ne. Ko ye abam ŋwaane mo dé jege teena Wɛ tei ne de wopwolo. Dé Teiru Yezu ná jwoori o ba, dé wó mage dé nyɔɔna, dé na jege teera de abam to ŋwaane. 20Ko ye chega mo, abam seene á pae dé jege teera de wopwolo.

english_text:
1 Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves 2and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you. 3We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer, 4because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know. 5At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
6 Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
7My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you. 8Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life. 9How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us? 10Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
11We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you. 12May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown. 13And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_text:
1-2Dé nam na ware se dé na daane to, abam fera tiini ya jege debam se ko gaale. Ko ma pa dé jeeli se dé toŋe dé nu-bu Timoti se o ba abam tei, ye debam tete daare dé maŋe Atena ne. Wonto ye wolo na tɔge de debam o toŋe Wɛ ŋwaane ye o tɔɔle Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam. Dé toŋe‑o abam tei ne se o woli abam de dam se á ta‑á tɔge Yezu de á wo maama, 3se yaara yalo á na nɛ to yé wane ya pa á jwoori kwaga. Abam yei we yaara yanto dwoŋi maŋe ya jege se ya ba debam baŋa. 4Debam déem ta na wo abam tei ne maŋa kalo to, dé maŋe dé ta dé bere abam we, nɔɔna wó bɛɛse debam. Á laam na nɛ to, mo kolo na seene ko ke. 5Amo na tiini a jege abam lwia to mo pɛ se a toŋe Timoti abam tei ne, se o ba o lɔre á daa ta tɔge Yezu de á wo maama na. Amo ya tiini a kɔre mo we, setaana pɛ mo tu o gane abam se á ywori Wɛ kwaga ne, se ko pa dé totoŋa yam maama laam ba ya ji kafɛ.
6Leile konto Timoti laam jwoori o ba debam tei ye o pa dé boboŋa peini tega ne, de o na tage á taane o we, á ta tɔge Yezu de á wo-dedoa de swono. O daa ta tage o we, á seene á jege debam boboŋa de wopwolo, ye á tiini á lage se á na debam, ne debam de na lage se dé na abam tei to.
7Dé nu-bia bam, yaara jege debam dedɛ. Dé bochara nam tiga de abam, á na tɔge Yezu de á wo-dedoa to ŋwaane. 8Á na tɔge dé Teiru wom de pu-dɛa konto to, ko pae dé ŋwea dae kafɛ. 9Dé wó tiini dé ke dé Tu Wɛ lei á ŋwaane, dedaane dé na nɛ wopwolo dedɛ o yiga ne abam ŋwaane to. 10Maŋa maama tete de wea dé yeini dé lwoori Wɛ de dé wo maama mo, se o yage chwoŋa se dé wane dé na daane, se dé fɔge dé bere abam á na gɛ kolo se á wae á ta‑á tɔge Yezu de á wo-dedoa to.
11Dé Kwo Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu nam wó pa debam chwoŋa se dé ba abam tei. 12Dé Teiru wom wó pa á swono kom puli dedɛ ko ja gaale, se á ta‑á swoi á dwonna de nɔɔna maama lanyerane, ne debam de na swoi abam tei to. 13Konto dwoŋi mo o wó pa á bochara ke dam, se á laam ba á zege dé Kwo Wɛ yiga ne de wo-pwoŋo, ye á ba jege tusim, maŋa kalo dé Teiru Yezu na wó jwoori o ba de o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama to.

english_text:
A Life That Pleases God
1Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder. 2Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus. 3God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex. 4Respect and honor your wife. 5Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God. 6You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things. 7God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure. 8So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
9We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this, 10and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more. 11Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do. 12 Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone.
The Lord's Coming
13My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope. 14We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died. 15 Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
16 With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life. 17Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever. 18Encourage each other with these words.
translation_text:
Kikia yalo na pwoli Wɛ wo to
1Dé nu-bia bam, ko ta daare woŋo fee se dé popone dé woli da. Dé lwoori abam dé Teiru Yezu ŋwaane se á da chwoŋa se ko pwoli Wɛ wo. Dé maŋe dé bere abam chwoŋa kam konto ye á jege-ka á tɔga de zem maama. Dé nam tiini dé lwoori abam se á ja jawala se ko dwoni á na maŋe á ke tei to. 2Abam yei nia yalo dé na bere abam ye ya tɔge dé Teiru Yezu dam ŋwaane to. 3Wɛ na lage se á ta‑á ye tei to mo tento:
O lage se á ta‑á jege wo-pwoŋo o yiga ne, se á lɔŋe ka-laga kikia. 4Abam baara jege se á lɔre á na wó ja á tete tei ka-laga seeni, se ko taa jege zula ye digiru tera ko wone. 5Á nam yé pa á fera taa zoore ka-laga. Mo nɔn-yɔɔro telo na yeiri Wɛ to na yeini ba ke kolo. 6Baaro de kaane laŋa ne, nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé zaŋe o chɔge o nu-bu naa o ke o de‑o. Dé maŋe dé kaane abam lanyerane we, nɔɔno ná ke wo-zɔɔna konto dwoŋi, dé Teiru wom wó waare‑o. 7Wɛ na kuri debam se dé taa tɔge‑o tei to, ko dae se dé taa ke wo-zɔɔna kikia ka-laga wone. O nam kuri debam se dé taa ye wose mo o yiga ne. 8Mo kokuri, nɔɔno wolo ná ve dé na bere tei to, konto tu mɛ o kwaga o ya Wɛ mo. Ko dae nabiina mo o ve, se ko ye Wɛ wolo na ke o Sin-laao kom á bochara ne to mo.
9Ko nam ná ye á na swoi á nu-bia tei to, ko daa wo maŋe se dé popone dé woli da. Wɛ tete maŋe o bere abam á na wó ta‑á jege da-swono tei. 10Ko ye chega mo, á seene á swoi á nu-bia balo maama na zoore Makedonia teene dem ne to. Mo kokuri, dé nu-bia bam, dé lwoori abam se á tiini á ta‑á ke konto se ko ja gaale. 11Kwaane-na se á ta‑á zoore chemm. Ta‑á nii-na á tete kikia se á yage á dwonna. Á ta ta‑á toŋa se á na á tete ni-wodiu á di. Dé maŋe dé ta abam konto mo se á ta‑á ke. 12Á ná dɛ chwoŋa kanto, balo na dae Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna to wó taa nege abam lanyerane. Ko maa wó pa se á daa bá daane nɔɔn-nɔɔno se o pa abam á na gɛ kolo to.
Dé Teiru wom tutuuri dem taane
13Dé nu-bia bam, ko ná ye nɔɔna balo na tege to, dé lage se á lɔre chega de ko na ke-ba tei to, se á wo daa yé chɔge toone ŋwaane, ne ko na yeini ko ke balo na ba jege teena Wɛ tei ne to. 14Debam sɛ we, Yezu tega ye o laam jwoori o bi toone wone. Konto ŋwaane, ko ná ye balo na sɛ‑o ye ba te to, dé yei we, o ná tua, Wɛ wó kale banto se ba tɔge ded‑o ba yi o tei.
15Yé ta‑á jege-na lwia. Dé na bere abam kolo to ye dé Teiru wom kwora mo. Dɛ dem dé Teiru Yezu na wó jwoori o ba to, debam balo na daare logo baŋa ne ye dé ta ŋwe to bá lwoori dé vo Wɛ tei dé daare balo na maŋe ba te to. 16Ko nam na wó ke tei to, dé Teiru wom wó nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne o chu o ba. Kwor-dɛa wó bage ka ta taane. Wɛ malese dedɛɛro wom kwora de wó zaŋe ka woli da. Wɛ nabɔnɔ de maa wó keeri. Balo na sɛ Yezu Krista ye ba te to wó da yiga ba bi toone wone. 17Wɛ laam wó ja debam balo na daare ye dé daa ta ŋwe to, se o pa dé la daane de banto kunkwonnu tem wone, se dé maama jeeri dé Teiru wom wɛyuu ne. Konto mo dé wó taa wora dé Teiru wom tei ne maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu.
18Ko na seene ko ye konto to, se á ta‑á mae chega kam konto á woli daane se á bochara taa tiga.

english_text:
1I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen. 2 You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night. 3People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
