4My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief. 5You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark. 6Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert. 7People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk. 8 But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
9God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ. 10Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes. 11This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing.
Final Instructions and Greetings
12My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord. 13Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other. 14My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone. 15Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
16Always be joyful 17and never stop praying. 18Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
19Don't turn away God's Spirit 20or ignore prophecies. 21Put everything to the test. Accept what is good 22and don't have anything to do with evil.
23I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns. 24The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
25Friends, please pray for us.
26Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
27In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
28I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_text:
Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom taane
1Dé nu-bia bam, ko daa wo maŋe se dé popone dé ta dé bere abam maŋa kalo wonnu tem konto na wó ke to. 2Abam tete maŋe á yei lanyerane we, dé Teiru wom dɛ dem wó pɔpɔ de ba, ne ŋweeno na yeini o pɔpɔ o ba tete ne tei to. 3Maŋa kalo nɔɔna na tɛ ba we, ko ye chemm mo, ye ywoni wora jei maama to, konto maŋa kam ne de cham wó pɔpɔ de ba ba baŋa, ye ba bá lu. Ko wó taa nye de kaane puga na pɔpɔ ka virigi ye ka wɔe tei to mo.
4Dé nu-bia bam, á nam maŋe á poore, ye á daa tere lim wone. Konto ŋwaane dé Teiru wom dɛ dem bá taa jege se de pɔpɔ de zaŋe de yi abam ne ŋweeno tei ye á yeiri ko ni ne. 5Abam maama wo Wɛ pwooni wone mo, ye á tɔge wea chwoŋa. Dé nam dae tete kokoro nɔɔna, ye dé kikia dae lim wone kikia. 6Konto ŋwaane dé yé pa se dɔɔm taa jege debam ne balo na yeiri Wɛ to. Pa-na dé fɔge dé che dé tete se dé yia waare. 7Tete ne mo nɔɔna yeini ba dɔa, ye ba kwori ba nyɔ sana ba buga. 8Debam nam ye wea nɔɔna mo. Ko maŋe se dé taa cho dé tete. Pa-na dé taa tɔge Yezu de wo-dedoa, ye dé pae da-swono. Konto wó che debam lwarem wone, ne nɔɔno na maa vei jara ye o kwei nantana o ma kwoli o nyɔɔne tei to. Pa-na dé taa jege teena lanyerane we, Wɛ wó jwoŋi debam o yage. Konto maa nye de jara yu-gwoŋo kolo nɔɔno na kwei o ma kwoli o yuu jara maŋa ne to. 9Wɛ na kuri debam se dé taa ye o nyem to, ko dae se o ban-zɔŋɔ kom ba ko chɔge debam mo. Ko nam ye se o jwoŋi debam o yage dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo. 10Wonto mo tege dé ŋwaane se dé wane dé tɔge ded‑o dé na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. O ná jwoori o ba, ye dé ná ŋwe, naa dé ná tega, ko ba chɔga. Dé wó tɔge ded‑o dé na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.
11Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á woli-na daane se ko pa á bochara taa tiga, se á fɔge á zeini daane ne á na maŋe á ke tei to.
12Dé nu-bia bam, dé nam lwoori abam se á ta‑á nege nɔɔna balo na toŋe á tetare ne to. Nɔɔna banto mo leiri dé Teiru wom yuu ne ba nii abam baŋa ne, ye ba korese abam. 13Á ta‑á zuli-ba lanyerane de swono ba totoŋ-ŋona yam ŋwaane. Pa se ywoni taa wora á wone.
14Dé nu-bia bam, dé kwoori abam se á ta‑á woli nɔɔna lanyerane.
Ko ná ye jawɔre-nyena, se á kaane-ba.
Ko ná ye balo na kɔre foone to,
se á pa ba na baare.
Ko ná ye nabwona, se á zeini-ba.
Ta‑á zuri-na á bochara de nɔɔna maama.
15Á ta‑á yei se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé ma wo-lɔŋɔ
o ma jwoori o ŋwe wo-lɔŋɔ o pa o dwoŋi.
Maŋa maama se á kwaane á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laao
de á nu-bia bam, ko woli de nɔɔna maama.
16Ta‑á jege-na wopwolo maŋa maama.
17Maŋa maama se á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ.
18Kolo maama ná kea, se á ta‑á ke Wɛ lei.
Mo Wɛ na lage se á ta‑á ke tei,
á na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane.
19Yé kwoli-na Wɛ Sin-laao kom.
20Sin-laao kom ná pɛ nɔɔno pworisi Wɛ kwora,
se á yé gwooni ka na ye tei to.
21Abam nam maŋe-na woŋo maama á nii.
Ko ná lana se á ta‑á tɔge-ko.
22Se á nam fɔge á che á tete de lwarem dwi maama.
23Baŋa Wɛ wom na pae nɔɔna bochare-zuru to wó taa jege abam de je selei, se á ta‑á jege wo-pwoŋo fase o yiga ne, se á ŋwea maama taa jege chega, ko ná ye á yera de á jworo de. Konto to, dé Teiru Yezu Krista ná tua, á bá ta‑á jege tusim Wɛ tei ne de fenfee de. 24Wɛ mo bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem. O nam zege o chega wone. O maa wó zeini abam ne o na tage tei to.
25Dé nu-bia bam, ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ á pa debam de.
26Jɔɔne-na dé nu-bia bam maama, ye á kukwori daane á zuli Wɛ.
27A nam tɛ abam dé Teiru wom dam ŋwaane se á ga tɔnɔ konto á bere dé nu-bia bam maama.
28Dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo á tei ne.

english_text:
1 From Paul, Silas, and Timothy.
To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
When Christ Returns
3My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time. 4This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
5All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering. 6It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble, 7but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels 8and with a flaming fire.
Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message. 9 Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength. 10This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
11God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do. 12Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl, dedaane Silas de Timoti mo popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa abam Tɛsaloni tiina balo na ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á tɔge á ye dé Kwo Baŋa Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu Krista nyem to.
2Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Lei keim dedaane wɛ-lworo
3Dé nu-bia bam, maŋa maama dé jege se dé ke Wɛ lei abam ŋwaane nenɛɛne ko na maŋe tei to, kokuri á na ke á wo-dedoa de Yezu tei to ke ko daŋe da-baŋa ne. Á maama tiini á swoi á dwonna lanyerane, ye á swono kom konto wora ko pula dedɛ. 4Á na ye konto dwoŋi to, dé yeini dé ta á taane dé bere Wɛ kɔgɔ kom na wo jeiga kalo maama ne to, ye dé jege teera abam ŋwaane. Dé tɛ-ba we, nɔɔna yeini ba bɛɛse abam ye á nae yaara dedɛ. Á nam ta zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa, ye á yɔɔre á tɔge Yezu de wo-dedoa.
5Abam na jege á tete konto dwoŋi to mo pae dé lɔre jaja we, Wɛ na wó di nɔɔna taane tei to wó yɔɔre ko tɔge chwoŋa chekke. Konto ŋwaane á wó na chega Wɛ yiga ne pa se á maŋe se á woli o paare dem wone, kokuri abam seene á nae yaara o paare dem konto ŋwaane. 6Wɛ nam zege o chega wone mo. O maa wó waare balo na jege abam ba yaare to pa se ba de jwoori ba na yaara. 7O ta maa wó woli abam balo na yaare to se á sii de á yaara yam, se ko woli de debam de. Wɛ wó ke konto maŋa kam o na lage o pa dé Teiru Yezu jwoori o ba se o veere o tete o pa nabiina to. Wonto wó nwoŋi Wɛ telaao de o malese dedɛɛra bam, 8ye min-vɔɛ zaŋe se kekare-ba. O maa wó waare balo na ve Wɛ to, ko woli de balo na wo sɛ omo kwor-ywoŋa kam to. 9Nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi wó na waarem, ne ko na maŋe de-ba tei to mo. Ba maa wó na lɛɛro se ko taa vei wuu. Ba ta maa wó pɔɔre ba yera dé Teiru wom tei ne, se ba daa yé na o paare dam-fɔrɔ kom. 10Konto maama wó ke maŋa kalo dé Teiru Yezu na wó jwoori o ba to. Dɛ dem konto ne o wó na zula o tete nɔɔna bam tei ne. Balo maama na sɛ‑o to wó taa seini‑o lanyerane. Abam nam wó ta‑á wo banto wone, á na sɛ Wɛ chega kalo dé na bere abam to ŋwaane.
11Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo dé yeini dé lwoori dé Tu Wɛ wom maŋa maama dé pa abam, se o pa á maŋe de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem ne o na twori abam se á ta‑á ye tei to. Dé lwoori‑o se o pa abam dam, se á wane á tɔge chwo-laao nenɛɛne á boboŋa na lage tei to maama, ye á ke totoŋa yalo maama á wo-dedoa kam na wae ka pa á ke to. 12Konto mo wó pa dé Teiru Yezu taa nae zula abam ŋwaane. Abam de maa wó na zula, á na me ded‑o to ŋwaane. Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista na ke abam zaane to mo wó pa konto maama ke.

english_text:
The Lord's Return
1 When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends, 2not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters. 3But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear. 4 He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God. 5Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
6You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come. 7His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way. 8 Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
9 When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs. 10Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it. 11So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie. 12All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth.
Be Faithful
13My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth. 14God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ. 15My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
16God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father 17will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_text:
Keim-lwanno tu taane
1Dé nu-bia bam, á yei we dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó jwoori o ba, ye Wɛ wó la debam o ke daane se dé taa wo Yezu tei ne. Dé nam lage dé kwoori abam 2se á yé pa á bochara taa di konto baŋa ne. Á yé zaŋe á pa á boboŋa vugimi de nɔɔna na tɛ ba we, dé Teiru Yezu dɛ dem maŋe de yi. Nɔɔna ná tɛ abam ba we, Wɛ Sin-laao kom pɛ-ba o kwora, naa ba ná we ko ye Wɛ chega mo ba bere abam, naa ba ná we ba jwoŋi tɔnɔ debam tei ne, 3se á yé pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno gane abam de wonnu tento dwoŋi. Kokuri, maŋa kalo nɔɔna dedɛ na wó ywori Wɛ kwaga ne to wó ke yiga ye dé Teiru wom dɛ-kamunu kom laam ba ko yi. Ko woli da, wolo wom na ye keim-lwanno tu to jege se o ba yiga. Wonto kweelim maama maa ye se Wɛ chɔge‑o. 4O wó pa se o tete taa dwoi wonnu telo maama nɔɔna na zuli to, de kolo maama ba na bwoi we, ba wɛ to. O ta wó kwori o done wonnu tem konto maama. O maa wó paale o zo o jeini Wɛ diga kam ne ye o bere o tete we, omo mo ye Wɛ. 5Amo ta na wo abam tei ne maŋa kalo to, a yeini a bere abam wonnu tento. Á nam wo guli-te na?
6Woŋo kodwoŋi ta wora ko na chege wonnu tento chwoŋa se te yé ke leile, ye á yei ko ni ne. Ko daare maŋa kam ná seene ka yi, keim-lwanno tu wom laam wó ba se nabiina lɔre‑o jaja. 7Keim-lwanno dam delo na seigi nɔɔna yia ne to maŋe de wora de chɔge nabiina. Ko nam ná ye wolo wom na wora o cho keim-lwanno tem chwoŋa leile se te yé tiini te ke to, konto tu wó taa wora se ko taa vei maŋa kam o na wó lage jeiga to. 8Maŋa kam konto ne mo keim-lwanno tu wom wó ba o taa wora pa se nabiina lɔre‑o jaja. Dé Teiru Yezu na wó jwoori o ba maŋa kalo to, o laam wó ma o ni-vio o wane wonto o di. Yezu na wó pɔpɔ o ba de nenɔŋa to mo wó pa se keim-lwanno tu wom yɔɔre o na chɔgem.
9Maŋa kam keim-lwanno tu wom na wó ba o taa wora to, o wó jwoŋi dam setaana pɛ wom tei ne se o ma ke wo-kenkagela de totoŋ-kamuna dwi dwi yalo na dae chega to. 10O ta maa wó ke keim-lwanno dwi maama o ma gane balo na lage ba ga ba ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to. Ko wó ke-ba konto, ba na ba sɛ se ba jwoŋi Wɛ chega kam de swono se ko pa o jwoŋi-ba to ŋwaane. 11Ba na lage ba ve Wɛ chega kam konto to, o laam wó pa se ba boboŋa daa yeiri chega, ye ba sɛ ba tɔge kolo na ye vwa to. 12Wɛ nam wó ke konto se balo maama na wo sɛ o chega kam ye ba daare ba swoi puseŋa kikia to mo to de ba bora.
Pu-dɛa taane
13Dé nu-bia bam, dé jege se dé ke Wɛ lei maŋa maama abam ŋwaane, á na ye balo dé Teiru wom na swoi to. Ko zege boboa ne mo Wɛ kuri abam se o jwoŋi abam o yage. O dɛ o Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane mo o pa á ji o tete nɔɔna, á na sɛ o chega kam de á wo-dedoa to ŋwaane. O tɔge tento baŋa ne mo o jwoŋi abam o yage. 14Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á ye konto to, o mɛ debam na tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere abam tei to mo se o pa á tɔge de dé Teiru Yezu Krista á na zula.
15Konto ŋwaane, dé nu-bia bam, fɔge-na á ja á boboŋa se á yé yage chega kalo dé na maŋe dé bere abam to, ko ná ye dé na maŋe dé wo abam tei ne ye dé ŋɔɔne kolo to, ko woli de dé na maŋe dé popone tɔnɔ kolo dé pa abam to de.
16-17Dé Teiru Yezu Krista, dedaane dé Kwo Wɛ wó zeini abam de boboŋ-dɛɛra se á ta‑á jege dam, se á wane á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laao de á kikia, de á ni taane maama. Wonto maŋe o jege debam swono ye o ke debam zaane, de o na pɛ dé jege baare delo na bá fɔge de ti to, dedaane teena yalo na ye chekke to.

english_text:
Pray for Us
1Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do. 2Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith. 3But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm. 4He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying. 5I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ.
Warnings against Laziness
6My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you. 7You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing, 8and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
9We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you. 10We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat. 11Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody. 12So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living. 13Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
14Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them. 15Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower.
Final Prayer
16I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
17I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
18I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_text:
Wɛ-lworo taane
1Dé nu-bia bam, ko ta daare fee se dé popone dé woli da. Ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ á pa debam, se dé Teiru wom kwor-ywoŋa kam jage ka yi jei maama, se nɔɔna daare ba sɛ-ka lanyerane, ne abam de na sɛ-ka tei to. 2Lwoori-na Wɛ se o jwoŋi debam nɔn-balwaaro jeŋa ne, kokuri ko dae nɔɔna bam maama mo sɛ Wɛ chega kam.
3Dé Teiru wom nam zege o chega wone de o na wó zeini debam tei to. Mo kokuri, o wó woli abam de dam, ye o che abam setaana pɛ dam wone. 4Á na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to mo dé jege abam chega we, á wora á tɔge dé na maŋe de bere abam kolo to, ye á ta wó ta‑á ke konto mo taa.
5Dé Teiru wom wó zeini abam, ye o pa á boboŋa tiini ya tɔge Wɛ swono kom, ye o daare o pa á zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa, ne Yezu Krista de na ye tei to.
Jawɔre-nyena taane
6Dé nu-bia bam, ko ná ye á nu-bu wolo maama na ye jawɔre-nyem ye o ba tɔge berem delo dé na pɛ abam to, se á lɔŋe konto tu. Ko ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista dam ŋwaane mo dé kaane abam konto. 7Abam nam yei lanyerane we, á jege se á ta‑á lwoni debam kikia na maŋe ya ye tei to mo. Dé déem na wo á tei ne to, dé ba jege jawɔrɔ. 8Dé wo jwoŋi dé ni-wodiu nɔɔn-nɔɔno tei ne zɛɛra ŋwaane. Dé nam tiini dé toŋe mo se ko chɛ dé yera wea de tete, se dé yé daane abam wolowolo wodiu ŋwaane. 9Ko nam dae we dé ya ba jege chwoŋa se dé daane abam konto. Dé déem nam lage se dé ke abam lanyerane se á wane á ta‑á lwoni dé kikia na ye tei to mo. 10Dé na wo abam tei ne to, dé yeini dé pa abam ni we, nɔɔno wolo ná ba lage totoŋa, konto tu ba jege chwoŋa se o jwoŋi o ni-wodiu nɔɔn-nɔɔno tei ne.
11Dé wora dé tɛ taane dem konto, kolo ŋwaane dé lɔre we abam badwonna ye jawɔre-nyena mo. Konto dwoŋi nɔɔna bam yeini ba ba toŋa, ye ba kare jei maama ba gigili ba dwonna yia. 12Dé nam tiini dé kwoori nɔɔna bam konto dé Teiru Yezu Krista dam ŋwaane, se ba taa toŋe chemm se ba wane ba nii ba tete baŋa ne de ba ni-wodiu.
13Dé nu-bia bam, abam tete nam yé yage totoŋ-laaro keim, ko ná maŋe ko chana ko pa abam tei to de.
14Abam wolo ná wora ye o wo sɛ debam na popone tɔnɔ konto wone dé bere kolo to, se á maane konto tu, se á wane á ja á tete ded‑o, se ko pa chaveera ja‑o. 15Á nam yé pa se o ji á dono. Ko nam maŋe se á kaane‑o, ne o ye á nu-bu mo tei.
16Dé Teiru wom mo ye bochare-zuru tu. O maa wó zeini abam se á ta‑á jege bochare-zuru maŋa maama wone, de kolo maama na ke abam to.
Dé Teiru wom taa wo á maama tei ne.
17Amo Pɔɔl mo jɔɔne abam. Amo tete laam mo popone konto de a jeŋa. A yeini a ke konto a twanno tem maama wone, se á lɔre we ko seene ko ye amo mo. A yeini a popone tento dwoŋi mo.
18Dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo abam maama tei ne.

english_text:
1From Paul.
God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
2 Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace!
Warning against False Teaching
3When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings. 4You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
5You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith. 6There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk. 7They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
8We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way. 9We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents. 10The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching 11of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me.
Being Thankful for God's Kindness
12I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me. 13 I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him. 14Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
15“Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all! 16But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life. 17I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
18Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier. 19You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences. 20Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl wolo na ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se a pa nmo Timoti. Baŋa Wɛ wolo na ye debam Vereno to, de Yezu Krista wolo debam na jege o teena to mo pɛ-ne chwoŋa se a taa ye o tontoŋeno. 2Nmo mo ye nenɛɛne amo bu chekke, dedaane n na sɛ Yezu Krista to.
Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa nmo zaane de yazura, ye o daare o duri nmo ŋwaŋa.
Vwa berena taane
3Maŋa kam amo déem na lage se a vo Makedonia to, a lwoori nmo se n maŋe Efesia ne. Nmo jege se n maŋe dáane mo, se n kaane nɔɔna badwonna ba na jege vwa ba bere nɔɔna to se ba yage ba bera yam. 4N jege se n ta-ba se ba yage ba boboŋa sensɔle selo na dae chega to, se ba daare ba yage ba kwoa kwoa yera natɔga kalo na ba jege kweelim jei to. Kolo ŋwaane wonnu tem konto pae se nɔɔna boboŋa ye kafɛ mo. Te nam ba woli nɔɔna se ba ke ba wo-dedoa dedaane Wɛ se ba taa tɔge‑o. 5N jege se n kaane-ba mo dedaane wonnu tem konto se ba yage-te, se ba taa jege swono kolo na ye chekke to. Swono kom konto nam tɔge bochare-ŋona mo, de boboŋ-laaro, de wo-dedoa keim chekke ŋwaane ko wora. 6Nɔɔna bam konto nam ywori wo-laaro tem konto wone mo, ye ba tusi ba tɔge taane delo na ba jege kuri to. 7Ba lage se ba taa ye Wɛ nia yam berena mo, ye ba nam ba ni ba tete ni taane kuri. Ba yeini ba seene ba yia mo ba ŋɔɔne wonnu tem, ye ba ta yeiri te kuri.
8Ko ná ye Wɛ nia yam, dé yei we ya lana ya pae nɔɔno wolo maama na tɔge-ya chekke to. 9Ta‑n yei we, Wɛ na pɛ o ni-kaana yam to, o wo pɛ ya zege nɔn-laaro ŋwaane. O nam pɛ-ya balo na yeini ba chɔge chullu to ŋwaane mo, dedaane zwabani-nyena ŋwaane. O ta pɛ-ya Wɛ-lwɛɛna, de wo-lwan-keira, de nɔn-chechɔgero, de balo na ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone to ŋwaane mo. O ta tage-ya balo de na go ba kwoa naa ba niina naa ba dwonna to ŋwaane mo, 10dedaane balo na bwoori to, de baara balo na mae ba dwonna ba jiri kaana to, dedaane balo na cho ba jaane nɔɔna de dam ba yeigi to, dedaane vwa-fɔra, de balo na du de Wɛ ye ko dae chega to ŋwaane. O nam tage o ni-kaana yam o pa balo na ke kolo maama ba chɔge berem delo na ye chekke 11ye de tɔge Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam na bere tei to mo. Kwor-ywoŋa kam konto nwoŋi Ywoni Tu Wɛ tei mo, ye wonto mo kwei-ka o ke amo jeŋa ne se a taa tɛa.
Wɛ zaane dem taane
12Dé Teiru Yezu Krista mo pɛ amo dam se a taa toŋa a pa‑o. A ke‑o lei dedaane o na boŋe we amo jege wo-dedoa, ye o le-ne o zege o totoŋa yam baŋa ne to. 13Faŋa to amo déem yeini a ŋɔɔne mo a chɔge Wɛ yere, ye a ta yaare o nɔɔna. A déem jege nankɔɔre mo ye Wɛ ta duri amo ŋwaŋa, kolo ŋwaane amo ya yeiri woŋo kolo a na jege a ke to, a na wo sɛ‑o to ŋwaane. 14Ko daare dé Teiru wom nam mo ke-ne zaane dedɛ ko ja gaale, ye o daare o pa se a taa jege wo-dedoa dedaane Yezu Krista, ye a swoi‑o.
15Taane dento ye chega ye de jege se nɔɔna yɔɔre ba sɛ-de mo:
“Yezu Krista tu logo baŋa
se o jwoŋi nɔn-chechɔgero mo
o daare o ke-ba Wɛ jeŋa ne.”
Amo nam mo ye nɔn-chechɔgɔ a dwoi nɔɔna maama. 16Wɛ nam ta ma duri amo ŋwaŋa se ko pore chwoŋa se Yezu Krista wane o tɔge-ka o bere nɔɔna o na zuri o yera de amo tei to. O tiini o zuri o yera de amo wolo na ye nɔn-chechɔgero tem yiga tu to. Ko maa ye maana ko pae nɔɔna balo na wó da amo kwaga ba ba ba sɛ‑o se ba daare ba na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.
17Baŋa Wɛ ye pɛ wolo paare na bá ti maŋa de maŋa to mo. O ye ŋwea tu, ye o yera ba nae de yia. O dwoŋi tera. Konto to, zula de paare taa wo o tei ne se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.
18Amo bu Timoti, a lage a ta de nmo se n ta‑n toŋe n pa Wɛ, ne ba déem na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora ba ta nmo taane tei to. Ko na ye konto to, se n kwaane n guli ba na tɔɔle tei to se n wane n ke n tete n ke daane, nenɛɛne n na lage n jaŋe jaŋa chekke tei to. 19Ta‑n tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa se n daare n ta‑n ke kolo maama n na yei we ko lamma to. Nɔɔna badwonna wora ye ba ba sɛ se ba taa tɔge kolo ba na yei we ko lamma to. Konto ma pa se ba daa ware ba da Wɛ chwoŋa. 20Humenaya de Alezanda mo tɔge ba wo nɔɔna bam konto wone. Amo maŋe a ke banto setaana pɛ jeŋa ne se o vaŋe ba zwɛ, se ko bere-ba we, ba daa yé ŋɔɔne ba twe Wɛ yere.

english_text:
How To Pray
1First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them. 2Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God. 3This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior. 4God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
5There is only one God,
and Christ Jesus
is the only one
who can bring us
to God.
Jesus was truly human,
and he gave himself
to rescue all of us.
6God showed us this
at the right time.
7 This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
8I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
9 I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls. 10Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others, 11and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention. 12They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do. 13 After all, Adam was created before Eve, 14 and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned. 15But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_text:
Wɛ nɔɔna na wó zuli‑o tei to
1Kolo amo na lage se a da yiga a ta mo tento. Á jege se á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ á pa nɔɔna maama. Lwoori-na Wɛ se o taa nii ba baŋa ne, se á daare á ta‑á ke‑o lei ko ŋwaane. 2Ta‑á ke-na konto dwoŋi á pae pwa, dedaane dedɛɛra maama na jege dam nɔɔna baŋa ne to, se ko pa dé taa zoore de ni-ywom de yazura, se dé na chwoŋa dé seene dé yia dé taa tɔge Wɛ. 3Wɛ-lworo kom konto dwoŋi mo lamma, ye ko pwoli Wɛ wo, wolo na ye dé Vereno to. 4Wonto mo lage se nɔɔna maama na verem, se ba kwori ba taa yei o chega kam. 5Wɛ dedoa yerane mo wora. Wolo de na fɔge nabiina de Wɛ daane to de ye dedoa yerane mo. Kotu nam mo ye nabiinu Yezu Krista. 6Wonto mo sɛ o te o ma ŋwe nɔɔna maama wɛleera jene. O tege maŋa kam na maŋe se o te to, se ko taa ye maana mo ko bere Wɛ zaane dem na ye tei to. 7Konto ŋwaane mo Wɛ pɛ se a ji o totoŋa nakwe, se a taa tɔɔle o kwora a bere nɔɔna. A ŋɔɔne chega mo se ko dae vwa. Wɛ seene o toŋe-ne mo se a taa tɛ o chega kam a bere dwi-gɛ tiina balo na maŋe ba ba tɔge‑o to.
8Abam ná lage á lwoori Wɛ mɛ maama, ko maŋe se baara mo zaŋe ba ware Wɛ, ne ko ná ye baara balo na wó wane ba zeiŋi je-ŋwe wɛɛne, ye ba ba jege ban-zɔŋɔ naa ni-kantɔgɔ to. 9Amo nam ta lage se kaana de ja ba tete de ba gwaaro vɔɔm, se ba taa kɔre chaveera ba zoore gwaaro telo na maŋe-ba to. Ba ba jege se ba tiini ba kwɛ ba yuni dedɛdɛ, naa se ba fɔge ba yera dedaane nenɔŋa wonnu. Ko ná ye sabu-seŋa wonnu, naa kandwa-nyenno, naa gwaaro telo sabia na damma to, ko wo maŋe se ba tiini ba kwaane ba taa fɔge ba tete konto dwoŋi. 10Kaana nam ná lage se ba taa lamma, ba jege se ba zo keim-laaro mo, nenɛɛne ko na maŋe de kaana balo na bere we banto tɔge Wɛ to. 11Kaana jege se ba taa jei chemm mo ba cheigi balo na bere-ba Wɛ chwoŋa to, se ba daare ba taa nege-ba. 12Amo ba sɛ se kaana taa bere baara, naa ba taa jege dam ba baŋa ne. Ba jege se ba taa jei chemm mo. 13Kokuri ŋwaane, Wɛ déem na ke nabiina to, o ke Adam mo yiga ye o laam daare o ke Awa. 14Ko woli da, ko déem dae Adam mo setaana pɛ wom gane, se ko déem ye kaane wom mo o gane pa se o chɔge Wɛ ni. 15Ko ná ye kaana, Wɛ pɛ se ba taa lore bia, ye konto mo wó pa se ba wane ba na verem. Ba ná sɛ ba yɔɔre ba tɔge Wɛ de wo-dedoa, de swono, de wo-pwoŋo, ye ba kwori ba jege ba tete, Wɛ wó jwoŋi-ba.

english_text:
Church Officials
1It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile. 2 That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach. 3They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
4Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful. 5If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
6They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil. 7Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil.
Church Officers
8Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money. 9And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith. 10They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
11Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
12Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home. 13Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus.
The Mystery of Our Religion
14I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions, 15so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
16Here is the great mystery of our religion:
Christ came as a human.
The Spirit proved
that he pleased God,
and he was seen by angels.
Christ was preached
to the nations.
People in this world
put their faith in him,
and he was taken up to glory.
translation_text:
Yezu kɔgɔ kom yiga tiina taane
1Taane dento seene de ye chega mo:
“Nɔɔno boboŋa ná jaane se o ji Yezu kɔgɔ kom yiga tu,
konto tu lage totoŋ-ŋom mo.”
2Konto ŋwaane, Yezu kɔgɔ kom yiga tu jege se o taa ye nɔn-ŋom mo nɔɔna maama tei ne. O nam jege se o taa jege kaane dedoa yerane mo. O ta jege se o taa ye nɔn-yero, de jawale-nyeno wolo na wae o tete o jaana to mo. O jege se o taa jeeri veira mo o sɔŋɔ ne lanyerane. O jege se o taa yei nɔɔna berem mo chekke. 3O nam ba jege se o taa ye sa-nyɔro, naa kantɔ-mageno, naa wolo na jege ban-lom to. Ko maŋe se o taa ye nɔn-cheno mo. O nam ba jege se o taa ye sabu-lageno. 4O jege se o taa wae o nii o sɔŋɔ tiina baŋa ne mo lanyerane, se o daare o pa o bia taa nege‑o dedɛ. 5Kokuri mo nɔɔno ná ware o nii o tete sɔŋɔ tiina baŋa ne, o nam wó ke tɛ mo o nii Wɛ kɔgɔ kom baŋa ne? 6Ko wo maŋe se o taa ye wolo na bobo se o tɔge Wɛ leile to. Ko ya ná ye konto, o wae o bobo se o bere o tete kamunim. Wɛ laam maa wó di o taane pa se o to, nenɛɛne setaana pɛ wom déem na bere o tete ye o to tei to. 7Yezu kɔgɔ kom yiga tu jege se o taa ye nɔn-ŋom mo nɔɔna maama tei ne, de balo na ba tɔge Wɛ to de tei ne. Ko ya ná dae konto, nɔɔna wó wane ba yaale o yuu pa se setaana pɛ ja‑o, nenɛɛne kalanchogo mo jaane‑o tei.
8Ko ye bedwe mo de Yezu kɔgɔ kom wolim tiina de. Ko maŋe se ba taa ye balo nɔɔna na nege to mo. Ko dae se ba taa jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ, naa se ba taa ye sa-nyɔra, naa nɔn-kwollu, naa kampin-nyena. 9Ba nam jege se ba ke boboŋe dedwe mo dedaane chega kalo Wɛ na le o bere debam to, se chaveera yé ja-ba. 10Nɔɔno ná lage se o ji Yezu kɔgɔ kom wolim tu, ba jege se ba da yiga ba maŋe‑o mo ba nii, ye o kolokolo ná tera, se ba laam pa o bobo o totoŋa.
11Ko maŋe se ba kaana de taa ye balo nɔɔna na nege to mo, se ba yé taa ye bebare-nyena. Ba jege se ba taa ye jawale-nyena mo, se nɔɔna taa jege ba chega wonnu maama baŋa ne.
12Yezu kɔgɔ kom wolim tu jege se o taa jege kaane dedoa yerane mo, se o daare o taa wae o nii o bia de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama baŋa ne lanyerane. 13Kokuri mo wolim tu wolo maama na toŋe o totoŋa lanyerane to wó na yere. Wonto wó na zula dedɛ nɔɔna tei ne, ye o daare o na baare de o na ke o wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista tei to.
14Amo boŋe se a ba nmo tei leile. Amo nam popone wonnu tento se a bere nmo se, 15a ná dáane fenfee, se n wane n lɔre nɔɔna balo na ye Wɛ sɔŋɔ tiina to na wó taa jege ba tete tei to. Banto mo ye Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna. Banto mo ye balo na fɔge ba nii Wɛ chega kam baŋa ne, nenɛɛne ywoa na woli diga se ka yé vi to mo. 16Ko seene ko ye chega mo we, Wɛ tɔgem ye wo-kamunu mo. Wɛ laam mo pɛ se dé lɔre wolo o na toŋe debam nabiina tei ne to:
Wonto mo jigi nabiinu.
Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma bere we o jege chega.
Wɛ malese ma na‑o.
Nɔɔna ma ja o kwora ba zo teene maama wo ba tɔɔle.
Nabiina ma sɛ‑o logo baŋa ne.
O laam ma di Wɛ telaao de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ.

english_text:
People Will Turn from Their Faith
1God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons. 2They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars 3will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth. 4Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything. 5What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat.
Paul's Advice to Timothy
6If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed. 7Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious. 8-9As the saying goes,
“Exercise is good
for your body,
but religion helps you
in every way.
It promises life
now and forever.”
These words are worthwhile and should not be forgotten. 10We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
11Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say. 12Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
13Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching. 14Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you. 15Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing. 16Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_text:
Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem taane
1-2Wɛ Sin-laao kom bere debam chekke we, maŋa wó ba ye nɔɔna badaara wó zaŋe ba ve berem delo debam na sɛ to. Pipiri-nyena balo na fɔ vwa to mo wó gane-ba, pa se ba yage berem chekke dem. Banto boboŋa mo chɔge pa se ba yeiri we ba na ke kolo to ba lamma. Ba wó pa se nɔɔna taa sɛ chichiri selo na fɔ vwa to ni mo, ye ba tɔge setaana bera yam na ye tei to. 3Nɔɔna bam konto mo yeini ba bere we, ko chula se nɔɔno di kaane. Wodiiru tedwonna de maa wora ye banto ta bere we, ko chula se nɔɔna taa di-te. Nmo nam yei we, Wɛ mo ke wodiiru tem konto se debam balo na tɔge‑o ye dé ba dé lɔre o chega kam to taa ke‑o lei te ŋwaane, se dé daare dé taa di-te. 4Kolo ŋwaane wonnu telo maama Wɛ na naane to lamma. Ko wo maŋe se dé taa chuli kolokolo dim. Dé ná jwoŋi woŋo kolo, ye dé ná ke Wɛ lei ko ŋwaane, dé ba jege se dé chuli ko dim. 5Wɛ ni taane dem dedaane debam wɛ-lworo kom mo pae se ko ba jege digiru Wɛ tei ne.
6Nmo jege se n ta wonnu tento mo n bere n nu-bia bam. N ná ke konto, ko wó pa se n ta‑n ye Yezu Krista tontoŋeno-ŋom. N ná yɔɔre n sɛ Wɛ chega kam de berem chekke delo n na maŋe n tɔge to mo, n bochare wó be lanyerane. 7Yé zaŋe n cheigi sensɔle selo na ba jege kuri ye se ba woli Wɛ chwoŋa to. Nam fɔge n che n tete se n ta‑n tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa chekke. 8Dé yei we, n ná waare n yera pa se ya damma, ko jege wolim fenfee. Ko daare, n ná tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa, konto mo tiini ko jege wolim wonnu maama baŋa ne. Kolo ŋwaane ko wó pa se n na wolim zem ŋwea kam baŋa ne, se n daare n na ŋwea kalo na lage ka ba to Wɛ tei ne. 9Taane dem konto ye chega ye de jege se nɔɔna yɔɔre ba sɛ-de mo. 10Konto ŋwaane mo pae se dé fe dé yera dé toŋe de dam, kolo ŋwaane Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ jege debam teena. Wonto mo ye nɔɔna maama Vereno, ko fɔge ko dae balo na sɛ‑o de wo-dedoa to.
11Ta‑n bere wonnu tem konto se n pa nɔɔna taa tɔge-te. 12Yé pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno gwooni‑m, n na ye nɔn-doŋo to ŋwaane. N jege se n ma n tete mo n bere Yezu nɔɔna bam ba na wó taa ke tei. Nmo ni-ŋɔŋa na ye tei to, de n totoŋ-naga, de n swono, de n na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to, de n boboŋ-dɛɛra de na ye tei to maama mo n jege se n ma n bere-ba. 13Amo ta ná wo tu, yɔɔre n ta‑n gare Wɛ tɔnɔ kom se nɔɔna taa cheiga, se n daare n bere-ba Wɛ chega kam se ba sɛ. 14Maŋa kalo nɔɔna déem na pworisi nmo ŋwaane, ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam de daŋe ba je nmo baŋa ne to, Wɛ mo pɛ‑m wolim se n ta‑n toŋe n pa‑o. Nmo nam ba jege se n dole n yage Wɛ pɛɛre dem konto. 15Ko maŋe se n seene n yia mo se n ta‑n ke wonnu tem konto de n wo maama. Konto mo wó pa se nɔɔna maama taa nae nmo na kɛ yiga tei to. 16Ta‑n yei n tete, se n daare n ta‑n yei n berem dem ni ne. Seene n yia se n ta‑n ke wonnu tem konto, se nmo wó jwoŋi n tete, ye n ta wó kwori n jwoŋi balo na cheigi‑m to de.

english_text:
How To Act toward Others
1Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother, 2and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
3Take care of any widow who is really in need. 4But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do. 5 A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
6A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
7Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing. 8People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
9For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least 60 years old, and she must have been faithful in marriage. 10She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
11Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ 12and become guilty of breaking their promise to him. 13Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
14I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us. 15Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
16If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need.
Church Leaders
17Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching. 18 It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
19 Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges. 20But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
21In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
22Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them.
Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
23Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
24Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later. 25It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_text:
Nɔɔna badwonna wolim taane
1Yé zaŋe n bwɛ Wɛ chwoŋa nɔn-kwea. N jege se n kwoori‑o mo, nenɛɛne o ye n kwo mo tei. Ko ná ye nɔn-donno, n jege se n ke-ba nenɛɛne ba ye n nyaana mo tei. 2Ko ta ná ye kazena, se n ta‑n ke-ba nenɛɛne ba ye n niina mo. Ko ná ye ka-donno, se n ke-ba nenɛɛne n nakɔa tei de n boboŋ-dɛɛra.
3Ko ná ye kadeina, ye ba ná seene ba ba jege nɔɔno se o taa nii ba baŋa ne, se n ta‑n zuli-ba. 4Ko daare kadeim ná jege bia naa naaro, banto mo jege se ba taa nii‑o, ba na ye o tete sɔŋɔ tiina to ŋwaane. Mo Wɛ chwoŋa berem dem na ye tei to. Kadeim bia ná woli‑o konto, ko wó pa se ba jwoori ba ŋwe ba tiina jene de ba na yaare ba ŋwaane to. Konto nam mo pwoli Wɛ wo. 5Kaane wolo nam ná seene o ye kadeim ye o ba jege nɔɔn-nɔɔno se o taa nii o baŋa ne, kotu daŋe o teena Wɛ baŋa ne mo. Tete de wea maama o tiini o ware Wɛ mo ye o lwoori wolim o tei ne. 6Ko daare kadeim wolo na lage ka jaŋa kikia yerane to maŋe o te mo ye o ŋwe. 7Nam pa se ba maama lɔre wonnu tento se ba taa ke, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o zaŋe o yaale ba yuu. 8Nɔɔno yiga ná tera de o chorro, ko fɔge ko dae o tete sɔŋɔ tiina, konto tu ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone mo. Wonto mo tiini o ye nɔn-balɔrɔ o dwoi balo na maŋe ba ba tɔge Wɛ to.
9Abam yé ga kadeim yere á woli kadeina yera yam wone, ko ná dae we wonto kɛ bena fuseredo. Wolo na maŋe se o woli da to jege se o baro zoorem taa ye bedwe yerane mo. 10Ko maŋe se nɔɔna taa yei o ni ne mo de totoŋ-laaro o na jege o ke to. O ná loge bia ye o nii ba baŋa ne, naa o ná jeeri veira o diga ne lanyerane, naa o ná gwooni o tete se o taa woli Yezu nɔɔna bam, naa o ná zeini balo na wo cham wone to, ye o ná yɔɔre o tɔge keim-laaro chwoŋa konto dwoŋi, abam wae á gare‑o á woli da. 11Ko daare kadeina balo na ye ka-bwona to, abam ba jege se á ga-ba á woli da. Kolo ŋwaane banto wo daa ná zaga se ba yé taa ye kadeina, ba wó ywori mo Yezu Krista tei ne ye ba lage se ba daa zo banna. 12Ba ná zaŋe ba ke konto, ba bá na bora, kolo ŋwaane ba chɔge ba na dɛ yiga ba du ba ni de Yezu Krista tei to mo. 13Ko nam ta woli da, kadeina balo na ye ka-bwona to yeini ba tɔge jawɔrɔ chwoŋa mo, ye ba swoi se ba taa tole ba vei sɔŋɔ de sɔŋɔ. Ko ma pa se ba ji bebare-nyena de ka-gɔɛ ba woli ba jawɔrɔ kom wone, ye ba ŋɔɔne wonnu telo na dae se ba ya ŋɔɔne to. 14Mo kokuri pa se amo boŋe we, ko wó ta lamma se kadeina balo na ye ka-bwona to taa zoore banna se ba lo bia se ba daare ba taa nii ba tete sam baŋa ne. Ba ná ke konto, ko wó pa se wolo na done debam to daa bá na chwoŋa se o twe debam. 15Kolo ŋwaane kadeina badaara maŋe ba ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone ye ba daare ba tɔge setaana pɛ wom.
16Kaane wolo ná tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa, ye kadeina ná wora o tete sɔŋɔ ne, konto tu mo jege se o taa nii ba baŋa ne mo. Ko dae se o yage-ba o pa Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna se ba taa nii ba baŋa ne. O ná yage-ba konto, ko wó daane Yezu nɔɔna bam mo, pa se ba daa bá wane ba nii kadeina balo na ba jege nɔɔn-nɔɔno to baŋa ne.
17Ko daare ko ná ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwa balo na ye yuu tiina ye ba nii Yezu nɔɔna baŋa ne lanyerane to maŋe se ba taa jwoŋi zula de ŋweero kuni belei belei mo, ko fɔge ko dae balo na seene ba yia ba bere Wɛ chega kam to. 18Kolo ŋwaane ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone mo we, “Nmo ná jege nabea n ma n toŋe n faao, yé vɔ ka ni se ka yé wane men-bia bam ka di.” Ko ta popone we, “Tontoŋeno maŋe se o taa jwoŋi o ŋweero mo.”
19Nɔɔno ná zaŋe o ŋɔɔne Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwe taane de nmo, se n yé sɛ, ko ná dae we nɔɔna balo yi na nɛ o keim-balwaaro tem to yi balei naa batɔ. 20Ko daare nakwa balo na seene ba ke keim-balwaaro to, se n bwɛ-ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kom yibia ne. Konto mo wó pa se foone ja badaara bam de.
21A nam lage a kaane‑m mo Wɛ yiga ne, de Yezu Krista yiga ne, de Wɛ tete malese sem yiga ne, se n yɔɔre n sɛ kolo a na tage to. Yé kuri nɔɔna daane de n na bere-ba ye n ke-ba tei to.
22Yé gare n zi n jea nɔɔn-nɔɔno baŋa ne se n pa o ji Wɛ tontoŋeno. Yé pa se nɔɔno keim-balwaaro tɔge te lɔgese‑m. Fɔge n ja n tete de boboŋ-dɛɛra ye tusim tera.
23A ya boŋe se a ta de nmo we, n wo kom na yeini ko wɔe maŋa maama to, ta‑n nyɔ sa-gwoo fenfee, se ko dae na yerane mo nmo wó ta‑n nyɔa.
24Nɔɔna badaara wo-balwaaro yɔɔre te nae mo jaja. Banto taane dem ná tua, nɔɔna maama maŋe ba yei ba wo-balwaaro tem ni ne. Ko daare babam wo-balwaaro nae kwaga yerane mo. 25Ko ta ye bedwe mo de keim-laaro, te de yɔɔre te nae mo ja. De konto de, telo na ba nae lanyerane to de maŋe te bá wane te seigi.

english_text:
1If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching. 2If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can.
False Teaching and True Wealth
These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do. 3Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ. 4Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions, 5and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth.
These people think religion is supposed to make you rich. 6And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have. 7We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave. 8So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes. 9People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them. 10The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain.
Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
11Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle. 12Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened. 13 Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith. 14Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
15 The glorious God
is the only Ruler,
the King of kings
and Lord of lords.
At the time that God
has already decided,
he will send Jesus Christ
back again.
16 Only God lives forever!
And he lives in light
that no one can come near.
No human has ever seen God
or ever can see him.
God will be honored,
and his power
will last forever. Amen.
17Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life. 18Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have. 19This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
20Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't. 21Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk.
I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_text:
Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem jege nyɔɔre
1Balo maama na ye kabɛ ye ba tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa to jege se ba taa pae ba yuu tiina mo zula dedɛ. Konto wó che se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé na chwoŋa se o ŋɔɔne o yaale Wɛ yere dem dedaane debam berem dem. 2Kabɛ selo na toŋe ba pae ba yuu tiina balo de na tɔge Wɛ to, ko wo maŋe se ba taa gwooni-ba de ba na ye nu-bia Wɛ chwoŋa wone to. Ba nam jege se ba tiini ba toŋe ba pa-ba se ko gaale, kolo ŋwaane ba yuu tiina balo ba na toŋe ba totoŋa to tɔge ba ye Yezu nɔɔna mo, ye Wɛ swo-ba. Nmo jege se n ta‑n bere nɔɔna wonnu tem konto maama mo se ba taa tɔge-te.
3Nɔɔno wolo maama ná wo sɛ se o tɔge debam Teiru Yezu Krista bera yam, dedaane Wɛ chwoŋa berem chekke dem, ye o nam ná bere wo-gaa, 4konto tu pae se o jege swa mo ye o nam yeiri kolokolo. Wonto dwoŋi tiini o lage se o taa mage ni-kantɔgɔ wonnu telo na ba jege kuri to baŋa ne mo. O na ke konto to mo pae se nɔɔno wo gweena de o dwoŋi. Ko ta maa pae se nɔɔna jaane daane, ye ba twe daane, ye ba ta boŋe lwarem ba pa daane, 5ye ba nia de ba maŋe daane. Ba yeini ba ke konto ba boboŋa na chɔge ye ba daa ba tɔge chega chwoŋa to ŋwaane. Konto maa pae se ba boŋe we, Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem ye kolo ba na wó tɔge ko baŋa ne ba na nyɔɔre ba pa ba tete to mo.
6Ko daare ko ye chega mo we, Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem jege nyɔɔre dedɛ ko pae balo na jege ba wonnu ye ba boŋe we tento mo maŋe to. 7Ba na loge debam to, dé wo jaane kolokolo dé ba logo baŋa. Dé nam ná lage dé yage logo baŋa, dé bá wane kolokolo dé ja dé viiri. 8Konto to, dé ná jege wodiiru se dé taa di, de gwaaro se dé taa zoora, dé wó pa se tento mo maŋe debam de dé wopwolo. 9Ko nam ná ye balo na boŋe se ba taa ye naduna to, sabu-laga yeini ko soge-ba mo, pa se ba to tega ne, nenɛɛne kalanchogo mo jaane-ba tei. Ba fera maa zoore wo-yɔɔro telo na wó yaare-ba to dedɛ. Konto keim dem mo yeini ko pae ba yuu yaala, ye ba yɔɔre ba na chɔgem. 10Kokuri to, nɔɔno boboŋa ná dɛ sabu-laga, wo-lwanno dwi maama wó ba da mo. Nɔɔna badaara wora ba na pɛ se ba yi zo sabu-laga, ye ba ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone pa se ba jege ba tete ba yaare dedɛ.
11Ko daare nmo Timoti na ye Wɛ tontoŋeno to, n jege se n ja n tete mo dedaane wonnu tem konto. Ke n tete n ke daane se n ta‑n jege boboŋ-dɛɛra, de Wɛ kɔrɔ, ye n jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ, de swono, de pu-dɛa, de ban-peno. 12Poore n yera se n ta‑n tɔge Wɛ chwo-laao, nenɛɛne n na kwaane n zo jaŋa wone se n di yiga tei to. Konto mo nmo wó jwoŋi ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to. Ŋwea kam konto mo Wɛ bwoŋi‑m se n ba n jwoŋi, de nmo déem na zaŋe n zege nɔn-kɔgɔ yiga ne n pa se ba lɔre we, n tɔge chega chwoŋa kam to. 13Yezu Krista de déem zege Pontusi Pilata yiga ne o pa se o lɔre we, omo tɔge chega chwoŋa kam. Amo nam lage a ta a bere nmo Yezu yibia ne, dedaane Wɛ wolo na pae wonnu maama ŋwea to yibia ne we, 14n jege se n yɔɔre n ta‑n tɔge chega kam konto, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o zaŋe o na nmo wo-lɔŋɔ, se ko taa nii dɛ dem debam Teiru Yezu Krista na wó jwoori o ba o veere o tete nabiina yiga ne to. 15Maŋa kalo na maŋe to ná yia, Lam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo yerane na tei nɔɔna maama to laam wó pa se Yezu Krista jwoori o ba konto. Wɛ mo ye pwa maama Pɛ de dedɛɛra maama Teiru, 16ye wonto yerane mo maŋe o jege ŋwea taa wuu. O nam zoore pwooni jeiga kalo na pepele yia to wone mo, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o twɛ da. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na nɛ o yibia yam kɔtaa, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam tera o yia na wó wane ya na‑o. Zula taa wo o tei ne, dedaane dam delo na ba jege tiim to. Ameena.
17Ko ná ye balo na ye naduna zem logo kom ne to, n jege se n kaane-ba se ba yé boŋe kamunim ba pa ba tete. Ba ba jege se ba kwei ba teena ba daŋe jejegero baŋa ne, kolo ŋwaane te nye de vio mo. Ba nam jege se ba kwei ba teena ba pa Wɛ, kolo ŋwaane o yeini o pa debam wonnu dedɛ se dé taa di ywoni te maama baŋa ne. 18Kaane-ba se ba taa ke wo-laaro dedɛ, se ba totoŋ-ŋona ji ba nadunni, se ba taa jege wo-ywoŋo ye ba pɔɔre ba wonnu tem ba zeini daane. 19Ba ná ke konto, ko wó bere we ba tiŋi wonnu mo ba pa ba tete, ye tento wó wane te woli-ba jwa seeni, te na jege kuri dedɛ te pa-ba to ŋwaane. Konto mo wó pa se ba na ŋwea kalo na ye chekke to Wɛ tei ne.
20Timoti, fɔge n ta‑n nii kolo maama Wɛ na kwei o ke nmo jeŋa ne to baŋa ne. Ja n tete dedaane wonnu telo nɔɔna na boŋe we te pae yi-poro ye te ba pae to. Tento mo ye lare-yɔɔro telo na ba woli Wɛ chwoŋa to, dedaane taana yalo na ba jege kuri to. 21Nɔɔna badaara wora ba na pae se ba jege yi-poro kom konto, ye ko laam pa se ba ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone. Konto to, fɔge n ja n tete de wonnu tem konto.
Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.

english_text:
1From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus.
God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
2 Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace!
Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
3Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience. 4I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy. 5 I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well. 6So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well. 7God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
8Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
9God saved us and chose us
to be his holy people.
We did nothing
to deserve this,
but God planned it
because he is so kind.
Even before time began
God planned for Christ Jesus
to show kindness to us.
10Now Christ Jesus has come
to offer us God's gift
of undeserved grace.
Christ our Savior defeated death
and brought us
the good news.
It shines like a light
and offers life
that never ends.
11 My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher. 12This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with. 13Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model. 14You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
15You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
16I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail. 17Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me. 18I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_text:
1Amo Pɔɔl wolo na ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se a pa nmo Timoti. Wɛ tete mo kuri-ne de o boboŋa se a taa ye o tontoŋeno, se ko pa nɔɔna na ŋwea o tei ne, ba na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. Mo Wɛ na pwooli se o ke kolo to. 2Nmo Timoti ye amo bu-swono.
Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa nmo zaane de yazura, ye o daare o duri nmo ŋwaŋa.
Lei keim
3Amo nam ke Wɛ lei. A maa toŋe a pa‑o nenɛɛne a nabaara bam déem na ke tei to, ye a bochare ba maga ko baŋa ne. A maa yeini a lwoori‑o maŋa maama wea de tete, ye a guli nmo gula a wɛ-lworo kom wone. 4Amo guli nmo na kane yi-na debam na pwɛ da-tei ne maŋa kalo to. Konto ŋwaane a tiini a lage se a jwoori a ba a na nmo, se a wane a di ywoni a su. 5Amo maane we n ke n wo-dedoa n sɛ Yezu. Nmo nu-nakwe Lowisi, de n nu Yunika de déem jege wo-dedoa de Yezu konto dwoŋi. Amo maa yei lanyerane we nmo de jega. 6Konto ŋwaane mo a lage a pa nmo guli a déem na daŋe a jea nmo baŋa ne ye Wɛ pa nmo wolim to. Nam fɔge n nii Wɛ pɛɛre dem konto baŋa ne, se n ta‑n ma n tiini n toŋe Wɛ totoŋa yam lanyerane. 7Kokuri, Wɛ na zeini debam de o Sin-laao kom tei to, ko dae se dé taa kɔre chaveera. Ko nam na zeini debam tei to pae se dé jege baare de swono dé bochara ne, ye dé ta wae dé tete dé jaana.
8Mo kokuri, yé ta‑n kɔre chaveera se n zege dé Teiru Yezu chega kam kwaga ne. Ta yé pa foone zo‑m de ba na ke amo peena diga ne Yezu chega kam ŋwaane to. Ko nam maŋe se n de sɛ yaara yalo na wó yi‑m Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam berem ŋwaane to mo. Wɛ wó pa‑m baare se n tɔge n yaare konto dwoŋi nenɛɛne amo tei. 9O nam maŋe o jwoŋi debam o pa se dé tɔge chwo-laao. O na zeini debam konto to, ko dae debam keim-laaro ŋwaane, se ko ye o tete boboŋa ŋwaane mo. Faŋa faŋa to, ko zege logo baŋa boboa ne, Wɛ déem maŋe o boŋe se o tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo o ke debam zaane. 10Wɛ laam ma pa se dé lɔre o boboŋa yam konto, dé Vereno Yezu Krista na tu logo baŋa o veere o tete to ŋwaane. Wonto mo chɔge toone dam. O ma daare o tɔge Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane o pa se dé yi poore, ye dé wae dé nae ŋwea kalo na bá ti Wɛ tei ne to.
11Wɛ nam mo tiŋi-ne se a taa ye o totoŋa nakwe se a taa tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere nɔɔna. 12Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo amo nɛ yaara yam konto. Amo nam bá taa kɔre chaveera. A ke a wo-dedoa de Yezu, ye a yei o wo lanyerane. Amo daŋe a teena wonto baŋa ne. A maa tiini a yei we o wae o nii amo na kwei kolo maama a ke o jeŋa ne to baŋa ne, se ko taa vei dɛ dem o na wó ba to.
13Nam fɔge n ta‑n tɔge chega chwoŋa kalo amo na maŋe a bere nmo to, se n kwori n ta‑n jege wo-dedoa de swono, ne Yezu Krista na woli debam tei to. 14Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo debam bochara ne. Tɔge wonto dam ŋwaane se n fɔge n nii chega kalo Wɛ na kwei o ke nmo jeŋa ne to baŋa ne, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé chɔge-ka.
15Nmo maŋe n yei we, Wɛ nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Asia jei sem ne to mo jwoori amo kwaga ne, ko woli de Figela, de Hɛmɔgena. 16Onesifɔrɔ nam mo yeini o pa a na ywoni a bochare ne. Wɛ wó duri o ŋwaŋa, de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama. Ba na ke amo peena diga ne to, o wo kɔre chaveera se o taa woli-ne. 17O na tu o yi Rom maŋa kalo to, o déem beeri amo jei mo taa, ye o laam ba o na amo. 18Wɛ wó pa o na chega dé Teiru Yezu dɛ dem ne. Nmo ta maŋe n yei lanyerane Onɛsifɔrɔ na tiini o woli-ne Efesia ne tei to.

english_text:
A Good Soldier of Christ Jesus
1Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace. 2You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
3As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering. 4Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer. 5No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules. 6And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field. 7If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
8Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says. 9And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail, 10and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus. 11Here is a true message:
“If we died with Christ,
we will live with him.
12 If we don't give up,
we will rule with him.
If we deny
that we know him,
he will deny
that he knows us.
13If we are not faithful,
he will still be faithful.
Christ cannot deny
who he is.”
An Approved Worker
14Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them. 15Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
16Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God. 17That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way 18by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
19But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
20In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not. 21This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
22Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure. 23Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble, 24and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
25Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth. 26They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_text:
Timoti maŋe se o taa tɔge Wɛ de baare
1Amo bu Timoti, ta‑n zege de dam, se Yezu Krista wó zeini‑m de o zaane dem, nmo na me ded‑o to ŋwaane. 2Chega kalo maama amo déem na yeini a bere nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama yiga ne ye n yei-ka to, ma-ka n bere nɔɔna badwonna balo na ye jawale-nyena to, se ba de daa wane ba maa bere nɔɔna badwonna.
3Nmo na tiini n toŋe n pa Yezu Krista tei to, ta ta‑n toŋa se ko chɛ n yera ne, nenɛɛne soja tu na nae cham tei to mo. 4Nɔɔno ná ye soja tu, ye o ná zo jara wo, wonto wó kwaane o ke kolo na wó su o dedɛɛro wom yi to mo. O nam bá sɛ se o toŋe ne nɔn-kafɛ tei. 5Ko ta nye de nɔɔno na kwaane o duri o di yiga tei to mo. Wonto ná dia, ye o wo dɛ durim dem chwoŋa chekke, ba bá sɛ ba pa‑o yiga tu pɛɛre dem. 6Ko ta woli da, nɔɔno ná ye valo, ye o ná tiini o toŋa, ko maŋe se wonto mo da yiga o jwoŋi o teiri wodiiru tem wone. 7Boŋe n nii amo na tɛ se n che n tete tei to. Dé Teiru Yezu wó pa n lɔre amo taane dem kuri n ti.
8Ta‑n boŋe Yezu Krista boboŋa. Wonto mo bi toone wone. O déem mo ye Pɛ David dwi tu. Kwor-ywoŋa kalo a na yeini a tɔɔle to bere kam konto. 9Amo na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam konto to mo tei a wo yaara wone, ye ba vɔ-ne de chaponno ne a ye ŋweeno mo tei. Ba nam bá wane ba che Wɛ kwora kam se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé lɔre-ka. 10Konto ŋwaane mo a sɛ se a taa nae cham wonnu maama baŋa ne, se ko wane ko woli nɔɔna balo Wɛ na kuri se ba taa ye o nyem to. Ko maa wó pa se Wɛ tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo o ma jwoŋi banto de, se ba daare ba na ŋwea o tei ne, de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ na bá ti to.
11Taane dento seene de ye chega mo:
Dé ná tɔge de Yezu dé te,
dé wó na ŋwea o tei ne.
12Dé ná fɔge dé zege lanyerane cham wone,
dé wó da dé di paare o tei ne.
Dé nam ná ve‑o,
o de wó ve debam mo.
13Dé ná maŋe dé ba jege o chega,
wonto ta wó zege o chega wone mo,
kolo ŋwaane o ware se o jwoori o tete kwaga ne.
Dé kikia na wó su Wɛ yi tei to
14Ta‑n guli amo berem dem konto n bere Yezu nɔɔna bam, se n daare n ma Wɛ n kaane-ba lanyerane se ba yé taa mage ni-kantɔgɔ botare baŋa ne. Kantɔgɔ konto dwoŋi ba jege kuri, ye ko pae se balo na jei ba cheigi-ko to boboŋa chɔge Wɛ chega kam tɔgem seeni. 15Kwaane n ta‑n tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane se ko su Wɛ yi, se chaveera yé ja‑m o yiga ne. Ta‑n toŋe de jawala de n na wó kwaane n ta‑n bere nɔɔna Wɛ chega kam tei to.
16Ja n tete de lare-yɔɔro telo na dae Wɛ chega kam to. Balo na lare konto dwoŋi to pae se nɔɔna jwoori ba maŋe kwaga kwaga mo Wɛ tei ne. 17Ba na kare ba bere wo-yɔɔro tem konto to, te lɔgese te jage jei maama, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na jege ŋɔne ye de woori de di o yera tei to mo. Humenaya de Fileta mo yeini ba bere wo-yɔɔro tem konto dwoŋi. 18Ba tusi chega chwoŋa kam wone mo. Ba maa tɛ ba we, Wɛ daa bá bi nɔɔna toone wone, se twa biim maŋe ko kɛ. Ba berem dem konto ma pa se balo na sɛ Wɛ to badwonna boboŋa jwoori ya leiri. 19Ko daare balo na yɔɔre ba tɔge Wɛ chega kam to boboŋa ba zae. Ba maa nye de kabiri-beira kalo Wɛ na fɔge o chwi to. Ka maa ba gɔe kɔtaa, ye Wɛ taane mo popone ka yera ne we:
“Dé Teiru wom yei balo na ye o nyem to.”
Ko ta popone we:
“Wolo maama na sɛ we o ye dé Teiru wom nyem to
jege se o yage keim-lwanno mo.”
20Ko nye de sɔ-fɔrɔ wone kabeili de zwe dwi dwi na wora tei to. Sedwonna ye lu-nyenno naa sabu-seŋa mo ba mɛ ba ke. Sento ye lonne nyem mo. Sedwonna maa ye dɛ naa dɔgɔ mo ba mɛ ba ke, ye ba mae sento yɔɔ yerane. 21Ko bere we, nɔɔno ná chege o tete de wo-yɔɔro tem konto, kotu wó taa ye lonne nyem mo. O maa ye wolo na kwei o tete o ke o tu wom jeŋa ne pa se o jege kuri o pa‑o to mo. O maŋe se o taa toŋe totoŋ-laaro telo maama o tu wom na lage to. 22Ko na ye konto to, se n yage keim-yɔɔro telo nɔn-donno boboŋa na yeini ya zoore to, se n daare n kwaane n tɔge chega chwoŋa, de wo-dedoa, de swono, de bochare-zuru. Ta‑n vei de balo bochara na lana ye ba ke ba tete dé Teiru wom jeŋa ne to.
23Ko ta woli da, fɔge n che n tete de ni-kantɔgɔ kolo maama na ba jege kuri ye swa tere ko wone to. Nmo yei we ko yeini ko kweeli jara ne mo. 24Nɔɔno wolo na ye dé Teiru wom tontoŋeno to nam ba jege se o taa mage ni-kantɔgɔ. Ko nam maŋe se o taa nege nɔɔna maama lanyerane, se o daare o bere-ba chekke de ban-peno. 25Ko ta maŋe se o zuri o yera o pa se balo na dwoni ded-o to jwoori ba tɔge chwoŋa. Dɛ delo Wɛ wó pa-ba chwoŋa se ba leiri ba boboŋa, ye ba daare ba ba ba lɔre o chega kam. 26Konto to, ba swa wó jwoori pa se ba wane ba lu setaana pɛ jeŋa ne. Wonto ya jaane-ba ne kalanchogo tei, ye o pa ba ke o boboŋa na lage tei to.

english_text:
What People Will Be Like in the Last Days
1You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times. 2People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless, 3heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good. 4They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure. 5Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
6Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires. 7These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth. 8 Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real. 9But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out.
Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
10Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with 11 trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles. 12In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others. 13But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
14Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things. 15Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved. 16Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live. 17The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_text:
Logo baŋa kweelim da yam taane
1Ta‑n yei we lɛɛro dedɛ wó taa wora maŋa de maŋa logo baŋa kweelim da yam ne. 2Kanto maŋa kam ne, nɔɔna wó taa wora ba na lage ba yerane wonnu, ye ba yi zo sabu-laga. Kachaare-nyena wó taa wora balo na bere ba tete to. Nɔɔna wó taa twe daane, ye ba ve ba tiina bam ni. Badwonna wó taa ye banegero nyena, de Wɛ-lwɛɛna. 3Nɔɔna bá taa jege ba dwonna swono, naa ba ŋwaŋa. Ba wó taa ye vwa-nyena. Badwonna maa wó taa ye nankɔ-nyena ye ba ware ba tete ba jaana. Ba wó taa chuli wonnu telo na lamma to. 4Nɔɔna wó taa wora ba na ye bebare-nyena, ye ba gare ba ke wo-lwanno. Ba wó taa mage ba nyɔɔna ye ba bere ba tete kamunim. Nɔɔna wó taa swoi ba tete ywoni ko dwoi Wɛ swono. 5Nɔɔna bam konto bere ba tete we ba tɔge Wɛ chega kam, ye Wɛ dam nam tera ba tei ne. Nam lɔŋe nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi.
6Nɔɔna bam konto badwonna yeini ba ke swa ba vei ba zoore sam ba gane kaana balo na ye ka-kayɛ to pa ba boboŋa chɔge. Kaana bam konto wo chɔge de ba keim-balwaaro dedɛ, ye ba boboŋa pae se ba tɔge woŋo kolo maama ba fera na zoore to. 7Maŋa maama kaana bam konto maa boŋa se ba na yi-poro, ye ba nam ware se ba lɔre Wɛ chega kam ba ti. 8Nɔɔna bam konto na ke tei to nye de Janese de Jambere déem na ve Moses ni faŋa faŋa tei to mo. Ba de ve Wɛ chega kam mo. Ba boboŋa jei mo, ye ba na tɔge Wɛ tei to ye kafɛ. 9Ba nam daa bá wane ba kɛ yiga de ba gana yam. Ba na ye nɔn-jworru tei to wó ba ko lɔre ja nɔɔna maama yiga ne, nenɛɛne ko déem na ke Janese de Jambere tei to.
Wɛ chega kam jege wolim lanyerane
10Ko nam ná ye nmo Timoti, n maŋe n yei amo berem dem na ye tei to, de a totoŋ-naga, de a boboŋa na ye tei to de. Nmo nam ta yei amo na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to, ye n ta yei a na jege ban-peno, de swono, de pu-dɛa tei to. 11Nmo ta yei nɔɔna na zeili-ne ye a yaare tei to. Nmo yei wonnu telo maama na ke amo Antioka ne, de Ikonium ne, de Lustera ne, ne ba na zeili-ne ye a ta wo yage Wɛ chega kam tei to. Dé Teiru wom nam mo jwoŋi-ne yaara yam konto maama wone. 12Ko ye chega mo we, balo maama na boŋe se ba seene ba yia ba taa tɔge Wɛ chega kam Yezu Krista ŋwaane to wó na yaara nɔɔna tei ne. 13Ko daare ko ná ye nɔn-balwaaro de kampin-nyena, banto keim-lwanno tem wó tiini te puli te gaale. Ba wó taa gane nɔɔna, ye nɔɔna wó taa gane ba de.
14Ko nam ná ye nmo, se n yɔɔre n ta‑n tɔge chega kalo nmo na maŋe n lɔre ye n jwoŋi-ka n ke n boboŋa ne to, kolo ŋwaane balo déem na bere‑m wonnu tem konto to, n yei ba wo lanyerane mo. 15Nmo na maŋe n ye bu-balaŋa wɛɛne to, nmo yei Wɛ chega twanno tem na bere kolo to. Te berem dem konto wae de pae se n yi poora, se Wɛ jwoŋi‑m o yage, nmo na sɛ Yezu Krista de wo-dedoa to ŋwaane. 16Kolo maama na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone to, ko ye Wɛ kikia mo ye ko jege nyɔɔre ko pa debam. Ko wae ko bere debam chega, naa ko kaane debam, naa ko pae dé na koresem, naa ko pae dé wae dé zamese chega tɔgem. 17Konto to, debam balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna to mo yɔɔre dé maŋe se dé taa toŋe totoŋ-laaro dwi maama.

english_text:
1When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you 2to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient. 3The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear. 4They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories. 5But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
6Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar. 7I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful. 8So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power.
Personal Instructions
9Come to see me as soon as you can. 10 Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia. 11 Only Luke has stayed with me.
Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you. 12 I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
13 When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
14 Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done. 15Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
16When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them. 17But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions. 18 The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen.
Final Greetings
19 Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
20 Erastus stayed at Corinth.
Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
21Do your best to come before winter.
Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
22I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_text:
Timoti na wó taa bere Wɛ chega kam tei to
1Timoti, a lage a ta nmo Baŋa Wɛ de Yezu Krista yiga ne, se n seene n yia n ta‑n toŋa n pa Wɛ. Yezu mo ye wolo na wó ba o di nɔɔna maama taane, nɔn-ŋwena dedaane twa maama de. O maa wó jwoori o ba o veere o tete nabiina yiga ne ye o daare o di paare o nɔɔna baŋa ne. 2Mo kokuri n jege se n ta‑n tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam. Fɔge n ta‑n ke konto, ne nɔɔna ná sɛa, naa ba ná ba sɛa de. Nam bwɛ-ba n pa ba lɔre ba na tusi tei to, se ba daare ba jwoori ba tɔge chwoŋa. Kwoori nɔɔna se ba taa jege pu-dɛa, se n bere-ba lanyerane de ban-peno. 3Kokuri, maŋa wó ba ye nɔɔna daa bá sɛ ba taa cheigi berem delo na ye chekke to. Ba laam wó daare ba taa tɔge ba tete boboŋa na lage tei to mo, ye ba pa se berem tiina dedɛ taa wo ba tei ne ba bere-ba wonnu telo maama ba na lage se ba ni to. 4Ba laam wó se ba zwa se ba yé taa cheigi Wɛ chega kam, ye ba daare ba sɛ nabiina sensɔle selo na ba jege kuri to. 5Ko daare nmo nam jege se n ja n tete mo de wonnu maama. Vɔ n wo yaara wone. Kwaane n ta‑n toŋa se n pa nɔɔna lɔre Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Totoŋe delo maama Wɛ na ke nmo jeŋa ne to, se n toŋe-de n ti maama.
6Ko nam ná ye amo, a ŋwea lage ka ti mo, ne ba na pwori wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre ba yage tega ne tei to. Maŋa kam yia se amo yage logo baŋa se a vo Wɛ tei. 7Amo na jege a ŋwea tei to nye de a yɔɔre a wo jaŋa wone mo chwori. Amo kwaane mo a peene a tete a duri taa, se a vo a yi de kweelim jei. Amo daa ta sɛ Wɛ chega kam, a wo yage. 8Konto to, amo pɛɛre dem laam tigi Wɛ tei ne de cheigi-ne, amo na jege chega o tei ne to ŋwaane. Dé Teiru Yezu mo ye wolo na yɔɔre o tɔge chega o di nabiina taane chekke to. O dɛ-kamunu kom ná yia, o wó kwei a pɛɛre dem konto o pa-ne. Ko nam dae amo yerane mo o wó pa pɛɛre dem konto. O nam wó pa balo maama de na swoi‑o ye ba jege teena we, o wó jwoori o ba o veere o tete to mo.
9Nam kwaane se n ba amo tei lela. 10Demas zaŋe o jwoori amo kwaga ne mo, ye o daare o kɛ Tɛsaloni, o boboŋa na tiini ya zo logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem to ŋwaane. Kerɛseka ma kɛ Galatia. Titusi de ma kɛ Dalmatia. 11Luka yerane mo wo a tei ne. Nmo nam ná ma‑n beena, se n pa Maake tɔge o ba, kolo ŋwaane wonto wae o woli-ne de Wɛ totoŋa yam. 12Kokuri amo toŋe Tichika Efesia ne, ye o daa tere amo tei ne. 13Nmo ná ma‑n beena, se n ja amo gɔrɔ kom a na yage Torase ne Kapusi tei ne to n ja n ba n pa-ne, dedaane twanno tem de. A tiini a lage tɔn-lilirru tem se a ga.
14Alezanda wolo na ye luru to tiini o ke lwarem mo o pa-ne. Dé Teiru wom nam wó waare‑o de o kikia yam konto. 15Nam ja n tete ded‑o, kolo ŋwaane o kwaane se o chɔge debam na yeini dé bere chega kalo to mo.
16Bobo ye a zege a tole a taane dem se a jwoŋi a tete to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo tu o zege amo kwaga ne. Ba maama duri ba yage amo yerane mo. Wɛ nam bere o yé taa jege taane de-ba konto ŋwaane. 17Dé Teiru wom nam zege amo kwaga ne, ye o pa-ne dam se a kwaane a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora se dwi-gɛ tiina maama cheigi-ka. Konto to, Wɛ nam mo jwoŋi amo toone jeŋa ne o yage. 18Dé Teiru wom nam wó jwoŋi-ne wo-lwanno maama wone o yage, ye o daare o ja-ne o vo o zo o telaao paare dem wone de yazura. Wonto maŋe de zula se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.
19Jɔɔne Pirisila de Akwila n pa-ne, dedaane Onesifɔrɔ sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama. 20Erasitu laam maŋe Korinti ne mo. Ko daare amo yage Torofima Militus ne, o na ba jege yazura to ŋwaane.
21Kwaane se n ke lela n ba ye yadɛ ta wo yi. Yubulu, de Pudɛnza, de Linusi, de Kaludia, ko ta woli de dé nu-bia bam maama jɔɔne‑m lanyerane.
22Dé Teiru wom wó taa wo nmo bochare ne.
Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.

english_text:
1From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ.
