ye de laam jwoori de ba de ji kandwɛ delo na pae diga kam dana to mo.”
8Ko woli da, balo na ve‑o to tei ne,
“O daa ta maa nye de pelɔrɔ kolo na cheili
pa nɔɔna gare-ko ba chɔɔle ba to tega ne to.”
Ko ye ba na wo sɛ Wɛ kwora kam to ŋwaane mo ba chɔɔle ba to. Ko maa jege se ko ke-ba konto mo.
9Ko daare ko ná ye abam,
Wɛ mo kuri á dwi dem se á ta‑á ye á yera.
O maa pae á ye o kaanem tiina
balo na toŋe o paare yerane ŋwaane to.
Á maa kwori á ye o tete kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna
balo o na le se á ta‑á ye o nyem to.
Wɛ tiŋi abam konto se á pa nɔɔna lɔre o na tiini o maŋe de zula tei to, de o na le abam lim wone ye o daare o pa á na jeiŋa jei o tete nenɔŋa pwooni dem wone to. 10Abam déem ya ye nɔɔna mo yɔɔ yerane, ye á laam ba á ji Wɛ tete nɔɔna. Abam déem ya dae balo Wɛ na jege á ŋwaŋa to, ye o laam ba o duri á ŋwaŋa.
11A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, abam na ye veira logo baŋa ne ye á ba jege kugu jei to, a lwoori abam se á ja á tete de á fera na zoore logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna yalo to. Tento mo kwaane se te chɔge á ŋwea de Wɛ. 12Abam na jege á tete tei to, se á pa á kikia taa lana balo na dae Wɛ nɔɔna to yiga ne. Konto mo, ba ná yaale abam ba we, á ye wo-lwan-keira, ba laam wó ba ba lɔre á keim-laaro na ye tei to mo, ye ba daare ba pa Wɛ zula maŋa kalo o na lage o ba o nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne to.
Dé wó sɛ dé pa dedɛɛra
13Ko ná ye nabiina balo maama na di dam ba dwonna baŋa ne to, se á ta‑á sɛ á pa-ba, á na tɔge dé Teiru wom to ŋwaane. Ko ná ye Pa-faro wolo na tei teo kom maama to, 14de o dedɛɛra balo o na pɛ-ba dam to, se á ta‑á nege ba maama. O tiŋi banto se ba taa waare balo kikia na ba lana to mo, se ba daare ba taa tei balo kikia na lana to. 15Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to mo ye se á pa á kikia taa lana, se ko wane ko pa nɔn-jworru pu ba nia de ba ta-yɔɔro telo ba na ŋɔɔne abam baŋa ne to.
16Abam ye balo na tei á tete to mo. Pa-na á ŋwea taa ye konto dwoŋi, se á nam yé tɔge konto ŋwaane á boŋe we, á jege chwoŋa se á ke keim-balwaaro. Pa-na se á kikia taa lana, á na ye Wɛ kabɛ to ŋwaane.
17Á ta‑á pae nɔɔna maama zula.
Á ta‑á swoi á nu-bia bam.
Ta‑á kɔre-na Wɛ.
Ta‑á zuli-na Pa-faro wom.
18Abam balo na ye tontoŋena to jege se á ta‑á sɛ á pa á yuu tiina, ye á tiini á nege-ba lanyerane. Ba ná jege á ŋwaŋa ye ba ke abam lanyerane, naa ba ná chana de abam, se á ta sɛ á pa-ba. 19Kokuri nɔɔno ná sɛ se o tɔge Wɛ boboŋa, ye o vɔ o wo de waarem delo o na nɛ kafɛ ŋwaane to, Wɛ yi wó su kotu keim dem konto. 20Abam nam ná ke á tusi, ye ko pa ba vaŋe á zwɛ lanyerane, á ná vɔge á wo de yaara yam konto, ko jege taane na? Á nam ná nɛ yaara á keim-laaro baŋa ne, ye á vɔ á wo, Wɛ yi wó su á keim dem konto. 21Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ba á ji o nyem to, ko ye se á vɔ á wo de yaara mo. Yezu Krista tete déem maŋe o yaare abam ŋwaane se ko pa á ta‑á tɔge o nɛ-bwora mo de cham delo dwi maama o na nɛ to.
22Wonto nam bere o wo ke kolokolo o tusi,
ye o ni taane ba jege ganem.
23Nɔɔna déem maa jege‑o ba twea,
ye o wo tɔge o twe-ba.
Ba ma kwori ba bɛɛse‑o,
ye o wo jwoori o chiŋi-ba.
O nam ke o tete mo Wɛ jeŋa ne, wonto na ye wolo na tɔge chega o ma di nɔɔna bora to ŋwaane. 24Yezu Krista na tege dagara kam yuu ne to, o ma pa se debam wɛleera daŋe o yuu ne, ye o ŋwe ya jene debam ŋwaane. O ke konto se ko pa dé wɛleera daa yé taa wae debam, nenɛɛne dé tege mo ya tei ne, se dé ŋwea daare ka taa tɔge chega Wɛ yiga ne. Yezu yera yam na nɛ zonne tei to mo pɛ se abam yɔɔre á na fɔgem. 25Abam ya nye de pei selo na beeri se jei to mo. Á laam ma pipiri se á jwoori á ke á tete Yezu jeŋa ne. Wonto mo nye de abam nayero ye o nii á baŋa ne.

english_text:
Wives and Husbands
1 If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him, 2because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life. 3 Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful. 4Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
5Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first. 6For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
7 If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers.
Suffering for Doing Right
8Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble. 9Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
10 “Do you really love life?
Do you want to be happy?
Then stop saying cruel things
and quit telling lies.
11Give up your evil ways
and do right,
as you find and follow
the road to peace.
12The Lord watches over
everyone who obeys him,
and he listens
to their prayers.
But he opposes everyone
who does evil.”
13Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds? 14 Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do. 15Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life.
Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope. 16Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ. 17You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
18Christ died once for our sins.
An innocent person died
for those who are guilty.
Christ did this
to bring you to God,
when his body
was put to death
and his spirit
was made alive.
19Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison. 20 They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
21Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death. 22Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_text:
Kaana de ba banna taane
1Ko ná ye abam balo na ye kaana to, abam de jege se á sɛ á pa á banna konto dwoŋi mo. Ko maa wó pa se á banna bam badaara ya ná ve Wɛ taane dem, se ba laam maane á nɛ-bwora na ye tei, ye ba pipiri ba ba ba sɛ Wɛ, de á ná maŋe á wo puri á ni de. 2Ba maa wó lɔre á na kɔre Wɛ, ye á seene á tɔge chwoŋa de boboŋ-dɛɛra. 3Abam na wó ke tei se ko pa á ta‑á jege lam to, ko dae se á ta‑á fɔge á yera dedaane nenɔŋa wonnu, ne ko ná ye á na kwɛ á yuni tei, de á na ke sabu-seŋa wonnu á yera ne, de á na wó taa zoore gare-laaro tei to. 4Á nam na wó fɔge á tete tei to jege se ko tɔge á bochara na ye tei ye ya seigi nɔɔna yiga ne to. Ko maŋe se á ta‑á nege nɔɔna mo lanyerane de bochare-zuru. Á ná fɔge á kwɛ á bochara se ya taa lana konto dwoŋi, ya lam dem daa bá chɔge, ye ko wó taa jege kuri lanyerane Wɛ tei ne. 5Kokuri, faŋa faŋa kaana balo na ye Wɛ nyem ye ba ke ba teena ded‑o to déem fɔge ba tete konto dwoŋi, de ba na sɛ ba pa ba banna to. 6Sara déem ye konto dwoŋi mo, ye o sɛ o baro Abaraham ni, de o na bwoŋi‑o we o yuu tu to. Abam de nam ye wonto bia mo, ne á ná ke keim-laaro ye á wo pɛ foone zo abam de kolokolo.
7Abam balo de na ye kan-banna to maŋe se á ta‑á nege á kaana de boboŋ-laaro konto dwoŋi mo. Á na zoore de á kaana bam tei to, ta‑á yei-na we ba yera bwona ya dwoi baara. Ba nam wó tɔge de abam ba na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam o zaane dem ŋwaane. Konto to, á ta‑á pa-ba zula, se kolokolo yé che abam na lwoori kolo Wɛ tei ne to.
Yaara taane
8Amo na lage a ta kolo a kweeli to mo ye se abam maama ta‑á jege boboŋe dedwe, se á ta‑á jege da-ŋwaŋa de da-swono, á na ye da-nu-bia to ŋwaane. Ta‑á jege-na á dwonna yibwona, se á daare á ta‑á tu á tete á pa daane. 9Nɔɔno ná ke wo-lɔŋɔ o yage abam yuu ne, se á yé jwoori á ke‑o konto dwoŋi. Nɔɔno ná twe abam, á daa yé tɔge á twe‑o, se á nam sɔɔle Wɛ swolim á yage o yuu ne. Kokuri, Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, ko ye se á ba á jwoŋi o swolim mo. 10Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we:
“Nɔɔno wolo maama ná lage se o na ŋwea ywoni,
kotu jege se o ja o tete mo
de ta-balwaaro ŋɔŋa de vwa fɔm.
11O nam jege se o yage totoŋ-lwanno keim,
se o daare o taa tɔge keim-laaro,
ye o kwaane o taa zoore de wo-zuru de ni-ywom.
12Kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o nii nɔn-ŋona baŋa ne mo,
ye ba wɛ-lworo de zo o zwa.
Ko nam ná ye wo-lwan-keira,
o yiga tera de-ba.”
13Abam ná seene á yia keim-laaro baŋa ne, wɔ mo wó wane o ke wo-lɔŋɔ o yage á yuu ne? 14Abam nam ná tɔge chega, ye nɔɔna yaare abam ko ŋwaane, á daa ta jege yu-ywoŋo mo. Á nam yé ta‑á fona de-ba, naa á ta‑á jege lwia. 15Yezu Krista na ye abam Teiru to, á ta‑á kɔre‑o de boboŋ-laaro. Fɔge-na á che á boboŋa maŋa maama se á wane á leiri nɔɔno wolo maama na wó bwei abam se o lɔre á na ke tei á daŋe á teena Wɛ baŋa ne to. 16Ko nam maŋe se á leiri‑o de bochare-zuru de zula. Ta‑á ke-na wonnu telo á boboŋa na bere we te lana to, se nɔɔna ná yaale abam, se ko pa chaveera ja-ba, de ba na ŋɔɔne ba chɔge keim-laaro telo á na yeini á ke Yezu Krista ŋwaane to. 17Wɛ boboŋa mo ná lage se á ta‑á nae yaara á keim-laaro tem baŋa ne, konto lana ko dwoi á ná ke keim-balwaaro ye á yaare te ŋwaane. 18Kokuri, Yezu Krista déem tege bedwe mo se o ma ŋwe nabiina wɛleera jene maama. Ko maa ye nɔn-ŋom mo leiri nɔn-balwaaro yuu ne o te, se o wane o ke abam Wɛ jeŋa ne. O yera yam mo ba goa, ye o jworo kom pa se o daa ta na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. 19O ma tɔge o jworo kom konto ŋwaane mo o vo nɔɔna balo jworru ba na pe churu ne to tei, se o tɔɔle Wɛ chega kam o bere-ba. 20Ko maa ye nɔɔna balo déem na ve Wɛ ni to jworru mo konto. Konto déem ye maŋa kalo Wɛ na peene o bane ye Noah wora o kwaare nabwor-kamunu kom se o ma jwoŋi o ŋwea to. Nɔɔna fenfee balo na zo nabworo kom wo to ye nana mo, ye ba tɔge na bam wo pa se Wɛ jwoŋi ba ŋwea. 21Wɛ déem tɔge na bam ŋwaane mo o vere banto ŋwea, ye ko ye maana mo se ko bere á na jwoŋi sɛɛm ye Wɛ vere abam tei to. Á na jwoŋi sɛɛm to, ko dae á na swɛ á yera digiru ŋwaane tei to mo Wɛ mɛ o vere abam. Ko nam ye á na tɔge boboŋ-laaro mo á ma gwoni ni ded‑o to, ye ko tɔge o na bi Yezu Krista toone wone to ŋwaane mo. 22Wonto mo diini wɛyuu o jeini Wɛ jazem ne, ye malese sem, de dedɛɛra, de wonnu telo maama na jege dam to maa wo o dam kuri ne.

english_text:
Being Faithful to God
1Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning. 2It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life. 3You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols. 4Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it. 5But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead. 6The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
7Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
8 Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
9Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
10Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well. 11If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen.
Suffering for Being a Christian
12Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire. 13Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
14Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you. 15But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody. 16Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him. 17God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
18 “If good people barely escape,
what will happen to sinners
and to others
who don't respect God?”
19If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_text:
Wɛ boboŋa na lage kikia yalo to
1Abam maŋe á lɔre Yezu Krista déem na wo logo baŋa ne ye o na yaara o yera wone tei to. Konto ŋwaane, ko maŋe se abam de kwaane á ja á boboŋa ne wonto tei, se á ma fɔge á che á tete yaara wone. Kokuri, nɔɔno wolo yera ná nɛ yaara, konto tu yiga le wɛleera wone mo. 2Konto to, abam daa ta ná jege ŋwea logo baŋa ne, á daa ba jege se á ta‑á tɔge wo-yɔɔro telo nabiina fera na zoore to. Á nam jege se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ boboŋa na lage kolo to mo. 3Abam maŋe á chɔge á ŋwea maŋa kam dedɛ, de á na yeini á ke tei á tɔge chwei selo balo na yeiri Wɛ to na lage se ba taa tɔge to. Abam déem yeini á ke wo-digiru kikia yalo na tɔge ka-laga to, de wo-zɔɔna yalo maama á fera na zoore to. Á déem maa ye sa-nyɔra, ye á ye nɔn-kwollu á nyɔ sana á buga. Á maa kwori á tɔge jwona kaanem na ye totoŋ-zɔɔne to. 4Ko daare leile konto, á daa ba tɔge de balo na yeiri Wɛ to, de ba na ke wo-zɔɔna kikia konto dwoŋi to. Ko ma ke-ba yaau, pa se ba jege á yere ba chɔga. 5Banto nam wó ba ba zege Wɛ yiga ne, se ba tole ba kwora ba bere‑o. Wonto nam ti o yiga se o di nabiina taane, ko ná maŋe ko ye balo na ŋwe to de balo na tege to maama de. 6Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo ba déem tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ba bere balo na tege to de. Banto yera yam mo tega, nenɛɛne nabiina maama na jege se ba te ba wɛleera ŋwaane tei to. Ba nam na nigi Wɛ kwora kam to, ko ye se ba jworru tem laam mo wane te na ŋwea, ne Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam na ye tei to.
7Logo baŋa de ko wonnu maama laam lage te kweeli. Nam fɔge-na á che á boboŋa se á ta‑á jege jawala de á na lwoori Wɛ tei to. 8Ta‑á swoi-na daane de á wo maama. Konto tiini ko ye wo-chɛɔ ko pa abam, kolo ŋwaane á ná jege da-swono, ko wó pa se á wɛleera dedɛ saare á boboŋa ne. 9Ta‑á jeeri-na á dwonna á sam ne lanyerane, se á yé ta‑á poone daane. 10Abam dedoa dedoa mo nɛ zeinim Wɛ tei ne, se á ta‑á ma‑á woli daane, ne o na pɛ se á ta‑á ye tei to. Abam maama jege se á ta‑á ke á dwonna zaane, ne Wɛ na ke abam zaane tei to. 11Abam wolo Wɛ na pɛ se o taa ŋɔɔne o bere nɔɔna to jege se o taa ŋɔɔne Wɛ kwora kam chekke mo. Wolo Wɛ na pɛ se o taa toŋe o woli o dwonna to de jege se o taa mae dam delo Wɛ na pɛ‑o to o maa toŋa. Konto maama wó pa se nɔɔna tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane ba pa Wɛ zula. Wonto nam mo maŋe se o jwoŋi zula de dam maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.
Dé yaara yam kuri na ye tei to
12A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, chanɛɛre na wora de daane abam to, de tu se de maŋe abam de nii mo. Á nam yé pa se ko sɔɔre abam yera, nenɛɛne ko ye wo-kenkagele mo tei. 13Abam na tɔge de Yezu Krista á na o yaara yam dwoŋi to, se á ta‑á jege wopwolo ko ŋwaane. Konto to, Yezu Krista ná jwoori o ba ye o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom bere jaja, á wopwolo kom laam wó tiini ko gaale. 14Nɔɔna nam ná yaale abam á na ye Yezu Krista nyem to ŋwaane, á jege yu-ywoŋo mo, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ Sin-laao kom na jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to wo abam tei ne. 15Abam wolo ná nɛ yaara, se ko yé taa ye o na ye nɔn-goro, naa ŋweeno, naa wo-lwan-keiru dwi maama, naa bebare-nyem to ŋwaane. 16Abam wolo nam ná yaare o na ye Yezu Krista nyem to ŋwaane, kotu yé pa chaveera taa jege‑o ko ŋwaane. Konto tu nam jege se o pa Wɛ zula, de nɔɔna na bwoi‑o we Krista bu to.
17Maŋa kam yia Wɛ na wó bobo se o di nabiina taane to. Ko maa ye o tete nɔn-bia bam baŋa ne mo o lage o bobo. Ko na wó bobo debam tei ne to, ko wó taa ye tetɛ mo de balo bam na ve Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to? Ko ná tu ko kweeli, ko bá taa chamma ba tei ne na? 18Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we:
“Nɔn-ŋona ná lage ba na verem,
ko wó chɛ mo.
Konto to, ko ná ye wɛle-keira,
ko wó ke-ba tɛ mo?”
19Ko ná ye balo na nɛ yaara, ne Wɛ boboŋa na lage se ko ke-ba tei to, banto jege se ba taa ke keim-laaro mo, ye ba ke ba tete ba Keiru Wɛ jeŋa ne, o na zege o chega wone to ŋwaane.

english_text:
Helping Christian Leaders
1Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
2 Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money. 3Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them. 4Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
5 All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say,
“God opposes proud people,
but he helps everyone
who is humble.”
6 Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes. 7 God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
8Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack. 9But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are. 10But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm. 11God will be in control forever! Amen.
Final Greetings
12 Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
13 Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones.
Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
14Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_text:
Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom taane
1A lage a ta woŋo de abam balo na ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwa to. Amo de ye abam dwoŋi nakwe mo. Amo yi déem nɛ Yezu Krista na yaare ye o daare o te tei to, ye a laam bere nɔɔna o chega kam. Amo wó tɔge a vo a na paare o tei ne, o na wó ba o veere-de jaja to. 2Amo nam kwoori abam balo na ye nakwa to, se á ta‑á nii Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo o na ke á jeŋa ne to baŋa ne, ne nayera na nii ba pei baŋa ne tei to. Ko nam dae fefeo ŋwaane mo á jege se á ta‑á nii-ba konto, se ko ye á boboŋa na tɔge totoŋe dem, ne Wɛ na lage tei to mo. Ko dae se á ta‑á toŋe sabu-laga ŋwaane. Á nam pa ko taa ye á yiga na wo totoŋe dem wone to ŋwaane. 3Á yé ta‑á bɛɛse balo á na jege á nii to, se á nam ta‑á ke keim-laaro se ba wane ba taa lwoni á totoŋ-naga na ye tei to. 4Konto to, abam Nayero-pɛ wom ná jwoori o ba se nabiina na‑o, o laam wó pa á jwoŋi pɛɛre delo lam na bá fɔge de ti ye de jege nenɔŋa se á ma á ke teera lanyerane.
5Ko woli da, abam balo na ye nɔn-donno to jege se á ta‑á sɛ á pa á nakwa bam mo. Ko nam maŋe se abam maama ta‑á tu á tete mo á pa daane, se á ta‑á wae á woli daane. Kokuri ko popone we:
“Wɛ vae balo na pae ba tete kamunni to,
ye o zaane wo balo na tu ba tete to yuu ne.”
6Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á tu-na á tete, se á ke á tete Wɛ dam-fɔrɔ kom jeŋa ne, se wonto maŋa kam ná tu ka yi, o laam wó zeiŋi abam pa á na zula. 7Lwia yalo maama na jege abam to, se á kwei-ya á pa Wɛ, se wonto mo nii abam baŋa ne.
8Ta‑á yei á tete ni ne, se á fɔge á che á tete. Abam dono setaana pɛ kare o lage chwoŋa se o chɔge abam, nenɛɛne kana na jege nywoŋo ye ko kare ko lage varem se ko zi ko di tei to. 9Nam fɔge á che á tete se á ve‑o, de á na yɔɔre á jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to. Kokuri, á yei we yaara yam konto dwoŋi mo maŋe ya daane á nu-bia bam logo baŋa jei maama ne. 10Abam nam ná yaare ye ko ná ke fenfee, Wɛ laam wó fɔge o kwɛ abam. Wonto jege zaane delo maama na zeini nabiina to, ye o kuri abam se á tɔge á ta‑á jege paare o tei ne se ko taa vei wuu, á na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. O maa wó fɔge abam de dam se á ta‑á zege lanyerane. 11Wɛ jege dam maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.
12Amo na popone tɔnɔ kom a pa abam to, ko ye Silas mo woli-ne. Wonto maa ye dé nu-bu wolo amo na yei o wo to. Amo popone taane dento fenfee mo se a ma pa abam na baare, se a daare a pa á lɔre we, chega kalo á na sɛ to mo zege Wɛ zaane delo na ye chekke to baŋa ne. Nam fɔge-na á ta‑á jege chega kam konto.
13Wɛ kɔgɔ kolo na wo Babilon ne ye Wɛ kuri-ba se á ta‑á ye nu-bia daane to jɔɔne abam. Maake wolo na ye amo bu Wɛ chwoŋa kam ŋwaane to de jɔɔne abam. 14Á ná jeeri daane, se á ta‑á kukwori daane de swono.
Abam balo maama na ye Yezu Krista nyem to, Wɛ wó pa abam yazura.

english_text:
1From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ.
To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
2I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus.
Living as the Lord's Followers
3We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness. 4God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
5Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding, 6self-control, patience, devotion to God, 7concern for others, and love. 8If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful. 9But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
10My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall. 11Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
12You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things. 13In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body. 14And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind. 15This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone.
The Message about the Glory of Christ
16When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness. 17 God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.” 18We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
19All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts. 20But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures. 21The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_text:
1Amo Simon Piita mo popone tɔnɔ konto. Amo ye Yezu Krista kabaa mo, ye a kwori a ye o totoŋa nakwe. Amo popone a pa abam balo Wɛ na pɛ se á jege wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista, ko maŋe de debam de na jege tei ye ko jege lonne ko pae debam to. Wonto mo ye debam Tu Wɛ, ye o ta ye debam Vereno. O na yɔɔre o zege o chega wone to mo pɛ dé sɛ‑o konto.
2Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura se ko gaale, de á na tu á lɔre o chega kam, ye á ta kwori á lɔre dé Teiru Yezu chega kam to.
Wɛ na bwoŋi debam se dé taa tɔge‑o tei to
3Yezu Krista tɔge Wɛ dam ŋwaane o pa debam woŋo kolo maama na wó fɔge dé ŋwe-doŋa kam dedaane dé Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to. O fɔgem dem konto tɔge dé na tu dé lɔre Baŋa Wɛ chega kam tei to. Wonto maa ye wolo na bwoŋi debam se dé tɔge dé na o tete nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ de o zaane dem to mo. 4O ma tɔge o zeinim dem konto baŋa ne mo o pa debam wo-laaro telo na tiini te jege kuri ye o pwooli se o kwei-te o pa debam to. O zeini abam konto se o pa á wane á lu logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna yalo na soge nɔɔna boboŋa pa ya chɔge to wone, se á daare á ta‑á jege Wɛ ŋwea kam á bochara ne.
5Konto ŋwaane, kwaane-na lanyerane se á pa nɔn-ŋonne tɔge de woli de á wo-dedoa kam á na maŋe á jege to,
se á woli yeino á nɔn-ŋonne dem wone,
6se á woli ban-peno á yeino kom wone,
se á woli pu-dɛa á ban-peno kom wone,
se á pa Wɛ kɔrɔ woli de á pu-dɛa kam,
7se á daare á ta‑á jege á nu-bia ŋwaŋa
á woli de á Wɛ kɔrɔ kom,
se á daare á ta‑á jege nɔɔna swono
á woli á na jege da-ŋwaŋa to wone.
8Abam ná seene á jege wo-laaro tem konto se te gaale, te wó che abam se á yé ta‑á ye jawɔre-nyena. Te ta pae á dae kafɛ Wɛ chwoŋa wone de á na tu á lɔre dé Teiru Yezu Krista chega kam to. 9Wo-laaro tem konto nam ná tera nɔɔno wolo tei ne, konto tu ware o lɔre Wɛ chega kam, nenɛɛne nɔɔno wolo yia na ba nae chekke to. O ma swei we, o déem na ke wɛleera yalo to maŋe ya saare.
10Konto ŋwaane, a nu-bia bam, Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ba á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, seene-na á yia se á kwaane se ko pa á na tɔge‑o tei to tiini ko ja kuri lanyerane. Á ná kwaane á ke konto dwoŋi, á daa bá sa Wɛ chwoŋa wone. 11Ko woli da, Wɛ wó tɔge o zaane dem ŋwaane o yage chwoŋa o pa abam se á na jeiŋa jei Yezu Krista paare dem wone. Wonto maa ye dé Teiru de dé Vereno, ye o paare dem ba jege kweelim maŋa de maŋa.
12Mo kokuri amo boŋe se a taa pae abam ta‑á guli wo-laaro tem konto gula maŋa maama. Abam nam maŋe á yei-te, ye á seene á tɔge chega kalo á na lɔre to. 13Amo nam boŋe we ko lana se, amo ta ná wora logo baŋa ne, se a taa guli abam konto dwoŋi, se ko pa á ta‑á jege te jawala. 14Amo yei we ko bá dáane ye a te, nenɛɛne dé Teiru Yezu Krista na pɛ a lɔre tei to. 15Amo nam wó kwaane a ke woŋo kolo na wó pa se á ta‑á wae á guli wonnu tem konto gula maŋa maama ye amo daa bá taa wora logo baŋa ne.
Dé na lɔre Yezu chega kam tei to
16Debam déem pɛ se á lɔre chega kalo na vei dé Teiru Yezu dam dem seeni de o tutuuri dem seeni to. Dé na pɛ se á lɔre o chega kam konto to, ko dae sensɔle mo dé mɛ dé bere abam, ne nɔɔna na mae ba tete swa ba bere tei to. Debam tete yi nam mo nɛ Yezu na jege Wɛ paare dem chekke to. 17Dé ma na o na jwoŋi zula dé Kwo Wɛ tei ne maŋa kalo kwora na ŋɔɔne Baŋa Wɛ paare jeiga kam ne ka ta ded‑o ka we:
“Amo Bu mo tento ye a swoi‑o.
O kikia su amo yi.”
18Debam tete nigi kwora kam konto na ŋɔɔne telaao ne ka ba debam tei, maŋa kalo debam de Yezu déem na wo peo kolo Wɛ na pɔɔre o pa o tete to yuu ne.
19Ko woli da, dé yɔɔre dé yei we, taane delo Wɛ sampwori sem na bere faŋa faŋa to seene de ye chega de dwoi maama. Ko maŋe se á ta‑á maane á nii Wɛ tɔnɔ berem dem na ye tei ye de nye de kanea ba na tɔre ba zege lim jei ne ye ka pae pwooni to mo. Berem dem konto wó woli nɔɔna se ko vo ko yi te-pora ye dé Teiru wom jwoori o ba. Wonto pwooni dem laam wó ba de taa wo á bochara ne, ne naŋɔgɔ na fuŋi te-pora ne tei to. 20Kolo na ye wo-chɛɔ se á ta‑á yei to mo tento: Nɔɔna déem na pɛ se Wɛ kwora kam ba ka lɔre jaja ye ba taane dem popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to, ko dae we ba tete mo bere Wɛ chega kam konto. 21Kokuri, ko ná ye Wɛ kwora kam na tu ka lɔre tei to, konto déem wo tɔge de nabiina boboŋa na lage tei. Ko nam ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo zeini nɔɔna pa ba wae ba ŋɔɔne Wɛ tete kwora kam.

english_text:
False Prophets and Teachers
1Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves. 2Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way. 3They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
4God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment. 5 And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
6 God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
7-8 Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him. 9This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
10The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven. 11Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
12These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them. 13They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil.
They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on. 14All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
15 They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook. 16But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
17These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them. 18They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life. 19They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
20When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first. 21They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given. 22 What happened to them is just like the true saying,
“A dog will come back
to lick up its own vomit.
A pig that has been washed
will roll in the mud.”
translation_text:
Vwa berena taane
1Faŋa faŋa to nɔɔna déem mo wora Wɛ nɔɔna bam wone ba na bere we ba ye Wɛ sampwori ye ba dae. Abam de wone berena wó taa wora ye ba ba jege chega. Banto wó ŋɔ ba zo abam wone ye ba ke swa ba bere berem delo na dae Wɛ nyem ye de chɔge nɔɔna to. Banto maa yeini ba ve ba Yuu-tu Yezu, ye o ye wolo na ŋwe ba wɛleera jene to mo. Konto ŋwaane ba kikia yam wó pa se Wɛ chɔge-ba lela. 2Nɔɔna dedɛ nam wó sɛ ba na bere kolo to, ye ba daare ba ke ba wo-digiru kikia yam dwoŋi. Ba na ke wonnu telo to wó pa se nɔɔna taa yaale Wɛ berem delo na ye chega to. 3Ni-gane-nyena bam konto na ye nɔn-kwollu to, ba wó kwaane se ba na nyɔɔre abam baŋa ne de ba na jege taane delo na ye tusim yerane to ba bere abam. Faŋa faŋa to, Wɛ maŋe o ti o yiga se o di banto taane, ye waarem wó ba ba baŋa lela.
4Ko nam ná ye malese selo déem na tusi to, Wɛ wo duri se ŋwaŋa. O nam de-se o yage te-seŋa ne mo. O ma pe-se bɔɔna wone mɛ na ye lim yerane to, se se taa wora taa se ko taa vei o borem dɛ dem o na wó chɔge-se to. 5Ko woli da, ko ná ye logo baŋa déem na ye tei faŋa faŋa ye nɔɔna ve Wɛ to, Wɛ déem wo duri banto ŋwaŋa. Ko maa ye Noah yerane mo Wɛ jwoŋi o ŋwea, ko woli de o diga tiina barepɛ bam, de wonto na tɔɔle Wɛ chega kam o bere nɔɔna tei to. Wɛ ma daare o chɔge balo na ve o ni to, ye o pa se doa tiini ka ne ka lim logo kom ye ba maama nyɔ na ba te.
6Ko daa ta ná ye nɔɔna balo déem na zoore Sodom de Gomora ne to, Wɛ pɛ se mini di ba jei sem de daare tentwarem yerane, se ko bere we ba ba jege bora. O chɔge-ba konto se ko taa ye maana mo ko pae balo maama na boŋe se ba ve o ni to. 7O ma daare o vere Lot ba wone o yage. Wonto déem mo sɛ Wɛ chega kam ye o wo tiini ko chɔge de puseŋ-nyena na ke wo-digiru kikia tei to. 8O na ye nɔn-ŋom ye o zoore de-ba to, o ma na ba keim-lwanno tem maama ye o ta kwori o ni ba ni-botare sem. Ko maa tiini ko jege o boboŋa ko daana de ba na toŋe ba chɔge Wɛ nia yam tei to.
9Ko maama bere we, Baŋa Wɛ wae o jwoŋi balo na sɛ‑o to o yage se ba yé na cham delo na maŋe-ba to. Ko nam ná ye balo na ve‑o to, o wae o peene-ba de waarem se ko vo ko yi o borem dɛ dem o na wó chɔge-ba de wone to. 10Ko ta ná ye balo yera na maŋe de wo-zɔɔna kikia, de balo na ba kɔre nɔɔn-nɔɔno dam to, Wɛ wó waare banto ko ja gaale.
Ni-gane-nyena bam na wo á wone to de ye konto mo. Ba ba kɔre chaveera ye ba ta ba nege nɔɔn-nɔɔno. Ba maa yeini ba ŋɔɔne ba yaale dedɛɛra balo na jege paare Wɛ tei ne to. 11Wɛ malese sem tete nam jege dam se dwoi ni-gane-nyena bam, ye se nam ba sɛ se ŋɔɔne se yaale wɛyuu dedɛɛra bam dé Teiru wom yiga ne. 12Ni-gane-nyena bam nam yeini ba ŋɔɔne ba yaale woŋo kolo maama ba na yeiri ko kuri to mo. Ba na ke wo-yɔɔro telo to, ba maa nye de ga-vara mo ye ba ba jege boboŋa. Ba na loge-ba to, ko ye se nɔɔna ja-ba ba go mo. Nɔɔna bam konto wó na chɔgem ne ga-vara bam tei. 13Wɛ wó chɔge-ba se ko maŋe de ba tete na chɔge nɔɔna tei to. Wonnu telo na pae se ba na ywoni to mo ye kachaare kikia yalo ba na paale ba ke jaja to. Ba maa tɔge de abam ba di wodiu kolo á na yeini á la daane se á di to, ye ba gane abam de ba na ke kachaare kikia á wone to. Ba na ye nɔn-digiru to ma pae se ba chɔge abam lam, nenɛɛne sambinnu na dwei wo-napwoŋo tei to. 14Banto yi maa sui ka-laga yerane mo. Ba maa ba jege siu de wo-balwaaro kikia, ye ba soge balo boboŋa na bwona to se ba de tusa. Ba maa ye nɔn-kwollu ye ba me de konto. Wɛ wó sɔɔle lwarem o yage ba yuu ne. 15Banto ma tusi ye ba daare ba ve chwo-laao tɔgem. Ba maa ke kikia yalo dwoŋi Beyora bu Balaam déem na ke to. O yi déem ma su nyɔɔre delo o na wó na o keim-balwaaro tem baŋa ne to. 16O na ve Wɛ ni to, Wɛ ma bwɛ‑o. Wɛ ma pa se varem na ba ŋɔɔne to mo ŋɔɔne de nabiinu kwora. O tete bonaga mo ŋɔɔne ka bwɛ‑o konto, se ko che Wɛ sampwora kam de jworim delo o na boŋe se o ke to.
17Nɔɔna bam konto maa ba jege nyɔɔre, ne buli-yi delo na na ba buri tei to mo. Ba ta maa nye de kunkwonnu telo vo-fɔrɔ na kale pa te jage to. Wɛ maa jege jei selo na tiini se ye lim yerane to se o ke-ba da. 18Ba maa tiini ba ŋɔɔne wo-kenkagela yalo na ba jege bu to. Ba maa yeini ba soge balo na bobo se ba pɔɔre ba tete de nɔɔna balo na tɔge tusim to. Ba maa mae wo-zɔɔna yalo nabiina yera na lage to mo ba soge-ba se ba ke wo-digiru kikia. 19Ba maa bere we kolokolo tera ko na wó che ba yiga. Balo tete na bere konto to nam nye de kabɛ mo, ba totoŋ-zɔɔna yam na wane-ba to ŋwaane. Kokuri, woŋo kolo maama na tu nɔɔno baŋa ko wane‑o to mo pae o ye kabaa ko tei ne. 20Nɔɔna ná tu ba lɔre Yezu Krista wolo na ye debam Teiru de de Vereno to chega kam, ko wó pa se ba lu logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna yam wone. Ba laam ná pipiri ba sɛ-ya ye ya jwoori ya wane-ba, ko kweelim jei ne ko wó taa ye lɛɛro mo ko pa banto se ko dwoni boboa kam ne. 21Kolo ŋwaane, ba ya ná wo lɔre Wɛ chega tɔgem chwoŋa kam, ko ya wó taa lana ko pa-ba ko dwoi ba ná tu ba lɔre-ka ye ba laam pipiri ba za ba boboŋa de Wɛ ni delo o na pɛ-ba se ba taa tɔge to. 22Ko na ke banto tei to nye de sinseira kadwoŋi ye ka bere chega ka we:
“Kukura jwoori ka di ka tetwanno.”
Sinseira kadwoŋi ta we:
“Nmo ná jaane teiri n swɛ de yera,
de nam ta wó jwoori de bibili bworu wone mo.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Return
1My dear friends, this is the second letter I have written to encourage you to do some honest thinking. I don't want you to forget 2what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
3 But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you 4and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
5 They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water. 6 Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood. 7But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
8 Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as 1,000 years, and 1,000 years is the same as one day. 9The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
10 The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
11Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live. 12You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat. 13 But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
14My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace. 15Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him. 16Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
17My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance. 18Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_text:
Dé Teiru wom tutuuri dem taane
1Amo badwoŋ-swonnu bam, tɔnɔ konto amo na popone a pa abam to laam ke telei mo. Twanno tem maama wone amo kwaane se a guli abam de Wɛ chega kam, se ko pa á ta‑á jege boboŋ-laaro. 2Ko maa ye se á guli faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem na maŋe ba bere taane delo to gula, se á daare á guli dé Teiru Yezu na ye dé Vereno to ni dem, ne o na pɛ o totoŋa nakwa badwonna ba ba bere abam tei to.
3Kolo na ye wo-chɛɔ se á ta‑á yei to mo tento: Logo baŋa kweelim da yam ne nɔɔna badwonna wó taa wora ba na yaale Wɛ chega kam. Banto wó taa tɔge wo-yɔɔro telo ba tete boboŋa na lage to mo, ye ba jege abam ba mɔna ba we, 4“Wɛ pwooli we o Bu wom ta wó jwoori o ba logo baŋa. O nam ta wo tu. Bɛ mo kea ye o dáane konto? Dé kwoa maŋe ba te, ye wonnu maama ta ye te na maŋe te ye tei ye Wɛ bobo o ke logo baŋa to mo.”
5Ba nam na tɛ konto to ye ba paale ba swei we, Wɛ déem maŋe o chɔge faŋa faŋa logo kom mo. Ba swei we wɛyuu de tega baŋa maŋe te wora faŋa faŋa ye Wɛ ni dem mo pɛ te wora konto. Ko ye na mo Wɛ déem mɛ o ke logo baŋa, ye o daare o tɔge na bam ŋwaane mo o pa logo kom wora. 6Ko ta maa ye na mo Wɛ déem mɛ o chɔge faŋa faŋa logo kom, de o na pɛ se doa ne ka lini-ko to. 7Ko ta ye Wɛ ni dem konto mo pae wɛyuu de tega baŋa wora de zem maama, ye Wɛ nii te baŋa ne se ko taa vei maŋa kam o na wó pa se mini chɔge-te to. Konto maa wó taa ye dɛ dem Wɛ na wó di nabiina taane se o daare o chɔge balo na ve‑o to mo.
8A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, yé zaŋe-na á swei woŋo konto ni ne we, ko ná ye Baŋa Wɛ, dɛ dedwe de bena moro maama ye bedwe mo wonto tei ne. Bena moro maa ye dɛ dedoa mo Wɛ tei ne. 9Nɔɔna badaara boŋe we dé Teiru wom dáane ye o wo tu. Wɛ nam ba wuura de o na pwooli se o ke kolo to. O nam peene o bane mo de abam, kolo ŋwaane o ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chɔgem, ye o lage se nɔɔna maama mo na chwoŋa ba leiri ba wo de ba tusim kikia yam. 10Dé Teiru Yezu tutuuri dɛ dem nam wó pɔpɔ de ba mo, ne ŋweeno na yeini o pɔpɔ o ba to. Dɛ dem konto ne wura dedɛ wó taa wora wɛyuu ne, ye wɛyuu kom ba ko jei maama. Ko daare mini mo wó di wonnu telo woŋo maama kuri na nwoŋi da to de ja chɔge, pa se logo baŋa de ko wonnu tem maama daa bá taa wora.
11Wonnu tento maama na lage te ba te chɔge konto to, ko maŋe se abam ta‑á ye tɛ mo leile? Abam jege se á ta‑á kɔre Wɛ mo ye á daare á tɔge o boboŋa yam á ŋwea wone. 12Abam nam na cheigi dɛ dem Wɛ na wó pa se Yezu jwoori o ba to, se á kwaane á ta‑á ke kolo na wó pa se dɛ dem ba lela to. Dɛ dem konto ná yia, mini mo wó di wɛyuu wonnu maama de ja chɔge, pa se woŋo maama de ko kuri lone ye te nyeene te chɔge. 13Debam nam jege teena se dé na wo-donno telo Wɛ na pwooli se o ke to. Tento maa ye wɛyuu de tega baŋa o na wó fɔge o ke to mo, ye chega kam wó yɔɔre ka taa toŋa jei sem konto ne.
14Konto ŋwaane a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, á na wora á cheigi wonnu tem konto se te ba te ke to, se á seene á yia á pa á bochara tiini ya taa lana de Wɛ, se ko yé pa o na tusim á tei ne. Konto to, dɛ dem ná yia, kolokolo bá taa wora ko na wó che abam de Wɛ daane. 15Dé Teiru wom nam na peene o bane se ko dáane to, se á pa ko taa ye chwoŋa kalo o na lage o ma o jwoŋi abam o yage to. Debam nu-bu-swono Pɔɔl maŋe o popone konto dwoŋi mo o pa abam, ne Wɛ na zeini‑o de boboŋ-dɛɛra tei to. 16O na popone twanno telo maama ye o bere wonnu tento chega kam to, o yeini o tɛ konto dwoŋi te wone. Wonnu tedwonna o na popone to nam dana se nɔɔna wane ba ni te kuri, pa se balo boboŋa na bwona ye ba yeiri Wɛ chega kam lanyerane to maa jege o berem dem konto ba pipira. Banto maa yeini ba pipiri Wɛ tɔnɔ jei sedaara de na bere kolo to, pa se chɔgem ba ba tete ŋwea wone.
17Ko nam ná ye abam, a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, á maŋe á yei ko na wó ba ko taa ye tei to. Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á cho-na á tete se á yé pa puseŋ-nyena na chwoŋa ba de abam ba tusim dem wone, se ko wó pa á daa ba jege zega jei Wɛ chega kam seeni. 18Abam nɛ fɔgem de Yezu Krista zaane dem ye á lɔre o chega kam lanyerane. Nam pa-na se á boboŋa kweere konto baŋa ne.
Yezu Krista maa ye debam Teiru de dé Vereno. Wonto maŋe de teem leile konto se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_text:
1 The Word that gives life
was from the beginning,
and this is the one
our message is about.
Our ears have heard,
our eyes have seen,
and our hands have touched
this Word.
2 The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us. 3We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ. 4We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy.
God Is Light
5Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
6If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth. 7 But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away. 8If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts. 9But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
10If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_text:
Ŋwea Botara
1Debam popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa á lɔre wolo na maŋe o wora boboa ne to. Debam nam seene dé ni o kwora mo, ye dé kwori dé na o yibia. Dé fɔge dé nii‑o ye dé tiini dé me ded‑o. Ko ye ŋwea botara taane mo dé lage dé ta. 2Ŋwea kam konto nam tu ka ba ka nae de yia. Dé ma na-ka, ye dé lage dé maŋe ka na ye tei to dé bere abam. Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo na ba ti to taane mo dé lage dé ta. Ŋwea kam konto ya wo debam Kwo Wɛ tei ne mo, ye o laam pa se dé ba dé lɔre-ka. 3Dé na nɛ kolo ye dé kwori dé ni to mo dé lage dé ta dé bere abam, se ko pa abam wane á me de debam. Debam nam me de dé Kwo Wɛ de o Bu Yezu Krista.
4Dé popone wonnu tem konto dé bere abam, se ko pa dé tiini dé di ywoni abam ŋwaane.
Baŋa Wɛ ye pwooni tu
5Kwora kam dé na nigi Wɛ Bu Yezu ni ne ye dé lage dé ta dé bere abam to mo tento: Baŋa Wɛ ye pwooni yerane mo, ye lim tera o wone de fenfee de. 6Dé ná tɛ dé we, dé me ded‑o, ye dé ta ná wo lim wone dé beera, ko bere we dé fɔ vwa mo, ye dé kikia ba tɔge chega chwoŋa kam. 7Ko daare dé ná jege dé ŋwea dé wo pwooni wone, ne Wɛ na wo pwooni wone tei to, konto wó pa debam maama me daane, ye Wɛ wó saare dé wɛleera maama o Bu Yezu toone jana bam ŋwaane.
8Dé nam ná tɛ dé we, dé ba jege wɛleera, dé gane dé tete, ye chega tera dé tei ne. 9Dé nam ná sɛ dé ŋɔɔne dé wɛleera yam dé bere Wɛ ye dé chuli-ya, o laam wó yage-ya o ma chɛ debam, ye o daare o saare dé tusim kikia maama, o na zege o chega wone ye o ba kwane o ni to ŋwaane. 10Ko daare, dé ná tɛ dé we, dé wo ke wɛleere, dé pae se Wɛ mo ye vwa-nyem. Ko bere we dé seene dé wo jwoŋi o ni taane dem dé ke dé boboŋa ne.

english_text:
Christ Helps Us
1My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us. 2Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
3When we obey God, we are sure we know him. 4But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts. 5We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him. 6If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ.
The New Commandment
7 My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard. 8But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
9If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark. 10But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them. 11If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
12Children, I am writing you,
because your sins
have been forgiven
in the name of Christ.
13Parents, I am writing you,
because you have known
the one who was there
from the beginning.
Young people, I am writing you,
because you have defeated
the evil one.
14Children, I am writing you,
because you have known
the Father.
Parents, I am writing you,
because you have known
the one who was there
from the beginning.
Young people, I am writing you,
because you are strong.
God's message is firm
in your hearts,
and you have defeated
the evil one.
15Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father. 16Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father. 17The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever.
The Enemy of Christ
18Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here. 19These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
20Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand. 21I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth. 22And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son. 23If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father. 24Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father. 25The Son has promised us eternal life.
26I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you. 27But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do.
Children of God
28Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame. 29You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_text:
Yezu zege nabiina de Wɛ laŋa ne
1A bia bam, amo popone tɔnɔ konto a pa abam se á yé ta‑á ke wɛleere mo. Debam wolo nam ná ke wɛleere, dé jege wolo na wó zege debam de dé Kwo Wɛ laŋa ne o fɔge debam to. Wonto mo ye Yezu Krista na yɔɔre o ye chega tu to. 2Wonto toone dem ŋwaane mo Wɛ saare debam wɛleera, ye ko nam dae debam wɛleera yerane, se ko ye de logo baŋa nɔɔna maama wɛleera mo.
3Dé na wó ke tei se dé lɔre we dé seene dé me de Wɛ to ye dé ná sɛ dé tɔge o nia mo. 4Nɔɔno nam ná tɛ o we omo yei Wɛ, ye o ná ba toŋe o tɔge Wɛ nia yam, konto tu ye vwa-nyem mo, ye chega tera o tei ne. 5Ko daare nɔɔno wolo nam ná sɛ Wɛ ni taane, konto tu ye wolo na tiini o bere Wɛ swono kom chekke to mo. Dé ná tɔge Wɛ nia tei to mo wó pa dé lɔre we, dé seene dé wo o jeŋa ne. 6Nɔɔno wolo nam ná tɛ o we, o me de Wɛ, konto tu jege se o taa tɔge Yezu nɛ-bwora na ye tei to mo.
Wɛ ni-doore dem na bere tei to
7A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, ni delo amo na popone se a pa abam to dae ni-doore. Ni dem nam maŋe de ye ni-dwoori mo, ye de maŋe de wora abam tei ne boboa ne. Ni dem konto ye taane delo abam na maŋe á ni to mo. 8Ko daare, de daa ta ye ni-doore mo, kolo ŋwaane Yezu mo pɛ de ji chega, ye de kwori de ji chega abam de tei ne. De maa nye de lim na wora de kɛa, ye pwooni delo na ye chekke to laam maa wora de nyea.
9Nɔɔno wolo maama ná tɛ o we, omo wo pwooni wone de o ŋwea, ye o ta ná chuli o dwonna, konto tu ta wo lim wone mo de zem maama. 10Ko daare nɔɔno wolo nam ná swoi o dwonna, konto tu mo zoore pwooni wone. Kolokolo tera ko na wó wane ko pa se o to tusim wone. 11Nɔɔno wolo nam na chuli o dwonna to wo lim wone mo. O maa kare o beera lim dem wone, ye o yeiri o na wó vo mɛ to, kokuri lim dem mo pɛ se o yia daa ba nae.
12A bia bam, amo popone tɔnɔ kom a pa abam, se á lɔre we Wɛ yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam Yezu yere ŋwaane.
13A kwoa bam, amo popone a pa abam, á na maŋe á yei wolo wom na maŋe o wora boboa ne to ŋwaane.
Nɔn-donno tem, amo popone a pa abam, á na wane wo-lwanno tu setaane to ŋwaane.
14A bu-swonnu tem, amo popone a pa abam, kolo ŋwaane abam maŋe á yei dé Kwo Wɛ.
A kwoa bam, amo popone a pa abam, á na maŋe á yei wolo wom na maŋe o wora boboa ne to ŋwaane.
Nɔn-donno tem, amo popone a pa abam, abam na jege pu-dɛa to ŋwaane. Á maa jege Wɛ ni taane dem á boboŋa ne, ye á wane wo-lwanno tu setaane.
15Yé zaŋe-na á ta‑á swoi logo baŋa de ko wo-yɔɔro tem. Nɔɔno wolo ná swoi logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem, konto tu daa ba jege dé Kwo Wɛ swono. 16Kolo ŋwaane logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem maama, ko ná ye nabiina fera na yeini ya zoore wo-zɔɔna yalo to, de nabiina yia na yeini ya su wonnu telo to, naa nabiina na mage ba nyɔɔna de ba jejegero tei to, tento maama dae dé Kwo Wɛ nyem, se te kuri nam nwoŋi logo baŋa ne mo. 17Logo baŋa de ko wo-yɔɔro telo maama nabiina fera na zoore to lage te jei mo. Ko daare wolo nam na ke kolo Wɛ boboŋa na lage to wó taa wora taa, se ko taa vei wuu.
Yezu Krista Dono wom taane
18A bia bam, logo baŋa kweelim da yam yi ya ti. Abam maŋe á ni we Yezu Krista Dono wom maa beena. Ko na ye tei to, Yezu dona dedɛ mo maŋe ba wora. Ko ma pa dé yei we da yam konto yi ya ti. 19Dona bam konto pwɛ ba tete debam kɔgɔ kom wone, ye ba maŋe ba dae debam kɔgɔ kom nyem. Ba ya ná ye debam kɔgɔ kom nyem, ba ya bá yage debam tei. Ba nam na pwɛ ba tete konto to, ko bere lanyerane we banto wolowolo tɔge o dae debam kɔgɔ kom nyem.
20Ko nam ná ye abam, á maŋe á na zeinim Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom tei ne, pa se á maama lɔre Wɛ chega kam. 21Konto to, amo na popone a pa abam to, ko dae we á na yeiri chega kam to ŋwaane. Woŋo kolo ŋwaane a na popone to ye á na maŋe á yei kolo na ye chega, ye á yei we vwa de chega ba tɔge daane to mo.
22Ko nam ná ye wolo na seene o ye vwa-nyem to, o ye wolo na tɛ we, Yezu dae Vereno wolo Wɛ na toŋe to. Konto tu maa ye Yezu Krista dono mo, ye o ve dé Kwo Wɛ de o Bu wom de. 23Wolo maama nam ná ve Wɛ Bu wom, o Kwo Wɛ de tere konto tu tei ne. Ko daare wolo maama ná bere we o sɛ Wɛ Bu wom, o Kwo Wɛ de wora konto tu tei ne.
24Ta‑á yei-na se á ta‑á tɔge berem delo á na maŋe á ni boboa ne to, se á fɔge á ta‑á jege-de á boboŋa ne. Á ta ná yɔɔre á tɔge berem dem konto, ko wó pa se abam de Wɛ Bu wom me daane, de o Kwo Wɛ de. 25Mo Wɛ Bu wom na pwooli se o pa debam kolo, ye ko ye Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo na ba jege kweelim to.
26Nii-na, amo popone wonnu tem konto a pa abam, se á wane á lɔŋe balo na lage ba gane abam to mo. 27Ko nam ná ye abam, zeinim delo á na jwoŋi Wɛ Bu wom tei ne to ta wora abam tei ne. Á daa ba jege se nɔɔn-nɔɔno zaŋe o bere abam á na wó tɔge chega tei to. Wɛ Bu wom na zeini abam to, ko ye se á lɔre wonnu maama mo. O berem dem ye chega mo ye de dae vwa. Konto to, me-na ded‑o, nenɛɛne o na bere abam se á ta‑á ye tei to.
28A bia bam, pa-na dé me de Wɛ Bu Yezu Krista. Konto mo dé wó na baare o yiga ne maŋa kam o na wó jwoori o nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne to, ye chaveera bá ja debam. 29Abam yei we wonto mo ye chega tu, ye ko pa á lɔre we wolo maama kikia na tɔge chega to seene o ye Wɛ bu mo.

english_text:
1 Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are. 2My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is. 3This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
4Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law. 5 You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful, 6and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
7Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself. 8Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done. 9God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning. 10You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other.
Love Each Other
11 From the beginning you were told we must love each other. 12 Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil. 13My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you. 14 Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
15If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life. 16We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other. 17If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God. 18Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
19When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God. 20But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything. 21Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him. 22He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him. 23 God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do. 24If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_text:
Wɛ na pɛ se de ji o bia tei to
1Boŋe-na á nii dé Kwo Wɛ na tiini o swoi debam tei to. Ba ma debam ba bwoi we Wɛ bia. Dé nam seene dé ye konto mo. Nɔɔna balo na ye logo baŋa nyem to yiga nam tera de debam, ba na yeiri Wɛ to ŋwaane.
2A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, debam laam ye Wɛ bia mo, ye dé ta wo lɔre jaja dé na wó taa ye tei to. Dé nam yei we, Yezu na wó jwoori o nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne maŋa kalo to, dé wó ba dé taa nye ded‑o mo, dé na wó yɔɔre dé na o yibia to ŋwaane. 3Wolo maama na daŋe o teena Wɛ baŋa ne tento dwoŋi to jege se o che o tete de wo-digiru maama mo, nenɛɛne Yezu na ye tei ye o ba jege digiru to.
4Wolo maama na yeini o ke wɛleera to paale o chɔge Wɛ ni dem mo. Wɛleera keim de Wɛ ni chɔgem ye bedwe mo. 5Abam yei we, Yezu déem na jigi nabiinu o ba logo baŋa to, ko ye se o saare nabiina wɛleera mo o yage. Wonto nam ba jege wɛleere kɔtaa. 6Konto to, wolo maama na me ded‑o to ba tɔge wɛleera keim. Wolo maama nam na yeini o ke wɛleera to maŋe o wo lɔre‑o, ye o wo me ded‑o.
7A bia bam, yé pa-na se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chwoŋa o gane abam. Wolo maama kikia na tɔge chega to mo jege chega Wɛ tei ne, ne Yezu de na jege chega tei to. 8Ko daare wolo maama nam na tɔge wɛleera keim to bere we o ye setaane nyem mo, kolo ŋwaane setaana pɛ wom maŋe o yɔɔre o tɔge wɛleera chwoŋa mo ko zege boboa ne. Wɛ Bu wom nam tu logo baŋa se o chɔge setaana pɛ wom kikia yam mo. 9Wolo maama na seene o ye Wɛ bu to ba tɔge wɛleera keim, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ ŋwea mo wo o bochare ne. Konto to, o daa bá wane o tɔge wɛleera keim, o na ye Wɛ bu to ŋwaane. 10Konto mo dé wó wane dé pɔɔre balo na ye Wɛ bia to de balo na ye setaane bia to daane. Wolo maama kikia na ba tɔge chega to dae Wɛ nyem, ko woli de wolo de na ba jege o dwonna swono to.
11Ko ye chega, dé jege se dé taa swoi daane mo. Konto ye Wɛ kwora kalo abam na maŋe á ni boboa ne to. 12Dé nam ba jege se dé ke nenɛɛne Kain déem na ke kolo faŋa faŋa to. Wonto déem ye wo-lwanno tu setaane jeŋa nɔɔno mo. O ma mage o nyaane o go. O déem ke konto kolo ŋwaane o tete kikia mo ye wo-lwanno, ye o nyaane wom kikia yɔɔre ya tɔge chega.
Wɛ swono kom taane
13A nu-bia bam, balo na jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to ná chuli abam, yé pa-na ko kagele abam. 14Ko ná ye debam, dé yei we dé maŋe dé yage toone chwoŋa kam, ye dé daare dé tɔge Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa chwoŋa kam mo. Dé na swoi dé dwonna tei to mo pae dé lɔre konto. Wolo maama nam na ba swoi o dwonna to ta wo toone jeŋa ne mo. 15Wolo maama na chuli o dwonna to nye de nɔn-goro mo. Abam yei we nɔn-goro tera o na wó wane o taa jege Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam o bochare ne.
16Yezu na tiini o swoi debam tei to mo tei o sɛ se o te debam ŋwaane. Konto ma pa dé lɔre swono chekke na ye tei to. Mo kokuri ko maŋe se debam de sɛ se dé te, se dé wane dé jwoŋi dé dwonna ŋwea. 17Nɔɔno wolo maama na ye jejegero tu to ná lɔre we o dwoŋi ba gara, ye kotu ná wo pɛ se o ŋwaŋa zo‑o, ko bere we Wɛ swono kom tera o bochare ne.
18A bia bam, dé kikia mo jege se ya bere we, dé swono kom dé na jege to dae ni taane yerane, se ko ye swono kolo na seene ko tɔge chega to mo.
19-20Dé ná jege swono kom konto dwoŋi, ko wó pa se dé lɔre we, dé seene dé tɔge chega chwoŋa kam. Konto to, dé bochara ná pɛ dé lɔre we dé ke woŋo dé tusi, dé nam bá taa kɔre foone Wɛ yiga ne, kolo ŋwaane dé yei we Wɛ daga o dwoi dé bochara yam na ye tei to, de o na yei wonnu maama to.
21A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, debam bochara na bá wane ya chɔge debam to, dé wó taa jege baare se dé taa ye de Wɛ. 22Ko woli da, dé wó seene dé na woŋo kolo maama dé na wó lwoori o tei ne to, dé na tɔge o nia ye dé ke kolo na pwoli o wo to ŋwaane. 23Wɛ ni dem mo tento: dé jege se dé ke dé wo-dedoa de o Bu Yezu Krista, se dé kwori dé taa swoi daane, nenɛɛne wonto na pɛ debam ni se dé taa ke tei to. 24Wolo maama na tɔge Wɛ nia yam to me ded‑o mo, ye Wɛ wo o tei ne. Wɛ Sin-laao kom o na pɛ debam to mo pae se dé lɔre we, Wɛ seene o wo debam tei ne.

english_text:
God Is Love
1Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world, 2and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body. 3But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
4Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world. 5These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language. 6We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
7My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him. 8God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him. 9God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life. 10Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven. 11Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
12 No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
13God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us. 14God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him. 15God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God 16and are sure God loves us.
God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us. 17If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment. 18A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
19We love because God loved us first. 20But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see? 21The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_text:
Dé na wó lɔre nɔɔna daane tei to
1A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, yé zaŋe-na á sɛ nɔɔno wolo maama na tɛ o we, Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo o tei ne to. Á nam jege se á faŋe á nii se á lɔre ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo, naa jworo kodwoŋi mo, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna dedɛ balo na pae ba ye Wɛ sampwori to tu ba kare logo baŋa ne mo ba gane nɔɔna. 2A lage a bere abam á na wó ke tei se á lɔre we, ko seene ko ye Wɛ Jworo kom naa ko dae. Nɔɔno wolo maama ná sɛ o we, Yezu Krista déem jigi nabiinu o ba logo baŋa, Wɛ Jworo kom wo konto tu tei ne. 3Ko daare nɔɔno wolo maama ná ve Yezu, Wɛ Jworo kom tera konto tu tei ne. Wonto jworo kom nam mo ye Yezu Krista Dono wom nyem. Abam maŋe á lɔre we, Dono wom konto lage o ba logo baŋa. Leile konto o laam maŋe o ba o wora.
4A bia bam, abam ye Wɛ nyem mo. Abam maŋe á wane vwa-nyena bam konto, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ wo abam tei ne, ye wonto dam dwoi dam delo na wo logo baŋa nyena bam tei ne to. 5Vwa-nyena bam konto kugu jei wo logo baŋa ne mo. Konto ŋwaane mo ba na yeini ba ŋɔɔne kolo to nwoŋi logo baŋa ne, ye ko nɔɔna bam yeini ba sɛ banto na tɛ kolo to. 6Ko nam ná ye debam, dé ye Wɛ nyem mo. Wolo maama na me de Wɛ to mo wó sɛ debam na tɛ kolo to. Wolo nam na dae Wɛ nyem to mo ba sɛa. Konto mo dé wó wane dé lɔre jworo kolo na tɛ chega, de kolo na gane nɔɔna to daane.
Da-swono taane
7A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, pa-na dé taa swoi daane, kolo ŋwaane swono nwoŋi Wɛ tei ne mo. Wolo maama ná jege o dwonna swono, konto tu ye Wɛ bu mo, ye o kwori o me de Wɛ. 8Wolo maama nam na ba swoi o dwonna to ta wo me de Wɛ, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ mo ye swono tu. 9Wɛ na jege debam swono tei to mo tu ko bere jaja de o na toŋe o Bu-doa se o ba logo baŋa, se dé wane dé na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam omo ŋwaane to. 10Swono chekke na ye tei to mo tento: Ko dae nenɛɛne debam mo swoi Wɛ, ko ye Wɛ mo swoi debam. Wonto swono kom mo pɛ o toŋe o Bu wom se o ba o te o ma o toone jana bam o saare dé wɛleera.
11A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, Wɛ na tiini o swoi debam konto to, ko maŋe se debam de taa swoi daane mo. 12Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o yi na nɛ Baŋa Wɛ. De konto de, dé ná jege da-swono, Wɛ wó me de debam, ye o swono kom wó ji chega debam tei ne.
13Wɛ na pɛ debam o Sin-laao kom to mo pae se dé yei we dé me de Wɛ, ye o wo dé tei ne. 14Debam nɛ we, dé Kwo Wɛ toŋe o Bu wom se o ba logo baŋa o ji nabiina Vereno mo. Debam laam zege chega kam konto kwaga ne mo. 15Wolo maama ná seene o bere we Yezu mo ye Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu bere we Wɛ wo o tei ne, ye wonto me de Wɛ. 16Debam tete lɔre Wɛ na swoi debam tei to, ye dé sɛ o swono kom lanyerane. Wɛ ye swono tu mo. Wolo maama ná swoi swono kikia, konto tu me de Wɛ, ye Wɛ wo o tei ne.
17Wɛ swono kom na jigi chega debam tei ne to, ko ye se dé na baare dɛ dem Wɛ na wó bore nɔɔna bora to. Dé bá kɔre foone, kolo ŋwaane debam ŋwea de Yezu ŋwea maama ye bedwe mo logo baŋa ne. 18Foone bá wane de taa wora swono wone. Swono kolo na ye chekke to mo wó zeili foone pa de viiri. Zwɛ vaŋem mo pae foone wora. Konto to, nɔɔno wolo ná kɔre foone, ko bere we Wɛ swono kom ta wo jigi chega konto tu tei ne.
19Wɛ na dɛ yiga o swoi debam to mo pae dé swoi dé dwonna. 20Nɔɔno wolo ná tɛ o we, omo swoi Wɛ, ye o ta ná chuli o dwonna, konto tu ye vwa-nyem mo. Kolo ŋwaane, nɔɔno wolo yi na nae o dwoŋi ye o ba jege o swono to, konto tu nam bá wane o taa swoi Wɛ wolo o yi na ba nae to. 21Wɛ pɛ debam o ni we, wolo maama na swoi omo to jege se o taa swoi o dwonna de mo.

english_text:
Victory over the World
1If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children. 2If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children. 3 We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
4Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory. 5No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God.
Who Jesus Is
6Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful. 7In fact, there are three who tell about it. 8They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
9We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son. 10If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar. 11 God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son. 12And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life.
Knowing about Eternal Life
13All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life. 14We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him. 15And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
16Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly. 17Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
18We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
19We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
20We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
21Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_text:
Wɛ Bu wom taane
1Wolo maama ná ke o wo-dedoa o sɛ we Yezu ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom, konto tu ye Wɛ bu mo. Wolo maama nam na swoi kwo to swoi kwo wom na loge bu wolo to de mo. 2Konto mo dé yei we, dé ná swoi Wɛ ye dé kwori dé tɔge o nia yam, dé jege se dé taa swoi o bia de mo. 3Dé na wó taa jege Wɛ swono tei to mo ye se dé taa tɔge o nia yam. O nia yam tɔgem bá taa chana ya pae debam, 4kolo ŋwaane Wɛ bia maama jege dam se ba chɔge logo baŋa wo-lwanno chwei sem. Ko ye debam na ke dé wo-dedoa de Yezu tei to mo wó pa dé na dam dé wane wo-lwanno tem konto. 5Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó wane o chɔge logo baŋa wo-lwanno tem, ko ná dae wolo yerane na sɛ we Yezu ye Wɛ Bu wom to.
6Yezu Krista mo ye wolo déem na tu logo baŋa, ye Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o bere we o ye omo Bu to. Yezu ma tɔge na baŋa o jwoŋi sɛɛm, ye o daare o tɔge jana baŋa ne o te. Ko maa dae na bam jei yerane mo o dɛ da. Wɛ nam tɔge na bam baŋa dedaane jana bam baŋa mo o bere Yezu chega kam. Wɛ Jworo kom de ma woli da ko bere jaja we, Yezu seene o ye Wɛ Bu wom, Wɛ Jworo kom na ye chega tu to ŋwaane. 7Mo kokuri Wɛ dɛ wonnu tetɔ ŋwaane o zege o Bu wom chega kam kwaga ne. 8Te ye Wɛ Jworo kom, de na bam, de jana bam, ye te maama jege ni dedwe. 9Nabiina ná zege keim dedwoŋi kwaga ne, dé yeini dé sɛ ba na tɛ kolo to. Ko nam ná ye Wɛ na zege chega kalo kwaga ne to, ka tiini ka jege kuri ka dwoi nabiina na tɛ kalo to. Wonto nam mo ye wolo na zege Yezu kwaga ne o bere we, o ye omo Bu to. 10Konto ŋwaane, wolo maama ná ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu jege Wɛ chega kam o bochare ne. Ko daare wolo maama ná wo sɛ Wɛ, konto tu lage o bere we Wɛ ye vwa-nyem mo, kolo ŋwaane o wo sɛ chega kalo Wɛ na tage o Bu wom ŋwaane to. 11Chega kam konto mo ye Wɛ na seene o pa debam ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim o tei ne to. Ŋwea kam konto nam ye o Bu wom ŋwaane mo. 12Wolo maama ná me de Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu mo jege Wɛ ŋwea kam konto. Wolo nam ná ba jege meem de Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu ta wo nɛ ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.
13Amo popone wonnu tento maama a pa abam balo na ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom to, se á lɔre we á seene á na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to. 14Dé wó taa jege baare Wɛ yiga ne, kokuri dé yei we, dé ná lwoori woŋo o tei ne ye ko tɔge o boboŋa, o wó cheigi dé wɛ-lworo kom. 15Dé yei we Wɛ yeini o sɛ debam wɛ-lworo kom, ne ko ná ye tei maama. Konto ŋwaane dé yei we dé wó jwoŋi woŋo kolo dé na lwoori o tei ne to.
16Nmo ná nɛ n dwoŋi na wora o toŋe tusim, ye ko dae tusim delo na wó pa toone chɔge‑o to, ko maŋe se n lwoori Wɛ mo n pa‑o. N ná lwoori Wɛ konto, o laam wó sɛ se o pa n dwoŋi wom na ŋwea. Ko daare, tusim dedwoŋi wora de na wó pa se toone chɔge de keiru to. Ko nam ná ye wolo na ke tusim dem konto dwoŋi, amo ba tɛ se n lwoori Wɛ n pa konto tu. 17Keim delo maama na ba tɔge chega to ye tusim mo. Tusim nam wora de na ba pae se toone chɔge nɔɔno. Ko ye dento taane mo a tɛa. 18Dé yei we wolo maama na ye Wɛ bu to ba yeini o ke wɛleera, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ Bu wom tete mo nii wonto baŋa ne pa se wo-lwanno tu setaane bá wane‑o o chɔge. 19Debam yei we de ye Wɛ nyem mo, ye balo kugu jei na wo logo baŋa ne to maama nam wo wo-lwanno tu setaane jeŋa ne mo. 20Dé kwori dé yei we, Wɛ Bu wom mo tu logo baŋa. O ma pa se dé yi poore, se dé wane dé lɔre Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye chega chega to. Dé nam me de wonto, ye dé kwori dé me de o Bu Yezu Krista. Wonto mo ye Wɛ chega chega, ye dé tɔge wonto ŋwaane mo dé jege ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.
21A bia bam, ta‑á cho-na á tete se á yé tɔge jwona.

english_text:
1From the church leader.
To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth. 2We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
3I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love.
Truth and Love
4I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do. 5 Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do. 6Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
7Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ. 8So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward. 9Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you. 10 If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them. 11Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds.
Final Greetings
12I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
13Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_text:
1Amo wolo na ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ se a pa debam nu wolo Wɛ na kuri to, de bia balo na wo nmo kɔgɔ kom wone to.
Chega ŋwaane to, amo jege abam swono lanyerane. Ko nam dae amo yerane mo swoi abam, se ko ye de balo maama na tu ba lɔre Wɛ chega kam to mo. 2Kokuri debam maama sɛ Wɛ chega kam, ye ka daa bá fɔge ka ti debam tei ne.
3Dé Kwo Wɛ wó pa debam zaane de yazura, ye o daare o duri dé ŋwaŋa. Yezu Krista wolo na ye dé Kwo Wɛ Bu wom to de wó zeini debam konto, Wɛ chega kam de o swono kom ŋwaane.
4Ko déem pɛ amo wo pwoli lanyerane de a na lɔre we nmo bia bam badaara tɔge chega chwoŋa kam, nenɛɛne debam Kwo Wɛ na pɛ debam ni se dé taa ke tei to. 5Amo nu, a lage a ta de nmo se n pa debam maama taa swoi daane. Amo na popone kolo to dae ni-doore, se ko maŋe ko ye Wɛ ni delo na wora debam tei ne boboa ne to mo. 6Dé na wó taa swoi daane tei to ye se dé taa tɔge o nia yam mo dé ŋwea wone. Wɛ ni dem nam ye se á ta‑á tɔge swono chwoŋa mo. Abam nam maŋe á lɔre o ni dem konto boboa ne mo.
7Nɔɔna dedɛ tu ba kare logo baŋa ne ba gane nɔɔna. Vwa-nyena bam konto maa ba sɛ we Yezu Krista jigi nabiinu o ba logo baŋa. Nɔɔno ná ye konto dwoŋi, o ye wolo na gane nɔɔna to mo. Wonto maa ye Yezu Krista Dono mo. 8Konto ŋwaane, á fɔge á che á tete se á wane á na á nyɔɔre maama Wɛ tei ne, se á yé pa á ga á na toŋe á lage kolo to.
9Ta‑á yei-na we, nɔɔno wolo maama ná yage Yezu Krista berem dem, ye o daare o bere wonnu tedwonna o woli da, Wɛ tera konto tu tei ne. Nɔɔno wolo nam ná yɔɔre o tɔge Yezu berem dem, Baŋa Wɛ de o Bu wom wo konto tu tei ne. 10Konto to, nɔɔno ná tu abam tei, ye o ba jege Yezu berem dem tete, se á yé sɛ á pa o zo á sam. Nam bere á yé zaane‑o de. 11Nɔɔno wolo nam ná zaane‑o, konto tu de tɔge o woli o totoŋ-balwaaro tem wone mo.
12Amo ya jege taane dedɛ se a ta a bere abam. Amo nam ba lage se a popone a ke tɔnɔ ne. A nam boŋe we, a wó ba abam tei mo se a ŋɔɔne dedaane abam jaja, se ko pa debam wopwolo kom tiini ko gaale.
13Debam balo na ye nmo choro bia ye Wɛ kuri debam to mo jɔɔne nmo.

english_text:
1 From the church leader.
To my dear friend Gaius.
I love you because we follow the truth, 2dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit. 3It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth. 4Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth.
Working Together
5Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before. 6They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve. 7When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower. 8We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
9I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us. 10So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
11Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
12Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true.
Final Greetings
13I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. 14I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
15I pray that God will bless you with peace!
Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_text:
1Amo wolo na ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se a pa a badwoŋ-swono Gayus. Chega ŋwaane to, amo swoi nmo lanyerane.
2Amo badwoŋ-swono, amo yeini a lwoori Wɛ a pa nmo se n ta‑n jege yazura de yiga-veiŋa woŋo maama wone, ne n bochare de na fɔge tei Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem ŋwaane to. 3Dé nu-bia badaara tu ba ta nmo taane, ye ko pa a tiini a na wopwolo, de a na lɔre we n fɔge n zege Wɛ chega kam wone to. A yei we n yɔɔre n tɔge chega chwoŋa kam konto mo. 4Amo ná yeini a lɔre we a bia bam seene ba tɔge chega chwoŋa kam, ko pae wopwolo tiini ko wora a tei ne se ko gaale.
