5Amo badwoŋ-swono, nmo tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane de n na yeini n woli dé nu-bia bam tei to, ne ba ná maŋe ba ye veira mo de. 6Dé nu-bia bam zege Yezu kɔgɔ kom yiga ne ba ta nmo na jege ba swono tei to. Ko lana se n ta‑n woli-ba ba chwoŋa kam veiŋa wone, se ko maŋe de Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to. 7Kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna bam konto na nwoŋi se ba kekare logo kom to, ko ye se ba zeiŋi Yezu Krista yere dem mo. Ba maa ba sɛa se ba jwoŋi kolokolo balo na yeiri Wɛ to jeŋa ne. 8Konto ŋwaane ko maŋe se debam mo woli nɔɔna bam konto dwi ba totoŋa yam seeni, se ko bere we debam de tɔge dé toŋe Wɛ chega kam ŋwaane.
9Amo déem popone tɔnɔ a pa Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo nmo tei ne to. Dioterefa yiga nam tera debam wone. O maa lage se o taa ye á kɔgɔ kom yiga tu. 10Konto ŋwaane, amo ná tu abam tei, a laam wó ta o kikia yam maama jaja se nɔɔna lɔre. Wonto yeini o ŋɔɔne ta-balwaaro mo o ke debam yuu ne. Konto nam ta ba pwoli o wo. Kolo na woli da to, o yeini o ba sɛ se o jeeri dé nu-bia bam lanyerane o daare o cheiŋi balo na lage se ba jeeri-ba lanyerane to, ye o ta zeili-ba Yezu kɔgɔ kom wone.
11Amo badwoŋ-swono, yé sɛ n lwoni keim-lwanno, se n daare n ta‑n tɔge keim-laaro. Wolo maama na toŋe keim-laaro to ye Wɛ nyem mo. Wolo nam na toŋe keim-lwanno to ta wo lɔre Wɛ. 12Ko nam ná ye Demetiru, nɔɔna maama pae o ye nɔn-ŋom. O na tɔge chega kam tei to de bere we o ye nɔn-ŋom. Debam ywo-seeni de zege o chega kam kwaga ne, ye á yei we dé na tɛ kolo to seene ko ye chega mo.
13Amo ya jege wonnu dedɛ se a ta a bere abam. A nam ba lage se a popone a ke tɔnɔ ne. 14Wɛ ná pɛ chwoŋa, a nam wó ba abam tei leile, se dé laam ŋɔɔne daane jaja.
15Wɛ wó pa‑m yazura.
Dé badwoŋ-swonnu na wo ywo-seeni to mo jɔɔne nmo. Nmo de jɔɔne dé badwonna bam dedoa dedoa n pa debam.

english_text:
1 From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James.
To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
2I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love!
False Teachers
3My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people. 4Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
5 Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them. 6You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment. 7 We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
8The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels. 9 Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
10But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings. 11 Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
12These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit. 13Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
14 Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said:
Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels 15to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
16These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want.
More Warnings
17My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ. 18 They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God. 19And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
20Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray. 21And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life. 22Be helpful to all who may have doubts. 23Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds.
Final Prayer
24-25Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_text:
1Amo Judi wolo na ye Yezu Krista kabaa ye a kwori a ye Jemsi nyaane to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se a pa abam balo Wɛ na bwoŋi se á ta‑á ye o nɔɔna to. Abam mo ye balo dé Kwo Wɛ na swoi ye Yezu Krista jege abam o jeŋa ne to.
2Wɛ wó taa jege abam ŋwaŋa, ye o pa abam yazura de swono se ko gaale.
Vwa berena taane
3Amo badwoŋ-swonnu bam, amo ya maŋe a kwaane a lage se a popone tɔnɔ a pa abam, se ko pa á lɔre Wɛ na ke tei o jwoŋi debam balo maama na ye o nɔɔna to. Amo laam nam nɛ we ko ye fefeo mo se a popone tɔnɔ a ma kwoori abam se á chichei á zege Wɛ chega kam ŋwaane. Ko ye chega kam konto mo Wɛ maŋe o ke o nɔɔna bam jeŋa ne, ye ka bá fɔge ka leiri. 4Kokuri to, a lɔre we Wɛ-lwɛɛna mo ŋɔge ba zo ba gwaane abam kɔgɔ kom wone. Ba maa ba kɔre Wɛ ye ba yeini ba pipiri o chega kam, se ko pa ba na chwoŋa ba taa tɔge wo-digiru kikia, ye ba ta boŋe we Wɛ wó duri ba ŋwaŋa, o na ye ŋwaŋa tu to ŋwaane. Ba kikia maa bere we, ba ve Yezu Krista wolo yerane na ye debam Yuu-tu de dé Teiru to. Faŋa faŋa to Wɛ tɔnɔ kom maŋe ko bere we, nɔɔna banto dwi wó na ba lɛɛro.
5Amo lage a guli abam de wonnu tedwonna á na maŋe á yei te ni ne to. Á yei we dé Teiru Wɛ déem vere o nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam o pa ba nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone. Ko kwaga ne to, o laam ma yɔɔre o chɔge balo na wo sɛ‑o to. 6Á maŋe á yei Wɛ na ke tei de malese sedwonna na lage se se dam taa dwoi Wɛ ya na pɛ-se tei to, ye se daare se yage se kugu jei Wɛ telaao ne to. Wɛ ma vɔ-se de chaponno o de jei selo na ye lim yerane to wone o yage da, se se taa wora taa wuu, se o dɛ-kamunu kom ná yia, se o laam pa se na waarem. 7Ko ta ye bedwe mo de Wɛ na ke tei o waare nɔɔna balo déem na zoore Sodom de Gomora ne, de teene delo na bwola da to. Banto de déem tɔge bwoorim wo-zɔɔna kikia, ne ko na wo maŋe se nabiina taa ke tei to. Wɛ ma pa ba na waarem de mini delo na ba ti to, se ko taa ye maana ko pae nɔɔna maama.
8Vwa-nyena bam konto na gwaane abam wone to, ba de tɔge kikia yanto dwoŋi mo. Ba maa pae se ba tete dendwa mo gane-ba, ye ba tɔge wo-zɔɔna kikia de ba yera. Ba maa ba kɔre nɔɔn-nɔɔno dam, ye ba yaale malese selo na jege paare Wɛ tei ne to. 9Wɛ malese dedɛɛro Mikayeli tete nam wo sɛ se o ke konto dwoŋi. Wonto na mage kantɔgɔ de setaana pɛ wom Moses yera yam keim ŋwaane to, o kɔre se o ŋɔɔne o yaale o yuu. O nam na tage kolo to mo ye we, “Wɛ wó vaŋe n zwa.” 10Ko daare vwa-nyena bam nam ŋɔɔne ba yaale woŋo kolo maama ba na yeiri ko kuri to. Ba nam na pae se ba yei wonnu telo to, ba tɔge-te ne ga-vara na ke tei ye ba ba jege boboŋa to. Ba kikia yam konto mo wó pa ba na chɔgem.
11Lɛɛro taa wo ba yuu ne! Ba tɔge Kain nɛ-bwora déem na ye tei to mo. Ba yi maa sui nyɔɔre delo ba na wó na ba keim-balwaaro tem baŋa ne, ne Balaam déem na ke tei ye o tusi to. Ba ma ve Wɛ ni, ne Kora déem na ve-de ye Wɛ go‑o to. Banto de wó ba ba na chɔgem konto dwoŋi.
12Abam na yeini á la daane se á di wodiu da-swono ŋwaane to, vwa-nyena bam konto boŋe se ba chɔge abam lam de ba kachaare kikia yam. Ba ba kɔre chaveera de ba na tiini ba di tei to, ye ba yiga tera de nɔɔn-nɔɔno ko ná dae ba tete yerane. Ba nam ba jege nyɔɔre, ne doa na tene ye ka da vio ka saare to. Ba ta nye de teeni delo na ba leiri bia, ko ya ze ná maŋe ko yi de leirim maŋa mo de. Ba maŋe ba ba jege ŋwea, ne teeni delo ba na gɔge de de kura maama ba daare kafɛ yerane to mo. 13Ba na tɔge ba chaveera kikia yam tei to nye de vio na dole buga na, pa ba pɔgele ye ba zaŋe puŋa tei to mo. Ba ba jege jeiŋa jei, ne chalechwe na kare se beeri tei to. Wɛ nam pɔɔre jeiga kalo na tiini ka ye lim yerane to se o ke-ba da taa wuu.
14Enoki déem ya wuuri o ta nɔɔna bam konto taane faŋa faŋa. Wonto déem ke Adam dwi tiina kuri berepɛ tu mo, ye o we, “Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ wó seene o ba de o malese-laaro tem morro kuni morro, 15se o di nabiina maama taane. O laam wó pa se Wɛ-lwɛɛna na ba chaveera, de ba na paale ba tusi ba tɔge wɛleera yerane, ye ba ŋɔɔne ba chɔge o yuu tei to.”
16Vwa-nyena bam konto yeini ba poona mo ye ba gwooni ba dwonna. Ba maa tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo maama ba fera na zoore to. Ba maa ŋɔɔne kamunni ba pa ba tete, ye ba ŋɔɔne ni-sone ŋɔŋa de nɔɔna se ba na nyɔɔre ba baŋa ne.
Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem taane
17Amo badwoŋ-swonnu bam, abam nam jege se á guli dé Teiru Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwa bam déem na maŋe ba ta kolo de abam to mo. 18Ba déem we, “Logo baŋa kweelim da yam ne nɔɔna badwonna wó taa wora ba na yaale Wɛ chega kam ye ba tɔge wo-lwanno telo ba tete fera na zoore to.” 19Nɔɔna bam konto dwi mo yeini ba pae abam pɔɔre daane. Ba boboŋa tɔge logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro mo ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom tere ba bochara ne.
20A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, ko nam ná ye abam, á kwaane á ta‑á woli daane se ko pa á bochara fɔge lanyerane de chega kalo á na sɛ de wo-dedoa ye ka ye Wɛ nyem chekke to. Á ta‑á ware Wɛ de o Sin-laao kom dam. 21Á ta‑á jege á ŋwea de Wɛ swono kom o na pɛ abam to, ye á jege teena we dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó ba o pa á na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo na ba jege kweelim to, o na jege abam ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane.
22Ko ná ye balo na jege bobwea to, se á duri ba ŋwaŋa de á na woli-ba tei to. 23Badaara nam wora á na jege se á vere-ba mini delo na lage de chɔge-ba to wone pa ba wori. Ko daare balo wo-zɔɔna kikia na pɛ se ba jege digiru to, se á ta‑á jege ba ŋwaŋa, ye á nam ta‑á yei á tete de ba wo-digiru tem se te yé lɔgese abam.
24Dé ke Wɛ lei, de o na jege dam se o taa cho abam se á yé to tusim wone to. O laam wó pa abam ba á zege o yiga ne de bora, se á wane á zo o paare dem wo de wopwolo dedɛ. 25O yerane mo ye Wɛ ye o dwoŋi tera. O maa ye dé Vereno. Dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo o maŋe de zula, de paare, de yere-zɔŋɔ, de dam, ko na zege faŋa faŋa ye logo baŋa ta tera to, de zem maama de, se ko taa vei wuu. Dé ke Wɛ lei. Ameena.

english_text:
1This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John. 2And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
3God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
4 From John to the seven churches in Asia.
I pray that you
will be blessed
with kindness and peace
from God, who is and was
and is coming.
May you receive
kindness and peace
from the seven spirits
before the throne of God.
5 May kindness and peace
be yours
from Jesus Christ,
the faithful witness.
Jesus was the first
to conquer death,
and he is the ruler
of all earthly kings.
Christ loves us,
and by his blood
he set us free
from our sins.
6 He lets us rule as kings
and serve God his Father
as priests.
To him be glory and power
forever and ever! Amen.
7 Look! He is coming
with the clouds.
Everyone will see him,
even the ones who stuck
a sword through him.
All people on earth
will weep because of him.
Yes, it will happen! Amen.
8 The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!”
A Vision of the Risen Lord
9I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus. 10On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet. 11The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
12When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands. 13 There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest. 14 His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire. 15 His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall. 16He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
17 When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said:
Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last, 18and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead. 19Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things. 20I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_text:
1Tɔnɔ konto wo wonnu tem ye kolo Wɛ na bere Yezu Krista se o ma le o bere o tontoŋena, se ba wane ba lɔre kolo na jege se ko ke leile to mo. Yezu pɛ o maleka mo ba amo tei se ka bere-ne wonnu tem konto. 2Amo Jɔn ye Yezu tontoŋeno mo, ye a popone kolo maama a na nɛ to a tiŋi. Amo zege Wɛ kwora kam kwaga ne mo, ne Yezu Krista na veere o bere-ne tei to.
3Nɔɔno wolo ná kwaane o ga tɔnɔ konto pa nɔɔna cheigi, wonto ye yu-ywoŋo tu mo. Balo de na cheigi tɔnɔ kom wo wonnu tem ye ba kwori ba sɛ-te de ba wo maama to wó taa jege yu-ywoŋo. Ko seene ko ye kolo Wɛ na le o bere-ne to mo, ye maŋa kam yia se wonnu tem seene te ke.
4Amo Jɔn mo popone tento a pa Yezu kɔgɔ kuni berepɛ kolo na wo Asia te-nia yam wone to.
Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Wonto maŋe o wora mo boboa ne,
ye o ta wora zem se ko taa vei wuu.
Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ balo na bere o Jworo kom dam ye ba zege o paare yitiŋu kom yiga ne to de wó pa abam zeinim konto.
5Yezu Krista de wó pa abam zaane de yazura.
Wonto mo ye wolo na yɔɔre o zege Wɛ chega kam kwaga ne to.
Wonto ta mo ye wolo na dɛ yiga o bi toone wone ye o na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam to.
O nam ta mo ye logo baŋa pwa bam maama yuu tu.
Yezu swoi debam ye o vere debam dé wɛleera wone o yage, o na tega ye o jana bam nwoŋi to ŋwaane. 6O ma daare o pa dé ji dwi delo na wó zege o Kwo Wɛ yiga ne ye dé zuli‑o ne kaanem tiina to.
Zula de dam taa wo Yezu tei ne se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.
7Nii-na! Wonto tɔge de kunkwonnu mo o beene.
Nɔɔno maama yi wó na‑o,
de balo na zɔge‑o de chichwei to de.
Ko daare logo baŋa dwi maama wó keeri o ŋwaane.
Ko ye chega mo. Ameena.
8Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo we:
“Amo mo ye pulim jei de kweelim jeiga.”
Wonto mo maŋe o wora boboa ne,
ye o ta wora zem se ko taa vei wuu.
9Amo Jɔn ye abam nu-bu mo. Amo na ye Yezu nyem to, ko ma pa se a tɔge a na yaara nenɛɛne abam de na nɛ yaara tei to. Amo nam kwori a tɔge de abam a woli Wɛ paare dem wone, ye a tɔge a na baare Yezu ŋwaane. Amo na kwaane a bere Wɛ kwora kalo Yezu na le o bere-ne to ŋwaane mo ba jaane-ne ba yage Patama buburu kom yuu ne. 10Dɛ delo na ye Wɛ siu dɛ to mo o Sin-laao kom tu amo tei de dam. Amo ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa a kwaga ne, ne nɔɔno na wui nabɔnɔ tei to. 11Kwora kam ma ŋɔɔne ka we, “Nam popone kolo maama nmo na wó na to n ke tɔnɔ ne, se n toŋe-ko n pa Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo teene derepɛ dem wone to. Teene dem konto mo ye: Efesia, Semuna, Pɛregama, Tuatera, Sadisa, Filafia, de Ladika.”
12Amo ma pipiri se a nii wɔ mo ŋɔɔna de amo. A ma na sabu-seŋa min-zwonnu terepɛ mo na zega. 13Nɔɔno maa zege te tetare ne, o na nye de nabiinu bu.
O ma zo gare-dedɔrɔ o de o napera ne,
ye o daare o vɔ sabu-seŋa kila o nyɔɔne ne.
14O yu-ywei maa tiini se peere cha,
ne lɔŋɔ tei.
O yia maa nye ne min-vogo tei.
15O napera maa nyeena,
ne channa kolo ba na ke mini ne pa ko be to.
O kwora maa dɔna ne na-fwaaro mo chuuri tei.
16O maa zei chalechwe serepɛ o jazem ne.
Se-zɔɔ kolo na tiini ko jege ni ye ko ye nia yalei to maa nwoŋi o ni ne.
O yibia maa nyeena, ne wea na tiini ka nye tei to.
17Amo na nɛ‑o ye o jege dam konto to, a ma to o yiga ne, ne a tega mo tei. O ma kwei o jazem o daŋe a baŋa ne, ye o we:
“Yé ta‑n kɔre foone.
Amo mo ye boboa kam de gurim tu.
18Amo ye ŋwea tu mo.
Amo ya tege mo,
ye a laam jwoori a jege ŋwea
se ko taa vei wuu.
Amo jege dam toone baŋa ne
de churu de baŋa ne.
19Nam popone wonnu telo nmo na nɛ to. Ko ná ye wonnu telo na wora te ke leile to, dedaane wonnu telo na lage te ke kwaga to, se n popone te maama n tiŋi. 20Amo wó bere‑m chalechwe serepɛ sem nmo na nɛ amo jazem ne to, de sabu-seŋa min-zwonnu terepɛ tem kuri na ye tei to chekke. Chalechwe serepɛ sem bere Wɛ tontoŋena balo na nii wɛ-di serepɛ sem nɔɔna baŋa ne to mo. Ko daare min-zwonnu terepɛ tem de bere wɛ-di serepɛ sem nɔɔna bam tete na ye tei to mo.”

english_text:
The Letter to Ephesus
1This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus:
I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
2I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars. 3You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
4But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to. 5Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand. 6But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
7 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden.
The Letter to Smyrna
8 This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna:
I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
9I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
10Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
11 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death.
The Letter to Pergamum
12This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum:
I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
13I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
14 I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral. 15Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans. 16Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
17 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone.
The Letter to Thyatira
18This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira:
I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
19I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before. 20 But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols. 21I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
22I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop. 23 I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
24Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands. 25But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
26 I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end. 27-28I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.
29If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_text:
Efesia tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ
1“Nam popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Efesia ne to. Popone we:
Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na zei chalechwe serepɛ sem o jazem ne, ye o kwori o wo sabu-seŋa min-zwonnu terepɛ tem tetare ne o vei to tei mo.
2Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. Amo yei á na tiini á chɛ de á totoŋa tei to, ye á wo fɔge á yage. Amo ta yei we, abam ba pae se nɔn-balwaaro na chwoŋa abam tetare ne. Ko ná ye balo na bere we ba ye Yezu totoŋa nakwa ye ba dae to, a yei we á yeini á maane-ba á nii, ye á lɔre we ba ye vwa-nyena mo. 3Abam jege pu-dɛa lanyerane. Abam nɛ yaara amo ŋwaane ye á tiini á vɔ á wo de-ya, se á vɔna yé pare.
4Ko daare amo nam jege abam taane se a ta. Á daa ba jege amo swono se ko maŋe de boboa ne ko na ye tei to. 5Boŋe-na á nii á déem ya na ye tei ye á daa dae konto to. Leiri-na á boboŋa se á daare á ta‑á ke lanyerane, ne á na bobo á ke tei to. Ko ná dae konto, amo wó ba abam tei ye a daare a le á min-zwoŋo kom ko jeiga kam ne a yage. Nam leiri-na á wo se ko yé ke konto. 6Ko daare, abam kwaane de á na chuli kikia yalo Nikolayi nɔɔna bam na ke to. Amo tete de chuli ba na ke tei to.
7Nɔɔno maama nam kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, amo wó pa konto tu chwoŋa se o zo Wɛ ywoni jei sem wo o di tio kolo bia na pae ŋwea to.
Semuna tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ
8Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Semuna ne to. Popone we:
Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na ye boboa kam de kweelim tu to tei mo. Wonto nam ta mo ye wolo na tega ye o jwoori o bi o jege ŋwea to.
9Amo maŋe a yei cham delo na yi abam to ni ne. A yei we yiniga jege abam. Ko daare, abam nam ye naduna mo Wɛ tei ne. Ko ná ye balo na pae ba ye Juu tiina ye ba ba tɔge chwoŋa to, amo yei ba na yaale abam tei to. Banto wo setaana pɛ chwoŋa wone mo. 10Yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone de á na wó na yaara yalo to. Nii-na! Setaana pɛ lage o pa ba ja abam badaara ba pe, se o maŋe abam o nii. Abam nam wó na cham se ko maŋe de da fuga. Ko ná maŋe ko twɛ á toone de, se á ta ta‑á jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Abam ná ke konto, amo wó pa á na Wɛ pɛɛre delo na ye ŋwea chekke to.
11Nɔɔno maama nam kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, toone delo na ye belei tu to daa bá wane‑o de chɔge.
Pɛregama tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ
12Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Pɛregama ne to. Popone we:
Taane dento nwoŋi wolo wom na jege se-zɔɔ kolo na tiini ko jege ni ye ko ye nia yalei to tei mo.
13Amo yei abam na zoore mɛ to, ye setaana pɛ mo tei jei sem konto. De konto de, abam ta wo kwei amo á yage. Antipa déem zege amo chega kam kwaga ne de o wo maama mo. Ba ma daare ba go‑o abam tei ne, setaana pɛ na zoore jei selo ne to. De konto na maŋe ko ke to de, abam daa ta wo leiri á wo de amo.
14Amo nam jege abam taane fenfee se a ta. Nɔɔna wora abam wone ye ba sɛ berem delo na ye Balaam nyem to. Faŋa faŋa to wonto mo bere Pɛ Balaki se o soge Isarele tiina o pa ba to tusim wone. Ba ma di wodiiru telo na ye jwona nyem to, ye ba daare ba chɔge nɔɔna kaana. 15Nikolayi berem dem de maŋe de ye konto mo. Nɔɔna badaara wora á wone ba de na tɔge berem dem konto. 16Nam leiri-na á wo. Ko ná dae konto, amo wó ba abam tei lela. A maa wó le se-zɔɔ kom na wo a ni ne to a ma ke jara dedaane-ba.
17Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, amo wó pa konto tu Wɛ wodiu kolo yere na ye ‘Manna’ ye ko seigi nabiina yiga ne to se o di. Ko woli da, amo wó kwei kandwɛ-pwoŋo a pa konto tu. Yere-doore wó taa wo kandwɛ dem konto baŋa ne ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri-de, ko ná dae wolo na jwoŋi-de to yerane.
Tuatera tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ
18Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Tuatera ne to. Popone we:
Taane dento nwoŋi Wɛ Bu wom tei mo. Wonto yia mo nye de min-vogo, ye o napera nyeena ne channa tei.
19Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. Amo yei á na jege nɔɔna swono ye á kwori á jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to. Amo yei abam na toŋe á woli nɔɔna ye á jege pu-dɛa tei to de. A nam ta yei abam na tiini á toŋe leile konto se ko dwoni á na maŋe á toŋe tei boboa ne to.
20Ko daare, amo jege abam taane se a ta. Abam yeini á yage chwoŋa á pa kaane wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu to, o yere mo Jezebele. Wonto na yeini o bere amo nɔɔna bam tei to, o gane-ba mo o pae ba tusa. O ma pa ba ke bwoorim, ye ba daare ba di wodiiru telo na ye jwona nyem to. 21Amo nam pɛ wonto maŋa mo se o leiri o wo de o kikia yam. O maa wo sɛ se o yage o wo-zɔɔna kikia yam. 22Nii-na. Amo wó pa se jaweo ja‑o se o daa yé wane o zaŋe wɛɛne. O na tigi da konto to, o de balo maama na tɔge daane ba ke bwoorim to wó yaare se ko chɛ ba yera ne. Ba ná wo leiri ba wo de ba kikia yam ba na tɔge ded‑o ba ke to, amo nam wó chɔge-ba lela. 23Amo wó mage balo na sɛ o berem dem to a go. Konto to, wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam maama wó ba ba lɔre we, amo mo ye wolo wom na seene o yei nabiina bochara de ba boboŋa to. Amo wó ke abam dedoa dedoa se ko maŋe de á kikia na mae tei to.
24Ko daare abam badwonna na wo Tuatera ne to wo tɔge kaane wom konto bera yam. Abam nam wo kwaane se á lɔre setaana pɛ berem dem, nɔɔna badaara na bwoi-de we setaane boboŋ-lilirru to. Amo nam daa bá che abam de chullu tedwonna a woli da. 25Á nam ta‑á jege abam na maŋe á tɔge tei to, se a laam ba abam tei.
26Wolo maama ná wane wo-balwaaro dam ye o toŋe o tɔge amo boboŋa se ko vo ko kweeli, amo wó pa konto tu dam se o taa tei logo baŋa dwi tiina maama. 27O wó taa tei-ba de dam. O maa wó kwei luu-dedɔrɔ o ma wane-ba, ye o daare o chɔge-ba, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na mage kambi o chochoge tei to. 28Konto mo ye dam delo amo Kwo na maŋe o kwei o ke a jeŋa ne to. Amo wó daare a pa se tetete chalechoa kam taa wo konto tu tei ne.
29Nɔɔno maama nam kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to.

english_text:
The Letter to Sardis
1This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis:
I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say.
I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead. 2Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God. 3 Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
4A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy. 5 Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
6If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
The Letter to Philadelphia
7 This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia:
I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
8I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers. 9 Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
10You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through. 11I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
12 Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
13If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
The Letter to Laodicea
14 This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea:
I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
15I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other. 16But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth. 17You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
18Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
19 I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins. 20Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together. 21Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
22If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_text:
Sadisa tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ
1Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Sadisa ne to. Popone we:
Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na tei Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ bam ye o kwori o jege chalechwe serepɛ sem o jeŋa ne to tei mo.
Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. Abam yere zaŋe pa se nɔɔna boŋe we á jege ŋwea mo Wɛ tei ne, ye á nam nye de twa mo tei. 2Zaŋe-na á che á tete se á ta‑á tɔge kikia yalo na maŋe to, se kolo fenfee á ta na ke to yé chɔge ko ti. Kokuri, amo na nɛ tei to, abam kikia yam ta wo yi amo Kwo Wɛ boboŋa. 3Nam fɔge-na á guli ba na bere abam Wɛ chwoŋa ye á ni kolo to, se á kwaane á ta‑á tɔge-ka. Leiri-na á wo de á keim-balwaaro tem. Á ta ná tigi á dɔa, ta‑á yei-na we, amo wó ba a dare abam ne ŋweeno tei, ye á bá lɔre maŋa kam amo na wó ba to.
4Ko daare, abam fenfee na wo Sadisa kɔgɔ kom wone to ke lanyerane, de ba na chege ba tete de wo-digiru to. Amo wó pa ba zo gare-pwonnu ye ba taa tɔge de amo ba via, ba na maŋe se ba taa ye konto to ŋwaane.
5Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to wó zo gare-pwonnu tento dwoŋi. Amo daa bá saare konto tu yere Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone. Amo nam wó sɛ o yere dem a bere a Kwo Wɛ de o malese sem.
6Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to.
Filafia tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ
7Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Filafia ne to. Popone we:
Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na ye wo-pwoŋo tu de chega tu to tei mo. Wonto mo zei Pɛ David bwor-bu. Diga kalo maama o ná pore, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o pe-ka. O nam ná pe diga kalo, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o pore-ka.
8Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. Nii-na! Amo pore chwoŋa a pa abam ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane-ka o che. Amo yei we abam dam ba tiini de daga, ye á ta kwaane á ke amo berem dem á bochare ne. Á ta maa wo seigi amo yere dem. 9Ko ná ye balo na pae ba ye Juu tiina ye ba ba tɔge chwoŋa to, ba wo setaana pɛ chwoŋa wone mo ye ba fɔ vwa. Amo wó pa se ba ba ba kuni dwoona abam yiga ne. Ba maa wó maane we amo swoi abam. 10Abam na tɔge amo ni dem ye á vɔ á wo cham wone to ŋwaane, lɛɛro maŋa kam ná yia, amo wó che abam de yaara yalo na wó ba ya maŋe nabiina maama logo baŋa ne to.
11Amo bá dáane ye a ba. Abam nam fɔge á ta‑á jege á na maŋe á tɔge tei to, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o che abam pɛɛre delo á na lage á jwoŋi Wɛ tei ne to.
12Wolo maama ná wane wo-balwaaro dam, amo wó pa konto tu na kugu jei amo Kwo Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne, ye o daa bá nwoŋi da maŋa de maŋa. Amo wó daare a popone amo Kwo Wɛ yere dem de o teo kom yere dem konto tu yera ne. Wɛ teo kom konto mo ye Jerusalem kolo na fɔge ko kwɛ to, ye amo Kwo Wɛ wó pa ko nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ko tu ko ba to. Amo ta wó popone amo yere-doore dem konto tu yera ne.
13Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to.
Ladika tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ
14Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Ladika ne to. Popone we:
Taane dento nwoŋi wolo yere na ye ‘Ameena’ ye o yɔɔre o zege Wɛ chega kam kwaga ne de o wo maama to tei mo. Wɛ na naane kolo maama to dɛ wonto jeŋa mo.
15Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. A yei we abam ba chuli Wɛ, ye á nam ba swoi‑o de á wo maama de. Amo boŋe we, á ya ná tɔge chwoŋa dedoa, ko wó taa lana ko gare á ná tɔge se maama. 16Abam nam na ba jege boboŋe dedwe to, a lage a ve abam, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na twe wodi-baywoŋo o ni ne o yage tei to mo. 17Abam yeini á tɛ we, á ye naduna mo ye kolokolo wo muri abam. Á nam wo lɔre we yini-gwia mo jege abam. Á nye de lwoona mo, ye á yia ba nae. Á ta ye kalambwolo mo de. 18Abam nam jege se á ba amo tei mo, se á yeigi sabu-seŋa kalo ba na tiini ba wɔ mini ne pa ka be to. Konto mo wó pa se á seene á ta‑á ye naduna Wɛ yiga ne. Ba-na á yeigi gare-pwonnu de amo tei ne á zo se te kwoli á chaveera yam. Nam yeigi-na yia nuga amo tei ne se á ke á yia ne se ya taa nae.
19Ko ná ye balo amo na swoi to, a yeini a kaane-ba mo ye a daare a korese-ba. Nam seene-na á yia Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem seeni se á leiri á wo de á tusim kikia yam. 20Nii-na! Amo zege manchwo-peena ne mo a dɔne dɛ sem. Wolo nam ná nigi amo kwora kam ye o ba o pore chwoŋa o zaane-ne, amo wó zo konto tu tei, ye a pa dé jeini daane dé di wodiu.
21Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, amo wó pa konto tu chwoŋa se o tɔge o jeini amo paare jeiŋa kam jei ne, nenɛɛne amo de na tɔge a jeini a Kwo Wɛ paare jeiŋa kam jei ne tei, amo na wane wo-balwaaro dam to ŋwaane.
22Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to.”

english_text:
Worship in Heaven
1After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.” 2 Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it. 3The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
4Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown. 5 Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne. 6 Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal.
Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes. 7The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle. 8 Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing,
“Holy, holy, holy is the Lord,
the all-powerful God,
who was and is
and is coming!”
9The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever. 10At the same time the 24 elders knelt down before the one sitting on the throne. And as they worshiped the one who lives forever, they placed their crowns in front of the throne and said,
11 “Our Lord and God,
you are worthy
to receive glory,
honor, and power.
You created all things,
and by your decision they are
and were created.”
translation_text:
Wɛ telaao wo-kenkagela taane
1Amo Jɔn daa na nɛ kolo a woli da to mo ye a nɛ diga ni na pore Wɛ telaao ne. A daa ma ni kwora kalo ya na maŋe ka ŋɔɔne de amo ye ka nye de nabɔnɔ ba na tiini ba wu to. Kwora kam we, “Diini n ba ywoba seeni se a bere nmo wonnu telo na lage te ba te ke to.”
2Kwora kam na tage konto to, Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma ba amo tei de dam. Amo ma yɔɔre a na paare yituŋu na zege telaao ne, ye a na wolo na jei ko baŋa ne to. 3Wolo na jei da to maa tiini o nyeena, ne kandwɛ-nyeno kolo na nyeene pele-pele to de kolo na seene chwɛ-chwɛ to. Manlaataŋa maa wora ka kekare paare yituŋu kom, ye ka nyeena nenɛɛne kandwɛ-nyeno kolo yere na ye Emeraleda to. 4Paare yitunnu finlei-tena laam maa zege te gilimi yituŋu kom konto. Nakwa finlei-bana maa jei te baŋa ne ba na zo gare-pwonnu ye ba daare ba pu sabu-seŋa yipwi. 5Pwooni de sɔɔ ma nwoŋi paare yituŋu kom na wo mɛ to, ne doa na pepela ka baga ka wuuri tei to. Mɔɔla yarepɛ maa wo paare yituŋu kom yiga ne ye te zege te di bileim-bileim. Tento mo bere Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ bam na ye tei to. 6Ko maa nye de naneo mo tigi paare yituŋu kom yiga ne, ye ko nyeena ne gelaase na ye tei to.
Wonnu tena na ŋwe to maa zege te gilimi paare yituŋu kom sɛ sena sem maama. Yia ma faare te yiga de te kwaga maama.
7Da-yiga woŋo kom nye ne nywoŋo mo tei.
Kolo na ke telei to maa nye de na-bala.
Kolo na ke tetɔ to yiga maa nye de nabiinu yiga.
Kolo na ke tena to maa nye de kawula na jaane wɛɛne tei to.
8Wonnu tem konto maama jege vɔna yaredo yaredo mo. Te yera yam maama maa ye yia yerane te yiga de te kwaga maama. Wea de tete maama te ba dɔa ye te seini Wɛ te we:
“Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo.
O maa yɔɔre o ye wose ye o dwoŋi tera.
O maŋe o wora mo boboa ne, ye o ta wora zem,
se ko taa vei wuu.”
9Wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to yeini te zuli wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to, ye te seini‑o, ye te kwori te ke‑o lei. Wonto mo ye wolo na jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu to. 10Wonnu tem ná yeini te ke konto, nakwa finlei-bana bam de maa yeini ba kuni dwoona wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to yiga ne ba pa‑o zula, de o na jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu to. Ba ma daare ba puri ba sabu-seŋa yipwi sem ba tiŋi o yituŋu kom yiga ne ba ma zuli‑o ye ba tɛ ba we:
11“Debam Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo seene n maŋe se n jwoŋi zula, de teem, de dam.
Kolo ŋwaane nmo mo naane wonnu maama.
Ko maa ye nmo tete boboŋa mo laga pa se n ke-te
ye n pa te wora.”

english_text:
The Scroll and the Lamb
1 In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places. 2I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?” 3No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
4I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it. 5 Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
6 Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
7The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne. 8 After he had taken it, the four living creatures and the 24 elders knelt down before him. Each of them had a harp and a gold bowl full of incense, which are the prayers of God's people. 9 Then they sang a new song,
“You are worthy
to receive the scroll
and open its seals,
because you were killed.
And with your own blood
you bought for God
people from every tribe,
language, nation, and race.
10 You let them become kings
and serve God as priests,
and they will rule on earth.”
11 As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them, 12and they were saying in a loud voice,
“The Lamb who was killed
is worthy to receive power,
riches, wisdom, strength,
honor, glory, and praise.”
13Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying,
“Praise, honor, glory,
and strength
forever and ever
to the one who sits
on the throne
and to the Lamb!”
14The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_text:
Wɛ Pipeila kam taane
1Amo laam ma na tɔnɔ na wo wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to jazem ne. Tɔnɔ kom dɛ sem maama maa jege poponem. Ko ni dem ma meeni de maaro kuni berepɛ. 2A ma daare a na Wɛ maleka na dana to ye ka tɔɔle de kwor-dɛa ka we, “Wɔ mo yi se o wane o kore maaro telo na meeli tɔnɔ kom ni dem ne to, se o daare o puri-ko?”
3Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera telaao ne, naa tega baŋa ne, naa tega kuri jei ne, o na wó wane o puri tɔnɔ kom o daare o ga-ko. 4A wo ma tiini ko chɔge de ba na wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno wolo na yi se o puri tɔnɔ kom o daare o ga-ko to. 5Nakwa finlei-bana bam wo dedoa ma ta de amo o we, “Yé pa se n wo chɔge. Nii. Judah dwi tu wolo na dana ne nywoŋo tei to mo wora, ye o kuri nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone. Wonto mo wane o dona maama o di, ye o na chwoŋa se o puri tɔnɔ kom de ko maaro terepɛ tem.”
6Amo daa ma na Pipeila, ka na zege paare yituŋu kom, de wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to, de nakwa bam tetare laŋa ne. Ka maa nye de ba ya gwoni-ka mo ba go. Ka jege nyea yarepɛ mo dedaane yia yarepɛ. Ka yia yarepɛ yam mo bere Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ bam na ye tei to, ye banto mo Wɛ toŋe logo baŋa ni maama ne.
7Pipeila kam laam ma vo wolo na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to tei ka jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom na wo o jazem ne to. 8Ka na jwoŋi-ko konto to, wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to dedaane nakwa finlei-bana bam ma kuni dwoona ka yiga ne. Ba maama dedoa dedoa maa jege kɔnɔ, ye ba zei sabu-seŋa zwe se ni na su de talwoŋ-ywoŋa. Ka lwom dem na zaŋe tei to bere Wɛ tete nɔɔna bam na ware‑o tei to mo. 9Ba ma daare ba leeni leiŋ-doŋa ba seini Pipeila kam ba we:
“Nmo yi se n jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom
se n daare n kore ko maaro tem.
Kolo ŋwaane ba ya gwoni nmo ba go,
ye n tɔge n toone jana bam ŋwaane mo
n ŋwe nabiina wɛleera jene
n daare n jwoŋi-ba n ke Wɛ jeŋa ne.
Balo nmo na jwoŋi to nwoŋi
nabiina dwi maama wone,
de taana dwi maama tiina wone,
de teene maama wone,
de paare dim jei sem maama wone mo.
10Nmo ma‑n daare n pa ba ji dwi delo
na wó zege dé Tu Wɛ wom yiga ne
ye ba zuli‑o ne kaanem tiina to.
Ba maa wó taa tei nɔɔna logo baŋa ne.”
11Amo daa ma nii a na Wɛ malese kɔgɔ dedɛ, ye a ni se kwori. Se daga lanyerane ne morro kuni morro dedɛ mo tei. Se maa zege se gilimi paare yituŋu kom, dedaane wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to, de nakwa bam. 12Se laam ma leeni baŋa baŋa se we:
“Pipeila kam ba na go to seene ka maŋe
se ka jwoŋi dam, de nadunni, de swa, de baare,
ko woli de seinim, de zula, de teem.”
13Amo daa ma ni wonnu maama na wo Wɛ telaao ne to, de telo maama na wo logo baŋa ne de tega kuri jei ne to, ko woli de wonnu maama na wo naneo wone to de. Ko maa ye wonnu telo maama Wɛ na ke to mo leeni te we:
“Wolo na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to,
dedaane Pipeila kam
maŋe de teem, de seinim, de zula, de dam,
se ko taa vei wuu.”
14Wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to ma sɛ ye te we, “Ameena. Ko ye konto mo.” Ko daare nakwa bam ma kuni dwoona ba zuli Wɛ.

english_text:
Opening the Seven Seals
1At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!” 2 Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
3When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!” 4 Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
5 When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand. 6I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
7When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!” 8 Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
9When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith. 10They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
11 Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
12 When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood. 13 The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm. 14 Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
15 The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people. 16 Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb. 17 That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_text:
Tɔnɔ kom maaro pulim taane
1Amo daa ma nii a na Pipeila kam laam na bobo se ka puri tɔnɔ kom. Ka ma kore boboa maao kolo na meeli-ko to. Amo ma ni wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to dedoa kwora na dɔna, ne doa na mumuna tei to, ye ko we, “Ba ywo.” 2Amo ma nii a na siseiŋ-pwoŋa na zege da. Wolo na dɔge ka baŋa ne to maa zei taŋa. Ba ma pu paare yipuga o yuu ne. O laam ma nwoŋi se o vo o mage jara o di.
Tɔnɔ kom maao 2
3Pipeila kam daa ma kore maao kolo na ke telei to. A ma ni woŋo kolo na ŋwe ye ko saŋe to na tage ko we, “Ba ywo.” 4Amo daa ma na siseiŋa kadwoŋi ka na nwoŋi ye ka ye naseŋa muri-muri. Wolo na dɔge ka baŋa ne to ma jwoŋi dam se o ba o chɔge ywoni logo baŋa ne, se nɔɔna bam taa mage jara ba go daane. Ba ma kwei se-zɔɔ-polɔgɔ ba ke o jeŋa ne.
Tɔnɔ kom maao 3
5Pipeila kam daa ma kore maao kolo na ke tetɔ to. A ma ni woŋo kolo na ŋwe ye ko ke tetɔ to na tage ko we, “Ba ywo.” A ma nii a na sisein-zwono na zege da. Wolo na dɔge ka baŋa ne to maa zei luu kolo ba na maa maŋe wonnu dunni ba nii to. 6Amo ma ni dɔnem na nye de kwora ye ka nwoŋi wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to tetare ne ka we:
“Nmo ná lage bworobworo muni bɔŋa dedoa yerane,
n wó ma n dɛ wone ŋweero maama mo n yeigi.
Kamaana muni bwɛ setɔ de maa wó yeigi konto dwoŋi.
Ko nam ná ye nuga kam de sana bam,
se n yé ja konto n chɔge.”
Tɔnɔ kom maao 4
7Pipeila kam daa ma kore maao kolo na ke tena to. A ma ni woŋo kolo na ŋwe ye ko kweeli te wone to na tage ko we, “Ba ywo.” 8A ma nii a na sisein-fufunu na zege da. Wolo na dɔge ka baŋa ne to yere mo ye Toone. Wolo yere na ye Churu to maa tɔge‑o o nɔne o nagwola. Ba ma jwoŋi dam se ba go nɔɔna bana maama wone nɔɔno dedoa. Ba jege dam se ba pa jara mo go nɔɔna badaara, se ba pa kana de go badaara, se jaweo de go badaara, se ba daare ba pa kago-vara de go badaara.
Tɔnɔ kom maao 5
9Pipeila kam laam ma kore maao kolo na ke tenu to. Amo laam ma na Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem, ye a na balo ba déem na go Wɛ chwoŋa kam tɔgem ŋwaane to jworru na wo de teiŋa ne. Banto na kwaane ba bere Wɛ chega kam to ŋwaane mo ba déem go-ba. 10Ba ma ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa ba we:
“Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo de chega tu.
Yé dáane se n laam di logo baŋa nabiina taane,
se n daare n waare-ba, ba na go debam to ŋwaane.”
11Ba laam ma kwei gare-napwon-dedwaaro ba pa ba maama. Ba ma ta-ba ba we, “Zuri-na á yera se á kɔgɔ kom laam ba ko puli ko ti. Kokuri á dwonna ta daare logo baŋa ne, balo na maŋe se ba woli á kɔgɔ kom wone to. Banto ye balo de na toŋe ba pa Wɛ to, ye nɔɔna wó go-ba, ne ba na go abam tei to.”
Tɔnɔ kom maao 6
12A ma na Pipeila kam daa na kore maao kolo na ke teredo to.
Tega kam laam maa tiini ka ziziŋa.
Wea kam ma ji nazwono tim-tim,
ne gare-zwono tei.
Chana kam maama ma ji nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ,
ne jana tei.
13Chalechwe sem ma siiri se toe tega ne,
ne vo-dɛɔ mo na sugi kapera ko pa ya siiri tei to.
14Wɛyuu kom ma piri ko kɛ,
ne nɔɔno na piri sara tei to.
Ko daare logo baŋa peero maama
de tega kalo maama na wo naneo tetare ne to
ma fɔɔre te tiga jei ne.
15Logo baŋa nɔɔna maama laam ma kɔre foone. Ko ná ye logo baŋa pwa, de dedɛɛra, de jar-keira yiga tiina, de naduna, de nɔn-kamuna, ko woli de kabɛ, de balo na tei ba tete to maama, ba maama fona ye ba duri ba vo ba seigi ba tete peero bɔɔna de gugworru wone. 16Ba laam ma lwoori kandwa yam de peero tem ba na seigi te wone to se te to ba baŋa ne te kwoli-ba. Ba maa we, “Kwoli-na debam, se wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to daa yé na debam. Ta‑á cho-na debam de Pipeila kam ban-zɔŋɔ kom na wo debam baŋa ne to. 17Kokuri to, dɛ dem yia se ba bane zaŋe debam nabiina baŋa ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o lu.”

english_text:
The 144,000 Are Marked for God
1-2 After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels, 3 “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
4Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were 144,000, and they came from every tribe of Israel:
512,000 from Judah,
12,000 from Reuben,
12,000 from Gad,
612,000 from Asher,
12,000 from Naphtali,
12,000 from Manasseh,
712,000 from Simeon,
12,000 from Levi,
12,000 from Issachar,
812,000 from Zebulun,
12,000 from Joseph, and
12,000 from Benjamin.
People from Every Nation
9 After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands, 10as they shouted,
“Our God, who sits
upon the throne,
has the power
to save his people,
and so does the Lamb.”
11The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God 12and said,
“Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom,
thanks, honor, power,
and strength belong to our God
forever and ever! Amen!”
13One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
14 “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.”
Then he told me:
“These are the ones
who have gone through
the great suffering.
They have washed their robes
in the blood of the Lamb
and have made them white.
15And so they stand
before the throne of God
and worship him in his temple
day and night.
The one who sits on the throne
will spread his tent
over them.
16 They will never hunger
or thirst again,
and they won't be troubled
by the sun
or any scorching heat.
17 “The Lamb in the center
of the throne
will be their shepherd.
He will lead them to streams
of life-giving water,
and God will wipe all tears
from their eyes.”
translation_text:
Wɛ kɔgɔ kom taane
1Konto na kɛ to, a ma na Wɛ malese sena na zege tega baŋa sapala yana yam ne. Malese sem maa jege logo baŋa vio kom maama se ko yé taa fula ko pae jei de jei tega baŋa ne naa naneo wone, se ko yé fuli ko pa logo baŋa tio de.
2A daa ma na Wɛ maleka kadwoŋi na zaŋe ka nwoŋi wɛ-puli jei ne ka maa beena. Ka nam tu se ka la gwona mo ka pa balo na ye Ŋwea Tu Wɛ nyem to. Ka ma bage ka ta de Wɛ malese sena sem, Wɛ na pɛ-se dam se se wane se chɔge tega baŋa de naneo kom to, ka we, 3“Zege-na. Á yé chɔge tega baŋa, naa naneo kom, naa teeni dem de. Nam cheigi-na se dé ná tu dé la dé Tu Wɛ tontoŋena bam gwona ba tira ne, se dé daare.”
4Amo laam ma ba a lɔre balo na lage Wɛ gwona yam to ni na mae tei to. Ko ye nɔɔna morro bi de finna-tena (144,000) mo laga Isarele tiina dwi dem maama wone. 5Nɔɔna bam konto maa ye:
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Judah dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Ruben dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Gad dwi dem wone.
6Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Asere dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Nafitali dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Manasɛ dwi dem wone.
7Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Simeon dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Levi dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Isakara dwi dem wone.
8Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Zebula dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Josɛf dwi dem wone.
Nɔɔna morro fuga-telei (12,000) Benjamin dwi dem wone.
9Konto na kɛ to, a ma daa nii a na nɔn-kɔgɔ na tiini ko wora, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane nɔɔna bam o ga o ti.
Nɔɔna bam konto nwoŋi
paare dim jei sem maama wone,
de nabiina dwi maama wone,
de teene maama wone,
de taana dwi maama tiina wone mo.
Ba maa zege paare yituŋu kom de Pipeila kam yiga ne. Ba zo gare-napwon-dedwaaro mo, ye ba daare ba zei konkwara vɔɔro ba jea ne. 10Ba laam maa ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa ba we:
“Debam Tu Wɛ mo jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne.
Pa-na dé tei‑o, o na vere debam lɛɛro wone o yage to ŋwaane,
ye dé tei Pipeila kam de.”
11Wɛ malese sem maama maa zege se gilimi paare yituŋu kom, de nakwa bam, dedaane wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to. Malese sem laam ma chɔɔle se yuni tega ne se yɔɔre paare yituŋu kom se zuli Wɛ se we:
12“Ko ye chega mo. Debam Tu Wɛ maŋe de teem, de zula, de swa, de lei keim,
ko woli de seinim, de dam, de baare,
se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.”
13Konto na kɛ to, nakwa bam dedoa ma bwei amo o we, “Nɔɔna bam na zo gare-napwon-dedwaaro tem to ye bera mo? Ba nwoŋi yei ne mo?” 14Amo ma leiri‑o a we, “Amo tu, ta n bere-ne, se nmo mo yei-ba.”
O laam ma ta o bere amo o we, “Nɔɔna banto mo ye balo na wo logo baŋa ne maŋa kalo lɛɛro na tiini te wora ye ba nwoŋi te wone to. Ba nam zare ba gwaaro tem de Pipeila kam jana bam mo pa te peere. 15Konto nam mo pɛ banto ba ba zege Wɛ paare yituŋu kom yiga ne, ye ba toŋe ba pa‑o wea de tete maama o sɔŋɔ kom ne. Wolo wom nam na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to wó pa ba jeini o woro ne.
16Kana daa bá fɔge ka ja banto.
Na-nyɔm de nam bá ja-ba.
Wea nam daa bá ja-ba, naa fonyogo.
17Kokuri Pipeila kam na wo paare yituŋu kom jei sem tetare ne to wó taa nii ba baŋa ne, ne ka ye nayero mo tei.
Ka nam wó tɔge ba yiga ka ja-ba ka vo buli selo na na pae ŋwea to se ba nyɔ.
Wɛ nam wó weeri nɔɔna bam maama yi-na,
se ba daa yé taa jege yi-nyɔna.”

english_text:
The Seventh Seal Is Opened
1When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour. 2I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
3 Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne. 4Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
5 After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook.
The Trumpets
6 The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
7 When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
8When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood, 9a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
10 When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water. 11 The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
12 When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
13Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_text:
Tɔnɔ kom maao 7
1Pipeila kam laam ma kore maao kolo na ke terepɛ to. Dɔnne maa wo ke Wɛ telaao ne nenɛɛne awa chichworo tei.
2A laam ma na malese serepɛ sem na zega Wɛ yiga ne to. Ba ma kwei nabwanno terepɛ ba pa se maama. 3Maleka kadwoŋi ma ba ka zege Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem tei ne, ye ka zei sabu-seŋa min-chala zoŋa. Ba ma kwei talwoŋ-ywoŋa dedɛ ba ke maleka kam zoŋa kam ne, se ka kwei ka woli de Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama wɛ-lworo kom. Ba na pɛ-ka konto to, ko ye se ka kwei ka ja vo sabu-seŋa bimbini dem na zege paare yituŋu kom yiga ne to, se ka zwɛ ka pa Wɛ. 4Ka na kwei ka zwɛ konto to, wonnu tem nyoa kam maa tɔge de Wɛ nɔɔna bam wɛ-lworo kom ka nwoŋi maleka kam jea ne ka yɔɔre ka diini Wɛ tei. 5Maleka kam ma daare ka pɛ min-chala bimbini dem baŋa ne ka su zoŋa kam ni. Ka laam ma kwei mini dem ka dole ka yage logo baŋa ne. Ka na ke konto to, doa ma pepele ye ka baga ka wuura. Sɔɔ ma tiini ko gaale ye tega kam de ziziŋa.
Malese serepɛ sem na ke tei to
6Malese serepɛ sem maama laam ma ti se yiga se se wu se nabwanno tem. 7Maleka kalo na ye da-yiga tu to ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kom. Ka na wugi-ko to, doa kandwa, de mini, de jana na gwaane daane to ma chuuri logo baŋa ne. Logo baŋa pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ma di mini. Teeni dem pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe de ma di mini, de ga-lɛɛro maama.
8Maleka kalo na saŋe to de ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kom. Ka na wugi konto to, ba ma kwei woŋo na nye de peo-zɔŋɔ ye ko jege mini to ba dole ba de logo baŋa naneo kom wone. Naneo kom ma ji jana. 9Wonnu telo na ŋwe naneo kom wone to pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ma te, ye nabwooru tem pɔɔrem dem konto de chɔge.
10Malese setɔ tu wom ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Chalecho-kamunu na jege mini ne mɔɔle mini tei to laam ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ka to logo baŋa bu-tole sem pɔɔrem kuni betɔ kom kuri bedwe wone, de buli sem de wone. 11Chalechoa kam konto yere mo ‘Nywaane’. Bwi sem konto na bam ma ji na-chɛɛra. Nɔɔna dedɛ maa nyɔ-ba ye ba toa.
12Malese sena tu wom de laam ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Wea kam pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ma chɔge. Chana kam pɔɔrem dem konto de ma chɔge, ko woli de chalechwe sem de konto. Konto ma pa se te maama pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ye lim. Konto ŋwaane, pwooni daa tera dɛ wone pɔɔrem kuni betɔ kom kuri bedwe wone, wea de tete maama.
13Amo laam ma nii a na kawula na tiini ka jaane wɛyuu wɛyuu. A ma ni ka na tage baŋa baŋa ka we, “Lɛɛro naa! Lɛɛro naa! Lɛɛro lage te yi balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to. Malese setɔ selo na daare to ná wugi se nabwanno tem pa te kwori zaŋe, lɛɛro tem konto wó ba nabiina baŋa.”

english_text:
1When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit. 2 As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke. 3 Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
4 The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads. 5The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion. 6 In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
7 These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces. 8 Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion. 9 On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle. 10Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months. 11Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
12The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
13 Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God. 14The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.” 15The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
16By listening, I could tell there were more than 200,000,000 war horses. 17 In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths. 18One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur. 19The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
20 The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk. 21No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_text:
1Maleka kalo na ye banu tu wom to laam ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kom. Amo ma na chalechoa na kwori wɛyuu ne ka ba ka to logo baŋa ne. Ba ma kwei bwor-bu ba pa-ka se ka ma pore gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom ni dem. 2Ka na pore gwoŋo kom ni dem to, nyoa maa yɔɔre ka pi ka nwoŋi ko wone, ne mini delo na daga ye de jege nyoa tei to. Nyoa kam ma nwoŋi ka li wea kam de wɛyuu kom maama. 3Kayere laam ma nwoŋi nyoa kam wone se tu tega baŋa. Se ma jwoŋi dam se se donem taa wɔe, ne nɔŋɔ donem na ye tei to. 4Ba ma kaane-se se se yé chɔge logo baŋa gaaro de teeni, naa vɔɔro dwi maama. Se ma jwoŋi chwoŋa se se chɔge nɔɔna balo yerane na wo lage Wɛ gwona yam ba tira ne to. 5Ba maa wo pɛ kayere sem chwoŋa se se go nɔɔna bam konto. Se nam nɛ chwoŋa se se pa nɔɔna bam yera mo taa wiira, se ko vo ko yi chane senu. Ba yera yam wó taa wiira ne nɔŋɔ donem na ye tei to mo. 6Maŋa kam konto ne, nɔɔna bam wó taa lage se ba te, ye toone bá ja-ba, de ba ná maŋe ba beeri toone tei maama de.
7Kayere sem maa nye de sisei mo ba na vɔga se se vo jara jei to. Kayere sem yuni nye de se pugi sabu-seŋa yipwi mo tei. Se yibia maa ye nenɛɛne nabiina yibia na ye tei to. 8Se yu-ywei maa nye de kaana yu-ywei tei. Se yeila maa nye de nywonnu yeila. 9Kayere sem nyɔɔna maa nye de lu-polwaro mo kwoli-ya tei. Se vɔna yam wuurim dem maa ke sɔɔ dedɛ, nenɛɛne sisein-kɔgɔ mo vaŋe torokooro se duri se maa vei jara jei tei. 10Se maa jege nabila ye ya nye de nwanno nabila tei. Se mae nabila yam konto se done nabiina ne nɔŋɔ na done tei to. Se nabila yam mo pae se jege dam se se wane se chɔge nɔɔna, se ba yera taa weera taa se ko vo ko yi chane senu. 11Se maa jege pɛ se o taa nii se baŋa ne. Wonto mo ye maleka kam na nii gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom baŋa ne to. Ka yere de Juu tiina taane mo ye ‘Abadon’. Ka yere dem de Girisi tiina taane maa ye ‘Apolua’.
12Mo lɛɛro telo na bobo se te ba to. Ko nam ta daare lɛɛro kuni belei mo.
13Malese seredo tu wom laam ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Amo ma ni kwora na nwoŋi sabu-seŋa bimbini dem na zege Wɛ yiga ne to nyea yana yam seeni. 14Kwora kam ma ta de malese seredo tu wom na zei nabɔnɔ kom to ka we, “Véi n bwoli malese sena sem ba na leiga ba zege Yuferata bu-zaŋa kam ni ne to n yage.”
15Maleka kam laam ma vo ka bwoli malese sena sem ka yage. Sento maŋe se wora mo se pɔe maŋa kam konto nɔɔ se ka ba ka yi. Se laam ma zaŋe se se vo se go nabiina pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe. 16Amo ma lɔre malese sena sem jara tiina bam kɔro tem ni na mae tei to. Ko ye moro kuni morro bia yalei (200,000,000) mo, ye ba maama dɔge sisei. 17Wɛ ma pa se a na sisei sem de se dira bam na ye tei to. Nɔɔna bam maa jege lu-polwaro telo ba na maa kwoli ba nyɔɔna ba ke jara to. Luuru tem konto maa tiini te seene, ne mini na ye tei to. Tedaara maa ye nazwom-pupweeru. Tedwonna de maa ye nasonno, ne su-muni tei. Sisei sem yuni tem nam nye de nywonnu yuni mo tei. Mini de nyoa maa nwoŋa se nia ne. Chilibugu kolo lwom na dana to de maa nwoŋa. 18Wonnu tem konto tetɔ ma to logo baŋa nabiina wone, ye te go ba pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe. Ko nam ye mini dem, de nyoa kam, de chilibugu kom na nwoŋi sisei sem nia ne to mo go-ba. 19Sisei sem nia yam mo pae se jege dam, de se nabila yam de. Se nabila yam nye de basankwe mo, ye ya jege yuni ya maa yaare nɔɔna.
20Nabiina balo na daare ye wonnu tem konto dam wo go-ba to maama nam wo sɛ se ba leiri ba wo de ba keim-balwaaro tem. Ba yɔɔre ba zuli wonnu telo ba tete jea na ke to mo. Ba ta zuli setaana, dedaane jwona yalo ba na mɛ sabu-seŋa, naa lu-nyenno, naa channa, naa kandwa, naa dɛ ba ma ke to mo. Jwona yam konto dwoŋi nam ba nae, ye ya kwori ya ba ni, ye ya ware ya vo de. 21Nɔɔna bam konto maa wo sɛ se ba leiri ba wo de ba nɔn-gora kam, de ba liri kikia yam. Ba ta maa wo yage ba bwoorim kikia yam de ba ŋweene dem.

english_text:
The Angel and the Little Scroll
1I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire, 2and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land. 3Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
4After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
5 The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven. 6He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer. 7God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
8 Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
9When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.” 10I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
11Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_text:
Maleka kadwoŋi de ka tɔn-balaŋa taane
1Amo daa ma nii a na maleka kadwoŋi na tiini ka dana to. Ka ma nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne ka maa tua. Ka mɛ kunkwoŋo mo ka kukwori ka yera, ye manlaataŋa kekare ka yuu seeni. Ka yibia nye de wea kam mo, ye ka nɛ sem nye de min-vogo na ye tei to. 2Maleka kam maa jege tɔn-balaŋa kalo na puri to ka jeŋa ne. Ka ma kwei ka jazem naga ka chwi naneo kom wone. Ka ma daare ka chwi ka jagwia naga kam tega baŋa ne. 3Ka laam ma daare ka bage baŋa baŋa, ye ka kwora kam ke sɔɔ ne nywoŋo na suuri tei to. Maleka kam na bage konto to, doa bagem kuni berepɛ ma leiri-ka. 4Doa kam na bage konto to, amo maa lage se a popone ka kwora kam a tiŋi. Amo laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we, “Ta‑n chem, se n yé zaŋe n popone doa kam na bage ka ta kolo to n tiŋi.”
5Maleka kalo amo ya na maŋe a na ka na zege naneo kom wone de tega baŋa ne to laam ma zeiŋi ka jazem jeŋa wɛɛne, 6ye ka du Wɛ yere ŋwaane.
Wonto nam mo jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu.
O ke wɛyuu baŋa kam mo
de wonnu telo maama na wo ka wone to,
ye o kwori o ke tega baŋa kam
de ka wonnu tem maama,
O ta mo ke naneo kom,
de wonnu telo maama na wo ko wone to.
Maleka kam na dugi tei to, ka maa we, “Wɛ daa bá dáane de o na lage o ke kolo to. 7Malese serepɛ tu wom ná lage o ba o wu o nabɔnɔ kom wɛɛne to, Wɛ boboŋa yalo ya na seigi to laam wó ba ya ke ya ti. O sampwori selo déem na tɔɔle o kwora to maŋe ba lɔre o boboŋa yam konto.”
8Maleka tu wom na tage konto to, amo ma jwoori a ni kwora kalo na wo telaao ne ka ŋɔɔne to. Ka daa ma ta de amo ka we, “Véi maleka tu wolo na zege naneo kom baŋa ne de tega kam baŋa ne to tei, se n jwoŋi tɔn-balaŋa kalo na puri ka wo o jeŋa ne to.”
9A ma vo a ta maleka kam se ka pa-ne tɔn-balaŋa kam. Ka ma ta-ne ka we, “Jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom n kwei n di. Ko ná yi nmo kana, ko wó taa chamma. Ko nam ta ná wo nmo ni ne, ko wó taa sona ne tooro tei.”
10Amo ma kwei tɔn-balaŋa kam maleka kam jeŋa ne a de a ni ne. Ka maa sona ne tooro tei. Ko daare, amo na ligi-ka to, ka ma leiri ka ji cham yerane a kana ne. 11Ba laam ma ta ba bere-ne ba we, amo daa taa jege se a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam se ko vo logo baŋa dwi tiina dedɛ seeni, de teene dedɛ seeni, dedaane taana dwi dwi tiina dedɛ de ba pwa de seeni.

english_text:
The Two Witnesses
1 An angel gave me a measuring stick and said:
Measure around God's temple. Be sure to include the altar and everyone worshiping there. 2 But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for 42 months. 3My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for 1,260 days.
4 These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth. 5Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths. 6 They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
7 After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them. 8 Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
9For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried. 10Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble. 11 But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
12 The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud. 13 At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
14The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon.
The Seventh Trumpet
15 At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said,
“Now the kingdom
of this world
belongs to our Lord
and to his Chosen One!
And he will rule
forever and ever!”
16Then the 24 elders, who were seated on thrones in God's presence, knelt down and worshiped him. 17They said,
“Lord God All-Powerful,
you are and you were,
and we thank you.
You used your great power
and started ruling.
18 When the nations got angry,
you became angry too!
Now the time has come
for the dead
to be judged.
It is time for you to reward
your servants the prophets
and all your people
who honor your name,
no matter who they are.
It is time to destroy everyone
who has destroyed
the earth.”
19 The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_text:
Wɛ nɔɔna balei taane
1Ba laam ma kwei daa kalo ba na maa maŋe wonnu to ba pa-ne. Ba ma ta amo ba we, a zaŋe a maŋe Wɛ diga kam de ko kaanem bimbini dem a nii, se a daare a jeeli nɔɔna balo na wo Wɛ diga kam wone ba zuli‑o to ni. 2Ba ma daare ba ta amo se a yé maŋe ka da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom, kolo ŋwaane ba kwei jei sem konto ba ke dwi-gɛ tiina bam jeŋa ne mo. Banto nam mo wó ba ba taa kare teo kolo Wɛ na pɔɔre o pa o tete to wone ba nɔne wonnu ba chɔge taa, chane finna-selei (42). 3Wɛ daa ma ta-ne o we, “Amo lage a toŋe nɔɔna balei se ba ba ba zege amo chega kam kwaga ne ba bere nɔɔna. Banto wó zo gare-nyenyaaro ye ba tɔɔle amo kwora kam se ko yi da moro de bia yalei de fuseredo (1,260).”
4Olivi teeni delei de min-zwonnu telei na zege logo baŋa Teiru wom yiga ne to mo bere Wɛ nɔɔna bam konto balei na ye tei to. 5Mini mo wó nwoŋi ba nia ne de chɔge ba dona balo na dwoni de-ba to. Wolo maama ná lage se o ke-ba lwarem, ko ye konto dwoŋi mo ba wó go kotu. 6Banto nam jege dam se ba ja wɛyuu kom se doa daa yé taa nena maŋa kam ba na wora ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to. Ba nam daa ta jege dam se ba pa bwi sem na leiri ba ji jana. Ba ta jege dam se ba pa jawe-chɛɛro dwi maama ba nabiina baŋa maŋa kalo maama ba na lage to.
7Ba ná tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam ba ti, juru kolo na zoore gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom wone to wó nwoŋi ko ba ko ja jara dedaane-ba. Ko maa wó wane-ba ko go. 8Ko ná go-ba, ba yera yam maa wó taa tigi pwooni yiga ne teo kamunu kom wone. Yera yalo na bere teo kom konto kuri chekke to mo ye ‘Sodom’ de ‘Ejipti’. Ko ye dáane mo ba jaane banto Teiru wom ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go.
9Nɔɔna laam wó nwoŋi teene maama wone,
de nabiina dwi maama wone,
de taana dwi maama tiina wone,
de paare dim jei maama wone,
ba ba ba nii banto yera yam na tigi da to.
Ba wó taa yɔɔre ba nii banto yera yam da yatɔ de chichworo, ye ba bá sɛ se ba kwei-ba ba suli. 10Balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to wó taa jege wopwolo de banto balei na tege to. Ba maa wó ke kwɛɛra daane, ye ba daare ba pae pɛɛra ba ma zuli daane. Ba wó taa chaka de wopwolo, Wɛ sampwori sem konto balei na pɛ se yaara dwi dwi ba nabiina baŋa ne ye ba laam te to ŋwaane. 11Da yatɔ de chichworo kom nam na kɛ to, Wɛ ma pa o siu kolo na pae ŋwea to laam ba ko zo ba yera yam, ye ba jwoori ba bi ba zaŋe. Foone ma tiini de ja balo maama na nɛ-ba to. 12Wɛ sampwori sem laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne telaao ne ka we, “Diini-na á ba ywo.”
Kunkwoŋo ma ba ko kwei-ba ko ja di wɛyuu, ye ba dona bam zege ba nia. 13Kanto maŋa kam ne nɔɔ, tega baŋa maama maa tiini ka ziziŋa. Ko ma pa se teo kom pɔɔrem kuni fuga wone kuri bedwe chɔge maama. Tega kam ziziŋim dem ma go nɔɔna morro terepɛ (7,000). Foone ma ja nɔɔna balo na daare to, ye ba sɛ we Telaao Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tiini o jege dam. 14Mo lɛɛro telo na ke belei tu to. Ko nam ta daare lɛɛro telo na wó ke betɔ tu to mo. Tento nam lage te ba leile mo.
Nabɔnɔ kolo na wugi ko ma kweeli to
15Wɛ malese serepɛ tu wom laam ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Kwori laam ma ŋɔɔne telaao ne baŋa baŋa se we, “Logo baŋa paare dem laam wo dé Yuu-tu Wɛ jeŋa ne mo de o Dam Tu Krista jeŋa ne. O nam wó taa di paare logo baŋa ne se ko taa vei wuu.”
16Nakwa finlei-bana bam ba na jei Wɛ yiga ne ba paare yitunnu tem baŋa ne to laam ma chɔɔle ba yuni tega ne ba zuli Wɛ, 17ye ba we:
“Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo maŋe n wora boboa ne,
ye n ta wora de zem maama.
Dé ke nmo lei de n laam na kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom
n ma n tei logo baŋa to.
18Logo baŋa dwi-gɛ tiina bam tiini ba jege ban-zɔŋɔ mo.
Leile konto nmo ban-lom dem nam wó zaŋe de-ba.
Ko laam yi maŋa kalo nmo na wó di twa taane to.
Nmo wó pa se balo maama na sɛ nmo to na pɛɛra.
Ko ná ye nmo ni-jwoŋina balo na tɔɔle nmo kwora to,
de balo maama na ye nmo nɔɔna ye ba kɔre n yere dem to,
ko ná ye nɔn-kamuna de nabwona de,
ba maama wó di nyɔɔre.
Ko nam ná ye balo na chɔge logo baŋa to,
maŋa yia se nmo laam chɔge-ba.”
19Ba na zuli Wɛ konto ba ti to, Wɛ diga kalo na wo telaao ne to ni laam ma pore. Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam na wo Wɛ di-yun-gala kam ne to ma ba ka nae jaja. Doa laam maa pepela ye ka baga ka wuura. Tega maa ziziŋa ye do-kandwa tiini ya toe dedɛ.

english_text:
The Woman and the Dragon
