1Something important appeared in the sky. It was a woman whose clothes were the sun. The moon was under her feet, and a crown made of twelve stars was on her head. 2She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
3 Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads. 4 With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
5 The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne. 6The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for 1,260 days.
Michael Fights the Dragon
7 A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels. 8But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven 9 and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan. 10 Then I heard a voice from heaven shout,
“Our God has shown
his saving power,
and his kingdom has come!
God's own Chosen One
has shown his authority.
Satan accused our people
in the presence of God
day and night.
Now he has been thrown out!
11“Our people defeated Satan
because of the blood
of the Lamb
and the message of God.
They were willing
to give up their lives.
12“The heavens should rejoice,
together with everyone
who lives there.
But pity the earth
and the sea,
because the devil
was thrown down
to the earth.
He knows his time is short,
and he is very angry.”
13When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son. 14 But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
15The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away. 16But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth. 17This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught. 18The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_text:
Kayanchɔrɔ zeili kaane de o bu
1Wo-kenkagele laam ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne. Amo ma na kaane na mɛ wea kam o kukwori o yera. Chana kam maa wo o napera kuri ne. Ko daare yipuga kalo na jege chalechwe fuga-selei to ma pu o yuu ne. 2Kaane wom ye kapua mo ye o puga kam virigi se o lo. Ko na chana to, o ma kaase baŋa baŋa.
3Wo-kenkagele dedwoŋi daa ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne. Amo ma na kayanchɔrɔ na wora, ko na nye de vare-kamunu. Ko ye nasoŋo mo chwɛ-chwɛ ye ko jege yuni terepɛ, de nyea fuga. Paare yipwi ma pu ko yuni tem maama baŋa ne. 4Ko ma kwei ko nabili dem ko ma vaŋe chalechwe sem pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ko kwori wɛyuu ne ko de tega ne. Ko ma ba ko zege kaane wolo na lage o lo to yiga ne, se o ná loge bu wom, se ko kwei ko di. 5Kaane wom ma lo o bu wom, o ye bakeira mo. Wonto mo wó taa tei logo baŋa dwi tiina maama de o dam. Kaane wom na loge konto to, ba ma chaale bu wom ba ja vo Wɛ tei, o paare yituŋu kom na wo mɛ to. 6Kaane wom laam ma duri o vo kagoa yuu, jeiga kalo Wɛ na maŋe o kwɛ se o pa‑o to. Wɛ wó taa nii o baŋa ne jei sem konto ne da moro de bia yalei de fuseredo (1,260).
7Jara déem ya ke Wɛ telaao ne. Wɛ malese dedɛɛro wolo yere na ye Mikayeli to dedaane o kwaga malese sem ma chiŋi jara de kayanchɔrɔ kom. Kayanchɔrɔ kom de ko kwaga malese sem de ma jwoori se kwaare jara yam. 8Ko maa wo wane jara yam ko ke ko di. Ko de ko kwaga malese sem ma daa wo nɛ jeiŋa jei Wɛ telaao ne. 9Ba ma zeili-ko Wɛ telaao ne ba dole ba yage logo baŋa ne, de ko kwaga malese sem maama. Kayanchɔrɔ kom konto mo ye basankwea kalo na maŋe ka wora faŋa faŋa to. Ka yere nam mo ye ‘Vwa-nyena pɛ’, de ‘Setaane’, ye ka gane logo baŋa nɔɔna maama.
10Amo laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we, “Leile konto debam Tu Wɛ tu o vere o nɔɔna setaana pɛ jeŋa ne. O ma pa o dam de o paare dem bere jaja. O Dam Tu Krista de tu se o taa tei nɔɔna de dam. Kokuri wolo wom na yeini o ŋɔɔne o chɔge dé nu-bia bam Wɛ yiga ne to daa tera. Wonto mo yeini o zege dé Tu Wɛ yiga ne tete de wea maama o ŋɔɔne o chɔge-ba. Ba laam nam de‑o ba yage. 11Ba na wane‑o konto to, ko ye Pipeila kam toone jana bam de ba na bere Wɛ chega kam tei to ŋwaane mo. Ba ma sɛ se ba kwei ba ŋwea ba ma leini toone. 12Abam balo maama na zoore wɛ telaao jei sem ne to, á ta‑á chaka de wopwolo. Ko daare ko ná ye logo baŋa de ko naneo kom, lɛɛro wó ba abam nɔɔna bam baŋa, vwa-nyena pɛ wom na tu abam tei to ŋwaane. O nam tiini o jege ban-zɔŋɔ lanyerane, kokuri o yei we o da yam gɛ fee mo.”
13Kayanchɔrɔ kom na lɔre we ba zeili-ko ba yage logo baŋa ne to, ko ma pɛ kaane wolo na loge bakeira kam to kwaga ko pu. 14Ba ma kwei kawul-zɔŋɔ vɔna yalei ba pa kaane wom se o ma jaane wɛɛne o vo o yi kagoa kam yuu jei sem o na maŋe se o taa wora to. Dáane mo Wɛ wó nii o baŋa ne bena yatɔ de chichworo, ye o daare o che‑o kayanchɔrɔ kom yiga ne. 15Kayanchɔrɔ kom ma twe na dedɛ se ba vo ba pɛ kaane wom ba ja viiri, ne bu-tola na na duri tei to. 16Tega kam ma zeini kaane wom, ye ka pore bɔɔne ka nyɔ na balo maama kayanchɔrɔ kom na twe to. 17Konto ŋwaane mo kayanchɔrɔ kom bane tiini de zaŋe de kaane wom. Ko laam ma vo se ko ke jara de kaane wom dwi tiina balo na daare to. Banto mo ye balo na sɛ Wɛ nia yam, ye ba bere we ba tɔge Yezu chega kam to. 18Kayanchɔrɔ kom laam ma vo ko zege naneo kom ni ne.

english_text:
The Two Beasts
1 I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God. 2 The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast. 3One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast, 4and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
5 The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for 42 months it was allowed to rule. 6The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God. 7 It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race. 8 The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
9If you have ears,
then listen!
10 If you are doomed
to be captured,
you will be captured.
If you are doomed
to be killed by a sword,
you will be killed
by a sword.
This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
11I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon. 12It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast. 13It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
14This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword. 15It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death. 16 All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves, 17they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
18You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is 666, and it stands for a person.
translation_text:
Juru kolo na nwoŋi naneo wone to
1Amo daa ma na juru kodwoŋi ko na nwoŋi naneo kom wone. Ko maa jege nyea fuga de yuni terepɛ. Ko nyea yam baŋa maama maa jege paare yipwi. Ko yuni tem yera ne ma popone yere delo na twe Wɛ to. 2Amo na nɛ juru kom konto to, ko nye de gweeru mo. Ko nɛ maa nye de faao nɛ, ye ko ni nye de nywoŋo ni. Kayanchɔrɔ kom laam ma kwei ko paare dem de ko dam-fɔrɔ kom ko ke juru kom jeŋa ne. 3Juru kom yuu dedoa maa jege fufwolo, nenɛɛne ba zage-ko mo tei. Fufwolo kom konto laam ma ba ko jei. Ko ma so nabiina maama logo baŋa ne, ye ba sɛ ba pa juru kom. 4Nɔɔna maama maa kuni dwoona ba zuli kayanchɔrɔ kom, de ko na kwei ko dam dem ko pa juru kom to. Ba ma daare ba zuli juru kom de, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔno tera o na mae de juru kom. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane o ke jara de‑ko.”
5Ba ma pa juru kom chwoŋa se ko ŋɔɔne kamunni ko pa ko tete, ye ko daare ko ŋɔɔne ko twe Wɛ yere. Ko ma jwoŋi dam se ko vo ko yi chane finna-selei (42). 6Ko ma kwaane ko sɔɔle lwarem ko pa Wɛ, ye ko ta twe Wɛ yere dem, de o sɔŋɔ kom, ko woli de balo na zoore Wɛ telaao ne to. 7Juru kom ma kwori ko na dam se ko kwaare jara de Wɛ nɔɔna bam, se ko wane-ba ko di. Ko ma jwoŋi dam se ko taa tei logo baŋa dwi maama, de teene maama tiina, de taana dwi maama tiina, de paare dim jei sem maama tiina. 8Nɔɔna balo maama na jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to wó taa zuli juru kom. Banto mo ye nɔɔna balo yera na maŋe ya wo popone ya tiŋi Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone maŋa kam logo baŋa ta na tera to. Ko nam ye Pipeila kam ba na go to mo tei tɔnɔ kom konto.
9Nam pore-na á zwa se á cheigi amo taane dem. 10Wolo maama na yɔɔre o ba se o dona ja‑o ba pe to, ba wó ja konto tu mo ye o bá lu. Wolo maama de na yɔɔre o ba se ba ma se-zɔɔ ba go‑o to, ba wó ma-ko mo ba go‑o ye o bá wane o lu. Konto mo tei Wɛ nɔɔna bam jege se ba taa vɔ pu-dɛa, se ba daare ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ.
Juru kolo na nwoŋi tega ne to
11Amo laam ma na juru kodwoŋi ko na nwoŋi tega ne. Ko maa jege nyea yalei, ne pi-bala nyea na ye tei to. Ko ŋɔŋa maa nye de kayanchɔrɔ ŋɔŋa kam na ye tei to. 12Da-yiga juru kom ma pa‑ko chwoŋa se ko ma ko dam-fɔrɔ kom ko toŋe ko pa-ko. Ko ma ma dam dem konto ko fe balo maama na zoore logo baŋa ne to pa ba zuli da-yiga juru kolo yuu ba na zage ye ko fufwolo kom laam jei to. 13Juru kolo na saŋe to ma tiini ko ke wo-kenkagela yalo na dana to. Ko ma pa se mini nwoŋi wɛyuu ne de ba tega baŋa ye nabiina maama zege ba nia. 14Ko na nɛ chwoŋa se ko ke wo-kenkagela yanto dwoŋi da-yiga juru kom ŋwaane tei to ma pa ko wane ko gane nɔɔna balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to. Ko ma ta-ba se ba mɔ kamɔgɔ se ko taa nye de juru kolo ba na mɛ se-zɔɔ ba zage ye ko ta ŋwe to. 15Ko ma daare ko na chwoŋa se ko kwei siu ko ke da-yiga juru kom kamɔgɔ kom wone, se ko taa ŋwe. Ko na ke konto to, kamɔgɔ kom maa wae ko ŋɔɔna, ye ko jege dam se ko pa balo maama na ve se ba zuli-ko to te. 16Ko ma fe nɔɔna maama se ba taa jege gwona ba jazena ne naa ba tira ne. Ko ná ye nabwona de nɔn-kamuna de, naa ko ná ye naduna de yiniga tiina, ko woli de kabɛ de balo na tei ba tete to de, ba maama wó la gwona yam konto mo. 17Nɔɔno ná wo lage gwona yam konto, kotu bá wane o yeigi woŋo naa o kwei woŋo o yeigi. Gwona yam konto nam mo bere juru kom yere, naa namba kalo na bere ko yere dem to.
18Konto nam tei se n ta‑n jege swa mo. Nmo yi ná poore, n wó wane n boŋe n lɔre juru kom namba kam kuri. Namba kam bere nabiinu yere mo. Ka nam ye bia yaredo de fuseredo-baredo (666) mo.

english_text:
The Lamb and His 144,000 Followers
1 I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion! With him were 144,000, who had his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads. 2 Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps. 3And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the 144,000 who had been rescued from the earth. 4All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth. 5 They never tell lies, and they are innocent.
The Messages of the Three Angels
6I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth. 7The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
8 A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
9Finally, a third angel came and shouted:
Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead. 10 You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
11 If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
12God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
13Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.”
The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.”
The Earth Is Harvested
14 I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand. 15 An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.” 16The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
17Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven. 18After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.” 19The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger. 20 The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about 300 kilometers long and almost deep enough to cover a horse.
translation_text:
Pipeila kam de ka nɔɔna bam taane
1Amo laam ma nii a na Pipeila kam ka na zege Zion peo kom yuu ne. Nɔɔna morro bi de finna-bana bam (144,000) maa tɔge ba wora. Pipeila kam yere de ka kwo yere dem ma popone ba tira ne. 2A ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne. Ka maa dɔna nenɛɛne na na wuuri ye doa bage tei to. A na nigi kwora kam konto to, ka kwori dem maa nye de kɔn-magena na mage ba kwanno tei to. 3Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maa zege ko yɔɔre Wɛ paare yituŋu kom, de wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to, de nakwa bam. Ba maa leeni leiŋ-doŋa kalo nɔɔn-nɔɔno na bá wane o zamese-ka to ko ná dae nɔɔna morro bi de finna-tena bam yerane (144,000). Banto mo ye balo Wɛ na le logo baŋa nabiina wone ye o ŋwe ba wɛleera jene to. 4Banto nam mo chege ba tete de wo-digiru keim, ye ba wo tɔge ka-laga wo-zɔɔna kikia. Banto yeini ba tɔge Pipeila kam kwaga mo ba vei jei selo maama ka na wó vo to. Wɛ mo le-ba nabiina wone o ŋwe ba wɛleera jene, pa se banto da yiga ba ji o nyem, de Pipeila kam de nyem. 5Banto nam wo fɔge ba fɔ vwa. Ba maa jege bora ye tusim tera.
Wɛ malese setɔ na tage wonnu telo to
6Amo laam ma na maleka tu wodwoŋi, ka na jaane wɛyuu ne. Ka maa jege Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kalo na jege kuri taa wuu to se ka tɔɔle ka bere balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to.
Ko nam ye paare dim jei sem maama ne mo,
de nabiina dwi maama,
de taana dwi maama tiina,
de teene maama tiina.
7Ka maa ŋɔɔne de kwor-dɛa ka we, “Nam kɔre-na Wɛ se á daare á ta‑á pa‑o zula, kolo ŋwaane maŋa kam yia se o di nabiina taane. Nam kuni-na dwoona á zuli wolo na ke wɛyuu jei sem, de tega baŋa kam, de naneo kom, dedaane buli sem to.”
8Maleka kadwoŋi ma saŋe ka kwaga ye ka tɛ ka we, “Babilon te-fɔrɔ kom chɔge ywoo! Ko yɔɔre ko chɔge mo zɔŋŋ. Ko déem nam yeini ko pa nabiina dwi maama mo tɔge ba ke ko kabwoŋa kikia yam, nenɛɛne sa-dɛɛra mo ba nyɔge ba su tei.”
9Malese setɔ tu de ma saŋe, ye ka tɛ de kwor-dɛa ka we, “Wolo maama ná zuli varem wom de o kamɔgɔ kom, ye ba daare ba la ba gwona yam o tiri ne naa o jeŋa ne, 10Wɛ ban-lom dem laam wó ba kotu baŋa ne, ne ba lwogi sa-dɛɛra mo ba su na-zoŋa ba pa o nyɔ o su tei. Wolo maama ná sɛ varem wom konto, chilibugu kolo na jege mini to mo wó di kotu pa o na cham dedɛ Wɛ malese sem yiga ne, de Pipeila kam yiga ne. 11Mini dem na di ba yera yam tei to wó pa se nyoa nwoŋi da ka yɔɔre ka taa zaŋe mo taa taa se ko taa vei wuu. Balo maama na zuli varem wom de o kamɔgɔ kom to, de balo maama de na lage gwona yalo na bere o yere dem to bá na siu kɔtaa, wea de tete maama.”
12Konto mo tei Wɛ nɔɔna bam jege se ba taa fɔge ba zege de pu-dɛa. Banto mo ye balo na sɛ Wɛ nia yam ye ba kwori ba jege wo-dedoa de Yezu to.
13Amo laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne telaao ne ka we, “Nam popone tento: Ko na zege zem se ko taa vei to, balo na sɛ dé Teiru wom ye ba ba ba te to, wó taa jege yu-ywoŋo.” Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma leiri ko we, “Ko ye chega mo. Banto wó sii de ba totoŋ-chɛɛra yam, kolo ŋwaane ba keim-laaro mo wó taa tɔge-ba.”
Wɛ borem maŋa kam na ye tei to
14Amo laam ma nii a na kunkwoŋ-pwoŋo, ye wolo na nye de nabiinu bu to jei ko baŋa ne. Sabu-seŋa yipuga ma pu o yuu ne, ye o daare o zei sekwara kalo na jege ni to. 15Maleka kadwoŋi ma nwoŋi Wɛ diga kam wone. Ka ma tɔɔle baŋa baŋa ka ta de wolo wom na jei kunkwoŋo kom baŋa ne to ka we, “Logo baŋa faao kom laam bege ko ti. Kwei n sekwara kam n ma n gaane faao kom, se ko maŋa kam yia.” 16Wolo wom na jei kunkwoŋo kom baŋa ne to laam ma vuvugi o sekwara kam logo baŋa ne o ma gaane ko wodiiru tem.
17Amo daa ma na maleka kadwoŋi na nwoŋi Wɛ diga kalo na wo telaao ne to wone, ye ka de jege sekwara kalo na jege ni to. 18Maleka kadwoŋi na nii mini baŋa ne to ma nwoŋi Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem seeni. Ka ma tɔɔle de kwor-dɛa ka ta de maleka kalo na zei sekwara kam to ka we, “Kwei n sekwara kam na jege ni to n ma n gwori Vini tio-bia bam, se logo baŋa tio-bia bam konto laam bege ba ti.”
19Maleka kam laam ma kwei ka sekwara kam ka fere Vini tio-bia bam ka gwori. Ka ma kwei-ba ka de kazɔ-zɔŋɔ wone se ba tɛ ba ma ke sana, se ko bere Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom na wó ba nabiina baŋa tei to. 20Kazɔgɔ kom maa zege teo kom dáa ne mo. Ba maa nɔne tio-bia bam ko wone se ba nyoa bam taa nwoŋa. Ba nyoa bam na nwoŋi to maa ye jana. Jana bam ma nwoŋi ba pɛɛle tega ne ba vo nenɛɛne stadia moro dedoa de bia yaredo (1,600), ye ba na luuna tei to diini ko maŋe de siseiŋa ni mo.

english_text:
The Last of the Terrible Troubles
1After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
2Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps, 3 and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing,
“Lord God All-Powerful,
you have done great
and marvelous things.
You are the ruler
of all nations,
and you do what is
right and fair.
4 Lord, who doesn't honor
and praise your name?
You alone are holy,
and all nations will come
and worship you,
because you have shown
that you judge
with fairness.”
5 After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open. 6And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold. 7One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever. 8 The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_text:
Malese serepɛ de se yaara dwi dwi taane
1Amo laam ma na wo-kenkagele dedwoŋi wɛyuu ne, de na tiini de dana ye de ba jege dwoŋi. A ma na Wɛ malese serepɛ na wora, ye se dedoa dedoa jege yaara dwi dwi se se pa ya ja nɔɔna. Yaara yarepɛ yam konto mo lage ya kweeli, kolo ŋwaane yanto ná ke ya ti, Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom laam wó ti. 2Amo ma daare a na woŋo na nye de naneo. Ko maa nyeena ne gelaase na nyeene tei to, ye ko nye ne mini mo gwaane da tei. Amo ta ma na balo na wane varem wom dam dem, de o kamɔgɔ kom dam dem, ko woli de o yere dem namba kam dam dem de to. Banto maa zege naneo kolo na nyeena lanyerane to ni ne. Ba maa zei kwanno telo Wɛ na pɛ-ba to. 3Ba maa leeni leiŋa kalo na ye Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses nyem to. Ka ma kwori ka ye Pipeila kam de nyem mo. Ba ma leeni ba seini Wɛ ba we,
“Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo kikia yam tiini ya dana
ye ya ba jege dwoŋi.
Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama Pɛ,
nmo chwei sem yɔɔre se tɔge chega mo.
4Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na bá kɔre nmo.
Nɔɔna maama nam wó taa zuli nmo yere dem.
Nmo yerane mo ye wo-pwoŋo tu chekke.
Logo baŋa dwi maama tiina wó ba
ba kuni dwoona nmo yiga ne ba zuli‑m,
kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna maama wó na
nmo kikia yam na jege chega tei to.”
5Ba leiŋa kam na ti konto to, amo ma nii Wɛ telaao ne a na Wɛ wara-vwei dem de de di-yuu kom ni na pore. 6Wɛ malese serepɛ sem na jege yaara dwi dwi kuni berepɛ to ma nwoŋi diga kam wone. Se ma zo gare-fefale selo na tiini se nyeena pele-pele to, ye se daare se vɔ sabu-seŋa kili se nyɔɔna ne. 7Wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to dedoa laam ma zaŋe ko kwei sabu-seŋa zwe serepɛ ko pa malese serepɛ sem. Zwe sem konto nam mo su de Wɛ ban-lom dem. Wonto nam mo jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu. 8Wɛ dam dem de o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ma pa nyoa nwoŋi ka su o diga kam ni maama. Nyoa kam ma pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware diga kam wo o zo, se ko taa nii maŋa kam yaara yarepɛ yam na ke ya ti malese serepɛ sem jeŋa ne to.

english_text:
The Bowls of God's Anger
1From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
2 The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
3The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
4 The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood. 5Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say,
“You have always been,
and you always will be
the holy God.
You had the right
to judge in this way.
6They poured out the blood
of your people
and your prophets.
So you gave them blood
to drink as they deserve!”
7After this, I heard
the altar shout,
“Yes, Lord God All-Powerful,
your judgments are honest
and fair.”
8The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire. 9Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
10 The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain. 11And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
12 The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east. 13An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet. 14These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
15 Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
16 Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
17As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!” 18 There were flashes of lightning, roars of thunder, and the worst earthquake in all history. 19 The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger. 20 Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared. 21 Hailstones, weighing about 50 kilograms each, fell from the sky on people. Finally, the people cursed God, because the hail was so terrible.
translation_text:
1Amo laam ma ni kwor-dɛa na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone, ye ka ta de Wɛ malese serepɛ sem ka we, “Kwei-na zwe serepɛ selo Wɛ ban-lom dem na wo se wone to á ja vo á lwo á yage logo baŋa ne.”
2Da-yiga maleka kam ma kwei ka zoŋa kam ka ja vo ka lwo ka yage logo baŋa ne. Ka na ke konto to, ŋɔn-zana ma ja balo na lage varem wom gwona yam ye ba zuli ko kamɔgɔ kom to.
3Maleka kalo na saŋe to ma lwo ka zoŋa kam ka yage naneo kom wone. Ko na bam ma ji ne too jana na ye tei to. Woŋo maama na zoore naneo kom wone to ma te.
4Malese setɔ tu wom ma lwo o zoŋa kam o yage bu-tole sem wone de buli sem de wone. Se na bam ma ji jana. 5Amo ma ni Wɛ maleka kalo na nii bwi sem baŋa ne to na we:
“Wo-pwoŋo Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo na maŋe n wora boboa ne
ye n daa‑n ta wora to,
nmo tɔge chega de nmo na ke tei n waare-ba to.
6Kokuri banto go n nɔɔna bam de n sampwori sem
pa se ba jana nwoŋi.
Nmo laam ma‑n pa na bam ji jana
se nɔɔna bam konto de nyɔ.
Mo kolo na maŋe de ba keim dem to.”
7Amo ma daare a ni kwora kadwoŋi na ŋɔɔne Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem seeni ka we:
“Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ,
nmo na di nɔɔna taane tei to
yɔɔre ko tɔge chega mo.”
8Malese sena tu wom ma kwei o zoŋa kam o lwo o yage wea kam yera ne. Wea kam ma jwoŋi dam se ka wulim dem zwɛ nɔɔna de mini. 9Ka mini dem na tiini de zwɛ nɔɔna konto to, ba ma twe Wɛ yere dem, o na tei yaara yam konto to ŋwaane. Ba nam wo leiri ba wo de ba kikia yam se ba daare ba zuli Wɛ.
10Malese senu tu wom ma lwo o zoŋa kam varem wom paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne. Lim ma ba de li varem wom paare dim jei sem maama. Nɔɔna ma done ba yeila de ba yaara yam. 11Ba ma ŋɔɔne ba twe Telaao Tu Wɛ wom, ba yaara yam de ba yera ŋɔna yam ŋwaane. Ba nam daa ta wo leiri ba wo de ba kikia yam.
12Malese seredo tu wom ma lwo o zoŋa kam o yage Yuferata bu-zaŋa kam wone. Ka na bam ma we, ye ko daare chwoŋa ko pa pwa balo na nwoŋi wɛ-puli jei sem ne to se ba wane ba bɛ. 13Amo ma daare a na chichiri-zɔɔna yatɔ na nye de mantwaaro to. Ba dedoa ma nwoŋi kayanchɔrɔ kom ni ne. Wodwoŋi de ma nwoŋi varem wom ni ne, ye dedoa kam de nwoŋi varem wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ sampwora ye o gane nɔɔna to ni ne. 14Chichiribia bam konto ye setaane nyena mo, ye ba wae ba ke wo-kenkagela. Ba ma zaŋe ba vo logo baŋa pwa bam maama tei se ba maama la daane ba ti ba yiga jara ŋwaane Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom dɛ ne.
Yezu tage o we:
15“Cheigi-na. A lage a ba ne ŋweeno na dare o ba tei to mo. Wolo na fɔge o che o tete to wó taa jege yu-ywoŋo. Wolo na yei o gwaaro tem tiŋim to, amo ná pɔpɔ a ba konto, chaveera bá ja‑o nɔɔna yiga ne, o na bá zaŋe de kuri-nɔrɔ to ŋwaane.”
16Chichiribia batɔ bam ma pa logo baŋa pwa bam la daane jeiga kadwoŋi ne. Ba maa bwoi jeiga kam konto de Juu tiina taane ba we, ‘Amagedon’.
17Malese serepɛ tu wom laam ma lwo o zoŋa kam wɛyuu ne. Kwor-dɛa laam ma ŋɔɔne Wɛ diga kam paare yituŋu kom jei sem ne ka we, “Ko ke ko ti.” 18Ka na tage konto to, doa maa pepela ka baga ka wuura. Sɔɔ ma tiini ko gaale ye tega kam de ziziŋi. Tega kam na tiini ka ziziŋi tei to ba jege dwoŋi. Tega nam maŋe ka wo ziziŋi konto dwoŋi ye nabiina wora logo baŋa ne. 19Te-fɔrɔ kolo yere na ye Babilon to ma yare kuni betɔ ko chɔge. Logo baŋa dwi tiina teene dem maama de ma vi tega ne. Wɛ maa wo swei te-fɔrɔ Babilon ni ne se o waare-ko. O ban-zɔŋɔ kom ma tiini ko ba teo kom baŋa, nenɛɛne o lwogi sa-dɛɛra mo o su na-zoŋa pa se ko nyɔ ko su tei. 20Tega kalo maama na wo naneo tetare ne to ma fɔɔre ka tiga jei ne, ye peero tem de yɔɔre te jei. 21Do-kandwa na duna ne luuru tei to maa nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ya toe nɔɔna baŋa ne. Nɔɔna bam ma ŋɔɔne ba twe Wɛ yere, do-kandwa yam na pɛ ba na yaara dedɛ to ŋwaane.

english_text:
The Prostitute and the Beast
1 One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans. 2 Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
3 With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns. 4 The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done. 5On her forehead a mysterious name was written:
I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
6I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me, 7and the angel said:
Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns. 8 The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
9Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings. 10Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
11You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
12 The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time. 13They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast. 14 These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
15The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages. 16The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire. 17God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
18The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_text:
Kaane na dɔge varem tei to
1Malese serepɛ sem na jege zwe serepɛ sem to dedoa ma ba ka ta de amo ka we, “Ba se a bere‑m Wɛ na lage o pa ka-tola kalo na dana to na waarem tei to. Ka-tola kam konto jeiŋa jei mo ye jeiga kalo bwi na daga da to. 2Logo baŋa pwa bam yeini ba ke bwoorim de ka-tola kam konto. Balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to de maa tiini ba bwoori de-ka, ne nɔɔno na nyɔge sana o bugi tei to.”
3Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam ma ba amo tei de dam, ye a na we maleka kam kale-ne ka ja ka vo kagoa yuu. Jei sem konto ne mo amo nɛ kaane, o na dɔge juru kodwoŋi na ye nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to baŋa ne. Yera yalo na twe Wɛ to ma popone juru kom yera ne. Ko maa jege yuni terepɛ de nyea fuga. 4Kaane wom ma zo gwaaro telo na ye nason-pupwiu de nasonno chwɛ-chwɛ to. O yera maa jege wonnu dedɛ telo na nyeene to. Te nam ye sabu-seŋa de kandwa-nyenno mo. O ma zei sabu-seŋa zoŋa, ye ka ni su de wo-zɔɔna yalo na bere o bwoorim kikia yam na jege digiru tei to. 5Yere delo kuri na seigi to ma popone o tiri ne de we:
Babilon kolo na ye te-fɔrɔ to.
Ka-tole maama nu,
de logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna maama nu.
6Amo na nɛ kaane wom to mo a maane we o nyɔge Wɛ nɔɔna balo na bere Yezu chega kam ye ba go-ba to jana bam mo o su, ne o nyɔge sana mo o bugi tei.
Amo na nɛ‑o konto to, ko ma tiini ko so-ne. 7Maleka kam ma bwei-ne ka we, “Ko ke‑m yaau se bɛ mo? Ko ná ye juru kolo na jege yuni terepɛ tem de nyea fuga to, de kaane wolo na dɔge o baŋa ne to, amo wó pa n lɔre ba kuri na ye tei to. 8Juru kolo nmo na nɛ to ya ŋwe mo. Ko nam daa tera. Ko daare se ko nwoŋi gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom wone mo, se ko laam vo ko na chɔgem. Ko ná ye balo na zoore logo baŋa ne ye ba yera maŋe ya wo popone ya tiŋi Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone maŋa kam logo baŋa ta na tera to, ba ná nɛ juru kom, ko wó so ba maama. Ko déem ya ŋwe mo, ye ko laam daa tera. Ko nam wó jwoori ko ba ko nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne.
9Konto mo tei n jege se n ta‑n jege boboŋ-dɛɛra de swa. Juru kom yuni terepɛ tem bere zwonnu terepɛ na ye tei to mo. Tento maa ye zwonnu telo kaane wom na jei te baŋa ne to mo. Yuni tem ta kwori te bere pwa barepɛ na ye tei to mo. 10Pwa bam konto banu maŋe ba to mo. Ba dedoa mo wora leile. Wolo na kweeli to ta wo tu. Ko daare, o ná tua, o paare dem bá dáane dedɛ. 11Juru kom tete kolo déem ya na ŋwe ye ko laam daa tera to bere pɛ wolo na ke ba wone nana to mo. Wonto mo ye pwa barepɛ balo na dɛ yiga to wo nɔɔno. O nam ná tua, o de laam wó vo o na chɔgem.
12Nyea fuga yalo nmo na nɛ to bere pwa fuga na ye tei to mo. Pwa bam konto ta wo jwoŋi ba paare dem. Ba nam wó ba ba jwoŋi dam se ba tɔge de varem wom ba taa tei nɔɔna, se ko maŋe de awa dedoa yerane. 13Pwa fuga bam maama jege boboŋe dedwe mo. Ba maa wó kwei ba dam maama ba ke juru kom jeŋa ne. 14Ba maa wó ke jara de wolo wom na ye Pipeila kam to. Pipeila kam nam wó wane-ba ka di, ka na ye wolo na ye yuu tiina maama Yuu-tu, de pwa maama Pɛ to ŋwaane. Balo na tɔge de wonto ye ba wane jara yam to mo ye balo o na maŋe o kuri se ba taa ye o nɔɔna to. Banto mo yɔɔre ba jege wo-dedoa ded‑o.”
15Maleka kam daa ta ma ta de amo ka we, “Ko ná ye bwi selo nmo na nɛ ye ka-tola kam jei da to, se bere logo baŋa teene de te nɔn-bia bam, de paare dim jei sem, de taana dwi maama tiina na ye tei to mo. 16Nyea fuga yalo nmo na nɛ to, de juru kom tete wó taa chuli ka-tola kam. Ba nam wó vere o wonnu tem maama o tei ne ba daare‑o kalambwolo. Ba laam wó di o ya-nɔna yam, ye ba daare ba zwɛ‑o de mini. 17Ba wó chɔge‑o konto, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ maŋe o pa se ba boboŋa taa ye konto, ye ba jege ni dedwe se ba ke ba dam maama juru kom jeŋa ne mo. Ko jege se ko taa ye konto mo, se ko vo ko yi maŋa kalo Wɛ taane dem na bere kolo to na wó ji chega, ye o boboŋa seene ya ke to. 18Ko daare kaane wolo nmo na nɛ ye o ye ka-tola to mo ye te-fɔrɔ kolo na tei logo baŋa pwa bam maama to.”

english_text:
The Fall of Babylon
1I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory. 2 The angel shouted,
“Fallen! Powerful Babylon
has fallen
and is now the home
of demons.
It is the den
of every filthy spirit
and of all unclean birds,
and every dirty
and hated animal.
3 Babylon's evil and immoral wine
has made all nations drunk.
Every king on earth
has slept with her,
and every merchant on earth
is rich because of
her evil desires.”
4 Then I heard another voice
from heaven shout,
“My people, you must escape
from Babylon.
Don't take part in her sins
and share her punishment.
5 Her sins are piled
as high as heaven.
God has remembered the evil
she has done.
6 Treat her as she
has treated others.
Make her pay double
for what she has done.
Make her drink twice as much
of what she mixed
for others.
7 That woman honored herself
with a life of luxury.
Reward her now
with suffering and pain.
“Deep in her heart
Babylon said,
‘I am the queen!
Never will I be a widow
or know what it means
to be sad.’
8And so, in a single day
she will suffer the pain
of sorrow, hunger, and death.
Fire will destroy
her dead body,
because her judge
is the powerful Lord God.”
9 Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire. 10Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say,
“Pity that great
and powerful city!
Pity Babylon!
In a single hour
her judgment has come.”
11 Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods. 12 There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble. 13No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
14Babylon, the things
your heart desired
have all escaped
from you.
Every luxury
and all your glory
will be lost forever.
You will never
get them back.
15 The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning. 16Then they shouted,
“Pity the great city
of Babylon!
She dressed in fine linen
and wore purple
and scarlet cloth.
She had jewelry
made of gold
and precious stones
and pearls.
17 Yet in a single hour
her riches disappeared.”
Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea. 18 When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
19 They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said,
“Pity the great city
of Babylon!
Everyone who sailed the seas
became rich
from her treasures.
But in a single hour
the city was destroyed.
20 The heavens should be happy
with God's people
and apostles and prophets.
God has punished her
for them.”
21 A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said,
“This is how the great city
of Babylon
will be thrown down,
never to rise again.
22 The music of harps and singers
and of flutes and trumpets
will no longer be heard.
No workers will ever
set up shop in that city,
and the sound
of grinding grain
will be silenced forever.
23Lamps will no longer shine
anywhere in Babylon,
and couples will never again
say wedding vows there.
Her merchants ruled
the earth,
and by her witchcraft
she fooled all nations.
24 On the streets of Babylon
is found the blood
of God's people
and of his prophets,
and everyone else.”
translation_text:
Te-fɔrɔ Babilon na chɔge tei to
1Maleka kam na tage konto ka ti to, amo ma na maleka kadwoŋi na nwoŋi telaao ne ka maa beene logo baŋa. Ka maa tiini ka jege dam ye ka nenɔŋa kam zeiŋi pwooni ka pa logo baŋa maama peere. 2Ka ma tɔɔle baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa ka we:
“Babilon te-fɔrɔ kom chɔge ywoo!
Ko yɔɔre ko chɔge mo.
Setaana yerane laam mo zoore ko wone,
ye chichiri-zɔɔna dwi maama de zoore da.
Zuna de vara balo nɔɔna na chula ye ba ba lae to
dwi maama maa tɔge ba wora.
3Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama ma to
teo kom konto kabwoŋa chwei sem wone,
ne ba nyɔge ko sa-dɛɛra mo ba su tei.
Logo baŋa pwa bam ma tɔge ba ke bwoorim de-ko.
Logo baŋa pipim-piina ma tiini ba di nyɔɔre
teo kom konto baŋa ne,
kolo ŋwaane ko nɔɔna bam swoi
se ba taa chɔge sabu dedɛ.”
4Amo laam ma ni kwora kadwoŋi na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we:
“Amo nɔɔna bam, nwoŋi-na teo kom wone,
se á yé tɔge ko wo-balwaaro chwei sem,
se á yé tɔge á na ko yaara yam.
5Kokuri ko wɛleera yam daga dedɛ
te daŋe da-baŋa ne te yi wɛyuu.
Wɛ nam yei ko keim-lwanno tem maama ni ne.
6Chɔge-na teo kom se ko maŋe de konto na chɔge nɔɔna badwonna tei to.
Pa-na ko chɛ ko yera ne se ko dwoni
ko na pɛ ko chɛ nɔɔna yera ne tei to.
Fe-na-ko se ko nyɔ sa-dɛɛra balo na tiini ba dana
ba dwoi konto sana bam ko na pae nɔɔna nyɔ to.
7Pipiri-na teo kom ywoni dem de ko wo-laaro tem
se te jwoori te ji cham de yaara te pa-ko.
Kokuri teo kom nye de kaane wolo na yeini o tɛ o we,
‘Amo di paare mo ye kolokolo daa bá daane-ne.
Amo dae kadeim, ye a yiga bá fɔge ka nyɔne.’
8Teo kom na bere ko tete kamunni to ŋwaane,
yaara dwi maama wó pɔpɔ ya ba ko baŋa dɛ dedwe wone.
Jawe-chɛɛro de yi-nyɔna de kana wó ba te ja-ko.
Mini de maa wó di-ko.
Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ jege dam-fɔrɔ,
ye wonto mo wó pa teo kom na waarem.”
9Ko ná ye logo baŋa pwa balo na tɔge ba ke teo kom kabwoŋa kikia yam ye ba di ywoni daane to, ba ná nɛ teo kom na jege mini tei to, ba wó taa keera de wo-chechɔgɔ. 10Ba na kɔre ko yaara yam to ŋwaane, ba wó taa zege yiga yiga ye ba nii ko nyoa kam. Ba wó taa chwoosa ye ba we:
“Ei! Lɛɛro wora! Lɛɛro yi te-fɔrɔ kom!
Babilon ya tiini ko jege dam.
Ko laam nam tu ko chɔge lela,
awa dedoa wone.”
11Logo baŋa pipim-piina bam de wó taa keera ye ba nyɔne ba yiga teo kom chɔgem ŋwaane, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera se ba taa yeigi ba zela yam. 12Zela yalo ba na jege ba yeigi to ye sabu-seŋa wonnu, de lu-nyenno wonnu, de kandwa-nyenno, ko woli de gwaaro dwi dwi, te na ye gare-fefale, de gare-nyenno, de gare-sonno telo na ye chwɛ-chwɛ to mo. Ba ta maa jege da-ŋwe dwi maama, de wonnu dedɛ telo ba na mɛ tuu yeila, de da-laaro, de channa, de luu, de pe-siswollu ba ke to. 13Ba ta maa kwori ba jege terale nuga dwi maama, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa dwi maama, de liri sedwonna, ko woli de sana, de nuga, de bworobworo muni, de kamaana, ko woli de naane, de pei, de sisei, de se torokooro. Ba ta jaane kabɛ ba yeiga.
14Ba laam maa wó ta de teo kom ba we, “Wo-laaro telo maama nmo fera na zo to daa tera. Nmo jejegero tem de n nenɔŋa kam maama laam jei. Nmo daa‑n bá‑n na wonnu tem konto maŋa de maŋa.”
15Pipim-piina balo na tiini ba na nyɔɔre teo kom baŋa ne to wó taa zege yiga yiga, ba na kɔre ko yaara yam to ŋwaane. Ba maa wó taa keera 16ye ba chwoosa ba we:
“Ei! Lɛɛro wora!
Teo kamunu konto tiini ko jege nenɔŋa.
Ko nɔɔna bam maa zoore gare-nyenno, ye ba yera jege sabu-seŋa wonnu de kandwa-nyenno.
17Ko jejegero tem maama laam ma ba te chɔge lela, awa dedoa wone.”
Ko nam ná ye balo maama na wo naneo wone ba lage ba ni-wodiu to, ko ná ye balo na cho nabworo to, de balo na toŋe nabworo ŋwaane to, de balo na zo nabworo se ba vo jei to, ba maama wó taa zege yiga yiga mo ba nii teo kom. 18Banto ná nɛ nyoa kam na zaŋe teo kom ne, ba wó ta baŋa baŋa ba we, “Teo kamunu konto dwoŋi tera.” 19Ba maa wó nyɔne ba yiga, ye ba chwoosa ba we,
“Ei! Lɛɛro wora! Lɛɛro yi te-fɔrɔ kom!
Ko na tiini ko jege jejegero tei to pɛ se
balo maama na tei nabwooru to di nyɔɔre ko baŋa ne.
Ko laam ma ba ko chɔge lela,
awa dedoa wone.”
20Abam balo na zoore Wɛ telaao ne to ta‑á chaka de wopwolo teo kom chɔgem dem ŋwaane. Abam balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna to, ta‑á jege-na wopwolo, ko woli de Wɛ totoŋa nakwa, de o sampwori sem maama. Wɛ mo di teo kom taane, ye o pa abam jege bora.
21Wɛ maleka kadwoŋi na tiini ka dana to laam ma kwei kandwɛ-kamunu, ne nɔŋ-zɔŋɔ na ye tei to. Ka ma dole-ko ka yage naneo kom wone ye ka we,
“Ba nam wó kwei te-fɔrɔ Babilon de
ba dole ba yage konto dwoŋi mo,
ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá na ko jei.
22Ko wó ji di-dwonnu yerane.
Nɔɔna daa bá taa wo ko wone
se ba taa mage kwanno, naa ba taa leena,
naa ba taa wui wi naa nabwanno.
Gɔgɔ dwi maama de bá taa wo ko wone,
ye nɔŋɔ kwori de daa bá taa zaŋe ko wone.
23Min-zwoŋo mini de daa bá tɔrege ko wone.
Kadiri sɔɔ de daa bá ke ko wone.
Te-fɔrɔ kom pipim-piina bam déem mo ye logo baŋa dedɛɛra yiga tiina.
Ko liri kikia yam ma soge logo baŋa dwi tiina maama boboŋa.
24Ko ná ye Wɛ sampwori selo ba na go to,
de Wɛ nɔɔna balo maama ba na go to,
ba toone dem zege teo kom konto yera ne mo.
Balo maama ba na go logo baŋa ne to chao wó jeini teo kom yuu ne mo.”

english_text:
1After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting,
“Praise the Lord!
To our God belongs
the glorious power to save,
2 because his judgments
are honest and fair.
That filthy prostitute
ruined the earth
with shameful deeds.
But God has judged her
and made her pay
the price for murdering
his servants.”
3 Then the crowd shouted,
“Praise the Lord!
Smoke will never stop rising
from her burning body.”
4After this, the 24 elders and the four living creatures all knelt before the throne of God and worshiped him. They said, “Amen! Praise the Lord!”
The Marriage Supper of the Lamb
5 From the throne a voice said,
“If you worship
and fear our God,
give praise to him,
no matter who you are.”
6 Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying,
“Praise the Lord!
Our Lord God All-Powerful
now rules as king.
7So we will be glad and happy
and give him praise.
The wedding day of the Lamb
is here,
and his bride is ready.
8She will be given
a wedding dress
made of pure
and shining linen.
This linen stands for
the good things
God's people have done.”
9 Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
10I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.”
The Rider on the White Horse
11 I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war. 12 He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
13 The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.” 14He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen. 15 From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made. 16On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
17 I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast! 18You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
19I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army. 20 But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur. 21But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_text:
Wɛ telaao wopwolo kom taane
1Amo laam ma ni kwor-dɛa, ka na nye de nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa telaao ne ba we:
“Aleluya!
Debam Tu Wɛ mo ye verem tu,
de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ tu, de dam tu.
2O borem dem yɔɔre de ye chega mo.
Ko ná ye ka-tola kalo na dana
ye ka bwoŋa kikia yam jage jei maama ya chɔge logo baŋa to,
Wɛ di ka taane pa ka to.
O ma waare-ka, ka na pɛ o tontoŋena bam te to ŋwaane.”
3Ba daa ma ta baŋa baŋa ba we:
“Aleluya!
Mini na di-ka to, ko nyoa kam wó taa zaŋa mo taa,
se ko taa vei wuu.”
4Nakwa finlei-bana bam, de wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to laam ma kuni dwoona Wɛ yiga ne ba pa‑o zula, o na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to. Ba ma zuli‑o ye ba we:
“Ameena! Aleluya!”
5Kwora kadwoŋi laam ma ŋɔɔne paare yituŋu kom seeni ka we:
“Abam balo maama na ye Wɛ tontoŋena to,
ta‑á tei-na dé Tu Wɛ wom.
Abam balo maama na kɔre‑o to,
ko ná ye nɔn-kamuna de nabwona,
á ta‑á zuli‑o.”
6Amo laam ma ni sɔɔ, ko na nye de nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa, ye ko dɔna ne na mo wuuri ye doa baga tei. Ko maa ŋɔɔne ko we:
“Aleluya!
Debam Tu, Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo di paare.
7Pa-na dé taa chaka de wopwolo,
ye dé zuli‑o o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.
Kokuri to, wolo na ye Pipeila kam to kadiri dem maŋa laam yia.
O kaane wom ti o yiga se o zo‑o.
8Ba kwei gare-fefale selo na tiini se nyeena pele-pele to mo
ba pa kaane wom se o zo.”
Gwaaro tem konto nam mo bere Wɛ nɔɔna bam keim-laaro tem na ye tei to.
9Maleka kam laam ma ta de amo ka we, “Popone tento n tiŋi: Ko ná ye balo ba na bwoŋi se ba tɔge ba di Pipeila kam kadiri dem wodiu kom to, banto jege yu-ywoŋo mo.” Ka daa ma ta ka we, “Nmo na nigi kolo maama to ye Wɛ kwora chekke mo.”
10Amo ma kuni dwoona ka yiga ne se a zuli-ka. Ka ma ta ka we, “Yé ke konto. Amo de ye Wɛ tontoŋeno mo, ne nmo de n nu-bia balo maama na bere we ba tɔge Yezu chega kam to de na ye tei to. N maŋe se n zuli Wɛ mo.”
Ko ye Yezu chega kam konto mo pae Wɛ sampwori sem tɔɔle o kwora.
11Amo laam ma nii a na Wɛ telaao ni na pore. A ma na siseiŋ-pwoŋa. Wolo na dɔge ka baŋa ne to ye ‘Wo-dedoa Tu’ de ‘Chega Tu’. O na bore nɔɔna taane tei to yɔɔre ko tɔge chega mo, ye o kwori o jaane jara de chega. 12O yia maa seene ne min-vogo tei. Paare yipwi dedɛ ma pu o yuu ne. Yere dedwoŋi ma popone o yera ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri-de, ko ná dae o tete yerane. 13Gare-dedɔrɔ kolo o na zo to ma bugi de jana. Ba maa bwoi‑o we, “Wɛ Botara kam”. 14Wɛ telaao jar-keira kɔgɔ kom ma pu o kwaga. Ba ma dɔge sisein-pwonnu baŋa ne, ye ba zo gare-fefale selo na ye napwonnu fase to. 15Se-zɔɔ kolo na tiini ko jege ni to maa nwoŋi o ni ne. O nam wó ma-ko o mage logo baŋa dwi tiina bam o de tega ne. O ta wó kwei luu-dedɔrɔ mo o ma wane-ba de o dam. O maa wó pa se Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom tiini ko ba ba baŋa, nenɛɛne o nɔne Vini tio-bia mo se ba nyoa bam taa nwoŋa tei. 16Yere dedwoŋi ma popone o gare-dedɔrɔ kom yera ne, de o chwei ne de we:
“Pwa maama Pɛ,
de yuu tiina maama Yuu-tu.”
17Amo laam ma na maleka kadwoŋi ka na zege wea kam tetare ne. Ka ma bage baŋa baŋa ka ta de zuna balo maama na jaane wɛyuu ne to ka we, “Ba-na á la daane se á tɔge á di wodi-fɔrɔ kolo Wɛ na ke to. 18Ba-na se á di pwa ya-nɔna, de jar-keira yiga tiina nɔna, de nɔn-babɛ nɔna, ko woli de sisei de se diina bam nɔna, de nɔɔna dwi maama nɔna, ko ná ye kabɛ de balo na tei ba tete to de, ko woli de nɔn-kamuna de nabwona.”
19Amo ma daare a na varem wom, de logo baŋa pwa bam maama, de ba jar-keira bam na lage daane se ba ke jara de wolo wom na dɔge siseiŋa kam baŋa ne to de o jar-keira kɔgɔ kom. 20Ba ma ja varem wom ba vɔ, de wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ sampwora ye o gane nɔɔna to. Wonto ya mo ke wo-kenkagela o ma woli varem wom. O na ke wo-kenkagela yam konto to, o mɛ o gane balo na lage varem wom gwona yam ye ba daare ba zuli o kamɔgɔ kom to mo. Ba ma kwei banto balei ŋweene, ba ja vo ba de buga wone. Buga kam kanto ye kalo na jege mini ye chilibugu wora ko di to mo. 21Ba jar-keira kɔgɔ kom na daare to maama ma te. Se-zɔɔ kolo na nwoŋi sisein-diru wom ni ne to mo go-ba. Zuna bam maama ma ba ba di ba ya-nɔna yam ba su.

english_text:
The Thousand Years
1I saw an angel come down from heaven, carrying the key to the deep pit and a big chain. 2 He chained the dragon for 1,000 years. It is that old snake, who is also known as the devil and Satan. 3Then the angel threw the dragon into the pit. He locked and sealed it, so 1,000 years would go by before the dragon could fool the nations again. But after that, it would have to be set free for a little while.
4 I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for 1,000 years.
5-6These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for 1,000 years.
No other dead people were raised to life until 1,000 years later.
Satan Is Defeated
7At the end of the 1,000 years, Satan will be set free. 8 He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach, 9and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army. 10Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever.
The Judgment at the Great White Throne
11 I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go. 12 I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
13The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done. 14Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death. 15Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_text:
Twa biim taane
1Amo laam ma na maleka kadwoŋi na nwoŋi telaao ne ka maa tu logo baŋa. Ka maa zei bwor-bu se ka ma pore gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom ni dem, ye ka kwori ka zei chapon-zɔŋɔ. 2Ka ma zi kayanchɔrɔ kom ka vɔ taa, se ko vo ko yi bena moro dedoa. Kayanchɔrɔ kom konto maa ye basankwea kalo na maŋe ka wora faŋa faŋa to. Kanto kam mo ye vwa-nyena pɛ wom, ye ka kwori ka ye setaane tete. 3Maleka kam ma de-ka gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom wone ka pe. Ka ma daare ka kwoni bɔɔne dem ni se ka yé wane ka nwoŋi ka daa gane logo baŋa dwi tiina bam se ko vo ko yi bena moro kom na wó ti to. Maŋa kam kanto ná kɛ, ko laam jege se ba bwoli-ka ba yage se ko ke fenfee.
4Amo ma daare a na paare yitunnu, ye nɔɔna jei te baŋa ne. Banto ma jwoŋi dam se ba di nɔɔna taane. Ba maa ye balo ba ya na gwoni ba yuni ba na tɔge Yezu chega kam ye ba bere Wɛ kwora kam to ŋwaane. Ba maa wo sɛ se ba zuli varem wom naa o kamɔgɔ kom. Ba nam ta wo sɛ ba la varem wom gwona yam ba tira ne naa ba jea ne. Amo na nɛ ba jworru tem konto to, ba ma jwoori ba bi ba na ŋwea, ye ba tɔge de Yezu Krista ba di paare se ko yi bena moro. 5Twa biim dem konto mo ye delo na dɛ yiga de ke to. Twa balo maama na daare to nam wo bi maŋa kam konto ne. Bena moro kom ná tu ko ba ko ti mo banto de laam wó bi toone wone. 6Balo maama na tɔge ba woli da-yiga twa biim dem wone to jege yu-ywoŋo, ba na ye Wɛ tete nɔɔna to ŋwaane. Toone delo na lage de ke belei to daa bá wane-ba. Banto wó taa zege Baŋa Wɛ de Yezu Krista yiga ne mo ba pa zula ne kaanem tiina tei. Ba maa wó tɔge ded‑o ba di paare se ko yi bena moro kom.
7Bena moro kom ná tu ko kɛ, ba laam wó bwoli setaana pɛ wom se o nwoŋi bɔɔne dem ba na pe‑o da to wone. 8O maa wó vo o gane dwi tiina balo na wo logo baŋa jei sem maama ne to. Banto maa ye Wɛ dona mo, ye ba yera ye ‘Goga’ de ‘Magoga’. O maa wó pa ba la daane se ba ke jara. Ba kɔgɔ kom nɔn-bia wó taa daga dedɛ, ne buga ni kasolo bia na ye tei to mo. 9Ba maa wó tɔge logo baŋa jei maama ba vo ba gilimi Wɛ nɔɔna bam kɔgɔ kom na lage daane mɛ to. Teo kom konto mo ye kolo Wɛ na swoi dedɛ to. Mini laam ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne de ba de chɔge Wɛ dona bam kɔgɔ kom maama. 10Ko daare setaana pɛ wom na gane-ba to, ba ma dole wonto ba de buga kalo na jege mini ye chilibugu wora ko di to wone. Kanto mo ye buga kalo ba na maŋe ba de varem wom de wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ sampwora ye o gane nɔɔna to ba yage ka wone to. Dáane mo ba maama wó na cham wea de tete maama se ko taa vei wuu.
11Amo ma daare a na paare yituŋ-kamunu kolo na ye napwoŋo to, de wolo na jei ko baŋa ne to. Tega baŋa de wɛyuu maama ma duri te kɛ o yiga ne, ye te daa tera. 12Amo ma na balo na tege to, dedɛɛra de nabwona maama, ba zege paare yituŋu kom yiga ne. Nɔɔna ma puri twanno se ba nii. Ba ma daare ba puri tɔnɔ kodwoŋi na ye Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom to. Ba ma bore twa bam taane se ko maŋe de ba na ke kolo to, nenɛɛne ko na popone ko tiŋi twanno tem wone tei to. 13Naneo kom ma pa twa balo na maŋe ko wone to chwoŋa se ba nwoŋi. Toone de ma yage balo de na jaane to. Churu de ma yage ko nɔɔna bam. Ba ma bore twa bam konto maama taane se ko maŋe de ba na ke kolo to. 14Ba laam ma ja Toone de Churu ba dole ba de buga kam na jege mini to wone. Buga kam de ka mini dem mo bere toone belei tu na ye tei to. 15Nɔɔno wolo maama yere na maŋe de wo popone de ke Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone to, ba dole konto tu ba de buga kam na jege mini dem to wone mo.

english_text:
The New Heaven and the New Earth
1 I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea. 2 Then I saw New Jerusalem, the holy city, coming down from God in heaven. It was like a bride dressed in her wedding gown and ready to meet her husband.
3 I heard a loud voice shout from the throne:
God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people. 4 He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
5Then the one sitting on the throne said:
I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted. 6 Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty. 7 All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
8But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death.
The New Jerusalem
9I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.” 10 Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
11The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone. 12 The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel. 13Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west. 14The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
15 The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls. 16The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about 2,400 kilometers high and 2,400 kilometers wide. 17Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about 60 meters high.
18 The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal. 19Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald, 20the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst. 21Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
22I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple. 23 And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
24 Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there. 25 Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes. 26The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city. 27 But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_text:
Wɛ de nabiina wó taa zoore daane
1Amo laam ma na wɛyuu-doŋo dedaane te-doŋa na wora. Boboa wɛyuu kom de boboa tega baŋa kam pipiri te kɛ. Naneo de daa tera. 2Amo ma daare a na teo kolo Wɛ na pɔɔre o pa o tete ye ko yere ye Jerusalem te-doŋo kom to. Ko ma nwoŋi wɛyuu Wɛ tei ne ko maa tu logo baŋa. Ko ma yɔɔre ko kwɛ lanyerane ne kaane na ti o yiga se o zo baro tei to. 3Amo ma ni kwor-dɛa na ŋɔɔne paare yituŋu kom seeni ka we, “Wɛ tete sɔŋɔ laam mo wo nabiina tei ne. O nam wó taa zoore ba tei ne, ye ba wó taa ye o nɔɔna. Wɛ tete wó taa wo ba tei ne ye o nii-ba. 4O maa wó weeri ba maama yi-na se ba daa yé taa jege yi-nyɔna. Toone de daa bá taa wora. Wo-chechɔgɔ, de keira, de yaara maama de wó jei. Kokuri to, boboa wo-dwonnu tem kɛ.”
5Wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to laam ma ta o we, “Nii! Amo laam pɛ se wonnu maama ji wo-donno.” O daa ta ma ta de amo o we, “Popone wonnu tento n tiŋi, kolo ŋwaane taane dento jege chega ye de maŋe se nɔɔna sɛ-de.”
6O ma daare o we, “Wonnu tem ke te ti. Amo mo ye pulim jei de kweelim jeiga. Amo nam ta mo ye da-yiga tu de tiim tu. Na-nyɔm ná jege wolo maama, amo wó pa kotu chwoŋa se o nyɔ buli-yi delo na na pae ŋwea to zɛɛra. 7Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to mo wó jwoŋi wo-laaro tem konto. Amo Wɛ wó taa nii‑o, ye o taa ye a bu. 8Ko nam ná ye balo na kɔre cham to, de balo na pipiri ba kwaga ba ya Yezu to, de nɔn-wo-korro, de nɔn-gora, de balo na bwoori to, ko woli de liri-mwa tiina, de balo na kaane jwona to, dedaane vwa-nyena dwi maama, banto nam maŋe se ba vo ba misi buga kam na jege mini ye chilibugu de wora ko di to wone mo. Toone dem konto mo ye delo na ke belei to.”
9Maleka kadwoŋi laam ma ba amo tei. Ka nwoŋi malese serepɛ sem wone mo, se na jege zwe serepɛ sem de se wo yaara yarepɛ yalo na lage ya ke ya ma kweeli to. Ka ma ta de amo ka we, “Ba se a bere‑m ka-dooro wom, o na lage o zo wolo na ye Pipeila kam to.”
10Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam ma ba amo tei de dam, ye a na we maleka kam kale-ne ka ja ka vo peo-zɔŋɔ kolo na tiini ko dɔra to yuu. Ka ma bere-ne Wɛ tete teo kom, ko yere na ye Jerusalem ye ko maa nwoŋi wɛyuu Wɛ tei ne ko tu logo baŋa to. 11Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ma pa se teo kom nyeena lanyerane. Ko maa nye de kandwɛ-nyeno kolo yere na ye Yasepa to, ye ko nyeene pele-pele ne gelaase na nyeene tei to. 12Kabiri-kamunu kolo na dɔra to ma lɔ ko kaage teo kom. Kabira kam maa jege nia fuga-yalei. Wɛ malese fuga-selei maa zege nia yam konto dedoa dedoa ne. Isarele tiina dwia fuga-yalei yam yera ma popone nia yam baŋa ne. 13Teo kom sɛ sem maama jege nia yatɔ yatɔ mo. Yatɔ yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni. Yatɔ maa wo wɛ-puli jagwia seeni. Yatɔ maa wo wɛ-puli jazem seeni. Yatɔ maa daare ya wo wɛ-zoore seeni. 14Teo kom kabira kam kuri ma chwi pelwaaro fuga-telei baŋa ne. Pipeila kam totoŋa nakwa fuga-balei bam yera ma popone pelwaaro tem konto yera ne.
15Maleka kalo na ŋɔɔne de amo to maa zei sabu-seŋa nacheiga se ka ma maŋe teo kom na mae tei to, de ko nia yam de ko kabira kam de na mae tei to. 16Teo kom sɛ sena sem maama mara se mara mo. Maleka kam ma kwei ka nacheiga kam ka ma maŋe teo kom. Ko saŋa maama dedɔrem maa ye stadia morro fuga-telei (12,000). Ko sɛ sem de ko wɛyuu maama dedɔrem mae daane mo. 17Ka ma daare ka maŋe teo kom kabira kam. Ka ma maŋe de jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi de finna-bena (144) mo. Maleka kam na maŋe-ko tei to ye bedwe mo de nabiinu na mae o jeŋa o maŋe wonnu tei to. 18Ba lɔge kabira kam de kandwɛ-nyeno kolo yere na ye Yasepa to. Ko daare teo kom tete yɔɔre ko ye sabu-seŋa kalo na tiini ka lana fase ne gelaase na ye tei to mo ba mɛ ba lɔ. 19-20Pelwaaro telo teo kom kabira kam na chwi te baŋa ne to mo ba mɛ kandwa-nyenno dwi maama ba ma gɔgere te yera. Pelɔrɔ maama jege ko kandwɛ-nyeno mo, ye te yera mo tento:
1. Jasipa 2. Safira 3. Agate
4. Emeraleda 5. Onika 6. Saadia
7. Kwatiza 8. Bɛrula 9. Topazi
10. Churusopa 11. Yakinta 12. Amɛtesa
21Ko daare kabira kam manchwo-nia fuga-yalei yam tete mo ba mɛ kandwa-nyenno telo yere na ye ‘pɛɛle’ to ba ma ke. Nia yam maama ye pɛɛle dedoa dedoa mo ke da. Teo kom pempale dem maa ye sabu-seŋa kalo na tiini ka lana ne gelaase na nyeene lanyerane tei to.
22Amo nam nɛ we Wɛ diga tera teo kom wone, kolo ŋwaane Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ dedaane Pipeila kam tete mo wora ye nɔɔna zuli-ba teo kom jei maama ne. 23Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom na pae teo kom jege pwooni to, ko daa ba lage se wea kam de chana kam daa taa zeiŋi ko baŋa ne. Pipeila kam de pae ko jege pwooni ne min-zwoŋo na pae pwooni tei to. 24Logo baŋa dwi tiina bam wó taa jege ba ŋwea pwooni dem konto wone. Logo baŋa pwa bam maa wó ja ba jejegero ba ba ba ke teo kom wone. 25Dɛ maama ba bá pe teo kom nia yam, kolo ŋwaane tega daa bá yi jei sem konto ne. 26Ba maa wó kwei logo baŋa dwi tiina jejegero tem de ba nenɔŋa maama ba ja ba ba ke da. 27Ko daare kolo maama na jege digiru to bá zo ko wo. Nɔɔno wolo maama na ke wo-zɔɔna to, de wolo maama na ye vwa-fɔro to bá zo ko wo. Balo yera na popone ya tiŋi Pipeila kam ŋwea tɔnɔ kom wone to yerane mo wó na chwoŋa se ba zo teo kom konto wo.

english_text:
1 The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated. 2 Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
3 God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God 4 and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people. 5 Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever.
The Coming of Christ
6Then I was told:
These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon. 7Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
8My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
9But the angel said,
Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
10Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
11 Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
12 Then I was told:
I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done. 13 I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
14 God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city. 15But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
16 I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
17 The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!”
Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!”
If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
18 Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book:
If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book. 19If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
20The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!”
So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
21I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_text:
Bu-tola kalo na na pae ŋwea to
1Maleka kam ma daare ka bere-ne bu-tola kalo na na pae ŋwea to. Na bam tiini ba nyeena pele-pele ne gelaase na nyeene tei to. Bu-tola kam na bam maa bura ba nwoŋa Wɛ de Pipeila kam paare yituŋu kom seeni ba dura. 2Teo kom pempale dem de bu-tola kam tetare laŋa ne mo tio wora kolo bia na pae ŋwea to. Tio kom konto maa yeini ko leiri bia kuni fuga-belei bene maama wone. Chana maama wone ko leiri bia mo. Ko vɔɔro tem wó wane te pa logo baŋa dwi tiina bam na yazura ba jaweero wone. 3Woŋo kolo maama na wora teo kom ne to, Wɛ sɔla bá taa wo ko baŋa ne. Wɛ de Pipeila kam paare yituŋu kom wó taa wo teo kom ne, ye Wɛ tontoŋena bam zuli‑o dáane. 4Ba wó taa nae o yibia. O yere dem maa wó popone ba tira ne. 5Tega daa bá yi teo kom ne. Ba bá taa lage min-zwonnu se te taa pae pwooni, naa wea de. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam wó taa zeiŋi pwooni ba baŋa ne. Ba wó taa tɔge ba di paare se ko taa vei wuu.
6Maleka kam daa ma ta de amo ka we, “Taane dento maama jege chega ye de maŋe se nɔɔna sɛ-de. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa o zeini o ni-jwoŋina bam se ba taa tɔɔle o kwora kam to mo. Wonto mo toŋe o maleka kam se ka ba ka le wonnu ka bere o tontoŋena bam, se ba lɔre kolo na jege se ko ke leile to.”
Yezu tutuuri dem taane
Yezu tage o we:
7“Nii-na! A bá dáane ye a ba. Wolo maama na sɛ o tɔge Wɛ kwora kalo na popone ka tiŋi tɔnɔ konto ne to jege yu-ywoŋo.”
8Amo Jɔn mo seene a ni wonnu tem konto, ye a kwori a na-te. Ko maama na tu ko ti to, a laam ma kuni dwoona maleka kalo na le wonnu tem ka bere-ne to yiga ne se a zuli-ka. 9Ka ma ta de amo ka we, “Yé ke konto. Amo de ye Wɛ tontoŋeno mo, ne nmo de n nu-bia balo na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to, ko ta woli de balo maama na sɛ ba tɔge kolo na popone tɔnɔ konto wone to de na ye tei to. N maŋe se n zuli Wɛ mo.”
10Ka daa ta ma ta de amo ka we, “Yé kwaane n seigi Wɛ kwora kalo na popone tɔnɔ konto ne to. Maŋa nam yia se wonnu tem konto seene te ke. 11Maŋa daare fenfee yerane mo se nɔɔna leiri ba wo de ba kikia yam.
Wolo maama na ba tɔge chwoŋa to,
kotu taa vei yiga de o tusim dem.
Wolo maama na tɔge wo-zɔɔna kikia to,
o de nam vei yiga de o wo-zɔɔna keim.
Ko daare wolo na yɔɔre o tɔge chwoŋa to,
kotu taa vei yiga de o keim-laaro tem.
Wolo na jege wo-pwoŋo Wɛ ŋwaane to,
kotu daa taa ke Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to mo.”
Yezu tage o we:
12“Nii-na! A bá dáane ye a ba. A ná maa beena, a maa wó taa jege ŋweero a jeŋa ne, ye a kwei-te a pa nɔɔno maama nyɔɔre delo na maŋe de o kikia to.
13Amo mo ye pulim jei de kweelim jeiga.
Amo ta mo ye boboa kam de gurim tu,
dedaane da-yiga tu de tiim tu.”
14Balo na zare ba gwaaro pa te lana fase to jege yu-ywoŋo. Banto jege chwoŋa se ba di tio kolo bia na pae ŋwea to, ye ba kwori ba jege chwoŋa se ba da Wɛ tete teo kom manchwo-nia yam ba zo ko wo. 15Ko daare balo na bá na chwoŋa se ba zo to mo ye nɔn-wo-korro, de liri-mwa tiina, ko woli de balo na bwoori to, de nɔn-gora, de balo na kaane jwona to, dedaane vwa-fɔra balo na swoi se ba taa gane nɔɔna to.
Yezu tage o we:
16“Amo mo toŋe a maleka se ka ba ka ta amo chega kam ka bere abam balo na ye amo kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna to. Amo ye wolo kuri na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to. Amo ye tetete chalechoa kalo yere na ye naŋɔgɔ ye ka tiini ka nyeene to mo.”
17Wɛ Sin-laao kom de ka-dooro wom ma sɛ Yezu ye ba we, “Nam ba.” Wolo maama na nigi kwora kanto to jege se o de ta we, “Nam ba.” Na-nyɔm na jege wolo maama to maŋe se o ba. Wolo maama na lage se o nyɔ na balo na pae ŋwea to jege chwoŋa se o ba o jwoŋi o nyɔ zɛɛra.
18Amo Jɔn nam lage a kaane balo maama na cheigi wonnu telo na popone tɔnɔ konto wone ye te ye Wɛ kwora to. Nmo ná kwei woŋo n woli tɔnɔ konto wonnu tem wone, Wɛ wó pa n na waarem se ko woli de yaara yalo tɔnɔ kom na bere to. 19Nmo nam ná le woŋo tɔnɔ kom wone n yage, Wɛ wó le nmo de yiga o yage, se n yé da n di tio kolo bia na pae ŋwea to, naa n tɔge n zo Wɛ tete teo kom wo, ne tɔnɔ konto na maŋe ko bere tei to.
20Wolo wom na zege wonnu tem konto chega kam kwaga ne to mo tɛ o we: “Ko ye chega mo. A bá dáane ye a ba.”
Ameena. Dé sɛ konto. Dé Teiru Yezu, nam ba!
21Debam Teiru Yezu zaane dem taa wo Wɛ tete nɔɔna bam maama tei ne. Ameena.
